Grand Canyon\n\nThe Grand Canyon is a very big hole in the ground in Arizona. It was made by the Colorado River cutting through rocks for a very long time. The canyon is very deep and wide. Many people visit the Grand Canyon to look at it. You can walk on trails, ride a boat on the river, or fly over it in a helicopter. The north side is called the North Rim and the south side is called the South Rim. People can hike down to the bottom and stay at a place called Phantom Ranch.
South America\n\nSouth America is a big piece of land on Earth. It is south of North America. There are 12 countries in South America. Some of them are Brazil, Argentina, and Peru. The Amazon rain forest is in South America. It is a very wet place where many trees and animals live. Animals like jaguars, monkeys, and toucans live there. The Amazon River is a very long river that runs through the forest. People grow coffee in Brazil. The soil in Argentina is good for growing food. South America also has gold and gemstones.
Japan\n\nJapan is a country made of many islands in the ocean. It is near China and Korea. The biggest island is called Honshu. Tokyo is the biggest city and the capital. Japan has tall mountains and many volcanoes. Mount Fuji is the highest mountain and looks very pretty. Japan has many earthquakes every year. Most people live near the coast. Japanese people eat rice, fish, and vegetables. Sushi is a famous Japanese food made with rice and raw fish. Japan makes cars like Toyota and Honda. It also makes robots. The Japanese flag is white with a red circle in the middle. The circle stands for the sun.
Fern\n\nA fern is a plant that does not have flowers or seeds. Instead, it makes tiny dust-like things called spores to grow new ferns. Ferns have big green leaves that are often shaped like feathers. You can find ferns in shady, wet places like woods and gardens. They like to live where there is a lot of rain and fog. Some ferns are very small, and some can grow as tall as a tree. Long, long ago, there were huge forests of ferns with giant insects.
Juniper\n\nA juniper is a kind of plant that stays green all year. Some junipers are small and close to the ground, and others grow into tall trees. They have special berries that smell nice and can be used as a spice in food. But some juniper berries are not safe to eat, so you have to be careful.
Atlas Mountains\n\nThe Atlas Mountains are a very long chain of big, rocky hills in Africa. They go through three countries: Morocco, Algeria, and Tunisia. The highest mountain in the Atlas is called Toubkal. These mountains stand between the ocean and the big, hot Sahara Desert. Many people live in the Atlas Mountains, and they are called Berbers. The mountains got their name from a giant in old stories named Atlas.
Social network service\n\nA social network service is a place on the computer or phone where people can talk to each other. You can use it to make new friends or talk to friends you already have. Many people use websites like Facebook and Twitter to send messages quickly. You can also use a social network on a phone. People use it to share pictures and stories with each other.
Pompeii\n\nPompeii was a town a long, long time ago. It was near a big mountain called Mount Vesuvius. One day, the mountain blew up and hot ash covered the whole town. The ash buried the houses, the streets, and even the people. That is why we can still see what the town looked like. People who dig in the ground find old walls with writing on them. Before the mountain blew up, Pompeii was a pretty town where people lived and played. Many people from Rome went there on vacation.
Winter\n\nWinter is the coldest time of the year. It is one of the four seasons. Winter comes after autumn and before spring. The days are shorter and the nights are longer. Some animals sleep a lot during winter. Many trees have no leaves. People wear warm clothes like coats and hats. In some places, snow falls from the sky. Many countries have holidays in winter, like Christmas and New Year's Day.
Salad\n\nA salad is a food made from leaves and vegetables. You can put lettuce, spinach, or other green leaves in a bowl. Then you add small pieces of vegetables like tomatoes, cucumbers, or carrots. Some salads have fruit, cheese, or chicken. You can pour a dressing on top, which is made from oil and spices. Salads can be a part of a meal or a whole meal by itself.
Engineering\n\nEngineering is using science and math to make things. People who do engineering are called engineers. They learn how to build things at school. Engineers make computers, buildings, watches, and websites. Some engineers work with machines, and some work with other people. Different kinds of engineers help each other. For example, computer engineers need help from electrical engineers to build a computer. Engineers have to solve problems and work together.
Diffusion\n\nDiffusion is when tiny bits of stuff move from a place where there are lots of them to a place where there are only a few. This happens in water and air. For example, when you put a drop of food coloring in a glass of water, the color spreads out until the whole glass is colored. That is diffusion. It happens because the tiny bits bump into each other and move around. Diffusion does not need any energy to happen. It helps your body get oxygen from the air into your blood.
Leap year\n\nA leap year is a year with one extra day. Most years have 365 days, but a leap year has 366 days. The extra day is added to February, so February has 29 days instead of 28. We have leap years because the Earth takes a little more than 365 days to go around the Sun. Without leap years, the seasons would slowly move to different months. Leap years happen every 4 years. The last leap year was 2024, and the next one is 2028.
Launch vehicle\n\nA launch vehicle is a big rocket that carries things from Earth up into space. It can take things like satellites or people to other places in space. Some launch vehicles can only be used one time, and then they are gone. But some new rockets, like the Falcon 9, can land back on Earth and be used again. The first part of the rocket that falls off can come back down and land. Different rockets are used depending on what they are carrying and where they are going.
Grill (cooking)\n\nA grill is a thing people use to cook food outside. Some grills burn wood or charcoal, and that makes smoke that gives the food a special taste. Other grills use gas. The heat can come from under the food or above it. People often cook meat like steak, burgers, and hot dogs on a grill. Grilling is popular in summer and on holidays like the 4th of July. Sometimes the fire touches the food and makes it taste a little burnt.
Christmas carol\n\nA Christmas carol is a special song about Christmas. People sing these songs at Christmas time or during the days before Christmas. Long ago, people in Europe sang carols at a winter party. Later, people started going from house to house to sing carols and wish their neighbors good health. This is called caroling. Some well-known Christmas carols are "We Wish You a Merry Christmas" and "Here We Come-A-Wassailing." Today, many families sing Christmas carols together during the holiday.
Environmentalism\n\nEnvironmentalism is when people work together to take care of nature. It means helping to keep the air, water, trees, and animals safe from harm.
Aurochs\n\nThe aurochs was a big, wild cow that lived long ago. It was bigger than the cows we see today. Aurochs had long, curved horns that looked like a lyre. The males were black with a pale stripe on their back, and the females were reddish. They lived in Europe, Asia, and North Africa. Aurochs are extinct now, which means there are none left alive. People used to hunt them, and it was very brave to kill one because they were fierce.
Pipe (material)\n\nA pipe is a long, hollow tube that carries water or other liquids from one place to another. Pipes can be made of metal or plastic. They are hard and stay in one place, unlike a garden hose which is soft and bendy. People use pipes in houses to bring water to sinks and toilets. To cut a pipe, a special tool called a pipe cutter is used. For thin plastic pipes, the cutter works like scissors. For thicker pipes, the cutter has a wheel that rolls around the pipe and cuts it.
Physician\n\nA physician is a person who helps sick people get better. They use medicine to fix hurts and illnesses. Doctors ask you questions about how you feel, like if you have a fever or a pain. They listen to your heart with a special tool called a stethoscope. Sometimes they take a little bit of blood or use a machine that takes pictures of your bones. When they know what is wrong, they give you medicine to help you heal. Doctors work in hospitals, clinics, or their own offices. Some doctors help with all kinds of problems, and some only help with one part of the body, like your tummy or your bones. Nurses help doctors take care of you.
Spring (device)\n\nA spring is a metal thing that can be squeezed. When you let go, it goes back to its old shape. Springs are often made of steel. Some springs are made to push, and some are made to pull. You can find springs in many things, like in the back of a car's tailgate. A long time ago, people used springs in door locks and clocks. A man named Robert Hooke found out that a spring pushes back just as hard as you squeeze it.
London Underground\n\nThe London Underground is a train system that runs under the ground in London. It is the oldest underground train system in the world. It started in 1863. Even though it is called "the Underground," about half of the tracks are above the ground. People also call it "the Tube" because some tunnels are round like tubes. The trains use electricity to move. There are 272 stations where you can get on and off. Many people ride the Underground every day. You can pay with a paper ticket or a special card called an Oyster card. You touch the card on a yellow reader to pay. The Underground has long stairs that move, called escalators, and some have lifts for people in wheelchairs. Smoking is not allowed on the trains or in the stations.
Beaver\n\nA beaver is a big animal that lives both in water and on land. It has a flat tail and strong teeth for cutting trees. Beavers build dams in rivers to make ponds. Their dams help slow down water and make homes for other animals. Beavers live in North America and Europe. There are two kinds: the American beaver and the European beaver. Long ago, people hunted beavers for their soft fur to make hats. Now people are helping beavers come back to places where they almost disappeared.
Archipelago\n\nAn archipelago is a group of islands that are close together. Islands are pieces of land with water all around them. Some archipelagos are made by volcanoes under the sea. Big countries like Japan, the Philippines, and Indonesia are archipelagos. The biggest archipelago is in the cold Arctic Ocean near Canada.
Nylon\n\nNylon is a special kind of thread that people make in factories. It is very strong and does not get wet easily. Nylon was first used to make toothbrushes. Now it is used to make many things like clothes, ropes, fishing nets, carpets, and parachutes. Nylon feels smooth and silky. It was invented a long time ago by a man named Wallace Carothers.
History of Japan\n\nThe history of Japan is a very long story about a country made of many islands. A long, long time ago, people started living in Japan after the last big ice age ended. They made pots and tools from stone and clay. Later, people learned to grow rice in wet fields. Different groups of people fought each other for land. Then a queen named Himiko brought many parts together. Over time, Japan had emperors and warriors called samurai. The samurai were very strong fighters. Japan also learned new things from other countries like China and Portugal. They built big cities and wrote books. Today, Japan is a country with many people and old traditions.
Ural Mountains\n\nThe Ural Mountains are a long line of big hills in Russia. They go from the cold Arctic Ocean in the north down to the warm grasslands in the south. These mountains are so long that they help show where Europe and Asia meet. The tallest part is called Mount Narodnaya.
Concrete\n\nConcrete is a strong material used to make buildings, roads, bridges, and many other things. It is made by mixing cement, sand, gravel, and water together. The mixture looks like thick dough at first. After a few hours, it becomes hard like stone. People use concrete more than any other man-made material in the world. Concrete can be used to make sidewalks, pipes, dams, walls, and even boats. It is very strong when you push on it, but it can break if you pull it apart. To make it stronger, steel bars are sometimes put inside. Concrete has been used for a very long time, even by the Romans thousands of years ago. Some concrete can set underwater. Modern concrete can have special things added to make it set faster, change color, or last longer in cold weather.
Green bean\n\nGreen beans are a vegetable that grows on plants. They are long and green, and you can eat them. People buy them fresh, frozen, or in cans. You can cook green beans in many ways, like boiling or frying them. In some places, people eat them with mushrooms and cream. In other places, they are cooked with garlic. But do not eat too many raw green beans, because they can make you sick.
Noh\n\nNoh is a kind of play from Japan that uses music, dancing, and singing. The people in the play wear masks and move very slowly. All the players are men. Even if the story has a woman, a man wears a woman mask to play her part. Some players are the main hero, some are helpers, and some tell the story to the audience. The music comes from drums and a flute. Noh started a long, long time ago, and people still watch it today.
Fortification\n\nA fortification is a strong wall or building that people make to keep safe during a war. Long ago, people built big walls around their towns to protect the people inside. Some fortifications are called forts or castles. They have thick walls and high towers. Soldiers stand on top of the walls to watch for danger. The last big fortification was a long wall built next to the ocean.
Minority group\n\nA minority group is a group of people that is smaller than the biggest group in a place. They might be different in how they look, what they believe, or the language they speak. Sometimes people in a minority group are treated unfairly because they are different. There are rules that say everyone should be treated nicely, even if they are in a minority group.
Cello\n\nThe cello is a big musical instrument that makes a deep, rich sound. It has four strings and is played with a bow. A person who plays the cello is called a cellist. The cello is part of the string family and is used in orchestras and by some pop musicians. To play it, you sit down and hold the cello between your knees. There is a long stick on the bottom that rests on the floor. The cello can play very low notes and also very high notes. Some famous cellists are Yo-Yo Ma and Jacqueline du Pré.
Advertising\n\nAdvertising is how a company tells people about something they want to sell. You see ads on TV, on the radio, in newspapers, and on big signs outside. Ads try to make you want to buy a toy, a snack, or a game. Sometimes ads are funny so you remember them. Long ago, people painted ads on walls. Today, ads are also on websites and buses. Ads help people know about new things to buy.
Animal husbandry\n\nAnimal husbandry is when people take care of animals on farms. People have done this for a very long time. Farmers raise cows for milk and meat. They raise chickens for eggs and meat. They also raise sheep for wool and meat. Some animals help people carry things. Children can learn how to take care of farm animals from their parents or from groups like 4-H. Taking good care of animals means giving them food, water, and a safe place to live.
Apricot\n\nAn apricot is a small, round fruit that grows on a tree. It is like a plum. The fruit has a fuzzy skin that is orange or yellow. Inside, there is a hard pit. Apricots taste sweet and soft. They are good for you because they have vitamin C and potassium. You can eat them fresh or dried.
Light microscope\n\nA light microscope is a tool that makes tiny things look big. You put a small thing on a flat piece of glass called a slide. The slide sits on a flat part called the stage. Light shines up through the slide. The lenses make the tiny thing look much bigger. You look through a tube called the eyepiece. Some microscopes can take pictures of small things. Many school microscopes can make things look 40 times bigger. Some can make things look hundreds or thousands of times bigger.
Greenhouse effect\n\nThe greenhouse effect is when some gases in the air around Earth trap heat from the sun. This keeps our planet warm, like a blanket. Without it, Earth would be very cold and icy. But people have been burning too much gas and coal, which puts extra heat-trapping gas into the air. This makes Earth get hotter, which is called global warming. Too much heat can cause problems for animals and plants.
Dakar\n\nDakar is a big city in Africa. It is the capital of a country called Senegal. Dakar sits next to the ocean, on the west side of Africa. Big ships come to Dakar to pick up things that are sent to other countries. Many people live in Dakar. The leaders of Senegal work in Dakar, in a big building called the Presidential Palace. Long ago, people from far away came to Dakar and built a fort there. Now it is a busy city where people live, work, and play.
Punk rock\n\nPunk rock is a kind of music that is loud and fast. People who like punk rock often want to break the rules. They wear funny clothes and put colors in their hair. Punk rock songs can be angry and talk about things that are not fair. Some punk rockers make their own music without help from big companies. Punk rock started in New York City a long time ago. Bands like The Ramones and The Clash played punk rock. Today, some punk rock bands mix punk with pop music.
Outback\n\nThe outback is a big, empty part of Australia far away from big cities. There are not many roads or farms there. Some people raise sheep or cows on big pieces of land. Other people dig for rocks and minerals or take visitors to see the wild places. Because the outback is so big and far away, a special doctor service called the Flying Doctor helps people who get sick. The doctors talk on the radio or fly in a plane to help. Some people visit the outback for fun, but they must be very careful and bring lots of food and water.
Teacher\n\nA teacher is a person who helps people learn new things. A teacher often works in a classroom with children or grown-ups. Some teachers teach little kids in kindergarten. Other teachers teach big kids in school. Some teachers teach adults in college. Teachers use boards and computers to show you how to read, write, and count. They help you get smarter every day.
Andorra\n\nAndorra is a small country in the mountains of Europe. It is between Spain and France. About 79,000 people live there. The capital city is Andorra la Vella. Andorra has two rulers: a Spanish bishop and the French president. Many people visit Andorra every year because it is a nice place to go on vacation. The people there speak Catalan, Spanish, and French. Andorra does not have an army. France and Spain help keep it safe. Children go to school from age 6 to 16 for free.
Bathroom\n\nA bathroom is a room in a house where people clean themselves. You can find a toilet, a sink, and a bathtub or shower in a bathroom. People use the bathroom to wash their hands, brush their teeth, take a bath, or use the toilet. Some bathrooms have only a toilet and a sink, and those are called half baths. A bathroom can be connected to a bedroom for just that person to use. Long ago, people did not have bathrooms in their homes. They went to special buildings to take baths.
Apollo\n\nApollo is a god from old Greek stories. He is one of the most important gods. He is the god of music, archery, healing, and the sun. Apollo is a young man with no beard, and he is very handsome. He wears a wreath made of laurel leaves on his head. He often plays a stringed instrument called a lyre. His twin sister is Artemis, the goddess of hunting. Apollo was born on a small island called Delos. He killed a big snake called Python with his bow and arrows. Then he built his temple at Delphi. At Delphi, a priestess called the Pythia would tell people about the future. Apollo also loved a nymph named Daphne, but she turned into a laurel tree to get away from him. That is why the laurel tree is one of his symbols. Another symbol is the raven.
Renaissance art\n\nRenaissance art is a kind of art made a long time ago, from about 1400 to 1600. Many of the most famous paintings in the world come from this time. Italy, especially a city called Florence, was where a lot of this art was made. Painters from Belgium also made beautiful pictures. They used oil paints, which made colors look very real. One famous painting from this time shows a woman with a mysterious smile. People still love to look at Renaissance art today.
Honour\n\nHonour is when people think you are a good person who does the right thing. Long ago, knights had rules about how to be brave and fair, and that was called honour. In some places, people would fight to protect their family's good name. Today, honour means doing what is kind and honest, so others can trust you.
Tadpole\n\nA tadpole is a baby frog that lives in the water. It comes from a tiny egg. Tadpoles swim by moving their tails side to side. Most tadpoles eat plants like algae on rocks. Some also eat tiny animals. After a while, tadpoles grow back legs first, then front legs. Then they are called froglets. Froglets grow lungs to breathe air and lose their tails. Their mouths get bigger and their insides change. They grow up to become adult frogs. Some tadpoles turn into frogs in a few weeks, and some take many months.
Icon\n\nAn icon is a special picture that has a religious meaning. It often shows a holy person like Jesus, Mary, or a saint. People in Orthodox Christian churches use icons to help them pray. They think an icon is like a window to see God. Icons are usually painted on a flat piece of wood. The artist makes the picture very carefully so it lasts a long time. Some icons are made of gold or silver. When a candle is lit near an icon, the gold shines and makes the picture look bright. Some people believe that praying in front of an icon can bring help or healing. Other religions, like Hinduism, also use holy pictures and statues.
Togo\n\nTogo is a small country in West Africa. It is next to Ghana, Benin, and Burkina Faso. The capital city is Lomé. About 9 million people live there. Many people speak French. Togo has lots of monkeys, snakes, and lizards. Farmers grow food like coffee, cocoa, cotton, yams, and corn. People also eat peanuts, plantains, and sweet pastries. Togo became its own country in 1960.
Canyon\n\nA canyon is a very big and deep crack in the ground. It is like a giant valley with steep sides. Most canyons are made by rivers that flow for a very long time. The water slowly takes away rocks and dirt, making the crack deeper and wider. Some canyons are made by earthquakes. The Grand Canyon is a very famous big canyon. You can see layers of different colored rocks on the canyon walls.
Lichen\n\nA lichen is a living thing that is made of two different parts working together. One part is a fungus, and the other part is a tiny plant or bacteria that can make food from sunlight. The fungus holds water and protects the tiny plant. The tiny plant makes food for both of them. Lichens can be found almost everywhere: on rocks, walls, trees, and even on the ground. They look like flat patches or little bushes. They can be many colors, like gray, green, orange, or yellow. Lichens do not need much water. They can dry out and then come back to life when it rains. Some lichens grow very slowly and can live for a very long time, even more than 1000 years. Reindeer eat lichens in the winter. People also use lichens to make dyes, medicines, and some foods.
Suffrage\n\nSuffrage is the right to vote. When you grow up, you can vote for who you want to be the leader. A long time ago, not everyone could vote. Some people were not allowed because of their skin color or if they were a boy or a girl. Today, most places let all grown-ups vote. Suffrage also means you can try to become a leader yourself.
Atlanta\n\nAtlanta is a big city in the United States. It is the capital of the state of Georgia. Atlanta is home to many big companies like Coca-Cola and CNN. The city has the busiest airport in the world. Atlanta was built on land that once belonged to Native Americans. During a war long ago, the city was burned down but was built again. That is why Atlanta is sometimes called the Phoenix City, like a bird that rises from ashes. Today, many people live and work in Atlanta.
Coral reef\n\nA coral reef is a big underwater home made of tiny animals called corals. Some corals are alive, and some are old and hard. Coral reefs are very colorful and look beautiful. Many colorful fish and other sea animals live there. People like to swim and look at coral reefs with special masks and tubes. Coral reefs grow in warm, sunny water near the top of the ocean. They are often close to land. Dirt and poison from boats and land can hurt the corals and make them turn white. Ships can also crash into them. Many countries try to protect coral reefs by being careful near them.
Nonprofit organization\n\nA nonprofit organization is a group that does not use its money to make owners rich. Instead, it uses the money to help people or do good things. Some nonprofits give food, clothes, or a place to stay to people who need help. Others help animals or keep the environment clean. Some nonprofits are small, like a neighborhood group. Others are big, like a church or a university. People who work for a nonprofit may get paid, but some are volunteers who work for free. A nonprofit can also be called an NGO when it works on big world problems. Wikipedia is a nonprofit group.
Recorder\n\nA recorder is a musical instrument that looks like a tube with one end bigger than the other. You put the big end in your mouth and blow to make a sound. It is a kind of flute. Long ago, people in Europe played the recorder to sound like bird songs. Famous music writers like Bach and Vivaldi wrote songs for it. Later, people stopped playing it because other instruments were louder. But in the 1900s, people started playing it again. One reason is that it is easy for children to learn. Many schools use plastic recorders to teach music. Recorders come in different sizes, from very small to very big. The smallest ones make high sounds, and the biggest ones make low sounds. People often play recorders together in groups, like duets or orchestras.
So Francisco River\n\nThe So Francisco River is a very long river in Brazil. It is about 3,100 kilometers long, which is like driving a car for many days. Many smaller rivers flow into it. This river is very important for Brazil because it connects different parts of the country, like the warm Southeast and the dry Northeast.
Primate\n\nPrimates are a group of animals that includes monkeys, apes, and humans. Most primates live in forests and have hands with five fingers and flat fingernails. They are covered in fur, but humans have less fur on their bodies. Primates can see many colors, like red and blue. Some primates are small, like lemurs and bush babies, and some are big, like gorillas and chimpanzees. Humans are special because we can talk using words, while other primates make sounds and gestures to communicate.
Old English\n\nOld English is a very old way of talking and writing that people used in England a long, long time ago. It sounds very different from the English we speak today. It is closer to German than to our English. People called Anglo-Saxons spoke it. They came from places that are now Germany and Denmark. Old English has many hard words and tricky rules. Not many people wrote it down at first. Later, some church men wrote it using letters like we use now. A famous story called "Beowulf" was written in Old English. After some new people came to England, Old English slowly changed into Middle English, and then into the English we know today.
Automobile\n\nA car, also called an automobile, is a machine with wheels that people ride in to go places. Most cars have four wheels and can carry up to eight people. Cars run on roads and are smaller than trucks or buses. Cars need energy to move. Many cars use gasoline, which comes from old plants that turned into oil deep underground. Some cars use electricity stored in a battery. Electric cars are cleaner because they do not make dirty smoke. There are also cars that use both gasoline and electricity, called hybrids. Cars have brakes to stop. Electric cars have special brakes that can make electricity when they slow down. People use cars to go to work, school, or on trips. Cars are faster than walking or riding a bike for long distances.
Latitude\n\nLatitude is a way to measure how far north or south a place is on Earth. The equator is a line around the middle of Earth, and it is 0 degrees. Places north of the equator are north latitude, and places south are south latitude. The North Pole is 90 degrees north, and the South Pole is 90 degrees south. People use latitude and another measure called longitude to find any place on Earth.
Fountain\n\nA fountain is a man-made thing that holds water. Water comes from a pipe or a hole and fills a bowl or a basin. Sometimes the water shoots up high into the air like a spray. Some fountains have statues or sculptures. Long ago, people made stone basins to keep water for drinking. Today, you can find drinking fountains in schools, libraries, and parks. You bend down and drink the water right from the stream. Some fountains have a tap that you turn on. They give us clean water to drink.
Soul music\n\nSoul music is a kind of music that mixes fast beats, church singing, and pop songs. It was made in the 1960s in America by black musicians. In soul music, one person sings a line and others answer back. People clap their hands and move their bodies. The singer uses a strong voice. The songs are about love, dancing, and life. Some soul music uses horns and saxophones. Ray Charles made one of the first soul songs. Today, singers like Adele also sing soul music.
Visayas\n\nThe Visayas is a group of islands in the middle of the Philippines. People who live there are called Visayans. The islands are in the middle of the sea, with the Philippine Sea on one side and the Sulu Sea on the other. The big islands are Panay, Negros, Cebu, Bohol, Leyte, and Samar. The Visayas has three parts: Western, Central, and Eastern. Each part has a big city where people go for work and fun.
Fear\n\nFear is a feeling you get when you are scared. When you feel fear, your body wants to run away or fight. Fear can be good because it stops you from doing dangerous things, like jumping off a high place. But fear can also be bad if it stops you from doing something you need to do, like going to the doctor. Some people have a very strong fear called a phobia. You can get over a phobia by facing the thing you are scared of, little by little, until you are not scared anymore.
Ancient history\n\nAncient history is about things that happened a very long time ago, before the Middle Ages. It started when people first learned to write, over 5000 years ago. Writing was a big invention because it let people keep track of what happened. Before writing, we only have old tools and buildings to look at. People who study old things by digging them up are called archaeologists. They find pots, tools, and weapons made long ago. Some old writings tell us stories from that time, but many are lost because they were written by hand and not printed.
Alternative rock\n\nAlternative rock is a kind of music that people play with guitars and drums. It started a long time ago, around 1980. Some bands that play alternative rock are Nirvana, Radiohead, and Coldplay. This music can sound different from other rock music. Some people like to listen to it on the radio or at concerts.
Blood\n\nBlood is a red liquid inside your body. Your heart pushes blood all around your body. Blood brings food and air to every part of you. It also takes away the stuff your body does not need. There are about 5 liters of blood in a grown-up person. Blood has red cells, white cells, and tiny pieces called platelets. Red cells carry air from your lungs to the rest of your body. White cells fight germs that make you sick. Platelets help stop bleeding when you get a cut. Blood is made inside your bones, in a soft part called bone marrow. Your liver helps make the liquid part of blood.
Managua\n\nManagua is a big city in a country called Nicaragua. It is the capital city, which means the leaders of the country live and work there. Managua sits next to a big lake called Lake Managua. The name Managua means "near water" in an old language. Many people live there, and they speak Spanish. The city has had big earthquakes that knocked down old buildings. People in Managua use big statues and monuments to tell each other where places are. Sometimes the statues get knocked down too, so it can be hard for visitors to find their way.
Reproduction\n\nReproduction is how living things make new babies. Some animals need a mommy and a daddy to make a baby. That is called sexual reproduction. Other living things, like tiny germs, can split into two to make a new one all by themselves. That is called asexual reproduction.
Respect\n\nRespect is a good feeling you have for someone or something that is important. It means you think they are special and you care about them. When you listen to your mom or dad, that shows respect. When you say please and thank you, that shows respect too. Respect is treating others the way you want to be treated.
History of astronomy\n\nThe history of astronomy is about how people long ago looked at the sky at night and tried to understand what they saw. Long ago, people in Babylon watched the stars and planets move. They gave names to groups of stars, which we call constellations. They noticed seven bright things that moved: the Sun, the Moon, and five planets. Later, Greek thinkers made models of the universe. Some thought the Earth was the center of everything. But a man named Aristarchus said the Sun is the center and the Earth goes around it. Most people did not believe him. Much later, in 1543, a man named Copernicus said the same thing again. He said the Sun is the center of our solar system. After that, more people started to believe that the Earth goes around the Sun. Over time, scientists learned more about the stars and planets with bigger telescopes.
Algiers\n\nAlgiers is a big city in Africa. It is the capital of a country called Algeria. Algiers sits on the coast, next to the sea. The name Algiers means "The Islands" in Arabic. Long ago, there were four small islands near the city. Now those islands are part of the land. Many people live in Algiers.
Graffiti\n\nGraffiti is drawings or words made on walls or other places outside. People often use paint or spray paint from a can to make graffiti. Sometimes it is a person's name written in a fancy way. Sometimes it is a big picture or a message. Some graffiti is allowed, but other times people make it without asking, which is not allowed. Long ago, people even wrote on walls in ancient Rome. Today, some graffiti artists are very famous.
Horse\n\nA horse is a big, strong animal that eats grass and other plants. People have kept horses for a very long time, over 5000 years. Horses can run fast, up to 30 miles an hour. A boy horse is called a stallion, and a girl horse is called a mare. A baby horse is called a foal. Horses have hard feet called hooves, and sometimes they wear metal shoes to protect them. People use horses for riding, pulling carts, and working on farms. Some horses are pets, and some race in sports. Horses live about 25 to 30 years.
Greater Antilles\n\nThe Greater Antilles are a group of big islands in the warm Caribbean Sea. The four biggest islands are Cuba, Jamaica, Hispaniola, and Puerto Rico. Hispaniola has two countries on it: Haiti and the Dominican Republic. Some smaller islands near them are also part of the group. The Cayman Islands are often included too. These islands are made of hard rock from the ground, not from volcanoes or coral.
Census\n\nA census is a way to count all the people who live in a place. It helps the government know how many people there are and where they live. In some countries, they do a census every 10 years. In other countries, they do it every 5 years. The word census comes from a very old language called Latin.
Crossword\n\nA crossword is a puzzle made of black and white squares. You write words in the white squares, one letter at a time. Each word has a clue that tells you what to write. The clues are next to the grid of squares. Some clues are easy, like "Sheep sound" for "Baa." Some clues are harder and use riddles. Crosswords are in newspapers, magazines, and on the Internet. People solve them for fun.
Court\n\nA court is a place where people go to solve big arguments. Grown-ups called judges listen to both sides and decide what is fair. Some courts decide if someone broke a rule. Other courts decide who gets to keep a toy or where a child should live. The court is inside a special building called a courthouse.
English language\n\nEnglish is a language that people use to talk and write. It started a long time ago in a place called England. Many people speak English today. It is the main language in America, Canada, Britain, Australia, and New Zealand. About 375 million people speak English as their first language. Even more people learn English as a second language to talk with others from different countries. English is used for science, travel, and business all over the world. The words in English come from many other languages like German, French, Latin, and Greek. English has 26 letters in its alphabet. People write English from left to right. Some words in English are spelled the same but sound different, like "through" and "rough." English has many famous stories and plays, like those by William Shakespeare.
Ice skating\n\nIce skating is when you slide on ice with special boots that have metal blades on the bottom. People wear these boots, called ice skates, to glide and spin on ice. Some people do figure skating, where they jump and twirl. Others do speed skating, where they race very fast. Hockey players also wear ice skates to play a game on ice. Ice skating started a long time ago in cold places like Scandinavia and the Netherlands. Today, many people go ice skating for fun at rinks or in shows.
Hotel\n\nA hotel is a big building with many rooms where people can sleep when they are away from home. You can stay in a hotel for one night or many nights. Some hotels have a swimming pool for fun. A motel is a kind of hotel where people who drive cars can park right outside their room. A smaller hotel is sometimes called an inn. Hotels give you a bed, a bathroom, and a place to rest.
Montreal\n\nMontreal is a big city in Canada. It sits on an island in the Saint Lawrence River. Most people there speak French. In the middle of the city is a hill called Mount Royal. Many old buildings are in the Old City, and you can ride in a horse-drawn carriage. Montreal has lots of festivals, like the Montreal Jazz Festival. The circus group Cirque du Soleil is from there. Ice hockey was invented in Montreal, and the city has its own team called the Montreal Canadiens.
Burundi\n\nBurundi is a small country in Africa. The capital city is Gitega. People there speak Kirundi, Swahili, French, and English. About 14 million people live in Burundi. It is one of the poorest countries in the world. Burundi is landlocked, which means it has no ocean next to it. It sits on a big flat land called a plateau. The Nile River starts in Burundi. There are two national parks where animals live.
Influenza\n\nInfluenza is another name for the flu. The flu is a sickness that can make you cough, sneeze, have a fever, and feel very tired. It is caused by tiny germs called viruses. People catch the flu when a sick person coughs or sneezes near them. The flu can be dangerous for little kids and old people. There is no medicine that makes the flu go away, but a doctor can give you medicine to help you feel better. A flu shot can help stop you from getting the flu. The flu changes every year, so you need a new shot each year. Most people get the flu in the winter.
Container\n\nA container is something you can put other things inside. A box is a container. A bag is a container. A jar is a container. A big metal box that goes on a ship or a truck is also a container. People use containers to keep things safe and to move them from one place to another.
Autumn\n\nAutumn is the season after summer and before winter. Some people call it fall. The weather gets colder and windier. Leaves on many trees turn yellow, red, or brown and then fall off. Farmers pick their crops in autumn. Many children start a new school year in autumn. Animals look for extra food to store for winter. The days and nights are the same length in autumn.
Hindustani language\n\nHindustani is a language that people speak in India and Pakistan. It can be written in different ways. One way is called Hindi, and another way is called Urdu. Hindi and Urdu sound almost the same when you talk, but they use different letters. Sometimes people write Hindustani with the same letters we use in English. If one person speaks Hindi and another speaks Urdu, they can understand each other.
Victoria Falls\n\nVictoria Falls is a very big waterfall in Africa. It is on a river called the Zambezi. The waterfall is very tall and very wide. The local name for the falls means "the smoke that thunders" because there is so much mist. In the dry season, the waterfall almost dries up.
Bering Sea\n\nThe Bering Sea is a big part of the ocean near Alaska and Russia. It is very cold and has lots of water. Many animals live there, like whales, seals, walruses, and polar bears. Many birds also live there, like puffins. People catch fish like salmon and crab in the Bering Sea. A long time ago, when the ice age made the sea level lower, people could walk from Asia to North America across a land bridge where the Bering Sea is now.
Lake Vostok\n\nLake Vostok is a big lake under the ice in Antarctica. It is very deep, under 4,000 meters of ice. The water is very cold but stays liquid because the ice pushes down hard. The lake has a lot of oxygen in it, more than most lakes. Scientists think that if any tiny living things live there, they must be very special to handle all that oxygen. This lake is like some icy moons far away in space.
Early childhood education\n\nEarly childhood education is about teaching little kids from when they are babies until they are about eight years old. During this time, children learn many new things like talking, playing with others, and getting ready for school. Teachers and grown-ups help kids learn by reading stories, singing songs, and playing games. This kind of learning started a long time ago in Europe. Different people have different ideas about the best way to teach young children.
Tree\n\nA tree is a very tall plant with a hard trunk and branches. Trees have roots that go into the ground to get water and food. The trunk is the main part, covered with bark to keep it safe. Branches grow out from the trunk, and leaves grow on the branches. Leaves are usually green and help the tree make food from sunlight. Trees can live for many years, some even thousands of years. They give us shade, wood, and clean air. Many animals live in trees. In autumn, some trees lose their leaves, and new leaves grow back in spring.
Mount Kailash\n\nMount Kailash is a tall mountain in Tibet. It is a very special place for many people. Hindus believe it is the home of Lord Shiva and his family. People think no one should climb it, so no one has ever climbed to the top. Every year, people walk around the mountain to show respect.
Hat\n\nA hat is something you wear on your head. There are many kinds of hats. Some hats keep the sun off your face. Other hats keep your head warm in winter. People wear different hats for different jobs. A chef wears a tall white hat. A firefighter wears a hard hat to stay safe. Some hats are just for fun or for dressing up. You can take a hat off when you go inside a house or a school.
Sumo\n\nSumo is a sport from Japan where two big, strong people try to push each other out of a circle. The circle is on the ground and is made of clay. The people who do sumo are called wrestlers. They wear a special belt and try to make the other person fall down or step out of the circle. Sumo tournaments happen many times a year in different cities in Japan. The best wrestlers are called grand champions. Some wrestlers come from other countries too.
Computer science\n\nComputer science is about how computers work and how people tell them what to do. People who study computer science learn to give computers steps, called algorithms, to solve problems. For example, to sort a deck of cards, you can use an algorithm that checks each pair and swaps them if they are in the wrong order. Some algorithms are fast, and some are slow. Computer scientists also ask questions to find easier ways to do things. They use math and logic to make computers help people.
French language\n\nFrench is a language that people speak in France and many other countries. About 220 million people around the world speak French. French uses the same letters as English, but some letters have little marks on them. Some French words look like English words because English took many words from French long ago. For example, the French word for 'yes' is 'oui', which sounds like 'we'. French is a pretty language that many children learn in school.
Freetown\n\nFreetown is a big city in Africa. It is the capital of a country called Sierra Leone. Freetown sits next to the ocean, and big ships come to its port. The city was first built by people who were once slaves and became free. They came from far away to start a new life. Today, many people live and work in Freetown. There is a famous old cotton tree in the city that has been there for a very long time. Freetown also has a big airport, but you have to take a boat or a helicopter to get there from the city.
Humidity\n\nHumidity is how much water is in the air. When the air feels wet and sticky, that is high humidity. When the air feels dry, that is low humidity. Deserts have low humidity, and hot, rainy places have high humidity. High humidity makes it harder for your body to cool down by sweating. Scientists measure humidity with a special tool called a hygrometer.
Trombone\n\nA trombone is a musical instrument made of shiny metal. It looks like a big trumpet but has a long slide that you push and pull to make different sounds. You buzz your lips into the mouthpiece to play it. The trombone can make low, deep sounds and is very loud. It is used in orchestras, bands, and jazz music. A person who plays the trombone is called a trombonist.
Magazine\n\nA magazine is a kind of book that comes out many times each year. Each new copy has different stories and pictures inside. Magazines are printed on paper and often have bright colors on every page. Some magazines come with little gifts for the people who buy them. You can get a magazine by having it sent to your house, or you can buy one at a store. There are magazines about many things, like toys, animals, or cars.
Congo River\n\nThe Congo River is a very big river in Africa. It is the largest river in Africa and the second longest on the continent. The river flows through a huge rain forest, which is the second largest in the world. Many animals and plants live in the forest near the river. The river gets its name from an old kingdom called Kongo. Two countries, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Republic of the Congo, are named after the river. The river starts high in the mountains and from big lakes. It flows west and then bends south, passing by cities like Kinshasa and Brazzaville. At the end, it flows into the ocean. People use the river to move goods like copper, palm oil, sugar, coffee, and cotton on boats. Some parts of the river have waterfalls that stop boats, so trains carry the goods around them. The river also helps make electricity for people to use.
Prehistory\n\nPrehistory is the time before people learned to write. It lasted a very, very long time, from when the Earth was new until people started writing things down. The word "prehistory" means "before history." People did not have books or paper back then, so we do not have any stories written by them. To learn about prehistory, scientists look at old tools, bones, and drawings on cave walls. During prehistory, people lived in groups called tribes. They lived in caves or tents made from animal skins. They used stones and bones to make tools for hunting and cutting. They made fire to cook food and stay warm. They wore clothes made from animal skins. Prehistory ended when people began to write, which happened at different times in different places.
Fictional universe\n\nA fictional universe is a made-up world where stories happen. It is not real, but people pretend it is real when they read books, watch movies, or play games. In a made-up world, things can be different from our world. There might be magic, spaceships, or talking animals. Many stories share the same made-up world. For example, Harry Potter stories all happen in a world with wizards and magic schools. Star Wars stories happen in a galaxy far, far away with spaceships and robots. Made-up worlds can be in the past, the present, or the future. They are inside books and movies, which are inside our real world.
Sauce\n\nA sauce is a liquid mixture you put on food to make it taste better. You do not eat sauce by itself. It adds flavor and makes food look nice. People all over the world use sauces. Some sauces are poured from a bottle, like ketchup on spaghetti. Gravy is a brown sauce you eat with meat. Mayonnaise is a cold sauce. Pesto is a green sauce made with herbs and garlic. Some sauces are sweet and go on desserts, like apple sauce. A cook who makes sauces is called a saucier.
Puzzle\n\nA puzzle is a game that makes you think. You have to look at colors, shapes, or numbers to find the answer. Some puzzles are word searches or crosswords in newspapers. Other puzzles are toys you hold in your hands or games on a computer. Puzzles help your brain get stronger.
Mississippi River\n\nThe Mississippi River is a very long river in the United States. Its name means "big river" in a Native American language. The river starts at a lake in Minnesota and flows south all the way to the Gulf of Mexico. It passes through many states like Minnesota, Wisconsin, Iowa, Illinois, Missouri, Kentucky, Tennessee, Arkansas, and Mississippi. Long ago, big boats called steamboats carried people and things on the river. The river is in a famous book called Huckleberry Finn.
Auditory system\n\nThe auditory system is the part of your body that lets you hear sounds. Your ear is the part that does the hearing. The outside part of your ear is called the pinna. It is made of soft, bendy skin and helps catch sound. Sound goes inside your ear and hits a thin skin called the eardrum. Tiny bones inside your ear help make the sound bigger. Then the sound goes to a part called the cochlea, which is filled with liquid. The cochlea changes the sound into messages for your brain. Your ear also has special loops that help you keep your balance so you do not fall down.
Scaffold\n\nA scaffold is a thing that people build to help them work on tall buildings. It is like a strong frame that you can stand on. Long ago, scaffolds were made of wood or bamboo. Today, many scaffolds are made of metal. Workers use scaffolds to paint walls, fix roofs, or clean windows high up. The scaffold holds them safely so they do not fall.
Bamboo\n\nBamboo is a giant grass that grows very tall and has a hard, wood-like stem. It grows in many warm places like Africa, America, and Asia. Bamboo can grow very fast—sometimes more than one meter in a day! Its stem is hollow and has bumps called joints. Bamboo is used to build houses, bridges, and boats. It is also the main food of giant pandas. People can eat bamboo shoots, but they are usually cooked first.
Taipei\n\nTaipei is a big city in Taiwan. It is the capital city, which means it is the most important city in the country. Many people live there. Taipei has a tall building called Taipei 101. There are also night markets where you can buy food and toys. The city has trains, buses, and airports to help people travel. Taipei has many parks and hot springs. The weather is warm and rainy. Sometimes the air can be a little smoky from cars and scooters.
Defensive wall\n\nA defensive wall is a big, strong wall built to keep a city safe from bad people who might want to hurt it. Long ago, many towns had walls all around them. People could walk on top of the wall to watch for danger. Some walls are very, very long, like the Great Wall of China. These walls show that the people inside are strong and free.
The Starry Night\n\nThe Starry Night is a famous painting of the night sky. It shows a big moon and many bright stars. The sky looks like it is moving with swirls of blue and yellow. A man named Vincent van Gogh painted it a long time ago. He used thick paint to make the stars and moon look very bright. There is a dark tree and a small town below the sky. The painting makes you feel like you are looking up at the stars at night.
Double bass\n\nThe double bass is a very big musical instrument with strings. It looks like a giant violin. People play it in orchestras, jazz bands, and some country bands. It makes low, deep sounds. The double bass is made of wood and has a long neck. It has four thick strings. Players can use a bow to make the strings sing, or they can pluck the strings with their fingers. In jazz, players often pluck the strings. Some players plug their double bass into a big speaker to make it louder. The double bass has many names, like upright bass or bass fiddle.
Biathlon\n\nBiathlon is a sport that has two parts. In winter biathlon, people ski fast on snow and then stop to shoot at targets with a rifle. They have to be good at both skiing and shooting to win. There is also summer biathlon, where people run instead of ski and still shoot at targets.
Lake Albert (Africa)\n\nLake Albert is a big lake in Africa. It sits between two countries: Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The lake is very long and wide. It is one of the biggest lakes in Africa. Water from other lakes flows into it. The water from Lake Albert flows out and becomes a river. There are swamps at one end of the lake. Big mountains stand near the lake. People use boats to travel on the lake. There is oil under the lake that people want to use.
Supergiant\n\nA supergiant is a very, very big star in the sky. It is much bigger than our Sun. Some supergiants are so big that they could fit inside the path of Mercury around the Sun. The biggest ones are even larger than the path of Jupiter. Supergiants are old stars that used to be smaller. When they run out of fuel in the middle, they grow bigger and change color. They can be red, blue, or yellow. Yellow supergiants are the rarest kind. Many of the bright stars you see at night are supergiants. They are easy to spot because they shine so brightly.
Watch\n\nA watch is a small clock that you can wear on your wrist or carry in your pocket. It helps you know what time it is. Some watches have hands that point to numbers, and some show numbers like a little computer. Many people wear a watch every day. A watch can be a pretty thing to wear, like a bracelet. Some watches are very special and cost a lot of money. Nurses wear a watch that hangs from their shirt. Long ago, watches had springs inside to make them work. Now, many watches use a tiny piece of rock called quartz to keep the time very well. There are also smartwatches that can do things like a phone.
Prophecy\n\nA prophecy is a guess about what will happen later. In some religions, people think a prophecy is a message from God. Some prophecies are about big things, like the end of the world or a big storm. They can be hard to understand. Long ago in Greece, people called oracles made prophecies. A famous prophet named Nostradamus lived many years ago. Sometimes people make wrong prophecies. Even smart people like scientists and inventors can be wrong about the future. If you believe something will happen, you might act in a way that makes it happen. That is called a self-fulfilling prophecy.
Science\n\nScience is how we learn about the world around us. Scientists look at things very carefully, measure them, and do experiments to find out how things work. There are many kinds of science. Some science is about animals and plants. Some is about stars and space. Some is about rocks and the ground. Some is about how people think and act. Science helps us understand why things happen and what will happen next. People who do science are called scientists. They use special tools and ask lots of questions. Science has been around for a very long time, and it keeps helping us learn new things every day.
Origami\n\nOrigami is the art of folding paper to make shapes and animals. You start with a flat piece of paper and fold it many times without cutting or using glue. People make paper cranes, boats, and flowers. Some people fold many small pieces and put them together to make big models. Origami started a long time ago in China and Japan. People gave folded paper to friends for good luck. Today, many people all over the world enjoy folding paper.
Line\n\nA line is a path that goes on and on. It has length but no width. A line can be straight or curved. A straight line is the shortest way between two points. A curved line is called a curve, like the edge of a circle. A line segment is a part of a line. Lines are named after points on them.
Peanut\n\nA peanut is a plant that grows small, brown, hard shells with seeds inside. It is not a nut, but a legume, like beans and peas. The peanut plant has yellow flowers that bend down and push into the ground. The peanut grows under the ground, so people also call it a groundnut. The shell has two or three seeds inside. Each seed has two soft, light-colored parts covered by a thin red-brown skin. Peanuts taste buttery and nutty. People eat peanuts as a snack, often roasted and salted. They also make peanut butter by grinding the seeds. Some peanut butter is chunky, and some is creamy. Peanuts are used in candy, cookies, and pies. Farmers in Africa and Asia grow most of the world's peanuts. Peanuts are good for you because they have healthy fats and vitamins.
Amnesia\n\nAmnesia is when a person cannot remember things. It can happen if the brain gets hurt, if someone is very sick, or if something very scary happens. Some people forget things for a little while, and some forget for a long time. There is no medicine that fixes amnesia, but sometimes it gets better on its own.
Organization\n\nAn organization is a group of people who work together. When people work together, they can do more than one person alone. Organizations have leaders to help everyone work as a team. Putting things in the right order is called organizing.
Stethoscope\n\nA stethoscope is a tool that doctors use to listen to your heart and your breathing. It has a long tube that goes to the doctor's ears. The doctor puts the round end on your chest or back. The stethoscope helps the doctor hear the sounds inside your body. The first stethoscope was made a long time ago by a doctor in France. Now, some stethoscopes can even help find heart problems very fast.
Andes\n\nThe Andes are a very long chain of tall mountains in South America. They stretch along the west side of the continent, from the bottom near Argentina and Chile all the way up to Colombia. The Andes are the longest mountain range in the world, and the second highest after the Himalayas. The highest peak is called Aconcagua, which is so tall that snow stays on top all year. Some of the mountains are volcanoes, but most are quiet now. The Andes have different weather in different parts. In the north it is warm and rainy, and rainforests grow there. In the middle it is dry, and in the south it is cold and wet. Many animals live in the Andes, like llamas, alpacas, and the big Andean condor bird. People also live in the mountains and grow potatoes and other food.
Music\n\nMusic is a kind of art that uses sounds put together in a way people like. People make music by singing with their voices or playing instruments like the piano, guitar, drums, or bass. Music often has a beat you can tap your foot to, and it can make you feel happy or want to dance. Long ago, people made music by clapping their hands or hitting stones together. The first musical instrument was probably the human voice. People have been making music for a very long time, even in the stone age.
Roman numerals\n\nRoman numerals are a way of writing numbers using letters. Long ago, people in ancient Rome used them. Today, we still see Roman numerals on some clocks. For example, the big clock called Big Ben has Roman numerals for the hours. The letters I, V, X, L, C, D, and M stand for numbers. I is 1, V is 5, X is 10, L is 50, C is 100, D is 500, and M is 1000. To write a number, you put the letters together. Sometimes a smaller letter before a bigger one means you take away. For instance, IV means 4 because you take 1 from 5. IX means 9 because you take 1 from 10. There is also a special letter for zero, which is N. Roman numerals are not used as much today, but they are still fun to learn.
Latin\n\nLatin is a very old language that people in Ancient Rome used to speak. It was the main language of the Roman Empire a long time ago. Today, no one speaks Latin as their first language, so it is called a 'dead language.' But some people still learn and use Latin. The Catholic Church uses Latin in some of its services. Scientists use Latin to name new plants and animals. Doctors use Latin words for bones and diseases. Many English words come from Latin. Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, and Romanian are languages that grew from Latin. They are called Romance languages.
Nail (anatomy)\n\nA nail is a hard part of the body at the tips of your fingers and toes. Most people have ten nails. Fingernails and toenails are made of the same stuff as hair and skin. Toenails grow much slower than fingernails. Nails never stop growing, so you have to cut them sometimes. It does not hurt to cut nails because they have no nerves. Some people paint their nails to make them look pretty. Sometimes a nail can grow into the skin and hurt, and a doctor can help fix it.
Climatology\n\nClimatology is about learning how the weather is over a long time. It is not about today's weather, but about what the weather is usually like in a place. Long ago, people in Greece started to study this. Knowing about climate helps us guess what the weather might be like soon.
Ape\n\nAn ape is a big animal that lives in Africa and Southeast Asia. Apes are mammals, which means they have hair and drink milk from their mothers when they are babies. Apes do not have tails, but monkeys do. Apes have long arms that can swing from tree to tree. They eat fruits, nuts, seeds, leaves, and sometimes small animals. Apes are very smart and can use tools.
Ocean current\n\nAn ocean current is water in the ocean that keeps moving from one place to another. Wind, how warm or cold the water is, and the moon's pull make the water move. Some currents flow near the top of the ocean, and some flow deep down. They can travel very far, like the Gulf Stream in the Atlantic Ocean. Ocean currents help move warm and cold water around the world.
Lesotho\n\nLesotho is a small country in Africa. It is all surrounded by South Africa. Lesotho has no ocean or big lake. It is very high up with many mountains. People go there to ski in winter. The capital city is called Maseru. About 1,800,000 people live there. Lesotho makes electricity from water and sells some water to South Africa.
Art Deco\n\nArt Deco is a way of making buildings and things look fancy and new. It was used a long time ago, in the 1920s and 1930s. People made tall buildings with straight lines and shiny shapes. Some buildings have pretty pictures on the walls. The Chrysler Building in New York City is an Art Deco building. It has a pointy top that shines. The Golden Gate Bridge also has Art Deco parts on its towers. Art Deco made things look fast and smooth, like a car.
Flag\n\nA flag is a piece of cloth with colors and shapes on it. People put flags on poles to show what group or country they belong to. Flags were first used a long, long time ago in China and in the Roman Empire. The colors and shapes on a flag have special meanings. For example, the flag of Japan has a white cloth with a red circle in the middle. The red circle stands for the sun, and the white stands for being honest and clean. There are many kinds of flags.
Famine\n\nFamine is when many people do not have enough food to eat. When people do not get food, their bodies get weak and they can get very sick. Famine happens most often in poor countries where people grow their own food, like in parts of Africa and Latin America.
Light bulb\n\nA light bulb is a thing that makes light from electricity. It helps you see in the dark. Long ago, people used candles and oil lamps to see at night. Thomas Edison and Joseph Swan made a better light bulb that people could use in their homes. The first kind of light bulb is called an incandescent bulb. It has a thin wire inside that gets very hot and glows bright. But most of the energy it uses turns into heat, not light. Another kind is a fluorescent bulb, which is a glass tube that makes light in a different way and uses less electricity. A newer kind is an LED bulb, which is very good at making light and lasts a long time. Light bulbs are used in houses, streets, and even in space.
Kazakhstan\n\nKazakhstan is a big country in the middle of Asia and a little bit in Europe. It is the biggest country in the world that does not touch any ocean. The capital city is Astana. People there speak Kazakh and Russian. Many people follow the religion of Islam. Long ago, people in Kazakhstan moved around with their animals, especially horses. Today, Kazakhstan has lots of oil, gas, and metals like gold and copper. The Aral Sea near Kazakhstan used to be big but got smaller. Now people are trying to help it come back.
Philadelphia\n\nPhiladelphia is a big city in the United States. It is in the state of Pennsylvania. Long ago, it was the capital of the whole country. Many important things happened there. The Liberty Bell and Independence Hall are in Philadelphia. People can visit them. A famous man named Benjamin Franklin lived there. He started a library and a hospital. He also helped write the Declaration of Independence. The city has many neighborhoods. Some are old and some are new. There are big sports stadiums where people watch baseball and football. The city is near a big river called the Delaware River. Many people live and work in Philadelphia.
Drawing\n\nDrawing is a way to make a picture by putting lines on paper. People draw with pencils, pens, chalk, or charcoal. You can draw things you see, like a house or a cat, or make up your own pictures. Drawing has been around for a very long time, even since people lived in caves. To make a drawing look real, you can add shading. Shading means making some parts darker and some lighter. You can also use hatching, which is drawing many little lines close together. Drawing is fun and you can do it with just a piece of paper and a pencil.
Lake\n\nA lake is a big area of water with land all around it. It is bigger and deeper than a pond. Lakes do not flow like rivers, but rivers can flow into and out of them. Most lakes have fresh water, not salt water. Some lakes are so big that people used to call them seas. Many lakes are made by people to get water for drinking or to make electricity. In very dry places, some lakes have salty water. You can swim, fish, or play near a lake.
Malay Archipelago\n\nThe Malay Archipelago is a big group of islands between Asia and Australia. It has more than 25,000 islands. Some of the islands are Indonesia, the Philippines, Singapore, and Brunei. The islands are in the Indian and Pacific Oceans. There are many mountains and volcanoes there. Some animals live on one side of the islands and different animals live on the other side. A man named Alfred Russel Wallace studied the animals there for eight years.
Revolution\n\nA revolution is a big change in a country. Sometimes people are not happy with how things are. They get together and try to make things different. Sometimes there is fighting, but sometimes there is not. The French Revolution was a time of big change in France long ago.
Yekaterinburg\n\nYekaterinburg is a big city in Russia. It sits in the Ural mountains, which is the part of Russia that is in Asia. Many people live there. The city was started a long time ago, in 1723. It was named after a queen called Catherine. Yekaterinburg has sister cities, which are other cities that are friends with it.
Flower\n\nA flower is the pretty, colorful part of a plant. Flowers have soft petals that can be many colors like red, yellow, pink, or white. Some flowers smell very nice. Flowers grow in gardens, parks, and even in cold places like the Arctic. People like to look at flowers and give them as gifts. Some flowers can be eaten, like broccoli and cauliflower. Bees visit flowers to make honey. Flowers help plants make seeds so new plants can grow.
Canal\n\nA canal is a water path that people dig in the ground. It is like a long, straight river that people make. Boats and barges can travel on canals to move heavy things from one place to another. Some canals connect big lakes or oceans. The Panama Canal is a famous canal that lets boats go from one ocean to another. Canals often have walls made of clay or concrete to keep the water in. Some canals have locks that help boats go up or down. Other canals bring water to farms to help plants grow.
Folk music\n\nFolk music is music that people make and share in a place or country. It is old music that children learn by hearing others sing or play it, not from a book. Every country has its own folk music. People sing folk songs when they work, play, or rest together. Some folk songs tell a story about love or make-believe. People also play folk music for dancing with simple instruments like drums, sticks, or a fiddle. Folk music is for everyone to enjoy, not just for special musicians.
Library of Congress\n\nThe Library of Congress is a big building in the United States that holds more books than any other library in the world. It has millions of books, pictures, maps, and papers. The library helps the people who make laws in the country. Anyone can go there to read and learn. The person in charge is called the Librarian of Congress.
Tibetan Plateau\n\nThe Tibetan Plateau is a very big, flat, and high place on Earth. It is the biggest flat high place in the world. It is so high that it is called the "roof of the world." The plateau is in China and near other countries like Nepal and India. It was made when big pieces of the ground pushed together a long time ago. This high land helps make the rain that falls in some parts of Asia.
Stick insect\n\nA stick insect is a bug that looks just like a stick or a leaf. It hides from animals that want to eat it by staying very still and looking like a part of a plant. Some stick insects are very long, even longer than a ruler. They eat leaves from trees and bushes. When they walk, they rock back and forth like a twig blowing in the wind. Some stick insects can spray a smelly liquid to keep enemies away. They live in warm places all over the world, especially in forests.
Cameroon\n\nCameroon is a country in Africa. It is in the middle part of Africa, near the Atlantic Ocean. The biggest city is Douala. The capital city is Yaound. Many people live there. People speak French and English in Cameroon. They also speak many other languages. Long ago, Germany ruled Cameroon, then France and Britain ruled parts of it. Now Cameroon is its own country.
Afterlife\n\nThe afterlife is what some people think happens after a person dies. Different people have different ideas about it. Some people believe you come back to life as a different person or animal. Others believe you go to a happy place or a sad place. Some people think there is no afterlife, and you just stop being alive. No one knows for sure what happens after death.
Silk\n\nSilk is a soft, strong thread that comes from a little animal called a silkworm. The silkworm makes a cozy house called a cocoon out of silk. People take the silk from the cocoon and weave it into cloth. This cloth can be made into pretty dresses, soft blankets, and even rugs. Long ago, only people in China knew how to make silk. They kept it a secret for a very long time. Silk was so special that people traveled far to buy it. Today, silk is still used to make beautiful things.
Marble (toy)\n\nA marble is a small, round toy. It can be made of glass, clay, steel, or plastic. Marbles come in many colors and sizes. Some are as small as a pea, and some are as big as a ball. You can play games with marbles by rolling them on the floor. People also like to collect marbles because they are pretty. You can build a track for marbles to roll down, called a marble run.
Poseidon\n\nPoseidon is a god from old stories. He is the god of the sea, storms, and horses. He lives in the water and can make big waves and earthquakes when he is angry. He carries a three-pronged spear called a trident. Sailors ask him for safe trips across the ocean. He is also called the Father of Horses because people say he made them. His special animals are the bull, the horse, and the dolphin.
Norse mythology\n\nNorse mythology is a set of old stories from people who lived in Scandinavia, a cold place in the north of Europe. These stories tell about gods, giants, and other magical beings. The gods lived in a place called Asgard, which you could reach by walking on a rainbow bridge. There were also giants who lived in a land of ice or a land of fire. The world where people live is called Midgard. Some of the names of the days of the week, like Tuesday and Wednesday, come from these old stories. Many books and movies today have elves, dwarves, and giants that come from Norse mythology.
Hong Kong\n\nHong Kong is a big city in China. It is a special place with its own rules. Many people live there, over seven million. Hong Kong has very tall buildings, more than any other city in the world. The weather is warm and rainy in summer, and cool in winter. Sometimes big storms called typhoons come. People in Hong Kong speak Cantonese, and they also learn English in school. The city used to be part of Britain, but now it is part of China. Hong Kong is a rich place where many people work with money.
Bullfrog\n\nA bullfrog is a big frog that lives near water. It is green or brown with dark spots and has webbed feet for swimming. Bullfrogs live in ponds, lakes, and swamps in North America. They eat bugs, fish, mice, and even other frogs. Male bullfrogs make a loud roar sound when they want a mate. That is why they are called bullfrogs. A female bullfrog can lay up to 20,000 eggs in the water. The eggs hatch into tadpoles that swim and eat plants. Tadpoles take a long time to grow into frogs. Bullfrogs can jump far and have strong back legs. They hide during the day and hunt at night. Some people keep bullfrogs as pets and feed them crickets and worms. Bullfrogs can live for many years in a safe home.
Diesel engine\n\nA diesel engine is a kind of engine that makes things move. It was invented by a man named Rudolf Diesel a long time ago. This engine does not use a spark to start. Instead, it squeezes air and fuel very hard until they get hot and explode. That explosion makes power. Diesel engines are very strong and use fuel well. They are used in big trucks, trains, and construction machines. Some diesel engines have a part called a turbocharger that pushes more air into the engine to make it even stronger. You can hear a whistling sound from the turbocharger. Some diesel engines can run on oil made from old cooking oil, which is called biodiesel.
Los Angeles\n\nLos Angeles is a big city in California, in the United States. It is the second biggest city in the country after New York. Many people live there, over 18 million in the area. The city is known for making movies and TV shows in a place called Hollywood. Many movie stars live there. Los Angeles has long beaches like Venice Beach. You can see the Hollywood Sign on a hill. The weather is warm and dry in summer, and a little cold and rainy in winter. Snow is very rare. The city has many people from different places, like Mexico, Japan, Korea, and many others. People eat a lot of Mexican food there. Los Angeles also has a big port where ships bring things from far away. The name Los Angeles means 'The Angels' in Spanish.
Pacific Ocean\n\nThe Pacific Ocean is the biggest ocean on Earth. It covers one third of the whole world. The ocean is between Asia and Australia on one side and the Americas on the other side. The Pacific Ocean is slowly getting smaller. The ground under the ocean folds and pushes down. This bumping makes many earthquakes and volcanoes. When an earthquake happens under the sea, it can make a big wave called a tsunami. Many volcanoes are islands in the Pacific Ocean or near its edge.
Granary\n\nA granary is a building on a farm that holds grain. Grain is the seeds from plants like wheat or corn that people use to make food. The granary keeps the grain dry so it does not get bad. It also keeps animals like mice away from the grain. Granaries are very old. People made them more than 11,000 years ago. A granary has few windows. It is built off the ground so water and mice cannot get in. There is a door near the bottom to take grain out and an opening up high to put grain in.
Gas\n\nA gas is one of the main kinds of stuff, like solids and liquids. Gases do not have a shape of their own. They spread out to fill any space they are in. You cannot see most gases, but you can feel them. The air you breathe is a gas. Gases can be squeezed into a smaller space. They are very light. Gas particles move around fast and bump into things. This bumping makes pressure. When a gas gets cold, it can turn into a liquid. When a liquid gets hot, it can turn into a gas. Some gases are made of one kind of atom, like oxygen. Some are made of different atoms together, like carbon dioxide. Air is a mix of many gases.
