Orange (color)\n\nOrange is a color. It is made by mixing red and yellow together. The color orange is named after the orange fruit. Before people in England knew about the orange fruit, they called this color 'yellow-red'. Orange is a bright and warm color. You can see it in pumpkins, carrots, and the setting sun.
Warsaw\n\nWarsaw is a big city and the capital of Poland. It is the biggest city in that country. About two million people live there. Warsaw sits on a river called the Vistula. The city has many schools, theaters, and art galleries. Long ago, in the 13th century, people started living there. By the 15th century it became a city. It became the capital of Poland in 1596. Warsaw was broken many times, but people always built it again. One famous place is the Palace of Culture and Science. Another is a palace in Wilanów where a king once lived. Many people visit the Museum of the Warsaw Uprising.
North Korea\n\nNorth Korea is a country in East Asia, next to China, Russia, and South Korea. The capital city is Pyongyang. North Korea is a place where the leader is very powerful and people must follow many rules. The country was split from South Korea after a war, and they are still separated by a special line called the DMZ. North Korea has made big rockets that can fly very far, and other countries worry about them. Life in North Korea is hard for many people because there is not enough food and the country is very closed off from the rest of the world.
Belt\n\nA belt is a strip of cloth or leather that you wear around your waist. It helps hold up pants or skirts. Belts have a buckle and holes to make them tighter or looser. Many belts are black or brown. Some people, like police officers, wear belts with pockets to carry things. Cowboys also wear belts with special buckles.
Special effect\n\nSpecial effects are tricks that movies use to show things that are not real. They can make little models of big things like a ship and blow it up. That is safer and cheaper than using a real ship. Movies about space or monsters often use computers to make pictures of things that do not exist, like three suns in the sky. These computer pictures are called CGI.
Happiness\n\nHappiness is a good feeling inside you. When you feel happy, you might smile, laugh, or feel excited. You can feel happy when you play with your friends, get a hug, or eat your favorite food. Happiness is the opposite of sadness, but sometimes you can feel both at the same time. No one is happy all the time, and that is okay. When you are very happy, you might even cry a little because the feeling is so big.
Chard\n\nChard is a green vegetable that you can eat. It has big green leaves and thick stems that can be white, red, or yellow. Chard is in the same plant family as spinach. You can cook chard or eat it raw in a salad. It tastes a little bit like spinach.
Pension\n\nA pension is money that someone gets every month after they stop working. People who are very old or cannot work anymore get a pension. The money comes from the place where they used to work or from the government. A pension helps people buy food and pay for a home when they are not working anymore.
Hinduism\n\nHinduism is a way of life and a religion that started in India. Many people around the world follow Hinduism. It is one of the oldest religions. Hindus believe in doing good things, being honest, and helping others. They also believe that every action has a result, called karma. Hindus celebrate many festivals and visit special places called temples. They have many holy books, like the Vedas and the Ramayana. Some Hindus believe in many gods, and some believe in one god. Hinduism teaches people to be kind to animals and to live a good life.
Wire\n\nWire is a long, thin piece of metal that can bend. Wires are made from different metals like copper or aluminum. Some wires carry electricity to lights and toys. The outside of electric wires has a colored cover to keep you safe. If you touch the metal part with electricity, it can hurt you. Wires help make many things work, like TVs and computers.
Tian Shan\n\nThe Tian Shan is a very big group of mountains in the middle of Asia. The highest mountain in this group is called Jengish Chokusu. Some parts of these mountains are special places that people all over the world want to keep safe. The mountains sit along the edge of China and Kyrgyzstan. Long ago, people walked next to these mountains on a road called the Silk Road to travel from one side of Asia to the other.
Cart\n\nA cart is a thing with two wheels that can carry things. Long ago, a horse or a donkey would pull a cart. Sometimes a person would push or pull a cart by hand. People have used carts for a very long time. Today, you see shopping carts at the grocery store. A shopping cart is a metal basket on wheels that you push around the store to hold your food and other things.
Lentil\n\nA lentil is a tiny, round seed that grows inside a pod on a small plant. The plant is about as tall as a ruler. Lentils come in many colors like yellow, red, green, brown, and black. People have been eating lentils for a very long time, even before they had pots to cook in. Lentils are good for you because they have lots of protein and iron. They do not need to cook for very long. You can eat them in soup or with rice. In India, many people eat lentils because they are healthy and taste good.
Ritual\n\nA ritual is a set of actions people do in a special way. Each action in a ritual means something. Rituals can be part of a religion or a tradition. They can mark a big change in a person's life, like when a child grows up. After a ritual, people often celebrate. Some rituals are done to show that a person belongs to a group.
Canary Islands\n\nThe Canary Islands are a group of islands in the ocean near Africa. They belong to Spain. There are seven big islands: La Palma, La Gomera, El Hierro, Tenerife, Gran Canaria, Lanzarote, and Fuerteventura. The islands were made by volcanoes a long time ago. Tenerife has a very tall mountain called Teide, which is a volcano that has not erupted for more than 300 years. The weather is warm and sunny, so many people go there to visit the beaches. Farmers grow yummy fruits like bananas and papayas. On the island of La Gomera, children learn a special way to talk by whistling. A long time ago, people called Guanches lived there first. Then people from Spain came and took over the islands.
Longevity\n\nLongevity means living a very long time. Some people live longer than others. Scientists study how to help people live longer. Long ago, people told stories about living for hundreds of years. Some stories said there was a special fountain that could make you young again. Today, people in rich countries often live to be 80 or 90 years old. In the future, people might live even longer.
Kale\n\nKale is a vegetable with green or purple leaves. It is a kind of cabbage. Kale has big curly leaves that are not round. It can grow in very cold weather, even when it is freezing outside. People in Scotland, Germany, and other cold places used to eat kale in winter. Now people all over the world eat it. Kale is very good for you. It has lots of vitamins that help your body stay strong. You can cook kale in soup or stew, or put it in a salad. Some people like to eat it with cheese or mashed potatoes. When you buy kale, pick leaves that are firm and bright. Wash the leaves well before you eat them. You can keep kale in the fridge for a few days.
Star formation\n\nStar formation is how new stars are born. It starts in big, dark clouds in space called 'stellar nurseries'. These clouds are made of gas and dust. The gas and dust clump together and get pulled by gravity into a ball. The ball gets very hot and starts to glow. That is a new star. Some stars are born in places called Bok globules, which are small, dark clouds. The Orion nebula is a place where big stars are being born. Astronomers can watch stars form by using special telescopes.
Sailing\n\nSailing is moving a boat by using the wind. The wind pushes the boat's big cloth, called a sail, and the boat goes forward. Long ago, people used sailing boats to carry things and people across water. Now, most boats use engines, but some people still sail for fun. Sailing is also a sport, and it is in the Olympic Games.
Sea of Azov\n\nThe Sea of Azov is a big body of water that is very shallow. It is the shallowest sea in the whole world. The sea touches Ukraine on one side and Russia on the other side. A river called the Don flows into it. Some cities near the sea are Berdjansk, Mariupol, Taganrog, and Jeisk. People live in these cities and use the sea for fishing and boats.
Unicorn\n\nA unicorn is a make-believe animal that looks like a small horse. It has one long, white horn on its head. In stories, unicorns are very shy and hard to catch. People say only a kind girl can get close to a unicorn. The unicorn is the special animal of Scotland.
Dadaism\n\nDadaism is a way of making art that started a long time ago, around the time of a big war. The artists who did Dadaism did not like war or the way people lived. They made art that was silly and strange on purpose. They wanted to show that anything could be art if someone said it was. They used things like cut-up paper, sounds, and funny words. Dadaism began in a place called Zurich and later moved to Paris. The name "Dada" might come from a baby's first sounds or from a toy horse. Dadaism helped other kinds of art later, like pop art and punk rock.
Cat\n\nA cat is a small animal with soft fur. People keep cats at home as pets. Cats live in many countries all over the world. They can be black, white, gray, orange, or many other colors. A cat has four legs, a long tail, two pointy ears, and small sharp claws. Cats sleep for many hours every day. They like to play at night and run very fast. When a cat is happy, it makes a soft humming sound called a purr. A cat can also meow when it wants food or wants to be near you. A baby cat is called a kitten, and kittens are very small and cute. Some cats like to hunt little mice or birds in the garden. Many children love to pet a cat because the fur feels warm and soft.
New Zealand\n\nNew Zealand is a country made of two big islands and many small ones. It is in the Pacific Ocean, far away from most other places. The capital city is Wellington, and the biggest city is Auckland. People in New Zealand often call themselves Kiwis, after a bird that cannot fly. The country has many special birds and animals that live only there. Before people came, there were no land mammals except bats. New Zealand has volcanoes and earthquakes because it sits where two big pieces of the Earth's crust meet.
Madrid\n\nMadrid is a big city in Spain. It is the capital, which means the king lives there and the government meets there. More than 3 million people live in Madrid. It is high up in the mountains, so it is cool in winter and sometimes snows. Summer is hot and dry. Madrid has many old buildings, like the Royal Palace and the Prado Museum. There are also big parks, like the Retiro Park. People in Madrid love football, and there are four big football teams. The city has a long history, with many different people living there long ago.
Fruit preserves\n\nFruit preserves are a way to keep fruit good to eat for a long time. People mix fruit with sugar and boil it. Then they put the hot mix into glass jars. When it cools, the jar seals tight. This keeps the fruit fresh. You can spread it on bread. Jams, jellies, and marmalade are kinds of fruit preserves.
Subsistence farming\n\nSubsistence farming is when a farmer grows food only for their own family to eat. They do not grow extra food to sell. The farmer has a small piece of land or not much water. If the weather is bad, there is less food and the family may go hungry. This kind of farming happens in many poor villages around the world. Some farmers move from place to place with their animals to find grass. It is hard work, but it helps the family have food to eat.
Chopsticks\n\nChopsticks are two long, thin sticks that people use to pick up food and eat. They are made of wood, bamboo, or plastic. Many people in China, Japan, Korea, and other Asian countries use chopsticks every day. You hold both sticks in one hand and move them like tweezers to grab food. Chopsticks are also used in cooking to stir food in a pan. Some chopsticks are used only once and then thrown away, but that makes a lot of trash. That is why some people now use chopsticks many times.
Golden eagle\n\nA golden eagle is a very big bird that hunts other animals. It has sharp claws on its feet to catch food like rabbits and squirrels. Golden eagles live in many places around the world, like North America, Europe, and parts of Africa. They are one of the biggest birds that hunt in North America. Only the California condor is bigger. Golden eagles also live in the Scottish Highlands.
Space exploration\n\nSpace exploration is when people send rockets and machines to outer space. People want to learn more about space. Long ago, people could only dream of going to space. Then rockets were made that could fly up high. The first satellite was Sputnik 1, sent up in 1957. Later, people went into space and some even walked on the Moon. Machines have gone to many planets to send back pictures and information. Before people went to space, animals were sent first to see if it was safe. The first person in space was Yuri Gagarin in 1961. Space is very big and has many stars and planets.
Mountain pass\n\nA mountain pass is a path that goes between two mountains. It looks like a saddle, with higher ground on each side. People use passes to cross from one side of a mountain to the other. Long ago, people walked through passes to trade goods or move to new places. Today, roads and train tracks often go through passes. Some passes have tunnels under them so cars can go faster. The top of a pass is flat, so people sometimes build houses or shops there. Famous passes include the Khyber Pass and the Great St Bernard Pass.
Raven\n\nA raven is a big black bird. It looks like a crow but is bigger. Its feathers are all black. A raven can be very smart. Some people think it is a trickster bird. A famous story has a raven in it.
Pulley\n\nA pulley is a simple machine that helps lift heavy things. It has a wheel with a rope around it. When you pull the rope down, the heavy thing goes up. A pulley makes it easier to lift big boxes or toys. Some pulleys work together in a set called a block and tackle. You can find pulleys in elevators and at building sites.
Mutton\n\nMutton is meat that comes from a grown-up sheep. A baby sheep is called a lamb, and its meat is called lamb. When the sheep gets older, its meat is called mutton. Mutton tastes stronger than lamb. People cook mutton and eat it for dinner.
Mesa\n\nA mesa is a hill or mountain that looks like a big table. The top is flat and the sides are steep. People sometimes call it a "table mountain." Mesas are found in Spain, Africa, and some parts of the United States.
Ash tree\n\nAn ash tree is a tall tree that grows in many parts of the world. Its leaves are light green and oval-shaped, with many small leaflets. The seeds look like little keys and are called samaras. Ash wood is strong and is used to make baseball bats, bows, and tool handles. In old stories, the first man was made from an ash tree. Some ash trees are in danger because of a small bug called the emerald ash borer and a sickness called ash dieback.
Genetics\n\nGenetics is about how living things get traits from their mom and dad. It is like a science that studies why you look like your parents. Inside your body are tiny things called cells. Each cell has a long string called DNA. DNA holds the instructions for how your body grows. Small parts of DNA are called genes. Genes tell your body what color your eyes will be or how tall you will grow. You get one set of genes from your mom and one from your dad. Sometimes a gene is strong and shows up, like brown eyes. Other times a gene is quiet and hides, like blue eyes. A long time ago, a man named Gregor Mendel learned about genes by growing pea plants. He saw that tall plants had tall babies and short plants had short babies. His work helped us understand how traits pass from parents to children.
Rodent\n\nA rodent is a small animal with teeth that keep growing all the time. Rodents have to chew on hard things to keep their teeth short and sharp. Mice, rats, chipmunks, and squirrels are rodents. Some people keep hamsters, guinea pigs, and gerbils as pets. Bigger rodents are porcupines, beavers, and capybaras. Rabbits and hares look like rodents but they are not. Almost half of all mammal animals are rodents.
Lawsuit\n\nA lawsuit is when two people or groups ask a judge to help fix a problem. The person who starts the lawsuit is called the plaintiff. The other person is called the defendant. Each side has a lawyer who talks to the judge for them. Both sides show proof and ask questions to witnesses. Then the judge decides who is right. The judge may make the loser pay money or stop doing something.
Ambulance\n\nAn ambulance is a special car that helps sick or hurt people. It takes them to the hospital. Ambulances have flashing lights and a loud siren to tell other cars to move out of the way. Inside, there is a bed for the person to lie down. A doctor or a helper rides in the back to take care of the person. People call an ambulance by dialing 911 in the United States or 999 in the United Kingdom. Some ambulances are helicopters that fly very fast to reach people in faraway places.
Wu Chinese\n\nWu Chinese is a way of talking that people use around Shanghai in China. It is a group of many different ways of talking, and they can be very different from each other. Some important people spoke Wu Chinese a long time ago. People who study languages call it Wu. But now, more people are starting to speak Mandarin instead of Wu.
Judiciary\n\nThe judiciary is a group of people who help make fair decisions when there is a problem. They work in special buildings called courts. The people in the judiciary are called judges. Judges listen to both sides of a story and then decide what is right. In the United States, the highest court is called the Supreme Court. Each state also has its own courts. The judiciary is one part of the government, and it helps make sure everyone follows the rules.
Karma\n\nKarma is a word that means what you do comes back to you. If you are kind, good things may happen to you. If you are mean, bad things may happen to you. It is like a rule that says your actions have results. Many people believe in karma. It helps you learn to be a better person.
Portrait\n\nA portrait is a picture of a person's face. It can be a painting or a photograph. The person in a portrait looks right at the person making the picture. A portrait shows how the person looks and feels. The person sits very still so the picture comes out clear.
Brown rat\n\nThe brown rat is a big rodent with brown or gray fur. It has a long body and a tail that is a little shorter. Brown rats live in many places around the world, except in very cold places like Antarctica. They like to live near people, especially in cities and towns. Some people think brown rats caused a sickness called the plague, but that is not true. The sickness is spread by fleas on other animals like ground squirrels.
Great Sphinx\n\nThe Great Sphinx is a very big stone statue in Egypt. It has a human head and a lion's body. The statue is 200 feet long and 65 feet tall. That is as long as a big swimming pool and as tall as a house. The Sphinx sits near the pyramids in a place called Giza. It is very old, built by people long ago. No one knows exactly why it was made. Some people think it was a guard. The Sphinx is getting worn down by wind, rain, and city air. People are working to keep it safe.
Visual system\n\nThe visual system is the part of your body that helps you see. It takes light from the world around you and turns it into pictures in your brain. Your eyes are like little cameras that catch the light. Then your brain figures out what you are looking at. Different animals see different colors. For example, bees can see colors that people cannot see.
Inference\n\nInference is when you know something and then figure out something else from it. For example, if you see wet ground, you can guess that it rained. It is like being a little detective and using what you already know to learn new things.
Japanese mythology\n\nJapanese mythology is a set of old stories from Japan. These stories are about gods and spirits that live in nature. Some stories tell about the sun goddess and how the emperor of Japan came from her. The stories come from very old books that people wrote long ago.
Social order\n\nSocial order is how people live together in a nice way. It means a group of people follow rules so everyone can be safe and happy. Long ago, people lived in different ways, like with kings and queens. When people follow the rules, there is no fighting or trouble. Some smart people thought about why we need rules and how we agree to follow them.
David\n\nDavid was a king of Israel a long time ago. He is in the Old Testament of the Bible. When David was a boy, he took care of sheep. He used a sling to throw stones and keep wild animals away from the sheep. He also played a harp and wrote songs. Many of his songs are in the book of Psalms. David fought a big giant named Goliath. Goliath was very tall and strong, but David hit him with a stone from his sling and won. Later, David became king. He was the father of King Solomon. People still remember David today.
Chicago\n\nChicago is a big city in the middle of the United States. It sits next to a huge lake called Lake Michigan. Many people live there, more than two million. Chicago has very tall buildings called skyscrapers. The first skyscraper in the world was built there in 1885. The city is known for deep-dish pizza and hot dogs with lots of toppings. You can see a big park by the lake called Millennium Park. There is also a long pier called Navy Pier where you can ride a big Ferris wheel. Many airplanes fly in and out of O'Hare Airport, one of the busiest in the world. Chicago has lots of museums, like the Art Institute and the Museum of Science and Industry. People visit from all over to see the city.
Radio\n\nRadio is a way to send sounds and messages through the air without wires. A special machine sends out radio waves, and another machine catches them. You can listen to music and news on a radio. People also use radios to talk to each other, like police officers and firefighters. Some radios are small and you can carry them around. Cars have radios too. Radio waves can go a long way, even around the world.
Human\n\nA human is a person. Humans are animals that walk on two legs. They have a big brain that helps them think, talk, and feel. Humans live in groups and help each other. They take care of their children for a long time. Humans use tools and make things like houses, clothes, and toys. They can make fire and cook food. Humans live all over the world. There are more than 8 billion humans on Earth. Humans come in many colors and sizes. They speak different languages and have different customs. Humans like to learn new things and make art and music.
Web design\n\nWeb design is when someone makes a web page or a website. A web page can have pictures, music, and moving parts. Some web pages are for stores, and some are for people. Web designers use special computer words to build pages. They pick colors, letters, and pictures to make the page look nice. A good web page helps people find what they need easily.
Megabat\n\nA megabat is a big kind of bat that eats fruit. These bats are also called flying foxes. They live in forests in Africa, Europe, Australia, and Asia. Megabats sleep during the day hanging upside down from their feet. At night they fly around to find food. They eat fruit juice and flower nectar. They use their nose to smell where the food is. Megabats help plants grow by spreading seeds and pollen. Some megabats can carry germs that make people sick, but that is very rare.
Multiculturalism\n\nMulticulturalism is when many different kinds of people live together in one place. These people may have different ways of eating, talking, or celebrating. In a multicultural place, no one way is the only way. Everyone's way is treated with kindness. This happens when people move from faraway countries to a new country. It is good to be nice to people who are different from you. When people from different backgrounds work and play together, they learn about each other's fun traditions.
Roller skating\n\nRoller skating is a fun activity where you wear special shoes with wheels on the bottom. You can roll around on flat ground like a sidewalk or a skating rink. Some people play games on roller skates, like roller hockey or roller derby. Others dance to music while skating. The wheels on the skates are set up so you can turn easily. Roller skating makes you feel fast and happy.
Scientist\n\nA scientist is a person who studies how the world works. Scientists ask questions and do experiments to find answers. They work in labs for schools, companies, or the government. Some scientists teach at schools and help other people become scientists. Scientists use special steps to test their ideas. There are many kinds of scientists, like ones who study animals, plants, or space.
Prose\n\nProse is the way we talk and write every day. It is not like a poem with rhyming words. Prose looks like a bunch of sentences put together in paragraphs. You see prose in storybooks, letters, and newspapers. It does not have a special beat or rhythm. Prose is just plain talking and writing.
Syllable\n\nA syllable is a part of a word that you say in one sound. Every word has at least one syllable. For example, "cat" has one syllable, and "water" has two. Some syllables end with a consonant sound, like "cat". Other syllables end with a vowel sound, like "go". Some languages, like Japanese, write each syllable with one sign. English has many different kinds of syllables.
Prague\n\nPrague is a big city in Europe. It is the capital of the Czech Republic. Many people live there. Prague is very old and has many beautiful buildings. There is a big castle on a hill. There is a famous bridge called Charles Bridge. People walk on the bridge and look at statues. In the middle of the city there is a big square with a clock that shows moving figures. Many tourists visit Prague to see the old streets and buildings. The city has a river called the Vltava that flows through it. People ride trams and trains to get around. Prague also has a big airport where planes come and go.
River\n\nA river is a long, moving stream of water that flows across the land. It starts high up in hills or mountains as a small, fast stream. The beginning is called the source. As it flows downhill, it gets bigger and wider. The middle part is called a mature river, and it often has bridges over it. Many towns and farms are built along rivers. The end of a river is called the mouth, where it flows into the ocean or a lake. Some rivers flow underground through caves. People and animals drink fresh water from rivers.
Gland\n\nA gland is a part of your body that makes special stuff like sweat or spit. You have many glands inside you. They help keep your body working right. For example, glands in your mouth make spit to help you eat. Glands in your skin make sweat to cool you down.
New World vulture\n\nNew World vultures are big birds that live in North and South America. They eat meat from dead animals. They have a very good nose and can smell food from far away. Their nostrils have a hole that goes all the way through their beak. When they walk on the ground, they walk instead of hop. The biggest ones are called condors.
Heat\n\nHeat is a kind of energy that makes things warm. When you touch something hot, like a stove, heat moves from the stove to your hand. Heat moves from hot things to cold things. Adding heat to something makes it hotter. Heat is not the same as temperature. Temperature tells how fast the tiny bits inside a thing are moving. Heat can move in different ways. You can measure heat with a tool called a calorimeter. The units for heat are calories or joules.
Russian language\n\nRussian is a language that people speak in Russia and many other countries. It is a Slavic language, like Ukrainian and Belarusian. Russian uses special letters called the Cyrillic alphabet, not the ABC letters we use in English. Many people around the world speak Russian. In Russian, a person's name has three parts: a first name, a middle name from their father, and a last name. For example, a boy named Ivan whose father is Nikolai might be called Ivan Nikolaevich. Girls add an 'a' to the end of their last name. Russian words change their endings to show who is doing what in a sentence, so the order of words can be different from English.
Electric field\n\nAn electric field is a special kind of force that you cannot see. It is around things that have electric charge, like a battery or a balloon you rub on your hair. The electric field pushes or pulls other charged things. If you put a tiny charged ball near it, the ball will move. Michael Faraday was the first person to think about electric fields. Electric fields also happen when a magnet changes over time.
Mahogany\n\nMahogany is a kind of wood that comes from a big tree. The tree grows in warm places like islands in the ocean. People use mahogany to make strong boats and pretty furniture. The wood is hard and lasts a long time. It does not get dirty easily. Mahogany trees can grow very tall.
Central Asia\n\nCentral Asia is a big area in the middle of Asia. It has six countries: Afghanistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, and Tajikistan. Long ago, people walked across this land on a road called the Silk Road to trade things. Many different groups ruled Central Asia, like the Persians, Arabs, Mongols, and Russians. In 1991, all the countries became free. Today, some places grow cotton, and others sell oil and gas. The cities of Bukhara and Samarkand are very old and have beautiful buildings.
Retirement\n\nRetirement is when people stop working. They may stop because they are old, or sick, or just want to. Usually, they have saved money to help them. Some people still work a little bit. If they need help, they might move to a special home where people take care of them. The word can also mean something is no longer used, like an old car.
Krishna\n\nKrishna is a very important god in the Hindu religion. People believe he came to Earth as a special helper of the god Vishnu. Krishna was a real person who fought in a big war called the Mahabharata. He is a main person in a holy book called the Bhagavad Gita. Many people think of him as a brave fighter, a smart teacher, and a great leader. He beat a mean king named Kansa, who had put Krishna's mother and father in jail.
Noun\n\nA noun is a word that names something. It can name a person, like 'mom' or 'dad'. It can name a place, like 'school' or 'park'. It can name a thing, like 'ball' or 'book'. It can even name an animal, like 'cat' or 'dog'. Some nouns name ideas, like 'love' or 'fun'. Every language has nouns. In English, nouns can be one (singular) or more than one (plural). For example, 'cat' is one cat, and 'cats' is many cats. Proper nouns are special names for one thing, like 'London' or 'John'. They start with a big letter. Common nouns are general names, like 'city' or 'boy'.
Evaporation\n\nEvaporation is when water turns into a gas and goes into the air. You can see it happen when a puddle of water dries up. The water disappears because it turns into tiny bits called water vapor that mix with the air. Heat makes evaporation happen faster. Wind also helps water evaporate faster. Evaporation is part of how water moves from the ground up to the clouds.
Hammerhead shark\n\nA hammerhead shark is a fish with a head that looks like a hammer. This special head helps it see all around, even what is under and above it. Hammerhead sharks live in the ocean and can be big or small. They are light grey with a green tint and a white belly. They like to eat stingrays, fish, and even other sharks. Baby hammerhead sharks are born alive and swim together in groups until they are big enough to be alone. Some hammerhead sharks can be dangerous to people, but not all of them. In Hawaii, people think hammerhead sharks are special protectors of the ocean.
Ballet\n\nBallet is a special kind of dance. Dancers who do ballet have to practice a lot. They tell a story using only their bodies and music. The dancers wear special shoes and pretty costumes. They spin, jump, and stand on their tiptoes. Ballet is performed on a stage in a theater. People watch and clap. A famous ballet is "The Nutcracker." Ballet started a long time ago in France and Russia.
East China Sea\n\nThe East China Sea is a big body of water next to China. It is part of the Pacific Ocean. The sea touches China, South Korea, Japan, and Taiwan. The Yangtze River, which is a very long river, flows into this sea. Many ships travel on the East China Sea.
Officer\n\nAn officer is a person with an important job in a group like the army or police. Other people in the group must do what the officer says. Some officers are called captains or lieutenants. An officer helps keep things safe and in order.
Kilogram\n\nA kilogram is a way to measure how heavy something is. It is a little more than two pounds. One liter of water weighs almost exactly one kilogram. A kilogram is used by people all over the world to weigh things like food, animals, and toys. A long time ago, a special piece of metal was made to be the perfect kilogram. It is kept safe in a glass jar in France. The metal does not rust because it is made of platinum and iridium.
Alhambra\n\nThe Alhambra is a big, old palace and fort in Spain. It sits on a hill near the city of Granada. Long ago, Muslim rulers lived there with their families. Today, many people visit the Alhambra to see its pretty buildings and gardens. The walls have beautiful shapes and patterns. In 1492, new kings took over the land, but the Alhambra was not broken.
Beet\n\nA beet is a plant that grows a round or long root under the ground. The most common kind is red beetroot, which people eat as a vegetable. Some beets are used to feed cows, and others are used to make sugar.
Philodendron\n\nA philodendron is a green plant that people grow inside their homes. It has big, shiny leaves and grows fast. Some philodendrons climb up walls or hang down from pots. They are easy to take care of and do not need much water. Philodendrons can help clean the air inside a room by taking away bad things in the air.
Language\n\nLanguage is how people talk to each other. Only humans use language. People can use words, writing, or hand signs to share ideas. Every language has rules for putting words together to make sentences. Children learn their first language best when they are very young, from about one and a half to four years old. Some languages are spoken by many people, like Chinese and English. English is used by people all over the world for science, travel, and fun. Some made-up languages, like Esperanto, were created so people from different countries can talk to each other.
Wind power\n\nWind power is a way to make electricity from the wind. The wind turns big blades on a tall tower, like a giant fan. The blades spin a machine inside that makes electricity. Wind power is clean because it does not make dirty smoke or bad air. It comes from the wind, so it never runs out. Many countries use wind power to help light up homes and schools. But wind does not always blow, so wind power does not always work. Some people think the tall towers look funny on the land.
Whirlpool galaxy\n\nThe Whirlpool galaxy is a huge group of stars and dust in space. It looks like a big spinning pinwheel with long, curvy arms. A smaller galaxy is next to it, and they bump into each other. The Whirlpool was the first galaxy people saw that has spiral arms. It is very far away, so far that light takes many years to reach us. You can see it with binoculars if you look in the right part of the sky at night.
Borobudur\n\nBorobudur is a very old temple in Indonesia. It is made of gray stone and has many levels that go up like stairs. On top there is a big round dome. The temple has many stone pictures and statues of Buddha. Long ago people stopped using it, but later it was found again and fixed up. Now many people visit Borobudur to see how big and beautiful it is.
Island\n\nAn island is a piece of land with water all around it. The water can be a lake, a river, or the big ocean. Most islands are in the ocean. Some islands are very big, like Greenland. Other islands are small. People live on many islands. Some islands have mountains and trees. You can only get to an island by boat or airplane.
Atheism\n\nAtheism is when someone does not believe in a god or gods. A person who thinks this way is called an atheist. Some people believe in a god, and some people do not. Atheists think there is no proof that a god exists. In some places, it is not safe to say you are an atheist. In other places, atheists have the same rights as everyone else. About 2 out of every 100 people in the world say they are atheists.
Muse d'Orsay\n\nThe Muse d'Orsay is a big art museum in Paris, France. The building was first a train station a long time ago. In 1986, it became a museum. Inside, you can see many paintings from the 1800s. Some paintings show soft, blurry shapes and bright colors. These are called Impressionist paintings. Famous painters like Monet, Van Gogh, and Renoir made them. The museum also has statues, old furniture, and photographs. It is one of the most famous museums in the world.
Antarctic Peninsula\n\nThe Antarctic Peninsula is a long, icy piece of land that sticks out from Antarctica. It is the northernmost part of Antarctica and is very cold. Many scientists live there in special buildings called research stations. The ice on the peninsula is melting because the air is getting warmer.
Ammunition\n\nAmmunition is the stuff that goes inside a gun to make it shoot. It is also called ammo. A bullet is one kind of ammunition. When you put a bullet in a gun and pull the trigger, the gun shoots the bullet very fast. Ammunition can also be big things like bombs and missiles that soldiers use. Factories make ammunition for people to use.
Crop\n\nA crop is a plant that farmers grow. Most crops are food like grain, vegetables, or fruit. Some crops give us things to wear, like cotton, or things to use, like wood. Farmers often grow just one kind of crop on their farm. People have picked the best plants to grow so they taste good and are big. Growing crops is part of farming.
Electric power distribution\n\nElectric power distribution is how electricity gets to your house. The electricity starts at a big power station and travels through wires on tall poles. These wires are called power lines. A machine called a transformer makes the electricity safe to use at home. A meter shows how much electricity you use. Long ago, electricity could only go one way, but now it can go back and forth, which is better for sending it far away.
Krakatoa\n\nKrakatoa is a big mountain that shoots hot rocks and ash into the sky. It is on an island in Indonesia. A long time ago, in 1883, it made the loudest sound anyone has ever heard. People far away in Australia and Africa heard it too. The explosion made a giant wave that hurt many people. The mountain blew up and most of the island went away. Later, a new little island grew in the same place. It is called Anak Krakatau, which means baby Krakatoa.
Sequence\n\nA sequence is a list of things that come one after another in a special order. For example, (Blue, Red, Yellow) and (Yellow, Blue, Red) are different sequences because the order is different. Some sequences have an end, like (1, 2, 3, 4, 5). Other sequences never end, like 2, 4, 6, 8, ... which keeps going forever. You can also make a rule to find any number in the sequence. For instance, if the rule is "2 times n", then the first number is 2, the second is 4, and the 100th is 200.
Apple\n\nAn apple is a fruit that grows on trees. Apple trees are small and lose their leaves in winter. The fruit is round and can be red, green, or yellow. Apples taste sweet or sour. You can eat them raw or cook them to make apple pie or apple sauce. Apple juice and cider are drinks made from apples. Apples have seeds inside, but it is safe to eat a few seeds. People grow apples in many places around the world. China grows more apples than any other country.
Game\n\nA game is something people do for fun. It is different from work. There are many kinds of games. Some games use a board, like Ludo or Go. Some games use a ball, like soccer. Some games are on a screen, like video games. People play games with rules. Games can be played alone or with friends. Games are very old. Long ago, people played games with stones and bones. Today, people play games on computers and phones. Games help us learn and have fun together.
Laos\n\nLaos is a country in Southeast Asia. It is a landlocked country, which means it does not touch the ocean. Laos is next to Myanmar, China, Vietnam, Cambodia, and Thailand. The Mekong River runs along part of the border with Thailand. Boats cannot go all the way to the ocean because there are big waterfalls and fast water in the south. Laos has fewer people living in it than any other country in Southeast Asia. The capital city is Vientiane. Long ago, France ruled Laos. Then Laos became its own country. There was a war, and now the country is led by one group of people.
Rubber\n\nRubber is a stretchy material that can bounce and pull. It comes from the sap of some trees, like the rubber tree. People also make rubber in factories. Rubber can stretch and shrink, and it does not let electricity go through it. Many things are made from rubber, such as tires for cars and bikes, balls, gloves, and erasers. A long time ago, a man named Joseph Priestley found that rubber could rub out pencil marks on paper. That is why we call it an eraser.
Printing\n\nPrinting is a way to put words and pictures on paper using a machine. Books, newspapers, and magazines are made by printing. A machine called a printing press puts ink on paper to make many copies. Long ago, people wrote everything by hand, which took a very long time. Then someone made a machine that could print many copies quickly. This helped more people learn to read and share ideas. Today, printing is used to make books, signs, and even photographs.
Tractor\n\nA tractor is a big work vehicle that pulls things. Farmers use tractors to help on farms. Construction workers use them too. Tractors can pull trailers and other heavy loads. Most tractors have big wheels. Some tractors have rubber tracks instead of wheels. The tracks help the tractor move on soft or muddy ground without getting stuck. A tractor usually has a seat for just one person, the driver.
Great Plains\n\nThe Great Plains is a very big, flat piece of land in the middle of North America. It is covered with grass and has few trees. In the summer it is hot, and in the winter it is cold. Long ago, many bison lived there, and people ate them. Now, farmers grow food like wheat on the Great Plains.
Colombo\n\nColombo is a big city in Sri Lanka. It is the largest city in that country. Many people live there. It is on the west coast, near the capital city. The name Colombo comes from words that mean "harbor with leafy mango trees." A long time ago, a traveler called it "Kalanpu."
Gabon\n\nGabon is a country in Africa. It is on the equator, which is an imaginary line around the middle of the Earth. Gabon has rainforests that cover most of the land. Many trees and animals live there. The capital city is Libreville. About 2.3 million people live in Gabon. The country has a lot of metal and oil in the ground. People in Gabon speak French and other languages. Some people believe in spirits, and some follow religions like Christianity or Islam. The national football team plays soccer for the country.
Dog\n\nA dog is a furry animal with four legs and a tail. Many people keep dogs as pets at home. Dogs can also work on farms or help the police. Some dogs are trained to find people who are lost. Dogs were the first animals to live with people. They are playful, friendly, and loyal. A baby dog is called a puppy. Dogs eat meat and vegetables mixed together as dog food. Dogs can smell and hear very well, but they cannot see all colors. They see yellows, blues, and grays. Dogs come in many sizes, from very small like a Chihuahua to very big like a Great Dane. There are over 450 kinds of dogs. Dogs are often called "human's best friend" because they like being around people.
Temperate climate\n\nA temperate climate is a kind of weather that is not too hot and not too cold. Places with this climate have four seasons: spring, summer, fall, and winter. In summer it is warm, and in winter it is cold. The weather can change a lot from day to day. One day might be sunny, the next rainy, and then cloudy. This happens in both summer and winter.
Musical theater\n\nMusical theater is a show on a stage where people act, sing songs, and dance. A musical is a story told with music and words. Some musicals have people talking and singing, while others sing almost the whole time. Famous musicals include "The Sound of Music" and "West Side Story." Long ago, people in France and England made funny musical shows that helped create the musicals we see today.
Carp\n\nA carp is a fish that lives in rivers and lakes. In some places, people like to catch and eat carp. But in other places, carp are a problem because they stir up mud and make the water dirty. Some pretty fish like goldfish and koi are also kinds of carp.
Taoism\n\nTaoism is a way of thinking and believing that started in China a long, long time ago. It is about a special force called the Tao, which is like the way everything in the world works. Taoists think that words cannot really explain what the Tao is. Instead, they try to live a simple and quiet life, being happy with what they have and not fighting. They believe it is better to go along with things than to push against them. Taoists also think that nature is very important and that people should live in peace with the world around them. The yin and yang symbol is a famous sign of Taoism. It shows two opposite things, like light and dark, that need to be balanced. Some Taoists believe in gods and heaven, while others just focus on the Tao and the energy called Qi that moves through everything.
Grapefruit\n\nA grapefruit is a fruit that grows on trees. It is bigger than an orange and can be sour or sweet. Grapefruits can be red, white, or pink inside. The tree has dark green leaves and white flowers. Some people eat grapefruit for breakfast. But if you take medicine, you should ask a grown-up before eating grapefruit, because it can change how the medicine works.
Crossbow\n\nA crossbow is a special kind of bow that shoots short arrows called bolts. It has a piece of wood shaped like a cross. You pull the string back and lock it, then press a trigger to shoot. Crossbows are very strong and can shoot through armor. They were used long ago in wars. Today, people shoot crossbows for fun in sports.
Ramayana\n\nThe Ramayana is a very old story from India. It is about a prince named Rama and his wife Sita. Rama had to leave his home and go to the forest with Sita and his brother Lakshman. A bad king named Ravana took Sita away. Rama got help from a group of bears and monkey-like friends called vanaras. They fought a big battle to get Sita back. Rama won and saved his wife. People still tell this story today. Every year, they put on a play called Ramlila and burn a big model of Ravana to show that good wins over bad.
Electronic commerce\n\nElectronic commerce is when people buy and sell things using the internet. You can shop for toys, clothes, and many other things on a computer or phone. People pay with special cards or money from their bank. This way of shopping has grown a lot because many people use the internet. It started when banks used computers to move money around.
Horn of Africa\n\nThe Horn of Africa is a part of East Africa that sticks out into the ocean like a pointy finger. Four countries are there: Eritrea, Ethiopia, Somalia, and Djibouti. Many people live in this area, and it is very old. People have lived there for a very long time. The land is hot and dry in some places. Some animals that live there are camels, goats, and birds.
Gothic cathedrals\n\nGothic cathedrals are very big and beautiful churches. They were built a long, long time ago in Europe. The most special thing about them is the pointed arches. They also have tall windows with pretty stone designs called tracery. Some windows are round and look like a flower, called a rose window. The walls are held up by special supports called flying buttresses. Many of these cathedrals are still standing today. People think they are works of art that are very precious.
Great Lakes\n\nThe Great Lakes are five very big lakes in North America. They hold a lot of fresh water. The five lakes are Lake Superior, Lake Michigan, Lake Huron, Lake Erie, and Lake Ontario. Four of them are on the border between Canada and the United States. Lake Michigan is all inside the United States. These lakes are connected to each other by rivers. Water flows from one lake to the next and finally to the Atlantic Ocean. Many big cities are on the shores of the Great Lakes, like Chicago and Toronto. The lakes have many islands and smaller lakes around them. Many kinds of fish live in the Great Lakes. Some fish have been hurt by too much fishing and by new animals that came from other places. These new animals, like zebra mussels, can cause problems. Pollution from factories and cities also makes the water dirty sometimes.
Club (weapon)\n\nA club is a short, heavy stick used to hit things. It is usually made of wood. People can hold it in one hand. Some clubs are used by police officers. A club can hurt if it hits you.
Black hole\n\nA black hole is a place in space where gravity is so strong that nothing can get out, not even light. The outside edge of a black hole is called the event horizon. Once something goes past this edge, it cannot come back. Black holes are invisible, but scientists can find them by watching how stars and gas move nearby. When gas falls into a black hole, it spins around and gets very hot, making bright light. Most big black holes are found in the middle of galaxies. Our own galaxy has a huge black hole at its center called Sagittarius A*. Black holes form when very big stars die and fall in on themselves. They can also grow by eating gas, dust, and even other black holes.
Opinion poll\n\nAn opinion poll is a way to find out what many people think about something. People are asked to pick from a few answers. The answers are counted and turned into numbers. This helps us guess what a big group of people might think. The people chosen for the poll should be like the whole group, so the answer is fair.
Renewable energy\n\nRenewable energy comes from things in nature that do not run out, like the sun, wind, and water. People have used it for a very long time to make heat and electricity. The sun gives us solar power, which turns sunlight into electricity. Wind power uses big fans called wind turbines to make electricity. Water power, like from rivers, can also make electricity. These kinds of energy do not make the air dirty like burning coal or oil does. Many countries now use more and more renewable energy to help keep our planet clean.
Eiffel Tower\n\nThe Eiffel Tower is a very tall metal tower in Paris, France. It was built a long time ago for a big fair. Many people helped build it. The tower is made of iron and has four big legs. It is very tall and you can see it from far away. At night, it sparkles with many lights. People from all over the world go to see it and climb up to look at the city. The tower was almost taken down, but it was saved because it helped send messages through the air. Today, it is used for radio and TV.
Diplodocus\n\nDiplodocus is a very big dinosaur that lived a long, long time ago. It had a very long neck and a very long tail. Its neck was as long as a school bus, and its tail was even longer. Diplodocus ate leaves from trees. It used its long neck to reach leaves that were high up. Its body was so big that other dinosaurs could not hurt it. People have found bones of Diplodocus in the Rocky Mountains in North America. No one has ever found a whole tail.
Serengeti\n\nThe Serengeti is a big grassy place in Africa with lots of wild animals. It is in two countries: Tanzania and Kenya. Many animals live there, like wildebeests, zebras, gazelles, and lions. Every year, millions of animals walk across the Serengeti to find food and water. This is called the migration. They cross rivers and travel a long way. The Serengeti also has a big hole in the ground called Ngorongoro Crater, where many animals live. There is also a place called Olduvai Gorge where scientists found very old bones of people from long ago.
Felt\n\nFelt is a kind of cloth. It is made by pressing fibers together with water and soap, or by poking them with special needles. The fibers can be from sheep, fur, or man-made materials. People have made felt for a very long time, longer than any other cloth. Felt can be any color and any shape. It is used to make hats, clothes, rugs, and even tents. Some people who move from place to place live in tents made of felt. Felt is different from most other cloth because it does not have a criss-cross pattern. Instead, the fibers are all jumbled up.
Horn (instrument)\n\nA horn is a brass instrument that makes music. Long ago, people used horns made from animal horns for hunting. Riders on horses would blow the horn to send messages to each other. Later, horns were used in orchestras for plays about kings and queens. A horn player can change the sound by putting a hand inside the bell or by using valves. The modern horn has three valves and a long tube that is 6.4 meters long. It makes a warm, beautiful sound, but it is hard to play because the mouthpiece is small. Orchestras usually have two to eight horns.
Comics\n\nComics are stories told with pictures. Sometimes there are words too. The pictures are in boxes called panels. You read the first panel first. Comic strips are short comics in newspapers. Comic books are thin books of comics. Graphic novels are bigger books of comics. Long ago, comics were funny. "Comic" means funny. Now some comics are serious, but we still call them comics. In comics, words are in balloons. A speech balloon shows talking. A thought balloon shows thinking. A scream balloon shows yelling.
Butterfly\n\nA butterfly is an insect that flies during the day. It has four wings covered with tiny scales that make pretty colors and patterns. Butterflies live almost everywhere in the world. They start as eggs on a plant. The egg hatches into a caterpillar that eats leaves. Then the caterpillar makes a hard case called a chrysalis. Inside, it changes into a butterfly. When it comes out, it has wings and can fly. Butterflies drink sweet liquid from flowers using a long tube that coils up like a straw. They have big eyes that can see many things, and two feelers on their head for smelling and balance. Birds and other animals eat butterflies, so their bright colors help them hide or warn others that they taste bad.
Djembe\n\nA djembe is a drum from West Africa. It looks like a big cup. People play it with their hands. The body is made from a hollow tree trunk. The top is made of goatskin.
Loon\n\nA loon is a bird that lives on water. It is as big as a large duck or a small goose. Loons are hard to find because they are shy around people. They live in cool places in North America and northern parts of the world. In winter, they fly to the ocean. Loons can dive very deep underwater to catch fish. Their bodies are good for diving. They have solid bones and feet far back on their body to help them swim. Loons have black-and-white heads, pale chests, and striped backs. They lay up to two eggs. Both mom and dad take turns sitting on the eggs. When the weather gets cold, they fly south. Young loons stay south for three years before coming back north. Loons are famous for their loud calls that sound like trumpets. They also make wailing or laughing sounds. They talk to each other with sounds and dance on the water to warn others away from their nests. Loons are very protective of their eggs and will dance until they are very tired to keep them safe. They eat fish like sunfish, perch, and bullheads. Loons swallow their food whole because their throats can stretch big enough.
Adjective\n\nAn adjective is a word that tells you more about a thing. For example, in "a big dog," the word "big" is an adjective. It tells you what the dog is like. Adjectives can be short like "hot" or "cold." Sometimes we compare things. If one day is colder than another, we say it is "colder." That is the comparative form. The very coldest day is the "coldest." That is the superlative form. For longer words like "beautiful," we say "more beautiful" and "most beautiful." Adjectives help us make a clear picture in our minds.
Satellite television\n\nSatellite television is a way to watch TV shows using a big dish outside your house. The TV shows go up to a satellite in space, and the satellite sends them back down to your dish. Then the shows appear on your TV. Some people use satellite TV because they cannot get cable TV where they live. You often have to pay money to watch satellite TV.
Dallas\n\nDallas is a big city in Texas, a state in the United States. It is part of a group of cities called the Metroplex. Many people live there. Dallas has sports teams like the Dallas Cowboys for football, the Dallas Mavericks for basketball, and the Texas Rangers for baseball. The city was started a long time ago, in 1841. It has a big airport and many companies. Some sad things happened there, but now it is a busy place where people live and work.
Water pollution\n\nWater pollution is when dirty things get into rivers, lakes, and oceans. This makes the water not clean. Dirty water can come from houses, factories, and farms. When farmers put food on plants to help them grow, rain can wash that food into rivers. This makes the water bad for fish and other animals that live in the water. Sometimes the water turns green or brown instead of blue. People and animals should not drink dirty water because it can make them sick.
Culinary mustard\n\nCulinary mustard is a yellow or brown paste that people put on food. It comes from tiny seeds of the mustard plant. People grind the seeds and mix them with water or vinegar to make mustard. Some mustard is hot and some is not so hot. You can spread it on bread, hotdogs, or salad. Many restaurants give mustard in small packets.
Daylight saving time\n\nDaylight saving time is when people move their clocks forward by one hour in the spring and back in the fall. This happens in some countries during the summer months. The sun stays out longer in the evening, so people can play outside more after school or work. It helps stores because people shop after work. It can also make roads safer because there are fewer car accidents. Not all countries use daylight saving time. It is common in places like the United States, Canada, and Europe. Many phones and computers change the time by themselves.
Theft\n\nTheft is when someone takes something that does not belong to them. They do not ask if they can have it, and they do not give it back. A person who steals is called a thief. Stealing is not allowed almost everywhere. Some thieves take things because they want them for themselves. Other thieves take things to sell them for money. They might steal a car, a phone, or a toy. Sometimes thieves plan to steal, and sometimes they just grab something when no one is looking.
Kiribati\n\nKiribati is a country made of many tiny islands in the big Pacific Ocean. The islands are very flat and close to the water. Most people live on the Gilbert Islands. The capital is called South Tarawa. People in Kiribati grow food like coconuts, sweet potatoes, and breadfruit. They also catch fish to eat. The country used to be called the Gilbert Islands. Now it is called Kiribati. The ocean is getting higher, so some land is going under water. The government bought land on another island country called Fiji, so people can move there if they need to.
Humanitarianism\n\nHumanitarianism is being kind and helping other people. A humanitarian is someone who helps make life better for others, no matter what they look like, where they come from, or what they believe. It is like the story of the Good Samaritan who helped a poor man who was hurt. There are also special rules called international humanitarian laws that tell people how to help others who need it.
Bassoon\n\nThe bassoon is a big musical instrument that makes low sounds. It is part of the woodwind family, like a flute or clarinet. The bassoon has a double reed, which is two thin pieces that vibrate when you blow air through them. The instrument is long and made of wood, with many keys and holes. It is heavy, so players often sit on a strap that holds the bassoon up. The bassoon can play very low notes and also high notes. It sounds deep and dark in the low part, and can be sweet or funny in the middle part. A person who plays the bassoon is called a bassoonist. You might hear the bassoon in an orchestra, playing along with the cello or tuba. Sometimes it sounds like a grumpy old man, like in the story 'Peter and the Wolf' where it plays the grandfather's tune.
Fish as food\n\nFish is a food that people eat. Many kinds of fish are good to eat, like cod, salmon, and catfish. People cook fish in different ways: they can bake it, fry it, grill it, or steam it.
Research\n\nResearch is a way of looking for new information and learning new things. A person who does research is called a researcher. Researchers work in schools, for companies, or for the government. They do experiments, read books, and take notes to find answers. Research helps us understand the world better. Scientists use research to learn about animals, plants, and how things work. When researchers find something new, they write it down so other people can learn from it too.
Breed\n\nA breed is a kind of animal or plant that people have made on purpose. People choose which animals or plants have babies together to get a certain look or way of acting. For example, some dogs are big and some are small because they are different breeds. A person who does this is called a breeder. They help make sure the babies are healthy and strong.
Mole cricket\n\nA mole cricket is a bug that lives in the ground. It is about as long as your thumb. It has big eyes and front legs that look like little shovels. It uses those legs to dig tunnels in the dirt and to swim. Mole crickets eat roots, grass, worms, and other tiny bugs. Birds, rats, skunks, and raccoons like to eat mole crickets.
Education\n\nEducation is about learning new things and how to do things. It helps people learn skills and think about what they learn. Teachers help students find and use information. Education passes knowledge from grown-ups to children. There are different kinds of education. Formal education happens in school, like kindergarten, elementary school, and high school. Some people go to college or university to learn more. Non-formal education is for people who are not in school, like learning to read or get a job skill. Informal education is learning from parents or by reading books. A parent can teach a child to ride a bike. People can also learn by themselves from books or websites. Teachers use different ways to teach, like group work or giving rewards. Tests help teachers see what students know.
Goldfish\n\nA goldfish is a small fish that people keep in a tank or a pond. Goldfish can be many colors, but the most common kind is golden-orange. Some goldfish have fancy tails. A goldfish can grow to be as big as your hand, but most are smaller. They can live for a very long time, up to 30 years, if they have a big enough home. Goldfish need lots of space to swim and clean water to stay healthy. You should not touch a goldfish because it can hurt them. Goldfish are smart and can learn tricks, like swimming through a maze or kicking a small ball. They can remember things for many months. Goldfish eat special fish food, and sometimes they like to eat peas to help their tummy feel better.
Cumulonimbus cloud\n\nA cumulonimbus cloud is a very tall, big cloud that brings thunderstorms. It looks like a huge, dark tower in the sky. When you see one, there might be heavy rain, thunder, lightning, and strong wind. Sometimes it can even make a tornado. These clouds start as smaller, fluffy clouds and grow very big.
Korea\n\nKorea is a piece of land in northeast Asia that sticks out into the ocean. Long ago, Korea was one country. In 1948, it split into two countries: South Korea and North Korea. South Korea has big cities like Seoul, where many people live. North Korea has a big city called Pyongyang. People in Korea speak the Korean language. South Korea has fast trains and fast internet. Many people around the world watch Korean shows on TV. Korea is known for its fine silk. A long time ago, a king named Sejong made the Korean alphabet. Korea has a long history with many kingdoms. Today, the two Koreas are still separate.
Nomad\n\nA nomad is a person who moves from one place to another instead of staying in one home. Some nomads move because they have animals like cows or horses that need fresh grass to eat. They live in tents and carry only a few things. Other nomads travel to sell things or make things for people. Some nomads follow animals like reindeer as they move to find food. Long ago, some nomads were also good at fighting on horses and conquered many lands.
Arts\n\nArts are things people make to show ideas or feelings. There are many kinds of arts. Visual arts are things you can see, like paintings, sculptures, and buildings. Painting uses colors to make pictures. Sculpting uses rock, metal, or wood to make shapes. Architecture is the art of making buildings look nice. Performing arts are things people do, like dancing and singing. Literary arts are words, like stories and poems. Some arts are about the idea more than how it looks.
Winter Olympic Games\n\nThe Winter Olympic Games are a big sports party that happens every four years in the cold winter. People from many countries come to play sports on snow and ice. They race on skis and sleds, spin on ice skates, and slide on ice with heavy stones. The games are only for winter sports, so they happen in places with lots of snow and cold weather. The first Winter Olympic Games were a long time ago, and now they are separate from the Summer Olympic Games.
Manga\n\nManga is a kind of comic book that comes from Japan. A person who draws manga is called a mangaka. You read manga from right to left, which is different from most books. Manga can be about many things like adventures, animals, or funny stories. Sometimes manga is turned into a cartoon show called anime. The pictures in manga use bright colors and special symbols to show feelings.
Ellipse\n\nAn ellipse is a shape that looks like an oval or a squished circle. You can make one with two pins and a string. Put the pins in a piece of cardboard, loop a string around them, and pull a pencil tight around the string. The pencil draws an ellipse. Planets move around the sun in an ellipse shape. A circle is a special kind of ellipse.
Curiosity\n\nCuriosity is a feeling that makes you want to learn new things. It makes you ask questions and explore. People and many animals, like cats and dogs, feel curious. Curiosity helps scientists discover new things. Sometimes people feel curious about scary things, but that is not always safe.
University\n\nA university is a big school where older kids go to learn after they finish regular school. At a university, students take many classes about one special thing, like animals or numbers. They can earn a degree, which is like a special paper that says they know a lot about that thing. Universities have teachers called professors, and they also have big rooms full of books called libraries. Some students live at the university in buildings called dormitories. The first universities were started a very long time ago in Europe.
Greece\n\nGreece is a country in Europe. Its capital city is Athens. Greece has many mountains and islands. The sea is all around it. Long ago, the people in Greece started democracy, which means people vote for their leaders. They also started the Olympic Games. Many people visit Greece to see old buildings and swim in the sea. The language people speak there is called Greek. Greece is a Christian country. It uses money called the euro.
Chad\n\nChad is a country in the middle of Africa. It is far from the ocean and very hot and dry. The capital city is N'Djamena. Many people in Chad are very poor and do not have enough food. The country has big deserts and some rivers. Many wild animals live there, like elephants, lions, and giraffes. People in Chad speak Arabic and French. Most children do not go to school.
Mural\n\nA mural is a big painting on a wall or ceiling. You can see murals outside on buildings or inside rooms. They are very large and show pictures like people, animals, or pretty designs. Many people work together to make a mural.
Reality\n\nReality is everything that is real. It means things that really exist and have happened. The chair you sit on is real. The food you eat is real. Dreams are not real because they happen only in your mind. Make-believe stories are not real either. But some things are hard to see, like love or being fair, and they are still part of reality. Some TV shows show real people doing real things, and those are called reality TV.
Reincarnation\n\nReincarnation is the idea that after people die, they are born again in a new body. Many people who follow religions like Hinduism and Buddhism believe this. They think the soul, which is the part of you that is alive inside, never dies. It just goes into a new body, like a baby, and lives another life. This happens many times. What you do in each life, called karma, helps decide what your next life will be like. Some children say things about a life they had before they were born. A few of them even have marks on their body that match where someone else got hurt.
Keyboard (computer)\n\nA computer keyboard is a flat board with many buttons called keys. You press the keys to tell the computer what letters, numbers, or symbols to show on the screen. This is called typing. Keyboards can be connected to a computer with a wire or without a wire. Some keyboards are part of a laptop and have thin keys. Other keyboards have keys that move a lot, like mechanical keyboards, which some people like for playing games. The most common keyboard layout is called QWERTY, named after the first six letters on the top row. Keyboards can have different numbers of rows, and some have special keys like Shift or Ctrl to do different things. Using a keyboard for a long time can hurt your hands, so it is good to take breaks.
Mountain biking\n\nMountain biking is a sport where you ride a special bike on bumpy, rough ground outside. The bike is strong and has thick tires to handle rocks and dirt. Riders wear a helmet, gloves, and knee pads to stay safe. You need to be strong and have good balance. You can ride on trails in the woods or on hills. The bike has many gears to help you go up or down. You must use the brakes carefully when going downhill. Mountain biking is fun, but you should not hurt the plants or animals around you.
Fig\n\nA fig is a soft, sweet fruit with a thin skin and many tiny seeds inside. Figs grow on fig trees in warm places. You can eat them when they are ripe or dried. Sometimes people make fig jam. Figs are also in some snacks. A fig is made from many tiny flowers that grow together inside. You cannot see the flowers unless you cut the fig open. Figs have vitamins and sugar. But the sap from the fig tree can hurt your eyes and skin. Tiny wasps help figs grow by going inside to lay eggs. The wasp dies and gets broken down, so you do not eat it. People have grown figs for a very long time.
Luge\n\nLuge is a fast winter sport. A person lies on their back on a small sled and goes down a long, icy track very fast. The sled has no brakes, so the person uses their body to steer. Luge is like bobsleigh but faster. It is a sport in the Winter Olympics.
Pie\n\nA pie is a baked food with a crust made from dough. The crust can hold sweet or salty fillings inside. Sweet pies have fruit, chocolate, or custard. Salty pies have meat, vegetables, and gravy. Pies can be round or oval. You can eat a pie warm or cold. Some pies are small snacks, and some are big enough for many people. People in different countries make their own kinds of pie. In America, apple pie is a favorite. In Britain, meat pies are popular. Sometimes people throw pies at each other for fun in movies.
Ancient Rome\n\nAncient Rome was a very big and important place a long time ago. It started as a small town in Italy. The people of Rome, called Romans, built a huge empire that covered many lands, from Britain to Africa. They spoke a language called Latin. The Romans made strong roads, big buildings, and good laws. They had many gods, like Jupiter and Juno. Later, many Romans became Christians. The Roman Empire ended a long time ago, but its ideas about laws and buildings are still used today.
Public transport\n\nPublic transport is a way for many people to travel together without needing their own car. Buses, trains, trams, and trolleybuses are types of public transport. People use buses to go places near their home and trains to go far away. You need a ticket or a card to ride. A timetable tells you when the bus or train will come. Public transport is good for the Earth because fewer cars make less dirty air. It is also cheap, so even people with cars sometimes use it.
Driving\n\nDriving is moving a car, truck, bus, or bike from one place to another. People who drive must follow the rules of the road. They stop at red lights and go when the light is green. A long time ago, people drove horses instead of cars. Now, many people drive cars to go to work, school, or the store.
Army\n\nThe army is a big group of people who protect their country on the ground. People in the army are called soldiers. Soldiers use things like tanks, airplanes, and helicopters to help them. Some soldiers choose to join the army, and others are made to join. Soldiers do many jobs, like guarding places, searching, or fighting. They always work together and follow orders. Before someone can be a soldier, they must pass hard tests. Soldiers have special clothes and tools, like guns and food, to help them do their job.
Magellanic Clouds\n\nThe Magellanic Clouds are two groups of stars in the sky. They are not round like our Milky Way. They look like two small, fuzzy clouds. You can only see them from the southern part of Earth. They are far away in space. They go around our Milky Way like friends. Each cloud has many stars, but not as many as our galaxy. You can see them without a telescope on a dark night. They look like pieces of the Milky Way that broke off. One cloud is bigger than the other. The bigger one is called the Large Magellanic Cloud. The smaller one is called the Small Magellanic Cloud. A long time ago, people from Europe saw them for the first time. They named them after a sailor named Magellan. The clouds have lots of gas and young stars. A very bright star explosion happened in the Large Cloud in 1987. People on Earth could see it with their eyes.
Prosthesis\n\nA prosthesis is a fake body part made to replace one that is missing. Some people are born without a body part, and others lose one in an accident or because they were sick. Long ago, prostheses were made of wood, like a wooden leg. Now they are made of light, strong materials. A prosthesis has three main parts: the socket that fits onto the body, the way it stays on (like straps or suction), and how it moves. Some prostheses are special for sports. For example, a skier might have a leg that works like an ankle for skiing. A climber might have an arm with a pick for climbing. Some runners use special blades that look like springs. Scientists are working on prostheses that can be moved by thinking.
Bermuda\n\nBermuda is a group of islands in the Atlantic Ocean. It is a British territory. The biggest island is called Main Island. The capital city is Hamilton. Bermuda has pink sand beaches and clear blue water. Many people visit Bermuda for vacation. The weather is warm in winter and hot in summer. Rain is the only fresh water, so people collect it on their roofs and store it in tanks. Bermuda has bats, a bird called the Bermuda Petrel, and a lizard called the Bermuda Rock Skink. You cannot rent a car there, but you can ride a motor scooter or take a bus.
Aubergine\n\nAn aubergine is a plant that grows a fruit we eat like a vegetable. It is also called eggplant. It is related to the potato and tomato. Aubergines come from India and Sri Lanka. They are usually purple and have a shiny skin. People cook them in many dishes.
Electric motor\n\nAn electric motor is a machine that uses magnets and electricity to make things spin. It changes electricity into movement. Inside, there are magnets that push and pull each other. When you turn on the motor, the pushing and pulling makes a part spin around. This spinning can make a fan blow air, a washing machine wash clothes, or a vacuum cleaner suck up dirt. The first electric motor was made a long time ago by a man named Michael Faraday. He used a nail with wire wrapped around it and a battery to make it spin.
Artemis\n\nArtemis is a Greek goddess. She is the goddess of the Moon, hunting, wild animals, and forests. She is the daughter of Zeus and Leto, and the twin sister of Apollo. Artemis is shown as a beautiful huntress with a bow and arrow. Her sacred animal is the deer. She helped her mother give birth to Apollo. One time, a man named Acteon saw her bathing, and she turned him into a deer. Artemis is also called Diana by the Romans.
Comic book\n\nA comic book is a book with pictures that tell a story. The pictures are just as important as the words. Some comic books have superheroes like Superman, Batman, and Spider-Man. These superheroes fight bad guys and save people. Comic books can also be about other things, like funny animals or adventures. People read comic books for fun. Some comic books come from America, and some come from Japan or Korea.
Marshall Islands\n\nThe Marshall Islands is a country made of many small islands in the big Pacific Ocean. About 58,000 people live there. The capital city is called Majuro. People there speak Marshallese and English. Some people from the Marshall Islands now live in a place called Arkansas in the United States.
