It became its own country in 1991. It is a member of NATO and wants to join the European Union. The country has a president and a parliament where people vote for leaders.
Asthma\n\nAsthma is a sickness that makes it hard to breathe. Inside your lungs, there are small tubes called airways. When a person has asthma, these tubes get tight and swollen. The body also makes extra sticky stuff called mucus that blocks the tubes. This makes it hard for air to get in and out. A person having an asthma attack may make a whistling sound called wheezing. They may also cough a lot or feel like their chest is being squeezed. Many children get asthma, and it often gets better as they grow up. There is no cure for asthma, but doctors can give medicine to help people breathe easier. Things like dust, smoke, or pets can make asthma worse. If you have asthma, you can learn how to stay safe and breathe well.
The Bahamas\n\nThe Bahamas is a group of many islands in the warm Caribbean Sea. The islands are low and flat, and the weather is hot most of the year. The capital city is Nassau, on an island called New Providence. Many people visit The Bahamas for holidays because the water is blue and the beaches are sandy. The people there speak English. The Bahamas does not have an army, but it has a small navy with boats that patrol the water.
Mars\n\nMars is a planet in our sky. It is the fourth planet from the Sun. Mars is called the Red Planet because it looks red. The ground on Mars is red because of rust in the rocks and dust. Mars is made of rock, like Earth. It has the biggest mountain in the whole solar system, called Olympus Mons. That mountain is very, very tall. Mars also has a very big canyon called Valles Marineris. Mars has two tiny moons named Phobos and Deimos. A day on Mars is a little longer than a day on Earth. Mars has four seasons, just like Earth, but each season is longer. The air on Mars is very thin and has almost no oxygen. It is mostly carbon dioxide. Mars is very cold because it is far from the Sun. There is ice made of water at the north and south poles. Long ago, there was probably liquid water on Mars. In 2024, scientists found water deep under the ground on Mars. Mars has many craters from rocks that hit it. Sometimes pieces of Mars fly to Earth as meteorites.
Credit card\n\nA credit card is a small plastic card that lets you buy things without using cash. When you pay with a credit card, you borrow money from a bank. You have to pay that money back later. If you do not pay on time, you have to pay extra money called interest. Each card has a special number and a date. Many cards have a tiny chip that helps pay safely. You can use a credit card in stores and on the computer. Some cards give you points or money back when you buy things. But you must be careful not to borrow too much, or you will have to pay a lot extra.
Europe\n\nEurope is a big piece of land on Earth. It is next to the Atlantic Ocean on one side and the Arctic Ocean on another. Many countries are in Europe, like France, Germany, and Italy. People from all over the world visit Europe to see old buildings and pretty places. Some parts of Europe are very cold and snowy in winter, while other parts are warm. The name Europe comes from a story about a princess called Europa. Many people live in Europe, and they speak different languages and eat different foods.
National Basketball Association\n\nThe National Basketball Association, or NBA, is a big group of basketball teams. There are 30 teams, 29 in the United States and 1 in Canada. The NBA has the best basketball players in the world. They are very tall, about 6 feet 6 inches. The season starts in October and ends in April. Each team plays 82 games. The best players play in a special game called the All-Star Game in February. After the season, the playoffs start. Eight teams from the east and eight from the west play games. The winners of each side play in the NBA Finals. The team that wins the finals is the champion. The Boston Celtics have won the most championships, 18. The Los Angeles Lakers have won 17.
Spring (season)\n\nSpring is the time of year after winter and before summer. The days get longer and the weather gets warmer. In many places, it rains a lot in spring. The rain helps plants grow and flowers bloom. Many animals have their babies in spring. Some people get sneezy because of tiny bits from plants called pollen. At the start of spring, day and night are the same length. People celebrate holidays like Easter and Passover in spring. School in spring is called spring semester, and some kids get a vacation called spring break.
Rural area\n\nA rural area is a place that is not a city or a town. It is often called "the country" or "countryside." People live in small villages or far away from other houses. Many people grow food on farms there. City people like to visit rural areas to relax and have fun on holidays.
Dragon\n\nA dragon is a make-believe animal that lives in stories. Dragons are in tales from China, Europe, South America, and many other places. Some dragons have wings and can fly. Some dragons breathe fire. You can see dragons in movies and books like 'How to Train Your Dragon' and 'Harry Potter'. In some stories, dragons are friendly and help people. In other stories, dragons are scary.
Inequality\n\nInequality is a math word that means two things are not the same. When you compare numbers, you can say one is bigger or smaller than the other. For example, 5 is bigger than 3. We use special signs like < and > to show this. Sometimes you have to solve a puzzle to find which numbers make the statement true. If you multiply or divide by a minus number, you have to flip the sign. You can draw the answer on a number line with a circle.
Lung\n\nA lung is a part inside your body that helps you breathe. Most animals with a backbone have two lungs. When you breathe in, air goes into your lungs. Your lungs take the good part of the air, called oxygen, and send it into your blood. Then your blood carries the oxygen to all parts of your body. When you breathe out, your lungs push out the bad air, called carbon dioxide. Your lungs are soft and spongy. They are inside your chest, one on each side. Birds have lungs too, but they are smaller and work a little differently. Frogs have simple lungs and can also breathe through their wet skin.
Niger River\n\nThe Niger River is a very long river in western Africa. It is shaped like a crescent moon. The river starts in Guinea and flows through Mali, Niger, and Nigeria before it reaches the sea. It is the third longest river in Africa. The Niger River floods every year, which helps people fish and grow food. The river has a special part called the Niger Inland Delta, where it spreads out into many streams and lakes. The countries Nigeria and Niger got their names from this river.
Museum\n\nA museum is a building where people can see special things from the past and from all over the world. Museums keep old things safe and show them to visitors. You can see paintings, old tools, dinosaur bones, and many other cool things. Some museums let you touch and play with things. People go to museums to learn and have fun. A zoo is a kind of museum with live animals.
Conservation of energy\n\nEnergy is what makes things move, grow, and change. You cannot make new energy, and you cannot use it up. Energy can only change from one kind to another. For example, when you eat food, your body turns that food into energy to run and play. When you turn on a light, electrical energy changes into light and heat. A ball held up high has stored energy, and when you drop it, that energy turns into movement. Energy is always there, just changing forms.
Bedbug\n\nA bedbug is a very small bug that lives in houses. It likes to hide in beds and sleep near people. At night, when people are asleep, the bedbug comes out and bites them to drink their blood. The bite makes a small itchy spot, like a mosquito bite. Bedbugs are hard to see because they are tiny and stay hidden.
Walk\n\nWalking is how people and animals move around using their legs. When you walk, one foot is on the ground and the other is in the air. Walking is slower than running. When you go outside to walk, you can say you 'went for a walk'. Walking fast or for a long time is good exercise and keeps your body healthy. Most babies learn to walk when they are about one year old.
Red blood cell\n\nRed blood cells are tiny cells in your blood that carry oxygen. They are red because they have something inside called hemoglobin. Red blood cells look like little round donuts, but without a hole in the middle. They pick up oxygen from your lungs and take it to every part of your body. Your body has many millions of red blood cells. They help you stay alive and strong.
Cargo\n\nCargo is stuff that people move from one place to another. It is carried in big trucks, trains, airplanes, or ships. Cargo can be toys, food, clothes, or anything else. The things are often packed in big boxes called containers. A place where cargo is loaded or unloaded is called a cargo terminal.
Breakup\n\nA breakup is when two people who love each other stop being together. It can happen when one person is not happy, or when both are not happy. After a breakup, people might feel sad for a while. It takes time to feel better.
Baffin Bay\n\nBaffin Bay is a big body of water between Baffin Island and Greenland. It is part of the Atlantic Ocean. The water is very cold and covered with ice most of the year. Big pieces of ice called icebergs float in the bay. Many animals live there, like beluga whales, walruses, narwhals, seals, and polar bears. Birds like snowy owls and little auks also live near the bay. People have lived near Baffin Bay for a very long time. A man named William Baffin wrote about the bay a long time ago, and that is how it got its name.
Horror fiction\n\nHorror fiction is a story that is meant to scare you. Some horror stories have ghosts and monsters that are not real. Other horror stories are about scary things that can happen in real life, like bad people or sickness. People read or watch horror to feel a little bit scared, but they know it is just a story.
Wedge\n\nA wedge is a tool that is thick on one end and thin on the other. You can use it to push things apart. For example, you can put the thin end of a wedge between two pieces of wood and hit the thick end to split them. A doorstop is a kind of wedge that keeps a door open. An axe is also a wedge that can cut wood.
Dominoes\n\nDominoes is a game you play with small flat tiles. Each tile has a line in the middle and black dots on each side. Some sides have no dots. You match the dots to play the game.
Physical fitness\n\nPhysical fitness means your body is strong and can move well. It helps you run, jump, and play without getting too tired. Some people, like firefighters and soldiers, need to be very fit for their jobs. To be fit, you need to exercise your heart and muscles, stretch your body, and eat good food. Being fit keeps you healthy and happy.
Sausage\n\nSausage is a food made from ground-up meat. People mix the meat with spices and put it inside a thin skin. Some sausages are long and thin, like hot dogs. Others are short and round. You can eat sausage for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. It can be in a sandwich or in a stew. Some sausages are made from beef, pork, or chicken. There are also sausages made without meat, like tofu sausages. Germany has many special kinds of sausages.
Surfing\n\nSurfing is a fun water sport in the ocean. A surfer stands on a long board called a surfboard and rides on top of a big wave. The wave pushes the surfer toward the beach. Surfing started a very long time ago in Hawaii. People all over the world like to surf, especially in places with big waves. Surfers wear swimsuits and sometimes a wetsuit to stay warm. It takes practice to balance on the board and ride the wave.
Swordfish\n\nA swordfish is a big fish with a long, flat nose that looks like a sword. It has a smooth body and can swim very fast. The swordfish uses its sword nose to hit other fish and make them hurt, so it can eat them. People like to catch swordfish for fun and for food. The meat is cut into big pieces and cooked on a grill. But grown-ups say not to eat too much swordfish because it has something inside that can be bad for you.
Sperm whale\n\nA sperm whale is a very big animal that lives in the ocean. It is the biggest whale with teeth. Its head is huge, bigger than any other animal's head. A sperm whale has a big brain too. It eats meat like squid and fish. It dives deep down in the ocean to find food and can stay underwater for a long time. Sperm whales make clicking sounds to find their way and talk to each other.
Atmospheric science\n\nAtmospheric science is about the air all around us. It studies the sky, clouds, wind, and weather. Scientists who study the air use special tools like weather balloons and satellites to learn about temperature and wind. They help us know if it will be sunny or rainy.
Chord\n\nA chord is when you play two or more notes at the same time. Some people say a chord needs three notes. When you play only two notes together, it is called a double stop. You can play chords on many instruments like the piano, guitar, or xylophone. A violin player can make a chord by bowing two strings at once. Some wind instruments can also make chords by playing more than one sound at a time.
Monastery\n\nA monastery is a place where monks live. Monks are people who spend their time praying and helping others. They do not get married and do not own things like toys or money. Everything they use belongs to the monastery. Some monasteries are far away from towns, and monks grow their own food. Other monasteries are near towns, and monks help by teaching or taking care of sick people. Many monasteries have a chapel where monks pray.
Confucianism\n\nConfucianism is a way of thinking that comes from a wise man named Confucius, who lived a long time ago in China. It teaches people how to be good to each other. The most important thing is to respect your mom and dad, older people, and your family members who lived before you. Confucius said we should always keep learning new things, because there is always more to know. He even learned from a little kid once! Confucianism also says that families are like the building blocks of a whole town or country. When people are kind and help each other, everyone can live together in peace. Today, many people in China and around the world still follow these ideas.
Maasai\n\nThe Maasai are a group of people who live in Kenya and Tanzania. They wear bright clothes and beads. They live near big parks where many animals live. The Maasai have cows, and the more cows a man has, the richer he is. They drink cow's blood because they think it makes them strong. The women build houses called Manyatta. The men build fences to keep lions out. Maasai boys jump over fire and hunt lions to become men. The Maasai speak a language called Maa.
Cairo\n\nCairo is a big city in Egypt. It is the capital, which means it is the most important city in the country. Cairo sits next to a long river called the Nile. The weather is hot and sunny almost every day. Many people live in Cairo, more than in most other cities in Africa. Outside the city, you can see the great pyramids of Giza, which are huge stone buildings from long ago. There is also a museum in Cairo that holds old treasures from the time of the pharaohs, including things from King Tutankhamun's tomb.
Surface tension\n\nSurface tension is when the top of water feels like a very thin, strong skin. This skin can hold up small things that are light. Some bugs, like water striders, can walk on top of the water because of this skin. Water drops are round because the skin pulls them into a ball shape. You can see surface tension when rain makes little round beads on a leaf. Soap can break the skin, which is why soap helps wash things clean.
Saxophone\n\nA saxophone is a musical instrument that you blow into to make sounds. It has a small piece of wood inside called a reed that shakes when you blow air. The saxophone has many keys that you press to make different notes. Some saxophones are big and some are small. People play the saxophone in bands and in jazz music. It was made a long time ago by a man named Adolphe Sax.
Sales\n\nSales is when someone sells things to get money. A person who sells things is called a salesman. Salespeople talk to people who might want to buy what they are selling. They try to help those people find what they need. Sometimes the buyer says no, but the salesperson keeps trying to explain why the thing is good. Sales and marketing work together to help a company do well.
Lie\n\nA lie is something someone says that is not true. People tell lies on purpose to hide something or get something. Sometimes people tell small lies called white lies to make others feel better. Telling a lie in a court is called perjury and is very bad. Some people tell many lies to trick others over a long time. Animals can also trick others, like a bird pretending to be hurt to protect its babies. People start telling lies when they are about two years old.
Stainless steel\n\nStainless steel is a kind of metal that does not get rusty easily. It is used to make forks, knives, and spoons. Some airplanes also use stainless steel. It is very strong and stays shiny for a long time.
Seafood\n\nSeafood is food that comes from the ocean. It can be fish, like salmon or tuna, or other sea animals like shrimp and lobsters. People catch seafood by fishing. Seafood has a lot of protein, which helps your body grow strong. Many people think seafood is healthy to eat.
Cooking\n\nCooking is how we make food ready to eat by heating it. People cook in a kitchen using a stove or an oven. You can also cook over a campfire or on a barbecue. There are many ways to cook food. Boiling cooks food in hot water. Frying cooks food in hot butter or oil. Baking and roasting cook food with hot air. Grilling cooks food on a metal rack over heat. People cook meat by boiling, roasting, frying, or grilling it. Bread and pastries are usually baked. Food is often cooked in a pot or pan. Sometimes food is wrapped in leaves and put into the fire. A person who cooks food is called a cook or a chef. A cooker is a machine that helps cook food, like a rice cooker.
Wisdom\n\nWisdom is knowing the right thing to do. A wise person has learned from things that happened before. Wise people help others by giving good advice. An owl is a sign of wisdom.
Syringe\n\nA syringe is a tool that doctors and nurses use. It has a thin, sharp needle at one end and a tube that can pull in or push out liquid. They use it to give medicine or a shot into your body. Most syringes are used only one time to keep people safe from germs.
Fan (person)\n\nA fan is someone who really likes a thing, a person, or an idea. Fans might like a sport, a music star, or a kind of book. They often meet other fans to talk about what they like. Sometimes fans are called fanatics. A fanatic can care so much that they might hurt people who disagree. In British English, a person who likes a sports team is called a supporter. In American English, supporter is used for people who like a politician or a law.
Dhaka\n\nDhaka is the biggest city in Bangladesh. It is the capital, which means it is where the country's leaders work. Many, many people live there. The city sits near a big river called the Buriganga. Long ago, Dhaka was part of a big empire called the Mughal Empire. Later, it was ruled by Britain. In 1971, Bangladesh became its own country, and Dhaka became its capital. Today, Dhaka has many schools, colleges, and universities. It also has a big bank and a stock exchange. People in Dhaka make clothes, jewelry, and other things. The city has old forts, temples, and a big building where the president lives. Buses even go from Dhaka to a place in India called Agartala.
Iceberg\n\nAn iceberg is a big piece of ice that floats in the sea. It lives in very cold water near the North Pole or the South Pole. Most of the iceberg is under the water, so you can only see a little bit on top. Icebergs break off from big ice sheets or glaciers. They are made from snow that falls in cold places and does not melt in summer. The snow gets squished into ice and slides into the sea. Icebergs can float for years before they melt. They are dangerous for boats because you cannot see the part under the water. A famous ship called the Titanic hit an iceberg and sank. Some icebergs are very big, as big as an island. Icebergs can be white or blue.
Elevation\n\nElevation tells how high a place is. We measure it from the sea level, which is the middle of the ocean. Most land is above the sea, so it has high elevation. Some places are below the sea, like a few deserts. A tall mountain has high elevation.
Quadrilateral\n\nA quadrilateral is a shape with four straight sides and four corners. The sides are straight lines. All the inside corners of a quadrilateral add up to 360 degrees. There are many kinds of quadrilaterals. A square has four sides that are all the same length and four square corners. A rectangle has four square corners but its sides can be different lengths. A rhombus has four sides that are all the same length but its corners are not square. A trapezoid has one pair of sides that are parallel, like train tracks. A parallelogram has two pairs of parallel sides.
Netherlands\n\nThe Netherlands is a country in Europe. It is also called Holland by some people, but the real name is Netherlands. The land is very flat and low. Some parts are even below the sea. Many people ride bicycles there. The big city of Amsterdam is the capital. The Dutch people speak Dutch. The country has a king, but the people choose the government. The Netherlands is known for being kind and letting people be different.
Olympus\n\nMount Olympus is a very tall mountain in Greece. It is the highest mountain in that country. Long ago, people told stories that the gods lived on top of this mountain. They said twelve special gods made their home there.
Sparrow\n\nA sparrow is a small bird. It is brown and gray. It has a short tail and a small, strong beak. Sparrows eat seeds and tiny bugs. They like to live near houses and buildings. You can see them in many places around the world. A sparrow makes its nest in a bush or a hole in a house. The male sparrow has a black throat. The female is brown and cream. Sparrows live in groups called flocks.
Spirituality\n\nSpirituality is about feelings inside you that are hard to see or touch. It is about what makes you feel happy and peaceful. Some people find spirituality in religion, like going to a church or temple. Other people find it in nature, like looking at a big tree or a quiet lake. Some people think about big questions, like what happens after we die. You can feel spiritual when you are quiet and think about things that are bigger than you. It is a way to feel good inside your heart.
Calculator\n\nA calculator is a machine that helps people do math. It can add, subtract, multiply, and divide. Some calculators are small and fit in your pocket. They use batteries or sunlight to work. Bigger calculators can do harder math like square roots. Many phones and computers have a calculator inside them.
Culture\n\nCulture is the way a group of people live and do things. Different groups have different cultures. Culture includes how people write, what they believe, the music they listen to, the clothes they wear, the food they cook, and what they do. People learn their culture from their family and friends. Each country has its own culture. For example, some people in Japan wear special clothes called kimonos and have tea ceremonies. Culture can also be different in different parts of a big country. A workplace can have its own culture too. Culture changes when people move to new places and share their ways with others.
Acoustics\n\nAcoustics is a kind of science. It looks at how sound moves through air, water, and hard things. Sound can bounce back and make an echo. It can also make things shake, which is called vibration. Some sounds are too high or too low for people to hear. A person who studies acoustics is called an acoustician. Another person who uses acoustics to build things is called an acoustical engineer.
Mamba\n\nA mamba is a snake that moves very fast. It lives in Africa. Most mambas live in trees, but the black mamba lives on the ground. Mambas hunt during the day and eat birds, lizards, and small animals. They have poison that can hurt people. Mambas usually do not want to be near people. When a mamba feels scared, it opens its mouth wide and leans forward. The black mamba is the most dangerous kind.
Helmet\n\nA helmet is a hard hat that keeps your head safe. People wear different helmets for different jobs and games. Soldiers wear metal helmets to protect from things that fly in the air. Construction workers wear plastic helmets so things that fall do not hurt them. People who ride bikes or horses wear helmets with soft foam inside. If they fall, the helmet helps keep their head from getting hurt. Some helmets have a dark window to protect eyes from bright light. Helmets can be made of metal, plastic, or leather. They have straps to stay on your head and soft padding inside.
Furniture\n\nFurniture is the word for things like chairs, tables, beds, and cupboards that you find in a house. People use furniture to sit, lie down, or put things on. Most furniture is made of wood, but some is made of leather or other materials. Different rooms have different furniture. A bedroom has a bed, a nightstand, and a dresser with drawers for clothes. A dining room has a table and chairs. An office has a desk and a chair. Furniture can be plain or fancy, and it helps make a house feel like home.
Heaven\n\nHeaven is a place that some people believe in. They think it is a perfect place where good people go after they die. In some stories, heaven is very beautiful and happy. People there do not feel sad or hurt. Different religions have different ideas about heaven. Some say it is a real place, and others say it is a feeling of being close to God.
Europa (moon)\n\nEuropa is a big moon that goes around the planet Jupiter. It is a little smaller than our own Moon. Europa has a very smooth and icy outside, like a giant frozen ball. There are cracks and lines on the ice, but not many holes. Scientists think there is a big ocean of water under the ice, kept warm by Jupiter's strong pull. Europa has a lot of water. It was found by a man named Galileo a long time ago. The name Europa comes from a princess in an old story.
Mass production\n\nMass production is when a factory makes a lot of the same thing very fast. The things made are called products. All the products look the same. Machines help make them. Many people work together to make many things in a short time.
Tomato\n\nA tomato is a round, shiny food that is usually red when it is ready to eat. It has a smooth skin and many tiny seeds inside. Tomatoes start out green and slowly turn red as they grow bigger. Some tomatoes are yellow or orange when they are ripe. People eat tomatoes in many ways: raw in salads, cooked in spaghetti sauce, or made into ketchup. Even though tomatoes have seeds and are really fruits, many people call them vegetables when they cook. Tomatoes are good for you because they have vitamin C and potassium. The tomato plant first grew in South America a long time ago. When people first brought tomatoes to Europe, some thought they were bad to eat, but now people all over the world enjoy them.
Native American\n\nNative Americans are the people who lived in the Americas before people from Europe came. They are also called Indians, but that name came from a mistake. Long ago, a man named Christopher Columbus thought he was in India, so he called them Indians. There are many different groups of Native Americans, called tribes. Each tribe has its own language and way of life. Some tribes moved around to find food. Others stayed in one place and built towns. Native Americans ate different foods depending on where they lived. They gave us chocolate, vanilla, and avocados. They made art with beads and musical instruments from things in nature. Many Native Americans died after Europeans came because of new sicknesses and fights over land. Today, there are still many Native Americans living in North and South America. Some live on reservations, and many live in cities.
Marble\n\nMarble is a hard rock that comes from the ground. It can be white, gray, pink, or many other colors. People use marble to make statues, buildings, and floors. Marble feels smooth and cold when you touch it. Some marbles have pretty swirls and patterns. Long ago, people in Greece and Rome used marble to build big temples and make beautiful statues. Today, you can see marble in some houses, museums, and churches. Marble dust is also used to make paint, toothpaste, and plastics.
Candle\n\nA candle is a stick of wax with a string in the middle. When you light the string on fire, it burns slowly and makes a small flame. The fire melts the wax, and sometimes the hot wax drips down the side. When the wax cools, it gets hard again. The flame is very hot and can burn you. If you blow on the flame, it goes out. A candle gets shorter as it burns until it is all gone. Long ago, people used candles to see at night. Today, some people still use candles when the lights go out, or because they look pretty or smell nice.
Vega\n\nVega is a star that shines very brightly in the night sky. It is the fifth brightest star you can see from Earth. Vega is not too far away, only 25 light-years. A light-year is how far light travels in one year. Vega is much bigger and hotter than our Sun. It spins very fast, which makes its middle bulge out. Vega has a ring of dust around it, like a big circle of tiny rocks and dust. This dust might come from things bumping into each other. Some scientists think there might be a big planet like Jupiter hiding in that dust ring. People have studied Vega for a long time. It was the first star, besides the Sun, that people took a picture of.
Croatia\n\nCroatia is a country in Europe. Its capital city is Zagreb. Croatia has a long coast next to the Adriatic Sea. There are many islands near the coast. Some islands have people living on them all year. Croatia has mountains, forests, and rivers. The Plitvice Lakes are famous lakes with pretty waterfalls. Many people visit Croatia to swim in the clear water and see old cities like Dubrovnik. Croatia became its own country in 1991. It joined the European Union in 2013.
Marsupial\n\nA marsupial is a kind of animal that carries its babies in a pouch on its belly. The babies are called joeys. When a joey is born, it is very tiny and crawls into its mother's pouch. There it drinks milk and stays warm and safe. When the joey gets bigger, it can leave the pouch for short times. When it is too big, it stops going back in. Kangaroos, koalas, and opossums are marsupials. Most marsupials live in Australia and nearby islands. Some live in South and Central America. One kind, the Virginia opossum, lives in North America.
Tunis\n\nTunis is a big city in Africa. It is the capital of a country called Tunisia. Many people live there. The city has houses, shops, and streets where people walk and play.
Pyrenees\n\nThe Pyrenees are a long line of very tall mountains in Europe. They sit between two countries, France and Spain, like a big wall. The mountains go all the way from the ocean on one side to the sea on the other side. Some of the mountains are so high that snow stays on top all year long.
Kuril Islands\n\nThe Kuril Islands are a group of islands between Russia and Japan. Some of the islands belong to Russia, and some are claimed by both countries. Japan wants four of the islands back. Russia said it would give back two small islands, but Japan did not agree. The islands are far away and have few people.
Biscuit\n\nA biscuit is a small baked food. In some countries, biscuits are sweet and people eat them with tea or milk. In other countries, biscuits are like small breads that you can eat with butter or jam. They are made from flour and baked in an oven.
Mongolia\n\nMongolia is a big country in Asia. It is between Russia and China. Mongolia has lots of grassy land called steppes. Some parts have mountains, and some parts have the Gobi Desert. Many people in Mongolia do not live in cities. They move from place to place with their animals. This is called being nomadic. Horses are very important in Mongolia. The biggest city is Ulaanbaatar. About half of the people live there. Mongolia has cold winters and mild summers. The sky is often blue, so people call it the 'Land of the Eternal Blue Sky.'
Photojournalism\n\nPhotojournalism is taking pictures to tell a story. A long time ago, a man named Mathew Brady took pictures of a big war. Many newspapers and magazines had people who took pictures for them. They tried to take the very best pictures. Now it is harder to make money doing this because there are many people taking pictures.
Estuary\n\nAn estuary is where a river meets the sea. The salt water from the sea mixes with the fresh water from the river. This mixed water is called brackish water. Estuaries can be big or small, and they often curve and bend. Many fish, crabs, and birds live in estuaries. Baby fish grow up there before they swim out to the ocean. Some big cities are built near estuaries.
Academy Award\n\nThe Academy Award is a prize for movies. It is also called the Oscar. The prize is a gold statue that is about as tall as a ruler and as heavy as a big bag of sugar. People give out the Oscars every year in Los Angeles. The best movies and actors get the prize. Some movies have won many Oscars, like 'Titanic' and 'Ben-Hur'. Walt Disney won the most Oscars ever, 26 of them.
Cumin\n\nCumin is a plant that grows flowers. People use its seeds to make food taste good. The seeds are small and brown. Cumin is used a lot in Indian and Pakistani cooking. It gives a warm, yummy flavor to dishes like rice and soup.
Wildlife conservation\n\nWildlife conservation is about taking care of wild animals and the places where they live. Some animals are in danger because their homes are being cut down or because people hunt them too much. Many animals might disappear forever if we do not help them. People all over the world work together to keep animals safe and to make sure they have enough food and space to live.
Thyme\n\nThyme is a small plant that smells and tastes strong. It has tiny green leaves and grows close to the ground. People use thyme in cooking to make food taste good, like in soups, stews, and with meat. Thyme likes warm, sunny places and dry soil. It can grow back every year. Long ago, people thought thyme gave courage and put it under pillows to help sleep. Thyme can also be used as medicine for coughs and sore throats.
Nut (fruit)\n\nA nut is a fruit with a hard shell. Some plants grow nuts. The shell keeps the seed safe inside. Nuts have good things for your body, like protein and fats. People and animals eat nuts. Some nuts are called almonds, walnuts, and peanuts. But not all nuts are true nuts. Some people get sick if they eat nuts.
Taklamakan Desert\n\nThe Taklamakan Desert is a very dry and sandy place in China. There is almost no water there, so it is dangerous to walk across. Long ago, people traveled through the desert with camels on a road called the Silk Road. They stopped at towns with water and trees called oases. Some of those towns are now old and empty. Today, people called Uyghurs live near the desert.
Japanese literature\n\nJapanese literature is stories and poems written in the Japanese language. Long ago, Japanese writing was a lot like Chinese writing because Japan and China talked to each other a lot. Over time, Japanese writers made their own special way of writing. A long time ago, women wrote many famous stories and poems. Later, when the emperor's court became less strong, women did not write as many famous works.
Web browser\n\nA web browser is a computer program that lets you look at websites on the Internet. You can use it on a computer, a tablet, or a phone. Many web browsers are free. You type the name of a website into a box at the top, and the browser shows you the page. It gets pictures, words, and videos from the Internet and puts them on your screen so you can see them.
Litre\n\nA litre is a way to measure how much space something takes up. People use litres to measure liquids like water, milk, and juice. One litre is the same as a box that is 10 centimetres tall, 10 centimetres wide, and 10 centimetres long. A litre of water weighs exactly one kilogram. You might see milk sold in one-litre cartons at the store. There are also smaller measures: 1000 millilitres make one litre. The symbol for litre is a letter L or a small l.
Freezing\n\nFreezing is when a liquid gets very cold and turns into a solid. When water freezes, it becomes ice. The cold makes the tiny bits of water slow down and stick together in a neat pattern. Freezing happens outside when it is very cold, like when puddles turn to ice or snow falls from the sky. Freezing also helps keep food fresh in the freezer. When you put water in the freezer, it turns into ice cubes. Salt water freezes at a colder temperature than plain water, so the ocean does not freeze as easily as a lake. Freezing is the opposite of melting, which is when ice turns back into water.
Natural satellite\n\nA natural satellite is a moon. A moon is a big rock that goes around a planet. The Earth has one moon. We call it the Moon. The Moon does not make its own light. It shines because the Sun lights it up. The Moon looks different at different times. Sometimes it looks round and bright. Sometimes it looks like a thin smile. This is called the phases of the Moon. The Moon takes about 28 days to go through all its phases. People have walked on the Moon. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin were the first. They went there in a spaceship called Apollo 11.
Observable universe\n\nThe observable universe is everything we can see from Earth. It is like a big ball around us. Light from far away takes a long time to reach us. The universe is very old, about 14 billion years. The observable universe is huge, about 93 billion light-years across. We cannot see everything because some light has not reached us yet.
Azerbaijan\n\nAzerbaijan is a country that sits between Europe and Asia. It is next to Russia, Georgia, Armenia, Iran, and the Caspian Sea. The capital city is Baku. Many people in Azerbaijan speak Azerbaijani. Most people are Muslim. The country has mountains, forests, and animals like the Karabakh horse. People in Azerbaijan like to eat rice with saffron and drink black tea. They also enjoy music, dancing, and playing backgammon.
Comet\n\nA comet is a big ball of ice and dust that moves in space. People sometimes call comets "dirty snowballs." Comets are not like rocks in space. They have long tails that point away from the sun. The sun melts the ice on the comet, and the tail is made of the melted stuff. The hard middle part of a comet is called the nucleus. It is very dark and does not shine much. Some comets come back again and again. Other comets visit only once. Long ago, people were scared of comets. They thought comets were bad signs. Now we know comets are just ice balls going around the sun.
Robbery\n\nRobbery is when someone takes something that is not theirs by making the other person scared or by hurting them. A person who does this is called a robber. If someone takes something without scaring or hurting anyone, that is called stealing, not robbery.
Deflation\n\nDeflation is when things you buy cost less money than before. It is the opposite of when prices go up. Sometimes people wait to buy things because they think prices will get even lower. Then stores sell less, and some workers may lose their jobs. Deflation can be a sign that a country's money is not doing well. Governments try to help by making taxes lower for companies, so they can still make money even with lower prices.
Outsider art\n\nOutsider art is art made by people who did not go to art school to learn how to draw or paint. These artists make art from their own ideas and feelings. They do not care what other artists are doing. Some outsider artists build strange houses or make paintings and sculptures. Their art is not usually sold in stores or shown in museums.
Girl\n\nA girl is a young female person. A girl is a child or a teenager. When a girl grows up, her body changes and she becomes a woman. The word "girl" was used a long time ago. Sometimes people call grown women "girls" too. The opposite of a girl is a boy. Girls can wear dresses, skirts, or pants. Many girls have long hair, but some have short hair.
Cotton\n\nCotton is a soft, fluffy plant fiber that grows around the seeds of the cotton plant. It feels like a little cloud. People take the cotton from the plant and spin it into thread. Then they make the thread into cloth. The cloth is used to make clothes, especially for hot weather, and also bandages. Cotton plants have pretty flowers and grow in many warm places around the world. The fluffy part helps the seeds float in the wind to new places. Cotton can soak up a lot of water, like a sponge.
Mosquito\n\nA mosquito is a small flying bug. It is a type of fly. Only girl mosquitoes bite people and suck their blood. They need the blood to make eggs. Boy mosquitoes eat sweet plant juice. Mosquitoes lay eggs in water. The babies wiggle in the water and breathe through tubes. They grow up to be mosquitoes. Mosquito bites can make you itchy. Some mosquitoes carry germs that make people sick. Many fish and dragonflies eat mosquitoes.
Painted turtle\n\nA painted turtle is a kind of turtle that lives in North America. It has a dark, smooth top shell and green or black skin with red, orange, or yellow stripes on its neck, legs, and tail. The male is smaller than the female. Painted turtles live in slow-moving water like ponds and marshes where plants grow. They eat water plants, tiny bugs, and small fish. They like to sit in the sun to get warm because they are cold-blooded. In winter, they sleep in the mud at the bottom of the water. The mother turtle digs a hole on land and lays eggs. Baby turtles grow up and become adults after a few years.
Sphere\n\nA sphere is a round shape that looks like a ball. Every part of its outside is the same distance from the middle. A big sphere is called a globe, like the Earth. A small sphere is called a ball, like a basketball or a playground ball. The Sun is also shaped like a sphere.
Sauropod\n\nA sauropod is a very big dinosaur with a long neck and a long tail. It had a small head, thick legs like pillars, and teeth like pegs. Some sauropods were the biggest animals that ever lived on land. They lived a long time ago, in the time of dinosaurs. Sauropods ate plants. They lived in groups, like a big family. They laid many eggs in the same place every year. Sauropods liked to be near water, like lakes or rivers. They could swim a little, but they mostly stayed on land. Their bones have been found all over the world, even in cold places like Antarctica.
Gardening\n\nGardening is when people grow plants like flowers, trees, or vegetables. Some people do gardening outside in their backyard or in pots on a balcony. Others do gardening inside their house or in a greenhouse, which is a special building with a glass roof that lets sunlight in. People use tools like a spade, a watering can, and a hose to dig and water the plants. Gardening can be a fun hobby, and some people grow food for their own family to eat.
Norway\n\nNorway is a country in the north of Europe. It is next to the North Sea and the Atlantic Ocean. The king of Norway is Harald the 5th. About 5 million people live there. The capital city is Oslo. People in Norway speak Norwegian. Norway has mountains, forests, and lots of fish in the sea. Many tourists come to see the Northern Lights, which are pretty colors in the sky at night. Norway also has oil and gas under the sea. The country is very cold in winter, and people like to go skiing.
Epidemic\n\nAn epidemic is when a sickness spreads to many people at the same time. It moves from person to person very fast. Doctors try to stop it by giving medicine and shots. If the sickness spreads all over the world, it is called a pandemic.
Charcoal\n\nCharcoal is a black, powdery thing that comes from wood. To make charcoal, wood is heated in a special place with almost no air. The wood does not burn but turns into charcoal. People use charcoal to cook food on a grill outside. Artists also use charcoal to draw pictures.
Burj Khalifa\n\nThe Burj Khalifa is a very tall building in Dubai. It is the tallest building in the whole world. The building is so tall that it goes up into the sky like a giant needle. It has 162 floors. People live and work inside the building. There is a big fountain outside that shoots water up high and lights up with many colors. The building took almost six years to build and opened in 2010. Many workers from faraway countries helped build it.
Tashkent\n\nTashkent is a big city and the capital of a country called Uzbekistan. It is in Central Asia, and many people live there. The name Tashkent means "Stone City." People have lived there for a very long time. The city is near a river and has cold, snowy winters and hot, dry summers. Sometimes the ground shakes in Tashkent, and a big shake in 1966 broke many buildings. Tashkent has old buildings like a school called Kukeldash Madrasah and a pretty theater called Navoi Theater. People in Tashkent like to play soccer, and there are many soccer teams there.
Learning\n\nLearning is how you get new ideas and learn to do new things. Your brain changes a little bit every time you learn something. The brain has special parts that help you remember and pay attention. You can learn by watching others, by practicing, or by having someone teach you. Learning happens in school, at home, and when you play. Animals can learn too, like dogs learning to sit for a treat. Learning is something you do your whole life.
French literature\n\nFrench literature is the stories and poems that people write in the French language. Some of these stories come from France, and some come from other countries where people speak French, like Belgium, Canada, and Senegal. The French language came from Latin, which is an old language. Many French writers have won big prizes for their stories.
Irrigation sprinkler\n\nAn irrigation sprinkler is a tool that sprays water on plants. It helps water the grass and flowers in a garden or on a farm. The sprinkler needs water that is pushed hard through pipes. Some sprinklers are small and sit on the ground. Others pop up from the grass when they turn on. The water comes out in a spray and makes the plants wet so they can grow.
Kuiper belt\n\nThe Kuiper belt is a big area in space far away from the Sun. It is past the planet Neptune. Many icy rocks live there. Some of them are round and very big, like Pluto. Pluto is a dwarf planet in the Kuiper belt. The Kuiper belt has lots of these icy rocks, more than we can count.
Wi-Fi\n\nWi-Fi is a way to connect to the internet without wires. It uses invisible waves to send information through the air. Many things at home use Wi-Fi, like phones, tablets, and computers. You can use Wi-Fi anywhere in the world if you have the right password. Wi-Fi is safe and not bad for you.
Cement\n\nCement is a powder that gets hard and sticks things together. People mix it with water and sand or small stones to make concrete. Concrete is used to build sidewalks, walls, and houses. Cement can also be spread on walls to keep them safe from rain. It is made by heating limestone and clay until they turn into a hard rock, then grinding that rock into a fine powder. Cement is very strong and can even be used underwater.
Damselfly\n\nA damselfly is an insect that looks like a dragonfly but is smaller and weaker at flying. Most damselflies rest with their wings held together along their body. They have big eyes that are far apart and can see movement very well. Damselflies are often bright and colorful, but they hide in bushes where it is shady. They eat other insects. Baby damselflies live in the water and eat tiny bugs there too. Damselflies live on every continent except Antarctica.
Sri Lanka\n\nSri Lanka is a country that is an island in the Indian Ocean, near India. The biggest city is Colombo, and the capital is Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte. Many people live there, over 22 million. The people are mostly Sinhalese, who speak Sinhala and are Buddhist. There are also Tamils, who speak Tamil and are Hindu, and Moors, who are Muslim. The flag has a lion holding a sword, and the colors stand for the different groups. Sri Lanka was once called Ceylon. It was ruled by other countries like Portugal, the Netherlands, and Britain. It became its own country in 1948. The country grows tea, and for a long time it was the biggest seller of tea in the world. There are also rubber and coconut trees. The weather is warm and tropical, with beaches and forests.
Powerlifting\n\nPowerlifting is a sport where people try to lift very heavy things. They do three special lifts: a squat, a bench press, and a deadlift. In a squat, you bend your knees and stand back up with a heavy bar on your back. In a bench press, you lie on a bench and push a heavy bar up from your chest. In a deadlift, you bend down and pull a heavy bar up from the floor. The person who lifts the most weight wins.
Plankton\n\nPlankton are tiny plants and animals that float in the ocean. They live near the top of the water where the sun shines. Plankton cannot swim very well, so they drift with the currents. Many sea animals eat plankton for food. Big whales and sharks eat lots of plankton. Small fish babies also eat plankton when they grow. Plankton need food from the land to grow big and strong.
Value\n\nValue is how much something is worth. Sometimes you can tell the value by the price you pay for it. But some things are very valuable even if they are free, like water. People may think different things have different value. That is okay.
Copyright\n\nCopyright is a law that says a person who makes something, like a book, a song, or a picture, owns it. No one else can copy it without asking first. This helps the person who made it earn money. If someone copies without permission, the owner can tell a judge. The judge may make the copier pay money or even go to jail. Copyright lasts for many years, even after the person who made it dies. After that, anyone can copy it. Sometimes people can copy a tiny bit for a school report or a news story. That is called fair use.
Squirrel\n\nA squirrel is a small animal with a long, fluffy tail. Squirrels live in trees and can climb very fast. They eat nuts, seeds, berries, and pine cones. Sometimes they eat bird eggs and bugs. In the fall, tree squirrels hide food to eat in the winter. Squirrels can be gray, black, red, or brown. They have sharp teeth and big eyes. Baby squirrels are born blind and deaf. Their mom takes care of them. Many animals like foxes and snakes hunt squirrels.
Train station\n\nA train station is a place where trains stop so people can get on or off. Trains run on tracks, and the station is next to the tracks. There are flat parts called platforms where people stand to wait for the train. Many stations have a place to buy tickets, benches to sit on, and a roof to keep dry. Some stations are very big and have shops and restaurants. The busiest train station in the world is in Tokyo, Japan. A station at the end of a train line is called a terminus, where trains have to stop and turn around.
Nut (hardware)\n\nA nut is a small piece of metal with a hole that has a spiral groove inside. It is used with a bolt to hold things together. Nuts and bolts are a pair. Most nuts have six sides so a tool can turn them. Nuts come in different strengths to match the bolt they go with.
Summer\n\nSummer is one of the four seasons. It is the hottest time of the year. In some places, summer has a lot of rain. In other places, it is dry. When it is summer in the north part of the world, it is winter in the south part. Many people go to the beach or have picnics in summer. Some places even get snow in summer.
Sky\n\nThe sky is the big space above your head that you see when you look up. During the day, the sky looks blue. At night, it looks dark blue or black. The Sun, Moon, and stars are in the sky. Sometimes you see clouds, rain, or lightning in the sky. Birds and airplanes also fly in the sky. Other planets have different sky colors. For example, the sky on Mars is pink.
Motivation\n\nMotivation is what makes you want to do something. It is like a push inside you that helps you get what you need or want. For example, when you are hungry, that feeling makes you want to eat food. Animals also have motivation, like when they are thirsty and look for water. People can have big plans, like learning to read or saving money for a toy. Sometimes a smile from a grown-up can make you feel good and want to try harder. Motivation can come from inside you, like when you feel proud of finishing a puzzle. It can also come from outside, like when you get a treat for being good.
Singing\n\nSinging is making music with your voice. When you sing, your voice goes high and low to make a tune called a song. People have been singing for a very long time, maybe since the beginning of people. Birds sing too, like the little birds that make pretty sounds outside. To sing, you use air from your lungs. You can practice to make your voice stronger and better. Some people sing in a group called a choir. Others sing alone. You can sing anywhere, even in the shower! Almost anyone can learn to sing if they try.
Beowulf\n\nBeowulf is a very old story about a brave fighter. A long time ago, a man named Beowulf went to help a king whose people were being hurt by a scary monster named Grendel. Beowulf fought Grendel with his bare hands and tore off the monster's arm. Then Grendel's mother came to get revenge, and Beowulf fought her too and won. Later, Beowulf became a king and fought a dragon. He killed the dragon but got hurt and died. The story of Beowulf has been told in books, plays, and movies.
Sewing machine\n\nA sewing machine is a tool that puts thread through fabric to make clothes and other things. It works much faster than sewing by hand. Some sewing machines can also make pretty designs on cloth. People use them at home to fix or make their own clothes. Big sewing machines in factories make lots of clothes very quickly. The machine has a needle that goes up and down, and a foot pedal that you push to make it go. You can sew straight lines or zigzag shapes with it.
Mullet (fish)\n\nA mullet is a fish that lives in warm and cool waters near coasts all over the world. Some mullets also live in fresh water. People have eaten mullets as food for a very long time. Mullets have two separate fins on their backs and small triangle-shaped mouths. They eat tiny bits of dead plants and animals. Mullets sometimes jump out of the water. One jump is fast and straight to get away from enemies. Another jump is slower and makes a big splash. Scientists are not sure why they do the slow jump.
National Gallery of Art\n\nThe National Gallery of Art is a big building in Washington, D.C., where people can look at paintings and statues. It was built a long time ago, in 1938. A man named Andrew W. Mellon gave money and art to help start the museum. Many other people also gave their art to the museum. Now it has lots of beautiful paintings and statues from America and other places. You can walk around and see them for free.
Brazilian jiu-jitsu\n\nBrazilian jiu-jitsu is a way to play fight on the ground. It is a sport and a way to protect yourself. A man named Helio Gracie made it up. He took moves from Judo and changed them to work better on the ground. People who do Brazilian jiu-jitsu wear a special jacket and pants called a gi. Sometimes they just wear a tight shirt. They learn how to hold someone down and how to get free. They also learn safe ways to make someone stop moving, like gentle squeezes and twists.
Artichoke\n\nAn artichoke is a plant that people can eat. It has a big flower bud with thick green scales. The bottom part of the bud is called the heart, and it is soft and tasty. People boil or grill artichokes. You can pull off the leaves and eat the soft part at the bottom. Artichokes grow in warm places like countries near the sea. They are picked in spring and early summer. Artichokes are good for you because they have vitamins.
Dwarf planet\n\nA dwarf planet is a big round thing in space that goes around the Sun. It is like a planet, but smaller and not as important. Dwarf planets live in different parts of our solar system. Some are in the asteroid belt, and some are far away near Pluto. There are nine dwarf planets that scientists know about. Their names are Ceres, Pluto, Orcus, Haumea, Makemake, Quaoar, Sedna, Gonggong, and Eris. In 2015, two space ships visited Ceres and Pluto and took pictures of them.
Nairobi\n\nNairobi is a big city in Africa. It is the capital of Kenya, a country far from the ocean. The name Nairobi means 'place of cool water' in the Maasai language. Many people live there, more than six million. The city started a long time ago as a place where trains stopped. Today, Nairobi has many big stores where people shop. Some people call it 'Nairobbery' because there can be bad people who take things that are not theirs.
Detergent\n\nDetergent is something you use to wash clothes and make them clean. It comes as a powder or a liquid. You put it in a washing machine with water and dirty clothes. The detergent grabs the dirt and helps the water take it away. Then the machine spins the clothes to get the water out. After that, the clothes are clean and wet. You can put them in a dryer or hang them up to dry.
Rwanda\n\nRwanda is a country in East Africa. It is called the "Land of a Thousand Hills" because it has many mountains and hills. The capital city is Kigali. Rwanda does not touch the ocean. It is a small country, but many people live there. Rwanda has clean cities and national parks where mountain gorillas live. Long ago, a very sad time happened when many people were hurt and killed. Now Rwanda is peaceful and growing again.
Human tooth\n\nA human tooth is a hard, white part inside your mouth. Teeth help you eat by cutting and smashing food into small pieces before you swallow. You have different kinds of teeth. The front teeth are flat and cut food like scissors. The pointy teeth next to them tear food apart. The back teeth are big and flat and grind food into mush. Your teeth are very strong, but you need to brush them every day to keep them clean and healthy.
Asparagus\n\nAsparagus is a plant that people can eat. There are many kinds of asparagus, over 300. Some are grown just for looks, like the "asparagus fern," which is not a real fern. The kind people eat is called "Asparagus officinalis." It is a vegetable that comes up in spring. Eating asparagus can make your pee smell funny.
Nurse shark\n\nA nurse shark is a type of shark that lives near the bottom of the ocean. It has a flat head, small eyes, and long whiskers near its mouth. Nurse sharks are usually light yellow or dark brown. Baby nurse sharks have small black spots all over their bodies. These sharks are slow and sleepy during the day. They rest on the sandy bottom or in caves with other nurse sharks. At night, they wake up and hunt for food like fish, crabs, and clams. Nurse sharks are not mean to people unless someone bothers them. They can stay still in the water, which helps them catch food. A mother nurse shark can have up to 29 babies at one time.
Diamond\n\nA diamond is a very hard, clear stone that comes from deep inside the Earth. Diamonds are made of the same stuff as coal, but they are much harder. They are the hardest natural thing in the world. People use diamonds to cut and polish other things. Some diamonds are clear, and some are yellow, red, blue, green, or pink. Big diamonds are rare and cost a lot of money. Only some diamonds are used in jewelry. The rest are used for tools like drill bits and saws. Diamonds are found where volcanoes used to be. Sometimes people find them on the ground, but other times they have to dig deep mines.
Hokkaidō\n\nHokkaidō is a big island in Japan. It is the northernmost island of Japan. It is very cold in winter and lots of snow falls. In summer it is warm or hot. Many people grow food there. It is the second biggest island in Japan.
Grief\n\nGrief is a sad feeling you have when you lose someone or something you love very much. It can happen when a pet dies or when someone you care about goes away. When you feel grief, you might cry a lot, feel angry, or feel very quiet and not know what to do. Everyone feels grief in their own way, and that is okay.
Achilles\n\nAchilles was a very strong hero from a long time ago. He fought in a big war called the Trojan War. His mother was a water fairy named Thetis. When Achilles was a baby, his mother dipped him in a magic river to make him very strong. But she held him by his heel, so that part stayed soft. Later, a bad man shot an arrow into his heel, and that hurt him very much. Today, people call a weak spot an "Achilles' heel." The strong cord at the back of your foot is also called the Achilles tendon.
Voltage\n\nVoltage is what pushes electricity through wires. It is like a force that makes tiny things called charges move. When charges move, we get electric current. Voltage is measured in volts. A battery has voltage, like 1.5 volts or 9 volts. The wall socket in your house has voltage too, like 120 volts. There are two kinds of voltage: DC voltage, which stays the same, like in a battery, and AC voltage, which changes back and forth, like in a wall socket. You can measure voltage with a tool called a voltmeter. Voltage always needs two points to measure between, like the two ends of a battery.
Medical diagnosis\n\nA medical diagnosis is when a doctor finds out what is making someone sick. The doctor asks questions and looks at the person's body. Sometimes the doctor does tests, like taking a little bit of blood or pee to check in a lab. X-rays are another kind of test that take pictures inside the body. When the doctor knows what is wrong, they can help the person feel better.
Sleep\n\nSleep is a time when your body rests. Most animals, including people, sleep. When you sleep, your body is quiet and your eyes are closed. Your brain still works, but you are not awake. Sleep helps you feel better and have energy for the next day. At night, the sun goes down, and many people go to sleep. Some animals sleep during the day and are awake at night. When you sleep, you might have dreams. Dreams are like little stories in your head. Babies sleep a lot, about 18 hours each day. Grown-ups need less sleep, about 7 to 9 hours. If you do not get enough sleep, you might feel tired and grumpy. It is important to sleep in a quiet, dark place. Taking a short nap in the afternoon can also help you feel rested.
Fighter aircraft\n\nA fighter aircraft is a small military plane that fights other airplanes. It is very fast and can turn quickly. Fighter planes have strong engines and carry weapons like missiles, machine guns, and bombs. Some fighters attack things on the ground, like trucks or buildings. But their main job is to fight other planes in the sky.
Atacama Desert\n\nThe Atacama Desert is a very dry place in Chile. It is one of the driest places on Earth. In some parts, rain does not fall for many years. The desert is cold at night and warm during the day. People who live there get water from fog. They put up plastic sheets, and fog drops water into pans. This water is used for drinking and growing food. Long ago, three countries fought over this desert because it had special salt mines. The oldest mummies in the world were found here.
Civil union\n\nA civil union is a special promise between two people. It gives them rights like married people have. In some countries, two people of the same sex can make this promise. The first country to have civil unions was Denmark. Later, Denmark let these people marry instead.
Aphrodite\n\nAphrodite is a make-believe goddess from old Greek stories. She is the goddess of love and beauty. People said she was the most beautiful of all the goddesses. She was married to Hephaestus, the god of fire and metal. But she liked to spend time with other gods, like Ares, the god of war. Some stories say she was born from sea foam. Her special animals are the dove, the sparrow, and the swan. The rose and the dolphin are also her symbols. The Romans called her Venus.
Everglades\n\nThe Everglades is a big, flat, wet place in Florida. It is like a slow river that moves through grass and trees. Many animals live there, like alligators, crocodiles, birds, and fish. It is the only place where crocodiles and alligators live together. The Everglades is a national park, which means people take care of it. Many people visit every year to see the animals and the water. But people have changed the water, and now fewer birds live there.
Mesoamerica\n\nMesoamerica is a place in the middle of America. It starts in Mexico and goes down to Costa Rica. Long ago, native people lived there before other people came. The cacao tree, which gives us chocolate, grows there.
Mermaid\n\nA mermaid is a make-believe creature with a girl's head and body on top and a fish tail on the bottom. Mermaids live in the sea. Sometimes they sit on rocks above the water. Old stories say mermaids sing pretty songs that make sailors crash their boats. Some mermaids are nice and help people, but others are mean. The most famous mermaid story is "The Little Mermaid" by Hans Christian Andersen. Many movies and books have mermaids in them. Some people dress up in mermaid tails for fun.
Flight\n\nFlight is when something moves through the air. Birds can fly by flapping their wings. Insects like bees and butterflies can fly too. Bats also fly. Some animals do not flap their wings but glide through the air, like flying fish and flying squirrels. The fastest flying animal is the peregrine falcon. People make things that fly, like balloons and airplanes. Even tiny seeds and germs can float in the air.
Airport\n\nAn airport is a place where airplanes take off and land. It has a long flat road called a runway for planes. There is a big building called a terminal where people wait for their plane. The doors where you get on the plane are called gates. There are also hangars where planes sleep when they are not flying. A tall building called a control tower tells planes where to go. Some airports are very big and let you fly to other countries. Others are small and only let you fly inside your own country. Big airports have shops and places to eat. Airports are very safe. You have to walk through a special machine that finds metal. Your bags go through a machine that looks inside. You cannot bring big bottles of water or drinks on the plane.
Lift (force)\n\nLift is a force that pushes things up. When air moves fast over a wing, the wing gets pushed up. This is how airplanes stay in the sky. The wing pushes air down, and the air pushes the wing up. Helicopters use spinning blades to make lift. Boats use propellers to push water and move forward. Even sailboats use lift from the wind to go sideways. Race cars have wings that push them down so they stay on the ground.
Skirt\n\nA skirt is a piece of clothing that hangs down from your waist. People have worn skirts for a very long time, even long ago. In some places, both men and women wear skirts. In other places, mostly women wear skirts. Some skirts are long and some are short. A kilt is a special skirt that men wear in Scotland. Skirts can be made of many different materials like cloth or straw. You can wear a skirt to a party or just for playing.
Wound\n\nA wound is a hurt on your skin. It can happen when you get a cut, a scrape, or a bruise. A cut happens when something sharp tears your skin. A scrape happens when you fall and rub your skin. A bruise is a dark spot on your skin from a bump. Your body works hard to fix a wound. It makes a scab to cover the cut and keep it clean. After a few days, the scab falls off and new skin grows underneath. You should keep a wound clean and put a bandage on it to help it heal.
Bronze\n\nBronze is a kind of metal. It is made by mixing copper with a little bit of tin. This makes it stronger than copper alone. Long ago, people in Egypt made the first bronze. They used it to make tools and things. That time is called the Bronze Age. Bronze does not break down easily in air or water. Today, we still use bronze to make bells, parts of machines, and other things that need to last a long time.
Mediterranean Sea\n\nThe Mediterranean Sea is a big body of water between Europe, Africa, and Asia. It is almost all around by land. The sea connects to the Atlantic Ocean through a narrow water path called the Strait of Gibraltar. People built a long canal called the Suez Canal to connect it to the Red Sea. The water is very salty and deep blue. Many old civilizations lived near this sea. People used it for travel, trade, and fishing. Today, it still helps countries trade with each other.
Harmonica\n\nA harmonica is a small musical instrument that you play with your mouth. You blow or suck air into the holes on its side to make sounds. The sounds come from tiny moving parts inside a metal case. Harmonicas are used in many kinds of music like blues, folk, rock, and pop. Some harmonicas have a button that lets you play more notes. People also call it a mouth organ or a blues harp.
Finland\n\nFinland is a country in the north of Europe. It is next to Sweden, Norway, Russia, and Estonia. The capital city is Helsinki. About 5.5 million people live there. Most people speak Finnish, and some speak Swedish. Finland has many forests, lakes, and islands. The weather is cold in winter with snow, and warm in summer. People in Finland like saunas, nature, and summer cottages. Popular sports are ice hockey and skiing. The national animal is the brown bear. Finland became its own country in 1917.
Lake Winnipeg\n\nLake Winnipeg is a very big lake in Canada. It is north of a city called Winnipeg. Many small towns are near the lake, like Gimli and Grand Beach. People go to the lake to swim, fish, and play in the water. The lake is so big that you cannot see the other side.
Tunnel\n\nA tunnel is a path that goes underground. Some tunnels are for cars and some are for trains. A tunnel can also be for ships or for wires that carry electricity. People dig tunnels in soft sand or hard rock. One way to build a tunnel is to dig a big hole, put a roof on top, and cover it with dirt. That is called cut-and-cover. Building a tunnel takes a long time and costs a lot of money. The Channel Tunnel between France and England is very long. It is 50 kilometers long.
Capsicum\n\nCapsicum is a plant that grows fruits we call peppers. Some peppers are sweet and mild, like bell peppers. Other peppers are hot and spicy, like chili peppers. The hot feeling comes from a special part inside the pepper called capsaicin. Birds can eat hot peppers without feeling the burn, but most animals do not like them. People eat peppers raw in salads, cooked in food, or stuffed with cheese or meat. Peppers can be green, red, yellow, or orange. They grow in many places around the world.
Variable star\n\nA variable star is a star that sometimes looks brighter and sometimes looks dimmer. Most stars, like our Sun, stay about the same brightness. But some stars change a lot. There are different kinds of variable stars. Some throw out gas or dust, which makes them change. Some are very young and not yet fully formed. Big giant stars can lose parts of themselves and change brightness. The biggest change happens when a star explodes. That is called a supernova. A supernova can shine brighter than a whole galaxy for a little while. It happens when a very heavy star dies. The star blows up and sends its parts flying into space. The leftover cloud is called a supernova remnant. One famous remnant is the Crab Nebula. People saw that supernova a long time ago in the year 1054.
Pacific Ring of Fire\n\nThe Pacific Ring of Fire is a big circle around the Pacific Ocean. In this place, there are many volcanoes and earthquakes. Most of the world's volcanoes are here. The ring is very long, like a giant belt. Most of the world's earthquakes happen here too. The ground moves and shakes because big pieces of the Earth's crust bump into each other.
Otter\n\nAn otter is an animal that lives near water. Otters are long and slim with four short legs. They have thick fur that keeps them warm in cold water. Their fur is brown on top and lighter underneath. Otters are great swimmers and can stay underwater for 8 minutes. They have webbed feet and a long tail to help them swim. Otters eat meat like fish, crabs, and frogs. They hunt for food in rivers and lakes. Otters are very playful and like to slide down hills and chase each other. A group of otters is called a romp. They live in nests called holts. Otters live on every continent except Australia and Antarctica. Some otters live in the sea and are called sea otters. Sea otters use rocks to break open shells. Otters can live 8 to 9 years in the wild and up to 21 years with people.
Fishing industry\n\nThe fishing industry is all the work people do to catch fish from the ocean, rivers, and lakes. Some people fish for fun, and some fish to sell the fish to stores and restaurants.
Flying fish\n\nFlying fish are small fish that live in warm ocean water all over the world. They do not really fly like birds. Instead, they jump out of the water and glide through the air. Their fins are big and stiff, like little wings. They have a tail that helps them push off the water. Flying fish glide to get away from bigger fish that want to eat them. They can glide a long way, sometimes as far as a big playground. Some flying fish can even glide for almost a minute by dipping their tail in the water to push again.
Oarfish\n\nAn oarfish is a very long, flat fish that lives in the ocean. It is the longest fish with bones in the whole world. Oarfish live far from the shore and deep in the water. They are very rare, so people almost never see them. Sometimes a dead oarfish washes up on the beach. When an oarfish is sick, it swims up near the top of the water. Long ago, people thought these fish were sea monsters. The name "oarfish" comes from how their bodies look like long, flat oars.
Canvas\n\nCanvas is a thick, strong cloth. It is made from cotton that is woven together. People use canvas to make tents and sails for boats. It is also used for painting pictures. Some shoes are made from canvas. Canvas feels rough and lasts a long time. It is often white or light tan.
Gear\n\nA gear is a wheel with bumps called teeth. The teeth of one gear fit into the teeth of another gear. When one gear turns, it makes the other gear turn too. Gears help machines move. You can find gears inside clocks, bikes, and cars. Most gears are made of metal, but some are made of plastic.
Cosmetics\n\nCosmetics are things people put on their body to change how they look. They are used to make someone feel pretty or to look different for a show. Lipstick, powder, and lotion are types of cosmetics. Most cosmetics are used on the face. Some clean the skin, and some color the skin. Cosmetics do not last forever and need to be put on again. Long ago, people in Egypt and Greece used cosmetics too.
Herbal medicine\n\nHerbal medicine is medicine that comes from plants. People use leaves, flowers, roots, and seeds to make it. Some herbal medicine also uses parts of animals or special rocks. People have used plants as medicine for a very long time. The first written recipes for herbal medicine were made 5,000 years ago.
Pollution\n\nPollution is when bad things get into the air, water, or ground and make it dirty. There are many kinds of pollution. Water pollution happens when yucky stuff like trash, soap, or oil gets into rivers and lakes. This makes the water bad for fish and other animals that live there. Air pollution is when smoke and gases from cars, factories, and fires go into the air. This can make it hard for people to breathe and can hurt plants and animals. Noise pollution is when loud sounds like cars, planes, or loud music hurt our ears and make it hard to think. People are trying to stop pollution by using clean energy from the sun and wind.
Lightning\n\nLightning is a big spark of electricity that happens during a thunderstorm. It makes the air very hot and fast, and that makes a loud sound called thunder. Lightning can go from one cloud to another cloud, or from a cloud to the ground. It is very hot, even hotter than the sun. Many lightning bolts hit the Earth every second. Lightning can hit tall buildings like the Empire State Building many times in one year. People can be hurt by lightning, so it is important to stay inside during a thunderstorm.
Syria\n\nSyria is a country in the Middle East, in the western part of Asia. It is next to Turkey, Lebanon, Jordan, Iraq, and Palestine. The western part of Syria touches the Mediterranean Sea. The biggest city is Aleppo, and the capital city is Damascus. Most people in Syria believe in Islam. Syria has a very long history. For a long time, there was a war in Syria that started in 2011. Many people were hurt. In December 2024, the old rulers left, and a new government started. Syria is mostly dry and hot, with some green land near the sea. The Euphrates River is an important river in Syria. Many people live near the river and the coast. Children go to school for free from age 6 to 12. People in Syria like to play football, basketball, swimming, and tennis.
Butter\n\nButter is a yellow food made from milk. It comes from cream, which is the fatty part of milk. People make butter by shaking or mixing cream for a long time until the fat sticks together. You can spread butter on bread or use it to cook food. Most butter comes from cows, but it can also come from sheep, goats, or other animals. Some butter has salt added to it. Butter melts when it gets warm.
Husband\n\nA husband is a man who is married. Married means a man and a woman are a family by law. At the wedding, the husband is called the groom. Some husbands have one wife, and some have more than one wife.
Spanish language\n\nSpanish is a language that many people speak. It started from Latin a long time ago. People in Spain and many other countries speak Spanish. Over 489 million people speak Spanish as their first language. Spanish is the second most common language in the United States. In school in Spain, children learn Spanish. The word for Spanish in Spanish is "español." Spanish is also called Castilian because it came from a place called Castile.
Interest\n\nInterest is extra money you pay when you borrow money, or extra money you get when you lend money. If you borrow 100 dollars and the interest is 1 dollar each year, you pay 1 dollar every year. That is called simple interest.
