When your part of the Earth faces away from the Sun, it is nighttime and you see darkness. One day has both daytime and nighttime and lasts 24 hours.
South Pole\n\nThe South Pole is the very bottom of the Earth. It is in a cold, icy place called Antarctica. From the South Pole, every direction you look is north. The South Pole is on land covered by thick ice, more than a mile deep. It is very cold and windy there. The sun comes up only once a year and stays for half a year, then it goes away for half a year of dark winter. The first people to reach the South Pole were from Norway, led by Roald Amundsen, in 1911. Today there is a big science station at the South Pole where scientists live and work.
Strait of Malacca\n\nThe Strait of Malacca is a narrow water path between two big pieces of land. It is like a long, skinny river in the ocean. Big boats use it to travel from one sea to another. The strait is very long and very busy. Many ships go through it every day to carry food, toys, and other things from one country to another.
Chemical industry\n\nThe chemical industry is a big group of factories that make things from oil, gas, air, water, and rocks. These factories turn these raw materials into over 70,000 different products. Some factories make plastics. Most of the things they make are not sold to people in stores. Instead, they are used by scientists and workers to make other things like soap, paint, or medicine. Many people work in the chemical industry, including scientists and helpers in labs. The first big factory was built a long time ago in Scotland to make a special kind of acid.
Yugoslavia\n\nYugoslavia was a country in Europe. It was made up of many different groups of people who spoke different languages and had different ways of living. The name means "land of the southern Slavs." Yugoslavia started in 1918 after a big war and ended in the 1990s when it broke into smaller countries. Now, the land that was Yugoslavia is split into several countries like Serbia, Croatia, Slovenia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, North Macedonia, Montenegro, and Kosovo.
Inflation\n\nInflation is when prices of things like food and haircuts go up over time. This means you need more money to buy the same things. For example, if a loaf of bread cost one dollar last year, it might cost two dollars this year. Inflation can happen when there is too much money and not enough things to buy. It can also happen when it costs more to make things. Too much inflation is bad because people cannot buy as much with their money.
Support group\n\nA support group is a bunch of people who meet to help each other feel better. They talk about sad or hard things that happened to them. Sometimes a doctor or a helper starts the group. Everyone in the group listens and cares.
Interchangeable parts\n\nInterchangeable parts are parts that are made exactly the same so they can fit into any machine of the same kind. A long time ago, a man named Eli Whitney made guns with parts that were all the same. This way, if one part broke, you could put in a new one that fit. Later, Henry Ford used this idea to make cars. He made many cars fast and cheap because all the parts were the same. Workers put the cars together on a moving line. This helped many people buy a car.
Face\n\nYour face is the front part of your head. It has your eyes to see, your nose to smell, and your ears to hear. Your mouth is on your face too, and you use it to eat and talk. Your face also has eyebrows, eyelashes, cheeks, lips, teeth, skin, and a chin. The hair on your head is part of your face. When you look at someone, you look at their face first.
Gymnastics\n\nGymnastics is a sport where people do exercises that need strength, balance, and the ability to bend and stretch. Gymnasts run, jump, flip, and balance. They practice on different things like a floor mat, bars, a beam, and a vault. Some gymnasts use ribbons, balls, or hoops. Gymnastics is part of the Summer Olympic Games. It started a long time ago in ancient Greece.
Metric system\n\nThe metric system is a way to measure things. It uses meters for length, grams for weight, and liters for how much space something takes up. People all over the world use the metric system. It was first made in France a long time ago. The metric system is easy because it uses tens, like counting 10, 20, 30. A meter is about as long as a big step. A gram is very light, like a small paper clip. A liter is about as much as a big water bottle. The metric system has special names like centimeter for small lengths and kilometer for long distances. Many countries use the metric system for school, science, and everyday life.
Common wheat\n\nCommon wheat is a plant that people grow for food. It is also called bread wheat. Most of the wheat in the world is common wheat. Farmers have been picking the best wheat plants for a very long time. This wheat can grow in cold places. People use it to make bread, pasta, and other foods.
Humour\n\nHumour is when something makes you laugh or feel happy. Most people like to smile at funny things. You can make jokes with words that sound the same but mean different things. Sometimes people say the opposite of what you expect, and that is funny too. Different people like different kinds of funny. Grown-ups might like jokes that are hard for kids to understand. A comedian is a person whose job is to make people laugh.
Lychee\n\nA lychee is a fruit that grows on trees in warm, wet places. It has a hard, bumpy shell on the outside that is red or brown. Inside, the fruit is clear and pinkish-white, and it tastes very sweet. There is a hard brown seed in the middle that you should not eat because it is poisonous. You can eat lychees fresh, or freeze them to make them taste like cold, sweet treats.
Basalt\n\nBasalt is a dark rock that comes from volcanoes. It is black or grey and feels very hard. When a volcano pushes out hot lava, the lava cools fast and turns into basalt. People use basalt to build roads and sidewalks because it is strong. Basalt can also be found on the Moon and Mars.
Daniel (biblical figure)\n\nDaniel is a man from the Bible. He lived a long time ago in a faraway land called Babylon. Daniel was very brave and trusted God. He was thrown into a den of lions, but God kept him safe and the lions did not hurt him. Daniel had special dreams that helped him understand things. Many people still read about Daniel today.
Traffic collision\n\nA traffic collision is when a car hits another car, a person, or something else on the road. It can hurt people or even make them very sick. Many people get hurt in car crashes every year. To stay safe, roads have special paths for walking and biking, and places to cross safely.
Ice cream\n\nIce cream is a cold, sweet treat that you eat in summer. It is made from cream, milk, sugar, and flavors. The mixture is stirred while it freezes so it stays smooth and not icy. Ice cream comes in many colors and tastes. The most common flavors are vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry. You can buy ice cream in a store, from a truck, or in a shop. Some ice cream has chocolate chips, nuts, fruit, or candy mixed in. You can eat it in a cone, a bowl, or on a stick. A long time ago, people in Persia and China made early kinds of ice cream with ice and flavorings. Now many people have freezers at home, so they can keep ice cream for a long time.
Information Age\n\nThe Information Age is a time in history that started around the middle of the 1900s. It is when people began using computers and the internet to share information very quickly. Before this time, most things were done with paper and machines that used moving parts. The Information Age began when a tiny part called a transistor was invented in 1947. This helped make computers smaller and cheaper. Soon, people could have computers at home. The internet was first used in 1969 when a message was sent between two computers far apart. Now, we can send pictures, music, and words to anyone in the world almost instantly. The Information Age changed how we work, play, and talk to each other.
Breathing\n\nBreathing is moving air in and out of your lungs. When you breathe in, air goes into your lungs. That air has something called oxygen in it. Your body needs oxygen to work. When you breathe out, a gas called carbon dioxide leaves your body. Your brain tells your body when to breathe. It has a special part that checks how much carbon dioxide is in your blood. If there is too much, it tells you to breathe faster. A big muscle under your ribs called the diaphragm helps you breathe. It moves down when you breathe in and up when you breathe out. Other muscles between your ribs also help. When you run and play, you breathe faster to get more oxygen.
Measles\n\nMeasles is a sickness that you can catch from other people. It is caused by a tiny germ called a virus. When someone with measles breathes out, tiny drops of water with the virus go into the air. If you breathe those drops in, you can get sick too. People with measles have a sore throat, a fever, a cough, red eyes, and a runny nose. They also get a red, bumpy rash all over their body that itches a lot. Measles is very easy to catch. If one person in a house has it, other people in the house will probably get it too. There is a shot called a vaccine that can stop you from getting measles. Many children get this shot. There is no medicine that can cure measles. People who are sick rest and take medicine to feel better and stop the fever. Most people get better, but some people can die from measles.
Ukraine\n\nUkraine is a country in Eastern Europe. It is a big country with many people. The capital of Ukraine is a city called Kyiv. Ukraine has a big river called the Dnieper that runs through it. The country is next to the Black Sea, which is a big body of water. People in Ukraine speak Ukrainian. Ukraine used to be part of a bigger country called the Soviet Union, but it became its own country in 1991. The name Ukraine means "borderland" or "edge." Long ago, a powerful state called Kyivan Rus was in this land. The people of Ukraine are called Ukrainians.
Carpet\n\nA carpet is a big piece of soft cloth that goes on the floor. Carpets make a room look pretty and help keep your feet warm. Walking on a carpet is quiet and soft. Some carpets are made by hand, and some are made by machines. The oldest carpet ever found was very old and came from a cold place called Siberia. A small carpet is called a rug. People in some places use rugs to kneel on when they pray. Some carpets even tell stories with their colors and shapes.
Arctic Ocean\n\nThe Arctic Ocean is the ocean at the very top of the world, around the North Pole. It is the smallest of all the oceans. In winter, thick ice and snow cover almost all of it. Even in summer, most of the ocean is still covered with ice. Special boats called icebreakers can push through the ice to travel. The Arctic Ocean is home to animals like polar bears, walruses, and whales. These animals need the ice to live. The ocean is getting less icy every year because the Earth is getting warmer. The water is very cold, almost frozen, and it is salty but not as salty as other oceans.
Drone\n\nA drone is a flying machine that has no person inside. A person on the ground tells it what to do with a remote control. Drones come in many sizes. Some are as small as a toy, and some are as big as a real airplane. Big drones are used by the army to watch places from the sky. Small drones are used to take pictures from up high. Some people race drones for fun. Drones are not allowed near airports or big cities because they can be dangerous.
Plastic\n\nPlastic is a material that can change its shape easily. Many things are made of plastic, like toys, food containers, bags, and clothes. Some plastic can be soft when hot and hard when cold. People use plastic to make many things because it is easy to shape. Most plastic is made from oil or gas. Old plastic can stay for a very long time, so it can make the world dirty. Some plastic can be used again, but most is thrown away.
Savanna\n\nA savanna is a big, flat place with lots of tall grass and a few trees and bushes. The most famous savanna is in Africa. It has a rainy season and a dry season. Many animals live there, like zebras, giraffes, elephants, lions, and cheetahs. In the dry season, some animals move to find water. Savannas also exist in Australia, North America, and South America. In Australia, eucalyptus trees grow. In North America, oak trees are common. Fires sometimes happen in savannas, but the grass grows back from the roots.
Western (genre)\n\nA Western is a kind of story. It is about cowboys who live in the old American West, a long time ago. These stories show people riding horses, wearing big hats, and living on wide plains. Westerns can be movies, TV shows, or books. They have been around since the very first movies were made.
Tibet\n\nTibet is a place high up in the mountains in Asia. It is part of China. The main city is called Lhasa. Many people in Tibet follow a religion called Buddhism. The leader of the Buddhists in Tibet is called the Dalai Lama. He had to leave Tibet a long time ago and now lives in another country. Tibet has very tall mountains and cold weather. Some people live in houses made of stone. They grow food like barley and raise animals like yaks. The people in Tibet have their own special clothes and music.
Community\n\nA community is a group of people or animals that live in the same place. They like to do the same things and help each other. People in a community share ideas and take care of one another. Even though everyone is different, they all work together to make the community a nice place to be.
Solstice\n\nA solstice is a special day that happens two times every year. On a solstice, the sun stops moving higher or lower in the sky and then goes the other way. One solstice is the longest day of the year, and the other is the shortest day of the year. In June, the sun is high in the sky for people who live in the north part of the world, and that day is very long. In December, the sun is low in the sky for people in the north, and that day is very short. Long ago, people had big parties on solstice days because they were happy that the days were getting longer or shorter.
Albatross\n\nAn albatross is a very big bird that lives near the ocean. It has long wings and can fly for a long time without stopping. Albatrosses eat fish, squid, and tiny sea animals. They come to land only to make nests and lay eggs. They build nests on islands, often near other birds. Albatrosses can live for many years, sometimes more than 50. They are very good at flying, but they need wind to help them. When there is no wind, they rest on the water. Some kinds of albatrosses are in danger because rats and cats eat their eggs, or because they get caught on fishing hooks.
Chickpea\n\nA chickpea is a small, round, yellow bean that you can eat. People buy chickpeas in a can or in a bag. They are soft and taste a little bit like a nut. You can mash them up to make hummus, which is a yummy dip. Chickpeas are good for you because they have protein, which helps your body grow strong. They come from a plant and grow in the ground.
Greenland\n\nGreenland is a very big island, the biggest island in the whole world. It is very cold there, and most of the land is covered with ice. Only about 50,000 people live in Greenland, mostly near the coast. The capital city is called Nuuk. There are no forests in Greenland, only small trees in the south. The people who live there speak Greenlandic and Danish. Many mountains are on the island, and the tallest one is called Gunnbjorn Fjeld. In summer it is cool, and in winter it is very cold and long.
Orchard\n\nAn orchard is a place where fruit trees grow. You can find apple trees, pear trees, and nut trees in an orchard. People grow the fruit to eat and to sell at stores. Some orchards are part of big gardens where families can pick their own fruit. The trees are planted in rows so it is easy to walk between them.
Sonata\n\nA sonata is a piece of music that one person plays on an instrument, sometimes with another person playing along. The word comes from an Italian word that means "to sound." A sonata is usually long and has several parts, called movements. A short and simple sonata is called a sonatina. Long ago, people played sonatas in their homes or in churches. Some sonatas are played on the piano, and some are played on the violin, flute, or other instruments. Famous composers like Mozart and Beethoven wrote many sonatas.
Mount Kilimanjaro\n\nMount Kilimanjaro is a very tall mountain in Africa. It is the tallest mountain in all of Africa. It is so tall that snow stays on top all year. The mountain is a volcano, but it has not erupted for a very long time. Many people like to climb it. They walk up special paths to reach the top. The climb takes many days because the mountain is very high. Some people feel sick from the high air. The mountain looks shiny and white from far away.
Electronics\n\nElectronics is about using electricity to make things work, like computers and TVs. It uses special parts called components, like batteries, bulbs, and wires, that connect together in a circle called a circuit. A TV has parts that take a signal from the air or a cable, change it, and then show a picture on a screen and play sound. Long ago, people used big glass tubes to control electricity. Later, they made tiny parts called transistors that use less power. Now, many things use small chips that have lots of parts inside. Some circuits are analog, which means they work with many levels, like the sound of your voice. Other circuits are digital, which means they just turn on and off, like a light switch. Computers and clocks use digital circuits. Radar uses circuits to send out bursts of energy that bounce off things like planes and show where they are.
Character\n\nA character can be a person in a story, movie, or game. Characters can be real or make-believe. Some characters are heroes, some are funny, and some are helpers. You can draw a character or pretend to be one when you play.
Bee\n\nA bee is a flying insect that buzzes. Bees have six legs and two pairs of wings. Many bees are hairy and have yellow and black or orange and black colors. Bees live all over the world except in very cold places like Antarctica. Bees collect pollen from flowers. Some bees live together in big groups called colonies. A colony lives in a home called a hive. In a hive, there is one queen bee who lays eggs. Worker bees are female and they collect pollen and protect the hive. Drone bees are male and they help the queen make eggs. Some bees have a stinger on their back. If a bee gets scared, it might sting and it hurts. After a worker bee stings, it dies. People keep honey bees to get honey.
Torah\n\nThe Torah is a special book for Jewish people. The word Torah means "instructions." It has the first five books of the Bible. These books are called Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, and Deuteronomy. People also call them the Five Books of Moses. The Torah tells stories about the beginning of the world and about people like Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and Joseph. It also tells how the Jewish people left Egypt and got rules for how to live. Every week, a small part of the Torah is read in a synagogue.
Jackfruit\n\nJackfruit is a big fruit that grows on a tree. It comes from India, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka. The fruit starts out green and turns yellow when it is ready to eat. Jackfruit is the biggest fruit that grows on a tree. It can be as heavy as a big bag of groceries and as long as your arm. The tree has shiny green leaves. People cook the seeds and eat them. They also cook the green, not-yet-ripe fruit like a vegetable. The ripe fruit is sweet and can be eaten cold.
Oven\n\nAn oven is a closed box that gets very hot inside. People use it to cook food like bread, cookies, and pizza. The heat inside an oven is dry and spreads all around the food. Some ovens use electricity to get hot, and some use gas or coal. There are also ovens outside made of brick or clay that are buried in hot coals. A special oven for making pots is called a kiln. Ovens are very hot, so things that come out of them are hot too.
Adam and Eve\n\nAdam and Eve are the first two people in the Bible. God made Adam from dust and breathed life into him. Then God made Eve from one of Adam's ribs. They lived in a beautiful garden called Eden. God told them not to eat fruit from one special tree. A sneaky snake told Eve to eat the fruit, and she gave some to Adam. God was sad because they did not listen. So God sent them out of the garden. After that, people had to work hard and feel pain. Adam and Eve are the parents of all people.
Crow\n\nA crow is a bird with black feathers. Crows are medium-sized birds that eat many things like bugs, worms, nuts, and even leftover food. They are very smart and can use sticks as tools to get food. Crows live in many places around the world, except in South America. They like open areas where they can see well. Sometimes crows live alone or in pairs, and sometimes they gather in big groups called flocks. A group of crows can also be called a murder. Crows are shy at first but can get used to people. Some crows have been known to bring small gifts to people who feed them.
Guilt (emotion)\n\nGuilt is a feeling you get when you think you did something wrong. It makes you feel bad inside. Your heart might feel heavy, and you might want to say sorry. Guilt helps you know the difference between right and wrong. When you feel guilty, you can try to fix what you did wrong. Sometimes guilt makes you worry a lot. It is a feeling that people start to have when they are little kids.
Paganism\n\nPaganism is a word for many different beliefs about gods and nature. Long ago, some people believed in many gods and goddesses, like in the old Greek stories. Pagans often think about nature and the world around them. Today, some people call themselves Pagans and they honor the Earth. One well-known Pagan religion is Wicca. Another is Druidism. Pagans do not all believe the same things, but they all care about nature and the world we live in.
Rice\n\nRice is a food that people eat. It comes from a plant that grows in warm, wet places. Rice is a kind of grass. Many people in Asia eat rice every day. It is also eaten in other parts of the world. Rice is usually cooked before you eat it. You can eat it with sauce, curry, or soup. Some people fry rice in oil first. Rice can also be used to make a drink called sake. Rice grows in fields that are filled with water. There are many kinds of rice. Some rice is long and not sticky. Other rice is short and sticky. Brown rice has more of the plant left on it, so it has more fiber than white rice.
Touchscreen\n\nA touchscreen is a special screen that you can touch with your finger to make things happen. You do not need a mouse or a remote control. Many phones and tablets have touchscreens. You can tap on pictures or words to open them. Some touchscreens work even if you touch them with a special pen called a stylus. Touchscreens are used in stores, banks, and schools. They are easy to use.
Capital city\n\nA capital city is a special city where a country's leaders work. It is often the biggest city in the country, but not always. For example, the capital of the United States is Washington, D.C., but New York City is bigger. Some countries have more than one capital. Bolivia has two, and South Africa has three. A few countries, like Nauru, do not have a capital city at all. The leaders and important offices are usually in the capital.
Child\n\nA child is a young person. A child can be a boy or a girl. Children like to play and use their imagination. In many places, children go to school to learn. Some children go to preschool or kindergarten. A child's mom and dad are called parents. If a child has no parents, they are called an orphan. A child who lives with new parents is called an adopted child.
Window\n\nA window is a hole in a wall or roof that lets air and light come inside. It is usually made of glass so you can see through it. Windows can be many shapes, like square, round, or even colored. Some windows open and close, and some stay shut. Curtains or blinds can cover a window to keep light out or give privacy. Long ago, people used paper instead of glass to fill the hole.
Killer whale\n\nA killer whale is a big animal that lives in the ocean. It is black with white patches. It is the biggest kind of dolphin. Killer whales live in family groups called pods. They eat many things like fish, seals, and even sharks. They are very smart and can learn tricks. Baby killer whales are called calves. Their tall fin on top can be seen above the water. Sometimes people see them in shows at parks.
Pronghorn\n\nA pronghorn is a mammal that looks like an antelope. It lives in North America, in prairies, deserts, and mountains. The pronghorn is the fastest land animal in the Western Hemisphere. It can run very fast, almost as fast as a cheetah, and it can keep running fast for a long time. The pronghorn has yellowish-brown fur with a white belly and white stripes on its neck. Male pronghorns have horns that are about as long as a ruler. They eat grass, leaves, and herbs. Baby pronghorns are born in spring and can run with their mother after one week.
Criminal law\n\nCriminal law is the set of rules that tell people what they cannot do. If someone breaks a rule, like taking something that is not theirs, they get in trouble. These rules help keep people safe and protect things that belong to them. Criminal law is different from other rules about money or promises.
Trunk (botany)\n\nA trunk is the big, thick part of a tree that stands up from the ground. It holds the branches and leaves up high. The trunk is covered with bark, which is like a coat that keeps the tree safe. Inside the trunk, there are different layers. Some parts are hard and dark, and some parts help water move up the tree. People cut down tree trunks to make wood for building things.
Seamount\n\nA seamount is a big mountain under the ocean. It is so tall that it goes up from the sea floor, but it does not stick out of the water like an island. Most seamounts are made by volcanoes under the sea. They can be very tall, as tall as a thousand big buildings stacked on top of each other. Many fish and other sea animals live near seamounts because the water brings them food. Some seamounts are flat on top because the waves wore them down long ago. There are many seamounts all over the world, but we have only looked at a few of them.
Domestication\n\nDomestication is when wild animals or plants change after people keep them for a long time. People choose which animals to have babies, so the babies become friendlier and more helpful. The first animal people tamed was the dog. Later, people tamed sheep, goats, cows, and pigs. Some animals give us food, some give us clothes, and some are just pets. Cats were also tamed long ago. People also tamed plants to grow food like wheat. When animals or plants are tamed, they need people to take care of them.
Truck\n\nA truck is a big car that carries things from one place to another. Trucks come in many sizes. Some are small like a car, and some are very big. Big trucks can carry heavy loads like sand, rocks, or food. Some trucks have a closed box on the back to keep things safe. Other trucks have a flat bed with no sides. A dump truck has a bed that lifts up to dump out sand or dirt. A concrete mixer has a big drum that turns around to mix concrete. Fire trucks carry water and hoses to put out fires. Garbage trucks pick up trash from houses. Trucks have a cabin in the front where the driver sits. The back part of the truck is for carrying things. Long ago, people used horses to pull wagons. Now trucks do that work much faster.
Land transport\n\nLand transport is how people, animals, and things move from one place to another on the ground. Long ago, people walked or used carts pulled by horses. The Romans built strong roads that were flat and straight. Later, people used coaches and wagons pulled by horses. In the 1900s, cars and trucks became the main way to travel on roads. Trains also move people and things on tracks. Trains can go very far and are not too expensive.
Equinox\n\nAn equinox is a special time when the sun shines right over the middle of the Earth. This happens two times every year. On equinox day, the daytime and nighttime are almost the same length. The word equinox means 'equal night.' The first equinox comes around March 21, and that is the start of spring. The second equinox comes around September 21, and that is the start of fall. People long ago had parties on equinox days.
Camellia\n\nA camellia is a plant with pretty flowers. It grows as a bush or a small tree. Camellia leaves are thick and shiny, and they stay green all year. The flowers can be white, pink, red, or yellow. They bloom in late winter, often before other flowers come out. Some camellia plants are used to make tea. People also grow camellias in gardens because the flowers are beautiful.
Music video\n\nA music video is a short movie that goes with a song. You can watch it on TV or a computer. The singer or band is usually in the video, singing or moving their lips to the song. Some TV channels like MTV play music videos all day. In some places, people call them PVs, which is short for "Promotional Video."
Tea\n\nTea is a warm drink people make by putting special leaves in hot water. The leaves come from a plant called Camellia sinensis. There are three main kinds of tea: green tea, black tea, and oolong tea. Green tea leaves are steamed to keep them green. Black tea leaves are dried until they turn brown or black. Oolong tea leaves are dried in the sun. People also make tea from fruits or other plants, like chamomile or rosehip. That is called herbal tea. Tea is the most popular drink in the world after water. Many countries grow tea, like China, India, and Japan. To make tea, you put the leaves in hot water for a few minutes, then you can drink it.
Bonobo\n\nA bonobo is a kind of ape that looks like a chimpanzee but is a little smaller. Bonobos live in the rain forest in a country in Africa. They spend most of their time in trees and eat fruits and plants. Bonobos are very friendly and like to hug and kiss each other. They use touch and play to feel happy and calm. A baby bonobo stays close to its mother for a long time. Bonobos are in danger because people cut down trees and hunt them.
Microscope\n\nA microscope is a tool that makes tiny things look much bigger. You can use it to see things that are too small for your eyes to see. Doctors and scientists use microscopes to look at very small bugs and cells. Students in school also use them to study little things. A microscope has a part you look through called the eyepiece and a part near the thing you are looking at called the objective. The lenses inside make the picture bigger, sometimes up to 1000 times bigger. That is much stronger than a magnifying glass. The most common kind of microscope uses light to see the tiny thing.
Turkish language\n\nTurkish is a language that people speak in Turkey and Cyprus. Many people around the world speak Turkish. It is a kind of language that is like other languages such as Azerbaijani and Uzbek. A long time ago, Turkish was written with different letters. Then a man named Mustafa Kemal Atatürk changed the letters to the ones we use in English. This made it easier for people to learn to read and write. Now Turkish has 29 letters, and some of them have special marks on top. When you hear Turkish, it sounds like the way it is written.
Mentha\n\nMentha is a plant that people call mint. It has green leaves that smell and taste cool. People use mint leaves to make food taste good, like in ice cream, tea, and sauce. There are many kinds of mint plants. Some people drink mint tea to help their tummy feel better.
Maharashtra\n\nMaharashtra is a big state in the west part of India. It sits next to the Arabian Sea. The main language people speak there is Marathi. Mumbai is the biggest city and the capital. Pune is another big city where many people go to school. Maharashtra has more business than any other state in India. There are old caves called Ajanta and Ellora that people visit. Farmers grow rice, wheat, and other foods. People there eat tasty dishes like Pav Bhaji and Vada Pav. Many people are Hindu and celebrate big festivals like Ganeshotsav, which lasts ten days. Cricket is a very popular game, and kids also play tag and other games.
Toucan\n\nA toucan is a bird that lives in warm forests in South America. It has a very big, colorful beak that can be orange, yellow, or red. The beak helps the toucan pick fruit from trees and stay cool. Toucans eat mostly fruit, but sometimes they eat bugs or small lizards. They live in small groups and sleep in holes in trees. Toucans fly short distances and do not travel far. Their bright beak helps them recognize each other and scare other birds away.
Komodo dragon\n\nA Komodo dragon is a very big lizard. It lives on some islands in Indonesia. It is the biggest lizard in the world. It can be as long as a car and as heavy as a grown-up person. It has a long tail, sharp teeth, and a forked tongue. Its skin can be blue, orange, green, gray, or brown. It eats meat, like deer, goats, and even smaller Komodo dragons. It can eat a whole goat in one bite. It has dangerous germs in its mouth that can make other animals sick. It also has poison in its jaws. Komodo dragons are good at smelling dead animals from far away. They can run fast and swim. Baby Komodo dragons live in trees to stay safe. They can live for 50 years. People protect them in a special park.
Social work\n\nSocial work is a job where people help others. A social worker is a person who is trained to help people who have problems. They help people who cannot help themselves, like people who are sick, poor, or have no home. Social workers also help people find food, money, and a safe place to live. It is a hard job because they have to solve many big problems. But it is also a very kind job because they care for others.
Momentum\n\nMomentum is how much push a moving thing has. A big heavy truck moving fast has a lot of momentum. A little ball rolling slow has only a little momentum. When two things bump into each other, their momentum can change. If a big truck hits a small car, the truck's momentum is bigger, so the car gets pushed. But the total momentum of both things together stays the same. That is called conservation of momentum. For example, when a gun shoots a bullet, the bullet goes forward and the gun goes backward a little. Their momentums are equal but opposite, so the total momentum is still zero.
Saint Peter\n\nSaint Peter was a friend of Jesus. He was a fisherman before Jesus asked him to come along. Peter was one of the twelve special helpers of Jesus. He saw Jesus do many amazing things. One time, Jesus said Peter was like a rock and would help build the church. When Jesus was taken away, Peter was scared and said he did not know Jesus. But later Jesus forgave Peter and gave him a job to take care of the people who follow Jesus. Peter wrote two letters that are in the Bible. He died in Rome a long time ago. People remember him as a very important person in the Christian church.
Horus\n\nHorus was a god in ancient Egypt. He was the god of the sky, the sun, and war. He looked like a falcon or a man with a falcon head. Sometimes he wore a special crown on his head. Horus had a fight with his uncle and lost his eye. The eye became a special sign that meant protection and good health. People in Egypt made jewelry with the eye to keep them safe. Horus was the son of Isis and Osiris. He helped the pharaoh, who was the king of Egypt. When a pharaoh died, the new pharaoh became like Horus. Horus was a good friend of Sobek, another god. People built temples for Horus in some towns in Egypt.
Middle East\n\nThe Middle East is a big area of land on Earth. It is between Europe and the Far East. Many people who live there follow the religion of Islam. A long time ago, very old cities and religions started in the Middle East. Today, many countries in the Middle East have oil that people use for cars and machines. Some places in the Middle East have arguments and wars.
Bali\n\nBali is an island in Indonesia. It is a place where many people go on vacation. Bali has tall mountains called volcanoes. The two biggest volcanoes are Mount Agung and Mount Batur. Mount Agung is special to the people who live there. Sometimes smoke and ash come out of the top. Bali also has old temples and green rice fields. People there do special dances and shadow puppet shows. Most people in Bali follow the Hindu religion. The big city in Bali is Denpasar. People use Indonesian money called rupiah.
Rocket\n\nA rocket is a machine that flies very fast by pushing fire out of its bottom. The fire makes hot air that shoots out and pushes the rocket up. Some rockets go to space and carry people or satellites. The first rockets were made in China a long time ago. They looked like arrows and were not very fast. Big rockets use special fuel to make a very hot fire. Some rockets are so strong they can take people to the moon. The first person to fly to space was Yuri Gagarin in 1961. A few years later, in 1969, Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin went to the moon in a big rocket called Saturn V.
Urdu\n\nUrdu is a language that people speak in Pakistan and India. It sounds a lot like Hindi, and people who speak one can often understand the other. Urdu is written from right to left, like Persian. Many words in Urdu come from Persian, Arabic, and other languages. People use Urdu to talk, write poems, and show respect to others. Some famous Urdu poets are Mirza Ghalib and Muhammad Iqbal.
Electric eel\n\nThe electric eel is a fish that lives in South America. It can give a big shock to other animals. It uses the shock to catch food and to stay safe. The electric eel lives in muddy rivers like the Amazon. It breathes air because the water has very little air in it. Even though it is called an eel, it is not an eel. It is a knifefish. Most people do not keep it as a pet because it can shock them. But after it shocks many times, it runs out of power and cannot shock for a while.
Nightingale\n\nA nightingale is a small bird. It is a little bigger than a robin. Its back is plain brown, and its tail is reddish. Its belly is light-colored. The nightingale is famous for its loud song. It sings at night and during the day. Only the male bird sings. He sings to find a mate. The song has many whistles and trills. It sings even louder in cities because of the noise. The nightingale lives in Europe and Asia in the summer. In winter it flies to Africa. It makes its nest on the ground near bushes.
Relay\n\nA relay is a part that turns things on and off using a magnet. Long ago, people made relays to help messages travel far on wires. Today, relays help machines work. Cars and toys with lights use relays.
Finch\n\nA finch is a small bird that sings. It eats seeds from plants. Finches live in many warm places around the world. Some finches have bright colors. People sometimes keep finches as pets in cages.
Chainsaw\n\nA chainsaw is a tool that cuts trees. It has a long metal blade with sharp teeth that spin around very fast. A small engine makes the blade move. People use a chainsaw to cut down big trees or to chop wood for a fire. Some chainsaws can even cut concrete. The blade gets dull after a while, so it needs to be sharpened.
Southeast Asia\n\nSoutheast Asia is the part of Asia that is down near the bottom. There are 11 countries in this place. Some of these countries are on the big land, and some are on islands. Most of Southeast Asia is very warm because it is near the middle of the Earth. The countries in Southeast Asia are friends and work together in a group called ASEAN. One country, East Timor, is not in that group. The very top part of Myanmar is a little cooler.
Softball\n\nSoftball is a sport where players hit a big ball with a bat and run around bases. It is like baseball. Boys, girls, men, and women can all play softball. The ball is bigger than a baseball and is not soft. It can be yellow or white. Players throw the ball underhand. The team that is batting tries to hit the ball and run to home plate. The other team tries to catch the ball and get the batters out. After three outs, the teams switch places. Softball games usually have 3 to 7 innings. People play softball in parks and fields all over the world.
Agriculture\n\nAgriculture is how people grow food and take care of animals. Farmers grow plants like corn, wheat, and vegetables in fields. They also raise animals like cows, chickens, and pigs for milk, eggs, and meat. Some farmers work in forests or fish in water. Agriculture gives us food to eat and other things like wood and cotton. The word comes from old words that mean 'growing in a field.'
Abacus\n\nAn abacus is an old tool that helps people count and do math. It has rods with beads that you can slide up and down. You move the beads to add, subtract, multiply, and divide numbers. Some people who cannot see use an abacus because they can feel the beads. There is a Chinese abacus and a Japanese one called a soroban. They both work the same way. Expert users can do math very fast with an abacus.
Bicycle\n\nA bicycle is a machine with two wheels that people ride by pushing pedals with their feet. It has a seat to sit on, handlebars to steer, and a chain that helps the wheels turn. Bicycles are also called bikes. People ride bikes to go to school, to work, or just for fun. Riding a bike is good exercise and does not use gas like a car. The first bike was made of wood and had no pedals. Later, people added pedals and made bikes safer. Today, bikes have brakes to stop, gears to help go up hills, and sometimes a bell to warn others. It is important to wear a helmet when riding a bike to stay safe.
Cook Strait\n\nCook Strait is a big stretch of water between two islands in New Zealand. One island is called the North Island, and the other is called the South Island. The water on one side is the Tasman Sea, and on the other side is the South Pacific Ocean. A man named James Cook was the first person from far away to sail through it. The water can be rough and tricky because of the tides and weather. People often take a big boat called a ferry to cross from one island to the other.
Louvre\n\nThe Louvre is a big museum in Paris, France. It is the most visited art museum in the world. Many people go there to see paintings and statues. The most famous painting in the Louvre is the "Mona Lisa" by Leonardo da Vinci. There are also famous statues like the Venus de Milo and the Winged Victory of Samothrace. Long ago, a king named Philip II built a castle where the museum now stands. Later, another king named Francis I knocked down the castle and built a new palace. King Henry IV added a very long room called the Grande Galerie. Today, the museum has a big glass pyramid at the front door.
Sumatra\n\nSumatra is a very big island in Indonesia. It is one of the largest islands in the whole world. The Indian Ocean is next to it. Many people live there, about 50 million. The island has lots of land and is very long and wide.
Right angle\n\nA right angle is a special kind of corner. It looks like the corner of a square. When two lines meet to make a right angle, they make a shape like the letter L. The walls in your house meet the floor at a right angle. The top of the letter T also makes a right angle. When two lines cross and make four right angles, we say they are perpendicular.
Pole vault\n\nPole vault is a sport where a person runs fast and uses a long, bendy stick to jump over a high bar. The stick helps them go up and over. People do pole vault at big games like the Olympics. Both men and women can do this sport.
Hovercraft\n\nA hovercraft is a vehicle that floats on a cushion of air. It can move over water, land, ice, and other smooth places. The air pushes down and makes the hovercraft lift up. This lets it ride on different surfaces. People use hovercraft to carry cars, people, and things. Some hovercraft are used by the army to go on water and land. A man named Christopher Cockerell made the first hovercraft.
Reindeer\n\nA reindeer is a big animal that lives in very cold places. It has fur that is gray-brown and gets lighter in winter. Reindeer have big feet that help them walk on soft snow. Both boy and girl reindeer grow antlers on their heads. Boy reindeer have bigger antlers than girls. Reindeer eat grass, plants, and moss. In winter, they dig under the snow with their feet to find food. Reindeer live in groups called herds. Some reindeer are tame and live with people. People use them to pull sleds and for their fur and meat. Santa Claus has reindeer that pull his sleigh.
Kinetic energy\n\nKinetic energy is the energy something has when it moves. When you run, your body has kinetic energy. A ball rolling on the ground has kinetic energy too. The faster something moves, the more kinetic energy it has. Kinetic energy can turn into other kinds of energy, like when a moving toy stops and makes a sound.
Pharmacist\n\nA pharmacist is a person who gives out medicine to people. They work in a store called a pharmacy or in a hospital. When a doctor writes a note for medicine, the pharmacist reads it and gives the right medicine. They also tell you how to take it and what to watch out for. Sometimes they give shots that keep you from getting sick, like the flu shot. They can also help you pick medicine for a sore throat or a cold. Pharmacists check the work of helpers called pharmacy technicians, who count the pills and put them in bottles. Pharmacists make sure everything is safe and correct.
Black pepper\n\nBlack pepper is a plant that grows in warm places like India. People use its fruit, called a peppercorn, to make food taste hot. You can grind the peppercorn into a powder and put it on eggs, meat, or vegetables. Black pepper is one of the most common spices in the world. It has been used for a very long time. Some people think pepper makes you sneeze because it tickles your nose.
Noah\n\nNoah is a man from a very old story in the Bible. He built a big boat called an ark. God told Noah to build the ark because a big flood was coming. Noah put his family and two of every kind of animal on the ark. After the flood, a rainbow appeared in the sky. The rainbow was a promise that the world would never be flooded again.
Manufacturing\n\nManufacturing is making things from raw materials. It is a part of industry. Some things are big and need many steps to make, like cars. Other things are small and simple, like pencils. Often, machines help make the things. Long ago, people made things by hand using tools. Today, most things are made by machines in factories. Machines can make things faster and cheaper than people can.
Maya people\n\nThe Maya people are a group of people who live in Mexico and Central America. They have lived there for a very long time, even thousands of years. Long ago, they built big stone cities and pyramids. Today, many Maya still live in the same places, like Mexico, Guatemala, and Belize. They speak their own languages and have their own traditions.
Māori people\n\nThe Māori people are the first people who lived in New Zealand. They came from faraway islands in the ocean a long, long time ago. Before other people arrived, they just called themselves "ordinary." Now, more than 700,000 Māori live in New Zealand. They have their own language, which is an important language in the country along with English. The Māori are a big part of New Zealand's culture.
Oesophagus\n\nThe oesophagus is a tube inside your body. It goes from your mouth down to your stomach. When you eat food, the oesophagus pushes the food down to your stomach. It has muscles that squeeze the food along. A special muscle at the bottom opens to let food into your stomach and then closes again. The oesophagus helps you swallow.
Mail\n\nMail is something you send to other people through the post office. You can send a letter or a small package. You put a stamp on it to pay for sending it. Then you drop it in a post box. The post office picks it up and takes it to the person you sent it to. Some post offices also help people get passports or pay bills.
Brahmaputra River\n\nThe Brahmaputra River is a very long river in Asia. It starts high up in the mountains of Tibet, where snow and ice melt into water. Then it flows through India and Bangladesh. In spring, when the ice melts a lot, the river can get very big and cause floods. The river joins another big river called the Ganges and together they flow into the sea. Where they meet the sea, they make a big triangle of land called a delta.
Cycad\n\nA cycad is a plant that looks like a palm tree or a fern. It has a big round top of leaves and a thick trunk. Cycads are very old plants. They were alive when dinosaurs walked on Earth. Today there are not many cycads left. They grow in warm places. Some cycads have seeds that can make animals sick if they eat them.
Himalayas\n\nThe Himalayas are a big line of very tall mountains. They are in Asia, north of India. The word "Himalayas" means "House of Snow" because snow stays on the tops all year. The highest mountain in the world, Mount Everest, is in the Himalayas. Many other tall mountains are there too. The mountains block cold wind and make rain fall on one side. Many animals live there, like snow leopards, blue sheep, and yaks. Yaks are big and furry like wild ox. There are also many trees like pine and oak. Five big rivers start in the Himalayas and give water to people and animals.
Melon\n\nA melon is a fruit that is soft and juicy inside. Some melons are round and some are long. Watermelon is a kind of melon that is green on the outside and red on the inside. Cantaloupe is another kind of melon with orange inside. Melons grow in warm places. They first came from Africa and Asia. People eat melons as a cool snack on hot days. Melons have a lot of water in them, so they help you stay wet inside. The seeds of some melons can be used as medicine.
Sunflower\n\nA sunflower is a tall plant with a big, round, yellow flower. The flower is actually made of many tiny flowers. The middle part of the flower turns into seeds. Sunflowers need lots of sun to grow. They can grow very tall, even taller than a person. People eat the seeds as a snack. Birds also like to eat sunflower seeds. Sunflower oil comes from the seeds and is used for cooking. Sunflowers can be yellow, red, or orange.
Dublin\n\nDublin is a big city in a country called Ireland. It is the capital city, which means the most important city in that country. Many people live there. A long time ago, people called Vikings built Dublin next to a river. The river splits the city into two parts. Some famous writers lived in Dublin. Dublin has a very big sports stadium where people play games like hurling, football, rugby, and soccer.
Euphrates\n\nThe Euphrates is a very long river. It is one of two big rivers in a place called Mesopotamia. The other river is the Tigris. The two rivers meet and flow into the sea. Long ago, people used the Euphrates for water to drink and to help plants grow. Now there are big walls called dams that hold some of the water back, so less water flows to the sea.
Sailing ship\n\nA sailing ship is a very big boat that uses the wind to move. It has tall poles called masts, and big pieces of cloth called sails that catch the wind. The wind pushes the sails, and the ship goes forward. People have used sailing ships for a very long time, even before there were cars or trains. Long ago, sailing ships were the main way to carry things and people across the ocean. They were also used in wars. Today, big sailing ships are not used much anymore, but small ones called sailboats are still used for fun and play.
Quartz\n\nQuartz is a very hard rock that is clear and smooth. It is found all over the world in the ground. Many pretty stones like amethyst and rose quartz are kinds of quartz. People use quartz to make jewelry and clocks. Most sand on the beach is made of tiny bits of quartz. Some quartz has lines inside that show where a big rock from space hit the Earth long ago.
Ginkgo\n\nA ginkgo is a kind of tree. It has leaves that look like little fans. In the fall, the leaves turn bright yellow and fall off. The ginkgo tree is very old and comes from China. It is the special tree of China.
Lawn mower\n\nA lawn mower is a machine that cuts grass. Some lawn mowers are small and you push them. Some are big and you ride on them. The biggest ones are pulled by a tractor. They cut grass at parks, golf courses, and fields. Always be careful when using a lawn mower.
Vietnam\n\nVietnam is a country in Southeast Asia. It is next to Cambodia, China, and Laos. The capital city is Hanoi. The biggest city is Ho Chi Minh City. Many people live in Vietnam, almost 100 million. Vietnam is long and thin, like a snake. The north has four seasons: winter, spring, summer, and fall. The south is hot all year. Long ago, two sisters named Trung Trac and Trung Nhi led a fight to chase away the Chinese ruler. They made their own kingdom and stopped taxes. But a Chinese general beat them. After that, China ruled Vietnam for more than a thousand years. Later, France took over Vietnam. Then the country was split into North Vietnam and South Vietnam. The north was led by Ho Chi Minh. The two parts were supposed to have an election to become one country, but the election did not happen. Today, Vietnam is one country again.
Notre-Dame de Paris\n\nNotre-Dame de Paris is a very old church in Paris, France. It sits on a small island in the middle of the River Seine. Many people visit it every year. The church has two big round windows that are as wide as a car is long. A man named Victor Hugo wrote a story about this church, called 'The Hunchback of Notre Dame'. In 2019, a big fire hurt the church, but people are fixing it.
Plate\n\nA plate is a flat dish where you put food to eat. Plates can be made of hard clay, plastic, paper, or foam. Some plates are round and some are flat. You use a plate at mealtime to hold your food.\n\nThere is another kind of plate that is not for food. The ground under our feet is made of big, flat pieces called plates. These plates float on hot, soft rock deep inside the Earth. They move very, very slowly. When they bump into each other, they can make mountains or earthquakes.
Human evolution\n\nHuman evolution is the story of how people came to be. A long, long time ago, the first humans lived in Africa. They looked different from us and walked on two feet. Over many, many years, their brains grew bigger and they learned to make simple tools. Humans are close cousins to apes like chimpanzees and gorillas. We share many things with them, like our hands and how our bodies work. Scientists find old bones and tools to learn about how people changed over time.
Kinship\n\nKinship is how people are part of the same family. It tells us who our mom, dad, brothers, sisters, and cousins are. Some family ties come from being born into a family, like your parents and siblings. Other family ties come from things like marriage or adoption, when someone new joins the family. Your father's side of the family is one kind of family line, and your mother's side is another kind. Kinship helps us know who we are related to and who we belong with.
Free and open-source software\n\nFree and open-source software is a kind of computer program that anyone can look at, change, and share. The people who make it let everyone use it for free. You can even help make it better if you know how to work with computers. Many games and tools are made this way.
Aerodynamics\n\nAerodynamics is about how air moves around things that go fast. When a car or a plane moves, the air pushes on it. A plane can fly because its wings push air down, and that makes the plane go up. The shape of the wing helps the air move faster over the top, so the plane lifts up. The engine makes the plane go forward, but the air also pushes back, which is called drag. Aerodynamics helps make cars and planes go faster by making them smooth so the air slides past easily.
Moses\n\nMoses is a very important person in the Bible. He was a leader and a prophet. When Moses was a baby, a king wanted to hurt all baby boys. His mother put him in a basket in the river. A princess found him and took care of him. When Moses grew up, he helped his people leave Egypt. God gave Moses ten special rules called the Ten Commandments. Moses led his people through the desert for many years. God gave them food and water. Moses died when he was 120 years old. People still remember Moses today.
Lemur\n\nA lemur is a small animal that lives on the island of Madagascar. Lemurs are not monkeys, but they are part of the primate family. The name "lemur" means "ghost" because they make scary sounds at night. Lemurs come in many sizes, from as small as a mouse to as big as a cat. Most small lemurs are awake at night, while bigger ones are awake during the day. Lemurs have long tails and soft fur. The ring-tailed lemur has a black-and-white striped tail. Lemurs eat fruit, leaves, and other plants. They live in groups called troops, with 5 to 42 members. The girl lemurs are the bosses and stay in the same troop their whole lives. Boy lemurs move between groups. A mother lemur has one or two babies and feeds them milk for about four months. Then the babies start eating fruit. Lemurs spend most of their time in trees and can jump far from tree to tree. They talk to each other with hoots and smells. When a boy lemur wants to scare another boy, he rubs his tail on smelly spots under his arms and waves it in the other's face. That is called a stink fight. Lemurs are in danger because people cut down their homes and sometimes hunt them.
Kenya\n\nKenya is a country in East Africa, near the Indian Ocean. Its capital city is Nairobi. Kenya has many wild animals like lions, elephants, giraffes, and rhinos. People visit Kenya to see these animals in special parks. The land has lots of grass and some mountains. The highest mountain is Mount Kenya. Kenya is hot near the coast and cooler in the highlands. People in Kenya speak English and Swahili. Children go to school for eight years of primary school and four years of high school. Kenya became its own country in 1963.
Hydroelectricity\n\nHydroelectricity is electricity made by moving water. People build big walls called dams across rivers to hold water. When the water is let out, it rushes through pipes and spins a wheel called a turbine. The spinning turbine makes electricity. This kind of electricity does not make smoke or dirt, so it is good for the Earth. It can be used again and again because water never runs out. Some places like Norway make most of their electricity this way. But building a dam can flood land and force people to move. It can also hurt fish and other animals that live in the water.
Loan\n\nA loan is when someone gives you money, and you promise to give it back later. You might pay a little bit each month until you have paid all of it back. Sometimes you also have to pay extra money called interest, which is like a fee for borrowing. Some loans are for buying a house or a car. Other loans are for small things you need right away. If you borrow money for a house, the house is like a promise that you will pay back the loan. If you do not pay back, the lender can take the house.
Jellyfish\n\nA jellyfish is a soft sea animal that lives in the ocean. Its body is shaped like a bell and is mostly water. Jellyfish have long, stinging arms called tentacles that hang down from their body. They use these tentacles to catch tiny animals like plankton and small fish. Jellyfish float in the water and move by squeezing their body, but they mostly drift with the current. Some jellyfish are very small, and some are big. The biggest jellyfish is the Lion's mane, with tentacles as long as a bus. Some jellyfish glow in the dark. Many animals eat jellyfish, like sea turtles and fish. People also eat jellyfish, especially in Asia. A group of jellyfish is called a bloom.
Transport\n\nTransport is moving people or things from one place to another. There are roads for cars and trucks, railways for trains, and airports for airplanes. Boats and ships travel on water. Some vehicles use electricity, like trains and trams. Others use gas or oil, which can make the air dirty. People build roads, train stations, and airports to help transport work.
Abraham\n\nAbraham is a man from the Bible and the Qur'an. He is the father of the Jewish people and is very important to three big religions: Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. Abraham had a son named Isaac with his wife Sarah. He also had a son named Ishmael with Sarah's helper Hagar. God told Abraham to leave his home and go to a new land called Canaan. God promised that Abraham would be the father of a great family. When Abraham was very old, God told him to take his son Isaac up a mountain. Abraham was ready to do what God said, but an angel stopped him. Instead, Abraham gave a sheep to God. Abraham lived to be 175 years old. His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in a cave.
Cognition\n\nCognition is a big word for how your brain works. It is how you think, remember things, and learn new stuff. When you see a dog and know it is a dog, that is cognition. When you remember your favorite toy, that is cognition too. Your brain uses your eyes, ears, and other senses to learn about the world. Thinking, solving puzzles, and making choices are all part of cognition. A man named Jean Piaget studied how children's brains grow and learn as they get older.
Mosque\n\nA mosque is a special building where Muslim people go to pray and learn about their religion. Muslims wash their hands and feet before they go inside to pray. Inside, there are no chairs or tables, just soft rugs on the floor. People sit on the rugs and bow to pray. Many mosques have tall towers called minarets. A person called a muezzin calls out from the minaret to tell everyone it is time to pray. Mosques often have big round roofs called domes. The walls may have pretty patterns and writing, but no pictures of people or animals. Some mosques have a courtyard with a fountain for washing. Mosques are found all over the world, even in cold places.
Hormone\n\nHormones are tiny messengers inside your body. They travel in your blood to tell different parts of your body what to do. Hormones help you grow, help you feel hungry or full, and help your body stay just right. Special groups of cells called glands make hormones. For example, when you eat sugar, a gland called the pancreas sends out a hormone called insulin. Insulin tells your body to use the sugar for energy. Hormones also help babies be born. They make a mother's belly squeeze until the baby comes out. Your body is very smart at keeping just the right amount of each hormone.
Indus River\n\nThe Indus River is a very long river in Asia. It flows through Tibet, Kashmir, and Pakistan. The river is 3,180 kilometers long, which is very, very long. It is the longest river in Pakistan and a special symbol for the country. The Indus starts high up in the mountains in Tibet. It runs fast down the mountains and picks up water from many icy streams. The river goes between two big mountain ranges called the Karakoram and the Himalayas. In Pakistan, the first town on the river is Skardu, which is very high up in the mountains. People live in Skardu and in small villages along the river. The Indus gives water to farms in Pakistan because there is not much rain there. Without the Indus, it would be very hard to grow food. Many other rivers flow into the Indus, like the Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas, and Sutlej. The name "India" comes from the word "Indus."
Ginger\n\nGinger is a plant that grows from a root. People use the root as a spice in food. The plant has tall green stems and narrow leaves. It has yellow or white flowers that grow from the root. Ginger tastes a little spicy and warm. People cook with ginger in many countries. It first came from China and then spread to other warm places. Some people have hair that is the color of ginger, which is a red-brown color.
Industrial Revolution\n\nThe Industrial Revolution is the name of a time long ago when people started making things with machines instead of by hand. Before, people made things one at a time in small shops. Then, big factories with machines could make many things quickly and cheaply. This started in England around the 1760s. Many people moved from farms to towns to work in factories. The steam engine was a very important machine that helped run the factories and trains. People burned coal to make the steam engines work. Life changed a lot. Some people became rich, but many workers, including children, had to work very long hours for little money. Families often lived in small, crowded rooms. New inventions also helped make things like cloth and metal faster. The Industrial Revolution spread to other countries like America. It changed how people lived and worked.
Chain mail\n\nChain mail is a kind of armor made from many small metal rings linked together. It looks like a shirt made of metal. Long ago, soldiers wore chain mail to protect their bodies in battle. The rings are strong and can stop cuts from swords or knives. Chain mail is heavy, so it is hard to move around in it. Today, some people still wear chain mail. Butchers and firefighters wear chain mail gloves to keep their hands safe from sharp things. Some divers wear chain mail suits when they swim near sharks. People who dress up like old-time soldiers also wear chain mail for fun.
Light\n\nLight is what helps us see things. It comes from the sun, stars, and lamps. Light makes the daytime bright. When light hits something, it bounces off, and our eyes see that. Different colors of light have different sizes of waves. Red has the biggest waves, and purple has the smallest. Rainbows are made when light bends in raindrops. Light travels very fast, faster than anything else. It moves in a straight line. When something blocks light, it makes a shadow. Some things let light pass through, like glass. Other things block light, like a wall. Light also keeps the Earth warm.
Appalachian Mountains\n\nThe Appalachian Mountains are a big group of mountains in North America. They are mostly in the United States but also in Canada. The mountains are very old and have been worn down by wind and rain over a long, long time. They are not very tall, but they are wide and stretch from Canada down to Alabama. The mountains make it hard to travel from east to west because you have to go up and down many hills. A long walking path called the Appalachian Trail goes through the mountains for more than 2,000 miles. Many people like to hike and camp there.
College\n\nA college is a school where people go to learn after they finish high school. Most people start college when they are 18 years old, but anyone can go at any age. In college, students take classes in many subjects like math, science, and reading. They also pick one special subject to learn a lot about, like animals or numbers. When they finish all their classes, they get a degree. Some people use their degree to get a job, and some go back to college to learn even more.
Seaweed\n\nSeaweed is a plant that lives in the ocean. It can be red, green, or brown. Seaweed needs sunlight and salt water to grow. It often grows near the shore on rocks. Some seaweed floats on the water. People eat seaweed in many countries. It is used in soups, sushi, and noodles. Seaweed is also in toothpaste and some paints.
Tropics\n\nThe tropics are the part of the Earth that is near the middle, where it is very warm. The sun shines right overhead there at least once each year. In the tropics, the weather is usually hot and wet. Many big forests with lots of trees and animals live there. Some places in the tropics have a dry season and a rainy season. Big storms called tropical cyclones can start in the warm ocean water there.
Satan\n\nSatan is a name for a bad spirit in some religions. Many people believe Satan tries to make people do wrong things. In the Christian Bible, Satan was once an angel named Lucifer who thought he was as strong as God and was sent away from heaven. In the Quran, Satan is called Iblis and was made from fire. Some people think Satan is not a real person but just a way to talk about the bad feelings inside people.
Tillage\n\nTillage is when people break up the dirt in a field. A big machine called a tractor pulls a tool that digs into the ground. Sometimes a horse or a person pulls the tool instead. This lets air and sunshine get into the soil, which helps plants grow. But if people do it too much, the dirt can get tired and not grow plants well.
Discrimination\n\nDiscrimination is when someone is treated badly or differently just because of who they are. It can happen because of the color of their skin, how old they are, if they are a boy or a girl, what they believe, or how they look. It is not fair to treat someone differently for these reasons. Many places have rules that say people should be treated the same and get the same pay for the same work. But sometimes, even with rules, discrimination still happens.
Battle\n\nA battle is a big fight between two groups of people. Each group tries to beat the other group. Battles happen during wars. A small battle is called a skirmish. The place where a battle happens is called a battlefield. Some battles are very important and can change history.
Music industry\n\nThe music industry is all the people and companies that make money from songs. They write songs, sing them, record them, and sell them. When you hear a song on the radio or buy it online, that is part of the music industry. Some people in the music industry are singers, songwriters, and people who help make the music sound good.
Bay\n\nA bay is a part of the sea or a lake that goes into the land. It is like a big curve of water between two pieces of land that stick out. The water in a bay is usually calm, and there is often a sandy beach where you can play. Some bays are very small, and some are so big they are called gulfs. Bays are made when soft rock wears away and hard rock stays, making the land shape.
Terracotta Army\n\nThe Terracotta Army is a big group of clay soldiers that were buried underground a long, long time ago. An old Chinese king named Qin Shi Huang had them made to protect him after he died. The soldiers are made of clay and are as tall as a grown-up. Each one looks different — some have bows, some have swords, and some have spears. They were found by farmers digging for water. Many of them are still buried in the ground.
Addition\n\nAddition is when you put numbers together to make a bigger number. The plus sign (+) means you add. For example, if you have 3 apples and 2 more apples, you put them together and get 5 apples. That is called the sum. You can add numbers in any order and still get the same answer. Adding zero does not change a number. When you add big numbers, you add the ones first, then the tens, then the hundreds, and so on.
Contemporary art\n\nContemporary art is art that people make right now. It can be paintings, sculptures, or even things like big shapes and bright colors. Some art looks like real things, and some art looks like funny shapes or splashes of paint. Artists use many different ideas to make their art. You can see contemporary art in museums and galleries.
Spruce\n\nA spruce is a kind of tree that stays green all year. It has pointy needles that grow one by one around the branches. Spruce trees are very tall and look like a cone. They live in cold places far north. The needles fall off after many years. Baby spruce trees have a hard time growing because they can get hurt by cold weather and snow.
Deforestation\n\nDeforestation is when people cut down or burn many trees in a forest. They do this to make room for farms, houses, and roads. When trees are gone, animals that live in the forest lose their homes and may die. Trees help keep the air clean, so cutting them down makes the Earth warmer. People can help by planting new trees where old ones were cut.
0\n\nZero is a special number. It means there is nothing at all. If you have zero toys, you have no toys. The symbol for zero is "0". When you add zero to a number, that number stays the same. For example, 3 plus 0 is still 3. People use zero when they count down to a race: "three, two, one, zero, go!" Zero is the start time. Long ago, some people did not know about zero, which made math harder. Now we use zero every day.
Papyrus\n\nPapyrus is a kind of paper that people used long ago in Ancient Egypt. They made it from a tall plant that grows near the Nile river. The plant is called papyrus too. People cut the plant and pressed it flat to make sheets for writing. They also used the plant to make boats, mats, rope, sandals, and baskets. Later, people in other places near the sea also used papyrus.
Tropical cyclone\n\nA tropical cyclone is a big, spinning storm that starts over warm ocean water near the middle of the Earth. It has very fast winds and lots of rain. The center of the storm is called the eye, and it is calm with little wind or rain. Around the eye is the eye wall, where the wind is fastest and rain is heaviest. These storms can be dangerous when they move over land. They can knock down trees, break houses, and cause floods. In different parts of the world, tropical cyclones have different names. In the Atlantic Ocean, they are called hurricanes. In the western Pacific Ocean, they are called typhoons. In the Indian Ocean and South Pacific, they are just called cyclones. People give these storms names to help keep track of them. The names are chosen by a group of weather experts. Sometimes these storms hurt people and break things, so it is important to be safe when one is coming.
Afghanistan\n\nAfghanistan is a country in Asia. It has many big mountains called the Hindu Kush. The capital city is Kabul. Many people live in small villages and some move around with their animals. The country has hot summers and cold winters. Wild animals like wolves, foxes, bears, and snow leopards live in the mountains. People in Afghanistan speak Dari and Pashto. Most people follow the religion of Islam.
Lagoon\n\nA lagoon is a pool of salt water that is partly cut off from the big ocean. Something like a sandy beach or a coral reef keeps the lagoon safe from big waves. Some lagoons are near the shore, and some are inside a ring of coral called an atoll. The water in a lagoon is usually calm and warm.
Yellow Emperor\n\nThe Yellow Emperor is a famous king from long ago in China. People tell stories about him, but no one knows if he was a real person. He is called the Yellow Emperor because of his name. Many Chinese people think he was the first father of all Han Chinese people. He lived a very, very long time ago, even before your great-great-grandparents were born. Some people in China still remember him and tell stories about his adventures.
Buckwheat\n\nBuckwheat is a plant with small seeds that people can eat like cereal. The seeds have three sides and look like tiny beech tree seeds. Buckwheat is not a real grass like wheat. It is a cousin of rhubarb and sorrel. People use buckwheat seeds to make pancakes, noodles, and porridge. The seeds are good for you and give you energy.
Cannon\n\nA cannon is a very big gun. It has a long tube called a barrel. Long ago, people in China made the first cannons. They put gunpowder in the back of the tube and a heavy ball in the front. When the gunpowder caught fire, it pushed the ball out very fast. Cannons were used in wars to shoot at enemies far away. Today, big cannons are on ships and tanks.
Buddhism\n\nBuddhism is a way of life that started a long time ago in India. It comes from a man named Siddhartha Gautama, who is called the Buddha, which means "the one who woke up." The Buddha taught people how to be happy and stop feeling sad. He said that all living things feel pain when they are born, get sick, grow old, or die. He showed people how to let go of wanting too much, being angry, and being confused. Buddhists try to be kind and not hurt others. They sit quietly to think and calm their minds. Many people around the world follow Buddhism.
Electromagnet\n\nAn electromagnet is a special kind of magnet that only works when electricity flows through a wire. The wire is wrapped around a piece of iron, like a nail. When you turn on the electricity, the electromagnet can pick up metal things like paperclips or nails. When you turn off the electricity, it stops being a magnet. You can make it stronger by adding more wire loops or using a bigger battery. Electromagnets are used in doorbells, motors, and big machines that lift heavy metal.
Inclined plane\n\nAn inclined plane is a flat surface that is slanted, like a ramp. It helps you move things up or down without having to lift them straight up. You use less force to push or pull something on a ramp. Ramps, hills, and slides are all inclined planes. Even a knife has two inclined planes back to back, which helps it cut things.
Mustelid\n\nMustelids are a big family of animals that eat meat. They come in many sizes. Some are small like weasels that catch mice. Some are big and strong like wolverines that can catch animals much bigger than themselves. Mustelids live in many places. Otters live in the water. One kind of weasel lives in the cold Arctic. A mustelid called the ferret has been tamed. Long ago people used ferrets for hunting. Now people keep them as pets. A ferret looks like a long skinny rat, so some people call it a tube rat.
Heat transfer\n\nHeat transfer is how heat moves from one thing to another. Heat always moves from something hot to something cold. For example, when you touch a warm cup, the heat moves from the cup to your hand. Heat can move through solid things, like a metal spoon. It can also move through air or water. Sometimes heat moves through empty space, like the heat from the sun that warms your face.
Gulf of Mexico\n\nThe Gulf of Mexico is a big body of water next to the United States, Mexico, and Cuba. It is part of the Atlantic Ocean. The water in the Gulf is warm, and many fish live there. People catch fish for food. There is also oil under the water. Hurricanes sometimes come to the Gulf and make big waves. In 2025, the United States started calling it the Gulf of America, but other countries still call it the Gulf of Mexico.
Venus (mythology)\n\nVenus is a goddess from old Roman stories. She is the goddess of love and beauty. People in ancient times built temples for her and had special days to celebrate her. She was married to Vulcan, the god of fire and volcanoes. Some important people, like Julius Caesar, said Venus was part of their family.
Courage\n\nCourage is when you do something even if you are scared. It means being brave. A person shows courage when they help someone else, even if it is a little bit scary. For example, saving a baby from a fire takes a lot of courage. Courage is the opposite of being afraid.
Perception\n\nPerception is how your body takes in things around you and your brain figures out what they are.
