They sound different, but they use the same writing system with special pictures called characters. Some characters are simple, and some are more complicated. In China, most people use the simple ones. To read a newspaper, you need to know about 3,000 characters. Chinese words have tones, which means your voice goes up or down to change the meaning. Many people learn Mandarin because it is the main language used in China.
Garlic\n\nGarlic is a plant that people eat to make food taste better. It has a very strong smell and flavor. Garlic is like onions and leeks. The part people eat is called the head, and it grows at the bottom of a long green stalk. You can pull the head apart into smaller pieces called cloves. Cloves have papery skin that you peel off before cooking. People plant garlic in the fall, and one clove can grow into a whole new head. Garlic is also used as medicine to help with colds. Some stories say garlic keeps vampires away.
United States dollar\n\nThe United States dollar is the money people use in America. It is also used in some other places around the world. The dollar sign looks like this: $. People also call it USD. One dollar is made of 100 cents. There are coins like the penny (1 cent), nickel (5 cents), dime (10 cents), quarter (25 cents), and half-dollar (50 cents). Paper dollars are more common than dollar coins. All paper bills and coins have pictures of famous Americans on them. People get dollars from banks or machines called ATMs. Dollars are used to buy things like food, toys, and clothes.
Kabuki\n\nKabuki is a kind of Japanese play that started about 400 years ago. The actors wear special makeup and colorful clothes. They sing, dance, and act in a way that is not like real life. A woman named Izumo no Okuni started kabuki in 1603. Later, only men could be actors, and men still play both boy and girl parts today. The makeup helps the audience know if a character is brave or kind. Kabuki theaters have a round stage that can turn around, and a walkway called a "hanamichi" that goes through the audience. People from all over the world now watch kabuki.
Common sense\n\nCommon sense is something that most people know and understand. It helps you make good choices and stay safe. For example, it is common sense to look both ways before you cross the street. Common sense comes from what you learn and see every day. Sometimes common sense can be wrong. A long time ago, people thought the sun went around the Earth. That seemed like common sense then, but now we know it is not true.
Crochet\n\nCrochet is a way to make things with yarn and a special hook. You pull loops of yarn through other loops to make fabric. It is like knitting, but you use one hook instead of two pointy sticks. People use crochet to make blankets, hats, toys, and even lace. Kids can learn crochet because the stitches are easy and small hands can hold the hook. You can see your work grow fast, which is fun. If you stop and start again later, it is easy to keep going. Just remember that the names of stitches are different in the US and the UK, so check your pattern.
Lobster\n\nA lobster is a sea animal with a hard shell. It lives in the ocean, on rocks or sand. Lobsters have claws on their front legs. One claw is big and strong for grabbing food. The other claw is smaller and sharp for cutting. Lobsters walk slowly on the sea floor. When they are scared, they swim backwards very fast by bending their tail. They eat fish, worms, and plants. Sometimes they eat old shells they have shed. Lobsters grow bigger by climbing out of their old shell. This is called moulting. After moulting, they are soft and must hide until a new hard shell grows. Some lobsters live for more than 100 years. People catch lobsters to eat because the meat tastes good.
Scroll\n\nA scroll is a long roll of paper with writing on it. Long ago, people wrote stories and important messages on scrolls. You unroll a scroll to read it, then roll it back up to keep it safe. Some scrolls are very old and live in museums.
Sardine\n\nA sardine is a small fish that lives in the ocean. It is an oily fish and is related to the herring. Sardines are named after an island called Sardinia, where people used to catch many of them. You can buy sardines in cans at the store. The cans have water or oil inside to keep the fish soft.
Ghost\n\nA ghost is a make-believe spirit of a person who has died. In stories, ghosts try to scare people. Some ghosts are said to be friendly and help people. Many people believe they have seen or felt a ghost. Scientists say there is no proof that ghosts are real. People dress up as ghosts at Halloween.
Temperature\n\nTemperature tells us how hot or cold something is. You can feel if something is hot or cold with your skin. To know exactly how hot or cold, people use a tool called a thermometer. Most of the world uses degrees Celsius, but in the United States people use degrees Fahrenheit. Scientists sometimes use kelvins. Temperature is not the same as heat. Heat is energy that moves from a hot thing to a cold thing. Temperature is about how fast the tiny bits inside a thing are moving. When the bits move fast, the thing is hot. When they move slow, the thing is cold. Different things need different amounts of heat to get warmer. For example, water needs more heat to get hotter than steel does. Temperature also matters for weather. It changes during the day, in different seasons, and in different places.
Vein\n\nA vein is a tube inside your body that carries blood back to your heart. Most veins carry blood that has used up its air, so it looks dark red. You can see some veins under your skin, and they look blue because of how light goes through your skin. Veins have little doors inside them that stop blood from going the wrong way. The biggest vein in your body is called the vena cava.
Polo\n\nPolo is a sport played on horses. Two teams of 4 players try to hit a ball into the other team's goal. They use long sticks called mallets to hit the ball. The horses are called polo ponies, but they are really full-sized horses. The game is split into short parts called chukkas. Players change horses between chukkas. There are rules to keep the horses and riders safe. If a player breaks a rule, the other team gets a chance to score. Polo was first played a long time ago in a place called Baltistan. Later, people in England and the United States started playing it too.
Porto\n\nPorto is a big city in Portugal. It is the second biggest city in that country. Porto sits next to a big river called the Douro, and part of the city touches the Atlantic Ocean. The city is very old, and its center is a special place that people protect because it has old buildings and streets. Porto is famous for a special drink called port wine, which is made from grapes and stored in big buildings across the river. Many people visit Porto because it is pretty and fun.
Wool\n\nWool is the soft hair that comes from animals like sheep and goats. People take the wool and make it into yarn. Then they use the yarn to make warm clothes like sweaters, socks, and blankets. Wool keeps you warm because it traps heat. It can also soak up water. Wool is stretchy and can be cleaned easily. Some wool comes from rabbits, and that is called angora wool. Australia grows the most wool in the world.
Washington, D.C.\n\nWashington, D.C. is the capital of the United States. It is a special place that is not part of any state. The President lives and works there in a big white house called the White House. Many important government buildings are in Washington, D.C., like the Capitol where Congress meets and the Supreme Court. The city was named after George Washington, the first President. "D.C." stands for "District of Columbia." Washington, D.C. has many museums and monuments that people visit. There is a big park called the National Mall with lots of statues and museums. The city was planned before it was built, with wide streets and roundabouts. People who live in Washington, D.C. pay taxes but do not have a voting person in Congress, so their car license plates say "Taxation Without Representation." The weather is hot and humid in summer, cool in winter, and mild in spring and fall. Snow falls a few times each winter.
Zucchini\n\nZucchini is a green vegetable that looks like a cucumber. You can eat it cooked, and people sometimes put it in sweet bread. It is a type of squash. Some people call it courgette or baby marrow. You can also make long, thin strips of zucchini that look like noodles, called zoodles.
Helicopter\n\nA helicopter is a flying machine that can go up, down, and stay still in the air. It has spinning blades on top called rotors that lift it up. Unlike an airplane, a helicopter does not need a long road to take off or land. It can land in small places like a field or a rooftop. Helicopters help people in emergencies by bringing food, water, and medicine to places where cars cannot go. They can also carry hurt people to the hospital very fast. Some helicopters are used by the army to move soldiers and supplies. A long time ago, children played with a toy called a flying top that worked like a helicopter.
Austria\n\nAustria is a country in the middle of Europe. It is next to Germany, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, Slovenia, Italy, Switzerland, and Liechtenstein. People in Austria speak German. The capital city is Vienna. Austria has many big mountains called the Alps. The tallest mountain is Grossglockner. There is also a big river called the Danube. Austria is a democratic republic, which means people vote for their leaders. It does not fight in wars with other countries. Famous foods from Austria are Wiener Schnitzel and Apfelstrudel. Many famous music makers, like Mozart, were from Austria.
Rapping\n\nRapping is a way of talking that goes with music. It is like singing, but more like talking in a rhythm. A person who raps is called a rapper. Rapping started in New York City in the 1970s. People would talk over music at parties. Today, many popular songs have rapping in them. Rappers tell stories or share feelings with their words.
Formation and evolution of the Solar System\n\nThe Solar System is the Sun and everything that goes around it. It started a very, very long time ago, about 4.6 billion years. First, there was a big cloud of gas in space. The gas pulled together because of gravity, and the middle got very hot. That hot middle became the Sun. The rest of the gas and dust spun around and made the planets. The planets are made of rock and dust, but the Sun is made of gas. The Sun is huge and gives us light and heat. The planets go around the Sun because gravity pulls them. The Solar System is still changing, but very slowly.
Self-esteem\n\nSelf-esteem is how you feel about yourself. If you think you are good at things and like yourself, that is high self-esteem. If you think you are bad at things and do not like yourself, that is low self-esteem. Having good self-esteem helps you feel happy and brave. It is important to be kind to yourself and others.
Landscape painting\n\nLandscape painting is a kind of art that shows the outdoors. The picture can have trees, hills, rivers, or fields. It can be a real place or a make-believe one. Some landscape paintings show farms or towns that people built. Other paintings show wild nature like mountains and forests. Artists use paint to make the sky, ground, and water look pretty.
Infantry\n\nInfantry is a part of a country's army. People in the infantry fight on their own feet. They do not ride in cars or on horses. They are called foot soldiers. Long ago, they used spears and swords. Today, they use guns and other weapons. Being in the infantry is very dangerous. Many soldiers in the infantry get hurt or die in war. But the infantry is very important to the army.
Peru\n\nPeru is a country in South America. The capital is called Lima. Peru has tall mountains called the Andes, a big jungle called the Amazon, and old stone buildings from the Inca people. The Incas lived long ago and built cities like Machu Picchu high in the mountains. They grew potatoes and used llamas to carry things. Later, people from Spain came and took over. Now Peru is its own country. Many people visit Peru to see the mountains, the jungle, and the old Inca buildings. People in Peru speak Spanish and also a language called Quechua. They eat food like ceviche and broiled chicken. Peru sells fish, gold, oil, coffee, sugar, and cotton to other countries.
Design\n\nDesign is how something looks and how it works. People who make designs want things to be pretty and easy to use. They use shapes, colors, and lines to make pictures, chairs, clothes, or even websites. A good design helps you find your way in a big building like a hospital. Designers think hard about how to make things better for everyone.
Brisbane\n\nBrisbane is a big city in Australia. It is the capital of a part of Australia called Queensland. The city sits next to a river called the Brisbane River. Many people live there, more than two million. Brisbane has tall buildings called skyscrapers. In summer it is hot and rainy. In winter it is warm and dry. Sometimes big storms come and cause floods. Brisbane has many schools and places to learn. People there like to play and watch sports like cricket and rugby.
Acceleration\n\nAcceleration is how fast something speeds up. When a toy car starts moving, it goes from not moving to moving fast. That is acceleration. If the car slows down, that is called deceleration. Acceleration also happens when you change direction, like when you turn a corner on your bike. Big things need more push to speed up than little things.
Hero\n\nA hero is a brave person who helps others. A hero can be real, like a firefighter who saves a baby from a fire. A hero can also be make-believe, like a superhero in a story. Heroes are strong and do good things. They help people who are in trouble. A girl hero is called a heroine. The opposite of a hero is a villain.
Olympic weightlifting\n\nOlympic weightlifting is a sport where strong people try to lift a heavy bar with big round plates on the ends. They have to lift it all the way over their head in one fast move. The person who can lift the heaviest bar wins. People watch this sport at the Olympic games.
Mall\n\nA mall is a very big building with many stores inside. Each store has its own room with walls. People walk in the middle part to go from store to store. Most malls have a place to park cars outside. They also have a roof so people can shop even when it rains. Many malls have a food court where you can buy lunch. Some malls have a movie theater where you can watch a film. In America people call it a mall, and in the United Kingdom people call it a shopping center.
Scarf\n\nA scarf is a long piece of cloth you wear around your neck or on your head. People wear scarves to stay warm when it is cold outside. Some scarves are made of soft yarn and are knitted. Others are made of thin cloth. Some women wear a scarf on their head for their religion. Scarves can be many colors like red, blue, or green.
Bahrain\n\nBahrain is a small island country in the Persian Gulf. It is near Saudi Arabia and Qatar. The land is flat and dry, with a low hill in the middle. People have lived there for a very long time. Long ago, Bahrain was known for sweet water springs and pearls. Today, it is a kingdom ruled by a king. The country has a parliament where people vote for some leaders. Women can also vote. Bahrain gets money from oil, but it also has other businesses. The biggest city is Manama.
Sahara\n\nThe Sahara is a very big desert in North Africa. It is the largest hot desert in the world. The Sahara is very hot and dry. It does not rain much there. In the summer, the air can be over 100 degrees. At night, it can get cold. Some parts have sand dunes, and other parts have rocks and mountains. A few rivers like the Nile flow through it. Not many people live in the Sahara because it is so dry. But some people live near water called oases. There are also animals like camels, snakes, and scorpions. The Sahara is as big as the whole United States.
Chamber music\n\nChamber music is music played by a small group of people. A chamber is a room in a big house. Long ago, rich people had musicians play in small rooms. That is why it is called chamber music. The group can have two to nine players. Each person plays a different part. There is no leader like in a big orchestra. Everyone listens to each other and plays together. It is like talking with music. Some famous music writers like Mozart and Haydn wrote chamber music. Playing chamber music is fun because you can hear your own playing.
Hunter-gatherer\n\nA hunter-gatherer is a person who gets food from wild plants and animals. They do not grow food in gardens or keep farm animals. Instead, they pick berries, nuts, and roots from the woods. They also hunt animals like deer or fish for meat. Hunter-gatherers move from place to place to find food. They do not stay in one house for a long time. Long ago, all people were hunter-gatherers. Today, only a few groups still live this way.
Skyscraper\n\nA skyscraper is a very tall building. Many skyscrapers are built in big cities like New York, Chicago, London, and Tokyo. Long ago, people did not build very tall buildings because they would fall down. Now we use strong materials like steel and concrete to make them stand up straight. The first skyscraper was built in Chicago in 1885 and was ten stories high. One of the most famous skyscrapers is the Empire State Building in New York City. Today, the tallest skyscraper in the world is the Burj Khalifa in Dubai.
Luanda\n\nLuanda is a big city in Africa. It is the capital of a country called Angola. Luanda sits next to the Atlantic Ocean, where big boats come and go. Many people live there, about as many as in a very large town. Long ago, people from Portugal built the city. Now it is the most important city in Angola.
Forging\n\nForging is a way to make things from metal. You hit the metal with a hammer to change its shape. Sometimes the metal is heated first to make it soft. People have been forging for a very long time. They make things like pots, pans, tools, and swords. Big machines can also forge very large pieces of metal.
Spiral galaxy\n\nA spiral galaxy is a big group of stars that looks like a flat spinning plate with a bump in the middle. The bump is the center, and arms of stars and dust go around it like a pinwheel. Some spiral galaxies have a bar of stars across the middle. Our own galaxy, the Milky Way, is a spiral galaxy. The arms are bright because they have young, hot stars. Spiral galaxies are common in the universe, but you do not find many near big groups of galaxies.
Pathogen\n\nA pathogen is a tiny living thing that can make you sick. Some pathogens are very small germs called viruses or bacteria. Your body has a helper system that fights off these germs to keep you healthy. Sometimes, if your helper system is weak, the germs can grow and make you very sick. A long time ago, a very bad germ called the flu made many, many people sick all over the world. Pathogens can also make plants sick, and fungi are the main germs that hurt plants.
Margarine\n\nMargarine is a food that looks like butter but is made from plant oil or animal fat. It has less fat than butter, so some people use it instead. But some margarines have a kind of fat that is not good for your heart. Butter or olive oil are better for cooking.
Greek language\n\nGreek is a language that people speak in Greece and Cyprus. It is a very old language that people have been writing for more than 3,000 years. The Greek alphabet is used to write it. Many other alphabets, like the one we use for English, came from the Greek alphabet. Over 13 million people speak Greek today. Most of them live in Greece and Cyprus, but some live in other countries like the United States and Australia.
Festival\n\nA festival is a special time when people come together to have fun and celebrate. Sometimes it is a holiday when everyone gets a day off from school or work. People at a festival might listen to music, watch dancing, hear poems, or see movies. Some festivals are about a religion, and some are about a whole country.
California\n\nCalifornia is a place in the United States, next to the Pacific Ocean. It is big and has more people than any other state. Some big cities are Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco, and the capital Sacramento. California has mountains, deserts, and a long coast. It has hot places like Death Valley and high mountains like Mount Whitney. Many fruits and vegetables grow there. Lots of movies are made in Hollywood. Many people from different countries live in California. There are earthquakes sometimes, so people keep extra food and water ready. The state flower is the golden poppy. People call it 'The Golden State'.
British Library\n\nThe British Library is a very big library in London, England. It is one of the biggest libraries in the whole world. It has more than 170 million things, like books, maps, and music. Every year, it gets about three million new things. The library has a tall glass tower inside that holds the King's Library, which has 65,000 books. Some of the books are very old, from a long time ago. People can go to the library to read and learn.
Boarding school\n\nA boarding school is a school where children live and sleep, not just go for lessons. Some children go home every day, but others stay there all the time. A child who stays at a boarding school is called a boarder. Most boarding schools cost money for both sleeping and learning. In Ghana, many older children go to boarding schools. Some boarding schools are for children who need extra help, and some let children help make the rules. There are also military schools that teach children to be strong and follow rules. Many stories, like Harry Potter, take place at boarding schools.
Digital art\n\nDigital art is art made with a computer or a tablet. Instead of using paper and crayons, you use a screen and a special pen. You can draw pictures, make funny cartoons, or change photos. Some people call it computer art. It is a fun way to make art with technology.
Havana\n\nHavana is a big city and the capital of Cuba. It is the largest city in the Caribbean. Many people live there. Havana is very old. It was first built a long time ago by people from Spain. The city has a big airport where planes come and go. There are old forts and walls that were built to keep the city safe. Ships used to stop in Havana on their way back to Spain.
History of video games\n\nThe history of video games is about how playing games on a screen began and grew. The first video games came out a long time ago, in the 1970s. People liked them so much that many companies started making games. Then, in 1983, the game business had a hard time and almost stopped. But two years later, it got better and grew bigger than before. Now, video games are very popular all over the world. Big companies like Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo make games for kids and grown-ups. Some old games, like Super Mario Bros, are still loved today. New games, like Super Mario Odyssey, are fun to play on new machines.
Stairs\n\nStairs are steps that help you go up or down. They can be straight or round. Some stairs have a railing to hold onto so you do not fall. Escalators are moving stairs. Ladders are like stairs you can carry.
Osaka\n\nOsaka is a big city in Japan. It is near the sea, so boats can come and go easily. Long ago, an emperor made Osaka the capital city. A man named Toyotomi Hideyoshi built a big castle there. Today, Osaka is a busy place where people work, shop, and have fun. People in Osaka eat special foods like okonomiyaki and takoyaki. They also speak a different way of talking called Osaka-Ben. Osaka is still a very important city in Japan.
Oat\n\nOat is a grain that people and animals eat. People make oatmeal from oats. Oatmeal is a warm breakfast food. You can also make oat bread and oat cookies. Oats grow in places that are not too hot and not too cold. They need a lot of rain. Horses and chickens like to eat oats too. Oat straw is soft and used for animal beds. Oats are good for you and help keep your heart healthy.
Critical thinking\n\nCritical thinking is a smart way to think. It means looking at something carefully and deciding if it is true or not. You ask questions and think about different ideas. You look for proof to help you decide. You also think about what might happen next. This helps you make good choices and solve problems. It keeps you from being fooled.
Garden\n\nA garden is a piece of land where people grow flowers, trees, and other plants. Taking care of a garden by watering the plants and pulling out weeds is called gardening. Some gardens are small and in people's backyards. Other gardens are big and in parks or zoos. A greenhouse is a special building with a glass roof that lets sunlight in to help plants grow. Water gardens have pools and ponds with water lilies. Gardens are smaller than farms. Farms grow lots of food to sell, but most backyard gardens are just for fun. Gardens can have paths, seats, ponds, fountains, and waterfalls. Many people think gardens are beautiful and relaxing. Some gardens have places to sit and read or have a barbecue. In Japan, people make special gardens with rocks, water, and tiny trees. Long ago, kings and queens had big fancy gardens built.
Buoyancy\n\nBuoyancy is a force that pushes things up in water or air. It helps boats float on water and balloons float in the sky. If something is lighter than water, it floats. If it is heavier, it sinks. A big ship made of metal can float because it has air inside, making it light enough to stay on top of the water.
Length\n\nLength is how long something is from one end to the other. Short means a small length. Long means a big length. A ruler is a tool to measure length. Shapes have sides, and each side has a length. Length can also mean how much time passes, like sitting for two hours.
Pearl\n\nA pearl is a small, hard, round thing that comes from an oyster. Oysters are animals that live in the sea. Pearls are often white, but can also be pale colors or black. They are used to make pretty jewelry like necklaces and earrings. A pearl is made when an oyster gets a tiny bit of sand or a little bug inside its shell. The oyster covers it with a shiny, smooth material to protect itself. Over time, this makes a pearl. Pearls can be very tiny, like a little seed, or as big as a fist. Some pearls come from oysters in the ocean, and some come from mussels in rivers and lakes. The month June has the pearl as its special stone.
Office\n\nAn office is a room or a building where people do work with papers and computers. People in an office write, read, and talk to each other. Some offices have desks, chairs, and shelves. There are also meeting rooms where people sit together and talk. Many offices have a kitchen where workers can make lunch. Long ago, offices were small rooms in palaces where people counted money for the king. Today, offices can be big buildings with many workers.
Metropolitan area\n\nA metropolitan area is a big city and the smaller towns and villages around it. The word "metropolitan" comes from old words that mean "mother city." Many people live in the big city, and even more people live in the towns and houses nearby. The biggest metropolitan area in the world is Tokyo. About 8 and a half million people live in Tokyo itself, and about 36 and a half million live in the whole metropolitan area. Sometimes the whole area is run by one government, like in Australia.
Power\n\nPower is a word that can mean different things. It can mean the energy that makes lights turn on and machines work. It can also mean when someone is very strong or in charge. For example, a king has power over his people. Electricity gives power to your toys and TV.
Bean\n\nA bean is a seed that comes from a plant. Beans grow inside pods, like little green cases. There are many kinds of beans, such as lentils, peas, and soybeans. Beans are good for you because they have lots of fiber and protein. Some beans, like coffee beans and cocoa beans, are not really beans but look like them. You can eat many beans, but some beans are poisonous and you should never eat them.
The Gambia\n\nThe Gambia is a small country in West Africa. It is very long and thin, like a ribbon. The Gambia is the smallest country on the mainland of Africa. It is surrounded by another country called Senegal, except for one side where the ocean is. The big river called the River Gambia flows through the middle of the country. The capital city is Banjul. Many people live in the cities of Serekunda and Brikama. The weather is hot, and from June to November it rains a lot. People who live there are called Gambians. Most of them follow the religion of Islam. They speak English and other languages too.
Enceladus\n\nEnceladus is a giant from old Greek stories. He was very big and strong. The stories say he fought against other gods and lost. Now he is said to be trapped under a mountain.
Trout\n\nA trout is a fish that lives in clear rivers, streams, and lakes. It can be found in America, Europe, and Asia. Trout have a small extra fin on their back. Young trout have dark spots on their sides. They are in the same family as salmon.
Parthenon\n\nThe Parthenon is a very old building in Athens, Greece. It was built a long, long time ago to honor a goddess named Athena. The building is made of big white stones called marble. It has tall columns all around it. For many years, people used it as a church and then as a mosque. A big explosion hurt the building in 1687. Some of its stone carvings were taken away and are now in a museum in London.
Guanaco\n\nA guanaco is an animal that lives in South America. It looks a bit like a camel or a llama, with a long neck and soft fur. Guanacos live in small groups called herds. When one guanaco sees danger, it makes a loud call to warn the others. Then they all run away very fast over rocks and hills. Guanacos eat grass, leaves, and buds. They can go a long time without drinking water because they get water from the plants they eat.
English Channel\n\nThe English Channel is a big stretch of water between Great Britain and Europe. People can cross it on a boat called a ferry, or ride a train through a tunnel under the water called the Chunnel. Cars can go on both the ferry and the train. The channel is very long and wide, but at one spot it is only as wide as a long swim. On a clear day, you can see the white cliffs on one side from the other side. Some people have swum across the channel, but now it is not allowed.
Zoo\n\nA zoo is a place where many different kinds of animals live so people can come and see them. Good zoos take care of the animals and give them big spaces that feel like their real homes. Zoos help keep animals safe when they are in trouble and might disappear from the world. People learn about animals by watching them at the zoo. Some zoos are not good and keep animals in small, sad cages where they get bored and sick.
Salt\n\nSalt is a white powder that people put on food to make it taste better. It comes from the ground or from the ocean. Long ago, salt was very special and people used it to keep food from going bad. They also used it to trade for other things. In winter, people put salt on icy roads to melt the ice. Salt can be many colors, but the salt we eat is usually white.
Gothic art\n\nGothic art is a kind of art from a long time ago called the Middle Ages. It started in France in the 1100s. Artists made big sculptures on church walls. They also made paintings on wood, colorful glass windows, and pictures in books. Many of these showed stories from the Bible, like Jesus and Mary. Mary looked soft and kind, like a real mom holding baby Jesus. Later, artists also made pictures of everyday life and stories, not just church stories. People in cities had money to buy art, so more art was made.
Grouper\n\nA grouper is a big fish that lives in warm ocean water. It has a big mouth and a strong body. Groupers like to hide near rocks and coral reefs. They sometimes work with octopuses to catch food. People like to catch groupers for eating because they are very tasty.
Safety\n\nSafety is a feeling that no bad things will happen. It means you are not in danger. Police help keep people safe by stopping bad things. A safety hat keeps your head safe from getting hurt. A house gives you safety from rain, wind, and cold. The opposite of safety is danger.
Apology\n\nAn apology is when you say you are sorry. You say it when you did something that made someone else feel sad or upset. Saying sorry can help the other person feel better. It is a way to show that you care about their feelings.
Niger\n\nNiger is a country in western Africa. It is very hot and dry, and much of it is desert. The capital city is Niamey. People there speak Hausa. Niger has no ocean or sea next to it. The country is named after the Niger River. Many people live in small villages and grow food like millet, sorghum, and peanuts. Some animals that live in Niger are giraffes and a special kind of antelope called the addax. Niger is one of the poorest countries in the world, and many people do not have enough food.
Stress (biology)\n\nStress is a feeling inside your body when something is hard or scary. It can make you feel worried or tight. A little bit of stress can help you do your best, like before a race. But too much stress is not good for your body or your mind. It can make you feel sick or very sad. When you feel stressed, you can take a break, play outside, or talk to a friend or family member. Taking deep breaths can also help you feel calm.
Steel\n\nSteel is a very hard and strong metal. It is made by mixing iron with a little bit of carbon. People use steel to make many things, like buildings, bridges, cars, and ships. Steel can be melted down and used again to make new things. It is a very useful metal.
Clown\n\nA clown is a person who makes people laugh. Clowns wear funny clothes and paint their faces with bright colors. They often have big wigs and big shoes. Many clowns work at a circus. They do silly tricks like juggling and falling down on purpose. Some clowns learn how to be funny at a special school. You might see a clown at a birthday party or on TV.
Clan\n\nA clan is a big group of people who are all part of the same family. The word 'clan' means 'family' in an old language. A long time ago, many people in Scotland and Ireland lived in clans. Each clan had its own name and its own special pattern on clothes called a tartan. People in a clan helped each other and stayed together.
Water tower\n\nA water tower is a tall building that holds water. It is built high up so the water can flow down. A machine called a pump fills the tower with water. Then gravity, which is the force that pulls things down, makes the water go through pipes to houses and other buildings. Even when the power goes out, the water tower still works because it does not need electricity to push the water down.
Beach volleyball\n\nBeach volleyball is a game played on sand. Two teams of two players hit a ball over a net. The sand is soft, so players jump and dive to get the ball. They use their hands to hit the ball. The team that makes the ball touch the other side's sand wins a point. People play beach volleyball at the beach or in a sand court.
Price\n\nPrice is how much something costs. You can pay for things with money or trade other things for them. For example, if you want a toy, the price is the money you give to get it. Sometimes people trade things, like eggs for wool. But money makes it easier to know the price.
Population\n\nPopulation is how many people live in a place. A city's population is the number of people who live there. The world has about 8 billion people. Asia has the most people. India has the most people of any country. Some places have many people living close together, like big cities. Other places have few people living far apart, like the countryside. The number of people in the world is growing, but not as fast as before.
Central Africa\n\nCentral Africa is a part of the big continent called Africa. It has many countries like Angola, Cameroon, Chad, and others. These countries work together to help each other.
Gladiolus\n\nA gladiolus is a flower that grows from a round bulb. It has tall stems with many colorful flowers on top. The leaves are long and pointy, like little swords. Gladiolus flowers can be pink, red, purple, white, orange, or yellow. They grow in warm places, especially in Africa. People plant them in gardens to enjoy their pretty colors.
San Antonio\n\nSan Antonio is a big city in Texas, USA. It has about 1.4 million people. The city is known for The Alamo, an old building, and the River Walk, which is a path with shops and restaurants along a small river. San Antonio also has a basketball team called the San Antonio Spurs. Many people visit the city for fun. There are two amusement parks: Six Flags Fiesta Texas and SeaWorld San Antonio. The city has a mix of people, and many speak Spanish because it was once part of Mexico.
Pediatrics\n\nPediatrics is a kind of doctor job that takes care of babies, children, and teenagers. A doctor who does this job is called a pediatrician. Pediatricians help kids stay healthy and grow well. They give shots that keep children from getting sick. They also teach parents about safe food and how to keep kids from getting hurt. Long ago, many children died from sickness, but now shots help stop that. Pediatricians check on children when they are well and when they are sick.
Texas\n\nTexas is a big state in the United States. It is the second biggest state after Alaska. Texas has many large cities like Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, and Austin, which is the capital. Texas is called the "Lone Star State" because its flag has one star. Long ago, Texas was its own country for almost ten years before joining the United States in 1845. Texas has mountains, forests, deserts, plains, and a coast. The Rio Grande river forms the border between Texas and Mexico. People in Texas work on farms, with cattle, and in technology companies. Oil was found in Texas in 1901, which made the state rich. Many tourists visit places like The Alamo in San Antonio and the Johnson Space Center in Houston.
Catfish\n\nA catfish is a fish that lives in rivers and lakes. It is called catfish because it has long feelers near its mouth that look like a cat's whiskers. Some catfish are very big, as long as a car. Some are very small. People eat catfish from fish farms. Some people keep small catfish in fish tanks at home. Most catfish do not hurt people. A few kinds of catfish can give a little shock, like a tiny zap.
Lima bean\n\nA lima bean is a kind of bean that you can eat. It is also called a butter bean. Lima beans grow inside a pod, just like other beans. They are soft and taste a little bit buttery. People cook them and eat them with dinner.
Carbon dioxide\n\nCarbon dioxide is a gas that you cannot see or smell. People and animals breathe out carbon dioxide when they breathe. Plants use carbon dioxide to make their food. Carbon dioxide is also made when things burn, like wood or gas. It is a greenhouse gas, which means it traps heat and can make the Earth warmer. There is a special kind of carbon dioxide called dry ice. Dry ice is very, very cold and turns from a solid straight into a gas. People use dry ice to make fog for shows and to keep things cold.
Ear\n\nThe ear is the part of the body that lets you hear sounds. People and most animals with fur have ears. Some animals like lizards hear through small holes instead of ears that stick out. The ear works by catching sound waves and sending them to the brain. The ear cleans itself by pushing earwax out with help from chewing and talking. The part of the ear you can see is called the pinna. Some animals use their ears in other ways. African elephants flap their big ears to stay cool. Bats use their ears to find food by listening to echoes. Some animals send messages to each other with their ears.
Apartment\n\nAn apartment is a place to live inside a bigger building. Many apartments can be in one building, and each one is a separate home. Apartments are common in cities where there is not much room for houses. People who live in an apartment pay money to the owner, called a landlord, to stay there. Some apartments have one big room for sleeping, eating, and playing, plus a bathroom. Others have separate rooms like a bedroom and a living room. Some apartments are very tall, and some are short with a garden outside. People share hallways and stairs to get to their own apartment.
Spanish literature\n\nSpanish literature is the stories, poems, and plays written in the Spanish language. It comes from the country of Spain. People in Spain have been writing stories and poems for a very long time. Some of these stories are about brave knights, funny adventures, or sad love. Spanish literature also includes writings from places in America where people speak Spanish. Many of these stories are famous all over the world.
Uluru\n\nUluru is a very big rock in the middle of Australia. It is in a hot, dry place called the Outback. The rock is red and looks very tall. Long ago, some people called the Anangu lived near Uluru. They think the rock is a very special and holy place. Many people visit Uluru to see how big and beautiful it is.
Sonar\n\nSonar is a machine that uses sound to find things under water. It sends out a sound and waits for the sound to bounce back, like an echo. This helps people know where boats, fish, or other things are in the sea. Some sonar machines just listen for sounds that other things make. Long ago, a man named Leonardo da Vinci put a tube in the water to listen. Today, sonar helps ships and submarines find their way.
Baobab\n\nA baobab is a very big tree that grows in hot, dry places like Africa and Madagascar. It is sometimes called the "tree of life" because it helps people and animals. The trunk of a baobab is very fat and can hold lots of water, like a giant bottle. For most of the year, the tree has no leaves and looks like its roots are sticking up in the air. The fruit of the baobab is called "monkey bread" and tastes a little like grapefruit and pear. People use the leaves to make soup, and the bark to make cloth and rope. Some baobab trees are so big that people build shops and bars inside the hollow trunk. These trees can live for a very, very long time, maybe even thousands of years.
Hare\n\nA hare is an animal that looks like a big rabbit. It has long ears with black tips. Hares are very fast and can run as fast as a car. They eat grass, leaves, and vegetables like lettuce. In spring, hares chase each other and sometimes box with their paws. A baby hare is called a leveret. Some hares change color in winter to white so they can hide in the snow.
Orange (fruit)\n\nAn orange is a round fruit that is orange in color. It grows on a tree with dark green leaves and small white flowers. The outside of an orange is a tough skin called peel. Inside, the orange is made of segments that are full of juice. Oranges have seeds inside some segments. You can peel the skin off and eat the segments. Oranges taste sweet and are good for you because they have vitamin C, which helps your body grow and stay healthy. Many people drink orange juice for breakfast. The color orange got its name from this fruit.
Taste\n\nTaste is how your tongue tells you what food is like. Your tongue has tiny bumps called taste buds that help you taste sweet, salty, sour, bitter, and umami (a savory taste). Sweet things like candy and fruit give you energy. Salty things like chips help your body work. Sour things like lemons can be sharp. Bitter things like coffee can warn you if something might be bad to eat. Umami is the taste of meat and cheese. Your nose also helps you taste food. When your nose is stuffy, food does not taste as good. Taste keeps you safe and helps you enjoy eating.
Protest song\n\nA protest song is a song that people sing when they want things to be different. The words in the song tell people to make a change. Some protest songs are funny, and some are sad. Long ago, singers like Bob Dylan made protest songs about war. People still sing protest songs today when they want to help fix something in the world.
Respiration\n\nRespiration is how living things get energy from food. All plants and animals do it. When you eat food, your body breaks it down to make energy. This happens inside your cells. Some cells use air to help break down food. That is called aerobic respiration. Other cells can break down food without air. That is called anaerobic respiration. Yeast and some tiny living things do that. They make alcohol and bubbles of gas. Respiration helps you run, play, and grow.
Metropolis\n\nA metropolis is a very big city where many people live. It has more than 500,000 people. A metropolis often has smaller towns and cities around it. The word comes from old Greek words that mean "mother city." Long ago, some big cities like Rome and Athens were metropolises. Today, many big cities around the world are metropolises too.
Ballad\n\nA ballad is a song that tells a story. Long ago, people in England and Ireland sang ballads. Later, people in America, Australia, and North Africa sang them too. Some ballads were written on big sheets of paper and sold. In the 1700s, poets and music makers wrote ballads. In the 1800s, ballads became slow love songs. Today, a ballad can be any love song. A power ballad is a slow love song that rock bands play. It is not as loud or fast as other rock songs. Bands like Poison and Bon Jovi made power ballads.
Human body\n\nThe human body is your body. It is the physical part of a person. Your body has bones, muscles, and skin. You need your muscles and joints to move. Your body can be hurt or get sick. Many people study the human body. Some look at how it is like other animals. Some learn how it works. Artists draw and paint the human body. Your body has many parts that work together to keep you alive.
Dust storm\n\nA dust storm is a storm made of tiny bits of sand and dirt. It happens when a very strong wind blows over dry ground. The wind picks up the sand and dust and carries them high into the air. The sky can turn dark and brown. The wind drops the sand and dirt somewhere else, far away. Dust storms can make it hard to see and hard to breathe.
Honduras\n\nHonduras is a country in Central America. It is next to Guatemala, El Salvador, and Nicaragua. The Pacific Ocean is to the south, and the Gulf of Honduras is to the north. The biggest city and capital is Tegucigalpa. Long ago, the Maya people lived in the western part of Honduras. They built big stone buildings and cities. Later, people from Spain came and took over the land. They made the people work in silver mines. Many people from Africa were brought to work too. Today, many people in Honduras have families from Spain, Africa, and the native people. Honduras grows bananas and ships them to other countries.
Chinese architecture\n\nChinese architecture is the way people in China build houses, temples, and walls. It uses special shapes like curved roofs that look like upside-down boats. The Great Wall of China is a very long wall made of stone and dirt. The Forbidden City is a big palace with many rooms and golden roofs. Other countries in Asia also copied this style of building.
Sedimentary rock\n\nSedimentary rock is a kind of rock made from tiny pieces of sand, mud, and old shells. These pieces fall to the bottom of oceans and lakes and get squished together over a very long time. You can see layers of sedimentary rock in cliffs. Sandstone and limestone are two kinds of sedimentary rock. Some sedimentary rocks have little bits of dead plants and animals in them. Coal is a sedimentary rock made from old plants. Sedimentary rocks cover most of the land on Earth.
Chess\n\nChess is a game for two people on a square board with 64 smaller squares. Each player has 16 pieces: one king, one queen, two rooks, two bishops, two knights, and eight pawns. The goal is to trap the other player's king, which is called checkmate. Players take turns moving one piece at a time. White always goes first. Each piece moves in its own special way. If a piece lands on an opponent's piece, that piece is taken off the board. The game ends when one player's king is trapped, or when a player gives up. Chess is played all over the world, and many people play in tournaments.
Newfoundland\n\nNewfoundland is a big island in the ocean near Canada. It is part of a place called Newfoundland and Labrador. The main city is St. John's. Many people live there, and they are called Newfoundlanders. Most people speak English, and some speak French. Long ago, people from Norway, England, Portugal, France, and Ireland came to live there. The first people were the First Nations. Vikings from Norway also came and built homes. People came because there were lots of fish in the sea. Now there are fewer fish because people caught too many. Some people cut down trees and dig for rocks in the ground. There are no bridges or tunnels to get to Newfoundland, but you can take a boat called a ferry.
Loire River\n\nThe Loire River is a very long river in France. It starts in the middle of France and flows to the Atlantic Ocean. It is the longest river in France. Long ago, boats used the river to carry things to sell. Later, trains became more important, so the river is not used as much for that now.
Starch\n\nStarch is a white powder that you can find in many foods. It has no taste and no smell. Foods like bread, potatoes, pasta, rice, and beans have lots of starch. Starch gives you energy to run and play. If you do not use all the energy, your body turns it into fat. People also use starch to make sauces thick. Some people put starch on clothes to make them smooth and stiff. Starch glue can stick paper, wood, and cloth together.
Early human migrations\n\nA long time ago, people moved from one place to another. The first people lived in Africa. Then, some of them walked to other parts of the world. They crossed land that is now under water.
Wavelength\n\nA wavelength is the distance between two bumps of a wave. Think of a wave like a line that goes up and down. The distance from one top bump to the next top bump is the wavelength. Waves are everywhere, like in water or sound. When a wave goes up and down faster, the wavelength gets shorter.
Sea snake\n\nA sea snake is a snake that lives in the ocean. It has a long, flat tail that helps it swim, like a paddle. Sea snakes cannot move on land. They have special holes on their nose that close underwater and open when they come up to breathe. Most sea snakes eat fish and eels. Some sea snakes have very strong poison, but they usually do not bite people unless they are scared. Sea snakes live in warm ocean waters, but not in the Atlantic Ocean.
Photography\n\nPhotography is a way of making a picture using a camera. A person who makes pictures with a camera is called a photographer. A camera is a box with a hole in the front. There is a special piece of glass called a lens that helps make a small picture inside the camera. To take a picture, you press a button that opens a door called the shutter. Light goes through the lens and makes a picture on film or on a special electronic sensor. Film is a strip that catches the light picture. After the film is taken out, it is put in special chemicals to make the picture stay. Then a machine can make a bigger picture on paper. Digital cameras do not use film. They save the picture on a small card that can be put into a computer. You can also print the picture on paper. To get a good picture, you need to make sure the lens is focused so the picture is not blurry. The picture should not be too bright or too dark.
Cinderella\n\nCinderella is a story about a kind girl who is treated badly by her stepmother and stepsisters. She has to do all the housework and sleep in the attic. One day, a fairy godmother helps her go to a big dance at the prince's castle. She turns a pumpkin into a coach and mice into horses. Cinderella wears a beautiful dress and glass slippers. She must leave the dance before midnight. When she runs away, she loses one glass slipper. The prince finds the slipper and tries it on every girl in the land. It fits Cinderella's foot. The prince marries her, and she forgives her stepsisters.
North Island\n\nThe North Island is one of two big islands that make up the country of New Zealand. It is smaller than the other island. A big water called Cook Strait sits between them. Many people live on the North Island. The biggest city on the island is Auckland. The capital city, Wellington, is at the bottom of the island. The North Island has twelve cities. Most of the people in New Zealand live here.
Porridge\n\nPorridge is a hot food made by boiling oats in water or milk. It is usually eaten for breakfast in a bowl. Some people add jam, sugar, or syrup to make it sweet. In Scotland and Finland, people add salt instead. Porridge is soft and easy to eat, so it is good for sick people. Long ago, prisoners in jail often ate porridge, and that is why people say "doing porridge" when someone is in prison.
Lard\n\nLard is fat from a pig that has been melted and cleaned. People use it for cooking and baking. It makes food taste good and helps make pie crusts flaky. Long ago, many people used lard instead of butter. Today, some cooks still like to use lard for certain foods.
Fat\n\nFat is a part of food that gives your body energy. There are three kinds of fat: unsaturated, saturated, and trans. Unsaturated fat is good for you and is found in foods like avocados, nuts, and fish. Saturated fat is not as good and is in meat and dairy. Trans fat is very bad and is in fried foods and baked goods. Your body needs some fat to stay warm and to use vitamins, but too much fat can make you sick. Eating too much bad fat can hurt your heart and make you gain too much weight. To stay healthy, eat good fats and exercise.
Fireplace\n\nA fireplace is a place inside a house where you can make a fire. It is made of bricks or metal. The fire sits in a special part called the firebox. A chimney goes up from the firebox to let the smoke go outside. Long ago, many homes had fireplaces to keep people warm. People also used them to cook food. Today, some houses still have fireplaces, but many homes use heaters instead.
Angel\n\nAn angel is a good spirit that many people believe in. The word angel means "messenger." Angels are said to be very powerful and do what God asks them to do. Sometimes they look like people and bring messages. Some angels have names like Michael, Gabriel, and Raphael. In stories, angels can appear in dreams or in real life. They can also look like they have wings. Some angels are called cherubs or seraphs. People read about angels in books like the Bible and the Qur'an.
Bladder\n\nThe bladder is a part of your body that holds pee. When you drink water, your kidneys clean it and send it to the bladder. The bladder gets bigger as it fills up, like a balloon. When it is full, it tells your brain you need to go to the bathroom. Then the muscles squeeze and the pee comes out through a small tube. All mammals have a bladder.
Navajo\n\nThe Navajo are a group of Native American people. They live in the southwestern part of the United States. Many Navajo live on a big piece of land called a reservation. The reservation is in Arizona, New Mexico, and Utah. The Navajo have their own government. They also have their own language, called Din. Some Navajo speak Din, and some speak English. The Navajo are good at raising sheep and goats. They use the wool from sheep to make cloth. Navajo women often own the sheep. The Navajo have special ceremonies to help sick people get better. Some ceremonies last for many days. Navajo people do not like to interrupt when someone is talking. They also do not always look at the person they are talking to. Navajo children are in the same clan as their mother. A clan is like a big family. Navajo people cannot marry someone from the same clan. The number four is important in Navajo culture. There are four seasons, four directions, and four holy mountains. During World War II, some Navajo helped the United States Marines. They used their language to send secret messages. The messages were very fast and the enemy could not understand them. These Navajo were called code talkers.
Dahlia\n\nA dahlia is a plant with big, bright flowers. It comes from Mexico and other warm places. People grow dahlias in gardens. The flowers can be many colors like red, yellow, pink, and purple. Dahlias like to grow where the sun is not too strong.
World Heritage Site\n\nA World Heritage Site is a very special place in the world. A group called UNESCO picks these places because they are important for nature or for people. Some sites are forests, mountains, lakes, or deserts. Other sites are buildings, cities, or old monuments. There are more than one thousand World Heritage Sites in many countries. Italy has the most sites of any country. UNESCO wants everyone to help keep these places safe. Sometimes UNESCO gives money to protect a site. Each year, a committee meets to choose new sites. To be chosen, a place must be very special and important for everyone in the world.
Lottery\n\nA lottery is a game where people pick numbers to try to win money. You buy a ticket with numbers on it. If your numbers match the ones that are picked, you win a prize. Some countries let people play the lottery, and some do not. In the United States, many people play the lottery. The money from tickets helps pay for things like schools and roads.
Athena\n\nAthena is a Greek goddess. She is the goddess of wisdom, war, and crafts. Her symbol is an owl. She wears a helmet and carries a shield. The shield has Medusa's head on it. Athena was born from Zeus's head, already grown up and wearing armor. She helped heroes like Perseus and Jason. She gave Athens the first olive tree, so the city was named after her. Her temple is the Parthenon in Athens.
Crystal\n\nA crystal is a hard thing that is made of tiny parts that line up in a pattern over and over. Crystals can grow from water or air. Snow is a crystal made of ice from water in the air. Some crystals are made when heat and pressure push on a rock, like diamond. Crystals often have flat, shiny sides that sparkle in the light. People cut crystals to make pretty jewelry. Salt is a crystal that looks like little cubes. Quartz and diamond are other kinds of crystals.
Rope\n\nA rope is made of many small threads twisted together. It can be made from plants like flax or from thin metal wires. Rope is very strong and hard to pull apart. People use rope to lift heavy things or to pull boats. Rope can also tie things so they stay in one place. People have used rope for a very long time, even in old Egypt.
Latin script\n\nThe Latin script is a way of writing that uses letters like the ones you see in this book. It is also called the Roman script. Many languages use it, including English, Spanish, French, and German. A long time ago, the Romans made this alphabet. Today, it is the most used writing system in the world. The letters come in big and small sizes, like A and a. Some languages add little marks above or below letters to show how to say them. English does not use those marks for its own words. People also use the Latin script to write languages that normally use other letters, like Chinese and Japanese, so they can type on a computer.
Meteorology\n\nMeteorology is about the air around our Earth. People who study it are called meteorologists. They check how hot or cold it is, how fast the wind blows, and how much water is in the air. They use this information to tell us what the weather will be like tomorrow. They also study how weather changes over a long time.
Cousin\n\nA cousin is a person in your family who is not your brother or sister. Your cousin is the child of your aunt or uncle. You and your cousin share the same grandparents. Many children have cousins they can play with at family parties.
Mars (mythology)\n\nMars is a make-believe person from old stories. He was the god of war, which means he liked fighting and battles. His mom was Juno and his dad was Jupiter. He had two baby boys named Romulus and Remus, and another son named Cupid. The planet Mars and the month March are named after him. In Greek stories, his name is Ares. He often tried to make the other gods fight each other.
Plate tectonics\n\nThe Earth's outside is like a big puzzle made of giant pieces called plates. These plates are not still; they move very slowly, like floating on thick, hot goo underneath. When plates bump into each other, they can push up mountains or make the ground shake in an earthquake. Sometimes hot rock from deep inside comes out through cracks and makes volcanoes. The plates are under the oceans and under the land. The ocean plates are thinner and heavier, so they dive under the land plates when they meet. This moving and bumping is called plate tectonics.
Mexico City\n\nMexico City is a big city in a country called Mexico. It is the capital, which means the most important city in that country. Many, many people live there. The city is high up on a big flat land called a plateau. Long ago, it was built on a lake, but the lake was drained to make room for houses and streets. Mexico City has mountains all around it. Sometimes the ground shakes, and that is called an earthquake. The weather is warm or mild all year, but summer is rainier than winter. Many people live close together, so the air can get dirty.
Arc de Triomphe\n\nThe Arc de Triomphe is a very big arch in Paris, France. It stands in the middle of a big round road. A long time ago, a leader named Napoleon asked for it to be built after a big win in a war. The arch is very tall, over 160 feet high. You can climb up many steps to the top and see the city. Under the arch, there is a special place for a soldier who is not known. The names of generals and battles are written on the walls. Cars drive around it, but not through it.
Bird of prey\n\nA bird of prey is a bird that hunts other animals for food. It has strong, sharp claws called talons to grab its food. It also has a sharp, hooked beak and very good eyesight to see small animals from far away. Some birds of prey hunt during the day, like eagles and hawks. Others hunt at night, like owls. These birds are very good at catching mice, fish, and other small animals.
Southern United States\n\nThe Southern United States is a part of the country where summers are long and hot, and winters are short and cool. It rains a lot there, so many plants grow well. Farmers grow cotton, tobacco, peanuts, and peaches. People in the South eat special foods like fried chicken and biscuits. Most people who live there have families from England, Scotland, Ireland, or Africa.
Ovenbird\n\nAn ovenbird is a small bird that sings. It builds a nest that looks like a little oven. The nest has a door on the side. The ovenbird lives in the eastern part of North America in the summer. In the winter, it flies to warm places like Central America and Florida. This bird walks on the ground instead of hopping like many other birds.
Chickenpox\n\nChickenpox is a sickness that mostly kids get. It makes little red spots on your skin that turn into blisters filled with water. The blisters can itch a lot, but you should not scratch them. You might also get a fever. Chickenpox goes away in a few days. There is a shot that can help keep you from getting it.
Lighthouse\n\nA lighthouse is a tall building that shines a bright light. It is built near the ocean or a big lake. The light helps boats stay safe and not hit the shore. The light turns around so boats see a flash. The light can be seen from far away. Long ago, a famous lighthouse was on an island called Pharos. Today, most lighthouses work by themselves.
Hard disk\n\nA hard disk is a part inside a computer that keeps your pictures, games, and stories safe. It looks like a small metal box. The hard disk spins very fast and uses a tiny arm to read and write information. Some hard disks can hold a lot of things, like thousands of songs. If you drop a hard disk, it might break and make a clicking sound. That means it is hurt and cannot work anymore. Hard disks come in different sizes and spin at different speeds. The faster they spin, the quicker they can find your stuff.
Tribe\n\nA tribe is a group of people who live and work together. They share the same way of life, like how they talk, what they believe, and what they do. A tribe has a leader called a chief. Long ago, people lived in tribes before they lived in big cities. Today, there are still tribes in many parts of the world. Some tribes move from place to place to find food, and some grow their own food.
Bread\n\nBread is a food that is baked in an oven. It is made from flour and water, with a little salt and yeast. You can eat bread by itself, toast it, or use it to make a sandwich. Bread comes in many colors and tastes. White bread is made from light flour, and brown bread is made from darker flour. People all over the world eat bread. Some people use bread in their religion. For example, Jewish people eat a special flat bread called matzo during Passover.
Mortgage\n\nA mortgage is a way to borrow money to buy a house. The bank gives you money to pay for the house, and you promise to pay the bank back little by little each month. The house is like a promise that if you cannot pay, the bank can take the house. People use mortgages to get a home to live in.
Hair\n\nHair is thin, soft stuff that grows from your skin. People have hair on their heads, and animals have hair all over their bodies. Animal hair is often called fur. Sheep and goats have curly hair called wool, which people use to make warm clothes and blankets. Hair can be many colors like black, brown, blond, or red. Your hair color comes from your mom and dad. As people get older, their hair may turn white or gray. Some men lose hair on their heads and become bald. People like to brush and style their hair to look nice.
Sow bug\n\nA sow bug is a tiny animal with many legs. It has fourteen legs and a hard shell on its back. Sow bugs live in damp places like under rocks or wet leaves. They need water in the air to breathe. They eat dead plants and help clean up the ground. When a sow bug is scared, it can roll up into a little ball. Its hard shell protects its soft body. Sow bugs are not insects. They are cousins of shrimps and crabs.
Parchment\n\nParchment is a thin material made from animal skin. People used it long ago to write on, like the pages of a book. It is not the same as leather because it is made in a different way. The best kind of parchment is called vellum.
Sales tax\n\nSales tax is extra money you pay when you buy something. When you go to a store and buy a toy or a snack, the price on the tag is not the full price. You have to pay a little more money on top. That extra money is called sales tax. The store gives that extra money to the government. The government uses it to pay for things like roads, schools, and parks. Some things you need, like food or medicine, do not have sales tax. Different places have different amounts of sales tax. Some places have a lot, and some have only a little.
Morocco\n\nMorocco is a country in North Africa. The capital is Rabat, and the biggest city is Casablanca. Morocco has mountains, forests, farms, and deserts. Many people live near the coast. The people are called Moroccans, and they speak Arabic and Berber. Most Moroccans follow Islam. Tourists visit Morocco to see old buildings, warm beaches, and the countryside.
Virtue\n\nVirtue is when someone does good things. A person who is kind, brave, and fair has virtue. The opposite of virtue is being bad or mean. Long ago, people said virtue means being fair, brave, smart, and not too much of anything. Other people said virtue means believing in good things, hoping for good things, and loving others.
Running\n\nRunning is how people and animals move fast on their feet. When you run, both feet leave the ground at the same time. Running is different from walking. Slow running is called jogging, and fast running is called sprinting. Many people run for exercise because it is good for your body. It helps your heart and lungs, and it keeps you fit. Running can also make you feel happy and less worried. When you run, you get thirsty, so you should drink water. People have races to see who can run the fastest. Some races are short, like sprints, and some are long, like marathons. Running races have been around for a very long time, even in the old Olympic Games.
City\n\nA city is a place where many people live close together. It has lots of buildings, streets, houses, and shops. People live in cities because it is easy to find everything they need. Some cities are very old and have walls around them. Other cities are new and have wide streets for cars and buses. Big cities can have trains and airports. People in cities work, play, and live in apartments or houses. Some cities are so big that they are called megacities.
Wedding\n\nA wedding is a party where two people get married. They say special words to each other and give rings. The party after the wedding is called a reception. People eat cake, dance, and have fun. The two people who get married often wear nice clothes. Sometimes the bride wears a white dress. After the wedding, they go on a trip called a honeymoon.
Mancala\n\nMancala is a game where you move seeds on a board with little holes. People play it in Africa, the Middle East, and central Asia. You pick up seeds from one hole and drop them one by one into the next holes. The player who gets the most seeds wins.
Paralympic Games\n\nThe Paralympic Games are a big sports event. People with bodies that work differently compete in these games. Some cannot walk and use a wheelchair. Some cannot see well. Some have an arm or leg that is missing. The games happen right after the Olympic Games. The first Paralympic Games were for soldiers who got hurt in a war. Now many people from all over the world come to play sports like running, swimming, and basketball. They are very strong and fast athletes.
Excretion\n\nExcretion is how your body gets rid of things it does not need. When you go to the bathroom, that is excretion. Your body also gets rid of bad air when you breathe out. If your body did not get rid of these things, you would get sick. Animals like birds and reptiles get rid of waste as a white paste. Fish get rid of waste right into the water.
Literacy\n\nLiteracy is when you can read and write. People learn to read and write at school. If you can read and write, you are called literate. If you cannot, you are called illiterate. Some people do not learn to read because they do not need it for their daily life. In some places, more people cannot read than in others. Reading and writing help you learn new things.
Combine harvester\n\nA combine harvester is a big machine that works on farms. It cuts plants like wheat and corn, takes the seeds off, and blows away the leftover parts, all at once. This machine helps farmers get food from the fields much faster than doing it by hand. Because of the combine harvester, not as many people need to work on farms anymore.
Rosh Hashanah\n\nRosh Hashanah is a Jewish holiday that is like a New Year celebration. It lasts for two days. People eat sweet foods like apples dipped in honey to wish for a sweet year. They also send happy greetings to family and friends. This holiday is a time to think about good things and say sorry for mistakes.
Steppe\n\nA steppe is a big, flat piece of land with no trees. It is covered with grass and small plants. Steppes are too dry for forests but not as dry as deserts. They get a little bit of rain. The biggest steppe is in Russia. People who live on the steppe often move from place to place with their animals. In Mongolia, families live in big tents called gers. They ride horses and use animals for food and drink. Long ago, cowboys in the United States herded cattle on the steppe.
Percussion instrument\n\nPercussion instruments are things you hit or shake to make music. A person who plays them is called a percussionist. Some percussion instruments can play tunes, like the xylophone and timpani. Others make sounds but not tunes, like the drum, maracas, and cymbals. In an orchestra, there are many kinds of percussion instruments. Sometimes people even use things like typewriters or milk bottles as percussion. Drum sets are used in rock and jazz music. A percussionist must keep a steady beat so the other players can follow.
Mexican food\n\nMexican food is food from the country of Mexico. Corn, beans, and chili peppers are very important in Mexican cooking. Tacos are a popular Mexican dish. They are made with a soft or hard tortilla filled with meat, beans, or vegetables. You can add salsa, sour cream, or guacamole on top. Enchiladas are another dish. They are corn tortillas rolled up with meat or cheese inside and covered with a spicy sauce. Guacamole is a dip made from mashed avocados mixed with tomatoes, onions, and cilantro. It tastes creamy and goes well with many Mexican foods.
Central African Republic\n\nThe Central African Republic is a country in the middle of Africa. It is a flat, high piece of land with thick forests in the south where rare gorillas live. The capital city is Bangui. Most people grow their own food, but sometimes there is no rain for a long time, which makes it hard. The country sells diamonds, cotton, coffee, and wood to other countries. People there speak French and a language called Sango.
India\n\nIndia is a big country in Asia. It is the country with the most people in the world. India has the Indian Ocean, the Arabian Sea, and the Bay of Bengal around it. The tall Himalayan mountains are in the north. Many different languages and religions are in India. Most people follow Hinduism. The capital city is New Delhi. India has a space agency that sends rockets to the Moon and Mars. India became free from British rule in 1947. People celebrate Republic Day every year on January 26. India has many famous buildings like the Taj Mahal. Indian movies and music are loved around the world.
Amun\n\nAmun was a very powerful god in ancient Egypt. People believed he made himself and then made everything else. He was called the hidden one. He wore a tall hat with two feathers on top. Sometimes he was shown sitting on a throne. Later, people mixed Amun with the sun god Ra and called him Amun-Ra. He was the king of the gods and helped the pharaoh. Many people gave gifts to his temple.
Visible spectrum\n\nThe visible spectrum is the colors we can see with our eyes. It is like a rainbow. The colors are red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. These colors come from light. A computer or TV screen uses red, green, and blue light to make all the colors you see.
Monotreme\n\nMonotremes are a special kind of mammal that lay eggs. Most other mammals have babies that come out alive, but monotremes lay eggs like birds do. Even though they lay eggs, they still feed their babies with milk. Monotremes have one opening at the back for everything, like going to the bathroom and having babies. They live in Australia and New Guinea. The two kinds of monotremes are platypus and echidnas. There is one platypus called the duck-billed platypus, and there are four kinds of echidnas. Monotremes are very old animals that have been around for a very long time.
Ionian Sea\n\nThe Ionian Sea is a big body of water that is part of the Mediterranean Sea. It sits next to Italy on one side and Greece on the other. There are many islands in this sea, like Corfu and Kephalonia. People ride on big boats called ferries across the Ionian Sea to travel between Greece and Italy. The ground under this sea sometimes shakes because it is a very active place.
Butane\n\nButane is a gas that comes from the ground. It is used to make fire. People put butane in lighters to make a flame. It is also used in camping stoves for cooking food. Some spray cans have butane inside to push out the spray. Butane can be dangerous. If you breathe too much of it, you cannot get enough air. If it touches your skin, it can hurt because it is very cold. Butane can also explode if there is a spark near it.
Flour\n\nFlour is a powder made from grains like wheat. People use flour to make bread, pasta, cookies, cakes, and tortillas. To make flour, grains are put between two stones or steel wheels and rubbed together until they become powder. Some flour has a special helper that makes baked foods puff up and become soft and fluffy. That kind is called self-raising flour. Flour without that helper is called all-purpose flour or plain flour. You can also make flour at home from things like pumpkins, rice, or nuts. Flour has good things in it that help your body stay healthy.
Minute\n\nA minute is a way to measure time. It is as long as 60 seconds. There are 60 minutes in one hour. A minute can also be used to measure how big something looks in the sky, like the Sun or the Moon.
Fast food\n\nFast food is food that a restaurant makes very quickly. You can buy it and eat it right away. Places like McDonald's and Burger King sell fast food. They have a short list of things to eat, like hamburgers and fries. Fast food has a lot of salt and fat, and not many good things for your body. Eating too much fast food can make you sick.
Lahore\n\nLahore is a big city in Pakistan. It is the second biggest city in that country. Lahore is called the 'City of Gardens' because it has many parks and gardens. The city is known for its fun and lively feel. Many movies are made there. Long ago, a king named Lava started the city. It has old buildings like the Badshahi Mosque and the Lahore Fort. People visit the Shalimar Gardens too. Lahore has many schools and colleges. The food there is very good. People from all over come to eat at the food street. The city is also a place where people are kind to each other.
Great Slave Lake\n\nGreat Slave Lake is a very big lake in Canada. It is the deepest lake in North America. The lake is long and wide. People live in towns around the lake, like Yellowknife and Hay River. Long ago, First Nations people lived there first. In winter, the lake freezes and people can drive a car on the ice to go from Yellowknife to Dettah. Birds called whooping cranes live near the lake too.
Rye\n\nRye is a type of grass that people grow for food. It looks like wheat and barley. People use rye to make flour for bread, like a dark bread called pumpernickel. Rye is also fed to animals. It is a strong plant that can grow in soil that is too sour or too sweet for other plants. Rye grows in many places, especially in Europe.
Tsetse fly\n\nA tsetse fly is a big biting fly that lives in warm parts of Africa. It bites animals and people to drink their blood. Tsetse flies can make people very sick with a disease called sleeping sickness. A mother tsetse fly keeps one baby inside her body and feeds it milk until it grows big. Then the baby crawls into the ground and turns into a hard shell. After about 20 to 30 days, a grown fly comes out. People catch tsetse flies using big blue cloths.
