Swimming\n\nSwimming is moving your body through water using your arms and legs. You can swim in the sea, a swimming pool, a river, or a lake. People swim for fun, to get exercise, or as a sport. There are different ways to swim, like the front crawl, breaststroke, and backstroke. Swimming works many muscles at once and does not hurt your joints. It also helps you get stronger and last longer without getting tired. Some swimmers use special tools like goggles to see underwater, a swim cap to keep hair dry, and a kickboard to practice kicking.
Lathe\n\nA lathe is a machine that helps shape things like wood or metal. It spins the material around and around while a tool cuts it into a new shape. People use lathes to make things like baseball bats, candlestick holders, and gun barrels. Some lathes are for wood, and some are for metal. A wood lathe spins a piece of wood while you use a chisel to shape it. A metal lathe works the same way but is stronger and more careful. Some lathes are run by a computer and can make shapes very exactly.
British Isles\n\nThe British Isles are a group of islands in the north-west of Europe. The biggest island is called Great Britain. On Great Britain there are three countries: England, Wales, and Scotland. These three countries join with Northern Ireland to make the United Kingdom. There are also other islands like the Isle of Man, the Isle of Wight, and Anglesey. Some people also count the Channel Islands, but those are closer to France. Long ago, the British Isles were part of a big land called Laurasia. That is why they have many different kinds of rocks and minerals.
Ruler\n\nA ruler is a tool that helps you measure how long or short something is. It has numbers and little lines along the edge. You can also use a ruler to draw straight lines. Rulers can be made of plastic, wood, or metal. They come in different sizes, like 30 centimeters or 12 inches.
Islam\n\nIslam is a religion. People who follow Islam are called Muslims. Muslims believe in one God. They believe that Muhammad was a prophet who brought God's message. The holy book of Islam is called the Quran. Muslims believe the Quran contains God's words. Muslims pray five times every day. They pray in a special building called a mosque. Before praying, Muslims take off their shoes. They pray on a small mat. Muslims also give money to help poor people. They do not eat during daylight in a special month called Ramadan. Many Muslims go on a trip to a holy city called Mecca at least once in their life.
China\n\nChina is a big country in Asia. It is very old and has a long history. Many people live there. The Yangtze River is the longest river in China. It is one of the longest rivers in the world. China has big mountains like the Himalayas. It also has deserts and forests. Long ago, China was ruled by kings and emperors. People in China invented writing a long time ago. They also made paper and fireworks. Today, China is a big country where many things are made and sold all over the world.
Switch\n\nA switch is something that turns things on and off. It changes the way electricity flows. You can find switches on walls in your house to turn on lights. Some switches are small and you push them with your finger. Other switches are big and used for trains to change tracks. A computer has many tiny switches inside that help it work.
Rabbit\n\nA rabbit is a small animal with long ears and soft fur. Rabbits live in many parts of the world. They eat vegetables and hay, and they love to hop around. Wild rabbits dig holes in the ground called burrows, and a group of rabbits living together is called a warren. A baby rabbit is called a kit. Some people keep rabbits as pets. Pet rabbits can live for eight to twelve years. Rabbits are careful because bigger animals like foxes and wolves try to eat them. When they feel scared, they run to their burrow to be safe.
Pound (mass)\n\nA pound is a way to measure how heavy something is. People in the United States and a few other countries use pounds to tell how much things weigh. One pound is the same as 16 ounces. A big bag of sugar might weigh one pound. A small baby weighs about 7 or 8 pounds. The word 'lb' is short for a Latin word that means 'weight'.
Erosion\n\nErosion is when water, wind, ice, or gravity move rocks and dirt from one place to another. The Sun gives energy that makes wind blow and water flow, which helps erosion happen. Water can carry rocks and soil downhill. Fast water can move big rocks, and slow water moves tiny bits. Wind can blow small pieces of dirt far away. Ice can break rocks when it freezes in cracks. Gravity pulls rocks and dirt downhill, like in a landslide. Erosion can make canyons and river deltas. It can also cause problems for farmers by washing away good soil.
SMS\n\nSMS is a way to send short written messages on a phone. People call them text messages. You can send a text to another person's phone. A text can only be as long as 160 letters. If you write more, it gets split into two or more texts. People use texts when they want to be quiet or send something private. Some phone plans let you send as many texts as you want.
Crane fly\n\nA crane fly is an insect that looks like a big mosquito but does not bite people or animals. It has very long, thin legs and a long, thin body. Its legs break off easily if you try to catch it. Crane flies cannot sting. They can fly, but not very well, and sometimes wobble in the air. Adult crane flies only live for about 10 to 15 days. Baby crane flies are called leatherjackets and live in the ground, where they eat grass roots. Some people call crane flies daddy longlegs.
Vadodara\n\nVadodara is a big city in Gujarat, India. It sits next to the Vishwamitri River. The city has a big, beautiful palace called Lakshmi Vilas Palace. There is also a large university there. Many people live in Vadodara. They speak Gujarati, Urdu, Marathi, and Hindi. The city has an airport and a busy train station. Many famous cricket players were born in Vadodara.
Madagascar\n\nMadagascar is a big island in the Indian Ocean. It is near the east coast of Africa. Many people live there. Long ago, Madagascar was part of a huge land. Then it broke away and moved close to Africa. Because it was alone for a long time, many special animals live only there. Some animals are in danger because people cut down forests. Farmers grow coffee and vanilla on the island. Madagascar sells more vanilla than any other country. People also visit Madagascar as tourists.
Wind turbine\n\nA wind turbine is a tall machine that uses the wind to make electricity. It has big blades that spin around when the wind blows. The spinning blades turn a part inside that makes electricity. This electricity can be used to power lights and other things in houses. Wind turbines are often put in groups called wind farms. They do not make smoke or dirty the air. Some people think they are noisy, but they are not much louder than an air conditioner.
Metalworking\n\nMetalworking is making things out of metal. People heat metal until it is soft, then hit it with a hammer to shape it. They can also pour hot liquid metal into a mold to make a shape. Some people cut metal with special tools or spin it to make round shapes. People have been working with metal for a very long time, almost 7000 years. They make tools, jewelry, and big buildings from metal.
Florence\n\nFlorence is a city in Italy. It sits on a river called the Arno. Many people live there. A long time ago, Florence was the home of many famous artists who made beautiful paintings and buildings. The city has a big football team called Fiorentina. The food in Florence is mostly meat, like big steaks cooked over hot coals. People also eat bread without salt and soups with olive oil. In summer, Florence is very hot, and in winter it can snow a little.
Lizard\n\nA lizard is a reptile with scaly skin. Lizards live all over the world, except in very cold places. Some lizards are very small, like geckos, and some are very big, like the Komodo dragon. Lizards can have different colors and patterns on their skin. Many lizards can lose their tail to get away from danger, and then grow a new one. Some lizards use bright colors to talk to other lizards or to scare away animals that want to eat them. Lizards like to sit in the sun to get warm.
Stock exchange\n\nA stock exchange is a place where people buy and sell small pieces of companies, called shares. Some stock exchanges are real buildings, like the New York Stock Exchange. Others are on computers, like the NASDAQ. When many people sell their shares at once, prices can drop very low. This happened on a day called Black Tuesday in 1929. After that, many banks ran out of money, and it was hard for people to buy food and other things. That hard time was called the Great Depression.
Interpersonal relationship\n\nInterpersonal relationship is how people are connected to each other. It is the way two or more people know each other and spend time together.
Concert\n\nA concert is when people play music for other people to listen to. The people who listen are called the audience. The musicians stand on a stage so everyone can see them. Concerts can be inside a big room called a concert hall, or outside in a field or stadium. Sometimes one person plays alone, and that is called a recital. People usually buy tickets to go to a concert. Some concerts are very big and last for many days; those are called festivals. At a concert, you might hear loud music, see bright lights, and watch the musicians play. You can clap and cheer when the music is over.
Reading\n\nReading is looking at marks on paper and knowing what they mean. When you read, you understand words that are written down. A long time ago, most people did not know how to read. They worked on farms and did not need to read. But mothers taught their daughters to read at home. Now, many people read books, signs, and stories. Reading can take you to make-believe worlds or help you learn about real things.
Thailand\n\nThailand is a country in Southeast Asia. It is next to Laos, Cambodia, Malaysia, and Myanmar. The king is the head of the country. Most people in Thailand follow Buddhism. The capital city is Bangkok. Thailand has many temples with golden roofs. People eat rice and spicy food. Elephants live there too.
Creativity\n\nCreativity is when you make something new. It can be a drawing, a story, a song, or even a new way to solve a problem. People use creativity in art, music, science, and many other things. Some people think only humans can be creative, but animals like apes and birds can also make new things to help them live. Creativity is special because it helps us think of ideas that no one has thought of before.
Cinema of India\n\nThe cinema of India is all the movies made in India. People in India have been making movies for a very long time, since the early 1900s. These movies are liked by many people in India and also in other countries like the United Kingdom and the United States. In 2010, India made more movies than any other country, even more than Hollywood and China.
Hollywood\n\nHollywood is a place in Los Angeles, California. It is very famous because many movies and TV shows are made there. You can see the big Hollywood Sign on a hill. There is a special sidewalk called the Hollywood Walk of Fame with stars on the ground. Each star has the name of a famous person who makes movies or music. Many people visit Hollywood to see the stars and the big sign. The first movie made in Hollywood was a short film called "In Old California" in 1910.
Chemical element\n\nA chemical element is a special kind of stuff that is made of only one kind of tiny building block called an atom. Everything in the world is made from elements. There are 118 different elements. Some elements are hard solids, like iron. Some are gases you cannot see, like oxygen. A few are liquids, like mercury. Each element has a short name, like 'C' for carbon or 'O' for oxygen. When elements join together, they can make new things. For example, sodium and chlorine join to make table salt. Your body is made of 26 different elements.
Orion (constellation)\n\nOrion is a group of stars in the night sky. It looks like a big hourglass shape. In the middle, there are three bright stars in a row. That part is called Orion's Belt. Orion has many stars, and some of them are very bright. One star, Betelgeuse, is a huge red star. Another star, Rigel, is the brightest in Orion. In old stories, Orion was a great hunter. People use Orion to find other stars in the sky.
Conformity\n\nConformity is when someone does what other people do. Sometimes you copy your friends because you want them to like you. Other times you copy because you are not sure what to do and think others know better. When you are in a group, you might change what you say or do to fit in. For example, if everyone is sitting still in a quiet place, you might sit still too even if you want to run and play. People can conform on the outside but still feel different on the inside. Or they might truly believe the same thing as the group. Conformity helps people get along, but it can also make someone do something they know is not right just because everyone else is doing it.
Interjection\n\nAn interjection is a word that shows how you feel. You say "Wow!" when you are surprised. You say "Ouch!" when something hurts. You say "Yay!" when you are happy. These words can stand by themselves.
New Testament\n\nThe New Testament is a part of the Christian Bible. It tells the story of Jesus and his friends. It has 27 books. Four books are called Gospels. They tell about Jesus's life. Other books are letters written to people who believed in Jesus. The letters teach about being good and loving God. Different churches have the same books, but some put them in a different order.
Travel\n\nTravel is when you go from one place to another place. Some people travel every day to go to school or work. That is called commuting. Some people travel to faraway places for fun on vacation. That is called tourism. When you travel on vacation, you might sleep in a hotel or a tent. People can travel by car, train, plane, or boat. Some people write books about the places they visit.
Jet engine\n\nA jet engine is a machine that pushes things forward by blowing out a fast stream of air or gas. Think of a balloon that you let go of — the air rushes out and the balloon zooms across the room. That is like a jet engine. Big airplanes use jet engines to fly high in the sky. The engine takes in air at the front, mixes it with fuel, and burns it. The hot air shoots out the back and pushes the plane forward. Some jet engines have fans inside that help make the air move faster. Rockets also use a kind of jet engine, but they carry their own air and work in space.
Biography\n\nA biography is a story about a person's life. It tells you about what they did and who they were. Some biographies are books, and some are movies. A long time ago, people wrote biographies about kings and rulers. Today, you can find biographies about many different people.
Geometer moth\n\nA geometer moth is a kind of moth that flies at night. Its baby, called a caterpillar, moves in a funny way. The caterpillar has only two pairs of feet in the middle, so it pulls its body up like a little loop. It looks like it is measuring the ground, so people call it an inchworm. The adult moth has wide wings and a thin body. It sits with its wings flat and looks like a butterfly. Many geometer moths are brown or gray to hide on tree bark.
Whale\n\nA whale is a very big animal that lives in the ocean. Whales are mammals, which means they breathe air, have a little bit of hair, and are warm. There are two kinds of whales: baleen whales and toothed whales. Baleen whales have no teeth. They open their big mouths and take in water with tiny food inside. Then they push the water out through long, hard strips called baleen, and the food stays inside. Toothed whales have sharp teeth and eat bigger fish. They can make sounds to find things in the dark water. Whales breathe through a hole on top of their head called a blowhole. When they come up, they shoot water out first, then take a breath. A baby whale is called a calf. The mother whale takes care of her calf for a long time. Whales can jump out of the water and splash back down. That is called breaching. Some people used to hunt whales for meat and oil, but now many countries say it is not allowed.
Grammar\n\nGrammar is the set of rules for how we put words together to make sentences. When we talk, we use grammar without thinking about it. When we write, we try to use correct grammar. Different languages have different grammar rules. For example, in English we say 'fast cars' but in Spanish they say 'cars fast'. Words can change their endings to show meaning, like adding 's' for more than one thing. Verbs show when something happens, like 'walk' and 'walked'. Grammar also tells us about nouns (naming words), verbs (action words), and adjectives (describing words).
Tram\n\nA tram is like a light train that carries people around a city. It runs on tracks on the street. Many people can ride a tram at the same time. Riding a tram instead of a car helps keep the air clean and the roads not too busy. Some trams are old and some are new. Old trams from long ago are called historic streetcars. In Hong Kong, there are special trams with two floors. The biggest tram networks are in cities like Melbourne, Berlin, and Moscow. Trams first started in the 1830s and were pulled by horses. Later, they used electricity to move.
Christmas\n\nChristmas is a happy holiday in December. It celebrates the birth of a baby named Jesus. Many people put up a tree with lights and ornaments. They give presents to family and friends. Some people go to church to sing songs. A man called Santa Claus brings toys to children. People eat special food and spend time together.
Superstition\n\nA superstition is a belief that does not make sense or have proof. Some people think black cats bring bad luck. Other people look for four-leaf clovers because they think these bring good luck. Some people do not look into broken mirrors because they think it brings bad luck. Not everyone believes in superstitions.
Angkor Wat\n\nAngkor Wat is a very big temple in a country called Cambodia. It was built a long, long time ago by a king. People went there to pray to their gods. It is the biggest place for praying in the whole world. The temple has tall towers and stone walls with carvings. Over time, some parts of the temple started to fall apart.
Mule\n\nA mule is a baby of a horse mom and a donkey dad. It has long ears like a donkey and a body like a horse. Mules can be white, gray, brown, or black. They are strong and help people pull carts and carry things. Most mules cannot have babies of their own. They are bigger than donkeys but smaller than horses.
Irrigation\n\nIrrigation is when people give water to plants to help them grow when there is not enough rain. The water can come from rivers, lakes, or wells. There are different ways to water plants. Sprinkler irrigation shoots water into the air like rain. Drip irrigation lets water drip right onto the plant roots, which uses less water. Surface irrigation floods the ground with water, like in rice fields. Sometimes people water plants by hand with buckets or watering cans. Irrigation helps farmers grow more food, but it can cost a lot of money and needs to be done carefully so the soil does not get too salty.
Glider\n\nA glider is a plane that does not have a motor. It flies through the air without an engine. The pilot uses a stick to steer the glider. Some gliders have one seat, and some have two seats. Gliders with long wings are called sailplanes. They can stay in the air for a long time by finding air that goes up. Good pilots can fly very far this way. Gliders cannot take off by themselves. A motor plane or a ground motor pulls them up into the sky. There are also hang-gliders and paragliders. Hang-gliders have a frame but no seats. Paragliders have wings like a parachute. These are often launched from hills or cliffs.
Revenge\n\nRevenge is when someone hurts another person because they think that person hurt them first. It is like saying 'you hurt me, so I will hurt you back.' People have felt this way for a very long time, even chimpanzees do it. Some scientists found that thinking about revenge makes a part of your brain feel happy, like getting a treat. But revenge can be bad. It can make the hurt go back and forth, and both people end up sad. Sometimes people who were hurt when they were little might want revenge more. It is better to find other ways to feel better.
Pillow\n\nA pillow is a soft cushion you put under your head when you sleep in a bed. It is made from two pieces of cloth sewn together and stuffed with something soft like feathers or man-made fluff. A pillow is usually shaped like a rectangle. A pillowcase is a cloth cover that goes over the pillow to keep it clean. Long ago, people in ancient Egypt used pillows made of wood or stone. Those pillows looked like stands and helped keep bugs away from their faces at night.
Mask\n\nA mask is something you wear on your face. It can cover your whole face or just part of it. People wear masks for many reasons. Some wear a mask to keep their face safe, like a gas mask that stops bad air from getting in. Doctors and nurses wear masks to keep germs away from sick people. Wood-workers wear masks so they do not breathe in tiny pieces of wood. Long ago, people wore masks during big sicknesses like the plague and the flu. Some masks are used for fun, like in plays or at parties, so no one knows who you are. The oldest mask ever found is made of stone and is 9000 years old.
Hot air balloon\n\nA hot air balloon is a big, colorful bag that can fly up in the sky. It works by heating the air inside with a fire. Hot air is lighter than cold air, so it makes the balloon go up. People stand in a basket tied to the balloon with ropes. The first hot air balloon that carried people was made a long time ago by two brothers. They sent a sheep, a duck, and a rooster up first. Later, people flew in it too. Today, you can see hot air balloons at festivals where they fly together in the morning or evening. Some balloons are round, and some are shaped like animals or other fun things.
Extremophile\n\nAn extremophile is a living thing that likes to live in very hot, very cold, very salty, or very dark places where most other living things cannot live. Most extremophiles are tiny and you need a microscope to see them. Some live deep under the ocean near hot water that comes out of the ground. Others live inside hot rocks far under the ground. A few extremophiles are bigger, like some bugs that live in very salty water. These special living things help scientists learn about where life can live.
Lake Eyre\n\nLake Eyre is a big lake in Australia. It is the lowest place in Australia, below the level of the sea. The lake is in a very dry desert, where almost no rain falls. When it fills up with water, it becomes the biggest lake in Australia. The water comes from rivers far away in Queensland. The lake does not have a way for water to flow out, so the water dries up and leaves salt behind. When the lake is full, many birds come to visit, like pelicans and ducks. Some fish live in the water when it is fresh, but they die when the water gets too salty. The lake turns pink when it is shallow because of tiny plants in the water. People sometimes sail boats on the lake when it has water. The lake is named after a man named Edward Eyre, who was the first European to see it.
Kyrgyzstan\n\nKyrgyzstan is a country in the middle of Asia. It is far away from any ocean. The country is very rocky and has tall mountains. More than half of the land is covered by mountains. The biggest lake is called Issyk-Kul Lake. It is a very big mountain lake. The capital city is Bishkek. People there speak Russian and another language. Many people in Kyrgyzstan are Muslim. The country used to be part of the Soviet Union. It became its own country in 1991. Farming is very important there. People grow wheat, potatoes, cotton, and fruit. Some farming is still done by hand or with horses. Kyrgyzstan has gold, coal, and other metals in the ground.
Cinnamon\n\nCinnamon is a spice that comes from the inside of a tree's bark. It smells very nice and tastes sweet. People put cinnamon in sweet foods like cinnamon rolls and cookies. Some people also put it in hot drinks like tea. Cinnamon is grown in a country called Sri Lanka.
Rodeo\n\nA rodeo is a sport where cowboys and cowgirls show how good they are at riding horses and working with cows. Long ago, cowboys in North America had to take care of cattle every day. They started to have contests to see who was the best at riding and roping. Today, people go to rodeos to watch riders try to stay on bucking horses or catch cows with a rope. The best riders can win prizes.
Classical music\n\nClassical music is a kind of music that people have been making for a very long time. It is written down so that musicians can learn to play it. This music is special because it is so good that people still want to listen to it many years later. Some famous composers who made classical music are Bach, Mozart, and Beethoven. Classical music can be played by many instruments, like violins, flutes, trumpets, and drums. It can also be sung by people with strong voices. Some classical music is happy, some is sad, and some tells a big story. People play classical music in concert halls and churches. It is different from pop music because it is not just made to be popular for a short time.
Sofia\n\nSofia is a big city in a country called Bulgaria. It is the most important city in that country, where the leaders work. Many people live there, more than one million. Sofia is very old, older than many other cities in Europe. It has a big university, a library, a theater, and a big park with waterfalls. There are also many movie theaters. Sofia is high up on a hill, so it is one of the highest capital cities in Europe.
Skepticism\n\nSkepticism is when you have doubt about something. It means you want to see proof before you believe something is true. People who are skeptics ask lots of questions. They do not believe things just because someone says so. They want to check and see for themselves. This helps people learn what is real and what is not.
Mosaic\n\nA mosaic is a picture or pattern made from many tiny pieces of stone, glass, or tiles. People put the pieces into cement to make them stick. Mosaics can be on walls, floors, or ceilings inside a building. They can also be on sidewalks outside. Some mosaics are made from round pebbles. Others use shiny gold tiles that are really glass with a thin gold leaf inside. Long ago, the Ancient Romans made mosaics that we can still see today. In Italy, many old churches have beautiful mosaics that tell stories from the Bible. Today, people make mosaics from broken dishes, mirrors, or old tiles to make cities look pretty.
Sound recording and reproduction\n\nSound recording and reproduction is when a machine catches sounds and saves them so you can hear them again later. The first machine for recording sound was the phonograph, invented by Thomas Edison in 1877. It had a spinning cylinder covered with soft material. A small needle made marks on the cylinder as sound waves shook it. Later, flat records were made that could be copied many times. Then came tape recorders, which use magnetic tape to store sounds. Cassettes are small tape cartridges with two sides. Compact discs, or CDs, came next and use digital data to play music. Today, many people listen to music online.
Rowing (sport)\n\nRowing is a sport where people race boats using long sticks called oars. The oars are attached to the boat with little hooks. In some boats, each person has two oars, one in each hand. In other boats, each person holds one oar with both hands. Some boats are very small and have only one person. Other boats are big and have eight people rowing together. Rowing races are on calm water, like a lake or a river. The race path is two kilometers long and has lanes marked with floating balls. Rowing is a very old sport. It was in the first Olympic games a long time ago. Now, many countries have rowing teams, and people row in the Olympics every four years.
Malta\n\nMalta is a small country that is an island in the Mediterranean Sea. It is near Italy. About 500,000 people live there. The capital city is Valletta. People in Malta speak Maltese and English. Many people also speak Italian. Malta used to have its own money called the Maltese Lira, but now it uses the Euro. Long ago, knights lived on the island. Malta became its own country in 1964.
Saudi Arabia\n\nSaudi Arabia is a big country in Asia. It is very hot and mostly covered with sand. The country has two holy cities called Mecca and Medina. Many Muslims from all over the world visit Mecca for a special trip called hajj. People who are not Muslim cannot go into Mecca. Most people in Saudi Arabia speak Arabic. The country has a lot of oil, which is used to make gas for cars. The national food is called Kabsa, which is rice with meat. Football is a popular sport there. The country is ruled by a king.
Vitamin\n\nA vitamin is a tiny thing in food that helps your body work right. Your body needs only a little bit of each vitamin. There are many kinds, like vitamin A, vitamin C, and vitamin D. Oranges and lemons have vitamin C. Your body cannot make vitamins, so you get them from the food you eat. If you do not get enough of a vitamin for a long time, you can get sick. For example, not enough vitamin C can cause a sickness called scurvy. Many people take vitamin pills to stay healthy. Some vitamins, like A, D, E, and K, can be stored in your body for later. Others, like vitamin C, leave your body quickly.
Respiratory system\n\nYour respiratory system helps you breathe. When you breathe in, air goes into your nose and mouth, down a tube called the windpipe, and into your lungs. Your lungs are like two soft bags inside your chest. They take in oxygen from the air, which your body needs. Then they push out a waste gas called carbon dioxide when you breathe out. Your lungs have tiny air sacs that swap oxygen for carbon dioxide. The oxygen goes into your blood and travels all over your body. Your diaphragm, a big muscle under your lungs, helps pull air in and push air out.
Cyrillic script\n\nThe Cyrillic script is a way of writing letters. It is used for the Russian language and many other languages. Long ago, two men named Cyril and Methodius made an early version of this alphabet. The letters look different from the ones we use in English. Some countries that used Cyrillic later switched to a different alphabet.
Fiction\n\nFiction is a story that someone makes up in their head. It is not about real things that happened. Fiction can be in books, movies, or on TV. The people in a fiction story are called characters. There is usually a good guy and a bad guy. The story has a beginning, a middle, and an end. The most exciting part is called the climax. Fiction is fun to read or watch because it lets you imagine new things.
Chongqing\n\nChongqing is a big city in Central China. It is a very crowded place with many people. A long time ago, people called the Ba lived there. Later, a king named Qin built a new city there. The city has had many names over the years. During a big war, the Japanese dropped bombs on Chongqing. Today, it is a special city that is part of China.
Artificial selection\n\nArtificial selection is when people choose which plants or animals to make babies together. A farmer might pick the biggest cow to have a baby cow, so the baby cow will also be big. People have done this for a very long time with dogs, cows, and plants. It is like picking your favorite toy to play with, but with living things. Sometimes people do it by accident, like when early farmers kept the best plants without knowing it.
National park\n\nA national park is a big piece of land that the government keeps safe. The land is protected so that animals and plants can live there without being hurt. People can visit national parks to see pretty trees, rivers, and wild animals. The first national park was Yellowstone in the United States. It was made a long time ago in 1872. Today there are many national parks all around the world.
Judaism\n\nJudaism is the religion of Jewish people. It is one of the oldest religions in the world. Jewish people believe in one God. They believe God made the whole world and everything in it. The most important holy book is called the Torah. The Torah tells Jewish people how to live and be good. Jewish people follow many rules called mitzvot. These rules help them be kind, fair, and honest. They also help them love God and take care of the world. Jewish people celebrate special holidays like Passover and Hanukkah. They go to a special building called a synagogue to pray and learn. A Jewish teacher is called a rabbi. Jewish people believe that everyone should be treated with respect because all people are made in God's image.
Crane (bird)\n\nA crane is a very tall bird with long legs and a long neck. It lives near water like marshes and lakes. Cranes can be white, gray, or brown. They are the tallest flying birds in the world. When they fly, they stretch their neck out in front and their legs stick out behind. Cranes eat plants, small animals, and bugs. They live in big groups called flocks. Cranes make loud sounds that can be heard far away. They do special dances by jumping and bowing. Baby cranes grow fast and learn to fly in a few months. Some people think cranes are special and holy, especially in Japan.
Tuatara\n\nA tuatara is a reptile that looks like a lizard but is special. It lives only in New Zealand. Tuatara are green-brown and can be as long as a big ruler. They have a row of pointy spikes on their back. Boys have bigger spikes than girls. Tuatara have two rows of teeth on top and one row on the bottom. They also have a third eye on top of their head, but it does not see like a normal eye. Baby tuatara can see it, but it gets covered up as they grow. Tuatara do not have ears, but they can still hear. They are in danger because rats eat their eggs and people change their homes. Now they live on small islands where it is safe.
Laboratory\n\nA laboratory is a special room where people do science. Scientists work in a lab to learn new things. They mix colorful liquids, look at tiny things through a microscope, and do experiments. You can find labs in schools, hospitals, and big buildings. People in labs wear white coats and sometimes goggles to keep their eyes safe.
Board game\n\nA board game is a game you play on a flat board with special spaces. You move little pieces around the board. Some games use dice or cards to make things different each time. There are many kinds of board games. Chess and checkers are played on a board with black and white squares. Monopoly and Scrabble are newer games that many people like to play.
Photographic film\n\nPhotographic film is a thin plastic sheet that can take pictures. It has a special coating that catches light. The film is kept in a small metal can to keep light away. When you take a picture, light hits the film and makes a hidden picture. After you take all the pictures, the film goes to a special place where it gets a bath in chemicals. That makes the pictures show up. Film can only be used once. Some film takes pictures in black and white, and some takes pictures in color. Some film needs a lot of light, and some needs only a little. Film comes in different sizes. The most common size is 35 millimeter. Before film, people used glass plates to take pictures. Now most people use digital cameras, but some still like film.
Rugby football\n\nRugby football is a sport played by two teams on a big field. Each team has 15 players. The players try to get more points than the other team in 80 minutes. They can carry the ball or kick it. They can pass the ball to teammates, but only to players who are not closer to the other team's goal. To score a try, a player must touch the ball to the ground in the other team's special area. After a try, the team can kick the ball through the H-shaped goal for extra points. Players tackle the person with the ball to stop them. Tackling means grabbing and making them fall. You cannot touch the neck. There are two kinds of rugby: Rugby Union and Rugby League. Rugby Union is the most popular. The Rugby World Cup happens every four years.
Anxiety\n\nAnxiety is a feeling of worry or fear inside your mind. It can make your tummy hurt or give you a headache. Everyone feels anxious sometimes, like before a test or when something scary happens. Most of the time, the feeling goes away after a while. But some people feel very worried a lot, and it makes it hard to play or sleep. They might shake, sweat, or have a fast heartbeat. A doctor can help them feel better with medicine or by talking to someone. You can also feel calmer by taking deep breaths or doing quiet things like drawing.
Underwater diving\n\nUnderwater diving is when a person goes under the water to do things. People dive to see fish and pretty coral, to fix boats, to find treasure, or just for fun. Some divers wear a big tank of air on their back so they can breathe underwater. Others hold their breath and swim down for a short time. Divers wear special goggles to see clearly and flippers on their feet to swim fast.
Lark\n\nA lark is a small bird that lives in many dry and open places. It can be found in the Old World, Australia, and one kind lives in North America. Larks sing beautiful songs while flying high up in the sky.
Protest\n\nA protest is when many people come together in a public place to show that they like or do not like something. For example, people might protest to say that something is not fair. People can protest in different ways. They can hold signs, sing songs, or write letters. Sometimes protests can be dangerous.
Pool (cue sports)\n\nPool is a game played on a big table with six holes called pockets. Players use a long stick called a cue to hit balls into the pockets. The balls are different colors and numbers. There are many kinds of pool games, like eight-ball and nine-ball. People play pool for fun or in contests. The table has a soft green cloth on top.
Partnership\n\nA partnership is when two or more people work together to do something. The people who work together are called partners. Sometimes partners make a special paper called a contract to say they will work together. Partners can share a business and help each other make money. If one partner makes money, they both get some of it. Sometimes a partnership is not just people but big groups or companies too.
Audience\n\nAn audience is a group of people who watch or listen to something together. They might watch a play, a movie, or a sports game. Sometimes the audience claps or cheers. Other times they just sit quietly and watch.
History of the United States\n\nThe history of the United States is the story of what happened in the past in a country called the United States. Long ago, Native Americans lived there for many years. Then people from England came and started towns. In 1776, the people who lived there said they wanted to be free from England. They wrote a paper called the Declaration of Independence. A man named George Washington helped them win a war, and he became the first president. Later, the country grew bigger and had a big war between the North and the South. In the 1900s, the United States fought in big wars and became very strong. People from many places came to live there. Today, it is a big country with many people and many different ways of life.
Lily\n\nA lily is a flower that grows from a bulb in the ground. It can be very tall and comes in many colors like white, yellow, pink, and orange. Lilies grow in Europe, North America, and Asia. Some lilies grow in forests or grassy mountains, and some like wet ground. The flower has petals that come in groups of three. Some lilies can make cats very sick if they eat them, so be careful.
Adult\n\nAn adult is a person who has grown up. In many places, you become an adult when you are 18 years old. Adults can make their own choices and do not have to ask a parent for permission. They also have to be responsible for what they do. Some adults can vote or drive a car. A child is not an adult yet.
Balkans\n\nThe Balkans is a place in Europe, near the bottom right side. It is a big piece of land with water on three sides: the Black Sea and the Mediterranean Sea. The name comes from a word that means "chain of wooded mountains." Many different countries are in the Balkans, like Bulgaria, Greece, and Serbia. People there speak different languages and follow different religions, like Christianity and Islam. Long ago, the Romans came and took over the land. They were very strong and spread their way of life.
Aeneas\n\nAeneas is a hero from old stories. He was a prince from a city called Troy. His father was Anchises and his mother was a goddess. Aeneas carried his father out of Troy when the city was burning. He went on a long trip and later helped start the city of Rome. Many people wrote stories about him, like Virgil and Shakespeare.
Milk\n\nMilk is a white liquid that comes from animals like cows and goats. It is the first food for baby animals and human babies. Milk helps bones and teeth grow strong. You must keep milk cold in the fridge, or it will turn sour. People make cream, butter, yogurt, ice cream, and cheese from milk. Some milk comes from plants, like coconut milk and almond milk, but they are not real milk. Many people drink cow's milk every day.
Northern Ireland\n\nNorthern Ireland is a country that is part of the United Kingdom. It is on the island of Ireland. The capital city is Belfast. About 1.9 million people live there. People speak English, Irish, and Ulster Scots. Many people are Christian. Some are Catholic and some are Protestant. After a big agreement in 1998, there has been more peace. People like to play football, Gaelic football, and rugby. Trains go from Belfast to other towns and to Dublin.
Video game\n\nA video game is a game you play on a screen. You can play it on a TV, a computer, a phone, or a small handheld machine. Some video games are about jumping and running, some are about racing cars, and some are about solving puzzles. To play at home, you can use a special machine called a console. Some consoles are big and plug into the TV, and some are small enough to carry around. People also play games on their phones or computers. Sometimes people have contests to see who is the best at a game, and that is called e-sports. The first video game was made a long time ago, in 1958, and it was a simple tennis game.
Hebrew Bible\n\nThe Hebrew Bible is a special book of old stories and rules. It is also called the Tanakh. It has three parts: the Torah, the Nevi'im, and the Ketuvim. The stories are mostly written in Hebrew. Many people read this book to learn about God and how to be good. It is used by Jewish people and also by Christians, but they call it the Old Testament.
Computer file\n\nA computer file is a place to keep information that goes together. You can open a file to see what is inside or add new things to it. Files live on a computer, like on a hard drive or a memory stick. Different files hold different kinds of information, like pictures, words, or music. The way the information is arranged in a file is called its format.
Saint Lucia\n\nSaint Lucia is a small island country in the warm Caribbean Sea. It is a tropical place with tall green mountains and sandy beaches. The capital city is Castries, where many people live. The island has two famous mountains called the Pitons that look like big pointy hills. Saint Lucia also has a volcano you can drive right up to. The weather is warm all year, with a dry season and a rainy season. Many people visit Saint Lucia on vacation to swim in the clear sea and play on the beaches. The people there speak English and a special language called Creole. Saint Lucia is the only country in the world named after a woman, Saint Lucy.
Birthday\n\nA birthday is the day you were born. On your birthday, you might have a party with your family and friends. You can eat cake and get presents. People often sing the song "Happy Birthday to You." A birthday cake has candles on top. Sometimes the number of candles is how old you are. Not everyone celebrates birthdays. Some people believe a special stone is linked to the month you were born.
Golden Gate Bridge\n\nThe Golden Gate Bridge is a very long bridge in California. It goes over the water from San Francisco to another place called Marin County. The bridge is painted a pretty reddish-orange color. People can drive cars or ride bikes across it. Some people also walk across it. Before the bridge was built, people had to take a boat to cross the water. The bridge was finished in 1937. It has tall towers and long cables that hold it up. At night, the bridge lights up and looks beautiful.
Iguanodon\n\nIguanodon is a big dinosaur that lived a very long time ago. It ate plants and had strong teeth for chewing. Iguanodon could walk on two legs or four legs. When it walked slowly, it used all four legs. When it ran fast, it used only its back legs. Its front legs were shorter than its back legs. Iguanodon had a long tail that stayed up off the ground. It had sharp thumb spikes that it used to fight other dinosaurs. Iguanodon lived in many places like Europe, North America, Africa, and Asia.
Acid rain\n\nAcid rain is rain that is very sour and can hurt things. It happens when smoke from factories, cars, and power plants goes up into the sky and mixes with clouds. The rain becomes sour and can hurt trees, fish, and even buildings. Some buildings made of stone get holes in them from acid rain. People are trying to make less smoke so the rain is not so sour.
Kerosene\n\nKerosene is a clear liquid that can catch fire easily. It is made from oil found deep in the ground. People use kerosene to make light in camping lamps. It can also be used in some stoves for cooking food and in heaters to keep warm. Big airplanes use kerosene as fuel to fly. In some places, people use kerosene to cook meals.
Costume\n\nA costume is a set of clothes you wear to look different. Some costumes show where people come from, like a kilt from Scotland or a kimono from Japan. Actors wear costumes when they pretend to be someone else in a play. People also wear costumes at fun parties like Halloween, where children wear scary masks and outfits.
Blackberry\n\nA blackberry is a small, round, black fruit that you can eat. It grows on a tall plant with thorny stems. The plant can grow as high as a tall person. Blackberries taste sweet and a little bit sour. They grow in many places around the world, like gardens and wild areas. Sometimes the plant grows so fast that people call it a weed.
Traditional medicine\n\nTraditional medicine is a way of helping sick people get better using old knowledge that families and communities have passed down for a very long time. Before doctors had modern tools and medicines, people used plants, roots, and other things from nature to heal. Some people still use traditional medicine today, along with the medicine from the doctor.
Primary color\n\nPrimary colors are special colors that you can mix together to make other colors. You cannot make a primary color by mixing other colors. There are two kinds of primary colors. One kind is for light, like on a TV or computer screen. Those primary colors are red, green, and blue. When you mix red and green light, you get yellow. Mixing green and blue makes cyan, which is a light blue. Mixing red and blue makes magenta, which is a pinkish purple. If you mix all three together, you get white light. The other kind is for paint or crayons. Artists often use red, yellow, and blue as their primary colors. Printers use cyan, magenta, yellow, and black. When you mix paint, yellow and blue make green, yellow and red make orange, and red and blue make purple. Mixing all the paint colors together makes a dark brown or black.
Prayer\n\nPrayer is a way to talk to God. You can say the words out loud, think them in your head, or sing them. People pray to say thank you, to ask for help, or to say sorry. Some people pray alone, and some pray with others. Christians often say a prayer called the Lord's Prayer. Muslims pray five times every day. Hindus pray to many different holy beings.
Coal\n\nCoal is a hard black rock that can be burned to make heat and energy. It comes from plants that lived a very long time ago, millions of years before people were on Earth. Those plants got squished under layers of dirt and rock for a very long time, and that turned them into coal. People dig coal out of the ground and burn it in big buildings called power stations to make electricity for lights, TVs, and other things. But burning coal makes smoke that is bad for the air and can make people sick. It also makes the Earth warmer, which is not good. That is why many countries are trying to use less coal and use sun or wind power instead.
Weaving\n\nWeaving is how people make cloth. You take two sets of threads and cross them over and under each other. One set goes up and down, and the other goes side to side. This is done on a big frame called a loom. Long ago, people used a tool called a shuttle to carry the thread across. Today, some machines can weave very fast without a shuttle.
Scorpion\n\nA scorpion is a small animal with eight legs and a long tail that ends with a stinger. It has two big claws in front. Scorpions live in hot, dry places like deserts. They hide under rocks to stay cool. A scorpion uses its claws to catch food and its stinger to sting. The sting can hurt, but only a few kinds of scorpions have a sting that is very dangerous to people. Scorpions eat bugs and can go a long time without food. Baby scorpions come from eggs and grow bigger by shedding their skin.
Dinosaur\n\nA dinosaur is a very big animal that lived a long, long time ago, before people were on Earth. Some dinosaurs were huge and ate plants, like Brachiosaurus and Apatosaurus. Others were big and ate meat, like Tyrannosaurus. Many dinosaurs walked on two legs and had long tails. They laid eggs in nests, like birds do. Some small dinosaurs had feathers and were warm-blooded. Dinosaurs are all gone now, but we find their bones in the ground. Those bones are called fossils. You can see dinosaur skeletons in museums. Birds are the living family of dinosaurs.
Saturn\n\nSaturn is a big planet far away from Earth. It is the sixth planet from the Sun. Saturn is the second biggest planet in our solar system. It has many rings around it made of ice, rocks, and dust. The rings are easy to see with a telescope. Saturn spins very fast, so a day on Saturn is only about 10 hours long. It takes Saturn 29 years to go around the Sun once. Saturn is very light and could float in water. It has many moons, more than any other planet. The biggest moon is Titan, which is bigger than the planet Mercury. Saturn has a very hot inside and strong winds that blow faster than any wind on Earth.
Hazelnut\n\nA hazelnut is a small, round nut that grows on a tree called a hazel tree. It falls off the tree when it is ready to eat. People use hazelnuts in many ways. They can grind them into a paste or make hazelnut butter. You can also find hazelnuts in chocolate treats. These nuts grow in places like Greece, Turkey, Italy, and some parts of the United States. Hazelnuts have lots of good fats and protein that help your body grow strong.
Freyja\n\nFreyja is a goddess from old Norse stories. She is the goddess of love, beauty, and war. Freyja rides in a chariot pulled by two big cats. She has a pretty necklace called Brisingamen. She also has a magic cloak made of falcon feathers that lets her fly. Freyja gets half of the heroes who die in battle. She lives in a place called Folkvang. Her tears turn into gold when they fall to the ground. Friday is named after her.
Eagle\n\nAn eagle is a very big bird that hunts other animals for food. Eagles live in many places around the world, especially in Africa and parts of Europe and Asia. They have very good eyes and can see small animals from far away. Eagles hunt during the day. They use their strong feet with sharp claws to catch food, and they use their sharp beak to tear the meat. Eagles eat meat from other animals, so they are called meat-eaters. The biggest eagle that ever lived was called Haast's eagle. It lived in New Zealand a long time ago, but now it is gone.
Pain\n\nPain is a bad feeling you get when you are hurt or sick. It tells your brain that something is wrong with your body. When you hurt your knee, nerves send a message to your brain, and your brain makes you feel pain. Pain can be short, like when you fall down, or it can last a long time. To feel better, you can rest the hurt part and put ice on it. Sometimes you need medicine to help the pain go away.
Gautama Buddha\n\nGautama Buddha was a man who lived a long time ago in a place called Nepal. He was born as a prince and had everything he wanted, but he was not happy. He left his palace to see old people, sick people, and dead people. He wanted to find out why people feel sad and hurt. He tried very hard by not eating much and sitting still for many days. Then he sat under a big tree and thought until he found the answer. He learned that people can stop feeling sad by being kind, not doing bad things, and training their minds. He taught many people about this, and they became his friends and followers. He walked around and told people how to be happy and peaceful. He said anyone can learn to be happy, not just him.
Italian language\n\nThe Italian language is the language people speak in Italy. It is also spoken in other countries like San Marino, Vatican City, and Switzerland. About 70 million people speak Italian. Many Italian words for food, like pizza and spaghetti, are used in English. Some music words, like forte and allegro, also come from Italian. Italian words can change their endings to show different meanings. Most words that are for boys or things end in -o, and most words for girls or things end in -a. Learning Italian can be tricky, but saying the words is easy.
Food industry\n\nThe food industry is all the businesses that make the food we eat. Some are small, like a family bakery. Others are big factories that make lots of food. This industry gets food from farms, animals, and fishing. It brings food to stores so you can buy it.
Mass media\n\nMass media are things like radio, TV, and the internet that tell many people news and stories. TV is used the most. It shows us news from all over the world. Radio plays music and news too. Books have old and long stories. The internet lets us look up anything we want to know. Libraries have books and music we can read and listen to.
Barcelona\n\nBarcelona is a big city in Spain, near the ocean. It is the capital of a part of Spain called Catalonia. The city has many old buildings and churches. One famous church is called Sagrada Familia, and it is still being built. Barcelona has a big port, an airport, and trains. Many people visit Barcelona every year. The city has a football team called F.C. Barcelona. In 1992, Barcelona had the Summer Olympic Games. The weather is warm, with rain mostly in spring and fall. People in Barcelona speak Catalan and Spanish. The city has museums, theaters, and a big aquarium. There is a street called La Rambla where people do shows.
Autism\n\nAutism is a way some people's brains work. It changes how a person thinks, moves, talks, and makes friends. Some people with autism like to do the same things every day, like eating the same food for breakfast. They might get upset if their routine changes. They may also move their body in the same way over and over, or be very interested in one thing, like trains or dinosaurs. Loud sounds can feel too strong for them. Every person with autism is different. Some need a lot of help, and some need only a little. There is no medicine to make autism go away, and many autistic people do not want a cure. They want people to understand that they are just different. Signs of autism often show up when a child is around two or three years old. Doctors now call it autism spectrum disorder.
Fuel\n\nFuel is something we use to make heat or energy. Most fuels are burned in fire to make things work. Cars and trucks use fuel to go. Some fuel comes from old plants and animals that lived a long time ago. That kind is called fossil fuel. It can make the air dirty when we burn it. We only have so much of it, so we need to use it carefully. Other fuel comes from plants we can grow, like corn. That kind is called renewable because we can make more of it.
Plesiosaur\n\nA plesiosaur was a big sea animal that lived a long time ago, even before dinosaurs. It had a long neck, a big body, and four flippers that helped it swim in the ocean. Plesiosaurs ate fish and other sea creatures. They swallowed stones to help crush food inside their tummies. Some plesiosaurs had short necks and big heads, and they were very good at catching big fish. Plesiosaurs are not alive today; they all went away 65 million years ago.
Dimension\n\nA dimension is a way to measure things. We use dimensions to talk about how long, how wide, and how tall something is. For example, a box has length, width, and height. Those are three dimensions. We can also use a dimension called time to say when something happens. Some things, like temperature and weight, are other kinds of dimensions. Scientists and mathematicians use dimensions to understand the world better.
Jigsaw puzzle\n\nA jigsaw puzzle is a game with many small pieces that fit together to make a picture. It is harder than a regular puzzle. Some puzzles have 300 pieces, and some have 1000 pieces. The biggest puzzle ever sold had 32,256 pieces. Puzzles for kids have bigger pieces. Some puzzles have two pictures, one on each side. There are also 3D puzzles made of wood or foam. You can play jigsaw puzzles on a computer or phone too.
Vacation\n\nA vacation is a time when you take a break from school or work. You can go to a new place with your family and have fun. Some people stay in a hotel or a camp. Others stay at home and find fun things to do nearby. That is called a staycation. Many people go on vacation during holidays when there is no school.
Female\n\nFemale is one of the two kinds of people or animals. A female human is called a woman. Women have bodies that are different from men. Women have a vagina and breasts. Women can have babies. When a woman is going to have a baby, she goes to a special doctor to stay healthy.
San Francisco\n\nSan Francisco is a city in California, in the United States. It sits between the Pacific Ocean and a big bay. The city is famous for the Golden Gate Bridge, which is a very long orange bridge. San Francisco has many steep hills and old houses that are all different colors. People there ride cable cars, which are trains that go up and down the hills. The city was started a long time ago by Spanish explorers. Later, many people came to San Francisco during the Gold Rush to look for gold. Today, lots of big companies have their main offices there. San Francisco also has a big airport called SFO.
Radish\n\nA radish is a crunchy vegetable that grows underground. People eat radishes all over the world. Radishes can be red, white, or purple. They taste a little bit spicy, like pepper. Some radishes are small and round, and some are long. You can eat them raw in a salad. The spicy taste keeps some animals from eating too many of them.
Water purification\n\nWater purification is a way to make dirty water clean. It takes out the bad stuff that can make you sick. People do this so they can drink the water safely. Clean water is also used to wash things and to make things like computer parts. Dirty water can hurt your body and also break things like pipes and machines. Many people around the world do not have clean water to drink.
Hamster\n\nA hamster is a small animal that looks a bit like a mouse. Hamsters have soft fur, a short tail, and big cheek pouches. They use these pouches to carry food back to their home. Wild hamsters live in the desert and stay underground during the day. People all over the world keep hamsters as pets. Pet hamsters need a cage with safe bedding, like wood shavings or recycled newspaper. They eat hamster food from the pet shop and can also eat small pieces of vegetables and fruit. Hamsters store food in their cheek pouches. Their teeth grow all the time, so they need wooden blocks to chew on. Most hamsters like to run on a wheel for exercise. There are different kinds of hamsters, like the Syrian hamster and the dwarf hamster.
Cloak\n\nA cloak is a big piece of cloth you wear over your clothes. It keeps you warm when it is cold or dry when it rains. You put it on and fasten it at your neck or over your shoulder. Some cloaks have a hood to cover your head. They have no sleeves for your arms. People wore cloaks a long time ago, and some still wear them today.
Peer pressure\n\nPeer pressure is when friends make you want to do what they are doing. Sometimes you might do something you would not do by yourself, just to feel like you belong. This can be good or bad. Good peer pressure helps you do nice things, like sharing or helping others. Bad peer pressure can make you do things that are not safe, like smoking or drinking. It is okay to say no if you do not want to do something.
Mexico\n\nMexico is a country in North America. It is next to the United States, Guatemala, and Belize. Mexico has big oceans on both sides: the Pacific Ocean and the Gulf of Mexico. The capital city is Mexico City, which is very big. Long ago, people called the Olmecs, Mayans, and Aztecs lived there. The Aztecs built a big city called Tenochtitlan. Then Spanish people came and took over. Later, Mexico became its own country. Now, Mexico has a president who is chosen every 6 years. Most people in Mexico speak Spanish. Many people have both Native American and Spanish families. Mexico has mountains, deserts, and rainforests. Some mountains are volcanoes, like Popocatépetl. The highest mountain is Pico de Orizaba.
Parasitism\n\nParasitism is when one small living thing lives on or inside another living thing and takes food from it. The small thing is called a parasite, and the bigger one is called the host. The parasite may hurt the host a little or a lot. Some parasites, like tapeworms, live inside people. Mosquitoes bite people and drink their blood, but they do not stay long, so they are not really parasites. Many insects, like aphids and caterpillars, eat parts of plants and are parasites of plants. There are many, many kinds of parasites all over the world.
Ounce\n\nAn ounce is a way to measure how heavy something is. It is a small amount of weight. You might see ounces on a food box or a bottle. One ounce is about as heavy as a slice of bread. There are 16 ounces in one pound.
Well\n\nA well is a deep hole in the ground that people dig to get water. Some wells are simple, like a hole with a bucket on a rope. Others have pipes and pumps to bring the water up. Many towns that are not near a lake or river get their water from wells. It is important to keep the ground near a well clean, because bad things in the ground can get into the water and make people sick. In some places, people walk a long way to get water, so charities help build wells in villages.
Hera\n\nHera is a goddess from old Greek stories. She is the queen of all the gods and lives on a high mountain called Mount Olympus. Hera is married to Zeus, the king of the gods. She takes care of women, families, and marriages. Her special things are the peacock, the pomegranate, and the cow. She also wears a crown and a veil. Hera has a mom named Rhea and a dad named Kronos. Her brothers and sisters are Zeus, Hestia, Demeter, Hades, and Poseidon. She has two daughters named Hebe and Eileithyia, and two sons named Ares and Hephaestus. Hera is very beautiful and important, but she can get very angry when Zeus likes other women. She sometimes tries to hurt those women or their children. One time she turned a woman named Io into a cow. Another time she sent snakes to kill a baby named Heracles, but the baby was so strong he killed the snakes with his hands. Later, Heracles grew up and became a hero, and Hera let him marry her daughter Hebe.
Performing arts\n\nPerforming arts are things people do on a stage for others to watch. The people who do them use their own bodies and voices. Dancing, singing, acting, and magic tricks are all performing arts. A person who does performing arts is called a performer. Performers often wear special clothes and makeup. Some performers tell funny stories to make people laugh. Others dance to music or play instruments. People go to a theater or a show to watch them.
Mont Blanc\n\nMont Blanc is a very tall mountain in the Alps. It is the highest mountain in Europe. The top of Mont Blanc is covered in snow all year long. The mountain sits on the line between France and Italy. People who like to climb mountains try to reach the top of Mont Blanc.
Hornbill\n\nA hornbill is a bird with a long, curved beak that is often bright in color. Some hornbills have a funny bump on top of their beak. They live in warm places in Africa, Asia, and some islands. The mother hornbill lays eggs inside a hole in a tree. She covers the hole with mud and poop, leaving only a tiny opening. The father hornbill brings food to her through that opening. This keeps the babies safe from snakes until they are big enough to fly.
Emergency medical services\n\nEmergency medical services help people who are very sick or hurt. They send a special car called an ambulance to where the person is. The people in the ambulance are called paramedics. They help the sick or hurt person right away and can take them to the hospital if needed. Some paramedics have a lot of training and can give strong medicine. Others have less training but can still help. In some countries, doctors also ride in the ambulance and try to fix the person at the scene. Long ago, ambulances just took people to the hospital without helping much. Now, paramedics help people before they get to the hospital.
Harmony\n\nHarmony is when you play more than one note at the same time to make a sound that is nice to hear. A single tune can be pretty, but adding other notes underneath makes it even better. In music class, children learn which notes sound good together. When a group of people sing or play instruments together, they make harmony. For example, in a choir, some people sing high and some sing low, and all the sounds mix together to make a beautiful song.
Tegucigalpa\n\nTegucigalpa is a big city in a country called Honduras. It is the capital, which means the most important city in that country. Many people live there, more than one million. The city sits on mountains, so there are hills all around. Some parts are covered with trees like pine and oak. The weather is warm, and there are two seasons: a rainy season when it rains a lot, and a dry season when it does not rain much.
Fox\n\nA fox is a small animal that looks a bit like a dog. It has pointy ears, a long nose, and a big bushy tail. Foxes run very fast. They eat small animals like mice and rabbits, and also eat berries and fruit. A mother fox is called a vixen, and a father fox is called a dog. Foxes use their bushy tail to keep warm when they sleep in cold weather. They also use their tail to talk to other foxes and to help them balance when they run. Foxes live in many places around the world, like forests and deserts. The most common fox is the red fox, which has reddish-brown fur and a white tip on its tail.
Volleyball\n\nVolleyball is a game where two teams hit a ball over a net. Each team has six players. The ball must stay in the air. If the ball hits the floor, the other team gets a point. Players can hit the ball with their hands or arms. They can only touch the ball three times before sending it over the net. The game starts with a serve. A player hits the ball from behind the back line. The other team tries to return it. Players can bump the ball with their forearms or set it with their fingertips. A spike is a hard hit down into the other side. A block is when players jump with their hands up to stop the ball. The team that wins the most points wins the game. Volleyball is played in the Olympics.
Geyser\n\nA geyser is a hot spring that shoots water and steam up into the air. It happens when water deep underground gets very hot from hot rocks near a volcano. The water turns into steam and builds up pressure. When the pressure gets strong enough, the water and steam burst out of the ground like a fountain. Geysers are not common. Most of them are in a place called Yellowstone National Park in the United States. Some are also in Iceland. Geysers do not last forever, but they can shoot water for many years.
Stonehenge\n\nStonehenge is a very old circle of big stones in England. It was built a long, long time ago, before anyone had cars or houses like we have today. The stones are huge and heavy. Some stones stand up tall, and other stones sit on top of them like a hat. No one knows for sure who built Stonehenge or why. But on the longest day of the year, the sun shines through the stones in a special way. This makes some people think it was a kind of calendar. Many people visit Stonehenge to see the big stones and wonder about the people who put them there.
Anubis\n\nAnubis is a god from ancient Egypt. He looks like a man with the head of a dog. Anubis helped take care of people after they died. He would weigh a person's heart on a scale to see if they were good. If the heart was light, the person could go to a happy place. If the heart was heavy, a monster would eat it. The old Egyptians thought Anubis was very important.
Smi\n\nThe Smi are a group of people who live in the far north of Europe, in countries like Norway, Sweden, Finland, and Russia. They are sometimes called Sami. Their home is called Spmi. There are about 80,000 to 135,000 Smi people in the world. The Smi have their own languages, and some of them can be written. Long ago, the Smi moved with reindeer herds to find food. They used reindeer for meat, milk, and clothes. They made tents and clothes from reindeer skins. Today, some Smi still take care of reindeer. But for many years, the governments tried to make the Smi stop speaking their own language and change their ways. This was hard for the Smi people. Now, the Smi work to keep their culture and language alive.
Linen\n\nLinen is a kind of cloth made from a plant called flax. People use linen to make light clothes and table covers. Linen is very old. People in Egypt made linen more than 6,000 years ago. They even used linen to wrap mummies. Today, people use cotton more because it costs less.
Gila monster\n\nA Gila monster is a lizard that lives in the desert. It has bumpy skin that looks like beads and is black, pink, orange, and yellow. It is slow and heavy for a lizard. It can grow up to two feet long. The Gila monster can bite fast and hold on tight, but it does not kill people. It eats small animals like mice, birds, and eggs. It chews its food and puts poison into it with its teeth. The Gila monster can keep food in its tail. A medicine for sick people was made from its spit.
Illustration\n\nAn illustration is a picture that helps you understand something better. It can be a drawing, a painting, or a photograph. Some illustrations make a story more fun to read. Others show you what something looks like in a book or a newspaper.
Ski jumping\n\nSki jumping is a winter sport where a person slides down a snowy hill on skis, jumps into the air, and tries to land far away. The skis are wide and long. Judges give points for how far the person jumps and how well they jump. Ski jumping is in the Winter Olympic Games. It started a long time ago in Norway. The jumper goes down a ramp, jumps up, flies through the air, and then lands on the snow.
Intimacy\n\nIntimacy is a warm, close feeling you have with someone you love. It means you feel very safe and happy together. You can have intimacy with your mom, dad, or best friend. It is about sharing special moments, like cuddling or telling secrets. Intimacy makes you feel like you belong together.
Pineapple\n\nA pineapple is a fruit that grows in warm places like South America and the Caribbean. It looks like a big pine cone with a spiky, rough skin on the outside and yellow, sweet fruit inside. The pineapple takes a very long time to grow, sometimes two or three years. It needs warm weather and cannot be kept in cold places. Pineapples have vitamin C, which helps keep you healthy, and they also have something that helps your body build strong bones. People eat pineapple fresh or in fruit salads, and it tastes sweet and a little bit sour. In some places, people put pineapples outside their homes to show they are friendly and welcome visitors.
Hunting\n\nHunting is when people or animals go out to find and kill animals for food. Long ago, people used sharp sticks called spears to hunt. Today, people mostly use guns or bows. Some people hunt animals for their fur to make warm clothes. Hunting too many animals can make them all go away, like what happened to the dodo bird. Some people do not like hunting and make rules to stop it.
Thorax\n\nThe thorax is a part of an animal's body between the head and the belly. In people and mammals, the thorax holds the ribs and bones that protect the heart and lungs. It starts at the neck and ends at a big muscle called the diaphragm. In bugs and crabs, the thorax is the middle part of the body, and the legs are attached to it.
Caspian Sea\n\nThe Caspian Sea is a very big body of salty water on Earth. It is called a sea because the water tastes salty, like the ocean. It is the biggest closed sea in the world, which means water does not flow out of it to the ocean. The Caspian Sea sits next to five countries: Russia, Azerbaijan, Iran, Turkmenistan, and Kazakhstan. More than half of the sea belongs to Iran. The water is not as salty as the big ocean, but it is still salty. Many fish live in the Caspian Sea.
Peninsula\n\nA peninsula is a piece of land that has water on three sides. It sticks out into the water like a long finger. Some countries are on peninsulas, like India. Other peninsulas are parts of countries, like Baja California in Mexico. The Arabian Peninsula is the biggest peninsula in the world.
Psychiatric hospital\n\nA psychiatric hospital is a place where people who have trouble with their feelings or thinking can stay to get help. Sometimes people choose to go there, and sometimes a doctor says they must go to keep them safe. Long ago, these places were like prisons and people were chained up. Later, a doctor named Philippe Pinel took away the chains and made them nicer. In the 1900s, new medicine helped people feel better, so many big hospitals closed. Now, people with these problems can get help in small clinics or at home.
La Paz\n\nLa Paz is a big city in Bolivia, a country in South America. It is the capital city, which means the leaders of the country work there. La Paz is very high up in the mountains, higher than any other capital city in the world. Many people live there, but another city called Santa Cruz has even more people. The city is in a place called La Paz Department.
Speed\n\nSpeed is how fast something moves. It tells you how far something goes in a certain amount of time. For example, if a car goes 100 miles in one hour, its speed is 100 miles per hour. The fastest speed in the whole world is the speed of light. Nothing can go faster than that.
Eucalyptus\n\nEucalyptus is a kind of tree that grows mostly in Australia. Many eucalyptus trees are called gum trees because they make sticky sap. The leaves smell strong and are used to make oil for coughs. Koalas eat eucalyptus leaves. The trees have special flowers that open from a little cap. The fruit is called a gumnut. Some eucalyptus trees are very tall, like the Mountain Ash. The bark can be smooth or rough. Eucalyptus trees need fire to grow new seeds. They grow back fast after a fire. People use eucalyptus wood for building and making things like the didgeridoo.
Continent\n\nA continent is a very big piece of land on Earth. Earth has seven continents: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and Australia. Each continent is a home to many people, animals, and plants. Asia has the most people. Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth and is covered in ice. Continents move very slowly over time. Sometimes they bump into each other and make big mountains.
Gray\n\nGray is a color that is made by mixing black and white together. It is the color of an elephant, cement, pencil writing, and rain clouds. Gray looks like black that has been made lighter, but not as light as white.
Squid\n\nA squid is an animal that lives in the ocean. It has eight arms and two long tentacles that grab food. Squids eat other animals, not plants. They can change color to hide from bigger animals. A squid moves by sucking water in and pushing it out fast. Most squids live for only one or two years. The female squid lays eggs that look like a flower. Some squids are very big, like the giant squid. Giant squid have the biggest eyes of any animal.
Cultural heritage\n\nCultural heritage is the special things from long ago that people in a group or country keep and share. It can be old buildings, stories, songs, dances, or ways of making food. These things come from people who lived before us. We keep them to remember our past and teach them to our children.
Tofu\n\nTofu is a food made from soybeans. It is made by pressing soy milk into soft white blocks. Tofu tastes plain and can be used in many dishes. People in China, Japan, Korea, and many other countries eat tofu every day. In the United States, people also buy tofu at the store. Tofu has a lot of protein and is good for your body.
Belgium\n\nBelgium is a small country in Europe. It is next to France, Germany, Luxembourg, and the Netherlands. The capital city is Brussels. Many important groups have their homes in Brussels. About 11 million people live in Belgium. Some people speak Dutch, some speak French, and a few speak German. Belgium has a king, but the people also vote for their leaders. The country has three parts: Flanders, Wallonia, and Brussels. Belgium is known for its yummy chocolate and tasty fries.
Auto racing\n\nAuto racing is a sport where people drive cars very fast to see who wins. It started in France a long time ago. There are many kinds of auto racing. In Formula One, the cars are low and have special wings that help them go fast. Each race is in a different country. Indy Cars look like Formula One cars but race on oval tracks that only turn left. Endurance races last many hours, so drivers take turns driving. The most famous endurance race is the 24 Hours of Le Mans in France. NASCAR races use cars that look like regular cars but are made for racing. They race on oval tracks too.
