Liquorice\n\nLiquorice is a plant that grows in warm places like southern Europe and parts of Asia. It is a sweet root that people use to make candy. The plant has green leaves and purple or blue flowers. It can grow as tall as a grown-up's waist. The root tastes sweet, and some people love to eat liquorice candy.
Ceiling\n\nA ceiling is the top part of a room that you see when you look up. It covers the room like a lid. The ceiling hides the floor or roof above it. Some ceilings have pretty paintings or tiles on them. The most famous painted ceiling is in a big church called the Sistine Chapel.
Ohio River\n\nThe Ohio River is a very long river in the United States. It is 981 miles long. The river starts in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It flows past many cities like Cincinnati and Louisville. The river is so wide in some places that you can see across it for one mile. Many other rivers, like the Wabash and Tennessee, flow into the Ohio River. The Ohio River helps make the borders for five states: Ohio, Kentucky, Illinois, Indiana, and West Virginia.
Middle Ages\n\nThe Middle Ages were a very long time in Europe, about 1000 years. They happened after the big Roman Empire ended and before people started learning many new things again. Life was hard for most people. Many could not read or write. There were wars and a very bad sickness called the plague that made many people die. But some things got better over time. People started to trade goods like silk and spices along long roads. In other parts of the world, like in Muslim lands, people learned a lot about math and science. The Middle Ages ended around the time people began to explore the world by ship.
Giant planet\n\nA giant planet is a very big planet that is much larger than Earth. There are four giant planets in our Solar System: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. Giant planets do not have a hard, rocky surface like Earth. Instead, they are made of thick gas and liquid. Jupiter and Saturn are mostly made of hydrogen and helium, which are light gases. Uranus and Neptune are made of water, methane, and ammonia, and they look blue. All giant planets have a thick atmosphere with clouds. They are very far from the Sun and are very cold. Some giant planets also have rings and many moons.
Cook Islands\n\nThe Cook Islands are a group of 15 small islands in the big ocean. They are far away in the southern part of the Pacific. About 18,000 people live there. Many people visit the islands for fun trips. The biggest island is called Rarotonga, and the main town there is Avarua. The people speak a special language called Cook Island Maori. The islands are friends with New Zealand and other countries.
Hermitage Museum\n\nThe Hermitage Museum is a very big building in St. Petersburg, Russia. It is a place where you can see old paintings and special things from long ago. The museum has six big buildings. One of them is the Winter Palace, where the Russian kings used to live. The museum started a long time ago, in 1764, when a queen named Catherine began collecting art. Now many people visit to see paintings by famous artists like Leonardo da Vinci and Rembrandt. There are also shiny jewels and old gold from faraway places. Some cats live on the museum grounds. They are called the Hermitage cats, and visitors like to see them too.
Mary, mother of Jesus\n\nMary is the mother of Jesus. She was a young woman who lived long ago in a town called Nazareth. Mary was going to marry a man named Joseph. One day, an angel named Gabriel came to Mary and told her she would have a baby boy. The angel said to name him Jesus. Mary was surprised because she was not married yet. But she said yes to God's plan. Mary and Joseph went to Bethlehem to pay a tax. There, Mary gave birth to baby Jesus in a place where animals slept. Mary loved Jesus very much. When Jesus grew up and died on a cross, Mary was there with him. After Jesus died, Mary went to his tomb and found it empty. An angel said Jesus was alive again. Many people honor Mary because she was Jesus's mother. They call her the Blessed Virgin Mary. Some people pray a special prayer called the Hail Mary to ask for her help.
Melbourne\n\nMelbourne is a big city in Australia. It is the second-biggest city in the country. Many people from all over the world live there. Melbourne has special trains called trams that run on the streets. There is a river called the Yarra River that flows through the city. Melbourne has many parks, gardens, and beaches. You can go to museums, look at art, eat food, and go shopping there. Big sports games like the Australian Open tennis happen in Melbourne. The weather can change a lot, sometimes having four seasons in one day.
Kaziranga National Park\n\nKaziranga National Park is a big park in India where many animals live. It is a special place that people protect. The park is home to most of the world's one-horned rhinoceroses. You can also find tigers, elephants, wild water buffalo, and swamp deer there. Many birds live in the park too, like pelicans and eagles. Every year, the park gets flooded when the river rises. Some parts of the park stay dry, and animals go there to be safe. People have built extra dry places to help the animals during floods.
Chisel\n\nA chisel is a sharp tool that looks like a long, flat stick with a pointy end. People hit the chisel with a hammer to cut or shape wood and stone. Artists use chisels to make statues out of big rocks. Workers also use chisels to break things apart so they can move them.
Violet (plant)\n\nA violet is a small plant with pretty flowers. Some violets are blue or purple. There is a famous poem that says "Roses are red, violets are blue." Violets can grow in gardens or in the wild. Some violets come back every year, and some only live for one year. People like to plant them because the flowers are beautiful.
Cryptography\n\nCryptography is a way to hide information so only the right people can see it. It is like a secret code. When you send a message, you change it into a secret code. The person who gets it knows how to change it back. This keeps your message safe from others. People use cryptography when they use bank cards, computer passwords, or shop on the internet. Long ago, people used simple codes like the Caesar cipher, which moves each letter in the alphabet. Today, computers make very strong codes that are hard to break.
African Great Lakes\n\nThe African Great Lakes are a group of big lakes in Africa. They are near Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, and Tanzania. The lakes are very large and deep. Many fish live in the water. People who live near the lakes use them for fishing and getting water to drink.
Uniform\n\nA uniform is a special set of clothes that a group of people wear to show they belong together. Everyone in the group wears the same thing. Soldiers wear uniforms to show their job. Nurses wear uniforms when they work in hospitals. In many countries, school children wear uniforms. This helps them feel proud of their school and makes all children look the same, whether they are rich or poor. Uniforms can also keep people safe or clean while they work.
Minotaur\n\nA minotaur is a make-believe creature from old Greek stories. It has the head and tail of a bull, but the body of a man. The minotaur lived in a big maze called a labyrinth. A hero named Theseus went into the maze and stopped the minotaur.
Red giant\n\nA red giant is a very big star that looks red. It is much bigger than our Sun. Many red giants could fit thousands of Suns inside them. Our Sun will become a red giant in about five billion years. It will get so big that it might eat up Mercury, Venus, and maybe Earth. A red giant is made when a star uses up all the hydrogen in its middle. Then the star gets bigger and cooler, and turns red or orange. After a long time, the red giant will blow away its outer parts and become a small white star called a white dwarf.
Park\n\nA park is an open place in a city or town where you can play and enjoy nature. Parks have trees, flowers, benches, and sometimes ponds or fountains. You can walk, run, ride a bike, or play on swings and slides. Some parks are very big and have picnic areas. There are also special parks called national parks that protect animals and their homes. Another kind of park is an amusement park with fun rides and shows.
Stingray\n\nA stingray is a flat fish that lives in warm, salty water. It is a cousin of the shark. Most stingrays have a long tail with a sharp, pointy sting on it. They only use the sting to protect themselves. Stingrays like to hide under the sand at the bottom of the ocean. Their eyes are on top of their body, and their mouth is on the bottom. They eat small animals like clams, crabs, and tiny fish. Some stingrays are very big, like the manta ray, and they do not have a sting. Baby stingrays grow inside their mother and are born alive. A mother stingray can have five to thirteen babies at once.
Crete\n\nCrete is a big island in Greece. It is in the warm sea. The ground is good for growing food. Long ago, people called Minoans lived there. They built a big palace called Knossos. The palace had many rooms and was like a maze. People used string to find their way out. The Minoans believed a monster called the Minotaur lived in the maze. The Minotaur was half bull and half man. The Minoans also liked games, music, and pretty clothes. Women wore long skirts and jewelry. Men wore small belts. They ate fish, cheese, nuts, and honey. They drank goat milk. Later, other people from Greece took over the island.
Firefly\n\nA firefly is a kind of beetle that can make its own light. It is an insect with three body parts and six legs. Fireflies are brown or black with yellow and red spots. They live in warm, wet places like marshes, ponds, and rain forests. Some also live in dry places like backyards and meadows. Fireflies use their light to talk to each other. The adults flash light to find a friend. The babies glow to tell animals that they do not taste good. Many animals do not like to eat firefly babies.
Pixel\n\nA pixel is one tiny dot in a picture on a computer screen. Each pixel is a small square. Every pixel has a color, and all the pixels together make the whole picture. The color of a pixel is made by mixing red, green, and blue light. The word "pixel" comes from "picture element." It was first used a long time ago to talk about the tiny dots that make up pictures on screens.
Shinkansen\n\nThe Shinkansen is a very fast train in Japan. People also call it the "Bullet Train" because it goes as fast as a bullet. The first Shinkansen started running in 1964, just in time for the Tokyo Olympics. It was the first high-speed train in the whole world. The Shinkansen can go up to 300 kilometers per hour, which is faster than a car on a highway. The trains have a long, pointy nose that helps them cut through the air. They run on special tracks that are different from old train tracks. The Shinkansen is very safe and almost never has accidents. It is also very punctual, which means it arrives almost exactly on time. People ride the Shinkansen to travel between cities in Japan.
Tapir\n\nA tapir is a big animal with a round body and short tail. It has a long nose that looks like a little trunk. Tapirs have four toes on their front feet and three toes on their back feet. Their fur can be brown, gray, or black. Baby tapirs have brown fur with light stripes and spots to help them hide. Tapirs cannot see very well, but they have good ears and a great nose for smelling. They are very good swimmers. Tapirs live in forests near water in South America, Central America, and Southeast Asia. They come out at night to eat leaves, fruit, and nuts. A mother tapir has one baby at a time, and the baby stays with her for about one year.
Volt\n\nA volt is a way to measure how much push electricity has. Think of it like water pressure in a hose. More volts mean more push, so the electricity can move faster. A battery has volts inside it to make things like toys and lights work. The volt is named after a man named Alessandro Volta, who made the first battery a long time ago.
Marseille\n\nMarseille is a big city in the south of France. It is the second biggest city in France. Many people live there. Marseille has a very big port where ships come and go. It is one of the most important ports in the Mediterranean Sea. The city is very old. It was started a long, long time ago by Greek sailors. The weather in Marseille is hot and sunny in summer. The winters are mild and not too cold.
Steam\n\nSteam is water that has turned into a gas. When water gets very hot, it changes into steam. You cannot see real steam because it is invisible. The white mist you see above a boiling pot is tiny water drops, not steam. Steam is very hot and can push things. Long ago, people used steam to make trains and machines move. Some people use steam to cook food, like in a pressure cooker.
Carpenter\n\nA carpenter is a person who works with wood. They can build houses, make cabinets, or create toys. Some carpenters build big things like the frame of a house. Other carpenters make pretty things like furniture or wooden toys. Carpenters use tools like hammers and saws to cut and shape wood. They learn new ways to work with wood all the time.
Walrus\n\nA walrus is a big animal that lives in the cold ocean near the North Pole. It has two long teeth that stick out of its mouth, called tusks. The walrus uses its tusks to pull itself up onto the ice and to protect itself from polar bears. Walruses are very heavy and have thick fat to keep them warm in the icy water. They are usually brown, but their skin can turn pink when they get warm. Walruses can sleep in the water with a special air pouch under their throat that helps them float.
Cider\n\nCider is a drink made from fruit juice, most often from apples. In some places, cider has alcohol in it, and grown-ups drink it. In the United States and Canada, people drink a special kind of cider around Halloween and Thanksgiving. This cider is thick and is often heated up with cinnamon before drinking. Cider is made from apples that are squeezed to get the juice. The juice is then left to sit for a while, which changes the taste. Cider can be found in many countries, like France and the United Kingdom. Some people use cider in cooking, too.
Sarajevo\n\nSarajevo is a city in Europe. It is the capital of a country called Bosnia and Herzegovina. Many people live there, and they come from different cultures. In Sarajevo, you can see mosques, synagogues, and churches. A long time ago, a very important man named Franz Ferdinand was killed in Sarajevo, and that started a big war. The city was hurt in another war, but now it is fixed and looks nice again.
Lake Victoria\n\nLake Victoria is a very big lake in Africa. It is the biggest lake in Africa and the second biggest freshwater lake in the whole world. Three countries touch the lake: Tanzania, Uganda, and Kenya. The lake is so big that you cannot see the other side. A river called the White Nile starts from this lake. The lake was named after a queen named Victoria.
Fjord\n\nA fjord is a narrow part of the sea with very steep sides. It is like a long, skinny gulf. Long ago, big heavy sheets of ice called glaciers moved over the land and carved out the fjord. When the ice melted, the sea filled the space. Fjords are found in places like Norway, Canada, and New Zealand. Many cities near fjords are ports where big boats come and go.
Computer hardware\n\nComputer hardware is the parts of a computer that you can touch. The screen, keyboard, mouse, and the box with the computer's brain inside are all hardware. Hardware needs software to tell it what to do.
Saddle\n\nA saddle is a seat for a person riding an animal's back. A strap called a girth holds it on. Most saddles are made for horses, but some are made for camels. The first saddles were just soft pads with a strap. Today, there are two main kinds: English saddles and Western saddles. English saddles are light and used for jumping and showing. Western saddles have a horn on the front and are used for working with cows and rodeo sports. Each saddle helps the rider do a different job.
Business\n\nA business is a place where people work together to make things or help others. People buy what the business makes. The person who starts the business is called the owner. The owner hires workers to help. A business can be big or small. A small business might be a barber shop with just one person. A big business, like Microsoft, has many workers all over the world. Some businesses stay in one place, like a store or a farm. Other workers, like carpenters, go to different places to do their job. They bring their tools in a truck. The word "business" comes from the word "busy," which means doing things.
Religion of ancient Egypt\n\nThe religion of ancient Egypt is what people in Egypt believed about gods and the world a long, long time ago. They believed in many gods. Some gods looked like people, and some looked like animals. The sun god was very important. They thought the world began with water and darkness. The first god came from the water and made other gods. They believed that after people die, their soul goes to a special place. To get ready for that, they wrapped the dead body in cloth and put it in a box called a coffin. This is called mummification. They also put spells and pictures in the tomb to help the dead person. They thought the heart would be weighed to see if the person was good. If the heart was light, the person could live happily after death. If the heart was heavy, a monster would eat it. For a short time, one pharaoh named Akhenaten said people should only worship one god, the sun disk Aten. But after he died, people went back to believing in many gods. Later, most Egyptians became Christian or Muslim.
West Lake\n\nWest Lake is a big lake in the middle of a city called Hangzhou. The water in the lake is fresh, not salty. Many people visit West Lake because it is very pretty. Around the lake there are old temples and gardens. You can see green trees and hills near the water. The lake looks beautiful in the morning and at night.
Weathering\n\nWeathering is when rocks break down into smaller pieces. This happens because of wind, rain, ice, and the sun. Wind blows sand against rocks and wears them down. Rain hits rocks and slowly makes them smaller. The sun heats rocks during the day, and at night they cool down. This makes cracks in the rocks. Water can get into the cracks and freeze, which makes the cracks bigger. Ice can also grind rocks like sandpaper. Weathering is different from erosion, which is when rocks are moved away by water or wind.
Bath\n\nA bath is a big tub you can sit in to wash your body. It is usually in the bathroom. People fill it with warm water and sometimes add nice smells, oils, or salts to make it feel good. Long ago, the Romans built big rooms with baths where people could relax and talk to friends. Some rich people even had their own baths at home.
Mumps\n\nMumps is a sickness that only people can get. It makes you have a fever and a headache. Your cheeks can get big and puffy. Your throat might hurt. There is a shot called MMR that stops you from getting mumps.
Man\n\nA man is a grown-up male person. He is the opposite of a woman. A boy is a male child, and when he grows up, he becomes a man. Men are usually taller than women. Men have different body parts than women, like a deeper voice and hair on their face. Some people are born with a girl's body but feel they are a man inside, and they can grow up to be a man too.
Empire State Building\n\nThe Empire State Building is a very tall building in New York City. It has 102 floors and is one of the most famous buildings in the world. It was the tallest building in the world when it opened in 1931. People can go to the 86th floor and look out at the city from high above. The building lights up at night with many colors. A long time ago, a plane crashed into it in the fog, but the building was not badly hurt.
Inch\n\nAn inch is a way to measure how long something is. It is a little bit shorter than your thumb from the first knuckle to the tip. There are 12 inches in one foot. People in the United States and the United Kingdom use inches to measure things like how tall a person is or how long a table is. Most other countries use centimeters instead. One inch is the same as two and a half centimeters.
Western Sahara\n\nWestern Sahara is a place in north Africa. It is next to Morocco, Algeria, Mauritania, and the Atlantic Ocean. Most of it is flat desert with lots of sand. The biggest city is Layoune, where more than half the people live. Not many people live there because it is very dry. Two groups say they are in charge of this land: Morocco and a group called the Polisario Front. Many people from the Polisario Front live in camps in Algeria. Other countries do not agree on who should rule Western Sahara.
Star cluster\n\nA star cluster is a big group of stars that stay close together in the sky. The stars in a cluster are all about the same age because they were born at the same time. Some star clusters are so bright that you can see them with just your eyes, like the Pleiades group. Other star clusters have very big, hot blue stars that give off a lot of light. These clusters are different from constellations, which are just patterns we make up by connecting stars that are not really close to each other.
Anise\n\nAnise is a plant that grows flowers. People use its seeds to make food taste like black licorice. The seeds are small and brown. Long ago, people used anise to make a special drink called claret.
Wrestling\n\nWrestling is a game where two people try to push each other to the ground. The people who do this are called wrestlers. They are not allowed to hit or punch. Instead, they use their arms and legs to pull, lift, and tip the other person over. Once on the ground, they try to hold the other person down on their back. Many people who learn wrestling also do other fighting sports.
Mekong River\n\nThe Mekong River is a very long river in Asia. It starts high up in the mountains of Tibet and flows through many countries: China, Burma, Thailand, Laos, Cambodia, and Vietnam. At the end, it goes into the sea. The river is home to many kinds of fish, river dolphins, crocodiles, and otters. People catch fish from the river for food. Boats also travel on the river to move things from place to place.
Panama\n\nPanama is a country in South America. It is famous for the Panama Canal, which is a big water path that lets ships go from one ocean to another. Panama is between the Caribbean Sea and the Pacific Ocean. It has many islands and good harbors for boats. Most people in Panama are Catholic. The country uses money called the balboa, but also uses US dollars. In 2022, Panama made a law that lets people use a special kind of computer money called bitcoin.
Legislature\n\nA legislature is a group of people who make laws. They talk about new laws and vote on them. In many places, the legislature is called a Parliament or Congress. Some legislatures have two groups of people who work together. Other places have just one group. Cities and towns also have groups like this, and they are called councils.
Chimney\n\nA chimney is a tall tube on a house or building. It lets smoke go up and out into the sky. Smoke comes from a fire inside, like in a fireplace or a stove. The chimney is straight up so the smoke can float away easily. Some chimneys are on trains and ships too. A tall chimney helps keep the air clean around the house.
Wheat\n\nWheat is a plant that people grow for food. It is a kind of grass with long, thin leaves and hollow stems. The top part of the plant has many tiny flowers that turn into seeds. Those seeds are called grains. People grind the grains into flour to make bread, cookies, cakes, and pasta. Wheat is grown all over the world. Every year, farmers pick a very large amount of wheat. It is one of the most important foods for people.
Mount Tai\n\nMount Tai is a very tall mountain in China. It is in a place called Shandong. Many people think it is a special mountain. Long ago, people believed a god named Cangdi lived on the mountain. There is a big party called Feng Shan that happens on the mountain.
United States\n\nThe United States is a big country in North America. It has 50 states. The capital is Washington, D.C. The biggest city is New York. Many people live there. The country is very big and has many kinds of land. There are high mountains, flat plains, and warm beaches. Some places are very cold and some are very hot. The United States has many animals and plants. People from all over the world live there. A long time ago, people came from other countries to live in the United States. The country has a special day called Independence Day on July 4. On that day, people celebrate with fireworks and parades.
Black\n\nBlack is a very dark color. It is the opposite of white. You can make black by mixing many different paint colors together. Black can look scary or strong. Some people think black is a brave color. Black is used in fancy clothes and fast cars. Many things in the world are black, like a black cat or a black crayon.
Chile\n\nChile is a country on the south-western side of South America. Most people there speak Spanish. Chile is the longest country on earth. It has a very dry desert in the north called the Atacama Desert. The middle part of Chile is good for growing plants. Many people live in the middle part, near the cities of Santiago and Valparaíso. Chile has mountains called the Andes on its eastern side. The country has many animals like the puma, guanaco, and pudu deer. There are also penguins and whales near the coast. Chile's national flower is the copihue, a red bell-shaped flower. People in Chile love soccer and tennis. They also enjoy rodeo and skiing. The money used in Chile is called the peso.
Petra\n\nPetra is a very old city in a country called Jordan. It is built inside mountains made of red and pink rock. Long, long ago, a group of people called the Nabataeans lived there. They carved houses, temples, and tombs right into the rock walls. To get to Petra, you walk through a narrow canyon with tall rock walls on both sides. At the end, you see a beautiful building called the Treasury, which is carved into the rock. Today, many people visit Petra to see the amazing rock buildings. It is a special place that the world wants to keep safe.
Adolescence\n\nAdolescence is the time when a child grows up to become an adult. It starts around age 10 and lasts until about age 25. During this time, your body changes a lot. You get taller, your voice may change, and hair grows in new places. Your brain also keeps growing and learning new things. You may feel many different feelings, like being shy or excited. You start to want to do things on your own, but you still need help from your parents. Many kids all over the world are going through this same time of change.
One Thousand and One Nights\n\nOne Thousand and One Nights is a big book of old stories. The stories come from places like Arabia, Persia, India, and China. A long time ago, people put all these stories together in one book. Some of the stories are about magic, kings, and faraway lands. One famous story is about a man named Sinbad who goes on many adventures on a ship.
Flatfish\n\nA flatfish is a fish that is very flat. It lives on the bottom of the ocean. Both of its eyes are on the same side of its head. This helps it hide in the sand. It can change its color to match the sand or rocks. Some flatfish are called flounder, sole, turbot, plaice, and halibut. People catch them for food. Baby flatfish start with one eye on each side, but as they grow, one eye moves to the other side.
Column\n\nA column is a tall, straight piece that holds up a building. It can be made of one big piece or many pieces put together. Columns help hold up the roof or the top part of a wall. Long ago, people in Egypt used stone columns to build strong buildings.
Inheritance\n\nInheritance is when someone dies and gives their things to their family. The things can be money, a house, or a toy. Sometimes a king gives his kingdom to his son. The person who gets the things is called an heir. A girl who gets things is called an heiress. People write down who gets what in a paper called a will. Sometimes the family has to pay a tax on the things they get.
Album\n\nAn album is a group of songs put together by a musician. You can buy an album in a store or listen to it on a computer. Long ago, albums were big black round discs called records. Now albums are often on small shiny discs called CDs. Some albums are made in a studio, and some are recorded when the musician plays in front of people. Each album has tracks, and each track is one song.
Scandinavia\n\nScandinavia is a group of countries in the north part of Europe. It includes Denmark, Norway, and Sweden. Some people also think Finland and Iceland are part of it. The people in these countries speak languages that are a lot alike. Long ago, the Vikings lived in Scandinavia. They were strong people who sailed in big boats and traveled to faraway lands. Today, Scandinavia has big forests, mountains, and many lakes. The far north is called Lapland, where some people still take care of reindeer.
Parrot\n\nA parrot is a colorful bird that lives in warm places like rainforests. Parrots have strong, curved beaks to crack open nuts and seeds. They have two toes pointing forward and two pointing back, which helps them climb trees. Many parrots can learn to copy sounds, even human words. Some parrots live for a very long time, up to 80 years. People keep parrots as pets because they are smart and have bright feathers.
Colosseum\n\nThe Colosseum is a very big old building in Rome, Italy. It is shaped like a big oval and made of stone. Long ago, people went there to watch fights and shows. Gladiators fought each other and wild animals. Sometimes the floor was filled with water for pretend sea battles. The Colosseum could hold 50,000 people. It was free to go in. Now the Colosseum is old and broken in some places because of earthquakes. Many people visit it every year to see how big and amazing it is.
Gunpowder\n\nGunpowder is a special mix of powders that burns very fast and makes gas. The gas pushes out hard. In a gun, the push makes a bullet fly out fast. A long time ago, people in China made gunpowder by accident. They were trying to make a drink that would let people live forever. But they made gunpowder instead. They called it "fire medicine" because it burned so easily. Later, people used gunpowder to make rockets, bombs, and guns.
Lunch\n\nLunch is a meal that you eat in the middle of the day, after breakfast and before dinner. You can have cold food like bread and fruit, or hot food like a big meal. Many people eat lunch with their friends at school or work. Some people bring lunch from home in a lunchbox or a paper bag. You can also buy lunch at a restaurant. In some places, lunch is the biggest meal of the day.
Alder\n\nAn alder is a kind of tree or bush. There are about 30 different kinds of alder. Most alders are not very big. They have leaves that fall off in winter. Alders grow in many places around the world, often in wet ground. The leaves have edges that look like little teeth. In spring, alders have long hanging flowers that let the wind carry their dust to make seeds. The seeds grow inside small round cones that turn brown in fall. Bees like alder trees very much, especially in spring. People also use alder wood to make charcoal for cooking.
Aviation\n\nAviation is about flying in the sky using a machine like an airplane. People use aviation to travel to faraway places and to fly in the military. A long time ago, people made kites and hot air balloons to fly. Later, the Wright brothers made the first airplane that could fly. Now, big airplanes carry many people all over the world.
Satellite navigation\n\nA satellite navigation is a way to find exactly where you are on Earth. It uses special machines in space called satellites. These satellites send signals down to a small box in a car or a phone. The box can tell you how far you are from each satellite. Then it knows your exact spot on the ground. This helps people drive to new places without getting lost. The most famous system is called GPS, and it was made by the United States. Other countries like Russia, China, India, and Europe have their own satellite navigation systems too.
Cape of Good Hope\n\nThe Cape of Good Hope is a special place near the bottom of Africa. It is where two big oceans meet: the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean. Many ships sail past it on their way to other countries. The Cape is part of a park in South Africa. A long time ago, a man from Portugal saw it first and called it the 'Cape of Storms'.
Hope\n\nHope is a good feeling you have when you want something nice to happen. It is like believing that something you wish for might come true. When you hope, you feel happy and look forward to the future.
Terrier\n\nA terrier is a kind of dog that is small and very active. Terriers love to dig in the dirt because they were made to hunt little animals that live underground. They are brave and not scared of much. Some terriers have stiff, wiry fur that feels rough. They do not always get along with other dogs. There are many types of terriers, like the Scottie and the Cairn.
Herring\n\nA herring is a small fish that lives in the ocean. There are many kinds of herring. They often swim together in big groups, called a school. This keeps them safe from bigger fish. People can eat herring. Sometimes it is smoked or pickled.
Soybean\n\nA soybean is a plant that grows beans. It comes from Eastern Asia. The plant can be short or as tall as a grown-up. It lives for only one year. People eat the beans or make them into oil, sauce, milk, flour, and tofu. These foods have a lot of protein, which helps your body grow. Some people who do not eat meat like soy foods. You can also make fuel from soybeans. In old China, soybeans were a very special food.
Play (activity)\n\nPlay is something fun you do because you want to. Kids play a lot, but grown-ups and animals play too. Play can be running around, pretending, or playing games with rules. When animals play, they learn how to be strong and get along with others. Play helps you learn new things and have fun with friends.
Crime\n\nA crime is something a person does that is against the rules of a country. A person who does a crime is called a criminal. Things like hurting someone, taking something that is not yours, or selling bad things are crimes. Police try to stop crimes and find criminals. When police think someone did a crime, they put that person in jail. Then a judge decides if the person really did it. If yes, the person may have to pay money or stay in jail.
Word processor\n\nA word processor is a computer program that helps you write and change words on a screen. You can make letters big or small, add colors, and put pictures next to your words. It can count how many words you wrote, check for mistakes, and even read your writing out loud. Many people use it to make stories, school papers, or fun cards.
Bullying\n\nBullying is when someone hurts or scares another person on purpose. The person who does this is called a bully. Bullying can be hitting, saying mean things, or leaving someone out on purpose. It can happen at school, at home, or on the computer. If you see bullying, you can help by telling a grown-up you trust. It is not okay to bully, and there are rules to stop it.
Parsnip\n\nA parsnip is a vegetable that grows underground. It looks like a white carrot and has a long, thick root. The outside and inside are cream-colored. Parsnips taste sweet, especially after cold winter weather. People have eaten them for a very long time, even the Romans. Before sugar came to Europe, people used parsnips to make food sweet. Parsnips are cousins of carrots and parsley.
Czech Republic\n\nThe Czech Republic is a country in the middle of Europe. Its biggest city is Prague. People there speak Czech. The country has no ocean. It is next to Germany, Austria, Slovakia, and Poland. The money used is called the Czech crown. The Czech Republic has mountains and forests. There are four big parks where animals and plants are protected. Many people in the Czech Republic do not go to church.
Republic\n\nA republic is a country where the people choose their leader by voting. There is no king or queen. The leader is called a president. People vote for the president to make rules and take care of the country. The United States and India are republics. A long time ago, the Romans started the first republic. In a republic, the people are in charge, not a king.
Earth's crust\n\nThe Earth's crust is the hard outer layer of our planet. It is like a thin shell around the Earth. The crust is made of rocks. There are two kinds of crust: one under the land and one under the ocean. The crust is the coldest part of the Earth because it touches the air. Deep down, the crust gets hotter. The crust moves very slowly in big pieces called plates. These plates can push up mountains or pull apart the ground.
Spain\n\nSpain is a country in Europe. It is next to France and Portugal. The people of Spain are called Spaniards. They speak Spanish. Many people in Spain are Catholic. The king of Spain is Felipe VI. The capital city is Madrid. Spain has mountains called the Pyrenees. Spain is known for flamenco, which is a kind of dance and music. Long ago, Spain had a big empire with many lands far away. Now Spain is a modern country and part of the European Union.
Weevil\n\nA weevil is a small bug that looks like a beetle. It has a long nose at the front of its head, like a tiny trunk. Weevils eat plants. Some weevils are pests because they hurt the plants people grow. The boll weevil is a famous weevil that ruins cotton plants. Another weevil, the maize weevil, eats grains like rice, wheat, and oats. There are many, many kinds of weevils all over the world.
City block\n\nA city block is a group of houses that are close together, with roads or paths around them. The houses touch each other, so they make a closed shape. In the suburbs, houses have more space and do not touch. City blocks have been around for a very long time, since the Middle Ages. Some cities are planned with blocks in a grid, like a checkerboard. People use city blocks to count how many people live in an area.
Cue sports\n\nCue sports are games played on a table with balls. The table has soft sides called cushions and a cloth cover. People use long sticks called cues to hit a white ball into other balls. In some games, you try to knock balls into holes called pockets. In other games, you try to hit one ball into another. There are many kinds of cue sports, like pool, billiards, and snooker.
Hieroglyph\n\nHieroglyphs are a way of writing that uses pictures to stand for sounds and words. Long ago, people in Egypt used these picture letters. They carved them on walls, tombs, and monuments. There were about 700 or 800 different pictures. They wrote from right to left and from top to bottom. Only important people like nobles and priests knew how to write them. After many years, people forgot how to read hieroglyphs. Then a big stone called the Rosetta Stone helped a man named Champollion figure out how to read them again.
Opinion\n\nAn opinion is what you think about something. When someone asks, "What is your opinion?" they want to know what you think. You can start your answer with "In my opinion..." or "I think..." Sometimes people ask many people what they think to find out if something is good or bad. An opinion is different from a fact. A fact is something that is true and can be proven. An opinion might be true or not.
Neanderthal\n\nNeanderthals were a kind of early human that lived a long time ago. They were shorter and much stronger than people today, with thick bones and big muscles. Neanderthals had larger brains than we do, so they were smart. They made stone tools and hunted big animals like bison and mammoths. They lived in caves and took care of sick or hurt family members. Neanderthals also buried their dead and maybe made music with a flute. They died out about 40,000 years ago.
Krishna River\n\nThe Krishna River is a very long river in India. It is the fifth longest river in the whole country. The river brings water to help farmers grow food in four states: Telangana, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh. Many smaller rivers flow into the Krishna River.
Francis of Assisi\n\nFrancis of Assisi was a man who loved God and animals very much. He lived a long time ago in a place called Italy. He wore simple clothes and helped sick people. He started a group called the Franciscans, where people promised to be poor and kind. There is a story that Francis talked to a big wolf and made it stop scaring a village. Today, many people remember him on October 4 by bringing their pets to church for a special blessing.
Domestic sheep\n\nA domestic sheep is a furry animal that lives on a farm. A farmer takes care of the sheep. A female sheep is called a ewe. A male sheep is called a ram. A baby sheep is called a lamb. Sheep have thick wool on their bodies. People cut the wool off and use it to make warm clothes like sweaters and socks. Sheep also give us meat to eat. A group of sheep is called a flock. Sheep like to stay together and follow each other. The most famous sheep was Dolly the Sheep. She was the first animal that was made to be exactly the same as another sheep. That is called a clone.
Secondary school\n\nSecondary school is a place where older kids go to learn after they finish primary school. In some places it is called middle school or high school. Kids start secondary school when they are about 11 or 12 years old. They go to secondary school for a few years, until they are 16 or 18. In secondary school, kids learn many subjects and move up a grade each year. When they finish, they may take a big test. After secondary school, some kids go to college or university, and some get a job.
Manioc\n\nManioc is a tall plant with big green leaves. It grows in hot, wet places like Africa, South America, and Asia. People grow it for its big white root, which is a food for many people. The root is long and white, about as wide as a big carrot. You must cook the root before eating it, because it has a poison inside. Cooking makes it safe to eat. People boil, fry, or bake the root. They use it to make cakes, bread, and a soft food called fufu. The root can also be made into flour and tapioca. Even the leaves can be eaten as a vegetable. Manioc is easy to grow and needs little care.
Barcode\n\nA barcode is a way to put numbers on things so a computer can read them. The first barcodes used black lines and white spaces. A machine called a scanner shines a light on the barcode and reads the lines. Barcodes are on almost everything you buy at the store. The first thing with a barcode was a pack of gum in 1974. There are also square barcodes called QR codes. You can scan a QR code with a phone to go to a website or see a special message. Barcodes help stores know what you are buying and how much it costs.
Association football\n\nAssociation football is a sport played by two teams. Each team has 11 players. One player is the goalkeeper, who can touch the ball with hands. The other players try to kick the ball into the other team's goal. The team that scores more goals wins. The game lasts 90 minutes with a break in the middle. People all over the world love to play and watch this sport. It is also called soccer in some countries.
Division (mathematics)\n\nDivision is a way to share things equally. If you have 6 cookies and 3 friends, division tells you each friend gets 2 cookies. The number you share is called the dividend, the number you share with is the divisor, and the answer is the quotient. Sometimes there are leftovers, called the remainder. Division is the opposite of multiplication. You can write division with a slash (/) or a line between the numbers. You cannot divide by zero because it does not make sense.
Arcturus\n\nArcturus is a big, bright star in the sky. It is one of the brightest stars we can see at night. Arcturus is far away, but it is closer than many other stars. It is a red giant star, which means it is very big and red. Arcturus is older than our Sun and will keep growing bigger.
Brazil\n\nBrazil is a big country in South America. It is the fifth biggest country in the world. Many people live there, about 212 million. The capital city is Brasília. People in Brazil speak Portuguese, which is different from Spanish. Brazil has the biggest rainforest in the world, called the Amazon Rainforest. The Amazon River flows through Brazil. It is the second longest river in the world. Brazil is known for soccer and has held big sports events like the World Cup and the Summer Olympics. The name Brazil comes from a tree called brazilwood.
Tropic of Cancer\n\nThe Tropic of Cancer is an imaginary line around the middle of the Earth. It is north of the middle line called the Equator. Once a year, in June, the sun shines straight down on this line. North of this line, the sun never shines straight down.
Hay\n\nHay is grass and other plants that people cut, dry, and collect. It is stored in piles called haystacks or tied into blocks called bales. Bales can be round or square. Hay is food for animals like horses, cows, goats, donkeys, and rabbits. Farmers give hay to animals in winter when there is no fresh grass to eat. Hay is different from straw. Hay is made from leafy plants and is good for animals to eat. Straw comes from grain stems and is used for animal bedding.
Pop art\n\nPop art is a kind of art that started a long time ago, in the 1950s and 1960s. Artists like Andy Warhol and Roy Lichtenstein made pop art. They used pictures from things people see every day, like ads in magazines, comic books, and food boxes. Pop art looks simple and bright, with bold black lines and flat colors, just like a comic book. The artists wanted to show that everyday things can be art too.
Hermes\n\nHermes is a god from old stories called Greek myths. He is the messenger of the gods. He helps travelers and shepherds. Hermes has a special stick with two snakes wrapped around it. He is very clever. On his first day, he made a musical instrument from a tortoise shell. He once took his brother's cows and burned them as a gift to the gods.
Activism\n\nActivism is when people work together to make something better or stop something bad. They might ask the government to change a rule or ask people to do things differently. Sometimes activists hold big meetings, walk in the street together, or stop working to show they care. Some activists make art on walls to share their message. That is called artivism.
Gun dog\n\nA gun dog is a kind of dog that helps people who hunt. These dogs find birds and other animals for the hunter. Some gun dogs point their nose at the animal to show where it is. Some gun dogs scare the animal out of its hiding spot. Other gun dogs bring back the animal after it is caught. Popular gun dogs are spaniels, golden retrievers, and labradors.
Ice shelf\n\nAn ice shelf is a big, flat piece of ice. It is like a giant frozen platform. An ice shelf forms where a big river of ice called a glacier meets the ocean. Some ice shelves float on top of the water. The biggest ice shelves are in a very cold place called Antarctica. They are very thick and can be as tall as a building.
Vicua\n\nA vicuña is a small wild animal that lives in the mountains of South America. It has soft, wooly fur that is light brown or reddish on top and white on its belly and legs. Its neck and legs are long and skinny, and its ears are small and pointy. The vicuña eats tough grass, and its front teeth keep growing all the time. It lives high up in the Andes mountains in countries like Peru, Bolivia, Argentina, and Chile.
Zoology\n\nZoology is the study of animals. Scientists who study animals are called zoologists. They learn about how animals look, how they live, and where they come from. Zoologists work in zoos, museums, and schools. They watch animals to see what they do. They also look at old bones to learn about animals that lived long ago.
Prescription\n\nA prescription is a note from a doctor. It tells you what medicine to take. Some medicines are very strong and you can only get them with a prescription. You cannot buy them at a store like candy. The doctor can send the prescription to the pharmacy by computer now. That is faster and helps stop mistakes. It is important to ask the pharmacist or read the paper that comes with the medicine to learn about it.
Lisbon\n\nLisbon is a big city in Portugal. It is the capital city, which means it is the most important city in the country. Many people live there. Lisbon sits next to a big river called the Tagus River. The weather is nice and sunny most of the year. There are pretty beaches close to the city. You can ride yellow trams that go up and down the hills. The trams are old and fun to ride. There are also trains under the ground called the Metro. Lisbon has many old buildings and places to see.
Duck\n\nA duck is a bird that lives in water. Ducks have short necks and are smaller than swans and geese. They can be black, brown, or gray. A baby duck is called a duckling, and a male duck is called a drake. Ducks eat plants and tiny animals from the water. They use their beak to strain food from the water. Many ducks fly to warm places in winter. People sometimes keep ducks as pets or for their eggs and meat.
Clone\n\nA clone is a living thing that is exactly the same as another living thing. Some animals can make clones by themselves. People can also make clones in a lab. The first animal clone was a sheep named Dolly. Human twins that look the same are natural clones. Even though clones start out the same, they can change a little as they grow up.
Barbados\n\nBarbados is an island country in the Atlantic Ocean. Its capital city is Bridgetown. People there speak English. Many tourists visit Barbados every year because it has beautiful beaches with clear water. The island is outside the main hurricane belt. Barbados makes rum. Cricket is the national sport, and famous players like Sir Garfield Sobers come from there. The singer Rihanna is also from Barbados. The country became a republic in 2021, which means it no longer has a king or queen as its leader.
Pond\n\nA pond is a small body of water that is smaller than a lake. Many animals live in or near a pond, such as ducks, turtles, swans, small fish, and frogs. In most ponds, sunlight can reach the bottom. Some ponds do not last all year long and are called temporary ponds. These ponds do not have fish. Some ponds are getting dirty because of people. Unlike rivers, ponds stay in one place and do not flow.
Skill\n\nA skill is something you learn to do well. You get better at a skill by practicing a lot. Some skills use your body, like kicking a ball or drawing a picture. Other skills use your brain, like counting or remembering things. When you first learn a skill, you might make mistakes. But if you keep trying, you get faster and better. After a lot of practice, you can do the skill without thinking hard. People who are very good at something, like a soccer player or a piano player, practice on purpose to get better. They work on the parts that are hard for them. Skills can be used in different places, like at school or at home. Some skills are easy to use in new ways, but others are not. Teachers help you learn new skills so you can do many things well.
Ethics\n\nEthics is about learning what is good and what is bad. It helps people decide how to act. Most people think that hurting others is bad. Ethics also helps us think about how to be fair to each other. Many countries make rules based on these ideas.
Skull\n\nA skull is the set of bones that make up your head. It holds your face in place and keeps your brain safe inside. The skull also keeps your eyes and ears at the right distance so you can see and hear well. In some animals, the skull has horns on top. The human skull is made of many flat bones that are joined together. An adult has 28 bones in the skull.
Leviathan\n\nLeviathan is a very big sea monster from old stories. In the Bible, it is a huge creature that lives in the water. Some people think of it as a giant whale. The word 'Leviathan' now means any large animal that lives in the ocean.
Cream\n\nCream is the thick, fatty part of milk. It is yellow-white and tastes rich. People put cream in coffee to make it taste softer. Cream can also be used to make yummy sauces for pasta. When you shake cream for a long time, it turns into butter.
Songbird\n\nA songbird is a kind of bird that can sing beautiful songs. There are many different kinds of songbirds all over the world. They use their songs to tell other birds where they are and to find a friend. Some songbirds sing more songs than others, and girl birds like the ones that sing the most. Songbirds also make short sounds to warn about danger or to keep in touch with their family. Most birds can make sounds, but only songbirds can sing long, pretty songs.
Berry\n\nA berry is a small, soft fruit that you can eat. Many berries are sweet and bright in color. They have tiny seeds inside. Some berries are red, blue, or purple. You can eat berries like strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries. Birds and other animals like to eat berries too. That helps the seeds spread to new places so new plants can grow.
Acrobatics\n\nAcrobatics is a way of moving your body in special ways. A person who does acrobatics is called an acrobat. Acrobats can do flips, handstands, and other tricks. They need to be very strong and balanced. Long ago, people in Egypt, Greece, Rome, and China did acrobatics. Later, acrobats performed in circuses. Today, acrobatics is also a sport where people compete.
Tessellation\n\nA tessellation is when you put shapes next to each other over and over with no empty spaces and no shapes on top of each other. It is like a puzzle where the pieces fit together perfectly. You can make tessellations with triangles, squares, and hexagons. Bees use hexagons to build their honeycombs. People have used tessellations to decorate buildings for a very long time. The artist M.C. Escher made beautiful pictures with tessellations.
Lava\n\nLava is very hot, melted rock that comes out of a volcano. It flows like thick, gooey syrup. Some lava is thick and moves slowly, like blocky lava that makes piles of sharp rocks. Other lava is thin and flows faster, like pahoehoe, which looks like twisted rope. Aa lava has a rough, spiky surface. When lava goes into the water, it makes round lumps called pillow lava. Lava can be so hot that it sets things on fire. Sometimes it even covers houses and roads.
Tajikistan\n\nTajikistan is a country in Central Asia. It is a republic, which means people vote for their leaders. The capital city is Dushanbe. The people there speak Tajik. Tajikistan is landlocked, which means it has no ocean next to it. It is very mountainous, with high mountains and river valleys. The summers are hot and the winters are mild. Long ago, Tajikistan was part of the Soviet Union. It became its own country in 1991.
Superhero\n\nA superhero is a make-believe person who helps people and fights bad guys. Many superheroes have special powers like being very strong, fast, or able to see far away. They wear colorful clothes and masks to hide who they are. Some superheroes, like Batman, do not have special powers but train very hard to be strong and smart. Superheroes keep their faces hidden so bad guys cannot hurt their families. Many superheroes became heroes because something sad happened to them, and they wanted to stop bad things from happening to others.
Dead reckoning\n\nDead reckoning is a way to guess where you are. It uses the last place you knew for sure, plus how fast and which way you moved. Long ago, sailors used dead reckoning to cross the ocean. They threw a log tied to a rope over the side of the ship to find how fast they were going. A compass told them which way they were going. The wind and water could push the ship off course, so they had to guess again. Today, people use GPS to know where they are. But dead reckoning is still taught to sailors and pilots in case GPS stops working.
Red deer\n\nA red deer is a big animal with antlers. It lives in many places like Europe, Asia, and Africa. Red deer eat grass and plants. They have brown fur and can run very fast. People sometimes eat the meat from red deer, which is called venison.
Five Pillars of Islam\n\nThe Five Pillars of Islam are five important rules that people who follow Islam must do. The first rule is to say that there is only one God and Muhammad is his messenger. The second rule is to pray five times every day. The third rule is to give money to help poor people. The fourth rule is to not eat or drink from sunrise to sunset during a special month called Ramadan. The fifth rule is to visit a special city called Mecca at least once in your life if you can.
Dolphin\n\nA dolphin is a mammal that lives in the ocean. It is not a fish. Dolphins breathe air, and their nose is on top of their head so they can breathe at the water's surface. They have smooth, gray skin that feels soft and rubbery. Dolphins live in groups called pods. They swim together, hunt together, and help each other stay safe. Dolphins eat fish and use sound to find their food. They can jump in and out of the water when they swim fast. Dolphins are very smart animals. Some dolphins live in rivers, but most live in the salty ocean.
Debt\n\nDebt is when you owe something to someone else. Usually it is money, but it can also be things or help. If you borrow a toy from a friend, you owe that toy back. That is a debt. People and companies use debt to buy big things they cannot pay for all at once, like a house or a car. If you do not pay back a debt, the person you owe can take something you own, like a car. Some debts are safe because you promise something, and some are not safe. Credit cards are a way to borrow money, but you must pay it back later.
Venice\n\nVenice is a city in Italy that is built on many small islands. Instead of roads, it has canals, which are like water streets. People ride boats to get around. The most famous boat is called a gondola. Venice has many old buildings and bridges. The Rialto Bridge is a famous stone bridge with shops on it. Every year, the city sinks a little bit because the ground is soft mud. Sometimes water floods the streets. Many tourists visit Venice to see the canals and the pretty buildings.
Socialism\n\nSocialism is a way for people to share big things like factories and tools together. In socialism, the workers who make things also own them, not just one rich person. People who like socialism think everyone should have food, a place to live, and a doctor when they are sick. Some people want to get socialism by voting, and some think they have to take it by force. Not everyone agrees with socialism. Some people think it is better when each person owns their own things. There are many kinds of socialism, like democratic socialism and social democracy.
Pork\n\nPork is meat that comes from pigs. People eat pork in many places around the world. Some foods made from pork are sausages, bacon, and ham. You can cook pork in different ways for a meal.
Air pollution\n\nAir pollution is dirty air that is not good to breathe. It comes from smoke, car fumes, and other bad gases. Big cities often have dirty air. Smoke from fires and cars makes the air dirty. Some air pollution comes from nature, like dust and ash from volcanoes. But people also make a lot of air pollution. Cars and factories make smoke that goes into the air. This dirty air can make people sick, especially kids and old people. It can also hurt trees, animals, and fish. Rain can mix with dirty air and become acid rain, which hurts plants and buildings. The air inside homes can also be dirty from paint, carpets, and new furniture. People are working to make the air cleaner.
Bird\n\nA bird is an animal with feathers, wings, and a beak. Birds have two legs and lay eggs with hard shells. They are warm-blooded, which means their body stays warm inside. Birds live all over the world. Some birds are very small, like the bee hummingbird, and some are very big, like the ostrich. Most birds can fly, but some, like penguins, cannot. Birds use their wings to fly and their feathers to stay warm and dry. Many birds sing songs to talk to each other. Birds build nests to lay their eggs and take care of their babies. Some birds are brown or green to hide from danger, while others have bright colors to show off. People keep some birds as pets, and we get eggs and meat from others.
Agricultural science\n\nAgricultural science is about learning how to grow food for people to eat. People who study this are called agricultural scientists. They help farmers grow big, healthy plants and take care of animals on farms. This science helps us have enough fruits, vegetables, and grains to eat every day.
Telecommunication\n\nTelecommunication is how people send messages far away. Long ago, people used smoke, drums, or flags to talk to each other from far away. Now we use telephones, radios, and computers to send messages. A telephone lets you talk to someone in another house. A radio sends music and news through the air. A computer can send pictures and words very fast. All these things help people stay in touch even when they are not close.
Probability\n\nProbability is about chance. It helps us guess if something might happen or not. For example, when you flip a coin, it can land on heads or tails. The chance of getting heads is one out of two. When you roll a dice, the chance of getting a 1 is one out of six. To find the chance of two things both happening, you multiply their chances together. Probability uses math to figure out how likely things are.
Holstein Friesian\n\nA Holstein Friesian is a kind of cow. It has black and white spots on its body. This cow comes from the Netherlands and Germany. It is big and heavy, like a small car. A baby Holstein Friesian is called a calf. The cow gives a lot of milk every day. People use the milk to make cheese and yogurt. You can see these cows in many fields eating grass.
Carbon\n\nCarbon is a very important thing that all living things need. It is a kind of stuff that is not metal. Carbon is in your body, and it is in plants and animals. Carbon can be hard like a diamond or soft like the gray part of a pencil. Diamonds are the hardest rocks. The gray part of a pencil is called graphite, and it is very soft. Carbon is also in coal, which we burn for heat. Carbon makes long chains that become plastic and the stuff in food. Carbon is everywhere: in the air, in the ground, and in you.
Javelin\n\nA javelin is a long, light stick that looks like a spear. Long ago, people used it as a weapon. Today, people throw it for sport. In the javelin throw, a runner holds the javelin in one hand and throws it as far as they can while running. It is an event in the Olympic Games.
Bleeding\n\nBleeding is when blood comes out of your body. It can happen if you get a cut on your skin. Sometimes bleeding happens inside your body, and you cannot see it. A little bleeding is okay, like when you get a small scrape. But if you lose too much blood, it can be very bad. Your body needs blood to stay healthy.
Honshū\n\nHonshū is a big piece of land in Japan. It is the biggest island of Japan. Many people live there. It is the main island where big cities are. Other islands are near it.
Wife\n\nA wife is a woman who is married. Married means two people are joined together by law. When a woman gets married, she is called a bride. Some men have one wife, and some men can have more than one wife. A queen is a wife of a king.
Riddle\n\nA riddle is a fun question or a tricky saying. You have to think hard to find the answer. The answer is not always easy to guess. Riddles make you use your brain in a clever way. People tell riddles to each other for fun.
Frostbite\n\nFrostbite is when very cold weather hurts your skin. It happens most often on toes, fingers, nose, and ears. The skin gets very cold and can turn white or gray. It hurts a lot. If you get frostbite, you need a grown-up to help you get warm right away.
United Arab Emirates\n\nThe United Arab Emirates is a country in Asia. It is next to Oman, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia. The capital is Abu Dhabi, and the biggest city is Dubai. In Dubai there is the Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world. The country has seven parts called emirates. Each emirate is ruled by a leader. The United Arab Emirates has a lot of oil and gas. Many people from all over the world live there. The country has mountains, flat land, red sand dunes, and an oasis with palm trees. In 2021, the United Arab Emirates sent a spaceship to Mars. It was the first Arab country to do that.
Kingdom of England\n\nThe Kingdom of England was a country in Europe. It was on the southern part of a big island called Great Britain. Long ago, many small groups of people lived there. Later, one king named Egbert became the first king of all England. The kingdom ended when it joined with Scotland to make a new country called the Kingdom of Great Britain.
Constellation\n\nA constellation is a group of stars that look like a picture in the night sky. The stars are very far away, but when you look up, they seem to make shapes like animals, people, or things. Long ago, people gave names to these star pictures. Some constellations are named after stories from long ago, like Orion the hunter or the big bear called Ursa Major. There are 88 constellations that scientists use today. Some of them are part of a special group called the Zodiac. The Sun moves through the Zodiac once every year.
Celebrity\n\nA celebrity is a person that many people know. They get a lot of attention from others. Most celebrities are famous because they act in movies, sing songs, or play sports. Some celebrities are famous just because their family is famous. People see celebrities on TV, in movies, and on the internet. Many people like to watch what celebrities do.
Kosher\n\nKosher is a word for the special food rules that Jewish people follow. Some foods are okay to eat, and some are not. Meat and milk cannot be eaten together in the same meal. Fish, fruits, and vegetables can be eaten with either meat or milk. Jewish people who keep kosher use separate plates and forks for meat and milk. Some animals, like pigs, are not allowed to be eaten at all. Animals that are okay to eat must be killed in a careful way by a special person.
Kyiv\n\nKyiv is a big city and the capital of Ukraine. It sits on a big river called the Dnipro. More than three million people live there. Kyiv is not part of any state, but it is the main place for the state around it. The city had a big soccer game in 2012 and a song contest in 2017. The weather in Kyiv is cold in winter and warm in summer.
Adder\n\nAn adder is a snake that lives in many parts of Europe and Asia. It is the only snake with poison in the British Isles. Adders are not mean and only bite if they are scared. Their bite hurts a lot but almost never kills people. Adders grow to be about as long as a big ruler. Girls are brown with dark spots, and boys are gray with black spots. Some adders are all black. They eat small animals like mice, frogs, and baby birds. In the United Kingdom, it is against the law to hurt an adder.
Contract\n\nA contract is a promise that people make to each other. Sometimes the promise is written down and signed. For example, when someone gets a job, they might sign a contract that says what they will do and how much money they will get. If someone breaks the promise, a judge can help fix it.
Royal National Park\n\nThe Royal National Park is a big park in Australia, near the city of Sydney. It is one of the oldest national parks in the world. The park has many different kinds of land: hills made of sandstone, forests with eucalyptus trees, a river that runs through it, and beaches by the ocean. Some parts of the park have picnic tables and places to cook food. You can get to the park by car from three different roads. You need to pay a small fee to go into the park.
Intensive farming\n\nIntensive farming is a way of growing food where people use a lot of machines and chemicals to get more food from the same piece of land. Farmers use strong sprays to kill bugs and medicine to keep animals healthy. This is different from old-style farming, which uses more people and less machines. Intensive farming started a long time ago when people invented machines like tractors and harvesters. These machines help one farmer take care of a very big farm. Farmers also use special food for plants called fertilizer to make them grow bigger. Some people do not like intensive farming because it can make animals sad and dirty the water. That is why some people buy food that is grown without these strong chemicals.
Hammer\n\nA hammer is a tool you use to hit nails into wood. It has a long handle and a flat end for hitting. Some hammers have a curved end to pull nails out. A big hammer called a sledgehammer is swung with two hands. People have used hammers for a very long time, even millions of years ago. The first hammers were just stones. Later, people tied stones to sticks to make handles. Hammers help with building things and fixing things.
Vinegar\n\nVinegar is a sour liquid that people use in cooking. It is made from things like wine or apple juice that have turned a little bit sour. The sour taste comes from a special part called acid. People put vinegar on salad, fish, french fries, and vegetables like pickles. There are many kinds of vinegar, such as balsamic, red wine, and apple cider vinegar.
Glasgow\n\nGlasgow is the biggest city in Scotland. It sits next to a big river called the River Clyde. People who live there are called Glaswegians. Many people visit Glasgow from other countries like France and America. The city has two airports and two big train stations. There are many theaters and concert halls where people watch shows. Football is very popular in Glasgow. The two biggest teams are Celtic and Rangers. The weather changes a lot, and mornings are often damp and misty. In summer, people stay in Glasgow and travel to see pretty lakes and islands.
International trade\n\nInternational trade is when countries buy things from each other or sell things to each other. One country might send toys to another country, and that other country might send fruit back. Sometimes countries put up walls to stop trade, like making things very expensive to buy from other countries. Other times, countries agree to trade freely without those walls. This helps people get things they need from far away.
Indian Ocean\n\nThe Indian Ocean is a very big body of water. It is the third biggest ocean in the world. It touches Asia, Africa, Australia, and other oceans. The ocean is named after India, a country that sticks out into it. Parts of the Indian Ocean are the Bay of Bengal, the Arabian Sea, the Persian Gulf, and the Red Sea. The deepest part is near some islands called the Sunda Islands. Most of the ocean is in the southern half of the world.
New York City Subway\n\nThe New York City Subway is a train system in New York City. It is one of the biggest train systems in the world, with 472 stations. The trains run all day and all night, every day of the year. They only closed a few times, like during a big storm. Some trains go above ground on tracks in the air, and some go underground in tunnels. People use the subway to go to school, work, and other places. You have to pay money to ride. You can buy a card from a machine to get on the train. The subway has many different train lines, each with a letter or number. Some trains stop at every station, and some skip some stations to go faster. Many stations have art on the walls. Sometimes people play music in the stations. The subway is a fast way to travel around the big city.
Siberia\n\nSiberia is a very big, very cold part of Russia. It is in Asia, not Europe. Siberia covers almost all of Russia, but not many people live there because it is so cold. The Yenisei river splits Siberia into two parts: east and west. Most people in Siberia live in big cities like Novosibirsk, Omsk, and Krasnoyarsk. Many different kinds of people live in Siberia, including some who came from Europe a long time ago.
Southern Ocean\n\nThe Southern Ocean is the big water that goes all around the very cold continent of Antarctica. It is one of the biggest oceans on Earth. The water is very cold and full of ice. Many whales and penguins live there.
History of writing\n\nWriting is a way to keep words so you can see them later. Long ago, people did not have writing. They drew pictures on rocks and caves to tell stories. Later, people made marks on clay and paper. Writing helps us remember things and share ideas with people far away. Today, we use letters and numbers to write.
Glacier\n\nA glacier is a very big, thick piece of ice and snow. It forms in cold places where snow does not melt all summer. Each winter, more snow falls on top. The snow gets so heavy that the bottom turns into ice. After many years, the ice becomes so big and heavy that it starts to move, very, very slowly, like a river of ice. Glaciers are blue because water soaks up most colors of light, but blue light can get out. Glaciers hold a lot of fresh water. They can change the shape of mountains as they move. Lately, many glaciers are melting because the Earth is getting warmer.
Tropical rainforest\n\nA tropical rainforest is a forest that gets a lot of rain. It is warm all year round, like a greenhouse. The biggest rainforest is the Amazon in Brazil. More than half of all plants and animals in the world live in the rainforest. Many medicines come from rainforest plants. The rainforest has five layers. The top layer is the emergent layer, where tall trees reach up high and birds like eagles and parrots fly. Below that is the canopy, which is like a big green roof. Monkeys, birds, and insects live there and never touch the ground. The understory is dark and humid, with bushes and ferns. The shrub layer has many orchids. The forest floor is dark and open, with snakes, jaguars, and ants. Some plants called air plants grow on trees and collect water from rain. Frogs lay eggs in the water pools of air plants. Many colorful birds and monkeys live in the trees. The rainforest is full of life.
Green politics\n\nGreen politics is a way of thinking about how people should take care of the Earth. People who follow green politics want to keep the air, water, and land clean. They think we should use less energy and protect animals and plants. Green parties are groups of people who work together to make these ideas happen. They started becoming popular in the 1970s.
Figure skating\n\nFigure skating is a sport where people skate on ice and do jumps and spins. They skate to music. Sometimes one person skates alone, and sometimes two people skate together. In pairs skating, the man can lift the woman in the air. In ice dancing, they hold each other and dance. There are also big groups that skate together. Figure skating is in the Winter Olympics. Skaters wear special boots with blades on the bottom so they can slide on the ice.
Giant star\n\nA giant star is a very big star in space. It is much bigger and brighter than our Sun. Some giant stars are red, some are yellow, and some are blue. They do not live as long as smaller stars. The biggest giant stars are called supergiants.
Forecasting\n\nForecasting is when people study things and try to guess what will happen next. It is like making a smart guess about the future. People use forecasting to tell if it will rain tomorrow. They look at clouds and wind to make their guess. Sometimes they are right, and sometimes they are wrong. That is okay because nobody knows the future for sure.
Celery\n\nCelery is a vegetable that you can eat. It is long and green, like a stick. People often put celery in salad. It is crunchy and makes a snapping sound when you bite it.
Lesson\n\nA lesson is a time when you learn something new. In school, a teacher gives a lesson to help you understand a subject. Lessons can happen in a classroom, outside, or on a computer. Sometimes you learn a lesson by accident, like when you touch something hot and learn not to do it again. A lesson can be fun, too, like when you play a game that teaches you something.
Beach\n\nA beach is a place where the land meets the water of an ocean, sea, lake, or river. It is covered with tiny bits of sand, small stones, or pebbles. People love to go to the beach to swim, play in the sand, and lie in the sun. Some beaches have warm water and soft white sand. You can also see boats at the beach. Beaches change over time as the water moves the sand around.
Book\n\nA book is a set of paper pages held together between two covers. The pages have words and sometimes pictures. A person who writes a book is called an author. Someone who draws the pictures is called an illustrator. Some books are stories that are made up, like fairy tales. Other books tell true facts, like a book about animals or a cookbook. Books can be borrowed from a library or bought from a store. Some books are hard and have a cover made of cardboard. Other books have a soft paper cover. A small book is called a booklet. People can also make their own books with drawings and photos.
Tamil language\n\nTamil is a language that people speak in India and Sri Lanka. Many people in Singapore and Malaysia also speak it. Tamil has its own special letters that look different from English letters. There are 247 letters in the Tamil alphabet. People write Tamil from left to right, just like English. Tamil is a very old language, and people have been writing stories and poems in it for a very long time.
Drainage basin\n\nA drainage basin is a big piece of land. All the rain that falls on that land goes into one river. Some rivers are very big and collect water from a huge area. The water comes from the sky and then flows away in the river.
Novel\n\nA novel is a book that tells one long story. It is longer than a short story. Novels have many pages, usually 100 or more. There are many kinds of novels. Some are adventure stories, like "Treasure Island." Some are scary stories, like "Frankenstein." Others are funny stories, like "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer." The first novels were written more than 300 years ago.
Gardenia\n\nA gardenia is a plant with pretty white or light yellow flowers. The flowers smell very sweet and nice. Gardenia plants have shiny dark green leaves that feel like leather. They grow in warm places like Africa and Asia. Gardenias like a lot of water in the air. Some people grow them in their gardens or in pots.
Breadfruit\n\nBreadfruit is a fruit that grows on a big tree. The tree is always green and comes from the mulberry family. Breadfruit looks like a big green ball and feels a little bumpy on the outside. Inside, it is soft and starchy, like a potato. People can cook breadfruit or grind it into flour to make bread.
