The tree grows in warm places like islands and near the ocean. Long ago, people took breadfruit trees on boats to new islands so they could have food to eat.
Seattle\n\nSeattle is a big city in the state of Washington. It sits near water, with a big lake on one side and the ocean on the other. Many people live there. Seattle has a tall tower called the Space Needle that you can ride up to see the whole city. It also has a train that runs on one rail. Big companies like Microsoft and Starbucks started there. People in Seattle like to watch sports teams like the Seahawks and the Mariners. The city is also home to the University of Washington.
Greek mythology\n\nGreek mythology is a big set of stories from a long time ago in a place called Greece. The stories tell about gods and goddesses who are very powerful and never die. They live on top of a tall mountain called Mount Olympus. The king of the gods is Zeus, who rules the sky. There are also heroes, monsters, and adventures in these stories. One monster is a minotaur, which is half man and half bull. The Greeks believed the sun was a chariot driven by the god Apollo across the sky every day.
Gasoline\n\nGasoline is a clear liquid that cars and other machines use to run. It is made from oil that comes from deep underground. Gasoline is very dangerous because it can catch fire easily. You should never drink it or get it on your skin. Cars need gasoline to go, and you can buy it at a gas station. Some machines like lawnmowers and small boats also use gasoline. Gasoline makes a car's engine go vroom-vroom.
True bug\n\nA true bug is a kind of insect. There are many different kinds of true bugs, like aphids, cicadas, and shield bugs. True bugs are very small or a little big, from 1 millimeter to over 10 centimeters. They have a long, tube-like mouth that they use to suck up plant sap. They cannot chew their food. Most true bugs have front wings that are half hard and half soft. Their back wings are all soft and shorter than the front ones. True bugs have antennae with five parts and feet with three or fewer parts.
Yak (disambiguation)\n\nA yak is a big animal with long hair. It is a kind of cow. There are two kinds of yak. Yaks live in cold, high places.
Zimbabwe\n\nZimbabwe is a country in Africa. It is far from the ocean, so it has no beaches. The capital city is Harare. Zimbabwe has a big waterfall called Victoria Falls. Long ago, the country was ruled by Britain. Now people vote for their leaders. The people speak many languages, like Shona and Ndebele. Many animals live there, like lions, elephants, and zebras. Soccer is the most popular sport.
Tundra\n\nTundra is a very cold place on Earth where trees cannot grow. The ground is frozen most of the year. Only small plants like grass, moss, and lichens live there. Some animals live in the tundra, like arctic foxes, caribou, and snowy owls. These animals have thick fur to stay warm. In winter, the snow is deep and cold, so some animals sleep through the winter.
Dove\n\nA dove is a kind of bird. Doves are usually small and have soft feathers. They can be white, gray, or brown. Doves make nests out of sticks. The mother and father dove both sit on the eggs to keep them warm. Baby doves drink a special milk that comes from the parent's throat. Doves eat seeds, fruit, and plants. You can see doves in many places around the world, like parks and cities. Some people think doves are a sign of peace.
Cheque\n\nA cheque is a special piece of paper that lets you give money to someone else. When you write a cheque, you promise to pay that person. The person who gets the cheque can take it to a bank and get the money. A cheque must have the name of the person or business you are paying. It also needs the amount of money written in numbers and in words. The person writing the cheque must sign it. A cheque has a date on it. If the date is in the future, the bank will not give the money until that day comes. Each cheque has its own number so no one can use it twice. People have used cheques for a very long time, even more than a thousand years.
Qatar\n\nQatar is a small country in Asia. It sits on a piece of land that sticks out into the water. It is next to Saudi Arabia and near the Persian Gulf. Many people live in Qatar, but most of them come from other countries to work. Qatar has a lot of natural gas and oil, so it is very rich. The weather is hot and dry. The ruler of Qatar is called an emir. In 2022, Qatar hosted the FIFA World Cup, which is a big soccer party where many countries play games. People in Qatar speak Arabic. The country has big cities with tall buildings and nice beaches.
Drink\n\nA drink is a liquid you can put in your mouth and swallow. People drink water, milk, juice, and tea. All drinks have water in them. Every living thing needs water to stay alive. If you do not drink enough water, you can get very sick. Plants take water from the ground through their roots. Most animals drink water too. Some places, like deserts, have very little water. A place in the desert that has water is called an oasis.
Berlin\n\nBerlin is a big city in Germany. It is the capital city, which means the country's leaders work there. Many people live in Berlin, about as many as in a very large town. The city has rivers and lakes, and lots of trees. There are famous old buildings like the Brandenburg Gate. Long ago, a wall split the city into two parts. People could not cross from one side to the other. In 1989, the wall came down and the city became one again. Today, Berlin has many people from different countries. There are many schools, museums, and places to eat. People enjoy visiting Berlin to see its sights and have fun.
Sydney\n\nSydney is a big city in Australia, on the east coast. It is the biggest city in Australia. Many people live there. Sydney has a big harbour and many beaches. The most famous beach is Bondi Beach. There are famous buildings like the Sydney Opera House and the Sydney Harbour Bridge. You can see animals at Taronga Zoo. Every year in May and June, there is Vivid Sydney with pretty lights and music. In March or April, there is the Royal Easter Show with rides and farm animals. Sydney has warm summers and cool winters. It rains a lot in some months. The sun can be very strong in summer.
Japanese language\n\nJapanese is the language people speak in Japan, a country in East Asia. It uses three ways of writing: hiragana, katakana, and kanji. Hiragana and katakana show how to say the words, and kanji shows what the words mean. In Japanese, the verb comes at the end of the sentence. The words can change by adding small parts to the end. Many English words, like "ice cream," are now used in Japanese. Japan is called "Nihon," which means "sun-origin," so it is called the Land of the Rising Sun.
Nervous system\n\nThe nervous system is a part of your body that sends messages all around. It helps you feel things, move, and think. The brain and the spinal cord are the main parts. The brain has many tiny cells that help you walk, breathe, and play. When you touch something hot, the nervous system tells your hand to pull away very fast. It works in less than a blink of an eye.
Space\n\nSpace is the big area above the sky. It is very far away, and there is no air there. The stars, the moon, and the sun are all in space. Space is very dark and very cold. Astronauts go to space in rockets to learn about it.
Desert\n\nA desert is a very dry place where it almost never rains. Deserts can be hot during the day and cold at night. Some deserts are covered with sand, and others have rocks or snow. The biggest hot desert is the Sahara in Africa. Some animals live in deserts, like lizards, snakes, and camels. Camels store water in their humps. Plants like cactus store water in their thick stems. Sometimes wind blows sand into big clouds called sandstorms.
Robin Hood\n\nRobin Hood is a hero from old stories in England. He lives in a big forest called Sherwood with his friends. Robin Hood takes money from bad people who are mean to the poor. Then he gives the money back to the poor people. He is very good at shooting a bow and arrow. His friends are called the Merry Men. They help him do good things. Many movies and cartoons tell stories about Robin Hood.
Assembly line\n\nAn assembly line is a way to make things fast. Many workers and machines each do one small job. They add parts one after another to build a whole thing, like a car. Long ago, one person made the whole thing by hand. That took a very long time. With an assembly line, many things can be made much faster. Henry Ford used an assembly line to make cars. His cars became cheaper, so more people could buy them. The workers also got more money. The idea of an assembly line is very old. Even the clay soldiers in China, called the Terracotta Army, were made by putting together parts that were made separately.
Precipitation\n\nPrecipitation is water that falls from the sky. It can be rain, snow, sleet, or hail. Rain is water drops. Snow is soft and white. Hail is hard ice balls. A rain gauge can measure how much rain falls. Fog and mist are not precipitation because they stay in the air.
Middle age\n\nMiddle age is the time in life after being young and before being old. It starts when a person is about 40 years old and lasts until about 60 years old. People in middle age often have jobs and families. They may have more money than when they were younger, but they also spend money on their children. Some people feel sad or worried about getting older. Middle-aged people start to get wrinkles on their skin and gray hair. They may not be as strong or fast as before. Women in middle age stop being able to have babies.
Dwarf galaxy\n\nA dwarf galaxy is a small group of stars in space. It has only a few billion stars, which is much fewer than our own galaxy, the Milky Way. The Milky Way has hundreds of billions of stars. Some dwarf galaxies orbit bigger galaxies, like the Milky Way. The Milky Way has more than 20 dwarf galaxies going around it. Sometimes a dwarf galaxy gets pulled into a bigger galaxy and becomes part of it.
Soap opera\n\nA soap opera is a story on TV or the radio that goes on for a long time. Each day or week, a new part of the story is shown. The story can last for weeks, months, or even years. In America, soap operas are on every afternoon from Monday to Friday. In the U.K., they are on in the evening a few times a week. Some famous soap operas are about people who live in a town or a village. People watch them to see what happens to the characters next.
History of technology\n\nThe history of technology is about how people made tools and machines over a long, long time. Long ago, people learned to make fire and simple tools from stone. Later, they made wheels, boats, and clocks. Then came trains, cars, and airplanes that help us travel far. Now we have computers and phones that let us talk to people far away. Technology helps us do things we could not do with just our hands and feet.
History of medicine\n\nThe history of medicine is about how people learned to help sick people get better over a very long time. Long ago, people used plants to heal. In old times, doctors in different places wrote down what they knew. A man named Hippocrates was one of the first to describe sickness. Another man named Galen thought that four body liquids—blood, phlegm, yellow bile, and black bile—made people sick. Later, a doctor named William Harvey found out that blood moves around the body. A man named Antonie van Leeuwenhoek used a special tool called a microscope to see tiny living things. Doctors learned that washing hands stops germs from spreading. Louis Pasteur made shots that keep people from getting sick.
Human skeleton\n\nYour skeleton is the hard frame inside your body that holds you up. When you are born, you have about 300 bones. As you grow up, some bones join together, so an adult has 206 bones. The skeleton helps you stand, move, and run. It also protects soft parts inside you, like your brain and heart. Your bones make blood cells and store minerals. Boys and girls have skeletons that are mostly the same, but a girl's hips are wider to help her have a baby someday.
Wetland\n\nA wetland is a place that is part land and part water. It is like a big, wet, muddy area. Many different plants, animals, and bugs live in wetlands because there is both wet and dry ground. Some wetlands are very special, and people work to keep them safe.
Uterus\n\nThe uterus is a part inside a woman's body. It is shaped like a pear. A baby grows inside the uterus for nine months before it is born. The uterus has a soft lining that gives food to the baby. Every month, the lining comes out as blood. This is called a period. The uterus is a strong muscle. When it is time for a baby to be born, the uterus pushes the baby out. The uterus changes size. It starts small and grows big when a baby is inside. After a baby is born, the uterus gets small again.
Infection\n\nAn infection is when tiny germs get inside your body and make you sick. These germs can be very small things like bacteria or viruses. They get in through your nose, mouth, or a cut on your skin. Once inside, they make more of themselves and can give you a fever, a cough, or a tummy ache. Some infections spread from one person to another when you cough, sneeze, or touch someone. You can help stop infections by washing your hands with soap and water. Doctors have special medicines that kill some germs, but not all. Some sicknesses, like a cold, go away by themselves. Shots from the doctor can also keep you from getting some infections.
Oil refinery\n\nAn oil refinery is a big factory where oil from the ground is turned into things we use every day. The factory heats the oil until it separates into different parts. Some parts become gas for cars, some become fuel for trucks and buses, and some become oil to heat houses. Other parts are used to make roads and to cook food. The refinery has many tall pipes and towers that help make these useful products.
Granite\n\nGranite is a hard rock that comes from deep inside the Earth. It is made when hot, melted rock cools very slowly under the ground. Granite can be gray, brown, or even pink. It has tiny sparkly bits in it that you can see when it is cut and polished. People use granite to make kitchen counters and buildings because it is strong and does not get hurt by water.
Japanese writing system\n\nJapanese writing is made of three kinds of letters. Hiragana is for Japanese words. Katakana is for words that came from other countries. Kanji are picture letters that came from China a long time ago. People in Japan use all three together to write.
Atoll\n\nAn atoll is a kind of island that looks like a doughnut. It is made from coral, which is a hard rock-like thing that tiny sea animals build. Long ago, a volcano stood in the ocean. Coral grew around it. Over many years, the volcano sank down into the water. The coral kept growing up toward the sun. In the end, only the coral ring was left, with a round pool of water in the middle. Most atolls are in warm oceans like the Pacific Ocean and the Indian Ocean. Some countries are made of atolls.
Water\n\nWater is a clear liquid that has no taste or smell. All living things need water to stay alive. You can drink water, wash with water, and play in water. Water comes in three forms: solid ice, liquid water, and gas you cannot see. Most of Earth is covered with water, but most of that is salty ocean water we cannot drink. Only a little bit of water is fresh and can be used by people. Water is always moving in a cycle: it falls as rain, flows into rivers and oceans, and goes back up into the sky. Water can dissolve many things, which makes it very useful for cleaning and cooking. Ice floats because water gets bigger when it freezes. Many animals and plants live in water. People use water for farming, making electricity, and having fun like swimming and boating. Water is also found in space on other planets and moons.
Dead Sea\n\nThe Dead Sea is a lake in Asia. It is the lowest place on Earth. The water is very, very salty — almost nine times saltier than the ocean. Most animals and plants cannot live there because the water is too salty. That is why it is called the Dead Sea. But some tiny living things can still live in it. The water is so heavy with salt that people can float on top without trying. Many people visit the Dead Sea to float in the water.
Baroque\n\nBaroque is a way of making art, buildings, music, and dance that was used a long time ago in Europe. It uses lots of bright colors, big shapes, and fancy details to make things look exciting and surprising. People who made Baroque art wanted to show big feelings and make you say 'wow!' You can see Baroque in old churches, palaces, and paintings with lots of gold and moving figures.
Aerosol\n\nAn aerosol is tiny bits of stuff floating in the air. Smoke from a fire is an aerosol. Fog and mist are aerosols too. Some cans spray out an aerosol when you push a button. That spray can be wet or dry. You can see it in the air for a little while.
Vapor\n\nVapor is when tiny drops of water float in the air. You can see vapor when water gets hot, like when a pot boils on the stove. The white mist that comes out is called steam. Vapor is not the same as air you cannot see. It is a mix of water and air.
Cave painting\n\nCave paintings are pictures that people made a long, long time ago on the walls and ceilings of caves. Nobody knows for sure why they made them. Maybe they were part of special ceremonies, or maybe they were like signs or stories. Most of these old paintings show animals or people hunting. Some also show handprints. The people who made them used rocks and dirt to make colors like red, yellow, and black. They drew with sticks or their fingers. Many of these caves are in France and Spain. Some paintings are very hard to reach inside the cave. Today, we can still see them and wonder about the people who made them.
Guatemala City\n\nGuatemala City is a big city in Central America. It is the capital of the country called Guatemala. Many people live there. The city was built a long time ago after big earthquakes broke the old capital. People in Guatemala City buy and sell things at markets. There is a museum for children and a big street where people can walk. There is also an old palace where the government used to work.
Rabies\n\nRabies is a very bad sickness that can hurt animals and people. It comes from a tiny germ that gets into the body through a bite or scratch from a sick animal, like a dog or a bat. At first, a person feels fine, but later they can get a fever and feel scared of water. Their mouth might make foam. Almost everyone who gets rabies dies, but there is a shot that can stop it if you get it right after a bite. Dogs and cats can get a shot to keep them from getting rabies. You should stay away from wild animals that act strange.
Muskrat\n\nA muskrat is a small animal that lives in water. It looks like a big mouse with a long, flat tail. Muskrats live in marshes, lakes, and ponds. They build houses out of plants in the water. The only way in is under the water, so other animals cannot get them. Some muskrats dig holes in the ground near the water. Muskrats are very good at swimming but slow on land. They come from North America, but now they also live in Europe and Asia. Muskrats have special glands that make a strong smell, and that is how they got their name.
Inertia\n\nInertia is a big word that means things like to keep doing what they are already doing. If a toy is sitting still on the floor, it will stay still until someone pushes it or picks it up. If a ball is rolling, it will keep rolling in a straight line until something stops it, like a wall or your hand. That is why you have to push a swing to make it go, and why a car needs brakes to stop. Inertia is also called Newton's First Law.
Nineveh\n\nNineveh was a very old city next to a big river called the Tigris. It was the main city of a strong kingdom called Assyria. The city had a big wall made of stone and mud bricks. The wall was very long and had tall towers. People had to go through gates to get in or out of the city. The gates were like small forts with rooms inside. A long time ago, the city was broken and now only ruins are left. The ruins are near a city called Mosul in a country called Iraq.
Hindi\n\nHindi is a language that many people in India speak. It is one of the official languages of India. Almost half of the people in India talk in Hindi. Hindi uses a special way of writing called Devanagari. Hindi and Urdu are very similar, so people who speak one can understand the other. Many movies in India, called Bollywood movies, use Hindi words. People in other countries like Fiji, Nepal, and the United States also speak Hindi.
Switzerland\n\nSwitzerland is a country in Europe. It is in the middle of the continent. Next to Switzerland are Germany, Austria, Liechtenstein, Italy, and France. Switzerland has very tall mountains called the Alps. Snow and ice stay on the mountains all year. Many rivers start in the mountains. There are also many big lakes. Most people live in the north part of the country. The biggest city is Zurich. The city of Bern is used like a capital. People in Switzerland speak four languages: German, French, Italian, and Romansh. Switzerland is famous for its chocolate, cheese, and watches. It is also known for not fighting in wars. That is called being neutral. Many important world offices are in Switzerland, like the United Nations office in Geneva.
Stoat\n\nA stoat is a small animal with a long, thin body and short legs. It has small ears and thick, warm fur. In summer its fur is brown, but in winter it turns white. Its tail has a black tip all year round. Stoats live in cold places in Europe, Asia, and North America. They hunt other small animals and can even kill animals bigger than themselves. They bite the neck of their prey. Stoats can climb trees and spray a bad smell when they are scared. They do not dig their own homes; they use the burrows of animals they kill. Baby stoats are called kits.
Cubit\n\nA cubit is an old way to measure how long something is. Long ago, people did not have rulers like we do today. They used their own arm to measure things. A cubit is the length from your elbow to the tip of your middle finger. That is about as long as a big ruler. People used cubits to measure cloth, wood, and stone. Different places had different cubits, but they were all about the same size.
Rainbow\n\nA rainbow is a colorful arc in the sky. You can see it when the sun shines through falling rain. The colors are red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. They always appear in the same order. A rainbow is really a circle, but we only see the top part from the ground. Sometimes you can see a second, bigger and lighter rainbow. Rainbows often show up after a storm. They are a sign of peace for many people. You can also see rainbow colors near waterfalls or when you spray water on a sunny day.
Short story\n\nA short story is a little made-up tale that you can read or tell. It is much shorter than a big book like a novel. The story starts fast and ends fast. Some short stories are so short they only have ten words. People often put many short stories together in one book.
Triangulum galaxy\n\nThe Triangulum galaxy is a big spinning group of stars far, far away in space. It is shaped like a pinwheel and you can see it from Earth on a very dark night if you know where to look. It is the third biggest galaxy in our neighborhood of galaxies, which also includes our own Milky Way and the Andromeda galaxy. The Triangulum galaxy has two main arms that curl around like a spiral, and it does not have a bar across its middle. There is no giant black hole at its center, but the middle part gives off a lot of X-rays, which are a kind of light we cannot see with our eyes.
Fence\n\nA fence is like a wall made of wood or metal. It keeps things inside or outside. Fences have posts that hold them up. Some fences are big, and some are small. You see fences in gardens and on farms. A fence is not like a wall because it does not sit on a solid bottom all the way.
Jordan\n\nJordan is a country in the Middle East. It is next to Syria, Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Palestine, and Israel. The capital city is Amman. The Jordan River flows along its western side. Jordan has mountains in the north and south. The Dead Sea is the lowest place on Earth. People in Jordan speak Arabic. The king is named King Abdullah II. Most people are Muslim. The national food is mansaf. Soccer is a popular sport. Jordan has little oil, but it mines a lot of phosphate. The money used is called the Jordanian dinar.
Combustion\n\nCombustion is when something burns. When something burns, it gets very hot and can make light, like a flame. Car engines and rocket engines work by burning fuel. In a car, gas burns and explodes inside parts called pistons to make the car move. In a rocket, fuel explodes out of the back to push it up. Burning things can be bad for the air because it makes gases that are not good for the Earth. Some things, like hydrogen, burn cleanly but can be dangerous. For something to burn, it needs fuel, oxygen from the air, and heat. When there is lots of oxygen, the burning is complete and gives off more heat. When there is not enough oxygen, the burning is incomplete and can make smoke and a gas called carbon monoxide.
Chameleon\n\nA chameleon is a kind of lizard. Many chameleons can change the color of their skin to hide or to show how they feel. They have feet that look like parrot feet, with two toes on each side. Their eyes can move all by themselves, so they can look in two different directions at once. Chameleons have very long, sticky tongues that shoot out fast to catch bugs to eat. Their tails can grab onto branches. They live in warm places like Africa, Madagascar, and parts of Asia. Some people keep chameleons as pets. The smallest chameleon in the world is very tiny, only as long as a small bug.
Tool\n\nA tool is something that helps you do a job more easily. Hammers, knives, and pencils are all tools. Some tools you hold in your hand, like a hammer. Other tools use electricity to work, like a drill. People have used tools for a very long time, since the Stone Age.
Plantain\n\nA plantain is a fruit that looks like a banana but is bigger and harder. People usually cook plantains before eating them, unlike sweet bananas that you can eat raw. Plantains have less sugar than dessert bananas. They grow in warm places like Southeast Asia, Africa, and the Caribbean. People use plantains like potatoes in many dishes. The leaves of the plantain plant are very big and can be used as plates or to wrap food for cooking. The flowers and the shoot of the plant can also be eaten.
Yoga\n\nYoga is an old way of moving your body and breathing. It comes from a country called India. In yoga, you do special poses, like standing on one leg or sitting with your legs crossed. You also breathe in and out slowly. Yoga helps your body feel good and your mind feel happy. Some people do yoga in a class with a teacher. You can do yoga inside or outside. It is like a game that makes you strong and calm.
Impressionism\n\nImpressionism is a way of painting that started in France a long time ago. The painters used quick brushstrokes and bright colors to show how things looked at a certain moment. They liked to paint outside, like gardens, rivers, and people doing everyday things. One famous painter was Claude Monet. He made a painting called "Impression, Sunrise," and that is how the style got its name. At first, some people did not like these paintings and made fun of them. But over time, many people came to love them. Other impressionist painters include Pierre-Auguste Renoir, Edgar Degas, and Mary Cassatt. They painted things like ballet dancers, people having picnics, and boats on the water.
Benin\n\nBenin is a country in Africa. The capital city is Porto-Novo, but the biggest city is Cotonou. Most people live near the coast. The main language is French, but people also speak Fon and Yoruba. Benin has two rainy seasons and two dry seasons. It is hot and humid there. You can see elephants, lions, and monkeys in the parks. Benin used to be called Dahomey long ago. It became its own country in 1960.
Oman\n\nOman is a country in Asia, on the coast of the Arabian Sea. It is hot and sunny, with very little rain. The capital city is Muscat. The ruler is called a sultan, and the people are called Omanis. Omanis are known for being very friendly and welcoming to visitors.
Agave\n\nAgave is a plant with thick, sharp leaves. It comes from Mexico and the southwestern United States. An agave plant lives for a long time, sometimes 10 to 25 years. It only makes flowers one time, and then it dies. People use agave to make sweet syrup and a drink called tequila. Long ago, some Native American people ate agave as food.
Boomerang\n\nA boomerang is a special tool that you throw into the air and it comes back to you. Long ago, people made boomerangs from wood. Today, many boomerangs are made from other things. People in Australia used boomerangs to hunt for food. The oldest boomerang ever found is more than 20,000 years old and was found in a cave in Poland. That kind of boomerang did not come back, but it could fly far. Now, people throw boomerangs for fun. To throw a boomerang, you hold it up high and spin it hard. You must throw it almost straight up and a little to the side. If you throw it right, it will fly in a big circle and land near you. Most boomerangs are made for right-handed people. Left-handed people need a special boomerang. There are boomerang clubs in many countries where people play and have contests.
Guam\n\nGuam is an island in the Pacific Ocean. It is part of the United States, so people who live there are American citizens. The native people are called Chamorro. The capital city is Hagåtña, and the biggest city is Dededo. Guam has big military bases for the U.S. Air Force and Navy. Many people visit Guam on vacation, especially from Japan. They like the pretty white sand beaches and the water full of fish. Guam is warm and wet all year. Sometimes strong storms come in October and November. The money used in Guam is the U.S. dollar.
Federated States of Micronesia\n\nThe Federated States of Micronesia is a country made of many small islands in the big Pacific Ocean. It is near Papua New Guinea. The capital city is Palikir. Long ago, people lived there for thousands of years. Later, other countries ruled the islands. Now the people make their own rules, but the United States helps them. The islands have lots of fish and pretty water.
Philosophy\n\nPhilosophy is thinking about big questions. A person who does philosophy is called a philosopher. Philosophers ask questions like 'What is real?' and 'What is good?' They think about the world, life, and how to be kind. Some philosophers lived a long time ago in Greece, like Plato and Aristotle. Others came from Asia, like Confucius and Buddha. Philosophy helps people understand things better. It is like using your brain to solve puzzles about life.
Morality\n\nMorality is about knowing what is right and what is wrong. It helps you decide how to act. You can learn what is right from your mom and dad, your teachers, or from stories. Some stories end with a lesson called a moral. Doing the right thing is called being moral. Doing the wrong thing is called being immoral.
Cuisine\n\nCuisine is a word for how people cook and eat food. Different groups of people have their own special ways of cooking. The food they make depends on what grows near them and what they like to eat. For example, Italian people are known for their pasta and pizza. Long ago, people in Europe did not have tomatoes or corn because those foods came from far away places. Today, people all over the world share their cooking with each other.
Horseradish\n\nHorseradish is a tall plant with big green leaves. It grows a long white root underground. The root does not smell much until you cut or grate it. Then it makes a strong smell that can make your eyes water. People mix the grated root with vinegar to make a sauce. This sauce is often eaten with meat like roast beef. Horseradish has been grown for a very long time. It can spread a lot in a garden if you do not dig it up. The plant is not safe for horses to eat, even though its name sounds like 'horse.'
Herakles\n\nHerakles is a very strong and famous hero from old Greek stories. He is also called Hercules. His father was a god named Zeus, and his mother was a person. A goddess named Hera was angry at Herakles and made him do twelve very hard jobs called the Twelve Labors. He fought a big lion and wore its skin. He also fought a snake with many heads. Herakles was so strong that he could lift heavy things and beat monsters. He started the Olympic Games. After he died, he went to live with the gods on Mount Olympus.
Phoenix (mythology)\n\nA phoenix is a special bird from old stories. It is very beautiful and lives for many, many years. When it gets old, it makes a nest of wood and sets itself on fire. But from the ashes, a new baby phoenix is born. That is why people say the phoenix lives forever. The phoenix has red and gold feathers and is as big as an eagle. In some stories, the phoenix brings its father's body to a temple. In China, the phoenix is a sign of joy and happiness.
Translation\n\nTranslation is when you take words from one language and say them in another language. The people who do this are called translators. Some translators work with books and use a dictionary to find the right words. Others work with talking and are called interpreters. Translators can work by themselves or for a company. Some people translate stories and poems. Computers can also do translation, like Google Translate on the internet.
Habitat\n\nA habitat is the place where a plant or animal lives. It is the home that gives them food, water, and shelter. Different animals like different habitats. Frogs and ducks live in wet places like ponds because they have special feet for swimming. Some animals live in forests, some in deserts, and some in the ocean. Plants also have special homes. Cactus plants live in dry deserts and store water in their thick stems. Other plants with big leaves live in shady forests where they need to catch more sunlight. When a habitat changes too much, the animals and plants that live there may have to find a new home or they might not survive.
Futurism\n\nFuturism is a way of making art and thinking about the world that started a long time ago in a country called Italy. People who liked Futurism, called Futurists, loved fast things like cars and airplanes. They did not like old things and wanted to make everything new and exciting. They made paintings, buildings, clothes, and even music that felt fast and full of energy. Some Futurists also helped make new kinds of art that we still see today, like in movies and cartoons.
Baku\n\nBaku is a big city next to the Caspian Sea. It is the capital of a country called Azerbaijan. Baku is special because it sits below the level of the sea. Many people live there. The city has an old part with small streets and old buildings. There is a lot of oil under the ground near Baku. People in Baku like to play chess and watch football games.
Crane (machine)\n\nA crane is a big machine that can lift heavy things up and down. It has a long arm and strong ropes. Cranes help build tall buildings and houses. They can also move big things from one place to another.
Clothing\n\nClothing is what people wear to cover their bodies. People are the only animals that wear clothes. Clothes keep us safe from the sun, dust, cold, and rain. In cold places, people wear thick coats and boots to stay warm. Clothes are also worn to look nice or to show what we like. Different people in different places wear different clothes. Most clothes are made from fabric sewn together, but some are made from animal skins. We wear shirts on our top, pants or skirts on our legs, gloves on our hands, shoes on our feet, and hats on our heads. People have been wearing clothes for a very long time, maybe more than 100,000 years.
Gravitational wave\n\nGravitational waves are like ripples in space that happen when big, heavy things move very fast. A smart man named Albert Einstein said they would be there a long time ago. In 2015, scientists found them for the first time using a special machine called LIGO. The waves came from two black holes crashing into each other. Black holes are very heavy things in space that even light cannot get out of. When two black holes or two neutron stars smash together, they make gravitational waves that travel through space like waves in water. These waves are very hard to find because they are tiny. Scientists use long pipes with lasers inside to measure them. The waves also help make heavy things like gold and platinum.
Tour de France\n\nThe Tour de France is a big bicycle race that happens every summer in France. It started a long time ago, in 1903. The race goes all around France and sometimes into other countries like England, Belgium, or Spain. It lasts about three weeks. Each day, the fastest rider gets a yellow shirt to wear. The best sprinter gets a green shirt, and the best rider in the mountains gets a polka dot shirt. The youngest good rider, under 26 years old, gets a white shirt. At the end, the winner is the one who rode the fastest all the way to Paris, past the Eiffel Tower.
Yoruba language\n\nThe Yoruba language is a way of talking that people use in West Africa. Many people speak it in Nigeria, Benin, and Togo. Some people also speak it in other parts of Africa, Europe, and the Americas. It is one of the languages spoken by many people.
Cicada\n\nA cicada is a small insect that makes a loud buzzing noise. The male cicada buzzes to call a female. The female cicada cannot buzz, so she listens for the male. After they mate, the female lays eggs in a tree branch. Cicadas are usually green or black. They live in warm places all over the world. Some cicadas come out every year, and some come out every 13 or 17 years. People in some countries eat cicadas.
Monarchy\n\nA monarchy is a kind of country where one person, called a monarch, is the leader. A monarch can be a king or a queen. The monarch usually gets the job from their family, like a father passing it to his son or daughter. Some monarchs have a lot of power and make all the rules. Other monarchs have less power and mostly do special ceremonies, while the people vote for other leaders to make the laws. Many countries like the United Kingdom, Japan, and Denmark have a king or queen today. Some people like having a royal family because it is a tradition and brings visitors to the country.
Hurdling\n\nHurdling is a running race where you jump over things called hurdles. The hurdles are like tall gates you have to leap over. People run very fast and jump over ten hurdles in the race. Some races are short, like 60 meters, and some are long, like 400 meters. Hurdling is a sport in the Olympic Games.
Earwig\n\nAn earwig is a small insect with a flat body. It is dark brown, red, or black. An earwig has six legs, two antennae on its head, and little pinchers on its bottom. The pinchers help it grab food. Male earwigs have curved pinchers, and females have straight ones. Earwigs live in damp, shady places like under leaves or in fallen trees. They can also be found in basements or bathrooms. Earwigs eat plants, pollen, fruit, and sometimes small bugs like spiders and flies. They have a bad smell, so birds do not like to eat them.
Hospital\n\nA hospital is a big building where people go when they are very sick or hurt. Doctors and nurses work there to help people get better. Some people stay overnight in a bed, and those are called inpatients. Other people come for a visit and go home the same day. Hospitals have special machines and tools to help fix broken bones or fight sickness. Long ago, hospitals were run by churches. Today, hospitals get money from the government, from people who pay for their care, or from charity.
El Dorado\n\nEl Dorado is a make-believe city in South America. A long time ago, people told a story about a king who was covered in gold dust. The king would go to a lake and throw gold and pretty stones into the water. When Spanish people came to South America, they tried to find this golden city, but it was only a legend and not real.
Vietnamese language\n\nVietnamese is the language people speak in Vietnam. It is the official language of that country. Vietnamese uses a special way of saying words where the pitch of your voice changes the meaning. Many Vietnamese words came from Chinese a long time ago. Today, Vietnamese is written with letters like the English alphabet, but with extra marks on top of some letters. These marks tell you how to say the word. People in different parts of Vietnam speak a little differently. The way people talk in the north sounds different from the way people talk in the south. Some words in Vietnamese come from French, like "cà phê" for coffee, and from English, like "tivi" for TV. When you learn Vietnamese, you call older people "anh" for big brother or "chị" for big sister, even if they are not your family.
Curse\n\nA curse is a word that says someone will have bad luck. Some people think curses can come true by magic. In fairy tales, a witch might curse a prince to turn into a frog or a beast. But a princess can save him. A long time ago, Romans wrote curses on tablets and let them float in the river. People make curses when they are jealous. The opposite of a curse is a blessing.
Lake Superior\n\nLake Superior is a very big lake in Canada and the United States. It is the biggest lake of fresh water in the world by how much space it covers. The Ojibwe people call it Gitchigume. Many kinds of fish live in it, more than 80 different types. Boats carry heavy rocks called iron ore through special locks to other lakes.
Mariana Trench\n\nThe Mariana Trench is the deepest place in the ocean. It is a long, narrow crack in the sea floor, deeper than any mountain is tall. The trench is near the Mariana Islands, far out in the Pacific Ocean. The very deepest part is called the Challenger Deep. The water there is very, very deep and the pressure is huge. A few special boats called submersibles have gone down to the bottom. They found some small animals living there, like sea cucumbers, worms, and shrimp. The trench was made when two big pieces of the Earth's crust pushed together.
Movie\n\nA movie is a story told with pictures and sounds. People watch movies to have fun or learn something. Movies can make you laugh, cry, or feel scared. You can watch a movie at a theater on a big screen or at home on a TV or computer. A movie camera takes many pictures very fast, and when they are shown quickly, the pictures look like they are moving. People called actors say words and do actions to tell the story. A director tells the actors what to do. After filming, an editor puts the pictures together to make the story. Sound is added later, like talking, music, and sound effects. Some movies are very popular and make a lot of money. Other movies are made by small groups with less money. Movies have ratings like G, PG, PG-13, and R to tell you if they are okay for kids.
Stomach\n\nYour stomach is a soft bag inside your belly. It is part of your body that helps you eat food. When you eat, food goes into your stomach. Your stomach squeezes and mixes the food with special juices. These juices help break the food into tiny pieces. Then the food goes to the next part of your body to give you energy. Sometimes your stomach can hurt if you eat too much or if the juices come back up. That is called heartburn. When you are sick, food can come back up and out of your mouth. That is called throwing up.
Shovel\n\nA shovel is a tool for moving things like dirt, snow, or rocks. It has a flat metal part on the bottom and a long handle. You can use it to scoop up loose stuff and carry it somewhere else. A shovel is not as good for digging as a spade, but it works well for moving piles of material.
Sphinx\n\nA sphinx is a make-believe animal from old stories. It has the head of a person, the body of a lion, and the wings of an eagle. In Greek stories, a sphinx was mean and ate people. It asked a riddle, and if you got it wrong, it would eat you. In Egyptian stories, a sphinx was kind and guarded special places. Big stone sphinx statues stand near old buildings and pyramids. The most famous sphinx is in Egypt and has a man's head and a lion's body.
Japanese food\n\nJapanese food is food from Japan. It has many different kinds of dishes. Soya beans are very important in Japanese cooking. They are used to make soya sauce, tofu, and miso. Tofu is made from soya beans and is soft and white. It is often put in soups. Noodles are also used a lot in Japanese food. They come in long strings and are eaten in hot soup or with sauce. Japan is near the ocean, so there is lots of fish and seafood. Sashimi is raw fish cut into thin pieces. It is eaten with soya sauce. Wasabi is a green paste that tastes very spicy. It is eaten with sushi and sashimi. Seaweed is also used in many Japanese dishes, like in soups and wrapped around rice.
Glove\n\nA glove is a piece of clothing that covers your hand. There are many kinds of gloves. Thick gloves keep your hands warm in cold weather. Thin gloves made of rubber or plastic keep your hands clean. Some workers wear heavy rubber gloves to protect their hands from bad stuff. A mitten is a glove that has a spot for your thumb but puts all your other fingers together. Some gloves are worn to look nice, and they can be made of leather or fur. People also wear gloves in sports like baseball and soccer to help them hold things better.
Tiger shark\n\nA tiger shark is a very big fish that lives in the ocean. It has black spots and stripes on its body, like a tiger. Tiger sharks can grow as long as a car and weigh as much as a small elephant. They have big, sharp teeth that help them eat fish, seals, and even sea turtles. Tiger sharks like to swim in warm, shallow water near the shore. They hunt at night and rest during the day. Baby tiger sharks are born alive, and a mother can have up to 82 babies at once. Tiger sharks are one of the most dangerous sharks to people, but they do not attack very often.
Pennsylvania\n\nPennsylvania is a state in the United States of America. It is in the northeastern part of the country. The biggest city in Pennsylvania is Philadelphia. The state capital is Harrisburg. Pennsylvania has many forests and hills. Long ago, people from Sweden were the first to live there. Later, a man named William Penn started a place for people to live. The state is named after him. Pennsylvania was one of the first 13 colonies. The Declaration of Independence was signed in Philadelphia. Today, many people live in Pennsylvania, especially near the cities of Philadelphia and Pittsburgh.
Sea otter\n\nA sea otter is a furry animal that lives in the ocean. It has very thick fur, with more hairs than any other animal. Sea otters live in the Pacific Ocean near North America. They eat shellfish like clams and sea urchins. Sea otters use rocks to smash open shells, which makes them one of the few animals that use tools. They carry a favorite rock in a pouch under their arm. Long ago, people hunted sea otters for their fur, and almost all of them died. Now they are coming back in some places. Sea otters help keep the ocean healthy by eating sea urchins, which can eat too much seaweed called kelp. When sea otters are around, the kelp forests grow big and give homes to fish and other animals.
Oil well\n\nAn oil well is a deep hole in the ground where people get oil. Workers find a place that might have oil and drill a big hole. Then they pump the oil up from the hole. Most oil is very deep underground. People have used oil for a very long time, even thousands of years ago. They used it for medicine and to make things burn. Today, oil wells help us get oil for cars and many other things.
Budgerigar\n\nA budgerigar is a small bird with colorful feathers. It is a kind of parrot. Budgies live in dry parts of Australia. People keep them as pets at home. They are smart and can learn to copy words that people say. A budgie has a long tail and can be green, yellow, blue, or white.
Falkland Islands\n\nThe Falkland Islands are a group of islands in the South Atlantic Ocean, near South America. They are far away from other land, about 300 miles east of Argentina. The islands belong to the United Kingdom, but Argentina says they belong to them. The two biggest islands are East Falkland and West Falkland. About 3,400 people live there. They speak English and are British. The people make money by fishing and raising sheep for wool. The islands are cold, windy, and rainy a lot. There are many hills and mountains. The biggest town is called Stanley. The islands have a special bird called the Falkland Islands' own bird, and there are many penguins too.
Natural selection\n\nNatural selection is how animals and plants change over a very long time. Some animals have special features that help them stay alive. For example, a moth that is the same color as a tree can hide from birds. If an animal lives longer because of its special feature, it can have more babies. The babies get the same special feature from their parents. Over many years, more and more animals have that feature. This is how living things get better at living in their home. A famous example is the peppered moth. Long ago, most moths were light colored and could hide on light trees. When factories made the trees dark, dark moths could hide better. So more dark moths lived and had babies. Later, when the trees got clean again, light moths became more common again. Another example is when medicine kills germs, but some germs have a special feature that keeps them alive. Those germs can then make more germs that are hard to kill. Natural selection was thought of by two men named Charles Darwin and Alfred Russel Wallace.
Organism\n\nAn organism is any living thing. Animals and plants are organisms. Organisms need air, water, food, and a place to live. They grow, use energy, and make more of themselves. Some organisms are big, like a dog or a tree. Most organisms are so small you need a microscope to see them. These tiny ones are called microorganisms. Some organisms are made of just one cell, like bacteria. Others are made of many cells, like you.
Human eye\n\nThe human eye is a round part of your body that helps you see. It works like a little ball. Light goes into the front of your eye. The front part is clear and lets light pass through. Inside, a special part called the lens bends the light. The light hits the back of the eye, which is like a screen. That screen sends a message to your brain. Your brain turns the message into a picture. That is how you see things. The eye also has a clear liquid inside that keeps it round and healthy.
Poinsettia\n\nA poinsettia is a plant with red and green leaves. It is very popular at Christmas time. It grows in Mexico and Central America. The poinsettia needs long nights to make its red leaves. Gardeners can trick the plant by keeping it in the dark for many hours each day. That way it turns red even when it is not Christmas.
Mecca\n\nMecca is a city in a country called Saudi Arabia. It is a very special city for people who follow Islam. Every year, many people travel to Mecca for a trip called the Hajj. In Mecca, there is a big square building called the Kaaba. People who follow Islam face the Kaaba when they pray. The city is in a sandy valley and is not near the ocean. Only people who follow Islam can go into Mecca.
Sail\n\nA sail is a big piece of cloth on top of some boats. The wind pushes the sail and makes the boat move across the water. The sail is attached to a tall pole called a mast. Some boats have one sail, and some have many sails. Boats with sails are called sailing boats. Long ago, people used sailing boats to travel across oceans. Today, people use them for fun and races.
Arctic\n\nThe Arctic is the cold area around the top of the Earth, near the North Pole. It is mostly an ocean covered with ice. In summer, the sun never sets there, so people call it the "Land of the Midnight Sun." The land in the Arctic is called tundra, which is a cold, flat place with no trees. Only small plants like moss, grass, and tiny flowers grow there. The ground has a layer of ice underneath called permafrost, so water from melting snow stays on top and makes puddles and lakes. Polar bears live in the Arctic. They are big, white bears that can swim very well and eat seals and fish. Arctic foxes follow the bears to eat leftover food. Caribou and reindeer also live there. They eat grass and lichen and move south in winter. Many birds come to the Arctic in summer to raise their babies. People called the Sami (or Lapps) live in the Arctic too. They raise reindeer for food, clothes, and tents.
Dew\n\nDew is tiny drops of water that you can see on grass and leaves in the morning. At night, the ground and plants get cold. When the air around them gets cold too, the water in the air turns into little drops on the grass. That is dew. If it gets very cold, the dew turns into frost. Dew forms best when the air is clean and still. You can also see something like dew when your glasses get steamy in a warm room.
Tern\n\nA tern is a bird that lives near the sea, rivers, or wet places. It has a thin body, long wings, a forked tail, a long bill, and short legs. Most terns are light gray on top and white below, with a black cap on their head. They lay eggs on the ground in big noisy groups. Some terns make floating nests in wet places. Most terns eat fish that they catch by diving into the water. Some terns eat bugs. Many terns fly very far to find warm places in winter.
Human settlement\n\nA human settlement is a place where people live. Some people live there all the time, and some live there only for a little while. When people move to a new place to live, it is called settling. A settlement can be a small group of houses, a village, a town, or a big city. Some people called nomads move from place to place and do not settle.
Pneumonia\n\nPneumonia is a sickness in your lungs. Your lungs have tiny air bags that help you get air. When you have pneumonia, these bags get red and sore and fill with yucky liquid. This makes it hard to breathe. You might cough or feel pain in your chest. Germs like bacteria or viruses can cause pneumonia. Doctors can give you medicine to help you get better. Some people get very sick from pneumonia, especially very old people and babies. But many people get better with good care.
Portugal\n\nPortugal is a country in Europe. It sits next to the Atlantic Ocean and Spain. The capital city is Lisbon. Many people visit Portugal for holidays, especially the sunny Algarve region and Lisbon. Portugal has a football team and won a big song contest in 2017. The country has islands in the ocean called the Azores and Madeira. People in Portugal speak Portuguese. Long ago, Portugal had a big empire with lands like Brazil and parts of Africa. In 1974, a peaceful revolution called the Carnation Revolution changed the government. Portugal joined the European Union in 1986.
Pigment\n\nA pigment is something that gives color to other things. Some pigments come from plants, animals, rocks, or dirt. People can also make pigments. For example, a blue pigment called ultramarine is a powder that comes from nature. It is used to make blue paint and blue dye for clothes. Long ago, a man made a new pigment that turned clothes a pretty purple color.
Writer\n\nA writer is a person who makes stories, books, or articles for other people to read. Some writers write make-believe stories, and some write about real things. Writers use words to share ideas and pictures in your mind. Many writers work on one kind of writing, like stories, poems, or news.
Skeleton\n\nA skeleton is the hard part inside your body that holds everything up. It is made of many bones joined together. The skeleton protects your brain, heart, and lungs. Without a skeleton, your body would be flat like a pancake. The bones in your head are called the skull. Your spine is a long line of small bones that helps you bend and move. Your ribs are curved bones that protect your heart and lungs. Your arms and legs have big bones at the top and smaller bones at the bottom. Your hands and feet have lots of little bones. A skeleton can also be a picture that means danger or poison.
Uganda\n\nUganda is a country in Africa. It is far from the ocean, so it is called landlocked. Uganda shares its borders with five other countries: Congo, Kenya, South Sudan, Rwanda, and Tanzania. The biggest city is Kampala, and that is also the capital. Many people in Uganda speak English and Swahili. Most people are Christian. The president is Yoweri Kaguta Museveni. Uganda has many big lakes, like Lake Victoria and Lake Kyoga. The weather is warm, and it rains a lot in the south. People grow food like coffee and tea to sell to other countries. Football is the most popular sport, and many people love to watch the national team play.
Journalism\n\nJournalism is a job about telling people what is happening in the world. People who do this job are called journalists. They write stories for newspapers, talk on TV news, or speak on the radio. Journalists find out true facts and share them with everyone. They try to be fair and tell the truth.
Surveillance\n\nSurveillance is when someone watches other people or listens to what they say. Sometimes it is done in secret. People might use cameras to watch a place, or they might listen to phone calls. Governments and police do this to keep people safe and stop bad things from happening. Some people also do it to get information. It is like being a very quiet spy.
Vacuum cleaner\n\nA vacuum cleaner is a machine that sucks up dirt and dust from floors. It uses air to pull the dirt into a bag or a can inside. You can dump the dirt into the trash later. Some vacuum cleaners are big and you push them around. Others are small and you hold them in your hand. Vacuum cleaners help keep your house clean.
Mallard\n\nA mallard is a kind of duck that lives in many places around the world. It is the most common duck you can see. Mallards live near water like ponds, lakes, and rivers, even in cities. The male mallard has a shiny green head and a yellow bill. The female mallard is brown with an orange bill. Both have a special blue patch on their wings. Mallards are big ducks with long bodies and wide bills. They like to swim and eat plants and small bugs.
Algeria\n\nAlgeria is a big country in North Africa. It is the second biggest country in Africa. The capital city is Algiers, which is in the north. Most people live in the north because the land is good for growing food. The south is mostly the Sahara Desert, which is very hot and dry. Algeria has mountains, and the highest one is Mount Tahat. People in Algeria speak Arabic and Berber. Many also speak French. Most people are Muslims. Algeria has a lot of oil and gas, which makes it one of the richest countries in Africa. Long ago, different groups like the Romans and Arabs ruled Algeria. France ruled for a long time, but Algeria became free in 1962.
Hour\n\nAn hour is a way to measure time. One hour is as long as sixty minutes. A whole day has twenty-four hours. We use hours to know when to wake up, eat lunch, and go to bed.
Spider monkey\n\nA spider monkey is a small monkey that lives in trees in the rainforest. It has very long arms and legs and a long tail that is longer than its body. The tail is like a fifth hand — it can grab things and swing from branches. Spider monkeys move fast by swinging and jumping from tree to tree. They almost never come down to the ground. They live in groups of 10 to 40 monkeys. Each group stays in its own part of the forest. A mother spider monkey has one baby each year. They eat fruit, nuts, leaves, and sometimes small eggs. The leader of the group is a female who finds food for everyone.
Lion\n\nA lion is a big wild cat with a yellowish-brown coat. Male lions have a big hairy mane around their head. Lions live in grasslands and places with trees in Africa and a small part of India. They live in groups called prides. A pride has mommy lions, their babies, and one or two daddy lions. Lions are very strong and eat meat like zebras and antelopes. The mommy lions do most of the hunting. They work together to catch food. Lions have a loud roar that can be heard far away. Baby lions are called cubs. Cubs are born blind and learn to walk after a few weeks. Lions are called the king of the beasts because they are brave and strong.
Tagalog language\n\nTagalog is a language that people speak in the Philippines. More than 22 million people speak it as their first language. Many other people in the Philippines use it to talk to each other. Tagalog used to be written with a special alphabet called Baybayin, but now people write it with the same letters we use in English. The Philippines has two main languages: Tagalog and English.
Great Victoria Desert\n\nThe Great Victoria Desert is a very big, dry, and sandy place in Australia. It is the largest desert in Australia. The ground has sand dunes, small hills, flat grass areas, and salty lakes. It is very hot and gets only a little rain each year. Aboriginal people have lived there for a very long time, more than 24,000 years. Even though it is dry, some animals live there, like kangaroos, wallabies, lizards, and many birds. These animals know how to stay safe in the hot days and cold nights.
Birch\n\nA birch tree is a tall tree with thin leaves that fall off in autumn. It has white bark that peels off like paper. Birch trees grow in many cold places around the world. Some birch trees are short and live only a few years. The bark of a birch tree is very special because it is white and smooth.
Sea ice\n\nSea ice is frozen ocean water. It grows in winter and melts in summer. Sea ice is salty, so it is heavier and easier to break than ice from a drink. It has tiny pockets of salt water and air bubbles inside, so light cannot go through it easily. This keeps the sea below cool and stops tiny plants from growing. When the ice melts, more light gets through and the plants grow. Many animals like seals and polar bears live on sea ice. People who live in the Arctic travel on sea ice and hunt for food. Sea ice is very shiny and bounces sunlight back into space, which keeps the poles cold. The Earth is getting warmer, so sea ice is melting faster. Scientists use satellites to watch the ice from space.
Antibiotics\n\nAntibiotics are special medicines that kill tiny germs called bacteria or stop them from growing. They help your body get better when you are sick from bacteria. But antibiotics cannot kill viruses, so they do not help if you have a cold or the flu. The first antibiotic was found by a scientist named Alexander Fleming in 1928. He saw that a mold could kill bacteria. Today, doctors give antibiotics to people who have bacterial infections. It is important to take all of the medicine, even if you start to feel better, because some bacteria might still be alive and become stronger.
Hua Mulan\n\nHua Mulan is a brave woman from old stories in China. She took her father's place in the army because he was too old to fight. She learned to use a sword and practiced kung fu. Mulan fought in the war for twelve years and became very famous. After the war, she did not want any reward. She just wanted to go back home to her family.
River delta\n\nA river delta is a piece of land shaped like a triangle. It forms where a river meets the ocean. The river carries mud and sand. When the water slows down, the mud and sand drop to make new land. Over time, the land grows into fingers with water in between. Plants grow on the dry parts. Some deltas are very big, covering many miles. The name "delta" comes from a Greek letter that looks like a triangle.
Chronology\n\nChronology is about time. It helps us put things in the order they happened. When you tell a story from the beginning to the end, that is chronological order. A timeline is a line that shows when things happened. Chronology helps us know what came first and what came next.
Eyeglasses\n\nEyeglasses are pieces of glass or clear plastic called lenses that sit in a frame in front of your eyes. They help some people see better. If you have trouble seeing far away or up close, glasses can make things look clear. Some glasses keep your eyes safe, like goggles that stop things from hitting your eyes. Sunglasses have dark lenses to keep too much sun out of your eyes. Some glasses have yellow lenses to block blue light from computers and TVs. People also wear glasses to look nice. Glasses come in many shapes and colors.
Rock and roll\n\nRock and roll is a kind of music that started a long time ago in the 1950s. It mixes different types of music like country, blues, and jazz. At first, only some people listened to it, but soon many young people loved it. The music has a strong beat and makes you want to dance. Some famous rock and roll singers were Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry, and Little Richard. Later, in the 1960s, groups like The Beatles and The Beach Boys became very popular. Rock and roll changed over time, and new styles like heavy metal and punk rock came along. People still listen to rock and roll today.
Natural number\n\nNatural numbers are the numbers you use when you count things. You start with 1, then 2, 3, and so on. There is no biggest natural number because you can always add 1 to get a bigger one. Natural numbers are always whole numbers, and they do not include zero.
Straits of Florida\n\nThe Straits of Florida is a narrow water path between the Florida Keys and Cuba. It is like a big water road that connects the Gulf of Mexico to the Atlantic Ocean. Boats and ships travel through this strait to go from one big water place to another.
Flowering plant\n\nA flowering plant is a plant that grows flowers and fruits. Most plants on land are flowering plants. Flowers can be many colors and smell sweet. They make nectar, which is a sweet drink for insects and birds. When an insect or bird visits a flower, it helps the plant make seeds. The seeds are inside the fruit. Fruits grow from the flower and can be eaten by animals. Animals carry the seeds to new places, and new plants grow there. Some flowering plants are grasses. Grasses do not need insects to help them. The wind blows their seeds around. Flowering plants grow almost everywhere on Earth, except in very cold forests where pine trees live.
Orange River\n\nThe Orange River is a very long river in Southern Africa. It starts in the Drakensberg mountains and flows through South Africa and Namibia. The river is used to water plants and make electricity. It was named after a Dutch royal family.
Edda\n\nEdda is a name for two old books with stories about Viking gods and goddesses. These books were written a long time ago by people in Iceland. The stories tell about gods like Odin and Thor. But the people who wrote the books did not believe in those gods, so they changed some parts of the stories to make the gods seem silly. The name Edda might come from a place called Oddi, where the writers lived.
English literature\n\nEnglish literature is all the stories, poems, and plays written in the English language. Many people around the world read English books. Long ago, a poem called Beowulf was written in Old English, which sounds very different from how we talk today. Later, a man named Geoffrey Chaucer wrote funny stories called The Canterbury Tales. William Shakespeare wrote many famous plays, like Hamlet, which has the line 'To be, or not to be.' The King James Bible was also written in English. Over time, writers like Charles Dickens and Jane Austen wrote stories that people still love. English literature comes from many countries, not just England.
Perspective (graphical)\n\nPerspective is a way to draw pictures so they look real. When you draw something far away, you make it smaller. When you draw something close, you make it bigger. This helps your eyes think the picture has depth, like a real place. Long ago, a man named Filippo Brunelleschi first showed how to do this. Artists use perspective to make flat paper look like a window into a world.
Uranus\n\nUranus is a big planet far away from the Sun. It is the seventh planet from the Sun. Uranus is made of ice, gas, and liquid metal. The planet is very cold. Uranus is tilted on its side, so it spins sideways. Nobody knows why. It takes 84 Earth years for Uranus to go around the Sun once. A day on Uranus is only 17 hours long. Uranus has 27 moons. The five biggest moons are Miranda, Ariel, Umbriel, Titania, and Oberon. They are named after characters from stories. Uranus also has 13 rings around it. The rings are made of ice and dark stuff. The planet looks blue because of gas in its air. In 1986, a spaceship called Voyager 2 flew by Uranus and took pictures.
Sparrowhawk\n\nA sparrowhawk is a small bird that hunts other birds. It has short, wide wings and a long tail to fly between trees. The male has a blue-grey back and orange stripes on his chest. The female is bigger and has brown back and wings with brown stripes. Sparrowhawks eat small birds like sparrows and finches. The males catch smaller birds, and females catch bigger ones like thrushes. They live in Europe, Asia, and Africa. Some fly south for winter. They build a nest of twigs in the woods. The female lays four or five pale blue eggs. The chicks hatch after 33 days and leave the nest about a month later. Most sparrowhawks live about four years. Long ago, chemicals on seeds hurt sparrowhawks, but now those chemicals are banned and there are many sparrowhawks again. People have used sparrowhawks for hunting for over 500 years.
Sign language\n\nSign language is a way of talking with your hands and body. People who cannot hear use sign language to talk to each other. Instead of using sounds from the mouth, they use hand shapes and movements. You watch with your eyes to understand. Many different sign languages exist around the world. Each country may have its own. Some signs look like what they mean, but many you just have to learn. Sign language has its own rules, just like spoken language. Some people also use fingerspelling to spell out words letter by letter.
Shoe\n\nA shoe is something you wear on your foot. You wear shoes outside to keep your feet safe and clean. Shoes come in pairs, one for each foot. You usually wear socks with shoes. Some shoes are for running and are light and soft. Slippers are soft shoes you wear inside to keep your feet warm. Boots are tall shoes that cover more of your leg. Rubber boots keep your feet dry in wet places. Some shoes are fancy, like high heels or shiny leather shoes for special events.
American Museum of Natural History\n\nThe American Museum of Natural History is a big place where you can learn about science. It is in New York City. The museum has many rooms with things to see, like dinosaur bones, rocks, and animals. Scientists work there to study nature and space. You can visit with your family and see how big the dinosaurs were.
Ireland\n\nIreland is a big island in the ocean. It is long and wide. Two countries live on the island: the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland. The Republic of Ireland has a big city called Dublin. Most people there speak English. Northern Ireland has a big city called Belfast. A famous ship called the Titanic was built in Belfast. Ireland has green fields and many farms. It rains a lot, so the grass is very green. People in Ireland like to play soccer and Gaelic games. Long ago, many Irish people moved to other countries like the United States and Canada. Today, many people around the world have family from Ireland.
Seabird\n\nA seabird is a bird that lives near the sea or far out on the ocean. These birds are good at finding food in the water, like fish and small sea animals. Many seabirds only come to land to have babies. They live together in big groups on islands or cliffs. Seabirds live a long time and take good care of their babies. Some seabirds fly very far every year to find warm places. They can dive into the water to catch food.
Ecology\n\nEcology is about how living things and their homes work together. It looks at all the plants, animals, and tiny bugs in a place, and how they help each other. Scientists who study this are called ecologists. They watch how animals find food and water, and how plants grow. A group of the same kind of animal living in one place is called a population. When there is lots of food, the population gets bigger. When food is hard to find, the population gets smaller. All the different animals and plants in one place make a community. The community and its home together are called an ecosystem. In an ecosystem, energy moves from plants to animals that eat them. Plants get energy from the sun. Animals that eat plants get energy from the plants. Animals that eat other animals get energy from them. Everything in an ecosystem is connected.
Weather\n\nWeather is what the sky and air are doing right now. It can be sunny, rainy, windy, or snowy. The Sun gives heat that makes weather happen. When the air gets warm, it rises up. When it cools, water falls as rain or snow. People check the weather to know what to wear. Some weather is very strong, like big storms or hurricanes. Scientists called weather watchers use computers to guess what the weather will be tomorrow.
Executive (government)\n\nThe executive is the part of the government that runs the country every day. It makes sure the laws are followed. The leader of the executive is called the head of government, like a president or prime minister. This leader has helpers called ministers who take care of different things, like schools or hospitals. All these people work together to keep the country going.
Hypnosis\n\nHypnosis is a special way of thinking where a person feels very relaxed and can pay close attention to one thing. A person called a hypnotist talks to another person in a calm voice to help them go into this relaxed state. While in this state, the person can be told to do things like forget their name or feel hot, and they might do it. Hypnosis can be used to help people feel better when they are scared or sad. It can also be done by one person alone, called self-hypnosis. Long ago, people in many places used chants and music to make someone feel like they were in a trance.
Wasp\n\nA wasp is a small flying insect with a thin waist and two pairs of wings. Wasps look smooth and shiny, not fuzzy like bees. Many wasps have black and yellow stripes. They live in nests made of paper that they chew from wood. A queen wasp starts the nest in spring and lays eggs. Worker wasps feed the baby wasps chewed-up insects. Adult wasps drink sweet nectar from flowers. Some wasps live alone and build nests out of mud. They catch spiders and bugs to feed their babies. Wasps can sting if they feel scared, but they usually leave you alone. A few people get very sick from wasp stings and need a doctor.
Paraguay\n\nParaguay is a small country in South America. It is not next to the ocean. It sits next to Brazil, Bolivia, and Argentina. The capital city is Asuncion. Many people there speak Spanish and another language called Guaran. The weather is wet in the east and dry in the west. Most people are Catholic. Paraguay used to be ruled by Spain, but now it is its own country.
Catholic Church\n\nThe Catholic Church is a big group of people who follow Jesus. It is the largest Christian church in the world, with more than one billion members. The church started about 2,000 years ago when Jesus taught people. The leader of the Catholic Church is called the Pope. The Pope lives in a tiny country called Vatican City, inside the city of Rome, Italy. Catholics believe the first Pope was Saint Peter, a friend of Jesus. Catholics go to a special meeting called Mass on Sundays. They pray using beads called a Rosary. They also honor Mary, the mother of Jesus, very much. The church runs many schools and hospitals to help people.
Simple machine\n\nA simple machine is a tool that helps you push or pull things more easily. It can change the way a force works. There are six kinds: lever, wheel and axle, pulley, inclined plane, wedge, and screw. A lever is like a seesaw. A wheel and axle help a car move. A pulley helps lift heavy things up. An inclined plane is a ramp. A wedge is like a knife. A screw holds things together. People have used simple machines for a very long time. When you put two or more simple machines together, you get a compound machine.
Limestone\n\nLimestone is a kind of rock that comes from the bottom of the sea. It is made from tiny shells and bones of sea animals that lived a long time ago. Limestone can be white, gray, or yellow. It is hard but soft enough to cut into blocks. People use limestone to build houses, churches, and banks. They also use it to make glass and cement. Sometimes you can see fossils in limestone, which are the shapes of old animals and plants. When limestone gets very hot and squeezed, it turns into marble.
Lute\n\nA lute is a musical instrument with strings. It has a round back made of thin strips of wood and a flat front. The front has a pretty hole in the middle called a rose. People play the lute by picking or strumming the strings with their fingers or a pick. Long ago, lutes came to Europe from faraway lands. The lute is like a great-grandparent of the guitar. Today, people still play lutes in Greece, Turkey, and Arabic countries.
Timor Sea\n\nThe Timor Sea is a big, not very deep body of water. It sits between the island of Timor and Australia. The sea has many reefs and empty islands. In 2009, there was a big oil spill there. The only big city by the Timor Sea is Darwin, in Australia. Many rivers flow into it. The sea is about 480 kilometers wide. Some early people may have crossed this sea to get to Australia.
Pet\n\nA pet is an animal that lives with people at home. People do not make pets work or eat them. Pets are kept for fun and to be friends. Dogs and cats are very common pets. Fish, hamsters, guinea pigs, mice, rats, and rabbits are also pets. Some people keep birds or even tarantulas and hermit crabs as pets. If no one can take care of a pet, it may go to a special place called an animal shelter. There, people try to find a new home for the pet.
Windmill\n\nA windmill is a tall machine with big blades that spin in the wind. The wind pushes the blades around, and that makes the inside parts turn. Long ago, people used windmills to crush grain into flour for making bread. They also used them to pump water from the ground or to cut wood. Today, some windmills make electricity for our homes. The blades are covered with cloth or hard material. When the wind blows, the blades go round and round. A famous story tells about a man named Don Quixote who thought windmills were giants and tried to fight them.
Nose\n\nYour nose is the part of your face that helps you smell things and breathe. It is in the middle of your face. The nose has tiny parts inside that send messages to your brain about smells.
