The country gets a lot of its power from hot water under the ground.
Mesopotamia\n\nMesopotamia is a land between two big rivers called the Tigris and the Euphrates. It is in the Middle East, where Iraq is today. Long ago, people there started the first cities, like Babylon and Ur. They learned to grow food by making water go to their fields. They also made the first wheel, first to make clay pots and later to move things. The people wrote with special marks called cuneiform. A famous story from there is about a king named Gilgamesh and his friend Enkidu. Many different groups of people lived in Mesopotamia over time.
Lettuce\n\nLettuce is a green vegetable that you can eat. It is a plant that grows every year. You can eat both the leaves and the stem. Lettuce is often eaten cold in salads, on hamburgers, and in sandwiches. Some people cook it, like in China. Most lettuce leaves are green, but some are red. They taste a little bit bitter. Some kinds of lettuce grow in a round head like cabbage, and other kinds have loose leaves. The name "lettuce" comes from an old word for milk, because the juice looks like milk. People have been eating lettuce for a very long time, even the ancient Romans and Greeks.
Wren\n\nA wren is a small brown bird. It is about as long as your hand. Wrens live in many places, like Europe, Asia, North Africa, and the Americas. They have round wings and a short tail that points up. Their song is very loud for such a tiny bird. It sounds like sweet music with lots of trills. When a wren is upset, it makes a churring noise like a clock winding down.
Gecko\n\nA gecko is a small lizard that lives in warm countries. Geckos come in many colors and sizes. They are mostly awake at night. Some geckos live inside people's houses and eat bugs like mosquitoes and flies. People like having them around because they eat pests. Unlike most lizards, geckos can make sounds. They chirp or click, a little like a bird or a frog. Some geckos are named after the sound they make, like 'gecko' or 'tokay'. Most geckos lay eggs, but a few have live babies. Geckos do not have eyelids. They have a clear skin over their eyes and lick it clean with their tongue. If a gecko loses its tail, it can grow a new one. The tail helps them balance and store fat. Geckos can walk on walls and ceilings because their feet have tiny hairs that stick to surfaces. Their skin is covered in very small hairs that keep them dry and can kill germs.
Caribbean Sea\n\nThe Caribbean Sea is a big, warm body of water near the Atlantic Ocean. It is south of the Gulf of Mexico and next to places like Cuba and Central America. The water is very deep, even deeper than some oceans. There are many islands in the Caribbean Sea. People like to go there on vacation because the weather is warm and sunny. A long time ago, a man named Christopher Columbus found some of these islands. He thought they were a different place, so he called them the West Indies. Later, people named the sea after a group of people called the Caribs.
Isis\n\nIsis is a goddess from ancient Egypt. She was the goddess of life and magic. Isis protected women and children and healed sick people. She was the wife of Osiris and the mother of Horus. Isis had great powers. She could heal people and cast spells. Her symbols were a throne on her head and wings. People in Egypt and other places built temples to honor her.
Nightjar\n\nA nightjar is a bird that comes out at night or when the sun is going down. It flies around and eats bugs like moths and beetles. Nightjars live in many places around the world. They have soft feathers that help them hide on the ground or in trees. Some people call them goatsuckers or nighthawks. There are about 100 different kinds of nightjars.
Arabian Sea\n\nThe Arabian Sea is a big body of warm salt water. It is part of the Indian Ocean. The sea sits between the Arabian Peninsula and India. Many fish and other sea creatures live in the Arabian Sea. Ships sail across it to carry things from one country to another. The water is very warm.
Tsunami\n\nA tsunami is a very big wave in the ocean that moves very fast. It starts when the ground shakes under the water, like during a big earthquake. The wave can knock down trees and houses and wash away sand from the beach. Tsunamis mostly happen in the Pacific Ocean. Before a tsunami comes, the water at the beach might pull back far away. That is a warning to run to high ground. People cannot stop a tsunami, but they can watch for warnings and go somewhere safe.
Kiss\n\nA kiss is when people touch each other with their lips. People kiss to show love or to say hello. Friends might kiss on the cheek. Some kisses are quick, like a peck. Other kisses are longer. Kissing can spread germs, like a cold. But kissing also makes people feel happy.
Elevator\n\nAn elevator is a box that moves people up and down inside a tall building. You push a button to go to a different floor. The elevator has doors that open and close. It is pulled by strong ropes or pushed by a special machine. Elevators are very safe. They help people who cannot walk up stairs. Some elevators are see-through, so you can look out while you ride.
Honeyguide\n\nA honeyguide is a bird that lives in warm places like Africa and Asia. Some honeyguides show people where to find bee nests. When people open the nest, the bird eats the wax and baby bees left behind. Honeyguide mothers lay their eggs in other birds' nests. The baby honeyguide hatches first and uses its sharp beak to push out the other eggs or baby birds. This way, the honeyguide gets all the food from the other bird parents.
Speed of light\n\nThe speed of light is how fast light moves. Light travels very, very fast. It is the fastest thing in the whole universe. Nothing can go faster than light. Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth. That means when you see the Sun, you are seeing light that left the Sun 8 minutes ago. The speed of light is always the same, no matter if you are moving or standing still. This is different from how a ball moves. If you throw a ball from a moving train, someone on the ground sees the ball go faster than someone on the train. But light does not act that way. Light always goes the same speed for everyone. This idea was discovered by a man named Albert Einstein. He used it to make a famous idea called special relativity. The speed of light is very important for scientists who study space and time.
Cherokee\n\nThe Cherokee are a group of Native American people. Long ago, they lived in the eastern and southern parts of the United States. They did not live in tepees. They lived in houses made from wood. A man named Sequoyah made a way to write the Cherokee language. The Cherokee had two chiefs: a red chief for war and a white chief for peace. Later, the United States government made most Cherokee people move to a place called Oklahoma.
Sword\n\nA sword is a tool for cutting, made long ago for fighting. It has a long metal part called a blade and a handle called a hilt. Some swords have a guard to keep your hand safe. Swords can be used to cut, slash, or stab. Long ago, before guns, many people used swords. Today, swords are mostly used in sports like fencing or in shows. There are many kinds of swords, like the curved saber or the straight broadsword. Some famous swords are make-believe, like King Arthur's sword Excalibur.
Mount St. Helens\n\nMount St. Helens is a volcano in the state of Washington. A volcano is a mountain that can shoot hot rocks and ash into the sky. This volcano is famous for a big explosion on May 18, 1980. Before that day, it was a tall, snowy mountain with a pointy top. Then the top blew off, and the mountain became shorter. Hot gas, rocks, and ash came out for many hours. The ash went high into the air and spread far away. Mud made from ash and melted snow rushed down the rivers. The explosion knocked down trees and destroyed houses and roads. 57 people died. After the big explosion, the volcano kept making small puffs of steam and ash for many years. A new pile of rock grew inside the hole at the top. Today, scientists watch the volcano to see if it will wake up again.
Laser\n\nA laser is a machine that makes a very strong, single-color beam of light. It uses special materials like crystals or gases to make the light. The light from a laser goes in one straight line and does not spread out like a flashlight. Lasers are used in many things you see every day. They read the music on a CD or DVD. They scan the barcodes on things at the store. Doctors use lasers to fix people's eyes. Strong lasers can cut metal. People also use small lasers as pointers to show things on a screen. Some lasers measure how far away the Moon is by bouncing light off mirrors left there.
Sawfish\n\nA sawfish is a fish that looks like a shark but is really a ray. It has a long, flat snout with little teeth on the sides, like a saw. Sawfish use their saw to dig in the sand for food and to hit other fish to stun them. They can also feel tiny movements in the water with their saw. Sawfish live in warm, shallow water near the shore.
Van\n\nA van is a big car that can carry things or people. Some vans are small and carry just a few boxes or a few people. Other vans are big and can carry many people, like a school van that takes kids to school. Some vans are used to deliver packages to your house. Vans have a big empty space in the back for putting stuff. They look like a box on wheels. Some vans have sliding doors on the side. People use vans for work, for family trips, or to move furniture from one house to another.
Lever\n\nA lever is a long stick that can move around a point called the fulcrum. Levers help us lift heavy things or move things more easily. There are three kinds of levers. In a first-class lever, the fulcrum is in the middle, like a seesaw. In a second-class lever, the load is in the middle, like a wheelbarrow. In a third-class lever, the push is in the middle, like a stapler. Your arm is also a lever. Levers are one of the six simple machines.
Dracula\n\nDracula is a scary story about a monster called a vampire. A vampire drinks blood and comes out at night. The story was written a long time ago by a man named Bram Stoker. In the story, a man named Jonathan Harker goes to a faraway place called Transylvania to meet a rich man named Dracula. But Dracula is not a man — he is a vampire. He traps Jonathan in his castle and then goes to England on a ship. In England, he bites a woman named Lucy and turns her into a vampire too. Her friends have to stop her. Then Dracula bites another woman named Mina. The friends chase Dracula all the way back to his castle and kill him so he can never hurt anyone again.
Pipe organ\n\nA pipe organ is a big musical instrument that makes sounds when air blows through pipes. A person who plays it is called an organist. The organist uses hands to play keyboards and feet to play pedals. The pipes are made of metal or wood. Small pipes make high sounds, and big pipes make low sounds. The organist can pull out knobs called stops to change how the organ sounds. Some pipes sound like flutes, and some sound like trumpets. Pipe organs are often found in churches and big halls. They can be very large and take up a whole room.
Legend\n\nA legend is a story that people tell each other. Some legends are about real people, and some are not. Legends can be about famous people, places, or things that are very old. For example, Robin Hood and the Loch Ness Monster are legends. People have told these stories for a very long time.
Starfish\n\nA starfish is an animal that lives in the ocean on the sea floor. It has five or more arms that come out from a round center. Starfish do not have a brain or blood. They use sea water to move things around inside their bodies. Most starfish eat clams, mussels, and other shell animals. They can pull open the shells with their tiny tube feet and put their stomach inside to eat. Starfish can grow back arms if they lose them. If an arm has a little piece of the center, a whole new starfish can grow from it.
Saint Kitts and Nevis\n\nSaint Kitts and Nevis is a small country made of two islands in the Caribbean Sea. It is the smallest country in the Americas. The capital city is Basseterre, on the bigger island called Saint Kitts. The other island is Nevis. The islands have tall mountains covered in rainforest. Many rivers flow down from the mountains. People live near the sea. Cricket is a popular sport there. The country once helped host the Cricket World Cup. Some runners from Saint Kitts and Nevis have won medals in big races.
Circadian rhythm\n\nA circadian rhythm is like a clock inside your body that runs for about one whole day. It tells you when to wake up and when to feel sleepy. Plants and animals have this clock too. It helps flowers open at the right time and animals know when to rest. Your body uses this clock for eating, sleeping, and staying warm. When the sun comes up, your clock says it is time to be awake. When it gets dark, your clock says it is time to sleep.
Stove\n\nA stove is a thing that gets very hot. Some stoves burn wood or coal to make a room warm. A kitchen stove is used for cooking food. It has hot parts on top where you put pots and pans. Some stoves have an oven underneath for baking bread and cakes.
Word\n\nA word is something you say with your mouth that has meaning. Words are part of sentences. You can also write words with letters. Some words have more than one meaning, like 'spring' which can be a season or a thing that bounces. Some words sound the same but are spelled differently. Every language has its own words. You can find the meaning of words in a dictionary.
Gallon\n\nA gallon is a way to measure how much liquid something can hold. People use gallons to buy gas for cars. In some countries, a gallon is a little bigger than 4 big water bottles. In other countries, a gallon is a little smaller than that. Different places use different kinds of gallons.
Brahma\n\nBrahma is a god in the Hindu religion. He is the one who made the whole world and everything in it. Brahma is one of three very important gods. The other two are Vishnu, who takes care of the world, and Shiva, who changes things when they are old.
Tense (grammar)\n\nTense is a way to show when something happens. There are three main tenses: past, present, and future. Past tense tells about things that already happened, like 'I walked'. Present tense tells about things happening now, like 'I walk'. Future tense tells about things that will happen, like 'I will walk'. Sometimes we change the word to show tense, like 'be' becomes 'was' for past. Other times we add words like 'will' for future. Some languages, like Chinese, add new words instead of changing the verb.
African buffalo\n\nThe African buffalo is a big animal with hooves. It is also called the Cape buffalo. It can be very tall and heavy. The males are bigger than the females. African buffaloes are strong and can fight off lions and crocodiles. They eat grass and plants. They are not tame like cows. Some people think they are very dangerous.
Aurora\n\nAn aurora is colorful light in the sky. It is also called the northern lights or southern lights. You can see it at night near the North Pole or South Pole. The lights look like green, red, and purple curtains moving in the sky. They happen when tiny bits from the Sun hit the air around Earth. The lights can stretch for many miles. People have told stories about the aurora for a long time. You can even see stars through the lights. Other planets like Jupiter and Saturn have auroras too.
Rosetta Stone\n\nThe Rosetta Stone is a big stone with writing carved into it. It has three kinds of writing: Greek, Egyptian, and another Egyptian writing. French soldiers found it in Egypt a long time ago, in 1799. The stone helped people learn how to read the old Egyptian picture writing called hieroglyphics. The writing on the stone said the same thing in two languages. People already knew how to read the Greek part, so they used it to figure out the Egyptian parts. The stone is named after the city where it was found, Rosetta. Now it is in a museum in London called the British Museum.
Circuit breaker\n\nA circuit breaker is a special switch that turns off the power when too much electricity flows. This can happen if you plug in too many things or if something goes wrong with the wires. The circuit breaker lives in a metal box in your house. Inside, there is a coil that pulls the switch when too much electricity passes through. There is also a strip that bends when it gets hot and turns the power off. A circuit breaker works like a fuse, but you do not have to throw it away. You can just flip the switch back on.
Temple\n\nA temple is a special building where people go to pray and do things for their religion. Different religions have different names for their temples. Christians call their temples churches. People go to temples to be quiet, to think, and to talk to God. Some temples are very old and have pretty statues and pictures inside.
Natural gas\n\nNatural gas is a mix of gases that comes from deep in the ground. It is mostly made of a gas called methane. People use natural gas to make heat and energy. It burns with a blue flame. We use it to cook food, heat our homes, and make electricity. Natural gas travels through pipes to get to houses and factories. It can also be used to make things like plastic and fertilizer for plants.
Cucumber\n\nA cucumber is a green food that grows on a climbing plant. It looks like a long, bumpy tube. Cucumbers need warm weather, sun, and water to grow. People can eat them raw, cook them, or put them in vinegar to make pickles. Some people take out the inside and fill it with other food like cheese. Cucumbers are fruits, but most people call them vegetables.
Microwave\n\nA microwave is a kind of wave that you cannot see. It is like light, but your eyes cannot see it. Microwaves can go through the air and through some things. People use microwaves to heat up food in a microwave oven. The oven makes the tiny bits inside the food move very fast, and that makes the food hot. Microwaves are also used to talk to spaceships far away. You should never put your hand inside a microwave oven when it is on, because the waves can hurt you.
Rio Grande\n\nThe Rio Grande is a very long river. It starts high up in the mountains in Colorado. Then it flows through New Mexico and Texas. It also makes the line between the United States and Mexico. The river ends in the Gulf of Mexico, which is a big body of water. The name Rio Grande means "big river" in Spanish.
Autocracy\n\nAutocracy is a way of running a country where one person has all the power. That person, called an autocrat, makes every rule and choice. No one else can say no. The autocrat may use tricks, lies, or force to keep control. Some countries with an autocracy have a king or queen who makes all the rules. Other countries have a dictator who took power by force. In an autocracy, people cannot vote for their leaders or say what they want freely. Long ago, many countries were run this way. Today, some countries still are.
Joke\n\nA joke is something you say or do to make people laugh. Some jokes are questions with funny answers. Some jokes are stories with a surprise at the end. You can find jokes in books, on the internet, or from your friends. Jokes can be about anything. Some jokes can hurt people's feelings, so it is important to be kind. People tell jokes in movies and plays. An example of a joke is: Why did the chicken cross the road? To get to the other side.
Arachnid\n\nArachnids are animals with eight legs. They have two body parts and no wings or antennae. Spiders, scorpions, ticks, and mites are all arachnids. Arachnids have a hard outside shell. Most arachnids eat bugs and other small animals. They use their front legs to grab food and put juice on it to make it soft. Then they suck up the food. The word 'arachnid' comes from a story about a girl named Arachne who was turned into a spider.
Birmingham\n\nBirmingham is a big city in England. It is the second biggest city in the United Kingdom. Many people live there. Long ago, Birmingham was a small town. Then it grew big because people made things there, like weapons and food. They also made airplanes called Spitfires for a big war. Today, they make Jaguar and Land Rover cars. Birmingham has canals, which are like water roads for boats. It also has many roads and motorways for cars.
Long jump\n\nThe long jump is a sport where people try to jump as far as they can. First, they run very fast down a path. Then they jump into a big pit filled with soft sand. The person who jumps the farthest wins. There is a line on the ground, and you must not step past it when you jump. If you fall backwards, you might not jump as far.
Iron\n\nIron is a metal. It is strong and cheap. People use iron to make buildings, bridges, nails, and screws. Iron is magnetic, so a magnet can pull it. When iron gets wet and stays in the air, it turns into rust. Rust is a brown, flaky stuff that makes iron fall apart. Iron is also in your body. It helps your blood carry air to your muscles. You can find iron in meat and some cereals. Too much iron can make you sick, but a little bit is good for you.
Costa Rica\n\nCosta Rica is a country in Central America. It is between Nicaragua and Panama. The Pacific Ocean is on one side, and the Caribbean Sea is on the other side. The people there speak Spanish. The capital city is San José. Costa Rica does not have an army. Instead, it spends money on schools and doctors. Many trees and animals live there. There are lots of national parks where you can see monkeys, birds, and colorful frogs. The weather is warm all year. It has two seasons: a dry season and a rainy season. Coffee and bananas grow there and are sent to other countries.
Wolverine\n\nA wolverine is a strong animal that looks a little like a small bear. It has brown fur that keeps it warm in very cold places. Wolverines live in snowy places like Canada, Alaska, and Siberia. They have big feet that help them walk on top of snow. Wolverines eat many kinds of food, like mice, birds, and eggs. They are very strong and can catch animals bigger than themselves. A mother wolverine has one to three babies, called kits, in a den under the snow. People hunt wolverines for their warm fur. Wolverines have a very good nose and can smell food under the snow.
Beetle\n\nA beetle is a kind of insect. There are many, many kinds of beetles all over the world. They live almost everywhere except in the ocean and very cold places like Antarctica. A beetle has a hard, shiny body on the outside. Its body has three parts: the head, the middle part, and the back part. On its head, a beetle has two feelers, two eyes, and a mouth. It has six legs and two pairs of wings. The front wings are hard covers that protect the back wings. When a beetle wants to fly, it lifts the hard covers up. Not all beetles can fly. Some have no back wings, and some have no wings at all. Beetles use their legs to walk, run, swim, or dig. Some beetles can jump. Beetles see with big eyes that are made of many tiny parts. They smell and feel with their feelers. A beetle's mouth has two hard parts that crush and cut food. Beetles do not breathe like we do. They have tiny holes on their sides that let air in. Beetles start as eggs. A baby beetle comes out of the egg. It looks very different from the grown-up beetle. The baby eats and grows, then turns into a pupa. When the pupa opens, a grown-up beetle comes out. Beetles eat many things, like plants, dead plants, dead animals, and animal poop. Some beetles eat only one kind of food. Beetles have ways to stay safe. Some hide. Some have colors that make them hard to see. Some have bright colors to warn other animals that they taste bad. Some beetles spray bad-smelling liquid. Some big beetles fight with their mouth parts. Male beetles sometimes fight each other to get a female. Then the female lays eggs, and the whole life starts again.
Sirius\n\nSirius is the brightest star in the night sky. It is actually two stars that go around each other. One star is called Sirius A, and it is bigger and brighter than our Sun. The other star is called Sirius B, and it is a small, hot star that used to be big but now is tiny. Sirius looks very bright because it is close to Earth. Long ago, people in Egypt watched Sirius to know when the river would flood. Some people call Sirius the Dog Star. The hottest days of summer are sometimes called the dog days of summer.
Adaptation\n\nAdaptation is how animals and plants change over a very long time to live better in their home. A horse has teeth that keep growing so it can eat grass all day without wearing them down. Horses can also run very fast to get away from lions. Birds have different beaks for eating different foods. Some animals live in dark caves and lose their eyes because they do not need them anymore. Adaptations are not perfect; they are a trade-off. For example, a peacock has a big, colorful tail to find a mate, but that tail makes it hard to fly and easy for enemies to see.
Supernova\n\nA supernova is a giant star that blows up. It happens when a very big star runs out of energy and its middle part falls in. Then the whole star explodes with a huge bang. The explosion is so bright that it can shine more than a whole galaxy for a little while. After the explosion, what is left can become a black hole or a neutron star. Most stars are small and do not explode. They just get colder and smaller. Supernovas do not happen very often. The last time people saw one in our own galaxy was in the year 1604. But we see about 300 supernovas in other galaxies every year. Supernovas are important because they make heavy elements. Those are the special things that living things need. Without supernovas, there would be no life on Earth. A supernova close to Earth could be dangerous, but there are no big stars near us that could explode.
Chinese New Year\n\nChinese New Year is a big holiday for Chinese people all over the world. It happens in winter, between January 21 and February 20, because it follows the moon. The holiday is a time for family to get together and eat big meals. Children get red envelopes with money inside as gifts. The holiday lasts for 15 days and ends with a Lantern Festival. Each year is named after an animal, like Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Goat, Monkey, Rooster, Dog, or Pig. People think the animal of your birth year can tell something about you.
Water vapor\n\nWater vapor is water that has turned into a gas you cannot see. When water gets very hot, it changes from liquid to gas. This is part of the water cycle. Steam is not water vapor; steam is tiny drops of liquid water floating in the air. Real water vapor is invisible. It is lighter than air, so it rises up. The amount of water vapor in the air is called humidity. Warm air can hold more water vapor than cold air. When water vapor cools down, it turns back into liquid water and makes clouds or fog.
Wild boar\n\nA wild boar is a big, strong animal that looks like a pig. It has a large head, short legs, and a tail that moves fast to show how it feels. Wild boars live in many places around the world, like forests and grasslands. They eat both plants and small animals. A mother wild boar gives birth to 4 to 6 babies, called piglets. The piglets are small and drink their mother's milk. After a few weeks, they start eating worms and bugs. Long ago, people used the hair from a wild boar's neck to make toothbrushes because the hair was soft.
Isaac\n\nIsaac is a man from a very old story in the Bible. He was the son of Abraham and Sarah. God told them they would have a baby, but they were very old and laughed. So they named the baby Isaac, which means laughter. Isaac grew up and married Rebecca. He had two sons named Esau and Jacob.
Soil\n\nSoil is the dirt on the ground where plants grow. It is made of tiny pieces of rock, water, air, and old dead plants and animals. Plants put their roots in soil to stand up and get food and water. Many animals live in soil, like worms and bugs. Worms make holes that let air and water go into the soil. Soil has different sizes of rock pieces: sand feels rough, silt feels smooth, and clay feels slippery. The best soil for growing food has a mix of sand, silt, and clay. Soil also has layers. The top layer has lots of old dead plants, and deeper down there is more rock. Soil is different in different places because the weather and rocks are different.
Bacteria\n\nBacteria are very tiny living things. They are so small you can only see them with a microscope. Each bacterium is just one cell. Bacteria live almost everywhere: in the ground, in water, and even inside your body. Some bacteria can make you sick, but many are helpful. Helpful bacteria help your body digest food and are used to make cheese and yogurt. Bacteria make more bacteria by splitting in half. They come in different shapes: some are round like balls, some are long like rods, and some are twisty like spirals.
Runes\n\nRunes are very old letters that people in Scandinavia used a long time ago, before they started using the letters we use today. The first six rune letters are F, U, A, R, K, and that is why the rune alphabet is called Fuark. People carved runes into big stones, called runestones, and you can find these stones in places like Denmark, Norway, and Sweden. Runes were used to write poems and stories. Some people still use runes today for secret codes. A famous writer named J. R. R. Tolkien used runes in his books about hobbits and elves.
Rhododendron\n\nA rhododendron is a plant with pretty flowers. It grows in many places, mostly in Asia. Some rhododendrons have green leaves all year, and some lose their leaves in winter. The flowers are very bright and colorful. Many people grow rhododendrons in their garden or in a pot. A kind of rhododendron is called an azalea. It is the special flower of a country called Nepal.
Giant\n\nA giant is a very big make-believe person. In old stories, giants are much bigger and stronger than real people. Some stories say giants live in faraway lands or on top of tall mountains. They are not real, but people like to tell tales about them.
Norwegian Sea\n\nThe Norwegian Sea is a big body of salt water next to Norway. It is part of the Atlantic Ocean. The sea is very deep, about two kilometers down. Warm water from the Atlantic keeps it from freezing, even in winter. Many fish live there, like herring and cod. Whales also visit the sea to eat the fish. People catch fish and find oil and gas under the sea floor. Birds like puffins and seagulls live near the water.
Mangrove\n\nMangroves are trees that grow in salty water near the ocean in hot places. They have twisted roots that stick up out of the mud like little straws to help them breathe. Their seeds fall from the tree and start growing as soon as they touch dirt or water. The roots catch dirt and sand, which can make new land or small islands over time. Mangroves help keep the water clean for fish and coral reefs. Many fish, shrimp, and crabs live in the mangrove roots.
Coronavirus\n\nCoronavirus is a tiny germ that can make people and animals sick. It is so small you cannot see it without a special tool. The name means "crown" because the germ looks like it has a crown on its outside. Some coronaviruses give people a mild cold, but others can make them very sick. The most famous one is the kind that caused COVID-19. People can catch the germ from each other when they cough or sneeze. Washing hands and staying home when sick helps stop the germ from spreading.
Bible\n\nThe Bible is a very special book that many people love. It is actually a group of books all put together. The word "Bible" means "books" in an old language. The Bible is the best-selling book in the whole world. Many people believe it tells about God. The Bible has two big parts. The first part is called the Old Testament. It tells old stories about God and people long ago. One story is about Noah and his big boat called an ark. The second part is called the New Testament. It tells about Jesus, who was born, lived, taught people, and helped them. It also tells about his friends who shared his stories. The Bible was written a very long time ago in different languages. Now people can read it in many languages, including English. Some parts of the Bible are songs and poems. Other parts are stories and rules. Many families read the Bible at home or at a place called church.
Trail\n\nA trail is a path in nature where people can walk. Some trails are for walking only, and some are for bikes or horses. Trails can be short for a quick walk or very long, even more than a thousand miles. People use trails to see trees, animals, and pretty views. Some trails have stairs made of dirt or rocks to go up hills. In winter, people make trails in the snow for skiing.
Company\n\nA company is a group of people who work together to do something. It can be a small business or a big one. The law treats a company like its own person. This means the company is in charge if something goes wrong, not the people who work there. A company can keep going even if the people in it leave. People can own parts of a company, which are called shares. Many companies are run by the people who own them. A company starts when the government says it can.
Grazer\n\nA grazer is an animal that eats grass. Grazers have special teeth and tummies to help them chew and digest grass. Horses are grazers. Cows and sheep are grazers too. If grazers eat too much grass in one place and do not let it grow back, that is called overgrazing.
Ink\n\nInk is a colored liquid that people use to write, draw, or print. It comes in many colors like black, blue, red, and green. You can find ink inside pens and printers. Long ago, people made ink from soot and water. Today, ink is made from special dyes. Some ink can smudge if it gets wet, so you have to be careful. Ballpoint pens use a thick ink that does not leak, so you can write with them anywhere.
Noise\n\nNoise is a sound that you do not want to hear. It can be too loud and hurt your ears. Loud noise for a long time can make it hard to hear. People measure noise with a tool. Some noise, like white noise, sounds like a soft hiss and can help you sleep. Other noise comes from cars, people talking, or machines. Many things are made to make less noise so sounds are clear.
Laundry\n\nLaundry is washing your clothes to make them clean. You can do laundry in a special room called a laundry room. Some houses have a laundry room, and some big buildings share one. There are also stores called laundromats where you can wash your clothes. To do laundry, you put soap and water on the clothes and move them around a lot. Then you rinse them in clean water. You can wash clothes by hand or use a washing machine. After washing, you dry the clothes in a dryer or hang them on a clothesline. Sometimes people iron the dry clothes to make them smooth.
Antigua and Barbuda\n\nAntigua and Barbuda is a country made of two islands in the warm Caribbean Sea. The islands are near the big Atlantic Ocean. The capital city is St. John's, on the island of Antigua. About 81,800 people live there. Long ago, the first people to live there were hunters and farmers. Later, people from Europe came on ships. They brought many people from Africa to work on farms growing sugar. Today, many people visit Antigua and Barbuda for vacation. They enjoy the sunny beaches and warm weather. The people speak English and a special way of talking called Antiguan Creole.
Shinto\n\nShinto is a kind of religion from Japan. It has many spirits called kami. Some kami are spirits of places like mountains or rivers. One important kami is the sun goddess named Amaterasu. The word Shinto means 'the way of the gods.' People in Japan sometimes go to shrines to say hello to the kami. They have festivals with music and dancing. Some people also follow Buddhist ways at the same time.
Chinese characters\n\nChinese characters are special pictures that people use to write in Chinese and Japanese. A long, long time ago, people in Korea and Vietnam also used them. These pictures are very old, more than 3000 years old. In Chinese, they are called "hanzi," which means "Han character." In Japanese, they are called "kanji." Each character stands for a whole word, not just a sound. Long ago, many characters were simple drawings of things, like a picture of a tree or a house. Today, most characters are made by putting two or more simple pictures together. Some characters show what a word means, and some help you know how to say the word. Nobody knows exactly how many Chinese characters there are, but big dictionaries list about fifty thousand. Most people only need to know three or four thousand to read and write every day. Writing Chinese characters nicely is called calligraphy, and it is a kind of art.
Cormorant\n\nA cormorant is a bird that lives near water. It has dark feathers and a long, thin beak with a hook at the end. Its feet have skin between all four toes to help it swim. A cormorant can dive under water for up to 4 minutes to catch fish. Some cormorants have bright blue, orange, red, or yellow skin on their faces. They live on rocky shores, islands, and near lakes and rivers.
Chrysanthemum\n\nA chrysanthemum is a flower that comes in many colors like yellow, white, pink, and red. It has many tiny petals that grow close together in a round shape. These flowers come from Asia and Europe. People like to plant them in gardens or put them in vases inside their homes. They bloom in the fall when the weather gets cooler.
Communications satellite\n\nA communications satellite is a big machine that goes up into space. It sends signals from one place on Earth to another. The signals can be TV shows, phone calls, or internet. The satellite stays high above the ground and moves around the Earth. It helps people talk to each other even when they are far away, like on a ship in the ocean. Some satellites send many TV channels to homes. The first person to think of using satellites for talking was Arthur C. Clarke. Now we have many satellites in space that help us every day.
Bed\n\nA bed is a piece of furniture that people sleep on. It has a soft mattress on a frame. Many beds have sheets to cover the mattress and a pillow for your head. Beds come in different sizes like single, double, and king. Long ago, people slept on piles of straw or leaves. Some old beds had ash underneath to keep bugs away. Today, there are many kinds of beds, including camp cots and air mattresses.
Karakoram\n\nThe Karakoram is a very tall mountain range in Asia. It is the second highest mountain range in the world, after the Himalayas. The name means "black gravel" in an old language. The Karakoram has eight very high mountains, and the tallest one is called K2. K2 is the second highest mountain on Earth. The mountains are covered with ice and snow, and there are many big glaciers there. Glaciers are like slow-moving rivers of ice. The Karakoram has more glaciers than almost anywhere else. Some of the glaciers are very long, like the Siachen Glacier and the Biafo Glacier. The mountains also have lakes and hot springs. The Karakoram is in several countries, including China, India, and Pakistan. It helps keep the wind from Siberia from blowing into a place called Kashmir.
Carrot\n\nA carrot is a plant that grows in the ground. The part we eat is the orange root. Carrots can be eaten raw or cooked. They are crunchy and taste a little sweet. Carrots are good for your eyes and help keep you healthy. You can find them in many dishes like salads and soups.
Centaur\n\nA centaur is a make-believe creature from old stories. It has a person's head, arms, and chest on top, and a horse's body and legs on the bottom. Some centaurs are girls. They lived in faraway lands like Thessaly and Cyprus. Centaurs were wild and free, just like wild horses. Two famous centaurs are Chiron and Nessus.
Silkworm\n\nA silkworm is a baby moth that makes silk. It is a caterpillar that eats mulberry leaves. Silkworms live only with people, not in the wild. A mother silkworm lays about 300 tiny eggs on mulberry leaves. The eggs hatch into little worms. The worm spins a soft, shiny house called a cocoon. The cocoon is made of one long, thin thread of silk. People boil the cocoons to get the silk thread. They use the silk to make clothes and other things. Adult silkworms are white and fuzzy. They have wings but cannot fly. They do not eat. In some places, people eat silkworm pupae as a snack.
Aardvark\n\nAn aardvark is an animal from Africa. Its name means "earth pig" because it digs in the ground. An aardvark has a long nose, a long sticky tongue, and a thin body. Its fur is pale yellow-gray and sometimes looks red from dirt. It has short hair on its head and tail, but longer hair on its legs. An aardvark is awake at night and sleeps during the day. It eats ants and termites by licking them up with its long tongue. It can dig a tunnel very fast. It is a good swimmer. A baby aardvark is called a cub. The cub stays with its mother until it is big enough to dig its own home.
Houston\n\nHouston is a big city in Texas. Many people live there, more than 2 million. It is named after a man named Samuel Houston. Houston has a place where astronauts work, called the Johnson Space Center. It also has a big hospital area called the Texas Medical Center. There are two big airports in Houston. People in Houston like sports. They have baseball, basketball, football, and soccer teams. The weather in Houston is warm and wet.
Haiku\n\nA haiku is a short poem from Japan. It has three parts. The first part has five sounds. The second part has seven sounds. The third part has five sounds. Many haiku talk about nature or the seasons. In English, people write haiku on three lines.
Ten Commandments\n\nThe Ten Commandments are ten special rules that the Bible says God gave to the people of Israel a long time ago. These rules were written on two flat stones. They tell people how to be good and kind. Some of the rules are: do not steal, do not lie, do not hurt other people, and love your mom and dad. Another rule says to rest on a special day of the week. These rules are very important for Jewish and Christian people.
Hoe (tool)\n\nA hoe is a tool used in farming and gardening. It has a long handle, usually made of wood, with a flat metal piece at the end. People use a hoe to pull out weeds from the ground. They also use it to shape the dirt and dig up vegetables like potatoes that grow underground. A hoe is a very important tool for people who grow food.
Veganism\n\nVeganism is when people choose not to use animals. Vegans do not eat meat, eggs, or milk. They also do not use things made from animals, like leather or wool. Instead, they eat fruits, vegetables, beans, grains, nuts, and seeds. Some people become vegan because they want to help animals or the planet. Vegans need to eat special foods to get all the vitamins their bodies need.
Great Britain\n\nGreat Britain is a big island in the ocean near Europe. It is the biggest island in Europe. Three countries are on Great Britain: England, Scotland, and Wales. The biggest city on the island is London. Great Britain is part of the United Kingdom. The United Kingdom also includes Northern Ireland, but Northern Ireland is not on the island of Great Britain. Some people call the United Kingdom "Great Britain," but that is not quite right. Great Britain is just the island, not the whole country.
Turkmenistan\n\nTurkmenistan is a country in the middle of Asia. It is next to Afghanistan, Iran, Kazakhstan, and Uzbekistan. It does not touch the ocean, but it touches the Caspian Sea. The capital city is Ashgabat. Most of the country is very dry desert. It is one of the driest places in the world. The big desert is called the Karakum Desert. The weather is hot in summer and mild in winter. Turkmenistan used to be part of a big group of countries called the Soviet Union. It became its own country in 1991.
Steamboat\n\nA steamboat is a kind of boat that moves using steam. Steam is made when water gets very hot and turns into a cloud. The steam pushes the boat through the water. Some old steamboats had big wheels with paddles on the sides or at the back. These boats went up and down rivers. Later, steamboats got faster and could go in the ocean. People used steamboats to travel and carry things long ago.
Information technology\n\nInformation technology is a big word for using computers and machines to handle information. Information is things like words, pictures, sounds, and videos. People use information technology to save pictures, send messages, play games, and watch movies on phones and computers. It helps people all over the world talk to each other. Many jobs use information technology to keep information safe and easy to find.
Christ the Redeemer (statue)\n\nChrist the Redeemer is a big statue of Jesus Christ. It stands on top of a tall mountain called Corcovado in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The statue looks over the whole city. It was built a long time ago, between 1922 and 1931. Workers climbed up high to build it, and no one got hurt, which people thought was a miracle. The statue was made in France and then brought to Brazil. Sometimes lightning hits the statue, so workers put special rods on it to keep it safe. Many people visit the statue to see the beautiful view.
History of science\n\nThe history of science is about how people learned about the world around them. A long time ago, people who studied nature were called natural philosophers. They watched the sky, the stars, and the animals. Some old Greek people, like Thales and Aristotle, were very interested in how things work. Later, smart people like Isaac Newton and Albert Einstein helped us understand more. Today, scientists use special ways to learn new things, and that is called science.
Encyclopedia\n\nAn encyclopedia is a book or a website with lots of information. It tells you about many different things, like animals, places, and people. Long ago, all encyclopedias were printed in books. Now, many are on the internet. The biggest English encyclopedia is called Wikipedia. It has millions of articles. Some encyclopedias are about one thing, like medicine or ships. Others have facts about everything. You can look up words in an encyclopedia to learn new things.
Energy\n\nEnergy is what makes things move, grow, and change. The sun gives us energy to keep warm. Food gives us energy to run and play. Energy can be in many forms, like heat, light, and sound. You cannot see energy, but you can see what it does. A ball rolling has energy. A fire gives off heat energy. Energy never goes away. It just changes from one kind to another. When you eat food, your body turns it into energy to play. When you turn on a light, electricity changes into light and heat. Scientists measure energy in units called joules.
Eastern Europe\n\nEastern Europe is a big part of the continent called Europe. It is the eastern side of Europe. Long ago, it meant the countries that followed a certain kind of church. Later, it meant the countries that were friends with the Soviet Union. Today, people use it to talk about countries like Poland, Ukraine, and Russia. Many people in Eastern Europe speak Slavic languages. There are also many Roma people, sometimes called gypsies. Some countries in Eastern Europe are also called Central Europe or Southeastern Europe.
Service (economics)\n\nA service is something people do for you, like cutting your hair or fixing a broken toy. You pay for the work, not for a thing you can hold. When someone mows your grass, that is a service. When a builder makes a house, that is also a service, and you get a house at the end. You do not own the service, but you might own what the service makes.
Malaysia\n\nMalaysia is a country in Southeast Asia. It has many people from different groups, like Malay, Chinese, and Indian. The country has 13 states and 3 special areas. Kuala Lumpur is the biggest city. Malaysia is hot and has lots of forests and animals. People there speak Malay, English, Chinese, and Tamil. The king is called the Yang di-Pertuan Agong. The leader of the government is the Prime Minister. Malaysia makes things like electronics and grows food like rice. People eat spicy noodles called laksa and drink a sweet tea called teh tarik. Badminton player Lee Chong Wei and squash player Nicol David are famous athletes from Malaysia.
Tire\n\nA tire is a round ring made of rubber that goes around a wheel. Cars, trucks, and many other vehicles use tires to move smoothly. Tires help the vehicle grip the road so it does not slip. Tires come in different sizes and have patterns on them to help with grip. Some tires are made for snow and ice, and some are made for dirt and rocks. Tires can get holes from nails, and then they lose air. When the patterns on a tire wear away, it is time to get new tires.
Halley's Comet\n\nHalley's Comet is a big ball of ice and dust that flies through space. It comes near Earth every 75 or 76 years. You can see it in the sky without a telescope. A man named Edmond Halley figured out that it comes back again and again. The last time it came close was in 1986. Some space robots flew near it and took pictures. They found out that the comet is made of ice, dust, and frozen gases. When it gets close to the Sun, the ice melts and makes a long, bright tail. The next time Halley's Comet will be near Earth is in the year 2061.
Dimetrodon\n\nDimetrodon was an animal that lived a very long time ago, before dinosaurs. It walked on four legs and had a big head with sharp teeth. The most special thing about Dimetrodon was the big sail on its back. The sail was made of long bones with skin in between. Dimetrodon used its sail to warm up in the sun or cool down in the shade. It ate meat and was a top hunter. Fossils of Dimetrodon have been found in the United States and Germany.
Ho Chi Minh City\n\nHo Chi Minh City is a big city in southern Vietnam. It is the biggest city in Vietnam, and about 9 million people live there. Long ago, the city was called Saigon, and many people still call it Saigon today. The city is very flat, like a big table. When it rains a lot, the streets can get flooded with water. The city has many trees, and fresh food markets are everywhere. There are also wetlands with birds, monkeys, and snakes. People in the city speak Vietnamese, and many are learning English. The city has many hospitals and schools. Some people are very rich, and some are very poor. There are many fun places to eat and play.
Pickling\n\nPickling is a way to keep food good to eat for a long time. You put food in vinegar or salty water, and then close it in a jar. This makes the food taste different. It stops tiny germs from growing. People often add things like garlic or cinnamon to make it taste even better. Some foods that get pickled are eggs, onions, and other vegetables.
Globe\n\nA globe is a round ball that shows the whole world. It is a small model of the Earth. The globe is shaped like a ball, just like the real Earth. You can spin it around to see all the countries and oceans. Some globes show mountains and rivers. Others show the names of countries. A globe helps you see how big the world is and where different places are.
Czech language\n\nCzech is a language that people speak in a country called the Czech Republic. About ten million people use it to talk to each other. It sounds a lot like another language called Slovak, and people who speak Czech can understand Slovak speakers. Learning Czech can be hard because the words change their endings a lot, just like in Latin.
Athens\n\nAthens is a big city in Greece. It is one of the oldest cities in the world. Many people live there. The city has a famous old building called the Parthenon. Long ago, people in Athens started the first democracy, where people vote. Athens has a big airport and trains that go under the ground. There are also museums with old things to see.
Calligraphy\n\nCalligraphy is a way of writing that makes words look pretty. People use special pens or brushes to make the letters fancy. Long ago, people in some countries thought calligraphy was a very important art. Today, even school children learn to do it.
Canada\n\nCanada is a big country in North America. It is the second biggest country in the whole world. Canada has three oceans next to it: the Atlantic Ocean, the Pacific Ocean, and the Arctic Ocean. Most people in Canada live near the bottom part of the country, close to the United States. The biggest city is Toronto, and the capital city is Ottawa. Canada is very cold in winter, but warm in summer in the south. There are lots of forests and lakes. Canada has ten parts called provinces and three parts called territories. People in Canada can speak English or French. Long ago, people called Indigenous people lived there first. Then people from France and England came to live there too. Canada became its own country on July 1, 1867.
Plum\n\nA plum is a sweet fruit that grows on a tree. Plums can be purple, red, yellow, green, or white. They have a groove on one side and a big seed inside. The skin is soft and you can eat it. Plums are juicy and taste sweet. Some plums are sour and need sugar. When plums are dried, they are called prunes. You can make jam from plums. Plum trees have white flowers in spring and sometimes have thorns.
Sub-Saharan Africa\n\nSub-Saharan Africa is the part of Africa that is below the big hot desert called the Sahara. It has many countries with lots of different people, animals, and plants. The weather is warm, and there are big forests, grasslands, and rivers. Many children live there and play outside.
Wheelbarrow\n\nA wheelbarrow is a small cart that you push with your hands. It has one wheel in the front and two long handles in the back. People use it in gardens to carry heavy things like dirt, rocks, or plants. You put the heavy stuff in the big bucket part, then lift the handles and push. Some wheelbarrows have two wheels instead of one.
Movie festival\n\nA movie festival is a special time when many movies are shown to people. People go to a big building to watch different movies. Some movies are new and some are old. People clap for the movies they like. Sometimes the best movies get a prize.
Symmetry\n\nSymmetry is when something looks the same on both sides. If you draw a line down the middle of a picture, and both sides match, that is symmetry. A butterfly has symmetry because its left wing looks like its right wing. A square also has symmetry. Some things look the same even when you turn them around. That is another kind of symmetry. Many things in nature, like flowers and snowflakes, have symmetry.
Swimming pool\n\nA swimming pool is a big hole in the ground or a big tub filled with water. People go in the water to swim, play, or cool off when it is hot outside. Some pools are inside a building so you can swim even when it rains. Most pools are outside. The water is kept clean with a special chemical called chlorine that kills germs. A pump and a filter help keep the water clean too.
Image scanner\n\nAn image scanner is a machine that takes a picture of a paper or a photo and puts it into a computer. You put the paper on the glass, and the scanner shines a light on it. Then it turns the light into a picture on the computer screen. You can save that picture or print it out. Some scanners can also read words and turn them into text you can type with.
Foundation (engineering)\n\nA foundation is the bottom part of a building. It sits on the ground and holds the building up. A building needs a strong foundation to stand for a long time. To make a foundation, people dig a deep hole in the ground. They fill the hole with hard stuff like concrete. Sometimes they put long thin pieces of steel inside to make it even stronger. When the concrete dries hard, the building can be built on top.
Shrimp\n\nShrimp are small animals that live in water. They have a hard shell on the outside and many legs. Shrimp can swim backwards very fast. They live near the bottom of the ocean, rivers, and lakes. Shrimp eat tiny bits of food from the water. Bigger animals like fish and whales eat shrimp for dinner. People also eat shrimp. We take off the head and shell and eat the tail part. Shrimp are related to prawns, but prawns are bigger. A shrimp's heart is inside its head.
Tropic of Capricorn\n\nThe Tropic of Capricorn is an invisible line on a map of the Earth. It goes around the middle part of the Earth, below the middle. It is very far south. The sun shines right above this line on one special day each year. That day is in December, when it is winter for us. The line passes through some countries like Australia, South America, and Africa. Long ago, people named it after a star group called Capricorn.
Arabian Desert\n\nThe Arabian Desert is a very hot and sandy place in Asia. It covers most of the Arabian Peninsula. The sand is dry and the sun is very bright. Some animals live there, like gazelles, oryx, sand cats, and spiny-tailed lizards. But in the middle of the desert, called the Rub' al Khali, almost no animals live because it is too dry.
Democracy\n\nDemocracy is a way for people to choose their leaders. In a democracy, people vote to pick who makes the rules. This is different from a dictatorship, where one person has all the power. In many countries, people vote for a party, and the party with the most votes picks the leaders. Not everyone can vote. You have to be a citizen and old enough. Some places make voting a rule, and you have to pay a fine if you do not vote. Long ago, the Greeks started democracy in Athens. All citizens would meet and vote on laws. Today, most countries use representative democracy, where people choose leaders to make laws for them.
Iraq\n\nIraq is a country in Asia. It is between two big rivers called the Euphrates and the Tigris. Long ago, people there learned how to write. The capital city is Baghdad. Most people in Iraq are Muslims. Iraq has a lot of oil, which is a black liquid that can be used for fuel. The weather is very hot and dry. There is a place called Kurdistan inside Iraq where people have their own leaders and army.
Almond\n\nAn almond is a small nut that grows on a tree. The tree can be as tall as a house. It has green twigs that turn gray when they get older. The leaves are long, and the flowers are white or light pink with five petals. The almond nut is inside a hard shell. People take the shell off to eat the nut. Almonds come from places like Iran and other warm countries.
Utopia\n\nUtopia is a made-up name for a perfect place where everything is good and people are happy. A long time ago, a man named Thomas More wrote a book about an island that was a perfect place. The word utopia means 'no place' because it is not real. Some people try to make perfect places, but it is very hard. Heaven is like a utopia for some people.
Tutsan\n\nTutsan is a bushy plant that grows in Europe and Asia. It has pretty golden yellow flowers. After the flowers, it makes red berries that turn black when they are ready to eat. The leaves and flowers come out in the spring and fall off in the fall. People use Tutsan as a medicine to help them feel better.
Brown algae\n\nBrown algae are plants that live in the ocean. They are big and have a brown color. Many brown algae grow on rocks at the seashore. Some brown algae, like giant kelp, grow very tall and make underwater forests. Fish and other sea animals live in these forests. People also eat some brown algae. The Sargasso Sea has brown algae that float on top of the water.
West Africa\n\nWest Africa is a part of Africa that is on the west side. It has many countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Senegal. The weather is often hot and rainy. People there grow food like rice, yams, and cocoa. Some animals that live there are elephants, lions, and monkeys. Many people speak different languages and live in villages or big cities.
Indigenous peoples\n\nIndigenous people are the first people who lived in a place long before other people came. They are also called Native people or First Nations. Long ago, new people came and took their land and things. This was not fair. Indigenous people had to work hard to keep their land and be treated well. Today, many people work to make sure indigenous people are treated fairly and with respect.
Whisker\n\nA whisker is a long, thick hair that grows near the mouth of some animals like cats and mice. Animals use whiskers to feel things around them. Some animals also have whiskers above their eyes and on the backs of their legs. You should never cut a whisker because it helps the animal know where it is.
Ice hockey\n\nIce hockey is a sport played on ice. Two teams try to score by hitting a small black puck into a net. Players wear ice skates and carry sticks to push the puck. Each team has six players on the ice at once: three forwards, two defenders, and a goalie. The goalie stops the puck from going into the net. When someone breaks a rule, they sit in a penalty box for a few minutes. Ice hockey is very popular in Canada, Russia, Sweden, and the United States. The best players play in the NHL, which has 32 teams. The game has three parts called periods, each 20 minutes long. A referee drops the puck to start play. Ice hockey started in Canada a long time ago.
Bering Strait\n\nThe Bering Strait is a narrow strip of water between Russia and Alaska. It is like a door between two big lands. The water is not very deep, only about as deep as a tall tree. There are two small islands in the middle called the Diomede Islands. Some people have thought about building a bridge or a tunnel across the strait so cars and trains could go from one side to the other. But no one has built it yet because the place is very far away and not many people live there.
Refugee\n\nA refugee is a person who has to leave their home country. This can happen because of war, fighting, or because they are scared. They go to another country to be safe. Sometimes they ask for help to stay in the new country. Many people help refugees find a safe place to live.
Moon\n\nThe Moon is a big round rock in the sky. It goes around the Earth. You can see it at night, and sometimes during the day. The Moon is much smaller than Earth. It has no air or water. The sky on the Moon is always black, even when the Sun is shining. There are many round holes called craters on the Moon. They were made by space rocks hitting it. The Moon does not make its own light. It shines because the Sun lights it up. Sometimes we see the whole Moon, and sometimes only a little part. This is called the phases of the Moon. It takes about a month for the Moon to go through all its phases. People have walked on the Moon. The first person was Neil Armstrong in 1969. Their footprints are still there because there is no wind or rain to wash them away.
Enki\n\nEnki is a god from very old stories. People long ago said he was the god of water and knowing things. They thought he made two big rivers. Enki was also shown as a man pouring water. Some people thought he was a star in the sky. He is part of a picture in the sky called Aquarius.
Polynesia\n\nPolynesia is a big group of islands in the Pacific Ocean. These islands are inside a big triangle shape. The top of the triangle is Hawaii, the bottom left is New Zealand, and the bottom right is Easter Island. All the islands inside this triangle are called Polynesia. The water around them is very blue and warm. People live on many of these islands and have their own special ways of dancing, singing, and making boats.
Rapids\n\nRapids are parts of a river where the water moves very fast. They happen when water flows over rocks in the river. The water splashes and looks white, so people also call it whitewater. Some people ride boats on rapids for fun.
Alligator\n\nAn alligator is a big animal that lives in water and on land. It has a long body, a flat head, a round nose, short legs, and a strong tail. Its skin is tough and dark gray, black, or dark green. The belly is white or light brown. Alligators live in swamps, rivers, and lakes in the United States and China. They eat small animals and can bite hard. They can run fast for a short time. Alligators are usually scared of people and swim away. But they will fight to protect their nests. American alligators are no longer in danger, but Chinese alligators are very rare.
Moa\n\nThe moa was a very big bird that could not fly. It had no wings at all. Moas only lived in New Zealand, a country far away. They ate plants like leaves and grass. Some moas were as tall as a house. People called the Maori came to New Zealand and hunted moas for food. After many years, all the moas died. Now there are no moas left in the world.
Cardamom\n\nCardamom is a spice made from the seeds of a plant that is like ginger. The seeds grow inside a small pod that is shaped like a triangle. Some pods are light green, and some are dark brown. Cardamom has a strong taste and a nice smell. People use it to add flavor to food and drinks like tea and coffee. It is also used in baking and in some medicines. A little bit of cardamom is enough to make food taste special.
Ground squirrel\n\nA ground squirrel is a small animal that lives on and in the ground. It is a kind of squirrel that digs holes in the dirt to make a home. Most ground squirrels live in the mountains. They sleep all winter long. They like to be with other ground squirrels and whistle to each other when danger is near. They can stand up on their back legs to look around for animals that might hurt them. They have short tails and are bigger than other squirrels.
Sesame\n\nSesame is a plant that grows flowers. It can grow as tall as a grown-up person. The plant makes tiny seeds that people use on bread and in cooking. The seeds are very small and can be white or black. They taste a little bit like nuts.
Bank\n\nA bank is a place where people can keep their money safe. You can put money in a bank and take it out later when you need it. Banks also let people borrow money to buy things like a house. The people who work at a bank are called bank employees. Banks use the money people save to help other people. The word "bank" comes from an old word that means "a bench" because long ago people did business on a bench. The oldest bank in the world is in Italy and started a very long time ago.
Eared seal\n\nAn eared seal is a kind of sea animal with small ears on the sides of its head. It has flippers to swim in the ocean and can walk on land better than other seals. Eared seals live in groups on beaches and rocky shores. They eat fish and squid. A baby eared seal is called a pup.
Iroquois\n\nThe Iroquois are a group of Native American tribes. They also call themselves Haudenosaunee, which means "People of the Longhouse." Long ago, five tribes came together to stop fighting and live in peace. These tribes were the Mohawk, Oneida, Onondaga, Cayuga, and Seneca. Later, the Tuscarora tribe joined, so they became known as the Six Nations. The Iroquois lived in what is now New York State. They built longhouses made of wood and bark, where many families lived together. The Iroquois grew corn, beans, and squash, which they called the three sisters. They also hunted deer and fished in rivers. Women had important jobs and could own property. Today, many Iroquois still live in New York and Canada.
Backgammon\n\nBackgammon is a game for two people. Each player has pieces that move around a board. You roll two dice to see how far your pieces can go. The first player to get all their pieces off the board wins. The game takes about 15 to 30 minutes. People have played games like backgammon for a very long time, even thousands of years ago.
Spreadsheet\n\nA spreadsheet is a computer program that looks like a big sheet of paper with many little boxes called cells. The cells are in rows and columns. You can put words or numbers in the cells. The best part is that the computer can do math for you, like adding up numbers on a bill. You can also make pictures like graphs and pie-charts from the numbers. Many people use spreadsheets at work. Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets are two popular spreadsheet programs.
Namibia\n\nNamibia is a country in Africa, near the bottom of the map. It sits next to the Atlantic Ocean. The country is very dry and has a big desert called the Namib Desert. Many animals live there, like lions and elephants. People in Namibia speak many languages, but English is the main one. The capital city is Windhoek. Namibia used to be ruled by other countries, but now it is its own country. Children go to school for free from age 6 to 16. The most popular sport is football. Tourists visit to see the desert and the animals.
Sustainable development\n\nSustainable development means making things better without hurting the world for later. It is about building homes, schools, and jobs while taking care of nature. People need food, water, safe houses, and clean air. If we use too much now, there might not be enough for kids who grow up later. So we try to be careful with what we use and keep the earth healthy.
Plow\n\nA plow is a tool that helps people work on farms. It is pushed or pulled across the ground. Long ago, people or animals pulled the plow. Today, a big machine called a tractor pulls it. The plow lifts and turns the dirt. This makes two lines of dirt behind it. Turning the dirt buries weeds and makes the soil soft. Crops grow better in dirt that has been plowed.
Military aircraft\n\nA military aircraft is a flying machine used by soldiers. It can be big or small. Some military aircraft fight in the sky, and some carry people or things to faraway places. They are very fast and strong.
Central nervous system\n\nThe central nervous system is the part of your body that controls everything you do. It has two main parts: the brain and the spinal cord. The brain is inside your head, and the spinal cord is a long bundle of nerves that runs down your back. Together, they help you think, move, feel, and learn. Hard bones protect the brain and spinal cord so they stay safe.
Belly dance\n\nBelly dance is a kind of dance that women mostly do. It started in Egypt, a country far away. The dancer moves her hips and body in circles. She wears clothes that let her belly show. The music is from the Middle East. Many girls and boys learn belly dance when they are young. People all over the world learn it in dance schools. Some people do not like belly dance because it shows skin. In some places, it was not allowed. But many people still love to watch and do it.
Fire ant\n\nFire ants are small ants that can sting you. Their sting hurts a lot. They are also called ginger ants. Fire ants first came from South America. A long time ago, they got on a ship and went to the United States by accident. Now they live in many warm places in the US. Fire ants build big dirt mounds on the ground. They are very mean and will bite you if you get too close. When they bite, they use a poison that is not like other ants. Fire ants can hurt people and animals. They also chew on wires and can break things. Many people go to the doctor each year because of fire ant bites. Some people are very allergic and can get very sick. It is hard to get rid of fire ants because they have many queens and make new homes fast.
Meteor\n\nA meteor is a bright light in the night sky, like a shooting star. It happens when a space rock falls to Earth and gets very hot. Most meteors are small and break apart. If a rock hits the ground, it is called a meteorite. A big meteorite can make a hole in the ground called a crater. Some meteorites are made of stone, some are made of iron, and some have both. Meteorites are very old, almost as old as the Sun and planets. They help us learn about space.
Barge\n\nA barge is a flat boat that carries heavy things from one place to another. It looks like a long box floating on water. Barges move very slowly but can carry really big loads, like coal or wood. Some barges are narrow to fit through small locks on canals. The people who move barges are called lightermen.
Internet\n\nThe Internet is a big way for computers all over the world to talk to each other. It connects homes, schools, and offices. People use it to send messages, look at websites, and play games. The World Wide Web is a part of the Internet where you can see pictures and words. You need to pay a company to use the Internet at home. Some places block parts of the Internet because they think it is bad. The Internet can be fun, but you have to be careful not to share secret information.
Slow loris\n\nA slow loris is a small animal that lives in trees in Southeast Asia. It comes out at night to look for food. Slow lorises eat fruit, tree sap, nectar, and sometimes bugs or small animals. They have big round eyes that help them see in the dark. They move very slowly and carefully through the trees. A slow loris has a special smell that it uses to talk to other slow lorises.
Kyoto\n\nKyoto is a city in Japan. Long ago, it was the capital of Japan for many years. There are mountains around the city on the east, north, and west sides. Kyoto has many old temples and shrines with beautiful Japanese buildings. Some of these buildings are very special and protected by the world. Many people from all over the world visit Kyoto. In spring, people come to see the pretty cherry blossoms. In autumn, they come to see the leaves change color. Kyoto is also famous for its festivals in summer and autumn. The food in Kyoto often uses vegetables. Even the McDonald's signs in Kyoto are brown to keep the city looking traditional.
Invention\n\nAn invention is a new thing that someone makes. When you make something that nobody has made before, you invent it. Computers and cars are inventions. People who make inventions are called inventors. Sometimes an invention is a new idea or a new story. Inventions help make life easier. For example, if you need something, you might invent it to help you.
Italy\n\nItaly is a country in Europe. Its flag is green, white, and red. The capital city is Rome, which is very old and famous. Italy looks like a boot sticking into the sea. It has mountains called the Alps and the Apennines. There are also big lakes and many islands, like Sicily and Sardinia. People in Italy are called Italians. They speak Italian. Italian food is famous all over the world. People love to eat pizza, pasta, and ice cream called gelato. Many tourists visit Italy to see old buildings and eat yummy food.
Saint\n\nA saint is a very good and holy person. Many people believe saints live close to God in heaven. Different religions have saints. In Christianity, all people who love God can be called saints. Some saints are extra special because they did very kind things or helped others. People sometimes pray to saints to ask for help. A saint can be a helper for a certain job or sickness. It takes a long time for the church to say someone is a saint. They look at the person's life and miracles. After a person becomes a saint, their body is kept as a holy thing.
Trade union\n\nA trade union is a group of workers who come together to ask for better pay and better work. The people who run companies often want to pay workers as little as they can. So workers join a union to help each other. If the company does not listen, the workers may stop working. This is called a strike. Most of the time, the company agrees before a strike happens. Long ago, unions were not allowed. Workers who joined a union could go to jail. Later, the law changed and unions became okay. Today, many workers in different jobs are in unions.
World economy\n\nThe world economy is about all the money and trading that happens everywhere on Earth. It includes everything people buy and sell, like food, toys, and clothes. When one country sends things to another country, that is part of the world economy. The world economy is like a big circle where money and things move around the whole planet.
Dam\n\nA dam is a big wall that stops water from flowing. It makes a lake behind it. Some water can go over the top of the dam. People build dams to keep rivers from flooding, to make electricity, or to save water for farms and drinking. Some dams have special steps for fish to swim over. The tallest dam is very, very tall, as high as a big hill.
Sight\n\nSight is how you see things with your eyes. Light goes into your eyes, and your eyes send a message to your brain. Your brain figures out what you are looking at, like a tree or a house. It also knows how far away things are, so you can catch a ball. Your brain works very fast to help you see the world.
University of Cambridge\n\nThe University of Cambridge is a big school in Cambridge, England. It is one of the oldest and best schools in the world. Many smart people study and work there. The school started a long time ago, in 1209, when some students left another school because they were not happy. Cambridge has many small schools inside it called colleges. Students live and learn in these colleges. There are 31 colleges. The first one was built in 1284. For a long time, only boys could go to Cambridge. Now girls can go too. Many famous people went to Cambridge, like scientists, writers, and even kings and queens. People at Cambridge have found out many new things about science. The school has a special way of teaching where students talk with a teacher in a small group. This helps them learn a lot.
Firefighting\n\nFirefighting is the job of putting out fires that are not wanted. A firefighter is a person who does this job. Fires can happen in houses, cars, or forests. Firefighters use water to spray on fires. Water makes the fire cooler and takes away the air the fire needs to burn. Firefighters wear special masks to breathe clean air because smoke can be bad for them. They work to keep people and places safe.
Upper class\n\nUpper class is a word for the richest people in a place. These people have a lot of money and power. They might own big houses, boats, or lots of land. Some are born into rich families, and others make their own money. They can buy fancy things like big cars and beautiful clothes.
Werewolf\n\nA werewolf is a make-believe creature that is part human and part wolf. When there is a full moon, a werewolf can change from looking like a person into looking like a wolf. In wolf form, it has pointy ears, sharp teeth, and a long tail. Most people are scared of werewolves because they look scary. A werewolf can be hurt by a silver bullet, but not by a cross or holy water. When a werewolf dies, it turns back into a human. Some stories say a person becomes a werewolf if a werewolf bites them. Other stories say sleeping outside under a full moon can turn someone into a werewolf.
Light year\n\nA light year is how far light can go in one whole year. Light moves very, very fast. It can go around the Earth many times in just one second. A light year is not a measure of time. It is a measure of distance. Scientists use light years to talk about how far away stars and other things in space are. Some stars are so far away that their light takes many years to reach us. When we look at a star that is 100 light years away, we see it as it looked 100 years ago.
