Addition\n\nAddition is putting things together to see how many you have. It uses a plus sign that looks like a small cross. You can add numbers, like when you have two apples and get three more, you have five apples. It works the same no matter which number you start with. You can also add things like steps or blocks. Every time you count up, you are adding one.
Address\n\nAn address tells you where a person lives or where a building is. It has a house number, a street name, a town, and sometimes a country. You see it written on letters and boxes that come in the mail. When you want to visit a friend, you need their address to find their house. It helps the mail carrier bring the right letter to the right door.
Adhesive\n\nAn adhesive is a sticky thing that holds two things together. It can be wet like glue or dry like tape. You can find it at home, at school, or in a craft box. People use it to fix broken toys, stick paper, or build things. A sticker on your shirt is one kind of adhesive.
Adjective\n\nAn adjective is a word that tells us more about a thing. It can say how something looks, feels, or acts. You find adjectives in stories and when people talk. For example, in "a big red ball," the words "big" and "red" are adjectives. They help you picture the ball in your mind.
Adolescence\n\nAdolescence is the time when a child grows into a grown-up. It happens between being a kid and being an adult. During this time, the body changes a lot. A boy's voice may get deeper, and hair grows on his face. A girl's body changes shape, and she may start having periods. Both boys and girls may get pimples on their skin. They also feel new feelings and may want to be more independent. This time can last from around age 10 to age 25.
Adolf Hitler\n\nAdolf Hitler was a man who lived a long time ago. He was the leader of a country called Germany. He had a small mustache and dark hair. He did many bad things and started a big war. Many people were hurt because of him. Today, people learn about him in school so they remember to be kind.
Adoption\n\nAdoption is when a grown-up takes a child into their home and becomes the child's new mom or dad forever. It is a way to make a family. The child may look different from the new parents, but they are a real family. The new parents take care of the child, give them food, a bed, and lots of love. Some children are adopted when they are babies, and some are older. The child may feel happy, but sometimes they also feel sad or have many questions. They might wonder about their first mom and dad. When they grow up, some adopted children want to meet their first parents. Adoption means the new family stays together always.
Adriatic Sea\n\nThe Adriatic Sea is a big stretch of water. It is part of an even bigger sea called the Mediterranean. It sits between two long pieces of land: Italy on one side and a group of other countries on the other side. The water is not very deep in most places. Big boats and small boats sail on it to carry people and things. Many people visit its shores in summer to swim and play on the beach.
Adult\n\nAn adult is a person who is all grown up. He is bigger and taller than a child. You can find adults everywhere—at home, at work, at the store. He can make his own choices, like what to eat or where to go. A grown-up can also take care of himself and help others. Your mom, dad, and teacher are all adults.
Adventure\n\nAn adventure is a fun trip or a big, new thing you do. It can be going to a park you have never seen before. It can be looking for bugs under a rock in the yard. Sometimes an adventure is a story in a book where a hero goes far away. You can have an adventure with your family or your friends. It makes your heart beat fast in a happy way.
Advertising\n\nAdvertising is when a company tells people about a thing they can buy. It uses pictures, words, or songs to get your attention. You can see it on TV, on the radio, or on big signs by the road. Sometimes it pops up on a computer or a phone. It helps you know about a new toy or a yummy snack. A short TV ad is often 30 seconds long. A movie ad is called a trailer and shows fun clips.
Advice\n\nAdvice is when someone tells you what they think you should do. It is like a helpful hint from a friend or a grown-up. You can get advice at home, at school, or from a book. A mom might give advice about how to share toys. A teacher might give advice about how to write your name. It helps you make a good choice when you are not sure.
Aegean Sea\n\nThe Aegean Sea is a big body of water. It sits between two lands called Greece and Turkey. It has many small islands with sandy beaches and blue water. Long ago, people used boats to sail across it and trade food and cloth. Today, families visit the islands to swim and play in the sun.
Aeneas\n\nAeneas is a hero from very old stories. He was a prince from a city called Troy. In one story, he carries his father on his back to keep him safe from a big fire. Later, people say his family helped start the city of Rome. You can find him in books and songs that are thousands of years old.
Aerodynamics\n\nAerodynamics is about how air moves around things. It helps us understand why a ball flies far when you throw it. It also helps make cars and planes go fast and smooth. A plane wing has a special shape so air pushes it up. That push is called lift. Lift helps the plane stay in the sky. When you ride a bike fast, you feel air push your face. That push is drag. Aerodynamics helps make drag small so things can move easy.
Aerosol\n\nAn aerosol is a tiny bit of something floating in the air. It can be a small drop of water or a tiny piece of dust. You can see it when you look at smoke from a fire or fog on a cold day. Sometimes people use a can that sprays out a mist, like when you spray paint or hair spray. That mist is also an aerosol.
Aesthetic\n\nAesthetic is about what looks pretty or nice. It is the way something feels when you see it, like a bright rainbow or a soft pink flower. You can find it in a tidy room, a colorful drawing, or a song that makes you happy. People use it when they pick clothes that match or put stickers on a card. A birthday cake with sprinkles and candles is a good example of something with a nice aesthetic.
Aesthetics\n\nAesthetics is about what makes things look or feel nice. It asks why we like a pretty flower, a fun song, or a soft blanket. Some people think beauty is different for everyone — what you love, your friend might not. Others look for rules, like shapes that feel just right. You use aesthetics when you pick your favorite color or say a drawing is pretty.
Afghanistan\n\nAfghanistan is a country in Asia. It has tall mountains, dry deserts, and some rivers. Many people there live in small villages and grow food. The capital city is Kabul. It is a very old place where people have lived for a long, long time.
Afraid\n\nAfraid is a feeling you get when something seems scary. It can make your heart beat fast and your hands feel shaky. You might feel it when you are in the dark or when you hear a loud noise. It is okay to feel afraid sometimes. A hug from someone you love can help it go away.
Africa\n\nAfrica is a very big piece of land on Earth. It has many countries, like Nigeria and Egypt. It is hot in some parts and dry in others, with a big desert called the Sahara. Many wild animals live there, such as lions, elephants, and giraffes. Long ago, the first people came from Africa. Today, many different people live there and speak many languages.
African\n\nAfrican means something or someone from Africa. Africa is a big, warm place with many countries. It has wide, dry lands called deserts and green places with tall trees. Many different animals live there, like lions, elephants, and giraffes. People in Africa speak many languages and wear colorful clothes. Some African music uses drums that you can feel in your chest.
African art\n\nAfrican art is art made by people in Africa. It can be a painting, a mask, a statue, or a cloth with bright colors. Many pieces are made from wood, clay, or beads. You might see it in a museum or in a book about faraway places. People use it to tell stories, to dance, or to make a home look nice. A wooden mask with big eyes is one kind of African art.
African buffalo\n\nAn African buffalo is a big wild animal that looks like a cow. It has dark brown or black skin and two large curved horns on its head. It lives in Africa, in places with grass and trees. It eats only plants, like grass and leaves. It is very strong and can be dangerous, so people do not keep it on a farm. Sometimes you can see it in a zoo or in a nature show on TV.
African Great Lakes\n\nThe African Great Lakes are a group of very big lakes in Africa. They sit in a long, deep crack in the ground called a rift. You can find them in countries like Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, and Tanzania. The lakes hold lots of fresh water, and many fish live in them. People use the water for drinking, washing, and growing food. One of the lakes is so big it looks like a sea.
African Traditional Religions\n\nAfrican Traditional Religions are the old ways of believing and praying that many people in Africa have followed for a very long time. They are not one single thing, but many different ways from many different places. People who follow them believe in one big God who made everything, and also in smaller spirits that live in trees, rivers, and the sky. They often sing, dance, and tell stories to feel close to these spirits. They also show great respect to older family members who have passed away, because they believe those family members can still watch over them. You might see special masks, colorful clothes, and hear drums when they have a happy time together.
After\n\nAfter means something happens later in time. It is the time that comes when one thing is done. You wash your hands after you play outside. After lunch, you might take a nap. After the sun goes down, it gets dark and you go to sleep.
Afterlife\n\nAfterlife is the idea that something happens to you after your body stops working. Some people think you go to a happy place up in the sky. Others think you come back as a new baby or a little animal. Many people around the world talk about it, but nobody knows for sure. It is a big mystery that grown-ups wonder about.
Afternoon\n\nAfternoon is the time of day after lunch and before it gets dark. It comes after the morning is over. The sun is high in the sky, and it feels warm. Many children play outside in the afternoon. Some people take a short nap when they feel sleepy. It is a good time for a snack like fruit or crackers.
Again\n\nAgain means one more time. When you do something again, you do it after the first time. You might ask a friend to read a story again because you liked it. If you jump in a puddle, you can jump again and again. It is a word that tells us something is happening not just once.
Against\n\nAgainst means one thing is touching or pushing another thing. It is like when you lean your back on a wall. You can put a book against a shelf so it does not fall. In a race, one team plays against the other team. It can also mean you do not want something, like when you say no to a rule.
Agave\n\nAgave is a plant with thick, pointy leaves. It grows in hot, dry places like Mexico. The leaves are green or blue-gray and have sharp tips. People use it to make a sweet syrup that goes on pancakes. It lives for many years and grows very slowly.
Age\n\nAge is how many years someone has lived. It tells us if a person is a baby, a child, a grown-up, or very old. You can count age with numbers, like when you turn four or five on your birthday. Every year, you get one year older. A baby has a small age, like one or two. A grandma or grandpa has a big age, like sixty or seventy. You can ask a friend, "How old are you?" to know their age.
Age of Discovery\n\nThe Age of Discovery was a time long ago when people from Europe sailed big ships across the ocean. They wanted to find new places and new things to trade, like gold and spices. Some of these sailors found lands they did not know before, like the Americas. They made maps of these new places and met people who already lived there. One famous sailor was Christopher Columbus. He sailed across the big blue sea and found a land that was new to him. This time changed how people saw the world.
Age Of Enlightenment\n\nThe Age of Enlightenment was a time long ago when people started to think in new ways. It happened in places like Europe. During this time, many people began to ask big questions about how to live, how to be fair, and how to learn about the world. They used their own minds instead of just believing what they were told. They wrote books and shared ideas. This helped make schools, science, and rules that are fair for everyone.
Ageing\n\nAgeing is the way a living thing changes as it gets older. It happens to people, animals, and plants. When a person ages, their hair may turn gray and their skin gets lines. They may move more slowly and need more rest. A grandpa or grandma is a good example of ageing. They were once young like you, but over many years their bodies changed.
Aggression\n\nAggression is when someone acts in a mean way to hurt another person. It can be hitting, pushing, or saying mean words. Sometimes a person feels very angry and wants to fight. Other times, a person acts mean to get a toy or to be the boss. You might see it when two kids argue over a ball and one pushes the other. It is not nice, and it can make people feel sad or scared.
Ago\n\nAgo means something happened before now. It tells us how much time has passed. When you say "I ate a snack five minutes ago," it means you ate it five minutes before this moment. You can use ago with words like days, weeks, or years. For example, "We went to the park two days ago." It helps us talk about the past in a simple way.
Agra\n\nAgra is a big city in India. It has many old, beautiful buildings made of white stone. One famous building is a big, round-topped house called the Taj Mahal. People from all over the world come to see it. The city is next to a river, and you can ride a small, three-wheeled car to get around.
Agree\n\nTo agree means you say yes to something. When a friend asks, "Do you want to play?" and you say, "Yes, I do!" that is agreeing. It is like sharing the same idea or feeling. When you agree, you might nod your head up and down. People agree when they pick the same game or the same snack. It feels nice when everyone agrees.
Agricultural science\n\nAgricultural science is a way of learning about farms and food. It looks at how plants grow and how animals live on a farm. People who study it help farmers grow more food. They also find ways to keep the soil healthy. You can see it at work when you eat an apple or a carrot from a farm.
Agriculture\n\nAgriculture is how people grow food and raise animals. It happens on big open land called a farm. A farmer uses it to plant seeds in the dirt. The seeds grow into plants like corn, rice, and wheat. The farmer also takes care of animals like cows, pigs, and chickens. From it we get milk, eggs, meat, and wool. You see it when you eat bread, drink milk, or wear a cotton shirt.
Ahead\n\nAhead means in front of you or before now. When you walk, you look ahead to see where you are going. It can also mean something that will happen later, like your birthday is ahead if it is next week. When you are in a line, the person ahead of you is the one in front.
Air\n\nAir is the invisible stuff all around us. It has no color, no taste, and no smell. You can feel it when the wind blows or when you wave your hand fast. People and animals need air to breathe. It goes into our bodies through our nose and mouth. Trees and plants also need air. Even though you cannot see it, air is always there, inside and outside.
Air conditioner\n\nAn air conditioner is a machine that makes the air inside a room feel cool. It has a box that sits outside and a part that hangs on the wall or sits in a window. You can find it in many homes, cars, and big buildings. It works by pulling warm air out and pushing cool air in. On a hot summer day, it helps you feel nice and fresh.
Air mass\n\nAn air mass is a big chunk of air that moves together. It can be warm or cold, and it can be wet or dry. You cannot see it, but you can feel it on your skin. When a cold air mass comes, the day feels chilly. When a warm air mass comes, the day feels hot. Weather people watch air masses to know if it will rain or be sunny.
Air pollution\n\nAir pollution is when the air gets dirty with things that are bad for us. It can be smoke from cars or factories. Sometimes it comes from dust, fires, or volcanoes. Dirty air can make people cough or feel sick. It can also hurt trees and fish. Inside a house, the air can be dirty too, from paint or new rugs. People try to keep the air clean so everyone can breathe safely.
Aircraft\n\nAn aircraft is a big machine that flies in the sky. It has wings that help it stay up in the air. Some aircraft have engines that make them go fast, and some float like a balloon. You can see an aircraft at an airport, where people get on to travel far away. A pilot is the person who drives it. An airplane is one kind of aircraft that many families use to go on trips.
Aircraft carrier\n\nAn aircraft carrier is a very big boat that carries airplanes. It has a long, flat top that looks like a small road on the water. Airplanes take off from the top and land back on it. The boat moves on the ocean and can go far away from land. It is like a floating airport. Many people work on it to help the airplanes fly. You might see one in a picture book or a movie about the sea.
Airline\n\nAn airline is a company that flies people and things from one place to another. It uses big airplanes with wings and engines. You can find an airline at an airport, where the planes take off and land. It helps families go on trips far away very fast. When you look up at the sky and see a white trail, that might be an airplane from an airline.
Airplane\n\nAn airplane is a big machine that flies in the sky. It has two long wings, a body, and a tail. You can see it at an airport. It takes people and things far away very fast. A pilot sits inside and makes it go. Some airplanes are small, and some are very big. They can fly over the ocean in just a few hours.
Airport\n\nAn airport is a big place where airplanes go up into the sky and come back down. It has a long flat road called a runway for the planes to roll on. There is a big building where people wait for their plane. Inside, you walk through a special door that beeps if you have metal. People put bags in a machine that looks inside. You can see shops and places to eat. When it is time, you walk through a gate to get on the plane.
Airship\n\nAn airship is a big flying thing that floats in the sky. It looks like a long, round balloon. It has a motor that makes it go, and a tail with fins to help it turn. You can see it in the sky at big games or shows, where it carries a sign or a picture. A long time ago, people used it to travel, but now it is mostly for fun.
Al Khwarizmi\n\nAl Khwarizmi was a very smart man who lived a long, long time ago. He wrote books about numbers and how to use them. He helped people learn new ways to add, take away, and solve number puzzles. Many of the number rules we use today come from his ideas. He is like a teacher from long ago who helped everyone understand math better.
Aladdin\n\nAladdin is a young man from a very old story. He finds a magic lamp in a dark cave. Inside the lamp lives a big, strong helper called a djinn. The djinn can make any wish come true. With the lamp, Aladdin gets rich and marries a princess. A bad man tries to steal the lamp, but Aladdin gets it back. Many children know Aladdin from a colorful movie.
Alan Turing\n\nAlan Turing was a very smart man who liked math and puzzles. He lived a long time ago. He helped make the first big thinking machines, which are like the brain inside a computer. He also helped solve secret codes during a big war. Today, people remember him as a hero who helped start computers.
Alaska\n\nAlaska is a very big piece of land that is part of the United States. It is far up north, near a cold ocean and next to Canada. It has tall mountains, white ice called glaciers, and many wild animals like brown bears and moose. People in Alaska catch fish like salmon from the sea. Some people work to get oil from deep under the ground. The biggest city is Anchorage, where many people live. In winter, it is very cold and dark, and in summer, the sun stays up late.
Albania\n\nAlbania is a country in Europe. It has tall mountains, blue sea water, and green fields. Many people live in towns and cities there. The biggest city is called Tirana. People in Albania speak a language called Albanian. They cook food with meat, bread, and fresh vegetables. A bird with two heads is a special sign for the country.
Albatross\n\nAn albatross is a very big bird that lives near the sea. It has long wings and a strong, sharp beak. It spends most of its life flying over the ocean. It eats fish, squid, and tiny sea animals. You can see it on islands far away, where it makes a nest on the ground.
Albert\n\nAlbert is a name for a boy. It is a short name with two parts: Al and bert. You might meet a boy named Albert at school or at the park. Sometimes a grandpa or an uncle has this name too. A famous Albert was a man with big, messy hair who thought very hard about how the world works.
Albert Einstein\n\nAlbert Einstein was a very smart man. He had white hair and a kind face. He thought about big ideas like light, time, and space. He lived a long time ago, but people still remember him. He helped us understand how the world works.
Album\n\nAn album is a set of songs that you can listen to. It is like a book, but with music instead of pages. You can find it in a store or on a phone. People play it to hear many songs from one singer or band. Each song on it is called a track. A track is one piece of music. You can pick the first track, the second track, or any track you like. Some albums are made in a quiet room, and some are made at a big show with lots of people clapping.
Alchemy\n\nAlchemy is a very old way of trying to change one thing into another. It was done long ago before we had science. People who did it wanted to turn plain metal into gold. They also looked for a magic stone and a special drink that could make you live forever. It mixed real things with magic and stars. Today we do not use alchemy. We use chemistry instead, which is the real study of what things are made of.
Alcoholic\n\nAn alcoholic is a person who drinks too much alcohol and cannot stop. He may feel sick if he does not drink. He might act different than usual, like being sad or angry. You might see him at a party holding a bottle or a can. Doctors and family can help him get better.
Alcoholic Beverage\n\nAn alcoholic beverage is a drink that has a special part called alcohol in it. It can look like water, juice, or a bubbly drink. Grown-ups sometimes have it at parties or with dinner. It is not for kids because it can make people feel funny and sick. You might see bottles of it at a store or in the kitchen.
Alder\n\nAn alder is a kind of tree. It has a brown trunk and green leaves with little bumps along the edge. It grows in places where the ground is wet, like near a river or a pond. In spring, it grows long, soft, hanging parts that hold tiny yellow dust. The wind blows the dust to other flowers so new seeds can grow. Later, little hard green balls appear and turn brown. Bees like to visit the alder for food in early spring.
Alexander\n\nAlexander is a name for a boy. He is a person, just like you have a name. You might meet an Alexander at school or at the park. He can be a friend who likes to play games and share toys. Sometimes, a storybook has a boy named Alexander who goes on adventures.
Alexander The Great\n\nAlexander the Great was a king a long, long time ago. He lived far away in a land called Greece. He was very strong and brave, and he led a big army. He rode a horse and carried a sword. He won many fights and his land grew very big. People still tell stories about him today.
Alexandria\n\nAlexandria is a big city in Egypt. It sits right next to a big blue sea. Long ago, a king named Alexander started the city. It once had the biggest library in the world, full of books. Today, many big boats stop there to bring food and things to people.
Algae\n\nAlgae are tiny living things that live in water. They are like very small plants. They make their own food from sunlight. You can find them in ponds, lakes, and the ocean. Sometimes they make the water look green. Fish and other water animals eat them.
Algebra\n\nAlgebra is a part of math that uses letters for numbers we do not know yet. It helps us solve puzzles with numbers. You can find it in school books and on a chalkboard. People use it to build things like bridges and to make phones work. For example, if you have 2 apples and get more apples to have 5, algebra helps find how many you got.
Algeria\n\nAlgeria is a big country in Africa. It sits next to the blue sea in the north. In the south, it has a huge, hot desert with sand and rocks. Many people live in the north where the land is green and good for growing food. The biggest city is Algiers. People there speak Arabic and another old language called Berber. They also often speak French. Long ago, other people ruled Algeria, but now it is its own country. It has lots of oil and gas under the ground, which helps it make money.
Algiers\n\nAlgiers is a big city in Africa. It sits next to the sea in the north of a country called Algeria. Long ago, it had small islands right by the land, but now they are part of the city. Many people live there and work in tall buildings. It is a place where people from far away come to talk and share ideas.
Alhambra\n\nThe Alhambra is a big, old castle in Spain. It sits on a hill in a city called Granada. Long ago, kings and queens lived there. It has many rooms with pretty walls and quiet gardens with water. Today, many people visit to see the beautiful old building. It is one of the most famous places in Spain.
Alice's Adventures in Wonderland\n\nAlice's Adventures in Wonderland is a made-up story about a girl named Alice. It is a book with words and pictures. You can find it in a library or a bookstore. In the story, Alice follows a white rabbit and falls down a hole. She meets funny friends like a talking cat and a queen. Many people have made movies and songs about it.
Alike\n\nAlike means two things look or act almost the same. It is like when you have two red apples and you cannot tell which is which. You can find things that are alike in your toy box, like two blue blocks. When you and your friend both wear a yellow shirt, you look alike. It helps us see how things match.
Alive\n\nAlive means something is living and not dead. A dog, a tree, and a person are all alive. When something is alive, it grows, moves, and needs food and water. A rock is not alive because it does not grow or eat. You are alive when you run, play, and breathe.
All\n\nAll means every one or the whole group. When you have a box of crayons and you take out every single crayon, you have all the crayons. It is the opposite of none. You might hear someone say "all done" when they finish their food. All can also mean the whole thing, like when you eat all of your snack.
Allah\n\nAllah is a name for God. It is a word people use in the Arabic language. Many Muslims say Allah when they talk about God. Some Christians and Jewish people who speak Arabic also use the name Allah. It means the one God who made everything.
Allergy\n\nAn allergy is when your body does not like a normal thing. It can be a food, like peanuts or milk. It can be something in the air, like dust or tiny bits from a cat. When the thing touches you or goes inside you, your body fights it too hard. Your eyes may get red and wet. Your nose may run and you may sneeze a lot. Your skin may get red bumps that itch. If it is a food, your tummy may hurt. Sometimes the throat can swell up and make it hard to breathe. That is very bad, and a grown-up must give you a shot of special medicine to help. Some people carry the medicine with them all the time, just in case.
Alligator\n\nAn alligator is a big animal with a long body and a tough, scaly skin. It has a wide, flat head, a round nose, short strong legs, and a long, powerful tail. It lives in warm, wet places like swamps, rivers, and lakes. It can swim very well and often floats with just its eyes and nose above the water. It eats fish, turtles, and other small animals. You can see it in some zoos or in the wild in parts of America and China.
Allosaurus\n\nAllosaurus was a big dinosaur that ate meat. It had a long tail, strong back legs, and short arms with three fingers. It lived a very long time ago, before people were on Earth. You can see its bones in some museums. It used its sharp teeth to bite other dinosaurs.
Alloy\n\nAn alloy is a mix of two or more things, and one of them is always a metal. It is made by melting the metal and mixing in something else, then letting it cool into a hard new thing. The new thing is often stronger or better than the metal alone. You can find alloys in many places, like in the shiny steel of a spoon or the brass of a door handle. Steel is an alloy made from iron, and it is used to build cars and bridges. Bronze is another alloy, made from copper and tin, and people long ago used it to make tools.
Almond\n\nAn almond is a small, hard nut that people eat. It grows on a tree that is not too tall. The tree has pretty white or light pink flowers. The nut hides inside a hard shell. You can buy almonds with the shell on or with the shell taken off. People eat almonds as a snack or put them in food like cookies and cereal.
Almost\n\nAlmost means very close to something, but not all the way. It is like when you have nine out of ten blocks—you almost have ten. You can use it for time, like when it is almost bedtime. You can use it for size, like when a puppy is almost as big as its mom. It helps you say something is nearly done or nearly there.
Aloe\n\nAloe is a plant with thick, pointy green leaves. It grows in warm, dry places. Inside each leaf is a clear, cool gel. People put the gel on their skin when it feels dry or sore. It helps the skin feel soft and calm. You can find aloe in a small pot at home or in a garden.
Alone\n\nAlone means you are by yourself. It is when no one else is with you. You might feel alone in your room at night. Sometimes being alone is quiet and nice. Other times it can feel a little sad. A friend or a hug can help when you do not want to be alone.
Along\n\nAlong means next to or beside something. When you walk along a path, you stay on the path as you go. You can also hold hands and walk along with a friend. It tells us that two things are moving or sitting side by side.
Aloud\n\nAloud means you say words so other people can hear them. It is the opposite of thinking words inside your head. When you read a book aloud, you say the story with your voice. In class, the teacher may ask you to say your name aloud. Saying something aloud helps others know what you are thinking.
Alpaca\n\nAn alpaca is a fluffy animal that looks a bit like a small llama. It has a long neck, big soft eyes, and a coat of thick, warm hair. You can find it on farms, often with sheep or goats. People keep it for its soft wool, which is made into warm clothes like sweaters and scarves. The wool is cut off once a year, like a haircut. It eats grass and hay, and it can live for many years. A baby alpaca stays inside its mom for almost a whole year before it is born.
Alpha Centauri\n\nAlpha Centauri is a group of three stars in the night sky. It looks like one bright dot, but it is really three stars close together. You can see it only if you live far down south, where the sky is different. It is the closest star group to our Sun. One of its stars has a planet going around it. Some day, people want to send a space ship to visit it.
Alphabet\n\nAn alphabet is a set of letters we use to write words. It has a fixed order, like A, B, C, D. You see it in books, on signs, and on your toys. We use it to read and write stories and names. The English alphabet has 26 letters, from A to Z.
Alpine skiing\n\nAlpine skiing is a fun winter sport. It uses two long, flat sticks called skis that you strap to your feet. You stand on a snowy hill and slide down very fast. The person who gets to the bottom first wins the race. You can try it at a snowy mountain place called a ski resort. Many people do it just for fun, and some do it in big races like the Olympics.
Alps\n\nThe Alps are very tall hills that touch the sky. They are in Europe, a big land far away. It has white snow on top all year long. People go there to slide on snow with long flat shoes called skis. In summer, they walk up the green parts and see pretty flowers and small lakes. Some animals like furry goats and big birds live there.
Already\n\nAlready means something happened before now. It is a word we use when a thing is done and we do not need to do it again. For example, if you ate your snack, you can say, "I already ate." It tells your mom or dad that the job is finished. You might hear it when someone asks about a chore, like putting toys away.
Also\n\nAlso is a word we use to add something more. It is a small word that comes in the middle of a sentence. You hear it when someone says, "I like apples. I also like bananas." It helps us say there is one more thing. When you tell a story, you can use it to add a new part. It is like saying "and" but a little different.
Altar\n\nAn altar is a special table used in a church or a holy place. It is often made of wood or stone and stands at the front. People put candles, flowers, or a cross on it. A priest or a leader stands near it to pray and share stories. You might see one when you visit a big church with your family.
Alternative medicine\n\nAlternative medicine is a way some people try to feel better. It is not the same as going to a regular doctor. It can be things like tiny needles, special back pushes, or sweet water pills. Some people use it together with a doctor's help. But it does not fix sickness the way real medicine does. Real medicine is what your doctor gives you and is tested to work.
Alternative rock\n\nAlternative rock is a kind of loud, fun music. It uses guitars, drums, and singing. People play it in bands with friends. You can hear it on the radio or at a big show. Some bands that play it are Nirvana and Coldplay. It makes you want to jump and dance.
Altruism\n\nAltruism is caring about other people and wanting to help them. It means you do something nice for someone else without thinking about what you will get back. You might share your snack with a friend who has none. You might help your little brother pick up his toys. You might give a hug to someone who feels sad. When you do these things, you are being kind and thinking about how the other person feels. It is the opposite of being selfish.
Always\n\nAlways means every time, with no stops. It is like the sun coming up each morning—it happens again and again. You can use it to say something never changes, like "I always brush my teeth before bed." It is a word that tells about things that keep going on and on.
Am\n\nAm is a short word we use to talk about ourselves. It tells what I am doing or how I am feeling right now. You say it with the word I, like "I am happy" or "I am running." It helps people know about you.
Amaranth\n\nAmaranth is a plant with colorful leaves and flowers. It can be red, purple, or gold. Some people grow it in gardens to look pretty. In other places, people eat its leaves like spinach. They also use its tiny seeds to make food like porridge. You might see it in a park or a friend's yard.
Amaterasu mikami\n\nAmaterasu mikami is a sun goddess from old Japanese stories. She is a bright and warm lady who brings light to the world. In the stories, she lives high up in the sky. Long ago, she got sad and hid in a dark cave, so the whole world became dark. Other gods made her laugh and come out, and the light came back. People in Japan still visit a special place called Ise to think of her.
Amateur radio\n\nAmateur radio is a fun way to talk to people far away using a special box. It looks like a radio with buttons and a big stick on top. People use it at home or in a club room. They talk with their voice or send beeps that spell out words. In an emergency when phones do not work, it can call for help. You need a special paper called a license to use it.
Amaze\n\nAmaze is a big, happy feeling you get when something is very, very good or hard to believe. It makes your eyes open wide and your mouth smile. You feel it when you see a magic trick, a huge rainbow, or a puppy doing a funny dance. It is like a surprise that fills your heart with joy.
Amazing\n\nAmazing is a word we use when something is very, very good or hard to believe. It is a feeling you get when you see a big rainbow or a magic trick. You might say "That is amazing!" when your friend does something great. It can also mean something is so big or so pretty that it makes you stop and stare. When you see fireworks light up the night sky, that is amazing.
Amazon\n\nAmazon is a very big forest with many trees. It is so big that it covers parts of many countries. Many animals live there, like monkeys, birds, and big cats. The weather is hot and it rains a lot. People also call it a rainforest. Some people live there too, in small villages by the river.
Amazon rainforest\n\nThe Amazon rainforest is a huge, warm, wet forest. It is the biggest rainforest on Earth. It has many tall trees that stay green all year. The forest is in South America, near a very long river called the Amazon. It is home to more animals and plants than any other place. You can find colorful birds, monkeys, frogs, and big cats there. The trees make a lot of the air we breathe. People are cutting down parts of the forest, and that hurts the animals and the air.
Amazon River\n\nThe Amazon River is a very big river in South America. It starts in tall mountains and flows all the way to the big ocean. It carries more water than any other river in the world. The water is often brown and muddy. Many fish, birds, and animals live in and around it. Big boats can travel on it like a road. There are no bridges across most of it because it flows through a huge forest with few roads. People use small boats or ferries to cross it.
Amazons\n\nAmazons are warrior women from old Greek stories. They are strong and brave, and they fight with bows and arrows. In the stories, they live far away near a big sea. They ride horses and are very good at it. Some people think the stories came from real women fighters long ago.
Amber\n\nAmber is a hard, shiny stone that comes from very old tree sap. It is often yellow, orange, or brown, and it feels smooth and warm when you hold it. People find it buried in the ground or washed up on sandy beaches near the sea. It is used to make pretty things like necklaces and bracelets. Sometimes, tiny bugs or leaves got stuck in the sticky sap long ago, and you can still see them inside it today.
Ambulance\n\nAn ambulance is a special car that helps sick or hurt people. It is big and white with bright red and blue lights on top. It also has a loud siren that goes wee-oo-wee-oo. You can see it on the road when it rushes to help someone. Inside, it has a bed and tools to take care of people. The helpers inside are called paramedics. They know how to fix boo-boos and keep people safe until they get to the hospital. If you ever need help, a grown-up can call 911 and an ambulance will come fast.
America\n\nAmerica is a big country where many people live. It has tall buildings in cities and wide open fields with farms. You can find it on a map across the ocean. People there speak English and eat foods like hamburgers and apple pie. A flag with stars and stripes stands for America.
American\n\nAmerican means something or someone from the United States. It is a big country with many people, cities, and farms. You can find Americans in all fifty states, like Texas or New York. They speak English, eat foods like hamburgers and apple pie, and celebrate the Fourth of July with fireworks. An American flag has red and white stripes and fifty white stars on a blue square.
American bison\n\nAn American bison is a big, hairy animal that looks like a cow. It has a large head, short curved horns, and a thick brown coat. The fur on its front is long and shaggy. It lives on flat, open land with grass, like a prairie. It eats grass and other plants. A long time ago, many bison walked all over the land, but people hunted too many. Now, it lives in a few parks and safe places. It is a strong animal that can be seen in pictures on some flags and coins.
American football\n\nAmerican football is a game played by two teams. It uses a ball that is not round—it has two pointy ends. The game happens on a big green field with lines on it. Players wear a hard hat called a helmet to keep their heads safe. One team tries to carry the ball to the other team's end of the field to score points. You might see it on TV on a Sunday, with lots of people cheering.
American Museum of Natural History\n\nThe American Museum of Natural History is a big building full of science things. It is in New York City, in a park. Inside, there are many rooms with old bones, stuffed animals, and shiny rocks. People go there to look and learn. Kids can see a giant blue whale hanging from the ceiling. Scientists work there and study animals, stars, and people from long ago.
American Revolution\n\nThe American Revolution was a big fight a long time ago. It happened when people in America did not want a faraway king to tell them what to do. They wanted to make their own rules. Many people fought with guns and cannons. After many years, they won and made a new country called the United States. Now, every year, people watch fireworks and wave flags to remember it.
American robin\n\nAn American robin is a bird with a bright red-orange chest. It has a round body, long legs, a long tail, and a yellow beak. You can see it in gardens, parks, and yards all over North America. It hops on the grass to find worms and bugs to eat. It also eats berries from bushes. In spring, it builds a cup-shaped nest out of grass and mud. The eggs inside are a pretty blue color.
Americas\n\nThe Americas are two big pieces of land. One is North America and one is South America. They are on the other side of the big water from Europe and Asia. Many people live there and speak different words. Some parts are hot and some are cold. You can find tall mountains, long rivers, and big forests there. A long time ago, people from far away came in big boats and found this land.
Amman\n\nAmman is a big city. It is the most important city in the country of Jordan. It sits on many hills and has lots of buildings. Many people live there, and many visitors come to see it. It has old parts and new parts. It is a place where people work, learn, and shop.
Ammunition\n\nAmmunition is the stuff that goes inside a gun to make it shoot. It has a hard outside case and a soft tip. You find it in places where soldiers or police keep their tools. When a person pulls the trigger, it flies out very fast. A bullet is one kind of ammunition that you might see in a toy gun or a movie.
Amnesia\n\nAmnesia is when a person cannot remember things. It can make someone forget what happened a long time ago or just a moment ago. Sometimes it happens if the brain gets hurt or sick. Other times, a very scary or sad thing can make a person forget. Some people forget for a little while, and some forget for a long time. A doctor can help the brain get better, but there is no special pill for it. If you hit your head very hard, you might forget what happened right before.
Among\n\nAmong means in the middle of a group. It is a word we use when something is with other things. You might find a red ball among many blue balls. A cat can hide among the tall grass. When you play with friends, you are among them.
Amount\n\nAn amount is how much of something there is. It tells you if you have a little or a lot. You can see an amount when you count your toys or when you pour milk into a cup. If you have three cookies, the amount is three. If your cup is full, the amount of milk is big. People use amounts every day to share things fairly.
Amphibian\n\nAn amphibian is a small animal that can live in water and on land. It has smooth, wet skin and four legs. You can find it near ponds, rivers, or wet forests. It starts life as a tiny egg in the water, then grows into a swimming baby with a tail. Later, it changes into an adult with legs and lungs. A frog is one kind of amphibian you might see hopping near a pond.
Amplifier\n\nAn amplifier is a box that makes music or sounds louder. It has buttons and knobs on the front. You can find it near a TV, a radio, or a music player. When a guitar or a singer plugs into it, the sound comes out big and strong through a speaker. Some amplifiers are small and sit on a desk, and some are big and stand on the floor. At a concert, you see big amplifiers so everyone can hear the music.
Amsterdam\n\nAmsterdam is a big city in a country called the Netherlands. It has many canals, which are long strips of water that go through the streets. People ride boats on the canals to get around. The city is very old and has many tall, narrow houses that stand close together. You can find many people from all over the world living there. It is a busy place with lots of bikes, shops, and parks.
Amun\n\nAmun is a very old god from stories in Egypt. He was a god of wind and making things grow. People thought he was the king of all gods. They built a big house for him called a temple. Later, people said he was also the sun god Ra, so they called him Amun-Ra. He was so strong that people said he made the whole world. In old pictures, he sits on a chair with two tall feathers on his head.
An\n\nAn is a small word we use before words that start with a, e, i, o, or u. It means one thing, but not a special one. You see it in books and hear it when people talk. For example, you might say "an apple" or "an egg." It helps the sentence sound smooth and easy to say.
Ana\n\nAna is a name for a girl. She is a person, just like you. You might meet an Ana at school or at the park. She can be a friend who likes to play and share toys. Sometimes Ana has long hair or short hair, and she smiles a lot.
Analysis\n\nAnalysis is when you look at something very carefully to understand it better. It is like being a detective with your eyes and brain. You can do it with a toy to see how it works, or with a story to find out why a character is sad. Grown-ups use it at work to solve problems. When you break a big thing into small pieces and think about each piece, that is analysis.
Analytical\n\nAnalytical means looking at things very carefully to understand them better. It is like when you take apart a toy to see all the little pieces inside. People use it when they want to solve a puzzle or find out why something happened. A detective is analytical when she looks for clues. You are analytical when you sort your blocks by color and shape.
Analytical Chemistry\n\nAnalytical Chemistry is a way to look at stuff and find out what it is made of. It uses tools like scales, lights, and special cups. People do it in labs with white coats. It helps make sure water is clean and food is safe. A doctor might use it to check if you are healthy.
Anarchism\n\nAnarchism is a way of thinking about how people can live together. It says that no one person or group should be the boss of everyone else. People who believe in anarchism think that we can share, help each other, and make rules together without a big leader. They want a world where everyone is free and kind to one another.
Anatomy\n\nAnatomy is learning about the body. It looks at what is inside and outside of people and animals. It shows where things like muscles, bones, and the heart sit in the body. A person who learns about anatomy is called an anatomist. They study how the body is put together. For example, the skeleton is all the hard bones that hold the body up. The muscles help the body move. The heart pumps blood all around. Anatomy helps doctors know how the body works.
Anchovy\n\nAn anchovy is a tiny fish that lives in the big, salty ocean. It has a long, thin body that shines green and silver. A shiny stripe runs along its side. It swims in big groups called schools, and you can find it in many seas around the world. It eats tiny plants and animals that float in the water. People catch it to eat, and it tastes very salty and strong. You might see it on top of a pizza or in a small can at the store.
Ancient\n\nAncient means something is very, very old. It is from a time long before your mom and dad were born. You can find ancient things like big stone buildings or old pots in a museum. People dig them up from the ground to learn about how people lived long ago. An ancient story might be about kings and queens from a faraway time.
Ancient Celtic religion\n\nAncient Celtic religion was a way of believing in many gods and spirits. It was followed by people called the Celts in Europe a long, long time ago. They did not write down their beliefs, so we learn about it from old things they left in the ground. It had special wise people called druids who led prayers and ceremonies. They met in quiet places like forests or near water. They gave gifts to the gods, like shiny things or food. Over time, new ideas came and the old ways changed, but some stories still live on today.
Ancient Egypt\n\nAncient Egypt was a place where people lived a long, long time ago. It was near a big river called the Nile. The river gave water and soft, dark dirt for growing food like wheat. People wrote with small pictures called signs. They built huge stone houses for their kings, who were called pharaohs. A pharaoh was like a king, and people thought he was very special. They also made big pointy buildings called pyramids. You can still see pyramids in pictures of Egypt today.
Ancient Greece\n\nAncient Greece was a place where people lived a long, long time ago. It was near a big blue sea. The people spoke the same language and told the same stories about gods. They lived in small cities, each with its own rules. Some cities had a king, and some let the people choose. They built tall white buildings with big stone sticks. They also made pretty pots and stone people. You can still see old broken parts of their buildings today.
Ancient Greek philosophy\n\nAncient Greek philosophy is a way of thinking that started long ago in a place called Greece. It asks big questions about the world, like what is good, what is real, and how people should live. Some of the first thinkers were Socrates, Plato, and Aristotle. They talked and wrote about these ideas. Their thoughts helped shape how people think even today.
Ancient history\n\nAncient history is the story of people who lived a long, long time ago. It starts when people first learned to write, more than five thousand years ago. It ends when a new time called the Middle Ages began. We learn about it by looking at old things left behind, like clay pots, stone tools, and metal swords. Some people long ago wrote down what happened, and we can still read their words today. But many old papers and wood things are gone now because they broke or got lost. So we only know a small part of the whole story.
Ancient Olympic Games\n\nThe Ancient Olympic Games were a big sports party a long, long time ago. It happened in a place called Greece. People from different towns came together to run, jump, and race. The winner got a crown made of olive leaves. It was a way to say thank you to a god named Zeus. Today we have new Olympic Games, but the first ones were very old.
Ancient philosophy\n\nAncient philosophy is old thinking about big questions. It started long ago in places like Greece, Rome, China, and India. People asked things like: what is good? what is real? They talked and wrote down their ideas. Some of those old ideas are still read in schools today.
Ancient Rome\n\nAncient Rome was a big city and a strong group of people from long, long ago. It had tall stone buildings, big roads, and a special kind of writing. You can find its old broken buildings in Italy today. The people there made rules and built things that we still use now. They also told stories about many gods, like Jupiter and Mars.
And\n\nAnd is a small word we use to put things together. It helps us say two things in one sentence, like "I have a cat and a dog." You see it in books, on signs, and when people talk. It makes a list, like "I like red, blue, and green." When you say "Mom and Dad," it joins two people you love.
Andean\n\nAndean means something that comes from the Andes mountains. The Andes are very tall mountains in South America. They stretch for a long way, like a giant rocky snake. You can find animals like the llama there, with its soft, woolly fur. People who live in the Andes wear bright, colorful clothes to stay warm. The air is thin and cold up high, and you can see snow on the peaks even when it is sunny.
Andean Civilizations\n\nAndean Civilizations were groups of people who lived long ago in the Andes mountains. They built homes and towns high up where the air is thin. They grew food like corn and potatoes on steep hillsides. They made colorful cloth and pots from clay. Some of their old stone cities still stand in the mountains today.
Andes\n\nThe Andes are very tall hills that go on and on. They are made of rock and have snow on top. You can find them in South America, near the sea. Many animals live there, like big birds and furry llamas. People climb the hills and use llamas to carry things.
Andorra\n\nAndorra is a tiny country high up in the mountains. It sits between two big countries, Spain and France. It has tall snowy peaks and green valleys. Many people visit it to ski and play in the snow. It has no king or queen of its own. Instead, two special people from Spain and France help take care of it together. The people there speak a language called Catalan. They also use Spanish and French. Andorra is very small, but it is a happy and peaceful place.
Andromeda galaxy\n\nThe Andromeda galaxy is a big group of stars very far away in the sky. It looks like a soft, fuzzy patch of light. You can see it on a dark night without a telescope if the sky is clear. It is the closest big star group to our own star group, the Milky Way. A long time ago, people thought it was a small cloud. Now we know it has many, many stars, even more than our own star group.
Anesthesia\n\nAnesthesia is a special kind of sleep that doctors give you. It makes your body feel no pain when you need an operation. A doctor gives it to you with a mask or a tiny needle. While you are under it, you do not feel, see, or hear anything. When you wake up, the operation is all done. It helps you stay safe and still so the doctor can fix what is wrong.
Angel\n\nAn angel is a kind of good helper from God. It looks like a person with wings, and sometimes it shines with light. You can find stories about angels in holy books like the Bible. An angel brings messages from God to people, and it can protect them or help them when they are in trouble. For example, an angel told Mary she would have a baby named Jesus. Some angels have special jobs, like watching over children or singing songs to God.
Angel Falls\n\nAngel Falls is a very tall waterfall. It is the tallest waterfall in the whole world. It falls from a big flat mountain in a country called Venezuela. The water drops so far that it turns into a soft mist before it hits the ground. A man named Jimmy Angel flew a plane near it a long time ago, and that is how it got its name.
Anger\n\nAnger is a big, hot feeling you get when something is not fair or when you cannot have what you want. It can make your face feel hot and your heart beat fast. Sometimes it makes you want to yell or stomp your feet. You might see anger when a friend takes your toy or when you have to stop playing. It is okay to feel angry, but it is not okay to hit or break things. Taking a deep breath can help the angry feeling go away.
Angkor Wat\n\nAngkor Wat is a very big, old temple. It is made of stone and has tall towers that look like pine cones. You can find it in a country called Cambodia, in a place with many trees. Long ago, people built it to pray to a god, and later it became a place for a different kind of prayer. It is the biggest building for prayer in the whole world. Many people visit it today to see the old stone walls and carvings.
Angle\n\nAn angle is the space where two straight lines meet. It looks like a corner. You can see angles in a door that is open a little, or in the corner of a book. When you open a pair of scissors, the two blades make an angle. A bigger opening makes a bigger angle, and a smaller opening makes a smaller one.
Anglerfish\n\nAn anglerfish is a fish that lives deep in the ocean. It has a big head and a wide mouth with sharp teeth. On top of its head, it has a little stick that glows in the dark. It wiggles the glowing stick to look like a tiny snack. When a small fish comes close, it opens its big mouth and eats it. It is dark brown and can be as small as your hand. Some people eat anglerfish for food.
Angling\n\nAngling is a way to catch fish. It uses a hook tied to a long string. The string is on a stick called a rod. The rod has a wheel that lets the string go out and come back. People put a worm or a shiny fake bug on the hook to make fish want to bite. Many people do angling for fun near a lake or a river. They often let the fish go back into the water after they catch it.
Angola\n\nAngola is a big country in Africa. It has land next to the ocean, and its capital city is called Luanda. Many people live there, and they speak Portuguese. The weather is warm, with a dry time and a rainy time. Angola has many different parts called provinces. Long ago, people from Portugal came and stayed for many years. Now Angola makes its own choices.
Angry\n\nAngry is a big, hot feeling you get when something is not fair or when you do not get what you want. It can make your face turn red and your hands feel tight. You might feel it when a friend takes your toy or when you have to stop playing. It is okay to feel angry, but it is not okay to hit or yell. You can take a deep breath or count to ten to help the feeling go away.
Animal\n\nAn animal is a living thing that can move around. It has a body made of many tiny parts called cells. It needs food, water, and air to stay alive. Some animals live on land, like dogs and cats. Some live in water, like fish. Some animals eat plants, some eat meat, and some eat both. A cow is an animal that eats grass. A lion is an animal that eats meat. A bear is an animal that eats plants and meat. You can see animals at a farm, in a zoo, or in your own home.
Animal colour\n\nAnimal colour is the way an animal looks on the outside. It can be brown, green, yellow, or many other shades. Some animals have spots or stripes on their fur or skin. Colour helps an animal hide from bigger animals that want to eat it. A green frog sits on a green leaf and is hard to see. A brown rabbit stays still in the dirt and looks like a rock. Some animals use bright colour to scare others away. A butterfly may show big spots that look like eyes. Colour also helps animals find a friend to make babies with. A boy bird may have bright feathers to show a girl bird he is strong. Animal colour is a big part of how they live and stay safe.
Animal husbandry\n\nAnimal husbandry is the way people take care of farm animals. It means giving them food, water, and a safe place to live. People do this to get milk, eggs, meat, and wool from the animals. A cow gives milk, a chicken gives eggs, and a sheep gives soft wool for clothes. Some children learn to care for animals in a group called 4-H. Long ago, families kept just a few animals, but now some farms have many. The animals need good care every day to stay happy and healthy.
Animal welfare\n\nAnimal welfare means making sure animals are happy and healthy. It is about how people take care of animals. It looks at how animals live on farms, in zoos, or at home as pets. It also thinks about how people treat wild animals outside. When a dog has a warm bed and good food, that is good animal welfare.
Animation\n\nAnimation is a way to make pictures move. It is made by putting many pictures together one after another. When you watch them very fast, it looks like the pictures are moving. You can see animation in cartoons on TV or in movies. Some people draw the pictures by hand, and some use a computer to help. A short cartoon is one kind of animation. A long movie like a Disney film is also animation.
Anime\n\nAnime is a kind of cartoon made in Japan. It is drawn by hand or made with computers. You can watch it on TV, on the internet, or in movies. It tells stories about many things like sports, magic, or robots. Some anime comes from Japanese comic books called manga. People all over the world enjoy watching it.
Anise\n\nAnise is a small plant with tiny white flowers. It has seeds that smell and taste a little like black licorice candy. People grow it in warm places near the sea. Cooks use the seeds to make bread, cookies, and sweet drinks taste special. You might find it in a kitchen spice jar or in a holiday cookie.
Ankara\n\nAnkara is a big city in the country of Turkey. It is the capital, which means it is the most important city for the country's leaders. It has many tall buildings, wide streets, and parks. People live and work there, and many visitors come to see a big white building on a hill called Anitkabir. Long ago, many different groups ruled the city, but now it is a busy, modern place.
Ankle\n\nAn ankle is the part of your leg where your foot joins your leg. It lets you move your foot up and down and side to side. You can feel it as a bump on each side of your foot. It helps you walk, run, and jump without falling. When you twist it too much, it can hurt and swell up. You wear socks and shoes over it to keep it safe.
Ann\n\nAnn is a name for a girl. It is short and easy to say. You might know a friend, a teacher, or a storybook person named Ann. She can be kind and funny, just like any friend you play with. Sometimes the name is spelled with an 'e' at the end, like Anne.
Anna\n\nAnna is a name for a girl. It is a short and sweet name. You might meet an Anna at school or at the park. She could be your friend or a girl in a storybook. Many people like the name because it is easy to say and sounds happy.
Another\n\nAnother is a word that means one more thing. It is like when you have a cookie and you want a second cookie. You can say, "I want another cookie." You use it when you already have one and you ask for one more. It can be a toy, a book, or a turn on the swing.
Answer\n\nAn answer is what you say when someone asks you a question. It is the words that come after a question mark. You give an answer when a teacher calls your name in class. At home, you might answer when Mom asks what you want for lunch. An answer can be one word, like yes or no, or many words that tell a story.
Ant\n\nAn ant is a tiny bug that lives with many other ants. It has six legs, a thin middle part, and two long feelers on its head. You can find ants almost everywhere on Earth, like in gardens, parks, and even on sidewalks. They work together in big groups to find food and build homes under the ground. Some ants can carry things that are much heavier than they are. You might see a line of ants walking to a piece of food on the ground.
Antarctic Circle\n\nThe Antarctic Circle is an invisible line around the bottom of the Earth. It is very cold there, with lots of ice and snow. In summer, the sun stays up all day and night. In winter, it stays dark all day and night. The land inside it is called Antarctica. Scientists go there to study, but no one lives there all the time.
Antarctic Peninsula\n\nThe Antarctic Peninsula is a long, skinny piece of land in a very cold place called Antarctica. It sticks out from the big ice land like a finger pointing north. It is covered in snow and ice, and big walls of ice called glaciers slide slowly into the sea. Scientists live there in small houses to study the weather and animals. It is one of the fastest warming spots on Earth, so the ice is melting more each year.
Antarctica\n\nAntarctica is a big, cold land at the bottom of the world. It is covered in thick ice that is very, very old. Almost no people live there all the time, but some scientists stay in small stations to study the ice and animals. You can find penguins, seals, and whales in the water around it. It is the coldest place on Earth, and the wind blows very hard. Even though it is full of ice, it is also a desert because it gets very little rain or snow.
Antbird\n\nAn antbird is a small bird that lives in warm forests. It has round wings, strong legs, and a short, hooked beak. Its feathers are mostly gray, brown, or white. It eats bugs and other tiny animals. Some antbirds follow big groups of ants to catch bugs that run away from the ants. It builds a nest and lays two eggs. Both the mom and dad bird take care of the babies.
Anteater\n\nAn anteater is an animal with a long nose and a long, sticky tongue. It has thick fur and a big, bushy tail. It lives in warm places with lots of trees and dirt. It uses its sharp claws to open ant homes and then licks up the ants with its tongue. Some anteaters walk on the ground, and some live in trees. You might see one in a picture book about jungle animals.
Antelope\n\nAn antelope is an animal that looks like a deer. It has four long legs, a smooth brown coat, and two horns on its head. It lives in big open fields in Africa and parts of Asia. It eats grass and runs very fast. A group of antelopes is called a herd. Some kinds can jump very high, even over a tall grown-up.
Antenna\n\nAn antenna is a metal stick that catches invisible waves from the air. It is long and thin, like a pencil or a ruler. You can find it on top of a car, on a roof, or on a phone. It helps a radio play music and a TV show pictures. Without it, a phone cannot call a friend far away.
Anthropology\n\nAnthropology is the study of people. It looks at how people live, what they do, and how they talk. It asks where people came from long ago. It also looks at how people make art, music, and food. You can see it in books about kids in faraway lands.
Antibiotic\n\nAn antibiotic is a kind of medicine. It helps your body fight tiny germs that make you sick. When you have a sore throat or an earache, a doctor may give you this medicine. It comes as a pink liquid, a pill, or a shot. It works only on germs, not on colds from a virus. You must take all of it, even when you feel better.
Antibiotics\n\nAntibiotics are special medicines that help your body fight bad germs called bacteria. They come as a pill, a liquid, or a shot from a doctor. When you have a sore throat or an ear ache caused by bacteria, a doctor may give you this medicine. It works by stopping the bacteria from growing or by killing them. You must take all of it, even after you feel better, so the bad germs do not come back stronger.
Antigua and Barbuda\n\nAntigua and Barbuda is a country made of two big islands and a few tiny ones. It sits in the warm blue sea called the Caribbean. Antoine Lavoisier\n\nAntoine Lavoisier was a man who studied what things are made of. He lived a long time ago in a country called France. He found out that air has different parts, and one part helps fire burn. He also showed that water is made of two things stuck together. People call him the father of chemistry because he helped us understand the world better.
Anubis\n\nAnubis is a god from old Egypt. He has the body of a man and the head of a dog. Long ago, people believed he helped take care of dead bodies and wrap them in cloth. He also helped decide if a person was good after they died. You can see pictures of him in old books and on walls inside big stone pyramids.
Anxiety\n\nAnxiety is a big, worried feeling inside your body. It can make your heart beat fast, your hands shake, or your tummy hurt. Sometimes it happens when you are scared or when something new is about to happen. Many people feel it before a test or a loud storm. It usually goes away after a little while. Any\n\nAny is a word we use when we talk about one thing, but we do not say which one. It can be a toy, a color, or a snack. You might hear someone say, "Pick any book you like." That means you can choose the red one or the blue one. It is a small word that gives you a big choice.
Anymore\n\nAnymore means not now. It is a word we use when something stops. Before, you did it. Now, you do not do it anymore. For example, a baby drinks from a bottle. Then the baby grows big. The baby does not drink from a bottle anymore.
Anyone\n\nAnyone means any person at all. It is a word we use when we talk about people, but we do not say who. You can use it when you ask a question, like "Is anyone home?" It can also be used when you say something is for all people, like "Anyone can play." It does not pick one person; it means every person is okay.
Anything\n\nAnything means any thing at all. It can be something you can see, like a toy or a tree. It can also be something you cannot see, like a sound or a feeling. When someone says "you can pick anything," it means you can choose whatever you want. It is a word that leaves the choice wide open.
Anyway\n\nAnyway is a word we use when we want to go back to the main thing we were talking about. It is like saying, "Let's not think about that other part now." You might hear a grown-up say it when a story gets a little mixed up. It helps everyone get back on track.
Anywhere\n\nAnywhere means in any place at all. It is a word you use when the place does not matter. You can sit anywhere on the rug during story time. A lost toy could be anywhere in the house. When you are happy, you feel like you can play anywhere.
Apart\n\nApart means two things are not together. It is when something is far away or not touching. You can see it when you put your hands far from each other. When friends are apart, they miss each other. A puzzle piece that is apart does not fit.
Apartment\n\nAn apartment is a home inside a big building. It has rooms like a bedroom, a kitchen, and a bathroom. Many apartments are in tall buildings in the city. Ape\n\nAn ape is a big animal with no tail. It has long arms and a wide chest. It lives in warm forests in Africa and Asia. It swings from tree to tree using its strong arms. It eats fruit, nuts, leaves, and sometimes small bugs. A monkey has a tail, but an ape never does.

Appalachian Mountains\n\nThe Appalachian Mountains are a long line of old, round hills in North America. They stretch from Canada down to the middle of the United States. The hills are not very tall, and they are covered with green trees. Many animals like bears, deer, and birds live there. People like to walk on a long path called a trail that goes over the hills. Appear\n\nTo appear means to show up or come into sight. When something appears, you can see it where you could not see it before. A rainbow can appear in the sky after rain. A friend can appear from behind a door. When the sun comes up in the morning, it appears over the trees.
Applause\n\nApplause is the sound people make by clapping their hands together. It is a happy noise you hear when someone does something good. You can find it at shows, games, or after a song. People use it to say "good job" or "we like that." When you see a play and everyone claps at the end, that is applause.
Apple\n\nAn apple is a round fruit that grows on a tree. It has smooth skin that can be red, green, or yellow. Inside, it has white, juicy flesh and a small star of seeds in the middle. You can find apples in a store or at a farm. People eat them raw as a snack, or cook them to make pie and sauce. They also make sweet juice and a drink called cider from apples. An apple is crunchy and can taste sweet or a little sour.
Apricot\n\nAn apricot is a small, soft fruit. It is round and has a fuzzy skin that feels like velvet. The outside is orange or yellow, and inside there is sweet, juicy flesh. In the middle, it has a hard pit that you do not eat. Apricots grow on trees in warm places. You can eat them fresh, or they can be dried and put in snacks. They are good for your body because they have things that help you stay healthy.
April\n\nApril is the fourth month of the year. It has 30 days. In many places, it is a spring month. Flowers start to open, and trees get new green leaves. Sometimes it rains a lot in April. People might see little animals like bunnies and baby birds. Some kids play outside more because the days get warmer.
Apron\n\nAn apron is a piece of cloth you wear over your clothes. It covers the front of your body and ties at the back. You see it in the kitchen when someone is cooking. It keeps food and water off your shirt and pants. A baker might wear one to stay clean while making cookies.
Aquaculture\n\nAquaculture is like a farm, but in water. It is a way people grow fish, shrimp, and other sea animals for food. Instead of catching them in the wild, people raise them in big ponds, tanks, or cages in the sea. It gives us fish like salmon and catfish to eat. Many places around the world do this, and it helps feed lots of people.
Aquarium\n\nAn aquarium is a glass box filled with water where fish and other water animals live. It can be small enough to sit on a table, or it can be a big building with huge tanks. You can see colorful fish, snails, and sometimes turtles inside it. People feed the animals and keep the water clean so they stay healthy. Many children have a small aquarium at home with a goldfish or a guppy. A big public aquarium is a fun place to visit and watch sharks or jellyfish swim.
Aqueduct\n\nAn aqueduct is a long path that carries water from one place to another. It can look like a big stone bridge with many arches. You can find it in old cities where people built it to bring fresh water. It helps water move across valleys or hills so towns have water to drink and wash. A long time ago, people used it to fill fountains and baths. Today, some places still use it to water farms.
Arab people\n\nArab people are a group of people who come from a big hot place called the Arabian Peninsula. They speak a language called Arabic. Many of them live in countries in West Asia and North Africa. They have a long history with stories from a very long time ago. Some Arab people follow the religion of Islam, and some follow other religions like Christianity. They have their own music, food, and ways of dressing. Arabian horse\n\nAn Arabian horse is a kind of horse with a special look. It has a triangle-shaped head, big eyes, and a small nose. Its neck is long and curved, and it carries its tail up high. Arachnid\n\nAn arachnid is a tiny animal with eight legs. It has a body split into two main parts: a front part with the head and a back part like a tummy. It does not have wings or feelers like bugs do. You can find arachnids in many places, like gardens, under rocks, or in quiet corners of a house. Aral Sea\n\nThe Aral Sea was once a very big lake. It sat between two lands called Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan. Over many years, it got smaller and smaller. Arapaima\n\nAn arapaima is a very big fish that lives in rivers. It has a long, round body and big scales that look like armor. It lives in warm rivers in South America. It eats other fish, bugs, and fruits that fall in the water. It can jump out of the water when it feels scared.
Arc de Triomphe\n\nThe Arc de Triomphe is a big stone arch in Paris. It stands in the middle of a round place where many roads meet. It is very tall and wide, and you can climb many steps to the top. Arcade game\n\nAn arcade game is a big machine you play with coins. It has a screen with bright colors and buttons or a stick to move things. You can find it in places like pizza shops or game rooms. Arch\n\nAn arch is a curved opening in a wall or a bridge. It looks like a rainbow made of stone or brick. You can see it over doors, windows, and big bridges. The top stone, called the keystone, holds all the other stones in place so it does not fall down. Some arches are made by nature when wind and water wear away rock over a long time.
Archaea\n\nArchaea is a tiny living thing. It is so small you need a big tool to see it. It lives in very hot water, very salty water, or deep in the ground. It helps break down old stuff and makes the earth healthy. Some archaea live inside animals and help them digest food.
Archaeologist\n\nAn archaeologist is a person who digs up old things from the ground. He looks for pots, tools, and bones that people left behind long ago. He works outside in the dirt with small brushes and shovels. He puts the old things in a museum so everyone can see them. You might see an archaeologist in a book or a show about dinosaurs or mummies.
Archaeology\n\nArchaeology is the study of how people lived a long, long time ago. It looks at old things that people left behind, like coins, tools, and broken pots. People who do this work are called archaeologists. They dig in the ground to find these old things. Sometimes they find them under water, like old ships. They also find them in ice when it melts. After they find old things, they clean them and put them in a museum. Then we can go see them and learn about the past.
Archaeopteryx\n\nArchaeopteryx is a very old animal that could fly. It lived a long, long time ago, even before people were on Earth. It had feathers and wings like a bird, but it also had a mouth with teeth, claws on its hands, and a long tail. Its body was small, and it looked like a mix of a bird and a lizard. People found its bones in rocks in Germany. Today, you can see its bones in a museum. It helps us learn how birds came to be.
Archery\n\nArchery is a game where you use a bow to send an arrow flying. A bow is a long, bent stick with a tight string. An arrow is a thin stick with a sharp tip at one end and feathers at the other. You pull the string back and let go, and the arrow zooms through the air. Long ago, people used archery to hunt animals for food. Today, it is a sport. You can see archery at a fair or on TV when people try to hit a round target.
Archimedes' screw\n\nArchimedes' screw is a tool that moves water up high. It has a long, twisty part inside a round tube. You put the bottom end in water and turn it. As it turns, water climbs up the twisty part and comes out at the top. People use it to bring water to dry fields so plants can grow. A long time ago, a smart man named Archimedes wrote about it. Today, you can still see it in some places where farmers need water.
Archipelago\n\nAn archipelago is a group of many islands close together. It looks like dots of land in a big blue sea. You can find it in the ocean, far from the main land. Some archipelagos are made by hot rocks under the water that push up to make islands. People live on some of these islands and use boats to go from one to another.
