Japan is a country that is an archipelago, with many islands where people live.
Architecture\n\nArchitecture is the way people plan and make buildings and other big things. It is like drawing a picture of a house before you build it with blocks. You can see it in houses, schools, tall towers, and bridges. An architect is a person who thinks up the plan and helps make it real. They use art to make it look nice and math to make it strong. Long ago, people built simple huts from wood and stone. Today, some buildings are so tall they touch the clouds. A skyscraper is a very tall building with many floors. The Eiffel Tower is a famous tall thing made of metal. Next time you see a big building, think about the plan someone made for it.
Archive\n\nAn archive is a special place that keeps old papers and things. It holds letters, maps, and pictures from long ago. People put these things in boxes to keep them safe. An archive is not like a library with books you can borrow. The things inside are one of a kind. A person who takes care of an archive is called an archivist.
Arctic\n\nThe Arctic is the cold place around the top of the Earth. It is mostly a big ocean covered with ice. In summer, the sun never sets for many days. The ground there is called tundra. It is a flat land with no big trees. Small flowers and moss can grow on it. Under the ground is hard ice that never melts. Many animals live in the Arctic. The polar bear is a big white bear that swims in the cold water. It hunts seals on the ice. The Arctic fox has thick white fur to stay warm. It follows bears to eat leftover food. Some people live in the Arctic too. They have been there for a very long time. They know how to stay warm and find food in the cold.
Arctic Circle\n\nThe Arctic Circle is an invisible line that goes around the top of the Earth. It is very cold there. In winter, the sun does not come up for a long time, so it stays dark. In summer, the sun does not go down, so it stays light all day and all night. The North Pole is in the middle of this circle. Some countries like Norway, Sweden, Finland, Russia, the United States, Canada, and Greenland have land inside it. The line moves a tiny bit every year because the Earth tilts a little.
Arctic Ocean\n\nThe Arctic Ocean is a big, cold sea at the very top of the world. It is covered with thick ice for most of the year. In winter, almost all of it is ice, and in summer, much of it still has ice. It is the smallest of all the oceans. Many animals live there, like big white bears called polar bears, walruses with long teeth, and huge whales. The ice is slowly melting because the Earth is getting warmer. People use strong ships to break the ice and travel through it.
Arcturus\n\nArcturus is a big, bright star in the night sky. It looks like a tiny, shiny dot that glows with a warm orange or red color. You can find it high up in the sky on a clear night, in a group of stars shaped like a kite. It is one of the brightest stars we can see from Earth. Long ago, people used stars like it to find their way home.
Are\n\nAre is a small piece of land. It is used to measure how big a piece of ground is. Farmers use it to talk about their fields. You cannot hold it in your hand because it is a way of counting space, not a thing you can touch.
Area\n\nArea is how much flat space a shape covers. It is like counting how many small squares fit inside a shape. You find it on paper, on a floor, or on a table top. People use it to know how much paint to buy for a wall or how much grass seed for a yard. A big square has more area than a small square.
Argentina\n\nArgentina is a big country in South America. It has tall mountains on one side and a big ocean on the other. Many people there speak Spanish. They love to play soccer and eat beef and pasta. The capital city is Buenos Aires, and it is very big.
Argument\n\nAn argument is when you tell someone why you think something is true. It is a reason you give to show your idea is right. You might say, "We should play outside because the sun is warm." That is an argument. A good argument has clear reasons that make sense. A bad argument has reasons that do not fit or are not true. People use arguments to share what they think and to try to agree on things.
Arithmetic\n\nArithmetic is about working with numbers. It is a part of math that you learn in school. It has four main ways to play with numbers: adding, taking away, times-ing, and sharing. Adding is putting numbers together. Taking away is finding how many are left. Times-ing is adding a number many times. Sharing is splitting a number into equal parts. You use arithmetic when you count your toys or share cookies with a friend. Many grown-ups use it at their jobs, like when a builder measures wood or a nurse counts medicine.
Arm\n\nAn arm is a long part of your body. It starts at your shoulder, near your neck, and goes down to your hand. You have two arms, one on each side. It has parts like the hand, wrist, elbow, and shoulder. You use it to pick up toys, hug your mom, and eat food. The hand at the end can hold things tight. Some animals like monkeys also use their arms to swing in trees.
Armadillo\n\nAn armadillo is a small animal with a hard shell on its back. It looks like it wears a suit of armor made of tough skin. It has a long tail and short legs with sharp claws. You can find it in warm places like South America and Central America. It digs in the dirt to find bugs and worms to eat. When it gets scared, it rolls up into a tight ball so nothing can hurt it. Some armadillos have four babies at the same time, and the babies all look exactly the same.
Armenia\n\nArmenia is a country far away. It has no sea next to it. Many people there follow a very old church. They have their own letters for writing. The biggest city is called Yerevan. Long ago, people made pretty stone buildings there. Today, families cook flat bread and tell old stories.
Armour\n\nArmour is a strong covering that keeps people and things safe from hits. It can be hard like a shell or soft like a thick coat. Long ago, people wore armour made of animal skin or metal. Today, police officers wear a special vest that stops bullets. Big army cars called tanks have very thick armour all around them. Even some dogs and horses wear armour to stay safe when they help police. In sports like hockey, players wear armour on their legs and arms so they do not get hurt when they fall.
Armstrong\n\nArmstrong is a last name that some people have. It is made from two words: arm and strong. A long time ago, it may have been a name for someone with very strong arms. Today, you might meet a friend or a teacher with this name. One famous person with this name walked on the moon.
Army\n\nAn army is a big group of people who protect a country on land. They wear the same clothes, called a uniform, and carry tools like guns. You can see them in parades or on the news. They work together to keep people safe. A person in the army is called a soldier.
Around\n\nAround means in a circle or on all sides. When you spin, the world looks like it is moving around you. You can walk around a big tree to see what is on the other side. At the park, you might run around the playground. It is a word that tells where something is or how it moves.
Arrive\n\nArrive means you get to a place. It is when you stop moving and you are there. You can arrive at home after a walk. You can arrive at school in the morning. When you arrive, someone might say hello or give you a hug.
Arrow\n\nAn arrow is a long, thin stick with a sharp point at one end. It has feathers at the other end to help it fly straight. You can find arrows in a bow and arrow set, which people use for target games. When you pull back the bowstring and let go, it flies through the air very fast. You might see an arrow in a picture book about knights or in a toy set at the park.
Art\n\nArt is making something that looks nice or feels special. It can be a drawing, a painting, a song, or a dance. You can find it at home on the fridge, in a book, or in a big building called a museum. People make it to share a happy or sad feeling. A child might draw a rainbow with crayons—that is art.
Art Deco\n\nArt Deco is a way of making buildings and pretty things. It uses straight lines, sharp corners, and shapes like zigzags and sunbursts. You can see it on tall buildings in big cities, like the Chrysler Building in New York. It also shows up on old movie theaters, lamps, and jewelry. It makes things look shiny, strong, and new.
Artemis\n\nArtemis is a goddess from old Greek stories. She is the goddess of the moon, hunting, and wild animals. She carries a bow and arrow, and she wears a short dress for running in the woods. She lives on a tall mountain with other gods. She has a twin brother named Apollo. In one story, a hunter saw her taking a bath, and she turned him into a deer. People long ago told many tales about her.
Artery\n\nAn artery is a tube inside your body that carries blood away from your heart. It has strong, stretchy walls made of three layers. You cannot see it because it is deep under your skin. Every time your heart beats, it stretches to let blood flow through. It brings fresh air from your lungs to all parts of your body. The biggest one is called the aorta, and it runs from your chest down to your belly.
Arthritis\n\nArthritis is when a part of your body called a joint gets sore and stiff. It can make it hard to move your fingers, knees, or hips. Some people feel it more in the morning or when it is cold. Doctors help by giving medicine and telling you to move gently. A grandma or grandpa might have it and use a warm cloth to feel better.
Arthropod\n\nAn arthropod is a small animal with a hard shell on the outside. It has many legs that bend at the joints. You can find it in gardens, under rocks, or in the water. It crawls or swims to move around. A spider is one kind you might see at home.
Artichoke\n\nAn artichoke is a plant that people eat. It looks like a big green flower bud with many thick, pointy leaves. You find it in the store near other green foods. People cook it in hot water or on a grill. Then they pull off a leaf, dip the soft bottom part in something yummy, and eat it. The very best part is the soft middle, called the heart. It tastes a little like a nut.
Article\n\nAn article is a piece of writing that tells you about something. It can be in a book, a magazine, or on a computer screen. It has words and sometimes pictures. People read it to learn new things or to enjoy a story. You might see an article about animals, toys, or places far away.
Artificial\n\nArtificial means something is made by people, not by nature. It looks or acts like a real thing, but a person built it. You can find artificial things all around you, like a toy car or a plastic flower. People use artificial things when the real thing is hard to get or costs too much. For example, a doll is an artificial baby that a child can play with.
Artificial intelligence\n\nArtificial intelligence is a computer program that can learn and think a little like a person. It lives inside computers and phones. It can hear your voice and talk back, like when you ask a phone a question. It can also look at pictures and tell what is in them. Some cars use it to drive without a person. One example is a talking helper on a phone that answers when you say "hello".
Artificial island\n\nAn artificial island is a piece of land in the water that people build. It is not made by nature like a normal island. People use big machines and rocks to make it. You can find it in the sea or in a big lake. Some are small, and some are very big. People may build houses, parks, or an airport on it. One example is an island with a big wheel you can ride, like in a picture book.
Artificial selection\n\nArtificial selection is when people choose which plants or animals get to have babies. It is a way to make sure the babies have a special look or skill. A farmer may pick the biggest, sweetest apples from a tree and plant their seeds. Over time, the new apple trees grow more big, sweet apples. People also use it with dogs. A person may want a dog with short legs, so they let two short-legged dogs have puppies. The puppies often have short legs too. This is how we got many kinds of dogs, like the small, fluffy ones or the big, strong ones. It is different from nature choosing, where animals and plants change slowly on their own to live better in the wild.
Artillery\n\nArtillery is a big, heavy gun that shoots far away. It has a long tube and sits on wheels or a stand. Soldiers use it in a war to hit things that are very far. It can shoot a big metal ball or a rocket that flies through the air. A person called a spotter helps aim it because the target is too far to see. The loud boom can shake the ground.
Artist\n\nAn artist is a person who makes art. He draws, paints, or builds things that are nice to look at. He can also sing, dance, or play music. You can find his work in a museum, a book, or on a stage. He uses colors, shapes, and sounds to show how he feels. A child who draws a picture for mom is a little artist too.
Arts\n\nArts are things people make to share feelings, stories, and ideas. They can be pictures you see, songs you hear, or dances you watch. Some arts stay still, like a painting on a wall or a statue in a park. Other arts move and happen in front of you, like a play or a song. You can find arts in a museum, a book, or even on a stage. When you draw with crayons or sing a song, you are making art too.
As\n\nAs is a very small word we use when we talk. It helps us say how something is done or when two things happen at the same time. You might hear it in a sentence like "I am as tall as my friend" or "She sings as she plays." It is not a thing you can touch or see, but it helps our words fit together.
Ash tree\n\nAn ash tree is a tall tree with a strong trunk and many branches. It has light green leaves that are made of many small parts. The leaves come out late in spring and fall off early in fall. Its buds are dark and look a little like a soft black hat. People use its wood to make bats, bows, and tool handles. It also burns well in a fire. A long time ago, people told stories about a giant ash tree that held up the sky. Some bugs and sickness can hurt it, so people try to keep it safe.
Ashoka\n\nAshoka was a king who lived a long, long time ago in a land called India. He was a strong leader who helped many people. He cared about being kind and fair. He put up big stone signs with words that told everyone to be good to each other. He also sent helpers to faraway places to share his ideas about peace. Today, people still remember him as a good king who wanted everyone to live happily.
Asia\n\nAsia is a very big piece of land on Earth. It is the biggest of all the big land pieces. Many, many people live there. It has tall mountains, long rivers, and big empty deserts. Some places are very cold, and some are very hot. Many old stories and ways of life started in Asia. You can find countries like China, India, and Japan there.
Asian Games\n\nThe Asian Games are a big sports party for countries in Asia. It happens every four years, just like a birthday that comes around again. Many different sports are played, like running, swimming, and soccer. People from many places come to join and try their best. It has a summer time and a winter time, so you can see games in the snow too. You might see it on TV with bright flags and happy crowds.
Ask\n\nAsk means you say a question to find out something. When you ask, you use words like who, what, where, when, or why. You can ask a grown-up for help, or ask a friend to play. Asking is how you learn new things every day.
Asleep\n\nAsleep means your body is resting and your eyes are closed. When you are asleep, you do not hear or see things around you. You lie down in a bed or a cozy spot to fall asleep. Your body grows and gets strong while you are asleep. You might dream about fun things like flying or playing. When you wake up, you feel full of energy again.
Asmara\n\nAsmara is a big city in a country called Eritrea. It is the most important city there. Many people live in it, and they make clothes, food, and shoes. A long time ago, four small towns joined together to make it. Later, people from Italy built many houses that look like the ones in Italy. Some of those old houses are still there today. It is a special place that the whole world thinks is important to keep safe.
Asparagus\n\nAsparagus is a green plant that people eat as a vegetable. It grows as a tall, thin stalk with a soft, pointy tip at the top. You can find it in a garden or at the grocery store in spring. People cook it in hot water or on a pan and eat it with butter or salt. It makes your pee smell a little funny after you eat it.
Assembly line\n\nAn assembly line is a way to make things in a big building called a factory. It has a long moving belt. A thing being made moves on the belt from one spot to the next. At each spot, a person or a machine adds one part. By the end, the thing is all put together. This makes many things very fast. Cars are often made this way. A long time ago, a man named Henry Ford used an assembly line to make cars that many people could buy.
Association\n\nAn association is a group of people who come together for the same reason. It can be a club at school, like a reading club. It can also be a group of grown-ups who help others, like a group that plants trees. People in an association meet, talk, and do things together.
Association football\n\nAssociation football is a game where two teams try to kick a ball into a goal. It is also called soccer. Each team has 11 players, and one player stands in front of the goal to stop the ball with their hands. The other players use their feet to move the ball. The team that kicks the ball into the goal more times wins. A game has two parts with a break in the middle. People play it in parks, schools, and big stadiums all over the world. Many kids play it with friends after school.
Asteroid\n\nAn asteroid is a big rock that moves around the Sun. It is smaller than a planet, but some are as wide as a city. Most of them are in a belt between Mars and Jupiter. A few come close to Earth. Long ago, a big one may have hit Earth and made the dinosaurs go away. Scientists study them to learn about space.
Asteroid belt\n\nThe asteroid belt is a big ring of rocks in space. It sits between Mars and Jupiter, two of our planets. The rocks in it are small and big, like pebbles and giant stones. Some are as tiny as dust, and some are as big as a mountain. The biggest one is called Ceres. The belt is very far from Earth, so we cannot see it without a big telescope. It is like a road made of rocks that goes all around the Sun.
Asthma\n\nAsthma is a sickness that makes it hard to breathe. It happens inside the lungs, where the air tubes get narrow and puffy. A person with asthma may make a whistling sound when breathing, cough a lot, or feel tight in the chest. It can start when someone is a child. Some things like dust, pets, or smoke can make it worse. There is no cure, but medicine helps. A doctor can show how to use a special puffer to feel better.
Astronaut\n\nAn astronaut is a person who travels into space. He wears a big white suit with a round helmet to keep him safe. He rides in a rocket ship that goes very fast and high up above the clouds. In space, he floats because there is no gravity to pull him down. He can visit a big house in the sky called a space station. From there, he can look down and see the whole Earth, which looks like a big blue and green ball.
Astronomical object\n\nAn astronomical object is a thing that floats in space. It can be big like a star or small like a rock. You can see some of them in the night sky, like the moon and tiny dots of light. The sun is a star, and it gives us light and heat. Earth is a planet, and it is where we live. A moon goes around a planet, and we see our moon at night.
Astronomy\n\nAstronomy is the study of things in the sky. It looks at stars, the moon, the sun, and faraway worlds. People use big tubes called telescopes to see these things better. Long ago, people watched the sky with just their eyes. They made up stories about the shapes they saw. Today, we know the sun is a star and the earth moves around it. Astronomy helps us learn what is out there in space.
At\n\nAt is a tiny word we use to say where something is or when something happens. It looks like two letters, A and T, put together. You see it in books, on signs, and in messages. We use it to tell a place, like "I am at the park," or a time, like "We eat at noon." It helps us share where we are and when we do things.
Atacama Desert\n\nThe Atacama Desert is a very dry place in the country of Chile. It is so dry that almost no rain falls there for many, many years. Some parts of it have not seen rain for over 400 years. It is not a hot desert like others; the air can be cool, and sometimes fog rolls in from the big ocean nearby. People who live there use big plastic sheets to catch tiny water drops from the fog. The water drips into pans so they can drink it and water their plants. The ground has a lot of salt and special rocks. Long ago, people found very old mummies buried in the dry sand.
Atheism\n\nAtheism is an idea. It means a person does not believe in any god. Some people believe in one god, and some believe in many gods. An atheist does not believe in any of them. It is not the same as not knowing. A person can say, "I do not know if a god is real," and that is different. Many atheists look at the world and see no proof of a god. They think nature is all there is. In some places, many people are atheists. In other places, very few are. Long ago, saying you were an atheist could get you in big trouble. Today, in many countries, people are free to be atheists or to believe in a god. It is a choice about what you think is true.
Athena\n\nAthena is a goddess from old Greek stories. She is the goddess of being smart, making things, and fighting in a clever way. She wears a helmet and holds a round shield. An owl sits near her because the owl is her special sign. People in Greece built a big, pretty house for her on a tall hill. That house is called the Parthenon. Athena gave people the first olive tree. The tree gave them food, oil, and wood. She helps heroes in stories when they need a good plan.
Athens\n\nAthens is a big, old city. It is the most important city in the country of Greece. It has many old stone buildings from a very long time ago. One famous building is the Parthenon, which was a special house for a goddess. Many people live in Athens today, and it has buses, trains, and a big boat stop called a port. Long ago, people in Athens started the first way of voting, which we call democracy.
Athlete\n\nAn athlete is a person who plays a sport. He runs, jumps, throws, or swims very well. He trains hard every day to get strong and fast. You can see an athlete at a big field, a pool, or a gym. He wears special clothes and shoes for his sport. Many children watch athletes on TV during big games like the Olympics.
Athletics\n\nAthletics is a big word for running, jumping, and throwing games. It is a sport where people try to go fast, jump high, or throw far. You can see it at school on sports day or on TV when big games are on. Kids do athletics when they race their friends or play catch with a ball. It makes your body strong and your heart happy.
Atlanta\n\nAtlanta is a big city in the state of Georgia. It has tall buildings, busy streets, and many people. You can find it near a river called the Chattahoochee. It is known for a very busy airport where many planes take off and land. A famous drink called Coca-Cola comes from there. Long ago, it was burned down but was built again, like a bird that rises from fire.
Atlantic\n\nThe Atlantic is a very big ocean. It is a huge body of salty water. You can find it between America and Europe and Africa. Many big ships sail on it to carry things from one land to another. It is home to fish, whales, and dolphins. When you go to a beach on the east side of America, the water you see is part of the Atlantic.
Atlantic Ocean\n\nThe Atlantic Ocean is a very big body of salty water. It is the second biggest ocean on Earth. It touches the east side of North and South America, and the west side of Europe and Africa. Big ships cross it to carry people and things from one land to another. The water is deep and blue, and many fish live in it. Some parts are warm, and some parts are cold. People like to swim and play at the beach next to it.
Atlantic Slave Trade\n\nThe Atlantic Slave Trade was a sad time long ago when people were taken from their homes in Africa. They were put on big boats and sent far across the ocean. They had to work very hard on farms with no pay and no freedom. Many families were broken apart. It was wrong and hurt many people.
Atlantis\n\nAtlantis is a made-up island from very old stories. It was a big piece of land in the ocean. People lived there long, long ago. The story says it sank down under the water and was gone. Some people think a real island that had a big fire mountain might be the start of the story. Today, you can see Atlantis in cartoons, books, and movies about underwater places.
Atlas\n\nAn atlas is a big book full of maps. It has many pages that show different parts of the world. You can find it in a library or at school. People use it to learn where countries, oceans, and mountains are. A map inside it might show your own town with little lines for streets.
Atlas Mountains\n\nThe Atlas Mountains are a long line of tall hills in Africa. They stretch across three countries near the top of the continent. The highest part is a big rock peak that touches the sky. Snow can fall on the top even when it is hot below. The mountains keep the dry desert sand away from the green land near the sea. People live in small villages on the sides and grow food on the slopes. Some people there tell old stories about a giant who held up the sky.
Atmosphere\n\nAn atmosphere is a blanket of air around a big thing in space, like a planet. It is made of tiny bits of gas you cannot see. It wraps around the planet and stays there because the planet pulls on it. The air we breathe is part of Earth's atmosphere. It keeps us warm and safe from the sun's strong rays. When you look up at the sky, you are looking through the atmosphere.
Atmosphere of Earth\n\nThe atmosphere of Earth is a big blanket of air all around our planet. It is made of tiny things called gases that we cannot see. The air has a gas called oxygen that we breathe in. It also has a gas called nitrogen, which is the most. The atmosphere keeps us safe from the sun's strong rays. It also holds heat so nights are not too cold. You can feel it when the wind blows on your face.
Atmospheric pressure\n\nAtmospheric pressure is the push of air all around us. It is the weight of the big blanket of air above the Earth. You cannot see it, but it is always there. When the air is thick and heavy, the push is strong. When the air is thin and light, the push is weak. High up on a tall mountain, it is weaker because there is less air above. A tool called a barometer can tell us how strong the push is. People who study weather use it to know if a storm is coming.
Atmospheric science\n\nAtmospheric science is the study of the air around our Earth. It looks at how the air moves, how it gets hot or cold, and how it makes clouds and rain. People who do this job use big balloons, flying machines, and special tools to watch the sky. They tell us what the weather will be like tomorrow. You see their work when you watch the weather news on TV.
Atoll\n\nAn atoll is a ring of tiny islands in the ocean. It looks like a doughnut made of sand and trees. You find it in warm, blue water far away. Coral, a tiny sea animal, builds the ring over a very long time. Inside the ring, the water is calm and shallow. People can live on the bigger islands and fish in the quiet water.
Atom\n\nAn atom is a tiny, tiny piece that makes up everything around us. It is so small you cannot see it with your eyes. Inside it, there is a heavy middle part and light bits that move around it. Everything you touch—like water, air, and your toys—is made of many atoms. When atoms join together, they make new things, like how two small bits join with one other bit to make a drop of water.
Attention\n\nAttention is when you look at one thing and think about only that thing. It is like a flashlight in your brain that shines on what you pick. You use it when you listen to a story or watch a bug crawl on a leaf. It helps you learn new things and remember them. Sometimes it is hard to keep it on one thing for a long time, and that is okay.
Attic\n\nAn attic is a room at the very top of a house, just under the roof. It often has a small window and a wooden floor. People use it to store old boxes, toys, and clothes they do not need every day. Sometimes you can find a dusty old book or a funny hat up there. It can be warm in summer and cold in winter.
Aubergine\n\nAn aubergine is a purple fruit that people cook like a vegetable. It has a smooth, shiny skin and a soft inside with tiny seeds. You can find it at the grocery store near other vegetables. People cut it up and cook it in soups, stews, or on the stove. It tastes mild and soaks up flavors from other foods.
Audience\n\nAn audience is a group of people who watch or listen to the same thing together. It can be big or small. You find an audience at a play, a movie, a concert, or a sports game. They clap and cheer when they like what they see. Sometimes they are quiet and just watch. A live audience is right there in the same room as the show.
Auditory system\n\nThe auditory system is the part of your body that lets you hear. It uses your two ears to catch sounds all around you. The outside part of the ear is the soft, curvy skin you can see on the side of your head. Inside, a thin, tight skin called the eardrum shakes when sound hits it. Tiny bones behind the eardrum pass the shake to a snail-shaped part deep inside. That part turns the shake into a message that goes to your brain. Your brain then tells you what the sound is, like a dog barking or a song playing. The ear also helps you keep your balance so you do not fall down.
August\n\nAugust is a month in the year. It comes after July and before September. It is a warm month in many places, and children do not go to school. You can play outside, swim, and eat ice cream. Many families go on a trip in August. The days are long and sunny.
Auk\n\nAn auk is a bird that lives near the cold ocean. It has a thick body, small wings, and short legs. It is black on the back and white on the belly, like a penguin. It can fly and swim very well. It stays far from land for a long time, then comes to land to make a nest and raise babies.
Aunt\n\nAn aunt is the sister of your mom or your dad. She is part of your family. Sometimes she is also the wife of your uncle. She may live near you or far away. She might give you hugs, read you stories, or bring you small gifts. You can call her "Aunt" and then her name, like Aunt Mary.
Aurochs\n\nAn aurochs was a big, wild cow. It lived a long time ago in Europe and other places. It had long, curved horns that looked like the shape of a lyre. It was much bigger than the cows we see on farms today. The boy aurochs was black with a light stripe down its back, and the girl aurochs was a red-brown color. It was very strong and could be angry. Long ago, people thought it was brave to hunt one. Now there are no more aurochs left anywhere on Earth.
Aurora\n\nAn aurora is a pretty light show in the night sky. It looks like long, soft curtains of green, pink, or purple light that move slowly. You can see it only in very cold places near the North Pole or the South Pole. It happens when tiny bits from the sun bump into the air high above us. The bump makes the air glow, like a night-light in the sky. People also call it the northern lights or southern lights.
Australia\n\nAustralia is a big island country far away. It is very hot and dry in the middle, so most people live near the sea. You can find animals there that live nowhere else, like the kangaroo and the koala. The kangaroo hops on two strong back legs and carries its baby in a pouch. The koala sits in trees and eats leaves. Long ago, the first people walked to Australia and took care of the land. Today, big cities like Sydney have tall buildings and busy streets. Many children in Australia like to play outside and go to the beach.
Australian rules football\n\nAustralian rules football is a game played with a ball. It is played on a big oval field with four tall poles at each end. Players kick the ball to score points. A kick between the two middle poles is a goal and gives six points. A kick between the outer poles gives one point. Players can also bounce the ball and hit it with their hand to pass it. The game has four parts called quarters. Many people in Australia love to watch it.
Austria\n\nAustria is a country in the middle of Europe. It has tall, snowy mountains called the Alps in the west and flatter land in the east. Many people there speak German. The biggest city is Vienna. A long time ago, kings and queens lived there in big palaces. Today, people visit to see the mountains, old buildings, and to eat a thin meat dish called Wiener Schnitzel.
Authoritarianism\n\nAuthoritarianism is a way of running a country. It means one person or a small group makes all the rules. People must follow the rules and cannot say no. They cannot choose their own leaders in a free vote. In some places, a king or a boss who stays for a very long time runs things this way.
Autism\n\nAutism is a way some people's brains work. It is something a person is born with and stays with them their whole life. A person with autism may find it hard to talk to others or make friends. They might like doing the same thing every day and feel upset if things change. They may move their body in the same way over and over, like flapping their hands. Some people with autism are very good at one thing they love, like trains or numbers. You cannot see autism by looking at someone, but you can see it in how they act.
Auto racing\n\nAuto racing is a sport where people drive cars very fast. It has many kinds of races. In one kind, the cars are low and have big wings that push them down. These races happen in many countries. Another kind uses cars that look like normal cars but go super fast on round tracks. Some races last a whole day, and drivers take turns. You might see auto racing on TV with colorful cars zooming around a track.
Autocracy\n\nAutocracy is a way of running a country. In it, one person has all the power. This person makes every big choice, and no one else can say no. Long ago, many places were run this way, like the old Roman Empire. Today, some countries still have one ruler who tells everyone what to do. It is not like a democracy, where many people vote and share the power.
Automation\n\nAutomation is when a machine does a job all by itself. It does not need a person to push buttons or pull levers every time. You can find it in many places, like a robot arm that paints cars in a big factory. It helps make things the same way every time, so toys and snacks look just right. It also keeps people safe by doing heavy or hot work for them. A washing machine at home is a simple kind of automation. You put clothes in, press start, and it washes them without your help.
Automobile\n\nAn automobile is a machine with four wheels that moves on roads. It has a metal body, seats inside, and a wheel for turning. You see it on streets and in parking lots. People use it to go to school, the store, or faraway places. It goes fast and carries a whole family. Some automobiles use gas to run, and some use electricity from a big battery.
Automotive industry\n\nThe automotive industry is all about making cars and trucks. It is the work of many people who think up new cars, build them in big factories, and then sell them to families. You see the things it makes every day on the road. A car has four wheels, doors, and seats inside. A truck can carry big, heavy things in its back. Long ago, the first cars were slow and looked like a box on wheels. Today, cars come in many colors and shapes. Some are small and some are big. Many families have one car or more to go to the store or to visit Grandma.
Autumn\n\nAutumn is a time of year after summer and before winter. It is also called fall. In many places, the air gets cool and the wind blows. Leaves on trees turn yellow, red, or brown and then fall to the ground. Farmers pick apples, pumpkins, and other food from their fields. Many animals look for food to save for the cold winter. Children go back to school when autumn starts. You can see piles of leaves on the grass and hear them crunch under your feet.
Avalanche\n\nAn avalanche is a big pile of snow that slides down a mountain very fast. It looks like a white river of snow, and it can carry rocks and trees with it. You find it on tall mountains where lots of snow has fallen. It can be dangerous for people who ski or play in the snow. If you see one, try to grab a strong tree or a big rock to stay safe.
Aviation\n\nAviation is flying in the sky using a big machine with wings. It is a way people travel far away very fast. You see it at an airport, where planes take off and land. A pilot sits in the front and steers the plane. Many people ride inside to visit new places. A long time ago, people made kites and balloons to go up high. Today, planes carry people and boxes all over the world.
Avicenna\n\nAvicenna was a very smart man who lived a long, long time ago. He thought a lot about how the body works and how to help sick people feel better. He wrote many big books that doctors read for hundreds of years. He also thought about stars, numbers, and how people think. Today, people remember him as a great teacher and healer.
Avocado\n\nAn avocado is a fruit that is shaped like a pear. It has a dark green skin that can be bumpy or smooth. Inside, the soft part is light green and feels creamy. You can find it in warm places like Mexico. People cut it open and eat the inside. It is used to make a dip called guacamole. Many people like to put it on toast or in salads. It has healthy fat that is good for your body.
Avoid\n\nTo avoid something means to stay away from it. It is like when you see a big puddle on the sidewalk and you walk around it so your shoes do not get wet. You can also avoid a loud noise by covering your ears. When you do not want to get hurt, you avoid things that are sharp or hot. It helps keep you safe and happy.
Awake\n\nAwake means your eyes are open and you are not sleeping. It is the time when you can play, eat, and talk. In the morning, the sun comes up and you wake up. You feel awake and ready for the day. At night, you get sleepy and go to bed. When you are awake, you can see, hear, and move your body.
Away\n\nAway means not here. When you go away, you leave a place. If your ball rolls away, it moves far from you. You might go away on a trip with your family. When someone is away, you cannot see them right now. You can wave and say bye-bye when a friend goes away.
Awesome\n\nAwesome means something is really, really good. It is a word you say when you see a big, bright rainbow or a fast red fire truck. You can feel awesome when you learn to ride your bike without help. A friend who shares a toy is awesome too. It is a happy word for things that make you smile big.
Axe\n\nAn axe is a tool for cutting wood. It has a sharp metal part and a long handle. You can find it in a shed or with a firefighter. People use it to chop big logs into smaller pieces. A woodcutter swings it to split a tree trunk.
Axle\n\nAn axle is a long, straight bar that helps wheels turn. It goes through the middle of a wheel. You can find it on cars, bikes, and toy wagons. When the wheel spins, it spins around the axle. On a car, it holds the wheels in place and carries the heavy weight of the car. On a bike, you can see a thin metal bar between the two wheels. Without it, the wheels would fall off.
Azerbaijan\n\nAzerbaijan is a country. It sits where Asia and Europe meet. It has big mountains, green fields, and a sea called the Caspian Sea on one side. The main city is Baku. Many people there speak a language also called Azerbaijani. They like to drink black tea and eat a rice dish called plov. They also love music and fast dancing. A special horse from there is called the Karabakh horse. It is one of the oldest kinds of horses in the world.
Aztec\n\nThe Aztec were people who lived a long, long time ago. They built big stone houses and tall step-like towers. They lived in a warm place with many lakes and mountains. They grew corn, beans, and squash to eat. They made colorful clothes and beautiful gold art. Today, you can see old Aztec stones in museums.
Aztecs\n\nThe Aztecs were people who lived a long time ago. They lived in a place that is now called Mexico. They built a big city on an island in a lake. They grew corn, beans, and squash to eat. They made chocolate from cocoa beans, but it was not sweet like today. They played a ball game with a rubber ball and hoops on walls.
Baba Yaga\n\nBaba Yaga is a make-believe old woman from old stories. She looks like a scary, wrinkly lady. She lives in a house that stands on big chicken legs, so it can walk around. Sometimes she flies in a big bowl with a stick that stirs it. In some tales she is mean, but in others she helps people. You might see her in a video game or a cartoon.
Baboon\n\nA baboon is a big monkey. It has a long face, a short tail, and thick fur. It lives in Africa and a place called Arabia. It stays on the ground with many other baboons in a big family. It eats grass, roots, bugs, and small animals. It can also take food from people. Big cats and wild dogs try to catch it, but it makes loud sounds and shows its teeth to scare them away.
Baby\n\nA baby is a very young person. It is smaller than a big kid and cannot walk or talk yet. A baby has soft skin, tiny fingers, and a round head. You can find a baby at home with its mom and dad. It sleeps a lot, drinks milk, and cries when it needs something. A baby grows fast and soon learns to smile and play.
Back\n\nYour back is the part of your body behind you. It goes from your neck down to your bottom. It has a long row of bones in the middle called a spine. You use it to stand up straight, bend over, and pick up toys. When you lie on a bed, your back rests on the soft blanket. Sometimes it can feel sore if you sit too long.
Backgammon\n\nBackgammon is a game for two people. It uses a board with long triangles and small round pieces. Each player rolls two dice to see how many spaces to move. The goal is to move all your pieces around the board and off first. You can find it at home or in a game box. It takes about as long as a short TV show to play one game.
Backpack\n\nA backpack is a bag you wear on your back. It has two straps that go over your shoulders. You can put books, a lunch box, or toys inside it. Many kids take a backpack to school every day. It keeps your hands free while you walk or run.
Backyard\n\nA backyard is an open space behind a house. It has grass, and sometimes flowers or a tree. You can run, play ball, or have a picnic there. Some backyards have a swing set or a sandbox. It is a safe place to play outside with friends or family.
Bacon\n\nBacon is a kind of meat that comes from a pig. It is cut into thin, flat pieces. People cook it in a hot pan until it gets crispy and brown. It smells very strong and tasty when it cooks. Many people eat it for breakfast with eggs. Some people do not eat it because of their family's rules about food.
Bacteria\n\nBacteria are tiny living things so small you need a special tool to see them. It is just one little cell, with no inside parts like our body cells have. It lives almost everywhere—in dirt, in water, on your skin, and inside your tummy. Some kinds help make food like yogurt and cheese. Other kinds can make you sick, but your body fights them. It grows by splitting into two new ones.
Bad\n\nBad means something is not good. It can be a feeling, like when you drop your ice cream. It can be a thing, like a toy that is broken. It can be an action, like hitting a friend. When something is bad, it makes you sad or upset. But sometimes, a bad day can turn into a good day after a hug.
Badge\n\nA badge is a small, flat piece of metal or cloth. It often has a picture, a word, or a shiny star on it. You can pin it on your shirt or jacket. People wear a badge to show they belong to a group, like a scout or a team. A police officer wears a badge to show their job. Sometimes you get a badge for doing something good, like helping in class.
Badly\n\nBadly means doing something in a way that is not good. When you color outside the lines, you color badly. It is the opposite of doing something well. If you feel sick, you might say you feel badly. It tells how an action happens.
Badminton\n\nBadminton is a fun game you play with a racket. It is for two or four people. You hit a small thing called a shuttlecock over a high net. The shuttlecock has feathers on top and a round bottom. You try to make it land on the other side so the other player cannot hit it back. You can play it in a yard, a park, or a big gym. Many people in Asia love to play it.
Baffin Bay\n\nBaffin Bay is a big body of cold water. It sits between a big island and a land called Greenland. It is covered with ice for much of the year, so boats cannot go there easily. Many animals live in and around it, like white whales, seals, and big white bears. Small birds also fly near it in summer and then fly away when it gets very cold.
Bag\n\nA bag is a soft thing that can hold other things. It has an open top and often has handles or straps. You can find bags at home, at school, or at the store. People use a bag to carry toys, books, food, or clothes. A backpack is a kind of bag that you wear on your back.
Baghdad\n\nBaghdad is a big, old city in a country called Iraq. It sits next to a long river named the Tigris. Long ago, it was a place where many people came to learn and share stories. Today, many people live there and call it home.
Bagpipes\n\nBagpipes are a musical instrument. It has a soft bag that holds air. A person blows into a tube to fill the bag, then presses it with an arm. The air comes out through a pipe with holes, and the player covers the holes to make different sounds. It also has long pipes that play one steady note. You can hear it at parades or big outdoor shows. The sound is loud and strong, and people often march while playing it.
Bahrain\n\nBahrain is a small country made of islands. It sits in warm blue water called the Persian Gulf. It has flat land with sand and a few low hills. People find sweet water under the ground and salty water in the sea around it. Long ago, people came to Bahrain for pearls from the ocean. Today, many people work with oil that comes from deep under the ground. A long bridge connects it to a bigger country next door.
Bake\n\nTo bake is to cook food in a hot box called an oven. It uses dry heat to make the food ready to eat. You can bake bread, cookies, and cakes. When you bake, the kitchen smells warm and sweet. Many people bake for birthdays or holidays. A child can help by mixing the soft dough.
Baker\n\nA baker is a person who makes bread, cakes, and cookies. He works in a bakery, which is a shop full of yummy smells. He wears a white hat and a white coat to stay clean. He mixes flour, water, and other things to make dough. Then he puts the dough into a hot oven to bake. You can see a baker early in the morning when he makes fresh bread for the day. Maybe you have eaten a cookie or a cupcake that a baker made.
Bakery\n\nA bakery is a shop where people make and sell bread, cakes, and cookies. It smells warm and sweet inside. Bakers wake up very early to mix flour, water, and other things. They put the dough into a hot oven to bake. You can buy a loaf of bread, a cupcake, or a cookie there. Some bakeries also make pies and pastries. It is a happy place to visit with your family.
Baking\n\nBaking is a way to cook food using an oven. It makes things like bread, cakes, and cookies. You mix flour, water, sugar, and other things into a soft dough. Then you put it in a hot oven to bake. When it comes out, it is warm and yummy. A person who bakes is called a baker. You can buy baked goods at a bakery. Many people bake at home for fun or for a party.
Baku\n\nBaku is a big city by the sea. It is the most important city in a country called Azerbaijan. It has an old part with small streets and a new part with tall buildings. Many people live there. Under the ground near the city, there is a lot of oil. Oil is a black liquid that can make cars and machines go. Baku also has big places where people play soccer and chess.
Balance\n\nBalance is when you can stand or move without falling over. It is like when you walk on a straight line or stand on one foot. You use it when you ride a bike or climb on a playground. Your body has a special part inside your ear that helps you keep balance. You can practice it by walking slowly on a low wall or a beam.
Bald\n\nBald means having no hair on the head. It looks smooth and shiny on top. Some people are bald because they are older, and some are bald when they are young. You might see a bald person at the store or on TV. A bald head can feel warm in the sun, so some people wear a hat.
Bali\n\nBali is a warm island in the country of Indonesia. It has green rice fields, tall hills, and two big fire mountains called volcanoes. Many people visit Bali to see old stone temples and watch bright dances with music and masks. The people there mostly follow a religion called Hindu. They grow rice and make clothes to sell. The biggest town on the island is Denpasar.
Balkan Mountains\n\nThe Balkan Mountains are a long line of tall hills and rocks. They stretch from one country to another in a part of the world called Europe. The tops are often covered with snow in winter. Many trees grow on the sides, and animals like bears and birds live there. People walk up the paths to see the view from the top. Some roads go through low places between the peaks so cars can cross.
Balkans\n\nThe Balkans is a big piece of land in Europe. It has mountains and forests and is next to the sea on three sides. Many different people live there, and they speak different languages and go to different churches. A long time ago, strong fighters called Romans took over the land. Today, many families live in the Balkans, and some of them cook yummy food like flat bread and grilled meat.
Ball\n\nA ball is a round toy or tool. It can be small like a marble or big like a beach ball. Some balls are soft and squishy, and some are hard and bouncy. You can throw it, catch it, kick it, or roll it on the ground. People play many games with a ball, like soccer, basketball, and catch. A ball can be many colors, like red, blue, or yellow. You might have a ball at home or see one at the park.
Ballad\n\nA ballad is a kind of song that tells a story. It is often slow and about love. People sing it with music, like a guitar or piano. You might hear a ballad on the radio when a singer sings about feelings. A long time ago, people wrote ballads on paper to share stories. Today, many bands play ballads that are soft and sweet.
Ballet\n\nBallet is a kind of dancing that tells a story. It uses soft steps, jumps, and turns. Dancers wear special shoes and pretty clothes. They practice for many hours to learn the moves. A teacher called a ballet master helps them. Ballet is done on a big stage with music. You might see it at a theater. One famous ballet is The Nutcracker. It has toy soldiers and a sugar plum fairy.
Ballista\n\nA ballista is a very old tool for throwing big sticks. It looks like a giant bow on a stand. People long ago used it in fights to send heavy spears far away. They pulled back a tight string and let it go to shoot. You might see one in a book about old times.
Balloon\n\nA balloon is a soft, stretchy bag that can get big when you blow air into it. It is made of thin, rubbery stuff that can be many bright colors. You see balloons at birthday parties and fun times. People tie a string to it and let it float, or they hang it on the wall. Some balloons are filled with water, and kids throw them at each other to play and get wet. A big, big balloon called a hot air balloon can carry people up into the sky.
Ballroom dance\n\nBallroom dance is a kind of dancing that two people do together. It is often a man and a woman who hold hands and move around a big room. There are two main types: smooth dances like the waltz, where they glide slowly, and lively Latin dances like the cha-cha, where they shake their hips. You can see it at a party, a wedding, or on a TV show. People also dress up in fancy clothes and compete to see who dances best.
Baltic Sea\n\nThe Baltic Sea is a big body of water in the north of Europe. It touches many lands like Sweden, Finland, and Poland. The water has very little salt, so the top can turn to ice in winter. People can even drive cars on the ice between some small islands. Long ago, boats sailed on it to carry things from one place to another. Today, many people still use it for travel and fishing.
Bamboo\n\nBamboo is a very tall kind of grass. It has a hard, wood-like stem that is hollow inside. The stem has rings called joints. It grows in warm places like Asia, Africa, and America. People use it to build houses, bridges, and boats. It is also the food that giant pandas eat. Some people cook and eat the soft new shoots. It grows very fast, sometimes taller than a grown-up in one day.
Banana\n\nA banana is a long, soft fruit that grows in warm places. It has a thick yellow skin that you peel off. Inside, it is white or light yellow and tastes sweet. You can eat it raw as a snack or put it in cereal. Some bananas are green and used for cooking. It grows in big bunches on tall plants that look like trees. Monkeys and people both love to eat it.
Band\n\nA band is a group of people who play music together. It has players with different tools like drums, guitars, and horns. You can see a band at a parade, a party, or on a big stage. They make happy sounds that make people want to dance and clap. Some bands wear matching clothes and march in a line. When you hear a band, you might feel the beat in your feet.
Bandage\n\nA bandage is a long, soft strip of cloth. It wraps around a cut or a scrape on your skin. It keeps the hurt place clean and stops a little blood. You might see a bandage in a first-aid box at home or at school. A grown-up puts it on you when you fall down and get a boo-boo. It helps your skin get better.
Bandung\n\nBandung is a big city in Indonesia. It sits on an island called Java. Many people live there, and it is full of pretty flowers and green trees. Long ago, leaders from many places came to Bandung for a big, friendly talk. People call it the City of Flowers because you can see bright blooms all around.
Banff National Park\n\nBanff National Park is a big, wild place in Canada. It has tall mountains with snow on top, big fields of ice, and thick green forests. Many animals live there, like bears, deer, and big sheep with curly horns. People go to the park to walk on trails, see the pretty blue lakes, and look at the animals. It is a very old park, and people have kept it safe for a long time.
Bang\n\nA bang is a loud, sudden noise. It sounds like a big pop or a hard hit. You might hear it when a door slams shut or when a balloon pops. It can also come from a drum if you hit it hard. A bang can make you jump because it is so quick and strong.
Bangkok\n\nBangkok is a very big city. It is the main city of a country called Thailand. Many, many people live there. It is hot almost all year. Lots of people visit it to see the big gold temples and ride on boats in the river. The city has a very long name in the Thai language, but people call it Bangkok for short.
Bangladesh\n\nBangladesh is a country in South Asia. It is a place with many people living close together. It has green fields, big rivers, and a long coast by the sea. The capital city is called Dhaka. People there speak a language called Bengali. Many people grow rice and fish in the rivers. The country has a big forest with trees that grow in water, where tigers live. It is a place with a long history and many stories.
Bank\n\nA bank is a place that keeps money safe. It has a big room with a counter and people who work there. You can find a bank in many towns and cities. People put their money in a bank to save it. Later, they can take the money out when they need it. A bank also gives money to people who want to buy a house. That is called a loan. The people must pay the money back a little at a time. A long time ago, people sat on a bench to trade money. That is where the word bank comes from.
Banknote\n\nA banknote is a piece of paper money. It is flat and has pictures and numbers on it. You can find it in a wallet or a purse. People use it to buy things like toys or food. A dollar bill is a banknote you might see.
Bankruptcy\n\nBankruptcy is a way to get help when you cannot pay your money back. It is a special rule from a court. When a person has no money to pay what they owe, a helper called a trustee takes some of their things and sells them. The money goes to the people they owe. After that, the person does not have to pay the rest. But it is harder for them to borrow money again. A company can also go bankrupt. Then a helper sells everything the company has, and the company closes. It is not the same as just having no money. It is a big step that a court must say yes to.
Baobab\n\nA baobab is a big, thick tree. It has a very fat trunk that can hold lots of water inside. It looks like its roots are sticking up in the air, so people call it the upside-down tree. It grows in hot, dry places in Africa and other lands. Its fruit is called monkey bread and tastes a little sour, like a mix of grapefruit and pear. People can eat the fruit and use the leaves to make soup. The trunk is sometimes so big that people make a little room inside it.
Baptism\n\nBaptism is a special water ceremony. It is a way to show that a person wants to follow God. A grown-up helper puts water on the person. Sometimes the water is just a little bit on the head. Other times the person goes all the way under the water. Many churches do this for babies. Some churches wait until the person is big enough to choose it. It is like a bath that says, "I am part of God's family now."
Bar\n\nA bar is a long, thin piece of something. It can be made of metal, wood, chocolate, or soap. You might see a bar on a playground to swing from. People also eat a bar as a snack, like a granola bar. A bar of soap is used to wash hands.
Barbados\n\nBarbados is a small island country in the big blue ocean. It has warm sun, soft sand, and clear water. Many people visit it to swim and play on the beach. It grows a sweet plant called sugar and makes a drink called rum. The people there speak English and love a game with a bat and ball called cricket.
Barber\n\nA barber is a person who cuts hair. He works in a shop with a big chair and a mirror. You sit in the chair, and he uses scissors and a buzzing tool to make your hair short and neat. He may also trim a beard or mustache. Many people go to a barber when their hair gets too long.
Barcelona\n\nBarcelona is a big city in Spain. It is next to the sea and has warm weather. Many people live there, and it has old buildings and new parks. People like to walk on a long street called La Rambla, where they see shows and shops. The city has a famous church with tall towers that is still being built. Many visitors come to eat small tasty foods and play on the beach. Barcelona also has a soccer team that wears red and blue.
Barcode\n\nA barcode is a picture of lines and spaces that a computer can read. It looks like a set of thick and thin black lines on a white box. You find it on almost every box or can you buy at the store. A machine at the checkout shines a red light on it to know what the thing is and how much it costs. When you see a pack of gum or a toy with a barcode, the scanner reads it fast and the computer says the name and price.
Bare\n\nBare means nothing is covering it. A bare foot has no sock or shoe on it. A bare tree has no leaves. When a room is bare, it has no furniture or toys inside. You can see bare ground where grass does not grow.
Barents Sea\n\nThe Barents Sea is a big, cold part of the ocean. It is near the top of the world, north of Norway and Russia. In winter, some of it is covered with ice, but in summer the ice melts. Many fish live in it, and people catch them for food. Big boats go out on it to bring fish back to land.
Barge\n\nA barge is a long, flat boat. It has a wide, open top and no tall parts. You can see it on rivers and canals. It carries big, heavy things like sand, rocks, or boxes from one place to another. Some barges are pulled by a small tugboat. A person who drives it is called a boatman.
Bark\n\nBark is the hard skin on the outside of a tree. It covers the tree trunk and branches, like a coat. It can feel bumpy or smooth, and it can be brown, gray, or white. It keeps the tree safe from bugs and bad weather. You can see it on trees in a park or in your yard. Some animals, like squirrels, climb on it.
Barley\n\nBarley is a plant that grows in fields. It has long, thin leaves and a tall stem with seeds at the top. Farmers plant it in big open spaces. People use its seeds to make food like bread and soup. Some people also use it to make a drink called beer. Animals like cows and horses eat it too. Barley has been grown for a very long time, even before your great-great-grandparents were born.
Barn\n\nA barn is a big building on a farm. It has tall walls and a wide roof. You can find it near fields and animals. Farmers use it to keep hay, tools, and animals safe. Sometimes it is painted red with white edges. A barn keeps things dry when it rains.
Barometer\n\nA barometer is a tool that checks how heavy the air is. It has a round face with a little hand that moves. You can find it in a weather station or sometimes in a house. It helps people know if the weather will be sunny or rainy. When the hand goes up, the air is heavy and the day is often clear. When the hand goes down, the air is light and rain may come. Pilots use a special kind to see how high their plane is flying.
Baroque\n\nBaroque is a fancy way of making art, buildings, and music from a long time ago. It has lots of curls, gold, and bright colors. You can see it in big old churches and palaces in Europe. The music has many notes that dance and jump. It makes people feel big and grand.
Barracuda\n\nA barracuda is a big fish that lives in warm ocean water. It has a long, thin body and a mouth full of very sharp teeth. It stays near the top of the water, close to sea grass and coral. It eats other fish, especially ones that are shiny and silver. Sometimes it can mistake a shiny bracelet on a person for a fish and try to bite. That is why people who swim in the ocean take off shiny things. It can swim very fast for a short time to catch its food.
Barranquilla\n\nBarranquilla is a big city in a country called Colombia. It sits near the top of the country, close to a big river and the sea. Many people live there, and it is one of the biggest cities in Colombia. People in Barranquilla have a big, happy party every year with music, dancing, and bright colors. It is a place where the weather is warm and sunny most of the time.
Basalt\n\nBasalt is a dark gray or black rock. It comes from hot, melted rock that flows out of a volcano. When the hot rock cools down fast, it turns into basalt. It is very hard and strong. People use it to make roads and sidewalks. You can also see it in some buildings and houses. Basalt is found in many places on Earth, and even on the Moon.
Base\n\nA base is the bottom part of something. It holds the rest of the thing up so it does not fall over. You can see a base under a lamp, a cup, or a big building. When you build with blocks, the block at the very bottom is the base. It keeps the tower strong and steady.
Baseball\n\nBaseball is a game where two teams take turns hitting a ball and running. It is played on a big grassy field with four white bags called bases. The bases make a diamond shape. One team throws the ball, and the other team tries to hit it with a bat. When a player hits the ball, they run around the bases to score a point. The other team tries to catch the ball and tag the runner out. You can see baseball in parks or on TV, and many kids play it in the backyard.
Basil\n\nBasil is a small green plant with soft leaves. It has a strong, sweet smell and a taste that is a little like candy. People grow it in gardens or in pots on a sunny windowsill. They use its leaves to add flavor to food, like pasta sauce or soup. You might see it on top of a pizza or mixed into a green sauce called pesto. It likes warm weather and needs water to stay happy.
Basket\n\nA basket is a container you can carry. It is made of long, thin pieces of wood, plastic, or grass woven together. You can find it in a kitchen, a garden, or a store. People use it to hold things like fruit, toys, or clothes. You might see a basket at a picnic with bread and apples inside.
Basket weaving\n\nBasket weaving is a way to make things by crossing strips over and under each other. It uses long, flat pieces like grass, thin wood, or paper. People do it to make baskets, mats, and bags. A basket is a bowl-shaped thing you can carry. You might see a woven basket at a picnic holding fruit or bread. Some people weave as a fun hobby at home.
Basketball\n\nBasketball is a game where two teams try to throw a ball into a hoop. It is played on a flat floor with a hoop at each end. The ball is round and orange, and it bounces when you push it down. Players run, jump, and pass the ball to their friends. They try to shoot the ball through the hoop to get points. You can see basketball in parks, school yards, and on TV. Many kids play it during recess or after school.
Basra\n\nBasra is a big city in a country called Iraq. It sits next to a wide river that leads to a big sea. Many boats stop there to bring things in and out of the country. It is one of the oldest cities in that part of the world. Long ago, people built it as a new home where they could live and pray together.
Bass guitar\n\nA bass guitar is a big string instrument that makes low, deep sounds. It looks like a guitar but is longer and heavier. It has a wooden body, a long neck, and four thick metal strings. You see it in bands that play rock, pop, or country music. A player plucks the strings with fingers or a small plastic pick. The sound goes through a wire to a big speaker so everyone can hear the deep notes. It helps the band by playing the low part of the song, like a steady heartbeat.
Bassoon\n\nA bassoon is a long wooden instrument that makes low sounds. It has many parts that fit together, and a small double reed at the top that you blow into. You hold it to your right side, and it is heavy, so players often sit on a strap to help carry it. It is found in an orchestra, where it plays deep, warm notes. Sometimes it plays funny bouncy tunes, and sometimes it plays sad, gentle songs. A person who plays it is called a bassoonist.
Bat\n\nA bat is a small animal that can fly. It has wings made of thin skin stretched over long finger bones. It sleeps during the day and comes out at night. It lives in dark places like caves, old buildings, or trees. It uses its ears to find its way in the dark by making high sounds that bounce back. It eats bugs, fruit, or sometimes nectar from flowers. You might see one flying in the evening sky when the sun goes down.
Bath\n\nA bath is a big bowl that people sit in to wash their body. It is usually found in a bathroom at home. It is often white and feels smooth and hard. You fill it with warm water and maybe some bubbles or nice-smelling soap. Then you can sit and relax while you get clean. Some people also go to big baths in special buildings to feel good and meet friends. A long, long time ago, people in old cities built big baths for everyone to use.
Bathing\n\nBathing is when you wash your body with water. It can happen in a bathtub, a shower, or even a big pool. People do it to get clean and stay healthy. Sometimes it is just for fun, like playing in the bath with toys. You might also see it at the beach when you swim in the ocean. After bathing, you feel fresh and smell nice.
Bathroom\n\nA bathroom is a room in a house. It has a toilet, a sink, and a tub or shower. People go there to wash hands, brush teeth, and take baths. It helps keep us clean every day. Some bathrooms are small with just a toilet and sink. Others are big with a tub for playing in water. You can find a bathroom in almost every home.
Bathtub\n\nA bathtub is a big bowl in the bathroom that you can fill with water. It is long and deep enough to sit or lie down in. You find it in most houses, next to the sink and the toilet. People use it to wash their body and to play with toys in the water. When you take a bath, you can add bubbles that smell nice and feel soft on your skin.
Battering ram\n\nA battering ram is a big, heavy log that people used long ago to break walls and doors. It is very thick and strong, and many people carry it together. In old times, soldiers used it to smash open castle gates made of wood or stone. They would swing it again and again until a hole appeared. Today, smaller ones are used by police to open locked doors in an emergency.
Battery\n\nA battery is a small thing that gives power. It is often a little round or square box. You can find it inside toys, a TV remote, or a flashlight. It makes things turn on, light up, or move without a cord. When a toy stops working, you may need a new battery.
Battle\n\nA battle is a big fight between two groups. It happens when each side wants to win. You can see it in old stories with knights and horses. Soldiers use swords, shields, or loud guns. A battle can change who is in charge of a land. Many battles happen on a big open field called a battlefield.
Battle-axe\n\nA battle-axe is a big, sharp tool for fighting. It has a long handle and a heavy metal head with a cutting edge. Long ago, fighters used it in battles. Some were small enough for one hand, and some were so big they needed two hands. It could cut through shields and armor. You might see one in a storybook about knights or in a cartoon with brave warriors.
Battleship\n\nA battleship is a very big boat used in wars. It is made of strong metal and has huge guns on top. Long ago, many countries used it to fight on the sea. Today, you can see old ones in museums, where they sit still for people to visit.
Bay\n\nA bay is a big pool of water that sits next to the land. It is part of the sea or a lake, and the land wraps around it on three sides. The water in a bay is often calm, so many bays have a soft, sandy beach where children can play. Some bays are small, and some are so big you cannot see the other side. A very big bay is sometimes called a gulf. You might see a bay when you go to the seaside with your family.
Bay of Bengal\n\nThe Bay of Bengal is a big body of water. It is part of the big ocean. It has a shape like a triangle. It sits next to India and some other lands. Many boats sail on it to carry things from one place to another. People catch fish in it. The water is warm and blue.
Bay of Biscay\n\nThe Bay of Biscay is a big part of the ocean. It sits next to the west side of France and the north side of Spain. The water is very deep, and the waves can get huge and scary. Big storms happen there, especially when it is cold outside. Long ago, boats got broken in the storms, but now people know when bad weather is coming. Many kinds of whales and dolphins live in this part of the ocean. It is a good place to see some whales that are hard to find anywhere else.
Be\n\nBe is a small word we use to talk about what something is. It helps us say things like "I am happy" or "The dog is big." We use it every day when we talk and write. It can change shape to am, is, or are. Without it, it is hard to make a sentence.
Beach\n\nA beach is a place where the land meets the water. It is covered with soft sand or tiny stones. You can find it next to the big ocean, a lake, or a river. People go to the beach to play in the sand, swim in the water, and feel the warm sun. Some beaches have white sand and clear blue water. You might see shells, little crabs, or birds there. Many families bring a towel and a bucket to build sandcastles. A beach is a happy place to run and splash.
Beach volleyball\n\nBeach volleyball is a game played on sand. It has two teams, with two people on each side. A net stands in the middle to split the court. Players hit a ball over the net with their hands. They try to make the ball land on the other team's sand. You can see it at the beach on a sunny day.
Bead\n\nA bead is a tiny, round thing with a hole through the middle. It can be made of wood, plastic, or glass. You find beads in craft boxes or on necklaces and bracelets. People put a string through the hole to make pretty jewelry. A bead can be many colors, like red, blue, or shiny gold.
Beak\n\nA beak is the hard, pointy mouth of a bird. It has no teeth, so the bird uses it to pick up food. You can see it on birds like a chicken, a duck, or a sparrow. It can be short or long, and it comes in many colors like yellow or black. A bird also uses it to clean its feathers and build a nest.
Beam\n\nA beam is a long, strong piece of wood or metal. It is straight and can be very heavy. You find it in buildings, holding up the roof or the floor above. It helps keep the house from falling down. When you look up in a big room, you might see a beam across the ceiling.
Bean\n\nA bean is a small seed that grows inside a pod. It can be round or flat and comes in many colors like red, black, or green. You find beans in gardens or at the store in cans or bags. People cook beans and eat them in soup or with rice. They are soft when you cook them and taste warm and yummy. A green bean is one kind you might see on your plate.
Bear\n\nA bear is a big, strong animal with thick fur. It has a large body, short legs, a short tail, and a wide head with small round ears. It lives in forests, mountains, and cold places all over the world. It can walk on all four legs or stand up on its back legs. It uses its big paws with long claws to dig, climb, and catch food. A bear eats many things like berries, grass, and fish. Some bears sleep all winter in a cozy den. A mother bear takes care of her little cubs and keeps them safe. You may know a bear from stories like Winnie the Pooh or a soft teddy bear toy.
Beard\n\nA beard is hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks. It can be short or long, thick or thin. Some men let it grow big, and some cut it short. Many men shave it off every day to keep their face smooth. You might see a beard on a dad, a grandpa, or a man in a storybook. Some animals, like goats, also have hair under their chin that people call a beard.
Beat\n\nA beat is a steady tap or sound that repeats. It is like a clock going tick, tick, tick. You can feel a beat in music when you clap your hands or tap your foot. Drums make a beat that people dance to. Your heart also makes a beat inside your chest, going thump, thump, thump.
Beatles\n\nThe Beatles were a band with four friends who played music together. They sang songs and played guitars and drums. Many people loved to hear them on the radio and at big shows. Their songs are still played today, and even kids can clap and dance to the happy tunes.
Beautiful\n\nBeautiful is a word we use when something makes us feel very happy just by looking at it. It can be a bright rainbow after the rain, a soft pink flower, or a shiny star in the night sky. You can find beautiful things all around you, like in a park, at the beach, or even in your own room. When you see something beautiful, you might smile or want to share it with a friend. A drawing you make with lots of colors can be beautiful too.
Beauty\n\nBeauty is a special feeling you get when something looks, sounds, or feels very nice. It can be a bright rainbow in the sky, a soft song, or a warm hug. You can find it in a flower, a smile, or a pretty painting. It makes you feel happy inside. A sunset with pink and orange colors is one example of beauty.
Beaver\n\nA beaver is a big animal with brown fur. It has a wide, flat tail and strong front teeth. It lives near rivers and lakes in North America and Europe. It can swim in water and walk on land. It builds a home called a dam out of sticks and mud. The dam stops the water and makes a small pond. Many other animals live in the pond too. A beaver cuts down trees with its teeth to get wood for the dam. Its fur is thick and soft to keep it warm in cold water.
Because\n\nBecause is a word that tells why something happens. It joins two parts of a sentence to give a reason. When you say "I am happy because I got a toy," it shows the toy is the reason for the happy feeling. People use it every day to explain things. It helps others understand what made something happen.
Become\n\nBecome means to change into something new. It is like when a tiny seed grows into a big flower. You can become a big kid when you learn to tie your shoes. A caterpillar becomes a butterfly inside a cozy cocoon. When you practice, you become better at drawing or singing.
Bed\n\nA bed is a soft place where you sleep at night. It has a big, fluffy part called a mattress on a strong frame. You put a sheet over the mattress and a warm blanket on top. A pillow goes under your head to make it comfy. Beds come in many sizes, like a small one for one person or a big one for two. You can find a bed in a bedroom at home. People use it to rest and dream when they are tired. A baby sleeps in a tiny bed called a crib. When you go camping, you might sleep on a small bed that blows up with air.
Bedbug\n\nA bedbug is a tiny bug that drinks blood. It has a flat, round body and no wings. It hides in beds, sofas, and small cracks during the day. At night, it comes out to bite people while they sleep. The bite feels itchy, like a mosquito bite. You might see small red spots on your skin in the morning.
Bedroom\n\nA bedroom is a room in a house where you sleep at night. It has a soft bed with a pillow and a blanket. You can find it in almost every home. It is a quiet place to rest when you are tired. In the morning, you wake up there and get ready for the day.
Bedtime\n\nBedtime is the time when you get ready to sleep. It happens at night when the sky is dark. You put on soft pajamas and brush your teeth. Then you climb into your cozy bed with a blanket and pillow. Mom or Dad may read you a story or sing a quiet song. After that, you close your eyes and rest until morning.
Bee\n\nA bee is a small flying bug that helps flowers grow. It has a fuzzy body with yellow and black stripes. It has six legs, four wings, and a tiny stinger at the back.
