You can see bees in gardens, parks, and fields where flowers bloom. It flies from flower to flower to pick up yellow dust called pollen. It uses the pollen to make food for its babies. Some bees live together in a big group called a hive. In a hive, one queen bee lays all the eggs. Worker bees are girls that find food and guard the home. A bee makes a sweet, sticky food called honey. People keep bees in wooden boxes to collect the honey. When a bee is scared, it might sting to protect itself. A sting can hurt, but bees usually stay calm if you leave them alone.
Beech\n\nA beech is a big tree with smooth, light gray bark. It has many green leaves that make deep shade on the ground. In spring, it grows tiny flowers, and later it makes small, pointy nuts. The nuts are called beechnuts, and some animals eat them. People use the wood from it to make chairs, tables, and tool handles. The wood also burns well in a fire. You might see it in a park or a forest, standing tall with other trees.
Beef\n\nBeef is meat that comes from cows. It is red before you cook it and turns brown when it is hot. People cut it into flat pieces called steak or chop it into tiny bits to make hamburgers. You can find it at the store or on a grill at a cookout. It has things inside that help your body grow strong, but eating too much is not good for you. Many people in a country called Argentina love beef and eat it often.
Beekeeping\n\nBeekeeping is when people take care of bees. They give the bees a safe home called a hive. The bees make sweet honey that people can eat. A beekeeper wears a special suit so the bees do not sting. Inside the hive, one big queen bee lays all the eggs. The other bees are her family. Some people keep bees in the city, and some keep them on farms. Bees also help flowers and food plants grow by carrying tiny yellow dust from one flower to another.
Beep\n\nA beep is a short, high sound. It comes from things like a car horn, a microwave, or a toy robot. You hear it when someone presses a button or when a machine wants to tell you something. A beep can mean "look out" or "I am done." Sometimes a truck goes beep-beep-beep when it moves backward.
Beer\n\nBeer is a drink that grown-ups sometimes have. It is yellow or brown and has bubbles on top. People make it from grains and water. It can taste bitter. You might see it in a can or a bottle at a store or a party. Kids do not drink beer.
Beet\n\nA beet is a plant with a round, fat root that grows under the ground. It is dark red or purple on the outside and bright red inside. You can find it in a garden or at a food store. People cook it and eat it in salads or soup. It tastes a little sweet and can turn your hands pink when you touch it.
Beethoven\n\nBeethoven was a man who made music a long time ago. He played the piano and wrote songs that people still play today. He lived in a place far away called Germany. When he grew older, he could not hear, but he still made beautiful music in his head. Many children learn to play his songs on the piano.
Beetle\n\nA beetle is a small bug with a hard, shiny body. It has six legs, two feelers on its head, and a tough shell on its back. You can find it in gardens, parks, and forests, but not in the ocean or very cold places. It uses its strong jaws to eat plants, dead things, or other tiny bugs. Some beetles can fly, and some have bright colors to warn birds that they taste bad. A ladybug is a beetle you might see on a leaf.
Before\n\nBefore means earlier in time. It is the opposite of after. When you wake up, morning comes before lunch. You put on your socks before your shoes. When you line up, the person in front is before you. Before you go to bed, you brush your teeth.
Begin\n\nTo begin means to start something. It is the very first step you take. When you open a new box of crayons, you begin to color. At school, the teacher says "let's begin" when it is time to learn. You can begin a game, a song, or a story. Every day, you begin with a big stretch and a smile.
Behavior\n\nBehavior is the way a person or an animal acts. It is what you do with your body and your words. When you share a toy, that is kind behavior. When you run and jump, that is active behavior. You can see behavior at home, at school, and on the playground. A dog wagging its tail is happy behavior. A cat purring is calm behavior. Everyone shows behavior all day long.
Behind\n\nBehind means at the back of something. When you stand behind a chair, the chair is in front of you. You can hide behind a door or a big tree. If you walk behind your friend, you follow them. It is the opposite of in front.
Beijing\n\nBeijing is a very big city in China. It is the capital, where the leaders work. It has many old buildings and big walls from long ago. Many people live there, and many more visit to see the sights. You can find big parks, busy streets, and a famous square. It is a place where old and new things meet.
Being\n\nBeing means that something is real and alive. It is what makes a person, an animal, or a plant not just a thing. When you are happy, sad, or sleepy, that is part of your being. Every living thing has its own way of being. A dog shows its being by wagging its tail. A flower shows its being by opening up to the sun.
Beirut\n\nBeirut is a big city by the sea. It has many old buildings and busy streets. People live there and work in shops and offices. It sits next to blue water, and tall mountains stand behind it. Long ago, many people came to Beirut to trade and share ideas. Today, families walk by the water and eat tasty food. It is a place full of stories.
Belarus\n\nBelarus is a country in Europe. It has many forests and lakes. The capital city is Minsk. Many people live there. It is next to Russia, Ukraine, Poland, and other places. The land is mostly flat and has big rivers. People speak Belarusian and Russian. A long time ago, it was part of a bigger group of countries. Now it is its own country.
Belgium\n\nBelgium is a country in Europe. It is not very big, and it sits next to France, Germany, Luxembourg, and the Netherlands. Many people there speak Dutch or French. Its main city is Brussels, where big groups from many countries meet. Belgium has flat land near the sea and hills with trees in the south. People eat yummy waffles and chocolate there. A king lives in Belgium, but the people also choose leaders to help run the country.
Belgrade\n\nBelgrade is a big city where many people live. It is the most important city in a country called Serbia. It has old buildings, busy streets, and a big river next to it. People visit to see the old walls and tall towers. At night, many lights turn on and people go out to eat and dance. Long ago, different groups of people lived there one after another. Today, it is a busy place full of cars, buses, and happy visitors.
Belief\n\nA belief is a strong thought that something is true. It lives inside your head and your heart. You cannot touch it or see it, but it feels real. Many people have a belief about a big, kind friend in the sky. Others have a belief that a friend will come to play. It is not like a fact you can check with your eyes. It is more like a warm feeling that helps you feel safe.
Believe\n\nBelieve means you think something is true. When you believe, you feel sure inside. You can believe in people, like your mom or your best friend. You can also believe in things you cannot see, like love or a wish. It helps you feel safe and happy.
Belize\n\nBelize is a small country in Central America. It sits next to the Caribbean Sea. It has many tiny islands and a big coral reef in the water. The weather is hot all year. People there speak English. Many also speak Spanish or other languages. You can see a bird with a big colorful beak called a toucan. You can also see a big animal like a donkey that loves water, called a tapir.
Bell\n\nA bell is a shiny metal thing that makes a sound. It is round and open at the bottom, with a little stick inside that hits the sides. You can find bells in churches, on boats, and in schools. When someone moves it, it goes ding-dong. A bell tells people the time or warns them to be careful. You might see a small bell on a cat's collar or on a bicycle.
Belly\n\nA belly is the soft, round part in the middle of your body. It is below your chest and above your legs. Inside it, your body keeps the food you eat and turns it into energy. When you are hungry, your belly might make a growling sound. After you eat a big meal, it can feel full and tight. You can put your hand on it to feel it move when you breathe.
Belly dance\n\nBelly dance is a kind of dance where people move their body in soft, round ways. It uses the hips and the tummy a lot. The dancer often wears bright clothes that show the tummy. It started in a place called Egypt, far away. People do it to happy music with drums and strings. You might see it at a party or a show. Many boys and girls learn it when they are small.
Belong\n\nTo belong means you are part of a group. It feels warm and safe, like when you sit with your family at dinner. You can belong at home, at school, or with your friends. When you belong, people know your name and smile when they see you. It is a happy feeling.
Below\n\nBelow means under something or lower than something. It is the opposite of above. You can find your shoes below your bed. A cat might hide below a table. When you look down, you see what is below you.
Belt\n\nA belt is a long, thin piece of clothing you wear around your waist. It is often made of soft animal skin called leather or strong cloth. It has a shiny metal part at one end called a buckle. You put the other end through the buckle to make it tight. It helps keep your pants or skirt from falling down. Many people wear a belt with jeans. You can see belts in black or brown most of the time. Some belts have fun buckles, like ones with a star or a horse.
Ben\n\nBen is a name for a boy. It is short and easy to say. You might know a Ben at school or in your neighborhood. A Ben can be a friend who likes to play and share toys. Sometimes a Ben has a big smile and a kind laugh.
Bench\n\nA bench is a long seat for more than one person. It has a flat part to sit on and legs to hold it up. You can find it in a park, a garden, or at a bus stop. People sit on it to rest, eat a snack, or watch birds. Some benches are made of wood, and some are made of metal. It can be a nice place to sit with a friend.
Bend\n\nA bend is when something straight turns or curves. It can be a bend in a road, a bend in a pipe, or a bend in your arm. When you fold a piece of paper, you make a bend in it. You can also bend your body to touch your toes. A bend changes the shape of a thing without breaking it.
Bengali Language\n\nBengali Language is a way people talk and write. It has pretty letters that look like round shapes and lines. Many people in a country called Bangladesh and a part of India speak it. They use it to say hello, sing songs, and tell stories. You might hear it if you meet someone from those places.
Benin\n\nBenin is a country in Africa. It is a long, thin shape on a map, next to the big ocean. Many people there speak French, but they also speak other local languages. In Benin, you can see elephants, lions, and monkeys in big parks. The weather is hot and wet, with lots of rain. Long ago, it was ruled by kings, and now it has its own leaders.
Beowulf\n\nBeowulf is a very old story about a brave man. It is a long poem from a land far away. In the story, a king and his people are scared of a big, mean monster that comes at night. Beowulf comes to help them. He fights the monster with his strong hands and wins. Later, he also fights the monster's angry mother and a big fire-breathing dragon. The story shows how Beowulf is strong and good. People still read this old story today in books and see it in movies.
Bering Sea\n\nThe Bering Sea is a big body of water near the top of the world. It touches Alaska on one side and Russia on the other side. It is very cold and full of fish, whales, and birds. Long ago, when the water was low, people walked across the land where the sea is now. Today, big boats go there to catch fish like salmon and crab.
Bering Strait\n\nThe Bering Strait is a narrow strip of water between two big lands. It sits between Russia and Alaska. It is not very deep, and it has a few tiny islands in the middle. Long ago, the water was not there, and people and animals could walk across on dry ground. Today, ships can sail through it. Some people dream of building a bridge or a tunnel so cars and trains could go from one side to the other.
Berlin\n\nBerlin is a big city in the country of Germany. It has many old and new buildings, wide streets, and a river that runs through it. Many people from all over the world live there. It is the capital city, so the leaders of Germany work there. A long time ago, a wall split the city into two parts, but now the wall is gone and people can walk everywhere. You can see a famous gate called the Brandenburg Gate, and many buses and trains bring people to work and school.
Bermuda\n\nBermuda is a group of small islands in the big blue ocean. It has one big island and many tiny islands around it. The sand on its beaches is pink and soft. The water is clear and warm. People visit Bermuda to swim and play. They also see old stone houses and bright flowers. It is far from other lands, so you need a boat or a plane to get there.
Berry\n\nA berry is a small, soft fruit that you can eat. It is often round and has tiny seeds inside or on the outside. Many berries are red, blue, or purple, and they taste sweet or a little sour. You can find them growing on small bushes in gardens or farms. People pick berries and eat them fresh, put them in cereal, or bake them into pies. A strawberry is a berry that many children love.
Best\n\nBest means the very top one. It is the one you like the most out of all the others. When you pick your favorite toy, that toy is the best. In a race, the runner who comes first is the best. You can be the best at sharing or helping. Being best does not mean you are better than everyone else. It just means you tried very hard and did a great job.
Betelgeuse\n\nBetelgeuse is a big, bright star in the night sky. It looks red and shiny. You can find it in a group of stars called Orion, which looks like a hunter. It is one of the biggest stars we can see. It is much, much bigger than our Sun. A long time from now, it will pop in a huge flash of light.
Better\n\nBetter means something is more good than another thing. It is a word we use when we compare two things. If you have a small cookie and a big cookie, the big cookie is better. It can also mean you feel more happy or well. After a nap, you might say, "I feel better." People use this word every day to talk about what they like more.
Between\n\nBetween means in the middle of two things. If you stand with a friend on your left and a friend on your right, you are between them. It can also mean a time that is after one thing and before another, like snack time is between lunch and dinner. You might see a small bug sitting between two big leaves in the garden.
Beverage\n\nA beverage is something you drink. It can be cold or hot. You find it in a cup, a bottle, or a glass. People drink it when they are thirsty. Water, milk, and juice are all beverages.
Bhagavad\n\nBhagavad is a very old story from India. It is a long poem about a man named Arjuna and his friend Krishna. They talk about big ideas like being brave and doing the right thing. People read it to feel calm and strong inside. You might see a picture of it in a book with blue and gold colors.
Bhagavad Gita\n\nThe Bhagavad Gita is a very old book from India. It is a story about a prince named Arjuna and his friend Krishna. In the story, Arjuna is sad and does not want to fight. Krishna teaches him to be brave and do the right thing. People read it to learn about being good and calm. Many people keep a copy at home or in a temple.
Bharata Natyam\n\nBharata Natyam is a kind of dance from India. It uses hands, face, and feet to tell a story. Dancers wear bright clothes with bells on their ankles. You can see it on a stage with music and singing. It is like a moving picture book.
Bhutan\n\nBhutan is a small country high up in big mountains. It has tall green hills, snowy tops, and clean rivers. Many people there follow a kind and quiet way of life. The king takes care of the land and the people. In Bhutan, you can see colorful birds, monkeys with golden fur, and pretty flowers. People love to shoot arrows at a target for fun. It is a place where the air is very fresh and the sky is blue.
Bias\n\nBias is when someone likes one idea more than another and does not treat both the same. It can show up in stories, news, or even how we measure things. For example, a news story might only tell good things about one side and leave out the bad. It can also use mean words to make something look bad. When we measure, bias can happen if we forget to take off our shoes and then say we are taller than we really are.
Biathlon\n\nBiathlon is a sport with two parts. It mixes skiing on snow and shooting at a target. You see it in cold places with lots of snow. A person skis fast on long, flat skis, then stops to shoot a small gun at round circles. It is like a race where you also need a steady hand. You can watch it on TV during the Winter Games.
Bib\n\nA bib is a small cloth that ties around a baby's neck. It hangs down over the baby's clothes. It catches food and drink that spills when the baby eats. Many bibs are made of soft cotton or plastic that is easy to wipe clean. You can see a bib in a kitchen or a restaurant when a family has a little baby.
Bible\n\nThe Bible is a very special book. It is made of many smaller books all put together. People read it in churches and at home. It tells stories about God and about a man named Jesus. It also has songs and wise sayings. Many people keep a Bible on a shelf or by their bed.
Bicycle\n\nA bicycle is a small ride with two wheels. It has a seat, two pedals, and a metal chain. A person sits on top and pushes the pedals with their feet to make it go. It has a handlebar to turn the front wheel. Many people ride a bicycle for fun or to go to school. It is a good way to move without using a car. Some bicycles have a bell to make a sound. Wearing a helmet keeps the rider safe.
Big\n\nBig means something is very large. It is the opposite of small. An elephant is big. A house is big. A big thing takes up a lot of space. You can see big things all around you, like a big tree or a big truck. When you grow up, you will get big too.
Big Bang\n\nThe Big Bang is how scientists think the whole universe began. It started very long ago as a tiny, hot, and heavy dot. Then it grew bigger and bigger very fast, like a balloon blowing up. From that big start, all the stars, planets, and everything we see came to be. The universe is still growing today, and it gets colder as it grows. Scientists see that faraway stars look red, which shows they are moving away from us.
Bike\n\nA bike is a thing with two wheels that you can ride. It has a seat, two pedals, and handles to hold. You push the pedals with your feet to make it go. Many kids ride a bike in the park or on the street. Some bikes have a little bell that goes ring-ring. You can ride it fast or slow, and it is fun.
Bill\n\nBill is a name for a boy or a man. It is a short way to say the name William. You might meet a Bill at school, at the park, or in a storybook. He could be a friend, a dad, or a grandpa. Some famous Bills are in movies or songs, but most Bills are just regular people you see every day.
Bin\n\nA bin is a box or a can that holds things. It can be made of hard plastic or metal. You find it in a kitchen, a room, or outside on the street. People use it to throw away trash or to keep toys tidy. When you put a candy wrapper in a bin, the room stays clean.
Binary number\n\nA binary number is a way to write numbers using only two digits: 0 and 1. It is like a secret code that computers use. Inside a computer, tiny wires can be on for 1 or off for 0. With many 0s and 1s, a computer can show words, songs, and videos. You can count with binary numbers just like you count with normal numbers, but each spot is worth two times the spot before it.
Bingo\n\nBingo is a fun game you play with a card and small markers. It has rows of numbers or pictures on a flat card. You find it at parties, school, or game nights with family. A grown-up calls out a number or word, and you cover it if you see it on your card. When you cover a whole row, you shout "Bingo!" and win. It is a happy game that makes people smile.
Binoculars\n\nBinoculars are a tool that helps you see things that are far away. It has two small tubes that you hold up to your eyes. Inside each tube there are special pieces of glass that make far things look big and close. You can find it in places where people watch birds, look at stars, or see a show on a big stage. Some people use it on a boat to look across the water. When you look through it, a bird in a tall tree looks like it is right next to you.
Biochemistry\n\nBiochemistry is a kind of science. It looks at the tiny things inside living bodies, like people, animals, and plants. It studies how these tiny parts work together to keep us alive. For example, it helps us know how food gives us energy to run and play. Scientists who do biochemistry work in labs with special tools.
Biodiversity\n\nBiodiversity means all the different kinds of living things in one place. It includes every plant, every animal, and every tiny bug. You can find it in a forest, in a pond, or even in your own backyard. When a place has many different living things, it is healthy and strong. People work hard to keep it safe so that animals and plants do not go away forever.
Biofuel\n\nBiofuel is a kind of fuel made from plants and other living things. It can be a liquid, a solid, or a gas. People use it to make cars go, to heat houses, and to cook food. One way to make it is from plants like corn or sugar cane. Another way is from old wood or grass. It is not the same as the old fuel from deep under the ground. That old fuel comes from things that died a very long time ago.
Biography\n\nA biography is the story of a real person's life. It tells what the person did, where they lived, and what they were like. You can find biographies in books at the library or in movies. Some people write the story of their own life, and that is called an autobiography. A biography helps us learn about people who lived long ago or far away.
Biology\n\nBiology is the study of all living things. It looks at animals, plants, and tiny living things we cannot see with our eyes alone. A person who studies biology is called a biologist. They watch how living things grow, move, and have babies. They also see how living things share food and space with each other. You can see biology when you plant a seed and it grows into a flower, or when a baby bird hatches from an egg.
Biome\n\nA biome is a big area of land where certain plants and animals live together. It has its own kind of weather, like hot or cold, wet or dry. You can find a biome all over the world, like a forest, a desert, or a grassland. In a forest biome, many trees grow and animals like deer and birds live there. In a desert biome, it is very dry and you might see a cactus or a lizard. Each biome is a special home for the living things that fit there best.
Biosphere\n\nThe biosphere is all the living things on Earth. It is like a big, invisible bubble that wraps around our planet. Inside it, you find every plant, animal, and tiny bug. It goes from deep in the ocean up to the sky where birds fly. Even in very cold ice or hot deserts, something lives there. The biosphere is our home where all life stays together.
Biotechnology\n\nBiotechnology is when people use living things to make new things. It uses tiny parts of plants, animals, or bugs that are too small to see. People use it to make bread rise and to make cheese. It can also help make medicine for sick people. Some farmers use it to grow bigger fruits and vegetables.
Birch\n\nA birch is a kind of tree. It has a thin, white trunk that looks like paper. You can find it in cool places with lots of trees. People use its wood to make things like chairs and toys. In fall, its small green leaves turn yellow and drop to the ground.
Bird\n\nA bird is an animal with feathers and wings. It has two legs, a beak, and a tail. Birds live all over the world—in trees, near water, and in gardens. It can fly high in the sky using its wings. Some birds, like a chicken or a duck, walk on the ground. A bird you might see is a robin with a red belly.
Bird of prey\n\nA bird of prey is a bird that hunts other animals for food. It has a strong, hooked beak and sharp claws called talons. It uses its claws to grab and hold its food. It has very good eyes to see small animals from far away. Some birds of prey fly and hunt during the day, like eagles and hawks. Others hunt at night, like owls. You might see one sitting on a high tree or flying in big circles in the sky.
Bird-of-paradise\n\nA bird-of-paradise is a kind of bird with very pretty feathers. It lives in warm, wet forests far away. The boy bird has long, bright, and fluffy feathers to show off. He dances and sings so a girl bird will pick him. The girl bird has plain brown feathers and builds a soft nest in a tree. It eats fruit and bugs. Some kinds are very small, and some are as big as a crow.
Birdhouse\n\nA birdhouse is a small home made for birds. It looks like a tiny wooden box with a round hole in the front. You can find it hanging in a tree or on a pole in a garden. Birds use it to stay safe from rain and wind. They also build a nest inside to keep their eggs warm. A child might see a birdhouse in a park or in a neighbor's yard.
Birmingham\n\nBirmingham is a big city in England. It has many houses, shops, and roads. A lot of people live there, more than in most other English cities. Long ago, people made cars and planes there. Today, you can still see big car factories. Many trains and cars go through the city every day.
Birth\n\nBirth is when a baby comes out of its mommy's tummy. It is the start of life outside the mommy. The baby grows inside a soft, warm place in the mommy for a long time. When the baby is ready, the mommy's body helps push it out. The baby comes out through a special path between the mommy's legs. A doctor or a nurse often helps the mommy and the baby. After birth, the baby cries, breathes air, and drinks milk. A baby cat is born from a mommy cat, and a baby bird comes out of an egg.
Birth Control\n\nBirth control is a way to stop a baby from growing inside a mommy's tummy. It can be a tiny pill she takes every day. Sometimes it is a small thing a doctor puts inside her body. It helps a family choose when they are ready to have a baby. A mommy and daddy talk to a doctor to pick the best way for them.
Birthday\n\nA birthday is the day you were born. It comes once every year. On this day, people have a party with friends and family. They eat a sweet cake with candles on top. The candles show how old you are. People sing a happy song and give you gifts wrapped in bright paper. You might get a card with kind words inside. Not everyone has a birthday party, but many children love this special day.
Biscuit\n\nA biscuit is a small baked food. It can be sweet or soft like bread. In some places, it is a flat, sweet treat you eat with tea or milk. In other places, it is a soft, round bread you eat with butter or jam. You can find biscuits at a bakery or make them at home with a grown-up.
Bison\n\nA bison is a big, strong animal with thick brown fur. It has a large head, short curved horns, and a big hump on its back. It lives in open grassy lands. It eats grass and plants all day. A long time ago, many bison walked across the land in big groups.
Bit\n\nA bit is a tiny piece of something. It is the smallest part you can have. You find bits in many places, like a bit of cookie on your plate or a bit of sand at the beach. People use the word to talk about a little bit of food, a little bit of time, or a little bit of color. When you share a snack with a friend, you might give them a bit.
Bite\n\nA bite is when you use your teeth to close down on something. It can be a small piece of food you take with your mouth, like a bite of an apple. When you eat a cookie, you take one bite after another until it is gone. Some bugs, like ants or mosquitoes, can bite your skin and make a little red bump. A bite from a dog or a cat can hurt, so you should be gentle with animals.
Bitter\n\nBitter is a sharp, strong taste. It is not sweet like candy or sour like a lemon. You can taste it in some foods like dark chocolate, coffee, or some green vegetables. Many people do not like it at first, but some learn to enjoy it when they grow up. It can also be a feeling, like when you are very sad about something.
Black\n\nBlack is a color. It is the darkest color you can see. You find it in the night sky when the lights are off. Many people wear black clothes to look neat and grown-up. A black cat is an animal with fur this color. Some people feel it is a strong color, and some feel it is a little scary.
Black Death\n\nThe Black Death was a very bad sickness a long time ago. It made people feel hot and get big bumps on their body. It spread from person to person very fast. Many people got sick and died. It happened in places far away, like Europe. Today, doctors have medicine to help, so it is not as scary.
Black hole\n\nA black hole is a place in space where gravity pulls so hard that nothing can get out, not even light. It is like a deep, dark hole you cannot see. You find it far away in space, at the center of big groups of stars called galaxies. It pulls in gas, dust, and even stars that come too close. When stuff falls in, it spins around fast and gets very hot, making a bright ring that telescopes can see. One black hole sits in the middle of our own galaxy, the Milky Way.
Black pepper\n\nBlack pepper is a tiny dried berry from a climbing plant. It is dark and wrinkly, and people grind it into a fine powder. You can find it in a small shaker on the dinner table at home or in a restaurant. It is used to add a hot, sharp taste to food like soup, eggs, or meat. When you smell it, it can make you sneeze. A long time ago, it was so special that people called it black gold.
Black Sea\n\nThe Black Sea is a big body of water between Europe and Asia. It looks dark blue or gray, and it is very deep in some places. Many big rivers pour fresh water into it, so the top part is not as salty as the ocean. Deep down, there is almost no air, so fish and plants cannot live there. Long ago, people in old stories sailed across it on wooden boats. Today, ships still use it to carry things from one country to another.
Blackberry\n\nA blackberry is a small, soft fruit that is dark purple or black. It is made of many tiny round parts all stuck together. You can find it growing on a bush with sharp thorns. The bush grows fast and can be seen in gardens, fields, or near fences. People pick blackberries in summer and eat them fresh or put them in pies and jam. It tastes sweet and a little sour.
Blackcurrant\n\nA blackcurrant is a tiny, dark berry. It is round and very dark purple, almost black. It grows on a bush in cool places far away. It tastes a little sour and a little sweet. People cook it with sugar to make jam and jelly. Some people put it in ice cream or cakes. It has a lot of good stuff that helps you stay healthy.
Bladder\n\nA bladder is a soft bag inside your body that holds pee. It sits low in your belly. When you drink water or juice, the liquid goes into your blood. Your kidneys clean the blood and send the extra water to the bladder. It fills up slowly, like a balloon. When it gets full, it tells your brain you need to go to the bathroom. Then the muscles around it squeeze, and the pee comes out. All animals like dogs and cats have a bladder too.
Blade\n\nA blade is a flat, thin piece of metal that is very sharp on one side. It is used to cut things like paper, food, or wood. You can find a blade in a kitchen knife, a pair of scissors, or a safety razor. A blade can be dangerous, so only grown-ups should use it. When you draw with a pencil, a small blade inside a sharpener makes the tip pointy.
Blanket\n\nA blanket is a big, soft cloth. It is flat and wide, and it feels warm and cozy. You find it on a bed or a couch. People use it to cover their body when they sleep or feel cold. A baby might have a small, fuzzy blanket to hold. At a picnic, a family sits on a blanket on the grass.
Bleeding\n\nBleeding is when blood comes out of the body. It can happen when you get a cut on your skin. Sometimes it happens inside the body where you cannot see it. A small cut bleeds just a little and stops soon. A big cut can bleed a lot and needs a grown-up to help. When you fall and scrape your knee, you see bleeding. A bandage helps stop it and keeps the cut clean.
Blindness\n\nBlindness means a person cannot see. It is like having eyes that do not work. Some blind people see a little bit, like fuzzy shapes or colors. A blind person may use a white stick to feel the ground while walking. They can also use a special dog called a guide dog to help them go places. Some blind people read with their fingers using bumpy dots called braille. A blind person can still do many things, like sing, play music, and tell stories.
Blink\n\nA blink is when your eyes close and open very fast. It happens all by itself many times every minute. It keeps your eyes wet and clean. You can also blink on purpose, like when you wink at a friend. Everyone blinks, even babies and grown-ups.
Blizzard\n\nA blizzard is a very big snowstorm. It has strong winds and lots of snow that blows around. It can happen in places where snow falls, like the northeast part of America. During a blizzard, the snow is so thick you cannot see far. It can make the air very cold, so you need to stay inside and keep warm. After it stops, people use big trucks to push the snow off the roads.
Block\n\nA block is a small, hard shape that you can hold in your hand. It can be a cube, a rectangle, or a triangle. You find blocks in a toy box or at school. Children stack blocks to build a tower or a little house. A block is often made of wood or plastic and comes in bright colors like red, blue, and yellow.
Blog\n\nA blog is like a diary on the computer. It is a place where someone writes stories or shares pictures. You can find it on the internet. People use it to tell others about their day, a fun trip, or a new toy. It is like a book that anyone can read on a screen.
Blood\n\nBlood is a red liquid inside your body. It moves through tubes called blood vessels. Your heart pushes it all around. It brings air and food to every part of you. It also takes away things your body does not need. Blood has tiny parts in it. Red parts carry air. White parts fight germs. Small sticky parts help stop cuts from bleeding. When you get a cut, you see a little blood come out.
Blood pressure\n\nBlood pressure is how hard your blood pushes on the tubes inside your body. It has two numbers, like a top number and a bottom number. A doctor or nurse checks it with a soft band that wraps around your arm. When it is too high, it can make your heart and body sick. When it is too low, you may feel dizzy or faint. Eating good food and playing outside helps keep it just right.
Blood test\n\nA blood test is a way for a doctor to look at a tiny bit of your blood. It uses a small needle to take a drop of blood from your arm or finger. The blood goes into a little tube and then to a lab. There, special machines check if you are healthy or sick. It can tell the doctor if you need more of something, like iron, or if a part of your body is not working right. Sometimes it helps find out if a medicine is helping you. A blood test is quick and feels like a tiny pinch.
Blood transfusion\n\nA blood transfusion is when a doctor gives blood to a sick person. It is a way to help the body when it has lost too much blood. The blood comes from a healthy person who shares it. The blood is kept in a cold, safe place until it is needed. It goes into the sick person through a tiny tube in the arm. This can make the person feel strong again.
Blood type\n\nBlood type is a way to sort blood into groups. It tells us what tiny marks are on the outside of your red blood cells. These marks are like name tags. Some people have A tags, some have B tags, some have both, and some have no tags. The tags help your body know which blood is yours. If you get blood with the wrong tags, your body might fight it. Doctors check blood type before giving blood to someone who is sick. There is also a plus or minus sign, like A+ or O-. That tells about another tag called Rh. If you have it, you are plus. If you do not, you are minus. People with O- blood can give blood to anyone. People with AB+ blood can get blood from anyone.
Bloom\n\nBloom is when a flower opens up. It starts as a small, closed bud. Then it slowly spreads its petals wide to show its color. You can see it in gardens, parks, and fields in spring. Bees and butterflies visit a bloom to sip sweet juice. A bloom makes the world look bright and pretty.
Blouse\n\nA blouse is a soft shirt that girls and women wear. It is often made of light cloth like cotton or silk. It can have buttons, a collar, or pretty sleeves. You might see a blouse at a party or at school. Some blouses have flowers or dots on them. A blouse looks nice with a skirt or pants.
Blow\n\nBlow means to push air out of your mouth. It can make a soft wind that you can feel on your hand. You can blow on hot soup to cool it down. It is also how you make bubbles with soap and a wand. When you blow out candles on a birthday cake, it makes the flame go away.
Blue\n\nBlue is a color that we can see. It is the color of the sky on a sunny day. It is also the color of the big, deep sea. You can find blue in many places, like on a blueberry or a blue jay bird. Some people feel calm when they look at blue. Others think of blue when they feel a little sad. You can make blue paint by mixing two other colors together.
Blue whale\n\nA blue whale is the biggest animal on Earth. It lives in the ocean and is a kind of whale. It is very long and has a blue-gray color on top and a lighter color under its belly. It eats tiny sea animals called krill that are as small as your finger. A blue whale can eat a huge amount of krill every day. Long ago, people hunted blue whales too much, and now there are not many left. Today, people keep them safe so they can live in the ocean.
Blueberry\n\nA blueberry is a small, round fruit. It is blue or purple and has a tiny crown on top. It grows on a bush in warm months. People pick it and eat it fresh. It tastes sweet with a little sour kick. You can find it in muffins, pancakes, and jam. Many kids like it in a bowl with milk.
Blues\n\nBlues is a kind of music that people play and sing. It started a long time ago in America. It often uses a guitar, a piano, or a mouth harp. The words in a blues song are often about feeling sad or having a hard time. The music has a slow, steady beat that makes you want to sway. You might hear it on the radio or at a park concert.
Board\n\nA board is a flat, hard piece of wood. It is long and wide, but not very thick. You can find it in a classroom, where a teacher writes on it with chalk. People also use it to build things like a table or a shelf. A cutting board in the kitchen is a small one for chopping food.
Board game\n\nA board game is a game you play on a flat board. It has pieces that you move around on the board. You follow rules to play. Some games use dice or cards to add a bit of luck. You can play with friends or family at a table. Chess is one board game with black and white squares. Another is checkers. Monopoly is a board game where you buy and sell pretend houses. Board games are fun to play on a rainy day.
Boarding school\n\nA boarding school is a school where children live and sleep. It has beds, a dining room, and classrooms all in one place. You can find it in many countries, like the UK or Ghana. Children learn lessons during the day and stay at night instead of going home. Some boarding schools are just for boys or just for girls, and some are for both. A child who stays there is called a boarder. In stories, a boy named Harry Potter went to a boarding school with magic.
Boat\n\nA boat is a thing that moves on top of water. It is smaller than a big ship. Some boats have a big cloth called a sail to catch the wind. Some boats have a motor that makes them go fast. People also use long sticks called oars to push a boat through the water. You can see a boat at a lake, a river, or the sea. People use it to go fishing, to ride for fun, or to carry things from one place to another.
Bobsleigh\n\nBobsleigh is a winter sport where a team rides a sled down an icy track. It looks like a long, skinny car with no wheels, and it slides on ice. You can see it at the Winter Olympics on TV. People push the sled to start, then jump in and steer it down the track. The team that finishes the fastest wins.
Body\n\nA body is the whole shape of a person or an animal. It has a head, arms, legs, and a middle part. Your body is what you live in every day. It lets you run, jump, and hug. You can see your body in a mirror. It needs food, water, and sleep to stay strong.
Body language\n\nBody language is how we talk without using words. It is the way we move our body, face, and eyes to show how we feel. You can see it when someone smiles, nods their head, or crosses their arms. It helps us know if a person is happy, sad, or angry without them saying a thing. For example, when your friend gives you a big smile and leans close, you know they are glad to see you.
Body of water\n\nA body of water is a big area of water on the ground. It can be still, like a lake, or moving, like a river. You can find it in many places, like parks, forests, or near your town. People use it for swimming, fishing, or sailing a boat. A pond in a park is a small body of water.
Bodybuilding\n\nBodybuilding is an activity where people grow their muscles big and strong. They lift heavy things over and over to make muscles bigger. Some people do it just to stay healthy, and some do it in shows. In a show, they stand on a stage and show their muscles to judges. The judges look at how the muscles look and pick a winner. A person who does bodybuilding is called a bodybuilder.
Bog\n\nA bog is a wet, spongy piece of land. It is covered in soft, squishy ground made of old dead plants. The water in it is brown and has no taste. Not many big trees grow there, but you can see small bushes and green moss. Some bogs are so big you cannot see the end. They are home to special bugs and birds that like the wet ground.
Boil\n\nA boil is a hot bubble that rises in water. It happens when water gets very, very hot. You can see it in a pot on the stove. The water moves fast and makes steam go up. When you cook pasta or eggs, you wait for the water to boil first.
Boiling\n\nBoiling is when a liquid gets so hot that it turns into a gas. You can see it when water in a pot bubbles and steam goes up. It happens all through the liquid, not just at the top. People use boiling to cook food like pasta or eggs. At home, a kettle boils water for tea. In high mountains, water boils at a lower heat, so food takes longer to cook.
Bold\n\nBold is a way to make words look thick and dark. It is used in books, on signs, and on screens to show that something is important. When you see a word in bold, your eyes stop and look at it first. It helps you find the big idea on a page.
Bolero\n\nBolero is a kind of slow music and dance. It started in Spain a long time ago. Later, people in Cuba made a new kind of bolero with a guitar. Today, people still play the music and dance to it. The dance has soft, slow steps. You might see it at a show or a party.
Bolivia\n\nBolivia is a country in South America. It has tall mountains, flat lands, and a big lake called Lake Titicaca. Many people there speak Spanish. They grow food like potatoes and corn. Some people wear colorful clothes and hats. Kids in Bolivia like to play soccer in the street.
Bolt\n\nA bolt is a small metal stick with lines on the outside. It has a flat top with six sides. You find it in tool boxes and on bikes, cars, and chairs. It holds two things together very tight when you turn it with a tool. A nut is a round piece with a hole that fits on the bolt to keep it in place.
Bomb\n\nA bomb is a thing that can break things with a big boom. It is a box or a ball with stuff inside that goes BOOM very fast. When it goes off, it can push things away and make a loud noise. Some bombs are used in wars to hurt buildings. Some are used to dig big holes in the ground. You should never touch a bomb because it can hurt you very much.
Bomber\n\nA bomber is a big airplane that drops bombs. It flies in the sky and carries heavy things that go boom on the ground. Long ago, it had many people inside to help fly and shoot guns. Now it is faster and has only one or two people. Computers do the other jobs. You might see one in a movie or a book about old wars.
Bond\n\nA bond is like a special promise to pay back money. It is a piece of paper that says someone will give you your money back later, plus a little extra. Grown-ups buy bonds from big groups like a city or a country. The big group uses the money to build things like roads or schools. Then, after some time, they pay the grown-up back with more money. It is a way to share money and help build big things.
Bone\n\nA bone is a hard, white part inside your body. It makes up your skeleton, which is like a strong frame that holds you up. Without bones, you would be soft and could not stand or walk. Bones also keep your soft parts safe. Your skull is a bone that protects your brain. Your ribs are bones that protect your heart and lungs. Bones are alive and need good food like milk to stay strong. Inside some big bones is a soft part that makes new blood for your body.
Bone fracture\n\nA bone fracture is when a bone in your body breaks. It can happen if you fall hard or hit something very strong. Sometimes the bone pokes through the skin, and you can see it. Other times the bone stays inside, and you only feel pain. A doctor takes a special picture called an X-ray to see the break. Then the doctor puts the bone back in the right place and wraps it so it stays still. Over many weeks, the bone grows back together and gets strong again.
Bonobo\n\nA bonobo is a kind of ape that looks like a monkey but has no tail. It has black fur, a dark face, and long arms. It lives in the warm, wet forests of Africa, near a big river called the Congo. Bonobos stay together in big family groups. They are very kind to each other and share hugs and touches to stay friends. They eat fruits, leaves, and sometimes small bugs. A bonobo can live for many years when people take care of it.
Boo\n\nBoo is a sound people make to surprise someone. It is a short, loud word you say when you jump out from a hiding spot. You might hear it on Halloween when kids wear costumes and try to scare each other. People also say it to a baby in a gentle way to make the baby laugh. It is a fun sound that can make people jump or smile.
Book\n\nA book is a set of paper pages held together between two covers. It has words and sometimes pictures on the pages. You can find books at home, in a library, or at a store. People read books for fun or to learn new things. A storybook tells a made-up tale, and a schoolbook helps you learn about numbers or animals. Some books are small and soft, and some are big and hard. You can even listen to a book when someone reads it out loud.
Bookcase\n\nA bookcase is a piece of furniture that holds books. It has flat shelves where you can put books standing up. You can find it in a bedroom, a living room, or a library. People use it to keep books neat and easy to find. Some bookcases are tall and some are short. You might have a small one in your room with your favorite storybooks.
Bookshelf\n\nA bookshelf is a piece of furniture that holds books. It has flat boards called shelves where you can put things. You can find it in a home, a school, or a library. People use it to keep books neat and easy to find. It can be made of wood or metal. Some are tall and some are short. You might have a small one in your room for your favorite storybooks.
Bookstore\n\nA bookstore is a shop that sells books. It has many shelves full of stories and pictures. You can find it in a town or a mall. People go there to pick a new book to read. A grown-up might buy a book for you, and you can look at the bright covers.
Boom\n\nA boom is a big, deep sound. It is loud and low, like a drum. You might hear it when thunder rolls across the sky. Sometimes a big door makes a boom when it shuts. Fireworks can also go boom in the night.
Boomerang\n\nA boomerang is a flying toy that comes back to you. It is often made of wood or plastic. It has two arms that look like a bent banana. You throw it high and fast with a spin. If you throw it the right way, it flies in a big circle and comes back to your hand. People play with it in big open parks. Some people even join clubs to throw it together.
Boot\n\nA boot is a strong shoe that covers your foot and goes up your leg. It is taller than a regular shoe. Some boots go all the way up to your knee. People wear boots to keep their feet dry in rain or snow. Some boots have long strings to tie them tight. The bottom of a boot is thick and hard so you can walk on rocks or mud. You might see boots on a rainy day or when someone goes for a walk in the woods.
Booth\n\nA booth is a small, closed space. It has walls on three sides and a roof on top. You can find a booth at a fair or a market. People use it to sell food, toys, or games. Sometimes a booth is a tiny room where you can sit and eat a snack.
Bordeaux\n\nBordeaux is a big city in a country called France. It sits next to a wide river named the Garonne. Many people live there, and it is very old. You can see old stone buildings and big bridges. It is famous for a red or purple drink made from grapes, called wine. People also go there to look at pretty art and old things in museums. A long, long time ago, kings and queens lived near it.
Border\n\nA border is a line that shows where one place ends and another place starts. It can be a line on a map or a real fence on the ground. You find borders between countries, like the line between the United States and Canada. People use borders to know which country they are in. When you go from one country to another, you cross the border. At a border, a guard may check your papers to let you through.
Bore\n\nBore is a feeling you get when nothing is fun. It happens when you sit still and have no toy or game. You might feel it on a long car ride or a rainy day. When you feel this way, your body feels heavy and your eyes look around for something to do. A friend or a new story can make it go away.
Bored\n\nBored is a feeling you get when nothing feels fun. It is like a big yawn inside your head. You might feel it when you have to sit still for a long time, or when your toys do not seem exciting. It can happen at home, in a car, or on a rainy day. When you feel bored, you can find a new game, draw a picture, or ask a friend to play. The feeling goes away when you start doing something you like.
Boring\n\nBoring is a feeling you get when something is not fun or new. It is like when you sit still for a long time with nothing to do. You might feel it when a grown-up talks too long or when a toy does the same thing over and over. When you feel boring, your body might get wiggly or your eyes might look around for something else. A good way to fix it is to find a game, a book, or a friend to play with.
Born\n\nBorn means you came into the world. It is the day you started to be a person. When a baby is born, it comes out of its mommy's tummy. Everyone has a birthday, which is the day they were born. On that day, people sing a happy song and give presents. A born baby is very small and needs lots of love.
Borneo\n\nBorneo is a very big island. It is the third biggest island in the whole world. It has thick, old forests with tall trees. Many animals live there, like big orange monkeys called orangutans, elephants, and colorful birds. Three countries share the island: Indonesia, Malaysia, and a small country called Brunei. Some people cut down the trees, and that hurts the forest.
Borobudur\n\nBorobudur is a very old stone building in a country called Indonesia. It is made of gray stone and has many flat floors that go up like a big cake. On the walls, there are many pictures carved into the stone. At the very top, there is a big round part with many bell-shaped stones. Inside some of those stones, there are statues of a man sitting quietly. Long ago, people used it as a quiet place to think and pray. Now, many people from all over the world come to see it and walk up its steps.
Borrow\n\nBorrow means you take something from someone for a little while. You must give it back when you are done. You can borrow a toy from a friend at school. You can borrow a book from the library. When you borrow, you say thank you and take good care of it.
Boss\n\nA boss is the person in charge at a job. He tells other workers what to do and helps them when they have a problem. You might see a boss in a store, a restaurant, or an office. He makes sure the work gets done and everyone is safe. A boss can be a man or a woman. Sometimes a boss is called a manager.
Boston\n\nBoston is a big city by the sea. It has tall buildings, old streets, and many parks. You can find it in a place called Massachusetts. Many people live there and speak with a special way of talking. It has a big green park where kids play and a long path called the Freedom Trail. You can see old houses and a big market with food. In the fall, the leaves turn red and yellow. It is also home to a famous baseball team that wears red socks.
Botany\n\nBotany is the study of plants. It is a kind of science that looks at how plants live and grow. People who study botany are called botanists. They look at flowers, trees, grass, and all green things. They learn how a plant makes food from sunlight and how it drinks water from the ground. You can see botany in a garden or a park when you watch a seed turn into a big plant.
Botfly\n\nA botfly is a kind of fly. It looks like a small, fuzzy bee. It lives in warm places with lots of animals. A botfly lays tiny eggs on an animal's skin. When the eggs hatch, the baby bug grows under the skin. It makes a little bump that can hurt. After some time, it comes out and flies away.
Both\n\nBoth means two things together. It is a word you use when you talk about two people, two animals, or two things at the same time. You can say, "I like both apples and bananas." That means you like the apple and you also like the banana. When you have two hands, you can hold a toy in both hands. If you and your friend want the same snack, you can share it so both of you are happy.
Botswana\n\nBotswana is a country in the south part of Africa. It is a big piece of land with no sea touching it. Much of it is dry and sandy, like a big desert. Some parts have water and green plants where animals live. People there find shiny stones called diamonds deep under the ground. Many visitors come to see wild animals like elephants and lions.
Bottle\n\nA bottle is a tall, round thing that can hold water or other drinks. It has a small hole at the top and a cap to close it. You can find bottles in the kitchen, at the store, or in your lunch box. People use it to carry water when they are thirsty. A baby drinks milk from a small bottle with a soft top.
Bottom\n\nA bottom is the lowest part of something. It is the part that is under everything else. You find it at the very end, like the bottom of a cup or the bottom of a box. When you sit on a chair, your body touches the bottom of the chair. If you drop a toy, it falls to the bottom of the floor.
Bounce\n\nBounce means to jump up and down or spring back. It happens when something hits a surface and pushes away again. You can see a ball bounce on the floor or a trampoline. When you drop a rubber ball, it comes back up fast. A bounce can be small, like a pebble on water, or big, like a kangaroo hopping. It is a fun way to move and play.
Bouncy\n\nBouncy is a way to say something can jump back up. A ball is bouncy when you drop it and it comes right back. A bed can be bouncy if you jump on it and it pushes you up. You can find bouncy things at the park, like a trampoline. When you sit on a bouncy chair, it feels soft and springy.
Bovid\n\nA bovid is an animal with a split hoof. It has two big toes on each foot that make the hoof look like two parts. You can find it on farms and in wild places all over the world, except very cold or far-away lands. It eats grass and plants, and its tummy has special parts to break down the food slowly. Cows, sheep, and goats are bovids that people keep for milk and wool.
Bow\n\nA bow is a tool made of a curved stick and a string. It looks like a half circle with a tight line from one end to the other. You can find it in stories about knights and hunters. People pull the string back and let go to shoot an arrow far away. A toy bow and arrow set is something you might play with in the backyard.
Bow (weapon)\n\nA bow is a tool that shoots arrows. It is a long, bent stick with a tight string tied to both ends. You can see it in games or in old stories about knights. To use it, you put an arrow on the string, pull it back, and let go. The arrow flies far and fast. A long time ago, people used it to find food and in fights.
Bowl\n\nA bowl is a round dish that is open at the top. It has a deep inside part where you can put food or liquid. You can find bowls in the kitchen at home. People use a bowl to hold soup, cereal, rice, or snacks. A bowl can be made of plastic, glass, or clay. When you eat breakfast, you might pour milk and cereal into a bowl.
Bowling\n\nBowling is a game where you roll a heavy ball. The ball has three holes for your fingers. You roll it down a long wooden floor to knock down ten pins. The pins stand at the far end like tall white bottles. If you knock them all down, you get a strike. If you miss, the ball can fall into a gutter on the side. People play it at a bowling alley with friends and family. They wear special shoes and take turns. The person with the most points wins.
Box\n\nA box is a thing that can hold other things inside. It has flat sides, a bottom, and sometimes a top that closes. You can find boxes in many places, like at home, in a store, or at school. People use it to keep toys, clothes, or food safe and tidy. A shoebox is one kind you might see in your closet.
Boxing\n\nBoxing is a sport where two people fight with their hands. It happens inside a square space with ropes around it, called a ring. The fighters wear big soft gloves to keep their hands safe. They try to hit each other on the head and body. A fight has short parts called rounds. Each round is a few minutes long. The person who hits more and harder wins. Sometimes a fighter falls down and cannot get up. That is called a knockout, and the other person wins right away. People watch boxing to see who is strong and fast.
Boy\n\nA boy is a young person who is not a man yet. He has a body that is still growing. You can see boys at school, at the park, and at home. He often likes to run, jump, and play rough games like soccer. Many boys wear pants and have short hair. The color blue is often used for a boy, like a blue blanket for a new baby. A boy can have a name like Tom or Sam. When he grows up, he becomes a man.
Boyfriend\n\nA boyfriend is a boy who is a special friend. He is someone you like to play with, talk to, and share fun times. You might see him at school, at the park, or at a party. He can make you laugh and feel happy. Sometimes you hold hands or give a hug. A boyfriend is like a best friend who is a boy.
Bracelet\n\nA bracelet is a pretty circle you wear around your wrist. It can be made of shiny metal, colorful beads, string, or soft rubber. You can find it in a store or make one at home with your friends. People wear it to look nice or to remember someone special. A bracelet can jingle when you move your hand. Some have small charms that hang down and sparkle.
Brahma\n\nBrahma is a god in stories from India. He is the one who made the whole world and everything in it. People draw him with four faces so he can see everywhere at once. He also has four arms and holds a water pot, a spoon, a book, and a string of beads. You can see his statue in some temples with colorful flowers around it.
Brahmaputra River\n\nThe Brahmaputra River is a very long river in Asia. It starts high up in the cold mountains of Tibet. It flows through three big lands: Tibet, India, and Bangladesh. In the spring, ice on the mountains melts and makes the river grow very big. Sometimes the water spills over the land and floods the fields. The river meets another big river called the Ganges, and together they spread out into a wide, flat shape before reaching the big sea. Many people live near it and use its water for their farms.
Brahmic\n\nBrahmic is a big family of writing. It is a way people draw letters to make words. You can find it in many places like India, Thailand, and Tibet. Many people use it to write their language every day. If you see round and curly letters on a sign, it might be Brahmic.
Brahmic Scripts\n\nBrahmic scripts are a big family of writing signs. They are used to write many languages in India and nearby lands. Each sign stands for a sound, and the signs have round and curvy shapes. You can see them on street signs, in books, and on food packages. Many children learn to read and write with them in school.
Braille\n\nBraille is a way of writing that people who cannot see use to read with their fingers. It is made of tiny raised dots on paper. You find it on signs in some buildings, like next to a door or on an elevator button. A person moves a finger over the dots to feel letters and words. For example, a book with Braille has pages full of these little bumps instead of flat ink letters.
Brain\n\nA brain is a soft, wrinkly part inside your head. It looks like a big gray walnut. It sits safely inside the hard bones of your skull. It helps you think, learn, and feel happy or sad. It also tells your body what to do, like moving your legs to run or your mouth to smile. Even when you sleep, it keeps your heart beating and your lungs breathing. All animals with a backbone have a brain, but some tiny sea animals do not.
Brain stem\n\nThe brain stem is a small part at the back of your brain. It looks like a short, thick tube that connects your brain to your back cord. You cannot see it because it is deep inside your head. It does very important jobs without you even thinking. It tells your body to breathe air in and out. It keeps your heart beating all day and night. It also helps you swallow food and blink your eyes. Without it, your body would not work.
Brake\n\nA brake is a tool that makes something slow down or stop. It is found on cars, bikes, and even some toys. When you push a pedal or pull a lever, it presses hard against a wheel. This makes the wheel turn slower until it stops. A bike has brakes on the handlebars that you squeeze with your hands. Cars have brakes that work when you push a pedal with your foot. Brakes help keep people safe by stopping things from moving too fast.
Branch\n\nA branch is a long, woody arm that grows out from a tree trunk. It has smaller sticks and green leaves on it. You can see branches on trees in a park, a forest, or your own backyard. A branch holds leaves up to the sun so the tree can make food. Birds often sit on a branch and build their nests there. In fall, the leaves on a branch may turn red, yellow, or orange before they drop.
Brand\n\nA brand is a special name or picture that tells you who made a thing. It is like a sticker on your toy or a sign on a store. When you see the same brand on a box of cereal, you know what it will taste like. A brand helps you pick your favorite things, like a certain kind of cookie or a pair of shoes. It makes one thing easy to remember among many others.
Braslia\n\nBraslia is a big city in the country of Brazil. It is the capital, where the leaders work. From the sky, it looks like a bird or a plane. It has a big lake and many wide roads. People live and work there, and many visitors come to see the tall buildings.
Brass\n\nBrass is a shiny, gold-colored metal. It is made by mixing two other metals: copper and zinc. It is very strong and does not rust easily. People use it to make things like door handles, musical horns, and pretty buttons. You might see it on a trumpet or a shiny key at home.
Brass instrument\n\nA brass instrument is a shiny tool that makes music when you blow into it. It has a small cup at one end where you put your lips. You make a buzzing sound with your lips, and the long metal tube makes the sound big and loud. It has round buttons called valves that you press to change the sound. You can see it in a marching band at a parade, where people walk and play happy songs together.
Brave\n\nBrave is a feeling you have when you do something even though it is scary. It is like a little light inside you that helps you try new things. You can be brave when you go down a big slide for the first time. You can be brave when you say sorry after a mistake. Being brave does not mean you are not scared. It means you do the thing anyway. A firefighter is brave when they run into a hot place to help someone. A child is brave when they start at a new school. Everyone can be brave, even if their hands shake a little.
Brazil\n\nBrazil is a big country in South America. It has many trees and a huge forest called the Amazon. Many people live there, and they speak Portuguese. The biggest city is São Paulo, and the capital is Brasília. People in Brazil love to play soccer. They also have big parties with music and dancing. The Amazon River runs through it, and it is very long. You can find many colorful birds and animals in the forest.
Brazil nut\n\nA Brazil nut is a big, hard seed that grows on a tall tree. It has a dark brown shell that feels bumpy and rough. Inside the shell, the nut is smooth and light brown. The tree lives in the Amazon rainforest, where it is very hot and wet. People crack the shell open to eat the nut. It tastes creamy and a little sweet. You might find Brazil nuts in a bag of mixed nuts at the store.
Brazilian jiu-jitsu\n\nBrazilian jiu-jitsu is a way of fighting and playing on the ground. It is a sport where two people try to hold each other down. They wear a special jacket and pants called a gi, or sometimes just a tight shirt. You can see it in a gym with soft mats on the floor. People use it to learn how to stay safe and strong.
Bread\n\nBread is a soft food that you can eat. It is made from flour and water mixed together and then baked in a hot oven. It can be white or brown, and it feels a little like a sponge. You can find it in a store or a bakery. People eat it for breakfast with butter or jam. You can also use it to make a sandwich with cheese or meat inside. Sometimes it is cut into slices and made warm and crispy in a toaster.
Breadfruit\n\nBreadfruit is a big green fruit that grows on a tree. It is round and bumpy on the outside. The tree grows in hot, sunny places near the ocean. People cook the fruit and eat it because it is soft and filling, like a potato. You can also make flour from it to bake bread. A long time ago, people carried the tree to new islands so they could grow food there.
Break\n\nA break is a short time when you stop doing something. It is like a little rest. You take a break after you play hard or work on a puzzle. During a break, you can sit down, drink water, or look out the window. After a break, you feel ready to play again. At school, the teacher says it is time for a break so everyone can rest.
Breakfast\n\nBreakfast is the first meal you eat in the morning. It comes after a long sleep when your tummy is empty. People eat many different foods for it. Some kids have cereal with milk and a banana. Other kids eat toast with jam or eggs. In some places, people eat rice or warm soup. It gives you energy to run, play, and learn at school.
Breakfast cereal\n\nBreakfast cereal is a food you eat in the morning. It is made from grains like wheat, corn, or oats. It comes in many shapes, like little circles, squares, or puffs. You pour it into a bowl and add cold milk on top. Some cereal is sweet and tastes like honey or fruit. Kids like to eat it before school. You can find boxes of it at the grocery store.
Breakup\n\nA breakup is when two people who were very close decide not to be together anymore. It can happen when one person feels sad or upset in the friendship or love. Sometimes both people feel this way and agree to stop being a pair. After a breakup, a person may cry or feel very sad for a while. They need time to feel happy again. A child might see a big brother or sister go through a breakup and notice they stay in their room more.
Breast\n\nA breast is a soft part on the front of the chest. It is round and has a small bump in the middle called a nipple. Both boys and girls are born with breasts. When a girl grows up, her breasts get bigger. A mom can make milk in her breasts to feed a baby. A dad has breasts too, but they stay small and do not make milk.
Breastfeeding\n\nBreastfeeding is when a mom feeds her baby milk from her body. The milk comes from her chest, and the baby drinks it with its mouth. This milk is the best food for a new baby. It helps the baby grow strong and healthy. Many moms do this at home, sitting in a soft chair. The baby feels warm and safe while it drinks. The milk changes as the baby gets bigger, so it always has what the baby needs. Some moms use a pump to take the milk out and save it in a bottle for later.
Breath\n\nA breath is the air you take in and let out of your body. It goes in through your nose or mouth and fills your chest. You can feel it when you put your hand on your tummy. Every person and animal needs to breathe to stay alive. When you run fast, your breath gets quick and deep. When you sleep, it is slow and soft.
Breathe\n\nBreathe means to pull air into your body and push it out. It is something your body does all by itself, even when you sleep. You can feel it when you put your hand on your chest and it moves up and down. Air goes in through your nose or mouth and fills your lungs inside. It helps your body stay alive and gives you energy to run and play.
Breathing\n\nBreathing is how your body takes in air and lets it out. It happens in your chest, where two soft bags called lungs sit. When you breathe in, your chest gets bigger and air goes into the lungs. The air has a special gas that your body needs to stay alive. When you breathe out, your chest gets smaller and a different gas leaves your body. You breathe all day and all night, even when you sleep. If you run fast, you breathe faster to get more air. Your brain tells your body when to breathe without you even thinking about it.
Breed\n\nA breed is a special kind of animal that people help make. It looks a little different from other animals of the same type. For example, a poodle is a breed of dog with curly hair. A Siamese is a breed of cat with blue eyes. People called breeders pick two animals to have babies so the babies get nice traits. This is called breeding. You can see many breeds at a pet show or on a farm.
Breeze\n\nA breeze is a soft, gentle wind. It moves the air just a little bit. You can feel it on your skin when you are outside. It makes leaves on trees dance and sway. A breeze can cool you down on a warm day. It can also carry the smell of flowers or fresh grass. You might see a breeze moving a flag or a pinwheel. It is not strong like a big storm wind.
Brick\n\nA brick is a hard block that people use to build things. It is made from soft, sticky mud called clay. The clay is shaped into a block and then baked in a very hot oven until it is hard. It is usually red or brown, but it can be other colors too. People stack bricks and stick them together with a gray paste to make walls, houses, and paths. You can see bricks on the outside of many buildings and on some sidewalks.
Bridge\n\nA bridge is a thing that helps you cross over a gap. It can go over a river, a road, or a deep valley. You walk or drive on top of it. Some bridges are made of wood or stone. Big bridges are often made of strong steel. You may see a bridge when you ride in a car over a highway.
Bright\n\nBright means something gives off a lot of light. The sun is bright, and a lamp can be bright too. When you look at a bright thing, it can make you blink or squint your eyes. A bright color is easy to see, like a yellow raincoat or a red ball. Some stars at night are bright, and some are not so bright. A room with many windows feels bright and happy.
Bring\n\nTo bring means to carry something with you when you go to a place. You can bring a toy to the park or bring a snack to school. When you bring something, you hold it in your hands or put it in a bag and take it along. Your friend might say, "Please bring your book so we can read together." Bringing is a kind thing to do because you share what you have.
Brisbane\n\nBrisbane is a big city in Australia. It sits next to a long river that winds through the land. Many tall buildings stand in the city center, and you can see boats on the water. People live and work there, and kids go to school just like you. It is warm most of the year, with hot summers and mild winters. Sometimes big storms bring lots of rain. Families can visit parks, museums, and a big wheel that spins high in the air.
British\n\nBritish means from a country called Britain. It is a big island with green hills and old castles. People there speak English, just like you and me. They like to drink tea with milk and eat small sandwiches. A red bus with two floors is something you might see there. The queen or king lives in a big house called a palace.
British Empire\n\nThe British Empire was a very big group of lands ruled by Britain long ago. It had many countries across the world, like India, Canada, and Australia. People in those places had to follow British rules. Ships with British flags sailed to faraway lands to trade goods like tea and cloth. Today, the empire is gone, and those places are their own countries.
British Isles\n\nThe British Isles are a group of islands in the sea near Europe. The biggest island is called Great Britain. It has three countries on it: England, Wales, and Scotland. Another part, Northern Ireland, joins with them to make the United Kingdom. Many people live on these islands. The land has green hills, old rocks, and long rivers. A long time ago, the islands were joined to the big land, so they have many kinds of rocks and metals.
British Library\n\nThe British Library is a very big building full of books and other things to read. It is in London, a big city in England. Inside, it has millions of books, maps, and old papers. People go there to read and learn. It also keeps a copy of every new book made in the country. Some of its old books are kept in a tall glass tower in the middle of the building.
British Museum\n\nThe British Museum is a big building in London full of old and special things from all over the world. It has many rooms with statues, stones with writing, and old tools. People go there to look and learn about long-ago times. It is free to visit, so anyone can walk in and see the treasures. One famous thing inside is a big stone with three kinds of writing on it. Another is a set of marble carvings from a very old temple. The museum also has a huge round room with a tall roof where you can sit and read.
Brittany\n\nBrittany is a part of France, near the big blue ocean. It has a long, bumpy edge where the land meets the water. The weather is not too hot and not too cold, with warm summers and rainy winters. People there grow food like corn and raise pigs and chickens. A very long time ago, people put up many big, tall stones in a row, and you can still see them there today.
Broadcast\n\nA broadcast is a way to send sounds or pictures to many people at once. It uses a big machine that sends signals through the air. You can hear it on a radio or see it on a TV. When a show comes on, it is a broadcast. Many people can listen or watch at the same time.
Broadcasting\n\nBroadcasting is a way to send shows and music to many people at once. It travels through the air as invisible waves, or through a wire, or from a big dish in space. You see it when you watch TV or listen to the radio at home. Some stations are paid for by the government, and they make shows for kids and learning. Other stations sell short ads to make money. There are also small stations run by people in your town, where they play music and talk about things nearby.
Broadway theatre\n\nBroadway theatre is a place where people act out stories on a big stage. It is in New York City, on a long street called Broadway. The room has many seats so lots of people can watch. Actors sing, dance, and talk to tell a story. Bright lights shine on the stage. The people watching clap when the show is over. Many families go to see a show together.
Broccoli\n\nBroccoli is a green vegetable that looks like a tiny tree. It has a thick stem and a top made of many small green bumps called florets. You can find it at the grocery store or in a garden. People cook it and eat it for dinner. It tastes a little bit like cabbage. It is very good for your body because it has vitamins that help you grow strong.
Bromeliad\n\nA bromeliad is a plant from warm places. It has long, stiff leaves that grow in a circle. Many bromeliads live in trees, not in the ground. Some kinds have a cup in the middle that holds water. A pineapple is a bromeliad you can eat. You might see a small bromeliad in a flower shop.
Bronze\n\nBronze is a hard, shiny metal that people make by mixing two other metals together. It looks a little like gold but is darker and more brown. Long ago, people used it to make tools, cups, and swords. Today, you can see it in big bells that go ding-dong and in statues in a park. It stays strong even when it gets wet, so it is good for things that sit outside in the rain.
Bronze Age\n\nThe Bronze Age is a time long ago when people learned to make tools from a strong metal called bronze. It is a mix of two metals: copper and tin. People heated the metals and shaped them into knives, axes, and pots. These tools were harder than stone or wood, so they helped people cut trees and build things. Farmers grew food like wheat and barley, and they kept sheep and cows for milk and meat. Some people became soldiers and used bronze swords. The Bronze Age happened at different times in different places, but it ended when people found an even stronger metal: iron.
Brooklyn Bridge\n\nThe Brooklyn Bridge is a very big bridge in New York City. It is made of strong ropes and stone towers. It goes over a wide river called the East River.
