It connects two parts of the city: Manhattan and Brooklyn. People walk, drive cars, and ride bikes across it every day. At night, lights shine on it and it looks very pretty. Many people visit to see it and take pictures.
Broom\n\nA broom is a long stick with many stiff hairs at one end. It is used to sweep dirt and dust off the floor. You can find a broom in a closet or a corner at home. People push it across the floor to make the room clean. Some brooms have soft hairs for inside, and some have hard hairs for outside.
Brother\n\nA brother is a boy who has the same mom and dad as you. He can be older or younger than you. He lives in the same house and shares toys and snacks. You play together, run outside, and sometimes fight over a toy. He can make you laugh when you feel sad. A brother is part of your family and you love each other.
Brown\n\nBrown is a color. It is dark and warm, like the color of tree trunks. You can make it by mixing red, yellow, and blue paint together. Many things in nature are brown, like dirt, wood, and chocolate. A teddy bear is often brown.
Brown algae\n\nBrown algae are a big group of plants that live in the sea. They look brown because of a special color inside them. You can find them in cold ocean water, often stuck to rocks at the beach. They are food for many sea animals and give them a place to hide. Some kinds grow very tall, like an underwater forest. People also pick them to eat.
Brown bear\n\nA brown bear is a big, strong animal with thick brown fur. It has a round body, four wide paws, and a short tail. It lives in forests and mountains in many places like Alaska, Canada, and Russia. It eats many things: berries, honey, fish, and small animals. A brown bear sleeps in a den all winter long. In spring, it wakes up and looks for food. You might see a brown bear in a picture book or a zoo.
Brown dwarf\n\nA brown dwarf is a round thing in space. It is like a star but too small to shine bright. It glows a little, with a soft pink-purple color. You cannot see it with just your eyes because it is very far away and very dim. Scientists use big telescopes to find it. It is bigger than a planet but smaller than a real star.
Brown rat\n\nA brown rat is a big, furry animal with a long tail. It has brown or gray fur, small ears, and a pointy nose. It lives in cities and towns, often near people, in places like basements or sewers. It eats bits of food it finds on the ground. You might see one running fast at night near a trash can.
Bruise\n\nA bruise is a blue or purple spot on your skin. It happens when you bump into something hard. Blood leaks out under the skin and makes the spot. It can hurt a little, but it is not dangerous. Over time, it changes color from blue to green to yellow and then goes away. Putting something cold on it right after the bump helps it stay small. You might get one on your knee when you fall while playing.
Brunei\n\nBrunei is a small country on a big island called Borneo. It is in a part of the world called Southeast Asia. It has green trees and a blue sea next to it. The king of Brunei is called a sultan. He lives in a big palace. The country has a lot of oil under the ground. People sell the oil to get money. Many people in Brunei follow the religion of Islam. They speak Malay and English. The capital city is Bandar Seri Begawan. It has pretty buildings and a big mosque.
Brush\n\nA brush is a tool with many soft or stiff hairs at one end. It has a long part to hold, called the handle. You can find brushes at home, in school, or in an art box. People use a brush to clean things, like a toothbrush for teeth or a big brush for the floor. Some brushes are for painting. An artist dips it in paint and makes smooth lines on paper. A paint brush can be flat, round, or pointy. You may have a small brush in your paint set.
Bubble\n\nA bubble is a tiny ball of air with a thin, shiny skin around it. It is round and clear, but it can show rainbow colors when light hits it. You can make bubbles with soap and water by blowing through a little wand. It floats in the air and moves softly with the wind. When you touch it, it pops and disappears. You often see bubbles at bath time or at a birthday party.
Bucket\n\nA bucket is a round, open container. It has a handle on top so you can carry it. You find it in a kitchen, a bathroom, or a garden. People use it to hold water, sand, or toys. A child might use a small bucket at the beach to build a sandcastle.
Buckwheat\n\nBuckwheat is a plant with seeds that people can eat like rice or oatmeal. Its seeds are small and have three sides, like tiny little pyramids. You can find buckwheat in some breakfast foods, like pancakes or porridge. People also use it to make noodles in some countries. It is not the same as wheat, even though the name sounds like it.
Budapest\n\nBudapest is a big city in a country called Hungary. It sits next to a long river called the Danube. A long time ago, three small towns joined to make one big city. It has old castles, tall churches, and a very big house where people make laws. Many people visit to see the pretty buildings and to swim in warm pools of water. You can ride a train under the ground there, too.
Buddhism\n\nBuddhism is a way of thinking and living that started long ago in India. It is based on the ideas of a man named the Buddha. He was a real person who wanted to understand why people feel sad or hurt. He sat very still and thought for a long time until he found a way to feel calm and happy inside. People who follow his ideas are called Buddhists. They try to be kind, not hurt others, and keep their minds quiet. Many Buddhists sit in a special quiet way called meditation. It helps them feel peaceful. You can see a statue of the Buddha in some gardens or homes. He often sits with his eyes closed and a soft smile.
Buddhist\n\nBuddhist is a person who follows the teachings of Buddha. They believe in being kind, calm, and not hurting others. You might see them sitting quietly with their eyes closed, which is called meditation. They often go to a quiet place called a temple to learn and pray. Some Buddhists wear orange or red robes. They try to be happy with simple things and help people who are sad.
Budgerigar\n\nA budgerigar is a small, colorful bird. It has a round head, a short hooked beak, and a long flat tail. Its feathers can be green, yellow, blue, or white. It lives in dry places in Australia. Many people keep it as a pet at home. It is very smart and can learn to copy words people say.
Buenos Aires\n\nBuenos Aires is a big city in a country called Argentina. It has many streets, tall buildings, and old houses. You can find it near a wide river, and many people live there. It is the most important city in that country, where the leaders work. In summer, it is hot and sticky, and in winter, it is cool but not too cold. Snow almost never falls there. People speak Spanish, but some also speak English. Many visitors come to see the pretty buildings and parks.
Bug\n\nA bug is a tiny animal with six legs. It has a hard shell on the outside and two feelers on its head. You can find bugs in the grass, on flowers, or under rocks. Some bugs fly with wings, and some crawl on the ground. A ladybug is a red bug with black spots that you might see in a garden.
Build\n\nTo build means to make something by putting parts together. You can build with blocks, sticks, or big stones. People build houses, bridges, and tall towers. When you stack blocks to make a castle, you are building. It is fun to build things with your hands.
Builder\n\nA builder is a person who makes houses and buildings. He uses tools like a hammer, a saw, and a drill. He wears a hard hat to keep his head safe. You can see a builder at a place where a new house is going up. He puts up walls, a roof, and windows so people can live inside. Sometimes he works with big trucks that carry wood and bricks.
Building\n\nA building is a place with walls and a roof. It has a door so people can go in and out. Windows let light come inside. Some buildings are small, like a house where a family lives. Other buildings are tall, like a big store or a school. People work, play, eat, and sleep inside buildings. A building keeps you safe from rain, wind, and hot sun.
Bulb\n\nA bulb is a round glass thing that makes light. It has a thin wire inside that glows when you turn it on. You find bulbs in lamps on the ceiling or on a table. People use bulbs to see in the dark at night. A bulb can be small like in a night-light or big like in a kitchen.
Bulbul\n\nA bulbul is a small bird that sings. It has soft feathers and a short beak. You can find it in warm places like Africa and Asia. It lives in trees and bushes, and it makes a happy sound. Some bulbuls are green or brown, and they like to eat fruit and bugs.
Bulgaria\n\nBulgaria is a country in Europe. It is near the sea and has mountains and rivers. People there speak a language called Bulgarian. The biggest city is Sofia. Many people live in towns and villages. Some grow food like tomatoes and grapes. You can see old stone houses and big churches there.
Bullfrog\n\nA bullfrog is a big frog that lives near water. It has a wide, flat head, a green or brown body with dark spots, and big back legs for jumping. You can find it in ponds, lakes, and swamps. It sits at the edge of the water and waits for food. It eats bugs, small fish, and even tiny birds. At night, the boy bullfrog makes a loud, deep roar to call a girl bullfrog. A girl bullfrog can lay many, many eggs in the water. The eggs turn into tadpoles that swim and grow. People sometimes eat the legs of a bullfrog.
Bullying\n\nBullying is when someone is mean to another person over and over. It can be hitting, pushing, or saying hurtful words. It can happen at school, at the park, or even on a computer. A bully wants to make the other person feel small or scared. If you see bullying, you can help by telling a grown-up you trust. No one should feel alone or afraid.
Bumblebee\n\nA bumblebee is a big, fuzzy bee that flies from flower to flower. It has a round, hairy body with black and yellow stripes. You can see it in gardens, parks, and fields when the weather is warm. It collects sweet juice and yellow dust from flowers to feed its family. It makes a loud buzzing sound when it flies. A bumblebee can sting, but it almost never does unless it is very scared.
Bump\n\nA bump is a small, raised spot on something flat. It can be on your skin, like when you hit your head and a little lump grows. It can also be on a road, like a speed bump that makes cars go slow. You might see a bump on a log or a rock. When you touch it, it feels round and a little bit high.
Bumpy\n\nBumpy means not smooth. It has lots of little hills and dips. A road with many rocks is bumpy. When you ride a bike on it, you go up and down. A toad's back can be bumpy too.
Bun\n\nA bun is a small, soft piece of bread. It is round and puffy, and it can be light brown or golden on top. You can find it at a bakery or a grocery store. People use it to hold a burger, a hot dog, or a sandwich. Sometimes it is sweet and has a little sugar on top. You might eat one at a picnic or a birthday party.
Bunch\n\nA bunch is a group of things that are all together. It can be a bunch of flowers tied with a string. It can be a bunch of bananas at the store. You can also have a bunch of friends to play with. When you hold many things at once, you have a bunch.
Bunny\n\nA bunny is a small, soft animal with long ears and a fluffy tail. It has four legs and likes to hop around. You can find bunnies in fields, forests, or sometimes as pets in people's homes. It eats plants like grass and carrots. A bunny wiggles its nose when it sniffs the air. Many children see a bunny in storybooks or during springtime.
Buoyancy\n\nBuoyancy is a push that makes things float in water. It is like an invisible hand that lifts things up from below. You can feel it when you try to push a ball under water and it pops back up. Big boats float because of buoyancy, even though they are very heavy. A small rock sinks because it is too heavy for the push. In the bathtub, a rubber duck floats because buoyancy holds it up.
Burger\n\nA burger is a round, flat piece of meat called a patty. It sits inside a soft bun that is cut in half. You can find it at a fast-food place or at a backyard cookout. People eat it with their hands, and they often add cheese, lettuce, tomato, and ketchup on top. A cheeseburger is a burger with a slice of cheese on the patty.
Burj Khalifa\n\nBurj Khalifa is a very, very tall building. It stands in a city called Dubai, where it is hot and sunny. It looks like a giant silver finger pointing up at the sky. People from all over the world come to see it. Inside, there are homes, offices, and a big hotel. At night, bright lights shine on it, and a big fountain with music plays outside. It is the tallest building made by people on Earth.
Burkina Faso\n\nBurkina Faso is a country in Africa. It is a big piece of land with no ocean next to it. Many people there grow food like corn and beans. The capital city is called Ouagadougou. People there speak French and other local languages. It is hot there, with a rainy time and a dry time.
Burn\n\nA burn is a hurt spot on your skin. It happens when something very hot touches you, like fire, hot water, or a hot pan. It can also happen from very cold things, electricity, or strong chemicals. A burn can make your skin red, sore, and sometimes blistered. You might get a small burn at home from touching a hot stove. If the burn is big or deep, a grown-up needs to help right away.
Burst\n\nA burst is when something breaks open all of a sudden. It can be a balloon that pops with a loud bang. It can be a pipe that cracks and water sprays out fast. You might see a burst when a bubble floats and then goes pop. A burst happens quickly and can be loud or messy.
Burundi\n\nBurundi is a small country in Africa. It has green hills and big lakes. Many people there grow food like beans and bananas. The weather is warm all year. A long river called the Nile starts in Burundi. It is one of the smallest countries in Africa.
Bus\n\nA bus is a big car that carries many people. It has a long body, many seats, and big windows. You see it on the road in towns and cities. A bus stops to let people get on and off. Some buses take children to school. Some buses go far, like to another city. A bus driver sits at the front and steers it. People pay a small coin or card to ride it.
Bush\n\nA bush is a plant that is smaller than a tree. It has many branches that grow close to the ground. You can find it in gardens, parks, and forests. People plant bushes to make their yards look pretty. Some bushes grow flowers in spring, and some have berries that birds eat. It can be trimmed into shapes like balls or boxes.
Business\n\nA business is a place where people work together. It makes things or helps people, and then sells them. Some businesses are very small, like a shop that cuts hair. Other businesses are very big, with many workers all over the world. A business can be in a building, like a store or an office. Some workers drive a truck to different places to do their job. The person who starts the business is the boss. When people buy what the business sells, the business can make money.
Bustard\n\nA bustard is a big bird that walks on the ground. It has long, strong legs and a round body. It lives in dry, grassy places in Africa and some parts of Europe. It eats leaves, seeds, fruit, and small bugs. It can also stomp on little animals to catch them. Some people let it eat the bugs that hurt their plants.
Busy\n\nBusy means you have many things to do. When you are busy, your hands and feet move a lot. You might see a busy bee flying from flower to flower. A busy street has many cars and people. When Mom is cooking dinner and talking on the phone, she is busy. It is okay to be busy, but it is also good to rest.
But\n\nA but is a small word that joins two ideas. It shows that the second idea is different from the first. You hear it when someone says, "I like ice cream, but I am full." It helps people say two things that do not match. You can use it when you want to add a new thought that changes the first one.
Butane\n\nButane is a kind of gas that burns very easily. It has no color and no smell by itself. People put it inside small metal cans. You can find it in a lighter that makes a flame when you push a button. It is also used in camping stoves to cook food outside. You must be very careful with it because it can catch fire fast.
Butter\n\nButter is a soft yellow food made from milk. It is made by shaking cream for a long time until it gets thick. People spread it on bread or use it when they bake cookies and cakes. It can also be used to fry eggs in a pan. Most butter comes from cow milk, but it can also come from sheep or goat milk. Sometimes a little salt is added to make it taste good. You keep it in the fridge so it stays cold and firm.
Butterfly\n\nA butterfly is a small flying bug with big, colorful wings. It has six legs, two feelers on its head, and a long tongue that curls up like a straw. You can see it in gardens, parks, and fields when the sun is warm. It flies from flower to flower, sipping sweet juice. Its wings have pretty patterns in red, yellow, blue, or orange. A butterfly starts as a tiny egg, then grows into a caterpillar that munches leaves. Later it wraps up in a hard shell and comes out with wings.
Button\n\nA button is a small, round thing on clothes. It is usually flat and has little holes in the middle. You find it on shirts, coats, and pants. It helps keep clothes closed. You push it through a small slit called a buttonhole. Some buttons are shiny, and some are made of plastic or wood. A button can pop off if you pull too hard, but you can sew it back on.
Buy\n\nTo buy means to give money and get something you want. When you go to a store with a grown-up, you see them buy food, toys, or clothes. They hand over coins or a card, and then the thing is theirs to take home. You can also buy a ticket to ride a bus or see a movie. Buying is how we get most things we need every day.
Buzz\n\nA buzz is a soft, humming sound. It goes on and on without stopping. You can hear it when a bee flies close by. Some toys and doorbells also make a buzz. It sounds like a little motor running.
By\n\nBy is a tiny word we use to show who did something or how something happened. It is very short, just two letters. You see it in books, on signs, and when people talk. It helps us say things like "the book by the bed" or "a story by Mom." When you walk by a friend, you move close to them. It is a helper word that makes sentences clear.
Bye\n\nBye is a short word people say when they leave. It is a friendly way to end a talk. You can wave your hand and say it with a smile. When you go home from school, you say bye to your teacher and friends. It means see you later.
Byte\n\nA byte is a tiny box inside a computer that holds one letter or number. It is made of eight even smaller parts called bits. When you type your name, each letter gets its own byte. Computers use many bytes to keep your games, pictures, and songs safe. A phone or tablet has millions of bytes inside it.
Byzantine architecture\n\nByzantine architecture is a way of building big, beautiful churches and halls. It uses round roofs called domes that sit on top of square walls. You can see it in very old cities near the sea, like Istanbul. Inside, the dome has many small windows that let light shine in like stars. The walls are often covered with tiny colored stones that make pictures of people and gold crosses. It is a style from a long, long time ago, when kings and queens ruled a big empire.
Byzantine Empire\n\nThe Byzantine Empire was a big, old country a long time ago. It had a strong city called Constantinople with tall walls. People there spoke Greek and made beautiful art with gold and tiny colored stones. They had a powerful leader called an emperor who wore a purple robe. You can see pictures of its round roofs and shiny art in some storybooks.
Cabbage\n\nA cabbage is a round, leafy vegetable that people eat. It has many thick leaves that wrap around each other into a tight ball. It can be green, red, or white. You can find it in a garden or at a grocery store. People chop it up to make crunchy salads, or they cook it in soups and stews. Some people turn it into a tangy food called sauerkraut. It is a cousin to broccoli and cauliflower.
Cabin\n\nA cabin is a small house made of wood. It has a roof, a door, and one or two windows. You can find it in the woods or by a lake. People stay in it for a short time to rest and play. It feels cozy and warm inside.
Cable television\n\nCable television is a way to watch shows on a TV. It uses a long, round wire that brings the picture and sound into your home. People pay money each month to get it. With it, you can see many different channels with cartoons, movies, and news. It is like a big box of shows that comes through the wall.
Cactus\n\nA cactus is a plant that lives in hot, dry places. It has a thick, green body that holds water inside. Instead of soft leaves, it has sharp spikes all over. These spikes keep animals from eating it. You can find a cactus in a desert, where the sun is very strong. Some people also keep a small cactus in a pot at home. It does not need much water to stay alive. A cactus can grow big flowers that are bright and pretty. Some kinds grow fruit that people can eat, like a red fruit called prickly pear.
Caecilian\n\nA caecilian is a long animal that looks like a worm or a snake. It has smooth, dark skin and no legs at all. It lives under the ground in warm, wet places like rainforests. It uses its head to dig and find bugs to eat. Some kinds have tiny eyes covered by skin, so they only see light and dark.
Caesar\n\nCaesar is a name from a very long time ago. It was the name of a strong leader in a place called Rome. He wore a white robe and a crown of leaves on his head. People remember him because he helped his city grow big. You might see his face on a coin or in a book about old times.
Cafe\n\nA cafe is a small shop where people go to sit and have a drink. It has tables and chairs inside. You can buy a warm cup of coffee, tea, or hot chocolate there. Some cafes also sell small snacks like cookies or cake. It is a nice place to meet a friend and talk. You might see one on a street corner in town.
Cage\n\nA cage is a box made of bars. It has open spaces between the bars so you can see inside. People use a cage to keep animals safe, like a pet bird or a hamster. At the zoo, big animals like lions live in a cage so they do not run away. A cage has a door that can open and close.
Caiman\n\nA caiman is an animal that looks like a big lizard. It has a long body, short legs, a long tail, and a big mouth with many teeth. It lives in rivers and lakes in South America. It moves slowly and can live for a very long time. It is a cousin of the alligator. You might see one at a zoo or in a picture book about wild animals.
Cairo\n\nCairo is a very big city in the country of Egypt. It sits next to a long river called the Nile. The weather is hot and sunny almost every day. Many people live there, more than any other city in Africa. Long ago, kings built giant stone triangles called pyramids near Cairo. People come from all over the world to see them. Inside the city, there is a big building full of old treasures from ancient kings. Cairo is a busy place with many cars, shops, and tall buildings.
Cake\n\nA cake is a sweet food you can eat. It is soft and fluffy inside. You bake it in a hot oven. People make it for happy days like a birthday. It can have sweet, creamy stuff on top called icing. Sometimes it has fruit or little candles on it. You see it at a party when someone turns a year older.
Calculator\n\nA calculator is a small machine that helps you with math. It has buttons with numbers and signs on them. You can find it at school, at home, or on a phone. It can add, take away, times, and split numbers for you. When you push the buttons, the answer shows up on a little screen. Some calculators are so tiny they fit in your pocket.
Calculus\n\nCalculus is a kind of math. It helps people understand how things change and move. You can use it to figure out how fast a car goes or how a ball curves in the air. Grown-ups learn it in school when they are older. It is like a tool for solving tricky puzzles about shapes and motion.
Calendar\n\nA calendar is a chart that shows the days of the year. It has pages or boxes for each month, with little squares for each day. You can find it on a wall at home, on a desk, or on a phone. People use it to know what day it is and to plan fun things like a birthday party. It helps you remember when to go to school or when a holiday is coming. A calendar shows the months, like January or June, and the days of the week, like Monday or Saturday.
Calgary\n\nCalgary is a big city in a place called Canada. It sits near tall, rocky mountains. Many people work with oil and gas there, so it has lots of tall buildings. Around the city, farmers raise cows on big fields. In winter, it gets very cold, but a warm wind sometimes blows in and makes the day feel nice. Every year, people have a big party called the Stampede with rides, cowboys, and horse races. Long ago, the Winter Olympics came to Calgary. It also has a hockey team called the Flames.
California\n\nCalifornia is a big piece of land in the west of the United States. It has tall mountains, hot dry deserts, and a long blue ocean coast. Many people live there, more than in any other state. It grows a lot of fruit and nuts that we eat. In California, you can see big movie signs in Hollywood and a happy mouse at Disneyland.
Call\n\nA call is when you use your voice to say something to someone who is not right next to you. It can be loud like shouting across a playground, or quiet like talking into a phone. People make a call to share news, ask for help, or just say hello. You might call your friend to come over and play. A call can also be the sound an animal makes, like a bird singing in a tree.
Calligraphy\n\nCalligraphy is a way of writing that looks very pretty. It uses a brush or a pen with a special tip. People make letters with thick and thin lines. You can see it on fancy cards, signs, and in old books. In some places, children learn to do it at school. It is like drawing with letters.
Callisto (moon)\n\nCallisto is a big moon that goes around the planet Jupiter. It is made of rock and ice. Its surface is very old and covered with many round dents called craters. It is one of the biggest moons we know. It is far from Jupiter and takes a long time to go all the way around it.
Calm\n\nCalm is a quiet, happy feeling. It is when your body is still and your mind is not worried. You can feel calm when you sit by a lake and watch the water. You can also feel calm when you take a slow, deep breath. A calm room has soft light and no loud noises. Many people like to feel calm before they go to sleep.
Calorie\n\nA calorie is a tiny bit of energy. It is not something you can see or touch. You get it from the food you eat. Your body uses it to run, play, and grow. If you eat more of it than you use, your body keeps the extra as fat. Food boxes sometimes show big numbers for it, but that just means a lot of tiny bits.
Cambodia\n\nCambodia is a country in a warm part of the world. It has green forests, big rivers, and old stone buildings. Many people live there and grow rice in wet fields. They also eat noodle soup and ride boats on the water. A famous old temple called Angkor Wat is on its flag.
Camel\n\nA camel is a big animal that lives in hot, sandy deserts. It has a thick coat of hair, long legs, and a hump on its back. The hump stores fat, which it uses for energy when there is no food. It has long eyelashes and bushy eyebrows to keep sand out of its eyes. People ride it and use it to carry heavy things. It can also give milk and wool. A baby camel is called a calf and can run soon after it is born.
Camellia\n\nA camellia is a plant with big, pretty flowers. It has shiny green leaves that stay on all year. The flowers can be white, pink, or red. It grows in gardens and parks. People like to look at the flowers in late winter and early spring. Some kinds of camellia leaves are used to make tea.
Camera\n\nA camera is a tool that takes pictures. It is a small box that keeps light out until you press a button. On the front, it has a round glass part called a lens that lets light in. Inside, it has a special part that saves the picture. Some cameras are big and some are very small, like the one on a phone. When you press the button, it opens a tiny door for a quick moment to catch the light and make a picture. You can look at the picture right away on a screen. People use a camera to remember happy times, like a birthday party or a trip to the park.
Cameroon\n\nCameroon is a big country in the middle of Africa. It has many trees, rivers, and green hills. Many people live there, and they speak lots of different languages. The biggest city is called Douala, and it sits next to the big blue ocean. In some parts, people speak French, and in other parts, they speak English. Children in Cameroon like to play soccer and eat yummy fruits like mangoes.
Camouflage\n\nCamouflage is a way animals hide by looking like the things around them. It helps an animal blend in so other animals do not see it easily. A tiger has stripes that look like tall grass, so it can hide when it hunts. Many animals are dark on top and light on the bottom, which makes them hard to spot from above or below. Some animals change color to match new places, like a chameleon turning brown on a tree branch. Camouflage keeps animals safe or helps them find food without being seen.
Camp\n\nA camp is a place where people sleep outside, away from home. It has tents or small wood houses. You can find a camp in a forest, by a lake, or near a mountain. People go there to play, cook food on a fire, and look at stars at night. Some kids go to a summer camp with friends and sing songs together.
Campfire\n\nA campfire is a small fire that people make outside. It has bright orange and yellow flames that dance and crackle. You can find it at a campsite, in a backyard, or on a beach. People sit around it to stay warm, cook food like marshmallows, and tell stories. You might see one when your family goes camping.
Camping\n\nCamping is when people sleep outside in a tent or a special car. It is a fun trip away from home. You can see trees, stars, and maybe a lake. People cook simple food on a fire. It is often done in warm weather. Some people camp to see new places and have an adventure.
Can\n\nA can is a round metal box with a lid. It is shiny and smooth, and it can be short or tall. You find cans in the kitchen or at the store. People put food like soup, beans, or fruit inside a can to keep it fresh. When you open a can, you hear a pop sound. After the food is gone, you can put the empty can in the recycling bin.
Canada\n\nCanada is a very big country. It is in the top part of North America. It has three big oceans touching its land: one on the left, one on the right, and one on top. Much of it is cold in winter, but the south part gets warm in summer. Many people live in big cities near the bottom, like Toronto and Vancouver. The top part has snow and ice and very few people. Canada has many trees, lakes, and animals. People there speak English or French. Its flag has a red maple leaf in the middle.
Canal\n\nA canal is a long path of water made by people. It looks like a straight river with hard sides made of stone or concrete. You can find a canal between two big lakes or two oceans. Boats and big ships use it to carry heavy things from one place to another. The Panama Canal is one that lets ships go from one big ocean to another without going all the way around.
Canary Islands\n\nThe Canary Islands are a group of seven big islands and many tiny ones in the ocean near Africa. They belong to the country of Spain. The islands were made by fire mountains called volcanoes a long, long time ago. On one island, the ground is black from old lava. The tallest mountain is on an island called Tenerife. It is a sleeping volcano. The weather is warm and sunny, so many people visit to swim at the beach. Farmers there grow sweet yellow bananas and other fruits. Some people on one island can talk by whistling, and kids learn it at school.
Cancer\n\nCancer is a sickness inside the body. It happens when some tiny parts of the body grow too fast and do not stop. These parts can make a lump that should not be there. Doctors help people with cancer by giving special medicine. Many people get better with rest and care.
Candle\n\nA candle is a stick made of wax with a string in the middle. It is long and round, and the string sticks out at the top. You can find candles in homes, on birthday cakes, or in churches. When you light the string, it makes a small, warm fire that gives light. The fire melts the wax, and the candle gets shorter as it burns. You can blow on the fire to put it out. Some candles smell nice, like flowers or cookies.
Candy\n\nCandy is a sweet food that tastes very good. It comes in many colors, shapes, and sizes. You can find it in stores or make it at home. People eat it as a snack, but not too much because it has a lot of sugar. Some candy is hard and some is soft and chewy. It can taste like fruit, chocolate, or mint.
Canning\n\nCanning is a way to keep food safe to eat for a long time. It puts food into a can or a glass jar and closes it tight so no air can get in. You can find canned food at the store, like cans of beans or fruit. People use canning to save food from the garden so they can eat it later. A can of peaches is one example you might see at home.
Cannon\n\nA cannon is a big, heavy tube that shoots heavy balls very far. It is made of strong metal and has a long, round opening at the front. Long ago, people used it in battles to break walls or hit far-away enemies. They put black powder and a big iron ball inside the tube, then lit the powder. The powder went BOOM and pushed the ball out fast. Today, big metal cars called tanks and big boats called warships carry cannons. You might see a cannon in a park or a museum, sitting still and quiet.
Cannot\n\nCannot is a word that means you are not able to do something. It is made by putting the words can and not together. When you say you cannot reach a high shelf, it means the shelf is too high for your hand. When you cannot find your shoe, it means the shoe is not where you look. It is a word people use every day when something is too hard or not there.
Canoe\n\nA canoe is a small boat that moves on water. It is long and pointy at both ends. You can sit or kneel inside it. People use a stick called a paddle to push it through the water. You can see a canoe on a lake or a calm river. Some people use it for fun, and some use it to race.
Canvas\n\nCanvas is a thick, strong cloth. It feels rough and tough, like the pants called jeans. People use it to make tents that keep you dry when you camp. It is also used for big sails on boats that catch the wind. Artists paint pictures on it with bright colors. You might see it in a backpack or on strong shoes.
Canyon\n\nA canyon is a big, deep crack in the ground. It looks like a long, narrow valley with tall, steep walls on both sides. You can find it in dry, rocky places where a river has cut through the land over a very long time. A river flows at the bottom and slowly wears away the rock. The Grand Canyon is a very big one that many people visit. It has layers of red and brown rock that glow in the sun.
Cap\n\nA cap is a small hat that sits on top of your head. It has a round part that covers your head and a flat piece in front that sticks out. You can find caps in stores that sell clothes. People wear it to keep the sun out of their eyes on bright days. Some caps have a picture or a word on the front. A baseball player wears a cap when he plays a game.
Cape\n\nA cape is a piece of clothing that hangs from the shoulders. It has no sleeves, and it is open in the front. You can find it in stories about kings, queens, and superheroes. People wear it to look fancy or to keep warm. A superhero like Superman wears a red cape that flies behind him when he runs.
Cape of Good Hope\n\nThe Cape of Good Hope is a special point of land at the very bottom of Africa. It is a rocky place where two big seas touch each other. You can find it in the country of South Africa, inside a big park with tall mountains. Long ago, people on boats used it as a sign to know where they were. It is a good spot to watch the water and see birds flying over the waves.
Cape Town\n\nCape Town is a big city in South Africa. It sits by the sea at the bottom of Africa. A very tall, flat mountain called Table Mountain stands right next to it. People in Cape Town work in shops, drive cars, and live in houses like in other cities. Long ago, ships from far away stopped there to get food and water. Today, many people visit to see the mountain and the blue ocean.
Cape Verde\n\nCape Verde is a country made of many small islands. It sits in the big blue ocean near Africa. The islands have dark rocks from old volcanoes. People live on nine of the islands. They grow bananas and catch fish. The sun shines almost every day, and a soft wind blows from the sea.
Capital\n\nA capital is the most important city in a country. It is where the leaders work and make big choices for everyone. You can find it on a map with a special star or a bigger dot. People visit it to see big buildings, flags, and sometimes a parade. For example, Washington, D.C. is the capital of the United States.
Capital (economics)\n\nCapital is the money or things people use to start a business. It can be coins, paper bills, or big tools like a tractor. A baker uses capital to buy flour and an oven. A farmer uses capital to buy seeds and a plow. Without capital, it is hard to make a shop or a farm.
Capital city\n\nA capital city is the main city of a country. It is where the leaders work and make rules. You can find big buildings, flags, and busy streets there. People go to the capital to talk about laws and help run the country. For example, Washington, D.C. is the capital of the United States.
Capitalism\n\nCapitalism is a way people buy and sell things. In this way, a person can own a shop or a farm. It lets people choose what to make and what to buy. If you have a lemonade stand, you are part of capitalism. You decide how much to sell a cup for, and people choose if they want to buy it. Many countries use this way.
Capsicum\n\nA capsicum is a plant that grows a fruit you can eat. It can be green, red, yellow, or orange. You find it in gardens or at the store. People eat it raw in salads or cook it in food. Some kinds taste sweet, and some taste hot and make your mouth feel warm. The sweet kind is called a bell pepper. You might see it on pizza or in a sandwich.
Capuchin monkey\n\nA capuchin monkey is a small, smart animal that lives in trees. It has dark brown or black fur, with a white face, throat, and chest. It lives in warm forests in Central and South America. It uses its long tail to help it climb and balance. It eats fruits, nuts, bugs, and sometimes small eggs. It is very clever and can use stones to crack open hard nuts. Some people even train it to help with simple tasks at home. You might see it in movies or at a zoo.
Capybara\n\nA capybara is a big, furry animal that looks like a giant guinea pig. It has short brown or reddish-brown fur, a round body, and small ears. Its eyes and nose sit high on its head so it can see and breathe while swimming. It lives near rivers and wet, grassy places in South America. It loves water and swims very well because it has a little skin between its toes. It eats grass and plants. It stays in big family groups and makes soft sounds like clicks and whistles to talk to its friends.
Car\n\nA car is a big machine with four wheels that helps people move from place to place. It has doors, windows, and seats inside. You see cars on roads and streets every day. People drive a car to go to school, the store, or to visit friends. It needs gas or a special battery to go. A car can be red, blue, or many other colors.
Carbohydrate\n\nA carbohydrate is a part of food that gives your body energy to run and play. It is made of tiny bits called sugars joined together. You find it in bread, pasta, rice, and potatoes. When you eat these foods, your body turns them into power for your muscles. If you eat more than you need, the extra is saved as fat. Many people get about half of their daily energy from it.
Carbon\n\nCarbon is a special kind of tiny building block. It is in all living things, like people, animals, and plants. You cannot see it because it is too small, but it is everywhere. It can join with other tiny blocks to make many things. For example, the black part inside a pencil has carbon. A shiny diamond is also made of carbon. It helps make the food we eat and the air we breathe out.
Carbon dioxide\n\nCarbon dioxide is a gas that has no color and no smell. It is made of tiny parts that are too small to see. People and animals breathe it out when they let air out of their mouths. Plants take it in from the air to make their own food. This helps plants grow big and strong. You can see it in bubbles in a fizzy drink. It is also in the air all around us, but you cannot see it.
Card\n\nA card is a small, flat piece of thick paper. It often has a picture on the front and words inside. You can find cards in a store or make one at home. People give cards to say happy birthday, thank you, or I love you. You might get a card on your birthday with a cake picture on it.
Card game\n\nA card game is a game you play with a set of cards. It has small paper cards with pictures or numbers on one side. You can play it at a table with friends or family. In many card games, you hold your cards so only you can see them. Some card games are about matching colors or numbers. Go Fish is a card game where you ask a friend for a card to make a pair. Another card game is Solitaire, which you can play all by yourself.
Cardamom\n\nCardamom is a spice that comes from tiny seeds inside a small pod. It has a very strong smell and a warm, sharp taste. The pod is shaped like a little triangle and feels papery on the outside. People use it to add flavor to food and drinks. You might find it in cookies, tea, or rice dishes. It is also used to help with tummy aches. A little bit of it goes a long way because the taste is so strong.
Cardboard\n\nCardboard is a thick, brown paper. It is stiff and hard to bend. You can find it in boxes that hold toys, shoes, or food. People use it to make boxes for moving things from one place to another. A big box that a new toy comes in is made of cardboard.
Cardiff\n\nCardiff is a big city in a country called Wales. It has many houses, shops, and tall buildings. A castle sits in the middle of the city, and three rivers run through it. Many people live there, and they can ride buses or trains to get around. The city has a huge stadium where people play sports and sing songs. It also has a big school with many students.
Cardinal (bird)\n\nA cardinal is a small bird with a bright red body. It has a short orange beak and a pointed crest on top of its head. You can see it in trees and bushes in North America. It sings pretty songs in the morning. The red one is the boy, and the girl is brown with a little red.
Cardinal direction\n\nA cardinal direction is one of the four main ways to go. It is north, east, south, or west. You can see them on a map or a compass. The sun rises in the east every morning. The sun sets in the west every afternoon. A compass needle points north to help you find your way.
Cardiology\n\nCardiology is a kind of doctor work that looks after the heart. It helps people when their heart is sick or not working right. A doctor who does this work is called a cardiologist. They check how the heart beats and make sure blood moves well inside the body. You might see a cardiologist if your heart needs extra care.
Cardiovascular\n\nCardiovascular is a big word for the heart and the tubes that carry blood. The heart is a strong pump inside your chest. It pushes blood through long, bendy tubes called blood vessels. Blood goes all around your body to bring air and food to every part. You can feel your heart beat when you run fast or put your hand on your chest.
Care\n\nCare is a warm feeling you have for someone or something you love. It means you want to keep them safe and happy. When you give a hug to a friend who is sad, that is care. When you water a plant so it can grow, that is care too. You can show care by sharing your toys or helping your mom set the table. It makes people feel good inside.
Career\n\nA career is the kind of work a grown-up does for many years. It is a job they learn about and get better at over time. You can see a career when you visit a fire station, a school, or a store. A firefighter, a teacher, and a shopkeeper each have a career. They help people and earn money to buy food and a home.
Careful\n\nCareful is a way you act when you want to keep things safe. It means you move slowly and look where you are going. When you hold a cup of juice with two hands, you are being careful. It helps you not spill or break things. Being careful also means you think before you do something, like crossing the street. You look both ways to make sure no cars are coming. It keeps you and others from getting hurt.
Carefully\n\nCarefully means doing something with a lot of care. When you do something carefully, you go slow and watch what you are doing. You do not rush or make big, fast moves. For example, when you carry a cup of water, you walk carefully so the water does not spill. When you color a picture, you move the crayon carefully to stay inside the lines. It helps you not break things or get hurt.
Cargo\n\nCargo is things that people move from one place to another. It can be food, toys, boxes, or big machines. You see it on big trucks that drive on the road. It also rides on long trains, big boats, and planes that fly in the sky. People put it in strong metal boxes so it stays safe. A place where it gets on or off a truck or boat is called a cargo stop.
Caribbean\n\nThe Caribbean is a warm, sunny part of the world. It has a big blue sea and many small islands. You can find white sand and clear water there. Many people visit to swim and play on the beach. Some islands have tall green hills and colorful birds. The weather is hot most of the year. People there grow sweet fruits like bananas and mangoes.
Caribbean Sea\n\nThe Caribbean Sea is a big, warm body of water. It is part of the bigger Atlantic Ocean. It sits below the Gulf of Mexico. Many small islands are inside it. The water is very deep in some spots. People from far away visit the islands to swim and play in the sun. Long ago, a man named Columbus sailed there and found the islands.
Carl Friedrich Gauss\n\nCarl Friedrich Gauss was a very smart man who loved numbers. He lived a long time ago and thought about math in new ways. He found a quick trick to add up all the numbers from 1 to 100 when he was just a boy. He also helped make maps and studied stars in the sky. Many math ideas we use today come from his work.
Carnival\n\nA carnival is a big, happy party that happens outside in a town. It has bright colors, loud music, and many people walking and dancing in the street. You can see people wearing funny clothes and masks. Some ride on big, pretty cars called floats. It often happens before a quiet time called Lent, when some people give up treats. In some places, it lasts for many days, and everyone comes out to play and watch.
Carnivore\n\nA carnivore is an animal that eats only meat. It has sharp teeth to bite and tear food. You can find it in forests, jungles, or even your own backyard. It hunts other animals to eat, or sometimes it finds animals that are already dead. A lion is a big carnivore that lives in the wild.
Carnivorous plant\n\nA carnivorous plant is a plant that eats bugs. It has special leaves that catch small animals like flies and ants. You can find it in wet, muddy places where the dirt is not very good for plants. It uses the bugs as food to help it grow strong. One kind you might see is the Venus flytrap. It has leaves that snap shut fast when a bug touches tiny hairs inside.
Carp\n\nA carp is a fish that lives in rivers and lakes. It has shiny scales and a big mouth. People in some places like to catch it and eat it. In other places, it stirs up mud and makes the water dirty. Some pretty fish in ponds, like goldfish, are its cousins.
Carpathian Mountains\n\nThe Carpathian Mountains are a long, curvy line of tall hills in the middle of Europe. They stretch like a big smile across many countries. You can find them in places like Romania, Poland, and Ukraine. The mountains are covered with green trees and are home to bears, wolves, and birds. Some parts are very high and have snow on top even in summer. People like to walk on the mountain paths and look at the pretty views.
Carpenter\n\nA carpenter is a person who builds and fixes things with wood. He uses tools like a hammer, a saw, and a ruler. You can find him making tables, chairs, and houses. Some carpenters build big strong parts of a house, like the walls. Others make pretty things like toy boxes or wooden animals. A carpenter works very carefully so everything fits together just right.
Carpet\n\nA carpet is a big, soft piece of cloth that covers the floor. It can be many colors and sizes. Some carpets go from one wall to the other wall in a room. It makes the floor warm and soft to walk on. You can sit or play on it. Some carpets have pretty pictures or shapes on them. A smaller one is called a rug. You might see a rug next to your bed or in the living room.
Carriage\n\nA carriage is a fancy cart that people ride in. It has four big wheels and a soft seat inside. Long ago, a horse pulled it on the road before cars were made. Today, you can see it at a wedding when a bride and groom ride together. It looks pretty with shiny paint and sometimes flowers on the door.
Carrot\n\nA carrot is a long, orange vegetable that grows under the ground. It has a green leafy top that sticks out of the dirt. You can find it in a garden or at the grocery store. People eat it raw as a crunchy snack or cook it in soups and meals. It tastes a little sweet. Rabbits love to munch on it too.
Carry\n\nCarry means to hold something and move it from one place to another. You can carry a toy in your hands, a bag on your back, or a baby in your arms. It helps you bring things with you when you walk. When you help Mom bring in the food from the car, you carry the bags.
Cart\n\nA cart is a small wagon with wheels. It has a flat part to carry things and a handle to pull or push. Long ago, people used a horse or a donkey to pull a big cart on the road. Today, you see a small cart at the grocery store. You push it down the aisles and put food inside. It helps you carry many things at once without holding them in your arms.
Cartography\n\nCartography is the way people make maps. A map is a picture that shows where places are. It can show roads, rivers, mountains, and houses. You can find a map in a book, on a phone, or on a big sign at the park. People use maps to find the way to a new place or to see how far away something is. A long time ago, people drew maps with a pen on paper. Today, many maps are made on a computer. A person who makes maps is called a cartographer.
Cartoon\n\nA cartoon is a funny drawing or a moving picture. It can be a single picture that makes you laugh, or many pictures that tell a story. You see cartoons in books, newspapers, and on TV. Some cartoons are about animals that talk and wear clothes, like a mouse or a duck. A person who draws cartoons is called a cartoonist. When the pictures move on a screen, it is also called a cartoon. Many kids watch cartoons on Saturday mornings.
Carve\n\nCarve means to cut a shape into something hard. It is done with a sharp tool like a knife. You can carve wood to make a toy or a statue. Some people carve a pumpkin to make a funny face for Halloween. You might see a carved stone with letters on it in a park.
Case\n\nA case is a box that keeps things safe. It can be hard or soft, and it often has a lid or a zipper. You might see a case for glasses, a pencil case at school, or a phone case on a phone. It holds something inside so it does not get broken or lost. A lunch box is a kind of case that holds your food.
Cashew\n\nA cashew is a small nut that grows on a tree. It has a curved shape and a light brown color. The tree grows in warm places far away, like Brazil and parts of Asia. People take off the hard shell before they sell it, because the shell can hurt your skin. You can eat it as a snack, or use it to make creamy butter. Some cooks put it in soups and stews to make them thick and yummy.
Caspian Sea\n\nThe Caspian Sea is a very big pool of water. It is so big that people call it a sea. It has salty water, but not as salty as the big ocean. Five countries touch its edges: Russia, Iran, and three others. Many fish live in it, and big boats carry things across it. Long ago, people from Rome came and tasted the water. They said it was salty, so they named it a sea.
Cassiopeia (constellation)\n\nCassiopeia is a group of stars in the night sky. It looks like a big letter W or M made of five bright stars. You can see it high up when you look north on a clear night. Long ago, people named it after a queen from a story. In fall, it is easy to find because the stars shine bright. Sometimes a new star appears there for a little while and then goes away.
Cassowary\n\nA cassowary is a big bird that cannot fly. It has a tall, hard bump on its head, like a helmet. Its neck is bare and has bright colors like red, blue, and yellow. It lives deep in warm, wet forests in places like Australia and New Guinea. It eats fruit and helps spread seeds so new trees can grow. It has strong legs with sharp claws on its toes. It can run fast and kick very hard. People do not see it often because it hides in the forest.
Cast\n\nA cast is a hard cover that a doctor puts on a broken arm or leg. It looks like a thick, white tube around the hurt part. You see it at the doctor's office or on a friend who fell down. It keeps the bone still so it can heal and get strong again. Sometimes friends write their names or draw pictures on it with markers.
Castle\n\nA castle is a big, strong house from long ago. It has tall walls, towers, and sometimes a deep water ring called a moat. You can find old castles in many places like England, France, and Japan. Long ago, a king or a lord lived in it with his family and helpers. It kept them safe from people who wanted to fight them. Today, many castles are old and broken, but people visit them to look and learn. Some castles are still homes, and some are museums.
Cat\n\nA cat is a small animal with soft fur. It has four legs, a long tail, two pointy ears, and small sharp claws. People keep cats at home as pets. It sleeps for many hours every day and plays at night. A cat can be black, white, gray, orange, or many other colors. It makes a soft humming sound called a purr when it is happy. It can also meow when it wants food. A baby cat is called a kitten. Many children love to pet a cat because the fur feels warm and soft.
Catalog\n\nA catalog is a book or a paper that shows many things you can buy. It has pictures and words to tell you about each thing. You can find it at a store or it may come in the mail. People look at it to pick what they want, like toys or clothes. A toy catalog shows many fun things to play with.
Catalonia\n\nCatalonia is a big piece of land in Spain. It sits near tall mountains and touches the country of France. It has four smaller parts, and its main city is called Barcelona. Barcelona is right next to a big blue sea. Many people visit it in the summer to play on the sand and swim. The people who live there speak more than one language. They have their own rules and helpers, like police. The land is green and grows lots of food because it gets more rain than other parts of Spain.
Catapult\n\nA catapult is an old machine that throws heavy things far away. It has a long arm and a big bucket at one end. People put a big rock or a burning ball in the bucket. Then they pull the arm back and let it go. The arm swings up fast and throws the thing through the air. Long ago, soldiers used it to break down tall castle walls. They put it on a hill or a tower so it could throw even farther. Today you can see a catapult in a museum or in a book about knights. Some big boats have a new kind of catapult that helps planes fly up into the sky.
Catch\n\nCatch is a game where you throw a ball and someone grabs it with their hands. It needs two or more people to play. You can play it outside in a park or a yard. It helps you run and move your body. A ball for catch can be big and soft or small and bouncy. When you catch the ball, you feel happy and proud.
Caterpillar\n\nA caterpillar is a small, soft bug that crawls on leaves. It has a long body with many tiny legs and can be green, yellow, or striped. You find it on plants in gardens or parks, munching on leaves. It eats and eats to grow big, then it makes a cozy shell around itself. Later, it turns into a butterfly or a moth with pretty wings.
Catfish\n\nA catfish is a fish that lives in water. It has long feelers near its mouth that look like a cat's whiskers. You can find it in rivers, lakes, and ponds. Some people keep small catfish in fish tanks at home. Other people eat catfish for food. It comes in many sizes, from very tiny to as big as a person. Most catfish are safe, but a few kinds can give a small shock like a zap of static electricity.
Catherine The Great\n\nCatherine the Great was a queen who lived a long time ago. She was the leader of a big country called Russia. She wore long, fancy dresses and a shiny crown on her head. She helped build schools and pretty buildings. She liked to read books and write letters. People remember her as a strong and smart queen.
Catholic\n\nCatholic is a big group of people who follow Jesus. They go to a special building called a church to pray and sing. Inside the church, there are colorful windows, candles, and a cross. A leader called a priest talks about being kind and helping others. Many Catholic families go to church on Sunday morning. They also have special days like Christmas and Easter with happy songs and food.
Catholic Church\n\nThe Catholic Church is a big family of people who love Jesus. It has a leader called the Pope, who lives in a tiny country named Vatican City. The Pope wears white clothes and a tall hat. You can see big, pretty buildings called churches where people go to sing, pray, and light candles. Inside, there are often colorful windows and a cross. On Sundays, families go to a special meal called Mass. They eat a small piece of bread that they believe is Jesus. Many children are part of this family and learn to be kind and help others.
Cattle\n\nCattle are big farm animals that eat grass. They have four legs, a long tail, and sometimes horns on their head. You can find them in fields and on farms all over the world. People keep cattle for milk and meat. A baby cattle is called a calf. It drinks milk from its mother. Many children see cattle in books or at a farm.
Cauliflower\n\nCauliflower is a white vegetable that looks like a small tree. It has a round head made of many tiny, tight buds. You can find it in a garden or at the grocery store. People eat it raw, cooked, or in soup. It tastes mild and soft. Some kids dip it in cheese or ranch dressing.
Causality\n\nCausality is the idea that one thing makes another thing happen. It is like a chain: when you push a toy car, it rolls. The push is the cause, and the rolling is the effect. You see causality every day. If you drop a ball, it falls down. If you water a plant, it grows. It helps us understand why things happen.
Cause\n\nA cause is the reason something happens. It is like the first domino that falls and makes the next one fall. When you push a toy car, your push is the cause of the car moving. If you water a plant, the water is the cause of it growing. You can find causes everywhere—like why a puddle dries up or why a bell rings.
Cavalry\n\nCavalry is a group of soldiers who ride into battle. Long ago, they rode on big, strong horses. Today, they ride inside big metal cars called tanks. They move much faster than soldiers who walk on foot. They can carry heavy gear because their ride is strong. You might see them in a parade with shiny helmets and flags.
Cave\n\nA cave is a big, dark hole inside the ground. It has long, thin paths and big open rooms. Water slowly makes the hole over a very long time. Inside, you can see pointy rocks that hang from the top and pointy rocks that stick up from the floor. Many bats sleep in caves during the day. Long ago, people lived in caves and drew pictures on the walls.
Cave painting\n\nA cave painting is a picture on a cave wall. It was made a long, long time ago by people who lived before us. It often shows animals like horses or big bulls. Sometimes it shows a hand shape or people hunting. You can find it deep inside dark caves in places like France and Spain. People used colors from rocks and burned wood to draw it. Today, we look at it to learn about how people lived back then.
Cd\n\nCd is a short way to write the metal cadmium. It is a soft, silver-white metal that feels heavy. You can find it in the ground, inside rocks and soil. People use it to make batteries, like the ones in toys, and to give bright colors to paint. It is not safe to touch or eat, so grown-ups keep it away from children.
Cedar\n\nA cedar is a big tree with a strong, nice smell. It has a thick, rough trunk and wide branches. The leaves are thin and pointy like little green needles. It grows in warm places near the big sea. People use its wood to make boxes and closets because the smell keeps bugs away. You might see a cedar in a park or a big garden.
Ceiling\n\nA ceiling is the top part of a room. It is the flat part you see when you look up. It hides the floor or roof above it. Some ceilings are plain and white. Others have pretty pictures or shiny tiles on them. A very famous ceiling is in a big church. An artist painted it with many colors and people.
Celebrate\n\nTo celebrate is to do something fun because you are happy. It can be a big party with cake and balloons, or a small happy dance at home. People celebrate when something good happens, like a birthday or a holiday. You might clap your hands, sing a song, or give a hug. It is a way to share joy with the people you love.
Celebration\n\nA celebration is a happy time when people come together. It can have bright colors, music, and yummy food. You might see a celebration at a birthday party or a holiday. People laugh, dance, and play games during it. It makes everyone feel joyful and loved.
Celebrity\n\nA celebrity is a person many people know. They are often on TV, in movies, or sing songs. You might see them on a big screen or hear them on the radio. People like to watch what they do and talk about them. Some play sports, like soccer or basketball, and many fans cheer for them. Others are funny and make people laugh. A few are famous just because their family is well-known. Even though they seem special, they are still people who eat, sleep, and have feelings.
Celery\n\nCelery is a long, green vegetable. It has a crunchy stem and small leaves on top. You can find it in the fridge at the grocery store. People eat it raw in salads or with dip. Sometimes they cook it in soup. It tastes fresh and a little bit like water.
Cell\n\nA cell is a tiny building block that makes up all living things. It is so small you cannot see it with just your eyes. Inside it has a soft jelly part and a thin skin around the outside. Some cells have a little ball in the middle that holds the plan for the whole body. You find cells in every part of you—your skin, your hair, your tummy. They work together to help you grow, move, and stay healthy. When you get a cut, new cells come to fix the hurt spot. All plants and animals are made of many, many cells.
Cellar\n\nA cellar is a room under a house. It is dark and cool inside. People use it to keep food like apples and potatoes fresh for a long time. Sometimes they also store old toys or boxes there. You go down some stairs to reach it.
Cello\n\nA cello is a big wooden box that makes music. It has four strings that you pull with a bow or pluck with your fingers. You sit down and hold it between your knees to play. It makes a deep, warm sound, like a big friendly bear singing. You can hear it in an orchestra, where many people play music together. Sometimes a person plays it all alone on a stage.
Celsius\n\nCelsius is a way to tell how hot or cold something is. It uses a special stick called a thermometer. You see it on weather maps and in kitchens. When water gets very cold and turns to ice, it shows 0. When water gets very hot and bubbles, it shows 100. A warm sunny day might be 25.
Cement\n\nCement is a gray powder that turns hard like a rock when you add water. It looks like soft dust before you mix it. People find it in big bags at building stores. Workers use it to make strong floors, walls, and paths. It helps bricks and stones stick together. When it dries, it stays hard for a very long time. You can see it on sidewalks and big buildings.
Cemetery\n\nA cemetery is a quiet place where people are buried after they die. It has many stones that stand up from the ground, each with a name on it. You can find it near a town or a church, often with a fence around it. People go there to remember someone they loved and to put flowers by the stone. Sometimes you see big trees and green grass there, which makes it feel calm.
Census\n\nA census is a big count of all the people in a place. It asks questions about who lives in each house. The government does a census to learn how many people there are and what they need. It happens every few years, like every five or ten years. The answers help build new schools, parks, and roads. A census is like a giant head count for a whole country.
Centaur\n\nA centaur is a made-up creature from old stories. It has the top part of a person and the bottom part of a horse. You can see it in some books with pictures of old tales. In the stories, it runs very fast and lives in wild places far away. One kind centaur named Chiron helped young heroes learn new things.
Centaurus\n\nCentaurus is a group of stars that makes a picture in the night sky. It looks like a creature that is half person and half horse. You can see it only if you live far down south on Earth, where the sky is very dark. Long ago, people gave names to star pictures like this one. Today, scientists use these star groups to help find their way around the sky.
Center\n\nA center is the middle part of something. It is the spot that is the same distance from all sides. You can find the center of a circle, a room, or a piece of paper. When you fold a paper in half, the line you make goes through the center. In a game, the center is where the action often starts.
Centipede\n\nA centipede is a long, thin bug with many legs. It has a flat body made of many small rings, and each ring has two legs. It lives in dark, wet places like under rocks or in old wood. It comes out at night to hunt small bugs for food. Some kinds can bite, but it mostly just hurts a little. One kind lives in houses and eats flies and roaches, so it helps keep the home clean.
Central\n\nCentral means the middle of something. It is the spot that is the same distance from all sides. You can find the central part of a circle by drawing lines from the edge to the middle. When you play with blocks, the block in the very middle is the central one. A town square is often the central place where people meet.
Central Africa\n\nCentral Africa is a big part of the world. It is made of many countries, like Angola, Cameroon, and Chad. You can find it in the middle of Africa on a map. Many people live there, and they speak different words and eat different foods. It has big rivers, thick green forests, and animals like gorillas and elephants. Some places are hot and wet all year.
Central African Republic\n\nThe Central African Republic is a big piece of land in the middle of Africa. It has no ocean touching it, so it is called landlocked. Much of it is flat with tall grass and some trees. In the south, there are thick, green forests where rare gorillas live. Many people there grow their own food like plants and vegetables. They also dig up shiny stones called diamonds from the ground to sell. The biggest city is Bangui, and that is where the leaders work.
Central America\n\nCentral America is a part of the world. It is a thin strip of land that joins North America and South America. It has seven small countries, like Guatemala, Honduras, and Panama. On one side is the big blue Pacific Ocean, and on the other side is the warm Caribbean Sea. The land has tall mountains, green valleys, and some mountains that can spit fire and smoke. These are called volcanoes. Many people there speak Spanish. They grow coffee and beans in the valleys. The forests are full of bright birds, monkeys, and colorful frogs.
Central Asia\n\nCentral Asia is a big part of Asia. It has many countries like Afghanistan and Kazakhstan. Long ago, people walked on a long road there to trade silk and spices. Today, some places grow soft white cotton, and others dig for oil deep under the ground. The land has tall mountains and wide, flat deserts. Many years ago, big groups of fighters on horses rode across it.
Central heating\n\nCentral heating is a way to keep a whole house warm. It has one big heater, like a furnace or boiler, that makes hot air or hot water. The hot air moves through big pipes called ducts and comes out of small openings in the floor or wall. The hot water goes to metal things called radiators that get warm and heat the room. You can find it in many homes and schools. It helps every room feel cozy, not just one room with a fire. Long ago, people only had a fire in one room, but now central heating lets you play in your bedroom even when it is cold outside.
Central nervous system\n\nThe central nervous system is the boss of your body. It has two big parts: the brain and the spinal cord. The brain sits inside your head, safe under hard bone. The spinal cord is a long bundle that runs down your back. It sends messages from your brain to the rest of your body. When you want to move your hand, your brain tells it to move. When you touch something hot, a message runs up to your brain fast, and you pull your hand away. It helps you think, feel, and move every day.
Central Park\n\nCentral Park is a big green park in New York City. It has many trees, grass, lakes, and paths for walking. People go there to play, run, ride bikes, or have a picnic. It also has a zoo where you can see animals. Many families visit it every day to enjoy the fresh air and sunshine.
Central processing unit\n\nA central processing unit is the brain of a computer. It is a small flat chip inside the computer box. It tells all the other parts what to do. It follows a list of steps called a program. When you click a button or type a letter, it thinks very fast and makes the screen change. It works so fast it can do a billion little jobs in one second.
Ceramic\n\nCeramic is a hard, smooth material made from clay and baked in a very hot oven. It can be shaped into many things like cups, plates, and tiles. You find it in the kitchen, on the floor, or in the bathroom. People use it to hold food, drink, or to make pretty art. A flower pot is a ceramic thing you might see at home.
Cereal\n\nCereal is a food made from grains. It is small and crunchy, and it comes in many shapes like circles, squares, or little balls. You find it in a box at the store or in your kitchen. People eat it for breakfast with cold milk poured on top. Some cereal is plain, but many kinds have a little sugar or fruit to make it sweet. A bowl of cereal is a quick and yummy way to start the day.
Cerebellum\n\nThe cerebellum is a part of the brain. It sits at the back of the head, under the big part of the brain. It helps you keep your balance when you stand, walk, or run. It also helps your hands and feet move together smoothly, like when you catch a ball or ride a bike. If it gets hurt, a person may shake or fall down a lot.
Ceres (dwarf planet)\n\nCeres is a small, round world in space. It is the biggest rock in a big ring of rocks between Mars and Jupiter. It is very far from the sun, so it is cold and dark. You cannot see it with just your eyes because it is too far and not bright. A space robot named Dawn went to look at it and took pictures. It found a big hole with shiny white spots made of salt.
Chad\n\nChad is a big country in the middle of Africa. It has no ocean next to it, so it is called landlocked. The land is mostly dry and sandy, with some grassy places and a big lake called Lake Chad. Many wild animals live there, like elephants, lions, and giraffes. People in Chad speak many languages, but the main ones are Arabic and French. The capital city is N'Djamena. Life can be hard there because there is not always enough food or water.
Chain\n\nA chain is a long row of small rings that are joined together. It looks like a metal rope made of many circles. You can find it on a swing at the park, on a bicycle, or holding a gate closed. People use it to pull heavy things or to lock a door. A chain on a necklace is pretty and holds a little charm.
Chain mail\n\nChain mail is a kind of strong shirt made from many tiny metal rings. It looks like a net of shiny circles all hooked together. Long ago, fighters wore it to keep safe from swords and arrows. Today, some people who cut meat or work with sharks wear it on their hands or body. It is heavy and hard to move in, but it stops sharp things from hurting you.
Chainsaw\n\nA chainsaw is a tool that cuts wood. It has a long metal bar with a sharp chain that spins around it very fast. People use it to cut down big trees or to cut logs into smaller pieces for firewood. Some workers also use it to cut hard things like stone. You might see a chainsaw in a cartoon or at a place where people cut trees.
Chair\n\nA chair is a thing you sit on. It has four legs, a flat seat, and a back to lean on. You can find it in a kitchen, a school, or a living room. People use it to sit at a table to eat, draw, or talk. Some chairs are soft and big, like the one Dad sits in to read.
Chalk\n\nChalk is a soft, white stick. It feels a little dusty on your fingers. You can find it in a classroom near a big green or black board. A teacher uses it to draw letters and shapes so children can see and learn. When you rub it on the board, it leaves a white line. You can also draw with it on the sidewalk outside.
Chamber music\n\nChamber music is music played by a small group of friends with instruments. It is made for a tiny room, not a big hall. Each friend plays a different part, so they all listen closely to each other. There is no leader waving a stick. They play like a team having a happy talk with sounds. You might see a group of four people with string instruments playing together. That is a kind of chamber music.
Chameleon\n\nA chameleon is a kind of lizard. It has a long sticky tongue that shoots out fast to catch bugs. Its eyes can move in different directions at the same time, so it can look all around without turning its head. It lives in warm places like forests and deserts, mostly in Africa. Many chameleons can change the color of their skin to hide or show how they feel. It has a tail that can wrap around branches to help it climb. Some people keep it as a pet at home.
Chance\n\nChance is when something happens that you did not plan. It is like a surprise. You can find a pretty rock on the ground by chance. When you roll a dice, the number you get is chance. Sometimes good things happen by chance, like finding money in your coat pocket.
Change\n\nChange is when something becomes different. It can be a small change, like when you put on a new shirt. It can be a big change, like when a baby grows into a kid. You see change every day. The sky changes from blue to orange at sunset. Leaves change color in the fall. Even you change as you learn new things.
Channel Tunnel\n\nThe Channel Tunnel is a long train road under the sea. It goes between England and France. It is very deep under the water. Trains carry people and cars through it. A fast train called Eurostar uses it to go from London to Paris in about two hours.
Chant\n\nA chant is a group of words that people say or sing over and over. It often has a steady beat, like a drum. You might hear a chant at a game when fans cheer for their team. In some quiet places, people use a chant to feel calm and peaceful. It can be slow and soft or loud and fast. When many voices join together, a chant can sound very big and strong.
Chaplin\n\nChaplin is a name many people know. It belongs to a funny man who made old movies with no talking. He had a small black mustache, a round hat, and big shoes. He walked in a silly way that made everyone laugh. You can see him in black-and-white shows on a screen. He is loved by grown-ups and kids all over the world.
Chapter\n\nA chapter is a part of a book. It is like a small story inside a bigger story. You find chapters in books you read at bedtime or in school. Each chapter has a number or a name to show where it starts. When you finish one chapter, you can stop and start the next one later. It helps you read a long book a little bit at a time.
Character\n\nA character is a person or animal in a story. It can be in a book, a movie, or a show. You might see a character on TV, like a talking dog or a brave girl. It does things in the story, like run, laugh, or help a friend. Some characters are make-believe, like a dragon or a fairy.
Charcoal\n\nCharcoal is a black, dusty thing made from wood. It is made by heating wood in a place with almost no air. The wood does not burn, but it turns into charcoal. People use it to cook food on a grill outside. It gets very hot and makes the food taste smoky. Some people also use it to draw dark, soft lines on paper.
Chard\n\nChard is a green vegetable with big leaves. It has thick stems that can be white, red, or yellow. You find it in gardens or at the store near other leafy greens. People cook it and eat it like spinach. It tastes a little like the ground after rain. Some kids dip the cooked leaves in butter.
Charge\n\nA charge is when something gets power to work. It is like filling up a toy with energy so it can move or light up. You see it when you plug in a phone or tablet to make the battery full again. It can also mean rushing forward fast, like when a dog runs to catch a ball. A charger is the cord that gives the power.
Chariot\n\nA chariot is a small cart with two wheels. It is pulled by horses. Long ago, people used it to move fast. A person who rides in it is called a charioteer. You can see pictures of it in old story books.
