Charlemagne\n\nCharlemagne was a king who lived a long, long time ago. He was a big, strong man with a long beard. He lived in a big stone castle with many rooms. He helped make rules for many people in a place called Europe. He liked to learn new things and had teachers come to his castle. He is remembered as a great king.
Charles Darwin\n\nCharles Darwin was a man who lived a long time ago. He looked at animals and plants very carefully. He saw that animals change a little bit over many, many years. He wrote a book about this idea. Many people read his book and learned new things about how animals become different.
Charlie\n\nCharlie is a name for a boy or a girl. He or she can be a friend, a brother, or a sister. You might know a Charlie at school or in your neighborhood. Some people call a pet dog or cat Charlie too. It is a happy name that is easy to say.
Charlie Chaplin\n\nCharlie Chaplin was a funny man who made movies a long time ago. He wore a small black hat, a tight coat, big pants, and big shoes. He had a tiny mustache and walked in a silly way. People watched his movies in big dark rooms with a big screen. He made people laugh without saying any words. You might see a picture of him with a funny walk and a cane.
Chart\n\nA chart is a picture that shows information. It uses lines, bars, or circles to help you see numbers or facts. You can find a chart in a book, on a computer, or on a classroom wall. It helps people understand things quickly, like how many sunny days there were in a month. A teacher might use a chart to show who likes apples or oranges best.
Chase\n\nA chase is when one person or animal runs after another. It happens when someone wants to catch the one in front. You might see a chase in a game of tag at the park. A dog may chase a ball when you throw it. In a cartoon, a cat often chases a mouse. It is fast and full of running.
Chat\n\nA chat is a happy talk between two or more people. It is when you sit with a friend and share words back and forth. You can have a chat at home, at school, or on the playground. People chat to tell stories, ask questions, or just to feel close. When you tell your friend about your favorite toy, that is a chat.
Cheap\n\nCheap means something does not cost a lot of money. It is when you can buy a thing with only a few coins. A cheap toy might be small and simple, but still fun. You can find cheap things at a dollar store or a yard sale. Sometimes cheap things break fast, but not always. A sticker or a bouncy ball is often cheap.
Check\n\nA check is a small piece of paper that tells a bank to give money. It has words and numbers on it, like the amount of money and a person's name. You can find it in a checkbook at home or in an office. People use it to pay for things without using coins or bills. For example, a grown-up might write a check to pay for food at the store.
Checkers\n\nCheckers is a game for two people. It uses a board with dark and light squares. Each player has small round pieces. They move one piece at a time across the dark squares. When a piece jumps over the other player's piece, it takes that piece away. The player who takes all the other pieces wins. You can play it at home with a friend or family.
Cheek\n\nA cheek is the soft, round part of your face. It sits on each side, below your eyes and next to your nose. When you smile, your cheeks puff up and look happy. You use your cheeks to hold food inside your mouth while you chew. Sometimes a cheek can turn pink when you feel warm or shy. A mom or dad might give a soft kiss on a child's cheek.
Cheer\n\nCheer is a happy sound people make with their voice. It is loud and full of joy. You hear it at a game when someone scores a point. People also cheer at a party or a show to say "good job." When you clap your hands and shout "yay," that is a cheer. It makes others feel proud and happy.
Cheese\n\nCheese is a food made from milk. It can be soft or hard, and it comes in many colors like white, yellow, or orange. You can find it in the store, on pizza, or in a sandwich. People eat it as a snack or melt it on top of food. A grilled cheese sandwich is a warm, yummy way to eat it.
Cheetah\n\nA cheetah is a big, fast cat. It has a thin body, long legs, and a long tail with spots. It lives in Africa and a few in Asia, in wide, grassy places. It runs faster than any other animal on land. It hunts small animals like gazelles during the day. It cannot roar like a lion; it makes a chirping sound.
Chef\n\nA chef is a person who cooks food for other people. He wears a tall white hat and a white coat in the kitchen. You can find him in a restaurant, a hotel, or a big kitchen. He uses pots, pans, and a sharp knife to make yummy meals. He mixes things like eggs, flour, and milk to bake a cake. Some chefs make pizza with cheese and red sauce.
Chemical\n\nA chemical is a tiny piece that makes up everything around us. It is so small you cannot see it with your eyes. Chemicals are in water, air, food, and even your own body. When you mix two chemicals together, they can change and make something new, like bubbles or colors. For example, baking soda and vinegar are chemicals that fizz when they meet.
Chemical Bond\n\nA chemical bond is like a tiny, strong glue that holds little pieces together. These little pieces are called atoms, and they are too small to see. When atoms stick together with a chemical bond, they make everything around us—like water, air, and even our bodies. It is what keeps the parts of a toy or a cookie all joined up, but much, much smaller.
Chemical Compound\n\nA chemical compound is a thing made when two or more different things join together. You cannot see it with just your eyes because it is very, very tiny. It is all around you. Water is one example. Water is made when two tiny parts called hydrogen join with one tiny part called oxygen. Another example is the white stuff on your teeth called fluoride. It helps keep your teeth strong.
Chemical element\n\nA chemical element is a tiny building block that makes up everything around us. It is made of even smaller parts called atoms, and all the atoms in one element are the same kind. You can find elements in nature, like the air you breathe or the water you drink. Some elements are shiny metals, some are gases you cannot see, and a few are liquids. For example, the shiny yellow metal called gold is an element, and the air has an element called oxygen that we need to live.
Chemical industry\n\nThe chemical industry is a big group of factories that make many things we use every day. It takes simple stuff from the ground, like oil, air, water, and rocks, and turns them into new things. Some of these new things are plastic toys, soap, and paint. Most of what it makes is not sold in stores, but is used to make other things. Many people work there, wearing special coats and glasses to stay safe. A long time ago, the first big factory of this kind was built to make a strong liquid called acid.
Chemical reaction\n\nA chemical reaction is when one thing changes into a different thing. It can happen fast, like a firework, or slow, like an apple turning brown. You can see it when you bake a cake—the wet mix turns into a fluffy cake in the oven. Some reactions make heat, like a candle burning. Others take in heat, like when you mix baking soda and vinegar and it feels cold.
Chemistry\n\nChemistry is a kind of science that looks at what everything is made of. It studies tiny parts called atoms and how they join or change. You can see chemistry when bread rises in the oven or when soap cleans your hands. It helps make things like medicine, clean water, and new toys. When you mix baking soda and vinegar and see bubbles, that is chemistry at work.
Chengdu\n\nChengdu is a big city in China. It sits on flat land with mountains far away. Many people visit it to see giant pandas at a special panda home. The food there is very spicy, with lots of red peppers. People like to eat hot pot and sit in tea houses. It is one of the biggest cities in the country.
Cheque\n\nA cheque is a special piece of paper that helps people give money to someone else. It is a small rectangle with words and lines on it. You find it in a checkbook at home or in a bank. A person writes a name and an amount on it, then signs it. The person who gets it can take it to a bank and get real money. It is like a promise to pay.
Cherokee\n\nCherokee is a group of Native American people. They lived in houses made of wood, not in tents. Long ago, they lived in the eastern part of the United States. A smart man named Sequoyah made a way to write their words. Today, many Cherokee live in a place called Oklahoma.
Cherry\n\nA cherry is a small, round fruit that grows on a tree. It is red and has a hard seed in the middle. It tastes a little sour and sweet. People eat it fresh or put it in cakes, ice cream, and pies. You can find it at the store in summer.
Chess\n\nChess is a game for two people. It is played on a board with 64 small squares, some light and some dark. Each player starts with 16 pieces, like a king, a queen, and small ones called pawns. They take turns moving one piece at a time. The goal is to trap the other player's king so it cannot move away. When that happens, the game is over and that player wins. You might see people playing it at a park or in a quiet room.
Chest\n\nA chest is the front part of your body between your neck and your tummy. It has strong bones called ribs that make a safe cage for your heart and lungs. When you breathe in, it gets bigger. When you breathe out, it gets smaller. You can feel it move if you put your hand on it. Many people have a chest, and it helps keep important parts safe inside.
Chestnut\n\nA chestnut is a kind of tree that grows a nut. It has big green leaves and a tall brown trunk. You can find it in parks, woods, or on farms. The nut is brown and shiny, and it sits inside a spiky green shell. People roast the nut over a fire and eat it warm. Squirrels like to gather chestnuts and hide them for winter.
Chew\n\nChew means to break food into tiny bits with your teeth. It happens inside your mouth before you swallow. You chew things like bread, apples, and meat. Chewing makes food soft and easy to go down your throat. It also helps your body get the good stuff from the food. When you eat, you should chew slowly and not talk with your mouth full.
Chicago\n\nChicago is a big city in the United States. It sits next to a huge lake called Lake Michigan. In the city, you can see very tall buildings that touch the sky. Many people live there and ride trains or buses to go places. There are fun parks where kids can play, and big museums with old dinosaur bones. Some people eat a special pizza there that is thick and full of cheese. Chicago is also home to many sports teams that play ball games.
Chichen Itza\n\nChichen Itza is a very old city made of stone. It has big buildings with many steps, like a tall cake with stairs on each side. You can find it in a warm place called Mexico. Long ago, people played a ball game there in a huge field. They also had a deep water hole where they gave gifts. Today, many people visit to see the big stone buildings.
Chick\n\nA chick is a baby chicken. It is small and soft, with fluffy yellow feathers. You can find it on a farm, peeping and walking near its mother hen. It grows inside an egg and pecks its way out when it is ready. A chick eats tiny seeds and grains. It cheeps loudly when it is hungry. Many children see a chick in springtime, around Easter.
Chicken\n\nA chicken is a bird that people keep on farms. It has two legs, two wings, and a beak. It is covered with soft feathers. Many chickens live in a small house called a coop. They eat seeds, bugs, and corn. A female chicken is called a hen. She lays eggs that people eat for breakfast. A baby chicken is called a chick. It is small and yellow and says cheep cheep. People also eat chicken meat. It can be cooked in many ways, like fried chicken or chicken soup.
Chicken as food\n\nChicken is a kind of meat that people eat. It comes from a bird with the same name. You can cook it in many ways, like in a pan, in an oven, or on a grill. It is a white or light brown meat that tastes mild. Many kids eat chicken as nuggets, strips, or a drumstick. It is good for your body because it helps you grow strong.
Chickenpox\n\nChickenpox is a sickness that gives you red, itchy spots. It starts with little bumps on the skin that fill with water. These bumps can pop and then dry up. Most kids get it before they are big. It can make you feel hot and tired for a few days. You can catch it from another person who is sick. There is a special shot that helps keep you from getting it. If you do get it, a grown-up can put on a cream to stop the itch.
Chickpea\n\nA chickpea is a small, round bean that is yellow. It grows in a pod on a plant, like peas. You can find it in cans at the grocery store, or dried in bags. People cook it and mash it to make a soft, yummy dip called hummus. It can also be ground into flour to make flat bread. It is full of good stuff that helps your body grow strong.
Chicory\n\nChicory is a plant with bright blue flowers. It has green leaves and a long root under the ground. You can find it growing by the side of a road or in a field. People use its leaves to make salad. They also dry and grind its root to make a warm drink that tastes a little like coffee. Some farmers grow it as food for cows and sheep.
Child\n\nA child is a young person who is not yet grown up. It is smaller than a mom or dad. A child has a lot of energy and loves to play. You can see children at home, at school, or at a park. A child learns new things every day, like how to read, draw, or tie shoes. It uses its imagination to make up games and stories. A child may go to a place called school to learn with other children. Some children live with a mom and dad, and some live with other grown-ups who take care of them. A child needs love, food, and a safe place to sleep.
Child development\n\nChild development is how a baby grows and learns to be a big kid. It starts when a baby is born and goes until the child is a teenager. A baby first learns to smile, sit, and crawl. Then it learns to walk, talk, and play with others. Every child grows at its own speed. Some learn fast, and some take more time. A child needs love, food, and sleep to grow well. Playing and talking with a child helps it learn new things. When a child feels safe and happy, it can learn best.
Childhood\n\nChildhood is the time when you are a kid. It starts when you are born and goes until you grow up. During this time, you learn to walk, talk, and play. You go to school, make friends, and have fun with toys. Childhood is full of new things to see and do every day.
Children's literature\n\nChildren's literature is books made just for kids. It has stories with words and often bright, colorful pictures. You can find these books at home, in a library, or at school. Grown-ups read them out loud to help kids learn new things and have fun. Some books tell about a naughty rabbit, a hungry caterpillar, or a boy who did not want to grow up.
Chile\n\nChile is a long, thin country in South America. It sits next to the ocean and has tall mountains called the Andes. In the north, it has a very dry desert where almost no rain falls. In the south, it is cold and has forests and ice. People in Chile speak Spanish. They like to play soccer and eat foods like meat, fish, and corn. A red bell-shaped flower called the copihue is the special flower of Chile.
Chili pepper\n\nA chili pepper is a small, spicy fruit that people eat. It can be red, green, yellow, or orange. It grows on a plant that first came from Mexico. People use it to make food taste hot and strong. Some chili peppers are long and thin, and some are round and fat. You might see it in salsa or on top of tacos. It can also be dried and turned into powder.
Chimney\n\nA chimney is a tall, hollow tube on top of a house or a big building. It is usually made of bricks or metal. You can see it poking up from the roof. When people make a fire inside, the hot, smoky air goes up through the chimney and out into the sky. This keeps the room fresh and safe. Some chimneys are very tall, like the ones at big factories. A train or a boat can have a chimney too.
Chimpanzee\n\nA chimpanzee is a big, smart animal that looks a little like a person. It has long arms, short legs, and a body covered in dark hair. Its face has no hair and can show many feelings. It lives in the forests of Africa with a big family group. It climbs trees to find fruit, leaves, and nuts to eat. Sometimes it uses sticks to get bugs out of holes. A baby chimpanzee stays close to its mom for many years.
Chin\n\nA chin is the part of your face below your mouth. It is the front part of your lower jaw. You can feel it when you touch the bottom of your face. It helps you move your mouth when you talk or eat. Some people have a small chin, and some have a big chin. When you are sad, your chin might shake a little.
China\n\nChina is a big country in East Asia. It has many people, mountains, rivers, and old stories. You can find it on a map next to the ocean. It has a very long river called the Yangtze. Long ago, people there built great walls and wrote with brushes. Today, many things we use are made there. It is a place with busy cities and quiet farms.
Chinese\n\nChinese is a way of talking and writing used by many people. It sounds different from English, with up-and-down tones like a song. You can see it written in small pictures called characters on signs, books, and menus. Many children learn to speak it at home with their family. If you go to a big city, you might hear someone say 'ni hao,' which means hello.
Chinese architecture\n\nChinese architecture is a way of building houses, walls, and big halls. It often has curved roofs that point up at the corners. You can see it in China and in other places nearby. People use wood, stone, and red paint to make it. The Great Wall is a very long wall built in this style. The Forbidden City is a big home for old kings, with many rooms and a golden roof.
Chinese calendar\n\nA Chinese calendar is a special way to count days and months. It uses both the moon and the sun to tell time. People in China used it long ago for planting food and for big parties. Today, most people use a different calendar for school and work. But they still use the Chinese calendar for fun holidays like Chinese New Year. On that day, families eat together and watch bright red parades.
Chinese characters\n\nChinese characters are special marks used to write words. They look like little drawings made of lines and dots. You can see them in books, signs, and on TV from China and Japan. People use them to tell stories and share ideas. Each mark stands for a word or a part of a word. Some marks look like the thing they mean, like a sun or a tree.
Chinese Folk Religion\n\nChinese folk religion is a set of old beliefs from China. It is not one big book or one big church. People who follow it honor gods, spirits, and family members who have died. They often have a small table or shelf at home with pictures, candles, and food for the spirits. You can see it in many Chinese homes and shops. It is a way to ask for good luck and keep bad things away.
Chinese food\n\nChinese food is the yummy food that people make and eat in China. It uses lots of rice, long noodles, and a brown salty sauce called soy sauce. Many dishes are cooked in a big round pan called a wok. People eat it with two sticks called chopsticks. You might see it in a restaurant near your home, like fried rice or noodle soup. It tastes warm and good, and many kids love the soft noodles.
Chinese language\n\nChinese is a way people talk and write. It is used by many people in China and other places. It looks like small pictures called characters. Each character means a word or part of a word. People write it with a brush or a pen. You might see it on signs in a big city or in a book. Some people speak it at home with their family. It sounds different from English because it uses high and low tones, like singing a little song.
Chinese martial arts\n\nChinese martial arts are ways of moving and fighting that people in China made long ago. It looks like a fast dance with kicks, jumps, and strong arms. You can see it in movies or at a show where people wear soft clothes and move together. It helps the body stay strong and quick. Some moves copy animals like a tiger or a bird. Many kids learn it after school to have fun and get strong.
Chinese mythology\n\nChinese mythology is a big set of old stories from China. It tells about how the world began, about gods, and about magic animals. One story says the world started from a giant egg. Another story says a goddess made people from mud. A dragon is a magic animal in many of these stories. It looks like a long snake with a horse head, and it can fly. People in China told these stories long ago to explain the world around them.
Chinese New Year\n\nChinese New Year is a big holiday for Chinese people. It starts on a new moon, so the day changes every year. It is always in January or February. Families come together and eat a big meal. Children get red envelopes with money inside. People also clean their homes to sweep away bad luck. Each year has an animal name, like Dragon or Rabbit. Many places have parades with loud drums and a long dragon that dances in the street.
Chip\n\nA chip is a thin, flat piece of food. It is often made from potatoes or corn. You can find it in a bag at the store. People eat it as a snack, and it is crunchy and salty. Sometimes it comes in flavors like cheese or barbecue. You might have it at a party or in your lunchbox.
Chirp\n\nA chirp is a short, high sound. It is like a tiny beep or a quick tweet. You can hear it when a small bird sings in the morning. Some bugs, like crickets, also make this sound at night. A toy or a phone can chirp too when it wants to tell you something.
Chisel\n\nA chisel is a tool with a sharp, flat end. It has a long handle that you hold. You hit the handle with a hammer to push the sharp part into wood or stone. It cuts away small bits to make a shape. A person who makes chairs or tables uses it to make the wood smooth and pretty. An artist might use it to make a statue from a big rock.
Chivalry\n\nChivalry is a way of acting kind and fair. It is how a knight long ago was supposed to behave. A knight would help people, keep his promises, and be brave. Today, it means being polite and nice to others. A boy might hold a door open for someone or share his snack. That is a small act of chivalry.
Chocolate\n\nChocolate is a sweet food made from special beans. It can be a hard bar you hold in your hand, or a warm drink in a cup. People use it to make cakes, cookies, and ice cream. It melts in your mouth when you eat it. There are three kinds: dark chocolate tastes a little bitter, milk chocolate is sweet and creamy, and white chocolate is the sweetest. You can find chocolate in stores, at birthday parties, and in your lunch box. But dogs and cats cannot eat it — it makes them sick.
Choice\n\nA choice is when you pick one thing from two or more things. It can be a big thing, like which shoes to wear, or a small thing, like which color cup to use. You make a choice every day. When you pick a toy to play with, that is a choice. Sometimes a choice is easy, and sometimes it is hard. But you always get to pick what feels right to you.
Choir (music)\n\nA choir is a group of people who sing together. They stand close to each other and make music with their voices. You can see a choir at a church, a school, or a big hall. They sing songs with high parts and low parts that sound pretty together. A grown-up called a leader helps them sing at the same time. Sometimes they wear the same color shirt or robe. You might hear a choir on a holiday or at a show.
Chongqing\n\nChongqing is a very big city in the middle of China. It sits where two rivers meet, and it has many tall hills and bridges. It is one of the biggest cities in the world, with many people living there. Long ago, it was a small town, but it grew and grew. Today, people go there to see the lights at night and to eat hot, spicy food. It is also a place where big boats stop on the river.
Choo\n\nA choo is a sound a train makes. It goes "choo-choo" when the train starts to move. You can hear it at a train station or when you play with a toy train. The sound comes from the train's whistle or its big wheels turning. It is a fun sound that makes people think of going on a trip.
Choose\n\nChoose means to pick one thing from a few things. It is like when you have a red crayon, a blue crayon, and a yellow crayon, and you pick the blue one. You can choose what to eat for a snack, like an apple or a banana. You can choose what game to play with a friend. Every day you make many small choices.
Chopsticks\n\nChopsticks are two long, thin sticks used to pick up food. They are often made of wood, bamboo, or plastic. People in many Asian countries like China and Japan use them to eat. You hold both sticks in one hand and pinch the food between the tips. In some places, people also use them to stir food while cooking. You might see chopsticks when your family eats noodles or rice at a restaurant.
Chord\n\nA chord is a group of notes that you play at the same time. It sounds full and pretty, like a little team of sounds. You can make a chord on a piano by pressing two or more keys together. On a guitar, you press strings with one hand and strum with the other to hear a chord. Many songs use chords to make the music feel happy or sad.
Chore\n\nA chore is a small job you do at home. It helps keep your house clean and tidy. You might put your toys away, or help set the table for dinner. Some chores are done every day, like feeding a pet. Other chores happen once a week, like helping to sweep the floor. Doing a chore makes you feel proud because you helped your family.
Choreography\n\nChoreography is the art of making up dances. It tells dancers how to move their bodies to music. A person who makes up dances is called a choreographer. He or she thinks of steps, turns, and jumps, and then shows them to the dancers. You can see choreography in ballet shows, on TV, and in movies. Sometimes it is used for ice skating or even for fight scenes in films.
Christ the Redeemer (statue)\n\nChrist the Redeemer is a very big statue of Jesus. It stands on top of a tall hill in Rio de Janeiro, a city in Brazil. It looks like a person with arms spread wide open. People can see it from far away because it is so high up. Many people visit it to look at the city below. It was built a long time ago to remember a special day for Brazil.
Christianity\n\nChristianity is a big group of people who follow a man named Jesus. They believe Jesus is the Son of God. They read a special book called the Bible. In the Bible, there are stories about Jesus and how he helped people. Many Christians go to a church to sing, pray, and learn about God. They also celebrate a holiday called Christmas to remember when Jesus was born. Another holiday is Easter, when they remember that Jesus came back to life. Christianity is the biggest group of people in the world, with many friends in many countries.
Christmas\n\nChristmas is a happy holiday that comes in winter. It is a day when many people remember the birth of a special baby named Jesus. On this day, families put up a green tree and hang bright lights and shiny balls on it. They also give each other pretty boxes with surprises inside. A big man in a red suit, called Santa, may bring toys for children. Many people sing soft songs and eat a big meal with family. You can see red and green colors everywhere.
Christmas carol\n\nA Christmas carol is a happy song about Christmas. It has words that tell the story of baby Jesus, Santa, snow, or giving gifts. People sing it in December, near Christmas Day. Sometimes a group walks from house to house singing it outside the door. You might hear it at a school show or on the radio in the car. One you may know is "We Wish You a Merry Christmas."
Chronology\n\nChronology is the study of time. It is a way to put things in order from first to last. You can use it to make a timeline, which is a line that shows when things happened. For example, you wake up, then you eat breakfast, then you go to school. That is a timeline of your morning. People use chronology to tell stories and to understand history.
Chrysanthemum\n\nA chrysanthemum is a flower that comes back every year. It has many small petals that grow in a round shape. You can find it in gardens, parks, and flower shops. People like to plant it because it adds bright color in the fall. Some chrysanthemums are yellow, some are white, and some are pink or red.
Church\n\nA church is a special building where people go to pray and sing. It often has a tall pointy top called a steeple, and big windows with colored glass. Inside, there are long wooden seats called pews. On Sunday, many families dress up and go to church together. They listen to stories, sing songs, and sometimes light candles. A church is a quiet, peaceful place.
Church (building)\n\nA church is a building where people go to pray and sing together. It often has a tall pointy top called a steeple and big windows with colored glass. You can find a church in many towns and cities. People sit inside on long wooden seats and listen to stories from a big book. On Sundays, many families dress up and go to a church to be quiet and happy together.
Cicada\n\nA cicada is a small bug that lives in warm places. It has a wide body, two big eyes, and clear wings that fold over its back. You can hear it in the summer when the boy cicada makes a loud buzzing sound to call a girl cicada. It sits high up in trees and is hard to see, but the noise is very easy to hear. Some cicadas are green, and some are black. In some parts of the world, people even eat it as food.
Cichlid\n\nA cichlid is a kind of fish. It comes in many sizes, from as small as your finger to as long as your arm. It lives in lakes and rivers, mostly in warm places like Africa. It takes good care of its babies by keeping the eggs safe in its mouth or watching over them. Many people keep it in fish tanks at home because it has bright colors.
Cider\n\nCider is a drink made from apples. It can be sweet and bubbly or still and clear. In some places, it has a little bit of alcohol, like a grown-up drink. In other places, it is just thick apple juice with no alcohol. People often drink it warm with cinnamon when it is cold outside. You might see it at a fall party or a family dinner.
Cinderella\n\nCinderella is a story about a kind girl. She lives with her mean stepmother and two mean stepsisters. They make her do all the housework. One day, a prince has a big dancing party. A fairy godmother helps Cinderella go to the party in a magic pumpkin coach. She wears a pretty dress and glass slippers. She must come home by midnight. At the party, the prince dances with her. She runs away at midnight and loses one glass slipper. The prince finds the slipper and looks for the girl whose foot fits it. Cinderella tries it on, and it fits. The prince marries her, and they are happy.
Cinema\n\nA cinema is a big room where people go to watch movies. It has many soft chairs all facing a giant white wall called a screen. The room gets very dark, and a bright light from the back shows moving pictures on the screen. People buy a ticket to get in and often eat popcorn while they watch. You might go to a cinema with your family to see a new cartoon or a funny story.
Cinema of India\n\nCinema of India is the making of movies in India. It is a big way people tell stories with moving pictures and sound. You can watch these movies in a dark room with a big screen called a theater. Many people in India and other countries love to see them. The movies often have singing, dancing, and bright colors. Some stories are about families, and some are about brave heroes. A child might see a movie from India on TV at home.
Cinematography\n\nCinematography is the art of making moving pictures. It is like taking many photos very fast, one after another, so they look like they are moving. A special camera is used to catch the light and save the pictures. Later, the pictures are shown on a big screen or a TV. You see cinematography when you watch a cartoon or a movie with your family.
Cinnamon\n\nCinnamon is a brown spice that comes from the inside bark of a tree. It smells sweet and warm. People use it in food to make things taste yummy. You can find it in cookies, cakes, and sometimes in hot drinks like tea. It looks like a rolled-up stick or a soft brown powder. When you smell it, it might remind you of holiday treats.
Circadian rhythm\n\nA circadian rhythm is a clock inside your body. It tells you when to feel sleepy and when to wake up. It works in a circle that takes about one whole day. All animals and plants have this inside clock. It helps flowers open at the right time and helps birds know when to sing. For people, it makes you tired at night and awake in the morning. When you travel far away, your inside clock gets mixed up and you feel tired at the wrong time. That is called jet lag.
Circle\n\nA circle is a round, flat shape. It has no corners. Every part of the edge is the same distance from the middle point. You can see circles in many places, like a clock face, a coin, or a wheel. People use circles to draw and build things. A circle is a simple shape that is fun to trace with your finger.
Circuit\n\nA circuit is a loop that electricity can travel around. It is like a circle path. You find circuits inside toys, lights, and phones. It makes things turn on when the loop is closed. For example, a flashlight has a circuit that lights up the bulb when you push the switch.
Circuit breaker\n\nA circuit breaker is a safety switch for electricity. It lives inside a metal box on the wall, often in a basement or closet. When too many things are plugged in, it feels the extra power and clicks off. This stops wires from getting too hot and keeps the house safe. You can turn it back on by flipping the little switch. It works like a fuse, but you do not need to buy a new one each time.
Circulatory system\n\nThe circulatory system is the body's way of moving blood around. It has a heart and tubes called blood vessels. The heart is a strong pump that pushes blood through the tubes. Blood carries good things like air and food to all parts of the body. It also picks up waste and takes it away. You can feel your heart beat when you put your hand on your chest.
Circus\n\nA circus is a fun show with many acts. It travels from town to town and sets up a big tent. Inside, there is a round stage where people do tricks. You can see acrobats who jump and flip, and clowns who make you laugh. Some shows have jugglers who throw balls in the air. A long time ago, animals like horses and dogs were in the show, but today many circuses only have people. The whole show is led by a person called the ringmaster.
Citizenship\n\nCitizenship is a special tie between a person and a country. It means you belong to that country. Most people get it by being born there. Some people ask to join a new country and become a citizen later. When you are a citizen, the country keeps you safe. You can live there, go to school, and get help when you are sick. Some people have ties to two countries at the same time. That is called having two citizenships.
Citrus\n\nCitrus is a group of plants that give us juicy fruits. It grows as a small tree or a bush with green leaves. You can find it in warm, sunny places like gardens or farms. People pick the fruit to eat or to make juice. An orange is a citrus fruit you may see in your lunchbox.
City\n\nA city is a place where many people live close together. It has lots of buildings, streets, and homes like houses and apartments. You can find shops, parks, and schools in a city. People live in a city because it is easy to find work, food, and fun things to do. A city can be big or small. Some cities have tall buildings that touch the sky. Many people use cars, buses, or trains to move around inside it. A city you might know is New York, where there are many bright lights and busy streets.
City block\n\nA city block is a group of buildings that sit together. It is like a big square or rectangle made of houses and other buildings. Roads, paths, or a river go around the outside of it. Inside, the buildings stand side by side. In a busy city, the buildings touch each other. In a place with more grass and space, they might not touch. You can walk all the way around a city block on the sidewalk.
City-state\n\nA city-state is a city that is also its own country. It has its own rules and leaders, just like a big country. Long ago, there were many city-states in a place called Greece. Today, a city-state is very small and hard to find. One example is a city by the sea where people speak a different language and have their own flag. It makes its own money and takes care of its own people.
Civics\n\nCivics is learning about how people work together to run a town or a country. It teaches you about rules that help everyone get along, like sharing toys or taking turns. You can learn civics in school when you are bigger. It helps you know how to be a good helper in your neighborhood. For example, when you vote for a class pet, that is a little bit like civics.
Civil\n\nCivil means being nice and polite to other people. It is how we act when we share, take turns, and say kind words. You see it at school when friends play together without fighting. Being civil helps everyone feel safe and happy. When someone says "please" and "thank you," that is being civil.
Civil engineering\n\nCivil engineering is a job where people plan and build big things we use every day. It makes bridges, roads, tunnels, and tall buildings. It also brings clean water to our homes and takes dirty water away. You can see its work when you cross a bridge or walk on a sidewalk. People who do this job learn a lot about how to make things strong and safe.
Civil law\n\nCivil law is a set of rules that tell people how to act. It started a long, long time ago in a place called Rome. Today, many countries use it, like France and Germany. In civil law, the rules are written down in big books called codes. Judges read these books to decide what is fair. They do not look at old cases the same way some other judges do. This helps everyone know what the rules are.
Civil rights movements\n\nCivil rights movements are when many people come together to ask for fair rules. They want everyone to be treated the same, no matter what they look like or who they love. These movements happen in towns and cities all over the world. People walk together in big groups, hold signs, and sing songs to show they want change. Sometimes they sit in places where they are not allowed, just to show it is not fair. One famous example is when Rosa Parks kept her seat on a bus. Because of her and many others, buses later let everyone sit anywhere.
Civil union\n\nA civil union is a special promise between two grown-ups. It gives them many of the same rules as a married couple. In some places, it is for two men or two women who love each other. They can share a home and take care of each other, just like a husband and wife. The first country to have this was Denmark a long time ago. Now, in Denmark, two men or two women can get married instead.
Civilisation\n\nCivilisation is a big group of people who live together. It has towns, farms, and rules. People in a civilisation share a way of talking, writing, and making things. They build houses, roads, and big buildings like schools. Long ago, people started the first civilisations near rivers. Today, we all live in a civilisation with many helpers like teachers and doctors.
Civilization\n\nCivilization is a big group of people who live together in cities. It has rules, a way to grow food, and a way to talk to each other. People in a civilization build big houses, roads, and bridges. They write things down so they can remember them. A long time ago, the Romans had a civilization. They spoke Latin and built many stone buildings. Today, we live in a civilization too, with schools, stores, and parks.
Clam\n\nA clam is a small animal that lives in water. It has a soft body inside two hard shells that can open and close. You can find it at the beach buried in sand or mud. People sometimes eat clams, and you might see their empty shells on the shore. The shells are often round and can be white, brown, or gray.
Clamp\n\nA clamp is a tool that holds things very tight. It has two flat parts that push together and a handle you turn to make it squeeze. You can find it in a workshop where people build things from wood. It keeps two pieces of wood from moving while the glue dries. A doctor also uses a special kind of clamp to hold something still during an operation.
Clan\n\nA clan is a big family group. It is made of many people who share the same old family name. Long ago in Scotland, a clan lived together on the same land. They had a special cloth pattern called a tartan that showed which clan they belonged to. Today, some people still feel proud of their clan name.
Clang\n\nClang is a loud, sharp sound. It happens when two hard things hit each other, like metal on metal. You might hear it when a big bell rings or when a hammer hits a nail. It is a sound that makes you turn your head to look.
Clap\n\nA clap is a sound you make with your hands. You hit your two hands together, and it makes a short, loud noise. People clap to show they are happy or to say "good job." You can hear it at a show, a game, or a party. When you clap, your hands feel a little warm and tingly.
Clarinet\n\nA clarinet is a long, thin tube that makes music when you blow into it. It has a small flat piece called a reed on the mouthpiece that shakes to make sound. You hold it with two hands and press round buttons to change the notes. It is often black and shiny, with silver keys. Many kids learn to play it in school bands. You can hear it in songs with an orchestra, where it plays pretty tunes.
Class\n\nA class is a group of children who learn together. It has a teacher who helps them read, write, and count. You find a class in a school, in a room with desks and a big board. Every day, the children sit, listen, and do fun work like drawing or singing. Your own class is the room where you go each morning.
Classical\n\nClassical is a word for things that are very old and still loved today. It can be music with violins and pianos that sounds soft and pretty. It can be stories or books that people have read for a long, long time. You might hear classical music in a movie or at a big hall with many seats. Some people dance to classical music in a show called a ballet.
Classical Mechanics\n\nClassical Mechanics is a way to understand how things move. It tells us why a ball rolls down a hill and why a swing goes back and forth. You can see it when you push a toy car or throw a ball. It helps people build safe bridges and fast cars. Even when you jump, your body follows its rules.
Classical music\n\nClassical music is a kind of music that people have played for a very long time. It is made by people who write down the notes so others can play it. You can hear it played by a big group with violins, flutes, trumpets, and drums. It can sound happy, sad, or exciting. Sometimes it is used in movies or games to show a feeling. It is different from pop songs because it is not made just to be a hit for a short time.
Classmate\n\nA classmate is a friend you see at school. They sit near you in the same room. You learn letters, numbers, and songs together. They may share crayons or play with you at recess. You see them every day when school is open.
Classroom\n\nA classroom is a room inside a school where children learn. It has small desks and chairs, a big board on the wall, and bright lights. You find it in a school building, and you go there every day with your friends. A teacher stands at the front and helps you read, write, and draw. It is a place where you sing songs, listen to stories, and play with blocks.
Clause\n\nA clause is a small group of words inside a sentence. It has a who or what part and a what happens part. Some clauses can stand alone like a full sentence. Other clauses need a friend clause to make sense. When you say "I love you," that is one clause. When you say "I love you and I always will," that is two clauses joined by the word "and."
Claw\n\nA claw is a sharp, curved part at the end of an animal's toe. It is hard and pointy, like a tiny hook. You can find claws on cats, dogs, birds, and many other animals. An animal uses its claws to grab food, climb trees, or dig in the dirt. A cat uses its claws to catch a toy or scratch a post. Some claws can pull back inside, like a cat's, so they stay hidden when not needed.
Clay\n\nClay is a soft, sticky kind of dirt. It feels smooth and squishy when it is wet. You can find it in the ground near rivers or lakes. People use it to make pots, bowls, and bricks. When it is shaped and baked in a very hot oven, it gets hard and strong. You might have played with clay at school or made a little cup with it.
Clean\n\nClean means something is not dirty. It has no spots, no dust, and no sticky stuff on it. You can make things clean by washing them with soap and water. When your hands are clean, they look nice and smell good. A clean room has toys put away and no crumbs on the floor. People feel happy when things are clean.
Clear\n\nClear means you can see through something very well. It is the opposite of cloudy or fuzzy. A window is clear, so you can look outside. Water in a clean glass is clear, and you can see the bottom. When the sky has no clouds, it is clear and bright blue. If a sound is clear, you can hear every word without any noise.
Clearly\n\nClearly means you can see or hear something very well. When the sky is blue and there are no clouds, you can see the sun clearly. When someone talks in a loud, slow voice, you can hear the words clearly. It is the opposite of fuzzy or blurry. If you clean your glasses, you will see everything clearly again.
Cleveland\n\nCleveland is a big city in Ohio, a state in America. It sits next to a very large lake called Lake Erie. Many people live there, and it has tall buildings, parks, and a big theater where shows happen. It is known for a special museum about rock music, shaped like a glass pyramid by the water. People in Cleveland love sports—they have teams for baseball, football, and basketball. A long time ago, it was a busy place for making steel, but now it is famous for a big hospital that helps sick people get better.
Clever\n\nClever means you can think fast and solve hard things. It is like when you find a lost toy by looking under the bed. A clever person can fix a broken toy or build a tall block tower that does not fall. You can be clever when you learn new words or count your snacks. Being clever helps you do well in school and at home.
Click\n\nA click is a short, sharp sound. It is like a tiny snap or a quick tap. You can make it with your tongue or by pressing a button. A computer mouse makes a click when you push it. You might hear a click when you turn on a light or close a lid.
Cliff\n\nA cliff is a tall, steep wall of rock. It goes straight up and down, like a giant stone wall made by nature. You can find cliffs near the ocean, by rivers, or in big hills and mountains. Some cliffs are so tall that they touch the clouds. Water sometimes falls over the top of a cliff and makes a waterfall. Birds like to build nests on the high, safe parts of a cliff. People stand on top of a cliff to see far, far away. It is very strong and does not fall down easily.
Climate\n\nClimate is what the weather is like in a place over many, many years. It tells us if a place is usually hot or cold, wet or dry. Some places have a hot climate all year, like near the big blue sea. Other places have a cold climate with snow in winter. The climate can change if the Earth gets warmer over a long time.
Climate change\n\nClimate change is a big change in the weather over a long time. It means the Earth gets warmer or colder, and rain and wind can change too. Right now, the Earth is getting warmer because of things people do. Cars and factories put tiny bits of gas into the air that trap heat from the Sun. This makes the ice at the North and South Poles melt, and the sea water rises. It can also make storms stronger and hurt the homes of animals. We can help by using the Sun and wind to make power instead of burning black rocks from the ground.
Climatology\n\nClimatology is the study of weather over a long time. It looks at how hot or cold a place usually is, and how much rain or snow it gets. Scientists who do this work watch the sky and the air for many years. They help us know what the weather will be like next week or next month. Long ago, people in Greece started thinking about weather in this way.
Climb\n\nClimb means to go up something using your hands and feet. It can be a tree, a hill, or a ladder. When you climb, you move higher and higher. You might climb at a playground or on a big rock. It is a way to see far away from up high.
Clinic\n\nA clinic is a small place where people go when they feel sick. It has a room with a bed, a sink, and a chair. You can find it on a street near your house. A doctor or a nurse works there and helps you feel better. They might look in your ears, listen to your heart, or give you a bandage. Sometimes you go to a clinic for a quick check-up or a shot.
Clink\n\nClink is a short, light ringing sound. It happens when two hard things tap each other softly. You can hear it when two glasses touch at a party. It is also the sound of a small bell or a key hitting a metal ring. The sound is quick and happy.
Clip\n\nA clip is a small tool that holds things together. It is often made of metal or plastic. You can find clips in a school bag or on a desk. It holds papers so they do not fly away. Some clips look like a little mouth that opens and shuts.
Cloak\n\nA cloak is a big, loose coat without sleeves. It hangs from the neck or the shoulders and covers the body. It can be short or long, down to the feet. Some cloaks have a hood to cover the head. People wear it over other clothes to stay warm or dry when it is cold or rainy outside. In old stories, kings and queens often wear long cloaks.
Clock\n\nA clock is a tool that tells you the time. It has a face with numbers, and little sticks called hands that move around. You can find a clock on a wall at home or at school. It helps you know when to wake up, eat, or go to bed. Some clocks make a loud ring to wake you up in the morning.
Clone\n\nA clone is a living thing that is an exact copy of another living thing. It starts out looking just like the first one. You can find clones in nature, like when a mom has two babies at the same time who look the same. Scientists can also make clones in a lab. A famous example is a sheep named Dolly, who was a copy of another sheep.
Close\n\nClose means something is near or not far away. It can be a door that is shut, so you cannot walk through it. You might sit close to your friend on the rug during story time. When you hug someone, you hold them close. A store can be close to your house, so you can walk there quickly.
Closed\n\nClosed means something is not open. It is the opposite of open. A door that is shut is closed. A box with its lid on is closed. When a store is not open for business, we say it is closed. You might see a sign on the door that says "Closed."
Closely\n\nClosely means doing something with care and paying full attention. When you look closely, you bring your face near and use your eyes to see every little part. When you listen closely, you stay quiet and hear every sound. You can hold something closely by keeping it right next to you. A friend who sits closely shares a seat or a hug.
Closet\n\nA closet is a small room or a box in the wall where you keep clothes. It has a door you can open and close. Inside, there is a long stick to hang shirts and dresses. You can also put shoes and toys on the floor of it. At home, your closet is where you find your coat before you go outside.
Cloth\n\nCloth is a soft, flat thing made from threads. It can be many colors and have patterns like stripes or dots. You find it in your home on your bed, on the table, or on your body as clothes. People use it to make shirts, pants, dresses, and blankets to keep warm. Your favorite t-shirt is made of cloth.
Clothe\n\nA clothe is something you put on your body. It can be a shirt, pants, a dress, or a coat. You find it in a closet or a drawer at home. It keeps you warm when it is cold outside. It also covers your skin so you are not bare. A soft sweater is a clothe you might wear on a chilly day.
Clothes\n\nClothes are things we wear on our body. They can be soft, like a t-shirt, or thick, like a coat. You find them in a closet or a drawer at home. We put on clothes every day to stay warm and to look nice. A shirt, pants, socks, and a dress are all clothes.
Clothes dryer\n\nA clothes dryer is a big box that makes wet clothes dry. It has a round part inside that spins around and around. You find it at home, near the washing machine. After you wash clothes, you put them in the dryer. It blows warm air on the clothes until all the water is gone. Then you can take out the clothes and they feel warm and soft.
Clothing\n\nClothing is what people wear on their bodies. It covers the skin and keeps a person warm when it is cold. It also keeps the sun off when it is hot. A shirt covers the top part of the body, and pants cover the legs. Shoes go on the feet, and a hat goes on the head. People wear clothing every day at home, at school, and outside. It can be many colors and have fun pictures on it. Some clothing is soft like a cozy sweater, and some is light like a summer dress. People pick clothing they like to show who they are.
Cloud\n\nA cloud is a big fluffy thing in the sky. It is made of tiny drops of water or bits of ice. You see it up high above the ground. It can look white, gray, or even pink when the sun goes down. Sometimes it brings rain or snow. On a foggy day, a cloud is right on the ground.
Cloudy\n\nCloudy means the sky is full of clouds. It looks gray or white, and you cannot see the sun. When it is cloudy, the day feels darker and cooler. Sometimes it rains or snows from the clouds. You can see a cloudy sky when you look up outside.
Clove\n\nA clove is a tiny dried flower bud that people use in cooking. It looks like a small brown nail with a round top. It grows on a tall green tree in warm places far away. When you put it in food, it gives a strong, warm smell and taste. You might find it in a ham or in a pumpkin pie. It is a spice, like cinnamon or pepper.
Clown\n\nA clown is a person who makes people laugh. It wears big, funny clothes and shoes that are too large. It paints its face white and puts on a red nose. You can see a clown at a circus or a party. It does silly tricks like juggling balls or falling down in a funny way. Some clowns give out balloons shaped like animals. A clown wants everyone to smile and feel happy.
Club\n\nA club is a group of people who like the same thing. They meet at a special place, like a room or a park. They do fun things together, like reading books, playing games, or making art. You can join a club at school or in your town. It is a nice way to make new friends.
Club (weapon)\n\nA club is a heavy stick used to hit. It is usually made of wood and is short enough to hold in one hand. Some people like police officers carry a club to stay safe. A long time ago, people used clubs to fight or hunt. You might see a club in a cartoon when a cave person holds one.
Cluck\n\nA cluck is a short, soft sound that a chicken makes. It sounds like a quick click with the tongue. You can hear it on a farm or in a yard where chickens live. A mother hen uses it to talk to her baby chicks. Sometimes people make a cluck sound with their mouth to call a chicken.
Clue\n\nA clue is a small hint that helps you find an answer. It can be a word, a picture, or a thing you see. You find clues in games like hide-and-seek or in puzzles. Detectives use clues to solve mysteries. When you see cookie crumbs on the table, that is a clue that someone ate a cookie.
Coach\n\nA coach is a person who helps a team get better at a sport. He or she shows players how to run, throw, or kick. You can find a coach at a field, a gym, or a pool. A coach cheers for the team and teaches them to work together. For example, a soccer coach helps kids learn to kick the ball and score goals.
Coal\n\nCoal is a hard, black rock that comes from deep under the ground. It looks shiny and dark, and it can be broken into smaller pieces. People dig it out of big holes in the earth called mines. It is burned to make heat and power. Long ago, many trains and factories used coal to run. Today, some places still burn it to make lights turn on in houses. But burning coal makes dirty air that can make people sick.
Coast\n\nA coast is the place where the land meets the big, salty sea. It has sand, rocks, or tall cliffs. You can find it at the beach, where you play in the sand and splash in the waves. Many animals live there, like crabs, birds, and fish. Some coasts have soft sand, and some have hard rocks. People like to visit the coast to swim, build sandcastles, and look for shells.
Coat\n\nA coat is a piece of clothing you wear over your shirt. It has long sleeves and opens at the front. You put it on when it is cold or rainy outside. It keeps you warm and dry. Some coats have a hood to cover your head. You might wear a coat to school on a chilly day.
Cockatoo\n\nA cockatoo is a kind of bird with a big curved beak and a fluffy top on its head. It has soft feathers that are mostly white, gray, or black. Some cockatoos have a little pink or yellow on their head or tail. It lives in warm places like Australia and some islands. It uses its strong beak to crack open seeds and nuts to eat. It can also climb trees using its beak and feet. You might see a cockatoo in a zoo or a pet store. Some people keep it as a pet at home.
Cockroach\n\nA cockroach is a small bug with six legs and a flat body. It has two long feelers on its head and a hard, shiny shell. It likes to hide in dark, warm places like under the sink or behind the fridge. It can eat almost anything, like crumbs or old food. It is very fast and hard to catch. Some people see it in the kitchen at night when they turn on the light.
Cocoa\n\nCocoa is a brown powder made from beans that grow on a tree. It tastes a little bitter by itself. People mix it with sugar and milk to make hot chocolate, a warm sweet drink. It is also used to make chocolate bars and chocolate cake. You can find cocoa in the baking part of a grocery store.
Coconut palm\n\nA coconut palm is a tall tree that grows in warm places near the sea. It has a long brown trunk and big green leaves at the top. The tree makes a big round fruit called a coconut. The coconut has a hard brown shell and white soft food inside. People open it to drink the sweet water and eat the white part. They also use the white part to make coconut milk for cooking. The oil from the coconut can go in food, soap, and hair. Sometimes the hard shell is used to make pretty things. The coconut can float on the ocean and travel far to grow on a new island.
Cod\n\nCod is a big fish that lives in the cold ocean. It has a long body, smooth scales, and a little beard under its chin. People catch it with boats and nets far out at sea. It is good to eat because the meat is soft and not too strong. Many people like it fried with chips. A long time ago, people also used part of it to make a special oil. A grown cod can be as long as a grown-up is tall.
Coelacanth\n\nA coelacanth is a very old kind of fish. It has big, thick scales and fins that look a little like legs. It lives deep in the ocean, far down where the water is cold and dark. People thought it was gone forever, but one day a scientist found a live one. It is not good to eat, so fishermen do not try to catch it. It is a rare fish that helps us learn about animals from long ago.
Coffee\n\nCoffee is a dark, warm drink that many grown-ups enjoy. It comes from small beans that grow on a bush. The beans are picked, dried, and cooked until they turn brown. Then they are crushed into tiny bits. Hot water is poured over the bits to make the drink. It has a strong smell and a bitter taste. Some people add milk or sugar to make it sweeter. You might see a cup of coffee in the morning at home or in a café.
Cognition\n\nCognition is how your brain thinks and learns. It helps you remember your friend's name, see colors, and solve puzzles. You use it when you listen to a story or figure out how to stack blocks. It grows as you get older and learn new things every day.
Coil\n\nA coil is a long, thin thing that is wound around and around. It looks like a spring or a curly line. You can find a coil inside a toy that bounces, or in a pen that clicks. It can stretch and then go back to its shape. A coil is also used in a stove to make heat for cooking.
Coin\n\nA coin is a small, flat, round piece of metal used as money. It is hard and shiny, and it often has a picture of a person or a building on it. You can find coins in a piggy bank, in a pocket, or on a store counter. People use coins to buy small things like candy or a toy. When you flip a coin in the air, it can land on one side or the other. Some people save old coins because they are special and fun to look at.
Coke\n\nCoke is a dark, bubbly drink that many people like. It comes in a red can or a glass bottle. You can find it in stores, at parties, or with a meal. It tastes sweet and makes a fizzy sound when you open it. Some people drink it with ice on a hot day.
Cold\n\nCold is a feeling when something is not warm. It can be the air outside on a winter day. When you touch ice or snow, your fingers feel cold. You might see your breath when the air is cold. People wear a coat, hat, and gloves to stay warm. Cold can also be a sickness that makes you cough and sneeze.
Cold War\n\nThe Cold War was a long time when two big countries did not get along. It was not a war with guns and bombs. The two countries were the United States and the Soviet Union. They did not trust each other and tried to be stronger. It lasted for many years after the big world war. People were scared because both sides had very big bombs. It ended when the Soviet Union broke apart.
Collage\n\nA collage is a kind of picture made by sticking things together. It uses bits of paper, cloth, or other flat things. You can make it on a big piece of paper or a board. People cut and glue shapes to make a new picture. You might see a collage at school or in an art book. Some artists use old photos or shiny wrappers in their collage.
Collect\n\nCollect means to pick up things and keep them together. It is something you do when you find things you like. You might collect shiny rocks, colorful leaves, or toy cars. You can put them in a box or a jar so they stay safe. Some people collect stamps or stickers. When you collect, you have many of the same kind of thing, and it is fun to look at them all.
Collection\n\nA collection is a group of things that someone keeps together. It can be toys, rocks, stickers, or anything you like. You might keep it in a box, on a shelf, or in a special book. People make collections because they enjoy finding new things to add. For example, you might have a collection of colorful marbles or pretty seashells from the beach.
College\n\nA college is a big school for grown-ups. It has many buildings with classrooms, a library, and a place to eat. You go there after you finish high school. At college, people learn about one special thing they like, such as numbers, stories, or how to help sick people. They read books, write on paper, and listen to a teacher. When they finish all their work, they get a paper that says they did a good job. Some people live together in a big house at college. You can see a college in a town or a city, with a sign and a big gate.
Cologne\n\nCologne is a big city in Germany. It sits next to a wide river called the Rhine. Many people live there, and it has a very tall, old church with two pointy tops. You can see the church from far away. People visit the church to look at a shiny gold box inside. The city also has a big school where grown-ups go to learn. A long time ago, people made a sweet-smelling water there that people still use today.
Colombia\n\nColombia is a warm country in South America. It has tall mountains, big rivers, and a long coast next to the sea. Many people live in cities like Bogotá, the biggest city. It grows lots of fruits and has many colorful birds. People there speak Spanish. It is named after a man called Columbus.
Colombo\n\nColombo is a big city in a country called Sri Lanka. It sits next to the sea on the west side of the island. Many people live there, and it is a busy place where ships bring things from far away. Long ago, people called it a name that meant "harbor with leafy mango trees." Today, you can see tall buildings, busy streets, and a big blue ocean. It is the most important city for buying and selling things in the country.
Colonization\n\nColonization is when people from one country go to a new place and take over. They build houses and make rules for the land. A long time ago, people from Europe sailed across the big ocean and started living in the Americas. They met Native Americans who already lived there. The new people stayed and changed many things. Sometimes, stories about space show people trying to live on other planets. That is also a kind of colonization.
Color\n\nColor is what you see when light bounces off things. It makes a red apple look red and the sky look blue. There are three main colors: red, yellow, and blue. You can mix them to make new colors, like green or orange. Some people cannot see all colors, and that is called color-blind. Food can have color too, like the orange in a carrot. When something has no color at all, you can see right through it, like a clean window.
Color blindness\n\nColor blindness is when a person cannot tell some colors apart. It is a way of seeing that is different from most people. Many people with it mix up red and green. Some mix up blue and yellow. A few see only black, white, and gray. It is not a sickness you can catch. It often runs in families. More boys have it than girls. A special test with colored dots can show if someone has it. People with it can still see shapes and things clearly. They just see colors in their own way.
Colorado River\n\nThe Colorado River is a very long stream of water. It flows through dry lands in the western part of the United States and a little bit of Mexico. It starts high up in big, rocky mountains where snow melts. People built tall walls called dams to hold back the water. They use the water to help plants grow on farms. The river is so used up that it often does not reach the big ocean anymore. It is an important river for many people and animals.
Colorful\n\nColorful means something has many bright colors. It looks like a rainbow with red, blue, yellow, and green all together. You can find colorful things in a box of crayons or in a garden full of flowers. A colorful picture makes people feel happy when they look at it. A clown's outfit is often colorful with lots of different patches.
Colosseum\n\nThe Colosseum is a very big, round stone building in Rome, Italy. It has tall walls with many arches and rows of seats inside. Long ago, people went there to watch fights and shows. It is now old and broken in some parts, but many people visit it to see how big and old it is.
Colour\n\nColour is what you see when light bounces off things. It can be red, blue, yellow, green, and many more. You find colour everywhere — on your toys, in your clothes, and in the sky. It makes the world look bright and pretty. When you draw with crayons, you pick a colour for each part of your picture.
Colour theory\n\nColour theory is a set of ideas about how colours mix and look together. It uses a colour wheel, which is a circle that shows colours in a special order. You can find colour theory in art class when you paint or draw. It helps you know which colours look nice next to each other. For example, red and yellow make orange when you mix them. Blue and yellow make green. People use colour theory to pick colours for clothes, toys, and pictures.
Colour vision\n\nColour vision is how your eyes and brain work together to see colours. It lets you tell the difference between red, blue, yellow, and green. Inside your eye, there are tiny parts called cones that catch light. You have three kinds of cones, and each kind likes a different part of the rainbow. When light bounces off a thing, your cones send a message to your brain, and your brain paints the colour you see. You use it every day to pick a ripe banana, find your red coat, or see a green frog on a leaf.
Column\n\nA column is a tall, strong stick that holds up a building. It stands straight up and down. You can see it in front of big old buildings, like a museum or a church. It carries the heavy roof so the walls do not fall down. Some columns are made of one big stone, and some are made of many stones stacked up. A long time ago, people in Egypt used stone columns to build huge temples.
Comb\n\nA comb is a flat tool with a row of thin teeth. It is used to make hair neat and smooth. You can find it in a bathroom or a bag. People pull it through their hair to take out tangles. Some combs are made of plastic, and some are made of wood.
Combine harvester\n\nA combine harvester is a big farm machine. It cuts down plants like wheat or corn. It also takes the seeds off the plant and cleans them. It does three jobs all at the same time. You can see it in big fields when the plants turn golden. It helps farmers get food ready for us to eat.
Combustion\n\nCombustion is when something burns. It happens when a thing like wood or gas meets the air and gets very hot. You can see it as a bright, hot flame. Cars and rockets use it to move. A car burns gas inside its engine to turn the wheels. A rocket burns special fuel that shoots out the back and pushes it up. When things burn, they make heat and light. They also make smoke and gases. Some gases are not good for the air we breathe. A campfire is one kind of combustion you might have seen.
Come\n\nCome means to move closer to a person or a place. When you say "come here," you ask someone to walk toward you. A dog runs to you when you call its name and say "come." At school, the teacher may say "come sit on the rug" so all the children gather together. It is the opposite of "go," which means to move away.
Comedy\n\nComedy is a kind of show or story that makes people laugh. It can be a play, a movie, or a TV show. In a comedy, people do silly things like trip and fall, or they say funny words. You might see a comedy on a screen at home or in a big dark room with lots of seats. One example is a cartoon where a cat chases a mouse and bumps into a wall. That is comedy because it is funny and not scary.
Comet\n\nA comet is a big ball of ice and dust that flies through space. It looks like a bright star with a long, glowing tail. You can see it in the night sky, far away from Earth. The Sun melts the ice, and that makes the tail shine. Some comets come back again and again, like a friend you see every few years. A long time ago, people were scared of comets, but now we know they are just icy space rocks.
Comfortable\n\nComfortable means something feels nice and easy on your body. A soft pillow or a warm blanket can feel comfortable. When you sit in a cozy chair, you feel relaxed and happy. It is the opposite of something that feels hard, scratchy, or too tight. You might say your bed is comfortable when you are sleepy and ready to rest.
Comic\n\nA comic is a story told with pictures and words. It has many small boxes on a page, and each box shows a part of the story. You can find it in a book or a newspaper. People read it for fun, and it often makes them laugh. Some comics have a hero who helps others, like a dog that saves the day.
Comic book\n\nA comic book is a book that tells a story with lots of pictures. It has small boxes on each page, and inside the boxes are drawings of people and places. The words are in little bubbles above the people’s heads. You can find comic books in a store or a library. Many comic books are about heroes who wear capes and help people. Some heroes can fly, and some are very strong. In Japan, people call these books manga, and they read them from the back to the front. A child might see a comic book about a hero like Spider-Man or a funny animal like a cat.
Comics\n\nComics are stories told with pictures. They use little boxes called panels that you read one after the other. You can find them in newspapers, in thin books called comic books, or in big books called graphic novels. When a person talks, you see their words inside a round bubble. A thinking bubble looks like a cloud. Many comics are funny, but some are serious too. You might see a comic about a superhero or a silly cat in the Sunday paper.
Commerce\n\nCommerce is buying and selling things. It happens when you give money and get a toy, a snack, or a haircut. A store is a place for commerce. A big truck that carries food from one town to another is part of commerce. When you help at a lemonade stand, you are doing a small kind of commerce.
Common\n\nCommon means something you see a lot. It is not rare or hard to find. A red apple is common at the store. A yellow school bus is common on the street. Rain is common in spring. Many things around you are common, like pencils and shoes.
Common cold\n\nThe common cold is a sickness that makes your nose and throat feel bad. It is caused by tiny germs called viruses. You might get a runny nose, a cough, or a sore throat. Sometimes you feel hot and tired. It spreads when you touch things with germs on them or when someone sneezes near you. Washing your hands with soap and water helps keep it away. There is no medicine to make it go away fast, but resting and drinking warm drinks can help you feel better. Most people get it a few times every year.
Common sense\n\nCommon sense is knowing what to do without being told. It is the little voice in your head that says, "Don't touch the hot stove." You use it when you look both ways before crossing the street. It helps you stay safe and make good choices. Everyone has it, but sometimes people forget to use it.
Common wheat\n\nCommon wheat is a plant that gives us flour for bread. It grows in big fields with long green stems and a top full of small grains. Farmers plant it in many places around the world where the weather is not too hot and not too cold. People pick the grains and grind them into soft white powder. That powder is used to make bread, cakes, and cookies. You have probably eaten bread made from it at breakfast or lunch.
Communication\n\nCommunication is how we share thoughts and feelings with others. It can be words we say out loud, like "hello" or "I am happy." It can also be a smile, a wave, or a hug. People use it every day at home, at school, and on the playground. Animals talk to each other too, like a dog wagging its tail or a bird singing. When you tell a friend about your favorite toy, that is communication.
Communications satellite\n\nA communications satellite is a machine that flies high above the Earth in space. It has big flat panels that catch sunlight for power and round dishes that send and receive signals. It stays far up in the sky so it can talk to many places at once. It helps send TV shows, phone calls, and internet to homes, cars, and even boats on the ocean. When you watch a cartoon on TV or a video on a tablet, a satellite might be helping the pictures and sounds travel to you.
Communism\n\nCommunism is a big idea about how people can share things. It says that everyone should work together and own things as a group, not just one person. In this idea, there are no very rich people and no very poor people. Everyone gets what they need, like food and a place to live. Some countries have tried to use this idea, but it is very hard to do. Many people talk about it in books and in school.
Community\n\nA community is a group of living things that share the same home. It can be people, animals, or plants that live close together. In a human community, people often like the same things and help each other. They may have the same rules and ways of talking. Each person in it is still special in their own way. A community can be a small town, a school, or even a group of friends who play together.
Commutative property\n\nThe commutative property is a math rule about adding and multiplying. It says you can swap the numbers and still get the same answer. For adding, 2 plus 3 is the same as 3 plus 2. For multiplying, 4 times 5 is the same as 5 times 4. It does not work for taking away or sharing. You can see it when you count toys or snacks.
Comoros\n\nComoros is a small country made of islands. It sits in the big, warm Indian Ocean near Africa. The islands have tall hills and a big mountain that can sometimes let out hot, red rock. Many people there grow sweet-smelling flowers and vanilla plants. They also fish in the blue sea. The weather is hot and wet for part of the year, then cool and dry. Most people follow a religion called Islam and speak their own island words.
Company\n\nA company is a group of people who work together. It is like a team that makes or sells things. You can see a company in a store, a bakery, or a toy shop. People in a company help each other to make food, fix cars, or build houses. When you buy a cookie at a shop, that shop is a company.
Compare\n\nCompare means looking at two things to see how they are the same and how they are different. You can compare a big red ball and a small blue ball. The big ball is bigger, and the small ball is smaller. Both are round and can bounce. When you compare, you use your eyes to see colors, shapes, and sizes. You can also compare how things feel, like soft or hard. It helps you learn about the world.
Compass\n\nA compass is a small tool that shows you which way to go. It has a round face and a little arrow that can spin. The arrow always points north, no matter where you stand. People use it when they walk in the woods or sail on a boat so they do not get lost. You might see one in a car or on a phone.
Competition\n\nA competition is a fun event where people try to see who is the best at something. It can be a game, a race, or a show. The people who join are called players. They all try very hard to win. The winner may get a prize, like a shiny cup or a ribbon. You can find a competition at school, like a running race or a drawing contest. Sometimes a grown-up watches to make sure everyone plays fair.
Competition (economics)\n\nCompetition is when two or more people or groups try to get the same thing. It happens in stores when different sellers try to sell you the same kind of toy or snack. Each seller wants you to pick their thing, so they try to make it better or cheaper. This can make things nicer for everyone. Sometimes, one big seller is the only one, and then there is no competition.
