Complete\n\nComplete means something is all done. When you finish a puzzle and every piece is in its place, the puzzle is complete. It can also mean you have all the parts of a set, like a full box of crayons with no colors missing. When you clean your room and put every toy away, your room is complete.
Complex\n\nComplex is a big word that means something has many parts. It is not simple, like a plain circle. A puzzle with many pieces is complex. A toy with many buttons and lights is complex. When you build a tall tower with blocks, it can be complex. It takes time to understand or finish.
Complex Number\n\nA complex number is a special kind of number. It has two parts: a real part and an imaginary part. You can think of it like a pair of numbers that work together. People use it in math to solve hard problems. It helps with things like building bridges and making computers work.
Composer\n\nA composer is a person who makes music. He writes down the notes so other people can play the music. You can find his music in songs, movies, and shows. He uses his mind to think of new tunes that sound pretty or fun. When you hear a happy song on the radio, a composer made it.
Compound\n\nA compound is when two or more things join together to make one new thing. It can be a word made from two smaller words, like "cupcake" from "cup" and "cake." In science, it is a new stuff made when different tiny parts stick together, like water from two kinds of air. You see compounds every day, like salt on your food or the sugar in your juice.
Computer\n\nA computer is a smart machine that helps people with many things. It has a screen that shows pictures and words. It also has a keyboard with buttons you can press. You can find computers at home, at school, and in stores. People use it to play games, watch videos, and learn new things. A tablet and a laptop are small computers you can carry around.
Computer data storage\n\nComputer data storage is a place inside a computer where it keeps things. It is like a big box that holds words, pictures, and games. You cannot see it from the outside, but it is inside the computer. When you save a drawing or a game, it puts it in that box. Later, you can open the drawing or play the game again because it remembers. Some computers have a small fast box and a big slow box. The small fast box helps the computer work quickly. The big slow box can hold many more things.
Computer file\n\nA computer file is a place on a computer where you keep things. It can hold words, pictures, songs, or games. You can open it with a program to see what is inside. It lives inside the computer, like a box on a shelf. You can give it a name so you can find it again later.
Computer graphics\n\nComputer graphics are pictures made with a computer. They can be flat like a drawing, or they can look round and deep like real life. People use them to make cartoons, movies, and games. You see them on TV, on a tablet, or when you play a game on a phone. Some computer graphics are made of tiny dots called pixels. Others are made of smooth lines and shapes. Artists use special tools on the computer to paint and draw, just like you use crayons on paper.
Computer hardware\n\nComputer hardware is the parts of a computer you can touch. It has a screen that shows pictures and words. It has a keyboard with buttons for typing. You find it on a desk at home or school. People use it to play games, draw, and learn new things. A tablet is one kind of computer hardware.
Computer monitor\n\nA computer monitor is a screen that shows pictures and words from a computer. It looks like a small TV. You put it on a desk so you can see it while you work or play. It shows games, videos, and pages you can read. Some monitors are flat and thin, and some are a little thicker. You can touch some monitors to make things move on the screen.
Computer mouse\n\nA computer mouse is a small tool that helps you use a computer. It has two buttons and a little wheel in the middle. You put it on a flat desk and move it with your hand. When you move it, a tiny arrow on the screen moves the same way. You press a button to pick things on the screen. The wheel helps you move pages up and down. Some mice have no wire and talk to the computer through the air.
Computer network\n\nA computer network is a group of computers that are tied together. It lets the computers talk to each other and share things like pictures or games. You can find it at home, at school, or at a store. It helps people send messages, print pages, or look at fun web pages. The biggest one is the Internet, which you use to watch videos or play online games.
Computer program\n\nA computer program is a set of steps that tells a computer what to do. It is like a recipe for the computer. You cannot see it or touch it, but it lives inside the computer. When you click a button or tap a screen, it makes the computer follow the steps. For example, a game on a tablet is a computer program. It shows pictures and makes sounds when you play.
Computer programming\n\nComputer programming is telling a computer what to do. It is like giving a list of steps to a friend. You write the steps in a special language the computer can learn. The computer follows the steps one by one. It can do math, show pictures, or play a game. When you tap a button on a tablet, a program makes it light up. Sometimes the steps have a mistake, called a bug. Then you fix the bug so the computer does the right thing.
Computer science\n\nComputer science is the study of how we use computers to solve problems. It is about giving a computer a list of steps to follow, like a recipe. People who do this are called computer scientists. They think of new ways to make computers faster and smarter. You see computer science when you play a game on a tablet or when a phone sorts your photos. It helps us find answers and do things more easily.
Computer security\n\nComputer security is keeping computers safe from people who should not use them. It is like a lock on a door, but for a computer. It stops bad people from looking at your pictures or taking your games. A computer can have a secret word, called a password, that only you and your family know. When you type the password, it lets you in. It also helps keep the computer healthy so it does not get sick from bad programs.
Concept\n\nA concept is an idea in your head. It helps you think about things that are alike. For example, you have a concept of a dog. It is all the things you know about dogs: they have fur, four legs, and a tail. The word "dog" is the name for that idea. Different words can mean the same idea. In another language, people say "perro" for the same furry friend. A concept is like a picture in your mind that helps you understand the world.
Conceptual art\n\nConceptual art is a kind of art where the idea is more important than how it looks. It can be a set of words that tell someone how to make the art. Anyone can follow the words and make it. Sometimes it is just words on a wall. It makes people think about what art really is.
Concert\n\nA concert is a show where people play music for others to listen. It happens on a big, raised floor called a stage. You can find it in a big room, a park, or a field. The people who play music sing songs or use tools like drums and guitars. Sometimes there are bright lights and fun smoke. You might see a concert at a fair or on TV.
Concerto\n\nA concerto is a piece of music for one main player and a big group of players. The big group is called an orchestra. The main player plays an instrument like a piano or a violin. It stands in front of the orchestra and plays the most important part. The orchestra plays along softly so the main player can be heard. You might hear a concerto at a big music hall. The music can be fast and happy or slow and calm. Sometimes the main player plays alone for a little while to show how good they are.
Concrete\n\nConcrete is a hard, strong material used to build things. It looks like gray stone. You can find it in sidewalks, roads, and big buildings. People mix it with water and small rocks, then pour it into a shape. After it dries, it becomes very hard. A sidewalk is a good example of concrete.
Concussion\n\nA concussion is a boo-boo inside your head. It happens when you bump your head very hard, like falling off a bike or hitting your head in a game. It can make you feel dizzy, have a headache, or feel very tired. Sometimes you might see things blurry or feel mixed up. A doctor checks you to make sure you are okay. Rest helps it get better. Wearing a helmet when you ride a bike helps keep your head safe.
Condensation\n\nCondensation is when a gas turns into a liquid. It happens when the gas touches something cold. You can see it on a cold glass of water on a hot day. Tiny water drops form on the outside of the glass. That is condensation. It is part of how water moves around the Earth.
Condiment\n\nA condiment is a food you add to other food to make it taste better. It can be a sauce, like ketchup, or a powder, like salt. You find it on the table at home or in a restaurant. People put it on hot dogs, burgers, or fries. Ketchup is a red sauce made from tomatoes. Mustard is a yellow sauce that tastes a little sharp. Salt is tiny white grains that make food less plain.
Condor\n\nA condor is a very big bird that flies high in the sky. It has wide, dark wings and a bald head. It lives in mountains and open lands. It looks for dead animals to eat, which helps keep the land clean. Some people see it in zoos or in nature shows. It can glide for a long time without flapping its wings.
Cone\n\nA cone is a shape that is round at the bottom and pointy at the top. It looks like a party hat or an ice cream cone. You can find cones in many places, like on the road where orange cones tell cars where to go. An ice cream cone holds a yummy scoop of ice cream. A pine cone falls from a pine tree and has hard, woody parts.
Conformity\n\nConformity is when a person changes what they do to be like the people around them. It happens because a person wants to fit in or be liked by a group. A child might copy what their friends do, even if they do not really want to. Sometimes a person follows others because they think the group knows best. This can happen at school, at home, or when playing with friends. For example, a child might laugh at a joke they do not understand just because everyone else is laughing.
Confucianism\n\nConfucianism is a set of ideas about how to be a good person. It comes from a wise man named Confucius who lived in China a long, long time ago. It teaches people to be kind to their mom and dad, to listen to older people, and to treat others with care. It also says that learning never stops, so you can always learn something new. Many people in China follow these ideas to live together in peace.
Confucius\n\nConfucius was a teacher who lived a long, long time ago. He was a man from a place called China. He thought a lot about how people should be kind to each other. He said that we should treat others the way we want to be treated. He also said that learning is very important. Many people still read his words today.
Congo\n\nCongo is a big country in Africa. It has many tall trees and a wide river. Many animals like elephants and monkeys live there. People in Congo speak French and other local languages. It is very warm there all year.
Congo River\n\nThe Congo River is a very long, wide river in Africa. It is the second longest river in Africa, after the Nile. It flows through a big, hot forest with many trees and animals. People use it to move things like food and goods on boats. Some parts of it have big waterfalls where boats cannot go, so trains carry things around those spots. It also makes power from moving water to light up homes.
Congolian rainforests\n\nCongolian rainforests are big, wet forests in the middle of Africa. They have tall trees that make a green roof high up. A long river called the Congo River runs through them. Many animals live there, like chimpanzees, gorillas, elephants, and hippos. It is the second biggest rainforest in the world. People go there to see the thick trees and the wild animals.
Conifer\n\nA conifer is a kind of plant that stays green all year. It has thin, pointy leaves that look like needles. You can find it in forests and parks, even in cold places. People use its wood to build houses and make paper. A pine tree is a conifer you might see at Christmas time.
Connect\n\nConnect means to join two things together. You can connect dots with a line to make a picture. You can connect train cars to make a long train. When you hold hands with a friend, you connect with them. A plug connects a lamp to the wall so it can light up.
Connector\n\nA connector is a small thing that joins two wires together. It is often made of hard plastic and has metal parts inside. You can find it on the end of a phone charger or a computer cord. It lets power or signals move from one wire to another. When you plug a cord into the wall, you are using a connector.
Conscience\n\nConscience is a quiet voice inside you. It tells you if something is good or bad. When you do something kind, it makes you feel warm and happy. When you do something mean, it makes your heart feel heavy and sad. It helps you know the right thing to do. Everyone has it, even when no one is watching.
Consciousness\n\nConsciousness is being awake and knowing what is happening around you. It is like a light inside your head that turns on when you wake up. When you are asleep, the light is off. It helps you feel happy, sad, or scared. You use it to think about things, like what toy to play with. It is also how you know that you are you.
Conservation of energy\n\nConservation of energy means energy cannot be made from nothing, and it cannot go away into nothing. It can only change from one kind to another. For example, when you rub your hands together fast, the moving energy turns into warm heat energy. The total amount of energy always stays the same. You can see it when a swing goes back and forth: it goes up high, then down fast, then up again. The energy just changes shape, but it never gets lost.
Conservatism\n\nConservatism is a way of thinking about how people should live together. It says old ways and old rules are good and should be kept. People who think this way like things that have been around for a long time, like family, church, and helping each other in small groups. They often want to keep things the same or go back to how things were before. In different places, it can mean different things. For example, in America, many people who think this way want less big government and more freedom for shops and farms.
Consonant\n\nA consonant is a letter that makes a sound when your mouth partly closes. It is not like a vowel, which you can sing out long. You can find consonants in every word you say. They work with vowels to make little parts called syllables. For example, the word "cat" has two consonants, "c" and "t", and one vowel, "a". When you say "b" or "p", your lips come together and then pop open. That is a consonant sound.
Constellation\n\nA constellation is a group of stars that make a picture in the night sky. It looks like a shape, such as an animal or a person. You can see it when the sky is dark and clear, far away from bright city lights. Long ago, people used it to tell stories and find their way at night. One you might know is the Big Dipper, which looks like a big spoon.
Constitution\n\nA constitution is a set of rules for a country. It tells how the leaders are picked and what they can do. It also says what people in the country are allowed to do, like speak freely or vote. Some countries write all the rules in one big book. Other countries have rules spread out in many old papers and court choices. The rules help keep things fair so no one person gets too much power.
Construction\n\nConstruction is the work of building things like houses, schools, and bridges. It uses big tools and strong materials. Workers put together bricks, wood, steel, and glass to make walls and roofs. You can see construction sites in your town where new buildings go up. Big machines like diggers and cranes help lift heavy things. Long ago, people built small huts with their hands. Today, we have tall buildings made of many parts.
Consumer electronics\n\nConsumer electronics are things that use power and help people at home. It can be a phone, a TV, a radio, or a game player. You find it in almost every house. People use it to talk, watch shows, listen to music, or play games. A tablet is one kind of consumer electronics that many kids use.
Container\n\nA container is something that holds other things inside it. It can be big or small, and it has walls and a bottom. You can find containers in the kitchen, like a box for cookies or a jar for jam. People use containers to keep things safe, clean, and easy to carry. A lunchbox is a container that holds your food when you go to school.
Contemporary\n\nContemporary means something that is happening right now or made in our time. It is a word people use to talk about new art, new music, or new ways of doing things. When you see a new toy in a store, that toy is contemporary. A song you hear on the radio today is contemporary music. A house with big windows and simple shapes can be a contemporary house. It is the opposite of old or from long ago.
Contemporary art\n\nContemporary art is art made by artists who are alive today. It can be a painting, a big shape, or something you can walk around. You find it in art museums and sometimes outside in parks. It often uses bright colors, funny shapes, or things from everyday life. For example, a giant balloon dog made of shiny metal is contemporary art.
Contemporary History\n\nContemporary history is the story of things that happened not very long ago. It talks about times that your parents and grandparents remember. You can find it in books, on TV, or in stories that grown-ups tell. It helps us know why the world looks the way it does today. For example, it tells about the first time people used computers at home.
Continent\n\nA continent is a very big piece of land. It is so big that many countries can fit on it. There are seven continents on Earth. You can find them on a map or a globe. People live on all the continents except one. The one with no people is Antarctica, and it is covered in ice. The continent where you live has your house, your school, and your friends.
Continental shelf\n\nA continental shelf is the part of the land that goes under the sea near the shore. It is like a big, flat step under the water. The water there is not very deep, so sunlight can reach the bottom. Many fish, plants, and tiny sea animals live there because it is warm and bright. People can find it next to every big piece of land, like the edge of a swimming pool. It is a very busy place full of life.
Continue\n\nContinue means to keep going and not stop. When you walk and do not sit down, you continue walking. If you are drawing a picture and you add more colors, you continue drawing. It is like when a song plays from start to end without pausing. You can continue a game by taking another turn.
Contract\n\nA contract is a special promise that grown-ups make. It is a promise that the law can help keep. Sometimes it is written on paper and signed with a pen. People use it for big things, like a new job or buying a house. If someone does not keep the promise, a judge can help fix it.
Control\n\nControl means you are the boss of something. It is when you make a thing do what you want. You use your hands to control a toy car with a remote. You use your voice to control a dog when you say "sit." A grown-up uses a wheel to control a car on the road. When you wait your turn in a game, you control your body and feelings.
Control of fire by early humans\n\nControl of fire by early humans is when people long ago learned to make and keep fire. It gave them light in the dark and kept them warm when it was cold. Fire also scared away big animals and bugs that bite. With fire, they could cook food like meat and hard roots, which made the food soft and safe to eat. Cooking helped their bodies get more good stuff from the food. This may have helped their brains grow bigger over time. You can see fire today when you light a candle or watch a campfire.
Convection\n\nConvection is how heat moves through water or air. When a part of water or air gets warm, it becomes lighter and moves up. The cooler part is heavier, so it sinks down. This makes a loop of moving water or air. You can see it when you heat soup in a pot. The hot soup at the bottom rises, and the cooler soup on top sinks. This loop is called a convection current. It helps move heat all around.
Conversation\n\nA conversation is when two or more people talk to each other. It is like a game of catch with words. You say something, and the other person says something back. You can have a conversation at home, at school, or on the playground. It helps you share ideas, tell stories, and learn new things. When you tell your friend about your favorite toy and they tell you about theirs, that is a conversation.
Cook\n\nA cook is a person who makes food. He works in a kitchen at a restaurant, a school, or at home. He uses pots, pans, and a stove to heat food. He mixes things like eggs, flour, and milk to make yummy meals. You might see a cook when you go out to eat with your family.
Cook Islands\n\nThe Cook Islands is a group of small islands in the big blue ocean. It has 15 islands, and the biggest one is called Rarotonga. Many people live there, and they like to welcome visitors who come to see the warm sand and clear water. The people speak their own special language, and they also know English. It is a faraway place where the sun shines a lot, and you can see palm trees and hear the waves.
Cook Strait\n\nCook Strait is a big stretch of water. It sits between the two main parts of New Zealand. On one side is the North Island, and on the other side is the South Island. It joins two bigger seas together. The water in it can move fast and get rough. People cross it on a big boat called a ferry. The ferry carries cars and people from one island to the other.
Cookbook\n\nA cookbook is a book full of recipes. It shows you how to make food. Inside, it has lists of things you need, like flour, eggs, and sugar. It also has steps that tell you what to do, like mix, stir, and bake. You can find it in a kitchen or on a shelf. Mom or Dad might use it to make a cake or cookies. Some cookbooks have big, colorful pictures of the food. It helps people cook yummy meals at home.
Cookie\n\nA cookie is a small, flat, sweet treat. It is round and can be soft or crunchy. You find it in a jar at home or in a bakery. People bake it with flour, sugar, and butter, and eat it as a snack. A chocolate chip cookie has little brown bits that melt in your mouth.
Cooking\n\nCooking is making food ready to eat by using heat. It happens in a kitchen on a stove or in an oven. Sometimes people cook outside over a fire. There are many ways to cook. You can boil food in hot water, fry it in hot oil, or bake it in an oven. Grilling puts food on a metal rack over heat. People cook meat, bread, and many other foods. A person who cooks as a job is called a cook or a chef.
Cooking oil\n\nCooking oil is a liquid fat that comes from plants or animals. It looks smooth and feels slippery. You find it in a bottle in the kitchen. People use it to fry food, like eggs or potatoes, in a pan. It helps food cook without sticking. Some kinds come from olives, sunflowers, or corn.
Cookware and bakeware\n\nCookware and bakeware are tools people use to make food. They are pots, pans, and flat sheets. You find them in the kitchen, on the stove or inside the oven. A frying pan is one kind—it has a long handle and a flat bottom. A big deep pot is for soup or pasta. A flat sheet goes in the oven for cookies. Some are made of shiny silver metal, and some are heavy and black. Mom or Dad uses them to cook dinner or bake a cake.
Cooky\n\nA cooky is a small, flat, sweet treat. It is round and can be brown, yellow, or have little dark chips inside. You find it in a jar at home or at a bakery. People eat it as a snack with milk. It is crunchy or soft when you bite it.
Cool\n\nCool means a little bit cold, but not too cold. It feels nice on a hot day. You can feel it when a soft wind blows on your face. A glass of cold water from the fridge is cool. Some people say "cool" when they like something, like a new toy or a fun game.
Cooling tower\n\nA cooling tower is a big, tall building that helps get rid of extra heat. It looks like a giant upside-down cup, wide at the bottom and narrow in the middle. You can see it at big places that make power, like a power plant. It works by letting warm water meet cool air, which makes some water turn into a white cloud that floats up. That cloud is just clean water, not smoke. The tower helps keep big machines from getting too hot.
Cooperation\n\nCooperation is when people or animals help each other. It means working as a team. You see it when friends build a block tower together. One child holds the blocks, and the other stacks them up. In the ocean, a small orange fish and a soft sea flower help each other. The fish cleans the flower, and the flower gives the fish a safe place to live. Cooperation makes hard things easier and more fun.
Cop\n\nA cop is a person who helps keep people safe. He wears a blue or black uniform and a shiny badge. You can see him in a police car or walking on the street. He stops cars that go too fast and helps when someone is lost. If you need help, you can find a cop and ask.
Copper\n\nCopper is a kind of metal. It is a shiny orange-red color when it is new, but after a while in the air it turns green. You can find it in wires inside your house, because it carries power very well. People also use it to make pipes for water and to make coins. A very big statue called the Statue of Liberty is covered in copper, and that is why it looks green.
Copy\n\nCopy means to make something that looks just like another thing. When you draw a picture and your friend draws the same picture, that is a copy. You can also copy words by writing them again on a new paper. A copy machine at a store can make a copy of a paper very fast. It looks the same, but it is a new piece of paper.
Copyright\n\nCopyright is a rule that says a work belongs to the person who made it. It means you cannot copy a book, a song, a movie, or a picture unless the maker says it is okay. If someone copies without asking, the maker can ask a judge for help. The rule lasts for many years, even after the maker is gone. After that, anyone can use the work for free. There is a small rule called fair use that lets people use a tiny bit of a work for school or news.
Coral\n\nCoral is a hard, rock-like thing made by tiny sea animals. It lives in warm, sunny ocean water. Each tiny animal has a soft body with small arms around its mouth. Many of these animals live together in a big group. When they die, they leave behind a hard shell. Over time, these shells pile up and make big shapes that look like brains, fans, or branches. Fish, crabs, and other sea animals make their homes in coral. Some people wear pretty pieces of coral as jewelry.
Coral reef\n\nA coral reef is a big, colorful home under the sea. It is made of tiny animals called corals that build hard, rocky houses. It lives in warm, sunny ocean water near the land. Many bright fish, turtles, and other sea animals live in it. People like to swim and look at it because it is so pretty. The biggest one is the Great Barrier Reef in Australia.
Coral Sea\n\nThe Coral Sea is a big patch of water near Australia. It is warm and has many islands made of sand and coral. Under the water, there are colorful reefs full of fish, sharks, turtles, and whales. The Great Barrier Reef lives in this sea. Long ago, big boats with planes on them had a fight here to keep Australia safe.
Coral snake\n\nA coral snake is a small, colorful snake. It has bright bands of red, yellow, and black along its body. It lives in warm places like the southern United States. It hides under leaves and rocks. It eats small animals like lizards and frogs. It has a bite that can make you very sick, so you should never touch it.
Cord\n\nA cord is a long, thin, bendy string. It can be made of soft cloth, plastic, or rubber. You see it on things like lamps, phones, and toys. It carries power from the wall to make them work. A cord can also tie things together, like a shoelace.
Core\n\nA core is the very middle part of something. It is the center, like the pit inside a peach or the seed inside an apple. You can find a core in many things. An apple has a core that holds the seeds. The Earth has a hot core deep, deep under the ground. When you eat an apple, you do not eat the core because it is hard. The core is the most inside part.
Cork\n\nCork is a light, soft material that comes from the bark of a special tree. It feels a little squishy and bouncy when you touch it. You can find it in bottle stoppers, on bulletin boards, and sometimes on the floor as tiles. People use it to close bottles so the drink inside stays fresh. You might have seen a cork in a bottle at a party or in a craft box at school.
Cormorant\n\nA cormorant is a big water bird. It has dark feathers, a long thin beak, and feet with skin between the toes. It lives near the sea, lakes, and rivers. It can dive under the water for a long time to catch fish. After it swims, it stands with its wings spread out to dry.
Corn\n\nCorn is a food that grows on a tall green plant. It has a long, round part called an ear, covered with small yellow seeds. You can find it in a garden or on a farm. People cook it and eat it with butter and salt. Sometimes it pops into a fluffy white snack called popcorn.
Corner\n\nA corner is the place where two walls or two lines meet. It makes a pointy edge. You can find it in a room where two walls touch. A corner can be inside, like the spot behind a door, or outside, like the edge of a table. Sometimes people put a chair or a plant in it. When you walk around a building, you turn at its corner.
Coronavirus\n\nA coronavirus is a tiny germ that can make people and animals sick. It is so small you cannot see it with your eyes. Under a big, big looking glass, it looks like a round ball with little bumps all over it, like a crown. It lives in the air and on things we touch. When it gets inside a nose or mouth, it can make a person cough or feel hot. One kind of coronavirus caused a big sickness that spread all over the world. To stay safe, people wash their hands and cover their mouth when they cough.
Corporation\n\nA corporation is a group of people who work together to run a business. It is like a big team that makes or sells things. You can find corporations in many places, like the store where you buy toys or the company that makes your favorite cereal. People who own part of a corporation are called shareholders. They help decide what the business does. A corporation can be very big, with many workers, or small, with just a few people. It is a way for people to share ideas and money to make something useful.
Correct\n\nCorrect means something is right and has no mistakes. When you put a puzzle piece in the right spot, it is correct. A teacher may put a star on your paper when your answer is correct. It is the opposite of wrong.
Corrosion\n\nCorrosion is when a hard thing breaks down over time. It happens when air and water touch the thing and change it. You can see it on old metal that turns red and flaky. That red flaky stuff is called rust. It makes the metal weak and bumpy. People stop corrosion by painting the metal or putting a shiny coat on it. A shiny sink in the kitchen has a coat that keeps it safe.
Cosmetics\n\nCosmetics are things people put on their face or body to change how they look. It can be a stick of color for lips, a soft powder for cheeks, or a shiny cream for eyes. You can find it in a store, in a bathroom, or on a grown-up’s dresser. People use it to add color, cover spots, or look fancy for a party. A clown at the circus wears bright white and red cosmetics to make a funny face.
Cosmology\n\nCosmology is the study of the whole universe. It looks at how the universe began and how it changes over time. Scientists who study cosmology use big telescopes to see faraway stars and galaxies. They ask big questions like: how old is everything, and what is space made of? You can see a little bit of cosmology when you look up at the night sky and see the moon and twinkling stars.
Cost\n\nCost is how much money you need to buy something. It is the number of coins or bills you give to the store. A small toy might cost one coin, and a big toy might cost many coins. When you go to the store with Mom or Dad, they look at the cost before they buy. If you save your coins in a piggy bank, you can use them to pay the cost of a treat.
Costa Rica\n\nCosta Rica is a small country in the middle of the Americas. It has warm weather all year and lots of green trees and bright flowers. You can find it between two big oceans, with sandy beaches on both sides. Many animals live there, like monkeys, colorful birds, and slow sloths. People in Costa Rica speak Spanish and grow yummy fruits like bananas and pineapples. It is a peaceful place with no army, and many families visit to see the pretty nature.
Costume\n\nA costume is a set of clothes you wear to look like someone or something else. It can have bright colors, a hat, a mask, or a long cape. You might see a costume at a party, on a stage, or during a holiday like Halloween. People put on a costume to pretend to be a different person, an animal, or a made-up character. For example, on Halloween, a child might wear a costume to look like a friendly ghost or a superhero.
Cotton\n\nCotton is a soft, fluffy part of a plant. It grows around the seeds inside a little green ball called a boll. When the boll opens, it looks like a small white cloud. People pick it from big fields in warm places. Then they clean it and twist it into long, thin strings called thread. The thread is used to make soft cloth. Many of our T-shirts, socks, and towels are made from it. It feels cool and light, so it is nice to wear on hot days. It can also soak up water very well, which is why bandages are often made from it.
Couch\n\nA couch is a big, soft seat for more than one person. It has a long, comfy place to sit and a place to rest your arm on each side. You find it in the living room, often in front of the TV. People sit on it to watch shows, read books, or take a nap. Sometimes a person who sits on it all day is called a couch potato. A small couch for two people is called a love seat.
Cough\n\nA cough is a quick, loud push of air from your mouth. It happens when something tickles your throat or chest. You might cough when you have a cold or when you swallow water the wrong way. It helps your body push out yucky stuff so you can feel better. Sometimes you cover your mouth with your hand or elbow when you cough.
Could\n\nCould is a word we use to talk about things that might happen or things we are able to do. It is a small helper word that goes before an action word. When you say "I could jump," it means you are able to jump if you want to. It can also mean something might be true, like "That could be a bird." You hear it in stories and when people make a guess.
Count\n\nCount means to say numbers one after another to find out how many things there are. You can count with your fingers, one finger for each number. People count things like toys, apples, or steps when they walk. When you count, you start with one, then two, then three, and keep going. It helps you know if you have enough cookies for everyone.
Counter\n\nA counter is a flat, long table in a kitchen or a store. It has a smooth top and sometimes drawers or shelves under it. You find it in the kitchen where grown-ups make food. In a store, a worker stands behind it to help you pay for things. When you go to a bakery, you see a counter with cookies and bread on top.
Country\n\nA country is a big piece of land with its own people and rules. It has lines on a map that show where it starts and ends. People in a country often speak the same words and sing the same songs. A country has a group of grown-ups who make rules to keep things safe and fair. You can find many countries on a world map or a globe. Some countries are very big, and some are very small. The place where you live is part of a country.
Country music\n\nCountry music is a kind of music that tells stories about life. It often uses guitars, fiddles, and drums. You can hear it on the radio or at a fair. People sing about love, home, and hard work. Some songs are happy, and some are sad. Many people like to dance to it.
Courage\n\nCourage is a strong feeling inside you. It helps you do something even when you are scared. You show it when you try a new thing, like going down a big slide for the first time. It also means standing up for a friend when someone is mean. A firefighter shows it by going into a hot fire to save a person. It is like a light in your heart that says, "You can do it."
Course\n\nA course is a set of lessons about one topic. It can be at a school, a club, or on a computer. You learn new things step by step. For example, a drawing course teaches you how to draw a cat or a tree. Some courses are short, and some take many days.
Court\n\nA court is a place where people go to solve big arguments. It is a room inside a big building. In it, a judge sits at a tall desk and wears a long black robe. People talk about what happened and the judge decides who is right. Sometimes it decides if a person broke a rule. You may see a court on TV when people argue about a toy or a house.
Courtship\n\nCourtship is a special time when two people get to know each other. They spend time together and talk a lot. Sometimes they go for walks or have a meal. Later, they may decide to get married. In some places, families help pick the person. It can be short or long, depending on the couple.
Cousin\n\nA cousin is a child of your aunt or uncle. They are part of your family but not your brother or sister. You might see them at a family party or a holiday dinner. They can be your age, older, or younger. You can play games, share toys, and have fun with them. Some cousins live close by, and some live far away.
Cover\n\nA cover is something that goes on top of another thing. It keeps the thing safe and clean. You can find a cover on a bed, a book, or a pot. When you put a cover on, it hides what is under it. At night, you pull a soft cover over your body to stay warm.
Cow\n\nA cow is a big farm animal. It has four legs, a long tail, and black and white spots. You can find it on a farm in the country. It gives milk that people drink. A baby cow is called a calf.
Cowboy\n\nA cowboy is a person who takes care of cows. He rides a horse and wears a big hat to keep the sun away. You can see him on a farm or in old stories about the Wild West. He uses a rope to catch cows and keeps them safe. Sometimes he sings songs to the cows at night.
Coyote\n\nA coyote is a wild dog that lives in North America. It looks like a small wolf with gray-brown fur, a white belly, and long pointy ears. It can live in many places like forests, mountains, and even cities. It eats small animals, fruits, and sometimes food from trash cans. A coyote digs a home under the ground called a den where it sleeps and has its babies.
Cozy\n\nCozy is a warm, soft, happy feeling. It feels like a big hug from a blanket. You can feel cozy when you sit by a fire on a cold day. It also feels cozy when you wear fuzzy socks and drink warm milk. A soft pillow and a quiet room can make you feel cozy too.
Crab\n\nA crab is a small animal that lives in water or on land. It has a hard shell on its body and eight legs for walking. It also has two big claws that can pinch. You can find it at the beach, in the ocean, or sometimes near rivers. It uses its claws to catch food and to fight. It eats tiny plants and animals it finds on the ground. Some people eat crab meat, and it can be made into yummy dishes like crab cakes.
Crack\n\nA crack is a thin line that opens up on something. It can be on a wall, a sidewalk, or an egg. It happens when something gets hit too hard or gets very old. You might see a crack on a toy that fell down. A crack can make a sound like a snap.
Cracker\n\nA cracker is a thin, flat, crunchy food. It is usually small and square or round. You can find it in a box at the store or in your kitchen. People eat it as a snack, often with cheese or peanut butter on top. It makes a loud crunch sound when you bite it.
Crackle\n\nA crackle is a short, sharp sound. It is like many tiny pops or snaps all at once. You can hear it when you step on dry leaves in the fall. It also happens when a fire burns wood in a fireplace. Some people hear a crackle when they open a bag of chips. It is a fun sound that makes you think of cozy or crunchy things.
Craft\n\nA craft is something you make with your hands. It can be made of paper, glue, clay, or string. You can do a craft at home, at school, or at a party. People make crafts to have fun, to give as a gift, or to put up on the wall. For example, you might cut out a paper heart and color it red. That is a craft.
Cranberry\n\nA cranberry is a small, round fruit that is red and a little sour. It grows on a short, green bush in wet, cool places. People pick it in the fall when it is ripe. Many families eat cranberry sauce or drink cranberry juice at big holiday meals. It can also be made into jam that tastes sweet and tangy.
Crane\n\nA crane is a big, strong machine that lifts heavy things. It has a tall arm and a hook that goes up and down. You can see it at a place where people build tall houses or fix roads. It picks up big blocks, steel, or dirt and moves them to another spot. A worker sits inside and uses levers to make it work. It helps build the tall buildings you see in a city.
Crane (bird)\n\nA crane is a tall bird with long legs and a long neck. It has big wings and a strong, pointed beak. It lives near water, like rivers and wet fields. It walks in shallow water looking for food. It eats plants, small animals, and bugs. Some cranes are white, some are gray, and some are brown. They fly with their neck straight out and their legs trailing behind. They make loud calls that you can hear from far away. When they want a mate, they do a special dance with jumps and bows.
Crane (machine)\n\nA crane is a big, strong machine that lifts heavy things. It has a tall arm, a long rope, and a hook at the end. You can see it at places where people build tall houses or big buildings. It picks up heavy stuff like steel beams and moves them up high. The arm can turn left and right to put things where they need to go. A crane helps workers build things that are too heavy to lift by hand.
Crane fly\n\nA crane fly is a bug with very long, thin legs. It looks like a big mosquito, but it does not bite people. You can see it on walls or near lights at night. It flies slowly and sometimes wobbles in the air. A crane fly does not live very long—only about two weeks. Its babies live in the ground and eat plant roots.
Crash\n\nA crash is when two things hit each other very hard. It makes a big, loud noise like a bang or a boom. You might see a crash when toy cars bump together on the floor. Sometimes a crash can break things into little pieces. After a crash, people check to make sure everyone is okay.
Crawl\n\nCrawl is a way of moving on your hands and knees. It is how babies move before they learn to walk. You can also crawl under a table or through a small space. Some animals, like ants and spiders, crawl on many tiny legs. When you crawl, you stay low to the ground.
Crayfish\n\nA crayfish is a small water animal with a hard shell. It looks like a tiny lobster. It has two big front claws, a long tail, and many small legs. It lives in rivers, ponds, and streams. It hides under rocks during the day and comes out at night to eat. It eats plants, worms, and tiny water bugs. Some people call it a crawfish or a crawdad.
Crayon\n\nA crayon is a stick of colored wax. It is short and round, and it comes in many bright colors like red, blue, and yellow. You can find it in a box with other crayons at home or at school. You use it to draw pictures on paper. When you push it across the page, it leaves a soft, waxy line. A green crayon can make a tree, and a yellow one can make a sun.
Creak\n\nA creak is a long, slow, squeaky sound. It happens when something old or stiff moves a little. You might hear it from a wooden floor when someone walks on it. An old door can make it when it opens or closes. It sounds like a rusty hinge that needs some oil.
Cream\n\nCream is the thick, rich part of milk. It is white or light yellow and feels smooth. You can find it in a carton at the store, near the milk. People pour it into coffee to make the drink taste softer. It is also used to make yummy sauces, like a white sauce for pasta. When you shake cream very hard, it turns into whipped cream, which is fluffy and sweet.
Create\n\nCreate means to make something new. When you draw a picture, you create it. You can also create a song by singing or a story by telling it. People create things every day, like building with blocks or baking cookies. It feels good to create something all by yourself.
Creation\n\nCreation is when something new is made. It can be a drawing, a song, a story, or a building. People use their hands and minds to make things. A child making a sandcastle at the beach is creation. A cook making a new kind of cookie is creation too. It starts as an idea and then becomes real.
Creation myth\n\nA creation myth is a very old story that tells how the world began. It explains where the sky, the land, and people came from. Long ago, people made up these stories to answer big questions. In one story, a little bug named Dayuni'si brought up mud from deep water, and the mud grew and grew until it became the whole earth. In another story, a man called the Creator made a tiny brown ball from sweat, and then the wind and a spider pulled it until it became our big world. Many different people around the world have their own creation myth.
Creativity\n\nCreativity is when you make something new from your own ideas. It is like a little light in your head that helps you think of things nobody else has thought of before. You can find it when you draw a picture, build with blocks, or tell a story. It helps you solve problems in fun ways. For example, if you use a box as a pretend car, that is creativity.
Creature\n\nA creature is any living thing that can move and grow. It can be big like an elephant or tiny like a bug. You can find creatures in the water, on land, or in the air. A creature eats food, breathes air, and has babies. A dog, a bird, and a fish are all creatures.
Credit card\n\nA credit card is a small plastic card that lets you buy things without using paper money. It has a long number on the front and a special chip inside. You can use it at a store or on a computer to pay. When you buy with it, the bank pays the store first, and you pay the bank back later. If you do not pay the bank back on time, you have to give them extra money. Many grown-ups keep one in a wallet or a purse.
Creek\n\nA creek is a small stream of water that moves along the ground. It is not as big as a river, and you can often step across it. You can find a creek in a park, a forest, or near hills. The water in it comes from rain or melting snow. It makes a soft, happy sound as it flows over rocks. Sometimes you can see little fish or frogs living in it. Children like to splash and play in a creek on a warm day.
Crescent\n\nA crescent is a thin, curved shape. It looks like a banana or a smile in the sky. You can see it at night when the moon is not full. Sometimes people use it as a picture on flags or in stories. It is a pretty shape that makes you think of quiet nights.
Crete\n\nCrete is a big island in the sea. It has warm sun, good dirt, and lots of water. Long ago, people there made pretty art and big houses. They picked small purple flowers to make yellow color for clothes and food. They played games and liked music. A famous old house on the island has many twisty halls. People told stories about a monster that was half bull and half man living there.
Crib\n\nA crib is a small bed for a baby. It has tall sides all around so the baby cannot fall out. You find it in a baby's room at home. The baby sleeps and naps in it. Sometimes a crib has soft blankets and a tiny pillow inside. A mobile with toys may hang above it for the baby to look at.
Cricket\n\nCricket is a game played outside on a big grassy field. It uses a bat and a ball. Two teams play, and each team has eleven people. One person throws the ball, and another person hits it with the bat. They run back and forth to score points. People play it in many countries, and lots of people like to watch it.
Cricket (insect)\n\nA cricket is a small bug with a flat body and very long feelers on its head. It looks a little like a grasshopper and has strong back legs for jumping. You can find it in grass, gardens, or under rocks, and it comes out mostly at night. It makes a loud chirping sound by rubbing its wings together. The boy cricket chirps to call a girl cricket or to tell other boys to stay away. You might hear it on a warm summer evening outside your window.
Crime\n\nA crime is when a person does something that the rules of a place say is not okay. It is an act that can hurt another person or take their things. Police officers work to stop crimes and find the people who did them. If a person does a crime, a judge may send them to a special room called a jail. Stealing a toy from a store is one kind of crime. Hitting someone on purpose is another kind.
Criminal law\n\nCriminal law is a set of rules that tell people what they must not do. It says that if someone hurts another person or takes their things, they get in trouble. Police and judges use these rules to keep everyone safe. For example, if a person steals a toy from a store, that breaks a rule. Then a judge may say the person must stay away from the store or pay money. The rules help protect our bodies and our stuff.
Critical thinking\n\nCritical thinking is a careful way of thinking. It means you stop and ask questions before you believe something. You look at the facts and check if they are true. You also think about what might happen next. It helps you make good choices and solve problems. For example, if a friend says a toy is broken, you can look at it yourself to see if it really is. You can ask a grown-up to help you find out more. This way, you do not get tricked by a mistake or a story that is not real.
Croatia\n\nCroatia is a country in Europe. It has a long coast next to a blue sea called the Adriatic Sea. Many people visit it to swim and see old stone towns. Its flag has red, white, and blue stripes with a shield in the middle. The biggest city is Zagreb, where many people live and work.
Crochet\n\nCrochet is a way to make soft things from long, thin string called yarn. It uses a small stick with a hook at one end. You pull loops of yarn through other loops with the hook. It is like drawing with string. People use it to make warm blankets, hats, scarves, and little toy animals. You can find crochet things at home, like a cozy blanket on the couch. It is easy for kids to learn because the hook fits in small hands. You can stop and start again any time.
Crocodile\n\nA crocodile is a big animal that lives in water and on land. It has a long body, a long tail, and a big mouth with many sharp teeth. Its skin is hard and bumpy, and it can be brown, gray, or green. It lives in warm rivers and lakes in places like Africa, Asia, and America. It hides in the water like a log and waits for animals to come close. Then it jumps out and grabs them with its strong mouth. A crocodile can hold its breath under water for a long time. Some crocodiles are very big, as long as a car. You can see one at a zoo or in a book about animals.
Crop\n\nA crop is a plant that a farmer grows. It can be food like corn, carrots, or apples. Some crops are not food but are used to make things like clothes or rubber. Farmers plant many of the same crop in one big field. They take care of it until it is big enough to pick. Then people eat it or use it to make other things.
Cross\n\nA cross is a shape made of two lines. One line goes up and down, and the other line goes side to side. They meet in the middle. You can see a cross on a church or a hospital sign. Some people wear a small cross on a necklace. It can also be a mark you make with a pen, like when you put an X on a box.
Crossbow\n\nA crossbow is a tool that shoots short arrows. It has a wooden body and a curved part that pulls back. People used it long ago in battles because it was strong and could hit far away. Today, some people use it for fun in a sport. It is not a toy and can be dangerous.
Crossword\n\nA crossword is a word game on paper. It has a big square made of many little white and black boxes. You find it in newspapers or in puzzle books. Next to the big square is a list of hints. Each hint tells you a word to write in the white boxes. Some words go across, and some go down. You fill in one letter in each box. When all the white boxes are full, you have solved the puzzle.
Crow\n\nA crow is a big black bird. It has shiny black feathers, a strong beak, and two bright eyes. You can see it in parks, fields, or sitting on a fence. It eats many things like bugs, seeds, and leftover food. It is very smart and can even use small sticks to get food. Sometimes a group of crows flies together in the sky.
Crowd\n\nA crowd is a big group of people standing close together. It can happen at a park, a store, or a show. In a crowd, you see many faces, arms, and legs all around. People in a crowd might cheer, clap, or walk the same way. It can feel loud and busy, so it is good to hold a grown-up's hand.
Crown\n\nA crown is a special hat that a king or queen wears on their head. It is often made of shiny gold and has pretty stones on it. You can see a crown in storybooks about princes and princesses. It shows that the person is very important. Sometimes children make a paper crown to wear at a party.
Crumb\n\nA crumb is a tiny piece that breaks off from bread, a cookie, or a cake. It is very small, like a dot. You can find it on a plate or on the table after you eat. When you bite a cracker, little bits fall down — those are crumbs. A bird might pick up a crumb from the ground to eat.
Crumbly\n\nCrumbly means something breaks into tiny pieces very easily. It feels dry and falls apart when you touch it. You can find crumbly things in the kitchen, like a dry cookie or old bread. When you squeeze it, little bits fall onto your hand or the plate. A sandcastle made of dry sand is crumbly too.
Crunch\n\nA crunch is a loud, sharp sound. It happens when you step on a dry leaf or bite a hard cracker. You can hear it outside in the fall when leaves are on the ground. It is a short noise that feels crisp in your ears. Sometimes snow makes a crunch too when you walk on it with boots.
Crunchy\n\nCrunchy is a word for food that makes a loud sound when you bite it. It feels hard and breaks into little pieces in your mouth. You can find crunchy food in your kitchen, like a fresh apple, a carrot stick, or a dry cracker. When you eat it, you hear a crisp, snapping noise. Many kids like crunchy snacks because they are fun to chew.
Crusade\n\nA crusade is a long, hard fight for something people believe in. It happened a very long time ago when groups of people traveled far away to take back a special place. They wore heavy metal clothes and carried big shields. You might see pictures of them in old storybooks with red crosses on their chests. Today, the word can also mean any big effort to make something better, like a crusade to keep the park clean.
Crust\n\nA crust is the hard, brown outside part of bread or a pie. It is the part you see first when you look at it. When you bake dough in a hot oven, the outside gets dry and turns a little brown. That is the crust. It can be crunchy when you bite it. Some people like to eat the crust, and some people do not. On a pie, the crust holds all the yummy fruit inside.
Crustacean\n\nA crustacean is a small animal with a hard shell. It has a body with three parts: a head, a middle, and a tail. It has two long feelers on its head and two eyes. Most crustaceans live in water, like the ocean or a river. Some live on land, like the little gray bug that rolls into a ball. People eat many crustaceans, like shrimp, crab, and lobster. When it grows bigger, it must take off its old shell and grow a new one.
Crux\n\nCrux is a group of stars in the night sky. It looks like a cross made of four bright stars. You can see it if you live far south, like in Australia. Long ago, people on big boats used it to find their way across the water. Today, many countries put it on their flags because it is a special sign for them.
Cry\n\nCry is when water comes out of your eyes. It happens when you feel very sad, hurt, or sometimes very happy. The water is called tears, and it rolls down your cheeks. You might cry if you fall down and scrape your knee. Sometimes a big hug makes the cry stop.
Cryptography\n\nCryptography is a way to keep secrets safe. It changes a message so only the right person can read it. You can think of it like a magic box. You put your words in, lock it with a special key, and send it. The other person uses the same key to open the box and read the words. If someone else tries to look, they see only messy lines. People use it on computers to keep passwords and bank cards safe.
Crystal\n\nA crystal is a hard, shiny rock with flat sides. It is made of tiny bits that line up in a neat pattern, like a checkerboard. You can find crystals in the ground or in caves. Some are clear like glass, and some have colors like purple or pink. People use pretty crystals to make jewelry, like rings and necklaces. When light hits a crystal, it sparkles and shines. Snowflakes are tiny ice crystals that fall from the sky. Salt from the kitchen is also made of tiny cube-shaped crystals.
Cub\n\nA cub is a baby bear. It is small and has soft, fuzzy fur. You can find it in the forest with its mama bear. It drinks milk from its mama and learns to walk and play. When it grows up, it will be big and strong like its mama.
Cuba\n\nCuba is an island country in the warm blue sea. It is made of one big island and many tiny islands. The biggest city is Havana. People there speak Spanish. Cuba is famous for fun dance music like Salsa. Long ago, it grew lots of sugar. Today, many people visit Cuba to see the pretty beaches and old buildings.
Cube\n\nA cube is a solid shape that looks like a box. It has six flat sides, and each side is a square. All its sides are the same size. You can find cubes in many places, like a block you play with or a dice you roll in a game. A cube has eight pointy corners and twelve straight edges. It is fun to stack cubes to build a tower.
Cubism\n\nCubism is a way of making art. It shows a person or a thing from many sides all at once. The shapes look like blocks, squares, and triangles. Artists paint with just one color so you look at the shapes, not the colors. Later, they used bright colors and glued on bits of paper. You can see Cubism art in big buildings called museums.
Cubit\n\nA cubit is an old way to measure how long something is. It is the space from a grown-up's elbow to the tip of their middle finger. Long ago, people used it to measure cloth, rope, and wood. Today we use rulers and tape measures instead, so we do not see a cubit very often.
Cuckoo\n\nA cuckoo is a bird. It is gray with a long tail and strong legs. It lives in woods and open land in Europe and Asia. It does not build its own nest. Instead, it lays its eggs in the nests of other birds. The other birds then feed and care for the baby cuckoo. The baby grows very fast and pushes the other eggs out of the nest. The cuckoo makes a sound like its name: "cuck-oo."
Cucumber\n\nA cucumber is a long, green food that grows on a climbing plant. It has a smooth or bumpy skin and a cool, wet inside with tiny soft seeds. You can find it in a garden, a farm, or a store. People eat it raw in salads, cut it into sticks for a snack, or pickle it in jars. It tastes fresh and a little bit sweet.
Cue sports\n\nCue sports are games you play on a big table with balls and a long stick. The table is covered with soft green cloth and has bumpy sides so the balls stay on. You use the stick to push a white ball so it hits other balls. Some tables have little holes called pockets around the sides. When a ball falls into a pocket, it drops into a net. There are many kinds of cue sports. In one game, you try to make all your balls go into the pockets before the other player does. In another game, the balls have numbers and you must hit them in order. Some tables have no pockets at all, and you score by making the white ball touch two other balls and the bumpy sides. You might see a cue sports table at a game room or a friend's house.
Cuisine\n\nCuisine is a way of cooking food. It is the special food that people from one place like to make and eat. It uses things that grow near them, like plants and animals. For example, Italian cuisine has pizza and pasta. People in Japan eat a lot of fish and rice. Every country has its own cuisine. It is like a big food family with its own rules and tastes.
Culinary mustard\n\nCulinary mustard is a yellow or brown sauce people eat with food. It is made from tiny seeds of a plant. The seeds are crushed and mixed with water or sour juice. It tastes sharp and hot on the tongue. You can spread it on a sandwich or put it on a hot dog. Many fast-food places give it in a small packet.
Cultural heritage\n\nCultural heritage is the special things that people from long ago left behind. It can be old buildings, stories, songs, or ways of doing things. You can see it in a museum, an old house, or a special dance. People keep it safe so we can remember the past. For example, a very old castle or a song your grandma sings is part of cultural heritage.
Culture\n\nCulture is the way a group of people live and do things. It is like a big invisible blanket that wraps around them. It includes the food they eat, the songs they sing, the clothes they wear, and the stories they tell. You can see it in a country, a town, or even a family. For example, your family might have a special cake for birthdays. That is part of your family's culture.
Cumin\n\nCumin is a tiny seed that people use to make food taste warm and yummy. It is long and thin, with a light brown color. You can find it in the kitchen, in a small jar with other spices. People put it in soups, stews, and bread to give a cozy smell. In some places, like India, cooks use it in almost every meal. When you eat a taco or a bowl of chili, you might taste cumin without even knowing it.
Cumulonimbus cloud\n\nA cumulonimbus cloud is a big, tall cloud that brings storms. It looks like a mountain in the sky, with a flat top and a dark bottom. You see it when there is thunder, lightning, and heavy rain. It can also make hail and strong winds. Sometimes it makes a spinning funnel called a tornado. When you see this cloud, it is time to go inside and stay safe.
Cumulus cloud\n\nA cumulus cloud is a big, puffy white cloud in the sky. It looks like a soft ball of cotton or a piece of cauliflower. It has a flat bottom and a top that keeps changing shape. You can see it on a sunny day when the air is warm. It floats high up where birds fly. When it grows very tall and dark, it can bring rain and thunder.
Cuneiform\n\nCuneiform is a very old way of writing. It was made by pressing a stick into soft, wet clay. The marks look like little wedges, or tiny triangles. People used it a long, long time ago in a place far away. They wrote on flat pieces of clay that dried hard in the sun. It was used to write down stories, lists, and letters. Today, we can see old clay pieces with these marks in big museums.
Cup\n\nA cup is a small open container that holds drinks. It is round and has a flat bottom so it can stand on a table. You find it in the kitchen, at school, or at a picnic. People use it to drink water, milk, or juice. A cup can be made of plastic, glass, or paper. When you are thirsty, you pick it up and sip from the top.
Cupboard\n\nA cupboard is a big box with doors. It stands on the floor or hangs on a wall. You open the doors to put things inside. People keep plates, cups, and food in it. In the kitchen, you can find a cupboard near the sink. It helps keep a room tidy.
Curie\n\nCurie is a last name of a very smart woman. She was a scientist who studied tiny things we cannot see. She found out about two new kinds of stuff called radium and polonium. Her work helps doctors today when they take pictures of bones. Many people remember her as a brave and hard-working person.
Curiosity\n\nCuriosity is a feeling of wanting to know new things. It makes you look, touch, and ask questions. You can see it in babies when they reach for a toy. It is also in animals like cats and apes when they sniff or poke at something. Curiosity helps people learn and find out how the world works.
Curl\n\nA curl is a round, bouncy shape that hair or a ribbon can make. It looks like a little circle or a spring. You can see curls on a person's head when their hair is not straight. Some people use a hot tool to make curls in their hair. A curl can also be a small, round piece of paper or a lock of hair. When you wrap a ribbon around your finger, it makes a curl.
Curling\n\nCurling is a game played on ice. It uses heavy, round stones with handles. Two teams of four people slide the stones toward a round target at the other end. The target is called the house, and it has colored rings. Players sweep the ice with brooms to help the stone go where they want. The team with the stone closest to the center gets points. You can see curling at the Winter Olympics.
Curly\n\nCurly means something has lots of little round shapes, like a spring or a circle. It can be hair that twists and bounces. You can find curly lines in drawings or on a present with a ribbon. Some people use a special tool to make paper curly for art. A pig's tail is curly and looks like a little loop.
Currency\n\nCurrency is a kind of money that people use to buy things. It can be paper bills or round coins. Every country has its own currency with different colors and pictures. In the United States, people use dollars and cents. In Europe, many people use euros. When you go to a store, you give currency to get a toy or a snack. Some people keep currency in a wallet or a piggy bank.
Curry\n\nCurry is a warm, tasty food with lots of spices. It can be yellow, red, or brown, and it often has a thick, smooth sauce. You find it in many countries, like India and Thailand. People eat it with soft rice or flat bread called naan. Some curry is a little spicy, and some is very mild. You might see it at a family dinner or a food stand.
Curse\n\nA curse is a mean wish for bad luck. It is like saying angry words that hope something sad happens to another person. In old stories, a witch might put a curse on a prince and turn him into a frog. Long ago, people wrote curses on small stones and threw them into a river. They thought the river would carry the bad wish to the person they did not like. A curse is the opposite of a blessing, which is a kind wish for good things.
Curtain\n\nA curtain is a big piece of cloth that hangs in front of a window. It can be long or short, and it comes in many colors and patterns. You find it in houses, schools, and other buildings. It keeps bright sunlight out of a room so you can sleep or watch TV. It also gives you privacy so people outside cannot see in. At night, you pull it closed, and in the morning, you open it to let the light in.
Curve\n\nA curve is a line that bends or turns. It is never straight like a ruler. You can draw a curve on paper with a pencil. A circle is a curve that goes all the way around and meets itself. A rainbow in the sky is a big curve made of colors. A ball has a curved outside that feels round and smooth.
Cushion\n\nA cushion is a soft bag filled with fluffy stuff. It is often square or round and feels nice to touch. You can find it on a couch, a chair, or a bed. People use it to make sitting more comfy or to rest their head. Some cushions have bright colors or fun shapes like stars. A child might hug a cushion while watching a show.
Custom\n\nA custom is a way of doing things that a group of people has shared for a long time. It can be a special day, a song, a dance, or a kind of food. You might see it at a party, a holiday, or a family get-together. People do it because their parents and grandparents did it too. For example, blowing out candles on a birthday cake is a custom. Another custom is giving gifts on a special day.
Customer\n\nA customer is a person who buys something. It can be a grown-up or a child. You see a customer at a store, a market, or a restaurant. A customer gives money and gets a toy, food, or clothes. When you buy a candy with your coin, you are a customer.
Cut\n\nCut means to make something into two or more pieces. You can use scissors or a knife to do it. When you cut paper, it makes a straight line. People cut food like fruit or bread to share it. Be careful with sharp things that cut.
Cute\n\nCute means something is very nice to look at and makes you feel happy inside. It can be a small puppy with big eyes, a soft baby chick, or a tiny flower. You might see cute things in a picture book, at the park, or on a baby's face. When you see something cute, you may want to smile, laugh, or give it a gentle hug. A kitten with a little pink nose is a good example of cute.
Cutlery\n\nCutlery is the name for tools we use to eat food. It includes a knife, a fork, and a spoon. A knife cuts food into small pieces. A fork has pointy parts to pick up food. A spoon has a round end to scoop up soup or soft food. You see it on the table at home, at school, and in a restaurant. Sometimes it is made of shiny silver metal, and sometimes it is made of plastic. Plastic cutlery is used once and then thrown away. In some places, people use two sticks called chopsticks instead of a fork and knife.
Cycad\n\nA cycad is a very old kind of plant. It has a thick, short trunk and a crown of big, feather-like leaves. You can find it in warm places, like gardens or forests. It looks a little like a palm tree, but it is not the same. Long ago, dinosaurs ate its leaves. Today, some people grow it in pots as a pretty plant.
Cycle sport\n\nCycle sport is a game where people race on bikes. It has many kinds, like riding fast on roads, over bumpy hills, or on small dirt tracks. Some people also do tricks or play ball games on bikes. You can see bike races in big sports shows like the Olympics. Many people in Europe love to watch and cheer for the riders. A long time ago, the first bike race was in a big city called Paris.
Cyclone\n\nA cyclone is a big, spinning storm with very strong winds. It looks like a giant circle of clouds when you see it from high above. In the middle, there is a quiet part called the eye. You find cyclones over warm ocean water. They bring heavy rain and can knock down trees and houses when they hit land. People also call them hurricanes or typhoons in different places.
Cymbal\n\nA cymbal is a shiny, round metal plate that makes a loud sound when you hit it. It looks a little like a pot lid, but it has a bump in the middle with a strap. You can find it in music groups like bands and orchestras. A person hits it with a stick or bangs two together to make a crash or a soft ring. You might see one when you watch a parade or a drummer play.
Cypress\n\nA cypress is a tall green tree that stays green all year. It has thin, pointy leaves that look like little needles. You can find it in parks, gardens, and sometimes in big forests. People use its wood to build things like fences and boats. Its seed cones are small and round, like tiny brown balls. A long, long time ago, many of these trees grew where dinosaurs walked.
Cyprus\n\nCyprus is a big island in the sea. It is a country where people live. It has warm sun and blue water all around. The land has tall hills and a long river. Many people visit Cyprus to swim and play on the beach. Some parts of the island are ruled by different groups. People there speak two languages: Greek and Turkish. A long time ago, kings and queens ruled Cyprus. Now it has a leader called a president. You can see old stone houses and big churches there.
Cyrillic\n\nCyrillic is a way of writing words. It uses shapes called letters, just like the ABCs you know. Many people in faraway lands use it to write their language. You might see it on a map or in a book about other places. Some of its letters look a little like ours, but some look very different.
Cyrillic script\n\nCyrillic script is a way of writing words. It has many letters that look different from the letters we use in English. People in Russia and some other countries use it to write their language. You might see it on signs or in books from those places.
Cyrus The Great\n\nCyrus the Great was a king a long, long time ago. He was the leader of a big land called Persia. He was kind to the people he ruled and let them keep their own ways. Many people remember him as a fair and good king.
Czech language\n\nCzech is a way people talk and write. It is used by people who live in a country called the Czech Republic. It sounds a lot like another way of talking called Slovak, so people who use one can often understand the other. It has many rules for how words change their shape, which makes it tricky to learn. You might hear it in songs or stories from that part of the world.
Czech Republic\n\nThe Czech Republic is a country in the middle of Europe. It has no sea next to it, but it touches Germany, Austria, Slovakia, and Poland. The biggest city is Prague, and many people live there. People in this country speak Czech, a language that sounds a bit like Polish or Slovak. They use money called crowns to buy things. The land has hills, forests, and old castles. Long ago, kings and queens ruled there, and now people choose their own leaders. Some children might see pictures of Prague's pretty clock tower or stone bridge.
Dad\n\nA dad is the father of a child. He is a grown-up man who takes care of his family. He may be tall or short, and he might have a beard or glasses. Many dads go to work during the day and come home at night. He plays with you, reads stories, and helps you when you are sad. A dad gives big hugs and keeps you safe.
Dadaism\n\nDadaism is a way of making art that is silly and strange. It started a long time ago when some people were sad about a big war. They made art with odd shapes, cut-up paper, and funny sounds. It can be a picture that looks like nothing, or a poem with made-up words. Some people put everyday things like a bike wheel in a museum and called it art. Dadaism shows that art can be anything you want it to be.
Daddy\n\nA daddy is the dad in a family. He is a grown-up man who takes care of his children. He may be tall and strong, and he gives big hugs. A daddy goes to work to earn money for food and toys. At home, he plays games, reads books, and helps with baths. He loves his kids very much and keeps them safe.
Dagger\n\nA dagger is a small, sharp tool that looks like a knife. It has a pointy end and two sharp sides. Long ago, people used it to fight. It is small enough to hide under clothes. A dagger is not for cutting food like a regular knife. You might see one in a story about knights or pirates.
Dahlia\n\nA dahlia is a big, bright flower. It has many soft petals that form a round, puffy shape. You can find it in gardens where people plant pretty flowers. People like to grow it because it comes in many colors like red, pink, yellow, and white. It likes to grow in places with light that is not too strong. You might see a dahlia in a vase at home or in a park.
Daikon\n\nDaikon is a long, white vegetable that grows under the ground. It looks like a big, thick carrot, but it is white all over. You can find it in stores that sell food from Japan and other far-away places. People cut it into small pieces and put it in soups or salads. It tastes a little bit spicy, but not too hot. Some people also pickle it to make it sour and crunchy.
Dairy product\n\nA dairy product is a food made from milk. It comes from animals like cows and goats. You can find it in the fridge at the store or at home. People eat it for breakfast, lunch, or a snack. Milk, cheese, and yogurt are all dairy products. Ice cream is a sweet dairy product that many kids love.
Daisy\n\nA daisy is a small flower. It has a round yellow middle and many white petals around it. You can find it in grass, gardens, and parks. It opens its petals when the sun is out and closes them at night. Some people pick it to make a pretty chain or to play a game.
Dakar\n\nDakar is a big city by the ocean. It is the most important city in a country called Senegal, in Africa. It has many houses, buildings, and a big port where boats come and go. Long ago, people from far away came to live there. Now, it is where the leaders of Senegal work and meet. Many people live in Dakar, and the streets are busy with cars and markets.
Dalian\n\nDalian is a big city by the sea in China. It has a port where big boats come and go. The water there stays warm even in winter, so boats can use it all year. People use the port to send things to other countries nearby. Long ago, other countries wanted to use the port too.
Dallas\n\nDallas is a big city in Texas. It has tall buildings, busy streets, and many houses. Many people live there. It is home to sports teams like the Cowboys who play football. A long time ago, a president was hurt there, but today it is a happy place where families live and work.
Dam\n\nA dam is a big wall that stops water in a river. It makes a lake behind it. Some dams have a part where water can flow over or through it. People build dams to hold water so they can use it later. They use the water to drink, to help plants grow on farms, or to make power. A dam can also stop a town from getting too much water when it rains a lot. Some dams have steps like a ladder so fish can swim past it.
Damascus\n\nDamascus is a very old city where many people live. It has tall buildings, busy streets, and big markets full of shops. You can find it in a country called Syria, far away across the ocean. Long ago, people used it as a place to buy and sell things. Today, children go to school there and families walk in the old stone streets. One famous spot is a huge, beautiful mosque where people come to pray.
Damp\n\nDamp means a little bit wet. It is not dry, but it is not dripping with water either. You can feel it on a towel after you use it, or on the grass early in the morning. A cloth can be damp if you wipe a table with it. Sometimes the air in a room feels damp after a hot shower.
Damselfly\n\nA damselfly is a small flying bug. It has a long thin body and four clear wings. When it rests, it holds its wings together over its back. It lives near ponds and rivers.
