Extended family\n\nAn extended family is a big group of people who are all part of one family. It has more than just a mom, a dad, and their kids. It also has aunts, uncles, and cousins. Sometimes a grandma or grandpa lives with them too. They all live together or very close by. They help each other every day, like sharing food and taking care of the little ones. When you visit your cousin's house and see your aunt and uncle there, that is part of an extended family.
Extinction\n\nExtinction is when a kind of animal or plant is gone forever. It means there are no more of them left anywhere on Earth. A long time ago, big dinosaurs lived here, but they are now extinct. Sometimes the place where they live changes too much, and they cannot find food or a safe home. People can also make animals extinct by hunting too many of them. The dodo bird is one animal that is extinct because people hunted it. When a kind of living thing is almost gone, we say it is endangered. We try to keep endangered animals safe so they do not become extinct.
Extra\n\nExtra means more than usual. It is the little bit you get after you already have enough. You might find an extra cookie in your lunch box, and that feels like a happy surprise. Sometimes you have an extra crayon when a friend needs one, so you can share. Extra can also mean a little more time to play before bed.
Extrasolar planet\n\nAn extrasolar planet is a big round world that moves around a far-away star. It is not in our own star family. It can be made of rock or gas, and some are very hot while others are cold. You cannot see it with just your eyes, but big telescopes help people find it. Some of these worlds might have water, like a big warm ocean. One of them is called Kepler-69c, and it is a little bigger than our Earth.
Extraterrestrial life\n\nExtraterrestrial life is living things that are not from Earth. It is also called aliens. No one has found any yet, but some people think it might live far away on other planets. In stories and movies, it can look like little green people or strange creatures with big eyes. Scientists use big tools to listen for sounds from space, hoping to hear a sign of it.
Extraversion and introversion\n\nExtraversion and introversion are two ways people can be. Some people like to be with others a lot. They feel happy and full of energy when they play with friends. Other people like to be alone more. They feel happy and full of energy when they play by themselves. It is not about being scared or shy. It is just how different people feel best. Everyone is a little bit of both, but some lean more one way.
Extremophile\n\nAn extremophile is a tiny living thing that likes very hard places. It can live where it is super hot, super cold, or very salty. Most other living things cannot stay alive there. You cannot see it with just your eyes because it is so small. Scientists find it deep in the ocean, in hot springs, or inside rocks. It helps us learn how life can be strong in strange spots.
Eye\n\nAn eye is a round part of your body that helps you see. It sits in a little hollow on your face, one on each side. The front has a clear cover and a dark circle in the middle. Light comes in through that circle, and the eye sends a message to your brain. Then your brain shows you a picture of what is in front of you. Some animals have eyes that work a little differently, but they all use them to see.
Eye examination\n\nAn eye examination is a check-up for your eyes. It is done by a special eye doctor. The doctor looks at your eyes with a bright light and asks you to read letters on a wall chart. It helps find out if you need glasses to see better. Sometimes the doctor puts drops in your eyes to make them feel a little funny, but it does not hurt. After the check-up, you may get a paper that tells you how strong your glasses should be.
Eyeglasses\n\nEyeglasses are a tool that helps people see better. They have two clear pieces called lenses that sit in front of the eyes. A frame holds the lenses on the face. The frame can be made of metal or plastic. You wear them on your nose and ears. Some eyeglasses have dark lenses to keep bright sun out of the eyes. Other eyeglasses keep things from hitting the eyes. Many people wear them to read or watch things clearly. You might see a friend or a teacher wearing them at school.
Eyelash\n\nAn eyelash is a tiny hair that grows on the edge of your eyelid. It is short and curved. You have many eyelashes on your top lid and your bottom lid. It helps keep dust and tiny bits out of your eye. When you blink, it moves like a little brush. Sometimes a loose one falls on your cheek, and you can make a wish and blow it away.
Fable\n\nA fable is a short story that teaches a lesson. It often has animals that talk and act like people. You can find fables in books or hear them told out loud. A fable helps you learn what is right and wrong. One famous fable is about a boy who cried wolf. He tricked people, and when a real wolf came, no one helped him.
Fabric\n\nFabric is a soft, flat thing made from many tiny threads. It can be smooth like a bed sheet or fuzzy like a towel. You find it on your bed, on your couch, and in your clothes. People use it to make shirts, pants, dresses, and blankets. When you wear a cozy sweater or wrap up in a warm blanket, that is fabric.
Face\n\nA face is the front part of your head. It has your eyes, nose, mouth, and ears. You use your eyes to see, your nose to smell, and your mouth to eat and talk. Your face also has cheeks that can turn pink when you are happy or hot. When you look in a mirror, you see your own face. Every face is a little different, and that is how we know who is who.
Fact\n\nA fact is something that is true. It is a real thing that you can check. You can find facts in books or by looking with your own eyes. For example, it is a fact that the sky is blue on a sunny day. A fact is not the same as a feeling or a guess.
Factor\n\nA factor is a part of something bigger. It is like a piece that helps make the whole thing. You can find factors in math, where numbers break into smaller numbers that multiply together. For example, 2 and 3 are factors of 6 because 2 times 3 makes 6. In life, a factor is a reason why something happens, like rain being a factor that makes flowers grow.
Factory\n\nA factory is a big building where people and machines make many things. It has tall smokestacks, loud noises, and long moving belts. You can find factories near cities or big roads. Inside, workers and machines put parts together to make cars, toys, clothes, and food. A long time ago, a man named Henry Ford made a special line where each person did one small job, and the car moved from one person to the next. This made building cars much faster. But factories can also make dirty smoke that hurts the air and water. Some factories are now so smart that machines do all the work, and no people are inside.
Fahrenheit\n\nFahrenheit is a way to tell how hot or cold something is. It uses numbers, like 32 for when water turns to ice and 212 for when water boils. People in the United States often use it to check the weather outside. It is less common in other parts of the world, where a different way called Celsius is used more.
Fair\n\nA fair is a happy place where people go to have fun. It has bright lights, music, and many rides that spin and go fast. You can find a fair in a big open field or a parking lot. At a fair, you can play games to win a toy, eat sweet treats like cotton candy, and ride a big wheel that goes high in the sky. Sometimes a fair has animals to pet or a show with clowns. A fair comes to town for a few days and then it moves away.
Fairly\n\nFairly means doing things in a way that is right and equal. When you share a cookie with a friend and both get the same size, you act fairly. It is the opposite of being mean or taking more than your share. In a game, everyone follows the same rules to play fairly. A teacher who listens to all children and does not pick favorites acts fairly.
Fairness\n\nFairness means everyone gets the same chance. It is when you share toys so each friend has a turn. You see it at school when the teacher gives every child one cookie. It is not about getting the same thing, but about what each person needs. When you play a game and follow the rules, that is fairness.
Fairy\n\nA fairy is a tiny, magic person with wings. It looks like a very small girl or woman and can fly in the air. You can find fairies in storybooks and make-believe tales. One fairy you might know is the Tooth Fairy. She comes at night when a child loses a tooth. She takes the tooth and leaves a small coin or a treat under the pillow. Some stories say fairies live in hidden places like woods or caves. They use magic to do kind or tricky things.
Fairy tale\n\nA fairy tale is a short made-up story. It often has magic, talking animals, and brave people like princes or princesses. You can find it in a book or hear it when someone reads out loud. It is told to make you feel happy, scared, or excited. Many children know stories like "Cinderella" or "The Three Little Pigs."
Faith\n\nFaith is when you believe in something even if you cannot see it or touch it. It is a feeling inside your heart. You can have faith in people, like trusting your mom will pick you up from school. Many people have faith in a higher power or God. It helps them feel safe and not alone.
Falcon\n\nA falcon is a strong bird that hunts other animals. It has pointy wings and a long tail. Its back is dark gray or brown, and its belly is white. It lives in many places around the world. It flies very fast and catches small birds in the air. Some people train it to help them hunt. Long ago, this was for food, but now it is a game.
Falkland Islands\n\nThe Falkland Islands are a group of islands far away in the big blue sea. They are near the bottom of the world, close to a place called South America. It has two big islands and many tiny ones. The land is rocky and windy, with hills and not many trees. People live there in a small town. They keep sheep and catch fish from the sea. Many penguins and birds also live on the islands. It is a quiet place with cold weather and lots of clouds.
Fall\n\nFall is a time of year when the air gets cool. It comes after summer and before winter. The leaves on trees turn red, yellow, and orange, then fall to the ground. You can find it outside in parks and yards. People wear sweaters and pick apples in fall. It is a good time to jump in big piles of leaves.
False\n\nFalse means something is not true. It is the opposite of true. When you say the sky is green, that is false because the sky is really blue. In a game, if you guess a number and it is wrong, your guess is false. A story that is made up and not real is also false.
Family\n\nA family is a group of people who love and take care of each other. It often has a mom, a dad, and children. Some families have only one parent. Other families have grandparents, aunts, uncles, and cousins all living together. They share a home, food, and happy times. A family makes you feel safe and warm.
Family name\n\nA family name is a name that people in the same family share. It is the last part of your full name. In many places, children get it from their dad. When a mom and dad get married, the mom often takes the dad's family name. For example, if your dad's family name is Kim, you might be called [Your Name] Kim. It helps people know which family you belong to.
Famine\n\nFamine is a time when many people do not have enough food. It happens in places where food is very hard to find. People feel hungry and weak, and they can get very sick. Sometimes it happens when rain does not fall and plants cannot grow. Other times it happens when there is a war. When there is a famine, kind people from far away may send food to help.
Famous\n\nFamous means many people know who you are. It is like when everyone in your class knows your name, but for the whole world. A famous person might be on TV, in a movie, or sing a song you hear on the radio. They can also be in a book or on a big sign. Sometimes people ask them for a picture or a name on paper.
Fan\n\nA fan is a thing that moves air to make you feel cool. It has blades that spin around very fast. You can find it in a house, a school, or a store on a hot day. People turn it on when they feel warm, and it blows a soft wind. Some fans sit on a table, and some hang from the ceiling.
Fan (person)\n\nA fan is a person who really likes something. It can be a sports team, a singer, a movie, or a book. A fan cheers for a team at a game or sings along at a music show. Sometimes fans meet in big groups to talk about what they love. A fan may wear a shirt with a team name or put up a poster of a star. It feels happy when it sees or hears the thing it likes.
Fandom\n\nFandom is a big group of people who all love the same thing. It can be about a book, a movie, a game, a sports team, or a famous person. People in a fandom like to talk about what they love, draw pictures, write stories, and sometimes dress up like the characters. You might see a fandom at a movie theater when many fans wear the same T-shirt and cheer together.
Fantasy\n\nFantasy is a kind of make-believe story. It has magic and things that cannot happen in real life. You might find it in a book, a movie, or a game. In it, people can fly, animals can talk, and a wand can make things appear. A story like Cinderella is a fantasy because a fairy helps her go to the ball.
Far\n\nFar means something is a long way away. It is the opposite of close. When you look at a mountain that is far, it looks very small. A far sound is quiet and hard to hear. You might walk far to get to the park, and your legs feel tired.
Faraway\n\nFaraway means something is a long, long way from where you are. It is not close, so you cannot touch it or see it well. A faraway place might be a mountain you see from your window, or a friend's house in another town. When you look at the sky at night, the stars are faraway. You can think of faraway as the opposite of near.
Farm\n\nA farm is a big piece of land where people grow food. It has fields for plants and barns for animals. Farmers work on it every day. They plant seeds, water them, and pick the food when it is ready. Some farms have cows, pigs, or chickens. The food from a farm goes to stores so we can buy it and eat it. You might see a farm when you ride in a car past big open fields.
Farmer\n\nA farmer is a person who grows food and takes care of animals. He works on a big piece of land called a farm. On the farm, he plants seeds in the dirt. The seeds grow into plants like corn, tomatoes, and apples. He also feeds animals like cows, chickens, and pigs. The cows give milk, and the chickens give eggs. When the food is ready, he picks it and sends it to stores. People buy the food to eat at home. You might see a farmer at a market selling fresh fruits and vegetables.
Faroe Islands\n\nThe Faroe Islands are a group of small islands in the big, cold ocean. They are far north, between other lands. It has green hills, tall cliffs, and many sheep. People live in small towns and fish in the sea. They also raise sheep and welcome visitors. The weather is often windy and foggy. Many birds fly over the islands and seals swim near the shore.
Fashion\n\nFashion is the way people dress and look. It is about the clothes, shoes, and hair we choose. In cold places, people wear warm coats and boots. In hot places, they wear light shirts and sandals. Fashion changes over time. Long ago, people wore big dresses and tall hats. Today, many people wear jeans and t-shirts. You can see fashion at home, at school, and on the street. When you pick your favorite shirt or put on a funny hat, you are using fashion too.
Fast\n\nFast means moving or happening very quickly. It is the opposite of slow. A cheetah is fast because it can run faster than a car on a small road. When you run as quick as you can, you are fast. A fast song has a quick beat that makes you want to dance. Some things are so fast you can hardly see them, like a hummingbird's wings.
Fast food\n\nFast food is food that is made very fast. You can get it at a shop and eat it right away. It often comes in a paper bag or a box. Some fast food is a burger with a meat patty and a bun. Other fast food is fried chicken or pizza. Many people like it because it tastes good and is quick. But if you eat too much, it can make your body feel bad. It is better to eat it only once in a while.
Fastener\n\nA fastener is a small tool that holds two things together. It can be a button, a zipper, a snap, or a clip. You find it on your clothes, your backpack, or your lunch box. It keeps things closed so they do not fall open. When you zip up your jacket, you use a fastener.
Fasting\n\nFasting is when a person chooses not to eat any food for a while. Sometimes they also do not drink water. People do it for different reasons. Some do it because their religion tells them to. Others do it to show they are upset about something, like a rule they think is wrong. Some people skip meals at certain times to help their body feel lighter. It is important to be safe and not go too long without food or water.
Fat\n\nFat is a part of many foods we eat. It can be solid like butter or liquid like oil. You find it in meat, milk, nuts, and fried snacks. It gives your body energy to run and play. It also helps keep you warm when it is cold outside. But eating too much fat can make your body feel heavy and tired. Some fats are better for you, like the kind in fish and avocados. Other fats, like the kind in many cookies and chips, are not so good. So it is smart to eat just a little bit of fat each day.
Father\n\nA father is a man who has a child. He is also called dad or daddy. He helps take care of his child by giving food, a home, and love. He plays with the child and keeps them safe. A father can be the man who helped make the baby, or a man who raises a child even if he did not make the baby. In many families, he works together with the mother to help the child grow happy and strong.
Fault (geology)\n\nA fault is a big crack in the hard ground under our feet. It is like a giant split in a rock. Sometimes the two sides of the crack slide past each other. When they move, the ground can shake. That shaking is called an earthquake. A fault can be very deep, and we cannot see most of it. But sometimes a fault makes a tall, steep hill or a cliff that we can see. People who study the ground look at faults to learn about earthquakes.
Favorite\n\nA favorite is something you like the most. It can be a toy, a color, a food, or a game. When you have many things, your favorite is the one that makes you happiest. You might pick a favorite book at bedtime or a favorite shirt to wear. Everyone has favorites, and they can be different for each person.
Favourite\n\nA favourite is something you like the most. It can be a toy, a color, a food, or a song. When you have many things, your favourite is the one that makes you happiest. You might have a favourite blanket that feels soft, or a favourite story you ask for again and again. Everyone has different favourites, and that is okay.
Fear\n\nFear is a big feeling you get when something seems scary. It makes your heart beat fast and your body feel tight. You might feel it when you see a big dog or when it is very dark. It tells you to be careful and stay safe. Sometimes it helps you run away from danger. But it can also stop you from trying new things, like saying hi to a new friend. Everyone feels fear sometimes, and that is okay.
Feather\n\nA feather is a soft thing that covers a bird. It has a stiff middle part and many tiny soft hairs on the sides. It grows on a bird’s body and wings. It keeps the bird warm and helps it fly. Some feathers are small and fluffy, like the ones on a baby chick. People use soft feathers inside pillows and blankets to make them cozy.
February\n\nFebruary is a month of the year. It is the second month after January. It has 28 days, but every four years it gets one extra day and has 29. It is a winter month in many places, so it can be cold and snowy. People celebrate Valentine's Day in February with hearts and cards.
Federated States of Micronesia\n\nThe Federated States of Micronesia is a country made of many small islands. It sits in the big blue ocean, far from big lands. People live on these islands in small towns. They fish in the sea and grow food like coconuts. The weather is warm and sunny all year. Long ago, people from far away came to these islands. Now the country is friends with a bigger country that helps keep it safe.
Federation\n\nA federation is a big group of smaller places that join together. Each smaller place can make its own rules for some things. But they all share one big boss for things that matter to everyone. The United States is one example. It has many states that work together but also make their own choices. Other places like Canada and Australia are federations too.
Fee\n\nA fee is money you pay to get something or to do something. It is like a small price. You might pay a fee to ride a bus or to go into a zoo. Sometimes you pay a fee to a person who helps you, like a doctor. It is not a toy or a thing you can hold—it is just the money part.
Feeble\n\nA feeble is a made-up word for something very weak. It is like a tiny baby bird that cannot fly yet. You might see a feeble little plant that needs water to stand up straight. It does not have much strength, so it can fall over easily. A soft whisper is a feeble sound because it is hard to hear.
Feed\n\nFeed means to give food to someone or something. You can feed a pet, like a dog or a cat, by putting food in its bowl. A mom or dad feeds a baby with a spoon or a bottle. On a farm, a farmer feeds the animals hay or grain. When you are hungry, someone feeds you a meal.
Feel\n\nA feel is something you have inside your heart or your head. It can be happy, sad, angry, or scared. You find it when something happens, like getting a hug or losing a toy. It tells you what you like and what you do not like. When you smile, that is a happy feel. When you cry, that is a sad feel.
Feeling\n\nA feeling is something you have inside your heart and head. It can be happy, sad, angry, or scared. You feel it when something good or bad happens. A smile shows a happy feeling. Tears show a sad feeling. Everyone has feelings every day.
Feet\n\nFeet are the parts at the end of your legs. They help you stand, walk, and run. Each foot has five toes, a heel, and a soft bottom. You put shoes and socks on them to keep them safe and warm. When you jump, your feet push you off the ground.
Felt\n\nFelt is a soft, thick cloth. It is made by pressing tiny threads together until they stick. You can find it in many colors at a craft store. People use it to make hats, warm rugs, and fun shapes for art. It feels fuzzy and does not have a criss-cross pattern like your jeans. You might have a felt puppet or a felt board at school.
Female\n\nFemale is one of the two kinds of bodies people and animals can have. A female body can grow a tiny egg inside. When the egg meets a seed from a male, a baby can start to grow. In people, a grown-up female is called a woman. She has a body that is a little different from a man. She has breasts that can make milk to feed a baby. She also has wider hips to help when a baby is born. Many animals have females too, like a mother dog or a mother cat.
Feminism\n\nFeminism is the idea that girls and boys should be treated the same. It says that women and men should have the same chances in life. A long time ago, women could not vote or have many jobs. People who believed in feminism worked hard to change that. Now, in many places, women can vote, work, and be leaders. Feminism also says that everyone should be free to be who they are. It is about being fair to all people, no matter if they are a girl or a boy.
Fence\n\nA fence is a kind of wall that stands around a place. It is often made of wood or metal. You can see it around a garden, a farm, or a house. It keeps animals inside or stops them from coming in. Some fences are short, and some are tall. A fence has posts that hold it up. It does not have a deep bottom like a big wall.
Fencing\n\nFencing is a sport where two people play with swords. It uses three kinds of swords: a light one, a heavy one, and a curved one. Players wear a white suit, a mask, and a glove to stay safe. They try to touch the other player with the sword to get a point. A judge watches to see who gets the touch first. You can see fencing at big sports games or in movies with knights.
Fennel\n\nFennel is a plant that people can eat. It has a round white part at the bottom, green stalks, and small yellow flowers. You can find it growing in warm places near the sea. People use the round part in salads and the tiny seeds to add a sweet taste to food. The seeds smell a little like licorice candy.
Fern\n\nA fern is a green plant with many soft, feathery leaves. It does not grow flowers or seeds. Instead, it makes tiny dust-like specks called spores under its leaves. It likes to live in cool, shady, wet places like forests or near streams. You may see a fern in a garden or in a pot inside a house. Its leaves unroll slowly as they grow, like a little green curl opening up.
Ferry\n\nA ferry is a big boat that carries people and cars across water. It moves back and forth between two places, like a floating bus. You can find it on rivers, lakes, and the sea. People use it to go to work, visit family, or go on a trip. Some ferries are small and some are very big, with space for many cars and trucks. You might see one if you live near the water or go on a boat ride.
Fertile\n\nFertile means something can grow new life. It is a word for soil, land, or a living thing. When soil is fertile, seeds can grow into strong plants. A fertile animal can have babies. A farmer likes fertile ground because it gives lots of food.
Fertilizer\n\nFertilizer is food for plants. It looks like tiny grains or powder, and people sprinkle it on the dirt. It helps grass, flowers, and vegetables grow tall and strong. Farmers put it on big fields, and you might see a bag of it at a garden store. When a plant gets fertilizer, its leaves turn bright green and it makes more flowers or fruit.
Festival\n\nA festival is a big, happy party where many people come together. It can happen outside in a park or on a street. People sing, dance, and eat yummy food at it. Sometimes there are bright lights and loud music. A festival can last one day or many days. You might see a parade with big floats and people in colorful clothes. It is a time to have fun and feel joy with others.
Fetch\n\nFetch is a game you play with a dog. You throw a ball or a stick, and the dog runs to get it. The dog picks it up with its mouth and brings it back to you. You can play fetch in a park or in a yard. It makes the dog happy and gives it good exercise.
Fever\n\nA fever is when your body gets too hot. It feels like your head and skin are warm. You might get it when you are sick. A grown-up can check it with a small tool that beeps. Rest and cool water help it go away.
Few\n\nFew means a small number of things. If you have three cookies and your friend has ten, you have few cookies. It is the opposite of many. When you see only a little bit of something, you can say there are few of them.
Fibre\n\nA fibre is a long, thin, bendy piece of stuff. It looks like a tiny hair or a piece of thread. You can find it in many places. Some come from plants, like the soft white fluff on a cotton ball. Some come from animals, like the wool on a sheep. People twist many fibres together to make string or rope. They also weave them to make cloth for shirts and pants. A sweater you wear in winter is made from fibres.
Fiction\n\nFiction is a made-up story. It comes from someone's imagination, not from real life. You can find it in books, on TV, or in movies. It has people in it called characters, and they do things that make a story. The story has a problem that the characters try to fix. A fairy tale is a kind of fiction you might know.
Fictional universe\n\nA fictional universe is a made-up world for stories. It is not real, but it feels real when you read a book or watch a movie. You can find it in books, TV shows, movies, and games. It has its own rules, like magic or talking animals, that are different from our world. For example, the world of Harry Potter is a fictional universe with wizards and a school called Hogwarts.
Field\n\nA field is a big open piece of land. It has lots of grass and sometimes flowers. You can find it in the countryside, away from tall buildings. Farmers use it to grow food like corn or wheat. Cows and sheep eat the grass there. You might see a field when you ride in a car past farms.
Field hockey\n\nField hockey is a game played on a big grassy field. It has two teams, and each team has 11 players. They use a stick shaped like a J to hit a small hard ball. The stick is made of wood and other strong stuff. At each end of the field there is a goal. Players try to hit the ball into the other team's goal to score a point. One player on each team stands in front of the goal to stop the ball. That player is called the goalkeeper. The game is played in four short parts with breaks in between. People play field hockey in many places around the world.
Field research\n\nField research is when people go outside to learn about things. It happens in real places like a forest, a park, or a busy street. A scientist might watch birds in a tree to see what they eat. Another person might talk to people at a market to learn what they like to buy. They write down what they see and hear. Later, they use those notes to understand how things work in the real world.
FIFA World Cup\n\nThe FIFA World Cup is a big soccer game that happens every four years. It is a time when the best soccer teams from many countries play against each other. People all over the world watch it on TV. The team that wins gets a shiny gold cup. Brazil has won it five times, more than any other country. The games take place in one country that is chosen before. Many teams try to get in, but only some make it to the final games. It is a very happy and loud event with lots of cheering.
Fifteen\n\nFifteen is a number. It comes after fourteen and before sixteen. You can count to it on your fingers and toes. If you have fifteen crayons, you have a big bunch to color with. It is also how old some big kids are.
Fig\n\nA fig is a soft, sweet fruit. It has thin skin and many tiny seeds inside. It grows on a tree in warm places. People eat it fresh or dried. Sometimes it is made into jam. A fig can be a tasty snack.
Fight\n\nA fight is when two people or animals push, hit, or yell at each other. It can happen with hands, feet, or loud words. You might see a fight on a playground when children are angry. It is not a nice way to solve a problem. It is better to use calm words and ask a grown-up for help.
Fighter aircraft\n\nA fighter aircraft is a small, fast plane that fights in the sky. It has a pointy nose and strong wings. People who fly it are called pilots. They use it to chase other planes and keep the sky safe. It can carry things that shoot, like small rockets and fast bullets. Some of them also help soldiers on the ground. It can turn very quickly to stay safe.
Figure\n\nA figure is a shape or form you can see. It can be a drawing of a person, an animal, or a thing. You might see it in a book, on a wall, or in a puzzle. Some figures are flat, like a circle or a square. Others are round and solid, like a ball or a block. When you play with blocks, you stack different figures to make a tower.
Figure skating\n\nFigure skating is a way of moving on ice with music. It is like dancing on ice. People who do it wear special shoes with a thin metal blade on the bottom. They glide, spin around very fast, and jump high in the air. Sometimes one person skates alone. Sometimes two people skate together and hold hands. You can see it on TV when the Winter Olympics are on. The skaters wear pretty clothes that sparkle.
Fiji\n\nFiji is a country made of many islands in the big blue ocean. It has over 300 islands, but only some have people living on them. The biggest island is called Viti Levu, and the main city is Suva. People in Fiji speak different languages, like Fijian and English. Many visitors come to Fiji to see the warm, clear water and the pretty fish. They can swim and look at the colorful rocks under the sea. Fiji is a sunny place with lots of trees and beaches.
Fill\n\nFill is a word that means to put something into an empty space. You can fill a cup with water or a box with toys. When you fill something, it is not empty anymore. It is full.
Film\n\nA film is a moving picture that tells a story. It is made of many tiny pictures shown very fast, one after the other. You can watch it on a big screen at a movie theater or on a TV at home. People in a film talk, sing, and do things, just like in a play. A film can make you laugh, feel happy, or sometimes a little scared. You might see a film about animals, superheroes, or a princess.
Filter\n\nA filter is a tool that takes out things you do not want. It can be a piece of paper, a small screen, or a special part inside a machine. You can find it in many places. In the kitchen, a coffee filter keeps the wet grounds out of your drink. In a fish tank, a filter cleans the water so the fish stay healthy. At the pool, a big filter pulls out leaves and dirt. Some filters work with sound or light, like the one in a radio that picks one song from many. A filter helps keep only the good stuff.
Fin\n\nA fin is a flat body part that helps an animal swim. It sticks out from the side or back of a fish. It looks like a thin fan or a small wing. A fish moves its fin to go left, right, up, or down in the water. You can see fins on a goldfish in a bowl or on a big shark in the ocean.
Final\n\nFinal is the very last part of something. It is the end, when nothing comes after. You see it at the end of a race, when the fastest runner crosses the line. In a game, the final score tells who won. At school, the final bell means it is time to go home.
Finally\n\nFinally means at the end, after waiting. It is a word we use when something happens last. You might hear it in a story when the hero wins after a long trip. At home, you wait for cookies to bake, and finally the timer rings. It feels good when something you want finally comes.
Finance\n\nFinance is about money. It is the way people think about saving money, spending money, and sharing money. When you put coins in a piggy bank, that is saving. When you buy a toy at the store, that is spending. Big places like banks keep money safe for many people. Mom and Dad use finance every day when they pay for food and bills.
Finch\n\nA finch is a small bird that sings pretty songs. It has a short, strong beak for eating seeds. You can see it in trees, bushes, and sometimes at a bird feeder in a yard. It pecks at seeds and flies from branch to branch. Some finches are bright yellow, red, or brown. A child might spot one hopping on the grass looking for food.
Find\n\nFind means to look for something and then see it. When you play hide-and-seek, you try to find your friends. You can find a lost toy under the bed. You can also find a pretty rock on the ground. Finding something makes you feel happy.
Fine\n\nFine means something is very good or okay. When you draw a picture and it looks nice, you can say it is fine. If you fall down but you are not hurt, you can say you are fine. Sometimes a grown-up says "That is fine" to mean they are not upset.
Finger\n\nA finger is a long, thin part of your hand. It has small bones inside that help it bend. You have five of them on each hand. The thumb is the short, thick one that can touch the other fingers. It helps you hold a spoon, a crayon, or a toy. The other four are longer and have three little bones each. You use them to point, to pick up small things, and to feel if something is soft or hard. When you wave hello, your fingers move together.
Fingerprint\n\nA fingerprint is a tiny pattern on the tip of your finger. It looks like little lines that go round and round. Every person has a different pattern, so no two people have the same one. You can see it when you press your finger on a window or a shiny table. Police and helpers use it to know who a person is. Some phones and doors open when they see your fingerprint.
Finish\n\nFinish means something is all done. It is when you stop doing a job or a game. When you eat all your food, your plate is finished. You can say "I finish my drawing" when the picture is ready. At the end of a race, the first person to cross the line is the finish.
Finland\n\nFinland is a country far up north in Europe. It has many trees, lakes, and islands. The weather is cold in winter and warm in summer. People there speak Finnish and Swedish. Many people like to go to a hot room called a sauna. In the very north, you can see colorful lights in the sky at night.
Fir\n\nA fir is a tall tree that stays green all year. It has thin, pointy leaves that look like little needles. The tree grows a sticky, gooey juice inside its trunk. You can find it in forests or in parks. People sometimes use its wood to make flat boards for building things inside a house. Many people also plant a fir in their yard because it looks pretty. At Christmas time, some families bring a small fir inside and put lights and shiny balls on it.
Fire\n\nFire is a hot, bright thing that can burn. It is made of light and heat. You can see it in a candle, a campfire, or a stove. It helps people cook food and stay warm on cold days. But it can also hurt you if you touch it, so you must be very careful. Firefighters are people who stop big fires and keep us safe.
Fire ant\n\nA fire ant is a tiny red-brown bug that lives in big groups. It has six legs, a head, and a sharp stinger on its back end. You find it in warm places like dirt, grass, and near sidewalks. It stings to protect its home, and the sting hurts a lot and makes a red bump. If you see a mound of dirt in a yard, that might be a fire ant home. Do not touch it!
Firearm\n\nA firearm is a tool that shoots a small metal piece very fast. It is made of hard metal and has a long tube called a barrel. Police officers and soldiers sometimes carry one to keep people safe. It makes a very loud bang when it shoots. You should never touch one without a grown-up.
Firefighter\n\nA firefighter is a person who helps put out fires. He wears a big heavy coat, tall boots, and a hard hat to stay safe. You can see him at a fire station with a big red truck. He uses a long hose to spray water on the fire. He also helps people and animals get out of burning buildings. Sometimes he visits schools to teach kids about fire safety.
Firefighting\n\nFirefighting is the job of stopping big fires. A firefighter is a person who does this job. They wear a heavy coat, a hard hat, and boots to stay safe. They ride in a big red truck with a loud siren. When they get to a fire, they use a long hose to spray water on the flames. The water makes the fire cool and weak so it goes out. They also save people and pets from burning buildings. You might see a fire truck at a parade or hear its siren on the street.
Firefly\n\nA firefly is a small bug that can make its own light. It has a soft body, six legs, and two wings. You can see it at night in warm, wet places like near a pond or in a field. It flashes its light to find a friend. The light is a yellow-green glow that turns on and off. Some people call it a lightning bug. When you catch one in your hand, it feels light and tickly.
Fireplace\n\nA fireplace is a special place in a house where you can make a fire. It is made of hard bricks or metal. It has a big open space to hold the fire, and a tall pipe called a chimney that takes the smoke up and out of the house. Long ago, people used it to keep warm and to cook food. Now, many people use it to feel cozy and watch the flames dance. You might see one in a living room or in a storybook about a snowy day.
Firework\n\nA firework is a bright, colorful light that shoots up into the night sky. It makes a loud boom and then bursts into many tiny sparkles. People light it on special days like New Year's Eve or a big party. You can see it high above houses and trees, painting the dark with red, green, gold, and blue. It is loud, so sometimes little kids cover their ears. After the boom, it fades away like magic.
Fireworks display\n\nA fireworks display is a show of bright lights and loud sounds in the night sky. It uses small rockets that shoot up high and burst into colors like red, green, and gold. You can see it on special days like New Year's Eve or a big party. People watch it outside and say 'ooh' and 'aah' when the sky sparkles. It makes a boom and a crackle that you can feel in your chest.
First\n\nFirst means before all others. It is the spot at the very front of a line. When you race with friends, the one who gets to the end first wins. You might be first in line for a slide at the park. Being first feels exciting.
First aid\n\nFirst aid is helping someone who is hurt or sick right away. It is what you do before a doctor or a grown-up helper comes. You can use a small box called a first aid kit, but you do not always need one. It can be done at home, at the park, or anywhere someone needs help. For example, if a friend falls and scrapes a knee, you can help by cleaning the cut and putting on a bandage.
Fish\n\nA fish is an animal that lives in water. It has a long body covered with small, flat pieces called scales. It breathes by taking water in through its mouth and pushing it out through slits on the side of its head. Most fish have fins to help them swim. You can find fish in the ocean, in lakes, and in rivers. Some fish are tiny, and some are very big. People catch fish to eat, and some people keep small, colorful fish in a glass tank at home.
Fish as food\n\nFish is a food that comes from the water. It has soft, white or pink meat inside. People cook it in many ways, like baking, frying, or grilling. You can find it at the store or at a restaurant. Eating fish helps your body grow strong because it has good stuff called protein. Some fish, like salmon, have special oils that are good for your heart.
Fishing\n\nFishing is when people try to catch fish. It can happen in the sea, a lake, or a river. People use a long stick called a rod, a string, and a hook to catch fish. Some people fish from a boat, and some stand on the shore. It gives us food to eat, like fish for dinner. Some people fish just for fun and let the fish go after they catch it.
Fishing industry\n\nThe fishing industry is all the work people do to bring fish from the water to your plate. It includes catching fish in the sea, rivers, or lakes. Some people do it for fun, and some do it as their job. Big boats go far out to catch many fish at once. Then the fish are cleaned, cut, and packed in ice so they stay fresh. Trucks and planes carry the fish to stores and markets. Many people around the world eat fish every day because of this work.
Fist\n\nA fist is a hand with all the fingers curled in tight. It looks like a small, round ball at the end of your arm. You can make a fist by bending your fingers and thumb. People sometimes make a fist to show they are strong or to bump a friend's fist as a hello. A fist can also hold things like a toy or a spoon very tightly.
Fit\n\nFit means something is the right size or shape for a person or a place. When you try on a shirt and it is not too big and not too small, it fits you. A puzzle piece fits when it goes into the right spot. Shoes that are too tight do not fit well. You can also say a person is fit when they are strong and healthy from running and playing.
Five\n\nFive is a number. It comes after four and before six. You can count five fingers on one hand. A starfish often has five arms. When you see five dots on a dice, you know it is five.
Five Pillars of Islam\n\nThe Five Pillars of Islam are five important rules for people who follow Islam. They are like five big jobs that Muslims try to do. One job is to say a special sentence about God. Another job is to pray five times every day. A third job is to give a little money to help people who need it. A fourth job is to not eat or drink during the day for one whole month. The last job is to visit a special city called Mecca one time in life. These five jobs help Muslims feel close to God and be kind to others.
Fix\n\nFix means to make something broken work again. When a toy stops moving, you can fix it with glue or new batteries. A grown-up might fix a flat tire on a bike. People also fix food, like making a sandwich. Fixing things helps keep them nice and useful.
Fixed-wing aircraft\n\nA fixed-wing aircraft is a big machine that flies in the sky. It has two long flat wings that do not flap. It also has a long body, a tail, and wheels under it. You can see it at an airport, where it takes off and lands on a long road. It carries people and boxes from one city to another very fast. A trip that takes a week on a boat takes only a few hours in it. Some of them are used by soldiers to keep a country safe. A glider is one without an engine that rides on the wind.
Fizz\n\nFizz is a soft, bubbly sound. It sounds like tiny bubbles popping one after another. You can hear it when you open a can of soda or when you pour a fizzy drink into a glass. It also happens when you drop a bath bomb into water. The sound is quick and tickles your ears.
Fizzy\n\nFizzy means full of tiny bubbles that tickle your tongue. It feels like a soft pop-pop-pop in your mouth. You find it in drinks like soda or sparkling water. When you open a fizzy drink, you hear a hiss and see bubbles rise up. It makes a drink fun and tingly to sip.
Fjord\n\nA fjord is a long, narrow part of the sea that goes deep into the land. It has tall, steep walls of rock on both sides. It was made a long time ago by big, slow rivers of ice. You can find it in cold places like Norway and Canada. Boats can sail into it, and people build towns near the water. The water is very deep and often looks dark blue or green.
Flag\n\nA flag is a piece of cloth with colors and a picture on it. It hangs from a tall stick called a pole. You can see it flying high outside a school, a big building, or in a parade. It stands for a country or a group of people. For example, the flag of Japan is white with a big red circle in the middle. The red circle looks like the sun. People wave a flag to show they are happy and proud.
Flame\n\nA flame is the bright, hot part of a fire. It is often yellow, orange, or red, and it dances and flickers. You can see it on a candle, a match, or a campfire. It gives us light and warmth. But it is very hot, so you must never touch it. When you blow on a small flame, it can go out.
Flamenco\n\nFlamenco is a kind of show with music, singing, and dancing. It has guitar playing, hand clapping, and feet stomping. People do it in Spain, and it is very famous there. A man and a woman dance in pretty clothes. The dance can be fast or slow, and it gets very exciting near the end. You might see it at a big party or on a stage.
Flamingo\n\nA flamingo is a tall bird with long, thin legs. It has pink or red feathers and a curved beak that looks like a banana. It lives near lakes and water, standing in big groups. It eats tiny things in the water that make its feathers pink. It often stands on one leg to rest. You might see one at a zoo or in a picture book.
Flap\n\nA flap is a flat piece that hangs from one side. It can move up and down. You see a flap on an envelope—it is the part you fold to close it. Some hats have ear flaps that keep your ears warm. A dog door often has a flap that swings when a pet goes through.
Flare\n\nA flare is a bright, hot light that shoots up into the sky. It looks like a big, colorful spark that burns for a short time. People use it on a boat or in the mountains to call for help when they are lost. You might see one far away at night, like a red or orange star falling slowly. It is not a toy—only grown-ups should use it.
Flash\n\nA flash is a very quick, bright light. It happens fast and then goes away. You might see a flash when someone takes a picture with a camera. Lightning in the sky is a big flash during a storm. A flashlight makes a flash when you turn it on and off quickly.
Flat\n\nA flat is a home where people live. It is a set of rooms inside a bigger building. Many flats are in tall buildings in a city. It has a door, windows, a kitchen, a bathroom, and a place to sleep. Some families live in a flat together. You might see a flat when you visit a friend who lives in an apartment building.
Flatfish\n\nA flatfish is a fish that is very flat, like a pancake. It has both eyes on one side of its head. It lives at the bottom of the ocean and hides in the sand. It can change its color to look like the sand or rocks around it. Some flatfish are flounder, sole, and halibut. People catch them to eat.
Flatworm\n\nA flatworm is a tiny animal with a soft, flat body. It looks like a thin, squishy ribbon. You can find it in water like ponds or rivers, and sometimes in wet dirt. Some flatworms live inside other animals and can make them sick. One kind came to new places by accident and ate many earthworms there.
Flavor\n\nFlavor is how food or drink tastes in your mouth. It can be sweet like candy, sour like a lemon, salty like a chip, or bitter like dark chocolate. Your tongue feels the flavor when you eat. Some foods have one flavor, and some have many flavors mixed together. Ice cream comes in many flavors like strawberry, chocolate, and vanilla.
Flax\n\nFlax is a plant with pretty blue flowers. It grows tall and thin with small green leaves. People grow it in fields to use its parts. From the stem, they make soft cloth called linen. From the seeds, they make oil for wood and paint. Some paper money is made from it too. You might see a flax flower in a garden or a shirt made from its stem.
Flea\n\nA flea is a tiny bug that lives on animals like dogs and cats. It has a small, flat body and strong legs that help it jump very far. You can find it outside in tall grass or sand. It bites the skin to drink a little blood, which makes a red bump that feels itchy. Some fleas live on rats, and long ago they carried a sickness that made many people very sick.
Fleet\n\nA fleet is a big group of boats or ships that move together. It can also be a group of cars or trucks that belong to one company. You might see a fleet of fishing boats at the harbor, all painted the same color. A fleet of delivery trucks brings packages to many houses. The boats or trucks in a fleet work as a team.
Flick\n\nA flick is a quick, light hit with your finger. It looks like a fast snap or tap. You can do it by pressing your thumb and middle finger together and then letting go. People use a flick to move a small bug off a table or to send a paper ball flying. You might see a flick when someone plays a game with marbles or when a grown-up taps a light switch.
Flight\n\nFlight is moving through the air. It happens when a bird, a bug, or a plane goes up and stays up. A bird flaps its wings to push against the air and lift its body. A plane has big metal wings and engines that help it go fast and high. You can see flight when a butterfly flutters in the garden or when a big jet leaves a white line in the sky.
Flip\n\nFlip is when something turns over fast. It can be a toy, a pancake, or even your body. You see a flip when a pancake flies up in a pan and lands on its other side. Some kids do a flip in the water at the pool. A flip is quick and fun to watch.
Float\n\nTo float is to stay on top of water without sinking. It looks like lying very still on your back or tummy. You can do it in a pool, a lake, or the sea. When you float, the water holds you up and you do not go under. A rubber duck in the bathtub is a good example of something that floats.
Flood\n\nA flood is when too much water covers the land. It happens after very heavy rain or when a river spills over its sides. The water can fill streets and even come into houses. During a flood, people move to high places to stay safe. The water is often dirty and not good to drink. After the water goes away, things can be muddy and broken.
Floodplain\n\nA floodplain is flat land next to a river. It gets covered with water when the river gets too full. The water leaves behind soft, rich dirt that helps plants grow. Farmers like to grow food on it because the dirt is so good. You might see tall grass or corn growing there. Sometimes people build small walls called levees to keep the water away from houses.
Floor\n\nA floor is the flat part of a room that you walk on. It is under your feet when you are inside a house or a building. It can be made of wood, stone, or soft carpet. Some floors are shiny and smooth, and some are bumpy. In a big building, the word floor also means a whole level, like the first floor or the second floor. You take stairs or an elevator to go up to another floor. At a gym, people do jumps and rolls on a special soft floor.
Florence\n\nFlorence is a big city in a country called Italy. It sits next to a river named the Arno. Many old and pretty buildings stand there, with tall towers and big stone churches. Long ago, famous painters and builders made beautiful art in it. Today, people visit to see the art and walk on old bridges. They also eat tasty food like bread soup and big grilled steak.
Florida\n\nFlorida is a warm, sunny state in the southeast part of the United States. It is a big piece of land with water on three sides. On one side is the big Atlantic Ocean, and on the other side is the warm Gulf of Mexico. It has many beaches with soft sand where you can play and swim. In the middle of Florida is a very big, shallow lake called Lake Okeechobee. Down at the bottom tip are many tiny islands called the Florida Keys. A lot of Florida used to be a wet, grassy swamp called the Everglades. Now it is a park where alligators and panthers live. People visit Florida to go to fun parks like Walt Disney World, where you can meet Mickey Mouse. It is also a place where people grow oranges and other fruits because the sun shines almost every day.
Flour\n\nFlour is a soft, white powder. It is made when grains like wheat are crushed very small. You can find it in a kitchen or a big store. People use it to make bread, cookies, cakes, and pasta. When you mix it with water and eggs, it turns into dough. Then you can bake it in a hot oven. Some flour has tiny bubbles inside that make the food puff up and feel light.
Flow\n\nFlow is when something moves along like water in a river. It is smooth and keeps going without stopping. You can see it when you pour milk into a cup or when a stream runs down a hill. It can also be a feeling when you are doing something fun and forget about time, like drawing or building with blocks.
Flower\n\nA flower is the pretty part of a plant. It has soft, colorful parts called petals. You can find flowers in gardens, parks, and fields. Bees and butterflies visit flowers to sip sweet juice. People give flowers as a gift to show love or to say happy things.
Flowering plant\n\nA flowering plant is a plant that makes flowers and fruit. It has green leaves, a stem, and roots that grow in the ground. You can find it in gardens, parks, and forests all around the world. It makes seeds inside the fruit, and the seeds can grow into new plants. Many animals like bees and birds visit the flowers to help them make seeds. An apple tree is a flowering plant that gives us apples to eat.
Flu\n\nThe flu is a sickness that makes you feel very tired and achy. It can give you a hot head, a runny nose, and a cough. You catch it from tiny germs that float in the air when someone sick sneezes or coughs. It can make you stay in bed all day. To feel better, you need lots of rest, warm soup, and water to drink. Washing your hands often helps keep the germs away.
Fluffy\n\nFluffy is a word for something that feels very soft and light. It looks like a cloud or a pile of cotton balls. You can find fluffy things in many places, like a soft blanket on your bed or a stuffed animal you hug. A fluffy puppy has fur that sticks out and feels nice to touch. When you pet something fluffy, your hand sinks in a little bit and it feels warm and cozy.
Fluorescence\n\nFluorescence is a special kind of light. It happens when something takes in light we cannot see and then gives back light we can see. It stops glowing as soon as the light that shines on it goes away. You can find it in some rocks that glow under a purple lamp. Some bright markers and stickers also use it to look very colorful.
Flush\n\nFlush means to push water through a toilet to make it clean. When you press the handle or button, water rushes down and carries everything away. You find a flush in every bathroom. It helps keep the room smelling fresh and clean. After you use the toilet, you always flush it.
Flute\n\nA flute is a long, thin tube that makes music. It is made of shiny silver metal, but long ago it was made of wood. You hold it sideways and blow across a hole at one end to make a sound. It has many small buttons called keys that you press to change the notes. The sound can be high and happy like a bird singing, or low and soft. You can hear it in a big group of instruments called an orchestra. Some flutes are very small and make very high sounds.
Fly\n\nA fly is a small bug with two wings. It has big eyes that see all around. It is very fast and hard to catch. A fly starts as a tiny egg, then grows into a little worm, and later gets a hard shell before it comes out as a fly. You can see it near food or trash on a warm day.
Flying disc\n\nA flying disc is a round, flat toy that you throw through the air. It has a thick edge that makes it easy to hold and spin. You can find it at parks, beaches, or in your backyard. People throw it to each other for fun, or play games like catch. Some people even play sports with it, like a game where you run and pass it to your team. When you throw it the right way, it spins and flies far without wobbling.
Flying fish\n\nA flying fish is a small fish that can jump out of the water and glide in the air. It has big, stiff fins that look like wings. It lives in warm oceans all over the world. When a bigger fish wants to eat it, it swims very fast and jumps up to get away. It can glide far above the water, sometimes for a long time. It does not flap its fins like a bird, so it does not really fly. Some flying fish can glide as long as you count to 45.
Foam\n\nFoam is a bunch of tiny bubbles all stuck together. It looks white and fluffy, like the top of a bubble bath. You can find it on the beach where waves hit the sand. It is also in a cup of hot chocolate with whipped cream on top. When you blow air into soapy water, you make foam. It feels light and soft, and it pops when you touch it.
Focus\n\nFocus means you look at one thing and think about only that thing. It is like a flashlight that shines on one spot. When you focus, your eyes stay still and your brain works hard on that one job. You can focus when you color a picture, build with blocks, or listen to a story. It helps you learn and finish your work.
Fog\n\nFog is a cloud that sits on the ground. It is made of tiny water drops that float in the air. You can see it outside on a cold morning. It makes things far away look blurry and hard to see. When the air gets warm, it goes away.
Fold\n\nA fold is a bend in something flat, like paper or cloth. It makes a straight line where the flat thing is doubled over. You can find folds in a blanket, a towel, or a piece of paper. People make folds when they want to make something smaller or neater. For example, when you fold a paper airplane, you make many folds so it can fly.
Folder\n\nA folder is a flat cover that holds papers together. It is made of thick paper or thin plastic. You can find it on a desk, in a school bag, or in an office. People use it to keep homework, drawings, and important papers safe and tidy. It has two sides that open and close like a book. Some folders have pockets inside to slide papers in. A child might use a bright red folder to carry art projects home.
Folk\n\nFolk is a group of people who share old stories, songs, and ways of doing things. They often live in the same place for a long time. They make music with simple tools like drums or wooden flutes. You might hear folk songs at a family party or a town fair. These songs tell about love, work, and fun times.
Folk dance\n\nA folk dance is a special kind of dance that people do together. It is often done at parties, festivals, or big family gatherings. People wear colorful clothes and move in a circle or a line. Some folk dances use sticks or swords, but they are not real swords—they are just for the dance. In Europe, many countries have their own folk dances. For example, you might see people dancing in a square, holding hands, and stepping to happy music. It is a way for people to share fun and remember old stories.
Folk music\n\nFolk music is music that comes from a place and its people. It is not written down. People learn it by listening and singing together. It can be a happy song for dancing or a slow song that tells a story. You might hear it at a family party or a town fair. Some people play it with a guitar, a drum, or just their hands. It is music for everyone to enjoy.
Folklore\n\nFolklore is the old stories, songs, and ways of a group of people. It is passed down by talking, not by writing in a book. It can be a story like Little Red Riding Hood, a song your grandma sings, or a dance at a party. People share it to remember where they came from. You might hear it at bedtime or at a family get-together.
Follow\n\nFollow means to go after someone or something. When you walk behind your friend on the playground, you follow them. It can also mean to do what someone says, like when you follow the rules at home. You might follow a line on the floor with your feet. A puppy can follow its owner around the house.
Font\n\nA font is a set of letters and numbers that all look the same way. It can be round, straight, or curly. You see fonts in books, on signs, and on a computer screen. When you type on a keyboard, you can pick a font to make your words look different. Some fonts are easy to read, and some are just for fun.
Food\n\nFood is what people eat to stay alive and grow. It can come from plants, like fruits and vegetables, or from animals, like meat and eggs. You find food in your kitchen, at a store, or in a garden. It gives your body energy to run, play, and think. A sandwich with bread, cheese, and a slice of apple is a simple food you might have for lunch.
Food group\n\nA food group is a way to sort foods that are alike. It puts foods into families so we can eat a mix of good things every day. You can find food groups on a colorful plate or a poster at school. It helps you pick foods that make your body strong and give you energy. For example, apples and bananas are in the fruit group, and carrots and broccoli are in the vegetable group.
Food industry\n\nThe food industry is all the people and places that make our food. It starts on farms where fruits, vegetables, and animals grow. Then big kitchens and factories cook, mix, and pack the food into boxes and cans. Trucks and trains carry it to stores near your home. When your family buys bread, milk, or apples at the store, that food came from the food industry.
Food poisoning\n\nFood poisoning is when you get sick from eating food that is not good. It can make your tummy hurt and you may throw up. You might also have a fever or feel very tired. It can happen if food is old, not cooked enough, or touched by dirty hands. Most people feel better after a day or two. But it can be more dangerous for babies, old people, or people who are already sick. To stay safe, always wash your hands before eating and keep food cold until you cook it.
Food preservation\n\nFood preservation is a way to keep food good for a long time. It stops tiny bugs called germs from making the food go bad. People dry food in the sun, like fish or meat, so it stays safe to eat. They also use salt to keep food fresh, like salty meat. Another way is to put food in a jar and heat it, like pickles or fruit jam. This helps the food last for many days or even months.
Fool\n\nA fool is a person who does silly things. He might trip over his own feet or wear his shirt inside out. You can find him in stories, jokes, and sometimes on a stage making people laugh. He makes funny mistakes that teach us not to be too serious. In old tales, a king's fool would wear a colorful hat with bells and make the king smile.
Foot\n\nA foot is the part at the end of your leg that you stand on. It has five small toes, a soft bottom, and a hard heel at the back. You find feet on people, dogs, cats, birds, and many other animals. It helps you walk, run, jump, and keep your body up. Some animals walk on their toes, and some put their whole foot down. A duck has wide, flat feet for swimming. You put shoes on your feet to keep them safe and warm.
Foot (unit)\n\nA foot is a way to measure how long something is. It is about as long as a grown-up's shoe. You can use it to tell how tall a person is or how big a room is. When you see a ruler, one foot is the same as 12 little inches. In some places, people use feet to show how high a door or a bridge is.
Football\n\nFootball is a game where two teams try to kick a ball into a goal. It is played on a big green field with lines. Each team has eleven players who run and kick the ball. The goal is a big net at each end of the field. People all over the world love to watch football games. You might see kids playing it at a park or on a school field.
Footprint\n\nA footprint is a mark your foot leaves behind. It shows the shape of your shoe or your bare foot. You can find it in soft mud, wet sand, or snow. When you walk on a beach, you leave a trail of footprints. Animals like dogs and birds also make footprints. You can tell who walked by looking at the size and shape.
For\n\nA for is a word we use to show who gets something or why we do something. It is a small word, but we say it a lot. You might hear it when Mom says, "This cookie is for you." It can also tell where something is going, like "We are going for a walk." When you draw a picture for your friend, you use this word to show it is a gift.
Forbidden City\n\nThe Forbidden City is a very big, old palace in Beijing, China. It has red walls and golden roofs. A long time ago, the emperor of China lived there with his family. No one could go in or out without the emperor saying yes, so it was called forbidden. Today, people can visit it and see beautiful rooms and old treasures. It is like a giant museum.
Force\n\nA force is a push or a pull. It can make things move, stop, or change shape. You can see it when you push a toy car or pull a wagon. It can also twist things, like when you turn a doorknob. Gravity is a force that pulls everything down to the ground. When you jump, gravity pulls you back down. Magnets also use a force to stick to the fridge.
Forecasting\n\nForecasting is a way to guess what will happen next. It uses clues and facts to make a smart guess. People do forecasting for the weather, like saying it will rain tomorrow. They also do it for money, like guessing if things will cost more. Sometimes the guess is right, and sometimes it is wrong. It is like looking at dark clouds and thinking, "It might rain soon."
Forensic science\n\nForensic science is a way to use science to help solve puzzles about a crime. It looks at tiny things left behind, like a hair or a fingerprint. People who do this work go to a lab and check the things very carefully. They make sure the answer is right so the wrong person does not get in trouble. A fingerprint is a mark your finger leaves when you touch something. A hair can tell if a boy or a girl was there. It helps the police find out what really happened.
Forest\n\nA forest is a big piece of land with many, many trees. It is a home for lots of animals, like bears, deer, birds, and bugs. You can find forests in many places around the world, but not in deserts where it is too dry. Some forests are cold and have trees with needles, while others are warm and have trees with big leaves. In a forest, the trees grow close together and make shade on the ground. Many animals live in the trees or under them, and they find food and shelter there.
Forestry\n\nForestry is a job of taking care of big woods. A person who does this job is called a forester. It makes sure the trees and animals stay healthy. It also stops fires from burning the woods too soon. People can walk and play in a forest that is cared for. Trees help make the air clean for us to breathe.
Forever\n\nForever means something that never, ever ends. It is a very, very long time. You cannot count how many days it is. When you love someone with all your heart, that love can feel like forever. A circle has no start and no stop, so it goes on forever.
Forge\n\nA forge is a hot, hot place where people make things out of metal. It has a big fire that gets very, very hot. The fire makes the metal soft so a person can hit it with a hammer and bend it into a new shape. A long time ago, people used a forge to make swords, horseshoes, and tools. Today, some people still use it to make pretty gates or art. You might see a forge in a movie about knights or in a museum.
Forget\n\nTo forget is when something leaves your mind. It is like a picture that fades away. You might forget where you put your toy or what you had for breakfast. It happens to everyone, even grown-ups. Sometimes you try hard to remember, but the thought stays hidden. When you forget, you can ask a friend or look around to find the answer.
Forging\n\nForging is a way to shape hot metal by hitting it hard. A person called a smith does this work. They use a big, heavy hammer and a flat block called an anvil. The metal gets very hot in a fire so it is soft. Then the smith hits it to make things like spoons, hammers, or swords. Today, big machines also help hit the metal. You can see forged things at home, like a metal pot or a tool in the garage.
Forgiveness\n\nForgiveness is when you stop feeling mad at someone who did something wrong. It is a choice you make in your heart. You do not try to hurt them back. You let go of the angry feeling. It can happen even if the other person does not say sorry. Many people learn about forgiveness from their family or their place of worship. It helps you feel light and happy again.
Fork\n\nA fork is a tool for eating food. It has a long handle and a few pointy parts at the end. The pointy parts are called tines. Most forks have three or four tines. It helps you hold food still when you cut it with a knife. You can also use it to pick up food and bring it to your mouth. Forks are made of metal, plastic, or wood. You see it on the table when you eat dinner.
Form\n\nA form is a piece of paper with empty spaces to fill in. It has lines or boxes where you write your name, your age, or other things about you. You might see a form at the doctor's office or at school. Grown-ups use forms to sign up for things or to get a library card. A form helps people know what to write and where to write it.
Formation and evolution of the Solar System\n\nThe Solar System is the Sun and everything that moves around it. It started a very long time ago from a big cloud of gas and dust in space. The cloud spun and got flat like a pancake. Most of the stuff went to the middle and became the Sun. The rest made the planets, moons, and rocks. Earth is one of those planets, and it is our home.
Fort\n\nA fort is a strong building made to keep people safe. It has tall, thick walls and sometimes a big gate. Long ago, soldiers lived in a fort to watch for danger. You can find old forts on hills or near water. Some forts have towers where people could look far away. Today, many families visit a fort to learn about old times.
Forth\n\nForth is a way to say 'moving forward' or 'going ahead'. It means something is not going back. When you walk forth, you take steps to the front. In a story, a hero may go forth on a big trip. You can also say 'from this day forth' to mean starting now and going into the future.
Fortification\n\nA fortification is a strong wall or building that keeps people safe from danger. It is made of thick stone, wood, or dirt. You can find it around old castles or on hills where soldiers once stood. Long ago, people used it to stop enemies from coming in. A big castle with tall walls is one kind of fortification.
Forty\n\nForty is a number. It comes after thirty-nine and before forty-one. You can see it on a clock when the big hand is on the eight. If you have forty crayons, you have a big box with many colors.
Forward\n\nForward means going to the front. It is the way you move when you walk ahead. You can also push a toy car forward on the floor. When you play a game, you might take a step forward. It is the opposite of backward.
Fossil\n\nA fossil is a very old part of an animal or plant that has turned into stone. It looks like a rock, but it has the shape of a bone, a shell, or a leaf. You can find fossils inside big rocks or in the ground, especially near cliffs and beaches. Scientists dig them up and put them in museums so people can see them. A dinosaur bone is a fossil that many children know.
Fossil fuel\n\nFossil fuel is a kind of fuel that comes from very old plants and tiny animals. It is found deep under the ground. People dig it up or pump it out. There are three main kinds: coal, oil, and gas. Coal is a hard black rock. Oil is a thick dark liquid. Gas is like air you cannot see. People burn it to make cars go, to cook food, and to make lights turn on. But burning it makes the air dirty and makes the Earth too warm. One day, it will all be gone because we cannot make more.
Foundation (engineering)\n\nA foundation is the bottom part of a building. It sits under the ground and holds the building up. It is made of very strong stuff like hard rock or concrete. Builders dig a deep hole to put it in. A heavy building needs a deep foundation so it does not fall down. When you see a tall house, it has a foundation under it that you cannot see.
Fountain\n\nA fountain is a thing that holds water and lets it move. It can be a big bowl or many bowls where water flows from one to the next. You can find it in a park, a garden, or a big city square. Some fountains shoot water high up into the air. Others are small and give people a drink of water. At school or the store, you might see a drinking fountain on the wall. You push a button and cool water comes out for you to sip.
Four\n\nFour is a number. It comes after three and before five. You can see it on a clock, on a dice, or when you count your fingers. It is how many legs a dog has and how many wheels a car has. When you are four years old, you can hold up four fingers.
Fourteen\n\nFourteen is a number. It comes after thirteen and before fifteen. You can count fourteen things, like fourteen crayons in a box. It is two groups of seven. When you see the number 14, that is fourteen.
Fowl\n\nA fowl is a bird that people raise for food. It has feathers, two legs, and a beak. You can find it on a farm. People eat its eggs and meat. A chicken is a kind of fowl you might see at a farm or in a book.
Fox\n\nA fox is a small wild animal with soft, thick fur. It has pointy ears, a long thin nose, and a big fluffy tail. It lives in forests, fields, and sometimes near towns. It runs very fast and hunts small animals like mice and rabbits. It also eats fruit and bugs. The most common kind is the red fox, which has orange-red fur and a white tip on its tail.
Fraction\n\nA fraction is a part of a whole thing. It is like when you cut a pizza into pieces. One piece is a fraction of the pizza. You see fractions when you share a cookie with a friend. Each of you gets one half, which is a fraction. You can also find it in a glass of milk when you drink some and leave the rest.
Frame\n\nA frame is a border that goes around a picture. It is made of wood, metal, or plastic. You can find it on a wall in a house or a museum. It holds a photo or a painting so it looks nice and stays safe. Sometimes it has glass in front to keep dust away.
France\n\nFrance is a big country far away across the ocean. It has green hills, tall mountains, and long rivers. You can find it on a map of the world, next to other countries like Spain and Germany. Many people visit France to see a very tall iron tower called the Eiffel Tower. They eat long, thin bread called a baguette and soft, smelly cheese. In France, people speak a language called French. They say "bonjour" to say hello.
Francis of Assisi\n\nFrancis of Assisi was a kind man who lived a long, long time ago. He was born in a town called Assisi in Italy. When he was young, he had nice clothes and money, but later he gave all of that away. He wore simple, rough clothes and helped people who were sick or poor. He loved animals very much. A story says he talked to a big, hungry wolf and made it stop scaring a village. People remember him as a friend to all animals. On his special day, some churches let people bring their pets to be blessed.
Frankenstein\n\nFrankenstein is a story about a man who makes a big, scary creature. The man is a scientist who puts together body parts and brings the creature to life with lightning. The creature is very tall and looks strange, so people run away from it. It feels sad and lonely because no one wants to be its friend. The creature asks the scientist to make a friend for it, but he does not. Many people call the creature Frankenstein, even though that is the scientist's name in the story. You might see a picture of the creature with a flat head and bolts in its neck around Halloween.
Free\n\nFree means you do not have to pay money for something. It is like when a friend gives you a sticker and you do not give any coins back. You can also be free to run and play outside, not stuck inside. Some things are free for everyone, like air to breathe or a park to visit.
Free and open-source software\n\nFree and open-source software is a kind of computer program. It is made by people who share the recipe, called code, with everyone. Anyone can look at the code, change it, or give it to a friend. It is often free like a gift, so you do not pay money. Many people work together to make it better. You can find it on computers, phones, and tablets. An example is a drawing program that kids use at school.
Free will\n\nFree will is the feeling that you can pick what you do. It means you choose between two things, like a red crayon or a blue crayon. When you pick the red one all by yourself, that is free will. It is inside your head when you think hard and then decide. People use it every day, like when you pick a snack or a game to play. If no one tells you what to do, you are using your free will.
Freedom\n\nFreedom is when you can choose what to do. It means no one tells you what to play or where to go all the time. You feel it when you pick your own toy or run in the park. Birds have freedom when they fly high in the sky. At home, you have some freedom, like picking your shirt color. But freedom also means you must be safe and kind.
