Freedom of religion\n\nFreedom of religion means you can pick your own faith. It is a rule that says no one can tell you what to believe. You can go to a church, a temple, a mosque, or stay home and not pray at all. The people in charge of a country cannot make you follow one religion. In the United States, a very important paper says the government must let people worship in their own way. This helps everyone feel safe and free.
Freedom of speech\n\nFreedom of speech means you can say what you think and share your ideas. It is a rule that lets people talk without being stopped or punished. You see it in places where people can speak in front of others, like at a big meeting or on TV. It helps people tell the leaders what they need and want. But you cannot say things that hurt others, like yelling about a fire when there is no fire, because that can scare people.
Freetown\n\nFreetown is a big city in the country of Sierra Leone in Africa. It sits next to the big blue ocean. Many boats come and go from its port, bringing fish, rice, and other things. A very old, big cotton tree grows in the middle of the city. Long ago, people who were once slaves came to live there and made it their home. Today, many people live and work in Freetown. You can see old churches, a museum, and sandy beaches there.
Freeze\n\nFreeze means something gets very, very cold and turns hard. When water gets cold enough, it turns into ice. You can see this when you put a tray of water in the freezer. After a while, it is not water anymore — it is solid ice. People also freeze food to keep it fresh for a long time. In winter, puddles outside can freeze, and you can slide on them.
Freezer\n\nA freezer is a big cold box in the kitchen. It has a door that you pull open. Inside, it is very, very cold. It keeps food frozen so it stays good for a long time. You can put ice cream, frozen peas, and meat in it. When you take food out, it is hard like a rock. The freezer helps families save food for later.
Freezing\n\nFreezing is when a liquid turns into a solid because it gets very cold. It happens when the liquid loses heat and its tiny parts slow down and lock together. You can see freezing when water turns into ice in a freezer. Outside, freezing makes frost on the grass and ice on puddles. People use freezing to keep food fresh for a long time. It also helps make snow and hail in the sky.
Freighter\n\nA freighter is a big boat that carries things across the water. It has a long, wide body and a tall front part. You can see it at a big dock by the sea or on a wide river. It moves boxes, cars, food, and toys from one place to another. Some freighters have their own big arms to pick up heavy boxes. It is like a floating truck that travels all over the world.
French\n\nFrench is a way of talking and writing. It is used by people in a country called France. Many people in other places also use it. You might hear it in a song or a movie. Some words like 'bonjour' mean hello.
French food\n\nFrench food is the kind of cooking that comes from a country called France. It uses many fresh things like butter, cream, herbs, and cheese. In the north, people cook with butter. In the south, they use olive oil and garlic. Each part of France has its own special dish. One dish is a soft egg pie called quiche. Another is a fish soup called bouillabaisse. French food is known all over the world. Many cooks in big restaurants learn to make it.
French language\n\nFrench is a way of talking that many people use. It sounds soft and pretty, like a song. You can hear it in France, a country far away, and in other places too. People say "bonjour" to mean hello and "merci" to mean thank you. It uses the same letters as English, but some letters have little marks on top. Many words look like English words, like "table" and "fruit".
French literature\n\nFrench literature is a big group of stories, poems, and books written in the French language. It comes from France, but people in other countries also write it. You can find it in libraries, bookstores, and schools. People read it to enjoy a good story or to learn something new. A child might see a picture book with French words, like a story about a little boy named Babar the elephant.
French Polynesia\n\nFrench Polynesia is a group of many islands in the big blue ocean. It has warm water and sandy beaches. People live on islands like Tahiti, which is the biggest one. The main town is called Papeete. You can see tall green mountains and pretty flowers there. Many people visit to swim and play in the sun.
French Revolution\n\nThe French Revolution was a big change in France a long time ago. It happened when many people were unhappy with the king. They wanted to share power and be treated fairly. People marched in the streets and shouted for freedom. It changed how the country was run.
Frequency\n\nFrequency is how many times something happens in a set time. It is like counting how many times you clap your hands in one second. If you clap fast, the frequency is high. If you clap slow, the frequency is low. You can see frequency with waves in water. A wave has a top part called a crest. When many crests pass by a stick in the water in one second, that is a high frequency. Sound also has frequency. A high sound, like a bird chirp, has a high frequency. A low sound, like a big drum, has a low frequency.
Fresh\n\nFresh means something is new, clean, and nice. It can be food that just came from the farm, like a crunchy apple or a cold glass of milk. It can be air that feels cool and clean when you open a window. It can be clothes that just came out of the wash and smell good. When you eat fresh food, it tastes the best.
Freyja\n\nFreyja is a goddess from old stories. She is very pretty and kind. She rides in a cart pulled by two big cats. She has a shiny necklace and a coat made of bird feathers that lets her fly. She lives in a big hall in a field where she takes care of brave fighters who have died. She cries tears that turn into gold. People think of her when they feel love or when a new baby is born.
Friction\n\nFriction is a force that slows things down when they rub together. It happens when two things touch and move. It makes heat and sometimes sound. When you rub your hands fast, they get warm. That is friction. Car brakes use it to stop the car. Shoes use it so you do not slip on the floor. Even a suitcase rolling on the ground has a little bit of it.
Friday\n\nFriday is a day of the week. It comes after Thursday and before Saturday. For many people, it is the last day of school or work before the weekend. On Friday, children might feel happy because they can play more the next day. Some families have a special meal or watch a movie together on Friday night.
Fridge\n\nA fridge is a big cold box in the kitchen. It has a door that keeps the cold air inside. You find it in almost every home. It keeps food like milk, eggs, and fruit fresh and cold so they stay good to eat. Some fridges have a freezer part at the top or bottom that makes ice and keeps ice cream hard.
Friend\n\nA friend is a person you like to play with. It is someone who shares toys and laughs with you. You can find a friend at school, at the park, or in your neighborhood. A friend does fun things with you, like drawing or running. When you feel sad, a friend can give you a hug. A friend is kind and makes you happy.
Friendly\n\nFriendly means being nice and kind to others. It looks like a smile, a wave, or a helping hand. You can find friendly people at school, at the park, or at home. When someone is friendly, they share toys, say kind words, and make you feel happy. A friendly friend might give you a hug or ask you to play.
Friendship\n\nFriendship is a warm feeling between people who like each other. It is when two people enjoy being together and care about each other. You can find it at school, in your neighborhood, or at the park. Friends play together, share toys, and help when someone is sad. A friend might be the kid you sit next to at lunch or the one you swing with at recess.
Friesian horse\n\nA Friesian horse is a big, strong horse that is always black. It has a long, thick mane and tail, and soft hair around its feet. It comes from a place called the Netherlands. People ride it and use it to pull carts. You might see one in a parade or a movie.
Frigatebird\n\nA frigatebird is a big bird that lives near warm seas. It has long, pointy wings that stretch very wide. It can fly for many hours over the water without getting tired. It has a black body and a tail that splits into two points. The boy bird has a red pouch under its beak that puffs up like a balloon. It eats fish and sometimes takes food from other birds. You might see it flying high near a beach or an island.
Frog\n\nA frog is a small animal that can live in water and on land. It has smooth, wet skin, big back legs, and no tail. You can find it near ponds, lakes, or wet grass. It jumps very far and catches bugs with its long, sticky tongue. It makes a loud sound called a croak. A baby frog is called a tadpole. It lives in water and has a tail, but no legs. As it grows, it gets legs and loses its tail.
From\n\nFrom is a small word that tells us where something starts. It shows the place or person something comes from. You might say, "I got this cookie from Grandma." It can also tell us about time, like "from morning to night." When you see a gift with a tag that says "From Mom," you know who gave it to you.
Front\n\nFront is the part of something that faces you first. It is the side you see when you look straight at a thing. You find the front of a house where the door is. The front of a book has the cover and the title. When you line up, the person at the front is first. A car has a front where the driver sits and the headlights shine.
Frost\n\nFrost is a thin layer of ice that forms on things when it is very cold outside. It looks white and powdery, like tiny bits of sugar. You can find it on grass, car windows, and leaves early in the morning. It can hurt plants and make them turn brown. Farmers use warm glass houses called greenhouses to keep plants safe from it.
Frostbite\n\nFrostbite is when very cold hurts a part of your body. It can make skin turn white or gray and feel hard. It often happens to fingers, toes, ears, or your nose when you play outside in snow too long. If you see it, you need a grown-up to help warm it up slowly. Wearing warm gloves and boots helps keep it away.
Frown\n\nA frown is a face you make when you are sad or upset. It looks like the corners of your mouth go down. You can see it on a friend's face when they lose a toy. It shows that someone feels bad inside. When you see a frown, you can give a hug to help.
Fruit\n\nA fruit is a part of a plant that holds the seeds. It can be soft and sweet, like an apple or a banana. You can find it growing on trees or bushes in gardens and farms. People eat it as a snack or put it in meals because it tastes good and is good for the body. An apple is a fruit you might see in your lunch box.
Fruit preserves\n\nFruit preserves are sweet spreads made from fruit and sugar. They are cooked until thick and then put in glass jars. You can find them in a kitchen cupboard or at the grocery store. People spread them on bread, toast, or crackers for a yummy snack. Strawberry jam and orange marmalade are two kinds you might have tried.
Fry\n\nTo fry means to cook food in hot oil. It makes the food brown and crispy on the outside. You can fry an egg in a pan on the stove. People also fry potatoes to make french fries. The oil is very hot, so only grown-ups should do it. Fried food smells yummy and tastes crunchy.
Frying\n\nFrying is a way to cook food using hot oil or butter. It makes the outside of the food brown and crunchy. You can fry an egg in a pan on the stove. People also fry potatoes to make crispy french fries. Some foods are fried in a big pot with lots of oil, like doughnuts. You can see frying at home when mom or dad makes breakfast.
Fuel\n\nFuel is something we burn to make heat or power. It can be a black rock called coal, a brown liquid called oil, or a clear gas. We find some fuels deep under the ground. People use fuel to make cars go, to cook food, and to keep houses warm. When you see a campfire, the wood is a kind of fuel.
Full\n\nFull means something has no more room inside. It is like a cup with water all the way to the top. When your tummy feels tight after a big meal, it is full. A bus is full when every seat has a person in it. You cannot put more things in a full box.
Fully\n\nFully means all the way or as much as can be. It is a word that tells how something is done. When you fill a cup fully, no more water can fit inside. When you eat fully, your tummy feels all done and happy. You can also listen fully by using both ears and not talking. It is the opposite of partly or a little bit.
Fun\n\nFun is a happy feeling you get when you do something you like. It can be playing with toys, running outside, or laughing with friends. You find it at the park, at a birthday party, or when you hear a funny story. It makes you smile and feel good inside. A swing at the playground is one place you can have fun.
Function\n\nA function is like a little machine that does one job. It takes something in, works on it, and gives something back. You can use it many times without making a new one each time. For example, a toaster is like a function: you put bread in, it heats it up, and you get toast out.
Fundamental force\n\nA fundamental force is a push or a pull that makes things move. There are four big ones in the whole world. One is gravity, which pulls you down to the ground. Another is the force that makes magnets stick to the fridge. The other two are tiny and work deep inside tiny bits of stuff. They hold those bits together so everything does not fall apart. You cannot see them, but they are always there.
Funeral\n\nA funeral is a special time when people come together to say goodbye to someone who has died. It is a sad but important gathering. Friends and family meet in a quiet place like a church or a hall. They talk about the person, share stories, and sometimes sing songs. The body is often put in a big box called a coffin. After the funeral, the body may be put in the ground or turned into soft ashes. People cry and hug because they miss the person. They also smile when they remember happy times. A funeral helps everyone feel a little better together.
Fungus\n\nA fungus is a tiny living thing. It can be very small, like yeast, or big, like a mushroom. It does not have green parts, so it cannot make its own food from sunlight. Instead, it eats dead plants and old food. Some fungi live in the ground or on old trees. People use yeast to make bread soft and fluffy. A mushroom is a fungus that you can see in the woods or at the store.
Funny\n\nFunny is a feeling that makes you laugh. It can be a silly face, a wiggly dance, or a joke with a surprise ending. You find funny things in cartoons, at the playground, or when your pet does a trick. When something is funny, your mouth turns up and happy sounds come out. A clown with a big red nose is funny.
Fur\n\nFur is the soft hair that covers the body of many animals. It has two layers: a short, thick layer close to the skin and a longer, thinner layer on top. You can find it on cats, dogs, rabbits, and bears. It keeps the animal warm when it is cold outside. Some animals, like elephants, have very little fur because they are big and live in hot places. A woolly mammoth had thick fur long ago when it lived in icy lands. Animals that live in water, like whales, do not have much fur because it would get too wet. Instead, they have a thick layer of fat under their skin to stay warm.
Furniture\n\nFurniture is the big and small things in a house that people use every day. It can be made of wood, soft cloth, or hard metal. You find it in every room. A bed is for sleeping, a chair is for sitting, and a table is for eating or playing. A dresser has drawers to keep clothes tidy. Some furniture is plain, and some has pretty shapes or colors. It helps make a home cozy and nice to live in.
Fuse\n\nA fuse is a small safety helper inside wires and plugs. It stops too much power from going through. When too many things are plugged in, it gets hot and melts inside. This turns off the power so nothing gets hurt. After it melts, a grown-up puts in a new one to make things work again. You can find a fuse in the plug of a lamp or a TV.
Future\n\nThe future is the time that has not come yet. It is what happens after right now. When you wake up tomorrow, that is the future. No one knows for sure what it will bring, but people can guess and dream. Some stories in books and movies show what the future might look like, with flying cars or robots. You can think about the future when you plan what to play later today.
Futurism\n\nFuturism is a way of making art that started a long time ago. It loves things that are fast and new, like cars, planes, and big cities. The art shows things moving with bright colors and sharp shapes. Some people who made this art also wrote about it in little books called manifestos. Today, you can see its ideas in movies and cartoons that have speedy robots and flying cars.
Fuzzy\n\nFuzzy means something is soft and has tiny hairs or fluff on it. It feels nice when you touch it, like a warm blanket or a teddy bear. You can find fuzzy things all around you, like a peach with its soft skin or a kitten with its fluffy fur. Some clothes, like a cozy sweater, are fuzzy too. When you pet a fuzzy animal, it makes you feel happy and calm.
Gabon\n\nGabon is a country in Africa. It sits right on the equator, where it is very warm. Much of it is covered in thick green forests. Many people live in the big city called Libreville. It has big rivers and many caves deep under the ground. Long ago, people from France came to live there. Now it has its own flag and its own leaders. Some people there play football, and they are very good at it.
Gaborone\n\nGaborone is a big city in the country of Botswana. It is the most important city there because the people who run the country work in it. The city sits next to a river in the south part of the land. Many people live in it, and more come every year. It has a school for big kids, an airport for planes, and many houses. Long ago, it had a different name, but now people call it Gaborone.
Galago\n\nA galago is a tiny animal that comes out at night. It has big round eyes, soft fur, and a long tail. It lives in trees in warm parts of Africa. It jumps very far from branch to branch. It eats bugs, fruit, and tree sap. Some people call it a bushbaby because it looks like a little baby and lives in bushes.
Galaxy\n\nA galaxy is a huge group of stars. It has gas and dust too. Gravity holds it all together. It can be a spiral shape, like a pinwheel, or a round shape. Our Sun is one star in a galaxy called the Milky Way. At night, you can see a faint band of light across the sky. That is part of our galaxy.
Galileo\n\nGalileo was a man who lived a long time ago. He looked up at the sky with a tube that made far things look close. He saw that the Earth moves around the sun. He also saw moons near the big planet Jupiter. People remember him because he helped us learn about the stars.
Galileo Galilei\n\nGalileo Galilei was a man who lived a long time ago. He looked at the sky with a tube that made far things look close. He saw that the moon has bumps and that the sun has dark spots. He also found four little lights moving around the big planet Jupiter. He said the Earth moves around the sun, not the other way. Many people did not believe him at first, but now we know he was right.
Galley\n\nA galley is a long, skinny boat. It moves when people pull on big sticks called oars that go into the water. Long ago, people used it to fight on the sea. It had a sharp front to bump into other boats. Some had many oars on each side, one row above the other. Today, you can see a galley in a picture book about old ships.
Gallon\n\nA gallon is a way to measure how much liquid you have. It is a big container, like a large milk jug. In some places, people use it to buy gas for their car. You might see a gallon of milk or water at the store. It holds a lot of liquid, more than a cup or a bottle.
Galpagos Islands\n\nThe Galpagos Islands are a group of small lands in the big blue ocean. They are far away from other lands, near a country called Ecuador. The islands were made by hot rocks from inside the Earth, called volcanoes. Some of these hot rocks still come out today. Many special animals live there, like big slow turtles with hard shells, funny birds with blue feet, and little penguins that swim in the water. These animals are not found anywhere else in the world. People visit the islands to see the animals and the pretty beaches. Only a few of the islands have people living on them, and most of the land is kept safe as a park.
Gamble\n\nA gamble is when you try to win something by luck. It is like picking a card and hoping it is the right one. You might lose what you gave, like a toy or a coin. People sometimes do it with cards or spinning wheels. It is not a sure way to get things, so it can make you sad if you lose.
Game\n\nA game is something you do for fun. It has rules that tell you what you can and cannot do. You can play a game alone or with friends. Some games use a board and pieces, like checkers. Other games use a ball, like soccer. You can also play games on a screen, like a phone or a computer. When you play hide-and-seek, that is a game too. Games make you laugh and think.
Game show\n\nA game show is a fun TV program where people play a game. It has a host who talks and asks questions. Players try to win points, money, or big prizes like a trip or a new car. Some shows test what you know, and some have spinning wheels or buzzers. You can watch it at home with your family and shout out answers. One you might know is "Wheel of Fortune," where a big wheel spins and people guess letters.
Gandhi\n\nGandhi was a man who helped his country. He lived in a land called India. He wore simple white clothes and round glasses. He did not fight with fists or swords. He used kind words and long walks to make things fair. Many people loved him and called him a great soul.
Ganesha\n\nGanesha is a special god with an elephant head. He has a big round belly, four arms, and big ears. People in India pray to him at home and in temples. They ask him for good luck and to help them when things are hard. He is the son of a god and a goddess. Many people love him because he is kind and wise.
Gang\n\nA gang is a group of people who stay together and do things as a team. They often wear the same colors or signs so others know who they are. You might see them in a big city, walking or standing on a street corner. Sometimes a gang does bad things, like fighting or taking things that are not theirs. But the word can also mean a group of friends who play together, like a little gang of kids at the park.
Ganges\n\nThe Ganges is a very long river in India. It starts high up in cold, snowy mountains and flows down to a big sea. Many people live near it and use its water to grow food like rice and wheat. It is also a holy river. People believe its water is special and can make them clean inside. They come from far away to take a bath in it. Sometimes the water gets dirty, and people are working to keep it clean.
Ganymede (moon)\n\nGanymede is a big moon that goes around the planet Jupiter. It is the biggest moon in our whole Solar System. It is even bigger than the planet Mercury, but it is much lighter. It is made of rock and ice. Deep inside, it has a hot, liquid center and a hidden ocean of water. The ocean may have more water than all of Earth’s oceans put together. Its outside has dark spots and light lines. The dark spots are very old and have many round dents from rocks hitting it long ago. The light parts have long grooves and ridges. It is the only moon that has its own magnetic field, like a big invisible bubble around it.
Gap\n\nA gap is an empty space between two things. It can be a little hole or a big open spot. You might see a gap between your two front teeth when you smile. A gap can also be the space under a door where light comes through. When you build with blocks, a gap is the space left when one block is missing.
Garage\n\nA garage is a room or a building where people keep cars. It has a big door that goes up and down so a car can drive in and out. Some garages are stuck to the side of a house, and some stand all by themselves. In a big city, you might see a tall garage with many floors where lots of cars can park. Another kind of garage is a place where people fix broken cars and make them run again.
Garden\n\nA garden is a piece of land where people grow flowers, trees, and other plants. It can be small, like in a backyard, or big, like in a park. You can find a garden outside a house, in a city, or even inside a big building with a glass roof. People take care of a garden by giving the plants water and pulling out weeds. Some gardens have pretty paths, seats, and little ponds with fish. A garden is a nice place to sit, play, or look at colorful flowers.
Gardenia\n\nA gardenia is a plant with pretty white flowers. It has shiny dark green leaves that feel thick and smooth. It grows in warm places where the air feels wet. People love it because the flowers smell very sweet and nice. You might see one in a garden or in a pot by a sunny window. It can be hard to keep happy because it needs lots of water in the air.
Gardening\n\nGardening is when people grow plants like flowers, trees, and food. It can happen outside in the dirt, in pots on a porch, or even inside a house. People use tools like a small shovel, a watering can, and a hose to help the plants. Some gardens are big and pretty, like in a park, and some are tiny, like a box on a windowsill. A gardener is a person who takes care of the plants every day.
Garlic\n\nGarlic is a plant that people eat. It has a round white bulb made of small pieces called cloves. It grows in the ground and has long green leaves. People use it in cooking to make food taste strong and yummy. You might see garlic in the kitchen or at the store. Some people also use it to help when they have a cold.
Garter snake\n\nA garter snake is a small, thin snake. It has a long body with a stripe down its back. The stripe can be yellow, white, or another color. It lives in many places like backyards, woods, and near water. It hides under leaves, rocks, and sticks. It eats small animals like bugs, worms, and tiny fish. It is not dangerous to people. If it gets scared, it might make a stinky smell or give a tiny bite that does not hurt much.
Gas\n\nA gas is a kind of stuff that is all around us. It is like air. You cannot see it, but you can feel it when the wind blows. It has no shape of its own. It spreads out to fill any space, like a balloon. When you blow up a balloon, you put gas inside. The gas pushes on the balloon to make it big. Some gases have a smell, like the yucky smell from a car. The air we breathe is a mix of gases. One gas in air helps us live. It is called oxygen. Another gas in air makes plants grow. It is called carbon dioxide. When you boil water, you see steam. Steam is water that turned into a gas. When the steam hits a cold lid, it turns back into tiny water drops. That is how a gas can change.
Gas station\n\nA gas station is a place where cars get a drink. It has big machines called pumps that give cars special liquid to make them go. You see it next to roads when you ride in a car with your family. A grown-up stops the car, opens a little door, and puts a nozzle inside. The pump makes a humming sound while the car fills up. Many gas stations also have a small shop where you can buy snacks or a cold drink. Some even have a big machine that washes the car with water and soap.
Gasoline\n\nGasoline is a clear liquid that cars use to go. It is made from oil found deep under the ground. People get it at a gas station, where a pump puts it into the car. It burns inside the car's engine to make it move. It smells strong and can catch fire very easily, so you must never play with it. It is also used in lawn mowers and small boats.
Gate\n\nA gate is a door in a fence or a wall. It is made of wood or metal and can open and close. You find it outside a house, in a garden, or at a farm. It lets people and cars go in and out. When it is closed, it keeps animals and small children safe inside.
Gaur\n\nA gaur is a big wild cow. It has a huge body with strong legs and two curved horns on its head. It lives in forests in parts of Asia. It eats grass and leaves all day. A baby gaur can walk just a few minutes after it is born. The mom keeps the baby safe until they go back to the group.
Gautama Buddha\n\nGautama Buddha was a man who lived a very long time ago. He was a prince when he was young. He left his big house to find out why people feel sad and hurt. He sat under a tree and thought very hard until he understood. After that, he taught people how to be kind and calm. Many people listen to his words even today.
Gaze\n\nA gaze is when you look at something for a long time without moving your eyes away. It is a soft, steady look. You might gaze at a pretty flower, a bright star, or a picture you love. When you gaze, you are not just looking fast—you stay still and watch. A gaze can show that you are thinking or feeling calm.
Gazelle\n\nA gazelle is a fast animal that looks like a small deer. It has long, thin legs, a light brown body, and a white belly. It lives in hot, grassy places in Africa and parts of Asia. It eats grass and leaves. It can run very fast to get away from big cats like lions. When it runs, it sometimes jumps high in the air with all four legs off the ground. Many gazelles stay together in a big group called a herd.
Gear\n\nA gear is a round wheel with little bumps on the edge. It looks like a circle with teeth all around it. You can find it inside toys, clocks, and bikes. When one gear turns, it makes another gear turn too. It helps machines move and do work. For example, when you pedal a bike, gears help the wheels spin.
Gecko\n\nA gecko is a small lizard with soft skin. It has four short legs, a long tail, and big eyes with no eyelids. It lives in warm places, like houses, trees, and walls. It comes out at night to eat bugs like flies and mosquitoes. It can walk up walls and even on the ceiling because its feet have tiny sticky pads. It makes a funny sound, like a chirp or a squeak. Some people call it a gecko because that is what its sound is like. If a cat grabs its tail, it can drop the tail and grow a new one later.
Gel\n\nA gel is a soft, wiggly thing. It feels wet and squishy, like jelly. You can find it in a jar of jam or in a bowl of dessert. It holds its shape but shakes when you touch it. Some gels are sweet and you can eat them. Other gels are used in shoes or hair to make things soft.
Gender\n\nGender is a word that helps us talk about how people feel and show who they are. It is not the same as the body a person is born with. Some people feel like a boy, some feel like a girl, and some feel like both or neither. You can see gender in the clothes people wear, the toys they like, or the way they play. For example, a child might say, "I am a boy," even if people thought they were a girl when they were born. Everyone gets to say their own gender when they are ready.
Gene\n\nA gene is a tiny set of instructions inside your body. It tells your body how to grow and what to look like. It decides if your hair is curly or straight, and if your eyes are blue or brown. You get your genes from your mom and dad. They are so small you cannot see them, but they are in every part of you.
Genealogy\n\nGenealogy is learning about your family from long ago. It is like a big story about your mom, dad, grandma, grandpa, and the people who came before them. Some people draw a family tree to show how everyone is connected. You can find old photos, letters, and stories that tell you where your family lived and what they did. It helps you know who you are and where you come from.
Generation\n\nA generation is a group of people born around the same time. In a family, it means all the kids on the same step of the family tree. You, your brothers, your sisters, and your cousins are all in one generation. Your mom and dad are in the generation before you. Your grandma and grandpa are in the generation before them. Each new generation grows up and has kids of their own.
Genetics\n\nGenetics is the study of how parents pass things to their children. It looks at tiny parts inside our bodies called genes. Genes are like little notes that tell our bodies how to grow. They decide if you have blue eyes or brown eyes, or if your hair is straight or curly. You get half your genes from your mom and half from your dad. That is why you may look a little like both of them.
Geneva\n\nGeneva is a big city in a country called Switzerland. It sits next to a very large lake with blue water. Many people from all over the world come to talk and make important choices there. You can see tall mountains with snow on top from the city. A big river flows through it, and boats float on the lake.
Genghis\n\nGenghis was a strong leader from long ago. He lived in a big land with wide, open fields. He rode a horse and led many people across the land. He is known for bringing many groups together under one rule.
Genghis Khan\n\nGenghis Khan was a leader from long ago. He brought many people together under one big group. He rode a horse and was very strong. People remember him as a great ruler.
Genie\n\nA genie is a make-believe being from old stories. It is said to be made of fire or smoke and can turn itself so people cannot see it. In tales, it often lives inside an old lamp or a bottle. When someone rubs the lamp, it comes out and can do magic. It may grant wishes, like giving you a toy or a sweet. But in some stories, it can be tricky, so you must be careful what you wish for.
Genocide\n\nGenocide is when a group of people is hurt very badly on purpose. It happens when one group wants to get rid of another group. They may hurt them, take their homes, or stop them from having children. It is very wrong and makes many people sad. We learn about it so we can be kind and stop it from happening again.
Gentle\n\nGentle means soft and kind. It is a way of touching or talking that does not hurt. A gentle touch feels light, like a feather. When you pet a small animal, you use gentle hands. A gentle voice is quiet and calm. It makes people feel safe and happy.
Gently\n\nGently means doing something in a soft and careful way. It is how you touch a baby or a small pet so you do not hurt them. You can speak gently by using a quiet, kind voice. When you hold a flower, you hold it gently so the petals do not fall off. It is the opposite of being rough or fast.
Geography\n\nGeography is the study of the Earth and the people, animals, and plants that live on it. It looks at big things like mountains, rivers, oceans, and deserts. It also looks at where people live and how they use the land. A person who studies geography is called a geographer. They use maps to show where things are. Maps can show roads, countries, or even the whole world. Geography helps us understand why some places are hot and some are cold, and why people in different places live in different ways.
Geological history of Earth\n\nEarth's geological history is the long, long story of our planet. It is split into very big chunks of time, like chapters in a book. Scientists look at rocks and the layers inside them to learn this story. Deep down, old rocks tell about times long ago. Higher up, newer rocks tell about times closer to today. This is how we know Earth is very, very old.
Geology\n\nGeology is the study of the Earth and what it is made of. It looks at rocks, dirt, and how the ground changes. Some people who study geology are called geologists. They look at rocks to learn about the past. They also study big things like mountains, volcanoes, and earthquakes. Rocks come in three main kinds: some are made from hot melted rock that cools down, some are made from tiny bits of sand and mud pressed together, and some are changed by heat and squeezing. Soil is the top layer of the ground. It is made of tiny pieces of rock and old leaves. Plants grow in soil. Geologists help us understand the Earth under our feet.
Geometer moth\n\nA geometer moth is a kind of moth. It has wide wings that it holds flat so you can see both pairs. Its body is thin, and it flies mostly at night. The baby, called a caterpillar, moves in a funny way. It pulls its back end up to its front, then stretches forward, like it is measuring the ground. Some people call it an inchworm. You might see one on a leaf or a tree branch.
Geometry\n\nGeometry is a way of looking at shapes and sizes. It helps us see how long, how wide, and how tall things are. You can find it in flat shapes like squares, circles, and triangles. You can also find it in solid shapes like balls, boxes, and cans. People use it to build houses, draw maps, and make toys. A pizza is a circle, and a door is a rectangle. That is geometry.
George\n\nGeorge is a name for a boy or a man. It is a short, friendly name that many people have. You might meet a George at school, in a storybook, or on TV. A George can be tall or short, with any color hair. He likes to play, laugh, and be with friends, just like you.
George Washington\n\nGeorge Washington was a man who helped start the United States. He was the very first president. He wore a white wig and a long coat. You can see his face on the one-dollar bill. People remember him as a brave leader.
Georgia (country)\n\nGeorgia is a country far away. It sits next to a big sea called the Black Sea. It has many tall mountains with snow on top. The biggest city is Tbilisi, where many people live. People there speak a language called Georgian. They grow grapes and make a sweet drink from them. They also sing songs with many voices at once. The flag has a big red cross and four small red crosses on a white cloth.
Geothermal energy\n\nGeothermal energy is heat that comes from deep inside the Earth. It is not heat from the Sun, but heat that lives under the ground. The Earth is very hot at its center, and that heat moves up toward the top. Sometimes it comes out as hot water in a spring or as steam that shoots up from the ground. People can use it to warm houses and buildings. In some places, it is used to make electricity. It is a clean kind of energy because it does not make dirty smoke.
Germ\n\nA germ is a tiny living thing that is too small to see with your eyes. It can get inside your body and make you feel sick. Germs are everywhere — on your hands, on toys, and on tables. Washing your hands with soap and water helps keep them away. When you cover your mouth when you cough, you stop germs from flying into the air.
German\n\nGerman is a way of talking and writing. It is used by many people in a country called Germany. You can also hear it in some other places nearby. If you meet someone who says "Hallo" instead of "Hello," they might be speaking German. Some storybooks and songs are written in it too.
German language\n\nGerman is a way of talking and writing that many people use. It sounds a little like English, but the words go in a different order. You can hear it in Germany, Austria, and parts of Switzerland. When people write it, they make every name word start with a big letter. Some words are very long because they put small words together to make one big word.
German literature\n\nGerman literature is all the stories, poems, and books written in the German language. It is made by people from Germany and other places where German is spoken. Some stories are very old, like fairy tales about magic and animals. Other stories are new and tell about life today. You might know a German story like "Hansel and Gretel" or "Cinderella."
Germanic languages\n\nGermanic languages are a big family of ways people talk. They all started from one very old way of talking long ago in a cold place up north. Today, many people use them every day. English is one of them. You hear it when your friend says hello. Other ones are German and Dutch. They share many words that sound a little bit alike.
Germany\n\nGermany is a country in Europe. It is a big piece of land with many trees, rivers, and mountains. You can find it on a map next to other countries like France and Poland. Many people live there and speak a language called German. They build cars, make yummy bread, and have big parties with music and lights. A long time ago, it was split into two parts, but now it is one country again.
Get\n\nGet means to take something or bring it to you. When you get a toy, you hold it in your hands. You can get a hug from Mom or Dad. You can get a cookie after dinner. When you get bigger, you grow tall. You can get a new friend at the park. Getting something makes you happy.
Geyser\n\nA geyser is a hot spring that shoots water and steam high into the air. It looks like a hole in the ground with water bubbling up. You can find it in places with hot rocks under the ground, like Yellowstone Park. When the water gets very hot, it pushes up and bursts out. After it shoots, it rests and then shoots again. Some geysers shoot every few minutes, and some wait a long time.
Ghana\n\nGhana is a country in Africa. It is near the big blue ocean and has warm weather all year. The land has flat places, small hills, and a very big lake called Lake Volta. Many people in Ghana grow cocoa beans to make chocolate. They also dig for gold and shiny diamonds. Children there go to school for six years. The most loved game is soccer, and the team is called the Black Stars.
Ghost\n\nA ghost is something people think is the spirit of a dead person. It is often said to look like a see-through shape or a misty cloud. Some people say they feel cold when a ghost is near. Many stories show ghosts in old, empty houses. People dress up as ghosts for Halloween with a white sheet.
Giant\n\nA giant is a huge person from old stories. It is much, much bigger than a grown-up. It looks like a person but is as tall as a tree. You find giants in fairy tales and books. They can be strong and sometimes a little scary. One story has a giant who lives at the top of a beanstalk.
Giant panda\n\nA giant panda is a big, soft bear. It has black and white fur. Its ears, eye spots, legs, and shoulders are black. The rest of its body is white. It lives in mountain forests in China. It eats bamboo almost all day long. It uses a special wrist bone like a thumb to hold the bamboo. A baby panda is tiny and stays with its mom for a long time. You can see a giant panda in some big zoos.
Giant planet\n\nA giant planet is a very big ball in space, much bigger than Earth. It is made mostly of soft, light stuff like air and water, not hard rock. There are four giant planets near our Sun: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. Jupiter and Saturn are mostly air, and they have thick clouds. Uranus and Neptune are mostly icy water, and they look blue-green. You can see some of them at night as bright dots in the sky.
Giant star\n\nA giant star is a huge, bright ball of hot gas in the sky. It looks like a very big, shiny dot at night. It is much bigger and brighter than our Sun. It does not live as long as smaller stars. Some giant stars are red, some are yellow, and some are blue. You can see them twinkling far away in the dark sky.
Giant tortoise\n\nA giant tortoise is a very big turtle that lives on land. It has a hard, round shell on its back and four thick legs. It can be as long as a grown-up is tall. It lives on warm islands far away in the ocean. It eats grass and leaves and moves very slowly. It can live for more than 100 years, which is older than any grandma or grandpa. A long time ago, people took too many of them for food, so now people keep them safe.
Gibbon\n\nA gibbon is a kind of ape that lives in trees. It has very long arms and no tail. It swings from branch to branch in the forest, moving fast and far. It lives in warm, thick forests far away in Asia. It eats leaves, flowers, fruit, and bugs. In the morning, it sings loud songs that can be heard from very far. These songs help it talk to its family and tell other gibbons to stay away. A gibbon can be black or light brown. It walks on two feet on the ground with its arms held up high.
Gift\n\nA gift is a thing you give to someone to make them happy. It is often wrapped in pretty paper with a bow on top. You can find gifts at a birthday party or under a tree on a holiday. People give gifts to show love or to say thank you. A toy, a book, or a drawing you made can all be gifts.
Gila monster\n\nA Gila monster is a big, slow lizard that lives in the desert. It has bumpy skin that looks like tiny beads. Its skin is black with pink, orange, and yellow spots. It hides under rocks and comes out to find food. It eats small animals like baby mice and bird eggs. When it bites, it holds on tight and puts a little poison in the bite. The poison does not hurt people very much. It can keep extra food in its fat tail. Some medicine for sick people was made from its spit.
Gill\n\nA gill is a body part that helps an animal breathe under water. It looks like soft, feathery lines or tiny leaves. Fish have gills on the sides of their heads, hidden under a flap. Sharks have slits on their necks that are gills. Baby frogs and salamanders have gills that stick out like little branches. The gill takes air from the water so the animal can stay under. Some bugs that live in water have a special patch of hairs that works like a gill. You can see gills on a fish at the pet store or in a pond.
Ginger\n\nGinger is a plant with a thick root that people use in food. The root looks bumpy and brown on the outside, but inside it is yellow and smells strong. You can find it in the kitchen or at the store. People cut it into tiny pieces and put it in cookies, tea, or soup to make the taste warm and a little spicy. Sometimes the word ginger also means a red-brown color, like the hair of some children.
Ginkgo\n\nA ginkgo is a kind of tree. It has leaves that look like little fans. The leaves turn bright yellow in fall. You can find it in parks and on streets in many places. People plant it because it is strong and pretty. It first grew in China a long, long time ago.
Ginseng\n\nGinseng is a plant with a thick, bumpy root that grows under the ground. It has green leaves and small red berries. It grows in cool, shady places in parts of Asia. People dig up the root and use it to make tea or medicine. Some people say it helps them feel strong and healthy.
Giraffe\n\nA giraffe is a very tall animal with a long neck and long legs. It has a light tan coat with big brown spots, and no two giraffes have the same spots. It lives in Africa on wide, grassy lands with some trees. It eats leaves from tall trees using its long, dark tongue to pull them off. A baby giraffe is called a calf and can stand up soon after it is born.
Girl\n\nA girl is a young person who will grow up to be a woman. She is a child or a teenager. She often has longer hair than a boy, but not always. She may wear a dress, a skirt, or pants. You can see girls at school, at the park, or at home with their family. A girl likes to play, draw, and make friends.
Girlfriend\n\nA girlfriend is a girl who is a special friend. She is someone you like to spend time with, talk to, and play with. You might hold hands or give each other hugs. She can be someone you see at school, at the park, or at a friend's house. A girlfriend makes you feel happy and you make her feel happy too.
Gita\n\nGita is a very old and important book from India. It is a story told as a talk between a prince and his friend. People read it to learn about being kind, brave, and doing the right thing. Many families keep a copy at home and read a little bit every day. It is often small and has a bright cover.
Give\n\nTo give is to let someone have something of yours. It can be a toy, a hug, or a snack. When you give, you hold it out and the other person takes it. You can give a gift on a birthday. Giving makes people feel happy and kind.
Giza\n\nGiza is a big city in Egypt. It sits next to a long river called the Nile. In Giza, you can see very old, giant stone triangles called pyramids. These pyramids are so big that people from all over the world come to look at them. Long ago, kings were buried inside the pyramids. Near the pyramids, there is a huge statue of a lion with a person's head. It is called the Sphinx. Today, many people live in Giza, and it is a busy place with houses and streets.
Glacier\n\nA glacier is a huge, thick river of ice. It looks like a giant frozen blanket on the land. You find it in very cold places, like tall mountains or near the North and South Poles. It moves very, very slowly, sliding downhill like a slow-motion river. When it moves, it can scrape the ground and carry big rocks with it. A glacier is often a pretty blue color because the ice is so thick. It holds lots of fresh water, like a giant ice cube. Some glaciers are so big you can walk on them, but you must be very careful.
Glad\n\nGlad is a happy feeling. It is the warm, light feeling you get when something good happens. You might feel glad when you see a friend, get a hug, or eat a yummy snack. It makes you smile and want to jump up and down. When you are glad, your heart feels full and bright.
Gladiator\n\nA gladiator was a fighter in old Rome. He fought other men or big wild animals in a big round place called an arena. Many people came to watch him fight. He used a sword, a shield, or a pointy stick. Most gladiators were not free. A few became famous and got lots of cheers.
Gladiolus\n\nGladiolus is a tall plant with big, bright flowers. It grows from a round, brown bulb under the ground. Its leaves are long and pointy, like a green sword. You can find it in gardens or in a vase at home. People plant it in spring, and it blooms in summer. The flowers can be pink, red, orange, yellow, or white. It makes a garden look very pretty.
Gland\n\nA gland is a tiny part inside your body that makes special juices. It looks like a small soft lump. You can find it under your skin, in your tummy, and in other places inside you. It sends out things your body needs, like water for your eyes or spit for your mouth. When you cry, a gland near your eye makes tears. When you eat, a gland in your mouth makes spit to help you swallow.
Glasgow\n\nGlasgow is a big city in Scotland. It sits next to a wide river called the Clyde. Many people live there, and it has tall buildings, shops, and parks. You can see big trains and planes that take people to other places. In the city, people play football, and two teams called Celtic and Rangers are very famous. The weather is often wet and gray, but it can get sunny later in the day.
Glass\n\nGlass is a hard, see-through thing. It can be flat like a window or round like a bottle. You find it in houses, cars, and schools. People use it to look through and to hold water or juice. A drinking cup is made of glass.
Glasses\n\nGlasses are a thing you wear on your face to help you see better. They have two clear pieces called lenses that sit in front of your eyes. The lenses are held in a frame that rests on your nose and hooks behind your ears. You can find glasses in a store where a doctor checks your eyes. People use them to read books, watch TV, or look at things far away. Some kids wear glasses at school, and some grown-ups wear them too.
Glider\n\nA glider is a flying thing with no engine. It has long, flat wings and a small body with seats for the pilot. You can see it in the sky on a sunny day, moving very quietly. A pilot sits inside and uses a stick to turn and go up or down. It cannot go up by itself, so a plane with an engine pulls it up first. Some gliders are so light that one person can carry it.
Global Positioning System\n\nA Global Positioning System is a tool that tells you where you are. It uses signals from far-away things in the sky called satellites. You can find it inside a phone, a car, or a watch. It shows a map and a dot that moves when you move. It helps people find the way to a new place without getting lost.
Globalization\n\nGlobalization is how people and places all over the world become more connected. It means things like toys, food, and clothes can travel from one country to another. You might see a shirt made far away in a store near your home. People also share ideas, music, and games across the world. Sometimes it helps people get new things, but it can also make small local shops close.
Globe\n\nA globe is a round ball that shows the whole Earth. It is like a map, but it is not flat. You can spin it around with your hand. It shows big blue oceans and colorful lands. You can find it in a classroom or a library. A teacher uses it to show where countries are. Some globes even show mountains and rivers. It helps you see how the Earth looks from space.
Glove\n\nA glove is something you put on your hand. It covers all five fingers and keeps them safe. Some gloves are thick and soft to keep hands warm in the cold. Others are thin and rubbery to keep hands clean. You can see gloves in winter when it snows. You also see them on a doctor or a baseball player. A mitten is like a glove but it holds four fingers together in one big pocket.
Glow\n\nGlow is a soft, warm light that comes from something. It can look like a gentle shine in the dark. You might see it from a nightlight in your room, a firefly at night, or the moon in the sky. Some things glow without being hot, like a glow stick when you bend it. It helps you see a little bit when it is dark.
Glue\n\nGlue is a sticky liquid that holds things together. It looks white or clear and feels wet at first. You can find it at school, at home, or in a craft box. People use it to stick paper, wood, or other light things. When it dries, it becomes hard and clear, and the pieces stay joined. A child might use it to make a paper collage or fix a broken toy.
Go\n\nGo is a board game for two people. It has a flat board with many lines that cross, and small round pieces called stones. One player uses black stones, and the other uses white stones. They take turns putting one stone on the board. The goal is to make a big space that belongs to you. It is a very old game that people still play today.
Go (board game)\n\nGo is a board game for two people. It has a flat board with many crossing lines. Players take turns putting down small round pieces called stones. One player uses black stones, and the other uses white stones. The goal is to use your stones to surround empty spaces on the board. You can also capture the other player’s stones by surrounding them. The game ends when both players do not want to move anymore. Then you count the spaces and captured stones to see who wins. Go is very old and was first played in China. Today, people play it all over the world, and you can even play it on a computer.
Goal\n\nA goal is something you want to do or get. It is like a finish line you run toward. You can have a small goal, like tying your shoes all by yourself. You can have a big goal, like learning to ride a bike. When you reach a goal, you feel proud and happy. People set goals to help them try hard and not give up.
Goat\n\nA goat is an animal with four legs and two horns on its head. It has a short tail and a coat of hair that can be white, black, brown, or spotted. You can find it on a farm or in a field, eating grass and leaves. It gives milk that people drink and turn into cheese. A baby goat is called a kid, and it likes to jump and play.
Gobi Desert\n\nThe Gobi Desert is a big, dry place with lots of sand and rocks. It is in two countries called Mongolia and China. It is very hot in the day and very cold at night. Not many plants grow there, but some small bushes and grass can live. Some animals call it home, like camels with two humps, wild donkeys, and big cats with spots. The wind can blow hard and make big dust clouds.
God\n\nGod is a special being that many people believe in. It is not a person you can see or touch. Some people think it made the whole world and everything in it. Many people talk to it when they pray. They believe it listens and cares about them. Different people call it by different names, like God, Allah, or Yahweh.
Godavari River\n\nThe Godavari River is a very long river in India. It starts in a place with hills and flows all the way to the big sea. Many people visit it because they think the water is special and can wash away bad things. Every twelve years, a big happy fair happens next to it. Long ago, people walked along its many ends to ask for babies.
Gold\n\nGold is a shiny yellow metal. It is very soft and heavy. People find it deep under the ground or in rivers. They use it to make pretty rings, necklaces, and coins. A gold coin is bright and does not get rusty. Long ago, people used gold as money. Today, you can see gold in a jewelry shop or on a winner's medal at a race.
Golden\n\nGolden means something looks like the color of gold. It is a bright, shiny yellow. You can see it on a ring, a necklace, or a shiny coin. Sometimes the sun looks golden when it goes down at night. A crown in a storybook is often golden. It feels warm and happy to look at.
Golden eagle\n\nA golden eagle is a big, strong bird that flies high in the sky. It has wide wings, a sharp hooked beak, and big feet with strong claws. It lives in wild places like mountains and open lands far from many people. It hunts small animals like rabbits and squirrels for food. It can be seen in parts of North America, Europe, and Asia. Some people call it the king of birds because it is so big and fast.
Golden Gate Bridge\n\nThe Golden Gate Bridge is a very long bridge that goes over water. It is painted a bright red-orange color. You can find it in California, where it connects two pieces of land. Cars, bikes, and people on foot can cross it. It has two tall towers and big ropes that hold it up. Many people visit it to look at the pretty water and hills.
Golden Rule\n\nThe Golden Rule is a simple rule about being kind. It says: treat other people the way you want them to treat you. If you want your friend to share a toy, you should share your toy too. If you want a hug when you are sad, give a hug when someone else is sad. Many people all over the world follow this rule. It helps everyone get along and feel happy.
Golden Temple\n\nThe Golden Temple is a very special holy place. It is a big, beautiful building that shines with gold on top. It sits in a city called Amritsar, in India. Around it is a big pool of clean water. People come from far away to pray and feel close to God. Inside, they sit quietly and listen to holy songs. Everyone can come in, no matter who they are. There is also a big kitchen that gives free warm food to all the visitors every day.
Goldfish\n\nA goldfish is a small fish that people keep as a pet. It has shiny scales and a tail that helps it swim. You can see it in a fish tank or a pond at home. It swims around and looks for food. Many goldfish are orange or gold, but some are black or have fancy tails. It can learn to know when it is feeding time.
Golf\n\nGolf is a game you play outside on a big field of grass. It uses a small white ball and a long stick called a club. You hit the ball with the club to make it roll into a small hole in the ground. The field has many holes, and you walk from one to the next. You try to use as few hits as possible. The person who gets the ball in all the holes with the fewest hits wins. You can play it with friends or family on a sunny day.
Good\n\nGood means something is nice, happy, or right. It is the opposite of bad. When you share your toy, that is good. When you eat your vegetables, that is good for your body. A sunny day feels good. A hug from mom feels good. People try to be good by helping and being kind.
Good And Evil\n\nGood and evil are two opposite ways of acting. Good means being kind, sharing toys, and helping a friend who is sad. Evil means hurting others on purpose, like pushing or saying mean words. You can see good when someone gives a hug or shares a snack. You can see evil when someone breaks a toy that is not theirs. In stories, good heroes try to save the day, and evil villains try to cause trouble. Everyone can choose to do good things.
Goodbye\n\nGoodbye is a word you say when you leave someone. It means you are going away for a little while or a long time. You can wave your hand and smile when you say it. People say goodbye at the door, at school, or on the phone. It is a nice way to end a talk before you go.
Goodnight\n\nGoodnight is a word you say when it is time to sleep. You say it to your mom, dad, or a friend before you close your eyes. It means "I hope you have a nice sleep." Sometimes you say it when you turn off the light. It is a kind way to end the day.
Goose\n\nA goose is a big water bird with a long neck. It has webbed feet, a flat beak, and soft feathers. You can see it at a pond, a lake, or a farm. It swims in the water and walks on land. It makes a loud honking sound. In the sky, it flies with other geese in a V shape. A baby goose is called a gosling.
Gorilla\n\nA gorilla is a big, strong animal that lives in warm, rainy forests. It has black hair all over its body, a wide chest, and long arms. It walks on its feet and the knuckles of its hands. It lives in Africa with its family group. It eats leaves, vines, and bamboo shoots most of the day. Sometimes it also eats ants or termites. At night, it makes a soft bed of leaves and branches on the ground to sleep in. A baby gorilla holds onto its mother for a long time. An older male gorilla has silver hair on its back and is called a silverback. You can see a gorilla in a zoo or in a picture book about animals.
Gothic art\n\nGothic art is a way of making pictures and statues from a long time ago. It started in France many hundreds of years back. You can see it in big old churches with tall windows. The windows have colored glass that glows when the sun shines through. Artists painted stories from the Bible and made statues of kind-looking mothers with babies. They also painted people from everyday life, like workers and families. Some old books have tiny painted pictures in this style. It looks a little different from art made later, with more gold and soft faces.
Gothic cathedrals\n\nA Gothic cathedral is a very big, old church. It has tall walls and pointy tops that reach high into the sky. You can find it in many old cities in Europe. Long ago, people built it to pray and sing songs. It has big windows with colored glass that let in pretty light. Some have stone arms on the sides that help hold the walls up. A famous one is Notre-Dame in Paris.
Government\n\nA government is a group of people who make rules for a place. It decides what people can and cannot do. You find it in every country, like where you live. It helps keep people safe and builds things like schools and roads. For example, the people in a big building in your town may work for the government.
Gown\n\nA gown is a long, soft dress. It goes from the shoulders all the way down to the feet. People wear it for very special times, like a big party or a wedding. A bride often wears a white gown on her wedding day. A doctor or a nurse may wear a short gown at work to stay clean. Some gowns have pretty flowers or shiny bits on them.
Grab\n\nGrab means to take hold of something fast with your hand. It is a quick move, like when you catch a ball before it falls. You can grab a toy, a cookie, or a friend's hand. When you grab something, you close your fingers around it tight. You might grab a blanket when you are cold. Sometimes you grab a grown-up's hand to cross the street safely.
Grade\n\nA grade is a mark that shows how well you did on school work. It can be a letter like A, B, or C, or a number like 1, 2, or 3. You see it on your paper after your teacher looks at it. It tells you and your family if you did a good job or if you need more practice. A happy face sticker can also be a grade for little kids.
Graffiti\n\nGraffiti is a drawing or writing on a wall or train in a public place. It is often made with paint from a can that sprays color. Sometimes it is just a name or a short word. Other times it is a big, bright picture with many colors. You can see it on city walls, bridges, or old train cars. Some people paint it without asking, and that is against the rules. But some towns have special walls where anyone can paint, and that is okay.
Grain\n\nA grain is a tiny, hard seed that grows on a plant. It is very small and can be brown, yellow, or white. You can find it in fields where farmers grow it in big rows. People pick it and use it to make food like bread, cereal, and pasta. It is good for your body and gives you energy to run and play.
Gram\n\nA gram is a tiny way to measure how heavy something is. It is very light. A paper clip weighs about one gram. You find grams on food boxes and kitchen scales. People use it to weigh small things like sugar or a coin.
Grammar\n\nGrammar is the set of rules for how we use words. It tells us how to put words together so people understand us. When you say "I have a red ball," you use grammar. It helps you know that "red" comes before "ball." In different places, people use grammar a little differently. For example, some say "I didn't do anything," and others say "I didn't do nothing." Both are grammar, just from different groups. Grammar changes slowly over time. The way we talk today is not the same as long ago. It has parts like nouns for things, verbs for actions, and adjectives for describing. All languages have grammar, and it helps us share our ideas.
Gran\n\nA gran is the mom of your mom or your dad. She is older and may have soft white hair. You can visit her at her house, and she might give you a warm hug. She likes to read you a story or bake yummy cookies. A gran loves you very much and smiles when you come to play.
Granary\n\nA granary is a small house on a farm that keeps grain safe. It has no windows, and it stands up on legs so water and mice cannot get in. Inside, it holds dry grain like wheat or corn. Farmers put the grain in through a hole up high and take it out through a door down low. This keeps the food fresh until people or animals need to eat it.
Grand Canyon\n\nThe Grand Canyon is a very big, deep crack in the ground. It is in a place called Arizona. It was made by a river named the Colorado River over a very, very long time. It has many layers of rock that look like stripes. You can see it from the top, and it is so wide and deep. Many people visit it to look and take pictures. Some people walk down inside it or ride a boat on the river.
Grandfather\n\nA grandfather is the dad of your mom or your dad. He is older than your parents, and he may have gray hair or a beard. Many grandfathers live in their own house, and you can visit them for a hug. He might tell you stories, take you to the park, or fix broken toys. Some grandfathers live very near, and some live far away. He loves you very much and is happy when you come to see him.
Grandma\n\nA grandma is the mom of your mom or your dad. She is older than your parents, and she may have white or gray hair. Many grandmas live in their own house, and you can visit them for a treat. She might bake cookies, tell stories, or play games with you. Some grandmas live very near, and some live far away. She loves you very much and is happy when you come to see her.
Grandmother\n\nA grandmother is the mom of your mom or your dad. She is older than your parents, and she may have white or gray hair. Many grandmothers live in their own house, and you can visit them for a treat. She might bake cookies, tell stories, or play games with you. Some grandmothers live very near, and some live far away. Grandpa\n\nA grandpa is the dad of your mom or your dad. He is older than your parents, and he may have white or gray hair. Many grandpas live in their own house, and you can visit them for a hug. He might tell funny stories, take you to the park, or show you how to fix things. Some grandpas live very near, and some live far away. He loves you very much and is happy when you come to see him.
Grandparent\n\nA grandparent is the parent of your mom or your dad. They are older than your parents and may have white or gray hair. You can find them at family parties, at their house, or on a video call. They often play with you, tell stories, or give you hugs and treats. A grandparent can be a grandma or a grandpa. Some kids call them nanna, papa, or other sweet names.
Granite\n\nGranite is a very hard kind of stone. It can be gray, pink, or brown, and sometimes has shiny little spots inside. You can find it deep under the ground, but sometimes it pushes up to make big hills or mountains. People cut it into flat pieces and use it for kitchen counters because it is strong and does not scratch easily. It also looks pretty when it is polished smooth.
Grape\n\nA grape is a small, round fruit that grows in bunches on a vine. It can be green, red, or purple. People eat grapes as a fresh snack, or they use them to make juice and jam. When grapes are dried, they become raisins, which are sweet and chewy. You might find grapes in a lunchbox or at a picnic.
Grapefruit\n\nA grapefruit is a big round fruit that grows on a tree. It has a thick skin that can be yellow or pink. Inside, the soft part can be red, white, or pink. It tastes sour and a little sweet. People cut it in half and eat it with a spoon for breakfast. Some people also make it into juice. It is bigger than an orange. The tree it grows on has dark green leaves and white flowers. If you take medicine, ask a grown-up before you eat grapefruit, because it can change how the medicine works.
Graph\n\nA graph is a picture that shows how two things go together. It has two lines that cross. One line goes up and down, and the other goes side to side. You can put dots on it to show numbers. For example, you can make a graph of how tall you are each year. It helps you see how things change. People use it in school and in books.
Graphic design\n\nGraphic design is a way to share ideas using pictures and words. It uses colors, shapes, and letters to make things look nice and easy to understand. You can see it on book covers, toy boxes, and signs at the store. People called graphic designers make these things. They put words and pictures together so you want to look at them. A cereal box with a happy tiger on it is graphic design.
Grass\n\nGrass is a small green plant that covers the ground. It has thin, flat leaves that grow close together. You can find it in yards, parks, and fields. People walk and play on it, and animals like cows and rabbits eat it. When you cut it short, it feels soft under your feet.
Grasshopper\n\nA grasshopper is a small bug that can jump very far. It has six legs, and the back two legs are big and strong. It lives in fields and gardens where there is lots of grass. It eats leaves and grass. Some people even eat it as food because it is good for the body.
Grassland\n\nA grassland is a big open place where the ground is covered with tall green grass. It has very few trees, so you can see far away. Many animals live there, like zebras, elephants, and rabbits. They eat the grass and run across the wide land. Some grasslands are called savannas or prairies. You can find them in hot parts of the world, like Africa.
Grateful\n\nGrateful is a warm, happy feeling you have when someone does something kind for you. It feels like a big hug inside your heart. You can feel it when a friend shares a toy, or when Mom makes your favorite snack. When you feel grateful, you want to say "thank you" and smile. It makes both you and the other person feel good.
Gravel\n\nGravel is many small, loose stones. It feels bumpy and rough when you touch it. You can find it on paths, in gardens, or on playgrounds. People use it to make roads and walkways so cars and feet do not slip. Sometimes it is mixed with sand to make strong stuff for building. It comes from old beaches or big rocks that are broken into tiny pieces.
Gravitational wave\n\nA gravitational wave is a tiny wiggle in space. It is like a small bump that moves through the air, but you cannot see it or feel it. It comes from very big things far away, like two giant stars crashing into each other. Scientists use big tools with long pipes and lights to find it. When they catch one, they learn about stars and how the sky works.
Gravity\n\nGravity is a pull that brings things together. It is invisible, like the wind, but you can see what it does. When you drop a ball, it falls down because the Earth pulls on it. The Earth is very big, so its pull is strong. The Moon also has gravity, but its pull is smaller. That is why people on the Moon can jump higher. Gravity keeps the Moon moving around the Earth and the Earth moving around the Sun. Without it, everything would float away.
Gray\n\nGray is a color. It is made by mixing black and white together. You can see it on a rainy day when the clouds are dark and soft. An elephant has thick gray skin. A pencil leaves a gray mark when you write on paper. Some roads and sidewalks are made of gray stone called cement. Gray is not as dark as black and not as bright as white. It sits right in the middle.
Grazer\n\nA grazer is an animal that eats grass. It has strong teeth to chew the tough grass all day. You can find it in big open fields where lots of grass grows. It moves slowly and eats for many hours. A cow is a grazer you might see on a farm. A horse is another grazer that likes to eat grass.
Great\n\nGreat means very big, very good, or very important. You might see a great big mountain that touches the sky. A great cake tastes so yummy you want more. When someone does something great, like sharing a toy, it makes others happy. A great big hug feels warm and safe.
Great Barrier Reef\n\nThe Great Barrier Reef is a huge, colorful home under the sea. It is made of many tiny animals called coral that build hard, rocky houses. It lives in the warm, blue water near a big island called Australia. Many fish, turtles, and other sea animals swim and play there. It is so big that people can see it from way up in space. The water must stay cool and clean for the coral to stay healthy.
Great Britain\n\nGreat Britain is a big island in the ocean. It has green hills, cities, and many people. You find it across the water from France and near Ireland. Three countries sit on it: England, Scotland, and Wales. The biggest city is London, where Big Ben stands. Many children live there and go to school.
Great Depression\n\nThe Great Depression was a long, sad time when many people had no money. It happened a long time ago. Stores closed, and many moms and dads lost their jobs. People stood in long lines to get a little bit of food. It was hard to buy new shoes or toys. Many families had to share one small home. After many years, things slowly got better.
Great Dividing Range\n\nThe Great Dividing Range is a very long line of hills and mountains in Australia. It runs along the east side of the country, from the top to the bottom. It is not one single mountain, but many hills and flat high places all in a row. The land is high, so clouds bump into it and drop lots of rain. This makes the coast side wet and green. Many rivers start here and flow down to the sea. Some parts are so big that people made parks to keep the trees and animals safe. You can see it if you look at a map of Australia — it is the long green line near the water.
Great Lakes\n\nThe Great Lakes are five very big lakes in North America. They are so big that they hold a lot of the world's fresh water. The five lakes are called Superior, Michigan, Huron, Erie, and Ontario. They are found on the border between the United States and Canada. One of them, Lake Michigan, is only in the United States. Many big cities sit next to them, like Chicago and Toronto. The lakes are all connected, so water can flow from one to the next. They are home to many fish and other water animals. People use the lakes for boats, fishing, and swimming. But sometimes, new plants or animals from far away get into the lakes and cause problems. Also, dirty water from factories can hurt the lakes. People work hard to keep the Great Lakes clean and safe.
Great Plains\n\nThe Great Plains is a big, flat land with lots of grass. It is in the middle of North America. It has hot summers and cold winters. Long ago, many big, hairy animals called bison lived there. Now, people grow food like wheat and corn on the land. Cows eat the grass and the food that grows there.
Great Pyramid of Giza\n\nThe Great Pyramid of Giza is a very big stone building in Egypt. It has a pointy top and four flat sides that meet at the bottom. It was built a long, long time ago for a king. Inside, there are three rooms and two long paths. People from all over the world come to see it because it is so old and so big.
Great Rift Valley\n\nThe Great Rift Valley is a very long, deep crack in the ground. It runs through many countries in Africa. It has tall mountains and big lakes along its sides. Some lakes are very deep and full of fish. People can see it in special parks where animals live.
Great Slave Lake\n\nGreat Slave Lake is a very big lake in Canada. It is long and wide, and it is the deepest lake in North America. The water is cold and deep, and in winter it freezes so people can drive cars on it. Many towns sit next to it, like Yellowknife. People live there and fish in it. Long ago, gold was found near it, and people came to dig for gold. Animals like birds and fish live in and around it.
Great Smoky Mountains National Park\n\nGreat Smoky Mountains National Park is a big park in the mountains. It sits in two states, Tennessee and North Carolina. The park has tall hills covered with many trees. You can see black bears, birds, and small animals that live there. People go to the park to walk on long paths and sleep in tents. It is a place where the air often looks a little smoky and blue.
Great Sphinx\n\nThe Great Sphinx is a very big statue made of stone. It has the head of a person and the body of a lion. It sits in the sand in a country called Egypt, near big triangle buildings called pyramids. It is very old and very large. The face looks straight ahead, and the paws stretch out in front. Long ago, people may have made it to guard the pyramids or to remember a king. Today, wind and water slowly wear the stone away, so people work to keep it safe.
Great Victoria Desert\n\nThe Great Victoria Desert is a very big, dry place in Australia. It is the largest desert in that country. It has tall sand hills, flat grassy spots, and salty lakes. It gets very little rain each year. Some animals live there, like kangaroos, lizards, and birds. They can stay alive in the hot sun and cold nights. Long ago, people from England tested big bombs in this desert. Today, not many people live there, but some families have called it home for a very long time.
Great Wall of China\n\nThe Great Wall of China is a very long wall made of stone, bricks, and dirt. It is so big that it goes over hills and across fields for many, many miles.
