You can find it in the country of China. Long ago, people built it to keep enemies out and to stay safe. It has tall towers where soldiers once stood to watch for danger. Today, many people walk on it and take pictures of it. It is one of the biggest things people have ever made.
Great white shark\n\nA great white shark is a very big fish that lives in the sea. It has a long, strong body, a pointy nose, and a big fin on its back. It has many sharp teeth that look like little triangles. It lives in warm water near the coast. It swims fast and hunts other animals like fish and seals. You might see one in a movie or a picture book about the ocean.
Great Zimbabwe\n\nGreat Zimbabwe is a very old city made of stone. It sits on a hill in a country called Zimbabwe, far away in Africa. It has big, tall walls built without any sticky stuff to hold the stones together. Long ago, a king and many people lived there. They bought and sold things with people from far places. Today, the city is empty and quiet, but people can visit and see the big stone walls.
Greater Antilles\n\nThe Greater Antilles is a group of big islands in the warm, blue sea. It has four main islands: Cuba, Jamaica, Hispaniola, and Puerto Rico. Hispaniola is one island with two countries on it. These islands are made of hard, old rock. They are not like the small islands nearby that grew from hot rock under the sea. People live on these islands and grow food like bananas and sugar. Many birds and colorful fish live around them too.
Greece\n\nGreece is a country in Europe. It is a place with many mountains and blue sea all around it. The land has many small islands, and the water is warm and clear. People live in white houses with blue roofs, and they grow olives and grapes. A long, long time ago, people in Greece told stories about gods and built big stone buildings. Today, many people visit Greece to see the old stones and swim in the sea.
Greed\n\nGreed is a strong wish to have more things than you need. It feels like a hungry voice inside that says, "I want more, more, more!" You can see it when someone grabs all the cookies and does not share. It can make a person forget to be kind. When you share your toys, you push greed away.
Greek\n\nGreek is something from a country called Greece. It can be the people who live there, the food they eat, or the way they talk. Greek people might eat flat bread, cheese, and olives. The Greek language uses letters that look different from English letters. Long ago, people in Greece built big stone buildings with tall white columns. You might see a Greek flag with blue and white stripes.
Greek alphabet\n\nThe Greek alphabet is a set of letters people use to write the Greek language. It has 24 letters, each with a big and a small shape. You can see these letters in math and science books, where they stand for numbers or ideas. Long ago, people used it to write stories and notes, and today people in Greece still use it every day. Some letters look like English letters, like A and B, but others have their own special shape.
Greek language\n\nGreek is a way of talking and writing that people use. It has its own letters that look different from the ones we use in English. Many people speak it in a country called Greece and on an island called Cyprus. A long, long time ago, people wrote big stories and smart ideas in Greek. Today, children in Greece learn to read and write it in school. Some words we use in English, like 'alphabet' and 'school', came from Greek.
Greek mythology\n\nGreek mythology is a big set of old stories from Greece. It tells about gods, goddesses, and brave people. The gods live on a tall mountain called Olympus. Zeus is the king of the gods and makes thunder and lightning. Poseidon is the god of the sea. The stories also have strange animals like a horse with a man's top, called a centaur. People long ago told these stories to explain the sun, the moon, and how the world began.
Green\n\nGreen is a color you see all around you. It sits between yellow and blue in the rainbow. You can make green paint by mixing yellow and blue paint together. Most leaves on trees and bushes are green because they have a special part inside that makes them look that way. Grass, frogs, and some apples are green too. When you look at a green light, it feels calm and cool.
Green algae\n\nGreen algae is a tiny living thing that grows in water. It looks like soft green fuzz or slime. You can find it in ponds, lakes, and even in a fish tank. It makes its own food from sunlight, just like a plant. Sometimes it floats on top of the water and makes it look green.
Green bean\n\nA green bean is a long, thin vegetable that is green. It grows on a plant in a garden or on a farm. You can find it fresh at the store, or in a can, or in a freezer bag. People cook it in hot water, in a pan, or in the oven. It is soft and a little sweet when you eat it. Some people mix it with mushrooms and crispy onions in a big dish. Others cook it with garlic and a dark sauce. You must cook it before you eat it, because raw ones can make your tummy hurt.
Green iguana\n\nA green iguana is a big lizard with green skin. It has a long tail, four legs with sharp claws, and a row of little spikes down its back. It lives in warm places with lots of trees, like forests in South America and on islands. It climbs trees to eat leaves, flowers, and fruit. Some people keep it as a pet in a big cage. You might see it at a zoo or in a book about animals.
Green politics\n\nGreen politics is a way of thinking about how people run a country. It cares a lot about keeping the air, water, and land clean. People who follow it want to use less stuff that makes smoke and dirt. They also want to protect animals and trees. You might see them planting trees or picking up trash at a park. They believe we should take good care of the Earth so it stays nice for everyone.
Greenhouse effect\n\nThe greenhouse effect is like a warm blanket around the Earth. It happens when some gases in the air hold heat from the sun. These gases are called greenhouse gases. One of them is carbon dioxide. The blanket keeps our planet warm enough for plants, animals, and people to live. But when people burn too much coal and oil, more carbon dioxide goes into the air. This makes the blanket too thick. Then the Earth gets too hot. That can cause big changes in weather and hurt animals in the ocean. We can help by using less energy and planting more trees.
Greenland\n\nGreenland is a very big island in the cold part of the world. It is covered with white ice and snow almost everywhere. The ground is hard and frozen, so trees do not grow tall there. Most people live near the sea, in small towns on the edge of the island. They use boats to catch fish and travel. The houses are often painted in bright colors like red, blue, and yellow. In winter, the sun does not come up for many days, and it is dark all the time. In summer, the sun stays out even at night, so children can play outside very late. Greenland is a place of ice, snow, and long, long nights.
Greenland ice sheet\n\nThe Greenland ice sheet is a huge blanket of ice that covers most of Greenland. It is very, very big and very, very thick. In some places, the ice is taller than a mountain. It is so heavy that it pushes the land down. If all the ice melted, the sea would rise and cover many beaches and towns. The ice is very old, much older than any person. It is the second biggest ice sheet in the whole world.
Greenland Sea\n\nThe Greenland Sea is a big body of water. It touches Greenland on one side and some islands on the other side. The water is very cold, and ice forms on top in winter. Many animals live in it, like seals, whales, and fish. Some seals have their babies on the ice there. People have gone there to hunt seals for a long time. The land near the sea has small plants that deer and big hairy oxen eat. Polar bears also live there and hunt for food.
Greeting\n\nA greeting is a way to say hello when you see someone. It can be a word, a wave, or a smile. You use it when you meet a friend, a teacher, or a family member. In the morning, you might say "good morning." When you wave your hand, that is also a greeting. It helps people feel happy and welcome.
Grenada\n\nGrenada is a small island country in the warm blue sea. It has green hills, sandy beaches, and colorful houses. Many people there grow spices like nutmeg, which smells sweet and goes into cakes. You can see boats and fish in the clear water. The main town is called St. George's, and it sits by a big, safe harbor.
Grey\n\nGrey is a color. It is not as dark as black and not as light as white. You can see it in clouds on a rainy day, in a soft mouse, or in a big elephant. Some rocks and stones are grey too. When you mix black paint and white paint together, you get grey. It is a quiet color that feels calm.
Grid\n\nA grid is a set of lines that cross each other. It looks like a big net made of straight lines going up and down and side to side. You can find a grid on a piece of paper with squares, like the kind you use for math. It helps people draw or put things in neat rows and columns. A checkerboard is a grid with black and red squares.
Grief\n\nGrief is a big sad feeling. It comes when someone or something you love is gone. You might cry a lot or feel very quiet inside. Sometimes it makes your tummy hurt or your eyes feel hot. It is okay to feel this way, and it gets softer over time. A hug from someone you trust can help.
Grill\n\nA grill is a metal frame that gets very hot. It sits on legs and has a flat top with bars. People put it outside in a yard or on a porch. They use it to cook food like burgers, hot dogs, and corn. The heat makes dark lines on the food and gives it a smoky taste. You might see a grill at a park or a friend's house when the weather is warm.
Grill (cooking)\n\nA grill is a tool for cooking food outside. It has a metal rack that holds the food over heat. The heat can come from burning wood, charcoal, or gas. It makes the food hot and gives it a smoky taste. People use it to cook meat like burgers, hot dogs, and steak. Many families use it in the summer for a fun meal in the yard.
Grimms' Fairy Tales\n\nGrimms' Fairy Tales is a big book of made-up stories. It has many tales about princes, princesses, talking animals, and magic. You can find it in a library or on a shelf at home. Grown-ups read the stories out loud to children before bed. One story you might know is about a girl named Snow White who lives with seven little friends.
Grind\n\nGrind means to rub something hard until it breaks into tiny bits. You can grind a rock with a bigger, harder rock. People grind coffee beans in a machine to make coffee. When you chew your food, your teeth grind it into small pieces so you can swallow. A loud, rough sound can also be called a grind, like when two stones scrape together.
Grip\n\nA grip is how you hold something with your hand. It is the way your fingers wrap around a thing and squeeze it tight. You use a grip when you pick up a cup, hold a crayon, or swing on the monkey bars. A good grip keeps the thing from slipping out of your hand. When you shake hands with a friend, you use a gentle grip.
Ground squirrel\n\nA ground squirrel is a small furry animal that lives on and in the ground. It has a round body, short legs, and a short tail. It digs holes and makes a home under the dirt called a burrow. It sleeps inside the burrow all winter long. When it stands up on its back legs, it can look around for danger. It makes a loud whistle to tell other ground squirrels to hide. Many of them live together in big groups.
Groundwater\n\nGroundwater is water that hides under the ground. It fills tiny holes in dirt and rocks. Rain falls from the sky and soaks down to become groundwater. It moves slowly under our feet for a long time. Sometimes it pops back up as a spring or flows into a river. Plants drink it with their roots to grow. People dig deep holes called wells to bring it up. They use it to water farms and for drinking.
Group\n\nA group is when two or more people or things are together. It can be a few friends playing in the park. You might see a group of birds flying in the sky. In school, your class is a group of children who learn together. A group shares something, like a game or a place.
Grouper\n\nA grouper is a big fish that lives in the sea. It has a wide mouth and a strong body. You can find it near warm coral reefs, hiding in rocks. It eats smaller fish and sometimes works with an octopus to catch food. Some groupers are as big as a grown-up person.
Grouse\n\nA grouse is a bird that looks a little like a chicken. It has brown, gray, and red feathers that help it hide on the ground. Its legs are covered with soft feathers all the way down to its toes. It lives in woods and fields, where it walks around looking for seeds and berries to eat. Some people call it a game bird because hunters sometimes look for it. You might see a picture of it in a book about forest animals.
Grow\n\nTo grow means to get bigger over time. A tiny seed can grow into a tall plant with green leaves. A baby grows into a child, then a grown-up. You need good food, water, and sleep to grow strong. A puppy grows fast and soon becomes a big dog. When you look at a photo from last year, you can see how much you have grown.
Growth\n\nGrowth means getting bigger or older. A tiny seed grows into a tall plant with green leaves. A baby grows into a child, then a grown-up. You can see growth when you mark your height on the wall every year. Animals grow too—a puppy grows into a big dog. Growth happens slowly, a little bit every day.
Guam\n\nGuam is a small island in the big blue ocean. It has warm weather, sandy beaches, and clear water with fish. Many people visit it to swim and play. It is part of the United States, so people there use dollars. The island has a city called Hagta and a busy beach called Tumon Bay.
Guanaco\n\nA guanaco is a tall animal with a long neck and soft, warm fur. It looks a little like a small camel without a hump. It lives in South America, high up on hills and mountains. It eats grass and leaves and can go a long time without drinking water. When it sees danger, it makes a loud call to warn its friends, and they all run away fast.
Guard\n\nA guard is a person who keeps a place safe. He watches the door or walks around to make sure no one gets hurt. You can see a guard at a school, a store, or a big building. He wears a special shirt or hat so you know who he is. He helps people when they are lost or need help.
Guatemala\n\nGuatemala is a country in the middle part of the world called Central America. It has warm weather and many mountains. Many people live there, and they speak Spanish. A long time ago, the big city moved three times because of fire mountains and shaking ground. Now the main city is called Guatemala City. You can see bright colored cloth and taste sweet fruits if you visit.
Guatemala City\n\nGuatemala City is a big, busy city. It is the most important city in the country of Guatemala. It has many houses, stores, and tall buildings. People go there to buy and sell things at big markets. You can also see old buildings where leaders once worked. It is full of cars, buses, and people walking on the streets.
Guava\n\nA guava is a sweet fruit that grows on a small tree. It is round like a ball and can be green or yellow on the outside. Inside, it has soft pink or white parts with tiny hard seeds. You can eat it raw, just like an apple, or make it into juice. It grows in warm places where the sun shines a lot. It has more vitamin C than an orange, so it helps keep you from getting sick.
Guess\n\nA guess is when you try to say an answer but you are not sure. It is like picking a door without knowing what is behind it. You can make a guess when you play a game, like guessing how many candies are in a jar. Sometimes your guess is right, and sometimes it is not. That is okay because a guess is just a try.
Guest\n\nA guest is a person who comes to visit your home. He or she may be a friend, a family member, or someone new. When a guest comes, you can say hello and make them feel welcome. They might stay for a short time, like for a meal, or sleep over for a night. You can share your toys or show them your room. A guest is someone you are kind to while they are with you.
Guide\n\nA guide is a person who shows the way. He helps you go from one place to another safely. You might see a guide on a hike in the woods or in a big museum. He points to things and tells you what they are. A guide can also be a book or a sign that gives you steps to follow.
Guild\n\nA guild is a group of people who do the same kind of work. Long ago, in towns, they made rules about how to learn and do their job. A new person had to learn from an older, wise worker for many years. After that, they could do the work on their own. There were guilds for bakers, builders, cloth makers, and many others. Today, some old guilds still help pick the leader of a big city.
Guilt (emotion)\n\nGuilt is a feeling you get when you think you did something wrong. It feels heavy and sad inside your chest or tummy. You might feel it after you break a toy, say a mean word, or take a cookie without asking. It can make you want to say sorry or fix what you did. Sometimes it helps you learn to be kind and do the right thing next time.
Guinea\n\nGuinea is a country in Africa. It is a big piece of land with many trees and rivers. People there speak French. Many people in Guinea follow the Muslim faith. The biggest city is Conakry, and it sits by the ocean.
Guinea pig\n\nA guinea pig is a small, furry animal that people keep as a pet. It has a round body, short legs, and no tail. Its ears are small and floppy. It comes in many colors like white, brown, black, and spots. You can find it in homes, where it lives in a big cage with soft bedding. It likes to eat hay, fresh veggies, and special pellets. It makes cute squeaky sounds when it is happy or hungry. A guinea pig needs a friend to play with because it does not like to be alone. Children often hold it gently in their hands and pet its soft fur.
Guitar\n\nA guitar is a musical instrument that makes sound when you pluck its strings. It has a big hollow body, a long neck, and six strings that go from the top to the bottom. You can see it in many places, like at home, in a music class, or on a stage. People use it to play songs by pressing the strings with one hand and plucking them with the other hand. A guitar can be soft and quiet or loud and fun, like the music you hear on the radio.
Gulf of Aden\n\nThe Gulf of Aden is a big body of water. It is part of the Indian Ocean. It sits between the land of Yemen on one side and Somalia on the other side. In the top corner, it joins the Red Sea through a narrow water path. In the bottom corner, it joins the Somali Sea. Big boats use it to carry things from one place to another.
Gulf of Alaska\n\nThe Gulf of Alaska is a big part of the ocean. It touches the south side of Alaska. The water is cold and blue. Big walls of ice called glaciers sit right next to the water. Some of these ice walls are as tall as tall buildings. Many fish, seals, and whales live in it. Big boats go there to catch fish. The land around it has tall mountains and dark green trees. Sometimes big waves roll in from the sea.
Gulf of Carpentaria\n\nThe Gulf of Carpentaria is a big, shallow sea in the north of Australia. It has land on three sides. The water is not very deep, and the bottom is flat. In the dry time of year, the wind blows and the sky is clear. In the wet time, lots of rain falls and the land near it gets covered with water. Long ago, people from far away came in boats and gave it its name.
Gulf of Guinea\n\nThe Gulf of Guinea is a big part of the ocean near West Africa. It is a warm, blue sea that touches many countries. You can find it on a map where the middle line of the world crosses the water. Big rivers like the Niger flow into it. It has many small islands, and some of them have tall mountains that once were hot fire mountains. People on the islands speak different languages and catch fish in the sea.
Gulf of Mexico\n\nThe Gulf of Mexico is a very big bowl of water next to the United States, Mexico, and Cuba. It is part of the big ocean called the Atlantic. The water in it is warm, and many fish live there. People catch fish from it to eat. Big storms called hurricanes can grow over its warm water. Some people also call it the Gulf of America, but many still say Gulf of Mexico.
Gulf of Saint Lawrence\n\nThe Gulf of Saint Lawrence is a very big body of water. It is where the Saint Lawrence River meets the big ocean. It has land on many sides, like a giant bowl of water. Many rivers flow into it, and it is home to fish, birds, and other animals. People use boats to cross it and to catch fish. Some small islands sit inside it, and birds stop there on long trips.
Gulf of Thailand\n\nThe Gulf of Thailand is a big body of water next to land. It is part of a bigger sea. Three countries touch it: Thailand, Cambodia, and Vietnam. It is not very deep, so the water is warm. Many rivers bring fresh water into it, so the water is not very salty. People like to visit because the water is warm and clear. They can see pretty fish and colorful rocks under the water. Some islands in the gulf have sandy beaches where families play and swim.
Gull\n\nA gull is a bird that lives near water. It has a white body, gray or black wings, and a yellow beak. It is about the size of a chicken. You can see it at the beach, by a lake, or even in a city. It looks for food on the ground, like bits of bread or fish. It can swim because it has special feet. It makes loud calls to talk to other gulls. A baby gull is called a chick.
Gulp\n\nA gulp is a big, fast swallow. It happens when you drink or eat something quickly. You can hear a small sound in your throat when you do it. Sometimes you gulp when you are very thirsty or scared. It is like a big sip that goes down all at once.
Gun\n\nA gun is a tool that can shoot a small metal piece very fast. It is made of hard metal and has a long part called a barrel. Police officers sometimes carry one to keep people safe. It makes a very loud bang when it shoots. You should never touch a gun because it can hurt someone badly. If you see one, tell a grown-up right away.
Gun dog\n\nA gun dog is a dog that helps people who hunt. It finds birds and brings them back. Some gun dogs point with their nose to show where a bird is hiding. Others run into bushes to scare birds out. A golden retriever is a kind of gun dog. It has soft yellow fur and loves to swim. Many people keep gun dogs as pets at home too.
Gunpowder\n\nGunpowder is a black powder that burns very fast. It is made from three things: saltpeter, charcoal, and sulfur. When it burns, it makes hot gas that pushes out hard. People put it inside guns and cannons to shoot a bullet or a ball far away. A long time ago, people in China first made it by mixing those three things. They also used it to make fireworks that fly up and go boom with bright colors. Today, you might see it in fireworks on a holiday.
Guppy\n\nA guppy is a tiny fish that lives in water. It has shiny scales and a tail that can be many bright colors like red, blue, or yellow. People keep it in a glass tank at home as a pet. It swims all day and is fun to watch. A guppy mom does not lay eggs—she has live babies that swim right away. It is easy to take care of and does not need much food.
Gupta Empire\n\nThe Gupta Empire was a big, old kingdom in a land called India. It was a time when people made beautiful art, wrote stories, and built tall temples. A king ruled over many towns and villages. People grew food on farms and traded things like cloth and spices. Long ago, children learned math and played games there.
Gut\n\nA gut is a long, twisty tube inside your belly. It looks like a soft, pink hose that folds up many times. You find it inside your tummy, below your ribs. It helps your body take good things from the food you eat and turns the rest into poop. When you eat an apple, your gut works to get the sweet part and the vitamins out of it.
Guy\n\nA guy is another word for a boy or a man. He can be tall or short, and he might have short hair or long hair. You can see a guy at school, at the park, or at the store. He can be a dad, a brother, a friend, or a teacher. A guy might like to play ball, read books, or tell funny jokes.
Gym\n\nA gym is a big room where people go to move their bodies and get strong. It has things like heavy balls, jump ropes, and soft mats on the floor. You can find a gym in a school or a special building in town. People run, jump, and lift things there to stay healthy. Sometimes a teacher shows kids fun games to play with a ball.
Gymnastics\n\nGymnastics is a sport where people move their bodies in strong and bendy ways. It has running, jumping, rolling, and flipping. In a gym, you can see a soft floor, a long low beam, and bars to swing on. Some gymnasts also use a big bouncy mat called a trampoline. They work hard to stay balanced and do moves that look like dancing. You might see gymnastics at a big sports show or on TV.
Ha\n\nHa is a sound people make with their mouth. It can be a laugh when something is funny. You might say it when you are surprised or when you blow out air. Sometimes people say it when they are tired after running. You can hear it when someone finds a fun surprise.
Habit\n\nA habit is something you do again and again without thinking much. It can be a good thing, like brushing your teeth every morning. It can also be a not-so-good thing, like biting your nails. You learn a habit by doing it many times until your body remembers. For example, putting on your seatbelt in the car is a habit for many people.
Habitat\n\nA habitat is a place where an animal or plant lives. It has everything the living thing needs, like food, water, and a safe spot to sleep. A pond is a habitat for frogs and ducks. A forest is a habitat for bears and tall trees. A desert is a habitat for cacti and lizards. If a habitat gets too hot or is cut down, the animals and plants may have to move or they may get hurt.
Had\n\nHad is a word we use to say something was with us before. It means you held it or owned it in the past. You might say, "I had a red ball yesterday." It is not with you now, but it was. You can use it for things, like a toy, or for feelings, like being happy. When you tell a story about what happened, you often use the word had.
Haddock\n\nA haddock is a fish that lives in the cold, salty sea. It has a long body with shiny silver skin and a dark mark on its side. People catch it in big nets far out in the ocean. It is a fish that many people like to eat. You can find it at the store or in a fish market. Sometimes it is cooked fresh, and sometimes it is smoked to give it a strong taste.
Hades\n\nHades is a king from very old Greek stories. He lives in a dark place under the ground where people go after they die. He is not mean, but people in the stories were scared of him. He has a wife named Persephone. She stays with him for part of the year. He has a special hat that makes him hard to see. His fruit is a red pomegranate.
Hagfish\n\nA hagfish is a long, thin fish that lives in the sea. It has a soft body with no hard bones, and its skin feels smooth. It has small eyes and little whiskers near its mouth to feel things. It lives deep down at the bottom of the sea. It eats dead fish and worms by using tiny teeth on its tongue. When it gets scared, it makes a lot of thick, gooey slime from its sides. The slime helps keep it safe from other animals.
Hagia Sophia\n\nHagia Sophia is a very old, big building in a city called Istanbul. It has a giant round roof called a dome that sits high up. Inside, the walls shine with tiny colored stones that make pictures. Long ago, people used it as a church to pray. Later, it became a mosque where people pray today. Many visitors come to look at its tall walls and bright lights.
Haiku\n\nA haiku is a short poem from Japan. It has three little parts. The first part has five sounds, the second has seven, and the last has five. It often talks about nature, like a frog jumping into a pond or a flower in the sun. You can write one too—just count the sounds on your fingers.
Hair\n\nHair is a thin, soft thing that grows out of your skin. It can be long or short, straight or curly. You have lots of it on top of your head. Some people have dark hair, and some have light hair. It keeps your head warm when it is cold outside. You can brush it, wash it, and put it in a ponytail. Many people go to a shop to cut it when it gets too long.
Hairbrush\n\nA hairbrush is a tool with a handle and many little sticks called bristles. It is used to make hair smooth and neat. You can find it in a bathroom or on a dresser. People use it every day to untangle hair after sleeping or before going out. Some hairbrushes are flat, and some are round. A child might see a small, colorful one with a soft grip.
Haircut\n\nA haircut is when someone cuts your hair to make it shorter. It happens at a special place called a salon or a barber shop. A grown-up sits in a big chair and wears a cape so hair does not fall on their clothes. The person cutting uses scissors or a buzzing tool. After it, your hair looks neat and tidy. You might get a haircut before a party or a picture day at school.
Hairstyle\n\nA hairstyle is the way a person's hair is cut and shaped. It can be short, long, straight, or curly. You see hairstyles every day on your friends, your family, and on TV. People change their hairstyle to look nice or to feel good. Some people like to put their hair up in a ponytail, and some like to wear it down. A barber or a hair stylist helps cut and shape hair into a new style.
Haiti\n\nHaiti is a country on an island in the warm blue sea. It shares the island with another country. Haiti has many tall green mountains and used to have many trees. People there speak French and a special kind of French mixed with African words. The biggest city is Port-au-Prince. Many people in Haiti grow food like mangoes and coffee to sell. A long time ago, the people fought to be free and became the first black republic. Sometimes big storms called hurricanes come and bring lots of rain. In 2010, the ground shook very hard in an earthquake, and many buildings fell down.
Hajj\n\nHajj is a big trip that Muslim people take. They go to a special city called Mecca. It is something they try to do once in their life if they can. Many people walk together and pray. They wear simple white clothes so everyone looks the same. It is a time to feel close to God.
Half\n\nA half is one of two equal parts of a whole thing. It is what you get when you cut something right down the middle. You can find a half when you share a cookie with a friend. If you have a whole apple and you cut it into two same-size pieces, each piece is a half. Two halves make one whole again.
Halibut\n\nA halibut is a big, flat fish that lives in the ocean. It has both eyes on one side of its head, and its body is brown on top and white underneath. People catch it to eat because its meat tastes good. It can grow very large, bigger than a big dog. You might see it at a fish store or on a dinner plate.
Hall\n\nA hall is a big room inside a building. It has a long, open floor and a high ceiling. You can find a hall in a school, a church, or a big house. People use it for walking from one room to another, or for having a party with many friends. Sometimes a hall has chairs and a stage for a show.
Halley's Comet\n\nHalley's Comet is a big ball of ice and dust that flies through space. It looks like a bright star with a long, glowing tail. You can see it in the night sky, but only once every 75 or 76 years. It travels around the Sun, and when it gets close, the Sun makes it shine and grow a tail. The last time people saw it was in 1986. The next time will be in 2061, when you are much older.
Halloween\n\nHalloween is a fun night on October 31. It is a time when children dress up in costumes. They go to houses and say "Trick or treat!" to get candy. People often wear scary clothes like ghosts or witches. Many homes have a pumpkin with a face cut out and a light inside. It is called a jack-o'-lantern. The colors of Halloween are black and orange. You might see fake spiders, bats, and skeletons as decorations. It is a happy night for playing pretend and eating sweets.
Halo\n\nA halo is a bright circle of light. It looks like a ring that shines above a person's head. You often see it in old paintings of angels or special people. It shows that the person is very good and kind. Sometimes you can see a halo around the moon on a cold night, made by tiny ice bits in the sky.
Ham\n\nHam is a kind of meat that comes from a pig. It is the back leg part of the pig. It is often pink and can be cut into thin, flat pieces. You can find it at the store in a cold box or in a can. People eat it on a sandwich with bread, or they put it on a plate with eggs for breakfast. Some ham is salty and some is a little sweet. It is a food many kids like.
Hamburg\n\nHamburg is a big city in the north of Germany. It sits next to a wide river called the Elbe, not far from the sea. Many boats and ships come to its port, which is one of the busiest in the world. People use the port to move boxes of toys, food, and clothes to other places. Hamburg has many bridges, more than any other city. It also has a big park where you can run and play. Some parts of the city have old, pretty buildings, and others have new, tall ones.
Hamburger\n\nA hamburger is a round, flat piece of meat between two soft bread buns. It often has a slice of cheese, a red tomato, and a green lettuce leaf on top. You can eat it with your hands, no fork needed. Many kids get one at a fast-food place with a toy. A cheeseburger is the same but with a melty cheese slice.
Hammer\n\nA hammer is a tool that helps you push nails into wood. It has a long stick you hold and a heavy metal part at the top. One side of the metal part is flat for hitting nails. The other side can be curved to pull nails out. You find hammers in a toolbox at home or with a builder. People use it to fix things or build new things like a birdhouse. A big hammer with a long handle is called a sledgehammer. You swing it with two hands to break big rocks. Long ago, people made hammers from stones tied to sticks.
Hammerhead shark\n\nA hammerhead shark is a kind of shark with a head shaped like a hammer. It has eyes on the ends of its wide head, so it can see all around. It lives in the ocean and swims near the bottom. It hunts fish, squids, and stingrays, using its head to hit them. It is gray with a white belly and can be as long as a car. Some people think it is a special protector of the sea.
Hamster\n\nA hamster is a tiny, furry animal that people keep as a pet. It looks a little like a mouse with a short tail. It has big, puffy cheeks where it hides its food. In the wild, it lives in dry, sandy places and sleeps during the day. As a pet, it lives in a cage with soft bedding. It loves to run on a wheel and play in tubes. It eats seeds, fruits, and veggies from a pet store. A hamster is fun to watch, but small children should be gentle with it.
Han\n\nHan is a name that many people have. It can be a boy's name or a girl's name. Some people have Han as their last name, too. You might meet a friend named Han at school or at the park. It is a short name that is easy to say and remember.
Han Dynasty\n\nThe Han Dynasty was a family of rulers in China a long, long time ago. It lasted for many hundreds of years. People remember it as a time when China grew big and strong. They made beautiful silk cloth and wrote on paper. Many children today learn about it in school.
Hand\n\nA hand is the part of your body at the end of your arm. It has four fingers and one thumb. The flat part inside is called the palm. It can bend and make a fist. You use it to hold a toy, eat food, and wave hello.
Handbag\n\nA handbag is a bag that people carry to hold their things. It is often made of soft cloth or leather. It has one or two straps so you can hold it in your hand or on your shoulder. People put many things inside it, like keys, a phone, a small wallet, and a brush. Some handbags are big, and some are small. You can see many people with a handbag at the store or on the street.
Handball\n\nHandball is a game where two teams try to throw a ball into a goal. It is played with the hands, not the feet. Each team has seven players: six who run and one who guards the goal. The court is bigger than a basketball court. Players bounce the ball and pass it to friends. They cannot step inside a special line near the goal unless they are the goalie. A game has two halves, and each half is thirty minutes long. You might see handball at a big sports event like the Olympics.
Handicraft\n\nHandicraft is making things with your hands. It uses simple tools like scissors, thread, or glue. People make pretty things that can also be used, like a basket or a clay cup. You can find handicraft at a fair or in a small shop. It is not made by big machines in a factory. When you make a paper flower or a bead necklace, that is handicraft.
Handle\n\nA handle is a part you hold with your hand. It is often a long bar or a round knob. You find it on doors, drawers, cups, and bags. You pull or push it to open something or to carry it. For example, the thing you grab to open the fridge is a handle.
Handsome\n\nHandsome means someone looks very nice. It is a word people use for a boy or a man with a kind face and a bright smile. You might hear someone say, "Your dad looks handsome in his new shirt." It can also mean a thing that looks strong and pretty, like a handsome horse or a handsome old car. When you dress up for a party, someone might call you handsome too.
Hang\n\nA hang is when something is held up in the air. It can be a coat on a hook, a picture on a wall, or a bag on a chair. When you put your jacket on a peg, it hangs there. A monkey hangs from a tree branch with its arms. Sometimes people hang wet clothes on a line to dry in the sun.
Hangul\n\nHangul is a set of letters for writing the Korean language. It has shapes that are easy to learn. A long time ago, a wise king made it so all people could read and write. Today, people in Korea use it every day. The letters join together into little blocks to make words.
Hanoi\n\nHanoi is a big city in the country of Vietnam. It has many old houses, busy streets, and a wide river called the Red River. Many people live there, and it is the place where the leaders of Vietnam work. You can see a big building where a famous leader rests, and a very old school made of stone. A yummy soup with noodles and meat was first made near this city.
Happen\n\nHappen is when something takes place or comes to be. It is like when a surprise party starts, or when rain begins to fall. You can see it happen when a friend smiles, or when a toy breaks. It is not a thing you can hold, but a moment that comes and goes. Every day, many little things happen around you.
Happily\n\nHappily is a way of doing something with a big smile and a light heart. It is how you skip when you get a new toy. It is how you hum when you eat your favorite snack. You can wave happily when you see a friend at the park.
Happiness\n\nHappiness is a warm, good feeling inside. It makes you smile and want to laugh. You feel it when you play with a friend, eat a yummy treat, or get a big hug. Sometimes it can even make you cry happy tears. It is the opposite of feeling sad. Everyone feels happy at some times and sad at other times.
Happy\n\nHappy is a feeling you get when something good happens. It makes you smile and want to laugh. You feel it when you play with a friend, eat a yummy treat, or get a big hug. Your heart feels light and your face gets bright. Everyone feels happy sometimes.
Harbor\n\nA harbor is a safe place for boats and big ships. It is like a quiet bed for them on the water. You can find it next to the sea or a big lake. Ships stop there so people can put things on or take things off. Some harbors are made by nature, and some are built by people. A harbor has long wooden paths called piers where you can walk and look at the water.
Hard\n\nHard means something is not soft. It does not bend or squish when you push on it. A rock is hard. A wooden block is hard. You can find hard things all around you, like the floor, a table, or a toy car. Some foods are hard too, like a carrot or a nut. When you tap a hard thing, it makes a loud sound.
Hard disk\n\nA hard disk is a box inside a computer that keeps your pictures, games, and songs safe. It has a shiny round plate inside that spins very fast. A tiny arm moves over the plate to read and write your stuff. You find it inside a laptop or a desktop computer. It stores all your favorite videos so you can watch them again later.
Hare\n\nA hare is an animal that looks like a big rabbit. It has long ears with black tips and strong back legs. You can find it in fields and meadows, hopping very fast. It can run as fast as a car on a slow street and jump far in one big leap. In winter, some hares turn white like snow so they can hide. In spring, they chase each other and sometimes hit with their paws. A group of hares is called a drove.
Harmonica\n\nA harmonica is a small music toy you play with your mouth. It is a flat metal box with many little holes on one side. You blow air in or pull air out through the holes to make sounds. Each hole makes a different note, like a tiny piano in your pocket. People use it in happy songs and sad songs. You might see one in a music store or hear it in a cartoon.
Harmony\n\nHarmony is when two or more notes play together and sound nice. It is like friends singing at the same time. You can hear it in a song when a group of people sing different parts. It makes the music feel full and warm. A choir at school or church often uses harmony. One person sings high, another sings low, and together they make a pretty sound.
Harp\n\nA harp is a big music tool with many strings. It is shaped like a tall triangle made of wood. You find it in an orchestra or in a music room. A person plays it by pulling the strings with their fingers to make pretty sounds. Each string makes a different note, like the white keys on a piano. Some harps are small enough to hold, and some are so big they stand on the floor.
Harrow (tool)\n\nA harrow is a big farm tool that makes dirt smooth and soft. It has a strong frame with metal teeth, round discs, or chains that scratch the ground. You find it on a farm, pulled behind a tractor. After a plow digs up the dirt, the harrow breaks the big lumps into tiny pieces. This helps seeds grow into plants. Some harrows also pull out weeds. A long time ago, horses pulled it, but now a tractor does the work.
Harvest\n\nHarvest is when people pick food that grew in the ground. It happens after seeds are planted and the sun and rain help them grow big. Farmers do most of the harvest on big fields. They pick things like apples, corn, and carrots. Sometimes a harvest is small if the weather was too hot or too wet. People also harvest food from the water, like oysters and scallops. After a good harvest, there is lots of fresh food to eat.
Has\n\nHas is a word we use to show that something belongs to someone or something. It is a small word we say when we talk about what a person or an animal owns. For example, a boy has a red ball. A cat has soft fur. We also use it to talk about parts of the body, like a dog has four legs. It helps us tell others about the things we carry or hold.
Haste\n\nHaste means doing something very fast. It is when you hurry and do not take your time. When you are in haste, you might run instead of walk. You might eat your snack too quickly. Sometimes haste makes you drop things or make a mess. It is better to be careful and not rush.
Hat\n\nA hat is something you wear on your head. It can be made of soft cloth or hard straw. People wear hats outside to keep the sun off their face. Some hats are for special jobs, like a firefighter’s hard hat or a chef’s tall white hat. You might wear a warm wool hat in winter to keep your ears cozy.
Hathor\n\nHathor is a goddess from old Egypt. She looks like a cow or a woman with cow horns on her head. People built big stone houses called temples for her near the Nile River. They went there to sing, dance, and ask for happy feelings. She helped people feel love and joy. Long ago, Egyptians drew her picture on walls and wore a special necklace to remember her.
Hatred\n\nHatred is a very strong feeling of not liking someone or something. It makes a person want to stay far away from that person or thing. It is the opposite of love. When someone feels hatred, they may feel angry and want to hurt or break what they hate. Sometimes people feel hatred for a long time. It is not a good feeling, and it can make people do mean things.
Havana\n\nHavana is a big city on an island called Cuba. It sits next to the blue sea. Many people live there. It is a very old city with old stone walls and big forts. Long ago, big ships stopped there on long trips. Today, people can fly to Havana on a plane. The streets have old houses painted in bright colors like yellow, blue, and pink. Some people ride in old cars that look like they are from a long time ago. Music plays in the streets, and people dance.
Have\n\nTo have means you hold something or it is yours. When you have a toy, you can play with it. You can have a pet, like a dog or a cat. You can also have a feeling, like being happy or sad. When you have a friend, you are not alone. You can have a snack when you are hungry.
Haven\n\nA haven is a safe, quiet place. It is somewhere you can go when you feel scared or tired. You might find a haven in your room, under a blanket, or in a cozy corner. It keeps you away from loud noises and big crowds. A haven feels warm and calm, like a hug. Some animals have a haven too, like a bird in its nest.
Having\n\nHaving means you hold something or it is with you. It is like when you have a toy in your hand or a snack in your bag. You can have a pet at home, like a dog or a cat. Having a friend means someone plays with you. It feels good to have things you like.
Hawaii\n\nHawaii is a group of islands in the big ocean. It is one of the fifty states of America. It has warm sun, blue water, and sandy beaches. Many people go there to swim, surf, and play. It has big hills made by fire mountains under the sea. The biggest island is also called Hawaii. The main city is Honolulu. People there say "aloha" to mean hello and goodbye.
Hawk\n\nA hawk is a big bird that flies high in the sky. It has wide wings, a short hooked beak, and sharp claws called talons. You can see it sitting on a tree or a tall pole, watching for food. It hunts small animals like mice and rabbits. It swoops down very fast to catch them. Sometimes you can spot a hawk circling in the air on a sunny day.
Hay\n\nHay is dry grass that farmers cut and save. It is put into big round or square blocks called bales. Farmers keep it in a barn or a big pile outside. It is food for animals like horses, cows, and rabbits. In winter, when the ground has no green grass, the animals eat hay to stay full and strong.
Haze\n\nHaze is when the air looks fuzzy and not clear. It is like a thin, gray blanket over the sky. You can see it on hot days when the sun makes the air thick. It makes faraway things look blurry and hard to see. Sometimes it comes from tiny bits of dust or smoke in the air. When you look through it, the world seems soft and quiet.
Hazelnut\n\nA hazelnut is a small, round nut that grows on a tree. It has a hard, brown shell and a soft, light-colored inside. You can find it in many places like Turkey, Greece, and Italy. People eat it as a snack or use it to make yummy things like chocolate spreads and nut butter. It tastes rich and a little sweet. You might have seen it in a chocolate candy or a jar of creamy spread at the store.
He\n\nHe is a boy or a man. You say "he" when you talk about a boy or a man. He can be your dad, your brother, or a friend. He might have short hair or wear pants. You see him at home, at school, or at the park.
Head\n\nA head is the top part of your body. It sits on your neck and holds your brain inside. On the front of it is your face, with eyes to see, ears to hear, a nose to smell, and a mouth to eat and talk. You can put a hat on it to keep warm. Sometimes it can hurt, and that is called a headache. A doctor who looks after it is a special kind of doctor.
Head of state\n\nA head of state is the top leader of a country. It can be a president or a king. In some places, people choose the president by voting. In other places, a king or queen gets the job from their family. Sometimes the head of state helps run the country every day. Other times, it just stands for the country at big events while someone else runs the government.
Heal\n\nHeal means to make something better when it is hurt or sick. When you have a cut on your skin, your body works to heal it. A bandage can help it heal by keeping it clean. A doctor or a nurse can give medicine to help you heal faster. When you rest and drink water, you help your body heal too.
Health\n\nHealth is how your body and mind feel. It means you are not sick and you feel good. When you are healthy, you can run, play, and jump without getting too tired. Eating good food like fruits and vegetables helps keep your body strong. Sleeping at night gives your body time to rest and grow. Washing your hands with soap keeps away germs that can make you sick. Feeling happy and safe is also part of being healthy. Doctors and nurses help people stay healthy by checking their bodies and giving medicine when needed.
Healthcare\n\nHealthcare is about keeping people healthy and helping them when they are sick. It includes visits to a doctor, getting medicine, and going to a hospital. A doctor is a person who checks your body and helps you feel better. They can give you a shot or a pill to make the hurt go away. A hospital is a big building where sick people stay to get care. When you have a cold or a fever, your mom or dad may take you to see a doctor. That is part of healthcare.
Healthy\n\nHealthy means your body feels good and strong. It is when you can run, jump, and play without getting tired too fast. You stay healthy by eating fruits, vegetables, and drinking water. Sleeping at night and washing your hands also help you stay healthy. When you are healthy, you smile a lot and feel happy inside.
Hear\n\nHear is when your ears pick up sounds. It happens when noises travel through the air and into your ears. You can hear many things every day, like a dog barking, a bell ringing, or a friend laughing. Your ears work even when you are sleeping, but your brain may not listen to all the sounds. Hearing helps you know what is happening around you.
Hearing\n\nHearing is how you know what sounds are around you. It uses your ears to catch tiny shakes in the air. These shakes are called sounds. Many animals can hear, like dogs, cats, and birds. Some animals hear with ears on the outside of their head, like you. Other animals, like fish, hear in a different way inside their body. When a sound comes to your ear, it goes through three parts inside. These parts help the sound get to your brain so you can know what it is. You can hear a dog bark, a bell ring, or your friend laugh.
Heart\n\nA heart is a strong muscle inside your chest. It is about the size of your fist. It pumps blood all around your body. Blood brings good air and food to every part of you. It also takes away things your body does not need. The heart has four little rooms inside. It sits between your two lungs. You can feel it beat when you put your hand on your chest.
Heat\n\nHeat is a kind of energy that makes things feel warm. It comes from the sun, a fire, or a stove. When you touch a warm cup of cocoa, you feel heat moving into your hand. It always goes from hot things to cold things. On a sunny day, you can feel it on your skin. It helps us cook food and stay cozy in winter.
Heat transfer\n\nHeat transfer is how warmth moves from one thing to another. It always goes from a hotter place to a colder place. You can see it when you touch a warm cup and your hand gets warm. That is one way it moves, called touch-passing. Another way is when warm air rises and cool air sinks, like in a room with a heater. The last way is when warmth travels through empty space, like the sun warming your face. All three ways help warmth get around.
Heat treating\n\nHeat treating is a way to make metal things stronger. It means heating a piece of metal until it is very hot, then letting it cool down. People do this in big ovens or with hot fire. It changes how hard or soft the metal feels. A blacksmith uses heat treating when making a sword or a horseshoe.
Heater\n\nA heater is a machine that makes a room warm. It can be small and sit on the floor, or big and hang on a wall. You find it in houses, schools, and cars when the air outside is cold. It uses electricity or fire to make heat. When you feel chilly, you turn it on and soon the room feels cozy. Some heaters glow orange and some blow warm air.
Heaven\n\nHeaven is a place some people believe in. It is a perfect, happy home where good people go after they die. Many people think it is up in the sky, above the clouds. In stories, it has bright light, soft music, and no pain or tears. Some say it has golden streets and pretty gardens. Different people have different ideas about it, but they all say it is a place full of love and joy.
Heavy\n\nHeavy means something is hard to pick up or carry. It feels like a big rock or a full bag of books. You can find heavy things at home, like a full laundry basket or a big pot of soup. When you try to lift it, your arms get tired fast. A grown-up often helps carry heavy things because they are too much for a little kid.
Heavy metal music\n\nHeavy metal music is a kind of loud, strong rock music. It uses electric guitars, a bass guitar, and drums. The guitars make a fuzzy, angry sound. People play it in big shows with bright lights. Some bands wear jeans, leather jackets, and have long hair. They jump and move a lot on stage. Many kids hear it on the radio or in video games.
Hebrew Bible\n\nThe Hebrew Bible is a very old book of stories and rules. It has three big parts: the Torah, the Nevi'im, and the Ketuvim. It was first written in the Hebrew language a long, long time ago. People read it in special buildings called synagogues. Some people also call it the Old Testament. It tells about how the world began and about brave people from long ago.
Hebrew language\n\nHebrew is a language that people speak. It has 22 letters that are written from right to left. Long ago, people in Israel spoke it, and the Bible was written in it. Today, people in Israel use it again to talk, read, and write. It sounds a little like Arabic.
Hedgehog\n\nA hedgehog is a small animal with a round body. It has many short, pointy sticks on its back. When it feels scared, it rolls into a tight ball so the sticks point out. It comes out at night to look for food like bugs and worms. Some people keep a hedgehog as a pet at home.
Height\n\nHeight is how tall something is. It tells you how far it is from the bottom to the top. You can measure height with a ruler or a tape. A baby is short, but a grown-up is tall. A tree can be very tall, and a flower is usually short. When you stand next to a friend, you can see who has more height.
Helicopter\n\nA helicopter is a flying machine with a big spinning fan on top. It has a long tail and a small fan at the back. You can see it in the sky, at an airport, or on TV. It can go straight up, stay still in the air, and land in small places. People use it to help sick people get to a hospital fast. It can also carry food and water when roads are broken. Some helicopters are used by soldiers.
Hello\n\nHello is a word you say when you meet someone. It is a friendly way to start talking. You can say it with a smile and a wave. People say hello on the phone, at the door, or when they see a friend. It makes others feel happy and welcome.
Helmet\n\nA helmet is a hard hat that keeps your head safe. It has a strong outside and soft padding inside. Straps go under your chin to hold it on. You see it on people who ride bikes, horses, or motorcycles. It stops your head from getting hurt if you fall. Builders wear one so nothing heavy hits their head. Firefighters and soldiers wear one too. Some sports like baseball and hockey use a helmet to play safe.
Help\n\nHelp is when you make something easier or better for someone. It can be a kind thing you do, like holding a door open or picking up a toy that fell. When you help, you use your hands, your words, or your time. A friend might help you tie your shoes. A grown-up might help you reach a high shelf. Helping makes people feel good and safe.
Helper\n\nA helper is a person who makes a job easier for someone else. It can be a friend, a family member, or a grown-up at school. A helper might carry heavy bags, clean up a mess, or show you how to tie your shoes. You see helpers in many places, like at home, in a store, or on the street. When you share your toys or hold a door open, you are being a helper too.
Helpful\n\nHelpful means you do something nice for someone. It is when you make a job easier or fix a problem. You can be helpful at home by putting your toys away. At school, you are helpful when you share crayons with a friend. Being helpful makes people feel happy and loved.
Helsinki\n\nHelsinki is a big city by the sea. It is the most important city in a country called Finland. It has many buildings, streets, and parks. Some parts of it are on islands. You can take a boat to go from one part to another. Many people live there and ride buses and trains. In winter, it gets very cold and snow covers the ground.
Hen\n\nA hen is a girl chicken. It has feathers, two legs, and a beak. You can find it on a farm or in a yard. It lays eggs that people eat for breakfast. A hen says 'cluck cluck' and sits on its eggs to keep them warm.
Henna\n\nHenna is a plant with small flowers. Its leaves are dried and crushed into a green powder. People mix the powder with water to make a thick paste. They use the paste to draw pretty shapes on hands and feet. The paste leaves a red-brown color on the skin that stays for many days. You can see henna art at weddings and happy parties.
Hephaestus\n\nHephaestus is a god from old Greek stories. He is the god of fire and making things from metal. He works in a hot shop under a mountain that sometimes spits fire. He uses a big hammer and fire to shape gold and silver into beautiful things. He made chairs, weapons, and even little helpers that moved on their own. People long ago told stories about him to show that working with your hands is good and strong.
Her\n\nA her is a girl or a woman. It is a word we use when we talk about someone who is not a boy. You might say "She is my friend" or "I gave it to her." When you see a girl playing with a doll, you can point and say "That is her toy."
Hera\n\nHera is a queen from old Greek stories. She is the wife of Zeus, the king of the gods. She wears a crown and a veil, and she likes peacocks, pomegranates, and cows. Hera takes care of women, families, and weddings. She lives on a tall mountain called Olympus with other gods. In some stories, she gets very angry and does mean things, but she also helps heroes like Jason.
Herakles\n\nHerakles is a strong hero from very old Greek stories. He is the son of a god and a human mother. People drew him as a big man with a club and a lion skin. He had to do twelve hard jobs, like fighting a lion and a snake with many heads. These jobs are called the Twelve Labors. In Rome, people call him Hercules. You might see him in a cartoon movie.
Herb\n\nAn herb is a small green plant that people use for food, smell, or medicine. It has soft leaves and a juicy stem when it is young. You can find it in a garden, in a pot by the window, or in the kitchen. People pick its leaves and add them to soup or meat to make the food taste better. Some herbs, like mint, smell very nice and are put in tea or candy. Others help when you have a cold or a tummy ache. You can grow an herb from a tiny seed, and it does not need much space.
Herbal medicine\n\nHerbal medicine is a way to help sick people feel better using plants. It can be made from leaves, flowers, roots, or seeds. People have used it for a very long time, even before writing was invented. Some old books from long ago have recipes for it. Today, you can find it in teas, creams, or pills at a store. A grown-up might give you a cup of warm tea with honey when you have a cold. That tea can be a kind of herbal medicine.
Herbivore\n\nA herbivore is an animal that eats only plants. It has teeth that are good for chewing grass and leaves. You can find it in fields, forests, and sometimes at the zoo. It spends much of its day looking for food and eating. A cow is a herbivore you might see on a farm. A deer is another one that lives in the woods.
Hercules\n\nHercules is a strong hero from very old stories. He is a man with big muscles, and people drew him wearing a lion skin on his back. You can find him in books with pictures of long-ago times. In the stories, he did twelve hard jobs, like fighting a big lion and catching a fast deer. He used his strong arms to help people and keep them safe. Many children see him in cartoons or on lunch boxes.
Herd\n\nA herd is a big group of animals that stay together. It can be cows, sheep, horses, or other animals that walk and eat grass. You can see a herd on a farm or in a field. The animals in a herd feel safer when they are close to each other. They move and eat as one big family.
Here\n\nHere means in this place or at this spot. It is the opposite of there, which means a place far away. When you point to the floor next to your feet, you say here. A teacher might say, "Come here," and you walk to her side. You can use it to show where something is, like when you find a lost toy and shout, "It is here!"
Heredity\n\nHeredity is how parents pass down looks and traits to their children. It is why a baby cat looks like its mom and dad. It is also why your eyes might be the same color as your mom's eyes. The way a flower gets its color from its parent flower is heredity too. It is like a tiny set of instructions inside every living thing.
Hermes\n\nHermes is a god from old Greek stories. He is the son of a big god named Zeus and a mother named Maia. He is very fast and clever. People say he carries a special stick with two snakes wrapped around it. He also wears a hat with wings and shoes with wings so he can fly. Hermes helps travelers find their way and brings messages from the gods. One story says he made a music tool from a turtle shell when he was just a baby.
Hermitage Museum\n\nThe Hermitage Museum is a very big building full of old and pretty art. It is in a city called St. Petersburg, far away in Russia. It has many rooms, and one part was once a home for kings and queens. Inside, you can see paintings, shiny gold things, and even a crown. Some cats live there too, and they walk around the halls. People from all over the world come to look at the art and the cats.
Hero\n\nA hero is a person who is very brave and helps others. He does good things even when it is hard or scary. You can find a hero in real life, like a firefighter who saves a cat from a tree. He can also be in a story, like a knight who fights a dragon. A hero is not mean; the mean one is called a villain. A girl hero is called a heroine. When you share your snack with a sad friend, you are a little hero too.
Heron\n\nA heron is a tall bird with long legs. It has a long, pointy beak and a long neck. You can see it standing still in shallow water near ponds, lakes, or rivers. It waits very quietly and then catches a fish with its beak. When it flies, it pulls its neck into an S shape. Some herons are white, and some are gray or blue.
Herring\n\nA herring is a small fish that lives in the ocean. It has shiny silver skin and a thin body. Many herrings swim together in a big group called a school. They do this to stay safe from bigger fish that want to eat them. People catch herrings to eat. They often smoke them or put them in a jar with salt water. You might see a herring at a market or on a plate.
Hers\n\nHers means something that belongs to a girl or a woman. It is a word you use when you talk about her things. You might say, "That toy is hers," or "The red coat is hers." You see this word in books and hear it when people talk. It helps you know whose thing it is.
Herself\n\nHerself is a word we use when we talk about a girl or a woman. It points back to the same person we just named. For example, if Mom says "She made the cake all by herself," it means she did it with no help. You can use it when a girl does something on her own. It is a small word that helps us know who did the action.
Hi\n\nHi is a short, friendly word people say when they meet. It is a way to say hello. You hear it at home, at school, or at the park. When you say hi, you smile and wave your hand. It makes people feel happy and seen.
Hibernation\n\nHibernation is a long, deep sleep that some animals take when winter comes. It is a way to rest when it is very cold and food is hard to find. During this sleep, the animal's body gets cool, and its breathing becomes very slow. It uses fat that it stored in its body from eating a lot in summer and fall. Animals like bats, hedgehogs, and some squirrels hibernate. They wake up when the weather gets warm again.
Hickory\n\nA hickory is a tall tree that loses its leaves in fall. It has long leaves made of many small parts, and it grows big nuts. In spring, it makes tiny yellow-green flowers that hang down like soft strings. The wind helps the flowers make new nuts. You can find it in forests and parks. Its wood is very hard and strong. People use the wood to make things like tool handles and chairs.
Hide\n\nTo hide means to put yourself or a thing where no one can see it. You can hide behind a big chair or under a blanket. When you play hide-and-seek, you find a good spot and stay very quiet. Animals hide too—a bug might hide under a leaf, and a rabbit might hide in tall grass. Hiding can keep you safe or just be a fun game.
Hide-and-seek\n\nHide-and-seek is a fun game that children play together. In it, one person closes their eyes and counts while the others run to hide. When the counting is done, the seeker shouts and starts looking for everyone. The last person found is the winner. Sometimes there is a safe spot called home base where you can run and be safe. It is a game you can play inside the house or outside in a park.
Hieroglyph\n\nA hieroglyph is a picture that stands for a sound or a word. It looks like a little drawing of an animal, a person, or a shape. Long ago, people in Egypt carved it on stone walls and big buildings. They used it to write stories and keep records. Only a few people, like priests and leaders, knew how to read and write it. Today, we can see it in museums or in books about old times.
High\n\nHigh means something is far up from the ground. It is the opposite of low. A bird can fly high in the sky. A tall tree is high, and its top is hard to reach. You can climb high on a ladder or a slide. When you look down from a high place, things below look very small.
High jump\n\nHigh jump is a sport where people jump over a bar. It is a long, thin stick that sits high up on two poles. You can see it at a big running track or at school on sports day. A person runs fast, then jumps up and over the bar without knocking it down. They get three tries at each height. If they touch the bar but it stays up, the jump is good. The goal is to jump higher than everyone else.
High-rise building\n\nA high-rise building is a very tall building. It has many floors stacked on top of each other. People live in it, work in it, or stay for a night like in a hotel. You can see it in big cities where many people need space. It uses a moving room called an elevator to go up and down fast. A very tall one is called a skyscraper.
High-speed rail\n\nHigh-speed rail is a kind of train that goes very, very fast. It looks like a long, smooth tube on wheels. You find it on special tracks, often between big cities. People use it to travel quickly from one place to another. It can go much faster than a car on a road. Some high-speed rail trains are white and have a pointy nose. You might see one in a picture book or a video about trains.
Highway\n\nA highway is a big road that cars and trucks drive on. It goes between towns and cities. It has many lanes so lots of cars can go at the same time. Sometimes it has a wall or a strip of grass in the middle to keep cars safe. You can see it when your family drives on a long trip. It often has a number on a sign to help people know which road it is.
Hike\n\nA hike is a long walk outside. It happens on a path in a park, a forest, or up a hill. You wear strong shoes and carry water. It makes your legs strong and your heart happy. You might see birds, trees, and flowers along the way.
Hiking\n\nHiking is walking outdoors for fun. It is a way to spend time outside in nature. People hike on trails in the woods, up hills, or near lakes. They carry a backpack with water and snacks. Hiking helps you feel strong and happy. You can see birds, trees, and flowers along the way. It is best to hike with a grown-up so you stay safe.
Hill\n\nA hill is a bump of land that is higher than the ground around it. It is not as tall as a mountain, and its sides are not very steep. You can find hills in parks, near farms, or in the countryside. People like to walk up a hill to see far away. Some hills have grass and trees on top. A hill is a good place to fly a kite or have a picnic.
Him\n\nHim is a word we use to talk about a boy or a man. When we say "him," we mean that person, but we are not saying his name. You might hear it in a sentence like "I gave the ball to him." It is a small word that helps us tell who did what. You can use it when you play with a friend and say "I see him!"
Himalayas\n\nThe Himalayas are very tall mountains in Asia. They are so high that the tops are always covered in white snow. Many of the biggest mountains in the world are there, like Mount Everest. It is the tallest one on Earth. Some animals that live there are snow leopards, blue sheep, and yaks. A yak is a big, hairy animal that looks like a cow. The mountains are so big that they stop cold wind and make rain fall on one side. Many people visit to see the pretty trees and animals.
Himself\n\nHimself is a word we use when a boy or a man does something all on his own. It means no one else helped him. You might hear someone say, "He made the sandwich himself." That means he did it with his own two hands. When a friend ties his shoes himself, he feels big and proud. It is a way to say he did it, and no one did it for him.
Hindi\n\nHindi is a language that many people speak. It is the most common language in India. Nearly half of all people in India use it to talk, read, and write. It looks like pretty shapes and lines when written down. You can hear it in songs and movies from India. Many families who moved to other countries still speak it at home.
Hinduism\n\nHinduism is a very old way of life and a set of beliefs. It started in a big country called India. People who follow it are called Hindus. They believe in being kind, telling the truth, and not hurting living things. They also believe that every good or bad action has a result, like a seed growing into a plant. Many Hindus visit colorful temples to pray and sing. They also have happy festivals with lights, colors, and sweet foods.
Hindustani\n\nHindustani is a way of talking that many people use in India. It is made of two older ways of talking: Hindi and Urdu. You can hear it in songs, movies, and on the street. People use it to say hello, tell stories, and buy things at the market. It sounds pretty and has many fun words.
Hindustani language\n\nHindustani is a way people talk in two big countries, India and Pakistan. It has two names: Hindi and Urdu. When people write Hindi, they use pretty letters called Devanagari. When they write Urdu, they use different pretty letters called Nastaliq. Even though the letters look different, the words sound almost the same. A person who speaks Hindi can understand a person who speaks Urdu. Many people use it every day to say hello, ask for food, and tell stories.
Hinge\n\nA hinge is a small metal piece that helps a door move. It has two flat parts that join with a pin in the middle. You can find it on doors, cabinets, and toy boxes. It lets the door swing open and shut without falling off. When you open a door, the hinge is the part that makes a little squeak sometimes.
Hint\n\nA hint is a small clue that helps you guess something. It is like a little push in the right direction. You might hear a hint when you play a guessing game. A friend can give you a hint by saying a word or making a face. It makes finding the answer easier and more fun.
Hip\n\nA hip is a part of your body. It is where your leg meets the side of your body, below your waist. You have two hips, one on each side. They help you walk, run, and jump. When you sit down, you bend at your hips. You can feel them by putting your hands on your sides.
Hip hop\n\nHip hop is a kind of music and art that started in big cities. It has three main parts: music with a strong beat, fast talking with rhymes called rapping, and a dance called breakdancing. You can hear it on the radio, on TV, or at a party. People move their bodies to the beat and sometimes spin on the floor. Some hip hop songs tell stories about life in the city. Many singers use short, fun names like Snoop Dogg or Eminem.
Hippocrates\n\nHippocrates was a very old doctor from a long, long time ago. He lived in a land called Greece. He helped sick people feel better. He is called the father of medicine because he was one of the first to say that sickness comes from nature, not magic. He taught other people to be kind and careful doctors. Today, new doctors still say a special promise that is named after him.
Hippopotamus\n\nA hippopotamus is a very big animal that lives in Africa. It has a huge mouth, short legs, and thick gray skin with almost no hair. It stays in rivers and lakes during the day to keep cool. At night, it comes out to eat grass. A hippo can be very dangerous if people get too close to its babies.
Hiroshima\n\nHiroshima is a big city in Japan. It sits near the water in the west part of the country. Many people live there. A long time ago, a very strong bomb fell on the city. The bomb hurt many people and broke many houses. Today, people remember that day at a special old building that is still standing. Near the city, there is a small island with friendly deer and a pretty red gate that stands in the water.
His\n\nHis means something belongs to a boy or a man. You use it when you talk about a thing that is his. For example, if a boy has a red ball, you can say the red ball is his. It is a small word that shows who owns something.
Hispaniola\n\nHispaniola is a big island in the warm blue sea. It has tall green mountains, wide valleys, and sandy beaches. Two countries share it: Haiti on one side and the Dominican Republic on the other. Many people live there and speak different languages. Long ago, a man named Columbus came with big ships and met the people who already lived on the island. Today, you can see old stone buildings from that time.
Hiss\n\nA hiss is a long, soft sound like air coming out of a tire. It sounds like sssssss. You can hear it when a snake opens its mouth and pushes air out. A cat also makes a hiss when it is scared or angry. Sometimes a hot pan makes a hiss when you put water on it. It is a quiet but sharp sound that tells you to be careful.
History\n\nHistory is the story of things that happened a long time ago. It tells us about people, places, and events from the past. We learn it from old books, letters, and things people made, like pots and tools. These old things are kept safe in big buildings called museums. A person who studies history is called a historian. Some people also learn about the past by talking to older people who remember what happened. This helps us know how people lived before we were born.
History of agriculture\n\nAgriculture is how people grow food and raise animals. Long, long ago, people picked seeds from wild plants and put them in the ground. They also kept wild animals close to home. Over time, the plants and animals changed to give more food. People in different parts of the world started doing this on their own. Later, big groups of people made ways to bring water to dry fields. They used animals to help pull tools. In the Middle Ages, farmers made better tools to dig hard dirt. They also learned to change which crop grows in a field each year. In the 1700s and 1800s, new machines helped plant seeds faster. In the 1900s, big machines called tractors took over the hard work. Today, farmers use many tools to grow lots of food for everyone.
History Of Architecture\n\nHistory of architecture is the story of how people build houses and big buildings. It tells us about homes made of mud, wood, or stone long ago. You can see old buildings in books or when you visit a city. People used to build with their hands, but now they use big machines. A castle with tall towers is one example from a long time ago.
History of Asia\n\nThe history of Asia is the story of people who lived there long ago. It is a very big place with many different lands. Long ago, people started the first big towns near rivers. They grew food and made wheels and writing. Later, some people rode horses across wide, flat grass fields. They moved from place to place and sometimes fought with the town people. Big walls of rock and sand kept some groups apart. Over time, many big families of rulers came and went. People built long roads for buying and selling things like silk. Today, many countries in Asia have their own flags and stories.
History of astronomy\n\nAstronomy is the study of stars, planets, and the sky. Long ago, people looked up at night and saw bright dots. They gave names to groups of stars and watched how some lights moved. A long time later, a man named Copernicus said the Sun sits in the middle and Earth goes around it. Today we use big tubes called telescopes to see faraway stars and learn more about space.
History of Australia\n\nThe history of Australia is the story of a big island far away. It is a land with deserts, forests, and beaches. The first people lived there for a very long time. They hunted, fished, and told dream stories. Later, people from across the sea came in big boats. Some were sent as a punishment. They built towns and farms. Gold was found in the ground, and many more people came. Now it is one country with its own rules.
History of China\n\nThe history of China is a long, long story about a big country. It starts many, many years ago. Long ago, different families called dynasties ruled the land. One early ruler joined the walls to make the Great Wall. People made writing and used the same money. Later, a golden time brought new ideas and big cities. A woman even became the only empress.
