Then, leaders from the north came and opened China to the world. Big ships sailed far away. The last old rulers built a famous palace. In modern times, China grew very fast and held big sports games.
History of Christianity\n\nChristianity is a big group of people who follow Jesus. It started a long, long time ago in a place far away. Jesus taught people to be kind and to love one another. His friends told many other people about him. At first, only a few people listened, but later, many people joined. They built big, pretty houses to pray in. Today, you can see churches in many towns. Some people wear a cross to remember Jesus.
History Of Earth\n\nThe history of Earth is the story of our planet from long, long ago until today. It is a very, very old place. At first, it was a hot ball of rock and fire. Over a very long time, it cooled down and water filled the big holes to make oceans. Tiny living things started in the water. Later, big animals like dinosaurs walked on the land. Now, people live all over it. You can see parts of this story in rocks and bones in a museum.
History of Europe\n\nThe history of Europe is the story of people who lived on a big piece of land across the ocean. It starts a long, long time ago, even before your great-great-grandparents were born. People built stone houses, made tools, and drew pictures on cave walls. Later, they built big cities with tall buildings and roads made of stone. Kings and queens ruled the land, and knights in shiny armor rode horses. People sailed on big wooden ships to find new places. They made beautiful art and wrote stories that we still read today. Over time, they built trains, cars, and tall buildings that touch the sky. The story of Europe is still going on, with new things happening every day.
History of India\n\nThe history of India is the story of a big, old land. It started a long, long time ago when people first lived there. They used simple stone tools to hunt and gather food. Later, they learned to grow plants and built big cities near rivers. Many kings and groups ruled the land over time. One king named Ashoka helped spread a kind and peaceful way of life. Today, people in India remember this long story through old books, songs, and special places.
History of Japan\n\nJapan is a country made of many islands in the ocean. A long, long time ago, people there lived in small groups and made pots from clay. Later, they learned to grow rice in wet fields. Rice became their most important food. Big families called samurai had swords and armor. They built strong castles with tall walls. Today, people can visit old castles and see shiny swords in museums. Japan has a very long story that goes back thousands of years.
History Of Life\n\nThe history of life is the story of how living things began and changed on Earth. It started a long, long time ago with tiny bits too small to see. Over many, many years, those tiny bits grew into fish, then animals that walked on land, and later into big dinosaurs. After the dinosaurs went away, small furry animals came, and one kind turned into people. You can see parts of this story in old bones and shells buried in the ground.
History Of Literature\n\nHistory of Literature is the story of books and writing from long ago until now. It tells us about old stories people wrote on clay, stone, or paper. You can find these stories in libraries and schools. People read them to learn about the past and to have fun. A fairy tale your teacher reads is part of this history.
History of mathematics\n\nThe history of mathematics is the story of how people learned about numbers, shapes, and counting long ago. It started in old places like Egypt and Babylon, where people used math to build big things and measure land. Later, smart people in Greece and India found new math ideas. They learned about zero, how to add and take away, and how to draw shapes with rules. Today, math helps us build cars, fly to the moon, and play games on a screen. You use math when you count your toys or share cookies with a friend.
History of medicine\n\nThe history of medicine is the story of how people learned to help sick people feel better. It started a long, long time ago. Early people used plants to heal cuts and aches. Later, smart people in places like Egypt and China wrote down ways to fix broken bones and stop pain. A man named Hippocrates in Greece taught that sickness comes from nature, not magic. Over time, doctors learned to look inside the body, wash their hands, and make shots that keep us from getting sick. Today, we have clean hospitals and pills that help us stay well.
History Of Music\n\nHistory of music is the story of how people made sounds and songs long ago. It started with clapping hands and hitting sticks together. Later, people made simple flutes from bones and drums from animal skins. A long time ago, kings and queens had special music in big stone rooms. Today, we hear music on phones, in cars, and on TV. Every country has its own songs and dances. Music helps people feel happy, sad, or excited.
History of North America\n\nNorth America is a big piece of land where many people live. Long ago, the first people came and made their homes all over it. They lived in small groups and big groups, and they knew how to grow food like corn. Later, people from far away came in big boats. They built new towns and changed how people lived. Today, you can see many different places and hear many stories about the old days.
History Of Religion\n\nHistory of Religion is the story of how people have believed in gods and spirits over a very long time. It is about the big ideas and stories that groups of people share. Long ago, people looked at the sun, moon, and stars and told stories about them. They built special places to pray and sing together. Today, many people still go to churches, temples, or mosques to be with others who believe the same things.
History of Saudi Arabia\n\nSaudi Arabia is a big country in a hot, sandy part of the world. It has a long story that starts with a family called Al Saud. Long ago, they became the leaders of a place in the middle of the Arabian Peninsula. Over many years, the family fought to keep their land. A man named Abdulaziz Ibn Saud took back the city of Riyadh and later became king. In 1932, he made the country one kingdom. Later, people found oil under the ground, and that made the country very rich. Before all of this, the land was home to many old people and cultures. A very important thing happened there: the religion of Islam began in the cities of Mecca and Medina. Today, those cities are holy places for Muslims all over the world.
History of science\n\nThe history of science is the story of how people learned about the world. Long ago, people looked at the sky and asked big questions. They watched the sun, moon, and stars. Some smart people in old times thought the sun went around the earth. Later, others found out the earth goes around the sun. People also learned about plants, animals, and how things move. They used tools to see tiny things and faraway things. Today, we know a lot because many people kept asking questions and sharing what they found.
History of Spain\n\nSpain is a country in Europe. It has a long story that goes back many, many years. Long ago, different groups of people lived there, like the Romans and later the Moors. They built big stone buildings that you can still see today. For a time, Spain sent ships across the big ocean and ruled faraway lands. Now it is a peaceful place where people vote for their leaders. Many families go there on vacation to play on sunny beaches.
History of technology\n\nThe history of technology is the story of how people made new tools over time. It starts a long, long time ago when people first used sticks and stones to help them. Over many years, they learned to make fire, wheels, and simple machines. Today, it includes things like phones, cars, and computers that we use every day. It shows how clever ideas can change the way we live, work, and play.
History of the Earth\n\nThe history of the Earth is the long story of our planet from the very start until now. It began as a big, spinning cloud of dust and gas in space. Over a very long time, the dust and gas came together to make a hot, round ball. Later, a big rock hit the Earth and broke off a piece that became the Moon. At first, the Earth was too hot for any living thing. After many, many years, it cooled down and water made the first oceans. Then, tiny living things started in the water. Slowly, the land broke into big pieces that moved around. Plants and animals grew and changed over a very, very long time. Today, the Earth has many places like mountains, oceans, and forests where people, animals, and plants live.
History of the United States\n\nThe history of the United States is the story of a country in North America. It is a big place with many people, and its story goes back a long, long time. First, Native Americans lived on the land for many years. Then, people from England came and built small towns. Later, the people in the towns did not want to be ruled by a faraway king, so they fought a war and made their own country. Over time, it grew bigger, with more states and more people. It had hard times, like a big war inside the country, and good times, when people made new things. Today, it is a strong country with many different people.
History of the universe\n\nThe history of the universe is the story of how everything began. It started with a big, hot burst of energy a very long time ago. After that, tiny bits called atoms came together to make stars and planets. Our Earth is one of those planets. People live on Earth, and we look up at the night sky to see stars that are very old. The universe is still growing bigger every day.
History of video games\n\nVideo games are fun things you play on a TV or a small screen. They started a long time ago, in 1971. At first, only a few people played them. Then, many people in America, Japan, and Europe began to like them. For a short time, the games had a big problem and almost went away. But they came back strong and grew a lot. Now, video games make a lot of money, almost as much as movies. You can play them on boxes like Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo. Some games are old, like a jumping man named Mario on a big gray box. New games let Mario run in big, open worlds on a small flat screen you can hold.
History of writing\n\nWriting is a way to put words down so people can read them later. It uses marks and shapes that stand for sounds and words. Long ago, people drew pictures on cave walls and clay to tell stories. Over time, those pictures turned into letters like the ones you see in books. Today, writing is everywhere — on signs, in storybooks, and on your tablet. You use writing when you draw your name or make a card for a friend.
Hit\n\nA hit is when one thing bumps into another thing with a lot of force. It can be a soft tap or a hard smack. You might see a hit when a ball meets a bat in a game. Sometimes people hit a drum to make a loud sound. A hit can also mean a song or movie that many people like.
Hive\n\nA hive is a house for bees. It is made of many tiny rooms called cells. You can find it hanging from a tree or in a wooden box that a beekeeper takes care of. Bees live inside it and make honey there. They work together to keep the hive safe and full of food. Sometimes you see a hive in a garden or on a farm.
Hmm\n\nHmm is a soft sound people make with their mouth closed. It can mean you are thinking hard about something. You might hear it when someone looks at a puzzle or tries to remember where they put their toy. Sometimes it means the person is not sure what to say. It is a quiet, humming noise that comes from the throat.
Hmong people\n\nHmong people are a group of people who first lived in China. They have their own way of talking, their own clothes, and their own stories. Long ago, many of them moved to other warm places like Vietnam, Laos, and Thailand. Today, some also live in the United States and other far-away lands. They grow food, make bright and pretty cloth, and sing songs to tell old tales.
Ho Chi Minh City\n\nHo Chi Minh City is a very big city in the south of Vietnam. It has many houses, tall buildings, and busy streets. A long river called the Saigon River runs through it. Many people live there, and they ride motorbikes and bikes on flat roads. Sometimes the streets get wet when it rains a lot. You can see boats on the river and eat yummy food at markets. Some people call it by its old name, Saigon.
Hobby\n\nA hobby is something you do just for fun. It is not work or a chore. You pick it because it makes you happy. Some hobbies use your hands, like drawing, painting, or building with blocks. Other hobbies use your brain, like reading a book or doing a puzzle. You can do a hobby inside your home or outside in the park. Many kids have a hobby like collecting stickers or playing a game with friends. A hobby is a special way to play and learn at the same time.
Hoe (tool)\n\nA hoe is a tool for working in the dirt. It has a long stick you hold and a flat metal part at the end. People use it in gardens and on farms. It helps pull out weeds, which are plants that grow where you do not want them. It can also move dirt to make rows for seeds. You might see one in a shed or in a picture of a farmer.
Hokkaidō\n\nHokkaidō is a big island in Japan. It is the most northern of Japan's four main islands. It has many mountains and some of them can spit fire and hot rocks. The winters there are very cold and full of snow. In summer, it gets warm and sunny. Many people grow food on the island, like rice and vegetables. It is a good place to see nature and wild animals.
Hola\n\nHola is a friendly word people say when they meet someone. It sounds like "oh-la" and means the same as "hello." You can hear it in places where people speak Spanish, like Spain or Mexico. When you say it, you smile and wave your hand. It is a nice way to start talking to a new friend.
Hold\n\nTo hold means to keep something in your hand or arms. It is like when you carry a toy, a book, or a cup. You can hold a ball before you throw it. When you hold a friend's hand, you feel safe and close. A mom holds her baby to keep it warm and happy.
Hole\n\nA hole is an empty space in something. It can be round like a circle. You can find a hole in the ground, in a wall, or in a piece of paper. Sometimes a hole is made by digging, like when you dig in the sand at the beach. A hole lets things go through it, like water going down a drain. A donut has a hole in the middle, and you can see right through it.
Holi\n\nHoli is a happy festival with lots of colors. It is celebrated in India and Nepal. People throw bright powder and water at each other. They sing and dance together. It happens in spring when flowers bloom. The colors mean good wins over bad. Families and friends come together to play and laugh.
Holiday\n\nA holiday is a special day when people do not go to work or school. It is a day to have fun, rest, or be with family. Some holidays happen every year at the same time, like a birthday party for a country or a person. People often put up pretty lights, sing songs, or eat yummy food on a holiday. You might see a big tree with shiny balls and a star on top for one winter holiday. Another holiday has colorful eggs and a bunny that hides them in the grass.
Hollywood\n\nHollywood is a part of a big city called Los Angeles. It is a place where people make movies and TV shows. Many visitors come to see a big white sign on a hill that says its name. They also walk on a long path with stars on the ground. Each star has the name of a famous actor or singer. Long ago, the first movie was made there, and now many movies are made there every year.
Holstein Friesian\n\nA Holstein Friesian is a kind of cow. It is big and heavy, with black and white spots all over its body. You can see it on a farm in the green fields. It gives milk every day, and people use the milk to make cheese, butter, and yogurt. A baby one is called a calf, and it is very cute with long legs.
Holy\n\nHoly means something is very special and close to God. It is not like everyday things. People use the word for places like a church or a temple. They also use it for books like the Bible. When something is holy, people treat it with great care and love.
Holy Grail\n\nThe Holy Grail is a special cup from very old stories. It is said to have been used by Jesus at a big meal long ago. Some stories say it can do amazing things, like heal sick people. Many brave people in tales look for it, but it is very hard to find. Today, people say 'Holy Grail' to mean something they want very much.
Holy Spirit\n\nThe Holy Spirit is a special part of God in the Christian faith. It is like a helper and a teacher that you cannot see. Christians believe it was there when God made the world. It also helped Jesus come as a baby to his mom Mary. After Jesus went up to heaven, the Holy Spirit came to his friends and gave them new power. It helped them speak in new words they did not know before. Many Christians believe the Holy Spirit lives inside them and guides them every day.
Home\n\nA home is a place where people live. It has walls, a roof, and a door. Inside, there are rooms like a kitchen, a bedroom, and a living room. People sleep, eat, and play in a home. It keeps them safe from rain, wind, and cold. A home can be a house, an apartment, or even a tent. It is where a family stays together and feels warm and happy.
Home appliance\n\nA home appliance is a machine that helps with jobs at home. It can be big like a fridge or small like a toaster. You find it in the kitchen, laundry room, or other rooms. It does work like keeping food cold, cooking, or washing clothes. A washing machine is one kind that cleans your shirts and pants.
Homelessness\n\nHomelessness means a person does not have a home to sleep in. It can happen when someone cannot pay for a house. Some people sleep on the street, in a car, or in a big room with many beds called a shelter. It is sad and hard because there is no warm bed, no kitchen, and no safe place to keep toys. Many cities have helpers who give food and a bed to people who need it.
Homer\n\nHomer is a person from very old stories. He told long tales about brave fighters and big trips. People say he could not see with his eyes. His stories are still read in books today.
Hometown\n\nA hometown is the town or city where you were born or where you grew up. It is a place you know very well, like the streets, the park, and the shops. Many people feel warm and happy when they think of their hometown. You might visit your hometown to see family or old friends. It can be big like a city or small like a village.
Homework\n\nHomework is work your teacher gives you to do at home. It is often on paper, like a worksheet or a page from a book. You do it after school, at a table or desk. It helps you practice what you learned in class. For example, you might read a short story and draw a picture about it.
Homicide\n\nHomicide is when one person hurts another person so badly that the hurt person dies. It is a very sad and serious thing. Police officers and judges work hard to find out what happened. It is not something children need to worry about every day, but it is a word for a very bad action. Most people never see it in real life.
Honduras\n\nHonduras is a country in the middle part of the Americas. It has warm weather and many green trees. On one side, it touches the big blue ocean. People there speak Spanish and live in towns and small villages. Many people grow bananas and other fruits on big farms. Some old stone buildings from long ago still stand there.
Honey\n\nHoney is a sweet, sticky food that bees make. It is thick and golden, like a slow-moving syrup. Bees collect tiny drops from flowers and turn them into honey inside their hive. People put honey on bread, in tea, or use it to make food taste sweet. You might see a jar of honey in your kitchen at home. It can stay good to eat for a very long time.
Honey badger\n\nA honey badger is a small, tough animal. It has a long body, short legs, and very strong claws. Its fur is black on the bottom and white on top. It lives in Africa and parts of Asia. It digs holes in the ground to sleep. It eats meat, like snakes and mice, and also some fruit. It is very brave and fights hard when it needs to. Its skin is thick and loose, so it can turn and bite even when something holds it.
Honeyeater\n\nA honeyeater is a small bird that drinks sweet juice from flowers. It has a long, thin beak and a special tongue with tiny hairs to soak up the juice. You can find it in Australia and nearby islands, hopping among trees and bushes. It also eats bugs and sometimes fruit. If you see a bird poking its beak into a bright flower, it might be a honeyeater looking for a sweet treat.
Honeyguide\n\nA honeyguide is a small bird that lives in warm places like Africa and Asia. It has brown and white feathers and a short beak. It is famous for helping people find honey. It makes a special sound and flies to a tree where bees live. When people open the tree, they take the honey, and it eats the wax and tiny bugs left behind. It does not build its own nest. It lays its egg in another bird's nest. The baby honeyguide pushes out the other eggs or chicks so it gets all the food.
Hong\n\nHong is a name that some people have. It can be a boy's name or a girl's name. You might hear it in a story or meet someone called Hong. It is a short name that is easy to say.
Hong Kong\n\nHong Kong is a big city by the sea. It has many tall buildings that touch the sky. People live and work in these tall buildings. It is a place where many boats and ships come and go. You can ride a little boat called a ferry across the water. At night, the buildings light up with many colors. It is a busy and bright place.
Honour\n\nHonour is a feeling of being good and true. It is when people think you do the right thing. Long ago, knights had honour by being brave and kind. Today, you show honour when you tell the truth or help a friend. It makes others trust you and feel proud of you.
Honshū\n\nHonshū is a very big piece of land with water all around it. It is the biggest island in the country of Japan. It has tall mountains, green forests, and many busy cities. Many people live on it, more than on almost any other island in the world. You can find big trains that go very fast there. It is next to other smaller islands, with water between them.
Hood\n\nA hood is a soft cover that is part of a coat or a jacket. It goes over your head to keep you warm and dry. You can pull it up when it is cold or rainy outside. It often has strings that you can tie under your chin. Many winter coats have a hood, and some sweatshirts have one too.
Hook\n\nA hook is a small, bent piece of metal or plastic. It has a curved end that can hold or catch things. You can find a hook on a wall to hang a coat or a bag. People also use a hook when they go fishing to catch a fish. A hook on a hanger helps keep clothes from falling down.
Hoopoe\n\nA hoopoe is a pretty bird with a special crown of feathers on its head. It has a long, thin beak and wings with black and white stripes. Its body is a warm orange-brown color. You can find it in many places across Africa, Europe, and Asia. It likes to walk on the ground and look for bugs to eat. When it is happy or scared, the feathers on its head stand up like a fan. It makes a soft sound that goes "hoop-oop-oop."
Hooray\n\nHooray is a happy shout people make when something good happens. It sounds loud and cheerful, like "Hoo-ray!" You might hear it at a birthday party when someone blows out the candles. People also say it when their team wins a game. It is a way to show you are very glad.
Hop\n\nA hop is a small, quick jump. It is when you push off the ground with one foot and land on the same foot. You can see a hop when a bunny moves across the grass. A frog also hops from one lily pad to another. Children like to hop during games like hopscotch. It is a fun way to move around.
Hope\n\nHope is a warm feeling inside. It is when you believe something good will happen. You might feel it when you wait for your birthday or a fun trip. It helps you keep trying, even when things are hard. When you see a rainbow after rain, that can give you hope.
Horizon\n\nThe horizon is the line where the sky meets the ground. It looks like a faraway line that goes all the way around you. You can see it best at the beach or in a big flat field with no trees or houses. When the sun goes down, it looks like it touches the horizon. The horizon is always far away, no matter how much you walk toward it.
Hormone\n\nA hormone is a tiny helper inside your body. It travels in your blood like a message. It tells parts of your body what to do. For example, one hormone tells your body to grow taller. Another hormone tells your tummy when it is time to eat. Hormones work slowly, but they keep your body happy and working well.
Horn\n\nA horn is a hard, pointy thing that grows on the head of some animals. It is made of the same stuff as your fingernails. You can find it on a cow, a goat, or a sheep. The animal uses it to push and fight when it feels scared. A horn is not the same as an antler, which falls off and grows back every year.
Horn (instrument)\n\nA horn is a shiny metal tube that makes music when you blow into it. It curls around in a big circle and has a wide, open end called a bell. You see it in an orchestra, where people play it with other instruments. It makes a warm, soft sound, and players press buttons called valves to change the notes. Long ago, hunters used it on a horse to send signals. Today, you might hear it in a movie or a concert.
Horn of Africa\n\nThe Horn of Africa is a big piece of land that sticks out into the sea. It is in the east part of Africa. Four countries sit on this land: Eritrea, Ethiopia, Somalia, and Djibouti. Many people live there, and they have different ways of life. Long ago, people in this area fought to stay free when others wanted to take their land. Today, you can see it on a map—it looks like a horn pointing into the water.
Hornbill\n\nA hornbill is a big bird with a very long, curved beak. It has a bright color on its beak, and sometimes a hard bump on top. It lives in warm places with lots of trees, like forests in Africa and Asia. It makes its nest inside a hole in a tree. The mom bird closes the hole with mud and stays inside to keep the eggs safe. The dad bird brings food through a tiny crack. When the baby birds are big enough, they break out and learn to fly.
Horned lizard\n\nA horned lizard is a small animal with a flat, round body. It has little horns on its head and a short tail. It lives in hot, dry places with sand and rocks. It eats tiny bugs like ants. When it feels scared, it can shoot a thin stream of blood from its eyes to keep other animals away. A horned lizard is sometimes called a horny toad, but it is not a toad at all.
Hornet\n\nA hornet is a big flying bug. It has a black and yellow body, six legs, and two wings. It lives in a nest made of paper, often high in a tree. It hunts other bugs like flies and caterpillars to eat. It can sting if it feels scared, and the sting hurts. You might see one near flowers or lights in the summer.
Horror fiction\n\nHorror fiction is a kind of story that is made to give you a little scare. It is a book, a movie, or a show that has spooky things in it. Sometimes it has ghosts or monsters that are not real. Other times it has bad people or sickness that can happen in real life. You might see a scary shadow or hear a creaky door in it. It is like a fun, safe way to feel a tiny bit afraid, like when you hide under a blanket during a storm.
Horse\n\nA horse is a big, strong animal with four long legs. It has a long face, big eyes, and a tail made of long hair. Horses live on farms and in fields. People ride on its back or use it to pull heavy carts. A baby horse is called a foal. It can run very fast and eats grass and hay.
Horse fly\n\nA horse fly is a kind of big, strong fly. It has big, shiny eyes that look like tiny mirrors. It can be as small as a housefly or as big as a bumblebee. You can find it near water, like ponds or rivers, on warm days. It bites animals like horses and cows to drink a little blood. The bite can hurt and make a sore spot. Only the girl horse fly bites. The boy horse fly does not bite.
Horse racing\n\nHorse racing is a sport where fast horses run a race. It happens on a big, round track. A person called a jockey sits on the horse and helps it go fast. People come to watch and cheer. Many people also guess which horse will win and put down a little money. You can see horse racing on TV or at a big field with lots of seats.
Horseradish\n\nHorseradish is a plant with a big, white root that grows under the ground. It has green leaves on top, and the root looks long and thick. People grow it in gardens, but it can spread fast if no one stops it. When you cut or grate the root, it makes a strong smell that can tickle your nose and make your eyes water. Cooks mix the grated root with vinegar to make a white sauce. This sauce is spicy and is often put on meat or in sandwiches. Some people also use it in red sauces or soups.
Horsetail\n\nHorsetail is a very old kind of plant. It has a long, thin, green stem that is empty inside, like a straw. The stem has many little rings around it, and tiny leaves grow in a circle at each ring. It looks a little like a horse's tail, which is how it got its name. You can find it growing in wet, muddy places near ponds or streams. Long, long ago, some horsetails grew as tall as big trees, but today they are much smaller. It does not make flowers or seeds. Instead, it makes tiny dust-like bits called spores that help new plants grow.
Horticulture\n\nHorticulture is the work of growing plants in a garden. It is about making flowers, fruits, and vegetables grow well. People who do this work are called gardeners. They dig in the dirt, plant seeds, and give water to the plants. They also pick out pretty flowers and tasty foods to grow. You can see horticulture in a park, a farm, or a backyard garden.
Horus\n\nHorus is a god from old stories in Egypt. He has the head of a bird called a falcon and the body of a man. People long ago drew him with a special eye that means keeping safe and getting better. They told a story that he lost his eye in a big fight, but the eye was fixed and became a sign of hope. He was the god of the sky and helped the king of Egypt. Many people in Egypt loved him and built big stone houses to say thank you.
Hose\n\nA hose is a long, bendy tube. It is made of rubber or plastic. You find it in a garden or yard. People use it to carry water from a tap to plants or to wash a car. It can spray water far when you press the end.
Hospital\n\nA hospital is a big building where sick or hurt people go to get better. It has many rooms with beds so people can stay all day and night. Doctors and nurses work there. They use special tools and machines to help fix what is wrong. Some people visit just for a short time and then go home. You might see a hospital when you drive past a tall white building with a red cross sign.
Host\n\nA host is a person who welcomes guests. He says hello and makes people feel happy when they come to a place. You might see a host at a restaurant door. He shows you where to sit and gives you a menu. At a party, a host gives out snacks and drinks. He makes sure everyone has a good time.
Hot\n\nHot means something has a lot of heat. It can feel like when you touch a warm cup of cocoa. You find hot things in the kitchen, like a stove or a toaster. The sun is very hot and warms the whole world. When you run fast, your body feels hot too.
Hot air balloon\n\nA hot air balloon is a big, round bag that flies in the sky. It has a basket under it where people stand. The bag is filled with hot air from a fire. Hot air goes up, so it lifts the balloon high. You can see it at a fair or a festival, floating like a giant ball.
Hot spring\n\nA hot spring is a pool of warm water that comes from deep under the ground. It looks like a small pond or a puddle, but the water is hot. You can find it in places with mountains. The heat comes from hot rocks far below the Earth. People like to sit in it because the warm water feels nice on the skin. Some hot springs have a funny smell, like eggs, from the rocks. You might see one on a trip to a mountain park.
Hotel\n\nA hotel is a big building with many rooms. It has a front door, a long hall, and many doors to small rooms inside. You find it in towns and near roads. When people travel far from home, they sleep in a hotel room. The room has a bed, a lamp, and a bathroom. Some hotels have a pool where you can swim. A mom and dad may pick a hotel when the family goes on a trip.
Hour\n\nAn hour is a way to measure time. It is made of sixty smaller parts called minutes. There are twenty-four hours in one full day and night. You see hours on a clock with numbers and two hands. When the long hand goes all the way around, one hour has passed. At school, you might have one hour to play outside or one hour to read a book.
House\n\nA house is a building where people live. It has walls, a roof, and a floor. The roof keeps rain and sun away. The walls keep out wind and cold. Windows let in light. Inside, there are rooms for cooking, eating, sleeping, and washing. A house can be big or small. Some houses stand alone with a yard. Others are joined side by side. A small house is sometimes called a cottage. A very big, fancy house is called a mansion. People feel safe and warm in a house. They call it their home.
Housefly\n\nA housefly is a small flying bug that often comes inside homes. It has six legs, two clear wings, and big red eyes. You can see it near food, trash, or farm animals. It buzzes around and can carry tiny germs that make people sick. A mom fly lays many eggs on old food or dead things. The eggs turn into little white worms called maggots. The maggots eat and grow, then change into a hard brown shell. Later, a grown fly comes out. That is how a new housefly is born.
Household\n\nA household is all the people who live together in one home. It can be a family with a mom, a dad, and kids. It can also be friends or other people who share a house. They eat meals together and help each other. They share things like the TV, the fridge, and the bathroom. Living together makes it easier to pay for food and bills. Your own home with the people you live with is your household.
Houston\n\nHouston is a big city in Texas. It has many tall buildings, busy streets, and lots of people. You can find a big space center there where people learn about stars and rockets. Many people in Houston work at big hospitals that help sick people get better. The city has fun sports teams that play baseball, football, basketball, and soccer. When you visit, you might see big planes at the airport or go to a park on a warm day.
Hover\n\nTo hover means to stay in one spot in the air without moving forward. It is like floating in place. A hummingbird can hover near a flower while it drinks. A helicopter can hover above the ground. You might see a toy drone hover when it stays still in the sky.
Hovercraft\n\nA hovercraft is a big machine that rides on a soft pillow of air. It has a flat bottom and a big fan on top that blows air down. This air lifts it up so it floats just above the ground or water. It can move over smooth places like a lake, a river, or even ice. People use it to carry cars and boxes across water. Some armies use it to go from water to land very fast.
How\n\nHow is a word we use to ask about the way something happens. It helps us find out the steps or the method. You can ask "How do you tie your shoes?" and someone shows you the loops and the pull. You can ask "How does a seed grow?" and learn about water, sun, and dirt. It is a small word that opens big answers.
However\n\nHowever is a word that joins two ideas. It shows that the second idea is different from the first. You might say, "I like apples. However, I do not like bananas." It helps people understand when you change your mind.
Howl\n\nA howl is a long, loud cry. It sounds like a sad song that goes up and down. You can hear it at night when a wolf calls to its friends. A dog sometimes makes this sound too, especially when it hears a siren. The wind can also howl when it blows very hard through trees or around a house.
Hua Mulan\n\nHua Mulan is a brave girl from old Chinese stories. She put on armor and went to fight in a big war so her father could stay home safe. She knew how to use a sword and was very strong. She fought for many years and did not ask for a prize. Today, people tell her story in books and movies.
Hubble Space Telescope\n\nThe Hubble Space Telescope is a big camera that floats in space. It looks like a long tube with two flat wings that catch sunlight. It flies high above the clouds, so it can see stars and planets very clearly. It takes pictures of faraway things in the sky and sends them to people on Earth. You can see its photos in books or on a computer.
Hudson Bay\n\nHudson Bay is a very big body of water in Canada. It is so big that it is one of the largest seas on Earth. It touches the land in the north, south, east, and west. It connects to two bigger oceans through narrow water paths. A long time ago, a man from England found it and gave it its name.
Hue\n\nHue is the name for a color, like red, blue, or yellow. It tells you what kind of color you see. When you look at a rainbow, each stripe has a different hue. You can mix hues to make new ones, like red and yellow make orange. A crayon box has many hues inside.
Hug\n\nA hug is when you wrap your arms around someone and hold them close. It feels warm and soft. You can give a hug to your mom, dad, friend, or even a teddy bear. A hug shows that you care about someone. It can make a sad person feel better. When you are happy, you might run and give a big hug. Sometimes people hug to say hello or goodbye.
Huge\n\nHuge means very, very big. It is bigger than big. You can see a huge elephant at the zoo. A huge mountain is so tall it touches the clouds. A huge truck can carry many things.
Hull\n\nA hull is the bottom part of a boat or a big ship. It sits in the water and keeps the boat from sinking. It is usually made of strong wood or metal. You can see it when a boat is out of the water, like on a beach or in a boat shop. It helps the boat float and move smoothly on a lake or the sea.
Hum\n\nA hum is a soft, low sound that goes on and on. It sounds like a bee flying near your ear or a fan spinning in a room. You can make a hum with your mouth closed, and it feels like a little buzz on your lips. Many machines, like a fridge or a car, make a hum when they are working. It is a quiet noise that you might hear when everything else is still.
Human\n\nA human is a person like you and me. It has two arms, two legs, a head with eyes, a nose, and a mouth. It walks on two feet and can run, jump, and play. Humans live all over the world in houses, apartments, or huts. They talk to each other with words and make friends. A human can think, feel happy or sad, and learn new things every day. It uses tools like a spoon to eat or a pencil to draw. A baby human grows inside its mom and drinks milk from her when it is small. Humans like to sing, dance, and tell stories.
Human Behavior\n\nHuman behavior is the way people act. It is what we do with our body and our words. You can see it everywhere: at home, at school, or on the playground. It can be a smile, a wave, or a hug. It can also be a cry, a shout, or a stomp. People learn how to behave from their family and friends. When you share a toy, that is kind human behavior.
Human body\n\nThe human body is the whole outside and inside of a person. It has a head, two arms, two legs, and a middle part called the trunk. Inside, there are bones that make a hard frame so you can stand up. Muscles pull on the bones to help you run and jump. The body needs food and water to grow and play. It also needs sleep to feel strong again. You can see your body in a mirror every day.
Human evolution\n\nHuman evolution is the long story of how people came to be. It started in Africa a very, very long time ago. The first people looked a bit like big, hairy apes. Over many years, they began to walk on two legs and use their hands to carry things. Their brains grew bigger, and they learned to make simple tools. Today, all people are part of one big family called humans.
Human eye\n\nThe human eye is a round part of your body that lets you see. It has a clear front part and a colored ring inside. You find two eyes on your face, one on each side of your nose. It takes in light and sends pictures to your brain so you know what you are looking at. When you look in a mirror, you can see your own eyes looking back at you.
Human geography\n\nHuman geography is a way of looking at people and places. It asks where people live and why they live there. It also looks at how people change the land around them. For example, it looks at how a town grows near a river or how people build roads. It helps us see how people and the earth work together.
Human history\n\nHuman history is the story of all people from long, long ago until today. It tells how people lived, what they ate, and where they went. Long ago, people moved from place to place to find food. They hunted animals and picked wild plants to eat. Later, they learned to grow food and stay in one spot. They built homes and made villages. Over time, people made tools from stone and learned to use fire for warmth and cooking. Today, we write things down, so we can remember our story.
Human migration\n\nHuman migration is when people move from one home to another. It can be a move to a new town, a new city, or a new country. People move because they want a better life. They look for good jobs, safe homes, and schools for their kids. Sometimes people have to move because of danger, like a big storm or a war. When they must leave their home fast, they are called refugees. Moving is hard. People may feel sad and miss their old friends. But they also bring new foods, songs, and stories to their new home.
Human rights\n\nHuman rights are rules that say how people should be treated. They mean every person is important and should be safe. These rules say you can say what you think, go to school, and play with friends. They also say no one can hurt you or take your things. Many countries write these rules down so everyone knows them. When someone does not follow the rules, it is called a wrong. People all over the world work to make sure the rules are kept.
Human settlement\n\nA human settlement is a place where people live. It can be a tiny spot with just a few houses, or a big city with many tall buildings. You find it on land, near water, or on hills. People build homes there, and they also make roads, shops, and parks. A small town with a school and a playground is one kind of human settlement.
Human skeleton\n\nA human skeleton is all the hard parts inside your body. It is made of many bones that fit together. It has a head bone called a skull, a long row of bones down your back, and a cage of bones around your chest. It also has arm bones, leg bones, and small bones in your hands and feet. It holds your body up so you can stand tall. It also keeps your soft parts safe, like your brain and heart. When you move, your bones work with your muscles to help you walk, run, and jump. You can feel some of your bones under your skin, like the hard bumps on your wrist or your knee.
Human tooth\n\nA human tooth is a small, hard white part inside your mouth. It has a top part you can see and a long root under the pink gum. You find it in your mouth, in two rows on top and bottom. It cuts and crushes food so you can swallow it. People use their front teeth to bite an apple and back teeth to chew it soft.
Humanism\n\nHumanism is a way of thinking about how people should live. It says we can use our own minds to know what is right and good. People who follow this way are called humanists. They believe in using science and facts to understand the world. They think people can be kind and fair without needing a god to tell them. They also believe that all people are important and should be treated well.
Humanitarianism\n\nHumanitarianism is being kind and helping people. It means you care about others, no matter where they come from or what they look like. A person who does this is called a humanitarian. They give food, water, or a safe place to people who are hurt or in trouble. You can see it when someone shares their snack with a friend who has none. It is like being a good helper, just because it is the right thing to do.
Humanities\n\nHumanities is a big word for learning about people. It is about the stories we tell, the songs we sing, and the pictures we paint. You find it in books at the library and in plays at the theater. It helps us understand how people feel and what they think. When you draw a picture or listen to a story, that is a little bit of humanities.
Humidity\n\nHumidity is how much water is in the air. It is not the water you see in clouds or rain. It is tiny water bits you cannot see. When the air has a lot of it, the air feels wet and sticky. When the air has only a little, the air feels dry. On a hot day with a lot of it, your skin feels sweaty and the sweat does not dry fast. On a dry day, your skin feels cool and the sweat dries quickly. People who study weather use a tool to check how much water is in the air.
Hummingbird\n\nA hummingbird is a tiny bird that can fly in a special way. It is very small, about the size of your hand. It has shiny feathers that can be green, blue, or red. You can see it in gardens where there are bright flowers. It flaps its wings so fast that they make a humming sound. It can stay in one spot in the air and even fly backwards. It drinks sweet juice from flowers with its long, thin beak. It helps flowers grow by moving yellow dust from one flower to another.
Humour\n\nHumour is a feeling that makes you laugh or smile. It happens when something is silly or funny. You can find it in a joke, a funny face, or a silly story. When you hear a knock-knock joke, that is humour. A clown at a party uses humour to make children laugh. It feels warm and happy inside.
Humpback whale\n\nA humpback whale is a very big animal that lives in the ocean. It has a long body, two long side fins, and a bumpy head. It can be as long as a big school bus. You can find it in all the oceans of the world. It eats tiny sea animals like small shrimp and little fish. It opens its big mouth and scoops up food with water, then pushes the water out. Sometimes it blows bubbles to catch its food. The boy whale sings long songs that can last for many hours. The girl whale and boy whale also make low sounds to talk to each other. A humpback whale can live for a long, long time.
Hundred\n\nA hundred is a big number. It is ten groups of ten. You can count to it with your fingers and toes many times. If you have a hundred pennies, you can trade them for a one-dollar bill. A hundred is more than the fingers on both hands, but less than the stars in the sky.
Hungarian language\n\nHungarian language is a way people talk and write. It is used by many people in a country called Hungary. It sounds different from English because it comes from a different family of languages. In Hungarian, little word parts are added to the end of a word to show things like "with" or "from." The writing uses letters that look like English letters, but some have small marks above them. If you hear someone say "szia" (see-ya), that means "hello" in Hungarian.
Hungary\n\nHungary is a country in the middle of Europe. It has no sea next to it, so it is called landlocked. Many other countries touch its sides. The land is mostly flat with big open fields, but there are some hills and a big lake called Balaton. A long river named the Danube runs through it. The biggest city is Budapest, where many people live and work. People there speak a special language that is not like most other languages nearby. They eat a thick soup called goulash and like to play with a cube puzzle that twists and turns.
Hunger\n\nHunger is a feeling in your tummy that tells you it is time to eat. It can feel like a little rumble or a soft ache. You feel it when you have not eaten for a few hours. After you eat a meal, the feeling goes away and you feel full. Some people do not have enough food, so they feel hunger a lot. That is very hard and can make them sick.
Hungry\n\nHungry is a feeling you get when your tummy is empty. It can make your tummy growl or rumble. You might feel a little tired or grumpy when you are hungry. When you eat food, the hungry feeling goes away. A snack like an apple or a cracker can help. Everyone feels hungry sometimes, and it is your body's way of saying it needs more energy.
Hunt\n\nA hunt is when a person or an animal looks for another animal to catch it. It often happens outside in the woods, fields, or water. A hunter may move very quietly and hide so the other animal does not see them. Some animals, like lions, hunt for food to eat. People may hunt for food too, or to help keep animal numbers safe. A dog can help a person hunt by using its good nose to find things.
Hunter\n\nA hunter is a person who looks for animals in the woods or fields. He walks very quietly and watches carefully. He may use a bow and arrow or a long stick called a rifle. Some hunters catch animals for food. Others help keep animal groups from getting too big. A hunter often wears bright orange so other people can see him.
Hunter-gatherer\n\nA hunter-gatherer is a person who finds food in the wild. They pick fruits, nuts, and plants that grow outside. They also catch animals like fish or rabbits to eat. Long ago, all people lived this way before farms and stores. They moved from place to place to find new food when the old spot was empty.
Hunting\n\nHunting is when a person goes out to find and catch an animal. It is an old way to get food. Long ago, people used long sticks with sharp ends. Today, some people use a bow that shoots a straight stick, or a gun that makes a loud bang. Some people hunt to eat the meat. Others hunt to keep the number of animals from getting too big. But if people hunt too much, an animal kind can go away forever. A bird called the dodo went away because of too much hunting.
Hunting dog\n\nA hunting dog is a dog that helps people find and catch animals. It has four legs, a wet nose, and a strong sense of smell. You can see it in the woods, on a farm, or by a lake with a hunter. It runs fast, sniffs the ground, and sometimes brings back a bird or a rabbit. Some hunting dogs point with their nose, some splash into water, and some dig into holes. A golden retriever is one kind of hunting dog that many kids know.
Hurdling\n\nHurdling is a running race where people jump over small walls called hurdles. It happens on a big track, like the one at school. Runners must go fast and jump high at the same time. They run a set path and jump over ten hurdles before the finish line. Some races are short, and some are longer. You can see hurdling at big sports shows like the Olympics.
Hurry\n\nHurry means to move or do something very fast. When you hurry, your legs go quick, and your heart beats a little faster. You might hurry when you are late for school or when you want to be first in line. Sometimes grown-ups say "hurry up" to help you go faster. It is the opposite of moving slow like a turtle.
Hurt\n\nHurt is a feeling you get when something bad happens to your body or your heart. It can be a small ouch, like when you bump your knee. It can also be a sad feeling inside, like when a friend says something mean. When you are hurt, you might cry or want a hug. A bandage or a kind word can help it feel better.
Husband\n\nA husband is a man who is married. He and his wife promise to be a family together. They often live in the same house and help each other every day. He might go to work, cook dinner, or play with the children. Some husbands wear a ring on their finger to show they are married.
Husbandry\n\nHusbandry is the way people take care of animals or plants. It means giving them food, water, and a safe place to live. A farmer does husbandry when he feeds his cows and collects eggs from his chickens. A gardener does husbandry when she waters her tomato plants and pulls out weeds. It is all about helping living things grow strong and healthy.
Hut\n\nA hut is a small, simple house. It has walls and a roof to keep out rain and sun. You can find a hut in a forest, on a beach, or in a village. People use it as a place to rest or sleep. It is often made of wood, mud, or straw.
Hyaena\n\nA hyaena is a wild animal that looks a bit like a big dog. It has a strong body, a thick neck, and front legs that are longer than the back legs. It lives in warm places like Africa and parts of Asia. It hunts for food at night and can eat almost every part of an animal, even the bones. A hyaena makes a loud laughing sound that you might hear in a movie about the wild.
Hybrid\n\nA hybrid is a baby animal or plant made from two different kinds of parents. It can look a little like each parent. A mule is a hybrid. Its mom is a horse and its dad is a donkey. Many garden flowers are hybrids too. People make hybrids to get plants with pretty colors or big fruit.
Hydroelectricity\n\nHydroelectricity is a kind of power that comes from moving water. It is made in big buildings called dams that sit on rivers. The dam holds back water, and when the water is let go, it spins a big wheel. That spinning makes electricity. People use it to turn on lights and run machines at home. It does not make dirty smoke like some other kinds of power. The water can be used again and again, so it never runs out. Many places near rivers use it to get their power.
Hydrogen\n\nHydrogen is a very light, invisible gas. It has no color, no smell, and no taste. You cannot see it, but it is everywhere. Most of it is in stars like the Sun. On Earth, it is part of water. Water is made of hydrogen and another gas called oxygen. When hydrogen burns, it makes water and gives off heat. People use it to help rockets fly up into space.
Hydropower\n\nHydropower is power we get from moving water. It can come from a big river, a waterfall, or the ocean. People use it to make lights turn on and machines run. A long time ago, water turned big wheels to grind corn into flour. Today, water spins a special fan called a turbine to make electricity. This electricity travels through wires to homes and schools. It is clean and does not make dirty smoke.
Hydrosphere\n\nThe hydrosphere is all the water on our planet. It is in the big oceans, in rivers, and in lakes. You can see it when you go to the beach or when it rains. People use it to make power for lights and machines. It covers most of the Earth, so our planet looks blue from space.
Hygiene\n\nHygiene means keeping your body clean. It is what you do every day to stay fresh and healthy. You wash your hands with soap and water to get rid of tiny, bad things called germs. You brush your teeth so they stay white and strong. You take a bath or a shower to wash off dirt. When you use the toilet, you wipe and wash your hands after. If you do not keep clean, you might get sick or smell bad. Good hygiene is a habit you learn when you are little, and it helps you feel good all day.
Hymn\n\nA hymn is a special song that people sing to God. It is often sung by everyone at a church. Sometimes a small group called a choir sings it while others listen. A piano or an organ plays the music. One famous hymn is called "Amazing Grace." It tells about God's love and help.
Hypnosis\n\nHypnosis is a way to make someone feel very calm and focused. It is like a deep daydream where a person listens closely to a helper. The helper talks in a soft, slow voice to guide the person into this calm state. When the person is in this state, they can follow simple ideas the helper gives. For example, the helper might say, "Your arm feels light like a balloon," and the person might feel it lift. Some people use hypnosis to feel less scared or to stop a bad habit. You might see it in a show where a person acts silly, but that is just for fun.
Hypothesis\n\nA hypothesis is a smart guess about why something happens. It is an idea that you can test to see if it is true. For example, you might guess that a plant grows faster when it gets more sunlight. Then you can do a test with two plants to find out. Scientists use hypotheses to help them learn new things. They try to prove the guess wrong, and if they cannot, the guess might be right.
Hyrax\n\nA hyrax is a small, round animal with thick fur. It has a short tail and looks a little like a big guinea pig. It lives in Africa and parts of Asia, often on rocky hills or in trees. It eats leaves, grass, and fruit. Even though it is small, it is a cousin of the elephant.
Iberian Peninsula\n\nThe Iberian Peninsula is a big piece of land in the southwest of Europe. It has water on three sides. The Mediterranean Sea is to the south and east of it, and the Atlantic Ocean is to the north and west. It is the third biggest peninsula in Europe. The name Iberia comes from a very old Greek word. Today, the land has two main countries: Spain and Portugal. Many people live there and speak Spanish or Portuguese.
Ibis\n\nAn ibis is a bird with long legs and a long, bent beak. It has feathers that can be white, brown, or black. It lives near water, like rivers and lakes. It walks in shallow water and pokes its beak into the mud to find small bugs and crabs to eat. It often stays with other ibises in big groups. Long ago, people in Egypt thought it was a special bird and made pictures of it on walls.
Ice\n\nIce is water that is very, very cold and hard. It is clear or white and feels cold and slippery. You can find it in a freezer at home or outside in winter when puddles freeze. People put ice in drinks to make them cold. It can also help a hurt spot feel better when wrapped in a cloth. In very cold places, ice covers lakes and rivers on top.
Ice age\n\nAn ice age is a very long time when the Earth is very cold. It has big sheets of ice that cover a lot of the land. You can find ice like this at the top and bottom of the Earth today. The ice moves slowly and can be as tall as a mountain. During an ice age, the sea gets lower because so much water turns into ice. Many animals with thick fur, like the woolly mammoth, lived back then. The last ice age ended a long, long time ago, before your great-great-grandparents were born.
Ice cream\n\nIce cream is a cold, sweet treat that you eat. It is made from cream, milk, and sugar. It can be many colors and flavors, like pink strawberry or brown chocolate. You can buy it from a store in a big box, or from a truck that plays music. Sometimes it comes on a stick or in a cone that you can hold. People eat it on hot days to feel cool and happy.
Ice hockey\n\nIce hockey is a game played on ice. It is played by two teams. The players wear special shoes called skates to move fast on the ice. They use long sticks to hit a small flat thing called a puck. The puck slides on the ice. Each team tries to put the puck into the other team's net to score. One player on each team stands in front of the net to stop the puck. This player is called the goalie. You can see ice hockey on TV or at a big ice rink. Many people in cold places like Canada and Russia love this game.
Ice pellets\n\nIce pellets are tiny balls of ice that fall from the sky. They look like small, hard, white beads. You see them when it is very cold outside, during a storm. They bounce and make a tapping sound when they hit the ground. Sometimes they are called sleet. Big ones can be called hailstones.
Ice sheet\n\nAn ice sheet is a huge, thick blanket of ice that covers a lot of land. It is very, very big and can be many miles deep. You can find it only in the coldest places on Earth, like the bottom and the top of the world. It stays frozen all year and never melts away. When it moves, it slides slowly over the ground like a giant frozen river. If all the ice in one big ice sheet melted, the ocean water would rise and cover more land.
Ice shelf\n\nAn ice shelf is a big, flat piece of ice. It is very thick and wide. You find it where the land meets the sea in very cold places. It can float on top of the water like a giant frozen raft. The biggest ones are in Antarctica, the coldest place on Earth.
Ice skating\n\nIce skating is moving on ice with special shoes. The shoes have a thin metal piece on the bottom. You can find ice skating at a cold rink or on a frozen pond. People do it for fun, to race, or to dance on the ice. Some skaters jump and spin in a show. Hockey players also wear these shoes to play on ice.
Iceberg\n\nAn iceberg is a big piece of ice that floats in the sea. It is mostly found in very cold water near the North Pole or the South Pole. You can only see a small part of it above the water. Most of it hides under the water where you cannot see it. It breaks off from even bigger ice called a glacier. It can float in the sea for a long time before it melts away. Ships must be careful because it can be dangerous if they hit it.
Iceland\n\nIceland is an island country far up north in the ocean. It has many mountains, hot springs, and big ice sheets called glaciers. Some parts of the ground are warm and steam comes out of the earth. People live in small towns, and the biggest town is Reykjavík. Many people there catch fish from the sea for food and to sell. It is a place where the sun stays up very late in summer and goes away early in winter.
Icon\n\nAn icon is a special picture that tells a holy story. It is painted on a flat piece of wood. You can find it in a church, where people light candles near it. It shows a person like Jesus, Mary, or an angel. People look at it when they pray. The paint is made from egg and bright colors, and the back shines with gold.
Icy\n\nIcy means very, very cold. It feels like ice when you touch it. You can find icy things in the freezer, like ice cubes or popsicles. When water gets icy, it turns hard and slippery. In winter, a sidewalk can be icy, so you have to walk slowly. An icy drink on a hot day feels nice and cool.
Idea\n\nAn idea is a thought in your head. It is like a little picture or a story you make up. You can get an idea when you play, when you read a book, or when you talk to a friend. It helps you make things, like a drawing or a new game. You can share an idea by telling someone about it.
If\n\nIf is a small word we use when we talk about something that might happen. It helps us think about choices. You can say, "If it rains, we will stay inside." It is a word you hear every day when people make plans or guess what comes next.
Igloo\n\nAn igloo is a small house made of snow. It looks like a big round ball cut in half. You find it in very cold places where snow stays on the ground for a long time. People build it by stacking blocks of snow on top of each other. It keeps them warm and safe from the cold wind. Some igloos are big enough for a few people to sit inside and even dance.
Igneous rock\n\nIgneous rock is a kind of rock made from hot, melted rock deep inside the Earth. It can be black, gray, or pink, and sometimes it has shiny little bits inside. You can find it in places where a mountain once blew out hot lava, or deep under the ground. When the melted rock cools down and gets hard, it turns into this rock. Some roads and kitchen counters are made from a strong kind called granite.
Iguanodon\n\nIguanodon is a big animal that lived a long, long time ago. It had a long tail, strong back legs, and shorter front legs. Its hands had a sharp thumb that looked like a small knife. It ate only plants and leaves. It could walk on all four legs or stand up on its two back legs to run fast. People find its old bones in the ground and put them together in big museums.
Illness\n\nAn illness is when your body does not feel good. It can make you feel hot, tired, or have a runny nose. Sometimes it makes your tummy hurt or your head ache. You might need to stay in bed and rest. A doctor can help you feel better. You can catch an illness from a friend who is sick, so it is good to wash your hands.
Illustration\n\nAn illustration is a picture that helps tell a story or show an idea. It can be a drawing, a painting, or a photo. You find it in books, newspapers, and on signs. It makes the words next to it easier to understand. For example, a picture of a red apple next to the word "apple" in your picture book is an illustration.
Image\n\nAn image is a picture of something. It can show a person, a place, or a thing. You see images in books, on TV, and on your tablet. People make images with a camera or by drawing with crayons and paint. An image helps you see what something looks like without being there.
Image scanner\n\nAn image scanner is a machine that copies a picture or a paper into a computer. It has a flat glass top and a lid that opens and closes. You put a photo or a drawing face-down on the glass. Then it shines a bright light and takes a picture of it. After that, you can see the picture on the computer screen. People use it at home, at school, or in an office to save old photos or send papers to friends.
Imagination\n\nImagination is a special power inside your head. It lets you see pictures and stories in your mind, even when your eyes are closed. You can use it to dream up a purple cat, a flying car, or a castle made of candy. It helps you play pretend games with your friends. When you draw a picture or tell a story, you are using your imagination. It is like a little movie theater that only you can see.
Imagine\n\nImagine is when you make a picture in your head. It is like a movie that only you can see. You can imagine a big red dog, a flying car, or a talking tree. When you close your eyes, you can imagine anything you want. It helps you think of new ideas and have fun. You can imagine you are a superhero or a princess. It is a special power that everyone has.
Imam\n\nAn imam is a leader for people who follow Islam. He leads the group when they pray together in a big room called a mosque. If someone has a question about their faith, they go to him for help. In small towns, he may also help the whole group make choices. He is like a teacher and a guide for the people.
Immigration\n\nImmigration is when people move from one country to live in another country. They leave their old home and go to a new place far away. It can be hard because they must learn a new way of talking and find a new house. Some people move to be safe or to find work. When they get to the new country, they may need a special card to stay. It takes a long time to become a full member of the new place.
Immune\n\nImmune means your body can fight off germs. It is like having a tiny army inside you that keeps you from getting sick. When a cold or a bug tries to get in, this army works hard to stop it. Eating good food and sleeping well helps keep it strong. Sometimes a doctor gives a shot to teach your body how to fight a new germ.
Immune system\n\nThe immune system is the body's team of tiny helpers that fight germs. It is made of special cells and parts that work together. You find it all through your body, from your skin to your blood. It stops bad things like cold bugs and cuts from making you sick. When you get a scratch, it sends helpers to fix it and eat the germs. Sometimes the spot gets red and warm, which means the helpers are busy working.
Impact crater\n\nAn impact crater is a big dent in the ground. It is made when a rock from space hits the Earth very fast. The dent is round like a bowl. You can find them on the ground, but many are old and hard to see. The Moon has many of them too. A big space rock hits the ground and makes a loud boom. Then the ground gets pushed down and broken. Some craters are very big, like a whole city. You can see pictures of them in books about space.
Impact event\n\nAn impact event is when two things in space bump into each other. It can be a rock from space hitting a big planet like Earth. The rock can be small or very big. When a small rock comes near Earth, it often burns up in the sky and makes a bright light. A big rock can make a big hole in the ground called a crater. You can see craters on the Moon. They look like big round bowls. Long ago, a huge rock hit Earth and made the dinosaurs go away. Today, people watch the sky with big telescopes to see if a rock is coming.
Impala\n\nAn impala is a kind of antelope that lives in Africa. It has reddish-brown fur and white fur on its belly, chin, and around the eyes. It has a black line on its back and a black stripe on each back leg. It lives in grassy places and woods near water. It can jump very far and run very fast to get away from big animals that want to catch it. Only the boy impala has long, curved, black horns. The girl impala has no horns. You can see an impala in a zoo or in a nature show on TV.
Impartiality\n\nImpartiality means being fair to everyone. It is when a person does not pick one side over another. A judge in a court must be impartial. She listens to both sides the same way. A jury is a group of people who also must be impartial. They decide if someone did a wrong thing after hearing all the facts. Being impartial helps make sure everyone gets a fair turn.
Imperial units\n\nImperial units are old ways to measure things. They include inches, feet, yards, and miles for how long something is. They also have ounces and pounds for how heavy something is. People in the United Kingdom used them a long time ago. Today, most places use a different set of measures called the metric system. You might still see Imperial units on some signs or in old stories.
Imperialism\n\nImperialism is when a big, strong country takes over a smaller, weaker place. It tells the people there what to do and uses their land and things. Long ago, some countries sailed far away to do this. The smaller place often had to follow new rules it did not choose. This made some people very sad and angry.
Important\n\nImportant means something matters a lot. It is a word we use when we need to pay attention. Your family is important because they love you and take care of you. Eating good food is important so you can grow big and strong. Listening to your teacher is important so you can learn new things. When something is important, we put it first.
Impressionism\n\nImpressionism is a way of painting. It started a long time ago in a country called France. Paintings in this style use many small, quick brush marks. The colors are often bright and sunny. Artists liked to paint outside, not inside a room. They painted things they saw every day, like trees, water, and people. When you look at the painting up close, you see spots and lines. When you step back, the picture looks soft and full of light.
In\n\nIn is a small word that tells where something is. It means inside a place or a thing. You can say the toy is in the box, or the milk is in the cup. It also works for time, like in the morning or in the summer. When you are in your room, you are inside it.
Inanna\n\nInanna is a goddess from very old stories. She is the goddess of love, war, and making things grow. People long ago in a place called Sumer told stories about her. She was also called the Queen of Heaven. Her special signs were a lion, a dove, and a star with eight points. The city of Uruk was her special home.
Inca\n\nThe Inca were people who lived long ago in the mountains of South America. They built big stone cities high up where clouds touch the ground. One famous city they made is called Machu Picchu. They grew food like corn and potatoes on steps cut into the hills. They used a special way to send messages with knotted strings. Today, people visit the old stone walls to see how the Inca lived.
Inca Empire\n\nThe Inca Empire was a big group of people who lived long ago. They lived high up in the mountains of South America. They built strong houses from big stones that fit together without any sticky stuff. They grew food like corn and potatoes on flat steps cut into the hills. They made roads and bridges to walk from one place to another. They had a king called the Sapa Inca. They used a special way to count and remember things with knots on strings.
Incense\n\nIncense is a stick or cone that makes nice-smelling smoke when you light it. It is long and thin, like a pencil, and has a special smell inside. You can find it in some homes, temples, or quiet rooms. People light one end and let it burn slowly, so the room fills with a soft, sweet smell. It helps people feel calm and peaceful. Some incense smells like flowers, and some smells like wood or fruit.
Inch\n\nAn inch is a way to measure how long something is. It is a small length, about as long as your thumb from the tip to the first line. You can find inches on a ruler or a measuring tape. People use it to measure small things like a toy car or a piece of paper. In some places, like the United States, people use inches to say how tall they are.
Inclined plane\n\nAn inclined plane is a flat surface that is tilted, like a ramp. It helps move heavy things up or down with less push or pull. You can find it on a playground slide, a sloping road, or a ramp for a wheelchair. People use it to lift a box onto a truck without lifting straight up. A wedge, like a doorstop, is two inclined planes put together.
Include\n\nInclude means to put something inside a group. When you make a list of your toys, you include your favorite bear. If you play a game with friends, you include everyone so no one feels left out. It is the opposite of leaving something out.
Income tax\n\nIncome tax is money that people give to the government. It is a small part of the money a person earns from a job. The government uses it to build roads, schools, and parks. When a grown-up works, their boss takes a little bit of their pay and sends it to the government. People who have their own shop or business also give a part of what they earn. Not all money is taxed — a small amount is left for the person to keep. The more money a person earns, the bigger the part they give. This helps everyone share the cost of things we all use.
India\n\nIndia is a big country in Asia. It has many people, more than any other country. It looks like a big triangle on the map, with water on three sides. You can find it near the Indian Ocean. Many people in India speak different languages and eat spicy food. They celebrate colorful festivals with lights and dancing. A famous building there is the Taj Mahal, which is made of white stone.
Indian\n\nIndian means something or someone from the country of India. It is a big, warm place with many people, spicy food, and colorful clothes. You can see Indian flags with orange, white, and green stripes. Indian music has drums and singing, and Indian dances use hands and feet in pretty ways. Many Indian families eat rice and bread called naan.
Indian Ocean\n\nThe Indian Ocean is a very big body of water. It is one of the biggest oceans on Earth. It touches many lands: Asia sits above it, Africa sits to one side, and Australia sits to the other side. The water is deep and blue. Big ships sail on it to carry things from one country to another. Many fish and sea animals live in it. People swim and play on the beaches next to it.
Indian philosophy\n\nIndian philosophy is a way of thinking about big questions. It asks things like: Who are we? Why are we here? It started a long, long time ago in India. People who study it think about the world, the mind, and how to live a good life. Some of these ideas are very old, from many hundreds of years ago. They are written in special books. Some people use these ideas when they sit quietly and think, or when they try to be kind to others. It is like a big tree with many branches, each one a little different.
Indigenous peoples\n\nIndigenous peoples are the first people who lived in a place. They were there long before other people came from far away. They have their own ways of talking, singing, and making art. Some live in the same land their great-great-grandparents lived in. They know a lot about the plants, animals, and rivers near their home. Today, many people work hard to keep their stories and ways safe.
Indigo\n\nIndigo is a deep blue color. It looks like the dark sky just before night. You can find it in some flowers, like the indigo plant, and in blue jeans. People use it to dye cloth a pretty blue. A rainbow has indigo between blue and violet.
Indonesia\n\nIndonesia is a big country made of many islands. It has green forests, tall mountains, and warm blue water all around. Many people live there, and they speak different languages. You can find it on a map near the big ocean. People in Indonesia grow rice and fruits, and they like to fly kites. Some islands have hot mountains that smoke and shake.
Indonesian language\n\nIndonesian language is the main language people speak in the country of Indonesia. It is also called Bahasa Indonesia. Many people in Indonesia speak it at home and at school. It is used on TV, in books, and when people talk to each other. Some words in Indonesian come from other languages like Dutch, English, and Arabic. People in other countries like Australia and Japan also learn Indonesian in school.
Inductive reasoning\n\nInductive reasoning is a way of thinking. It means you look at many small things and then guess a big rule. For example, if you see water go down a hill every time, you guess water always goes down. It is not always right, but it helps people start learning. Scientists use it to make a guess, then they test the guess to see if it is true.
Indus\n\nIndus is the name of a very long river. It flows through mountains and flat lands in a faraway place called Asia. Long, long ago, people built big cities next to it. They used the water to grow food and to travel in boats. Today, people still live near it and use its water.
Indus River\n\nThe Indus River is a very long river in Asia. It flows through big lands called Tibet, Kashmir, and Pakistan. It is the longest river in Pakistan and is a special sign for the country. Many smaller rivers join it along the way. The water from it helps farmers grow food in dry places. Without it, the land would be too dry for plants.
Indus Valley Civilisation\n\nThe Indus Valley Civilisation was a very old group of people who lived a long, long time ago. They built big cities near a river called the Indus. Their houses were made of bricks, and they had streets that were straight and clean. They made pots, toys, and pretty beads from stones. People today find old things they left behind buried in the ground. It was one of the first big groups of people to live in cities.
Industrial\n\nIndustrial means things made in big buildings called factories. It is about making lots of things, like cars, toys, or clothes, using big machines. You can see industrial places where there are tall smokestacks and big trucks. People work there to put parts together. The things they make go to stores for us to buy.
Industrial park\n\nAn industrial park is a big area with many buildings where people make things. It has big, boxy buildings and tall pipes that let out steam.
