You can find it far from houses, near big roads or train tracks. Workers go there to build cars, make food, or pack boxes. Trucks and trains bring things in and take things out all day.
Industrial Revolution\n\nThe Industrial Revolution was a time when people started using big machines to make things. It began long ago in a country called Britain. Before this time, people made things by hand at home. After, they used machines in large buildings called factories. A machine called the steam engine helped power the factories and trains. Many people moved from farms to towns to work in the factories. This changed how people lived and worked every day.
Industrialisation\n\nIndustrialisation is when people use big machines to make things. It changed how people work and live. Long ago, one person made a whole shoe by hand. Now, many people in a factory each do one small part, and machines help them. This way, they can make many more shoes in a day. Towns grew bigger because people moved there for factory jobs. It started a long time ago and spread to many places.
Inequality\n\nInequality is a way to compare two numbers or amounts. It tells you which one is bigger or smaller. You see it in math class when you learn about numbers. It uses signs like a wide open mouth that always wants to eat the bigger number. For example, if you have 5 cookies and your friend has 3, you can say 5 is greater than 3. That is an inequality.
Inertia\n\nInertia is a rule about how things move. It says a thing that is not moving will stay still until something pushes or pulls it. A thing that is moving will keep moving the same way until something stops it or turns it. You can see it when you ride in a car. If the car stops fast, your body wants to keep going forward. That is inertia. It is also why a ball sits on the floor until you kick it.
Infant\n\nAn infant is a very young baby. It is small and cannot walk or talk yet. You find an infant at home with its mom and dad. It drinks milk and sleeps a lot. When it is hungry or tired, it cries. A big person holds it gently and sings soft songs.
Infantry\n\nInfantry is a group of people in the army who fight on their own two feet. They do not ride in big trucks or on animals when they fight. They carry guns and other tools to keep safe. They walk on the ground and work together as a team. It is a very hard and brave job.
Infection\n\nAn infection is when tiny living things get inside your body and make you feel sick. It can happen in your throat, your tummy, or your skin. These tiny things are so small you cannot see them with your eyes. They grow and make more of themselves, which hurts your body. You might get a fever, a cough, or a runny nose. You can catch an infection from a friend who is sick, like when they sneeze near you. Washing your hands with soap and water helps keep the tiny things away. A doctor can give you special medicine to help you feel better.
Inference\n\nInference is a way to figure out something new from things you already know. It is like a puzzle in your head. You use clues to guess what will happen next. For example, if you see dark clouds in the sky, you can guess it might rain soon. People use it every day without thinking. When you hear a loud bark, you know a dog is near.
Infinity\n\nInfinity is an idea about things that never end. It is not a number you can count to, like 1, 2, or 3. You can think of it like a line that goes on and on forever, with no stop. In math, people use it to talk about how many numbers there are. For example, you can count 1, 2, 3, and keep going without ever reaching the last number. That is one kind of infinity. There are also bigger kinds, like all the numbers between 0 and 1. Infinity helps us understand things that have no end.
Inflation\n\nInflation is when prices go up. It means your money buys less than before. A candy bar that cost one coin might cost two coins later. You can see it at the store when the same toy gets a bigger price tag. It happens when there is too much money and not enough things to buy.
Influenza\n\nInfluenza is a sickness that makes your body feel bad. It is also called the flu. When you have it, you may cough, have a hot head, and your body may hurt. It spreads when a sick person coughs or sneezes tiny wet drops into the air. You can catch it by breathing those drops or touching things they land on. A shot from the doctor can help keep you from getting very sick. It is most common in the cold winter months.
Information\n\nInformation is what you learn when someone tells you something or when you read a book. It is like a message that helps you know more. You can find it in many places, like a picture, a story, or a song. A teacher gives you information when she tells you the names of colors. A stop sign gives you information when it tells you to stop. It helps you understand the world around you.
Information Age\n\nThe Information Age is a time when people use computers and the internet a lot. It started many years ago when a tiny part called a transistor was made. This part helps computers think and talk to each other. Before this age, people used big machines in factories. Now, they use small screens and phones to learn, play, and share pictures. You can see it when you watch a video on a tablet or talk to Grandma on a phone.
Information technology\n\nInformation technology is a way people use computers and phones to share and keep information. It helps us send messages, look at pictures, and watch videos. You can find it at home, at school, and in stores. It lets you play games on a tablet or talk to Grandma on a video call. When you see a grown-up typing on a laptop, that is information technology at work.
Infrastructure\n\nInfrastructure is all the big things people build to help us live. It includes roads, bridges, and pipes that bring water to your house. It also has schools, hospitals, and places where people work. When you turn on the tap, clean water comes out because of pipes under the ground. When you go to the park, you walk on a path that is part of infrastructure. Buses and trains run on roads and tracks that are infrastructure too. Without it, life would be much harder.
Inhaler\n\nAn inhaler is a small tool that helps people breathe better. It looks like a little tube or box with a mouth part. You hold it up to your mouth and press it, and a puff of medicine goes in. People with asthma use it when their chest feels tight. You might see a friend at school use one before running.
Inheritance\n\nInheritance is when someone's things go to family after they die. It can be a house, money, or a special toy. A paper called a will says who gets what. Sometimes only boys get it, and sometimes only girls. The person who gets the things is called an heir. Some places ask for a tax on what you get.
Injury\n\nAn injury is a hurt on your body. It can be a cut, a bump, or a bruise. You can get it when you fall down, bump into something, or touch something hot. Sometimes it happens by accident, like when you trip on the sidewalk. A doctor or a grown-up can help clean it and put a bandage on it. It gets better when you rest and take care of it.
Ink\n\nInk is colored water that helps people write and draw. It can be black, blue, red, or any color. You find it inside a pen, a marker, or a stamp pad. When you push a pen on paper, it leaves a line or a shape. Some ink is wet and can smudge if you touch it too soon. A ballpoint pen has thick ink that dries fast, so it does not make a mess.
Inn\n\nAn inn is a small house where people can sleep when they are away from home. It has a bed, a blanket, and a pillow. You can find it along a road or in a town. A tired traveler stops at an inn to rest for the night. In the morning, they eat breakfast and then go on their way. It is like a cozy home for a short stay.
Inner Mongolia\n\nInner Mongolia is a big piece of land in the north of China. It has wide, open fields of grass where horses and sheep can run. Many people there live in round, white tents called yurts. Some people ride horses and take care of animals. The land is very big, but not many people live there. In the biggest city, called Hohhot, you can see tall buildings and busy streets.
Inorganic\n\nInorganic means something is not from a living thing. It does not come from a plant or an animal. Rocks, water, and air are inorganic. A toy made of plastic is also inorganic. You can find inorganic things all around you, like the sand at the playground or the metal spoon in your kitchen.
Inorganic Chemistry\n\nInorganic chemistry is a kind of science about stuff that is not alive. It looks at things like rocks, metals, and water. You can find these things all around you, like the salt on your food or the iron in a pan. People use it to make glass, clean water, and build strong houses. A shiny gold ring is an example of something it studies.
Input\n\nInput is what you put into something. It can be words you type on a computer, a button you press, or a sound you make. When you talk to a toy and it moves, your voice is the input. It is the start of how a machine or game knows what to do next.
Insect\n\nAn insect is a tiny animal with six legs. It has a hard shell on the outside of its body. Its body has three parts: a head, a middle part, and a back part. Most insects have wings and can fly. You can find insects almost everywhere on land, like in gardens, parks, and forests. Some insects, like ants and bees, live in big groups. Others, like butterflies, have pretty wings. A ladybug is a small, round insect with red and black spots. Insects eat many things, like leaves, nectar, or other tiny bugs.
Inside\n\nInside means the part of something that is not outside. It is the space you see when you open a door, a box, or a bag. You find it in your house, in a closet, or in your toy chest. When you go into a room, you are inside that room. A cookie has a soft inside under the hard outside.
Instead\n\nInstead means you pick one thing and not another. It is a word that helps you choose. When you want juice instead of milk, you say no to milk and yes to juice. You can use it when you change your mind, like playing with blocks instead of a puzzle. It helps you tell people what you really want.
Instinct\n\nAn instinct is something an animal does without thinking or learning. It is born with it. A baby sea turtle knows to walk to the ocean right after it comes out of its egg. It does not need a mom to show it the way. A baby bird opens its mouth wide for food when a parent comes near. It does not learn this; it just does it. A bee dances to tell other bees where to find flowers. It never went to school to learn the dance. These are all instincts. They help animals stay safe and find food.
Institution\n\nAn institution is a set of rules that people follow together. It can be a big group, like a school or a church, or a way of doing things, like saying "please" and "thank you." It helps people know what to do and how to act. You can find it in many places, like your town or your home. It makes life more fair and safe for everyone. For example, a family is an institution because it has rules, like sharing toys and listening to parents.
Instrument\n\nAn instrument is a tool that makes music. It can be big like a piano or small like a flute. You hit it, blow into it, or move your fingers on it to make sounds. People play instruments in bands, at school, or at home for fun. A guitar is an instrument with strings you can strum.
Insurance\n\nInsurance is a promise to help when something bad happens. You pay a little money every month to a big company. If your toy breaks or you get sick, it gives you money to fix it. It is like a safety net that catches you. There are different kinds. One kind helps if you get hurt. Another kind helps with your house or car. People who are good at math decide how much you pay each month.
Integer\n\nAn integer is a whole number. It has no little parts after a dot, like 1, 2, or 3. It can be a counting number, like 5, or a number below zero, like -2. Zero is also an integer. You see integers when you count your fingers or when you look at a clock.
Integrate\n\nIntegrate means to put things together so they work as one. When you mix red and blue paint, you integrate the colors to make purple. In a puzzle, you integrate all the pieces to see the whole picture. At school, you integrate new words with old words to tell a longer story.
Integrated Circuit\n\nAn integrated circuit is a tiny flat piece that holds many tiny electric parts. It looks like a small black box with little metal legs. You can find it inside phones, computers, and toys. It helps these things think and remember. When you press a button on a toy, it tells the toy what to do.
Intellectual\n\nIntellectual means being good at thinking and learning. It is a word for a person who likes to read, ask questions, and figure things out. You might see an intellectual person at a library or a school. They enjoy solving puzzles and learning new facts. A teacher or a scientist is often an intellectual person.
Intellectual disability\n\nIntellectual disability is a problem with the brain. It makes it harder for a person to think, learn, and do everyday things. A child with this problem may need extra help at home and at school. Some people are born with it, and some get it when they are very young. With love and teaching, they can still learn many things and be happy.
Intelligence\n\nIntelligence is how well your brain can think and learn. It helps you solve puzzles, remember things, and figure out new games. You use it when you count your toys or find a lost shoe. Some people learn fast, and some take more time, but everyone has it. Animals like dogs and birds also use their own kind of intelligence to find food or play.
Intensive farming\n\nIntensive farming is a way of growing food where people use many tools and helpers to get a lot of food from a small piece of land. It uses big machines like tractors to dig the ground and pick the food. Farmers also put special plant food called fertilizer on the ground to help plants grow fast. They spray things to keep bugs away from the plants. Animals like cows and chickens are often kept in big buildings with many other animals. This way of farming gives us lots of food, but it can make the water and air dirty. Some people worry that the animals are not happy in small spaces.
Interaction\n\nInteraction is when two things or people do something together. It is like a back-and-forth game. When you talk to a friend and they talk back, that is interaction. When you pet a dog and it wags its tail, that is interaction. You can see it when you play catch with a ball. It happens every day when you say hello and someone says hello back.
Interchangeable parts\n\nInterchangeable parts are pieces that are all made the same. It means one part can fit in any toy or tool of the same kind. Long ago, people made each thing by hand, so parts were not the same. A man named Eli Whitney used machines to make many parts that were all alike. Later, Henry Ford used this idea to build cars fast. He made many cars with the same parts, so fixing them was easy. Today, many things you use, like a toy with blocks that snap together, have interchangeable parts.
Interest\n\nInterest is the extra money you pay when you borrow money. It is also the extra money you get when you let someone use your money. Think of it like a small fee added on top. If you borrow one coin and the interest is one penny, you give back one coin and one penny. Sometimes the extra money grows over time, like a snowball getting bigger as it rolls. Interest can also mean something you like a lot, like a favorite toy or game. When you say "I have an interest in trains," it means you really like trains and want to learn more about them.
Interested\n\nInterested means you really want to know more about something. When you are interested, your eyes get big and you listen closely. You might ask a grown-up a lot of questions about it. It feels like a happy, curious feeling inside you. You can be interested in a new toy, a bug on the ground, or a story someone tells you.
Interesting\n\nInteresting means something makes you want to look, listen, or learn more. It can be a fun toy, a pretty picture, or a story that makes you smile. You might find it in a book, at the park, or when a friend shows you a new trick. When something is interesting, you feel happy and curious. A bright red bug on a leaf can be interesting because you want to watch what it does.
Interior design\n\nInterior design is making the inside of a room look nice and work well. It picks the colors, the soft chairs, the rugs, and where to put the lamp. You see it in your house, in a store, or at the doctor’s office. A person who does this job helps a room feel cozy and easy to use. For example, they might put a soft rug next to your bed so your feet feel warm in the morning.
Interjection\n\nAn interjection is a short word or sound that shows a strong feeling. It can be a happy word like "Yay!" or a sad word like "Oh no!" You say it when something happens fast, like when you get a surprise or feel a little hurt. It often stands all by itself, and you say it in a loud or quick way. When you see a big dog and say "Wow!" that is an interjection. When you drop your toy and say "Oops!" that is one too.
Internal Combustion Engine\n\nAn internal combustion engine is a machine that makes cars and trucks move. It burns fuel, like gas, inside a small space to make power. This power turns the wheels so the car can go. You can find it under the hood of most cars on the road. When you hear a car start with a vroom sound, that is the engine working.
Internal Structure Of Earth\n\nThe inside of Earth has three big parts. It has a hard outer skin called the crust. Under that is a hot, soft part called the mantle. At the very middle is a super-hot ball called the core. The crust is where we live and where the oceans sit. The mantle is so hot that rock moves very slowly, like thick honey. The core is made of metal and is as hot as the sun. We cannot dig down to see these parts, but scientists know they are there.
International Date Line\n\nThe International Date Line is an invisible line on the Earth. It runs from the top to the bottom of the world in the big ocean. When you cross it going one way, the day changes to the next day. When you cross it going the other way, the day goes back one day. It helps people all over the world know what day it is.
International Red Cross And Red Crescent Movement\n\nThe International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement is a big group of helpers. It has a red cross or a red moon on a white flag. You can see it in many countries when people need help after a storm, a fire, or a war. They give food, water, and a safe place to sleep. They also help sick people feel better. Many grown-ups wear a vest with the red cross or red moon when they work.
International Space Station\n\nThe International Space Station is a big house that flies in space. It goes around the Earth way up high. People from many countries built it together. Astronauts live inside it for many months. They sleep in bags stuck to the wall so they do not float away. They eat food from pouches and drink from tubes. It has no up or down because there is very little pull from the Earth. The sun rises and sets many times each day there. Astronauts look out the window and see the whole Earth below.
International trade\n\nInternational trade is when people in one country send things to people in another country. It is like swapping toys with a friend who lives far away. A country might send food, clothes, or toys to another country. Then the other country sends back different things. Sometimes countries make rules about what can be sent. When countries agree to trade freely, it is called free trade.
Internet\n\nThe Internet is a big, invisible web that connects computers and phones all over the world. It lets people send messages, watch videos, and play games with friends far away. You can find it on a computer, a tablet, or a phone when you open a browser. It helps you see pictures, read stories, and talk to Grandma on a video call. For example, when you watch a cartoon on a tablet, that cartoon comes to you through the Internet.
Internet meme\n\nAn internet meme is a funny picture, video, or saying that people share online. It can be a silly face, a cute animal, or a short joke. You see it on phones, tablets, and computers when you watch videos or look at pictures. People send it to friends to make them laugh. Sometimes it has words on top of a picture. A meme can change a little bit each time someone shares it.
Interpersonal relationship\n\nAn interpersonal relationship is a bond between people. It is like a bridge that connects two or more hearts. You find it in families, at school, and with friends. It grows when people share things they like, play together, and help each other. A child and a parent have this bond. Friends who laugh and share toys also have it.
Interview\n\nAn interview is a talk between two people. One person asks questions, and the other person answers them. You might see an interview on TV when a host talks to a singer or an actor. Sometimes a grown-up goes to an interview to get a new job. They sit in a room and answer questions about what they can do. An interview helps people learn more about someone.
Interviewer\n\nAn interviewer is a person who asks questions. He talks to people to learn about them. You might see him on TV when he talks to a famous singer or actor. He also helps when someone wants a new job by asking about what they can do. He listens carefully and writes down the answers.
Intimacy\n\nIntimacy is a warm, close feeling between people. It is when you feel very safe and loved with someone. You can have it with your mom or dad when you hug or read a book together. You can also have it with a best friend when you share a secret or play a game. It is not just about touching—it is about feeling happy and close inside. When you feel intimacy, you know the other person cares about you a lot.
Into\n\nInto is a small word that tells us something is moving inside. You use it when a ball rolls into a box or a cat jumps into a basket. It shows the way from outside to inside. When you walk into your room, you go from the hall to the inside of the room. It is a word you hear and say many times every day.
Introduce\n\nIntroduce means to tell someone about a new person or thing. When you meet a new friend, you say your name and ask for theirs. You can also introduce a toy to your friend by showing it and saying what it does. It helps people get to know each other.
Introspection\n\nIntrospection is when you look inside your own mind. It is like sitting quietly and thinking about what you feel or why you did something. You can do it anywhere, like in your room or under a tree. It helps you understand if you are happy, sad, or angry. For example, after you cry, you might think about why you cried.
Inuit\n\nInuit are people who live in very cold, snowy places far up north. They have warm, thick coats made from animal skins. You can find them in parts of Canada, Greenland, and Alaska. They hunt for food like fish, seals, and whales. They use dogs to pull sleds over the snow. Long ago, they built houses from snow called igloos. Today, many live in regular houses but still hunt and fish.
Invention\n\nAn invention is a new thing that someone makes for the first time. It can be a toy, a tool, or a big machine. Before it was made, no one had ever seen it. The computer was an invention long ago. Cars and plastic bottles are inventions too. The person who makes it is called an inventor. Sometimes an invention helps people do a job faster or have more fun. A new kind of pencil with a built-in eraser is a small invention. A new story with made-up people is also an invention.
Inventor\n\nAn inventor is a person who makes new things. He thinks of ideas that no one has thought of before. He might build a tool, a toy, or a machine that helps people. You can find inventors in workshops or labs, drawing plans and trying again and again. For example, the person who made the first light bulb was an inventor. His work makes our lives easier and more fun.
Invertebrate\n\nAn invertebrate is an animal that has no backbone. It does not have hard bones inside its body. Many invertebrates live in the sea, like jellyfish and crabs. Some live on land, like bugs and worms. A butterfly is an invertebrate you can see in a garden.
Investment\n\nInvestment is when you put money into something to get more money later. It is like planting a tiny seed and waiting for a big plant to grow. People put money in a bank, and the bank gives a little extra money back. Some people buy a small part of a big company, hoping the company grows. It takes time, and sometimes you must wait a long while. A grown-up might save coins in a jar to buy a big toy later—that is a simple kind of investment.
Invisible\n\nInvisible means you cannot see it with your eyes. Air is invisible, but you can feel it when the wind blows. Some things are invisible because they are very small, like tiny bits of dust. A ghost in a story is often invisible too. Even when something is invisible, it can still be real and touchable.
Invite\n\nAn invite is a kind note that asks someone to come to a fun time. It can be a pretty card or a message on a phone. You might get an invite for a birthday party, a play date, or a picnic. When you get one, it tells you where to go and what time to be there. You can also send an invite to a friend when you want them to play with you.
Io (moon)\n\nIo is a moon that goes around the big planet Jupiter. It is a little bigger than our own moon. It has many, many hot mountains that shoot out fire and red-hot rocks. These are called volcanoes. The ground on Io is yellow, orange, and red from all the hot stuff that comes out. It is always changing because new hot rocks cover the old ones. You can see pictures of Io in space books. It looks like a pizza with bright colors.
Ionian Sea\n\nThe Ionian Sea is a big body of water. It is part of a bigger sea called the Mediterranean. It touches the land of Italy on one side and Greece on the other side. Many pretty islands sit in it, like Corfu and Zante. Big boats called ferries carry people and cars across it. The ground under it sometimes shakes, which can make waves.
Iran\n\nIran is a big country far away. It has tall mountains and dry, flat land. Many people live there, and they speak a language called Persian. Long ago, it was called Persia. The capital city is Tehran. People in Iran make beautiful rugs with bright colors and patterns. They also write poems and paint pictures. A long time ago, there were kings and big empires there. Today, many families live in cities and villages. Some people grow food on farms. Iran has a lot of oil deep under the ground. Oil is used to make cars and trucks go. It is a very old place with many stories.
Iraq\n\nIraq is a country far away. It is in a part of the world called Asia. It has two big rivers that give water to the land. The land between the rivers is very old and people lived there a long, long time ago. The biggest city is called Baghdad. The weather is very hot and dry. Iraq has a lot of oil under the ground. Oil is a black liquid that can be turned into gas for cars.
Ireland\n\nIreland is a big island in the ocean. It is green and has many hills, fields, and lakes. It is made of two parts: one part is its own country, and the other part is joined with a bigger country nearby. Many people live on the island, and they speak English. A long time ago, people built big stone houses that you can still see today. The island is known for music, dancing, and stories. It rains often, so the grass stays very green.
Iris\n\nAn iris is a pretty flower that grows in gardens. It has tall green stems and big petals that can be purple, blue, yellow, or white. You can find it in sunny spots where the ground is not too wet. People plant it to make their yards look bright and happy. In spring, it opens up and looks like a little flag waving in the wind.
Iris (plant)\n\nAn iris is a pretty flower that grows in gardens. It has tall green stems and big, colorful petals. The petals can be purple, blue, yellow, white, or many other colors. It has three outer petals that hang down and three inner petals that stand up. Some kinds have soft, fuzzy hairs in the middle. People plant irises in the ground, and they come back every year. Butterflies and tiny birds like to visit the flower. People also cut the stems and put the flowers in a vase to make a room look bright and happy.
Irish Sea\n\nThe Irish Sea is a big body of water. It sits between Ireland and Great Britain. It is very deep in some spots. Ships carry people and things across it every day. Many fish live in it, like sharks and dolphins. People also catch fish and shellfish there for food. Big machines in the sea make power from wind. It is a busy and important sea.
Iron\n\nIron is a strong, gray metal. It is found deep in the ground and in rocks. People dig it up and use it to make many things. It is used to build bridges, cars, and tall buildings. When iron gets wet, it can turn red and flaky. That red stuff is called rust. Iron is also inside our bodies. It helps our blood carry air to all parts of us. Some foods like meat and cereal have iron in them to keep us healthy.
Iron Age\n\nThe Iron Age is a time long ago when people learned to make tools from iron. It came after the time when people used stone and then bronze. Iron is a strong, dark metal that can be shaped into sharp things like swords, knives, and plows. People dug iron out of the ground and heated it in a very hot fire. They made better tools for farming and building. This helped towns grow bigger. You can see old iron tools in a museum today.
Ironing\n\nIroning is a way to make clothes flat and smooth. It uses a warm, heavy tool called an iron. The iron gets hot, and you push it over the cloth to take out the bumps and lines. You do it on a soft, flat board. Some clothes need a little water to turn into steam, which helps the iron work better. You can see a grown-up doing ironing at home when shirts and pants come out of the dryer.
Iroquois\n\nThe Iroquois are a group of Native American tribes who lived in the northeastern part of what is now the United States. They are also called the Haudenosaunee, which means People of the Longhouse. A longhouse is a big wooden house where many families lived together. They grew corn, beans, and squash for food. They also hunted deer and fished in rivers. Today, many Iroquois people live in New York and Canada.
Irregular galaxy\n\nAn irregular galaxy is a big group of stars that does not have a neat shape. It is not round like a ball and does not have pretty arms like a pinwheel. It looks messy and spread out. You can find many of them in space, far away from Earth. Some were once a nice shape but got pulled and bent by other galaxies nearby. It has lots of gas and tiny dust bits floating inside.
Irrigation\n\nIrrigation is a way to give water to plants when there is not enough rain. It uses pipes, hoses, or buckets to bring water to the fields. You can see it on farms where big sprinklers spray water over the crops. Some farmers use small tubes that drip water right near the plant roots. This helps the plants grow big and strong, even on hot, dry days.
Irrigation sprinkler\n\nAn irrigation sprinkler is a tool that sprays water on plants. It has a head with small holes where water comes out. You can find it in a garden or on a farm. It helps grass, flowers, and food plants grow when there is not enough rain. Some sprinklers stay in one spot, and some move around. When it is on, it makes a soft hissing sound and the water looks like tiny rain drops.
Is\n\nIs is a small word we use every day. It helps us say what something is or how it is. You can say "The sky is blue" or "The cat is soft." It is a word that connects a thing to a word that tells more about it. You hear it in stories, songs, and when people talk.
Isaac\n\nIsaac is a person from a very old story. He is the son of a man named Abraham and a woman named Sarah. When he was a baby, his parents laughed because they were so happy and surprised. He grew up and had a wife named Rebecca. They had two boys named Esau and Jacob. Many people still read the story of Isaac in a big book called the Bible.
Ishmael\n\nIshmael is a boy from a very old story. He was the first son of a man named Abraham. His mother was a helper named Hagar. When he was a baby, he and his mom had to walk far away into a hot, dry place. They ran out of water, but a kind angel showed them a well. He grew up and had a big family with twelve sons. Some people tell stories that his family became many people in a big desert land.
Isis\n\nIsis is a goddess from old Egyptian stories. She is a kind and powerful helper. She takes care of moms and kids, and she can make sick people feel better. People drew her with big wings, a special hat shaped like a chair, and a cross with a loop on top. She is the mom of a god named Horus. Long ago, many people in Egypt and faraway lands loved her and built pretty houses to say thank you.
Islam\n\nIslam is a way of life for many people around the world. It teaches that there is one God, who made everything. People who follow Islam are called Muslims. They have a special book called the Quran, which they believe are God's words. Muslims pray five times every day, facing a holy city called Mecca. They often go to a quiet building called a mosque to pray together. Before praying, they wash their hands, face, and feet to be clean. Many Muslims also give food or money to help people who have less. Once a year, they do a special month of not eating during the day, called fasting. This helps them feel closer to God and think about others. Islam is one of the biggest ways of life in the world, with many families and children following it.
Islamic architecture\n\nIslamic architecture is a way of building things. It uses big round tops called domes and tall thin towers called minarets. You can see it in places where people pray, called mosques. It has pretty shapes and writing on the walls instead of pictures of people or animals. The writing is often from a special book. The walls and floors have small colored tiles that make bright patterns. Many old buildings in hot, sandy lands look like this.
Islamic calendar\n\nThe Islamic calendar is a way to count days and months. It uses the Moon to tell time, not the Sun. It has 12 months, and each month has 29 or 30 days. A whole year is about 354 days long. That is a little shorter than the year we use every day. People use it to know when special Muslim days happen. The months move through all the seasons over many years.
Island\n\nAn island is a piece of land with water all around it. It can be big or small. You find islands in oceans, lakes, or rivers. Some islands have trees, sand, and animals. People can live on islands or visit them for a fun day at the beach. A small island with just a few palm trees is one you might see in a picture book.
Israel\n\nIsrael is a small country far away. It sits next to a big blue sea. In Israel, you can see old stone walls and busy streets. Many people live there, and they speak different languages. Some places in Israel are very dry with sand, and some have green hills. People go there to see special old buildings and pray.
Istanbul\n\nIstanbul is a very big city. It sits in two parts of the world: one side is in Europe and the other side is in Asia. A long, blue water road called a strait runs through the middle of it. Big boats and small boats go up and down the water every day. Many, many people live there—more than you can count. Long ago, it had a different name: Constantinople. Today, people visit it to see old, beautiful buildings and to eat yummy food.
It\n\nIt is a small word we use when we talk about a thing, an animal, or a place. We say it instead of the name over and over. If you see a red ball, you can say, "Look at it!" It helps us talk faster and not repeat the same word. When you point to a dog, you can say, "It is fluffy." You use it many times every day without even thinking.
Itaipu Dam\n\nItaipu Dam is a very big wall that holds back a river. It sits on the border between two countries, Brazil and Paraguay. It is so long and tall that you can see it from far away. The dam uses moving water to make power that lights up homes and schools. Many people think it is one of the most amazing things people have ever built.
Italian\n\nItalian is a way of talking and a way of living from a country called Italy. It sounds like music when people speak it. Many people use it to say hello, to sing songs, and to name yummy food like pizza and pasta. You can hear it in movies or when a friend's family talks at home. Italy is shaped like a boot on the map, and that is where Italian comes from.
Italian food\n\nItalian food is the yummy food that people make in Italy. It is not just one dish — different parts of Italy cook different things. You can find pasta and pizza almost everywhere. Pasta is long or short noodles with red or white sauce. Pizza is a flat round bread with cheese and tomato on top. Many people also love a cold sweet treat called ice cream. In Italy, people put olive oil on their food to make it taste good. They also eat olives, which are small round fruits. You might have seen spaghetti or a slice of pizza at your own dinner table.
Italian language\n\nItalian is a way people talk and write. It is used in a country called Italy and some other places. It sounds like music when people speak it. Many food words we know come from it, like pizza and spaghetti. Some music words also come from it, like the name of a big violin called a cello.
Italian literature\n\nItalian literature is all the stories and poems people wrote in the Italian language. It started a long, long time ago, when people first began writing books in Italy. One of the first big writers was a man named Dante. He wrote a very long poem about a trip through different worlds. Later, other people wrote plays and stories about love, heroes, and real life. Some wrote about history, and some wrote about ideas. Today, people still read these old books and also new ones by Italian writers. Six Italian writers have won a very big prize for their stories and poems.
Italy\n\nItaly is a country in Europe. It looks like a boot on a map. It has big mountains in the north and a long coast with blue sea. People in Italy eat yummy food like pasta and pizza. Many people visit Italy to see old buildings and pretty art.
Item\n\nAn item is one single thing. It can be something you hold, like a toy or a spoon. It can also be something you see, like a picture on a wall. When you make a list, each thing on the list is an item. At the store, every box on the shelf is an item you can buy. An item is just one piece of a bigger group.
Its\n\nIt is a small word we use every day. We say it when we talk about a thing, an animal, or a place. For example, we say "The ball is red. It is round." We also use it for the weather, like "It is sunny today." It helps us not say the same name again and again.
Itself\n\nItself is a word we use to talk about the same thing again. It means the thing we just said, not a new thing. When you say "the cat cleaned itself," you mean the cat cleaned the cat. You can use it for one thing, like a toy or a pet. It helps us not say the same name over and over.
Ivory\n\nIvory is a hard, smooth material that comes from big animals like elephants. It is a yellowish-white color, like old milk. People used to make pretty things from it, like piano keys and small statues. But now it is very hard to get because we must keep the animals safe. Today, most of those things are made from plastic instead.
Ivory Coast\n\nIvory Coast is a country in Africa. It sits next to the big ocean and has warm weather all year. Many people live in a big city called Abidjan. In the country, you can see tall trees, green plants, and animals like monkeys. People there grow food like bananas and cocoa beans. Cocoa beans are used to make chocolate.
J-pop\n\nJ-pop is fun music from Japan. It has a happy beat and people sing in Japanese. You can hear it on the radio, on TV shows, and in cartoons from Japan. Many young people and grown-ups like to dance to it. Some songs are fast and some are slow and sweet. It is a big part of life in Japan.
Jack\n\nJack is a name for a boy. He can be a little boy or a grown-up man. You might meet a Jack at school or at the park. He likes to play and have fun, just like you. Sometimes a Jack has a dog or a cat that he loves very much.
Jackal\n\nA jackal is a wild animal that looks like a small dog. It has pointy ears, a bushy tail, and long legs. Jackals live in Africa, Asia, and Europe. They run fast and can run for a long time. They eat small animals like mice and birds. Sometimes they eat food that other animals leave behind. A jackal lives with one mate, and they stay together. They mark their home with a strong smell to keep other jackals away. Young jackals stay with their parents until they are big enough to find their own home.
Jacket\n\nA jacket is a piece of clothing you wear on top of your shirt. It has long sleeves and a zipper or buttons in the front. You put it on when it is cold or windy outside. It keeps your body warm and dry. Some jackets have a hood to cover your head. You might wear a jacket to school, to the park, or when you go for a walk.
Jackfruit\n\nA jackfruit is a very big fruit that grows on a tree. It is green on the outside and has bumpy skin. When it is ready to eat, the color turns a little yellow. Inside, it has soft yellow parts and hard brown seeds. People cook the seeds and eat them. They also cook the green fruit like a vegetable. The ripe yellow fruit is sweet and can be eaten cold. The tree it grows on is tall, with shiny green leaves. A jackfruit can be as heavy as a big dog and as long as your arm.
Jackson\n\nJackson is a name for a boy. It starts with the letter J. Some boys named Jackson have brown hair or blond hair. You might meet a Jackson at school or at the park. He could be your friend who likes to play tag or share his snack.
Jacob\n\nJacob is a person from very old stories. He had a big family with twelve sons and one daughter. He lived a long, long time ago in a place far away. He took care of sheep and goats. One time, he made a warm soup and shared it with his brother. He is remembered as a father of a big group of people.
Jade\n\nJade is a pretty, hard stone. It can be green, white, or other soft colors. People find it deep in the ground. Long ago, people used it to make sharp tools and knives. Today, people wear it as shiny jewelry like necklaces and bracelets. Some think it brings good luck.
Jade Emperor\n\nThe Jade Emperor is a very important god in old Chinese stories. He is like a king who lives high up in the sky. People say he watches over the whole world and makes sure things are fair. Long ago, he was picked to be the boss of all the other gods. On a special day each year, people go to temples and give him food and sweet smells to show they are thankful. In some stories, he is called the Heavenly Grandfather because he is like a kind, wise grandpa in the sky.
Jaguar\n\nA jaguar is a big wild cat. It has yellow or orange fur with dark spots shaped like flowers. It lives in forests and wet places in South America and Central America. It is very strong and can swim well. It hunts alone and eats many kinds of animals. Sometimes a jaguar is all black, but you can still see its spots if you look close.
Jail\n\nA jail is a building with strong walls and locked doors. It has small rooms with bars on the windows. Police bring people there when they break a rule. Inside, people must stay until a judge says they can go. You might see a jail in a movie or a book, but it is not a nice place to visit.
Jainism\n\nJainism is a very old way of thinking and living. It started in India a long, long time ago. People who follow it believe that every living thing has a soul inside. They try to be kind and not hurt any animal or bug. They also try not to want too many things, like toys or treats. By being good and peaceful, they feel happy and free inside.
Jaipur\n\nJaipur is a big city in the country of India. It has many people, about as many as three big bags of rice grains. The city is very old and was built by a king a long time ago. It is known for its pink buildings, so some people call it the Pink City. You can see big forts and palaces there. Many people visit Jaipur to see the pretty colors and busy streets.
Jakarta\n\nJakarta is a very big city on an island called Java. It is the biggest city in the country of Indonesia. Many, many people live there — more than ten million. It sits next to the sea, and sometimes too much water comes in and floods the streets. The ground under the city is slowly going down, so the city is sinking a little bit every year. Long ago, it had different names, like Batavia. Today, it is a busy place with lots of cars, houses, and tall buildings.
Jake\n\nJake is a name for a boy. He is a person, just like you. You might meet a Jake at school or at the park. He could be a friend who likes to play games and share toys. Sometimes a Jake has a big smile and a loud laugh. He is special because every Jake is different.
Jam\n\nJam is a sweet, thick food made from fruit. It is soft and can be spread on bread or toast. You find it in a jar in the kitchen. People eat it for breakfast or as a snack. Strawberry jam is a kind many kids like.
Jamaica\n\nJamaica is a warm island country in the big blue sea. It has green mountains, sandy beaches, and many rivers. People live in towns like Kingston, and they speak English. It is famous for happy music called reggae and a singer named Bob Marley. A very fast runner named Usain Bolt comes from Jamaica too.
January\n\nJanuary is the first month of the year. It has 31 days. It is a cold month in many places, and sometimes snow falls. People start a new calendar in January. They may make a wish for the year, like trying a new thing. You might see frost on windows or wear a warm coat outside.
Japan\n\nJapan is a country made of many islands. It sits in the ocean near China and Korea. The biggest island is called Honshu, and the capital city is Tokyo. Many people live in big cities near the water. Japan has tall mountains, and one is a pretty volcano named Mount Fuji. The ground sometimes shakes there because of earthquakes. People in Japan eat rice, fish, and noodles. A food called sushi is made with rice and raw fish. In spring, pink flowers called cherry blossoms bloom on trees. Japan makes many cars, like Toyota and Honda. It also builds robots that help in factories.
Japanese\n\nJapanese is a way people talk and write. It comes from the country of Japan. It uses three kinds of writing: hiragana, katakana, and kanji. Many people in Japan say words like 'konnichiwa' to say hello. You might see it in cartoons or on food boxes with pretty letters.
Japanese art\n\nJapanese art is making pretty things in Japan. It can be a picture, a statue, or a folded paper. Some art is very old, like pots made from clay. Other art is new, like colorful comics and cartoons. You can see it in a book or on a wall. People use a brush and black ink to paint soft lines. They also fold paper into shapes like a bird or a flower. That is called origami.
Japanese food\n\nJapanese food is the food people eat in Japan. It uses many things from the sea, like fish and seaweed. It also uses rice, noodles, and a white soft block called tofu made from beans. A green spicy paste called wasabi adds a hot taste. Some food is cut into thin raw slices and dipped in a dark salty sauce. You may see it in a restaurant with small bowls and chopsticks.
Japanese language\n\nJapanese is a language people speak in Japan. It uses three kinds of writing: hiragana, katakana, and kanji. Hiragana and katakana are like an alphabet, each shape makes a sound. Kanji are shapes that show a whole word. You can see it in books, signs, and cartoons from Japan. People use it to talk, write, and tell stories. In Japanese, the action word comes at the end of a sentence. Many words come from other languages, like English. For example, 'aisukurimu' means ice cream.
Japanese literature\n\nJapanese literature is stories and poems written in the Japanese language. Long ago, it looked a lot like Chinese writing because the two countries shared ideas. Over time, it grew into its own special style. In one old time called the Heian period, many women wrote beautiful stories. One famous story is about a prince named Genji. Today, people all over the world read Japanese books and poems.
Japanese mythology\n\nJapanese mythology is a set of old stories from Japan. It tells about gods and spirits called kami. Many of these stories come from very old books. One story tells about a sun goddess named Amaterasu. People say the first emperor of Japan came from her family. These stories are part of the Shinto and Buddhist ways of thinking.
Japanese writing system\n\nThe Japanese writing system is how people write words in Japan. It has three parts: hiragana, katakana, and kanji. Hiragana is for everyday Japanese words. It looks like soft, curvy lines. Katakana is for words from other countries. It looks like sharp, straight lines. Kanji are picture-like marks that came from China a long time ago. Each kanji stands for a whole word. You can see all three on signs, in books, and on TV in Japan.
Jar\n\nA jar is a round container with a wide opening at the top. It is usually made of glass or hard plastic. You can find it in the kitchen, where it holds food like jam, pickles, or cookies. It has a lid that you twist to open and close. People use it to keep things fresh and safe. A jar can also be used to store small toys or shiny coins.
Jason\n\nJason is a hero from very old Greek stories. He was the leader of a big boat called the Argo. The people who helped him sail were called the Argonauts. They went on a long trip to find a special golden sheep's wool. Jason fell in love with a girl named Medea. She helped him get the golden wool. Later, they went to live in a city called Corinth. You can see his story in some old movies.
Java\n\nJava is a big island in the country of Indonesia. It has many tall mountains that can spit fire and hot rocks. Many, many people live there, more than on any other island in the world. The ground is very good for growing food like rice. The biggest city in Indonesia is on this island, and it is called Jakarta.
Javelin\n\nA javelin is a long, thin stick that people throw far. It is light and has a pointy end. You see it in big sports games where a person runs fast and lets it fly through the air. The person who throws it the farthest wins. It is a very old sport, played a long, long time ago and still played today.
Jaw\n\nA jaw is a body part that helps an animal grab and chew food. In people, it is made of two bones in the mouth. It moves up and down so teeth can bite and grind. You can feel your own jaw when you open and close your mouth. Some animals, like bugs, have jaws that open side to side. A fish called a moray eel even has two sets of jaws. A jaw is named for what it does, not what it is made of.
Jazz\n\nJazz is a kind of music that people play together. It often uses a saxophone, a trumpet, a piano, a guitar, a big bass, and drums. In jazz, one person can make up new sounds while the others keep the beat. This is called making it up on the spot. The music has a bouncy feel that makes you want to tap your foot. You might hear it at a concert or on the radio. Some songs are fast and happy, and some are slow and soft. Jazz started a long time ago in America and now people all over the world enjoy it.
Jazz dance\n\nJazz dance is a kind of dancing that is fun to watch and do. It has quick steps, big jumps, and turns. You can see it on a stage in a show. People move their whole body to music with a happy beat. Sometimes they wear shiny clothes and hats. A dancer might kick high or spin around fast. Many kids learn jazz dance in a class after school.
Jealousy\n\nJealousy is a feeling you get when you want something that another person has. It can make you feel sad or angry inside. You might feel it when a friend gets a new toy and you do not have one. It is a normal feeling, but it does not feel good. When you feel it, you can talk to a grown-up about it.
Jean\n\nA jean is a kind of pants. It is made from thick, blue cloth. Many people wear it every day to play, go to school, or go outside. It has two legs, a button at the top, and small pockets to put things in. You can see jeans in stores and on people walking down the street.
Jeans\n\nJeans are pants made from strong blue cloth. They have two legs, a zipper or buttons in front, and pockets. You can find them in almost every closet because many people wear them every day. People put them on to play, go to school, or work outside. A common pair is blue, but you can also see black or light ones.
Jeju Island\n\nJeju Island is a big piece of land with water all around it. It has a tall mountain called Hallasan that used to be a fire mountain. The island is made of dark rock from old fire mountains. Many people go there after they get married because it is pretty. You can see the blue sea and green trees all around.
Jellyfish\n\nA jellyfish is a soft animal that lives in the ocean. It has a body like a bell and long, thin arms that hang down. These arms can sting, so you should not touch it. It floats in the water and moves with the waves. Some jellyfish are tiny, and some are very big. You might see one at the beach or in a big tank at the aquarium.
Jerusalem\n\nJerusalem is a very old city. It sits on hills with valleys all around. You can see old stone walls and a big gold dome that shines in the sun. Many people go there to pray because it is a special place for three big religions. People live and work there today, and you can find busy streets next to quiet old buildings.
Jesus\n\nJesus is a very special person from long ago. He lived in a place far away, in a small town. He was a teacher who told people to be kind and to love one another. He helped sick people feel better and did amazing things like sharing food with many hungry friends. People remember him at Christmas, when they give gifts and sing happy songs. Many people around the world still follow his words today.
Jet\n\nA jet is a big flying machine. It has two long wings, a tall tail, and round engines under the wings. You see it high in the sky, leaving a white line behind. It carries people far away, faster than a car or a train. Sometimes you hear a loud roar when it flies over your house.
Jet aircraft\n\nA jet aircraft is a big flying machine with special engines. It has long wings and a long body. You see it at big airports when you go on a trip. It flies very high in the sky, much higher than birds. It goes very fast and can take many people far away. When it takes off, it makes a loud roaring sound.
Jet engine\n\nA jet engine is a machine that pushes things forward very fast. It has a big fan at the front that pulls in air. Inside, it burns special fuel to make the air very hot and big. Then it blows the hot air out the back with a strong push. This push makes an airplane zoom through the sky. You can see jet engines under the wings of big planes at the airport.
Jet stream\n\nA jet stream is a fast wind that blows high up in the sky. It moves like a long, thin river of air. You cannot see it, but it is always there above the clouds. It helps push big storms and cold or warm air around the world. Pilots use it to make planes go faster when they fly east.
Jewel\n\nA jewel is a pretty, shiny stone. It comes from deep under the ground. People find it in a rough, dull shape. Then they cut it and rub it until it sparkles. It can be many colors, like red, blue, green, or clear. People wear jewels on rings, necklaces, and bracelets. A jewel is very hard and does not break easily. Because it is hard to find, it is very special.
Jewellery\n\nJewellery is a pretty thing you wear on your body. It can be a ring on your finger, a chain around your neck, or a small piece in your ear. People make it from shiny metal, bright stones, wood, or even animal teeth long ago. It does not have a job like a coat or shoes—it just looks nice. You might see a grown-up wear a gold ring or a colorful bead bracelet. Some jewellery is very special and kept for big days.
Jigsaw puzzle\n\nA jigsaw puzzle is a game with many small pieces. Each piece has a little bump or a hole on its side. You put the pieces together to make one big picture. It can be a picture of a cat, a house, or a forest. Some puzzles have only a few big pieces for little hands. Other puzzles have many tiny pieces and take a long time to finish. You can find it at home, in a toy store, or at school. When all the pieces fit, you feel happy and proud.
Job\n\nA job is work that a person does to help others and get money. It can be something you do at home, like washing dishes or fixing a broken toy. Many grown-ups have a job outside the house. A teacher has a job helping children learn. A firefighter has a job keeping people safe from fires. When someone does a job, they get money to buy food, clothes, and toys. Some jobs need special skills, like driving a bus or taking care of sick people. Every job is important because it helps the world go round.
Johannes Gutenberg\n\nJohannes Gutenberg was a man who lived a long time ago. He made a machine that could print many copies of a book very fast. Before his machine, people had to write every book by hand, which took a very long time. His printing machine used small metal letters that could be moved around to make words. It helped more people learn to read because books became cheaper. One of the first big books he printed was the Bible.
Johannesburg\n\nJohannesburg is a big city in South Africa. It has very tall buildings, like a big tower and a tall office block. People call it the city of gold because there is gold under the ground. You can see polar bears at the zoo there. It is a busy place where people work and trade.
John\n\nJohn is a name for a boy or a man. It is a short name with four letters. You might know a friend, a dad, or a grandpa named John. Many people all over the world have this name. It is easy to say and easy to write.
John Locke\n\nJohn Locke was a man who lived a long time ago. He thought a lot about how people should be treated. He said every person is born with the right to be free and safe. He also said people learn by seeing and touching things, not just by being told. His ideas helped make rules that are fair for everyone.
Join\n\nJoin means to put things together. When you join hands with a friend, you hold hands. You can join two pieces of paper with glue or tape. At a party, you join a group of kids to play a game. When you join a line, you stand at the back and wait your turn.
Joint\n\nA joint is a place where two or more bones meet inside your body. It helps your body bend and move. Some joints let you swing your arms, and some let you turn your head. Inside a joint, there is a soft, smooth cover on the ends of the bones so they do not rub too hard. There is also a tiny bag of slippery liquid that works like a pillow, making the movement easy and smooth. You can feel a joint when you bend your knee or your elbow.
Joke\n\nA joke is a short story or a question that makes people laugh. It has a funny ending that surprises you. You can hear jokes from friends, read them in books, or see them on TV. Some jokes are silly and make everyone smile. But a joke can also hurt someone's feelings if it is mean. It is best to tell jokes that are kind and fun for all.
Jordan\n\nJordan is a country in a hot, dry part of the world. It has mountains in the north and south, and a big salty lake called the Dead Sea. Many people live in the capital city, Amman. The king helps lead the country. People there speak Arabic and like to eat a special rice and meat dish. They also love to play soccer.
Jordan River\n\nThe Jordan River is a long, winding river in a hot, dry part of the world. It flows from tall mountains down to a big, salty lake called the Dead Sea. The water is very important because people use it for drinking and growing food. Many years ago, people wrote about this river in a special old book. They said it was a place of hope and new beginnings. Today, the river is much smaller than it used to be because people take a lot of water from it.
Journalism\n\nJournalism is a kind of writing that tells people what is happening in the world. It shares news through newspapers, TV, radio, and magazines. People who do this job are called journalists. A journalist finds out facts, writes stories, and takes pictures to show others. You might see it when Mom or Dad reads the news on a phone or watches it on TV.
Journey\n\nA journey is a long trip from one place to another. It can be in a car, on a train, in a plane, or even on your own two feet. You might go on a journey to see a new city, visit family, or explore a forest. Along the way, you see new things and maybe stop for a snack. A journey takes more time than a quick ride to the store. It can feel like a big adventure.
Journey to the West\n\nJourney to the West is a very old story from China. It is a book about a monkey named Sun Wukong. He is strong and can do magic. He goes on a long trip with a monk and two friends. They fight bad guys and have big adventures. Many people in Asia know this story. In English, it is sometimes called Monkey.
Joy\n\nJoy is a happy feeling you get inside. It makes you smile, laugh, and want to jump up and down. You feel it when something good happens, like getting a hug or eating ice cream. It can come from playing with a friend or seeing a rainbow. Joy makes your heart feel light and warm.
Judaism\n\nJudaism is a very old way of believing in one God. It started long, long ago in a place far away. People who follow it are called Jews. They have a special book called the Torah that tells them how to be kind and fair. Jews go to a big building called a synagogue to pray and learn together. They light candles on a special day called Shabbat to rest and be with family. Many Jews also eat flat bread called matzah during a holiday in spring.
Judge\n\nA judge is a person who helps people solve fights in a special room called a court. He wears a long black robe, like a cape. You can find him in a big building with many chairs and a high desk. He listens to what each person says and then makes a fair choice. Sometimes he works with a group of people called a jury who help decide. A judge makes sure everyone follows the rules.
Judiciary\n\nThe judiciary is a group of people who help solve fights about rules. They work in a big building called a court. Inside, a judge sits at a tall desk and wears a black robe. When two people do not agree, they go to the court. The judge listens to both sides and then says what the rule means. This helps everyone follow the same rules. In some places, there is a very important court at the top that makes the final choice.
Judo\n\nJudo is a sport where two people try to throw each other down. It comes from Japan and is now played all over the world. Both boys and girls can do judo. They wear a thick jacket and pants, and they play with no shoes on. One person tries to grab the other and pull or push them onto the floor. When someone falls, the other person gets a point. The person with the most points wins. You can see judo in big games like the Olympics.
Juice\n\nJuice is a drink made from fruit. It comes in many colors, like orange, red, or yellow. You can buy it in a bottle at the store. People make it by squeezing the fruit until the liquid comes out. Orange juice is a kind many kids drink at breakfast. It tastes sweet and is good for your body.
Juicy\n\nJuicy means something has a lot of juice inside. It is wet and tasty when you bite it. You can find juicy things in the kitchen, like oranges, watermelons, and grapes. When you eat a juicy fruit, the sweet water runs down your chin. A juicy apple makes a crunchy sound when you take a bite.
Jujutsu\n\nJujutsu is a very old way of fighting from Japan. It uses the body without big swords or sticks. A person throws, grabs, and holds another person to stop them. Long ago, fighters called samurai used it when they had no sword. Today, people learn it as a sport to get strong and quick.
Julius Caesar\n\nJulius Caesar was a leader from a long, long time ago. He lived in a place called Rome. He was a strong soldier and a good talker. People followed him because he was brave. He helped make Rome bigger and stronger. Some people did not like him, and he got hurt. His name is still known today.
July\n\nJuly is a month in the middle of the year. It comes after June and before August. It is one of the warmest months, so many people go swimming or eat ice cream. In July, the days are long and sunny. Some families go on trips or have a picnic outside. You might see fireworks in the sky on the Fourth of July.
Jump\n\nA jump is when you push your body up off the ground. It happens when you bend your legs and then spring up fast. You can jump on a bed, on a trampoline, or on the floor. It makes you feel light for a tiny moment. Many animals jump too, like a frog or a bunny. Kids love to jump in puddles after rain.
Jumper\n\nA jumper is a piece of clothing you wear on the top half of your body. It is made of soft, warm fabric like wool or cotton. You put it on by pulling it over your head. It keeps you cozy when the weather is cold. Some jumpers have long sleeves, and some have no sleeves. You might wear a jumper to school or when you play outside on a chilly day.
Jumping\n\nJumping is when you push your body up off the ground and then come back down. It makes you fly in the air for a little bit. You can jump up high or jump far ahead. Many animals jump too. A frog jumps to get away from danger. A kangaroo jumps to move from place to place. People jump in games and sports, like hopping over a rope or jumping into a big sand pit. It is a fun way to move your body.
June\n\nJune is a month in the middle of the year. It comes after May and before July. In many places, the weather is warm and sunny. Flowers are big and bright, and trees have green leaves. School often ends in June, so children can play outside all day. Some families go to the beach or have a picnic. It is a happy time when summer begins.
Jungle\n\nA jungle is a hot, wet place with many, many trees and plants. It is so thick that it is hard to walk inside. It has big rivers and small streams running through it. Many animals live in a jungle, like bright birds, loud monkeys, and long snakes. Some snakes are very big and can be dangerous. The biggest jungle on Earth is the Amazon. It is in a country called Brazil. People can find food in a jungle, but they must be careful because the ground is full of roots and leaves.
Juniper\n\nJuniper is a plant that stays green all year. It can be a small bush or a tall tree. It has thin, pointy leaves that look like needles. It grows in many places where it is not too hot. Some junipers make little round seed balls that look like berries. People use these berries to add a nice smell and taste to food. But some berries are not safe to eat, so you should never pick them without a grown-up.
Junk\n\nJunk is stuff that people do not want anymore. It can be old toys, broken chairs, or empty boxes. You might see it in a big pile on the side of the road or in a special bin outside. People throw junk away because it is broken or they do not need it. Sometimes, people take old junk and make it into something new and fun.
Jupiter\n\nJupiter is a very big ball of gas in the sky. It is the biggest planet that goes around our Sun. It looks like a round ball with stripes of white, brown, and orange. You can see a big red spot on it, which is a giant storm that has been there for a very long time. Jupiter is far away from Earth, so you need a telescope to see it clearly. It has many moons that go around it, like little friends. Jupiter is made mostly of gas, so you cannot stand on it like you stand on the ground.
Jupiter (mythology)\n\nJupiter is the king of the gods in old Roman stories. He is the god of the sky and thunder. He has two brothers named Pluto and Neptune. Jupiter lives high up in the sky and rules over the clouds and storms. People long ago told stories about him and drew pictures of him with a big beard and a lightning bolt in his hand.
Jurassic\n\nThe Jurassic is a very old time in Earth's story. It was a time when the world was hot and wet. Big animals called dinosaurs walked on the land. Some dinosaurs had long necks and ate leaves from tall trees. Others had sharp teeth and ate meat. The sea had big swimming animals too. You can see dinosaur bones in a museum. That is how we know about the Jurassic.
Jury\n\nA jury is a group of people who help a judge in a court. They listen to a story about someone who may have broken a rule. Then they talk together and decide if the person did it or not. All of them must agree on the answer. If they cannot agree, the judge may ask a new group to try. A person in a jury is called a juror. A juror must be fair and listen to both sides. Some people, like doctors, can say no to being on a jury. In some places, a jury has twelve people.
Just\n\nJust means something is fair or right. It is when people are treated in a good way. For example, when you share your toys with a friend, that is just. It is the opposite of being mean or unfair.
Justice\n\nJustice is when things are fair for everyone. It means people get what they need and no one is left out. You see it when a grown-up makes sure all kids get the same number of cookies. It also happens when a teacher listens to both sides of a fight before deciding who is right. At home, it is fair when you and your brother both get a turn with a toy.
K2\n\nK2 is a very tall mountain. It is the second-highest mountain in the whole world. It has snow and ice on top all year. It is on the line between two big lands, Pakistan and China. Many people try to climb it, but it is very hard and can be scary. The wind is strong and the air is thin up high. Some people call it the Savage Mountain because it is so wild. Only a few brave climbers make it to the very top.
Kaaba\n\nThe Kaaba is a very special building for people who follow Islam. It is a big box made of dark stone, and it sits in a city called Mecca. It has a black cloth cover with gold writing on it. The cover is changed for a new one every year. Muslims all over the world turn toward the Kaaba when they pray. Many people visit it on a big trip called Hajj.
Kabaddi\n\nKabaddi is a fun game that two teams play. It comes from a country called India. The teams take turns sending one player to the other side. That player must hold their breath and say "Kabaddi, Kabaddi" over and over. They try to touch someone and run back fast. If they make it back, their team gets a point. The other team tries to stop them. The team with the most points wins.
Kabuki\n\nKabuki is a kind of play from Japan. It started a long, long time ago. In it, actors wear bright, painted faces and move in big, slow ways. The stage can turn around, and there is a long path where actors walk through the crowd. Men play all the parts, even the girls. It tells stories about brave fighters, old times, and town life. People all over the world now come to watch it.
Kalahari Desert\n\nThe Kalahari Desert is a big, dry place with lots of sand. It is in the south part of Africa. It covers parts of three countries: Botswana, Namibia, and South Africa. It is not a true desert because some rain falls there. After rain, green grass grows and animals come to eat. You can find lions, giraffes, meerkats, and many birds there. Some people called the Bushmen used to live there long ago. They moved from place to place to find food and water.
Kale\n\nKale is a leafy green vegetable. It has big, curly leaves that can be dark green or a little purple. You find it in the garden or at the grocery store. People cook it in soups or bake it into crunchy chips. It is full of good things that help you grow strong.
Kali\n\nKali is a goddess from Hindu stories. She is often shown with dark blue or black skin and many arms. In pictures, she may wear a necklace of heads and hold a sword. People pray to her for strength and protection. She is very powerful and can stop bad things.
Kamchatka Peninsula\n\nKamchatka Peninsula is a big piece of land in Russia. It sticks out into the ocean. It has many tall mountains that can shoot out hot, red fire and smoke. These are called volcanoes. Some of them are covered in snow at the top. The land is far away, where it is cold and wild. Bears, big fish, and birds live there. People visit to see the volcanoes and the hot water that bubbles up from the ground.
Kangaroo\n\nA kangaroo is a big animal that hops. It has strong back legs, a long thick tail, and a pouch on its belly. Kangaroos live in Australia and nearby islands. They eat grass and plants. A baby kangaroo is called a joey. It stays safe inside its mother's pouch. Kangaroos live in big groups. They can jump very far and fast.
Karachi\n\nKarachi is a very big city in the country of Pakistan. It is next to the sea and has a big port where ships come and go. Many people live there, more than in any other city in Pakistan. It has tall buildings, busy streets, and a big airport for planes. You can find long sandy beaches where families play. It also has a big stadium where people watch cricket games. Long ago, a very important man who helped start Pakistan was born there.
Karakoram\n\nKarakoram is a big group of tall mountains in Asia. It has many high tops covered with snow and ice. You can find it in countries like China, India, and Pakistan. It is the second highest mountain group in the world. Some of its peaks are so high that people need special gear to climb them. The mountains have huge rivers of ice called glaciers that move very slowly. These glaciers are some of the biggest outside the cold North and South Poles. Long ago, traders used paths through these mountains to travel between lands.
Karaoke\n\nKaraoke is a fun way to sing songs with music that has no voice. It started in Japan a long time ago. You stand in front of a screen that shows the words, and you sing along. The music plays, but the singer's voice is missing, so you get to be the star. Many people do karaoke at parties or in special rooms with friends. It makes everyone laugh and clap.
Karate\n\nKarate is a way of fighting without any toys. It comes from a place called Japan. People use their hands, feet, elbows, and knees to hit and block. They wear a white jacket and white pants called a Gi. A colored belt shows how long they have trained. Many kids and grown-ups learn it to get strong and to be safe.
Karl Marx\n\nKarl Marx was a man who lived a long time ago. He thought a lot about how people work and share money. He wrote big books with his ideas. Some people liked his ideas and tried to change how countries work. He had a big beard and looked very serious in pictures.
Karma\n\nKarma is like a big rule about what you do. It says that when you do something nice, nice things come back to you. When you do something mean, mean things come back to you. It is like a boomerang that always comes back. People in some lands think about karma a lot. They try to be kind so good things happen. It helps them learn to be better people.
Katana\n\nA katana is a long, curved sword from Japan. It has a shiny, sharp blade with one cutting side and a pointy tip. Long ago, only special fighters called samurai carried it. They wore it on their left side, tucked into a belt, with the blade facing up. A katana is used for cutting and sometimes for stabbing. Today, people practice with it in sports like kendo, using safe bamboo swords.
Kathmandu\n\nKathmandu is a big city in a country called Nepal. It is the most important city there. It has many old buildings, temples, and palaces. The weather changes with the seasons. In winter it is cool and dry. In summer it gets warm and rain falls a lot. Many people live there. Some people go there to sit quietly and think. It is a busy place full of color and life.
Kayak\n\nA kayak is a small, narrow boat. It has a covered top with a hole where one person sits. You use a long stick with flat ends, called a paddle, to push the water and move it. People ride it on lakes, rivers, and the ocean. It is quiet and can go into small spaces. Some people race in kayaks, and others use them to see fish and birds up close.
Kazakhstan\n\nKazakhstan is a big country far away. It is a place with no ocean next to it. It has wide, flat lands and big, empty spaces. Long ago, people there moved around with horses and sheep. Today, people live in cities and towns. One big city is called Astana. It is very cold in winter and warm in summer. Some people there speak Kazakh, and some speak Russian. They eat bread and meat, and they drink tea. A long time ago, rockets flew into space from a place in Kazakhstan.
Kaziranga National Park\n\nKaziranga National Park is a big, safe home for wild animals in India. It has tall grass, trees, rivers, and small lakes. Many animals live there, like the one-horned rhino, tigers, elephants, and big birds. The park is very special because it keeps rare animals safe. When it rains a lot, the rivers grow and cover parts of the park with water. The animals move to higher ground to stay dry. People from all over the world come to see the animals.
Keep\n\nKeep is a word that means to hold on to something and not let it go. When you keep a toy, you put it in your room and do not throw it away. You can keep a secret, which means you do not tell anyone. A mom might keep cookies in a jar so they stay fresh. When you keep trying, you do not stop even if it is hard.
Keeper\n\nA keeper is a person who takes care of something. He watches over it and keeps it safe. You can find a keeper at a zoo, where he feeds the animals and cleans their homes. He also works at a park, making sure the grass is cut and the paths are clean. A keeper at a museum protects old things so people can see them. He has a big job because he helps things stay nice for everyone.
Kelp\n\nKelp is a kind of plant that lives in the sea. It is brown and looks like a long, wavy ribbon. It grows in big groups under the water, like a forest. It has little air bags that help it float up toward the light. Many fish and sea animals live and hide in it. People can eat it as a sea vegetable. You can see it in big fish tanks at some aquariums.
Kennedy Space Center\n\nThe Kennedy Space Center is a big place in Florida where rockets go up into the sky. It has tall buildings to put rockets together and long roads for them to land. People work there to send astronauts and machines to space. You can visit it and see real rockets and learn about the Moon and stars.
Kenya\n\nKenya is a country in Africa. It has hot, dry plains called savannas where many wild animals live. You can find lions, elephants, and giraffes there. People visit Kenya to see these animals in big parks. It also has a tall mountain and a big lake. Many people in Kenya speak English and Swahili.
