Kerosene\n\nKerosene is a clear liquid that burns easily. It looks like water but smells strong. People use it to make light in lamps when they go camping. It also gives heat in some stoves and heaters. Big planes use a special kind of kerosene to fly in the sky. You might see a kerosene lamp at a campfire or in a story about old times.
Ketchup\n\nKetchup is a thick, red sauce made from tomatoes. It tastes a little sweet and a little sour. People squeeze it from a bottle or open a small packet. Many kids like to dip french fries, hot dogs, or burgers into it. It can also be called tomato sauce. You often see it on the table at a picnic or in a fast-food restaurant.
Key\n\nA key is a small metal tool. It has a long flat part and a round or square top. You put it into a lock to open a door. People use keys to get into their house or car. A key can be shiny silver or gold. You might see one hanging on a hook by the front door.
Keyboard\n\nA keyboard is a flat board with many small buttons called keys. It has letters, numbers, and other signs on the keys. You find it on a computer, a tablet, or a phone. When you press a key, it makes a letter show up on the screen. It helps you write words, play games, and tell the computer what to do. Some keyboards have a wire, and some work without one.
Keyboard (computer)\n\nA keyboard is a flat board with many small buttons called keys. It has letters, numbers, and other signs on the keys. You find it in front of a computer or laptop. When you press a key, it sends a signal to the computer, and the letter shows up on the screen. You use it to type words, play games, or tell the computer what to do. Some keyboards have a wire, and some work without one. The keys are usually in a pattern called QWERTY, named after the first six letters on the top row.
Keyboard instrument\n\nA keyboard instrument is a music tool that you play by pressing keys. It has a row of long keys, often white, and shorter keys, often black, that sit higher up. You can find it in many places like a school music room, a church, or on a stage. When you press a key, it makes a sound. Some keyboard instruments use strings inside, and some use electricity to make the sound. A piano is one kind of keyboard instrument that many people know.
Kharkiv\n\nKharkiv is a big city in the country of Ukraine. It has many houses, streets, and tall buildings. It sits in the east part of the country. Many people live there and work in shops, schools, and factories. Long ago, it was a small town, but it grew bigger over many years. Today, it is one of the biggest cities in Ukraine. Some children ride a train under the ground to go to school.
Khartoum\n\nKhartoum is a big city in a country called Sudan. It sits where two rivers, the Blue Nile and the White Nile, meet and become one big river. The weather there is very hot and dry for most of the year. Many people live in Khartoum, and some came from far away to be safe. It is one of the hottest big cities in the world.
Kick\n\nA kick is when you push something hard with your foot. It can be a fast, strong push. You see a kick when someone plays soccer and hits the ball with their foot. You can also kick a ball in the park or in your yard. Sometimes people kick to move things out of the way. A kick can be big and strong or small and soft.
Kickboxing\n\nKickboxing is a sport where people use their hands and feet to hit. It looks a little like boxing, but you can also kick. People do it to stay strong and healthy, or to fight in a ring. In a match, two people wear big soft gloves and try to hit each other above the belt. They also wear a mouth guard to keep their teeth safe. You might see it on TV or at a gym.
Kid\n\nA kid is a young person, like you. It is smaller than a grown-up and is still learning many things. You can find kids at home, at school, or at the playground. A kid likes to play, run, and ask lots of questions. You are a kid, and so are your friends.
Kidney\n\nA kidney is a part inside your body that helps clean your blood. It is shaped like a bean, and you have two of them. They sit in your belly, one on each side. They take out extra water and waste and turn it into pee. When you drink a lot, they make more pee. When you drink a little, they make less pee. They also send out helpers that keep your body steady. If they get very sick, a doctor can help with a machine or give a new kidney from another person.
Killer whale\n\nA killer whale is a big black-and-white animal that lives in the ocean. It has a round head, a long body, and a tall fin on its back. It is not a fish—it breathes air like you. It lives in all the oceans, from cold places to warm places. It swims very fast and jumps out of the water. It hunts with its family group called a pod. Together they catch fish, seals, and even sharks. Sometimes people see it at big water parks doing jumps and splashes.
Kilogram\n\nA kilogram is a way to tell how heavy something is. It is a number that helps us know how much stuff is inside a thing. You can find it on a food box or when you step on a scale. People use it to weigh fruit, like a big bag of apples. One kilogram is about as heavy as a full bottle of water.
Kin\n\nKin means the people in your family. It is your mom, dad, brother, sister, grandma, and grandpa. They are the ones who love you and take care of you. You live with some of your kin in your house. Other kin may live in a different house, but you see them on special days like a birthday or a holiday. They are all connected to you, like branches on a big family tree.
Kind\n\nKind means you are nice to others. It is when you share your toy or say a soft word. You can be kind at home, at school, or at the park. When you help a friend who fell down, that is kind. A smile or a hug can show you are kind too.
Kindness\n\nKindness is when you do something nice for someone. It can be a big help or a small smile. You can show kindness by sharing a toy, giving a hug, or saying a kind word. It makes the other person feel happy and warm inside. It also makes you feel good. You can find kindness at home, at school, or on the playground. When you see a friend fall down and you help them up, that is kindness.
Kinetic energy\n\nKinetic energy is the energy a thing has when it moves. It is like a secret power inside a rolling ball or a running dog. When a thing moves fast, it has more of this energy. When it stops, the energy goes away. You can see it when you push a toy car across the floor. The car moves because you gave it kinetic energy.
King\n\nA king is a man who is the leader of a whole country. He wears a shiny crown on his head and sits on a big chair called a throne. He lives in a large house called a castle or a palace. Long ago, a king told people what to do and made the rules. Today, some countries still have a king, but he often shares the job with other leaders. You might see a king in a storybook or a movie.
Kingdom\n\nA kingdom is a big piece of land with a king or a queen. It has towns, farms, and castles where people live. The king or queen makes the rules for everyone in the kingdom. Long ago, many kingdoms had knights in shiny armor and big stone walls. Today, some places still have kings and queens, like in a fairy tale.
Kingdom of England\n\nThe Kingdom of England was a country a long time ago. It was on a big island called Great Britain. It had a king or queen who ruled over the land. Long before, many small groups of people lived there. Later, they all came together under one ruler. After many years, it joined with another country called Scotland to make a bigger kingdom. Today, the land is still there, but the old kingdom is gone.
Kingston, Jamaica\n\nKingston is a big city on an island called Jamaica. It sits next to the sea, with a long strip of sand that keeps the water calm. Many people live there, and they speak English. It is the most important city in Jamaica, where the leaders work. You can see boats and ships in the water near the city.
Kinship\n\nKinship is the way people are connected in a family. It tells us who is our mom, dad, brother, sister, grandma, or grandpa. Some family ties come from being born into the same family. Other ties come when people get married or when a child is adopted. Every person in the world has some kind of kinship. It helps us know who we belong to and who takes care of us.
Kiribati\n\nKiribati is a small country made of many tiny islands. It sits in the big blue ocean near the middle of the world. The islands are flat and low, with sandy beaches and palm trees. People live in simple houses and fish in the sea. They also grow food like coconuts and sweet potatoes. The weather is warm and sunny all year. Many people go to church on Sundays. The water around Kiribati is rising, so the land is getting smaller.
Kiss\n\nA kiss is when you touch someone with your lips. It can be a quick peck on the cheek or a longer touch on the mouth. People kiss to show they care, like when a mom kisses a child goodnight. Friends may kiss on the cheek to say hello or goodbye. A kiss can also be part of a special day, like when a bride and groom kiss at a wedding. It makes people feel warm and happy inside.
Kit\n\nA kit is a box or bag that holds many things you need to do one job. It has small parts inside, like tools or toys. You can find a kit at home, at school, or in a store. People use a kit to build, fix, or make something. For example, a doctor has a kit with bandages and a light to check your ears. A craft kit has paper, glue, and stickers to make art.
Kitchen\n\nA kitchen is a room in a house where people make food. It has a stove to cook hot meals and a sink with water to wash hands and dishes. You can find a kitchen in almost every home, and also in schools and big buildings where people eat. In a kitchen, a grown-up uses pots and pans to boil, fry, or bake yummy things. Sometimes the whole family sits at a table in the kitchen to eat together. A kitchen often has a cold box called a fridge to keep milk and fruit fresh.
Kite\n\nA kite is a toy that flies in the sky. It has a light frame and a thin cover that catches the wind. You hold a long string to keep it from flying away. On a windy day, you can run and watch it go up high. Some kites look like birds or dragons. Many children fly kites at the park or the beach.
Kitten\n\nA kitten is a baby cat. It is very small and has soft, fluffy fur. You can find it in a warm box or basket with its mommy cat. It drinks milk and sleeps a lot when it is tiny. A kitten likes to play with balls of yarn and chase little toys. It makes a tiny meow sound. When it grows up, it becomes a big cat.
Kiwi\n\nA kiwi is a bird that cannot fly. It has a long, thin beak and brown feathers that look like soft fur. It lives in New Zealand, a country far away. It sleeps during the day and comes out at night to look for worms and bugs to eat. It makes a home in a hole in the ground, like a rabbit. A kiwi is a special bird that many people love.
Kiwifruit\n\nA kiwifruit is a small fruit that grows on a vine. It has a fuzzy brown skin that you can peel off. Inside, it is bright green with tiny black seeds that you can eat. It tastes sweet and a little bit sour. You can find it in the store next to other fruits. People eat it as a snack or put it in fruit salad. It is full of good things that help your body stay strong.
Knee\n\nA knee is the part in the middle of your leg. It lets you bend your leg so you can walk, run, and jump. It looks like a bump when your leg is straight. You can feel it with your hand right under your skin. When you fall down, your knee can get a scrape or a bruise.
Knife\n\nA knife is a tool with a sharp part that cuts things. It has a handle you hold and a flat metal part that is very sharp. You can find it in the kitchen, where grown-ups use it to cut food like bread, fruit, and meat. Some people carry a small one in their pocket when they go camping. It helps cut rope or make a stick pointy. You should never touch it without a grown-up because it can hurt you.
Knight\n\nA knight is a person who was a brave fighter long ago. He wore a shiny metal suit and a helmet to stay safe. He rode a big horse and carried a sword and a shield. Knights lived in castles and helped keep people safe. Today, a king or queen can still make someone a knight as a special thank-you. That person gets a tap on the shoulder with a sword and is called 'Sir.'
Knitting\n\nKnitting is a way to make soft cloth from long strings called yarn. It uses two long, pointy sticks called needles. You loop the yarn around the needles over and over. This makes rows of little loops that hold together. People knit to make warm things like hats, scarves, and blankets. A sweater is often made by knitting. Some people knit just for fun while they sit and watch TV.
Knob\n\nA knob is a small round thing you turn with your hand. It is often on a door, a drawer, or a stove. When you turn it, something opens, closes, or changes. For example, a door knob lets you open a door. A stove knob makes the fire bigger or smaller. It is easy to hold because it is round and fits in your hand.
Knock\n\nA knock is a sound you make when you hit a door with your hand. It goes tap-tap-tap. People do it to let someone inside know they are waiting. You can also knock on a table or a wall to get a friend's attention. It is a quick, short noise that says, "Hello, I am here!"
Knot\n\nA knot is a way to tie something so it stays in a loop. It is made by twisting and pulling a string, rope, or even hair. You can find knots on your shoes when you tie the laces. It holds things together so they do not come apart. A knot on a balloon keeps the air inside. People also tie pretty knots on gifts with ribbons. Sailors use strong knots on boats to keep ropes in place.
Know\n\nTo know something means you have it in your head. When you know a color, you can point to it. When you know a song, you can sing it. You know your own name and the names of your family. You learn new things every day, and then you know them too.
Knowledge\n\nKnowledge is all the things you know and can do. It lives inside your head, like a big box of ideas. You get it when you look, listen, try, or ask someone. Some knowledge is about facts, like the sky is blue. Some is about doing things, like tying your shoes. You use it every day when you play, talk, or eat. A teacher helps you grow your knowledge at school.
Knuckle\n\nA knuckle is the bumpy part where your finger bends. It helps your finger move and grab things. You can see it when you make a fist. It looks like a little hill on the back of your hand. When you knock on a door, you use your knuckles.
Koala\n\nA koala is a small, furry animal that lives in Australia. It has soft gray fur, a big dark nose, and sharp claws for climbing. It lives high up in trees and eats leaves from a special tree called eucalyptus. It sleeps for many hours every day because its food gives it very little energy. A baby koala is tiny and stays in its mother's pouch until it grows bigger. It is not a bear, even though some people call it a koala bear.
Kohlrabi\n\nKohlrabi is a round vegetable that grows above the ground. It has a thick, light green or purple skin. Inside, it is white and crunchy. You can eat it raw like an apple, or you can cook it in soup. It tastes a little like a cabbage stem. People in some countries like to put it in salads or stir it in a pan. The leaves on top are also good to eat.
Koi\n\nA koi is a big, pretty fish that people keep in outdoor ponds. It has shiny scales and comes in many colors like white, black, red, yellow, and blue. People like to watch it swim in garden ponds because it looks bright and calm. It is a kind of carp, which is a fish that lives in fresh water. Some places do not let people keep it because it can hurt other fish.
Kolkata\n\nKolkata is a big city in India. It sits next to a wide river. Many people live there, and the streets are busy with cars, buses, and yellow taxis. Long ago, kings and British rulers made it their home, so you can see old, pretty buildings. Today, people work in shops and offices. Children play in parks and fly kites from rooftops.
Komodo dragon\n\nA Komodo dragon is the biggest lizard in the world. It has a long body, a tail as long as its body, and about 60 sharp teeth. Its skin can be blue, orange, green, gray, or brown. It lives on a few hot, dry islands in Indonesia. It eats meat, like dead animals, goats, and deer. It can run fast and climb trees when it is young. It digs big holes to sleep in at night.
Korea\n\nKorea is a long piece of land that sticks out into the sea. It is in the east part of Asia. Today, it is split into two countries: North Korea and South Korea. Many people live in big cities there, like Seoul. People in Korea speak the Korean language. They eat rice, soup, and a spicy food called kimchi. Long ago, kings and queens lived in big houses with curved roofs. Now, South Korea makes cars, phones, and fun TV shows that kids around the world watch.
Korean language\n\nKorean is a language that people speak in two countries, South Korea and North Korea. It sounds different from English, with its own words and way of talking. Many people, more than 78 million, use it every day. It has its own writing called Hangul, which has shapes that stand for sounds. Long ago, people also used Chinese characters, but now most writing is in Hangul. If you see a book or a sign with round and straight lines that look like little boxes, it might be Korean.
Kosher\n\nKosher is a set of rules about food for Jewish people. It tells them which foods they can eat and which foods they cannot eat. One big rule is that meat and milk foods must stay apart. They cannot be on the same plate or in the same meal. Fish, fruit, and vegetables can go with either meat or milk. People who follow these rules have two sets of dishes and pots—one for meat and one for milk. They also wait some hours between eating meat and milk. Some animals are never okay to eat. The animals that are okay must be killed in a very careful way by a special helper.
Kosovo\n\nKosovo is a small country in Europe. It has mountains in the west and flat fields in the middle. Many people there speak Albanian. A long time ago, it was part of a bigger country, but now it wants to be on its own. Some other countries say it is a real country, but not all of them agree.
Krakatoa\n\nKrakatoa is a big mountain that can get very hot and explode. It sits in the water between two big pieces of land. A long time ago, it blew up with a boom so loud that people far, far away could hear it. The boom made a giant wave in the water that hurt many people. After it blew up, most of the mountain fell into the sea. Later, a new, smaller mountain grew in the same spot. Today, it still lets out smoke and fire sometimes.
Kremlin\n\nA kremlin is a big, strong fort in an old Russian city. It has tall walls and towers made of red brick. In Moscow, the biggest kremlin sits in the middle of the city. Long ago, people built it to keep safe from enemies. Today, the leader of Russia works inside it. You can see its pointy towers and a big clock on one tower in pictures.
Krill\n\nKrill is a tiny animal that lives in the ocean. It looks like a small shrimp and is about as long as your finger. It swims in big groups with many, many friends. Many big sea animals eat it, like whales, seals, and penguins. Some krill can make a little light in the dark water.
Krishna\n\nKrishna is a god that many people in India love. He is often shown with blue skin and a peacock feather in his hair. People tell stories about him in a big old book. He was a brave fighter and a kind teacher. In one story, he stopped a bad king from hurting his mom and dad. Many children hear about Krishna when their parents read them stories at night.
Krishna River\n\nThe Krishna River is a very long river in India. It flows through many places and gives water to farms. People use its water to grow food like rice and sugarcane. Smaller rivers join it along the way, like friends coming together. It is one of the biggest rivers in the south part of India.
Kuala Lumpur\n\nKuala Lumpur is a big city in a warm country called Malaysia. It has very tall buildings that touch the sky. Two of them stand side by side and look like shiny silver towers. It is hot there all year, and rain falls on many days. People in the city go to work, ride trains, and eat yummy food at busy street markets.
Kuiper belt\n\nThe Kuiper belt is a big ring of icy rocks far out in space. It is past the planet Neptune, very far from the Sun. It has many small, cold worlds that are round like balls. Some are even bigger than the rocks between Mars and Jupiter. Long ago, people found Pluto and its friend Charon there. Now we know there are many more of these icy rocks. They are so far away that the Sun looks like a tiny dot.
Kumquat\n\nA kumquat is a tiny fruit that looks like a small orange. It is yellow or orange and has a thin, sweet skin you can eat. It grows on a small tree with shiny green leaves and white flowers. The tree came from warm places far away, like China. People eat it whole, skin and all, as a snack or in sweet treats. You might see it in a store near other fruits.
Kurdish people\n\nKurdish people are a big group of people who live in a part of the world called Kurdistan. They have their own language, and many of them speak Kurdish. A long time ago, they moved from place to place with their animals, but now most of them live in cities and towns. They are mostly Muslim, but some follow other religions. Many Kurdish people live in Turkey, Iran, Iraq, and Syria.
Kuril Islands\n\nThe Kuril Islands are a long line of islands in the sea. They sit between Russia and Japan. Some of the islands belong to Russia, and some are wanted by Japan too. The islands have hills, trees, and water all around. People fish in the sea near them. It is a place where two big lands almost touch.
Kuwait\n\nKuwait is a small country in a hot, sandy part of the world. It has a flat, dry land with very little rain. Many people live in tall buildings in the city. Kuwait has a lot of oil under the ground. It sells this oil to other countries to make money. Long ago, another country came to fight, but now Kuwait is safe. People speak Arabic there, and many also speak English. Children go to school to learn and play.
Kuwait City\n\nKuwait City is a big city where many people live. It sits next to a big blue sea called the Persian Gulf. The weather is very hot in summer, and it does not rain much. Sometimes the wind blows sand and dust around. Important buildings for the whole country are there, like the place where leaders meet to make rules. A long time ago, the city got hurt in a war, but people fixed it up again.
Kyiv\n\nKyiv is a big city in the country of Ukraine. It has many tall buildings, wide streets, and a long river called the Dnipro running through it. Over three million people live there. It is the main city of Ukraine, where the leaders work. People go there to see old churches with gold tops and to watch big sports games. Once, a big singing show with people from many countries was held there.
Kyoto\n\nKyoto is a big city in Japan. It has many old wooden buildings with curved roofs. You find it on an island in Asia, with mountains around it. People go there to look at pink cherry flowers in spring and red leaves in fall. It is also a place where people eat food made from fresh green plants.
Kyrgyzstan\n\nKyrgyzstan is a country far away in the middle of Asia. It has no ocean next to it, only land all around. Most of the country is covered by tall, rocky mountains. The capital city is called Bishkek. People there speak Kyrgyz and Russian. Many people grow food like wheat and potatoes, and they also dig for gold and coal. A big, blue lake named Issyk-Kul sits high in the mountains. It is a very cold lake, but it never freezes.
La Paz\n\nLa Paz is a big city in the country of Bolivia. It sits very high up in the mountains, higher than many other cities in the world. The streets go up and down steep hills. Many people live there, and it is a place where leaders make rules for the country. You can see colorful houses and busy markets with fruits and bright cloth. The air is thin because it is so high, so it can feel hard to run and play.
Lab\n\nA lab is a special room where people do tests and learn new things. It has tables, bright lights, and tools like bottles and tubes. You can find a lab in a school, a hospital, or a big building. People in a lab mix things, look close with a big glass, and write down what they see. A doctor might use a lab to check if you are sick.
Label\n\nA label is a small piece of paper or plastic that tells you about a thing. It is often stuck on a box, a jar, or a shirt. It can have words, a picture, or a number. You see it on food to know what is inside. It also tells you how to wash a shirt or who made a toy. A label helps you find your name on your school bag.
Laboratory\n\nA laboratory is a special room where people do science. It has tables, bright lights, and tools like glass cups and tubes. You can find it in schools, hospitals, and big buildings. People use it to mix things, look at tiny bugs, and learn new things. A doctor might use it to check if you are sick.
Labrador Sea\n\nThe Labrador Sea is a big body of water. It sits between two large pieces of land called Labrador and Greenland. In winter, much of it is covered with ice. Many animals live in and around it, like seals, whales, and fish. People catch shrimp and fish there. On the land nearby, you can find bears, foxes, and birds.
Lace\n\nLace is a thin, soft cloth with pretty holes in it. It looks like a web of tiny flowers or shapes with open spaces. You can find it on fancy dresses, curtains, and sometimes on pillows. People use it to make clothes look extra special and pretty. A bride might wear a white dress with lace on her wedding day.
Lacrosse\n\nLacrosse is a game where two teams try to score goals. It uses a long stick with a small net on the end to catch and throw a ball. Players run on a big field and try to put the ball into the other team's goal. Each team has ten players who wear helmets and pads to stay safe. You can see lacrosse at parks or on TV when big kids and grown-ups play.
Ladder\n\nA ladder is a tool that helps people climb up or down. It has two long side pieces and many short steps in the middle. You put your feet on the steps and your hands on the sides. Some ladders lean against a wall, and some can stand by themselves like a big letter A. You might see a small ladder on a bunk bed or a big one on a fire truck. People use it to reach high places safely.
Ladle\n\nA ladle is a big spoon with a long handle. It has a deep, round bowl at the end. You find it in the kitchen, near the stove or in a drawer. People use it to scoop soup, stew, or punch from a big pot into a bowl or cup. It keeps your hands safe from the hot food.
Lady\n\nA lady is a grown-up girl. She is older than a child and can be a mom, a teacher, or a friend. You can see a lady at home, at the store, or at the park. She might wear a dress, have long hair, or carry a bag. A lady can read you a story, give you a hug, or help you tie your shoes.
Lady beetle\n\nA lady beetle is a tiny, round bug. It has a hard, shiny back that is often red with black spots. You can find it on leaves in gardens and parks. It eats small bugs called aphids that hurt plants. This helps farmers and flowers grow better. Some lady beetles are orange or yellow, and a few have no spots at all.
Ladybug\n\nA ladybug is a tiny, round bug. It has a red back with small black spots. You can find it in a garden on a leaf. It eats tiny bugs that hurt plants. A ladybug can fly with its little wings.
Lagoon\n\nA lagoon is a pool of salty water next to the big sea. It is like a quiet bath that the sea leaves behind. Sand, small rocks, or a wall of coral keeps it safe from the big waves. You can find it near a beach or around a warm island. The water in it is still and shallow, so little fish and crabs like to live there. Sometimes people swim or float in it because the water is calm and not too deep.
Lagos\n\nLagos is a big city in a country called Nigeria. It has many tall buildings, busy streets, and lots of people. You can find it near the water, where big boats come and go. Many people live there and work in shops, offices, and markets. It is a place where cars, buses, and motorbikes move all day long.
Lahore\n\nLahore is a big city in a country called Pakistan. It has many parks and gardens, so people call it the City of Gardens. It is very old, with big old buildings like a huge fort and a pretty mosque. Many people live there, and they like to eat tasty food on a busy street. It is a place where people learn in big schools and make art and movies.
Lake\n\nA lake is a big pool of water with land all around it. It is not the ocean, so the water does not taste salty. It does not move fast like a river, but small rivers can bring water in and out. Many lakes have fresh water that people can drink. Some lakes are made by people to hold water for homes and farms. You can find lakes in parks where families go to swim, fish, or watch ducks.
Lake Albert (Africa)\n\nLake Albert is a very big body of water in Africa. It is long and wide, and the water is deep. You can find it in the middle of Africa, between two countries called Uganda and Congo. Many rivers bring water into it, and one river takes water out to the north. People use boats on it to move things from one place to another. Long ago, big boats with steam engines carried people and goods across it. Today, there is also oil deep under the water that people want to use.
Lake Baikal\n\nLake Baikal is a very big lake in a cold part of Russia. It is the deepest lake on Earth and holds a lot of fresh water. The water is so clear you can see far down. It is home to many fish and a special kind of seal that lives only there. In winter, the top of the lake freezes into thick ice that people can walk on. Many rivers flow into it, but only one river flows out.
Lake Chad\n\nLake Chad is a big, wide lake in Africa. It sits on the edge of a hot, sandy desert. It gives water to many people in four countries around it. The lake can get much smaller when there is little rain. Long ago, old bones of early people were found in its dry mud.
Lake District\n\nThe Lake District is a big, pretty place in England. It has many lakes, which are big pools of water, and tall hills called mountains. People go there to walk, sail boats, and look at the green land. It is a special park where animals and trees are kept safe. Many families visit to play and rest.
Lake Erie\n\nLake Erie is a very big lake. It is one of five big lakes called the Great Lakes. It sits between the United States and Canada. Many rivers bring water into it, and the water then flows out past big cities. It is so big that you can see it on a map. People use it for boats and for fun.
Lake Eyre\n\nLake Eyre is a very big, flat lake in the middle of Australia. It is the lowest place in the country. Most of the time, it is dry and covered with white salt. When rain comes, water fills it up and it becomes the biggest lake in Australia. The water is often pink because of tiny living things in it. Many birds fly there when there is water. People sometimes sail small boats on it when it is full.
Lake Huron\n\nLake Huron is a very big lake. It is one of the five Great Lakes in North America. It is so big that it touches two countries: the United States and Canada. The water is deep and blue. Big boats carry heavy things like iron across it. There are small towns by the water, but no huge cities. The water from Lake Huron flows into a river and then into another lake called Lake Erie. A long time ago, a big storm with strong winds formed right over the lake. Some people called it a hurricane on the lake.
Lake Malawi\n\nLake Malawi is a very big lake in Africa. It has water that is deep and blue. Three countries share it: Malawi, Mozambique, and Tanzania. Many fish live in it, and people catch them for food. Some fish are bright and colorful, like a rainbow. People also swim and ride boats on it. It is one of the biggest lakes in the whole world.
Lake Michigan\n\nLake Michigan is a very big body of water. It is one of five big lakes in North America. It looks like a giant blue blanket under the sky. You can find it next to four states: Indiana, Illinois, Wisconsin, and Michigan. Many people live near it in big cities like Chicago. They swim in it, sail boats on it, and play on its sandy beaches. It is so big that you cannot see the other side.
Lake Nicaragua\n\nLake Nicaragua is a very big lake. It sits in a warm country called Nicaragua. A river joins it to another lake nearby. It has many tiny islands and two big fire mountains inside it. Another river takes its water all the way to the big blue sea.
Lake Ontario\n\nLake Ontario is a very big pool of water. It is one of five big lakes called the Great Lakes. It sits between the country of Canada and the state of New York in the United States. Water from Niagara Falls flows into it, and water flows out of it into a big river called the Saint Lawrence River. Many people live near it. It is deep, deeper than some other Great Lakes. You can see boats on it in the summer.
Lake Superior\n\nLake Superior is a very big lake. It sits between Canada and the United States. It is so big that it looks like a sea. Many kinds of fish live in it. Big boats carry heavy rocks and other things across it. Some people call it by an old name, Gitchigume. It is one of five big lakes that are all close together.
Lake Titicaca\n\nLake Titicaca is a very big lake high up in the mountains. It sits between two countries, Peru and Bolivia. The water is deep and blue. It has many islands, some made of floating reeds by people called the Uros. These islands look golden and can move on the water. People live on the islands and use boats to travel. The lake is home to a big frog and a bird that cannot fly. Many visitors come to see the lake and the islands.
Lake Victoria\n\nLake Victoria is a very big lake in Africa. It is so big that three countries touch its water: Tanzania, Uganda, and Kenya. It is the biggest lake in all of Africa. A long river called the White Nile starts here and flows away. Many people live near it and use its water for drinking and washing. Boats carry people and things across it. It is home to many fish and birds.
Lake Vostok\n\nLake Vostok is a big lake hidden under thick ice in a very cold place called Antarctica. It sits far below the ground, under a heavy blanket of ice. The water in it stays liquid even when it is very cold, because the ice on top pushes down so hard. It has more air in its water than most lakes. Scientists found it using special tools that can see through ice. They think tiny living things might be in it, but it is too hard to reach them.
Lake Winnipeg\n\nLake Winnipeg is a very big lake in Canada. It is full of water and looks like a giant blue blanket on the ground. You can find it north of a city called Winnipeg. Many small towns sit next to it, where people live and play. In summer, families go there to swim and sail boats. In winter, the top of it turns to ice. People can walk or skate on the frozen water.
Lakshmi\n\nLakshmi is a kind and loving goddess. She has four arms and sits on a big pink flower called a lotus. People in India pray to her for money, good luck, and being smart. They think of her during a happy festival with lights called Diwali. She wears pretty gold rings and necklaces. Big gray elephants often stand near her.
Lamb\n\nA lamb is a baby sheep. It has soft, white wool all over its body and four small legs. You can find it on a farm with its mommy sheep. It drinks milk from its mom and likes to run and play in the grass. When it grows up, people use its wool to make warm clothes.
Lamp\n\nA lamp is a thing that gives light. It has a bulb inside that glows when you turn it on. You can find a lamp on a desk, next to a bed, or on the floor in a room. People use it to see when it is dark outside. A small lamp by your bed helps you read a book before sleep.
Lamprey\n\nA lamprey is a long, thin fish that lives in water. It looks like a snake or an eel, but it has no scales. Its mouth is round like a circle and has many tiny sharp teeth inside. It uses this mouth to hold on to rocks or other fish. You can find it in rivers and in the sea, mostly in places that are not too hot and not too cold. It has seven small holes on each side of its body to help it breathe.
Lance\n\nA lance is a long, pointy stick. It looks like a very big pencil with a sharp end. Long ago, people on horses used it to protect themselves. They held it in one hand and pointed it forward. You might see a lance in a storybook about knights or in a parade with flags.
Land\n\nLand is the dry part of Earth that is not covered by water. It has dirt, sand, rocks, and soil. You can walk, run, and play on it. Some land is flat, and some land is bumpy with hills and mountains. People build houses, schools, and roads on it. Farmers use it to grow food like corn and apples. Animals like cows, horses, and dogs live on it too. A big piece of land is called a continent, and a small piece with water all around is called an island.
Land transport\n\nLand transport is how people and things move from one place to another on the ground. It can be a car, a bus, a train, or a big truck. You see it every day on roads and train tracks. People use it to go to school, to the store, or to visit friends. A yellow school bus is one kind of land transport that many children ride.
Landfill\n\nA landfill is a big hole in the ground where trash goes. It is far from houses because it smells bad. Trucks bring bags of old food, paper, and broken toys. Big machines push the trash down flat and cover it with dirt. Over time, the trash makes a gas that can be used to make power. You cannot play there because it is not safe.
Landform\n\nA landform is a shape that the ground makes. It can be big like a mountain or small like a hill. You can see it outside when you look at the land around you. Some landforms are made by water moving over the ground for a long time. A valley is a landform that is low between hills. A beach is a landform where the land meets the sea.
Landscape architecture\n\nLandscape architecture is a way of making outdoor places look nice and work well. It is about planning gardens, parks, and open spaces where people can walk and play. A person who does this job is called a landscape architect. They think about where to put trees, flowers, paths, and benches. You can see their work in a city park with a pond and a playground, or in a school garden with flowers and a little bridge.
Landscape painting\n\nA landscape painting is a picture of the land outside. It shows things like hills, trees, rivers, and fields. Sometimes it shows a real place, and sometimes it shows a place the painter made up in their head. You can see it hanging on a wall in a house or a big building. The painter uses colors to make the sky look blue and the grass look green. It helps people feel like they are standing in a pretty outdoor spot.
Landslide\n\nA landslide is when a lot of dirt, rocks, and mud slide down a hill or a mountain. It happens when the ground on a slope gets loose and heavy. Rain can make the dirt very wet and soft, so it slips down fast. Sometimes the ground shakes and that starts a landslide too. It can cover roads, houses, and trees with mud and rocks. People who live near steep hills watch out for landslides after big storms.
Lane\n\nA lane is a narrow road. It is smaller than a big street and often has trees or bushes on the sides. You can find it in the countryside or in a quiet part of a town. Cars drive slowly on it, and people also walk or ride bikes there. Sometimes a lane is so small that only one car can go at a time.
Language\n\nLanguage is how people talk to each other. It uses words and rules to put words together. You can speak it with your mouth, write it on paper, or make signs with your hands. Every person learns a language when they are very little. The language you learn is the one your family and friends speak. There are many languages in the world, like English, Spanish, and Chinese. Some languages are made up so people from different places can talk, like Esperanto. Language helps you tell others what you think and feel.
Language family\n\nA language family is a group of languages that are like brothers and sisters. They all grew from one very old language that people spoke a long, long time ago. The words and the way the words go together are a little bit the same in each language. You can find these language families all over the world. For example, Spanish and French are in the same family. They both came from an old language called Latin. Some languages do not have any brothers or sisters, so they are all alone.
Lantern\n\nA lantern is a light you can carry or hang up. It has a bright part inside, like a candle or a small bulb, and a see-through cover that keeps the wind away. You can find it at a camp, on a porch, or at a party with pretty colors. People use it to see in the dark when there is no lamp nearby. Some lanterns float up into the night sky like tiny stars.
Laos\n\nLaos is a country in a part of the world called Southeast Asia. It has no beach or ocean touching it. It is next to five other countries. A big river called the Mekong runs along one side of it. Many people in Laos grow food on farms. The houses and streets are not too crowded because not many people live there. You might see a picture of a golden temple with a pointy roof from Laos.
Lap\n\nA lap is the flat top part of your legs when you sit down. It is the place where a cat or a small dog likes to curl up and sleep. When you sit on the floor, you can put a book or a toy on it. A grown-up might let you sit on their lap to read a story. It feels warm and safe.
Lard\n\nLard is a soft white fat that comes from a pig. It looks like butter but feels a little greasy. People use it in the kitchen to cook food. Long ago, many cooks put it in pies and bread to make them flaky and tasty. Some bakers still use it today because it makes the crust very light. You can find it in a store near the butter and oil.
Large\n\nLarge means something is very big. It takes up a lot of space. A house is large, but a mouse is not. An elephant is a large animal with big ears and a long nose. A truck is a large car that can carry heavy things. When you see a big, tall tree, you can say it is large.
Large intestine\n\nThe large intestine is a long tube inside your belly. It is wider than the small tube that comes before it. It takes water out of the food your body does not need. What is left becomes poop, which stays there until you go to the bathroom. You can feel it working when your tummy rumbles.
Lark\n\nA lark is a small brown bird. It has feathers that look like the dry ground where it lives. You can find it in open fields and places with not many trees. It sings pretty songs while flying high up in the sky. Some people wake up early to hear it sing in the morning.
Larva\n\nA larva is a baby animal that looks very different from its mom or dad. It comes out of an egg and is very small. You can find it in water, on leaves, or in the ground. It eats and grows, and later it changes shape into an adult. A caterpillar is a larva that turns into a butterfly. A tadpole is a larva that turns into a frog.
Laser\n\nA laser is a special light. It is a thin, straight beam of light that is all one color. You can see a red dot from a laser pointer in a classroom or at home. People use it to point at things on a board. It also reads music from a CD or a movie from a DVD. A laser can cut metal or help doctors fix eyes.
Last\n\nLast means at the very end. It is the one that comes after all the others. When you line up for a drink, the last person is the one at the back. In a race, the last runner finishes after everyone else. At bedtime, the last story is the one you hear before you close your eyes.
Latch\n\nA latch is a small lock that keeps a door or gate closed. It has a metal bar that slides into a hole or hook. You can find it on a garden gate, a fence, or a cabinet door. When you push the bar up or down, it opens so you can go through. A latch is easy for little hands to use. It makes a click sound when it closes tight.
Late\n\nLate means you did not come on time. It is when you get to a place after the clock says you should be there. If school starts at 8 and you come at 8:10, you are late. It can happen when you wake up too slow, or when the car gets stuck in a long line of other cars. Being late can make a friend wait for you. It feels better to be early or right on time.
Later\n\nLater means after some time has passed. It is not now, but a little while from now. When you wait for your turn on the swing, you go later. Mom might say, "We will have a snack later." That means you will eat soon, but not right this second. You can use later when you talk about something that will happen after playtime or after a nap.
Lathe\n\nA lathe is a machine that helps people shape wood or metal. It has a motor that spins a piece of wood or metal very fast. While it spins, a sharp tool cuts away little bits to make a shape. You can find a lathe in a workshop or a factory. People use it to make round things like baseball bats, table legs, and candle holders. A potter's wheel is a kind of lathe that spins clay to make bowls and cups.
Latin\n\nLatin is a very old language. It was spoken a long, long time ago in a place called Rome. Today, people do not speak it as their first language, so we call it a dead language. But it is still used in some churches and by scientists who name plants and animals. Many words we use today, like in Spanish and French, came from Latin.
Latin America\n\nLatin America is a big part of the world. It is made of many countries where people speak Spanish or Portuguese. You find it below the United States, all the way down to the bottom of South America. It has warm places, big forests, and long beaches. People there make happy music and colorful art. They eat foods like tacos and rice with beans. Many children play soccer in the streets. Some people live in big cities, and some live in small villages. Not everyone has the same amount of money, and some families are very poor.
Latin American literature\n\nLatin American literature is stories and poems made by people from Latin America. It is written in Spanish or Portuguese, but sometimes in other languages too. You can find it in books at a library or a store. It often mixes real life with magic, like a dream. One famous story is about a family with many strange and wonderful things happening to them.
Latin script\n\nLatin script is a set of letters we use to write words. It has 26 letters, like A, B, C, all the way to Z. You see it in books, on signs, and on your toys. People use it to write English and many other languages. When you learn your ABCs, you are learning Latin script.
Latitude\n\nLatitude is a way to tell how far north or south a place is on Earth. It is measured in lines that go around the Earth like a belt. The line in the middle is called the equator, and it is zero. Places above the equator have north latitude, and places below have south latitude. The very top of the Earth is 90 degrees north, and the very bottom is 90 degrees south. You can see latitude lines on a map or a globe. They help people find where a city or a country is.
Latvia\n\nLatvia is a country in Europe. It is next to the sea, with forests and rivers. People there speak a language called Latvian. The biggest city is Riga, where many people live. A long time ago, other countries ruled Latvia, but now it is free. It is part of a big group of countries that help each other.
Laugh\n\nA laugh is a happy sound you make with your mouth. It comes out when something is funny or silly. You can hear it when friends play together or when someone tells a joke. A laugh makes your belly shake and your face smile. It feels good and can make other people laugh too.
Launch\n\nA launch is when something big starts moving up into the sky. It can be a rocket that goes to space. You might see it on TV with fire and smoke coming out the bottom. People use a launch to send things like satellites or astronauts way up high. A launch is very loud and fast.
Launch vehicle\n\nA launch vehicle is a big, tall machine that sends things into space. It looks like a long tube with fire coming out the bottom. You can see it at a space center, standing on a big flat field before it goes up. It pushes satellites, space ships, and people way up high above the clouds. Some of them can only fly one time, but a few can come back and fly again. When it takes off, it makes a loud roar and bright light.
Laundry\n\nLaundry is the job of washing clothes. It makes clothes clean and fresh again. You can do it at home in a room with a washing machine. The machine spins the clothes in soapy water, then rinses them with clean water. After that, the clothes go into a dryer or hang on a line to dry. Sometimes a hot iron makes them flat and smooth. You might see a basket of clean, warm clothes that smell nice.
Lava\n\nLava is hot, melted rock that comes out of a volcano. It is red, orange, or yellow and glows like fire. You can find it when a mountain with a hole on top, called a volcano, opens up. It flows down the side of the volcano like a slow, thick river. When it cools down, it turns into hard, black rock. Some lava moves fast and looks like shiny ropes. Other lava moves so slowly that it piles up in big, sharp chunks. Underwater, it makes round shapes that look like pillows. People must stay far away because it is very, very hot and can burn things.
Lavender\n\nLavender is a plant with pretty purple flowers. It has a sweet, strong smell that many people love. You can find it in gardens and sunny fields. People pick the flowers and dry them to make little bags that keep clothes smelling nice. Some people use it in food, like cookies or tea, to give a soft flower taste. The oil from it can help you feel calm before sleep. At a wedding, people sometimes throw the dried flowers like tiny purple confetti.
Law\n\nLaw is a set of rules that people must follow. It tells everyone what they can and cannot do. Police and courts help make sure people follow the rules. If someone breaks a rule, they may have to pay money or go to a special room called jail. Laws are made by leaders that people choose. They write the rules down so everyone can know them. A lawyer is a person who knows a lot about the rules and helps other people with them. Laws help keep everyone safe and fair.
Lawn\n\nA lawn is a big, soft, green carpet of grass. It grows outside around houses, schools, and parks. People cut it with a noisy machine to keep it short and neat. You can run, play, or sit on it when the sun is warm. Sometimes you see tiny flowers like daisies hiding in it. A lawn feels cool and tickly under your bare feet.
Lawn mower\n\nA lawn mower is a machine that cuts grass. It has a sharp part that spins very fast to make the grass short. Some are small and you push them with your hands. Big ones have a seat so you can ride on top. You see it outside on green lawns at homes, parks, and big fields. People use it to keep the grass neat and tidy.
Lawsuit\n\nA lawsuit is when two people or groups ask a judge to fix a fight. It starts when one side says the other side did something wrong. Both sides have a helper called a lawyer who talks to the judge. They show proof and tell the judge their story. The judge listens and then picks who is right. The side that wins may get money or make the other side stop doing the wrong thing.
Lawyer\n\nA lawyer is a person who helps with rules called laws. He knows a lot about these rules and how to use them. You can find him in a big room called a court, where people talk about problems. He talks for a person who has a problem, and he tries to make things fair. If someone is in trouble, he helps tell their side of the story.
Lay\n\nTo lay means to put something down flat. You can lay a book on a table or lay a blanket on a bed. When you lay a toy on the floor, it stays still. A hen lays eggs in a nest. You might lay your head on a pillow when you are sleepy.
Layer\n\nA layer is one flat piece that sits on top of another piece. It is like a blanket on a bed. You can find layers in a cake, where one sweet part sits on another. In the ground, dirt has layers of sand and rock. When you put on clothes, you wear a shirt as one layer and a coat as another layer. Layers help keep things warm or make them tall.
Lead\n\nLead means to go first and show the way. When you hold a friend's hand and walk to the playground, you lead them. A teacher leads the class by telling everyone what to do next. In a line, the person at the very front leads all the others. You can also lead a song by starting to sing so others join in.
Leader\n\nA leader is a person who helps a group decide what to do. He or she shows the way and keeps everyone working together. You can find a leader in a classroom, on a sports team, or in a family. A leader listens to others and makes sure everyone is safe and happy. For example, a teacher is a leader who helps children learn new things every day.
Leaf\n\nA leaf is a flat, green part of a plant. It grows on a stem or a branch. You can find it on trees, bushes, and small plants in your yard or a park. It makes food for the plant using sunlight, air, and water. In fall, many leaves turn red, yellow, or orange and fall to the ground. Some leaves are big, like the ones on a sunflower, and some are tiny, like the ones on a little weed.
Leak\n\nA leak is when water or air comes out of a hole where it should not. It can happen in a pipe under the sink or in a hose in the yard. When there is a leak, you might see a puddle on the floor or hear a drip-drip sound. A grown-up can fix it by putting a patch on the hole or by calling a plumber. If you see a leak, you should tell a big person so it does not make a mess.
Leaning Tower of Pisa\n\nThe Leaning Tower of Pisa is a tall, round building in Italy. It looks like it is about to fall over because it tilts to one side. It is a bell tower, so it has big bells at the top. People can climb up 294 steps inside it to see far away. The ground under it is soft, so it started to lean a long time ago. Workers fixed it so it would not fall down. Many people visit it to take funny pictures.
Leap\n\nA leap is a big jump. It is when you push off the ground with both feet and fly through the air for a moment. You can leap over a puddle on the sidewalk or leap from one rock to another at the park. A frog leaps from a lily pad into the water. A dancer leaps across the stage. It makes you feel light and free.
Leap year\n\nA leap year is a year with one extra day. It has 366 days instead of 365. The extra day is added to February, so February has 29 days instead of 28. This extra day is called a leap day. We have leap years because the Earth takes a little more than 365 days to go around the Sun. Without the extra day, the seasons would slowly move on the calendar. Leap years happen every four years, like 2024 and 2028. But some years that can be divided by 100 are not leap years, unless they can also be divided by 400.
Learn\n\nTo learn is to find out something new. It happens when you listen, look, or try things. You learn at school when a teacher shows you letters and numbers. You also learn at home when you help cook or tie your shoes. Every day you learn a little bit more about the world.
Learner\n\nA learner is a person who is learning something new. It can be a child at school, a grown-up at work, or anyone who wants to know more. A learner asks questions and tries hard to understand. When you learn to tie your shoes or count to ten, you are a learner. Everyone is a learner at some time in life.
Learning\n\nLearning is how you get to know new things. It happens when you try something, watch someone, or listen to a teacher. You can learn at school, at home, or when you play with friends. When you learn, your brain gets stronger and makes new paths. You learn to count, to read, and to tie your shoes. Every day you learn a little more.
Leash\n\nA leash is a long strap that you hold when you walk a dog. It clips onto the dog's collar or harness so the dog stays close and safe. You can find it at a pet store or in a park where people walk their dogs. It helps you guide the dog and stop it from running into the street. Many leashes are made of strong cloth or rope, and some have a loop at the end for your hand.
Leather\n\nLeather is a strong, bendy material made from animal skin. It comes from cows, pigs, goats, and sometimes other animals. People use it to make shoes, bags, jackets, and balls. It feels smooth and lasts a long time. You can see it on a baseball glove or a belt.
Leave\n\nTo leave means to go away from a place. You leave your house when you walk out the door. You leave the park when it is time to go home. When you leave, you are not in that place anymore. Sometimes you leave a room, and sometimes you leave a big place like a city. It can feel sad to leave a friend, but you can come back another day.
Lebanon\n\nLebanon is a country near the big blue sea. It has tall mountains and a long sandy beach. Many people live there, and they speak Arabic. A green tree called the cedar grows on its mountains. Its biggest city is Beirut, where many people work and play.
Lee\n\nLee is a name that many people have. It can be a first name or a last name. You might meet a boy named Lee at school or in a storybook. Some people spell it with more letters, but Lee is short and easy to say. It is a friendly name that makes you smile.
Leech\n\nA leech is a small worm that lives in wet places. It has a soft body made of many tiny rings. You can find it in ponds, lakes, or damp ground. Some leeches eat tiny bugs, and some drink blood from bigger animals. If you walk in a muddy pond, one might stick to your leg.
Leek\n\nA leek is a long, green and white vegetable. It looks like a tall, skinny stick with flat leaves at the top. You can find it in a garden or at a food store. People cook it in soups and other warm meals. It tastes a little like an onion, but it is softer and sweeter. Some kids see it in a bowl of hot soup on a cold day.
Left\n\nLeft is one side of your body. It is the side where your heart lives. When you hold up your hands, the hand that makes an L shape with the thumb and pointer finger is your left hand. You can turn left when you walk or ride a bike. Many people write with their right hand, but some write with their left hand.
Leg\n\nA leg is a long part of the body that helps you stand and walk. It has a foot at the bottom and a knee in the middle. You have two legs, and they are under your hips. It is used for running, jumping, and kicking a ball. Many animals also have legs, like dogs and cats.
Legend\n\nA legend is a very old story that people tell each other. It is about a person, a place, or a thing that may or may not be real. You can hear it from your grandma or read it in a book. It often has magic or big adventures. Some legends are about a giant man who cut down trees, or a monster that lives in a deep lake. Even if the story is not true, people love to tell it again and again.
Legendary creature\n\nA legendary creature is a make-believe animal from old stories. It can have parts from different real animals, like a lion's body and an eagle's wings. You find it in fairy tales, books, and movies. People tell stories about it, but no one has ever seen a real one. A dragon is one kind of legendary creature. It has big wings and can breathe fire.
Legislature\n\nA legislature is a group of people who make new rules for a place. It meets in a big room with many seats. You can find it in a country, a state, or a city. It talks about ideas and then votes to turn them into laws. For example, a town council is a small legislature that decides about parks and streets.
Leisure\n\nLeisure is free time when you can choose what to do. It is time away from school or work. You can play with toys, draw a picture, or run outside. On a weekend, families often have leisure time together. A vacation is a long stretch of leisure time when you might go to a new place or stay home and rest.
Lemon\n\nA lemon is a small yellow fruit that grows on a tree. It has a thick, bumpy skin and soft, juicy parts inside. You can find it in a store or at a market. It tastes very sour, so people do not eat it like an apple. Instead, they squeeze it to make a drink called lemonade. They also use a little bit of it to add a fresh taste to food. A lemon is a cousin of an orange, but it is much more sour.
Lemonade\n\nLemonade is a cold, sweet drink. It is made from lemons, water, and sugar. It looks yellow and tastes sour and sweet at the same time. You can find it at a lemonade stand, a store, or at home on a hot day. People drink it to cool down when the sun is bright.
Lemur\n\nA lemur is a small animal with soft fur and a long tail. It has big round eyes and pointy ears. It lives only on a big island called Madagascar, in trees. It eats fruit and leaves. It jumps from tree to tree and makes loud calls. Some lemurs have black-and-white rings on their tail. They live in big family groups.
Lena River\n\nThe Lena River is a very long river in a cold, far-away place called Siberia. It looks like a big, winding blue snake on a map. It starts in tall hills and flows all the way to a frozen sea at the top of the world. Boats can carry things on it, and fish live in its water. In winter, much of it turns to ice.
Length\n\nLength is how long something is. It is the space from one end to the other end. You can find length on a pencil, a table, or a piece of string. A ruler is a tool that helps you measure length. It has little lines and numbers on it. Short means a small length, and long means a big length. Length can also mean how much time something takes. If you play from one o'clock to three o'clock, the length of your play is two hours.
Lens\n\nA lens is a clear, curved piece of glass or plastic. It is round and smooth, and it can be thick in the middle or thin at the edges. You find it in glasses, cameras, and telescopes. It helps people see things that are far away or very small by bending light. When you look through a magnifying glass, you are using a lens to make tiny words look big.
Lentil\n\nA lentil is a tiny, flat seed that people eat. It is round like a little button and comes in colors like green, brown, red, or yellow. You find it in bags at the grocery store. People cook it in water to make soup or soft food. It tastes warm and earthy. Many families eat it with rice. It is good for your body because it has things that help you grow strong.
Leo\n\nLeo is a name for a boy. It is a short name with three letters. You might know a friend or a boy in a book named Leo. Sometimes a lion in a story is called Leo, because the word sounds like lion. People with this name can be kind and funny.
Leo Tolstoy\n\nLeo Tolstoy was a man who wrote big books with many words. He lived a long time ago in a faraway land. His most famous book tells a story about a sad lady and a train. Another book is about a big war and many people. He had a long beard and liked to think about how to be good. Many grown-ups read his books even today.
Leonardo\n\nLeonardo is a name for a boy. He is a person who lived a long time ago. He could draw and paint very well. He made a famous picture of a lady with a soft smile. He also thought of new things like a flying machine. Many people still look at his art today.
Leonardo Da Vinci\n\nLeonardo Da Vinci was a man who lived a long, long time ago. He was very good at drawing and painting. He made a famous picture of a lady with a small smile. He also thought of new ideas for flying machines and other clever things. Many people still look at his art and ideas today.
Leopard\n\nA leopard is a big wild cat. It has soft fur that is tan with dark spots shaped like rings. It lives in Africa and Asia, where there are trees and tall grass. It is very good at climbing trees and often rests on branches. It hunts animals like deer and rabbits, mostly at night. A leopard can carry its food up a tree to keep it safe from other animals.
Leprechaun\n\nA leprechaun is a tiny make-believe man from old Irish stories. He looks like a very small old man with a beard, a green hat, and a green coat. He lives in Ireland and hides in the woods or near rainbows. He is very tricky and loves to play little jokes. People say he keeps a pot of gold hidden at the end of a rainbow. If you catch him, he must tell you where the gold is, but if you look away, he disappears in a flash.
Lesotho\n\nLesotho is a small country in Africa. It is completely inside another country called South Africa. It has no sea next to it, so all things must come by land or by plane. It has many tall hills and mountains. In winter, people can go there to play in the snow. The capital city is called Maseru. A king lives there and helps run the country.
Less\n\nLess means a smaller number or a smaller amount. When you have five cookies and your friend has two, your friend has less. It is the opposite of more. You can use less when you talk about water in a cup, toys in a box, or time before bed. If you pour out some water, there is less water in the cup.
Lesson\n\nA lesson is a time when you learn something new. It happens at school with a teacher and other kids. You sit at a desk and listen, draw, or sing. A lesson can be about numbers, letters, or how plants grow. Sometimes you learn a lesson outside, like when you touch something hot and learn not to do it again.
Let\n\nLet is a small word we use when we want to allow something. It means "it is okay to do." You might hear it when a grown-up says, "I will let you have a cookie." It is also in games like hide-and-seek when someone says, "Let's go!" It helps us tell others that something is allowed or that we want to do something together.
Letter\n\nA letter is a small mark we use to write words. It is one of the shapes in the ABCs. You see letters in books, on signs, and on your toys. Each letter has a sound, and we put them together to make words like "cat" or "dog." The English ABC has 26 letters, from A to Z. Some letters are big, like A, and some are small, like a. When you learn your ABCs, you learn all the letters.
Lettuce\n\nLettuce is a green plant that people eat. It has soft, leafy parts that can be green or sometimes red. You can find it in gardens, on farms, or at the grocery store. People eat it cold in salads, on burgers, or in sandwiches. Some kinds grow in a tight round ball, and some have loose, wavy leaves. A common kind is the one with long, crisp leaves called romaine.
Levee\n\nA levee is a long, raised wall of dirt or stone. It stands next to a river or the sea. It keeps water from spilling over onto the land when the water gets high. People build it to keep houses and farms safe from floods. You can see a levee as a big grassy hill that runs along the water. Some are made by people, and some are made by nature. In some places, people walk or ride bikes on top of it.
Level\n\nA level is a tool that shows if something is flat and straight. It has a long body with a small tube of water and a bubble inside. You find it in a toolbox or with a builder. People use it when they hang a picture or build a shelf. If the bubble sits in the middle, the thing is not tilted.
Lever\n\nA lever is a simple tool that helps you lift or move heavy things. It is a long, straight stick or bar that rests on a point called a fulcrum. You can find levers in many places, like on a playground seesaw or in a pair of scissors. When you push down on one end, the other end goes up. This makes a small push feel strong enough to lift something big. A crowbar is another lever that helps open boxes or move rocks.
Leviathan\n\nLeviathan is a big monster from old stories. It lives deep in the sea. It looks like a giant snake or a huge fish with sharp teeth. People long ago were scared of it because it could break boats. Some think it is like a whale, but much bigger and meaner.
Lhasa\n\nLhasa is a city way up high in the mountains. It sits in a place called Tibet, where the air is thin and the sky is very blue. In this city, you can see big, old buildings with gold roofs and bright colors. One of them is a giant palace on a hill. People go there to pray and feel close to their gods. Many visitors come from far away to see these special places.
Liberalism\n\nLiberalism is a way of thinking about how people should live together. It says that everyone should be free to make their own choices. It also says that people should be kind and fair to each other. In a place with liberalism, you can say what you think and pick your own job. It is like when you share toys so everyone gets a turn.
Liberia\n\nLiberia is a country in Africa. It sits next to the big ocean, and it has warm weather all year. Much of it is covered with tall green trees and thick forests. Many people live in the main city called Monrovia. Long ago, freed people came from America to start a new home there. Today, people in Liberia speak English and grow rubber trees. Rubber from the trees is used to make things like boots and balls.
Liberty\n\nLiberty means you can choose what to do. It is like when you pick which toy to play with. People have liberty when they can say what they think and go where they want. In some places, a big statue called the Statue of Liberty stands tall to remind everyone about being free.
Librarian\n\nA librarian is a person who works in a library. He or she helps people find books to read. The librarian keeps the books neat on the shelves. He or she can show you where the picture books are. You can ask the librarian for a story about animals or trucks. He or she is very kind and loves to share books with everyone.
Library\n\nA library is a special room or building full of books. It has tall shelves where books sit in neat rows. You can find a library in many towns, schools, and big cities. People go there to pick a book and take it home for a little while. A helper called a librarian shows you where to look. Some libraries also have movies, music, and computers. It is a quiet place to read and learn new things.
Library of Congress\n\nThe Library of Congress is a very big building full of books. It is in the United States, near the White House. Inside, it has millions of books, maps, and old papers. People can go there to read and learn new things. It also keeps a copy of every book made in the country. It is the biggest library in the whole world.
Libya\n\nLibya is a big country in Africa. It has sand, sun, and a long blue sea at the top. Most of the land is dry and hot, with a huge desert called the Sahara. Many people live in cities by the water, like Tripoli. They speak Arabic and follow a religion called Islam. Long ago, people found oil under the ground, and now Libya sells it to other places.
Lichen\n\nA lichen is a tiny living thing made of two friends that help each other. It looks like a flat, crusty patch or a little bushy plant. You can find it on rocks, tree bark, old walls, and roofs. It does not need much water and can live in very cold or very hot places. Some animals, like reindeer, eat it in winter.
Lick\n\nA lick is when you touch something with your tongue. It feels wet and soft. You can lick a lollipop or an ice cream cone to taste it. Animals like dogs and cats lick their fur to clean it. A dog might also lick your hand to show it likes you.
Lid\n\nA lid is the top part of a box, jar, or pot. It covers the opening to keep things inside safe and clean. You can find it in the kitchen on a pot of soup or on a jar of cookies. When you twist it or lift it, you can open the container. A lid can be made of metal, plastic, or glass. It helps stop spills and keeps food fresh.
Lie\n\nA lie is when someone says something that is not true on purpose. It is a trick with words. You might hear a lie at home or at school. People tell lies to hide a mistake or to get something they want. A small lie to make someone feel better is called a white lie. For example, saying you like a gift even if you do not is a white lie.
Life\n\nLife is something that can grow, make more of itself, and change. It is all around us. You can see it in a dog, a tree, a flower, and even in tiny things you cannot see with your eyes. All living things need water and food to stay alive. They can be big like a whale or small like a bug. A baby is a new life that grows inside its mommy. Life is very special because it can do so many things.
Lift\n\nA lift is something that moves people up and down inside a tall building. It is a small room with doors that open and close. You find it in places like big stores, hotels, and apartment houses. When you press a button, it takes you to a different floor without using stairs. It helps people who cannot walk up steps, like grandmas or people with wheelchairs.
Lift (force)\n\nLift is a push that goes up. It helps a big metal bird called an airplane stay in the sky. You cannot see it, but it is made when air moves fast over and under the wings. The wings push air down, and the air pushes the wings up. This same push also helps a toy with spinning blades fly up. A fan on a hot day uses a kind of lift to move air, too.
Ligament\n\nA ligament is a strong, stretchy band inside your body. It ties one bone to another bone at a joint. It helps hold your bones together so they do not move too far. You can find it in places like your knee, your elbow, and your wrist. When you run and jump, it keeps your joints safe and steady.
Light\n\nLight is what lets you see things. It comes from the sun, a lamp, or a fire. When it is dark, there is no light. Light moves very fast and goes in a straight line. It can be many colors. You see these colors in a rainbow: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. When light hits something you cannot see through, it makes a dark shape called a shadow. Light keeps us warm and helps plants grow.
Light bulb\n\nA light bulb is a thing that makes light when you turn it on. It is made of glass and has a small part inside that glows. You find it in lamps, on the ceiling, and in many rooms of a house. It helps people see when it is dark outside. Some light bulbs are round, and some are long tubes. When you flip a switch, it lights up the room so you can play or read a book.
Light microscope\n\nA light microscope is a tool that makes tiny things look big. It has a flat part called a stage where you put a small glass slide. A light at the bottom shines up through the slide. You look through the top part, and the lenses make the tiny thing look much bigger. You can see things like little dots that are really tiny living things. Some light microscopes can take pictures instead of having a top to look through.
Light year\n\nA light year is how far light goes in one year. It is a very, very long way. Light moves super fast, so in one year it goes a huge distance. People use it to talk about stars and space. Stars are so far away that we need a big word to say how far. When we see a star, the light left it a long time ago. So we see the star as it was back then.
Lighthouse\n\nA lighthouse is a tall tower by the sea. It has a bright light at the top. The light turns around and around at night. Sailors on boats see the light from far away. It tells them where the land is so they do not crash. Long ago, people lived inside to keep the light on. Now, most lights turn on by themselves. You might see a lighthouse in a picture book or at the beach.
Lighting\n\nLighting is the way we use light to see things. It can come from the sun during the day. It can also come from lamps and lights we turn on at night. In a house, windows let in sunlight to make rooms bright. At night, we use a lamp to read a book before bed. In movies and photos, lighting helps make the picture look pretty.
Lightning\n\nLightning is a big, bright flash of light in the sky. It looks like a jagged line that lights up the clouds. You see it during a storm, when the sky is dark and it rains hard. It makes the air very hot, and that hot air makes a loud boom called thunder. Sometimes it jumps from a cloud to the ground. It can hit tall things like trees or buildings. If you see lightning, go inside a house to stay safe.
Like\n\nLike is a feeling you have when something makes you happy. It is a warm, good feeling inside. You can like a toy, a food, or a friend. When you like something, you smile and want to be near it. You might say, "I like this!" when you see your favorite snack. Liking is not as big as loving, but it still feels very nice.
Likely\n\nLikely means something will probably happen. It is a word we use when we think something is almost sure to be true. If the sky is full of dark clouds, it is likely to rain. If you see a friend holding a ball, it is likely they want to play. It is not the same as 'for sure,' but it is a very good guess.
Lily\n\nA lily is a tall flower with big, soft petals. It grows from a round bulb under the ground. You can find it in gardens, forests, and grassy hills. It comes in many colors like white, pink, yellow, and orange. The petals are often shaped like a trumpet or a star. Some lilies have spots on the petals. People like to put lilies in a vase at home. But be careful—if a cat eats any part of a lily, it can make the cat very sick.
Lily of the valley\n\nLily of the valley is a small plant with pretty white flowers. It has little bell-shaped flowers that hang down from a thin green stem. It grows in cool places like forests and gardens. The flowers smell very sweet, but the whole plant is not safe to eat. You might see it in a park or in a flower shop in spring.
Lima\n\nLima is a big city in the country of Peru. It is the most important city there, where the leaders work. Many people live in Lima—more than eight million. It has tall buildings, busy streets, and a big port for ships. People come to Lima to see old places, eat yummy food, and visit museums. Long ago, a man from Spain started the city. Today, most people in Lima speak Spanish.
Lima bean\n\nA lima bean is a small, flat seed that people eat. It is light green or white and looks like a tiny, smooth pebble. You can find it in gardens, at the store in bags or cans, and in warm meals like soup. People cook it until it is soft and then eat it with a spoon or fork. It tastes mild and a little buttery, so some call it a butter bean. You might see it mixed with corn or carrots on your plate.
Lime\n\nA lime is a small green fruit that grows on a tree. It is round and has a sour, sharp taste. The inside is soft and juicy, and the skin is bright green. If it stays on the tree a long time, it can turn yellow. People use lime juice in drinks like lemonade and in food to add a fresh flavor. Sailors long ago ate limes to stay healthy on long boat trips.
Limestone\n\nLimestone is a kind of rock. It is often white, gray, or yellow. You can find it in the ground or in big hills. People cut it into blocks to build houses and churches. It is also used to make glass and cement. Some limestone has old shells and bones inside it from long ago.
