Limit\n\nA limit is a line you cannot cross. It tells you how far you can go or how much you can do. When you play tag, the fence might be the limit. Your mom might set a limit on how many cookies you can eat. It keeps things safe and fair.
Limpopo River\n\nThe Limpopo River is a long, winding river in Africa. It flows through four countries: South Africa, Botswana, Zimbabwe, and Mozambique. It marks part of the edge of South Africa. At the end, it empties into the big Indian Ocean. People and animals use its water to drink and to help plants grow.
Lincoln\n\nLincoln is a name for a boy. It was the last name of a man who was a leader of America a long time ago. He was very tall and wore a tall black hat. You can see his face on a small brown coin called a penny. Many schools and streets have his name too.
Line\n\nA line is a long, thin mark that goes on and on. It can be straight, like a pencil line on paper. It can also be curved, like the edge of a round plate. A line has no thickness, only length. You can draw a line with a crayon or a stick in the sand. A short piece of a line is called a line segment. Two lines can cross each other or run side by side.
Linear\n\nLinear means something that goes in a straight line. It is like a row of blocks, one after the other, with no turns or curves. You can see it in a line of ants walking on the ground. When you draw with a ruler, you make a linear mark. A train track that goes straight is linear too.
Linen\n\nLinen is a kind of cloth. It comes from a plant called flax. The plant has tall, thin stems. People take the stems and make soft threads from them. Then they weave the threads into linen. It feels cool and light on your skin. You can find it in summer shirts, dresses, and tablecloths. Long ago, people wrapped mummies in linen. Today, many people like it because it is strong and dries fast.
Linguistics\n\nLinguistics is the study of how people talk and use words. It looks at the sounds we make, like 'mmm' and 'ahh', and how we put them together to say things. You can find it everywhere people are talking—at home, at school, on TV. It helps us understand why we say 'cat' and not 'dog' for a furry pet. When you learn a new word, you are doing a little bit of linguistics.
Link\n\nA link is a part of a chain. It looks like a small ring or loop. You can find it in a necklace, on a swing, or on a bike. It joins with other links to make a long, strong chain. When you wear a necklace, the links hold it together around your neck.
Lion\n\nA lion is a big, strong cat. It has a long body, short legs, a big head, and a long tail. The boy lion has thick, fluffy hair around his neck called a mane. Lions live in warm places with lots of grass and some trees. They live together in a big family called a pride. The girl lions work as a team to catch food like zebras and antelopes. A lion makes a very loud roar that you can hear far away. You can see a lion at the zoo or in a picture book.
Lip\n\nA lip is the soft, pink part around your mouth. It has two parts: the top lip and the bottom lip. You use it to talk, eat, and give kisses. When you smile, your lips curve up and show your teeth. In the cold, lips can get dry and need a little balm to feel soft again.
Lipid\n\nA lipid is a kind of fat. It feels slippery and does not mix with water. You can find it in foods like butter, oil, and cheese. Your body uses it to keep warm and to have energy to play. It also helps build the tiny parts inside you, like the walls of your cells.
Liquid\n\nA liquid is a kind of stuff that can flow. It does not have its own shape. It takes the shape of whatever you pour it into. You can find it in many places, like water from a tap or milk in a cup. People drink it, wash with it, or use it to cook. Water, juice, and oil are all liquids.
Liquid crystal display\n\nA liquid crystal display is a flat screen that shows pictures and words. It is thin and light, like a piece of paper. You can find it on a watch, a phone, or a TV. It uses a tiny bit of power to turn little dots on and off. Each dot can be clear or dark, and together they make a picture. Some have a light inside so you can see them in the dark.
Liquorice\n\nLiquorice is a plant root that tastes very sweet. It grows under the ground like a long brown stick. People dig it up and use it to make candy and tea. The candy is often black and chewy. Some people love the taste, but others think it is too strong. The plant has small purple flowers and green leaves. It grows in warm places far away.
Lisbon\n\nLisbon is a big city by the sea. It is the most important city in a country called Portugal. It sits next to a wide river, and the sun shines there on most days. Many old, pretty buildings stand on hills, and yellow trains called trams climb up and down the steep streets. People can eat fresh fish from the ocean and visit sandy beaches close by. It is a very old city where many people live and work.
List\n\nA list is a way to write things down in a row. It helps you remember what to do or buy. You can make a list on paper with a pencil. It often has one thing on each line. A shopping list tells you what to get at the store. A to-do list tells you what jobs to finish. You can check off each thing when it is done.
Listen\n\nListen means to use your ears to hear a sound. It is something you do when you stop talking and pay attention to noises around you. You can listen to a bird singing, a dog barking, or a friend telling a story. When you listen, you stay quiet and focus on what you hear. It helps you learn new things and understand how people feel.
Literacy\n\nLiteracy is knowing how to read and write. It is a skill that helps you understand words in books, on signs, and on screens. Most people learn it at school when they are young. When you can read, you can enjoy stories, follow a recipe, or write a note to a friend. A person who cannot read or write is called illiterate. In some places, many grown-ups never learned to read, so they cannot do things like read a newspaper or fill out a form.
Literature\n\nLiterature is a group of stories and poems made of words. It can be written in a book or told out loud. You find it in a library, at school, or at home when someone reads to you. People read it for fun or to learn about faraway places and long-ago times. A fairy tale like Cinderella is a kind of literature.
Lithuania\n\nLithuania is a country in Europe. It is next to the Baltic Sea. Its flag has three stripes: yellow on top, green in the middle, and red at the bottom. Many people there speak a language called Lithuanian. The biggest city is Vilnius. It has old buildings and big churches. People in Lithuania like to sing and dance at big parties with lots of food.
Litre\n\nA litre is a way to measure how much space something takes up. It is used mostly for liquids like water, milk, or juice. One litre of water is as heavy as a big bag of sugar. You can see a litre at the store on a bottle of soda or a carton of milk. It is the same size as a box that is ten little blocks long, ten blocks wide, and ten blocks tall.
Little\n\nLittle means something is very small. It is the opposite of big. You can use it to talk about a tiny bug, a short story, or a baby animal. When you hold a little rock in your hand, it feels light and easy to carry. A little puppy is smaller than a big dog. Many things around you can be little, like a button on your shirt or a seed in an apple.
Live\n\nTo live means to be alive. A thing that lives can grow, move, and feel. A dog lives, a tree lives, and you live too. When something lives, it needs food, water, and air. It can have babies or make new little ones. A rock does not live because it does not grow or eat.
Liver\n\nThe liver is a soft, red-brown part inside your belly. It sits on the right side, under your ribs. It helps clean your blood and makes a green-yellow juice called bile that helps your body use food. It also stores energy so you can run and play. When you eat meat like chicken or cow, sometimes the liver is cooked and eaten too. It tastes strong and has good things that help you grow.
Livestock\n\nLivestock are animals that people keep on farms. They give us food and other things we use. Some of them are cows, pigs, sheep, goats, and chickens. Cows give milk and meat. Sheep give wool for warm clothes. Chickens give eggs. Some big animals like horses help people pull heavy things. People take care of them every day by giving them food and water. A long time ago, people started keeping these animals near their homes. Today, many of them live on big farms. You can see them in picture books or at a petting zoo.
Lizard\n\nA lizard is a small animal with dry, scaly skin. It has four short legs, a long body, and a long tail. You can find it in warm places like gardens, rocks, or deserts. It eats bugs and tiny animals. If a bigger animal grabs its tail, the tail can fall off and grow back later. Some lizards can change color to hide from danger.
Llama\n\nA llama is a big, fluffy animal from South America. It has long ears, a long neck, and soft, thick fur. It lives high up in the mountains where the air is thin. People keep it to carry heavy bags and to use its warm wool for clothes. Long ago, it helped the Incan people move things over rocky paths. Today, some people keep it as a pet on farms. It likes to be with other llamas and can make a funny spitting sound when it is upset.
Loan\n\nA loan is when someone gives you money and you promise to give it back later. It is not a gift. You pay back a little bit at a time, like putting coins in a jar each week. The person who gives the money may ask for a little extra, called interest. A loan can help buy big things like a house or a car. You can get a loan from a bank.
Lobby\n\nA lobby is a big room inside a building. It is the first room you see when you walk in. You can find it in a hotel, a movie theater, or a big office. People wait in it, meet friends, or walk through it to go to other rooms. It often has chairs, a desk, and sometimes a plant or a big clock.
Lobster\n\nA lobster is a big animal that lives in the sea. It has a hard shell, two big claws, and a long tail. It walks on the bottom of the sea and hides under rocks. People catch it to eat because the meat tastes good. It can live for a very long time and grow very big.
Local\n\nLocal means something is close to where you live. It is the park down the street, the store around the corner, or the school you walk to. You can find local things in your own town or neighborhood. People like local places because they are easy to get to and feel like home. For example, the playground you visit every week is a local spot.
Lock\n\nA lock is a small metal thing that keeps doors, boxes, or gates shut. It has a hole for a key. You turn the key inside it, and it clicks open or closed. You see locks on front doors, school gates, and bike chains. It helps keep your things safe so only the right person can open them.
Lock (water navigation)\n\nA lock is a big box of water that helps boats go up or down a hill. It has tall walls and two strong doors, one at each end. You find it on a river or a long water path called a canal. When a boat comes in, the doors close and the water inside can go up or down. This lets the boat float to a new level and then go out the other door. It is like a water elevator for boats.
Locomotive\n\nA locomotive is the strong front part of a train that pulls the rest. It is big and heavy, much bigger than a car. You see it on train tracks, pulling long lines of cars behind it. It has a powerful engine inside that makes the wheels turn. Some use special fuel like diesel, and some use electricity from wires above. A long time ago, many used steam from hot water. Today, most use diesel to make power. When you watch a train go by, the first thing you see is the locomotive.
Locust\n\nA locust is a kind of bug that can jump and fly. It looks like a grasshopper with long back legs and wings. Sometimes many, many locusts fly together in a big group called a swarm. A swarm can eat all the green leaves on farms very fast. People in some places cook and eat locusts as a special food.
Loft\n\nA loft is a room at the very top of a house. It is right under the roof, so the ceiling can be slanted. You often find it in old houses or big city buildings. People use it as a bedroom, a playroom, or a place to keep boxes. Sometimes you climb a ladder to get up there. It feels cozy and high up, like a secret hideout.
Log\n\nA log is a big piece of a tree that has fallen down. It is long and round, and it has rough brown bark on the outside. You can find it on the ground in a forest or a park. Sometimes people use it to sit on or to make a fire. Bugs and small animals may live inside it.
Logarithm\n\nA logarithm is a way to count how many times you multiply a number to get another number. It is like asking, "How many jumps of the same size do I need to reach a bigger number?" You can find it in math class when you are older. It helps people solve big number puzzles. For example, if you keep doubling 2, a logarithm tells you how many doublings make 8.
Logic\n\nLogic is a way of thinking that helps us know what is true and what is not. It is like a set of rules for our brain. We use it every day when we decide things. For example, if all dogs bark and your pet is a dog, then your pet barks. That is logic. It helps us put ideas in order so they make sense. Computers also use logic to work and play games.
Loire River\n\nThe Loire River is a very long, winding path of water in France. It starts in the hills in the middle of the country and flows all the way to the big, blue ocean near a city called Nantes. It is the longest river in France. Long ago, people used it to move things from one town to another on boats. Now, trains and trucks do that job instead. Many smaller rivers join it along the way, like friends holding hands. If you stand by it, you see water moving slowly, trees on the sides, and maybe a little fish jumping.
Lollipop\n\nA lollipop is a sweet candy on a stick. It is round and comes in many bright colors like red, blue, and yellow. You find it in candy stores or at parties. You hold the stick and lick the candy part until it is all gone. Some lollipops have a surprise inside, like bubble gum or a toy.
London\n\nLondon is a very big city where many people live and work. It has old buildings, tall towers, and a long river called the Thames running through it. You can find it in a country called England, across the ocean. It is the most important city there, where the king or queen sometimes stays and where leaders make rules. Big red buses and trains under the ground help people move around. A giant clock tower named Big Ben stands tall, and a huge wheel called the London Eye lets you see the whole city from up high.
London Underground\n\nThe London Underground is a train system that runs under and above the ground in London. It has many long trains that move on tracks. Some trains go through round tunnels deep under the streets. People use it to go to work, to school, or to visit fun places. You can pay with a special blue card called an Oyster card. Many stations have big moving stairs called escalators. It is one of the oldest train systems in the world.
Lonely\n\nLonely is a feeling you get when you are all by yourself and wish someone was with you. It can feel like a little ache inside your chest. You might feel it when your best friend moves away or when you are the last one picked for a game. It is okay to feel lonely sometimes. A hug, a kind word, or playing with a pet can help the feeling go away.
Long\n\nLong is when something is not short. It means there is a lot of space from one end to the other. A snake is long because its body stretches out far. A road can be long if it goes on and on. When you wait a long time, it feels like many minutes pass.
Long jump\n\nLong jump is a sport where you run and jump as far as you can. It has a long path to run on and a soft sand box to land in. You find it at a track or a big field. People run fast, then push off with one foot and fly through the air. They try to land far in the sand without falling back. A jump is good if you start before a special line on the ground.
Longevity\n\nLongevity means living for a very long time. It is about how many years a person, an animal, or a plant can stay alive. Some people try to eat healthy food and move their body to live longer. In old stories, people looked for magic water or a magic place that could help them live for many, many years. Today, doctors and scientists help people stay healthy so they can live longer, too.
Longitude\n\nLongitude is a way to tell where a place is on Earth. It uses lines that go up and down, from the top of the world to the bottom. These lines are not real; they are drawn on maps and globes. Longitude tells you how far east or west a place is from a special line called the Prime Meridian. It is measured in degrees, like a circle. Sailors long ago had a hard time knowing their longitude at sea, until better clocks were made. The lines get closer together near the North and South Poles.
Look\n\nLook means to use your eyes to see something. When you look, you turn your head and point your eyes at a thing. You can look at a book, a toy, or a friend. Looking helps you know what is around you. You can look for a long time or just a quick peek. Everyone looks many times every day.
Loom\n\nA loom is a machine that makes cloth. It has many strings that go up and down. People push other strings through them to make a flat piece of fabric. Long ago, people used small looms at home. Today, big looms in factories make clothes, blankets, and towels. You might see cloth from a loom on your bed or on your shirt.
Loon\n\nA loon is a bird that lives on water. It is about the size of a big duck. It has a black or gray head, a white chest, and striped feathers on its back. You can find it on lakes in cool places in summer. In winter, it flies to the ocean. It can dive very deep under the water to catch fish. It makes a loud, funny call that sounds like a trumpet or a laugh. It lays two eggs in a nest near the water, and both parents keep the eggs warm.
Loop\n\nA loop is a shape that goes around and around with no end. It looks like a circle or a ring. You can find a loop in a shoelace when you tie a bow. It is used to hold things together, like a belt loop on pants. A roller coaster track also has loops that go upside down.
Loose\n\nLoose means something is not tight. It can be a shirt that is too big and hangs down. It can be a tooth that wiggles and is ready to fall out. When a jar lid is loose, it is easy to open. A loose knot comes apart with a small pull.
Lord's Prayer\n\nThe Lord's Prayer is a special prayer that Christians say. It is a way to talk to God. Jesus taught this prayer to his friends a long time ago. People say it in church, at home, or before bed. It starts with the words "Our Father." Many songs use the words of this prayer.
Los Angeles\n\nLos Angeles is a big city in the state of California. It is near the ocean and has many sunny days. It has tall buildings, long beaches, and big hills. Many people live there, and they speak many different languages. It is famous for making movies and TV shows. You can see the big white Hollywood Sign on a hill. Many movie stars live there. It also has a big park where you can see animals.
Lose\n\nTo lose means you cannot find something you had before. It can be a toy, a sock, or a pet. When you lose a thing, you look around and feel sad. Sometimes you lose a game, and that means the other team wins. It is okay to lose because you can try again.
Lot\n\nA lot is a piece of land. It is a flat or empty space on the ground. You can find a lot in a town or city, often between houses or buildings. People use a lot to build a new house, plant a garden, or park cars. Sometimes a lot is just an open field where kids play or dogs run.
Lottery\n\nA lottery is a game where you pick numbers to win a prize. It is often run by a big group, like a state or a country. You buy a small paper ticket with numbers on it. Later, someone pulls out winning numbers, and if your numbers match, you get money. Many people play it, but only a few win. You might see lottery tickets at a store near the cash register.
Loud\n\nLoud means a sound is very big and strong. It can make your ears feel full or even hurt a little. You hear loud sounds when a fire truck goes by with its siren on, or when someone bangs a drum very hard. A whisper is not loud, but a shout is. Sometimes people cover their ears when something is too loud.
Loudly\n\nLoudly means making a big, strong sound. It is the way you talk or sing when your voice is high and fills the room. You might hear it when someone calls your name from far away. When a fire truck goes by, its siren rings loudly. A drum played with force sounds loudly too. Sometimes people say "shh" when a sound is too loudly.
Loudspeaker\n\nA loudspeaker is a box that makes sound. It has a round paper part inside called a cone. You find it in radios, TVs, and music players. It takes quiet electric signals and turns them into loud sounds we can hear. When you listen to a song or a story, the loudspeaker helps the sound come out big and clear.
Louis\n\nLouis is a name for a boy. It is a short name with two parts: Lou and is. You might meet a boy named Louis at school or at the park. Sometimes a king or a prince has this name. A boy named Louis can have brown hair, black hair, or blond hair. He likes to play and laugh just like other children.
Louis Armstrong\n\nLouis Armstrong was a man who played music. He played a shiny horn called a trumpet. He had a big, warm smile and a deep, happy voice. You can hear him sing and play in old songs on the radio. He made people feel good with his music.
Louis Pasteur\n\nLouis Pasteur was a man who helped keep people healthy. He found that tiny living things called germs can make us sick. He showed that heating milk kills bad germs, so we can drink it safely. He also made a way to stop sickness before it starts, like a shot at the doctor. Many people are alive today because of his work.
Lounge\n\nA lounge is a room where people sit and rest. It has soft chairs and sofas. You can find it in a house, a hotel, or an airport. People use it to talk, read, or wait. It is a calm and cozy place.
Louse\n\nA louse is a tiny bug with no wings. It has six short legs with small claws that help it hold on tight. It lives in hair, fur, or feathers of animals and people. It stays there its whole life and eats tiny bits of skin or blood. A louse egg is called a nit and sticks to hair like glue. You might see one if a grown-up checks your head with a fine comb.
Louvre\n\nThe Louvre is a big building with many old and beautiful things to see. It is in the city of Paris. Inside, you can find paintings and statues. The most famous painting is a picture of a smiling lady. There are also big stone people with no arms and stone wings. Long ago, the building was a castle for a king. Now, many people visit it every day to look at the art.
Love\n\nLove is a warm, happy feeling you have for someone very special. It feels like a big hug inside your heart. You can feel love for your mom, your dad, your pet, or your best friend. When you love someone, you want to be near them and make them smile. You might draw them a picture or share your favorite toy. Love makes you feel safe and cared for, like when you are tucked into bed at night.
Lovely\n\nLovely means something is very nice to look at or be with. It can be a pretty flower, a soft song, or a warm hug. When you see a rainbow or a cute puppy, that is lovely. It makes you feel happy and smile. People say "that is lovely" when they see something sweet or kind.
Low\n\nLow means something is close to the ground. It is the opposite of high. A small stool is low, and a tall ladder is not. You can duck under a low branch when you walk outside. A low voice is quiet and soft, like a whisper. When you play hide-and-seek, you can hide low behind a chair.
Luanda\n\nLuanda is a big city by the ocean. It is the most important city in a country called Angola. Many people live there, and big boats come to its port. Long ago, people from a faraway land built it. Today, it has many houses, streets, and markets. Some parts of the city are still broken from a long fight, but people are fixing them.
Lucky\n\nLucky is a happy feeling when something good happens. It feels like a warm smile inside. You can feel lucky when you find a shiny penny on the ground. You can also feel lucky when you get an extra cookie after dinner. Some people think a four-leaf clover brings lucky feelings. It is a nice feeling that makes you want to jump up and down.
Lucy\n\nLucy is a name for a girl. She is a person, just like you. You might meet a Lucy at school or at the park. She could have a big smile and like to play. Sometimes you see the name Lucy in a storybook.
Luge\n\nLuge is a winter sport where a person lies on a small sled and slides down an icy track. The sled is flat and has no brakes. It is found on special icy tracks made for sliding sports. People use it to race down the track as fast as they can. It is very fast and can be dangerous. You might see it on TV during the Winter Olympics.
Lullaby\n\nA lullaby is a soft, gentle song. It is slow and quiet, like a rocking chair. Moms and dads sing it to a baby at bedtime. It helps the baby feel safe and fall asleep. You may know the song "Rock-a-bye Baby" — that is a lullaby.
Lumber\n\nLumber is wood that people cut into long, flat pieces. It comes from big trees. You can see it at a store where people buy things to build houses. People use it to make walls, floors, and roofs. A common piece is called a two-by-four. It is strong and holds up a house.
Lump\n\nA lump is a small bump or a piece of something. It can be round or have funny shapes. You might find a lump in your pocket, like a ball of paper. Sometimes a lump is in food, like a bump in your mashed potatoes. It can feel hard or soft when you touch it.
Lunar\n\nLunar means something that has to do with the moon. The moon is a big, round, white light in the night sky. It changes shape over many days, from a thin smile to a full circle. When we say lunar, we talk about the moon's light or its path around the Earth. You can see the lunar light shining through your window at bedtime.
Lunar eclipse\n\nA lunar eclipse is when the moon goes into the dark shadow of the Earth. It looks big and round, but its color changes to a deep red or brown. You can see it in the night sky when the Earth moves between the sun and the moon. It is safe to look at with just your eyes, unlike a sun eclipse. A lunar eclipse can last for a few hours, and it happens about two times each year.
Lunch\n\nLunch is a meal you eat in the middle of the day. It comes after breakfast and before dinner. It can be cold, like a sandwich and an apple, or hot, like soup and rice. Many kids bring lunch to school in a box or a bag. Some people buy lunch at a shop near their work. It gives you energy to play and learn until the day is done.
Lunchbox\n\nA lunchbox is a small box that holds food. It has a lid that opens and closes to keep the food safe inside. You can find it in a school bag or a picnic basket. People use it to carry a meal to school, work, or a park. A lunchbox can be made of plastic or metal and may have a picture of a favorite animal or hero on it. Some lunchboxes have a handle so you can carry it easily.
Lunchtime\n\nLunchtime is the middle of the day when people stop to eat a meal. It happens after the morning and before the afternoon. At school, kids sit together and open lunch boxes or get a tray of food. It is a time to rest, talk with friends, and fill up your tummy. You might eat a sandwich, an apple, or some crackers. After lunchtime, you feel ready to play and learn again.
Lung\n\nA lung is a soft part inside your chest that helps you breathe. It is like two spongy bags, one on the left and one on the right. You can find it inside your body, behind your ribs. It pulls in air when you breathe in and pushes air out when you breathe out. The air has something your body needs to run and play. When you run fast, you feel your chest move because your lungs are working hard.
Lungfish\n\nA lungfish is a special kind of fish that lives in fresh water. It has both gills and lungs, so it can breathe in water and in air. It lives in small lakes and rivers that can dry up. When the water goes away, it digs into the mud and sleeps for a long time. It can stay like that for up to four years. There are only a few kinds of lungfish in the world. Some live in Africa, one lives in South America, and one lives in Australia.
Lusaka\n\nLusaka is a big city in a country called Zambia. It is the most important city there because the leaders work in it. It sits on flat, high land. Many people live in Lusaka, more than in any other city in Zambia. You can see tall buildings, busy streets, and lots of cars there.
Lute\n\nA lute is a musical instrument with strings. It has a round back made of wood strips and a flat front with a hole in the middle. You hold it by a long neck and press the strings to make different sounds. People play it by pulling the strings with their fingers. It looks a little like a guitar, but the back is round like a bowl. Long ago, people in many countries played the lute for songs and dances.
Luxembourg\n\nLuxembourg is a small country in Europe. It has no sea next to it, so it is called landlocked. The countries next to it are Belgium, Germany, and France. People there speak Luxembourgish, French, and German. It is a very old place with a big castle from long ago. Today, it is a grand duchy, which means a grand duke is the leader. Buses and trains are free for everyone to ride. Many people live close together in its towns and cities.
Lychee\n\nA lychee is a small fruit that grows in warm, wet places. It has a hard, bumpy shell on the outside that is red or pink. Inside, it is soft and white, and it tastes very sweet. You can eat it fresh or frozen, and it feels cool like ice cream. Do not eat the big brown seed in the middle, because it can make you sick.
Lynx\n\nA lynx is a wild cat. It looks a bit like a big house cat with short legs, big furry feet, and a short tail with a black tip. It has long hair on its ears that sticks up like little brushes. Its fur is brown or gray with dark spots, and it has a fluffy collar of fur around its face. A lynx lives in forests with lots of bushes and tall grass, in cold places far north or high up in the mountains. It hunts on the ground for small animals like rabbits and mice, but it can also climb trees and swim. Most of the time it stays alone, not in a big group. A baby lynx is called a kitten, and it stays with its mom for many months before going off on its own.
Lyon\n\nLyon is a big city in the country of France. It sits where two rivers meet. Many people live there, and it is one of the largest cities in the country. You can find old buildings and a big park in the middle of the city. People in Lyon like to play soccer and other sports. A long time ago, it had a different name.
Lyre\n\nA lyre is a musical instrument that makes soft, pretty sounds. It has a hollow body, two arms that curve up, and a bar across the top. Strings are stretched from the top bar down to the body. You hold it in one hand and use your other hand to pull the strings. When you pull a string, it shakes and makes a sound. A lyre looks a little like a small harp. Long, long ago, people in faraway lands played it while they sang songs or told stories. Today, you might see one in a picture book about old times.
Lyrebird\n\nA lyrebird is a bird that lives on the ground in forests far away. It has brown feathers and a long tail that can open like a fan. It lives in wet, green woods in a place called Australia. It can copy many sounds it hears, like other birds singing, a car horn, or even a camera click. The boy lyrebird sings and shows his tail to get a girl lyrebird to like him. The girl builds a messy nest low to the ground and sits on one egg for a very long time until a baby bird comes out.
Maasai\n\nThe Maasai are a group of people who live in Africa. They are very tall and slim. They wear bright red cloth and pretty beads. They live in houses made of sticks and mud. The men take care of cows, and the cows are very important to them. They drink milk from the cows every day. The Maasai live near big parks where wild animals like lions and elephants walk free.
Macadamia nut\n\nA macadamia nut is a small, round nut that grows on a tree. It has a very hard brown shell. Inside, the soft part is creamy white and tastes buttery. People eat it as a snack after it is cooked. It is also put into cookies and cakes. The tree first grew in Australia, where it is warm and wet. You should never give it to a dog because it can make a dog sick.
Macaque\n\nA macaque is a kind of monkey. It has fur, a long tail, and a face with two eyes, a nose, and a mouth. Macaques live in warm places like Africa and Asia. They stay together in big groups and have a leader. They eat fruits and berries. Sometimes a macaque takes food from another one if it is the boss. People study them to learn about how eyes work.
Macau\n\nMacau is a small city by the sea in China. It has tall buildings, bright lights, and many people living close together. A long time ago, people from a faraway country called Portugal lived there. Today, many visitors go to Macau to play games of chance in big, fancy houses called casinos. You can also see old stone streets and eat yummy egg tarts that came from the Portuguese way of cooking.
Machete\n\nA machete is a big, long knife. It has a flat, sharp metal part and a handle to hold. People use it in hot, thick forests to cut through plants and vines. It can also open a hard coconut or cut down a small tree. Some machetes have a saw edge on the back. It is bigger than a kitchen knife and very strong.
Machine\n\nA machine is a tool that helps people do work. It can be big or small. Some machines have parts that move, like a bicycle. Other machines do not move, like a phone. People use machines every day to make jobs easier.
Machu Picchu\n\nMachu Picchu is a very old city made of stone. It sits high up on a mountain in a country called Peru. Long ago, people called the Incas built it. They cut big rocks to make flat places for houses, steps, and a place to look at stars. Today, people from all over the world go to see it. They can walk up a long path or ride a train to get there. It is one of the most special old places on Earth.
Mackerel\n\nA mackerel is a kind of fish that lives in the big, wide sea. It has a long, shiny body with dark stripes on its back. Its tail looks like a deep V shape. It swims very fast in the water. Bigger fish and animals like sharks eat it. People catch it to eat, but they must cook it very soon after catching it. You might see it at a fish store or on a dinner plate.
Macroeconomics\n\nMacroeconomics is the study of how money works for a whole country. It looks at big things like how many people have jobs, how much things cost, and how much the country makes. You cannot see it in one place, but you feel it when prices go up or when grown-ups talk about jobs. It helps leaders decide how to keep the country's money safe and growing.
Mad\n\nMad is a strong feeling you get when something is not fair or when someone is mean. It can make your face feel hot and your hands want to squeeze tight. You might feel mad when a friend takes your toy without asking. When you are mad, it helps to take a deep breath or talk to a grown-up. Everyone feels mad sometimes, and it is okay.
Madagascar\n\nMadagascar is a big island in the ocean near Africa. It has many trees, beaches, and hills. Many animals live there that you cannot find anywhere else, like funny lemurs that jump in trees. People grow vanilla and coffee on the land. Some forests are cut down, so the animals lose their homes. Many people visit to see the special animals and plants.
Madam\n\nMadam is a polite word for a woman. You say it when you do not know her name, like when you meet a new teacher or a friend's mom. It is a kind way to talk to a grown-up lady. You might hear it in a store when someone says, "Excuse me, madam." It is like saying "sir" for a man.
Madrid\n\nMadrid is a big city in the country of Spain. It is the most important city in Spain, where the king and the government work. It has many old and new buildings, big parks, and art museums. People who live there are called madrileños. Many people visit Madrid to see the big palace, the pretty squares, and the famous football teams. It is a busy place with lots of shops and places to eat.
Madurai\n\nMadurai is a big city in a country called India. It has many old and pretty buildings. One famous place is a big temple with a thousand stone pillars. Many people visit the city to see the temple and join happy festivals. The city is also known for sweet-smelling white flowers called jasmine. Some people call it the city that never sleeps because the streets are busy even at night.
Magazine\n\nA magazine is a thin book with a soft cover. It has many pages with bright pictures and words. A new one comes out every week or every month. You can find it at a store or get it in the mail. It tells stories about one big idea, like animals, cars, or cooking. Some have a small toy or a sticker inside. A grown-up might read it while waiting at the doctor's office.
Magellanic Clouds\n\nThe Magellanic Clouds are two big groups of stars far away in space. They look like fuzzy, glowing patches in the night sky. You can only see them from the bottom half of the world, where it is warm. They move around our own big star group, the Milky Way. One cloud is bigger and one is smaller. They are made of gas and many, many stars. Some stars inside them are very young and bright.
Magic\n\nMagic is when something happens that seems like a trick. It can make things look like they float or change color. You might see it at a birthday party when a person pulls a coin from behind your ear. It is not real, but it is fun to watch. Sometimes people in stories use magic to fly or make things grow big.
Magic (illusion)\n\nMagic is a show where someone does tricks that look impossible. It is done by a person called a magician. The magician might pull a bunny out of a hat or make a coin vanish. You can see it at a party or on a stage. It is fun to watch because your eyes think they see something that cannot really happen.
Magma\n\nMagma is hot, melted rock deep under the ground. It is so hot that it glows red or orange. Sometimes it has tiny bits of hard rock and gas bubbles inside. When a volcano opens, it can push up and spill out. Then people call it lava. Lava cools down and turns into hard, dark stone. Deep under the ground, it can cool very slowly and make shiny rocks with spots. You can see pictures of it in books about volcanoes.
Magnet\n\nA magnet is a special piece of metal. It can pull some things close or push them away. It has two ends called a north side and a south side. When the same sides face each other, it pushes away. When different sides face each other, it pulls together. You can find a magnet on a fridge door holding up a drawing. Some magnets are in toys that stick to each other. A compass has a tiny magnet that always points north to help people find their way.
Magnetic field\n\nA magnetic field is a special space around a magnet. It is invisible, but it can push or pull on some things. You can see what it looks like by putting tiny bits of iron near a magnet. The bits line up in curved lines around it. The closer the lines are, the stronger the push or pull. A big magnet has a strong field that can pick up heavy metal things. A small magnet has a weak field. The Earth also has a big magnetic field. That is why a compass needle always points north.
Magnetism\n\nMagnetism is a hidden push or pull. It can pull some metal things close, or push other magnets away. You can see it when a magnet sticks to a fridge. It also makes a compass needle point north. Big magnets can even lift heavy cars.
Magnificent\n\nMagnificent means something is very, very beautiful or big and grand. It is a word you use when you see something that makes you say "wow!" A rainbow after the rain can be magnificent. A tall castle with shiny towers can be magnificent. When you see a huge, colorful firework in the sky, that is magnificent too.
Magnify\n\nMagnify means to make something look bigger. You can do it with a special glass called a magnifying glass. It has a round piece of glass that bends light. When you hold it over a tiny bug or a small letter, it looks much larger. A magnifying glass helps you see things that are too small for your eyes alone.
Maharashtra\n\nMaharashtra is a big place in the west part of India. It has a long coast next to a big sea. Many people live there, and they speak a language called Marathi. The biggest city is Mumbai, where you can see tall buildings and the sea. People in Maharashtra eat yummy food like a spicy potato snack called vada pav. They also celebrate a happy festival for ten days with music and dancing. You can find old caves with paintings on the walls and big strong forts on hills.
Mahatma Gandhi\n\nMahatma Gandhi was a man from India. He was thin and wore simple white clothes and round glasses. He lived a long time ago and helped people in his country. He taught that fighting with words is better than fighting with fists. Many people loved him and called him a great soul.
Mahayana\n\nMahayana is a big group of people who follow a kind of teaching. It started a long time ago in a faraway land. People in this group try to be kind and help others feel happy. They read old stories and sit quietly to think. You can see them in special houses with colorful flags and calm faces.
Mahjong\n\nMahjong is a game played with small tiles. It is usually played by four people sitting around a square table. Each person picks up tiles and tries to make sets that match. The game needs thinking and a little luck. You can also play a simpler version by yourself on a computer. In that version, you take away two matching tiles at a time until all the tiles are gone.
Mahogany\n\nMahogany is a kind of wood that comes from a tall tree. It is hard and strong, and it has a pretty red-brown color. People find the tree in warm places near the sea, like islands with sun and sand. A long time ago, people used it to build big boats because it does not break easily. Later, they made chairs, tables, and beds from it. You may see a shiny brown table at home that is made of this wood.
Mail\n\nMail is a letter or a small box that someone sends to you. It has your name and address on the front. A person brings it to your house and puts it in a box by the door. You can also send mail to a friend by putting it in a big blue box on the street. Before you send it, you stick a small paper stamp on it. That stamp is like a ticket that pays for the trip. Mail can bring a birthday card, a note from Grandma, or a toy from a store.
Mailbox\n\nA mailbox is a box where you put letters. It stands on a post near the road or hangs on a wall. It has a little door so the mail carrier can take the letters out. When you want to send a letter to a friend, you put it inside and lift the red flag up. The mail carrier comes in a truck and takes the letter away. Some mailboxes are blue and sit on the street corner for everyone to use.
Mailman\n\nA mailman is a person who brings letters and boxes to your house. He wears a blue or brown uniform and carries a big bag. You can see him walking on the street or driving a small truck. He puts mail in a box near your door. Sometimes he brings a birthday card or a fun surprise. He works even when it is rainy or cold.
Main\n\nA main is the biggest or most important part of something. It is like the big road in a town where all the cars go. You can find the main door of a house, which is the one people use the most. When you eat, the main food is the biggest part of your meal, like the sandwich, not the chips. At a playground, the main slide is the tallest one that all the kids want to try.
Maize\n\nMaize is a tall plant that grows seeds on a big stick called a cob. It has long green leaves and a thick stem. The seeds, called kernels, are small and yellow, but they can also be white, red, or blue. Farmers grow maize in big fields where the sun is warm. People cook and eat the sweet kernels right off the cob. They also pop the kernels to make popcorn, or grind them into flour for bread and flat cakes. Many animals like cows and chickens eat maize as their food too.
Make\n\nTo make is to put things together to get something new. When you use blocks to build a tall tower, you make a tower. You can make a picture with paper and crayons. A cook makes food in the kitchen. A bee makes honey from flower juice. Making is fun because you start with little parts and end with a whole thing.
Maker\n\nA maker is a person who builds or creates things with their hands. He uses tools like hammers, scissors, or glue to put pieces together. You can find a maker in a workshop, a kitchen, or even at a school art table. He might make toys, fix a broken chair, or bake a cake. When you build a tower with blocks or draw a picture, you are a maker too.
Malaria\n\nMalaria is a sickness caused by tiny bugs that get into your blood. It makes you feel very hot and cold, and your body shakes. The bug comes from a mosquito bite. The mosquito carries the bug in its spit and puts it into you when it bites. Only girl mosquitoes bite people. Malaria happens a lot in hot places far away, like Africa. Many children get sick from it. Doctors can give medicine to help, but it is hard to stop all the mosquitoes.
Malawi\n\nMalawi is a country in Africa. It is a small, warm place with a big lake called Lake Malawi. Many people there grow food like corn and beans to eat and sell. It has green hills and flat fields where animals like zebras live. Children in Malawi go to school and play games like soccer.
Malay\n\nMalay is a group of people who live in a part of the world called Southeast Asia. They have brown skin and dark hair. Many of them live in a country named Malaysia, and some live in nearby places like Indonesia and Singapore. They speak a language also called Malay. They eat yummy food like rice with fish and spicy sauce. Some Malay people wear colorful clothes for special days.
Malay Archipelago\n\nThe Malay Archipelago is a big group of islands in the warm ocean. It sits between two very big lands called Asia and Australia. It has more than 25,000 islands, which is a lot. Some of the islands are very big, and some are tiny. You can find countries like Indonesia and the Philippines there. Many islands have tall mountains that can spit out hot, red fire. The water around the islands is full of colorful fish and coral. A long time ago, a man named Wallace went there to look at all the different animals and plants.
Malay Language\n\nMalay Language is a way people talk and write. It is used in countries like Malaysia and Indonesia. Many children learn it at home and at school. It sounds soft and has words like 'selamat pagi,' which means 'good morning.' You can hear it in songs and stories from those places.
Malay Peninsula\n\nThe Malay Peninsula is a long, thin piece of land with water on three sides. It is in a part of the world called Southeast Asia. It has thick green forests and tall hills. Many people live there in towns and villages. Some grow rice and some fish in the sea. You can see it on a map as a long shape that points south.
Malaysia\n\nMalaysia is a country in a warm part of the world called Southeast Asia. It has two big pieces of land with blue sea between them. You can see a flag with stripes and a yellow star. Many different people live there, and they speak many languages. People in Malaysia eat yummy rice and noodle dishes. Some famous buildings there are very tall twin towers. It is a place with green forests and many animals.
Maldives\n\nMaldives is a country made of many small islands in the big blue ocean. It has white sand and clear water. Many fish and colorful coral live under the water. People go there to swim and play on the beach. It is very flat and warm all year. Some islands have houses and shops, but many are empty. Boats and planes take people from one island to another.
Male\n\nMale means a boy or a man. A male has a body that is different from a female body. Most boys and men have a deeper voice and hair on their face when they grow up. You can see males in your family, like your dad or your brother. In many animal families, the male is bigger or has brighter colors, like a rooster with a red comb.
Mali\n\nMali is a big country in Africa. It has no ocean next to it, so it is called landlocked. Much of the north is a hot, sandy desert called the Sahara. In the south, a long river called the Niger River gives water to plants and people. Many people in Mali grow food like cotton and fish in the river. The biggest city is Bamako, where many people live and work.
Mali Empire\n\nThe Mali Empire was a big kingdom in Africa a long time ago. It had a strong king who kept people safe. Many people there sold gold and salt. It was in a hot place with big rivers and sandy land. Long ago, children there learned stories from their parents.
Mall\n\nA mall is a big building with many small shops inside. It has a long, wide path where people walk from one shop to another. Each shop has its own door and walls. You can find a mall in most towns and cities. People go there to buy clothes, toys, and food. Many malls have a big room with tables and chairs where you can eat. Some malls also have a movie theater. Outside, there is a big parking lot for cars.
Mallard\n\nA mallard is a kind of duck. It has a big body and a wide, flat bill. The boy mallard has a shiny green head and a yellow bill. The girl mallard is brown with an orange bill. It lives near water like ponds, lakes, and rivers. You can see it in parks and even in cities. It swims on the water and looks for food with its bill.
Malta\n\nMalta is a small country made of islands in the big blue sea. It is near a bigger island called Sicily. The main city is Valletta, and many people live close together there. People in Malta speak Maltese and English. Long ago, brave knights lived on the island and built big stone walls. Today, people visit Malta to see the warm sun and old buildings.
Mama\n\nA mama is a person who takes care of a child. She is the grown-up who gave birth to you or who loves you like a mom. She might have soft hands and a warm smile. You can find her at home, cooking food or reading a book. She gives hugs, kisses, and helps you when you are sad. A mama is someone you can always count on.
Mamba\n\nA mamba is a long, thin snake that moves very fast. It has smooth scales and a narrow head. It lives in Africa, mostly up in trees, but one kind stays on the ground. It hunts during the day for birds, lizards, and small furry animals. It has strong poison in its bite that can make people very sick. When it feels scared, it may open its mouth wide and spread a small hood. It usually stays away from people if it can.
Mammal\n\nA mammal is a warm animal with fur or hair on its body. It has a backbone inside, and it breathes air with lungs. Most mammals grow inside the mom and are born alive. The mom makes milk to feed the baby. You can find mammals in many places—on land, in water, and in the air. A dog, a cat, a cow, and a whale are all mammals. Even you are a mammal!
Mammoth\n\nA mammoth is a big animal that looks like an elephant. It had long, thick hair all over its body to keep warm. It also had two very long, curved tusks that grew from its mouth. Mammoths lived a long, long time ago when much of the land was cold and icy. They are not alive today. People have found their bones and even whole bodies frozen in ice. Early people used sharp sticks to hunt them for food.
Man\n\nA man is a grown-up boy. He is taller and bigger than a child. You can see men at home, at work, or at the park. A man can be a dad, an uncle, or a grandpa. He helps take care of his family and does many jobs. Some men have short hair and some have long hair. A man's voice is often deep and low.
Manage\n\nTo manage is to take care of something and make sure it works well. When you manage your toys, you put them back in the box so the room stays tidy. A grown-up might manage a store by helping people and keeping the shelves full. It means you are the boss of that thing for a little while.
Management\n\nManagement is when someone helps a group of people work together. It is like being the leader of a team. A manager makes sure everyone knows what to do. They also check that the work gets done the right way. You can see management at a store, a school, or a big company. The boss at a pizza shop uses management to make sure the pizzas are hot and the customers are happy.
Managua\n\nManagua is a big city. It is the most important city in a country called Nicaragua. It sits next to a very big lake. Many people live there and speak Spanish. The city has had big shakes from the ground, so many old houses are gone. People use big statues and parks to tell others where to go.
Mancala\n\nMancala is a game played with a board and small seeds. It has a board with little round holes in two rows. People play it in Africa, the Middle East, and parts of Asia. You pick up seeds from one hole and drop them one by one into other holes. The goal is to collect more seeds than the other player. It is an old game that many families play together.
Manchester\n\nManchester is a big city in England. It has many houses, shops, and tall buildings made of red bricks. You can find it in the north of England, not far from hills and rivers. Many people live there and work in offices or stores. It has two famous football teams that play with a round ball. Trains and buses help people move around the city. Some parts have parks where you can run and play.
Manchuria\n\nManchuria is a big piece of land in the northeast part of China. It has wide fields, tall hills, and some deserts. The weather there is very hot in summer and very cold in winter. Long ago, a group of people called the Manchu lived there and later ruled all of China. Today, most of it is part of China, but a small piece belongs to Russia. Many people there grow food on farms.
Mandarin Chinese\n\nMandarin Chinese is a way of talking that many people use. It is the main talk of China and Taiwan. Over 800 million people speak it, more than any other talk in the world. It sounds like the talk from Beijing, the big city in China. People learn it in school so everyone can understand each other. It is written with little pictures called characters. Each picture stands for a word or an idea. You may see these pictures on signs or in books from China.
Mandarin orange\n\nA mandarin orange is a small, sweet fruit. It is round and has a bright orange skin that is easy to peel with your fingers. You can find it in stores or at markets. People eat it as a snack or put it in fruit salads. It is full of good things that help your body stay strong. Inside, it breaks into little pieces that do not make a mess. Some people also give it as a gift during a happy new year time.
Mandolin\n\nA mandolin is a small music tool that makes pretty sounds. It looks like a tiny guitar with a round wooden body and a long neck. You hold it in your hands and pluck the strings with a pick to make music. It has eight strings that sound bright and happy, like a little bell. People play it in bands with other music tools, and you might hear it in songs from faraway lands.
Mane\n\nA mane is the long hair that grows around the neck of some animals. It looks thick and fluffy, like a big scarf made of fur. You can see it on a lion, and sometimes on a horse. It makes the animal look big and strong. A lion's mane can be brown, gold, or even dark black.
Manga\n\nManga is a kind of book with lots of pictures and words. It comes from Japan. You read it from the back to the front, and the pictures and words go from right to left. The people who draw manga use special marks to show feelings, like big eyes for surprise or sweat drops for being nervous. Many manga stories are about kids with big dreams, funny animals, or brave heroes. Sometimes a manga becomes a cartoon on TV.
Mango\n\nA mango is a sweet fruit that grows on a tree. It has smooth skin that can be green, yellow, or red. Inside, it has soft, juicy orange-yellow flesh and a big flat seed in the middle. You can find mangoes in warm places like India and parts of Africa. People eat it fresh, cut into pieces, or in drinks and desserts. When it is not ripe, it tastes very sour. When it is ripe, it is soft and sweet. You might see mangoes at the store or in a fruit bowl at home.
Mangrove\n\nA mangrove is a tree that grows in warm, salty water near the sea. It has long, twisty roots that stick up out of the mud like fingers. You can find it in hot places where the water meets the land. Its roots help clean the water and give small fish and crabs a safe place to live. When its seed falls, it can float away and grow into a new tree far from the first one.
Manila\n\nManila is a big city in the Philippines. It sits next to a wide blue bay. It has many tall buildings and busy streets. People live and work there. It is the most important city in the country. Long ago, big walls and old stone forts were built there. You can still see them today. Many people visit a big green park with flowers and a tall statue.
Manioc\n\nManioc is a plant with a big white root that people eat. It has tall green stems and large leaves. It grows in hot, sunny places near the middle of the Earth. The root must be washed, peeled, and cooked before anyone can eat it. People boil it, fry it, or bake it to make soft food. They also turn it into flour for bread and cakes. Some people cook the leaves and eat them like a green vegetable. It gives the body energy and helps you grow strong.
Mansa Musa\n\nMansa Musa was a king from a land called Mali. He lived a long, long time ago. He had so much gold that he was one of the richest people ever. When he went on a big trip, he gave away gold to many people. He also built big schools and pretty buildings. People still tell stories about him today.
Mansion\n\nA mansion is a very big, fancy house. It has many rooms, like bedrooms, bathrooms, and a big kitchen. You can find it in a nice neighborhood or on a big piece of land. Rich people or important families often live in it. It might have a big garden, a pool, or even a playroom inside. Some mansions look like small castles with tall doors and shiny windows.
Manta ray\n\nA manta ray is a big, flat fish that lives in warm ocean water. It has wide, triangle-shaped fins that look like wings. It swims by moving its fins up and down, like a bird flying in water. It eats tiny sea animals by opening its big mouth while it swims. Sometimes it jumps out of the water and splashes back down. You can see it in pictures of the ocean or at a big aquarium.
Mantis\n\nA mantis is a kind of bug. It has a long body, six legs, and big eyes on a head that can turn far around. Its front legs are bent and have little spikes, so it looks like it is saying a quiet prayer. It lives in warm places with lots of plants. It sits very still and waits for a smaller bug to come close. Then it grabs the bug fast with those front legs and eats it. A mantis can be green or brown to hide on a leaf or a stick. You might see one in a garden or a park.
Mantra\n\nA mantra is a special group of words or sounds. It can be a short song or a few soft noises. People say it out loud or think it quietly inside their head. They use it when they sit still and pray or when they want to feel calm. Some people believe it brings good things like health and happiness.
Manufacture\n\nManufacture is when people make things. It happens in big buildings called factories. Workers use tools and machines to turn stuff like wood, metal, or plastic into toys, clothes, or cars. You can see things that were made this way all around you, like your chair or your cup.
Manufacturing\n\nManufacturing is making things from stuff we find in nature. It happens in big buildings called factories. Inside, machines cut, shape, and put parts together. People also help the machines work. Many things you use every day come from manufacturing, like your toy car, your cup, and your chair. Long ago, people made things slowly with their hands. Now, machines make them fast so we can have many of them.
Many\n\nMany means a big number of things. When you have many toys, your toy box is very full. You can see many stars in the sky at night. Many friends can come to your birthday party. It is the opposite of a few.
Map\n\nA map is a picture of a place. It shows where things are, like roads, rivers, and houses. You can find it on paper or on a phone. It helps people know how to go from one place to another. A map of your town might show your school and the park.
Map projection\n\nA map projection is a way to draw the big round Earth on flat paper. It is like peeling an orange and trying to make the peel lie flat. The picture always gets a little stretched or squished. Map makers pick the kind of stretching that works best for each map. Some maps show the whole world, and some show just one country.
Maple\n\nA maple is a kind of tree. It has wide leaves with pointy tips. You can find it in parks, yards, and forests. In fall, its leaves turn bright red, orange, or yellow. Some maple trees give sweet sap that people turn into syrup for pancakes. The tree also grows seeds with little wings that spin like toy helicopters when they fall.
Marathon\n\nA marathon is a very long running race. It is so long that people run for many miles without stopping. Many cities have a marathon once a year, and lots of runners come to try it. Before the race, runners practice by running a little bit more each day. The race was named after a very old story about a man who ran a long way to bring happy news. Today, people run a marathon to show they are strong and to have fun with friends.
Marble\n\nA marble is a small, round ball that children use for games. It is hard and smooth, and it can be made of glass, clay, or stone. You can find marbles in toy stores or at home in a bag or box. Children roll marbles on the floor or shoot them with their fingers to play. Some marbles are clear like glass, and some have colorful swirls inside. A big, shiny stone used for statues and buildings is also called marble, but that is a different thing.
Marble (toy)\n\nA marble is a small, round toy. It is often made of glass and feels smooth and cool in your hand. You can find it in many bright colors, and some have a little swirl inside. Kids play games with it by rolling it on the ground and trying to hit other marbles. You might see a marble in a toy store or in a jar at a friend's house.
March\n\nMarch is the third month of the year. It has 31 days. In many places, the weather starts to get warmer in March. Snow melts, and little green plants begin to grow. Sometimes the wind blows hard, and it can rain a lot. You might see early flowers like yellow daffodils. At the end of March, the days get longer and the sun stays up later.
Margarine\n\nMargarine is a soft food that looks like butter. It is made from plant oil or animal fat. People spread it on bread or use it for baking cookies and cakes. It has less fat than butter, so some people pick it instead. You can find it in a tub at the grocery store near the butter.
Margin\n\nA margin is the empty space around the words or pictures on a page. It is like a quiet, blank border. You can see it in a storybook, where the words stay in the middle and the white part near the edge is the margin. It gives your eyes a rest and makes the page look neat. When you draw a picture, leaving a margin keeps your drawing from touching the edge of the paper.
Maria\n\nMaria is a name for a girl. It is a pretty name that many people use in different countries. You might meet a Maria at school or at the park. She could be a friend who likes to play and share toys. Some songs and stories have a girl named Maria in them.
Mariana Trench\n\nThe Mariana Trench is a very deep crack in the ocean floor. It is the deepest place on Earth. It is long and narrow, like a big ditch under the sea. The water there is very heavy and pushes down hard. Only a few small boats have gone all the way down. At the bottom, it is dark and cold. Some tiny soft animals live there, like little worms and see-through bugs. One part of it is called the Challenger Deep, and that is the deepest spot of all.
Marie\n\nMarie is a name for a girl. It sounds soft and pretty. Many girls and women have this name. You might meet a Marie at school or in a storybook. Some famous people are named Marie, like a scientist who found new things. A Marie can be a friend, a mom, or a teacher.
Marie Curie\n\nMarie Curie was a scientist who lived a long time ago. She worked with special rocks that gave off a hidden light. She found two new things in those rocks, and people called them radium and polonium. Her work helped doctors see inside a person's body. She won two big prizes for her smart work.
Marine\n\nMarine means something that lives in or belongs to the sea. It is the big, salty water that covers much of the Earth. Many animals like fish, whales, and crabs are marine animals. You can see marine life at the beach or in a big tank called an aquarium. The sea is very deep and blue, and it is home to many creatures.
Mark\n\nA mark is a small spot or line you can see on something. It can be a dot, a scratch, or a little color that was not there before. You might find it on paper, on a wall, or on your skin. Sometimes you make a mark with a crayon or a pen when you draw. A smudge on a window is a mark too. If you spill juice on your shirt, it leaves a mark. You can try to clean it with water and soap.
Marker\n\nA marker is a tool for drawing and writing. It has a soft tip that holds colored ink. You can find markers at school, at home, or in an art box. People use it to make bright lines on paper, a whiteboard, or a poster. A marker comes in many colors like red, blue, green, and yellow. Some markers have a smell, like fruit or flowers. When you draw with it, the color stays on the paper and dries fast.
Market\n\nA market is a place where people buy and sell things. It can be a big building or an open space with small tents called stalls. You can find it in a town or a city. People go there to get food, toys, clothes, and many other things. A farmer may sell apples, and a baker may sell bread. Some markets are only open on certain days. When you go, you can see many colors and hear people talking. It is a busy, happy place.
Marketing\n\nMarketing is how people tell others about things to buy. It is like a big sign that says, "Look at this toy!" or a fun video that shows a new snack. It helps you know what is at the store. When a company makes a new thing, they use marketing so you will want it. You see marketing on TV, on the computer, and on big pictures outside.
Marlin\n\nA marlin is a big fish that lives in the ocean. It has a long, thin body and a very sharp nose that looks like a stick. It also has a tall fin on its back that stands up like a flag. It swims very, very fast in the water. People sometimes catch a marlin with a fishing rod, but they often let it go back into the sea. Some people cook and eat it, but that is not very common.
Marriage\n\nMarriage is when two grown-ups promise to be a family together. It often happens in a big party with flowers and a cake. The two people say they will love and help each other for their whole lives. Sometimes they wear special rings to show their promise. After marriage, they may live in the same house and have children. In some places, a man can marry more than one woman, but most of the time it is just two people. Some marriages happen in a church or temple, and some happen in a big building called a city hall. Two men or two women can also get married in many countries. A marriage is a way to show that two people care about each other very much.
Married\n\nMarried means two grown-ups love each other and promise to stay together. They have a big party with a cake and flowers. After the party, they live in the same house. They help each other every day. Sometimes they have children and become a mom and dad.
Marry\n\nMarry is when two grown-ups promise to be a family together. They stand in front of friends and say special words. After that, they live in the same house and help each other every day. Sometimes they wear pretty rings on their fingers to show the promise. You might see a marry party with flowers, cake, and dancing.
Mars\n\nMars is a planet that goes around the Sun. It is the fourth one from the Sun. It looks red in the night sky. It is made of rocks and red dust. The red color comes from rusty bits in the ground. It has two tiny moons that spin around it. It has the biggest mountain of all the planets. The mountain is much taller than any mountain on Earth. It also has a very long, deep crack in the ground, like a giant valley. It is very cold there because it is far from the Sun. The air is thin and not good for people to breathe. It has white caps of ice at the top and bottom. Long ago, water may have flowed on the ground. People send robots to look at it and take pictures. Some day, people might go there to visit.
Mars (mythology)\n\nMars is a strong god from old Roman stories. He is the god of war, which means fighting and battles. People long ago thought he liked loud fights and red blood. They named a big red star in the sky after him — the planet Mars. They also named the month of March after him. In some stories, he is the dad of two boys who built a great city.
Marseille\n\nMarseille is a big city in the south of France. It sits next to the blue sea and has a very large port where big boats come and go. It is one of the oldest cities in France, started by people who came on boats long ago. Many people live there, and the sun shines hot in the summer. You can see boats, old stone houses, and busy streets full of life.
Marsh\n\nA marsh is a wet, soft piece of land. It has tall grass and other green plants that grow in shallow water. You can find it near a lake, a river, or the ocean. The water in it can be fresh like a pond or salty like the sea. Many animals live there — frogs hop in the mud, birds build nests in the tall grass, and fish swim in the water. A marsh is not the same as a swamp, because a swamp has big trees and deeper water.
Marshall Islands\n\nThe Marshall Islands is a country made of many small islands. It sits in the big blue ocean far away. Many people live on these islands, and some have moved to a place called Arkansas in America. They love to dance, sing, and eat together with family. Once a year, they have a big party to see old friends and share their island songs and food.
Marsupial\n\nA marsupial is a kind of animal that has a pouch. It is a mammal, so it has warm blood and fur. It lives mostly in Australia and nearby islands, but one kind lives in America. It carries its tiny baby in the pouch, where the baby drinks milk and grows. A kangaroo is a marsupial you might see in a zoo or a book.
Marten\n\nA marten is a small wild animal with soft brown fur. It has a long body, short legs, a bushy tail, and a pointy face. It lives in forests in cold places like Canada and Europe. It climbs trees very well because its claws can go in and out like a cat's claws. It comes out at night to find food. It eats mice, squirrels, bugs, and sometimes berries. A baby marten is called a kit.
Martial\n\nMartial is a word that means about fighting or war. It is not a thing you can touch. You might hear it in a story about brave fighters. Some people learn martial arts to move their body in strong, fast ways. It is not for real fighting but for practice and fun.
Martial arts\n\nMartial arts are ways of moving your body to stay safe and strong. It has kicks, punches, and throws. You can find it in a gym or a big room with soft mats. People use it to protect themselves and to get fit. Karate is one kind you may see in a movie or a class.
Martin\n\nMartin is a name for a boy or a man. It is a short name that is easy to say. You might meet a Martin at school, at the park, or in a storybook. A Martin can be tall or short, with any color hair. He likes to play and laugh, just like you. Sometimes a Martin has a pet or a favorite toy. If you know a Martin, you can call him by his name when you want to play.
Martin Luther\n\nMartin Luther was a man who lived a long time ago. He was a teacher and a leader in a church. He saw some things in the church that he thought were not fair. He wrote down his ideas and shared them with many people. This started a big change in how some people thought about God. He helped make a new kind of church that many people still go to today.
Mary\n\nMary is a name for a girl. It is a short name with four letters. Many girls and women have this name. You might know a Mary at school or in your family. A Mary can be a friend, a sister, or a mom.
Mary Wollstonecraft\n\nMary Wollstonecraft was a woman who lived a long time ago. She wrote a book that said girls and boys should learn the same things. She believed women are just as smart as men. Many people read her words and started to think in new ways.
Mary, mother of Jesus\n\nMary is the mother of Jesus. She was a kind young woman who lived a long time ago. An angel came to her and said she would have a special baby. She gave birth to Jesus in a place where animals sleep, because there was no room anywhere else. She took care of Jesus when he was little. Many people love Mary and remember her in stories and songs.
Mascot\n\nA mascot is a person, animal, or thing that stands for a group. It is often a fun character that brings good luck. You can see it at a school, a sports game, or on a box of food. It dances, waves, and makes people smile. Some mascots are big fluffy animals, and some are small like a lizard. A mascot helps everyone feel like one big team.
Mask\n\nA mask is something you wear on your face. It can cover all of your face or just part of it, like your nose and mouth. You might see a mask at a doctor's office or on a woodworker to keep tiny bits out of the nose. Some masks are for fun, like at a party, and some keep you safe from bad air. A hockey player wears a mask to stop a fast puck from hurting the face. Long ago, people used masks in plays and dances to look like spirits.
Masonry\n\nMasonry is a way of building things with small blocks. It uses blocks like bricks or stones and a sticky paste called mortar to hold them together. You can see it in walls of houses, schools, and big old buildings. A brick wall is one kind of masonry. It is very strong and can last for a long, long time.
Mass\n\nMass is how much stuff is in a thing. A big rock has more mass than a small rock. It is not the same as weight. Weight changes if you go to the moon, but mass stays the same. You can feel mass when you push a toy car. A heavy car is harder to push than a light one. That is because it has more mass. Everything you can touch has mass. Even a tiny ant has a little bit of mass.
Mass media\n\nMass media is a way to send news and stories to many people at once. It includes things like TV, radio, books, and the internet. You can see it on a screen at home or hear it in the car. It tells you what is happening far away or shows you fun shows. For example, when you watch cartoons on TV, that is mass media.
Mass production\n\nMass production is making many things that are all the same. It happens in a big building called a factory. Workers and machines each do one small job over and over. This way, they can make lots of things very fast. For example, a toy car you get at the store was made this way. Many toy cars come out looking just alike.
Mastiff\n\nA Mastiff is a very big kind of dog. It has a wide body, strong legs, and a big head with soft wrinkles on its face. It can be as heavy as a grown-up person. Many people keep it at home to be a friend and to watch over the family. It is calm and gentle with people it knows. It can be a good guard dog and will stand between its family and someone who seems scary. A Mastiff learns slowly, so it needs kind and patient teaching when it is a puppy.
Mat\n\nA mat is a flat piece of soft or rough stuff. It can be made of cloth, rubber, or straw. You find it on the floor in front of a door. People wipe their shoes on it so dirt stays outside. Some mats are in the bathroom to step on after a bath. A mat can also be a small rug where a pet sleeps.
Match\n\nA match is a small stick that makes fire. It has a colored tip on one end. You find it in a small box in the kitchen or a drawer. When you rub the tip on a rough side, it makes a tiny flame. People use it to light candles or a campfire. You must be very careful because fire is hot and can hurt.
Mate\n\nMate is a name for a boy. He is a person, like a friend or a classmate. You might meet a boy named Mate at school or at the park. He can play games, share toys, and laugh with you. Some boys named Mate have dark hair, and some have light hair. He is just like any other boy you know.
Material\n\nMaterial is what something is made of. It can be soft like a blanket or hard like a rock. You can see it all around you every day. Your shirt is made of a material called cloth. Your cup might be made of a material called plastic. A spoon can be made of a material called metal. When you touch something, you feel its material.
Math\n\nMath is about numbers, shapes, and patterns. It helps you count how many toys you have. You use it when you share cookies with a friend. You can see math in a clock, a calendar, or when you measure how tall you are. It is like a game of finding answers.
Mathematical\n\nMathematical is a word that means about numbers and shapes. It is used when we count things, like how many cookies are on a plate. You see it when you learn to add or take away numbers in school. It helps us know how big or small something is, like a tall tower or a short line. When you play with blocks and put them in a row, you are doing something mathematical.
Mathematical Proof\n\nA mathematical proof is a way to show that something is always true. It is like a chain of small, clear steps. Each step follows from the one before it, like building with blocks. You can find proofs in math books and on chalkboards at school. People use proofs to be sure that a math idea works every time. For example, you can prove that adding two even numbers always gives an even number.
Mathematics\n\nMathematics is about numbers, shapes, and patterns. It helps us count things, like how many cookies are on a plate. You use it when you share toys with a friend, so each of you gets the same amount. It also helps us see shapes, like circles and squares, all around us. People use mathematics to build houses, make games, and even bake cakes. When you add or take away, you are doing mathematics.
