Matter\n\nMatter is everything around you that takes up space. It is the stuff that makes up your toys, your bed, and even you. You can see it, touch it, or feel it. Matter can be hard like a rock, wet like water, or light like air. When you hold a cup of juice, you are holding matter.
Mauna Loa\n\nMauna Loa is a big mountain that can spit out hot, melted rock. It is on an island called Hawaii. From the bottom of the ocean, it is taller than any other mountain on Earth. The top is often covered in snow, but inside it is very hot. Sometimes red, runny rock comes out of the top and slides down the sides. This happened not too long ago, in 2022. The name means "long mountain" in the Hawaiian language.
Mauritania\n\nMauritania is a big country in Africa. It sits next to the big blue ocean. The land is mostly flat and sandy. Many people there grow food and take care of animals like cows and goats. They also dig up a hard rock called iron from the ground. The iron is sent to other places to make things like cars and bridges. People in Mauritania speak different languages, but many speak Arabic. A long time ago, France ruled the country, so some people also speak French.
Mauritius\n\nMauritius is a small island country in the big, warm Indian Ocean. It has sandy beaches, blue water, and green hills. The capital city is Port Louis. Long ago, people from faraway lands came to live there. Today, many people visit it to swim and play in the sun. A funny bird called the dodo once lived only on this island, but it is gone now. The flag has four bright stripes: red, blue, yellow, and green.
Max\n\nMax means the biggest or the most. If you have three cookies and your friend has one, you have the max number of cookies. It is the top of something, like the tallest tower in a block stack. When a cup is full to the very top, it is at its max. You might hear a grown-up say "max" when they mean "no more can fit."
May\n\nMay is a month in the middle of spring. It has 31 days and comes after April. The weather gets warm, and many flowers open up. People may have a day off for a holiday called Mother's Day. You can see green leaves on trees and hear birds sing.
Maya\n\nMaya is a name for a girl. She is a person, just like you. You might meet a Maya at school or at the park. She could have a smile and like to play. Sometimes Maya is a name in a storybook too.
Maya Civilization\n\nThe Maya were people who lived a long, long time ago. They built big stone houses and tall towers in the jungle. They knew a lot about stars and made a special calendar. They grew corn and made yummy food from it. You can still see their old stone buildings in places like Mexico today.
Maya people\n\nThe Maya people are a group of people who live in warm places. They live in parts of Mexico and nearby lands. A long time ago, they built big stone houses and tall steps called pyramids. Today, many Maya people still speak their own special words and make bright, colorful clothes. They grow food like corn and beans on the land.
Mayan civilization\n\nThe Mayan civilization was a group of people who lived a long, long time ago. They built big stone cities with tall pyramids and wide steps. You can still see some of these old buildings in places like Mexico and Guatemala. They grew food like corn, beans, and squash to eat. They also made beautiful art and wrote stories using pictures. Today, some people still speak Mayan languages and keep old traditions.
Maybe\n\nMaybe means you are not sure. It is a word you say when something could happen or could not happen. You use it when you do not know the answer yet. For example, if someone asks if it will rain, you can say maybe because the sky looks gray but you are not sure.
Mayonnaise\n\nMayonnaise is a thick, creamy white sauce. It is made by mixing oil, egg yolk, and a little lemon juice or vinegar. People put it on sandwiches, salads, and fries to make them taste rich and tangy. You can find it in a jar at the store or in a squeeze bottle at home.
Mayor\n\nA mayor is the leader of a town or city. He or she works in a big building called city hall. People in the town choose the mayor by voting. The mayor helps make rules to keep the town safe and clean. He or she also talks to people about what the town needs, like new parks or fixing roads. You might see the mayor at a parade or a town party.
Maze\n\nA maze is a puzzle made of many paths. It has walls and turns that make it tricky to find the way. You can see a maze on paper, where you draw a line with your finger or a pencil. Some mazes are big enough to walk inside, like in a park or a garden. The goal is to find the way from the start to the end. It is fun to try and not get lost.
Me\n\nMe is a word you use to talk about yourself. It is the person you see in the mirror every day. You have a body with arms, legs, a head, and a belly. You can run, jump, draw, and sing. You live with your family in a house or a flat. You eat food, sleep at night, and play with toys. You have a name that your mom and dad gave you. You are special and there is no one else just like you.
Meadow\n\nA meadow is a big open field full of grass and flowers. It has no big trees, just soft green plants. You can find it in the countryside, where the land is flat and sunny. Cows, sheep, and goats like to eat the grass there. In spring and summer, it is covered with bright yellow, white, and purple flowers. Butterflies and bees fly from flower to flower. A meadow is a nice place to run and play.
Meal\n\nA meal is the food you eat at one time. It has different parts like bread, fruit, and sometimes meat. People eat three meals a day. The morning meal is called breakfast. It often has cereal, fruit, and milk. The noon meal is lunch. It can be a sandwich, soup, or fruit. The evening meal is dinner. It may have meat, rice, and a sweet treat after. You sit at a table with your family to eat a meal.
Mean\n\nMean is when someone is not nice. It is when a person says or does things that hurt others. You might see it at the playground when a child pushes or calls names. It makes people feel sad or angry. Being kind is the opposite of mean.
Meander\n\nA meander is a big bend in a river. It looks like a snake moving across the ground. You can see it when a river flows over flat land. The water moves fast on the outside of the bend and slow on the inside. Over time, the bend gets bigger and bigger. Sometimes two bends touch and make a small round lake.
Meaning\n\nMeaning is what something tells you. It is the idea inside a word, a picture, or a face. When you hear a word like "apple," the meaning is the round red fruit you can eat. When a friend smiles, the meaning is that they are happy. Even a dog wagging its tail has meaning—it means the dog is glad to see you. Meaning helps people and animals understand each other every day.
Measles\n\nMeasles is a sickness caused by a tiny germ. It makes a person feel hot, cough, and have red, itchy eyes. A bumpy red rash shows up all over the body. It spreads very fast when a sick person coughs or sneezes near you. Doctors give a special shot to keep children from getting it. Most people get better with rest and medicine.
Measure\n\nTo measure is to find out how big, how long, or how heavy something is. You can use a ruler to see how long a pencil is. You can use a cup to see how much water you have. You can step on a scale to see how heavy you are. Measuring helps you know more about things.
Measurement\n\nMeasurement is finding out how big, how long, or how heavy something is. It uses numbers to tell us the size. We can measure how tall you are with a ruler. We can measure how much water is in a cup. We use words like inches, feet, or cups to say the number. When you step on a scale, it measures your weight.
Meat\n\nMeat is a food that comes from animals. It is the soft part of an animal that people cook and eat. You can find meat at the store or in the fridge at home. People cook it in a pan, on a grill, or in the oven to make it safe and yummy. Some kinds of meat are chicken, beef from cows, and pork from pigs. Many kids eat meat in burgers, nuggets, or hot dogs. It helps your body grow strong.
Mecca\n\nMecca is a city in a hot, sandy country far away. It is a very special place for many people who follow a faith called Islam. In the city, there is a big stone building shaped like a box. People turn toward it when they pray. Every year, many grown-ups travel to Mecca for a big trip called Hajj. They walk together, pray, and feel close to God. Only people who follow Islam can go inside the city.
Mechanic\n\nA mechanic is a person who fixes cars and trucks. He works in a garage with big tools. He looks under the hood to find what is broken. He uses wrenches and lifts to change parts. When your family car makes a funny noise, a mechanic makes it quiet again.
Mechanical\n\nMechanical means something that has moving parts. It is like a toy car with wheels that turn, or a clock with hands that go around. You find mechanical things in many places, like a bike with a chain or a music box that plays a tune. People use mechanical tools to fix things or build new things. A wind-up toy is a good example—you turn a key and it walks or spins.
Mechanical engineering\n\nMechanical engineering is a job where people make and fix machines. It uses ideas about how things move and how strong they are. People who do this job build big things like cars and planes. They also build tiny parts inside toys and phones. You can see their work in a bike, a fan, or a door that opens and closes.
Mechanics\n\nMechanics is a part of science that looks at how things move. It studies why a ball rolls, why a swing goes back and forth, and why a toy car stops. A long time ago, smart people like Newton thought about these rules. He said that a thing stays still until something pushes or pulls it. You can see mechanics when you kick a ball or pull a wagon. It is all around us every day.
Medal\n\nA medal is a small, flat piece of metal. It is often round and hangs from a ribbon. People give it as a prize for doing something very well, like running fast or being brave. You might see one on a soldier's jacket or around the neck of a winner at a race. It can be gold, silver, or bronze in color.
Media\n\nMedia is a way to share stories, pictures, and sounds with many people. It can be a book with pages you turn, a TV show you watch, or a song you hear on the radio. You find it at home, in the car, or at school. It tells you news, makes you laugh, or teaches you new things. A cartoon on a tablet is one kind of media.
Medical\n\nMedical means about health and the body. It is the way doctors and nurses help people feel better when they are sick. You see medical things at a doctor's office, like a stethoscope to listen to your heart. Bandages and medicine are medical things too. When you have a check-up, the doctor uses medical tools to make sure you are growing strong.
Medical diagnosis\n\nA medical diagnosis is when a doctor finds out why a person feels sick. The doctor looks at the body, asks questions, and sometimes does small tests. Tests can be taking a little blood or taking a picture of the inside of the body with a big camera. After the doctor knows what is wrong, they can tell the person how to get better. When you go to the doctor with a tummy ache, the doctor feels your tummy and asks what you ate. That is part of making a medical diagnosis.
Medical Imaging\n\nMedical imaging is a way to take pictures inside your body. It uses big machines that look like a tunnel or a camera. You find these machines in a hospital or a doctor's office. Doctors use it to see your bones, your heart, or your tummy without any owies. For example, when you break your arm, the doctor takes a picture to see the crack.
Medication\n\nMedication is something you take to feel better when you are sick. It can be a pill, a liquid, or a shot. A doctor or a grown-up gives it to you. It helps stop pain, bring down a fever, or fight germs. You might see it at home in a cabinet or at the drug store. You should only take it when a grown-up says it is okay.
Medicine\n\nMedicine is the way doctors help people feel better. It is a job where people learn about the body and how to fix it when it is sick. You find medicine in a doctor's office or a hospital. A doctor uses medicine to check your heart, give you a shot, or put a bandage on a cut. When you have a cold, the doctor might give you a special drink to help you get well.
Medieval music\n\nMedieval music is very old music from a long, long time ago. It was played by people called minstrels who sang songs and used simple instruments. They traveled to big houses and towns to play for people. Some music was for church, where only singing was allowed at first. A famous song from that time is "Sumer is icumen in," which is about summer coming. It was often played on instruments like the harp, which is a big wooden frame with strings, or the recorder, a small pipe you blow into.
Meditation\n\nMeditation is a quiet time when you sit still and calm your mind. It is like giving your brain a soft, gentle rest. You can do it by closing your eyes and breathing slowly. Many people do it in the morning or before bed. It helps you feel peaceful and happy inside.
Mediterranean\n\nThe Mediterranean is a big, warm sea. It is blue and shiny, with water that tastes salty. You can find it between Europe and Africa. Many people swim and play on its sandy beaches. Big boats called ships carry things across it. Fish and dolphins live in its water. On a map, it looks like a big blue puddle.
Mediterranean Sea\n\nThe Mediterranean Sea is a big body of water. It sits between Europe, Africa, and Asia. It is almost all the way closed in by land. A thin strip of water called the Strait of Gibraltar joins it to the big ocean. The water is very blue and a little bit salty. Long ago, people used it to sail boats and trade things like food and cloth. Today, big ships still cross it to carry goods. Many fish live in it, and people catch them to eat.
Medium\n\nA medium is something in the middle. It is not too big and not too small. You can find a medium size when you pick a shirt or a cup. It is the one that is just right, not the biggest and not the smallest. When you draw with crayons, a medium crayon is not too long and not too short.
Meet\n\nA meet is when people come together in one place. It can be at a park, a school, or a big room. People talk, play, or share things at a meet. Sometimes a meet is for a race, like a swim meet where kids race in the water. You might go to a meet with your family to see friends.
Meeting\n\nA meeting is when two or more people come together to talk. It can happen in a room, at a big table, or even on a computer screen. People use it to share ideas, make plans, or solve a problem. At school, your teacher might have a meeting with other teachers. At home, your family might have a meeting to decide what game to play.
Megabat\n\nA megabat is a big bat that eats fruit. It has soft fur, big eyes, and wide wings. It lives in warm forests in Africa, Asia, and Australia. During the day, it hangs upside down in big groups called camps. At night, it flies out to find fruit and flower juice. It helps plants grow by moving seeds and pollen. Some megabats can carry germs that make people sick, but this is very rare.
Mekong River\n\nThe Mekong River is a very long river in a warm part of the world. It starts high up in the mountains and flows down through many countries. It is home to many fish, dolphins, and other animals. People use it to catch food and to travel by boat. Some big walls called dams are built on it to make power.
Melbourne\n\nMelbourne is a big city in Australia. It has many houses, tall buildings, and wide streets. A river called the Yarra runs through the middle of it. You can see long trains on tracks called trams that move people around. It has big green parks where you can run and play. Some parts of it are next to the beach with sand and water. People from many different places live there and bring their own food and music. It is a busy place full of shops, museums, and fun things to see.
Melody\n\nA melody is a line of music notes that you hear one after another. It is like a song you can hum or sing. It goes up high and down low, like steps on a hill. You can find a melody in a lullaby your mom sings, or in a happy tune on the radio. When you whistle a little song, you are making a melody. It is the part of music that you remember and want to sing again.
Melon\n\nA melon is a big, round fruit that grows on a vine. It has a hard outside skin and soft, sweet inside part that you can eat. The inside is often orange, green, or yellow and very juicy. You can find it in a garden or at a food store. People cut it open and eat the inside raw, sometimes in small cubes or balls. A watermelon is one kind of melon that is very big and has red inside with black seeds.
Melt\n\nMelt means something hard or cold turns into a soft, warm liquid. It happens when it gets very hot. You can see it when an ice cube sits in the sun and turns into water. Snow melts when spring comes and the air feels warm. A crayon left on a hot sidewalk can melt into a waxy puddle. Even butter melts in a warm pan when you cook.
Melting\n\nMelting is when a hard thing turns into a runny liquid. It happens when the thing gets very warm. Think of an ice cube on a hot day. The ice gets warm and turns into water. That is melting. You can see it in the kitchen too. Butter on warm toast melts and gets soft. Chocolate in your hand melts and feels sticky. Melting is the opposite of freezing, when a liquid turns back into a hard solid.
Member\n\nA member is a person who belongs to a group. It can be a club, a team, or a family. When you join a group, you become one of its members. Each member helps the group in some way. For example, in a soccer team, every player is a member. In a family, you are a member too.
Memory\n\nMemory is how your brain keeps things you saw or heard. It lets you remember your friend's name or the way to school. Some memories stay for a very short time, like a phone number you just heard. Other memories stay for a long time, like your birthday party last year. It helps you learn new songs and stories. When you sleep, your brain sorts memories so you can find them later.
Memory card\n\nA memory card is a tiny flat thing that saves pictures, songs, and games. It has no moving parts inside, so it does not break easily. You put it into a camera, a phone, or a game machine to keep your stuff safe. It can hold a little or a lot, depending on its size. The most common kind is called an SD card, and a very small one is called a microSD card. You might see one when Mom or Dad takes photos with a camera.
Mental\n\nMental is about what happens inside your head. It is how you think, feel, and remember things. When you are happy or sad, that is a mental feeling. When you learn a new song or story, your mental part is working. It helps you solve puzzles and dream at night. Everyone has a mental side, just like they have a body.
Mental Disorder\n\nA mental disorder is when a person's feelings or thoughts make it hard to do everyday things. It is not something you can see like a broken arm. It can make a person feel very sad, very worried, or think things that are not real. A doctor can help by talking and sometimes giving medicine. Just like a cold can get better, a mental disorder can get better with help.
Mental Health\n\nMental health is how you feel inside your head and heart. It is about being happy, sad, calm, or worried. When you have good mental health, you can play, learn, and make friends. Sometimes you might feel scared or angry, and that is okay. Talking to a grown-up you trust can help you feel better. Just like your body needs food and sleep, your feelings need care too.
Mentha\n\nMentha is a plant with soft green leaves. It has a strong, cool smell that many people like. You can find it growing in gardens or in pots on a windowsill. People use its leaves to add a fresh taste to food and drinks. For example, it can go in ice cream, tea, or candy. Some people also use it to help a sore tummy, but for a few people it can make a tummy ache worse.
Menu\n\nA menu is a list of food you can pick. It tells you what you can eat at a place like a restaurant. You look at it to choose your meal. It might have pictures of the food. Sometimes it is a big board on the wall, and sometimes it is a paper you hold. A grown-up reads it and tells the waiter what you want.
Meow\n\nA meow is a sound that a cat makes. It is a soft, high noise that comes from its mouth. You hear it when a cat wants food, wants to play, or says hello. A kitten meows to call its mom. Some cats meow a lot, and some are very quiet. If you have a cat at home, you know this sound well.
Mercury\n\nMercury is a small, rocky planet. It is the closest planet to the sun. It looks gray and has many round holes called craters. You can see it in the sky, but it is very hard to spot because it is near the bright sun. It moves around the sun very fast. A year on Mercury is only 88 days long.
Mercury (planet)\n\nMercury is a small planet that goes around the Sun. It is the closest planet to the Sun. It looks a lot like our Moon, with many round holes called craters and flat, smooth places. It is very hot in the day and very cold at night. You can sometimes see it in the sky just before the Sun comes up or just after it goes down. It has no moon of its own.
Mercy\n\nMercy is when someone is kind to a person who made a mistake. It means you do not punish them, even if you could. You might see it when a friend breaks your toy and you say, "It is okay, I still like you." It feels warm, like a hug after a sad moment. A teacher shows mercy by giving a second chance. A mom shows mercy by forgiving a spilled cup of milk.
Merge\n\nMerge is when two things come together to make one thing. It is like when you pour red water and blue water into one cup, and they mix to make purple water. On a road, two lines of cars can merge into one line when the road gets smaller. In a game, you can merge two small blocks to make one big block. It means joining things so they are no longer apart.
Mermaid\n\nA mermaid is a made-up creature from old stories. It has the top part of a person and the bottom part of a fish. In tales, it lives in the sea and sometimes sits on big rocks near the water. People say it sings songs that can trick sailors. You might see a mermaid in a cartoon or a book, like the one with long hair and a shiny tail.
Merry\n\nMerry means feeling very happy and full of fun. It is a word people use when they laugh, smile, and have a good time. You might feel merry at a birthday party with cake and games. People also say "Merry Christmas!" to wish others a happy holiday. When you are merry, your heart feels light and you want to sing or dance.
Mesa\n\nA mesa is a big hill with a flat top and steep sides. It looks like a giant table made of rock. You can find it in dry, open places like deserts. The flat top is hard rock that protects the softer rock below. Wind and rain wear away the sides slowly, leaving the tall shape. Some mesas are so big that people can walk on top and see far away.
Mesh\n\nA mesh is a net made of thin lines that cross each other. It has many small holes between the lines. You can find it on a window screen to keep bugs out. People also use it in a kitchen strainer to let water out but keep food in. A bag for carrying fruit can be made of mesh too.
Mesoamerica\n\nMesoamerica is a big piece of land in the middle part of the world. It starts in Mexico and goes down near a country called Costa Rica. Long ago, many native people lived there before new people came from far away. They grew a special tree that gives us chocolate. Today, you can still see old stone buildings they made.
Mesopotamia\n\nMesopotamia is a very old place between two big rivers. It is a land where people first built cities long, long ago. The two rivers are called the Tigris and the Euphrates. People used the water from the rivers to help plants grow. They also made the first wheel there. It was first used to shape clay pots, and later to move things. One famous city there was called Babylon. People wrote with little marks on clay, which was the first writing. Mesopotamia is now part of the country called Iraq.
Mesozoic\n\nThe Mesozoic is a very, very long time ago when dinosaurs lived on Earth. It was warm, with no ice at the north and south ends of the world. Big forests of tall trees and ferns grew everywhere. Dinosaurs walked on land, and big swimming reptiles lived in the sea. Small furry animals that came out at night hid in the woods. It ended when a big rock from space hit Earth and most dinosaurs went away.
Mess\n\nA mess is when things are not in their place. It looks like toys on the floor, clothes on the chair, or food bits on the table. You can find a mess in a bedroom, a playroom, or a kitchen after a big meal. When you clean up, you put everything back where it belongs. A tidy room is the opposite of a mess.
Message\n\nA message is words you send to someone. It can be a note on paper, a voice you leave on a phone, or words you type on a screen. You find it in a letter, a text, or a chat. It tells the other person what you think or feel. For example, when you draw a heart for Mom, that is a message.
Messiah\n\nMessiah is a special person who comes to save the world. In old stories, God promised to send this person to help people. Some people believe the Messiah is a king, a teacher, or a healer. Many people think Jesus is the Messiah. They say he came to fix what was wrong and will come back one day. Other people wait for a different Messiah to come in the future.
Messy\n\nMessy means things are not in their place. It looks like toys on the floor, clothes on the chair, and crumbs on the table. You can find a messy room after playtime or a messy face after eating. When something is messy, you can clean it up by putting things away. A child's bedroom is often messy before bedtime.
Metabolism\n\nMetabolism is how your body turns food into energy. It is like a tiny engine inside you that never stops. When you eat an apple, it breaks the apple down into tiny pieces your body can use. It helps you run, jump, think, and grow. Even when you sleep, it keeps working to fix your body and keep you warm.
Metal\n\nMetal is a kind of hard, shiny stuff that comes from the ground. It feels heavy and cold when you touch it. You can find it in many places, like in pots and pans in the kitchen, in coins, and in big bridges. People use it to make things that need to be strong, like cars, bikes, and tools. A fork or a spoon is a good example of something made from metal.
Metallurgy\n\nMetallurgy is the way people work with metal. It is about taking metal from the ground and making it into things we use. People heat metal until it is very hot and soft, then they shape it into tools, cars, or pots. You can see metal in your kitchen, like a spoon or a fork. A blacksmith is a person who does metallurgy with a big hammer and fire.
Metalworking\n\nMetalworking is how people shape metal into things. It is like playing with clay, but with hard, shiny stuff. People use tools to cut, bend, or melt metal. They make things like pots, cars, and bridges. A blacksmith is a person who does metalworking with a big hammer and fire. You can see metal things all around you, like a spoon or a bike.
Metamorphic rock\n\nA metamorphic rock is a rock that has changed deep inside the Earth. It starts as one kind of rock, then gets very hot and squeezed hard. This makes it turn into a new, different rock. You can find it under big mountains or near hot melted rock. It often has shiny specks or wavy lines inside. Some kinds are used to make floors or pretty statues.
Metamorphosis\n\nMetamorphosis is a big change in the body of an animal as it grows up. It happens to some bugs and frogs. A young animal looks very different from the grown-up one. For example, a caterpillar is long and crawly. It later turns into a butterfly with wings. A tadpole lives in water and has a tail. It later turns into a frog that hops on land. This change takes time and helps the animal live in a new way.
Meteor\n\nA meteor is a bright light in the night sky. It looks like a fast-moving star that falls down. You see it when a small rock from space flies into the air around Earth. The rock gets very hot and glows. Most of the time, it burns up before it hits the ground. Sometimes a piece lands on Earth. That piece is called a meteorite. It can be a big rock or a tiny speck of dust. People call a meteor a shooting star because it zips across the sky so quickly.
Meteor shower\n\nA meteor shower is when many shooting stars fly across the night sky. It looks like bright lines of light that move fast and then go away. You can see it outside on a dark night, far from city lights. It happens when tiny bits of rock and dust from space burn up high above us. One famous meteor shower happens every year in August. People lie on blankets and watch the sky to see the pretty lights.
Meteorology\n\nMeteorology is the study of weather. It looks at the air around our Earth. People who do this work are called weather helpers. They watch the wind, how hot or cold it is, and how wet the air feels. They use big computers to guess if it will rain or be sunny tomorrow. You see their work when you watch the weather on TV. They help us know if we need a coat or an umbrella.
Meter\n\nA meter is a way to measure how long something is. It is a little longer than a big step you take. You can find a meter stick in a classroom. People use it to see how tall a door is or how wide a room is. A baseball bat is almost one meter long.
Method\n\nA method is a way of doing something. It is like a plan or a list of steps you follow. When you make a sandwich, you have a method: first bread, then cheese, then more bread. At school, your teacher shows you a method to write your letters. A method helps you do things the same good way every time.
Metre\n\nA metre is a way to measure how long something is. It is a little longer than a big step. You can use a ruler or a tape to see it. People all over the world use it to measure things like a table, a door, or a room. A metre is about as tall as a small child.
Metric system\n\nThe metric system is a way to measure things. It uses meters for how long, grams for how heavy, and liters for how much space. You can find it on rulers, scales, and measuring cups. People use it to know how tall you are, how much milk to pour, or how far away the park is. For example, a big bottle of soda is two liters.
Metro\n\nA metro is a fast train that runs under a big city. It has many long cars joined together, and it stops at stations with bright lights. People ride it to go to work, to school, or to the park. You can find it in cities like New York or London. It moves through tunnels under the ground, so it does not get stuck in traffic.
Metropolis\n\nA metropolis is a very, very big city. It has so many people that you cannot count them all. Inside it, there are tall buildings, busy streets, and many smaller towns around it. People live, work, and play there. You can find big parks, shops, and trains that go under the ground. New York and London are two big cities like this. A metropolis never sleeps because lights stay on all night.
Metropolitan area\n\nA metropolitan area is a big city and all the smaller towns around it. It has many houses, stores, and roads that all connect together. You can find it on a map where the city spreads out very far. People live and work in different parts of it, and they often drive or take a train to go from one part to another. The biggest one in the world is Tokyo, where many millions of people live.
Metropolitan Museum of Art\n\nThe Metropolitan Museum of Art is a big building full of art. It is in New York City, next to a big park. Inside, you can see many old and new things like paintings, statues, and even old clothes. People come from all over to look at the art. It is so big that you cannot see everything in one day.
Mew\n\nA mew is a tiny, soft sound. It is the little cry a baby cat makes. You can hear it when a kitten is hungry or wants its mom. It sounds like a high, quiet 'mew'. If you have a small cat at home, you might hear it in the morning when it wants food.
Mexican food\n\nMexican food is the food people eat in the country of Mexico. It uses corn, beans, hot peppers, and fruits. A taco is a flat bread folded around meat or beans. It is easy to hold and eat with your hands. Guacamole is a soft green dip made from a fruit called avocado. People dip chips in it. Enchiladas are rolled-up breads with a spicy red sauce on top. Many kids like Mexican food because it is fun to eat and full of color.
Mexico\n\nMexico is a country. It is in the south part of North America. It looks like a triangle on a map. It has big mountains, hot deserts, and green forests. Many people live there, and they speak Spanish. They eat yummy food like tacos and corn. Some kids play with a piñata at parties. Mexico is next to the United States.
Mexico City\n\nMexico City is a very big city. It is the biggest city in the country of Mexico. It sits in a flat place with tall mountains all around. Long ago, people built it on top of a big lake. Now the lake is gone, and the city has many houses, roads, and parks. The air can get dirty because so many cars and people are there. Sometimes the ground shakes because of earthquakes. Many people live and work there, and children play in its parks.
Miami\n\nMiami is a big city in a warm place called Florida. It is next to the ocean, so it has many beaches with soft sand and blue water. Many people in Miami speak Spanish and come from places like Cuba. You can see tall buildings, bright lights, and lots of palm trees there. People visit Miami to swim, play in the sun, and eat yummy food.
Mice\n\nA mouse is a tiny animal with soft fur. It has a small body, four short legs, a long thin tail, and round ears. You can find it in fields, forests, or sometimes in houses. It likes to eat seeds, grains, and little bits of food. It makes a soft squeak sound. A group of them is called mice.
Michael Faraday\n\nMichael Faraday was a man who loved to learn about science. He lived a long time ago and did many tests with magnets and wires. He found out how to make a magnet move a wire, which is called electricity. Today, people use his ideas to make lights turn on and toys move. He came from a family with not much money, but he worked very hard and became a great thinker.
Michael Jackson\n\nMichael Jackson was a singer and dancer. He sang songs that many people love, like the one about a spooky night. He could spin around fast and do a special walk that looked like he was sliding on the floor. People all over the world watched him on TV and cheered. He wore a shiny glove on one hand and a black hat. Even today, children and grown-ups still dance to his music.
Michelangelo\n\nMichelangelo was a man who made art a long time ago. He lived in a country called Italy. He could paint big pictures on walls and ceilings. He also made big statues out of stone. One of his most famous statues is a man named David. You can see his art in books or if you visit Italy.
Micronesia\n\nMicronesia is a big area in the ocean with many tiny islands. It is in the warm Pacific Ocean, far from big lands. Most islands are flat rings of sand and coral, but some are tall with green hills. People there live in small villages and use boats to visit other islands. They have chiefs who help make rules, and everyone works together. Many families have relatives on different islands.
Microphone\n\nA microphone is a tool that catches sound. It turns the sound into a tiny electric wave. You can find it on a phone, a computer, or a stage. People use it to make their voice louder or to record songs and stories. When you sing into it, your voice comes out of a big speaker. Some have a soft cover to stop puff sounds from the mouth.
Microscope\n\nA microscope is a tool that makes tiny things look big. It has a long tube with special glass pieces called lenses inside. You find it in schools, doctor offices, and science labs. When you put a small thing under it, you can see parts that are too small for your eyes alone. For example, you can look at a tiny bug leg or a drop of water and see little shapes moving inside.
Microwave\n\nA microwave is a kind of invisible wave that moves through the air. It is very small and fast, like light but we cannot see it. People use it to talk to far-away spaceships and to see planes in the sky. At home, a microwave oven uses it to heat food. The waves make tiny bits inside the food move fast, and that makes the food hot. You must keep the oven door closed so the waves stay inside and do not hurt you.
Microwave oven\n\nA microwave oven is a box that cooks food very fast. It uses tiny waves you cannot see. You put food inside it, close the door, and press a button. It makes the water inside the food shake and get hot. It can warm up milk, make popcorn, or heat last night’s dinner. You often see it in a kitchen at home.
Mid-Atlantic Ridge\n\nThe Mid-Atlantic Ridge is a very long mountain chain deep under the ocean. It sits in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean. It is so tall that in one place, it pokes out of the water and makes the country of Iceland. The ridge is where the ground under the ocean slowly pulls apart. Hot, melted rock comes up from deep inside the Earth and cools into new hard rock. This makes the ocean floor grow a little bit wider every year.
Middle\n\nMiddle is the spot that is the same distance from two sides. It is not at the start and not at the end. You can find the middle of a line, a circle, or a sandwich. When you cut a cookie in half, the cut is in the middle. In a game of tag, the person who is 'it' stands in the middle of the yard.
Middle age\n\nMiddle age is the time when a person is not young and not old. It is when someone is about 40 to 60 years old. People in middle age often have a job and a family. They may have more money than when they were young, but they also spend a lot on their kids. Some people feel sad or worried during this time. Their body changes too. They get lines on their face and gray hair. They may get a little bigger around the middle. Women stop having babies after middle age.
Middle Ages\n\nThe Middle Ages is a long time in history. It happened in Europe a very long time ago. It lasted for about 1000 years. During this time, many people lived in castles and worked on farms. Knights wore shiny armor and rode horses. Kings and queens ruled the land. Most people could not read or write. The Middle Ages ended when people started to explore and learn new things again.
Middle East\n\nThe Middle East is a big part of the world. It has many countries with hot deserts and old cities. People live there and speak different languages. Long ago, the first big towns grew in this place. Today, many people in the Middle East follow a faith called Islam. It is also where a lot of the oil that cars and trucks use comes from.
Midnight\n\nMidnight is the middle of the night. It is the time when one day ends and a new day begins. The sky is very dark, and most people are fast asleep in their beds. You can see the moon and stars up high if the sky is clear. Some animals, like owls and bats, wake up and go out at this time.
Midwestern United States\n\nThe Midwestern United States is a big part of the country in the middle. It has many states like Ohio, Michigan, and Kansas. The land has flat fields, rolling hills, and some big lakes. People grow corn and wheat on farms there. Big cities like Chicago have tall buildings and many people. The weather can be hot in summer and very cold in winter with snow.
Might\n\nMight means something can happen, but it is not sure. It is a word we use when we do not know for sure. For example, it might rain today, so we bring an umbrella just in case. Or your friend might come over to play after lunch. It is like saying maybe, but a little bit stronger.
Migraine\n\nA migraine is a very bad headache that often hurts on one side of the head. It can make a person feel sick to their stomach and not want to see bright lights or hear loud sounds. Some people see funny shapes or spots before it starts. It can last for a few hours or even a few days. Lying down in a dark, quiet room and sleeping can help it go away.
Migration\n\nMigration is when animals move from one place to another at the same time every year. It is like a long trip that happens again and again. Many birds fly to warm places when winter comes. They come back when it gets warm again. Some fish swim far away to have their babies. Big animals like caribou walk a long way to find fresh grass to eat. Even tiny sea animals move up and down in the water every day. Migration helps animals find food and a safe place to live.
Mile\n\nA mile is a way to measure how long something is. It is a big step for grown-ups. You can use it to tell how far away a place is. When you ride in a car, the road signs might say how many miles to the next town. A mile is longer than a walk around your block. It is about how far you go if you walk for 20 minutes.
Military\n\nThe military is a big group of people who keep a country safe. They wear special clothes called uniforms that are often green or brown. You can see them in parades, on big ships, or in airplanes. They help when there is a big storm or a fire. Sometimes they march together and carry a flag.
Military aircraft\n\nA military aircraft is a flying machine that helps soldiers. It has wings, a long body, and big engines that make it go fast. You can see it in the sky or at an air show. It carries people and things, and some can drop food or water to help on the ground. A fighter jet is one kind that zooms very fast.
Military History\n\nMilitary history is the story of how people fought in wars long ago. It tells about big fights between groups of people, like knights or soldiers. You can find it in books with pictures of old swords, shields, and uniforms. It helps us learn why people fought and how they kept safe. For example, you might see a castle that was built to protect people during a war.
Milk\n\nMilk is a white drink that comes from animals like cows. It looks smooth and white, like a cloud in a cup. You find it in the fridge at home or at the store. People drink it with cookies or pour it on cereal. It helps make your bones and teeth strong. Some milk also comes from plants, like almonds or coconuts, but that kind looks white too.
Milkfish\n\nA milkfish is a big, shiny fish that lives in warm ocean water. It has a long body with silver scales and a forked tail. People in the Philippines call it bangus, and it is a very special fish there. Many people eat it for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. It tastes good with rice and a little salt. You can see it at a wet market or in a fish pond.
Milky\n\nMilky means something looks like milk. It is a soft white color, not see-through. You might see milky water in a puddle after rain mixes with dirt. Some glass is milky, so you cannot see through it clearly. A milky stone can be smooth and pretty.
Milky Way\n\nThe Milky Way is a big group of stars in the sky. It looks like a fuzzy, glowing band of light at night. You can see it best far from city lights, where the sky is very dark. It is our home in space, with our Sun and Earth inside it. Long ago, people told a story that it was made from spilled milk.
Mill\n\nA mill is a big building with a wheel that turns. It uses moving water or wind to spin the wheel. Inside, heavy stones grind grain into flour. People use the flour to make bread and cakes. Long ago, many towns had a mill near a river. You might see one in a storybook or on a farm.
Millet\n\nMillet is a tiny, round seed that people eat. It is small and yellow or white. You can find it in fields where farmers grow it. People cook it like rice and eat it for breakfast or dinner. Some people also use it to make flat bread. It is good for your body and helps your tummy feel full.
Millipede\n\nA millipede is a small, long animal with many legs. It has a body made of many round parts, and most parts have two pairs of tiny legs. It lives in wet, dark places like under rocks or old leaves in the woods. It eats dead plants and helps clean the forest floor. When it feels scared, it curls up into a tight ball to stay safe. Some kinds can make a yucky liquid that keeps bigger animals away. You might see one crawling slowly on the ground after rain.
Mimosa\n\nA mimosa is a plant with soft, feathery leaves. It has small, round, pink or purple flowers that look like tiny pom-poms. You can find it growing in warm places, like gardens or forests. The most special thing about it is that its leaves close up fast when you touch them. It does this to protect itself. Some kinds of mimosa are used by people to make special drinks, but those are not for children. You might see a mimosa in a park or a plant store.
Mind\n\nYour mind is the part of you that thinks and feels. It is inside your head, but you cannot see it or touch it. You use it when you remember your favorite toy, when you make up a story, or when you feel happy or sad. It helps you learn new things, like how to count or sing a song. When you dream at night, your mind shows you pictures and stories. Everyone has a mind, and no one else can know exactly what is in yours.
Mine\n\nA mine is a deep hole in the ground. It is dark inside, and people dig it to find things like shiny rocks or black coal. Big trucks and tools help move the dirt and rocks. People use what they find to make things like jewelry or to keep houses warm. You might see a mine in a picture book or a movie about digging.
Mineral\n\nA mineral is a hard, solid piece of the Earth. It is not made by people; it grows in nature. A mineral has a special shape inside, like tiny building blocks. You can find it in rocks, sand, and dirt. Some are shiny and pretty, like a ruby. People use it to make things like salt for food and wires for lights.
Minimalism\n\nMinimalism is a way of making art or music with very few things. It uses simple shapes, colors, or sounds. In music, a short tune or beat is played many times, but it changes a little each time. You might hear it in a song that feels calm and steady. In art, you see big blocks of color or plain stripes on a canvas. Some paintings have only one color. It is about showing that simple can be strong and beautiful.
Mining\n\nMining is digging things out of the ground. It is how people get rocks and metals that we cannot grow. Some mining scrapes the top dirt away. Some mining goes deep down into a dark hole. Workers called miners do the digging. It can be a hard and unsafe job. People use what they dig up to make things like cars, phones, and rings. A shiny gold ring starts as a tiny bit of gold from a mine.
Minority group\n\nA minority group is a group of people who are not the biggest group in a place. They may look different, speak a different language, or love in a different way. Sometimes they are not treated fairly because they are not like most people. Even if there are many of them, they can still be a minority if they have less power. The United Nations says all people should be kind and fair to them.
Minotaur\n\nA Minotaur is a make-believe monster from old Greek stories. It has the body of a man and the head and tail of a bull. It lived in a big, twisty maze called a Labyrinth. A brave hero named Theseus came and stopped it. People drew pictures of it with strong arms and big horns.
Minute\n\nA minute is a way to measure time. It is made of 60 tiny bits called seconds. When the big hand on a clock moves all the way around, one minute has passed. You can use it to know how long to brush your teeth or wait for cookies to bake. Sixty of them make one whole hour.
Miracle\n\nA miracle is something very good that happens, but nobody can explain how. It feels like magic, but some people believe it is a gift from God. You might hear a story about a sick person who gets all better in one day. That could be a miracle. It makes people feel hope and wonder.
Mirage\n\nA mirage is a trick your eyes see when light bends in the air. It happens because hot air and cold air mix in a special way. You might see it on a hot road when the road looks wet and shiny, but it is really just the sky. It can also make far-away things look like they are floating in the air. A mirage is not real water or a real floating thing — it is just light playing a game with your eyes.
Mirror\n\nA mirror is a flat piece of glass that shows you a picture of yourself. It has a shiny back that bounces light back to your eyes. You can find it on a wall, in a bathroom, or in a bedroom. People use it to see their face, brush their hair, or check their clothes. When you look into it, you see your own smile looking back at you. If you hold up a word to it, the letters look flipped around.
Miss\n\nMiss is a word you say when you want to get a lady's attention. It is used for a girl or a woman who is not married. You might hear it at school when a child talks to a teacher. It is a polite way to speak to someone you do not know well.
Mississippi\n\nMississippi is a long, winding river in the United States. It looks like a big, brown snake from above. You can find it flowing from the north all the way down to the south. Boats carry things on it, and people fish in it. Many birds and turtles live near its muddy banks.
Mississippi River\n\nThe Mississippi River is a very long river in the United States. It is a wide, blue path of water that flows through the middle of the country. You can find it starting in a lake in Minnesota and going all the way down to the big ocean water called the Gulf of Mexico. It is used by big boats to carry things from one place to another. Many cities sit next to it, like Memphis. A famous story about a boy named Huckleberry Finn takes place on this river.
Missouri River\n\nThe Missouri River is a very long river in the United States. It starts high up in the Rocky Mountains where snow melts. Then it flows across flat, dry land for many, many miles. It joins another big river called the Mississippi. The water looks brown and muddy because it carries soft dirt. Long ago, people used it to travel and move things in boats. Some people call it the Big Muddy.
Mistake\n\nA mistake is something you do that is not right. It is like when you color outside the lines or put your shoes on the wrong feet. Everyone makes mistakes sometimes, and that is okay. When you make a mistake, you can try again and learn how to do it better next time. A mistake can help you grow smarter and stronger.
Mitten\n\nA mitten is a warm cover for your hand. It has one big pocket for all four fingers and a separate pocket for the thumb. You wear it when it is cold outside, like in snow. It keeps your fingers warm and cozy. Mittens can be made of soft wool or fuzzy cloth. They often come in bright colors like red or blue. Some mittens have a string that goes through your coat so you do not lose them.
Mix\n\nA mix is when you put two or more things together. It can be colors, like red and blue making purple. It can be food, like stirring milk into cereal. You can mix sounds to make a song. When you mix things, they become one new thing.
Mixer\n\nA mixer is a tool in the kitchen. It has a handle and two round beaters that spin very fast. You plug it in and push a button to make it go. It mixes eggs, flour, and milk to make cake batter. Some mixers are big and sit on the counter. A mixer helps you cook without getting your hands tired.
Mixture\n\nA mixture is when you put two or more things together. It can be made of solids, liquids, or gases. You can often see the different parts, like in a bowl of mixed nuts. Sometimes you cannot see the parts, like when sugar melts into water. A mixture is not stuck together forever—you can often pull the parts apart again.
Moa\n\nA moa was a very big bird that could not fly. It had no wings at all. It lived only in a far-away land called New Zealand. It ate plants and leaves. It was taller than a grown-up person and very heavy. Long ago, people hunted it for food. Now there are no moa left anywhere on Earth.
Moai\n\nA moai is a big stone statue. It has a large head, a body, and arms, but the head looks very big. You can find it on Easter Island, a far-away island in the big blue sea. Long ago, people made it to remember their family and bring good luck. Some moai stand near the water, and some are still in the ground where they were made.
Moat\n\nA moat is a big, wide ditch filled with water. It goes all the way around a castle. Long ago, people built moats to keep enemies away from the castle. It was very hard for an enemy to swim across a deep moat. It also stopped enemies from digging under the castle walls. Some moats had no water at all, just a deep, dry ditch. In stories, moats sometimes have big, scary animals in them, but that is not true. A real moat might have had fish for food.
Mob\n\nA mob is a big group of people all in one place. They may be loud and pushy, and they move close together. Sometimes a mob is angry and wants to break things. You might see a mob in a story or on TV, but it is not a safe place for a child. It is better to stay away from a mob and find a grown-up.
Mobile\n\nA mobile is a toy that hangs above a baby's bed. It has light, colorful parts that spin slowly. You can see it in a baby's room. It moves when the air blows or when you push it gently. The baby looks up at it and feels calm. Some mobiles play soft music too.
Mobile device\n\nA mobile device is a small machine you can hold in your hands. It has a screen that lights up and shows pictures or words. You can carry it in your pocket or a bag. It runs on a battery, so you do not need to plug it into the wall all the time. People use it to talk to friends, play games, or watch videos. A phone and a tablet are two kinds of mobile devices. You may see one at home or on the bus.
Mobile phone\n\nA mobile phone is a small phone you can carry with you. It has no wires, so you can talk to people far away. It looks like a flat box with a screen and buttons or a touch screen. You find it in people's hands, pockets, or bags. People use it to call, send messages, take pictures, and play games. A smartphone is a kind of mobile phone that is also a tiny computer. You might see your mom or dad using one every day.
Mockingbird\n\nA mockingbird is a small gray bird. It has a long tail and white spots on its wings. You can find it in trees and bushes in many places. It sings many different songs, and it can copy the sounds of other birds. Sometimes it even copies the sound of a cat or a car alarm. It sings loudly and fast, one sound after another.
Model\n\nA model is a small copy of something big. It looks like the real thing but is much smaller. You can find it in a toy store or a museum. People use it to show how something works or to play with it. For example, a toy car is a model of a real car.
Modern\n\nModern means something is new and from today. It is the opposite of old or from long ago. You can see modern things all around you, like a shiny new car or a tall building with lots of glass. A modern toy might light up and make sounds, while an old toy might be made of wood. People use the word modern to talk about ideas, clothes, or ways of doing things that are popular right now.
Modern art\n\nModern art is a kind of art that people made a long time ago, from about 150 years ago to 50 years ago. It looks different from old art because artists tried new things. They used bright colors, funny shapes, and sometimes just lines and dots. You can see it in big buildings called museums. It can be a painting of a face that looks like a puzzle, or a picture of a flower that is just a big red circle. Some modern art does not look like a real thing at all, but it still feels nice to look at.
Modern dance\n\nModern dance is a way of moving your body to music on a stage. It does not have strict rules like ballet. Dancers often make up their own moves to show feelings. They may dance with no shoes and wear any clothes they like. You might see it at a show or in a movie.
Modern Era\n\nThe Modern Era is a time that started a long time ago and is still going on. It is when people began to use big machines and new ideas. You can see it in cars, phones, and tall buildings. It is the time we live in right now. In this time, people can talk to someone far away with a small screen.
Modernism\n\nModernism is a way of making art, buildings, and stories. It started a long time ago when people wanted to try new shapes and ideas. You can see it in tall glass buildings with straight lines. It also shows up in paintings that use bright colors and simple forms. Some books and poems use modernism by playing with words in fun ways.
Mojave Desert\n\nThe Mojave Desert is a big, dry place with lots of sand and rocks. It is in parts of California, Nevada, and Arizona. It has very hot days and cold nights. You can find special parks there, like Joshua Tree National Park. Some plants grow in the sand, like the Creosote Bush. These plants do not need much water. Many animals live there and eat the plants.
Mold\n\nMold is a tiny living thing that grows in wet places. It looks like fuzzy spots that can be green, black, or white. You might find it on old bread or fruit that has been left out too long. It can also grow on walls or in bathrooms where it is damp. Mold helps break down old food and leaves outside, but inside a house it can make people sick. It is important to keep things dry and clean so mold does not grow.
Moldova\n\nMoldova is a country in the east part of Europe. It is next to Ukraine and Romania. The main city is called Chișinău. People there speak a language that sounds like Romanian. Long ago, it was part of bigger countries, but now it is its own place. Many people there do not have a lot of money. It is working to join a big group of countries called the European Union.
Mole\n\nA mole is a small furry animal that lives under the ground. It has soft, dark fur that feels like velvet. Its front paws are big and strong, so it can dig long tunnels in the dirt. It eats bugs and worms it finds in the soil. A mole does not see very well, but it can feel its way in the dark. You might see little hills of dirt in a yard or park where a mole has been digging.
Mole cricket\n\nA mole cricket is a small bug that digs in the dirt. It has a brown body and big front legs that look like little shovels. It uses those legs to dig tunnels under the ground. You can find it in gardens or fields where the soil is soft. It eats tiny worms, roots, and grass. Birds and other animals like to eat it.
Molecular\n\nMolecular is a word that tells us about the tiny, tiny bits that make up everything around us. It is like saying something is about the smallest building blocks. You cannot see these bits with your eyes alone. They are in water, air, and even in your own body. When many of these bits stick together, they make the things we can touch and see.
Molecule\n\nA molecule is a tiny group of atoms that stick together. It is the smallest piece of something that still acts like that thing. You cannot see a molecule because it is way too small. In air, molecules fly around fast. In water, they slide past each other. In a hard block, they shake in place. A water molecule has two small hydrogen atoms and one bigger oxygen atom. When you drink a glass of water, you drink many, many water molecules.
Mollusc\n\nA mollusc is a soft animal with no bones inside. It often has a hard shell on the outside to keep it safe. Some molluscs live in the ocean, some live in lakes and rivers, and some live on land. You can find a snail in a garden or a clam at the beach. Many molluscs move around on a flat, soft foot. Some, like an octopus, have long arms and no shell at all. People eat some molluscs, like clams and squid.
Mollusca\n\nMollusca is a big group of soft animals. It has a soft body, and many kinds have a hard shell on the outside. You can find them in the ocean, in lakes, or on wet ground. Some crawl slowly, and some stay in one spot. A snail is one kind you might see in a garden. A clam is another kind that lives in the sand at the beach.
Mom\n\nA mom is a grown-up who takes care of you. She is the one who gave you life and loves you more than anyone. She has soft hands and a warm smile. You find her at home, in the kitchen, or by your bed at night. She cooks yummy food, reads stories, and hugs you when you are sad. When you fall and hurt your knee, she kisses it better. A mom is like a safe, cozy blanket on a cold day.
Moment\n\nA moment is a very short bit of time. It is like the blink of an eye or a quick snap of your fingers. You can find a moment in every part of your day, like when you take a bite of a cookie or hear a funny joke. People use the word to talk about something that happens fast. A happy moment is when you get a hug from someone you love.
Momentum\n\nMomentum is how hard it is to stop a moving thing. It depends on how big the thing is and how fast it goes. A big, fast truck has a lot of it. A small, slow toy car has only a little. When things bump into each other, it can move from one to the other. If you roll a ball and it hits another ball, the first ball slows down and the second ball starts to move. That is it passing between them.
Mommy\n\nA mommy is a grown-up who takes care of you. She is the lady who gave you life. She may have soft hands and a warm smile. You find her at home, in the kitchen, or at the park. She hugs you when you are sad and reads you stories at bedtime. She makes your favorite food and helps you get dressed. A mommy loves you more than anything.
Mona\n\nMona is a name for a girl. She has a smile that makes people feel happy. You might see her in a picture hanging on a wall. In the picture, she sits very still with her hands folded. People from all over the world come to look at her face. No one knows for sure what she is thinking, but her eyes seem to follow you.
Monaco\n\nMonaco is a very small country. It is so small that the whole country is just one city. It sits next to the sea, near France and Italy. Many rich people live there because they do not have to pay money to the country. It has a big, fancy building where people play games of chance. It also has a famous car race on its streets every year. The country is ruled by a prince, and a princess once lived there who was a movie star.
Monarchy\n\nA monarchy is a way a country is run by one person called a king or queen. It is a job that often passes from a parent to a child when the old ruler dies or steps down. You can find a monarchy in places like the United Kingdom, where a king or queen lives in a big palace. The king or queen may wave to people, wear a crown, and be a symbol for the whole country. In some places, the king or queen makes all the rules, but in many places today, they share the job with a group of people chosen by the country.
Monastery\n\nA monastery is a big house where monks live together. It has a special room for quiet prayer. Monks are men who share everything and do not marry. Long ago, monasteries were places where people kept books and taught others. Some monasteries are far from towns, and monks grow their own food there. Today, monks also help people nearby by teaching or caring for the sick.
Monday\n\nMonday is the first day of the week. It comes after Sunday and before Tuesday. On Monday, many people go back to work or school after the weekend. It is a day to start new things and make plans. Some people feel a little tired on Monday morning, but a good breakfast helps.
Money\n\nMoney is something people use to buy things they need or want. It can be coins made of metal or paper bills with numbers and pictures. You find it in a wallet, a piggy bank, or a store cash box. People work to earn money, then trade it for food, toys, or clothes. A child might get a coin from a parent to buy a candy at the shop.
Mongol\n\nA Mongol is a person from a big, open land called Mongolia. They live in round, moveable homes called yurts. Long ago, they rode fast horses across wide, grassy fields. Today, some still live with their animals and move with the seasons. A Mongol might wear a warm, colorful coat and a pointed hat. They love to sing songs and tell stories about brave heroes.
Mongol Empire\n\nThe Mongol Empire was a very big group of lands long ago. It was ruled by a strong leader named Genghis Khan. He and his horse riders traveled far across grassy fields and deserts. They took over many places and made one of the biggest lands ever. People in the empire traded silk, spices, and stories along long roads. Today, you can still see old walls and hear tales about them in some countries.
Mongolia\n\nMongolia is a big country in Asia. It has wide, flat grassy lands and some tall mountains. In the south, there is a hot, sandy place called the Gobi Desert. Many people there move from place to place with their animals, like horses and sheep. They live in round, white tents called gers. The capital city is Ulaanbaatar, where many people live. In winter, it gets very, very cold, and in summer, it is warm. Mongolia has more sunny days than most places on Earth.
Mongoose\n\nA mongoose is a small furry animal with a long body and a bushy tail. It has short legs, sharp claws, and tiny round ears. It lives in warm places like Africa and Asia, where it runs through grass and bushes. It is famous for fighting and eating snakes, even big ones with poison. It moves very fast and is not afraid. Some people know a mongoose from a story called Rikki-Tikki-Tavi, where it saves a family from two bad snakes.
Monk\n\nA monk is a person who lives a simple, quiet life. He often wears a long robe and has no hair on his head. You can find him in a quiet building called a temple or a monastery. He spends his day praying, thinking, and helping others. He does not keep many things and shares what he has. Sometimes he sings soft songs and lights candles.
Monkey\n\nA monkey is a smart animal that lives mostly in trees. It has two arms, two legs, and a long tail. Some monkeys have a tail that can grab branches like a hand. Monkeys live in warm places with lots of trees, like jungles and forests. They eat fruit, leaves, and sometimes bugs. A group of monkeys is called a troop. You might see a monkey at the zoo swinging from branch to branch.
Monopoly\n\nA monopoly is when only one person or company sells something. It means no one else can sell the same thing. For example, if only one store in town sells ice cream, that store is a monopoly. It can pick the price because there is no other store to buy from. Sometimes a monopoly is a big company that makes all the phones or all the lights work. The government watches monopolies to make sure prices are fair.
Monopoly (game)\n\nMonopoly is a fun game you play on a flat board with friends or family. It has a big square board with many colored spaces. You move a small piece around the board by rolling two dice. You can buy streets and houses with play money. The goal is to have the most money when others run out. You can find it in toy stores or at home on game night.
Monorail\n\nA monorail is a kind of train that rides on one thin rail. It looks like a long bus that sits on top of a tall track. You can find it in some big cities, where it carries people from place to place. It moves on wheels that hug the rail from the sides. Some monorails use magnets to float above the rail, which makes the ride very smooth. Because it is hard to build, you do not see it everywhere. A monorail is often high up, so it does not get stuck in car traffic.
Monotreme\n\nA monotreme is a very special kind of animal. It has fur and makes milk for its babies, just like other mammals. But it is different because it lays eggs, like a bird or a turtle. It lives in Australia and New Guinea. The two kinds you might see are the platypus and the echidna. The platypus has a flat bill like a duck and loves to swim. The echidna has sharp spines and a long nose. Both are shy and hard to find in the wild.
Monsoon\n\nA monsoon is a big wind that brings lots of rain for many days. It happens when the land gets very hot and the sea stays cool. The hot air over the land goes up, and cool wet air from the sea rushes in. This wet air makes heavy rain fall on the land. You can see a monsoon in places like India, where it rains so much that streets fill with water. It helps plants grow, but sometimes it causes floods.
Monster\n\nA monster is a made-up creature from stories. It often looks big, scary, or ugly with sharp teeth or claws. You find it in fairy tales, movies, or books where it might roar or chase people. Sometimes a monster is mean and tries to scare others, but in some stories it is friendly and helps. A child might see a monster in a cartoon like a big, furry one with horns.
Mont Blanc\n\nMont Blanc is a very tall mountain. It is covered with white snow on top. You can find it in a big group of mountains called the Alps. It sits between two countries, France and Italy. Many people climb it with special boots and ropes. From far away, it looks like a giant white triangle against the blue sky.
Montenegro\n\nMontenegro is a small country near the sea. It has tall mountains that look dark, so its name means Black Mountain. You can find it on a map next to other countries like Croatia and Albania. Many people there speak a language called Montenegrin. The capital city is Podgorica, where many people live and work. In the past, it was part of a bigger country, but now it stands on its own. The sea next to it is blue and pretty, and people like to swim there in summer.
Month\n\nA month is a way to measure time. It is one of the twelve parts of a year. Each month has about 30 days. You can see months on a calendar on the wall. Some months are named January, June, or October. A month is a little longer than the time it takes for the moon to go around the Earth.
Montreal\n\nMontreal is a big city in Canada. It sits on an island in a wide river. In the middle of it, there is a small mountain called Mount Royal. Many people there speak French. You can see old stone buildings and ride in a cart pulled by a horse. It is also where ice hockey was first played.
Moo\n\nMoo is the sound a cow makes. It is a low, loud noise that comes from its big mouth. You can hear it on a farm when a cow is hungry or wants to say hello. Sometimes a calf, which is a baby cow, makes a smaller moo to call its mom. If you visit a farm, you might hear many moos in the field.
Mood\n\nA mood is how you feel inside. It can be happy, sad, or angry. When you wake up and want to play, you are in a good mood. When you feel grumpy and want to be alone, you are in a bad mood. A mood can stay for a little while or a long time. Things that happen can change it. If you get a new toy, you feel happy. If you fall down, you feel sad. Everyone has moods every day.
Moon\n\nThe Moon is a big, round rock that moves around Earth. It looks white or gray in the sky. You can see it at night, and sometimes during the day. It is very far away, so it looks small. The Moon has no air, no wind, and no rain. It is covered in dust and has many big holes called craters. The Moon does not make its own light. It shines because the Sun lights it up. Sometimes it looks like a circle, and sometimes it looks like a thin banana. People have walked on the Moon and left footprints there. Those footprints stay for a very long time because there is no wind to blow them away.
Moon landing\n\nA Moon landing is when a spaceship goes all the way to the Moon and touches down on its ground. The Moon is a big round rock that shines in the night sky. It is very far away. People built a special ship to fly there. The ship had a part that stayed in space and a small part that went down to the Moon. When it landed, a door opened and a person stepped out. He wore a big white suit and a round helmet. He walked on the Moon and left footprints in the gray dust. He put up a flag and picked up some rocks to bring back. Only a few people have ever walked on the Moon. The last time was a long time ago. Now we use robots to land on the Moon and look around.
Moor\n\nA moor is a big, open land with low plants and soft, wet ground. It has no tall trees, just small bushes, grass, and moss. You can find it in places where it rains a lot and the sky looks wide. Many birds and small animals live there. The ground feels squishy under your feet because it holds water. Sometimes people walk on a moor with boots to keep their feet dry.
Moose\n\nA moose is a very big animal with long legs and a big nose. It has brown fur that keeps it warm. It lives in cold places with many trees, lakes, and snow. A boy moose has big flat antlers on its head. It eats grass, leaves, and water plants. Sometimes people see a moose near a road, and cars must be careful not to hit it.
Mop\n\nA mop is a long stick with soft strings or a sponge at the end. It is used to clean floors with water and soap. You push it back and forth to wipe away dirt and spills. Many people keep a mop in a closet or a bucket. After using it, you rinse it and let it dry.
Morality\n\nMorality is knowing what is right and what is wrong. It is like a little voice inside that helps you choose to be kind and fair. You learn it from your mom, dad, teachers, and friends. When you share a toy or help someone who is sad, that is a good choice. When a story ends with a short lesson, that lesson is called the moral. The opposite of a good choice is a bad choice.
More\n\nMore means a bigger number or a bigger amount of something. If you have one cookie and get another cookie, you have more cookies. You can see more when you add things together. At snack time, you might ask for more crackers. When you pour water into a cup, the water goes up and you have more water. More is the opposite of less.
Morning\n\nMorning is the first part of the day. It starts when the sun comes up and the sky gets light. You wake up in the morning and eat breakfast. The air feels cool and fresh. Birds sing and flowers open up. Morning is a good time to play outside or go to school.
Morocco\n\nMorocco is a country in the north of Africa. It has big blue water on two sides: the sea to the north and the ocean to the west. The land has green farms, tall cold mountains, and hot dry sand. The king lives in the capital city called Rabat, but the biggest city is Casablanca. Many people in Morocco speak Arabic or Berber. They cook tasty food with spices and mint tea. Some people visit to see old buildings and warm sunny beaches.
Morse code\n\nMorse code is a way to send messages using dots and dashes. A dot is a short beep or flash, and a dash is a longer one. People used it a long time ago with machines that went beep-beep. Sailors on ships could blink lights to talk to other ships. Today, some people still use it for fun with radios. You can even try it on a phone app.
Mortgage\n\nA mortgage is a big promise to pay back money for a house. It is a way to buy a home when you do not have all the money right now. A bank gives you the money, and you promise to give it back a little bit every month. The house is like a safety net: if you cannot pay, the bank may take the house. Many grown-ups use a mortgage to live in their own home.
Mosaic\n\nA mosaic is a picture made from many tiny pieces. It uses small bits of stone, glass, or colored tiles. You can see it on walls, floors, and even on the ground outside. People push the little pieces into soft wet stuff that dries hard and holds them tight. Some pieces are shiny like gold, but they are really glass with a thin gold back. Old mosaics from long ago still look pretty today. Many old churches have big mosaics that tell stories. Today, people make mosaics from broken plates, mirrors, and bright tiles to make a plain wall look happy.
Moscow\n\nMoscow is a big city in Russia. It has many old and pretty buildings, like the colorful Saint Basil's Cathedral and the tall Kremlin walls. It sits next to a river called the Moskva River. Many people live there, and it is the capital city where the country's leaders work. In winter, it gets very cold and snow covers the ground. You can ride a train under the ground called the Metro to go around the city.
Moses\n\nMoses is a very important person from old, old stories. He lived a long, long time ago. In the stories, he was a baby who was put in a basket on a river to keep him safe. A princess found him and took care of him. When he grew up, he helped his people leave a place where they were not treated well. He led them through a big sea that opened up for them. He also went up a tall mountain and came back with special rules from God. These rules are called the Ten Commandments. They tell people to be good and kind. Many people still remember Moses and his story today.
Mosque\n\nA mosque is a special building where Muslim people go to pray. It often has a big round dome on top and a tall thin tower called a minaret. You can find a mosque in many towns and cities around the world. Inside, people sit on soft rugs and face a wall that points to a holy city. Before they pray, they wash their hands and feet to be clean. A mosque is also a place where people learn, meet friends, and celebrate happy days like weddings.
Mosquito\n\nA mosquito is a tiny flying bug. It has six legs, two wings, and a long thin mouth. You can find it near water, like ponds or puddles. The girl mosquito bites people and animals to drink a little blood. The bite makes a red bump that feels itchy. The boy mosquito does not bite; it drinks sweet juice from flowers. Mosquitoes can carry germs that make people sick, so it is good to stay away from them.
Moss\n\nMoss is a tiny green plant that grows in soft, fuzzy patches. It has no roots, no flowers, and no seeds. You find it in wet places like near a river, on rocks, or on tree bark in the woods. It soaks up water like a sponge to stay alive. When it is dry, it can pause and wait for rain. Many people see moss on old stones or in shady gardens.
Most\n\nMost means the biggest number or the biggest part of something. If you have ten cookies and you eat seven, you ate most of the cookies. It is a word that helps you talk about almost all of a group. When you see a big pile of red blocks with just a few blue blocks, you can say most blocks are red.
Mostly\n\nMostly means almost all of something. If you have ten cookies and you eat nine, you ate mostly all the cookies. It is a word we use when a big part of a group is one way. For example, if the sky is mostly blue with a few white clouds, it means there is more blue than clouds. You can use it to talk about food, toys, or even your day.
Moth\n\nA moth is a small flying bug with soft wings. It looks a lot like a butterfly, but it comes out at night. It has two feelers on its head that look like tiny feathers. When it rests, it holds its wings flat on its back. You can see a moth near a bright light outside at night. It flies around the light because the light confuses it. Some moths help flowers grow by carrying yellow dust from flower to flower. A baby moth is called a caterpillar, and it eats leaves.
Mother\n\nA mother is a woman who has a child. She can give birth to a baby after carrying it inside her body for about nine months.
