She can also be a mother by taking care of a child who is not born from her body. A mother feeds her baby milk from her body or from a bottle. She holds the baby close, sings soft songs, and keeps it warm and safe. Many children call their mother "Mom" or "Mommy."
Motion\n\nMotion is when something moves from one place to another. It can be fast like a running dog, or slow like a turtle walking. You see it when a ball rolls on the floor, when a swing goes back and forth, or when your legs push you on a scooter. Everything that moves has motion. Even when you blink your eyes, that is a tiny motion.
Motion (disambiguation)\n\nMotion is when something moves from one place to another. It can be a ball rolling on the floor or a bird flying in the sky. You see it when you run, jump, or wave your hand. It is also when a car drives down the street or a leaf falls from a tree. Everything that changes where it is has motion.
Motivation\n\nMotivation is the feeling that makes you want to do something. It is like a little push inside you. When you are hungry, it tells you to eat. When you see a toy you like, it tells you to play. It can come from inside, like feeling proud after you finish a puzzle. It can also come from outside, like a smile from Mom when you share. Everyone has it, and it helps you try new things.
Motor\n\nA motor is a machine that makes things move. It has parts inside that spin or turn when you give it power. You can find a motor in a car, a fan, a toy train, or a blender. It helps the wheels go around or the blades spin fast. When you press a button on a toy car, the motor inside makes it zoom across the floor.
Motorcycle\n\nA motorcycle is a machine that takes people from one place to another. It has two wheels, a seat, and a loud motor. It looks like a bicycle but goes much faster. You can see it on roads and sometimes on dirt tracks. One person sits on it and holds the handles to steer. Sometimes a friend rides on the back. It is smaller than a car, so it can zip through tight spaces. But it does not have a roof or doors, so the rider must wear a hard hat called a helmet. Many people use it for fun or to get to work.
Moulting\n\nMoulting is when an animal drops its old skin or coat. It happens so the animal can grow bigger or get a fresh cover. A snake slides out of its old skin and leaves it behind. A bird loses old feathers and grows new ones. A dog loses some fur, especially when the weather gets warm. After moulting, the animal has a clean, new layer that fits better.
Mount\n\nA mount is an animal you can ride on. It has a strong back and four legs. You can find it on a farm or in a big field. People sit on it to go from one place to another. A horse is a mount that many children see in books or at a petting zoo.
Mount Etna\n\nMount Etna is a big mountain that can shoot out hot, melted rock. It sits on an island called Sicily, near the country of Italy. It is the biggest fire mountain in all of Europe that still wakes up. Sometimes it gets loud and red, and hot orange rock called lava runs down its sides. The lava can burn trees and houses. People who live near it watch it very carefully. They move away when it gets too loud. Even though it can be scary, many people visit to see it from far away.
Mount Everest\n\nMount Everest is the tallest mountain on Earth. It is a giant rock and ice peak that reaches way up into the sky. It sits in a faraway place called Asia, between two countries named Nepal and China. The top is so high that the air is very thin, and people need extra air to breathe. Many brave climbers try to walk to the top, but it is very hard and cold. The first people to reach the top were Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay. Today, some people live near the bottom and help climbers by carrying food and tents.
Mount Fuji\n\nMount Fuji is a very tall mountain in Japan. It is the tallest mountain there. It is also a sleeping fire mountain. It has a white top that is snow. You can see it from far away. Many people climb it in the summer. It is in many pretty pictures and art.
Mount Kailash\n\nMount Kailash is a very tall, rocky mountain in a far-away land called Tibet. It has a round top that is always covered with white snow. Many people think it is a holy place. They walk around the bottom of it to show love and respect. No one climbs to the top of it because people believe it is too special to touch.
Mount Kenya\n\nMount Kenya is a very tall mountain in the country of Kenya. It is the tallest mountain in Kenya and the second tallest in all of Africa. It is an old volcano that does not erupt anymore. It sits right on the equator, which is an imaginary line around the middle of the Earth. You can find it northeast of the big city called Nairobi. The top of the mountain is so high that it has snow and ice, even though it is in a warm place.
Mount Kilimanjaro\n\nMount Kilimanjaro is a very tall mountain in Africa. It has a flat top and is so high that snow sits on it, even when the land around it is hot. You can find it in a country called Tanzania, where the ground is mostly flat. People from all over the world climb it, walking up long paths for many days. From the top, you can see far across the plains. Long ago, it was a fire mountain, but it has been quiet for a very, very long time.
Mount St. Helens\n\nMount St. Helens is a big mountain that can blow up. It is a volcano in a place called Washington. It looks like a tall cone with a wide, round hole at the top. Long ago, people called it a name that means fire mountain. In 1980, it blew up with a loud boom. Hot rocks and ash flew high into the sky. The top of the mountain fell down and became shorter. Gray mud ran down the sides and broke trees and bridges. Today, it still has small puffs of steam and ash. You can see it from far away on a clear day.
Mount Tai\n\nMount Tai is a very tall mountain in China. It has rocks, trees, and a top that reaches high into the sky. Many people visit it to walk up the long paths and see the view. It is a special place where people have come for a very long time to feel close to nature and the sky. Some people go there for a big happy party with music and dancing. You can see it in pictures of China with its big shape and green trees.
Mount Vesuvius\n\nMount Vesuvius is a big mountain that can blow up hot fire and smoke. It is in a country called Italy, near a big blue sea. A long time ago, it threw out so much hot ash that it covered two whole towns. The towns stayed hidden under the ash for many, many years. Today, people can walk there and see old houses and streets. It still sleeps, but one day it might wake up again.
Mountain\n\nA mountain is a very big bump on the ground. It is much taller than a hill and has a pointy top. You can find it in many places, like in big parks or far away lands. Some mountains have snow on top all year, even when it is warm down below. People like to climb up a mountain to see far, far away. A mountain can be made when hot rock from deep inside the earth pushes up, or when big pieces of land slowly bump into each other. The tallest one on Earth is called Mount Everest.
Mountain biking\n\nMountain biking is riding a strong bike on bumpy, rocky paths. It has big, knobby tires and a tough frame. You find it on dirt trails in forests, hills, or mountains. People ride it for fun and to go fast down slopes. A rider wears a helmet and pads to stay safe.
Mountain pass\n\nA mountain pass is a low path between two tall hills or mountains. It looks like a saddle on a horse, with high ground on both sides. You find it high up where the land dips down. People use it to walk or drive from one side of the mountains to the other. Long ago, traders and travelers crossed passes to bring food and goods to new places. Today, roads and train tracks often go through a pass. Some passes have a tunnel under them so cars can go faster. The top of a pass is flat, so people sometimes build small houses or shops there.
Mountain range\n\nA mountain range is a long line of many mountains close together. It has tall peaks, low valleys, and paths called passes. You can see mountain ranges in many parts of the world, like the big snowy ones in pictures. They are made of rock and can be very old. When clouds hit a mountain range, it often makes rain or snow on one side. Over a very long time, wind and water wear the mountains down into smaller hills.
Mountaineering\n\nMountaineering is climbing up big, tall mountains. It is a hobby for many people, but a few do it as a job. A person who does it is called a mountaineer. They use their arms and legs to pull and push up the rocks and snow. They wear strong shoes and a hard hat to stay safe. They also use ropes to hold on to each other. It can be very cold and slippery, so they bring warm clothes and tools. Some mountaineers climb to see the view from the top. Others study the mountain for science. It is hard work, but it feels good to reach the top.
Mouse\n\nA mouse is a tiny animal with soft fur. It has a pointy nose, small round ears, a long thin tail, and tiny feet. You can find it in houses, fields, or forests. It looks for food like seeds and berries. Some people keep it as a pet in a cage. A mouse can be brown or gray. It is very quick and can run fast. Cats and owls try to catch it.
Mouth\n\nA mouth is the hole in your face that you use to eat and talk. It has lips on the outside and teeth and a tongue inside. You find it on every person and animal. It chews food into tiny bits so your body can use it. It also helps you say words, sing songs, and laugh. When you smile, your mouth shows your teeth.
Move\n\nTo move is to go from one place to another. It can be a big jump, a small step, or a wiggle. You move your body when you walk, run, or dance. Animals move too—a bird flies, a fish swims, and a worm crawls. When you move a toy, you pick it up and put it somewhere new. Moving helps you play, work, and get things done.
Movement\n\nMovement is when something changes its place or position. It can be fast like a rabbit hopping, or slow like a snail crawling. You see movement when you run, jump, or wave your hand. Animals use movement to find food or play. Even things like leaves move when the wind blows.
Movie\n\nA movie is a story told with moving pictures and sound. It can make you laugh, cry, or feel excited. You can watch it at home on a TV, on a tablet, or in a big dark room called a theater. People make it by taking many fast pictures and adding voices and music. Some movies are about funny animals, and some are about brave heroes. A movie you might know is one with a talking snowman or a flying carpet.
Movie festival\n\nA movie festival is a big show where people watch many movies. It happens in a big room with a very large screen. Many people come to see new movies together. Sometimes the people who made the movies talk about them. You might see a movie festival in a big city near you.
Movie theatre\n\nA movie theatre is a big room where people watch movies together. It has a very large screen at the front, and many soft chairs to sit in. The sound comes from speakers on the walls, so you can hear the movie all around you. You can buy popcorn, candy, and drinks at a little shop inside. A movie theatre is sometimes called a cinema. Some have more than one screen, so you can pick which movie to see. It is a fun place to go with your family.
Mozambique\n\nMozambique is a country in Africa. It sits next to the big blue ocean on one side and has other countries around it. A long river called the Zambezi runs through the middle. The land has flat parts, hills, and some tall rocky places. Many people live in small villages and grow food like corn and cassava. They speak Portuguese and other local languages. The weather is hot and has a rainy time and a dry time. People make music with wooden drums and a kind of xylophone called a marimba. They also carve beautiful wooden masks and figures. A favorite food is chicken cooked with a spicy red sauce. Children there like to play football.
Mozart\n\nMozart was a man who made music a long time ago. He played the piano and wrote many songs. His music is still played today in big rooms with lots of chairs. You might hear it in a cartoon or a movie. Some of his songs are fast and happy, and some are slow and soft.
Mr\n\nMr is a short word we put before a man's name. It is a way to be polite, like saying hello with your words. You might hear it when someone talks to your dad or a teacher. For example, your friend's dad might be called Mr Smith. It is not used for boys, only for grown-up men.
Much\n\nMuch means a lot of something. It is a word we use when there is more than a little. You can have much water in a big cup or much sand in a bucket. When you see many toys on the floor, you can say there is much to clean up. It is the opposite of a tiny bit.
Mud\n\nMud is soft, wet dirt. It feels squishy and sticky when you touch it. You can find it on the ground after rain or near a pond. Children like to play in it and make mud pies. Pigs and some other animals roll in it to stay cool. When it dries, it becomes hard and can crack.
Muddy\n\nMuddy means covered in wet, sticky dirt. It feels soft and squishy under your feet. You find it outside after rain, in puddles or on a path. When you play in it, your shoes and clothes get brown and dirty. A muddy puddle is fun to jump in with boots on.
Mug\n\nA mug is a cup with a handle. It is round and deep, and you can hold it with one hand. People use it to drink hot things like milk, tea, or hot chocolate. You can find a mug in the kitchen, on a shelf, or next to the sink. Some mugs have pictures, words, or funny faces on them. A mug keeps your drink warm while you sip.
Mughal\n\nMughal is a name for a group of people who lived long ago in a big land called India. They built very big, pretty houses with round tops and tall towers. One famous house they built is the Taj Mahal, which is all white and shiny. People today still visit it to see how beautiful it is. The Mughal people also made soft, colorful cloth and cooked yummy food with lots of spices.
Mughal Empire\n\nThe Mughal Empire was a big group of people who ruled a large part of India a long time ago. They had a strong leader called an emperor. They built beautiful buildings with big domes and tall towers. One famous building they made is the Taj Mahal, which looks like a white palace. People visit it today to see how pretty it is. The empire was known for its art, gardens, and busy markets.
Mulberry\n\nA mulberry is a tree that grows sweet fruit. It has wide green leaves that can have bumpy edges. The fruit grows in little bunches and can be red, dark purple, or white. People pick the fruit to eat fresh or to make pies and sweet drinks. Some mulberry leaves are food for a special worm that makes silk.
Mule\n\nA mule is an animal that comes from a horse mom and a donkey dad. It has long ears like a donkey and a big body like a horse. Its coat can be white, gray, brown, or black. People use it to pull carts and carry heavy things. You might see one on a farm or in a parade.
Mullet (fish)\n\nA mullet is a kind of fish that lives in the water. It has a long body with two fins on its back and a small mouth shaped like a triangle. You can find it in warm seas near the shore, and sometimes in rivers and lakes. It eats tiny bits of old plants and animals from the mud. People catch it to eat, and it has been food for a very long time. Sometimes it jumps out of the water to get away from bigger fish that want to eat it.
Multiculturalism\n\nMulticulturalism is when many different kinds of people live together in one place. It means people have different ways of talking, eating, and playing. You can see it in a big city where families come from far-away lands. They share their songs, food, and stories with each other. Everyone is kind and says it is okay to be different. A school with children from many places is a good example.
Multilingualism\n\nMultilingualism is when a person can talk in more than one language. It means you know words from two or more ways of speaking. Many people learn one language as a baby and another later in school. You can find people who speak two languages in big cities and in families that moved from one country to another. It helps when you travel or meet new friends who do not talk like you. A person who knows many languages is sometimes called a polyglot.
Multimedia\n\nMultimedia is a way to share stories or ideas using many things at once. It can use words, pictures, sounds, and moving pictures all together. You see it on a computer, a tablet, or a phone. A game on a tablet that has music, talking, and moving pictures is multimedia. A video that shows a song with dancing and words on the screen is multimedia too.
Multiplication\n\nMultiplication is a way to add the same number many times. It uses a special sign that looks like a small x. You can think of it as counting groups of things. For example, if you have 3 bags and each bag has 2 apples, you have 3 times 2 apples, which is 6 apples. It helps you find the total quickly without adding one by one. You can see it on a chart called a times table at school.
Mum\n\nA mum is your mom. She is the person who takes care of you every day. She gives you hugs, makes your meals, and reads you stories at bedtime. You can find her at home, in the kitchen, or in the garden. She loves you more than anything in the whole wide world.
Mumbai\n\nMumbai is a very big city in India. It sits next to the sea on the west side of the country. Many, many people live there — more than you can count. It has tall buildings, busy streets, and a big bridge by the water. People in Mumbai work with money, make movies, and sell things. The movies they make are full of songs and dancing. Boats and trains help people move around the city every day.
Mummification\n\nMummification is a way to keep a dead body from rotting. It makes the body dry and leathery. Long ago in Egypt, people did this on purpose. They took out the soft parts inside the body and wrapped it in cloth strips. They put a mask on the face so the person could be known later. Sometimes a body dries out all by itself in a very hot, dry place like a desert. A mummy can also form in a cold, windy place or in a wet, sour bog. You can see a mummy in a big museum.
Mummy\n\nA mummy is a mom. It is a warm word for mother. A child calls her mom "Mummy" when they want a hug or need help. She takes care of you, makes food, and reads stories at bedtime. You might say "Mummy, look!" when you draw a picture. She smiles and says "Good job!"
Mumps\n\nMumps is a sickness that only people can get. It makes parts of the face and neck swell up and feel sore. A person with it may feel very hot and have a headache. There is a special shot that can stop a person from getting it. Many children get this shot so they stay healthy.
Munich\n\nMunich is a big city in Germany. It has many houses, tall buildings, and a river that runs through it. Many people live there, and it is a place where cars, trains, and buses move around. People in Munich work in offices, shops, and big halls where they make things. Some people go to a big park in the middle of the city to play and walk. In the fall, many people come to Munich for a happy party with music, food, and rides. It is a city that many children visit with their families.
Mural\n\nA mural is a big painting on a wall or a ceiling. It is made with bright colors and can cover a whole side of a building. You can see it outside on a street wall or inside a big room like a library. People make it to tell a story or make a place look pretty. Sometimes many people paint it together. A mural can show trees, animals, or people dancing.
Murray River\n\nThe Murray River is a very long river in Australia. It starts high in snowy mountains and flows across the land. It is so long that it makes a border between two big parts of Australia. Many other rivers join it, and together they bring water to farms. People use the water to grow food. A long time ago, boats with big wheels carried people and things up and down the river. Today, you can see big trees with red wood growing near the water. The river ends at a big lake and then flows into the sea.
Muscat\n\nMuscat is a big city in a country called Oman. It sits next to the sea on the north east side of the country. It is very hot and dry there, with almost no rain. Long ago, many people fought to own the city because of its busy port. Today, people visit Muscat to see old buildings, play at the beach, and watch dolphins in the water.
Muscle\n\nA muscle is a soft part inside your body that helps you move. It is like a stretchy band that can get shorter and pull. You have many muscles all over your body, under your skin. It lets you run, jump, smile, and pick up your toys. Your heart is a special muscle that pumps blood all day long without you telling it to. When you eat good food and play outside, it grows bigger and stronger.
Muse d'Orsay\n\nThe Muse d'Orsay is a big art museum in Paris. It was once a train station a long time ago. Now it is full of pretty paintings and statues. You can see art made by people who painted with soft, light colors. Many of the pictures show flowers, water, and people dancing. It is a happy place to visit.
Museum\n\nA museum is a big building where people can go to see old and special things. It has many rooms with things like paintings, dinosaur bones, or old toys. You can find a museum in a city or a town. People go there to look and learn new things. Some museums let you touch or play with the things inside. A museum is a quiet place where you walk and look with your eyes.
Museum of Modern Art\n\nThe Museum of Modern Art is a big building full of paintings and art. It is in New York City, on a street called 53rd Street. Inside, you can see bright colors, funny shapes, and big pictures made by artists. One famous painting there has stars that swirl in the sky. Another has a can of soup painted on it. People from all over the world come to look at the art. It is a place where you can walk around and see many new things.
Mushroom\n\nA mushroom is a small living thing that grows from the ground. It has a soft top part called a cap and a long thin part called a stem. Under the cap, there are tiny lines that hold little seeds. You can find it in wet, dark places like woods or grass after rain. Some mushrooms are safe to eat and people cook them in food. But some are bad and can make you very sick if you eat them. Never pick a mushroom without a grown-up who knows which ones are safe.
Music\n\nMusic is sound that people make to feel happy or to dance. It has a beat you can tap your foot to and a tune you can hum. You hear it on the radio, on TV, and when people sing or play instruments like a piano or a drum. It can be fast and loud, or slow and soft. When you clap your hands or sing a song, you are making music too.
Music industry\n\nThe music industry is all the people and companies that make music and sell it. It includes singers, bands, and people who write songs. It also has places where music is recorded, like a big room with microphones. You can hear the music on the radio, on a phone, or at a concert. When you buy a song or listen to it, you help the music industry.
Music of Africa\n\nMusic of Africa is the songs and sounds people make in Africa. It is very old and comes from many different places on the big land. People use it to sing and dance for happy times and special days. It helps tell stories from long ago. Some music has drums that go boom-boom-boom. Other music has strings you pluck or shake. Today, some music mixes old African sounds with new pop sounds. You can hear it on the radio or see people dance to it on TV.
Music video\n\nA music video is a short movie made for a song. It shows the singer or band on a TV screen. They move their lips to the words and dance or act out a story. You can watch it on special TV channels or on a phone. It helps people see the song and not just hear it.
Musical\n\nA musical is a show where people sing, dance, and act to tell a story. It happens on a big stage with bright lights and colorful clothes. You can see it in a theater with your family. The songs help show how the people feel, like happy or sad. Some musicals have animals or funny characters that make you laugh.
Musical genre\n\nA musical genre is a way to group music that sounds alike. It is like a big family of songs that share the same feel. You can find it on the radio, on TV, or when people play instruments. Some kinds make you want to dance fast, and some are slow and soft for bedtime. A song with a happy beat and loud drums is one example you might hear at a party.
Musical instrument\n\nA musical instrument is a thing that makes music. It can be big or small. You hit it, blow into it, or shake it to make a sound. A drum is one kind. You hit it with sticks. A guitar is another kind. You move your fingers on its strings. Many people play instruments together in a big group called an orchestra. You can hear them in songs on the radio.
Musical notation\n\nMusical notation is a way to write down music so people can play it later. It uses special marks on five lines. You can find it in song books or on paper for piano lessons. It tells you how high or low to sing and how fast to go. When you see notes going up, the sound goes up too.
Musical theater\n\nMusical theater is a show on a stage where people tell a story. It uses acting, singing, and dancing. You can see it in a big room with many seats called a theater. The actors talk and sing songs to make the story fun. Some shows have lots of dancing too. A famous one is "The Sound of Music," where a family sings together.
Musician\n\nA musician is a person who makes music. He can play a tool that makes sounds, like a guitar or a drum. He can also sing songs with his voice. Some musicians write new songs for other people to play. You can see a musician on a stage, on TV, or at a school show. When many musicians play together, they are called a band.
Musicology\n\nMusicology is the study of music. It is like being a music detective. People who do this look at how songs are made, how they sound, and why we like them. They listen to old songs and new songs from all over the world. They write down what they learn so we can understand music better. You might see a musicology book in a library or a school.
Musk ox\n\nA musk ox is a big, furry animal that lives in very cold places. It has a thick, warm coat and long, curved horns on its head. It lives in the far north, where snow and ice cover the ground. It eats grass, leaves, and small flowers. When wolves come near, it stands in a circle with its friends to stay safe. It uses its strong head and horns to push away danger.
Muskrat\n\nA muskrat is a small animal that lives in water. It has brown fur, a long tail, and sharp teeth. You can find it in ponds, lakes, and wet places with tall grass. It is a great swimmer and can stay under the water for a long time. It builds a round house out of mud and plants to keep safe. The house has a door under the water so other animals cannot get in. A muskrat got its name because it can make a strong smell.
Muslim occasions\n\nMuslim occasions are special days and times that Muslim people celebrate. They happen all through the year. Some are happy feasts with food and family, like Eid ul-Fitr after a month of fasting. Others are quiet days for prayer and thinking, like Fridays when people go to the mosque. Many occasions remember stories about the prophet Muhammad. During Ramadan, grown-ups do not eat or drink while the sun is up. They learn to be patient and kind. Children might get gifts or see lights and decorations. These days bring people together to share and help others.
Must\n\nMust is something you have to do. It is a rule or a need. When your mom says you must brush your teeth, it means you cannot skip it. You must eat food to stay alive. You must look both ways before you cross the street. It is a strong word for things that are very important.
Mustache\n\nA mustache is hair that grows on the upper lip of some men. It can be thick and bushy or thin and small. Some men let it grow long, and some cut it short. Many men shave it off every day so it stays smooth. A mustache is just above the mouth, under the nose. Some animals, like a walrus, have long hair near their mouth that people also call a mustache.
Mustelid\n\nA mustelid is a furry animal that eats meat. It has a long, thin body and short legs. Some mustelids live in the water, like the otter, and some live in cold, snowy places. One kind, the ferret, is kept as a pet. It looks like a long, stretchy rat and is sometimes called a tube rat. Other mustelids are weasels and wolverines.
Mute\n\nMute means no sound comes out. It is when a person or a thing is very, very quiet. A TV can be mute if you press a button and the sound stops. Some people cannot talk, so they are mute. They may use their hands to show words instead. A mute button on a phone lets you listen without the other person hearing you.
Mutton\n\nMutton is meat from a grown-up sheep. It comes from a sheep that is older than one year. It has a strong, rich taste that some people like very much. You can cook it in a pot with carrots and potatoes to make a warm stew. In some places, people eat it for a big family meal. It is not as soft as meat from a baby sheep, but it has more flavor.
My\n\nMy is a word you use when something belongs to you. You say it to show that a thing is yours. For example, you might say "my toy" or "my book." It is a small word, but it helps people know what is special to you.
Myanmar\n\nMyanmar is a country in Asia. It has big rivers, green hills, and many trees. People live in busy cities and small villages. In the country, you can see golden temples that shine in the sun. Farmers grow rice in wet fields. Many people there speak a language called Burmese. It is next to other countries like China and India.
Myocardial Infarction\n\nMyocardial Infarction is a big name for a heart attack. It happens when blood cannot get to a part of the heart. The heart is a strong muscle inside your chest that pumps blood all over your body. When a small tube that brings blood to the heart gets blocked, that part of the heart gets hurt. It can make a person feel a very bad pain in the chest. Doctors help by giving medicine or doing a small fix to open the tube again. Eating healthy food and playing outside can help keep the heart happy.
Myself\n\nMyself means me. It is the word I use when I talk about who I am. I have a body with two arms, two legs, and a head. I can do things like run, jump, draw, and sing. I like some foods and not others. I feel happy when I play and sad when I fall down. Myself is special because there is only one me.
Myth\n\nA myth is a very old story. It tells about gods, heroes, or how the world began. People told these stories long ago before books. It is not a true story like in a news show. You might hear a myth about a big strong man or a magic animal. Many myths come from faraway lands.
Mythology\n\nMythology is a big box of old stories. It holds tales that people told long ago to explain the world. These stories talk about gods, heroes, and magic. You can find mythology in books, movies, and pictures. It helps us see how people long ago thought about the sun, the moon, and why things happen. For example, a story about a strong hero who brings fire to people is a myth.
Māori people\n\nMāori people are the first people who lived in New Zealand. They came to the islands a long, long time ago in big boats from warm islands far away. They have their own way of talking, called the Māori language. Today, many Māori people live in New Zealand, and they are a big part of the country. They share songs, dances, and stories with everyone.
Nail\n\nA nail is a small, thin piece of metal. It has a flat top and a very sharp point at the other end. You find nails in a toolbox or at a hardware store. People use a hammer to hit the flat top and push the sharp point into wood. This holds two pieces of wood together, like when building a chair or a birdhouse. A nail is strong and does not bend easily.
Nail (anatomy)\n\nA nail is a hard flat part at the end of your finger or toe. It is smooth and a little bit shiny. You have ten on your hands and ten on your feet. It grows all the time, so you need to cut it with small clippers. Cutting it does not hurt because it has no feeling inside. Some people paint it with pretty colors to make it look nice. It is made of the same stuff as your hair.
Nairobi\n\nNairobi is a big city in a country called Kenya. It has many tall buildings, busy roads, and lots of people. You can find big stores and markets there where people buy food and clothes. It is far from the sea, but a long time ago trains stopped there on a long trip. Many people move to Nairobi to find work, so the city keeps growing bigger.
Naive\n\nNaive means someone does not know much yet. It is like a very young child who thinks the world is always nice. A naive person may believe everything people say. They might not see when someone is tricking them. For example, a little kid who thinks a toy will grow if they plant it in the ground is being naive.
Naja\n\nNaja is a kind of snake that can make its neck wide and flat. It has a special mark on the back of its neck that looks like a pair of glasses. It lives in warm places far away, like Africa and Asia. When it feels scared, it lifts its head and spreads its neck to look big. It eats small animals like mice and birds. Some Naja snakes can even spray a stinging juice from their mouth to keep danger away.
Name\n\nA name is a word we use for a person, an animal, or a thing. It helps us know who is who. Your name is the word your family calls you, like "Emma" or "Liam." Every person has a name. Some people have a first name and a last name, like "Mia Smith." A pet also gets a name, like "Buddy" the dog. When you name something, you pick a word just for it.
Namibia\n\nNamibia is a country in Africa. It is next to the big blue ocean. It has a hot, dry desert with tall orange sand hills. Many wild animals live there, like big cats and elephants. People visit to see the animals and the big sand hills. Some people there play soccer and run fast races.
Nanjing\n\nNanjing is a big city in the east part of China. It has many, many people living there—more than nine million. Long ago, it was called the Southern Capital because the king moved his home to a northern city. Today, it has 11 smaller parts inside it, like pieces of a puzzle. It also has friends in other cities around the world, called sister cities. You might see tall buildings, busy streets, and a big river there.
Nanning\n\nNanning is a big city in China. It has many people living there. You can find it in the south part of the country. It is the most important city in a place called Guangxi. Many buses and cars go through its streets. People there speak Chinese and other local languages.
Nap\n\nA nap is a short sleep you take during the day. It happens when you lie down on a bed, a couch, or a soft mat. You close your eyes and rest your body for a little while. After a nap, you feel more awake and happy. Little kids often take a nap after lunch. Grown-ups sometimes nap when they are very tired.
Napkin\n\nA napkin is a small soft square of paper or cloth. It sits next to your plate at the table. You use it to wipe your mouth and hands while you eat. It can be plain white or have pretty colors and pictures. After a meal, you throw a paper napkin away, but a cloth napkin gets washed and used again.
Narcissus (genus)\n\nNarcissus is a bright spring flower. It has soft petals around a little cup in the middle. The petals are often yellow, but they can be white or light orange too. It grows from a round bulb under the ground, like an onion. You see it in gardens and parks when the cold winter ends. People like to pick it and put it in a vase at home.
Narrative\n\nA narrative is a story. It tells what happens, one thing after another. You find it in books, movies, and when someone tells you about their day. It helps you know who did what and why. When Mom reads a bedtime book, that book has a narrative.
Narrow\n\nNarrow means something is not wide. It is the opposite of wide. A narrow path is a path that is very thin, so only one person can walk on it at a time. A narrow street has houses close together on both sides. A narrow piece of paper is long but not very big from side to side. When you go through a narrow door, you have to turn your body a little bit.
Nation\n\nA nation is a big group of people who live together in one land. They often share the same flag, songs, and stories. You can find a nation on a map, with lines that show where it starts and ends. The people in a nation make rules to help everyone get along. A nation you might know is the one where you live.
National anthem\n\nA national anthem is a special song for a whole country. It is a song that people sing together to show love for their home. You hear it at big games, at school, or on a holiday. When it plays, people stand up tall and quiet. It helps everyone feel like one big family.
National Basketball Association\n\nThe National Basketball Association is a big group of basketball teams. It has 30 teams that play against each other. Most teams are in the United States, and one is in Canada. The players are very tall and jump high to put a ball through a hoop. Many people watch the games on TV or in big arenas. The best team at the end of the year wins a shiny trophy.
National Gallery of Art\n\nThe National Gallery of Art is a big building that holds many paintings and statues. It sits on a long, green park in Washington, D.C. Inside, you can walk through rooms full of colorful art. People come from all over to look at the pictures and shapes. Some art is very old, and some is new. It is a place where you can see art that tells stories without words.
National park\n\nA national park is a big piece of land that a country keeps safe. It has trees, rivers, mountains, and many animals. People can visit it to walk, camp, and see nature. The first one was made a long time ago in a place called Yellowstone. Today, many countries have their own national parks. They help keep the land and animals safe so everyone can enjoy them for a long, long time.
Nationalism\n\nNationalism is a big idea about loving your own country. It means people want their country to make its own choices and not be told what to do by other countries. They feel proud of their land, their flag, and the way people live there. Sometimes it helps small groups stay strong and keep their own ways. But it can also make people not like other countries.
Nationality\n\nNationality is the country where a person was born or belongs to. It is like being part of a big team called a country. You can have the same nationality as your mom and dad. People with the same nationality often speak the same language and celebrate the same holidays. For example, if you were born in Japan, your nationality is Japanese.
Native American\n\nNative Americans are the first people who lived in America. They were here long before anyone came from far away. They have many different groups, called tribes, and each tribe has its own way of talking and its own stories. Some of them lived in big houses made of wood or stone, and some moved around to find food. They grew corn, beans, and squash to eat. Today, many Native Americans live in cities and towns, and some live on special lands called reservations. They keep their old dances, songs, and art alive.
Natural\n\nNatural means something that is not made by people. It comes from the world around us. Trees, flowers, and rivers are natural. The sun, the moon, and the stars are natural too. When you see a bird flying or a rock on the ground, that is natural. It is not made in a factory or by a person.
Natural disaster\n\nA natural disaster is a big, scary event that comes from the Earth or the sky. It can be a flood, where water covers the land. It can be a shaking of the ground called an earthquake. It can be a big storm with strong wind and rain. A volcano can throw out hot, red rock and ash. These events can hurt people and break houses. They happen when the Earth changes, like when the weather gets too wild. Sometimes people make things worse by cutting down too many trees. If a big shake happens where no one lives, it is not a disaster. But if it happens in a town, it can be very bad.
Natural gas\n\nNatural gas is a kind of gas that comes from deep under the ground. It has no color and no smell, so people add a special smell to keep us safe. It burns with a pretty blue flame. People use it in stoves to cook food and in heaters to keep houses warm. Big buildings burn it to make the lights turn on. Some buses and cars can run on it too.
Natural History Museum\n\nA Natural History Museum is a big building full of old bones, rocks, and stuffed animals. It has many rooms with glass cases so you can look at the things inside. You can find it in a big city, and many families go there to learn. Inside, you can see a giant dinosaur skeleton standing tall. It also has shiny stones and colorful butterflies. People who work there study the old things and keep them safe.
Natural number\n\nA natural number is a number you use to count things. It is always a whole number, like 1, 2, or 3. You start counting with 1, because you cannot count zero apples. There is no biggest natural number—you can always add 1 to get the next one. You see natural numbers when you count your fingers, your toys, or the steps you take.
Natural resource\n\nA natural resource is something from nature that people can use. It can be air, water, wood, or sunshine. People find it in forests, rivers, and under the ground. It helps us live: we drink water, we breathe air, and we use wood to build houses. Some of it, like sunshine and wind, never runs out. Other kinds, like oil and coal, can run out if we use too much. We must take care of it so there is enough for later.
Natural Rubber\n\nNatural rubber is a stretchy, bouncy stuff that comes from a tree. It is soft and can be pulled long, then it snaps back. People find it inside the bark of a rubber tree, which grows in hot, rainy places. Workers cut the bark and catch the white, milky sap in a cup. They cook and shape the sap to make things like balls, boots, and gloves. You might see it in a bouncy ball or the soles of your sneakers.
Natural satellite\n\nA natural satellite is a small thing that moves around a big thing in space. It is also called a moon. It does not make its own light. We see it because the Sun's light bounces off it. Earth has one moon. It looks bright and round, then small and thin, then bright again. This takes about four weeks. Some other planets have many moons, and some have none.
Natural selection\n\nNatural selection is how animals and plants change slowly over a very long time. It happens when some living things have a small difference that helps them stay alive. The ones that live longer can have more babies. Those babies often get the same helpful difference. After many, many years, more and more of them have that helpful part. For example, some moths are light and some are dark. When trees got dark from smoke, birds could see the light moths easily and eat them. The dark moths hid better and had more babies. Soon, most moths were dark.
Nature\n\nNature is everything that is not made by people. It is the sky, the trees, the animals, the rivers, and the mountains. You can see it when you go to a park, a forest, or the beach. It gives us air to breathe, water to drink, and food to eat. Birds, bugs, flowers, and big old trees are all part of it. People should take care of it and keep it clean.
Navajo\n\nNavajo is a group of Native American people. They live in the southwestern part of the United States, in places like Arizona, New Mexico, and Utah. They have their own land called the Navajo Nation, which is very big. Many Navajo speak English, and some speak their own language called Diné. They are known for weaving beautiful blankets from sheep wool. A long time ago, some Navajo helped the U.S. Marines by using their language as a secret code during a big war.
Naval mine\n\nA naval mine is a big bomb that sits in the water. It is round or shaped like a ball with pointy parts on the outside. You find it in the sea or in big lakes. It waits under the water until a boat touches it, then it goes BOOM. People use it to stop bad boats from coming close. A long time ago, big countries put many of them in the water to keep their land safe.
Navigation\n\nNavigation is finding your way from one place to another. It helps you know where you are and how to get where you want to go. Long ago, people used the sun, stars, and birds to find their way. Today, many people use a phone or a small screen in a car to show the way. When you walk to your friend's house, you use navigation too.
Navy\n\nA navy is a group of people who protect their country on the water. They use big boats called ships. Some ships carry small, fast flying machines. Other ships can go under the water and hide. The people who work on these boats are called sailors. They wear special blue or white clothes. You might see a navy boat in a big harbor or in a movie about the sea.
Neanderthal\n\nA Neanderthal was a kind of person who lived a long, long time ago. It looked a lot like people today, but it had a bigger, stronger body and a thicker head. It lived in caves in cold places, like Europe. It made tools from stone and hunted big animals for food. It also painted pictures on cave walls. A Neanderthal is not alive anymore, but you can see its bones in a museum.
Near\n\nNear means something is close by. It is not far away. You can see it or touch it with just a few steps. When your toy is on the table right next to you, it is near. When your friend sits beside you at lunch, they are near. The opposite of near is far.
Neat\n\nNeat means clean and tidy. It is how a room looks when all the toys are put away. You can also be neat when your clothes have no spots and your hair is brushed. A neat desk has pencils in a cup and paper in a stack. When things are neat, it is easy to find what you need.
Nebula\n\nA nebula is a big cloud in space. It is made of tiny bits of dust and gas. You can find it far away among the stars. Some nebulae glow with pretty colors, and some are dark and hide the stars behind them. A nebula can be the place where new stars are born. It can also be the leftover cloud when an old star ends its life. If you look through a big telescope, you might see a picture of one that looks like a soft, fuzzy patch of light.
Neck\n\nA neck is the part of your body that holds up your head. It is between your head and your shoulders. It lets you turn your head to look left, right, up, and down. Inside it, there is a tube that carries food from your mouth to your tummy. You can feel it when you swallow. You can also feel the hard bumps in the front of it when you touch it with your fingers.
Necklace\n\nA necklace is a pretty thing you wear around your neck. It is often made of a thin chain or a soft string. It can have small shiny bits like beads, a stone, or a little charm hanging from it. People put it on to look nice for a party or a special day. You might see one on your mom or a teacher. Some necklaces are made of gold or silver and feel cool on your skin.
Need\n\nA need is something you must have to live or be happy. It is not just a wish, like wanting a new toy. Food, water, and a safe place to sleep are needs. When you are hungry, you need food. When you are cold, you need a warm coat. A need is very important, and you cannot go without it for long.
Needle\n\nA needle is a very thin, pointy tool. It is long and shiny, with a tiny hole at one end. You find it in a sewing box at home. People use it to pull thread through cloth to fix a rip or make clothes. A doctor also uses a needle to give medicine, but that kind is even smaller. You might see one when Mom or Dad sews a button back on a shirt.
Negative\n\nNegative means something is not there or not good. It is the opposite of positive. When you say "no," that is a negative answer. A sad face can show a negative feeling. In a test, a negative mark means you got something wrong.
Negative number\n\nA negative number is a number that is less than zero. It has a little minus sign in front of it, like -3. You can find it on a number line to the left of zero. It is used when you talk about things like very cold weather or when you owe someone a cookie. For example, if the temperature is -5 degrees, it is five steps below freezing.
Neighbor\n\nA neighbor is a person who lives near you. They might live in the house next door or down the street. You can wave and say hello when you see them outside. Sometimes they help you, like when they bring in your mail or watch your pet. You can be a good neighbor by being kind and quiet.
Neighborhood\n\nA neighborhood is a small part of a town or city where people live. It has houses, streets, and maybe a park or a store. You can walk around it and see your neighbors. Some neighborhoods are quiet, and some are busy. Your home is in a neighborhood, and you might play outside with friends who live nearby.
Neighbourhood\n\nA neighbourhood is a small part of a city or town where people live near each other. It has houses, streets, and maybe a park or a shop. You find it in every city and town all over the world. People in a neighbourhood often say hello and play together. It is a place where you know your neighbours. For example, your own street with your friends' houses is a neighbourhood.
Nelumbo\n\nNelumbo is a water plant with big, pretty flowers. It has wide leaves that float on top of the water. Its roots sit in the mud under the water. The flowers can be pink or yellow and smell sweet. People can eat the roots and seeds. Cows like to eat the leaves and flowers. You can see it in ponds and lakes.
Neolithic Revolution\n\nThe Neolithic Revolution was a big change a long, long time ago. It happened when people stopped moving around to find food. They learned to plant seeds and grow their own food. They also kept animals like goats and sheep near their homes. Because of this, people built the first villages and stayed in one place. It was the start of farming.
Nepal\n\nNepal is a country in Asia. It is a place with very tall mountains, like Mount Everest, the highest mountain on Earth. You find it between two bigger countries, India and China. Many people in Nepal grow food like rice and wheat on farms. A child might see a picture of Nepal with snowy peaks and colorful flags.
Nepali language\n\nNepali language is a way people talk and write. It is the main language in a country called Nepal. Many people in Nepal speak it at home and at school. It is also spoken in some parts of India and a few other places nearby. The words come from a very old language, and it is written with pretty, curly letters that look like the letters used for Hindi. In Nepal, children learn it in school until they are big.
Nephew\n\nA nephew is the boy child of your brother or sister. He is part of your family, like a cousin or an uncle. You might see him at family parties or when you visit his house. He can be a baby, a little kid, or a big kid. You can play with him, share toys, and read stories together. He calls you aunt or uncle.
Neptune\n\nNeptune is a big, blue planet far away in space. It is the last planet from the Sun. It looks like a soft blue ball because of a gas called methane. It has very strong winds that blow faster than any other planet. You cannot see it without a big telescope, but it is always moving around the Sun.
Nervous\n\nNervous is a feeling you get when you are not sure what will happen. It can make your tummy feel jumpy, like little butterflies inside. You might feel it before you go on a stage or meet new people. Your hands might shake a little, and your heart beats faster. It is okay to feel this way, and it goes away after a while.
Nervous system\n\nThe nervous system is the body's way of sending messages. It has two big parts: the brain and the long cord inside your back. The brain is like a boss that thinks and tells the body what to do. The cord is like a thick wire that carries messages up and down. Tiny cells called nerve cells zip the messages very fast. It helps you feel a soft touch, a hot stove, or a tickle. It also helps you run, jump, and blink your eyes.
Nest\n\nA nest is a small home that birds build. It is made of twigs, grass, and soft things like feathers. You can find it high up in a tree or on a roof. Birds use it to keep their eggs safe and warm. Baby birds stay in it until they can fly. Some nests are round like a little bowl.
Net\n\nA net is a thing made of string or rope with many holes. It looks like a big spider web. You can find a net at the beach, where people use it to catch fish. In a park, you might see a net on a tennis court or a soccer goal. A butterfly net is a small net on a stick that kids use to catch bugs gently.
Netball\n\nNetball is a game where two teams try to throw a ball through a hoop. It is like basketball, but you cannot bounce the ball or run with it. Each team has seven players, and each player stays in one part of the court. The court is a big rectangle with lines on the floor. One player throws the ball to a friend, and then another friend tries to shoot it into the hoop. You might see kids playing netball at school or in a park.
Netherlands\n\nThe Netherlands is a country in Europe. It is a small, flat land with many canals, windmills, and colorful tulip flowers. You can find it next to the sea, near Germany and Belgium. Many people ride bikes there every day. The people speak Dutch and live in cities like Amsterdam. Some parts are so low that big walls called dikes keep the water out.
Neuron\n\nA neuron is a tiny cell inside your body that sends messages. It has a round middle part and long, thin arms that reach out. You find it in your brain and all through your body. It helps you think, feel, and move by passing signals very fast. When you touch something hot, a neuron tells your hand to pull away quickly.
Neutron\n\nA neutron is a tiny piece inside the middle of an atom. It is very, very small, so you cannot see it with your eyes. It sits next to other tiny pieces called protons. Together, they make the center of an atom heavy. Neutrons help hold the atom together. They are in everything around you, like your chair, your water, and even you.
Never\n\nNever means not at any time. It is a word we use when something will not happen, not today, not tomorrow, not ever. You might say, "I will never eat a bug," because you do not want to do it. It is the opposite of always. When you promise to never do something, you mean you will not do it at all.
New\n\nNew means something that was not there before. It can be a toy you just got, a baby that was just born, or a day that just started. When something is new, it looks clean and fresh. You can find new things at a store, in your home, or outside. People feel happy when they see something new because it is a surprise. A new crayon is bright and sharp, not broken or dull.
New England\n\nNew England is a part of the United States. It is in the top right corner of the country. It has six smaller parts called states. They are Maine, Vermont, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Connecticut, and Rhode Island. Many trees grow there, and the leaves turn bright red, orange, and yellow in the fall. People visit to see the pretty leaves and to eat sweet maple syrup. Long ago, people from England came to live there, so they called it New England.
New Guinea\n\nNew Guinea is a very big island. It sits in the ocean north of Australia. It is the second biggest island in the whole world. It has tall green hills and thick forests. Many different people live there in small groups. They speak more than one thousand languages. That is more languages than any other place. Some animals live only on this island. Birds of paradise have bright, pretty feathers. Echidnas are animals with spikes that lay eggs. Wallabies look like small kangaroos and hop on their back legs. The island is a special home for nature.
New Orleans\n\nNew Orleans is a big city in the United States. It sits by a wide river called the Mississippi. The land is very low and flat, so people built tall walls to keep water out. A long time ago, a big storm named Katrina brought too much water, and many houses got wet. Today, people fix the houses and help each other. In New Orleans, you can hear happy music, see bright parades, and eat yummy food like rice with spices.
New Religious Movement\n\nA new religious movement is a group of people who believe in something together. It is a new way of thinking about big questions, like where we come from or what happens after we die. You might hear about it from a friend or see a special building where they meet. People in it often read a special book, sing songs, or help others. It is like a new club for the heart and mind.
New Testament\n\nThe New Testament is a special book for Christians. It tells the story of a man named Jesus and his friends. Inside, there are many smaller books, like letters and stories. People read it in church or at home to learn about being kind and good. It is a very old book, written long ago in a different language.
New World monkey\n\nA New World monkey is a kind of monkey that lives in warm forests in Central and South America. It has a flat nose with holes that point to the side. Many of them have long tails that can grab branches like a hand. They swing and jump high in the trees to find fruit and leaves to eat. Some of them have babies two at a time, and the daddy monkey helps take care of the little ones. You might see one in a picture book about jungle animals.
New World vulture\n\nA New World vulture is a big bird that lives in the Americas. It has dark feathers, a bald head, and a sharp, hooked beak. It flies high in the sky looking for dead animals to eat. It helps keep the land clean by eating things that are no longer alive. The two biggest kinds are called condors. You might see one at a zoo or in a nature show.
New Year\n\nNew Year is a special day when one year ends and a new year starts. It happens on the last night of December and the first day of January. People stay up late to see the clock hit twelve. They cheer, hug, and say happy words. Bright fireworks light up the sky with many colors. Some people make a wish for the new year. It feels like a fresh start for everyone.
New York (state)\n\nNew York is a big place in the United States, like a giant neighborhood with many people. It has tall mountains, green forests, and long rivers. You can find it in the northeast part of the country, next to a big lake and Canada. Many people live in a huge city also called New York, with tall buildings and busy streets. Up north, there are smaller cities like Albany, where the leaders work. Long ago, people built a water road called a canal to help boats carry things. Now, families visit to see the big city lights or play in the parks.
New York City\n\nNew York City is a very big city with many people. It has five parts called boroughs. You can see tall buildings, busy streets, and a big green lady called the Statue of Liberty. Many people from all over the world live there and speak different languages. You can ride a train under the ground to go places. It is a city where people work, play, and visit from far away.
New York City Subway\n\nThe New York City Subway is a big train that runs under and above the ground in New York City. It has many train cars joined together, and it stops at lots of stations. You can find it in four parts of the city: Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, and the Bronx. It takes people to work, school, and fun places every day and night. It never closes, so you can ride it at any time. To get on, you pay with a card or tap your phone at the gate. Many people use it because it is a fast way to move around the big city.
New Zealand\n\nNew Zealand is a country made of two big islands and many small ones. It is far away in the big blue ocean. The land has green hills, tall mountains, and sandy beaches. Many people live in cities like Auckland and Wellington. A special bird called the kiwi lives there and cannot fly. The kiwi is the country's favorite bird. People in New Zealand speak English and sometimes another language called Maori. They like to play outside and be happy.
Newfoundland\n\nNewfoundland is a big island in the ocean near Canada. It has rocky shores, green hills, and many small towns. Many people there speak English, and some speak French. Long ago, people came from far away to fish in the water around it. Today, people still fish, but not as much. They also cut down trees and dig for rocks in the ground. You can ride a big boat called a ferry to get there.
News\n\nNews is a way people share what is happening right now. It can be on paper, like a big sheet with words and pictures. You can also see it on a TV or hear it on a radio. It tells about many things, like weather, sports, or fun events. A person who shares the news is called a newsman.
Newspaper\n\nA newspaper is a big paper that tells people about things that happen. It comes out every day or every week. You can find it at a store or it can come to your house. It has words and pictures about many things like sports, the weather, and funny drawings. People read it to learn what is new in the world. After you read it, you can put it in a blue box so it can be made into new paper.
Newt\n\nA newt is a small animal that lives both in water and on land. It has a long body, four short legs, and a tail. Its skin is smooth and often bright orange or red on the belly. You can find it near ponds and wet places in North America, Europe, and parts of Asia. It starts life as a tiny baby in the water, then grows legs and walks on land for a while. Later, it goes back to the water to have babies. Some newts have poison in their skin to keep other animals from eating them. If you see one, look but do not touch, and always wash your hands after.
Newton\n\nNewton was a person who thought a lot about how things move. He lived a long time ago. He saw an apple fall from a tree and wondered why it fell down, not up. He came up with rules that explain why things fall, why balls roll, and why the moon goes around the Earth. Many people learn about his ideas in school.
Newton's laws of motion\n\nNewton's laws of motion are three big ideas about how things move. The first idea says a thing sitting still will stay still until a push or pull makes it move. A thing that is moving will keep moving the same way until a push or pull stops it or turns it. The second idea says a big push makes a thing speed up fast, and a heavy thing needs a bigger push to speed up. The third idea says when you push something, it pushes you back just as hard. You can see this when you kick a ball and your foot feels a push back. These ideas help us know why a ball rolls, a car goes, and a fish swims.
Next\n\nNext is a word that means the one that comes after. When you are in a line, the person behind you is next. At story time, the next page is the one you turn to. You can say "I am next" when it is your turn.
Niagara Falls\n\nNiagara Falls is a big, loud waterfall. It is made of three waterfalls that fall down a tall rock wall. It sits on the line between two countries: the United States and Canada. The water comes from big lakes and flows very fast. Many people come to see it because it is so big and pretty. At night, colored lights shine on the water. The falling water also helps make power for lights and homes.
Nicaragua\n\nNicaragua is a country in the middle part of the Americas. It has warm weather, big green forests, and tall mountains that can spit fire. On one side of it is the big blue ocean, and on the other side is a warm sea. Many people there speak Spanish. They love to play a game with a bat and a ball called baseball. Some people also make music and dance to happy songs. Many visitors come to see the animals and the pretty land.
Nice\n\nNice is a big town by the sea in a country called France. It has warm, sunny summers and soft, cool winters. Many people visit it to swim at the beach and walk by the water. Long ago, a queen from a faraway land came to stay because she liked the warm sun. The town has a long path by the sea that was made for visitors. You can eat yummy food there, like a fish soup and a salad with eggs and tuna. Some people in Nice speak a special old way of talking that sounds a little like the words from a nearby country.
Nicely\n\nNicely is a way of doing things that makes people feel good. It means you are kind, gentle, and careful with your words and hands. When you share a toy with a friend, you are playing nicely. You can also speak nicely by saying please and thank you. It helps everyone feel happy and safe.
Niece\n\nA niece is the daughter of your brother or your sister. She is part of your family. You might see her at family parties or when you visit her house. She can be a baby, a little girl, or a grown-up. You can play with her, give her hugs, and watch her grow bigger. She calls you aunt or uncle.
Niger\n\nNiger is a big country in Africa. It has no ocean next to it, so it is all land. Much of it is hot and dry with lots of sand. A long river called the Niger River runs through it. People there grow food like onions and peanuts. Some animals like giraffes live there too.
Niger River\n\nThe Niger River is a very long river in Africa. It looks like a big smile or a boomerang on a map. It flows through many countries, like Guinea, Mali, and Nigeria. People use it for fishing and farming. Every year, the water rises and covers the land, which makes the soil good for growing food. At the end, it spreads out into many small streams and meets the big ocean.
Nigeria\n\nNigeria is a big country in Africa. It has many people, more than any other country in Africa. It has green forests, wide grasslands, and a long coast next to the ocean. The weather is very hot because it is close to the middle of the Earth. Many people in Nigeria play football, and their team is called the Super Eagles. They have won big prizes for football. In Nigeria, people cook food with lots of spices, and the food can be very hot. Some people live in the north and some in the south, and they have different ways of praying and living. The biggest city is Lagos, where many people work and live.
Night\n\nNight is the time when the sky is dark. It happens when the Sun is not in the sky. You can see the Moon and many tiny stars at night. People and animals sleep at night. Some animals, like owls, wake up and look for food. Night feels cool and quiet. In the morning, the Sun comes back and night goes away.
Nightingale\n\nA nightingale is a small brown bird. It is a little bigger than a robin. It has a plain brown back and a tail with a bit of red. It lives in woods and bushes in Europe and parts of Asia. When it gets cold, it flies far away to Africa to stay warm. It sings a very loud and pretty song with many whistles and trills. It sings at night when most other birds are quiet. Only the boy bird sings at night to find a friend. People have loved its song for a very long time.
Nightjar\n\nA nightjar is a bird that flies at night. It has soft, brown and gray feathers that look like tree bark. It hides on the ground or on a tree branch during the day. It eats bugs like moths and beetles. You might see one if you go camping and look up at the sky when the sun goes down.
Nikola Tesla\n\nNikola Tesla was a man who thought of new ways to use electricity. He made a motor that spins with a special kind of power. He also dreamed of sending power through the air without wires. You can see his work in things like radios and remote controls. He was very smart and had many big ideas.
Nile\n\nThe Nile is a very long river in Africa. It is the longest river on Earth. It starts from a big lake and flows through many countries. It ends at a big sea in the north. Many people live near it and use its water to drink and to grow food. Boats carry things on it. Long ago, people built big stone pyramids close to it. Animals like crocodiles and fish live in it.
Nine\n\nNine is a number. It comes after eight and before ten. You can count nine fingers if you hide one thumb. It looks like a circle on a stick. You see it on clocks, in books, and on birthday cakes.
Nineteen\n\nNineteen is a number. It comes after eighteen and before twenty. It is one more than eighteen and one less than twenty. You can count nineteen toys, nineteen crayons, or nineteen steps. If you are nineteen years old, you are almost a grown-up.
Nineveh\n\nNineveh was a very old city a long, long time ago. It had a big, strong wall made of stone and mud bricks all around it. The wall had tall towers and many big gates for people to go in and out. You can still see some old broken parts of it near a city called Mosul. A long time ago, it was the most important city for a group of people called the Assyrians.
Ninja\n\nA ninja is a person from long ago in Japan who moved quietly and hid well. They wore dark blue or brown clothes to blend into the night. Ninja were hired to watch enemies and get secrets. They used short swords, throwing knives, and claws on their hands and feet. A ninja could climb walls and sneak into places without being seen. Today, you might see a ninja in a cartoon or a movie, dressed all in black and doing flips.
Nitrogen\n\nNitrogen is a kind of gas that has no color and no smell. It is all around us in the air. Most of the air we breathe is nitrogen. It is not the same as the air we need to live, but it is safe. People use it to keep food like chips fresh inside the bag. It can also get very cold and turn into a liquid that freezes things.
No\n\nNo is a small word we use when we do not want something. It is a way to say "I do not agree" or "stop." You hear it at home when a grown-up says "no" to keep you safe, like "no touching the hot stove." You also say it when a friend asks for a toy you are playing with and you are not ready to share. It is a strong word that helps people know what you like and what you do not like.
Noah\n\nNoah is a man from a very old story. He lived a long, long time ago. In the story, God told him to build a big boat called an ark. He put his family and many animals on the boat. Then a big flood came and covered the land. After the water went away, he saw a rainbow in the sky. The rainbow was a sign that the flood would not happen again.
Nobel Prize\n\nA Nobel Prize is a very special award. It is a shiny gold medal, a paper called a diploma, and a big bag of money. People get it for doing great things in science, writing, or helping peace in the world. A man named Alfred Nobel started it a long time ago. Every year, the winners are picked by groups of smart people. They get the prize in a big party in a faraway city called Stockholm. Some people have won it more than once, and some families have many winners. It is one of the biggest honors a person can get.
Nobility\n\nNobility is a group of people who were very important long ago. They helped a king or queen rule the land. A noble person often lived in a big house and owned lots of land. Some were rich, but some were not. Today, in most places, being noble does not give special power, but in a few countries they still have old titles.
Noble\n\nNoble means very good and kind. A noble person helps others and does the right thing. They share toys, say sorry when they make a mistake, and take care of friends. A king or queen in a story is often noble. You can be noble too when you are brave and honest.
Nobody\n\nNobody means not one person. It is a word we use when there are zero people in a place. You might say "nobody is in the room" when the room is empty. It is the opposite of "everybody." If you look around and see no friends, you can say "nobody is here."
Nod\n\nA nod is when you move your head up and down. It is a way to say yes without using words. You can see someone nod when they agree with you. People also nod to say hello or show they are listening. A nod is quick and easy, and even little kids can do it.
Node\n\nA node is a small bump or a place where things meet. It can be a little round spot on a plant stem where a leaf grows. It can also be a point where lines cross, like in a drawing or a net. In a computer, it is a box that helps send messages to other boxes. You can find nodes in many places, like on a tree branch or in a game of connect-the-dots.
Noh\n\nNoh is a kind of play from Japan. It has slow dancing, music, and singing. The people in the play wear special masks on their faces. They move in a careful, quiet way. You can see it on a big wooden stage. Long ago, only men acted in it, even when the story had a girl or a woman. Some plays tell old tales about brave heroes or sad spirits.
Noise\n\nNoise is a sound you do not want to hear. It can be loud and hurt your ears. You find it in many places, like a busy street with cars or a room with a loud TV. Too much noise can make it hard to sleep or talk. A soft hum from a fan can be a noise that helps some people fall asleep.
Noisy\n\nNoisy means something makes a lot of sound. It can be a loud sound that hurts your ears or just many sounds all at once. A busy street with cars and trucks is noisy. A room full of children playing and laughing is noisy too. When a dog barks a lot, it is being noisy. Sometimes noisy things make it hard to hear your friend talk.
Nomad\n\nA nomad is a person who moves from place to place. They do not stay in one house or one town. Some nomads move to find fresh grass for their animals, like cows or sheep. They may live in a tent that is easy to pack up. Other nomads travel in wagons to sell things or make things for people. A long time ago, some nomads rode horses and were very good at fighting while moving.
Non\n\nNon means not or no. It is a small word you put in front of another word to flip its meaning. If something is non-sticky, it does not stick. If a toy is non-breakable, it will not break. You see it on signs like non-stop or non-toxic. It helps you know when something is the opposite.
Non Fiction\n\nNon fiction is a kind of book or story. It tells about real people, real places, and real things that happen. It is not made up like a fairy tale. You can find non fiction books at the library or at school. They have pictures and words that teach you about the world. A book about dogs or a book about how cars work is non fiction. It helps you learn new facts.
Non-fiction\n\nNon-fiction is writing about real things. It tells true stories or facts. You can find it in books, pictures, and movies. It helps you learn about the world. A book about animals is non-fiction.
Non-governmental organization\n\nA non-governmental organization is a group of people who work together to help others. It is not part of the government. It does not try to make money for itself. Instead, it helps people who are poor or need food, water, or a safe place to live. You might see one giving out blankets after a big storm or teaching children in a far-away village. Some are very big and work in many countries.
None\n\nNone means zero or nothing at all. It is a word you use when there is not even one. If you have no cookies left, you have none. It can also mean you do not want something, like when you say "none for me, please."
Nonprofit organization\n\nA nonprofit organization is a group of people who work together to help others. It does not keep the money it makes for itself. Instead, it uses the money to do good things. You can find it in many places, like a food bank that gives food to hungry people or a shelter that gives a warm bed to those who need one. Some help animals, like saving hurt dogs and cats. Others help keep parks clean. People who work there may get paid, but many are helpers who give their time for free. A big one you might know is the group that runs Wikipedia, where you can learn about many things.
Nonverbal communication\n\nNonverbal communication is talking without words. It uses your face, hands, and body to show how you feel. You can see it when someone smiles, waves, or gives a hug. It also uses sounds like a happy laugh or a sad sigh. Even clothes and dancing are ways to send a message without speaking. When you point at a toy you want, that is nonverbal communication.
Noodle\n\nA noodle is a long, thin piece of food. It is soft and can be white or yellow. You find it in a bowl of soup or on a plate with sauce. People boil it in hot water to make it soft, then eat it with a fork or chopsticks. Sometimes it is fried in a pan with vegetables and meat. You may have eaten noodle soup when you were sick, because it is warm and easy to eat.
Noon\n\nNoon is the middle of the day. It is when the sun is highest in the sky. At noon, the light is very bright and shadows are short. People often eat lunch around this time. You can see noon when the clock says 12:00 in the daytime.
Normal\n\nNormal means something is like most other things. It is not strange or different. When you see a red apple, that is normal because many apples are red. A normal day is a day when nothing big or new happens. It feels calm and easy.
Norse mythology\n\nNorse mythology is a set of old stories from people who lived in the north a long time ago. It tells about many gods, giants, and other magical beings. The stories say the world has nine big lands. One land is for gods, one is for people, and one is a cold, dark place for the dead. A rainbow bridge connects some of these lands. The most famous god is Thor, who has a big hammer and makes thunder. Another god is Odin, who is very wise and has two ravens. These stories were told out loud for many years before they were written down. Today, you can see parts of these stories in movies, books, and even the names of days like Thursday, which is named after Thor.
North\n\nNorth is a direction. It points toward the top of a map or a globe. When you face the sunrise, north is to your left. It is the way to cold places with snow and ice. A compass needle shows you where north is.
North Africa\n\nNorth Africa is the top part of the big land called Africa. It is mostly a very hot, dry place with lots of sand called a desert. In the west, there are tall hills called mountains where it is not so dry. Many people there speak Arabic and follow a way of life called Islam. They live in busy cities and small towns near water. A long, long time ago, people built giant stone shapes called pyramids there, and you can still see them today.
North America\n\nNorth America is a big piece of land on Earth. It has three big countries: Canada, the United States, and Mexico. It also has many small islands with warm weather. You can find it between two very big oceans. Many people live there, and they speak different languages like English and Spanish.
North Island\n\nNorth Island is a big piece of land in the country of New Zealand. It is one of two main islands, and it is the smaller one. It has green hills, long beaches, and some big cities. Many people live on it, more than on the other island. The biggest city is Auckland, and the capital city, Wellington, is at the bottom end. You can see it on a map next to a bigger island called the South Island.
