Parcel\n\nA parcel is a box or a bag that you send to someone. It is wrapped in paper or put in a box so the things inside stay safe. You can take it to the post office, and a mail carrier brings it to a friend's house. It can hold a gift, a toy, or a book. When you get a parcel, you open it and see what is inside.
Parchment\n\nParchment is a thin, flat sheet made from animal skin. It is smooth and light in color, like old paper. Long ago, people used it to write on and to make the pages of a book. You might see it in a museum, inside a very old book with a hard cover. It feels a little stiff and can last for many, many years.
Parent\n\nA parent is a grown-up who takes care of a child. It can be a mom or a dad. A parent gives food, a home, and love. It helps the child learn to walk, talk, and play. When a child is sick, a parent gives hugs and medicine. A parent reads stories at bedtime and tucks the child in. Some children have two parents, and some have one. A parent is very important in a family.
Parenting\n\nParenting is how moms and dads take care of a child. It means giving a baby food, a warm bed, and lots of hugs. When a baby is very small, it cannot talk, so parents watch it closely to know what it needs. As the child gets bigger, parents teach it how to brush its teeth and say please and thank you. They also show the child how to be kind and share with others. Parenting is a big job full of love every day.
Paris\n\nParis is a big city in a country called France. It has many old buildings, tall towers, and a long river that runs through the middle. You can see a very tall iron tower there called the Eiffel Tower. Many people visit Paris to look at art in big houses called museums. It has a train that goes under the ground so people can ride from place to place. Some people eat long bread and soft cheese when they are there.
Park\n\nA park is a big open place with grass and trees. It has benches to sit on, paths to walk on, and sometimes a pond with ducks. You can find a park in a city or a town. People go there to play, run, ride a bike, or have a picnic. Some parks have a playground with swings and a slide. A few parks are very big and protect wild animals and forests. You might visit a park with your family on a sunny day.
Parking\n\nParking is when you stop a car and leave it in a safe spot. It means the car stays still while you go do other things. You can park in a big flat lot with painted lines, or next to the curb on a street. Some places have a tall building with many floors just for parking. Before you park, you must check signs to make sure it is okay to leave the car there. If you park where you should not, you might get a paper ticket and have to pay money.
Parliament\n\nA parliament is a group of people who make the rules for a country. It has a big room where they sit and talk. They decide what is fair and what is not fair. The leader of the group is called the Prime Minister. People choose who sits in the parliament by voting. It is a bit like a big school meeting where everyone helps decide the rules.
Parody\n\nA parody is a funny copy of a song, a movie, or a story. It takes something people know and makes it silly. It shows the same parts but bigger and funnier. For example, in a cowboy movie, the good guy always wins. In a parody, the good guy might shoot one time and ten bad guys fall down. People make parodies to laugh at things everyone has seen. You can find a parody on TV, in a book, or in a song.
Parrot\n\nA parrot is a bird with bright feathers. It has a big head, a short neck, and a strong, curved beak. It uses its beak to crack open seeds and nuts. Many parrots live in warm places with lots of trees. Some parrots can copy the sounds people make. People keep them as pets because they are pretty and can learn to talk.
Parsley\n\nParsley is a small green plant that people use in food. It has many tiny, flat or curly leaves on thin stems. You can find it in gardens or in pots on a sunny windowsill. People put it on top of soup, salad, or meat to make the food look pretty and taste fresh. Some people chew a little bit of it after a meal to make their breath smell nice. It grows best in soft, damp dirt with lots of light.
Parsnip\n\nA parsnip is a vegetable that grows under the ground. It looks like a long, white carrot. You can find it in a garden or at a food store. People cook it and eat it because it tastes sweet. It is a cousin to the carrot and the green herb called parsley.
Part\n\nA part is a piece of something bigger. It is one small bit that fits with other bits to make a whole thing. You can find parts in many places, like a puzzle piece on the floor or a wheel on a toy car. When you take a cookie from a box, that cookie is a part of the box. Every part helps the big thing work or look right.
Parthenon\n\nThe Parthenon is a very old stone building in a country called Greece. It sits on a big flat hill in a city named Athens. It has many tall round poles called columns that hold up the roof. Long ago, people built it to say thank you to a goddess named Athena. Today, many people visit it to see the pretty white stone and learn about old times.
Particle\n\nA particle is a very tiny piece of stuff. It is so small you cannot see it with your eyes. Everything around you is made of particles. Some particles are bigger, like dust or powder. Other particles are so small they make up air and water. Inside every little thing, there are even smaller parts called atoms. Atoms have a center with even tinier bits inside. Scientists study particles to learn what the world is made of.
Particle Physics\n\nParticle physics is a kind of science. It looks at the tiniest bits that make up everything around us. These bits are so small you cannot see them with your eyes. Scientists use big machines to learn about them. It helps us know what the world is made of.
Partner\n\nA partner is someone you do things with. It can be a friend you play with at the park. It can be the person you sit next to in class and share crayons with. When you work on a puzzle together, you are partners. A partner helps you and you help them back.
Partnership\n\nA partnership is when two or more people work together. They share a job or a fun task. You can see a partnership when friends build a sandcastle together. They help each other and share the work. Sometimes grown-ups make a partnership to run a store or a shop. They share the money they make. A partnership works best when everyone is kind and helps.
Party\n\nA party is when people come together to have fun. It can be at a house, a park, or a big room. People play games, eat yummy food, and sometimes dance. There are often balloons, cake, and happy music. A birthday party is one kind you might know. Friends sing a song and the birthday child blows out candles.
Pass\n\nA pass is when you let someone go ahead of you. It can also mean a card or paper that lets you go into a place. You might see a pass at a bus or a train, where people show a card to get on. At school, you might need a hall pass to leave the room. In a game, you can pass a ball to a friend so they can play too.
Passenger pigeon\n\nA passenger pigeon was a kind of bird. It had a small head, a long tail, and soft gray and brown feathers. It lived in North America and flew in huge groups across the sky. A group could have more birds than you can count, and it took a long time for them all to fly past. People used to see it everywhere, but now there are none left. The very last one died many years ago.
Passerine\n\nA passerine is a kind of bird. It is small or not too big. It has feet that can hold on to a branch very well. You can find it in trees, bushes, or on the ground in many places around the world. It sings pretty songs that you can hear in the morning. A sparrow or a robin is a passerine you might see in your yard.
Passover\n\nPassover is a special holiday for Jewish people. It lasts for a whole week. During this time, they eat flat bread called matzah and tell the story of long ago. The story says that a man named Moses helped his people become free. They were slaves in a faraway land, and he led them out. Families sit together for a big meal and sing happy songs. Passover comes in spring, when flowers start to bloom.
Passport\n\nA passport is a small book that helps you travel to other countries. It has your picture and your name inside. A government gives it to you so other countries know who you are. When you go to a new country, a person at the border looks at it and may put a stamp in it. It helps you come back home too.
Password\n\nA password is a secret word or set of letters and numbers. It is like a key that only you know. You use it to open your tablet, a game, or a grown-up's computer. It keeps your things safe so only you can see them. Never tell your password to anyone except your mom or dad.
Past\n\nThe past is everything that has already happened. It is like a story that is finished. You cannot touch it or see it, but you can remember it. Yesterday is part of the past. When you were a baby is also the past. People who study the past are called history teachers. They look at old things and read old papers to learn what happened long ago. Some books and movies tell made-up stories about the past. They show kings, castles, or old trains. The past helps us know how we got here today.
Pasta\n\nPasta is a food made from flour and water. It comes in many shapes, like long strings, small tubes, or little bow-ties. People cook it in hot water until it gets soft. Then they eat it with a yummy sauce on top. You can find pasta at home for dinner or in a restaurant. Some pasta has eggs inside to make it taste richer.
Paste\n\nPaste is a soft, wet mix that you can spread. It is often white and feels a little sticky. You can find it in a jar at home or at school. People use it to stick paper together when they make art. When you glue two pieces of paper with paste, they stay stuck after it dries.
Pastry\n\nPastry is a soft dough used to make yummy baked foods. It is made from flour, butter, and sometimes eggs or sugar. You roll it out flat and thin. Then you can shape it into a pie, a tart, or a small sweet cake. People eat pastry as a treat or a snack. You can find it in a bakery or at a party. A fruit pie has a pastry crust on top and bottom.
Pat\n\nA pat is a soft, quick tap with an open hand. It is gentle and does not hurt. You can pat a dog on the head to show you like it. A mom might pat a baby's back to help it fall asleep. You can also pat your friend on the shoulder to say hello or good job.
Patagonia\n\nPatagonia is a big piece of land at the very bottom of South America. It has tall mountains with snow on top, wide flat lands, and a cold, windy coast by the sea. Many animals live there, like the guanaco that looks like a tall, fuzzy horse, and the Magellanic penguin that waddles near the water. You can also see big whales and seals in the ocean. It is a place where the sky feels very big and the land is mostly empty of people.
Patch\n\nA patch is a small piece of cloth or other material. It is flat and can be any shape, like a circle or a square. You can find a patch on clothes, bags, or blankets. It is used to cover a hole or a tear, or just to add a fun picture. For example, a patch with a star on a jacket makes it look cool.
Patent\n\nA patent is a special paper from the government. It says that a new idea belongs to the person who made it. If you make a new toy or a new tool, a patent stops other people from making or selling the same thing without asking you. You can let someone else use your idea if they pay you money. A patent lasts for many years, but after that, anyone can use the idea.
Path\n\nA path is a long, thin piece of ground that people walk on. It is often made of dirt, small stones, or hard ground. You can find a path in a park, a forest, or a garden. It helps you go from one place to another without getting lost. Sometimes a path goes next to a river or up a small hill. When you walk on a path, you can see flowers, trees, and maybe a little bug.
Pathogen\n\nA pathogen is a tiny living thing that can make you sick. It is so small you cannot see it with your eyes. Some kinds are viruses, some are bacteria, and some are tiny bugs. It can get inside your body and make you feel bad. Your body has helpers inside that fight it to keep you well. Washing your hands helps keep it away.
Patience\n\nPatience is when you wait without getting upset. It is a quiet feeling inside that helps you stay calm. You use it when you stand in a long line for a slide. You also use it when you wait for your turn with a toy. It can be hard, but it gets easier with practice.
Patient\n\nA patient is a person who is sick or hurt. They go to see a doctor or a nurse to get help. The doctor checks their body and gives them medicine to feel better. Sometimes a patient stays in a big building called a hospital. A patient might have a bandage on a cut or a cast on a broken arm. They rest a lot so their body can heal.
Patriotism\n\nPatriotism is a warm feeling of love for your own country. It is like a big hug in your heart for the place where you live. People show this feeling by singing songs about their country or waving its flag. It is not the same as wanting to take over other lands. A person who feels this way is called a patriot. They are happy when their country does good things.
Pattern\n\nA pattern is something that repeats in the same way. It can be a shape, a color, or a sound that happens again and again. You can see patterns on clothes, like stripes or dots. You can also find patterns in nature, like the spots on a butterfly or the rings on a tree. When you clap your hands in a beat, that is a pattern too. Patterns help us guess what comes next.
Pause\n\nA pause is a short stop. It is a little break in the middle of something. You can pause when you are talking, walking, or playing. It gives you a moment to rest or think. When you watch a show, you can press a button to pause it. The picture stops and waits for you. A pause is like taking a breath before you keep going.
Paw\n\nA paw is the soft foot of an animal like a dog or a cat. It has small pads on the bottom that feel like pillows. You can find it at the end of each leg. An animal uses it to walk, run, and play. When a dog gives you its paw, it feels warm and a little rough.
Pay\n\nPay means giving money to someone. It is what you do when you buy a toy or a snack. Mom and Dad get pay from their jobs. They use it to buy food, clothes, and a place to live. Sometimes you get a little pay for helping at home, like a coin for setting the table. Pay can be paper bills or round coins.
Pea\n\nA pea is a small, round, green seed that people eat as food. It grows inside a soft green shell called a pod. You can find peas in a garden or at the grocery store. People cook peas in hot water and eat them with a little butter and salt. Some peas are dried and made into warm soup. A pea is tiny, but it is full of good things that help you grow strong.
Peace\n\nPeace is a feeling of quiet and calm. It is like a still pond with no ripples. You can feel peace inside when you are happy and not worried. People also try to have peace between countries so there are no fights. When you share a toy with a friend, that is a small way to make peace.
Peaceful\n\nPeaceful is a calm and quiet feeling. It is how you feel when everything is soft and still, like when you are tucked in bed with your favorite blanket. You can find it in a quiet room or outside under a tree. When you feel peaceful, your body is relaxed and your mind is not busy. It is like the quiet after a rainstorm, when the sun comes out and the birds sing softly.
Peach\n\nA peach is a soft, sweet fruit that grows on a tree. It has a round shape and a fuzzy skin that is orange or yellow. Inside, the fruit is golden and juicy, with a big hard seed in the middle called a pit. You can find peaches in warm places, like gardens or farms. People eat them fresh, or use them to make pies and sweet treats. A peach without fuzz is called a nectarine.
Peafowl\n\nA peafowl is a big, pretty bird. It has a small head, a long neck, and a big body with strong legs. The boy bird is called a peacock. He has very long, shiny tail feathers with many bright colors like blue and green. He can lift his tail up and spread it out like a big fan. The girl bird is called a peahen. She has short, brown feathers that help her hide when she sits on her eggs. Peafowl live in warm places with trees and grass. They eat bugs, seeds, and green plants. You can see them in parks and gardens walking around. The peacock makes a loud call that sounds like a yell. When he wants a friend, he dances and shakes his tail to show off his pretty feathers.
Peak\n\nA peak is the very top of a mountain or hill. It is the highest point you can reach. From a peak, you can see far away in all directions. Some peaks are covered in snow all year. People like to climb to a peak because the view is beautiful.
Peanut\n\nA peanut is a small food that grows under the ground. It has a brown, bumpy shell. Inside the shell, there are two or three little seeds. The seeds are light yellow and have a thin red skin. Peanuts grow in warm places like Africa and South America. People eat them as a snack, often with salt. They also make peanut butter by mashing the seeds into a soft paste. Many kids like peanut butter on bread. Peanuts are not real nuts, but they taste buttery and good.
Pear\n\nA pear is a sweet fruit that grows on a tree. It has a round bottom and a thin top, like a teardrop. Its skin can be green, red, yellow, or brown. Inside, it is white, soft, and full of juice. You can eat it fresh or put it in pies and salads. People also make it into jam and juice. It tastes best when it is cool from the fridge.
Pearl\n\nA pearl is a small, shiny ball that grows inside a shell. It is often white, but can be pink, gray, or even black. It feels smooth and looks like a tiny moon. People find pearls in the ocean, inside animals called oysters. They use pearls to make pretty necklaces and rings. A pearl can be as small as a seed or as big as a marble. It is a gift from the sea.
Peasant\n\nA peasant is a person who worked on a farm a long time ago. They wore simple, rough clothes and lived in a small house. They worked very hard every day, planting food and taking care of animals. Most peasants could not read or write. They did not have much money, but they grew their own food to eat. A long time ago, many people were peasants.
Peat\n\nPeat is a soft, dark, muddy stuff from wet, spongy ground. It is made of old, dead plants that did not rot all the way. You can find it in big, flat, wet places called bogs. In some cold lands, people dig it up, dry it, and burn it to make a warm fire. It can also give a smoky taste to some drinks. When it is very dry, it can catch fire and burn for a long time.
Pebble\n\nA pebble is a tiny, smooth rock. It is round and small enough to fit in your hand. You can find it at the beach, by a river, or on a path. Water makes it smooth by rubbing it for a long, long time. A child might pick one up and put it in a pocket because it feels nice.
Pecan\n\nA pecan is a kind of nut that grows on a tree. It has a hard, brown shell on the outside. Inside, the nut is light brown with lines on it. You can find pecan trees in warm places. People crack the shell open to eat the nut inside. It tastes buttery and a little sweet. Many people use it to make a yummy pie called pecan pie.
Peccary\n\nA peccary is an animal that looks like a small pig. It has a round body, short legs, and a flat nose. It lives in warm places with trees and grass. It eats roots, bugs, and fruit. A peccary stays with its family group all day. It has a strong smell that helps it know its friends.
Peck\n\nA peck is a quick, light tap with a beak. It is what a bird does when it moves its head forward and taps something. You can see a bird peck at seeds on the ground or at a piece of bread. It uses its beak to pick up tiny bits of food. Sometimes a bird gives a soft peck to say hello or to check if something is safe.
Pedal\n\nA pedal is a flat part you push with your foot. It is found on a bike, a car, or a sewing machine. On a bike, you push it down to make the wheels turn. In a car, you push it to go faster or to stop. A sewing machine pedal makes the needle move up and down. It helps you do work without using your hands.
Pediatrics\n\nPediatrics is a kind of doctor job that helps babies, kids, and teenagers stay healthy. A doctor who does this job is called a pediatrician. They check how a child grows and give shots to stop bad sickness before it starts. They also teach moms and dads about good food and safe play. When a child feels sick, they find out what is wrong and help make it better. You might see one at a bright, friendly doctor's office with toys and books.
Peel\n\nTo peel means to take the outside skin off a fruit or a vegetable. You can do it with your fingers or with a small tool called a peeler. It is something you do before you eat a banana, an orange, or a potato. The skin comes off in long strips or small pieces. After you peel it, the inside is soft and ready to eat.
Peer\n\nA peer is a friend who is the same age as you. You see them at school, in your class, or at the playground. They play with you, share toys, and sit next to you at lunch. A peer can be a boy or a girl. You learn new games from them, and they learn from you too.
Peer pressure\n\nPeer pressure is when friends push you to act a certain way. It feels like a strong wish to be just like the people around you. You can find it at school, on the playground, or in any group of kids. It can make you do things you might not pick on your own, like trying a new game or sharing a snack. Sometimes it helps you do kind things, like saying sorry or helping a friend. But it can also push you to do things that are not safe, like running into the street. A good example is when everyone at lunch trades stickers, and you feel you must trade too, even if you love your sticker.
Pegasus\n\nPegasus is a horse with big wings. It is white and can fly high in the sky. It comes from very old Greek stories. A young man named Bellerophon once rode it with a special gold rein. Together they beat a scary fire-breathing beast. You might see a picture of it in a storybook about magic animals.
Pelican\n\nA pelican is a big bird that lives near water. It has a very long beak with a big stretchy bag under it. The bag looks like a soft pocket. It uses the bag to scoop up fish from the water. Then it tips its head to let the water out and swallows the fish. Most pelicans are white or light gray. Some are brown. You can see them at the beach or at a big lake.
Pelvis\n\nThe pelvis is a set of bones at the bottom of your body. It is shaped like a big bowl. You can feel it when you put your hands on your hips. It connects your legs to your back. It holds up your body when you stand, walk, or run. It also keeps some soft parts inside your tummy safe. In grown-up women, the pelvis is wider so a baby can come out when it is born.
Pen\n\nA pen is a tool for writing or drawing. It has a long body and a tip that puts ink onto paper. You can find pens at school, at home, or in an office. People use it to write words, draw pictures, or sign their name. A ballpoint pen is a common kind you might see every day. It has a tiny ball at the tip that rolls the ink out.
Pencil\n\nA pencil is a tool for writing and drawing. It has a thin, dark stick inside a wooden case. You hold it in your hand and move the tip across paper to make lines. The dark part is not real lead, but a soft black rock called graphite. You can find pencils at school, at home, and in art boxes. If you make a mistake, you can use a pink eraser on the end to rub it away. Many children use a pencil to learn letters and draw pictures of their family.
Pendulum\n\nA pendulum is a heavy thing that hangs from a string or a stick. It swings back and forth, left and right, over and over. You can see one in a big old clock on the wall. The heavy part at the bottom pulls it down, and it keeps swinging the same way each time. People use it to help clocks keep the right time.
Penguin\n\nA penguin is a bird that cannot fly. It has a white belly and a black back. It lives near cold water, like in Antarctica. It swims very well and uses its wings like flippers. It eats fish and other small sea animals. It lays eggs on land and keeps them warm with its body.
Peninsula\n\nA peninsula is a piece of land with water on three sides. It sticks out into a big lake or the sea. You can find peninsulas on maps, like the shape of Florida or Italy. People live on peninsulas, build houses, and go to the beach. If you stand on a peninsula, you see water almost all around you.
Pennsylvania\n\nPennsylvania is one of the 50 states in the United States. It is in the northeast part of the country. It has big cities like Philadelphia and a smaller capital called Harrisburg. It has many hills, forests, and rivers. Long ago, it was one of the first places where people fought to make America free. Today, many people live there and work in different jobs.
Penny\n\nA penny is a small, round coin. It is brown and flat, with a smooth edge. You can find it in a pocket, a piggy bank, or on the ground. People use it to buy tiny things or save it in a jar. One penny is worth one cent, which is the smallest amount of money.
Pension\n\nA pension is money that a person gets after they stop working. It comes every month, like a small gift for all the years they worked. Some people get it when they are old and their hair turns gray. Others get it if their body is too tired or hurt to work. The money helps them buy food, pay for a home, and get things they need. It is like a big thank-you from the place they worked at.
People\n\nPeople are living beings like you and me. They have two arms, two legs, a head with eyes, a nose, and a mouth. People live all over the world in houses, apartments, or huts. They talk, laugh, play, and help each other. A person can be a mom, a dad, a child, or a friend. You see people every day at home, at school, or on the street.
People's Republic of China\n\nThe People's Republic of China is a very big country in Asia. It has many people, more than any other country. Its capital city is Beijing, and Shanghai is its biggest city. It has tall mountains, long rivers, and big cities. People there speak Chinese and eat rice and noodles. A long, long wall called the Great Wall is in this country.
Pepper\n\nPepper is a small spice that comes from dried berries. It is black, white, or sometimes green or red. You find it in a little shaker on the kitchen table. People sprinkle it on food to make it taste a little hot and strong. It goes well with eggs, soup, and meat. A pepper shaker often has tiny holes on top.
Percentage\n\nA percentage is a way to talk about parts of a whole. It uses the number 100 to show how much. You see it with a little sign that looks like a line and two small circles: %. If you have a whole pizza cut into 100 tiny slices, a percentage tells you how many slices you have. It helps you compare things even when the whole is not the same size. For example, if you get 8 out of 10 on a test, that is 80%. It means you did as well as getting 80 out of 100.
Perception\n\nPerception is how your brain understands the world around you. It uses your eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin to collect clues. Your brain then puts these clues together to make a picture, a sound, a smell, a taste, or a feeling. For example, when you see a red apple, your eyes send a message to your brain, and your brain says, "That is a red apple!"
Perch\n\nA perch is a fish that lives in fresh water like lakes and rivers. It has a round body and rough scales. It has two fins on its back—one is sharp and one is soft. It also has fins on its sides and a tail fin to help it swim fast. You can find it in ponds and streams in many parts of the world. It eats small fish, bugs, and tiny water animals. People like to catch perch for fun and also eat it because it tastes good.
Percussion instrument\n\nA percussion instrument is something you hit or shake to make music. It can be a big drum that goes boom, or small sticks you tap together. You find it in a band, at a parade, or in music class at school. When you hit it with your hand or a stick, it makes a sound. A drum is one kind of percussion instrument. You might have a little tambourine at home that jingles when you shake it.
Peregrine falcon\n\nA peregrine falcon is a fast bird that hunts other birds. It has a blue-gray back, a white chest with dark lines, and a black head that looks like it has a mustache. You can find it in many places around the world, near tall cliffs or even on big city buildings. It dives down from the sky faster than any other animal. A long time ago, a bad chemical hurt its eggs, but now people help keep it safe.
Perfect\n\nPerfect means something is as good as it can be. It has no mistakes and nothing is missing. When you draw a circle that is very round, it looks perfect. A sunny day with a blue sky can feel perfect. When you finish a puzzle and every piece fits, that is perfect too.
Perform\n\nTo perform means to do something in front of people who watch. It can be singing a song, dancing, or acting in a play. You might see someone perform on a stage at school or on TV. When you clap your hands after, it makes the person feel happy.
Performance\n\nPerformance is when someone does something in front of people who watch. It can be singing a song, dancing, or acting in a play. You might see a performance at school, on a stage, or on TV. The people who watch clap their hands when they like it. A birthday party with a magic show is a kind of performance.
Performing arts\n\nPerforming arts are shows where people use their body, face, and voice to tell a story or share a feeling. It is not like a painting or a statue, because the person is the art. You can see it on a stage with bright lights. People sing, dance, act, or do magic tricks. A play at school is a kind of performing arts. When you watch a movie, the actors are doing performing arts too.
Perfume\n\nPerfume is a liquid that smells very nice. It comes in a pretty bottle. People put a little bit on their neck or wrist to smell good all day. It is made from flowers, fruits, or special oils. Some perfume smells like a rose, and some smells like a lemon. When you hug someone who wears it, you can smell the sweet scent.
Period\n\nA period is a dot at the end of a sentence. It tells you to stop reading for a tiny moment. You see it in books, on signs, and in your school work. When you write, you put a period to show the thought is done. It is like a red light for words.
Periodic\n\nPeriodic means something happens again and again in a pattern. It is like the way the sun comes up every morning and goes down every night. You see it in the seasons: spring, summer, fall, winter, then spring again. A clock shows a periodic tick-tock sound. When you clap your hands in a steady beat, that is periodic too.
Periodic Table\n\nThe periodic table is a big chart that shows all the tiny building blocks of everything around us. It has many little boxes, each with a name and a number. You can find it on a wall in a science room at school. Scientists use it to learn about different kinds of stuff, like the air we breathe or the water we drink. It helps them know how things mix and change. The shiny metal in a spoon and the gas that makes a balloon float are both on the chart.
Permafrost\n\nPermafrost is ground that stays frozen all year long. It is like dirt and rocks that never get warm. You can find it in very cold places near the North Pole and the South Pole. It also sits on top of tall mountains where the air is chilly. When it melts, it lets out a gas that can make the air around us too warm. That is not good for the Earth.
Permit\n\nA permit is a special paper that says you can do something. It is like a note from a grown-up that gives you a yes. You might see a permit when someone wants to build a new house or open a lemonade stand. It helps keep people safe by making sure rules are followed. Without it, you might have to stop what you are doing.
Perseus\n\nPerseus is a brave hero from very old Greek stories. He is the son of a god named Zeus and a kind woman named Dana. He is most known for cutting off the head of a scary monster called Medusa. She had snakes for hair, and looking at her face could turn you into stone. With magic shoes that let him fly and a shiny shield, he was able to beat her. On his way home, he saved a princess named Andromeda from a big sea monster. He married her and they lived together. Perseus is also part of a big family of heroes.
Persian Gulf\n\nThe Persian Gulf is a big body of water in a hot, sandy part of the world. It is long and wide, with blue water that is not very deep. Many countries sit next to it, like Iran and Saudi Arabia. It has many fish and pretty rocks under the water called coral. People also find shiny pearls inside shells there. Big boats carry oil from the ground under the water. This oil helps make gas for cars.
Persian language\n\nPersian language is a way people talk and write. It is used in a country called Iran and some other places. People who speak it use letters that look different from English letters. It sounds soft and has many pretty poems. You might hear it in songs or stories from far away.
Persian literature\n\nPersian literature is stories and poems from a land called Iran. It is very old — more than a thousand years. Some of it is poetry that sounds like a song when you say it out loud. Other parts are long stories written in books. Long ago, people wrote it by hand on paper. Today, children in Iran still read some of these old stories in school.
Person\n\nA person is a human being, like you and me. They have a head, two arms, two legs, and a body. People live all over the world in houses, apartments, or other homes. They can walk, talk, think, and feel happy or sad. Every person is special and different. You see people every day—your family, friends, and neighbors.
Personal\n\nPersonal means something that belongs to one person. It is not for everyone to share. Your toothbrush is personal. Your bed is personal. Your name is personal. A diary is a book where you write personal thoughts. You keep personal things in a special spot, like a box or a drawer. No one should touch your personal things without asking.
Personal computer\n\nA personal computer is a machine that helps you do many things. It has a screen that shows pictures and words. You use a keyboard to type and a mouse to point and click. It sits on a desk at home or in school. People use it to write, draw, play games, and talk to friends far away. Inside it has tiny parts that think and remember for you.
Personal name\n\nA personal name is a special word that tells people who you are. It is made of two parts: a first name and a last name. Your mom and dad pick your name when you are born. They may choose a name that has a happy meaning. Every child in the world has the right to a name. When you meet a new friend, you learn their name so you can call them.
Personal protective equipment\n\nPersonal protective equipment is special clothing and gear that keeps people safe. It covers parts of the body like hands, eyes, and feet. You can see it on firefighters, doctors, and builders at work. It stops cuts, burns, and germs from hurting the person. A helmet is one kind that protects the head.
Personality\n\nPersonality is the way a person acts and feels most of the time. It is like a special mix of things that makes each person different. You can see it in how someone plays, talks, or shares. Some people are quiet, and some are loud. Some like to run fast, and some like to sit and draw. A person's personality can change a little bit as they grow up, but it takes a long time.
Perspective (graphical)\n\nPerspective is a way of drawing that makes things look far or near. It uses lines that come together at one point on the paper. When you draw a road, it looks wide at the bottom and narrow at the top. That is perspective. It helps a flat picture look deep, like a real place. You can see it in storybooks and cartoons.
Peru\n\nPeru is a country in South America. It has tall mountains called the Andes, and a big jungle where many rivers start. Long ago, a group called the Inca lived there and built stone cities high up. One famous old city is Machu Picchu. Today, people in Peru speak Spanish, and many also speak Quechua. They grow potatoes, and there are thousands of kinds. The food is tasty, with dishes like fish cooked in lemon juice. Many people visit to see the old stones and the pretty nature.
Pesticide\n\nA pesticide is a strong liquid or powder that people use to stop bugs and weeds. It can be sprayed on plants at a farm or in a garden. It kills tiny bugs that eat the leaves and fruit. But it can also hurt good bugs like bees. If it gets into rivers or lakes, the water can become dirty and make fish sick. Some people use soapy water or pick bugs off by hand instead.
Pet\n\nA pet is an animal that lives with people at home. It is not for work or for food. People keep it to love and play with. A pet can be soft and furry, like a dog or a cat. It can also swim in water, like a fish. Some pets are small and run in a wheel, like a hamster. You can find a pet in many houses. It sleeps in a cozy bed or a cage. People feed it every day and give it water. They also take it to the doctor when it feels sick. A pet makes people happy when they feel sad. A dog can wag its tail and lick your hand. A cat can purr and sit on your lap. A fish can swim around and look pretty. Many children have a pet at home to be their friend.
Petal\n\nA petal is a soft, flat part of a flower. It is often bright and pretty, like red, yellow, or pink. You can see petals on roses, daisies, and tulips in a garden. It helps bring bees and butterflies to the flower. When you touch a petal, it feels smooth and light.
Peter Pan\n\nPeter Pan is a boy from a story. He can fly and never grows up. He lives on a far-away island with his friends, the Lost Boys. A tiny fairy named Tinker Bell stays by his side. He fights a mean pirate called Captain Hook. Peter Pan flies by thinking happy thoughts. You can see him in a Disney movie.
Petra\n\nPetra is a very old city made of stone. It sits in a valley between big hills in a country called Jordan. Long ago, people carved houses and steps right into the red rock walls. It was a busy place where traders stopped with their camels. Today, many people visit Petra to see the tall stone buildings and walk through a narrow path in the rock. It is a special place that the whole world wants to keep safe.
Petroleum\n\nPetroleum is a thick, black liquid found deep under the ground. It is also called crude oil. People drill big holes to bring it up from rocks. It is used to make gas for cars, fuel for airplanes, and black sticky stuff for roads. It is very important because it gives us energy to move and go places.
Pharaoh\n\nA pharaoh was a king or queen of Egypt a very long time ago. He or she wore a tall crown and held a stick called a scepter. The pharaoh lived in a big house and made rules for all the people. He or she was also a leader for prayers and big shows. Today, we can see old pictures and statues of pharaohs in museums. One famous pharaoh was a boy named King Tut.
Pharmacist\n\nA pharmacist is a person who gives medicine to people. He works in a store called a pharmacy or in a big hospital. He knows a lot about pills and liquids that help you feel better. When you are sick, a doctor writes a note for medicine, and the pharmacist reads it. He counts out the right pills and puts them in a bottle. He tells you how to take the medicine and what it might make you feel like. He can also give you a shot to keep you from getting sick, like a flu shot. If you have a sore throat or a cold, he can help you pick a medicine from the shelf. He checks everything very carefully so you get the right thing.
Pharmacy\n\nA pharmacy is a store where people get medicine. It has shelves with bottles, boxes, and tubes. You can find a pharmacy in a town or inside a big hospital. The person who works there is called a pharmacist. They help you pick the right medicine when you feel sick. Some medicine you can buy right away. Other medicine needs a special note from a doctor called a prescription. Many pharmacies also sell soap, band-aids, and things to keep you clean and pretty.
Phase change\n\nA phase change is when something turns from one kind of stuff into another. It can be a hard solid, like ice, that gets warm and turns into a wet liquid, like water. If you heat the water more, it turns into a gas you cannot see, called steam. When the gas cools down, it can turn back into a liquid, and then back into a solid. You can see this happen with an ice cube on a hot day.
Pheasant\n\nA pheasant is a big bird with bright, colorful feathers. It has a long tail that can be very pretty. The boy pheasant is bigger and has more colors than the girl pheasant. It lives in fields and woods, and you might see it walking on the ground looking for seeds to eat. Some people hunt it, but that can make it hard for it to stay safe. It is not just one kind of bird—it is a name for many birds that look alike.
Philadelphia\n\nPhiladelphia is a big city in the United States. It has many old buildings and a bell called the Liberty Bell. A long time ago, it was the capital of the country. Today, many people live there and visit to see the old places. You can find big parks, a zoo, and a museum with old art. It is near a river, and you can cross a bridge to another state.
Philippine Sea\n\nThe Philippine Sea is a big body of water. It is part of the big ocean called the Pacific. It sits next to the Philippines and Taiwan. It touches Japan up north and Palau down south. Big boats sail on it to carry things from one place to another. Many fish and other sea animals live in it.
Philippines\n\nThe Philippines is a country made of many islands. It sits in the warm ocean near Asia. It has over seven thousand islands, so you can see water and beaches almost everywhere. People live on big islands and small islands. The biggest island is called Luzon, and the capital city, Manila, is there. Many people ride boats to go from one island to another. The weather is hot and rainy, and sometimes big storms called typhoons come. You can find tall mountains, green forests, and volcanoes that still smoke. Children there play games, go to school, and eat rice and fish with their families.
Philodendron\n\nA philodendron is a green plant that people keep inside their homes. It has big, flat leaves that are often shaped like a heart. It grows fast and does not need a lot of care. You can put it in a pot by a window, and it will climb up a stick or hang down. It helps make the air in a room clean and fresh.
Philosophy\n\nPhilosophy is thinking about big questions. It asks things like: What is real? How do we know things? What is right and wrong? People who do this thinking are called philosophers. They use their minds to wonder about the world and our lives. A long time ago, a man named Plato asked these kinds of questions. You can do philosophy too when you ask why the sky is blue or why we share toys.
Phobia\n\nA phobia is a very big, strong fear of one thing. It is not just a little scared feeling. It makes a person want to stay far away from that thing. If they cannot get away, they feel very upset inside. Some people have a phobia of spiders. Some have a phobia of high places. A phobia can make it hard to play or be with friends. Doctors can help a person feel less scared over time.
Phoenicia\n\nPhoenicia was a place a long, long time ago. It sat next to a big blue sea. People there built strong boats from wood. They sailed far away to trade things like purple cloth and glass. Today, that place is part of other lands with new names.
Phoenix (mythology)\n\nA phoenix is a magic bird from very old stories. It has bright red and gold feathers, and it looks as big as an eagle. People in many lands tell stories about it. When it gets very old, it makes a nest of sweet-smelling sticks and sets itself on fire. Then a new, young bird rises from the warm ashes. It is a sign of starting over and living a long, long time.
Phone\n\nA phone is a small machine that lets you talk to someone far away. It has a screen and buttons you can touch. You can find it in a house, a pocket, or a bag. People use it to call a friend, send a message, or look at pictures. Some phones can play music or show a map. A phone you carry around is called a cell phone.
Photo\n\nA photo is a picture made with a camera. It shows a moment that happened, like a smile or a birthday cake. You can see photos on a phone, in a book, or on a wall. People take photos to remember fun times. When you look at a photo, you can see people, places, and things just as they were.
Photocopier\n\nA photocopier is a big machine that makes copies of paper. It has a flat glass top where you put the paper you want to copy. You find it in schools, offices, and stores. When you press a button, a bright light moves under the glass and it prints the same words or pictures on a new piece of paper. It helps people share the same page with many friends.
Photographic film\n\nPhotographic film is a thin, bendy sheet that holds pictures. It is kept inside a small dark box so light does not touch it. You put it inside a camera to take a photo. When you press the button, light hits the film and makes a hidden picture. Later, a grown-up uses special water to make the picture show up on paper. One roll of film can hold many pictures, but you can only use it one time.
Photography\n\nPhotography is a way to make pictures with a camera. A camera is a box with a hole and a special glass piece called a lens. It lets light in to make a picture. You press a button to open a tiny door inside. The door opens and shuts very fast to catch the light. The picture can be saved on a small card or on a roll called film. People use it to take photos of their family, pets, or a sunny day at the park.
Photojournalism\n\nPhotojournalism is taking pictures to tell a story. It uses a camera to show what is happening in the world. You can see it in newspapers, magazines, and on TV. A photojournalist goes to big events, like a parade or a sports game, and takes photos. The photos help people understand the news. For example, a picture of a fire truck at a burning house tells a story without words.
Photon\n\nA photon is a tiny bit of light. It is so small you cannot see it with your eyes. It comes from the sun, a lamp, or a flashlight. It moves very, very fast. When many photons hit your eye, you see bright things.
Photosynthesis\n\nPhotosynthesis is how plants make their own food. It happens in the green parts of a plant, like the leaves. The plant uses sunlight, water from the ground, and air to do it. It makes a kind of sugar that helps the plant grow big and strong. It also puts fresh air back out for people and animals to breathe. You can see it working when a plant sits in the sun and looks happy and green.
Phrase\n\nA phrase is a small group of words that work together. It is not a full sentence because it does not have a complete idea. You can find phrases in books, on signs, and when people talk. It helps add more meaning to a word. For example, 'the big red ball' is a phrase that tells you more about the ball.
Physic\n\nPhysic is an old word for medicine or a kind of plant that helps sick people feel better. It can be a drink or a pill made from leaves or roots. Long ago, people used physic when they had a tummy ache or a fever. Today, we say medicine more often, but physic means the same thing. You might see it in a story about a doctor from long ago.
Physical\n\nPhysical means your body. It is how your body moves, feels, and grows. You use your body when you run, jump, or dance. Eating good food and sleeping help your body stay strong. Playing outside is a fun way to move your body.
Physical Chemistry\n\nPhysical chemistry is a kind of science. It looks at how tiny bits of stuff move and change. It helps us know why water turns to ice when it gets cold. It also tells us why a cake rises in the oven. Scientists use it to make new things like better batteries.
Physical Cosmology\n\nPhysical cosmology is a big idea about the whole sky and everything in it. It is the way grown-ups try to understand how the stars, the sun, the moon, and our world all began. They look far into the dark night sky with strong tools to see tiny lights. They think about how everything moves and changes over a very, very long time. It is like a giant story of where we all came from.
Physical disability\n\nA physical disability is when a part of the body does not work the same as most people's. It can make it hard to walk, see, hear, or move an arm or leg. Some people are born with it, and some get it after an accident or sickness. You might see a person using a wheelchair to move around. That is one example of a physical disability. Another example is a person who cannot see well and uses a white stick to walk. People with a physical disability can do many things, just sometimes in a different way.
Physical examination\n\nA physical examination is when a doctor or nurse looks at your body to see if you are healthy. It happens in a clean room with a soft bed. The doctor uses a light to look in your eyes, ears, and mouth. They also listen to your heart and breathing with a cold tool on your chest. They may tap your knee to make your leg jump. This check helps find any hurts or sickness early. You might have one before starting school or playing a sport.
Physical exercise\n\nPhysical exercise is moving your body to stay healthy and strong. It can be running, jumping, dancing, or playing outside. You can do it at a park, at home, or at school. It makes your heart beat faster and your muscles grow. After you exercise, you may feel happy and sleep better at night. Playing tag with friends is one fun way to exercise.
Physical fitness\n\nPhysical fitness is how well your body can move and play. It means your heart, muscles, and bones are strong and healthy. You can find it when you run, jump, climb, or dance. It helps you play longer without getting too tired. For example, when you chase a friend at the park, your body is using physical fitness.
Physical geography\n\nPhysical geography is about the land, water, and air around us. It looks at big things like mountains, rivers, and deserts. It also looks at the weather and how plants and animals live in different places. You can see it when you go to a beach or climb a hill. It helps us know why some places are hot and some are cold. People use it to decide where to build houses and farms.
Physician\n\nA physician is a person who helps sick people feel better. She wears a white coat and uses a tool to listen to your heart and breathing. You can find her in a hospital, a small doctor's office, or sometimes she comes to your home. She asks you where it hurts and looks at your body to find out what is wrong. She may give you medicine or tell you to rest so you get well. When you have a fever or a cough, your mom or dad takes you to see her.
Physics\n\nPhysics is the science of how things move and work. It looks at big things like stars and small things like tiny bits called atoms. It studies pushes and pulls, like when you roll a ball or drop a toy. You see physics when a swing goes back and forth or when a magnet sticks to the fridge. It helps people build cars, planes, and phones.
Physiology\n\nPhysiology is the study of how living things work. It looks at what happens inside a body, like how a heart beats or how lungs breathe. You can find it in books and at school when you learn about your body. It helps doctors know why you get sick and how to make you better. When you run fast and feel your heart thump, that is part of physiology.
Pi\n\nPi is a special number that helps us talk about circles. It is always the same number, no matter how big or small the circle is. You can find it when you measure around a circle and across the middle. It starts with 3.14 and the numbers go on forever without stopping. People use it to figure out how big a circle is or how far it is around. Some people even have a fun day for it on March 14, because that date looks like 3-14.
Piano\n\nA piano is a big music box with black and white keys. It has a wooden body and a row of keys you press with your fingers. You can find it in homes, schools, and concert halls. When you press a key, a soft hammer inside hits a string and makes a sound. It can play soft, quiet notes or loud, happy notes. Many people learn to play songs on it.
Pick\n\nA pick is a tool with a long handle and a sharp point. It is used to break hard things like rocks or hard ground. You might see a pick in a garden or at a building site. A person swings it to make a hole or to break something apart. It looks a little like a big hammer with a pointy end.
Pickling\n\nPickling is a way to keep food fresh for a long time. It uses a sour liquid called vinegar or very salty water. The food sits in this liquid inside a closed jar. It changes the taste, making the food sour or salty. You can find pickled cucumbers at the store, and people call them pickles. Some people also pickle onions, eggs, or carrots. The sour liquid stops tiny bugs that make food go bad, so the food stays good for many months.
Picnic\n\nA picnic is a meal you eat outside. It is often on a blanket on the grass. You can have it in a park, at the beach, or in your backyard. People bring food in a basket or a bag. They eat sandwiches, fruit, and cookies. A picnic is fun with family or friends. You can play games after you eat.
Picture\n\nA picture is something you look at that shows a person, a place, or a thing. It can be made with a camera, a brush, or a pencil. You can see it on paper, on a wall, or on a screen. A picture helps you remember a happy day or learn how to do something new. When you draw a sun with crayons, that is a picture too.
Pie\n\nA pie is a baked food with a crust on the outside and yummy stuff inside. It is often round and flat, like a big cookie. You can find it in a bakery or at home after someone bakes it. People eat it as a snack or for dessert. Some pies have fruit inside, like apple or cherry. Other pies have meat and vegetables inside. You might see a pie at a birthday party or a holiday dinner.
Piece\n\nA piece is a small part of something bigger. It can be a bit of a puzzle, a slice of cake, or a part of a toy. When you break a cookie, each little bit is a piece. You can put pieces together to make a whole thing again.
Pier\n\nA pier is a long path that goes out over the water. It is made of wood or hard stone. You can walk on it and look down at the waves. Some piers have little shops or places to eat. People like to fish from it or watch boats go by. At the beach, you might see a pier with a big wheel that spins around.
Pig\n\nA pig is a big animal with a round body and short legs. It has a flat nose, small eyes, and a curly tail. Pigs live on farms all over the world. They eat plants and other things, like corn and special food. A pig is very smart and can learn games. It rolls in mud to stay cool and keep bugs away. A baby pig is called a piglet. Some people keep small pigs as pets.
Piggy\n\nA piggy is a small, round animal with a pink, soft body. It has four short legs, a curly tail, and a flat nose. You can find it on a farm, where it lives in a pen with other piggies. It likes to roll in mud to stay cool and clean. A piggy makes a loud oink sound when it is happy or hungry. Many children know a piggy from a toy bank where they put coins to save money.
Pigment\n\nA pigment is a powder that gives color to other things. It can come from rocks, plants, or animals. People mix it into paint, crayons, or clay to make them bright. For example, a blue pigment can make a blue crayon. You see it every day in the colors of your toys and drawings.
Pile\n\nA pile is a group of things put on top of each other. It can be a pile of books, a pile of leaves, or a pile of toys. You can make a pile by putting one thing on top of another. A pile can be big or small. When you clean your room, you might put all your blocks in a pile. It is a simple way to keep things together.
Pilgrimage\n\nA pilgrimage is a long trip to a special place. It is a trip that people take because of their faith or beliefs. The place is often far away, in a different city or country. People walk or ride to get there. They may pray or think quiet thoughts along the way. Some pilgrimages are not about faith, but about a place that is important to a person or a group.
Pill\n\nA pill is a tiny, hard thing you swallow. It is round or oval and very small. You find it in a bottle at home or at the doctor's office. It has medicine inside to help you feel better when you are sick. A grown-up gives you one pill with a cup of water. You should never take a pill by yourself.
Pillar\n\nA pillar is a tall, strong post that holds something up. It is often round or square and made of stone, wood, or metal. You can see pillars holding up the roof of a big building, like a church or a museum. Some pillars are plain, and some have pretty shapes carved into them. A pillar helps keep the building from falling down.
Pillow\n\nA pillow is a soft thing you put your head on when you sleep. It is made of cloth and filled with soft stuff like feathers or fluffy cotton. It is usually shaped like a rectangle. You find it on a bed, and it has a cover called a pillowcase to keep it clean. When you lie down at night, it helps your head and neck feel cozy. Many kids hug a pillow when they go to sleep.
Pilot\n\nA pilot is a person who flies an airplane. He sits in the front of the plane in a special seat with many buttons and screens. You can see him at the airport when you go on a trip. He wears a uniform with stripes on the sleeves. He talks to people on the ground to know where to go. He makes the plane go up, down, and turn. He keeps everyone safe in the sky.
Pin\n\nA pin is a small, thin piece of metal. It has a sharp point at one end and a flat or round top at the other. You can find it in a sewing box or on a desk. People use it to hold pieces of cloth or paper together. A pin can also be a shiny badge you wear on your shirt.
Pinball\n\nPinball is a fun game you play on a big machine. It has a glass top, and inside there is a slanted board with bumpers, lights, and holes. You press buttons on the sides to move flippers that hit a small metal ball. The ball bounces around and you try to keep it from falling down a hole at the bottom. When the ball hits bumpers and targets, you get points. You can see pinball machines at arcades or fun places with games.
Pinch\n\nA pinch is when you squeeze a little bit of skin or something soft between your thumb and finger. It can feel like a tiny, quick press. Sometimes a grown-up gives a gentle pinch on your cheek to show they like you. You might pinch a piece of play dough to make it flat. A pinch does not hurt much, but it can make you say "ouch" if it is too hard.
Pine\n\nA pine is a tall tree with thin, pointy leaves called needles. It stays green all year, even in winter. It has a straight brown trunk and branches that spread out high up. You can find it in forests, parks, and sometimes in your own yard. It grows a woody cone that holds seeds inside. The cone opens when it is warm to let the seeds fall out. Some cones need a fire to open. People use the wood to build houses and make paper. At Christmas, many families bring a small pine inside and put lights on it.
Pineapple\n\nA pineapple is a sweet, yellow fruit. It has a rough, spiky outside that looks a bit like a pine cone. Inside, it is soft and juicy. It grows in warm places where the sun shines a lot. People eat it as a snack or put it in drinks and cakes. It tastes both sweet and a little sour. You can find it at the grocery store, often with its green, pointy leaves on top.
Pink\n\nPink is a light, soft color. It looks like red mixed with white. You can see it on flowers, candy, and sometimes on a baby's blanket. Many people use pink to make things look sweet and pretty. A pig is pink, and so is cotton candy at the fair.
Pioneer\n\nA pioneer is a person who goes first to a new place. He or she walks where no one has walked before. Pioneers often travel to wild lands with no roads or houses. They build new homes and towns for other people to come later. A long time ago, pioneers crossed big fields and mountains in wagons. They worked very hard to make a new life.
Pip\n\nA pip is a small, hard seed inside a fruit. It is often brown or black and feels smooth. You find it when you eat an apple, an orange, or a grape. If you put a pip in the ground, it can grow into a new plant. Some pips are safe to eat, but others are not, so always ask a grown-up.
Pipe\n\nA pipe is a long, round tube that is empty inside. It can be made of metal, plastic, or clay. You can find pipes under the sink in your kitchen or bathroom. Water moves through a pipe to get to the faucet. When you turn on the water, it comes out because a pipe brings it there.
Pipe (material)\n\nA pipe is a long, round, empty tube. It is hard and stays in one place. People use it to carry water or other things from one spot to another. You can see pipes under the sink in your kitchen or bathroom. Water comes out of the faucet because a pipe brings it there.
Pipe organ\n\nA pipe organ is a big music maker with many pipes. It has one or more keyboards for the hands and a pedal board for the feet. You find it in big churches or halls. A person plays it to make loud, beautiful music. The sound comes from air blowing through pipes of different sizes.
Pipeline\n\nA pipeline is a very long, round tube. It is made of strong metal. It carries things like water, oil, or gas from one place to another, sometimes very far away. Some pipelines even carry thick mud with tiny bits of rock inside. You might see a big pipe at a sports game that brings a drink from a big tank to the cups. It works like a secret road under the ground or inside walls.
Piranha\n\nA piranha is a small, sharp-toothed fish that lives in warm rivers and lakes. It has a flat, round body and a mouth full of tiny, pointy teeth. It lives in South America, in places where the water is warm. It eats meat, like other fish or small animals that fall into the water. It moves in big groups called schools. Many people think it is a very fast and scary fish, but it is also food for bigger animals like birds and turtles.
Pirate\n\nA pirate is a person who steals things from ships at sea. He often has a big hat, an eye patch, and a hook for a hand. You can find stories about him in books and movies. He sails on a big boat with a black flag that has a skull and crossbones. He looks for treasure like gold and jewels. Sometimes he has a parrot on his shoulder.
Pit\n\nA pit is a deep hole in the ground. It can be big or small, and it is open at the top. You might see a pit at a playground or in a forest. Sometimes people dig a pit to plant a tree or to find water. Animals like rabbits can dig a pit to make a home. Be careful near a pit so you do not fall in.
Pixel\n\nA pixel is a tiny dot of color. It is a small square on a screen. Many pixels together make a picture. Each pixel has its own color. You see pixels on a TV, a tablet, or a phone. When you look very close, you can see the little squares.
Pizza\n\nPizza is a round, flat food that people love to eat. It has a soft bread bottom called the crust. On top of the crust, there is red sauce made from tomatoes. Then, people put cheese and other yummy things on it. You can find pizza in restaurants, at parties, or in the freezer at the grocery store. Many kids eat it for dinner or at birthday parties. Some pizzas have just cheese, and some have little round meats called pepperoni.
Place\n\nA place is a spot where something is or where something happens. It can be a room, a park, a store, or your own bed. You can point to a place with your finger. Some places are big, like a beach, and some are small, like a chair. Every day you go to many places, like the kitchen for breakfast or the playground to swing.
Place value\n\nPlace value is a way to know how much a number is worth. It looks at where a number sits in a line. The same number can mean different things if it sits in a different spot. For example, in the number 25, the 2 is in the tens spot, so it means twenty. The 5 is in the ones spot, so it means five. You see place value when you count money or read big numbers.
Plaice\n\nA plaice is a flat fish that lives in the sea. It has both eyes on one side of its head, and its body is very thin. It lies on the sandy bottom of the ocean, where it is hard to see because its top side looks like sand. People catch it to eat, and you might see it at a fish market or in a picture book about sea animals.
Plain\n\nA plain is a big, flat piece of land. It has no tall hills or bumpy mountains. You can see far across it because the ground is so smooth. Farmers like plains because the flat land is good for growing food like wheat and corn. Many animals, like cows and horses, live on plains and eat the grass. Some plains are so big they stretch farther than your eyes can see.
Plan\n\nA plan is a list of steps you make before you do something. It is like a map in your head that shows what to do first, next, and last. You can find a plan in your mind when you think about your day. People use a plan to get ready for a trip, a party, or a fun game. For example, before you build a block tower, you might plan which blocks to put at the bottom.
Plane\n\nA plane is a big machine that flies in the sky. It has two long wings, a tail, and big engines that make a loud sound. You can see a plane at an airport, where people get on and off. It takes people and things to faraway places very fast. When you look up, you might see a tiny white line behind a plane high in the blue sky.
Plane (tool)\n\nA plane is a tool that makes wood smooth and flat. It has a sharp metal blade inside a hard body. When you push it over a bumpy piece of wood, it cuts off thin, curly strips. The blade is held at a steady angle so the wood feels soft and even. People who build things with wood use it in a workshop. Long ago, the body was made of wood and the blade was made of bronze or iron. Today, many planes have a metal body. Some are big and some are small, for different jobs.
Planet\n\nA planet is a big, round ball that moves around a star. It does not make its own light, but it shines by bouncing light from a star. You can see some planets in the night sky. They look like bright dots that do not twinkle much. Earth is the planet we live on. It is the only one we know has water, air, and life. Other planets near us are Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn. Some planets are hot, and some are very cold. People use big tools called telescopes to look at planets far away.
Planetary system\n\nA planetary system is a family in space. It has a big bright star in the middle, and planets that go around the star. Our own Solar System is one example. The Sun is our star, and Earth is one of the planets that goes around it. Many other stars in the night sky also have planets going around them. Some stars have just one planet, and some have many. Scientists look at these systems with big telescopes to learn about faraway worlds.
Plankton\n\nPlankton are tiny living things that float in the ocean. They are so small that you need a tool to see them. They drift with the water because they cannot swim against the waves. Many fish and big whales eat them for food. Plankton live near the top of the water where the sun shines.
Plant\n\nA plant is a living thing that grows in the ground. It has roots that hold it in the soil and drink water. It has a stem that stands up tall, and leaves that catch sunlight. It uses sunlight, water, and air to make its own food. Many plants have flowers that turn into fruits with seeds inside. You can see plants in gardens, parks, and forests. A tiny seed can grow into a big tree.
Plant breeding\n\nPlant breeding is a way people help plants change. It means picking the best plants and using their seeds to grow new ones. Farmers and gardeners do this to get plants that make more food, stay healthy, or grow in hot or dry places. Long ago, people started by saving seeds from the biggest and tastiest plants. Today, people also use science to mix plants and make new kinds. You might see a big, red tomato at the store — that came from plant breeding.
Plant reproduction\n\nPlant reproduction is how plants make new baby plants. It can happen in two ways. One way needs two parent plants, like a mom and a dad. The baby plant gets a little bit from each parent. The other way needs only one parent plant. The baby plant is just like the parent. A piece of a plant, like a stem or a leaf, can grow into a whole new plant. People can help by cutting a small part and putting it in dirt. This is a simple way to get more plants.
Plant stem\n\nA plant stem is the long part of a plant that holds it up. It has little bumps called nodes where leaves and flowers grow. You can see stems in your garden or in a park. It carries water and food from the ground to the rest of the plant. A thick stem on a tree is called a trunk. Some stems are soft and green, like on a flower. Other stems are hard and brown, like on a big tree.
Plantain\n\nA plantain is a fruit that looks like a big banana. It is green or yellow and feels hard. You find it in warm places, like near the ocean. People cook it before they eat it, because it is not sweet like a soft banana. They boil it, fry it, or bake it. Some people use its big green leaves as plates for food.
Plasma\n\nPlasma is a kind of hot, glowing gas. It is made when gas gets so hot that tiny bits inside it break apart. You can see it in lightning during a storm. It is also inside the sun and all the stars that shine at night. People use it in flat TV screens and in long, bright lights called neon signs. It can be many colors, like blue, pink, or white.
Plastic\n\nPlastic is a material that can be made into many shapes. It is often light and can be hard or bendy. You see it in toys, bottles, bags, and cups. People use it to make things that are easy to carry and clean. A plastic toy is something you might play with every day.
Plastic surgery\n\nPlastic surgery is a kind of doctor work that changes how a body looks or works. It can fix parts that are hurt, like skin after a bad burn. It can also change parts to make them look different, like pulling face skin tight so a person looks younger. Doctors do this work in a big clean room called a hospital. They use special tools to help the body heal or change shape.
Plate\n\nA plate is a flat round thing that holds food. It can be made of hard clay, plastic, or paper. You see it on the table at breakfast, lunch, and dinner. People put food on it so they can eat with a fork or spoon. Some plates have pictures of animals or flowers on them. After eating, you wash it with soap and water.
Plate armour\n\nPlate armour is a strong suit made of metal. It covers a person from head to toe. Long ago, knights wore it to stay safe in fights. It has many hard pieces that fit together like a puzzle. You can see it in old castles or in storybooks about brave knights.
Plate tectonics\n\nPlate tectonics is a big idea about how the Earth's hard outside moves. It says the ground we walk on is broken into giant pieces called plates. These plates are like huge puzzle pieces that fit together. They float on a hot, soft layer deep under the ground. Sometimes the plates bump into each other, and that can make mountains. When they slide past each other, the ground can shake — that is an earthquake. You can see tall mountains like the ones in pictures, and they were made when plates pushed together a long time ago.
Plateau\n\nA plateau is a big piece of land that is flat on top. It looks like a giant table made of rock and dirt. You can find it high up in the mountains or sometimes under the sea. It is so high that you can see far away from the top. Some plateaus are made when hot rock from a volcano cools down. Others are made when the ground pushes up very slowly. The top is often windy and has few trees.
Plato\n\nPlato was a man who lived a long, long time ago. He thought a lot about big ideas like what is good and what is true. He wrote many stories where people talk and ask questions to learn new things. He started a school where people came to think and learn together. Many people still read his words today.
Platypus\n\nA platypus is a small, furry animal that lives in rivers. It has a wide, flat tail and a big, soft nose that looks like a duck's bill. It lives in eastern Australia, in streams and river banks. It swims very well and hunts for worms and water bugs at night. It is a special mammal because it lays eggs, but the mother still makes milk for the babies. You might see one in a zoo or in a quiet river at sunset.
Play\n\nPlay is something you do for fun. It can be running, jumping, drawing, or pretending. You can play alone or with friends. It makes you happy and helps you learn new things. You play at home, at the park, or at school during break time.
Play (activity)\n\nPlay is a fun thing you choose to do. It can be running, jumping, pretending, or playing a game with friends. You can play outside on a playground or inside with toys. When you play, you feel happy and you learn new things. A game of tag is one kind of play.
Playdate\n\nA playdate is a time when two or more children get together to play. It usually happens at one child's house or at a park. A grown-up watches to keep everyone safe. During a playdate, kids share toys, run around, and have fun. Sometimes they eat a snack like crackers or fruit. It is a nice way to make friends and learn to take turns.
Player\n\nA player is a person who plays a game or a sport. It can be a boy or a girl. You see players on a field, on a court, or in a park. They run, jump, kick, or throw a ball. A player tries to win and have fun. When you play tag with friends, you are a player too.
Playground\n\nA playground is a fun place where children go to play. It has things like a slide, a swing, and a seesaw. You can find it outside in a park or at a school. It helps kids run, jump, and climb to stay strong and healthy. The ground is soft, like rubber or sand, so it does not hurt if you fall. Many children love to go there with friends.
Playhouse\n\nA playhouse is a small house made for children to play in. It can be made of wood or plastic and has a little door and windows. You can find it in a backyard or a park. Children use it to pretend they are cooking, sleeping, or having a tea party. It is like a tiny real house where kids can be the boss.
Playroom\n\nA playroom is a room in a house where children can play. It has toys, books, and games on the floor or on low shelves. You find it in some homes, often near the kitchen or living room. It is a safe place to run, jump, and make noise. A playroom may have a soft rug, a small table, and chairs just your size. It is where you can build with blocks, dress up, or read a story.
Playtime\n\nPlaytime is a happy time when you can do fun things. It happens at home, at school, or outside. You can run, jump, draw, or play with toys. It helps your body grow strong and your mind learn new ideas. Friends often play together and laugh a lot. After playtime, you might feel tired but very happy.
Plaza\n\nA plaza is a big open space in a town or city. It has a flat floor made of stone or brick. You can find it in the middle of a town, near shops and tall buildings. People walk, sit, and meet friends there. Sometimes a plaza has a fountain with water that splashes. On sunny days, children run and play in the open space.
Please\n\nPlease is a small word we say to be kind. It is a way to ask for something in a nice voice. You say it when you want a snack, a toy, or a turn. When you say please, people feel happy to help you. You can hear it at home, at school, or at a friend's house. It is a good word to use every day.
Pleasure\n\nPleasure is a happy feeling you get inside. It is the opposite of feeling hurt or sad. You feel it when you do something fun, like eating a sweet treat or playing with a friend. It can make you smile or laugh. Your brain has special spots that light up when you feel it. Feeling it often helps you stay happy and healthy.
Pleiades\n\nPleiades is a group of stars in the night sky. It looks like a tiny bunch of bright dots close together. You can see it with just your eyes when the sky is dark and clear. It is part of a bigger picture in the sky called Taurus, the bull. Long ago, people gave it a name from old stories. The brightest star in the group is a big, hot star called Alcyone. It is one of the closest star groups to Earth.
Plesiosaur\n\nA plesiosaur is an old, big animal that lived in the sea. It had a wide body, a short tail, and four long flippers like paddles. Some had long necks and small heads, and some had short necks and big heads. It ate fish and other sea animals. It lived a long, long time ago, but now there are none left. We know about it because people find its bones in rocks.
Plot\n\nA plot is the story of a book, a movie, or a play. It tells what happens from the start to the end. First, something begins the story. Then, things get exciting or hard. At the end, the problem is fixed. When you watch a cartoon, the plot is all the things the characters do.
Plow\n\nA plow is a big tool that helps farmers and people move dirt or snow. It has a strong metal blade at the front. You can see it on a farm, pulled by a tractor. It digs into the ground and flips the soil over. This makes the dirt soft and ready for seeds. In winter, a plow pushes snow off the road so cars can drive safely.
Plug\n\nA plug is a small thing at the end of a cord. It has two or three metal sticks that go into holes in the wall. You find it on lamps, TVs, and toys that need power. It lets electricity flow from the wall to make things turn on. When you push it in, the light or toy starts to work.
Plum\n\nA plum is a small, round fruit that grows on a tree. It has smooth skin that can be purple, red, yellow, or green. Inside, it has soft, juicy flesh and one big hard seed. You can eat it fresh as a snack, or use it to make sweet jam. When a plum is dried, it becomes a prune. You might find plums at the grocery store or in a lunch box.
Plumber\n\nA plumber is a person who fixes pipes. He works on the pipes that bring water into your house and take dirty water away. When a sink is clogged or a toilet won't stop running, a plumber comes to help. He uses tools like a wrench and a long snake to clear the pipes. You might see a plumber under the kitchen sink or in the bathroom. He makes sure the water flows where it should.
Plumbing\n\nPlumbing is all the pipes that bring water into a house and take dirty water away. It has long straight parts and small bent parts that fit together under the floor and inside walls. You find it in your kitchen and bathroom. It gives you clean water to drink and wash your hands. When you flush the toilet, it carries the waste down and out of the house.
