A plumber is a person who fixes it when a pipe breaks or gets clogged.
Plus\n\nPlus is a way to put numbers together. It uses a little cross sign that looks like a plus. When you have two apples and you get one more, you use plus to know you have three. You see it in school when you learn to count. It helps you add things up.
Pluto\n\nPluto is a small, cold world far away in space. It is round like a ball and made of rock and ice. It is smaller than our Moon. Pluto lives very far from the Sun, so it is super cold there. It moves around the Sun, but its path is not a perfect circle. Sometimes it even comes closer to the Sun than another big world called Neptune. Pluto has five little moons that go around it. The biggest moon is named Charon. A long time ago, people called Pluto a planet, but now they call it a dwarf planet because it is so small and shares its path with other things.
Pneumonia\n\nPneumonia is a sickness in the lungs. It makes the tiny air bags inside the lungs fill up with gooey stuff. This makes it hard to breathe. A person with it may cough, feel pain in the chest, or feel very tired. Doctors give special medicine to help the body fight the sickness. Sometimes a person needs extra air from a mask to feel better. Many people get well with rest and care.
Pocket\n\nA pocket is a small bag sewn onto clothes. It is a little open space where you can put tiny things. You find it on pants, shirts, jackets, and coats. It keeps your hands warm or holds a tissue, a coin, or a small toy. When you wear pants, you can slide your hand into it to feel cozy.
Podcasting\n\nPodcasting is a way to share talking and sounds. It is like a radio show that lives on a computer or a phone. You can find a podcast about almost anything — funny stories, news, or learning new things. People make a podcast at home with a microphone. Then they put it online so others can listen. You can listen to it in the car, at home, or while playing. It is like having a story or a lesson in your pocket.
Poem\n\nA poem is a short piece of writing that uses words in a special way. It often has lines that sound like music, with beats and rhymes. You can find poems in books, on cards, or hear them in songs. People write poems to share feelings or tell a tiny story. A poem can be about a cat, a flower, or a happy day. Some poems are funny and make you laugh.
Poet\n\nA poet is a person who writes poems. He uses words that sound pretty together, like a song without music. You can find his poems in books at the library or at school. He writes about feelings, nature, or funny things he sees. Sometimes a poet reads his poem out loud, and the words dance in the air.
Poetry\n\nPoetry is a way to play with words. It uses words like music, with sounds that match and a beat you can feel. You can find it in books, songs, and little rhymes. People read it out loud or sing it to share a feeling or a story. A short poem you might know is a nursery rhyme like "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star."
Poinsettia\n\nA poinsettia is a plant with bright red leaves. It has green leaves too, and the red parts look like big flowers. You see it a lot in winter, around Christmas time. People put it in their homes to make the room look happy and colorful. It grows in warm places far away, but you can buy it in a store in a small pot.
Point\n\nA point is a tiny dot. It is so small that it has no size at all. You can make a point with a pencil tip on paper. It shows a place, like where two lines meet. In a game, you get a point when you do something good.
Point (geometry)\n\nA point is a tiny spot that shows a place. It has no size at all — no length, no width, and no height. We draw it as a small dot or a little cross on paper. You can see points on a map to show where a house or a park is. When you put two points together, they make a straight line. A point is one of the first things you learn in shapes.
Pointer\n\nA pointer is a long, thin stick. It is used to show or point at things. You might see a teacher use it to point at a board in a classroom. Some pointers have a small hand shape at the end. It helps people see what you are talking about.
Pointy\n\nPointy means something has a sharp end. It can be like the tip of a pencil or the top of a party hat. You can feel it with your finger, but you must be careful not to poke yourself. Many things in your house are pointy, like a fork or a needle. A mountain top far away can also look pointy.
Poison\n\nPoison is something that can make a living thing very sick or even die. It can be in food, drink, or air, or it can touch the skin. Some plants and mushrooms have poison inside them, so you should never eat them. A snake has poison in its bite, and a bee has poison in its sting. If someone eats or touches poison, they need a doctor right away. A special medicine called an antidote can sometimes stop the poison from hurting more.
Poland\n\nPoland is a country in Europe. It is next to Germany and other places. The land has big cities, green fields, and a sea at the top. Many people live there, and they speak Polish. A long time ago, kings and queens ruled it. Today, people choose their own leaders. You can see the Polish flag with white and red stripes.
Polar\n\nPolar means the very top or very bottom of the Earth. It is the coldest place on our planet. At the North Pole and South Pole, there is ice and snow all year. Polar bears live at the North Pole, and penguins live at the South Pole. The sun stays up all day in summer and hides all day in winter.
Polar bear\n\nA polar bear is a big white bear that lives in the cold, icy north. It has thick white fur that keeps it warm, and black skin underneath. It is very strong and can swim fast in the water. It eats mostly seals and fish, waiting by holes in the ice to catch them. Baby polar bears stay with their mom for about two years, learning to hunt and swim. You can see a polar bear in a zoo or in pictures of snow and ice.
Polaris (star)\n\nPolaris is a bright star in the night sky. It looks like a tiny dot of light that does not move. You can find it almost straight above the North Pole. Long ago, people on boats used it to know which way to go. It is part of a group of stars that make a shape like a little bear.
Pole\n\nA pole is a long, straight stick that stands up tall. It can be made of wood, metal, or hard plastic. You can see a pole holding up a tent, a flag, or a street light. People use it to hold things up high or to push a boat in water. A pole is often round and smooth, and you can hold it with your hands.
Pole vault\n\nPole vault is a sport where a person jumps high over a bar. It uses a long, bendy stick to push off the ground. You can see it at big games like the Olympics. The jumper runs fast, plants the stick, and swings up into the air. If they clear the bar without knocking it down, they win.
Police\n\nPolice are people who help keep us safe. They wear a blue or black uniform with a shiny badge. You can see them in a police car or at a police station. They help when there is a car crash or a fire. They also catch people who break the rules. If you are lost, a police officer can help you find your mom or dad.
Polish language\n\nPolish is a way people talk and write. It is the main language in a country called Poland. Many people in other places also speak it. It has letters that look like English letters with little marks. Some letters make sounds that are not in English. People use it to say hello, ask names, and tell stories.
Polite\n\nPolite means using kind words and nice actions. It is saying "please" when you ask for something and "thank you" when you get it. You can be polite at home, at school, or at a friend's house. It helps people feel good and happy with each other. When you wait your turn on the slide, that is polite too.
Politely\n\nPolitely means doing things in a kind and nice way. It is how you act when you say please and thank you. You find it when people talk softly and wait their turn. It is used to make others feel good and happy. For example, you say excuse me if you bump into someone.
Political\n\nPolitics is how a big group of people make rules and decide things together. It is like when your family picks what game to play, but for a whole town or country. People talk and vote to choose leaders. The leaders help keep things fair and safe. You might see politics on TV when grown-ups talk about new rules for schools or parks.
Political freedom\n\nPolitical freedom means people can say what they think. It means they can pick their own leaders. It also means they can meet with friends and talk about ideas. In some places, people have a lot of political freedom. In other places, they have only a little. It is like being able to choose your own game at playtime.
Political party\n\nA political party is a group of people who work together to run the country. They pick a person to be the leader and ask people to vote for them. When they get the most votes, they make the rules and decide how things work. In some places, there are two big parties, like in the United States. In other places, many parties share the power. They often have a name and a sign, like a donkey or an elephant, so people know who they are.
Political Science\n\nPolitical science is about how people make rules and share power. It looks at how leaders are picked and how towns, cities, and countries are run. You see it when people vote or when a mayor talks on TV. It helps us understand why we have laws, like stopping at a red light. Even in a classroom, when kids pick a line leader, that is a tiny bit like political science.
Politics\n\nPolitics is how people in a group make decisions together. It happens when people talk and agree on rules so everyone can live safely. You can see it in a country, a school, or even a family. In a country, some people called leaders make big rules, like stopping cars from going too fast. These rules help keep people from getting hurt. At home, your family might use politics when they decide what game to play or what to eat for dinner. It is about sharing ideas and picking the best one for the group.
Pollen\n\nPollen is a fine yellow powder made by flowers. It looks like tiny dust grains. You can see it on the inside of a flower, on the fuzzy middle part. Wind or small animals like bees carry it from one flower to another. This helps the flower make seeds so new plants can grow. Sometimes you see yellow dust on a bee's legs when it visits a flower.
Pollination\n\nPollination is how plants make seeds. It happens when tiny yellow dust called pollen moves from one flower to another. Wind can carry it, or bees and butterflies can carry it on their bodies. When the pollen reaches the right spot, a seed starts to grow. Many fruits we eat, like apples and tomatoes, need pollination first.
Pollution\n\nPollution is when bad stuff gets into the air, water, or land and makes it dirty. It can hurt plants, animals, and people. You might see trash on the ground or dark smoke from a big truck. Sometimes the water in a pond looks green and yucky because of pollution. People can help by picking up trash and using less stuff that makes smoke.
Polo\n\nPolo is a game that people play while riding on horses. It has two teams, and each team has four riders. The riders use long sticks called mallets to hit a small ball. They try to hit the ball through two tall posts at the end of a big grass field. The horses are fast and strong, and they help the riders move quickly. You might see polo in a park or on TV, with riders wearing helmets and bright shirts.
Polygon\n\nA polygon is a flat shape with straight sides. It has corners where the sides meet. You can see polygons in many places. A square is a polygon with four sides that are all the same. A triangle is a polygon with three sides. Some polygons have many sides, like a stop sign with eight sides. People use polygons to draw pictures on computers.
Polynesia\n\nPolynesia is a big group of islands in the ocean. It is shaped like a triangle on the map. The top point is Hawai'i, the bottom left is New Zealand, and the bottom right is Easter Island. All the islands inside that shape are part of it. Many people live on these islands and use boats to travel between them. The water around it is warm and blue.
Polytheism\n\nPolytheism is when people believe in many gods. It is a way of thinking about the world. Long ago, people in places like Greece and Rome told stories about many gods. These stories are called myths. Today, some people still follow religions with many gods. It is different from believing in just one god.
Pomegranate\n\nA pomegranate is a round fruit with a tough, leathery skin. It is about the size of a big orange. Inside, it has many small, juicy seeds that are bright red. You can eat the seeds, and they taste sweet and a little sour. People grow pomegranate trees in warm places like the Middle East and California. You might see the fruit in a store or at a market. Some people use it to make juice or add it to salads.
Pompeii\n\nPompeii is a very old city that got covered by a big mountain that spit fire. It looks like a town made of stone, with streets, houses, and walls you can still walk on. You find it in a country called Italy, near a mountain that can get hot and loud. A long, long time ago, the mountain threw out hot ash and rocks, and it covered the whole city. That kept the city safe under the ground for many years. Now, people dig it up and look at the old houses and pots. They learn how people lived back then. You can go see it today, like a big stone puzzle from the past.
Pond\n\nA pond is a small body of water. It is like a tiny lake where the water stays in one place. You can find it in a park, a forest, or near a farm. Many animals live in it, like ducks, turtles, and frogs. Small fish swim in it too. The sun can shine all the way to the bottom. Some ponds dry up when the weather gets hot and come back when it rains. People should keep it clean so the animals stay safe.
Pony\n\nA pony is a small kind of horse. It has a round, chubby body and short legs. You can find it on a farm with other horses. People ride it and take care of it. A baby pony is called a foal. A Shetland pony is one kind you might see.
Pool\n\nA pool is a big bowl of water made for people to play in. It has clean, blue water that feels cool on a hot day. You can find it outside in a yard or at a park. People swim, splash, and float in it. Some pools have a shallow end where little kids can stand. You might see one at a friend's house or a hotel.
Pool (cue sports)\n\nPool is a game played on a big flat table. It has six holes around the edges called pockets. You use a long stick to push a white ball. The white ball hits other colored balls. The goal is to make the colored balls fall into the pockets. Many people play it at a game room or a friend's house.
Poop\n\nPoop is the brown stuff that comes out of your body when you go to the bathroom. It is made of food your body did not need. After you eat, your tummy takes the good parts and leaves the rest. That rest comes out as poop. It can be soft or hard, and it smells. Everyone poops—moms, dads, kids, and even animals. Flushing the toilet sends it away.
Poor\n\nPoor means you do not have much money. It is when a person cannot buy many things they need, like food, clothes, or a warm place to sleep. Some people who are poor live in small houses or on the street. They may not have toys or books. It is hard for them to get new shoes or a coat. Many kind people try to help by giving food or old clothes. Being poor is not a choice, and it can make a person feel sad.
Pop\n\nPop is a kind of music that is fun and easy to dance to. It has a strong beat that makes you want to clap your hands or tap your feet. You can hear it on the radio, on TV, or when people sing and play instruments. Many kids like pop songs because the tunes are catchy and you can sing along. A pop song often talks about happy things, like friends or sunny days.
Pop art\n\nPop art is a kind of art that uses pictures from everyday things. It often shows things like soup cans, comic strips, or movie stars. The colors are bright and clear, and the edges are often black like in a coloring book. You can see pop art in museums or on posters. It makes people look at simple things in a new way.
Pop music\n\nPop music is a kind of music that many people like to listen to. It has a strong beat that makes you want to dance. You can hear it on the radio, on TV, or at a party. Singers use a microphone to make their voice loud. Some pop music is fast and happy, and some is slow and soft. A famous pop singer is Taylor Swift. She sings songs that many kids and grown-ups enjoy.
Popcorn\n\nPopcorn is a yummy snack made from corn. It looks like small white fluffy clouds. You make it by heating tiny hard corn seeds until they pop open. People eat it at the movies, at home, or at a fair. It can be salty or sweet with butter on top.
Pope\n\nThe Pope is the leader of the Catholic Church. He lives in a small country called Vatican City, inside the big city of Rome. He wears a long white robe and a tall white hat. He talks to people about being kind and good. Many people come from far away to see him and listen to his words. He is chosen by a group of men in red robes called cardinals. Once he is chosen, he keeps the job for his whole life.
Popular\n\nPopular means many people like something. It can be a song, a toy, a game, or a person. When a thing is popular, lots of kids want to play with it or talk about it. A popular color might be blue because many friends say it is their favorite. If a new snack is popular, you see it in many lunch boxes at school.
Popular culture\n\nPopular culture is the fun stuff many people like at the same time. It comes from TV, radio, games, books, and music. You can see it in a catchy song on the radio or a cartoon show on TV. It can be a dance everyone does or a toy everyone wants. Sometimes grown-ups worry about it and say no, but in many places people are free to enjoy it.
Population\n\nPopulation is how many people live in one place. It counts all the people in a town, a city, or the whole world. A big city has a high population because many people live close together. A small town has a low population because people live far apart. The world has more than 8 billion people now. India has the most people of any country.
Porcelain\n\nPorcelain is a hard, white material that people make from special clay. It is smooth and shiny, and it can be very thin. You can find it in cups, plates, and pretty dolls at home. People use it to eat and drink, and they also put it on shelves to look nice. A tea set with flowers painted on it is often made of porcelain.
Porcupine\n\nA porcupine is a small animal with a body covered in sharp, pointy sticks. It has a round body, short legs, and a small face. It lives in forests, deserts, and grassy places. The sharp sticks on its back help keep it safe from other animals. When another animal gets too close, the sticks can poke them and hurt. A baby porcupine is called a porcupette. Its sticks are soft when it is born so it does not hurt its mom.
Pork\n\nPork is meat that comes from a pig. It is pink or white when it is cooked. People eat it in many places around the world. Some people make it into bacon, ham, or sausages. You might see it on a plate at breakfast or in a sandwich. Some families do not eat pork because of their rules about food.
Porpoise\n\nA porpoise is a small animal that lives in the ocean. It looks a lot like a dolphin, but it is shorter and rounder. It has a round head, a short nose, and a fin on its back that is shaped like a triangle. It swims in the sea and comes up to the top to breathe air. Some people teach porpoises to do tricks in big water parks. You might see one in a picture book about the ocean.
Porridge\n\nPorridge is a warm, soft food made from oats. It is cooked with water or milk in a pot until it gets thick and creamy. People eat it from a bowl, often in the morning for breakfast. Some add a little sugar, jam, or fruit on top to make it sweet. It is easy to eat and good for you when you feel sick.
Port\n\nA port is a place by the water where big boats stop. It is next to the ocean, a river, or a lake. Boats come to a port to pick up things like food, toys, and clothes. They also drop off things people need. People can get on a boat or get off a boat at a port. Some ports are just for fishing boats. Other ports are for big boats that take people on fun trips. A port has long wooden paths called docks where boats can rest. You might see a port when you go to the beach or visit a big city by the water.
Port-au-Prince\n\nPort-au-Prince is a big city. It is the most important city in a country called Haiti. Many people live there, more than two million. It has a big place where boats bring in food and take out coffee and sugar. It also has schools, stores, and an airport for planes. A long time ago, a big shaking of the ground broke many buildings and hurt many people. Some parts are still broken today.
Porter\n\nA porter is a person who carries bags and suitcases for other people. He works at a train station, an airport, or a hotel. He wears a uniform so you can see him easily. When you have a big, heavy bag, he picks it up and takes it where you need to go. He helps people who are tired or have too many things to carry.
Porto\n\nPorto is a big city in Portugal, a country near the sea. It sits next to a wide river, and the big blue ocean is not far away. Many old stone buildings and a tall bridge make it look pretty. People visit Porto to see the river and taste a sweet drink called port wine. The city is so old and special that it is on a list of important places in the world.
Portrait\n\nA portrait is a picture of a person's face. It can be a painting or a photo. It shows what the person looks like and how they feel. You can see portraits in a museum or on a wall at home. When someone makes a portrait, the person sits very still and looks at the artist. A family photo where everyone smiles is a kind of portrait.
Portugal\n\nPortugal is a country in Europe. It is next to the big blue ocean and next to Spain. Its main city is Lisbon. People speak Portuguese there. It has warm sunny beaches where families go on holiday. Long ago, its ships sailed far across the sea to find new lands. Today, it is a peaceful place with pretty tiles on houses and tasty custard tarts to eat.
Portuguese\n\nPortuguese is a way people talk and write. It sounds like music and has many soft sounds. People speak it in a country called Portugal and in a big country called Brazil. You can hear it in songs, on TV, and when people say hello. Some kids learn it at home from their mom or dad.
Portuguese language\n\nPortuguese is a way people talk and write. It sounds soft and has many words that roll off the tongue. People speak it in Portugal, a country in Europe, and in Brazil, a big country in South America. It is also spoken in some parts of Africa and Asia. Many children learn Portuguese at home from their mom and dad. It is one of the most spoken languages in the world.
Poseidon\n\nPoseidon is a god from old Greek stories. He is the god of the big blue sea and the waves. He carries a long fork with three sharp points called a trident. When he gets angry, he hits the ground with it and makes the earth shake. Sailors ask him to keep the water calm so they can sail safely. He also made the first horse, so people call him the father of horses. You can see pictures of him with a fish tail or riding a dolphin.
Positive\n\nPositive means something good or happy. It is the opposite of negative. When you feel positive, you smile and feel light inside. A sunny day can make you feel positive. A kind word from a friend is also positive. It is a nice feeling that makes you want to play and share.
Possible\n\nPossible means something can happen or can be done. It is not a sure thing, but it is not a no. When you say "It is possible," you mean maybe yes, maybe no. For example, it is possible that it will rain today. That means rain might come, but it might not. Another example: it is possible to jump over a small puddle. That means you can do it if you try. Some things are not possible, like flying without a plane. That means they cannot happen.
Post\n\nA post is a tall, straight stick that stands up from the ground. It can be made of wood, metal, or stone. You see posts in many places, like holding up a fence or a sign. A post helps keep things steady and in place. Sometimes people tie a rope to it or hang a light on it. A mailbox often sits on a short post by the road.
Postage stamp\n\nA postage stamp is a small piece of paper you stick on a letter. It shows that you paid to send the letter. You put it on the top right corner of the envelope. It has a sticky back, so you can lick it or peel it to make it stick. Each country has its own stamps with different pictures. Some show people, maps, or animals. Many people like to save stamps in a special book. A very old stamp from Britain was the first one ever made.
Postcard\n\nA postcard is a small, flat piece of thick paper. It has a picture on one side and a blank space on the other. You can write a short note on it and stick a stamp in the corner. People send postcards in the mail when they go on a trip. It shows a pretty place like a beach or a big city. A friend or family member gets the postcard and sees where you went. It is like sending a little hello from far away.
Poster\n\nA poster is a big piece of paper with a picture or words on it. It is often bright and colorful so people will look at it. You can find it on a wall, in a classroom, or on a board outside. It tells you about something, like a movie, a show, or a rule. Sometimes it has a drawing of a favorite hero or animal. People put it up to share news or make a room look nice.
Postman\n\nA postman is a person who brings letters and boxes to your house. He wears a blue or red uniform and carries a big bag. You can see him walking on the street or driving a small truck. He puts mail in your mailbox so you can read it. Sometimes he brings a birthday card or a toy you ordered.
Pot\n\nA pot is a round, deep bowl that you use for cooking. It is often made of metal and has two handles on the sides. You find it in the kitchen, on top of the stove. People put food and water inside it and heat it up to make soup, pasta, or boiled eggs. A pot is bigger than a pan and has tall sides. When you see bubbles rising in hot water, that is a pot boiling.
Potato\n\nA potato is a vegetable that grows under the ground. It is round or long and has a brown or yellow skin. Inside, it is white or yellow and feels hard when raw. You find potatoes in the dirt on a farm or in a garden. People dig them up and cook them by boiling, baking, or frying. You can eat them as soft baked potatoes, crispy fries, or thin chips. Many kids like mashed potatoes with butter.
Potential energy\n\nPotential energy is energy that is saved up and waiting to be used. It is like a toy car at the top of a ramp. The car is not moving yet, but it has energy ready to go. When you let go, it rolls down fast. A stretched rubber band also has it. When you let go, the rubber band snaps back. A ball held up high has it too. When you drop the ball, it falls down. The energy changes into moving energy, but no energy is lost.
Potter's wheel\n\nA potter's wheel is a round, flat tool that spins around. It helps people make bowls, cups, and pots from soft, wet clay. The person sits in front of it and pushes the clay with their hands while it turns. You can find a potter's wheel in an art room or a workshop. When the clay is dry, the bowl or cup goes into a hot oven to become hard. A child might see one at a fair where a grown-up makes a pot.
Pottery\n\nPottery is a hard bowl, cup, or plate made from soft, wet mud called clay. It starts as a lump of clay that a potter shapes with their hands or a spinning wheel. Then it goes into a very hot oven to bake until it is hard and strong. After baking, it can be painted with shiny colors to make it pretty and smooth. You can find pottery in your kitchen, like a cereal bowl or a mug for milk. Long ago, people made all their pots and jars this way because there were no plastic cups.
Poultry\n\nPoultry are birds that people keep on farms. They give us eggs and meat to eat. Chickens are the most common kind. They have feathers, two legs, and a beak. You can find them in a coop or a big farm field. People cook chicken for dinner and use eggs to make cakes. Other poultry are ducks and turkeys. A duck likes to swim in water. A turkey is bigger and has a funny red neck. Many children eat chicken nuggets or a boiled egg for lunch.
Pound\n\nA pound is a way to measure how heavy something is. It is used in some places, like the United States. A small bag of apples can weigh one pound. A big dog can weigh many pounds. People use a scale to see how many pounds something weighs.
Pound (mass)\n\nA pound is a way to tell how heavy something is. It is used in places like the United States. One pound is the same as 16 smaller bits called ounces. You see it on a kitchen scale when you weigh fruit or flour. A loaf of bread often weighs about one pound.
Pound sterling\n\nPound sterling is the money people use in the United Kingdom. It is made of coins and paper notes. The coins are small and round, and the notes are flat and colorful. People use it to buy food, toys, and clothes. One pound can be split into 100 tiny bits called pence. You might see a pound coin with a picture of the queen on it.
Pour\n\nPour means to tip a cup or a bottle so that the water or juice inside falls out. You do it when you fill a glass with milk at breakfast. It makes a soft splashing sound as the drink goes down. You can also pour sand from a bucket to make a sandcastle. When you pour, you hold the thing with two hands and tilt it slowly.
Poverty\n\nPoverty means a person does not have enough money for the things they need. It means they may not have enough food, clean water, or a safe place to sleep. Many people in the world live this way. Some have a job but still do not earn enough money. When people learn to read and write, it can help them find better work. Governments can also help by giving money or food to people who need it.
Powder\n\nPowder is a soft, dry thing made of many tiny bits. It feels light and can be white or other colors. You can find it in the kitchen, like flour for baking a cake. People also use it on their skin, like baby powder, to feel smooth and dry. If you blow on it, the tiny bits fly up like a little cloud.
Power\n\nPower is the ability to make things happen. It can be a push or a pull that moves something, like when you push a toy car. It can also be the energy that makes lights turn on and machines work. You see power when a fan spins fast or when a ball rolls far after you kick it. In stories, a superhero has power to fly or lift heavy things.
Power (physics)\n\nPower is how fast work gets done. It is like how quickly you can push a toy car across the floor. A bright light bulb uses more power than a dim one, so it shines stronger. A car uses a lot of power to go fast up a hill. When you lift a heavy box slowly, you use the same work as lifting it fast, but lifting it fast needs more power.
Power station\n\nA power station is a big place that makes electricity. It has tall towers and long wires that carry power far away. You can find one near a town or by a river. It sends electricity to homes so lights turn on and the TV works. Some use fire, some use wind, and some use the sun to make power.
Powerlifting\n\nPowerlifting is a sport where people try to lift very heavy things. It has three main moves: the squat, the bench press, and the deadlift. In a squat, a person bends their knees with a heavy bar on their back. In a bench press, they lie down and push a bar up from their chest. In a deadlift, they bend and pick up a bar from the floor. People who do powerlifting are very strong. They practice a lot to lift more and more weight.
Practice\n\nPractice means doing something many times to get better at it. It is like when you try to ride a bike again and again. At first, it feels hard, but after practice, it becomes easy. You can practice drawing, singing, or writing your name. Every time you practice, you learn a little more. It helps your brain and body remember how to do things.
Prague\n\nPrague is a big city where many people live. It has old stone bridges, tall towers, and a castle on a hill. You can find it in the middle of Europe, next to a river. People walk on the old bridge, look at a big clock on a wall, and buy small toys. A long time ago, kings and queens lived in the castle, and now many visitors come to see it.
Prairie\n\nA prairie is a big, open land with lots of grass. It has some flowers and a few bushes, but not many trees. You can find it in North America. It is home to animals like the big, furry buffalo and fast antelope. Birds like the meadowlark sing there. Some prairies have tall grass that grows higher than a grown-up. Other prairies have short grass that is only as high as your knee. Farmers use the rich dirt to grow food like corn and wheat. Long ago, fires would sweep across the land and keep trees away. Today, people work to protect the prairie so it stays healthy.
Prank\n\nA prank is a funny trick you play on someone. It is meant to make people laugh, not to hurt or be mean. You might hide behind a door and jump out to say "boo!" That is a prank. Another prank is putting a fake bug on a chair to see a friend jump. After the trick, everyone should laugh together. A prank works best when it is silly and safe.
Pray\n\nPray is when you talk to God or a higher power. You can do it with your eyes closed and your hands together. People pray in a quiet place like a church, a temple, or at home. They say thank you, ask for help, or think about others. A child might pray before bed to feel safe and loved.
Prayer\n\nPrayer is talking to God. It can be out loud, quiet in your heart, or sung in a song. People pray to say thank you, to say sorry, or to ask for help. You can pray by yourself or with your family. Many people close their eyes and put their hands together when they pray. Some people kneel down. In some places, people pray many times a day, like in the morning and at night. A child might pray before bed to say goodnight to God.
Pre\n\nPre is a short word we put in front of another word. It means before. When you hear pre in a word, it tells you something happens first. For example, a preview is when you see a little bit of a movie before the whole thing starts. A preschool is a place you go to learn before big school. It is a helper word that changes what other words mean.
Pre Columbian Era\n\nThe Pre Columbian Era is a long time ago, before a man named Columbus came to America. It is the time when only Native people lived on the land. They built homes, grew food, and made beautiful art. They had their own stories and ways of living. You can see things they made in museums today.
Precipitation\n\nPrecipitation is water that falls from the sky. It can be rain, snow, or small balls of ice. Rain is water drops. Snow is soft, white, and cold. Ice balls are hard and can bounce. It falls when clouds get too full of water. You can see it on a rainy day or a snowy day.
Predation\n\nPredation is when one animal catches and eats another animal. The animal that eats is called a predator. It hunts the other animal, which is called prey. A predator can be big like a lion or small like a spider. It uses sharp teeth, claws, or a sticky web to catch food. Some predators hide and wait very still. When prey comes close, it jumps out fast. You might see a cat chase a mouse. That is predation.
Prefer\n\nTo prefer means to like one thing more than another. It is a choice you make in your head. When you have two snacks, you might pick the one you like best. That is what it means to prefer. At the park, you might prefer the swing over the slide. It is a feeling that helps you decide.
Pregnancy\n\nPregnancy is when a baby grows inside a mommy's tummy. It takes about nine months for the baby to get big enough to be born. The mommy's tummy gets round and bigger as the baby grows. A doctor helps check that the baby is healthy. At the end, the baby comes out, and the mommy can hold it in her arms.
Prehistory\n\nPrehistory is the time before people wrote things down. It was a very, very long time ago. People lived in caves or tents made from animal skin. They used simple tools made of stone, wood, and bone to hunt and cut. They made fire to cook food and stay warm. We know about them because scientists find old tools, bones, and drawings in caves.
Prejudice\n\nPrejudice is when you decide you do not like someone before you really know them. It is like putting a label on a person without looking at who they are inside. You might see it when someone is mean to another child because of their skin color or where they come from. It can hurt people’s feelings and make them sad. A good rule is to wait and learn about a person before you make up your mind.
Prepare\n\nPrepare means to get something ready. When you set the table before dinner, you prepare it. You can also prepare for school by packing your bag the night before. It helps things go smoothly and on time.
Prescription\n\nA prescription is a note from a doctor. It tells a sick person what to do to feel better. It often says to get special medicine from a store called a pharmacy. The medicine is very strong, so you can only get it with the note. The note can also say to do special moves to help your body, like stretches. Before, the note was on paper. Now it is often sent on a computer, which is faster and safer.
Present\n\nA present is a gift you give to someone. It is wrapped in pretty paper with a bow on top. You find it at a birthday party or under a Christmas tree. It makes the person who gets it feel happy and loved. You might give a present to your friend or your mom.
Preservation\n\nPreservation means keeping something safe so it stays the same for a long time. It is like putting a toy in a box so it does not break. People use it to keep food fresh, like putting fruit in the fridge. They also use it to protect old buildings and trees. When you put a drawing in a folder, that is preservation too.
President\n\nA president is the leader of a country. He or she works in a big white house or a special building. People choose a president by voting. The president helps make rules to keep people safe. He or she talks to other countries and shakes hands with their leaders. You can see a president on TV giving a speech.
Press\n\nA press is when you push down on something with your hand or finger. It is a quick, firm push. You can press a button to turn on a light or make a toy play music. When you press a stamp onto paper, it leaves a mark. You might press your hands together to clap. A press can also be a big machine that squishes things flat, like a fruit press that makes juice.
Pressure\n\nPressure is how hard something pushes on a spot. It is like when you press your hand on a table. A small push over a big spot feels soft. The same push on a tiny spot feels hard. You can feel it when you poke a balloon with one finger. The air around us also pushes on everything. That is why a balloon stays round. A tool called a barometer tells us how hard the air pushes.
Pretend\n\nPretend is when you use your imagination to make believe something is real. It is like playing a game in your head. You can pretend to be a dog, a superhero, or a mommy. You might use a box as a car or a stick as a magic wand. When you play with friends, you all pretend together and make up stories.
Pretoria\n\nPretoria is a big city in the country of South Africa. It is one of three special cities that help run the country. It sits in a warm valley with hills around it. Many people live there, and they speak different languages. Long ago, a man named the city after his father. Today, people work there making cars, trains, and strong metal things.
Pretty\n\nPretty means something looks very nice to your eyes. It can be a flower with bright colors, a shiny star, or a new dress. You might see pretty things in a garden, in a picture book, or at a party. When you see something pretty, it makes you smile and feel happy. A rainbow after the rain is pretty.
Prey\n\nPrey is an animal that another animal hunts and eats. It is often smaller and faster than the animal that chases it. You can find prey in forests, fields, and even in the water. A rabbit is prey for a fox. A small fish is prey for a big fish. The prey tries to run away or hide so it stays safe.
Price\n\nPrice is how much something costs. It tells you what you must give to get a thing. Long ago, people traded one thing for another, like eggs for wool. Now we mostly use money to pay a price. When you go to a store, the number on a toy is its price. You give that much money and the toy is yours.
Pride\n\nPride is a happy feeling you get when you do something good. It feels warm and big inside your chest. You might feel it when you learn to tie your shoes or draw a nice picture. It can also be a feeling you have for someone you love, like when your friend shares a toy. Pride makes you stand tall and smile.
Priest\n\nA priest is a person who helps people talk to God. He works in a church, a special building with a tall pointy roof. He wears a long robe, sometimes white or black. On Sundays, he stands at the front and tells stories from a big book. He also gives out bread and says prayers. Some priests can have a family, and some cannot. You might see a priest at a wedding or when a baby gets a blessing.
Primary color\n\nA primary color is a color that cannot be made by mixing other colors. It is one of three special colors. You can mix these three colors to make many other colors. When you use light, like on a TV or a tablet, the primary colors are red, green, and blue. When you mix paint or crayons, the primary colors are red, yellow, and blue. You can see primary colors in a rainbow or in a box of paints.
Primary school\n\nA primary school is a place where young children go to learn. It has many rooms with desks, chairs, and a big board. You can find it in almost every town and city. Teachers help children read, write, and do simple math there. A child you know might go to one every morning with a backpack.
Primate\n\nA primate is a kind of animal with fur and hands. It has five fingers on each hand, just like you. Most primates live in forests with lots of trees. They climb and swing from branch to branch. Monkeys and apes are primates. So are lemurs. People are primates too!
Prime\n\nA prime is a number bigger than one. It can only be divided by one and itself. You cannot split it into equal groups without leftovers. For example, the number five is a prime. If you have five blocks, you can only make one long line or five tiny piles of one. The number two is also a prime. It is the smallest prime and the only even one.
Prime Meridian\n\nThe Prime Meridian is an invisible line that goes from the top of the Earth to the bottom. It runs through a special building in London, England. People use it to help find places on a map. It is the starting line for measuring how far east or west a place is. You can stand with one foot on each side of the line when you visit the building.
Prime Number\n\nA prime number is a number that can only be divided by 1 and itself. It is like a special counting number. You cannot break it into smaller equal groups. For example, 5 is a prime number because you can only make one row of 5 or five rows of 1. Another example is 7. But 6 is not a prime number because you can make two rows of 3. Prime numbers are like building blocks for all other numbers.
Princess\n\nA princess is a girl from a royal family. She often wears a long, pretty dress and a shiny crown on her head. You can find her in fairy tales and storybooks, living in a big castle. She is kind and helps people in her land. Sometimes she rides a horse or dances at a ball. Many children dress up as a princess for fun.
Print\n\nPrint is when you put words or pictures onto paper. It can be made by a machine called a printer. You see print in books, on signs, and on the box of your favorite cereal. When you draw a picture and your teacher copies it for the class, that is print too. Print helps people share stories and ideas without talking.
Printing\n\nPrinting is a way to put words and pictures on paper. It uses ink and a big machine called a press. You see printing in books, newspapers, and posters. Long ago, people wrote everything by hand, but now printing makes many copies fast. It helps everyone read the same story or learn the same things.
Printing press\n\nA printing press is a big machine that makes many copies of words and pictures on paper. It has parts that push ink onto the paper, like a stamp. You can find it in a factory where people make books and newspapers. It works fast to print the same page over and over. A book you read at bedtime was made with a printing press.
Printmaking\n\nPrintmaking is a way to make art by pressing a picture onto paper. It starts with a flat piece like wood, metal, or stone. The artist cuts or draws a picture on it. Then they put paint on it and press paper on top. The same picture can be made many times. Each one is called a print. You can see prints in books, on walls, or on T-shirts.
Prism (optics)\n\nA prism is a special piece of clear glass or plastic. It has flat sides and can be shaped like a triangle. When light goes into it, the light bends and comes out as a rainbow stripe. You can see this rainbow on a wall or a piece of paper. Some prisms are used in binoculars to help you see far-away things. A prism can also be inside a camera so the person taking a picture can see what the picture will look like.
Privacy\n\nPrivacy is about keeping some things just for yourself. It means you can choose who knows your secrets, like your birthday wish or a funny story. At home, you might have a special box where you hide your favorite toys. That is your private space. On a computer or tablet, grown-ups help keep your name and picture safe so strangers cannot see them. Privacy is a rule that says people should ask before they look at your stuff or tell your stories to others.
Private\n\nPrivate means something that is just for one person or a few people. It is not for everyone to see or know. Your bedroom is a private place where you keep your toys and sleep. A secret you tell only to your best friend is private. When you close the door to the bathroom, that is private time. Some things are private because they are special or personal.
Prize\n\nA prize is a special thing you get when you win. It can be a toy, a shiny ribbon, or a paper with your name on it. You might get a prize at a party game or at school when you do something good. It feels nice to hold a prize and know you did a great job.
Probability\n\nProbability is a way to talk about how likely something is to happen. It helps us guess if a thing will happen or not. You can use it when you flip a coin. The coin has two sides: one side is called heads, and the other side is called tails. When you flip it, it can land on heads or tails. The chance of heads is the same as the chance of tails. You can also use it with a die. A die is a small cube with dots on each side, from one dot to six dots. When you roll it, it can land on any number. The chance of getting a one is the same as getting a two, or any other number. You can find probability in games you play, like board games with dice or picking a card from a deck.
Problem\n\nA problem is something that is hard or makes you feel stuck. It can be a puzzle you cannot solve, a toy that breaks, or a time when you feel sad or angry. You find problems at home, at school, or when you play with friends. When you have a problem, you can ask a grown-up for help. You can also try to fix it by thinking of a new way. For example, if your block tower falls down, that is a problem. You can build it again with bigger blocks at the bottom.
Process\n\nA process is a set of steps you follow to do something. It is like a recipe for making cookies. First you mix the dough, then you shape it, and then you bake it. Each step happens in order. You can find a process in many places, like when you get ready for school. First you wake up, then you brush your teeth, then you eat breakfast. It helps you finish a job from start to end.
Product\n\nA product is something that people make or grow. It can be a toy, a book, or a snack. You can find it in a store or at a market. People buy it to use or to eat. For example, a box of crayons is a product you can color with.
Professional wrestling\n\nProfessional wrestling is a show where big, strong people pretend to fight. They wear colorful clothes and have fun names. They wrestle inside a ring with ropes all around it. They jump, lift each other, and fall down, but it is all a play to make people cheer. The best wrestlers win shiny belts to show they are the top star. You can watch it on TV or go see it in a big room with lots of seats.
Profit\n\nProfit is the extra money you get when you sell something for more than you paid. It is like a reward for making or selling things. If you buy a toy for five coins and sell it for eight coins, you have three coins of profit. Stores use profit to buy more things to sell. It helps people grow their business and save money.
Program\n\nA program is a set of steps that tells a computer what to do. It is like a recipe for the computer. You can find programs on phones, tablets, and computers. People use programs to play games, draw pictures, or watch videos. For example, a game on a tablet is a program.
Project\n\nA project is a job you plan and do. It has a start and an end. You might make a drawing, build a block tower, or grow a plant. You pick what to do, get your things ready, and then you work on it. When you finish, you can show it to your family. A project can be big or small, and it feels good to see it done.
Promise\n\nA promise is when you say you will do something and you mean it. It is like a strong yes that you keep. When you promise to share a toy, you let your friend play with it. When you promise to be quiet, you do not make loud sounds. A promise helps people trust each other. It feels good when someone keeps a promise to you.
Pronghorn\n\nA pronghorn is an animal that looks like a deer. It has brown fur on top and white fur on its belly. It lives in North America on wide, flat grassy lands. It can run very, very fast—faster than almost any other animal. It eats grass and leaves. Male pronghorns have two short, pointy horns. Female pronghorns usually have no horns. A baby pronghorn can run with its mom when it is just one week old.
Pronoun\n\nA pronoun is a small word that takes the place of a name. It helps us talk without saying the same name over and over. You use it when you say "I," "you," "he," "she," "it," "we," or "they." For example, instead of "Mom said Mom is happy," you say "Mom said she is happy." It can show who something belongs to, like "my toy" or "her book." It can also point back to the person doing the action, like "I did it myself."
Proof\n\nA proof is a way to show that something is true. It is like a strong reason that leaves no doubt. When you say you did not eat the cookie, but there are crumbs on your shirt, that is a proof. In school, a teacher might ask you to show your work on a math problem. That is a proof that your answer is right. A proof can be a picture, a story, or a thing you can see. It helps people trust what you say.
Property\n\nProperty is something that belongs to a person. It can be a thing you can hold, like a toy or a book. It can also be a place, like a house or a flat. When you buy something, it becomes your property. People use the word to talk about land and buildings too. A drawing you make is your property because you made it.
Prophecy\n\nA prophecy is a guess about what will happen later. It is like a story someone tells before it comes true. Long ago, special people called oracles gave prophecies in old lands. Some people think a prophecy comes from God. It can be about a big storm, a new leader, or the end of the world. A prophecy can be wrong, and many guesses do not come true. Sometimes, if you believe a prophecy, you act in a way that makes it happen.
Prose\n\nProse is the way people talk and write every day. It looks like a group of sentences put together in a block on a page. It does not have a beat or a rhyme like a song or a poem. You can find it in story books, letters, and the news. When you tell a friend about your day, you are using prose.
Prosthesis\n\nA prosthesis is a helper part that takes the place of a missing body part. It can be a leg, an arm, a hand, or a foot. Some people need one because they were born without that part or lost it in an accident. It is made of light, strong stuff so it is easy to move. A leg prosthesis helps a person walk and run. An arm prosthesis helps a person grab things. Some are made just for sports, like running or skiing. A special cup holds it onto the body so it stays on tight.
Protect\n\nTo protect means to keep someone or something safe from harm. It is like when you hold an umbrella over a friend so the rain does not get them wet. A big brother might protect his little sister by holding her hand near a busy street. A warm coat protects you from the cold wind. A fence around a yard protects the flowers so no one steps on them. Even a simple hug can protect a sad heart by making it feel loved.
Protein\n\nProtein is a tiny helper inside your body. It is in the food you eat, like meat, eggs, and beans. It helps you grow tall and strong. It also fixes your body when you get a small cut. Your muscles and bones need it every day.
Protest\n\nA protest is when many people come together to show they are unhappy about something. They might stand in a street or a park. They often hold signs with words or pictures. They can shout, sing, or walk in a big group. Sometimes they do it to ask for a change, like being fair to everyone. A protest can be loud, but it is a way for people to say what they feel.
Protest song\n\nA protest song is a song that asks people to make things better. It has words that say something is not fair. People sing it together when they want to change a rule or help others. You might hear it at a big walk where many people hold signs. It can be fast and loud, or slow and soft. A protest song helps people feel strong when they are sad or angry about something.
Protestantism\n\nProtestantism is a way of following Jesus. It started a long time ago when some people wanted to change the big church. They said the Bible should be the most important guide. Today, many people around the world are part of it. They meet in buildings with a cross on top to sing, pray, and learn about God.
Proton\n\nA proton is a tiny piece inside every atom. It lives in the middle part of the atom, called the center. It is so small you cannot see it, even with a big looking glass. A proton has a happy little push that pulls other tiny pieces close. In water, the smallest atom has just one proton. All the things around you are made of atoms, and every atom has protons inside.
Proud\n\nProud is a happy feeling you get when you do something good. It feels warm and big inside your chest. You might feel it when you learn to tie your shoes all by yourself. You can also feel it when someone you love does something great, like your big sister winning a race. It makes you want to smile and stand up tall.
Provence\n\nProvence is a big, sunny place in the south of France. It has blue sea on one side and tall hills on the other. You can find fields full of purple flowers called lavender there. The air smells sweet and warm. People go to Provence to see old stone houses and eat yummy food. It is a happy place with lots of color and light.
Proverb\n\nA proverb is a short, wise saying. It tells us something true about life. You can hear it when grown-ups talk or in stories. It is like a little rule that helps people be kind or work hard. One you might know is "Look before you leap." That means think before you do something.
Psychiatric hospital\n\nA psychiatric hospital is a place where people go when their feelings or thoughts make them very sick. It has rooms for sleeping, eating, and talking with doctors. The doctors there help people feel better and stay safe. Long ago, these places were like jails, but now they are more like a quiet home with gardens. Some people stay for a short time, and some stay longer. Today, many people get help in small clinics or at home instead.
Psychology\n\nPsychology is the study of how people think and feel. It looks at why we do the things we do. A person who studies this is called a psychologist. They watch people and ask them questions to learn about their minds. They also help people who feel sad or scared. You can see psychology when a teacher helps a child calm down or when a friend shares a toy.
Pterosaur\n\nA pterosaur is a flying animal that lived a long, long time ago. It had wings made of skin, not feathers like a bird. Its wings were big and stretched from its body to a very long finger. Many of them ate fish from the water. Some were small, but a few were as big as a small plane. They lived when dinosaurs walked on land, but they are not dinosaurs. You can see their bones in some big museums.
Pub\n\nA pub is a place where grown-ups go to sit, talk, and have a drink. It is like a cozy room with tables and chairs. You can find it on a street in a town or city. People meet friends there after work. Sometimes it has a sign with a funny picture outside. You might see one when you walk with your family.
Puberty\n\nPuberty is the time when a child's body grows into an adult body. It happens to boys and girls, but in different ways. For girls, it often starts around age 10 and ends around 15. For boys, it often starts around age 12 and ends around 16. During this time, the body changes. Hair grows in new places. Girls grow breasts and start having a monthly bleed. Boys get deeper voices and bigger muscles. Both boys and girls may feel new feelings and think about new things. After puberty, a person can make a baby.
Public\n\nPublic means a group of people. It is not just one person, but many people together. You can find a public at a park, a school, or a library. A public shares something, like a problem or a fun idea. For example, all the kids in your class are a public when they listen to a story.
Public health\n\nPublic health is about keeping people healthy and stopping sickness from spreading. It looks at big groups of people, not just one person. You find it in towns and cities where people work to make sure the water is clean and the air is safe. It helps by teaching people to wash hands, giving shots to stop sickness, and making rules to keep food clean. For example, when you wash your hands before eating, you are doing something that public health teaches.
Public transport\n\nPublic transport is a way to travel without your own car. It is a big vehicle that many people ride together. You can find it in towns and cities, like a bus on the road or a train on tracks. It takes you to places near your house or far away. A bus is one kind you might see every day.
Publishing\n\nPublishing is making stories and pictures so many people can see them. It turns words into books, magazines, and things you can read on a screen. A person who writes the story is called an author. The publisher prints the pages and puts them together. You can find published books at a library, a store, or on a tablet. When you read a bedtime story, someone published that book just for you.
Puddle\n\nA puddle is a small pool of water on the ground. It forms after rain falls and the water cannot soak into the dirt. You can find it on a sidewalk, a road, or in a grassy spot. It is fun to jump in and make a splash. When the sun comes out, it slowly dries up and goes away.
Puerto Rico\n\nPuerto Rico is a big island in the warm blue sea. It belongs to the United States, but it is not a state. It has green hills, sandy beaches, and a busy city called San Juan. People there speak Spanish and English. They use dollars to buy things, just like in the United States. Many people visit Puerto Rico to swim, play on the beach, and see old forts.
Puff\n\nA puff is a short, soft blow of air. It can come from your mouth when you blow out a candle. You can also feel a puff of wind on your face outside. Some things, like a dandelion, fly away when you give them a puff. It is quick and light, not strong like a big wind.
Pufferfish\n\nA pufferfish is a fish that can blow up like a ball. It has a round body and four big teeth that look like a beak. It lives in warm ocean water, near rocks and coral. When it feels scared, it drinks a lot of water fast and gets big and round. This helps it stay safe from bigger fish. Some pufferfish have tiny spikes on their skin. It eats small hard-shelled animals like crabs and clams. Its body has a strong poison, so people should never touch or eat it unless a special cook makes it safe. You might see one in a big fish tank at an aquarium.
Pull\n\nA pull is when you grab something and move it closer to you. It is the opposite of a push, where you move something away. You can pull a door to open it, or pull a wagon behind you. When you pull a rope, you use your arms and hands. A dog might pull on its leash when it wants to run. Pulling helps you move things that are too heavy to lift.
Pulley\n\nA pulley is a simple tool that helps lift heavy things. It has a wheel with a rope or chain around it. You can find it on a flagpole, a crane, or a window blind. When you pull down on the rope, the heavy thing goes up. It makes lifting feel easier. A builder uses it to move big blocks.
Pulse\n\nA pulse is a little thump you can feel in your body. It happens when your heart pushes blood through tiny tubes under your skin. You can feel it on your wrist or on the side of your neck. It beats faster when you run and slower when you rest. A doctor listens to it to check if you are healthy.
Puma\n\nA puma is a big wild cat. It has tan fur, a long tail, and strong legs. It lives in mountains and forests in the west of North America and in South America. It hunts at night and eats meat like deer and rabbits. It cannot roar, but it can purr and hiss. A baby puma is called a cub or kitten.
Pump\n\nA pump is a tool that moves water or air from one place to another. It has a tube and a handle or a motor. You can find a pump on a bike to fill the tires with air. It is also used in a fish tank to keep the water clean. When you push or turn the pump, it pushes the water or air out.
Pumpkin\n\nA pumpkin is a big, round fruit that grows on a vine. It is usually orange, but it can be purple, red, blue, or white. It has a thick skin, a soft inside, and many seeds. You can find it in a garden or at a farm. People cook it to make pie or soup. They also cut a face into it to make a glowing light for Halloween. The seeds can be cleaned, cooked, and eaten as a snack.
Punch\n\nA punch is a hit with a closed hand. It happens when someone makes a fist and pushes it forward fast. You might see a punch in a cartoon when a hero fights a bad guy. It can hurt, so it is not nice to do to friends. People learn to punch in a safe place called a gym, with big soft gloves on their hands.
Pune\n\nPune is a big city in India. It has many schools and places to learn, so people call it a city of learning. Two rivers flow through it, and it has old buildings and museums to visit. Many people live there, and they celebrate a big happy festival with music and food. You can see buses, cars, and lots of people on the streets.
Punjabi language\n\nPunjabi language is a way people talk. It comes from a place called Punjab, which is in two big countries, India and Pakistan. Many people speak it at home with their family. It has its own special letters to write with, called Gurmukhi in India and Shahmukhi in Pakistan. You can hear it in songs, stories, and when people pray at a Sikh temple.
Punk rock\n\nPunk rock is a kind of loud, fast music. It uses guitars, drums, and singing. The singing can sound angry or shouty. People who play it often wear bright hair colors and clothes that look different. They want to say that rules can be wrong and that people should think for themselves. You might hear it at a show or on the radio.
Pupa\n\nA pupa is a little home where some bugs change into grown-ups. It is a hard shell that keeps the bug safe inside. You can find it hanging from a leaf or a branch. Inside, a caterpillar slowly turns into a butterfly or a moth. A butterfly pupa is called a chrysalis. A moth pupa is called a cocoon. When the change is done, a pretty butterfly or moth comes out.
Puppet\n\nA puppet is a toy that looks like a person or an animal. It can be made of cloth, wood, or paper. A person hides behind it or puts a hand inside to make it move. The person talks in a funny voice so it seems like the puppet is talking. You can see puppets in shows on a stage or on TV. Some puppets have strings that make them dance. Others fit on your hand like a glove. A simple one you can make at home is a sock puppet. You put your hand in an old sock and draw a face on it.
Puppy\n\nA puppy is a baby dog. It is very small and has soft, fluffy fur. You can find a puppy in a home with a family or at a farm. It likes to play, run, and chew on toys. A puppy drinks milk from its mom and sleeps a lot. When it grows up, it becomes a big dog.
Pure\n\nPure means something is very clean and has nothing else mixed in. It looks clear, like water from a new bottle. You can find pure things in nature, like fresh snow before anyone walks on it. People use the word to talk about water, air, or even a color that is not mixed with other colors. A good example is a glass of water that has no dirt or juice in it—just water.
Purple\n\nPurple is a color you can see. It is made when you mix blue and red together. You can find it in a bunch of grapes, a pretty flower, or a soft blanket. A long, long time ago, people made purple from tiny sea animals. It was a special color for kings and queens. Today, you can color with a purple crayon or wear a purple shirt.
Purr\n\nA purr is a soft, rumbling sound that a cat makes. It sounds like a tiny motor running inside the cat. You hear it when the cat is happy and cozy, like when it sits on a lap. A cat may also purr when it feels safe and sleepy. It is a quiet, warm sound that makes people smile.
Purse\n\nA purse is a small bag. It has a handle or a strap. People carry it in their hand or on their shoulder. It holds things like money, keys, and a phone. You might see a purse at a store or with a grown-up.
Push\n\nA push is when you use your hands to move something away from you. It is a strong move that makes a thing go forward. You can push a toy car on the floor, or push a door to open it. When you push a swing, it goes up and away. Sometimes you push a friend on a bike to help them start. A push is the opposite of a pull, which brings things closer.
Put\n\nPut means to place something down. You can put a toy on the floor or put a book on a shelf. When you put your shoes on, you slide your feet into them. It is a simple action you do many times every day.
Puzzle\n\nA puzzle is a fun game that makes you think. It has pieces or parts that you must put together or figure out. You can find puzzles in books, on paper, or on a computer. When you play with a puzzle, you look at colors, shapes, or letters to solve it. A jigsaw puzzle is one kind where you fit flat pieces to make a picture. Puzzles help your brain grow strong.
Pyjama\n\nA pyjama is a soft set of clothes you wear to bed. It has a top and pants that feel cozy on your skin. You can find it in your drawer or closet at home. People put it on at night to sleep comfortably. It often has fun prints like stars, animals, or stripes.
Pyramid\n\nA pyramid is a big stone shape with a flat bottom and four sides that meet at a point on top. It looks like a triangle from the side. You can find pyramids in Egypt, where they were built long ago for kings and queens. People used them as special houses for the dead, with rooms and treasures inside. The biggest one is the Great Pyramid, and it is still standing today.
Pyrenees\n\nThe Pyrenees are big, tall mountains. They sit between two countries called France and Spain. They stretch a long way from one big sea to another big sea. In winter, the tops are white with snow. In summer, people walk up the green slopes. Some people ski down the snowy parts when it is cold.
Qatar\n\nQatar is a small country far away. It is on a piece of land that sticks out into warm blue water. Most of it is dry and sandy. People find a lot of oil and gas under the ground there. Many big buildings and tall towers stand in its main city. A big soccer game with teams from all over the world was played there.
Qin Shi Huang\n\nQin Shi Huang was a king a long, long time ago. He was the first person to bring all of China together under one rule. He had a big clay army made to guard him after he died. People can see parts of that army in a museum today.
Quadrilateral\n\nA quadrilateral is a flat shape with four straight sides. It has four corners where the sides meet. You can find it in many places, like a picture frame, a window, or a book cover. Some quadrilaterals have sides that are the same length, like a square. Others have two long sides and two short sides, like a door. When you draw a shape with four sides, you make a quadrilateral.
Quake\n\nA quake is when the ground shakes very hard. It can make buildings wiggle and things fall off shelves. It happens deep under the ground when big rocks move. Sometimes it feels like a big truck driving by, but it is the earth moving. After a quake, there can be small shakes called aftershocks.
Quantum\n\nQuantum is a tiny, tiny piece of something. It is so small you cannot see it with your eyes. Scientists study it to learn how the smallest things in the world work. It is like the smallest block that makes up light or energy. You can think of it as a very small dot that helps things like computers and lights do their job.
Quantum Mechanics\n\nQuantum mechanics is a set of rules about very tiny things. It tells us how tiny bits like atoms and light move and act. These rules are not like the rules for big things we can see. For example, a tiny bit can be in two places at the same time. Scientists use these rules to make computers and phones work.
Quarry\n\nA quarry is a big hole in the ground where people dig out rocks. It is like a giant sandbox, but with hard stone. Workers use big machines to cut the rock into blocks. These blocks are used to build houses, walls, and roads. Sometimes, when the digging is done, the hole fills with rain and becomes a small lake.
Quarter\n\nA quarter is a coin that is worth 25 cents. It is round and flat, and it has a shiny silver color. You can find it in a piggy bank or in your pocket. People use it to buy small things like a gumball or a sticker. It is bigger than a dime but smaller than a half-dollar.
Quartz\n\nQuartz is a hard, shiny rock found in the ground. It can be clear like glass or have colors like purple, pink, or smoky gray. You can find it in sand at the beach or in big rocks on a mountain. People use it to make pretty jewelry like necklaces and rings. Some clocks have a tiny piece of quartz inside to help them keep time.
Quebec\n\nQuebec is a big piece of land in Canada. It is in the east part of the country. Most people there speak French, not English. It has many trees, rivers, and lakes. The biggest city is Montreal, and the capital is Quebec City. In winter, it gets very cold and snowy. Many people visit to see old stone buildings and eat a sweet treat called maple taffy.
Queen\n\nA queen is a woman who is the leader of a country. She wears a shiny crown on her head and lives in a big house called a castle. People see her in parades or on special days. She helps make rules and takes care of her people. In stories, a queen might sit on a throne and wave to a crowd.
Quest\n\nA quest is a long, hard trip to find something or do something important. It is like a big adventure with a goal at the end. In stories, a brave person goes on a quest to find a hidden treasure or save a friend. Along the way, they may meet new people and solve puzzles. You can have a small quest too, like looking for a lost toy in your house.
Question\n\nA question is when you ask something because you want to know more. It often starts with words like who, what, where, when, why, or how. You use it when you are curious or do not understand. For example, you might ask, "What is for lunch?" or "Where is my toy?" When you ask a question, someone can give you an answer. It helps you learn new things every day.
Queue\n\nA queue is a line of people or things waiting for their turn. It looks like a row where the first one to join is the first one to go. You can see it at a store when people wait to pay, or at a bus stop when people wait to get on. People stand in it to be fair, so everyone gets a turn. It is like when you and your friends line up to go outside for playtime.
Quick\n\nQuick means something happens very fast. It is like when you run to catch a ball before it hits the ground. You can be quick with your hands, your feet, or your thinking. A quick snack is one you eat in a short time. A quick look is when you see something for just a moment. Being quick helps when you are in a race or when you need to answer a question right away.
Quickly\n\nQuickly means doing something very fast. When you run quickly, your legs move fast. If you eat quickly, you finish your food in a short time. You might see a squirrel move quickly up a tree. It is the opposite of slowly.
Quiet\n\nQuiet means no loud sounds. It is when a room is still and you can hear tiny things, like a clock tick or a soft breath. You find quiet in a library, at bedtime, or early in the morning. People like quiet when they read, sleep, or think. A whisper is a quiet way to talk.
Quietly\n\nQuietly means doing something with very little sound. When you walk quietly, your feet do not make a loud noise. You can talk quietly by using a soft, low voice. It is a good way to act when a baby is sleeping or in a library. You might hear the word when a grown-up says, "Please play quietly."
Quinoa\n\nQuinoa is a tiny seed that people cook and eat like rice. It looks like small round beads and can be white, red, or black. You find it in a store in a bag or a box. People boil it in water until it gets soft and fluffy. It tastes a little nutty and fills your tummy. You can eat it with veggies or beans for lunch or dinner.
Quite\n\nQuite means very much or a lot. When you are quite happy, you have a big smile on your face. If a room is quite dark, you cannot see well. It can also mean almost, like when you are quite done with your snack. You might say, "I am quite tired" after a long day of play.
Quiz\n\nA quiz is a fun game where you answer questions. It can be played alone or with a team. A teacher or a game leader asks the questions, and you try to give the right answer. You get points for each right answer. The person or team with the most points wins. You might see a quiz at school or on TV.
Quote\n\nA quote is a group of words someone said or wrote. It is like a little box that holds their words so other people can read or hear them. You can find quotes in books, on signs, or when grown-ups talk. People use quotes to share a smart or funny idea. For example, your teacher might put a quote on the wall that says, "Be kind to everyone."
Qur'an\n\nThe Qur'an is a very special book for people called Muslims. It is their most important holy book. They believe it has words from God, given to a man named Muhammad long ago. It is written in the Arabic language. Muslims read it to learn how to be good and kind. They keep it in a clean, safe place and treat it with great care.
Quran\n\nThe Quran is a special book for people who follow Islam. It has many pages with words that teach about God. People read it in a place called a mosque or at home. They treat it with care and keep it on a high shelf. Many children learn to say parts of it out loud.
Ra\n\nRa is a god from long-ago Egypt. He is the god of the sun. People in Egypt thought he made the sun come up each morning. He looks like a man with the head of a bird called a falcon. On his head he wears a round sun. Every day he rides a boat across the sky. At night he goes under the world and comes back the next morning. He was the most important god to the people of Egypt.
Rabbi\n\nA rabbi is a teacher in the Jewish religion. He or she knows a lot about the holy book called the Torah. You can find a rabbi in a synagogue, which is a Jewish place of prayer. A rabbi teaches people about God and how to be kind. He or she also helps at weddings and baby namings. Sometimes a rabbi checks food to make sure it is okay to eat. Three rabbis can work together to solve problems between people.
Rabbit\n\nA rabbit is a small, furry animal with long ears. It has soft fur, a short fluffy tail, and strong back legs for hopping. You can find it in fields, woods, or sometimes in a hutch at home as a pet. It eats grass, hay, and crunchy vegetables like carrots. A rabbit digs a hole called a burrow to live in with its family. It has big eyes on the sides of its head to watch for danger. When it is scared, it runs fast and hides in its burrow. A baby rabbit is called a kit.
Rabies\n\nRabies is a very bad sickness that animals can give to people. It is caused by a tiny germ that gets into the body through a bite or a scratch. The germ travels to the brain and makes it swell. A person with rabies may feel scared of water and cannot drink. Dogs, bats, and other wild animals can carry it. If a person is bitten, a doctor can give a special shot to stop the sickness, but it must be done fast. Once a person feels sick, there is no fix. That is why we give pets a shot to keep them safe.
Rabindranath Tagore\n\nRabindranath Tagore was a man from India who wrote poems and songs. He had a long white beard and kind eyes. He lived a long time ago, but people still read his words today. He wrote a song that became the special song for his whole country. He also drew pictures and started a school where children could learn outside under the trees.
Raccoon\n\nA raccoon is a small wild animal with a bushy tail. It has gray fur, a pointy nose, and a black mask around its eyes. It lives in woods, but sometimes it comes into towns to look for food. It uses its front paws like little hands to pick up things and wash them in water. At night, it climbs trees and looks for berries, nuts, or food people throw away. You might see one near a park or a trash can after dark.
Race\n\nA race is when people or animals try to go fast to see who is first. It can be running with your legs, riding a bike, or swimming in water. You might see a race at school on sports day or on TV with fast cars. The person who gets to the end first wins a prize or a ribbon. It is fun to cheer for someone in a race.
