Racism\n\nRacism is when people are mean to others because of their skin color or where they come from. It can be saying unkind words or not letting someone play. It hurts people's feelings and is not fair. Everyone should be kind and treat others the way they want to be treated.
Racket\n\nA racket is a tool you hold in your hand. It has a long handle and a round or oval head with strings pulled tight across it. You see it in games like tennis or badminton. People use it to hit a ball or a small flying toy back and forth. If you watch a tennis game on TV, you will see players swing a racket.
Radar\n\nA radar is a machine that finds things far away. It sends out tiny waves we cannot see or hear. When the waves hit something like a plane or a ship, they bounce back to the machine. It then shows where that thing is and how far away it sits. People use it to watch the sky for planes and to see rain coming. Some police officers use a small one to check how fast cars go on the road.
Radiation\n\nRadiation is energy that moves through the air or space. It is like tiny waves or bits that you cannot see. Some kinds come from the sun and give us light and warmth. Other kinds can be harmful if there is too much, like the rays that cause a sunburn. Doctors use a safe kind to take pictures of the inside of your body, called an X-ray.
Radio\n\nA radio is a box that catches invisible waves from the air. It has a button or a dial to turn it on and off. You can find a radio in a car, at home, or in a kitchen. It plays music, tells the news, and people talk on it. When you hear a song in the car, that is the radio working.
Radio broadcasting\n\nRadio broadcasting is a way to send sounds through the air. It uses invisible waves that travel far from a tall tower. You need a radio box at home or in a car to catch the waves and turn them back into sounds. People use it to listen to music, stories, and news. A radio can play songs even when you are far away from the singers. Many families turn on the radio in the morning to hear the weather.
Radio wave\n\nA radio wave is a kind of energy that moves through the air. It is like a tiny, invisible wave, similar to waves in the ocean, but you cannot see it. It can travel very far and go through walls. People use it to send sounds and pictures. For example, when you listen to music in the car, the radio catches these waves and turns them into songs. Your phone also uses it to talk to someone far away.
Radioactive\n\nRadioactive means something gives off tiny bits of energy that you cannot see. It is like a hidden light that can go through things. Some rocks deep in the ground are radioactive. It can be used in hospitals to take pictures of the inside of your body. Too much of it can hurt you, so people stay far away from it.
Radish\n\nA radish is a small, round vegetable that grows under the ground. It has a red or white skin and a white inside. You can find it in a garden or at a food store. People eat it raw in salads because it is crunchy. It has a sharp, hot taste that can make your tongue feel funny. Some radishes are big, and some are tiny. You can also cut it into thin slices and put it on a sandwich.
Raft\n\nA raft is a flat thing that floats on water. It is made of wood, plastic, or air-filled tubes tied together. You can find it on a lake, a river, or a pool. People sit or stand on it and use a long stick to push it along. Sometimes a raft is used for fun, like a big floaty toy. You might see one at a water park or in a story about a river.
Rage\n\nRage is a very big, hot feeling of anger. It can make your face turn red and your hands shake. When someone feels rage, they might want to yell or stomp their feet. It is like a storm inside the body. After the storm passes, the person often feels tired. It is okay to feel rage, but it is important not to hurt anyone. Taking deep breaths can help the feeling go away.
Rail\n\nA rail is a long, hard bar made of metal. It looks like a straight line on the ground. You find it on train tracks, where two rails run side by side. Trains roll on top of it to move people and things from one place to another. If you have ever seen a train go by, you have seen a rail.
Rail transport\n\nRail transport is a way to move people and things on a track. It uses long cars called trains that roll on two metal lines. You can see it at a train station in a city or town. It carries many people to work and school, and it also carries big heavy boxes of food and toys. A train can go very fast and does not get stuck in car traffic. Some trains run on electricity and some run on a special fuel. A child might see a train when a crossing gate goes down and the train zooms by with a loud horn.
Railway track\n\nA railway track is a long path made of two shiny steel bars. It lies flat on the ground and goes very far. You can see it outside when a train goes by. The bars sit on big pieces of wood or stone that keep them in place. Trains roll on it to carry people and heavy things from one town to another. Sometimes one track is for trains going one way, and another track is for trains going the other way.
Rain\n\nRain is water that falls from clouds in the sky. It comes down as tiny drops. You see it when the sky gets dark and gray. It makes the ground wet and helps plants grow. After it stops, you might see a rainbow in the sky.
Rainbow\n\nA rainbow is a big, colorful curve of light in the sky. It has seven colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet. Red is on the outside, and violet is on the inside. You can see it when the sun shines through rain. It always appears on the side of the sky opposite the sun. Sometimes you can see a second, dimmer rainbow above the first one. Rainbows can also show up near waterfalls or when you spray water on a sunny day. It is really a full circle, but from the ground, we only see the top part.
Raincoat\n\nA raincoat is a special coat that keeps you dry when it rains. It is made from smooth, shiny stuff that water cannot go through. You wear it over your other clothes when you go outside on a wet day. It often has a hood to cover your head and keep your hair dry. Some raincoats are yellow, but they can be any color. You might see one hanging by the door at home or at school.
Rainforest\n\nA rainforest is a thick, wet forest. It has many tall trees that grow close together. Rain falls there almost every day, so the ground stays muddy and damp. Many animals live in a rainforest, like colorful birds, monkeys, and big bugs. It is very warm and green all year long. You can find rainforests in faraway places near the big, warm middle of the world.
Rainy\n\nRainy means a day when water falls from the sky. It looks like tiny drops that make everything wet. You see rainy days when clouds turn dark and gray. On a rainy day, people use umbrellas and wear boots to stay dry. Rainy weather helps flowers and trees grow big and strong.
Raise\n\nRaise means to lift something up. You can raise your hand in class when you want to speak. You can raise a flag up a pole. When you raise a cup, you move it higher. It is the opposite of lower.
Rajasthan\n\nRajasthan is a big piece of land in India. It is the biggest state in the country. Much of it is covered by a sandy desert called the Thar Desert. The main city is Jaipur, which is also called the Pink City. Many different groups of people live there. They have bright clothes, fun dances, and old stories. Long ago, many small kings ruled different parts of this land.
Rake\n\nA rake is a tool for the garden. It has a long stick and a row of teeth at the end. You hold the stick and pull the teeth over the ground. It picks up leaves, grass, and little sticks. People use it in the fall when leaves drop from trees. It also helps make the dirt soft for new plants.
Rama\n\nRama is a hero from very old stories in India. He is a kind prince with a bow and arrow. Many people in India and nearby places tell stories about him. In the stories, he goes on a long walk in the woods with his wife Sita and his brother. A bad king with ten heads takes Sita away. Rama and his brother look for her with help from a monkey friend. They fight the bad king and bring Sita back home. People love Rama because he is brave and good. They build big, pretty houses called temples to remember him.
Ramayana\n\nThe Ramayana is a very old story from India. It tells about a prince named Rama and his wife Sita. A bad king takes Sita away, and Rama goes to save her with help from animal friends. People still tell this story today with plays and shows.
Ramesses Ii\n\nRamesses II was a king of Egypt a long, long time ago. He lived in a big stone house called a palace. He had a tall hat and a stick that showed he was the boss. People made big stone pictures of him that you can still see today. He was a very strong king who helped his land grow big.
Ranch\n\nA ranch is a big piece of land with lots of open space. It has fields, barns, and fences. People live and work on a ranch. They take care of animals like cows, horses, and sheep. The animals eat grass and walk around. You might see a ranch when you drive in the country. Cowboys and cowgirls ride horses to help move the animals.
Range\n\nA range is a big open space where animals can walk and eat grass. It has lots of land with no fences. You can find it in places with hills and wide fields. Cows and sheep live on a range and eat the plants that grow there. Some people ride horses on a range to watch the animals.
Rank\n\nA rank is a place in a line from best to last. It tells you who is first, second, third, and so on. In a race, the fastest runner gets the top rank. In school, your teacher may put names in rank order for a game. It helps people see how things compare.
Rapeseed\n\nRapeseed is a plant with bright yellow flowers. It grows in big fields where it looks like a yellow blanket. People pick its seeds to make oil for cooking. The oil is also used in some foods like salad dressing. You might see it growing on a farm when you ride in a car.
Rapid transit\n\nRapid transit is a kind of train that moves many people fast inside a city. It has long cars with many doors and seats. It runs on its own track, often in tunnels under the ground or on bridges above the street. People use it to go to work, school, or the store without a car. It stops at stations where people get on and off. Some cities call it a metro, subway, or the tube.
Rapids\n\nRapids are parts of a river where the water moves very fast. It looks like white, bubbly water splashing over rocks. You find it in rivers near hills or mountains. The water rushes and makes a loud, happy sound. Some people ride in a small boat over it for fun. That sport is called rafting.
Rapping\n\nRapping is a way of talking with a beat. It sounds like fast talking that goes up and down with the music. You can hear it in songs on the radio or on a phone. A person who does it is called a rapper. They use their voice to tell a story or make rhymes. Sometimes a rapper talks about their day or things they see. Many kids like to move their head and dance when they hear it.
Raspberry\n\nA raspberry is a small, soft fruit that grows on a bush. It looks like a tiny red cap made of many little round bumps. You can find it in gardens, at farms, or in the store. People eat it fresh, put it on top of cereal, or use it to make sweet jam. It tastes a little sour and a little sweet. When you pick it, the inside is hollow like a tiny cup.
Rat\n\nA rat is a small animal with a long tail. It has four legs, two small ears, and a pointy nose. It can be brown, black, or white. Rats live in many places, like cities, fields, and sewers. They eat many kinds of food, like seeds, fruit, and leftovers from people. Some people keep rats as pets. A pet rat is soft and can learn to do tricks. It likes to play with toys and can be very friendly.
Rate\n\nA rate is how fast something happens. It tells you how many times a thing takes place in a certain amount of time. For example, your heart beats at a rate of many times each minute. When you run, your breathing rate goes up. A clock ticks at a steady rate. You can also have a rate for how fast a car goes, like miles per hour.
Ratio\n\nA ratio is a way to compare two amounts. It tells you how much of one thing there is compared to another thing. You can find it when you mix things, like two cups of water for every one cup of rice. It helps people follow recipes or share things fairly. For example, if you have three apples and two oranges, the ratio of apples to oranges is three to two.
Rattle\n\nA rattle is a toy that makes a fun sound when you shake it. It is small and light so a baby can hold it in one hand. You can find it in a baby's room or in a toy box. When you move it back and forth, little bits inside hit the sides and make a clicky noise. It often looks like a ball on a stick, and some have bright colors or a smiling face. A baby smiles and laughs when someone shakes a rattle nearby.
Rattlesnake\n\nA rattlesnake is a kind of snake with a special tail that makes a loud buzzing sound. It has a long body with no legs, and it slides on the ground. It lives in dry, hot places like deserts and rocky hills. The tail has hard parts at the end that shake fast to make a rattle noise. This noise tells big animals to stay away. It eats small animals like mice and birds. A rattlesnake can bite, and its bite can hurt a lot, so people should never touch one.
Raven\n\nA raven is a big black bird. It looks like a crow, but it is bigger. Its feathers are all black and shiny. You can see it in many places, like woods, mountains, or even cities. It makes a loud, deep sound. Some people think it is very smart. It can learn tricks and even copy sounds. In a famous story, a raven visits a sad man and says one word over and over.
Raw\n\nRaw means something is not cooked. It is food the way it comes from the ground or from an animal. You can eat some things raw, like a crunchy carrot or a sweet apple. But some foods, like chicken or eggs, must be cooked first so they are safe to eat. When you bite a raw carrot, it is hard and makes a loud sound.
Ray\n\nA ray is a flat fish that lives in the ocean. It has a wide body and a long, thin tail. It swims by moving its big side fins up and down, like a bird flying in water. You can find it on the sandy bottom of the sea. Some rays have a sharp sting on their tail to stay safe.
Reach\n\nReach is when you stretch your arm or hand to try to touch or grab something. It means moving your body a little to get closer to a thing. You reach for a toy on a high shelf. You reach for a cookie in a jar. You reach for a friend's hand to hold it. When you reach, your arm gets long and your fingers open wide. It feels like a little stretch in your side. You can reach up, reach down, or reach across. Every day you reach for many things without even thinking.
Reaction\n\nA reaction is something that happens because of something else. It is like when you push a ball and it rolls away. Your body can have a reaction too, like when you touch something hot and pull your hand back fast. In a kitchen, mixing baking soda and vinegar makes a bubbly reaction. It is a change you can see or feel.
Read\n\nTo read is to look at words and understand what they say. It is something you learn in school with your teacher. When you read, your eyes move across the page and your brain turns the letters into a story or a message. You can read a book, a sign, or a card from a friend. Reading helps you learn new things and go on adventures without leaving your chair.
Reader\n\nA reader is a person who looks at words in a book or on a page. It uses its eyes to follow the letters and its brain to understand the story. You can find a reader at home, in school, or at the library. It reads to learn new things or to have fun with a tale. When you sit with a picture book and turn the pages, you are a reader too.
Reading\n\nReading is looking at words and knowing what they say. It is a way to learn from books, signs, and papers. You can read a story about a talking bear or a note from your mom. Long ago, many people could not read, but now kids learn it in school. When you read, you can visit new places in your mind without leaving your room.
Ready\n\nReady means you are all set to do something. It is a feeling when your shoes are on and you can go out the door. When you are ready, you do not need to wait for anything else. You can be ready for school, ready for a snack, or ready for a story. It feels good to be ready because you can start right away.
Real\n\nReal means something that is true and not made up. It is the opposite of pretend or fake. A real dog barks and wags its tail, but a toy dog does not. You can touch a real flower and smell it. When you see a real rainbow in the sky, it has bright colors after rain. Real things are all around you every day.
Real Number\n\nA real number is any number you can find on a number line. It can be a counting number like 1, 2, or 3. It can also be a number with a dot, like 2.5 or 3.14. You see it when you count toys, measure how tall you are, or look at a clock. It helps us know how many, how much, or how long something is.
Realism\n\nRealism is a way of making art or telling stories. It tries to show things just as they are in real life. When you draw a picture of your house and you draw every window and door the way it really looks, that is realism. It does not add magic or make-believe parts. Some painters use realism to show people working or sitting at a table. Some writers use realism to tell stories about everyday life. They want you to feel like the story could really happen. Realism helps us see the world clearly, without pretending it is different.
Reality\n\nReality is everything that is real. It is the world around you that you can see, hear, and touch. Your bed, your toys, and your family are all part of reality. It is not a dream or a made-up story. When you wake up in the morning, you are back in reality. Some things you cannot touch, like love or a happy feeling, are still real because they happen inside you. On TV, some shows show real people doing real things, and people call that reality TV.
Reality television\n\nReality television is a kind of TV show with real people, not actors. It shows them doing funny things, playing games, or living together. You can watch it at home on a TV. One show is called Big Brother, where people stay in a house and cameras watch them all day. Sometimes the show is not fully real because people are told what to do.
Really\n\nReally is a word we use when we want to say something is true. It can mean "for sure" or "no kidding." When you say "I really like ice cream," it means you like it a lot. You hear it when someone is surprised, like "Really?" It helps show strong feelings about what you say.
Rear\n\nA rear is the back part of something. It is the side you do not see when you look at the front. You can find a rear on a car, a house, or a toy. When you walk behind a person, you are at their rear. A rear door is the door at the back of a building.
Reason\n\nReason is a way of thinking with your head. It means you look at facts and use them to decide what is true. When you use reason, you do not just feel something in your heart. You stop and think about what makes sense. For example, if you see dark clouds, you can use reason to know it might rain. You can also use reason to pick the best toy by thinking about which one you like more and why.
Rebel\n\nA rebel is a person who says no to rules. He does not follow what others tell him to do. Sometimes a rebel fights against a leader or a group. He may want to change things he thinks are wrong. In stories, a rebel can be a hero who helps people. But in real life, a rebel can get in trouble for not listening.
Recipe\n\nA recipe is a set of steps that tells you how to make food. It lists the things you need, like flour, eggs, and sugar. You can find a recipe in a book, on a box, or on a screen. Mom or Dad reads it to know what to mix and how long to cook. When you follow a recipe, you can make yummy things like cookies or a cake.
Record\n\nA record is a big, flat, black circle that plays music. It has tiny lines that go around and around, like a spiral. You put it on a special machine called a record player. The machine has a little arm with a needle that sits on the record. When the record spins, the needle feels the tiny lines and makes the music come out. You can see a record in some homes or at a store that sells old music.
Recorder\n\nA recorder is a long, thin tube that makes music when you blow into it. It has holes along the top that you cover with your fingers to change the sound. You hold it in front of you and blow gently into the bigger end. Many children learn to play it at school because it is light and easy to hold. It can make high, happy notes that sound a little like a bird singing. Some recorders are made of wood, and some are made of bright plastic. You can play it alone or with friends in a group.
Recreation\n\nRecreation is fun time that makes your body and mind feel happy and fresh. It can be many different things, like playing a game, reading a book, or listening to music. You can do it at home, in a park, or at the beach. Some people like to draw, some like to run, and some like to watch a movie. It helps you rest after work or school. When you play with your friends, that is recreation too.
Rectangle\n\nA rectangle is a flat shape with four sides. It has four corners that look like the corner of a book. Two sides are long, and two sides are short. You can find it in many places, like a door, a window, or a piece of paper. People use it to make tables, boxes, and picture frames. A square is a special kind where all four sides are the same length.
Recycle\n\nRecycle means using old things to make new things. It helps keep our Earth clean. You can recycle paper, plastic bottles, and cans. When you put these in a special bin, a truck takes them away. Then people turn them into new paper, new bottles, or new cans. Recycling is good because we use less new stuff from the ground.
Recycling\n\nRecycling is a way to turn old things into new things. It means we do not throw away paper, glass, plastic, or metal. Instead, we put them in a special bin. A big truck takes the bin to a place where people and machines sort the stuff. Then they clean it and break it into tiny bits. Those bits get melted and shaped into new things like a bench or a toy. Recycling helps keep the ground and water clean. It also saves trees and energy. When you put a milk bottle in the blue bin, you are recycling.
Red\n\nRed is a color. It is the color you see at the top of a rainbow. You can find it on a fire truck, a stop sign, and a ripe strawberry. People use red to say "stop" or "be careful." It is a bright, warm color that is easy to see from far away.
Red algae\n\nRed algae is a kind of plant that lives in water. It looks red because it has a special color inside. You can find it in the big, warm sea near the shore. Some people use it to make a flat, green-black food called nori that wraps around rice. It grows in groups and can be very small or as big as a bush.
Red blood cell\n\nA red blood cell is a tiny part of your blood. It is round and flat, like a little pillow. It is red because it has a special helper inside. This helper grabs air from your lungs and carries it all over your body. Every part of you needs this air to stay alive. Red blood cells are so small you cannot see them without a big glass that makes things look bigger. They travel through your body in tubes called blood vessels. Your heart pushes them along, like a water pump. They go to your lungs to pick up fresh air, then to your heart, and then to your toes, fingers, and brain. After they drop off the air, they go back to the lungs for more. They work all day and all night to keep you strong.
Red deer\n\nA red deer is a big animal with four long legs and brown fur. It has a short tail and big ears that stand up. The boy deer has big, branch-like horns on its head. It lives in forests and grassy hills in many parts of the world. It eats grass, leaves, and small plants. People sometimes eat its meat for food.
Red giant\n\nA red giant is a huge, old star. It looks red or orange and is very, very big. You can see some red giants in the night sky, like the bright star called Betelgeuse. It used to be a smaller star like our Sun, but it grew much bigger when it got old. A red giant is so big that it could hold thousands of our Suns inside it.
Red Sea\n\nThe Red Sea is a big body of water between Africa and Asia. It is long and not very wide. The water is very clear and has a lot of salt. Sometimes it looks a little red because of tiny red plants in the water. Big boats use it to go from one ocean to another. People like to swim and dive there to see pretty fish and colorful rocks under the water. Many families go there for a warm vacation in winter.
Red-eared slider\n\nA red-eared slider is a turtle that lives in water and on land. It has a hard shell on its back and a red mark near each ear. You can find it in warm places like ponds and slow rivers. Many people keep it as a pet at home. It eats small water bugs, plants, and special turtle food. If you see one, it might slide off a rock into the water very fast.
Redwood\n\nA redwood is a very tall, big tree. It has a thick, brown trunk and green, needle-like leaves. You can find it in forests near the ocean in a place called California. It grows so tall that it can touch the sky. Its bark is strong and can stay safe when a fire comes. Some redwood trees are bigger around than a car. People come from far away just to look at them.
Reflection (physics)\n\nReflection is when light bounces off a shiny thing. It happens when light hits a smooth, flat surface like a mirror or a calm lake. You can see your face in a mirror because of it. When you look into a still puddle, you see the sky and trees upside down. People use it to make things like telescopes that help us see faraway stars.
Reflex\n\nA reflex is a fast move your body makes all by itself. It happens when something touches you, scares you, or surprises you. You do not have to think about it at all. For example, if you touch something very hot, your hand pulls away quickly before you even feel the burn. Another reflex is when the doctor taps your knee and your leg kicks out. These moves keep you safe without waiting for your brain to decide.
Refraction\n\nRefraction is when light changes its path. It happens when light moves from one clear thing into another, like from air into water. When light goes into water, it slows down and bends a little. You can see this when you put a straw in a glass of water. The straw looks like it is broken or bent at the water line. That is because the light bends as it goes from air to water. A rainbow is also made by refraction. Light goes through tiny drops of water in the sky and bends, splitting into many colors.
Refrigeration\n\nRefrigeration is a way to keep food cold. It uses a special box called a fridge. The fridge has a cold air maker inside it. When you put milk or fruit in the fridge, it stays fresh longer. Many homes have a fridge in the kitchen. Without it, food would go bad fast.
Refrigerator\n\nA refrigerator is a big box that keeps food cold. It has a door and shelves inside. You find it in the kitchen at home. People put milk, fruit, and leftovers in it so the food stays fresh longer. When you open the door, a light comes on and you feel cold air. Some refrigerators have a freezer part at the top or bottom that makes ice and keeps things frozen hard.
Refugee\n\nA refugee is a person who had to leave their home country. They ran away because it was not safe there. Sometimes there is a big fight or war. Other times there is no food or a big storm breaks houses. They go to a new country to be safe. A refugee may live in a tent with other families while they wait for a new home. Many children are refugees too. They bring only a few things, like a toy or a blanket. People in the new country try to help them feel welcome.
Reggae\n\nReggae is a kind of music that makes you want to sway. It comes from a warm island called Jamaica. It has a bouncy beat where the guitar goes chop-chop and the drum goes boom on the second and fourth counts. People play it with drums, a guitar, a piano, and shiny horns like a trumpet. Many songs talk about love, being kind, and helping others. A man named Bob Marley made it famous all over the world. You might hear it at a beach party or when people dance with big smiles.
Region\n\nA region is a part of the world. It is a piece of land or water that is not too big and not too small. You can find a region on a map. It can be a place where the weather is the same, like a hot desert or a cold, snowy place. Sometimes a region is a group of smaller places that are close together. People who live in the same region often share things like food or stories.
Reincarnation\n\nReincarnation is the idea that after a person dies, they are born again in a new body. It is like starting a new life as a baby. Many people in places like India and Africa believe this happens over and over. They think a part of you that does not die moves to a new body. Some little children say they remember a life before this one. This idea is very old and is part of some big religions.
Reindeer\n\nA reindeer is a big animal with soft brown fur. It has four long legs, big feet, and antlers on its head. Both boy and girl reindeer grow antlers. It lives in cold places where snow falls, like the far north. It walks on soft ground and snow with its wide feet. It eats grass and soft plants. In winter, it digs under snow to find food. Some people keep it to help pull sleds. You might see it in a story about Santa Claus.
Relativity\n\nRelativity is a big idea about space and time. It says that time can move slower or faster depending on how fast you go. It also says that heavy things like stars can bend space around them. This idea helps us understand how the world works, like why we stay on the ground and why light bends. A scientist named Einstein thought of it a long time ago.
Relax\n\nRelax means to let your body feel soft and calm. It is what you do when you stop running and sit down quietly. You can relax by taking slow, deep breaths. It helps your muscles feel loose and not tight. After a busy day, you might relax on the couch with a blanket. When you relax, your mind feels happy and peaceful.
Relay\n\nA relay is a small switch that turns things on and off. It has a coil of wire and a metal arm inside. You find it inside many machines like cars, fridges, and toys. It lets a tiny electric push move a bigger switch safely. For example, when you turn the key in a car, a relay helps start the engine.
Relic\n\nA relic is a very old thing that people keep because it is special. It can be a small piece of a person or something that person used a long time ago. People put it in a pretty box or a special room to keep it safe. They visit it to feel close to someone they love or to remember a story. Some relics are from long-ago teachers like Buddha or Jesus. A relic is not a toy; people look at it quietly and think happy thoughts.
Religion\n\nReligion is a set of ideas that many people share. It tells stories about how the world began and what happens after we die. Many people pray or sing together in a special building like a church or a temple. Some people wear a small sign, like a cross or a star, to show what they believe. A child might see a family pray before a meal or light a candle on a special day.
Religion of ancient Egypt\n\nThe religion of ancient Egypt is what people in Egypt believed long, long ago. They thought many gods and goddesses lived in the sky, on the ground, and in the water. These gods looked like people, animals, or both. People built big stone houses called temples for the gods. They gave food and gifts to the gods there. They also made the bodies of dead people into mummies. They wrapped the body in cloth so it would not break. They put the mummy in a box and gave it food for a long trip after death. They believed a person's heart was weighed to see if they were good. If the heart was light, the person went to a happy place. If the heart was heavy, a monster ate it. Some gods were Ra the sun god, Osiris the king of the dead, and Isis his wife. You can see pictures of these gods in books about old Egypt.
Religious\n\nReligious means believing in a god or many gods. It is about special stories, songs, and ways to be kind. People who are religious may go to a quiet building to pray, like a church or a temple. They often have a special book they read. Some families light candles or say thanks before eating. It helps people feel close to something bigger than us.
Rembrandt\n\nRembrandt was a man who painted pictures a long time ago. He lived in a country far away. He used dark colors and bright light in his paintings. Many of his pictures show people's faces. You can see his paintings in big buildings called museums. Some people say he was one of the best painters ever.
Remember\n\nRemember means to keep something in your mind. It is like a picture or a feeling that stays with you. When you remember, you can think of a fun day at the park or a song you heard. It helps you know your friends' names and where you put your toys. Sometimes a smell or a sound makes you remember something from a long time ago.
Remind\n\nRemind means to help someone remember something. When you forget to bring your lunchbox, your friend might remind you. A teacher can remind the class to be quiet. A sticky note on the fridge can remind your family to buy milk. It is like a little helper for your brain.
Remora\n\nA remora is a small fish that rides on sharks. It has a flat, round sucker on top of its head. It uses this sucker to stick to the shark's body. It lives in the big, blue ocean. It eats tiny bits of food the shark drops. It also eats little bugs on the shark's skin. The shark does not mind, and the remora gets a free ride and a meal.
Remote\n\nA remote is a small thing you hold in your hand. It has buttons on it. You use it to tell a TV or a toy what to do from far away. When you press a button, it sends a hidden light or sound to the thing, and the thing moves or changes. You might see one on the couch at home.
Remote control\n\nA remote control is a small thing you hold in your hand. It has many buttons on top. You use it to turn on the TV or change the show from far away. It sends a hidden light or wave to the TV, and the TV listens. It needs little batteries inside to work. When you press a button, something happens on the screen.
Remove\n\nRemove means to take something away. When you take a toy off the table, you remove it. You can remove a sticker from your shirt by peeling it off. If you clean your room, you remove the mess. It is the opposite of put or add.
Renaissance\n\nThe Renaissance was a special time long ago when people made beautiful art and learned many new things. It started in a country called Italy and then spread to other places. During this time, artists painted pretty pictures, and builders made big, strong buildings. People also read old books from long ago to learn new ideas. A famous man from this time was Leonardo da Vinci. He could paint, make music, and think of clever machines.
Renaissance art\n\nRenaissance art is a kind of painting and making that people did a long time ago. It started around the year 1400 in a place called Italy. Many of these pictures show people with soft, quiet faces. One very famous painting is of a woman with a little smile. You can see these old pictures in big buildings called museums. They are very old but still very pretty to look at.
Renaissance music\n\nRenaissance music is old music from Europe. It was made a long time ago, from about the year 1400 to 1600. It sounds smooth and gentle, with many voices singing different tunes at the same time. People sang it in big churches and in the homes of kings and queens. Some songs were about love, and people played a soft stringed instrument called a lute along with the singing. Later, people learned how to print music on paper, so more people could have the songs.
Renewable\n\nRenewable means something that can be made again and again. It does not run out. Sunlight is renewable because the sun shines every day. Wind is renewable because the wind keeps blowing. Water in rivers is renewable because rain fills them back up. People use these things to make power for lights and cars.
Renewable energy\n\nRenewable energy is power that comes from things that never run out. It uses the sun, the wind, and water to make electricity. You can see big windmills in fields that spin to make power. Solar panels on roofs catch sunlight and turn it into energy for lights and TVs. Some cars even run on fuel made from plants. This kind of energy is good because it keeps the air clean.
Renminbi\n\nRenminbi is the money people use in China. It is made of paper and round coins. The paper comes in different sizes and colors, and the coins are small and shiny. You can use it to buy food, toys, and clothes in stores. One piece of it is called a yuan. People keep it in a wallet or a piggy bank.
Rent\n\nRent is money you pay to use something that belongs to someone else. It is often paid every month. People pay rent to live in a house or an apartment. You can also rent a car, a bike, or a movie. When you pay rent, you can use the thing for a while, but you do not own it.
Repeat\n\nRepeat means to do something again. When you say a word two times, you repeat it. In a song, the same part can come back again and again. That is a repeat. You can repeat a jump, a clap, or a dance move. It helps you learn and remember.
Report\n\nA report is a way to tell someone what you saw or learned. It can be a few words on paper or a story you say out loud. A teacher may ask you to make a report about a book you read. You can draw a picture and write a sentence to show what you found out. A report helps other people know things without seeing them for themselves.
Reproduction\n\nReproduction is how living things make new babies. It is how a mommy and a daddy animal make a little one that looks like them. Some tiny living things, like germs, can make a new one all by themselves by splitting in two. Big animals like cats, dogs, and people need a mommy and a daddy together to make a baby. Plants also make new plants, like when a seed grows into a big flower. Reproduction keeps life going on and on.
Reptile\n\nA reptile is an animal with dry, scaly skin. It has a long body and four short legs, or sometimes no legs at all. You can find it in warm places like deserts, forests, or near water. It moves by crawling or slithering on the ground. A turtle is one kind of reptile that carries a hard shell on its back. A snake is another kind that has no legs and slides on its belly.
Republic\n\nA republic is a way a country is run. It has no king or queen. The people pick a leader by voting. The leader is often called a president. The United States is a republic. In a republic, the rules are made by people the citizens choose.
Republic of Ireland\n\nThe Republic of Ireland is a country in Europe. It is on a big island, and it shares the island with another part called Northern Ireland. Its flag has green, white, and orange stripes. The capital city is Dublin, where many people live and work. People there speak English, and some also speak Irish. It has green fields, farms, and not many forests. Long ago, it was part of the United Kingdom, but now it is its own country. It uses a kind of money called the euro.
Republic of the Congo\n\nThe Republic of the Congo is a country in Africa. It sits near the middle of the world, where it is very warm. Much of the land has big, thick forests with tall trees. In other parts, people grow food like bananas and peanuts. The biggest city is Brazzaville, and it sits next to a wide river. Many people live in small towns and villages.
Research\n\nResearch is a way to find out new things. It is like being a detective who looks for answers. A person who does research asks questions and then looks very carefully to learn the answer. They might read books, watch things happen, or try small tests. Some people do research to help sick people feel better. Others do it to make new toys or to learn about stars and animals. When they finish, they write down what they found so other people can learn it too.
Reservoir\n\nA reservoir is a big lake made by people. It holds water so we can use it later. You might see one near a town or in the countryside. People use the water from it for drinking, washing, and making power. Sometimes it looks like a giant swimming pool, but it is for water we need every day.
Respect\n\nRespect is a kind and caring way you treat people. It means you listen when someone talks and you do not hurt their feelings. You show it by saying please and thank you. You also show it when you wait for your turn and share your toys. When you are nice to your friend even if you are mad, that is respect. It helps everyone feel safe and happy.
Respiration\n\nRespiration is how living things get energy from food. It happens inside tiny parts of the body called cells. All plants and animals do it to stay alive. Sometimes it uses air we breathe in, and sometimes it does not. When it uses air, it makes a lot of energy. When it does not use air, it makes less energy and a sour thing called lactic acid. You breathe in and out because your body is doing respiration right now.
Respiratory system\n\nThe respiratory system is how your body breathes. It brings in air and lets out used air. You have two lungs inside your chest. When you breathe in, air goes through your nose or mouth, down a tube, and into your lungs. Inside the lungs, the air goes into tiny little bags. There, the good part of the air goes into your blood. The used air comes back out when you breathe out. This gives your body the air it needs to run and play.
Resplendent quetzal\n\nA resplendent quetzal is a bright, pretty bird. It has green feathers on its body and a red belly. Its tail is very long and blue-green. It lives in the forests of Central America. People in Guatemala love this bird so much that they put its picture on their flag and money.
Rest\n\nRest is when you stop moving and let your body feel quiet. It can look like lying on a bed, sitting in a soft chair, or closing your eyes. You find rest at home, in a cozy spot, or anywhere you feel safe. It helps your body get strong again after playing or working. A nap is a kind of rest that many children take in the afternoon.
Restaurant\n\nA restaurant is a place where you can buy food and eat it there. It has tables and chairs for people to sit. Some restaurants are big, and some are small. You can find them in many towns and cities. At a restaurant, a person called a waiter brings food to your table. Some restaurants have a window where you can get food without leaving your car. That is called a drive-through. Many restaurants serve food like burgers, pizza, or noodles. A long time ago, people in old cities also had small places to eat and drink with friends.
Result\n\nA result is what happens at the end of something. It is the answer you get after you try. When you mix red and yellow paint, the result is orange. If you build a tall block tower and it falls, the result is a mess on the floor. A race has a result too—the person who runs fastest wins.
Retail\n\nRetail is when a store sells things to people who will use them. It is not selling to other stores. A store buys many things from a big maker, then sells one or two to you. You see retail at a shop, a mall, or a market stand. You can also buy things by mail, phone, or on a computer, and a truck brings it to your door. When you buy shoes to wear or food to eat, that is retail.
Retirement\n\nRetirement is when a grown-up stops going to work. It happens after many years of working, when they are older. Some people stop because they want to rest, and some stop because their body feels tired. They stay home more and can do fun things like play with grandkids or go for walks. Sometimes they move to a special house where helpers take care of them. The word can also mean an old car or bus that is not used anymore.
Return\n\nReturn means to go back to a place or to give something back. When you come home after school, you return to your house. If you borrow a toy from a friend, you return it when you are done playing. A return can also be a ticket that lets you go somewhere and come back, like a bus return ticket.
Revenge\n\nRevenge is a strong feeling of wanting to hurt someone back. It happens when a person thinks another person hurt them first. It feels like a hot, angry push inside the chest. Some people shout or hit when they feel it. But revenge often makes the hurt bigger, not smaller. It can turn into a long fight where both people keep hurting each other. A better way is to talk about the hurt or ask a grown-up for help.
Revolution\n\nA revolution is a big, fast change in how people live or who is in charge. It happens when many people are very unhappy and want things to be different. Sometimes it is loud and has fighting, but sometimes it is quiet and peaceful. A long time ago in France, people had a revolution to change their king and rules. In other places, people used a revolution to start a new way of running their country. It is like when a whole group of friends suddenly changes the game they are playing.
Rex\n\nRex is a name for a boy or a pet dog. It is a short, strong name that is easy to say. Many people name their big, friendly dog Rex. You might meet a dog named Rex at the park or in a storybook. A boy named Rex could be your friend at school.
Rhea (bird)\n\nA rhea is a big bird that cannot fly. It has long legs, a long neck, and soft gray or brown feathers. It lives in South America, in open fields and woods. It runs very fast to stay safe. It eats plants, fruits, seeds, and sometimes bugs. A group of rheas stays together, with one boy bird taking care of the eggs and babies.
Rhine River\n\nThe Rhine River is a long, winding river in Europe. It starts in a lake in Switzerland and flows through many countries like Germany and the Netherlands. Big boats carry things on it, and people grow grapes near it to make wine. The water is home to many fish. Long ago, old castles were built next to it. Today, people work to keep the water clean so fish can live there.
Rhinoceros\n\nA rhinoceros is a big, strong animal with thick skin. It has a large horn on its nose. It lives in parts of Africa and Asia, in places with grass and trees. It eats plants, like grass and branches. It is very heavy and can be taller than a grown-up. Some people hurt it to take its horn, so it needs to be kept safe.
Rhododendron\n\nA rhododendron is a bush with many bright flowers. It has big leaves that stay green all year or fall off in winter. You can find it in gardens, parks, and in the woods. People plant it because the flowers are very pretty. The flowers can be pink, red, purple, or white. Some people call a smaller kind an azalea. It grows in many places around the world.
Rhyme\n\nRhyme is when two words end with the same sound. It makes a little song or poem feel bouncy and fun. You can hear it in nursery rhymes like "Humpty Dumpty" or "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star." When words like "cat" and "hat" sound alike at the end, that is a rhyme. It helps you remember the words more easily. Many children's books use rhyme to make the story playful.
Rhythm\n\nRhythm is a pattern of sounds and quiet times in music. It is like a heartbeat that goes thump, thump, thump. You can feel it when you clap your hands or tap your foot to a song. Some beats are strong and some are soft. A drum often keeps the rhythm for a band. When you dance, your body moves to the rhythm. Even your heart has a rhythm that keeps you alive.
Rhythm and blues\n\nRhythm and blues is a kind of music that makes you want to move and sing. It has a strong beat and a smooth sound. People sing it with feeling, and it often tells a story. You can hear it on the radio, at a party, or when someone dances. Many singers use their voice to make the music sound happy, sad, or full of love.
Rib\n\nA rib is a long, curved bone in your chest. It is part of a set of bones that make a cage around your heart and lungs. You can feel your ribs when you touch the sides of your chest. They help keep your soft inside parts safe from bumps. When you breathe in, your ribs move up a little bit to let your lungs fill with air.
Ribbon\n\nA ribbon is a long, thin piece of cloth. It is soft and can be many colors like red, blue, or pink. You can find it in a craft box or on a pretty gift. People use it to tie a bow on a present or in a girl's hair. Sometimes you see it on a dress or a teddy bear. It makes things look nice and special.
Rice\n\nRice is a tiny white or brown grain that people eat. It is a kind of grass that grows in warm, wet places. You can find it in fields full of water. People cook it in hot water until it gets soft and fluffy. Many families eat it with meat, beans, or vegetables. It is a food that gives you energy to run and play.
Rich\n\nRich means having a lot of money. A rich person can buy many things, like a big house or a new car. They do not have to worry about paying for food or toys. Some people get rich by working hard at a job. Others get rich by making something that many people want to buy. Being rich can also mean having many friends and a happy family.
Rickshaw\n\nA rickshaw is a small cart with two wheels. It has a seat where one or two people can sit. A person pulls it by holding two long handles in front. You can see it in busy streets in some countries far away. It is used to carry people from one place to another, like a taxi. Some rickshaws are pulled by a bicycle instead of a person walking.
Rid\n\nTo rid means to make something go away. When you clean your room, you rid it of toys on the floor. If you have a bug in your cup, you pour out the water to rid the cup of the bug. It is like taking away something you do not want.
Riddle\n\nA riddle is a fun question that has a secret answer. It sounds like a little puzzle made of words. You hear it from a friend, a teacher, or in a book. When you think hard about the words, you can guess the answer. For example, 'I have a face but no eyes, hands but no arms. What am I?' The answer is a clock. People tell riddles to make each other laugh and think.
Ride\n\nA ride is when you sit on something that moves and takes you from one place to another. It can be on a car, a bus, a train, or a bike. Sometimes a ride is just for fun, like on a swing or a merry-go-round at the park. When you go to school in the morning, you take a ride in a car or a big yellow bus. A ride can be short, like going to the store, or long, like a trip to see Grandma.
Rifle\n\nA rifle is a long gun that people hold with both hands. It has a part that rests on the shoulder to help keep it steady. Inside the long tube, there are tiny twisty lines that make the bullet spin as it flies. This spin helps the bullet go far and straight. People use it for hunting animals in the woods. Soldiers and police also use it to keep people safe. Some people use it to hit paper targets for fun and practice.
Rigel\n\nRigel is a very big, bright star in the night sky. It looks like a tiny blue-white dot. You can see it in a group of stars called Orion. It is much bigger and hotter than our Sun. It shines so bright because it burns its fuel very fast. One day, it will run out of fuel and end with a big boom.
Right\n\nRight is a side of your body. It is the hand most people use to write and draw. When you look at a clock, the numbers go around to the right. You can find your right hand by making an L shape with your thumb and pointer finger. It is the hand that makes the L look the right way. Many things in the world are made for right-handed people, like scissors and desks.
Right angle\n\nA right angle is a corner that is perfectly straight, like the corner of a piece of paper. It looks like an L shape. You can find it in many places, like the corner of a book, a table, or a window. Builders use it to make walls stand straight up from the floor. When two lines make a right angle, they are called perpendicular.
Rights\n\nA right is something every person should have. It is a rule that says what you are allowed to do or keep. No one should take it away from you. For example, you have the right to be safe. You also have the right to play and learn. Grown-ups make laws to protect these rights. When everyone has their rights, the world is more fair.
Ring\n\nA ring is a small circle you wear on your finger. It is often made of shiny metal like gold or silver. Some rings have a pretty stone on top that sparkles in the light. People give rings as a gift to show love, like when two grown-ups get married. You might see a ring on your mom's hand or in a treasure box.
Rio de Janeiro\n\nRio de Janeiro is a big city in the country of Brazil. It sits next to the ocean, with tall green hills and sandy beaches. You can see a huge white statue of a man with open arms on top of a mountain. Many people visit to swim in the blue water and play in the sand. The city has busy streets with buses and cars, and a little train that goes up a hill. It once held the big sports games where people run and jump.
Rio Grande\n\nThe Rio Grande is a very long river. It starts high up in big hills called mountains. It runs through dry, hot land and then into a big sea. It is the line between two countries, the United States and Mexico. People use its water to drink and to help plants grow on farms.
Ripe\n\nRipe means a fruit is ready to eat. It looks full of color, like a yellow banana or a red strawberry. You find ripe fruit on a plant or at the store. When you touch it, it feels a little soft, not hard. It smells sweet and tastes the best. If you wait too long, it can get too soft and yucky.
Rise\n\nRise means to go up. When you stand up from sitting, you rise. The sun rises in the morning and goes up into the sky. When you blow up a balloon, it rises into the air. A bird rises from the ground when it starts to fly.
Risk\n\nRisk is the chance that something bad might happen. It is like when you climb a tree and you could fall. You think about it before you do something. If you cross the street without looking, there is a risk a car could hit you. People try to stay safe by thinking about risks first.
Ritual\n\nA ritual is a set of actions people do in a special way. It is like a little play where each move means something. You can see a ritual at a birthday party when everyone sings a song and the child blows out candles. Some rituals happen at big times in life, like when a boy or girl becomes a grown-up. People also do rituals at church or temple to show they belong to a group. Doing the same steps each time makes the ritual feel safe and important.
River\n\nA river is a long line of water that moves across the land. It starts high up in hills or mountains as a tiny stream. As it flows down, it gets bigger and wider. The water in a river is fresh, so people and animals can drink it. Many towns and farms sit next to a river. At the end, it flows into a big lake or the sea.
River delta\n\nA river delta is a piece of land shaped like a triangle. It is made where a river meets a big body of water, like the sea. The river brings tiny bits of mud and sand with it. When the water slows down, it drops these bits. Over a long time, the bits pile up and make new land. The land has many small streams running through it, like the fingers on your hand. Plants and animals can live on the dry parts. Some deltas are small, and some are very, very big.
Rivet\n\nA rivet is a small metal stick that holds two pieces of metal together. It looks like a short pin with a round head on one end. You can see it on old bridges, big ships, and some airplanes. Workers heat it until it is very hot, then push it through holes in the metal. When it cools, it gets tight and keeps the metal from moving apart. A long time ago, many people used rivets to build things, but now they often use other ways to join metal.
Riyadh\n\nRiyadh is a big city in a hot, sandy country. It is the capital of Saudi Arabia. The city has tall buildings, busy streets, and many cars. It is in the middle of a big desert, so it is very hot in summer and gets very little rain. Sometimes the wind blows dust and sand all over the city. Many people live and work there. The king and other leaders have their offices in Riyadh.
Road\n\nA road is a long, flat path on the ground. It connects two places so people can go from one to the other. It can be made of hard gray stuff, or just dirt and small stones. Cars, buses, and bikes drive on it every day. People walk on the side of it, called a sidewalk. You see a road outside your house or near the park.
Roar\n\nA roar is a very loud, deep sound. It comes from a big animal's mouth, like a lion or a bear. When you hear it, you might feel a rumble in your chest. A lion roars to say, "This is my home" or to talk to other lions far away. You can hear a roar at the zoo or in a movie about wild animals.
Rob\n\nRob is when someone takes a thing that is not theirs. It is not nice to rob. A person who robs takes money, toys, or food without asking. It can happen in a store or on a street. Police help stop rob and keep people safe. If you see a rob, tell a grown-up right away.
Robbery\n\nRobbery is when someone takes a thing that is not theirs. It happens when a person uses pushing or hitting to take it. The person who does this is called a robber. It is not the same as taking a thing quietly from a store or a pocket. Robbery is wrong and against the rules. Police help keep people safe from it.
Robe\n\nA robe is a soft, long piece of clothing you wear over your pajamas. It has two big sleeves and a belt to tie it closed. You find it at home, often hanging on a hook in the bathroom. People put it on after a bath or shower to stay warm and dry. It feels cozy, like a blanket you can wear.
Robin Hood\n\nRobin Hood is a person from old stories. He is a good man who helps poor people. He lives in a big forest with his friends. They wear green clothes and hide among the trees. Robin Hood is very good with a bow and arrow. He takes money from bad rich people and gives it back to those who have very little. Many children know him from books, cartoons, and movies.
Robot\n\nA robot is a machine that can move and do jobs. It can look like a person with arms and legs, or it can look like a big metal arm. You can find robots in factories, where they help build cars and lift heavy things. Some robots are in homes, like a small round one that cleans the floor all by itself. A robot follows a set of steps, like a recipe, to know what to do. It does not have feelings, even if it seems to smile. In movies and books, robots often talk and have adventures, but those are just stories.
Robotics\n\nRobotics is the work of making robots. It uses ideas from building, wires, and computer brains. People who do this work are called roboticians. They build robots that can go to hot or small places where people cannot go. Some robots look like people, but many just look like machines. You might see a robot toy that walks or talks. That is a simple kind of robot.
Rock\n\nA rock is a hard, solid piece of the ground. It can be big like a mountain or small like a pebble. You can find rocks outside in the dirt, in rivers, or at the beach. People use rocks to build houses and roads. Some rocks are smooth and round, and some are sharp and bumpy. A child might pick up a pretty rock and keep it in a pocket.
Rock (geology)\n\nA rock is a hard, solid piece of the Earth. It can be big like a mountain or small like a pebble. You can find rocks in many places, like a park, a beach, or a forest. Some rocks are smooth and some are bumpy. People use rocks to build houses and roads. A long time ago, people made tools from rocks.
Rock and roll\n\nRock and roll is a kind of music that makes you want to dance. It has a strong beat and loud sounds from guitars and drums. People started playing it a long time ago, in the 1950s. You can hear it on the radio, in movies, or at a party. Many famous singers like Elvis Presley and The Beatles made this music. It makes people feel happy and full of energy.
Rock art\n\nRock art is a picture or shape that people made on big stones long ago. It can be a painting with color or a carving scratched into the rock. You can find it on cave walls or on rocks outside. People made it to tell stories or show what they saw. Some rock art shows animals like deer or horses. It is very old and helps us learn about people who lived before us.
Rock climbing\n\nRock climbing is a sport where you use your hands and feet to go up a big rock or a wall. It is hard work and makes your arms and legs strong. People do it outside on real rocks or inside on a wall with little bumps to hold. They wear a special belt and use a rope to stay safe. You might see a climbing wall at a playground or a gym.
Rock dove\n\nA rock dove is a kind of bird. It has a light gray body and two black lines on each wing. Its neck shines with green and purple colors in the sun. Wild rock doves live on rocky cliffs far away, but you can see their cousins in cities. These city birds are called pigeons. They walk on streets and eat crumbs that people drop. Some people keep pigeons as pets or for racing. A long time ago, people used them to carry notes.
Rock music\n\nRock music is a kind of loud, fun music. It uses an electric guitar that plugs into a big box to make sound. A band plays it with a drum set, a bass guitar, and a singer. People dance and jump when they hear it. You can hear rock music on the radio or at a show with bright lights.
Rocket\n\nA rocket is a big, fast machine that flies up into the sky. It has a long, round body and a pointy top. It uses a hot fire at the bottom to push itself up. The fire makes hot air that shoots out and lifts it high. Some rockets carry people, and some carry things like satellites. A satellite is a small box that sends TV signals or takes pictures from space. You can see a rocket on TV when it blasts off from the ground. It goes very fast and leaves a trail of smoke behind it.
Rocket engine\n\nA rocket engine is a machine that pushes a rocket up into the sky. It works by shooting hot gas out of a hole at the bottom. The gas goes down fast, and that pushes the rocket up. Some rocket engines use liquid fuel, and some use solid fuel. A solid fuel engine is like a big firework stick. A liquid fuel engine has tanks and pipes that move the fuel. You can see a rocket engine on a space rocket when it blasts off.
Rocky\n\nRocky is a word that means something is full of rocks. It feels bumpy and hard when you touch it. You can find a rocky place outside, like a hill or a path with many stones. It is not smooth like a floor inside a house. When you walk on a rocky road, you have to step carefully so you do not trip.
Rocky Mountains\n\nThe Rocky Mountains are very tall hills that go up into the sky. They are so big that they stretch from one country to another, all the way from Canada down to the United States. The tops are often covered with white snow, even in summer. Many people visit them to hike, camp, and see animals like bears and deer. Some parts are a special park where you can drive on a road high up and look at the peaks all around.
Rodent\n\nA rodent is a small furry animal with sharp front teeth. It has four legs, a tail, and two big teeth on top and two on the bottom that never stop growing. You can find it in many places like fields, forests, and even inside houses. It chews on hard things like wood to keep its teeth short and sharp. A mouse is a tiny rodent you might see in your kitchen. A squirrel is a rodent that climbs trees and has a big bushy tail.
Rodeo\n\nA rodeo is a fun show with cowboys and cowgirls. It has many games that come from old ranch work. You can see people ride fast horses and try to stay on bucking bulls. They also use ropes to catch cows. People cheer and clap when someone does a good job. A rodeo often happens in a big open space with dirt on the ground.
Role\n\nA role is a part you play in a game or a story. It is like when you pretend to be a mom, a dad, or a doctor. In a play at school, you might have a role as a tree or a bunny. It tells you what to do and say. Everyone has a role in their family, like being a big sister or a little brother.
Role-playing game\n\nA role-playing game is a kind of make-believe game. In it, you pretend to be a different person, like a brave knight or a clever wizard. You can play it sitting around a table with friends, on a computer, or even by acting it out. One person, called the game master, tells the story and says what happens. The other players say what their made-up person does. When you try something hard, you often roll dice to see if it works. As you play, your made-up person gets stronger and learns new things.
Roll\n\nA roll is when something turns over and over. It can be a ball moving across the floor, or a log going down a hill. You can also roll play dough into a snake shape with your hands. Sometimes people do a forward roll on a soft mat, tucking their head and rolling like a ball. It is a fun way to move.
Roller skating\n\nRoller skating is moving around on shoes with wheels. It has four small wheels on the bottom, two in front and two in back. You can do it on a smooth floor or a special rink. People use it for fun, to race, or to dance with music. Some kids learn to skate at a birthday party.
Roma people\n\nRoma people are a group of people who came from India a long, long time ago. They traveled far and now live in many places around the world. They have their own way of talking, their own songs, and their own food. Music is very big for them—they play guitars and violins and dance in fun ways. Many Roma people live in parts of Europe, and they move from place to place in big homes on wheels called caravans. Some people have not been kind to them, but they keep their families and traditions strong.
Roman\n\nA Roman is a person from a very old city called Rome. It lived a long, long time ago. Romans wore long white clothes and built big stone houses. They told stories about gods and brave fighters. You can see pictures of Romans in storybooks about old times.
Roman art\n\nRoman art is art made by people who lived in Rome a long, long time ago. It can be a big stone building with tall round posts, a painting on a wall, or a statue of a person. You can see it in old places where Romans once lived, like broken houses or deep under the ground. Some of it is made of tiny colored stones put together to make a picture on the floor. It shows us how people dressed, what they did, and the stories they loved.
Roman Empire\n\nThe Roman Empire was a very big group of lands and people long ago. It had a strong army and a leader called an emperor. It built long roads, big stone bridges, and tall buildings that carried water. People in the empire spoke Latin and used coins to buy food and clothes. You can still see old Roman walls and roads in some places today.
Roman mythology\n\nRoman mythology is a big set of old stories from long ago. It tells about gods and goddesses who lived in the sky. They look like people but have magic powers. They can fly fast and turn into animals. People built pretty houses called temples for them. The stories are like the ones from Greece, but with Roman names.
Roman numerals\n\nRoman numerals are letters that stand for numbers. They were used a long, long time ago by people in Rome. You can still see them on some clocks, where I is 1, V is 5, and X is 10. To make other numbers, you put the letters together. If a smaller letter is before a bigger one, you take it away. For example, IV means 4 because I is 1 and V is 5, so 5 take away 1 is 4.
Romania\n\nRomania is a country in Europe. It is near the Black Sea and has big mountains called the Carpathian Mountains. Many people live there, and the biggest city is Bucharest. People in Romania speak Romanian. They eat foods like corn porridge and small sausages. The land has rivers, hills, and forests. Children go to school for many years. Romania has cold winters and warm summers.
Romantic music\n\nRomantic music is a kind of music from a long time ago. It was made in the 1800s. It often tells a story or paints a picture with sounds. You can hear it in movies or on the radio when the music feels big and full of feelings. Some of it sounds like a walk in the woods or a storm at sea.
Romanticism\n\nRomanticism is a way of making art, music, and stories. It started long ago in Europe. People who made Romantic art liked to show big feelings, like love or wonder. They also loved to paint and write about nature, like tall mountains and deep forests. It was a time when artists wanted to be free and use their own ideas. You can see Romantic art in old paintings with bright skies and wild places.
Rome\n\nRome is a big, old city in a country called Italy. It has many old stone buildings, big churches, and pretty water fountains. A long river named the Tiber runs through it. Long ago, Rome was the most important city in the world, with kings and big fights. Today, people from all over come to see its old places, like a huge round stone building called the Colosseum. The Pope lives in a small part of Rome called Vatican City.
Romeo and Juliet\n\nRomeo and Juliet is a story about two young people who love each other. It is a play that people act out on a stage. The story takes place in a city far away called Verona. Romeo is a boy and Juliet is a girl. Their families do not like each other, but Romeo and Juliet fall in love anyway. They get married in secret. Later, they both die because of a sad mix-up. The story ends with the families making peace. Many people watch this play in theaters or see it in movies.
Roof\n\nA roof is the top part of a house or building. It covers the whole place like a big hat. It keeps rain, snow, and hot sun away from the people inside. Some roofs are flat, and some are slanted so water slides off. You can see a roof on every house when you look up from the street.
Room\n\nA room is a space inside a building. It has walls all around, a floor, and a roof. A door lets you go in and out. You find rooms in houses, schools, and stores. Each room has a job. A bedroom is for sleeping. A kitchen is for cooking food. A bathroom has a toilet and a tub for washing. Long ago, people also had rooms like we do today.
Root\n\nA root is the part of a plant that grows under the ground. It looks like long, thin strings or a big, thick stick. You find it in the dirt, holding the plant so it does not fall over. It drinks water and food from the soil to help the plant grow. A carrot is a root that you can eat.
Rope\n\nA rope is a long, strong string. It is made by twisting many tiny threads together. You can find it in a garage, on a boat, or at a playground. People use it to pull heavy things or to tie something so it stays in one place. A rope on a swing lets you go up and down. Some ropes are thick and rough, and some are thin and smooth.
Rose\n\nA rose is a pretty flower that grows on a bush. It has soft, colorful petals that can be red, yellow, pink, white, or purple. Many roses smell very sweet. You can find roses in gardens, parks, and flower shops. People give roses to show love or to say sorry. The bush has sharp little spikes on its stems, so you must be careful when you touch it. After the flower falls off, a small round fruit called a hip grows in its place.
Rosetta Stone\n\nThe Rosetta Stone is a big, old rock with words cut into it. It has three kinds of writing on it: Greek, and two kinds of Egyptian writing. French soldiers found it in Egypt a long time ago. It helped people learn how to read the old Egyptian picture writing. Now it sits in a big museum in London for everyone to see.
Rosh Hashanah\n\nRosh Hashanah is a special Jewish holiday. It is the start of a new year on the Jewish calendar. People celebrate it for two days in the fall. They think about being kind and saying sorry for mistakes. Families eat sweet foods like apples with honey to wish for a sweet year. They also blow a ram's horn called a shofar. It makes a loud sound that wakes up the heart.
Ross Sea\n\nThe Ross Sea is a big, cold part of the ocean near the bottom of the world. It is covered with ice for much of the year. In summer, some of the ice melts and you can see dark blue water. Many animals live there, like penguins, seals, and whales. It is one of the cleanest seas on Earth because people do not go there very much.
Rotation\n\nRotation is when something turns around and around. It can turn around a point, like a spinning top. It can also turn around a line, like a wheel on a bike. You see rotation when a merry-go-round spins at the park. The Earth does a big rotation every day, which makes the sun look like it moves across the sky.
Rotterdam\n\nRotterdam is a big city in a country called the Netherlands. It has a very large port where many big boats come and go. The city sits next to a wide river. Many people live there, and they work in shops, offices, and at the port. A long time ago, it was just a small fishing town. Now it has tall buildings and a big red bridge that looks like a harp. Some parts of the city are lower than the sea, so big walls called dikes keep the water out.
Rough\n\nRough is how something feels when it is not smooth. It has bumps and little hills on it. You can find rough things outside, like tree bark or a rocky path. Sandpaper is rough, and people use it to make wood smooth. A cat's tongue feels rough when it licks your hand.
Round\n\nRound is a shape with no corners. It looks like a circle or a ball. You can find it in many things, like a wheel, a coin, or the sun. When something is round, it can roll easily on the ground. A plate, a button, and a full moon are all round.
Routine\n\nA routine is a set of things you do in the same order every day. It is like a plan for your day. When you wake up, you might brush your teeth, eat breakfast, and get dressed. That is a morning routine. At night, you might take a bath, put on pajamas, and read a story. That is a bedtime routine. It helps you know what comes next and makes you feel safe and calm.
Row\n\nA row is a line of things that sit next to each other. It can be a line of chairs, a line of people, or a line of toys. You see rows in a classroom where children sit at desks. In a garden, plants can grow in a row. When you put your blocks in a straight line, you make a row.
Rowing (sport)\n\nRowing is a sport where people race in long, skinny boats. It uses long sticks called oars to push the boat through the water. In one kind, each person holds one oar with both hands. In another kind, each person holds two oars, one in each hand. Some boats have just one person. Bigger boats hold eight people and a friend who steers. You can see rowing on rivers and lakes. People race to see who can go the fastest. It is a very old sport that started a long time ago in England.
Royal National Park\n\nRoyal National Park is a big, green place with trees, hills, and water. It is near a big city called Sydney in a country named Australia. It has tall trees with leaves that smell nice, and many colorful flowers. You can walk on paths and see birds, lizards, and maybe a kangaroo. Some parts have sandy beaches where you can play. Families go there to have a picnic and cook food outside. It is a good place to see nature and have fun.
Rub\n\nA rub is when you move your hand back and forth on something. It can feel warm and soft, like when you rub a blanket. You might rub your arm if it feels cold or sore. Sometimes people rub a dog's belly to make it happy. You can also rub a crayon on paper to make a picture.
Rubber\n\nRubber is a stretchy material. It can be soft or a little hard. You find it in many things at home and outside. It is used to make balls, boots, and the tires on cars and bikes. A rubber band is a small loop that can stretch and go back to its shape. When you erase a pencil mark, you use a small piece of rubber too.
Ruby\n\nA ruby is a pretty red stone. It is very hard and shiny. People find it deep under the ground. They cut it and make it smooth to put on rings and necklaces. It is often red, but sometimes it can be pink or other colors. Many people like it because it sparkles in the light.
Rug\n\nA rug is a soft, flat piece of cloth that covers part of a floor. It can be small like a bath mat or big like a carpet in a living room. You find it in many homes, where people put it on the floor to make the room feel warm and cozy. It helps keep your feet from touching the cold floor. A rug can have many colors and patterns, like stripes or flowers. You might have a rug next to your bed to step on when you wake up.
Rugby football\n\nRugby football is a game where two teams try to get points by carrying or kicking a ball. It is played on a big grass field with an H-shaped goal at each end. Players run with the ball, pass it to friends, and try to touch it down past the other team's line. The other team tries to stop them by grabbing and holding. You might see it on TV or at a park.
Rugby League\n\nRugby League is a game with a ball. It has two teams, and each team has 13 people. The ball is not round; it is long like an egg. The field is a big green rectangle. People run with the ball and try to put it down past a line to get points. That is called a try. After a try, someone can kick the ball high between two tall sticks to get more points. Many people play it in places like Australia and England. You might see it on TV when big teams play.
Rugby union\n\nRugby union is a game where two teams try to score points with an oval ball. It is played on a big grass field with two tall H-shaped posts at each end. Each team has 15 players who run, pass, and kick the ball. The ball can only be passed to the side or backward, never forward. Players try to carry the ball past the other team and touch it down behind the posts to get points. They also kick the ball through the tall posts to get more points. The team with the most points at the end wins.
Ruin\n\nA ruin is an old building that is broken. It has walls that are falling down and no roof on top. You can find it in a quiet field or an old part of a town. Long ago, people lived or worked there, but now no one uses it. Sometimes birds make nests in the cracks. A ruin can look like a castle with big stones all around.
Rule\n\nA rule is a way to tell people what they can or cannot do. It is like a simple list of things that are okay and things that are not okay. You find rules at home, at school, and on the playground. It helps everyone play fair and stay safe. For example, a rule at the dinner table is to wash your hands before you eat.
Rule of law\n\nRule of law means everyone must follow the same rules. It says no one is too big or too strong to be above the law. Even the people who make the rules have to follow them too. This keeps things fair and safe for all people. It stops one person from having all the power and hurting others. In places with rule of law, judges help make sure the rules are followed. It is like a game where everyone plays by the same rules, so no one cheats.
