Ruler\n\nA ruler is a tool for measuring how long something is. It is a long, flat stick with numbers and little lines on it. You can find it in a classroom, at home, or in a desk. It helps you draw straight lines and see how many inches or centimeters something is. A child might use a ruler in art class to make a neat line.
Rumble\n\nA rumble is a low, deep sound that shakes a little. It is like the noise you hear when a big truck drives by or when thunder rolls far away. Sometimes your tummy makes a rumble when you are hungry. It can also be the sound of rocks moving deep under the ground. You can feel a rumble in your chest when it is very loud.
Rumi\n\nRumi was a man who lived a long time ago. He wrote many beautiful poems about love and being kind. People still read his words today all over the world. His poems feel like a warm hug for the heart.
Run\n\nTo run is to move your legs very fast. It is faster than walking. You can run in a park, on a street, or in a race. When you run, your heart beats faster and you breathe harder. It is a fun way to play with friends.
Runes\n\nRunes are very old letters that people used long ago. They look like straight lines and sharp marks carved into wood or stone. You can find them on big rocks called runestones in countries like Denmark, Norway, and Sweden. People used them to write stories and poems. Some runes are still used in stories about magic and old times.
Runner\n\nA runner is a person who moves fast on their feet. They wear light shoes and comfy clothes. You can see a runner in a park, on a track, or on a street. They run to stay strong, to play a game, or just for fun. Some runners race each other to see who is fastest. When you run to the door when your friend calls, you are a runner too.
Running\n\nRunning is moving your legs very fast to go from one place to another. It is like walking, but both feet leave the ground at the same time. You can run slow, which is called jogging, or run fast, which is called sprinting. People run to stay healthy and strong. It makes your heart beat faster and helps you breathe deep. Many kids run during playtime at school or in a race on sports day. After running, you feel hot and need a big drink of water.
Runny\n\nRunny means something is very soft and wet, like water. It can be food that is not thick, like soup or a soft egg yolk. Sometimes a nose gets runny when you have a cold, and clear liquid comes out. You can wipe it with a tissue. Paint can be runny if you add too much water.
Rural area\n\nA rural area is a place with lots of open land and not many buildings. It has farms, fields, trees, and animals like cows and sheep. You can find it far from big cities where the roads are quiet. People grow food there and take care of the land. Some families live in small houses with big yards. It is a nice place to see stars at night because there are not many bright lights.
Russia\n\nRussia is a very big country. It has land in both Europe and Asia. It is the biggest country in the whole world. The capital city is Moscow. Many people live there. The weather can be very cold, with lots of snow in winter. Some parts have big forests and wide rivers. The flag has three stripes: white, blue, and red. People in Russia speak Russian. They eat bread, soup, and pancakes. A famous toy from Russia is a wooden doll that opens up, with smaller dolls inside.
Russian\n\nRussian is a language that many people speak. It uses letters that look different from English letters, with shapes like funny sticks and circles. You can hear it in a big country called Russia, and in other places nearby. People use it to talk to friends, sing songs, and read stories. If you meet someone who says "Privet," that means "Hello" in Russian.
Russian language\n\nRussian is a language that many people speak. It is the main language in Russia, a very big country. It uses special letters that look different from the ones we use in English. Some of its letters are round and some have funny shapes. People also speak it in other places near Russia. At the United Nations, where many countries talk together, Russian is one of the important languages they use.
Russian literature\n\nRussian literature is stories and poems written by people from Russia. It is made of words in the Russian language. Many people around the world read these stories in their own language too. Some stories are about families, some are about big feelings, and some are about long trips. A famous story is about a girl named Anna. Another story is about a man who thinks a lot about right and wrong. You can find these books in a library or a bookstore.
Rust\n\nRust is a red-brown flaky coat that grows on iron. It forms when iron gets wet and sits in the air for a long time. You can find it on old cars, gates, or tools left outside. It makes the metal weak and crumbly. If you touch it, it feels rough and may leave orange dust on your fingers.
Rusty\n\nRusty means something has rust on it. Rust is a red-brown coat that forms on metal when it gets wet for a long time. You might see a rusty old bike left outside in the rain. It can look bumpy and flaky. If you touch it, the red-brown color might come off on your hand. People try to keep things dry so they do not get rusty.
Rutabaga\n\nA rutabaga is a round vegetable that grows under the ground. It has a rough skin that is often covered with a thin wax. The inside is yellow, not white like a turnip. People cook it and eat it in soups or mash it like potatoes. It grows best when the weather is cool. You might see it at a farm stand or in a big store near the potatoes and carrots.
Rwanda\n\nRwanda is a country in Africa. It has no ocean next to it, so it is all land. It is called the Land of a Thousand Hills because it has many hills and mountains. The biggest city is Kigali. Many people live there. In the mountains, you can find big, gentle animals called gorillas. The country has two rainy times each year, and the rest of the year is dry. People grow food on the hillsides.
Rye\n\nRye is a tall green plant that grows in fields. It looks a lot like wheat and barley. Farmers plant it to make food for cows and horses. People also use it to make dark, heavy bread. Some grown-ups make a strong drink from it called whiskey. You can find rye bread in a store or at a bakery.
Sabbath\n\nA sabbath is a special day for rest and quiet. It happens once every week. On this day, people stop working and spend time with family or say prayers. Some people go to a church or a temple on this day. It is a day to feel calm and happy.
Sad\n\nSad is a feeling you get when something makes you unhappy. It can feel like a heavy weight inside your chest. You might cry, or your face might look droopy. It can happen when you lose a toy, when a friend moves away, or when someone says something mean. It is okay to feel sad sometimes. A hug from someone you love can help it feel smaller.
Saddle\n\nA saddle is a seat you put on a horse to ride it. It is made of strong leather and has a soft part to sit on. Under the horse's belly, a strap holds it tight so it does not slip. People use it when they ride a horse for fun, for work, or in a race. You can see one at a farm or in a cowboy movie.
Sadness\n\nSadness is a feeling you get when something hurts your heart. It is the opposite of feeling happy. You might feel it when you lose a toy, when a friend moves away, or when someone you love is not near. When you are sad, your face may look droopy, and tears may come from your eyes. It is okay to feel sad sometimes. A hug from someone you love can help it feel smaller.
Safe\n\nA safe is a strong box with a lock. It is made of hard metal and has a heavy door. People keep money, jewelry, and important papers inside it. You might see a safe in a bank or at home in a closet. Only a person with the key or secret code can open it.
Safely\n\nSafely means doing something in a way that keeps you from getting hurt. It is like holding a grown-up's hand when you cross the street. You also act safely when you wear a helmet on a bike. It means looking both ways before you go, and not touching hot things. When you play safely, you have fun without any owies.
Safety\n\nSafety is a feeling that nothing bad will happen. It means you are not in danger. A safety hat keeps your head safe when you ride a bike. A house gives safety from rain and cold wind. Police officers help keep people safe on the street. When you hold a grown-up's hand near cars, that is a safety measure too.
Saffron\n\nSaffron is a spice that comes from a flower. It is made from tiny red threads inside the flower. It has a strong smell and a bitter taste. People use it in cooking to give food a yellow color and a special flavor. It is very expensive because picking the threads takes a lot of time. You might see it in rice dishes that look bright yellow.
Saga\n\nA saga is a very old story from long ago. It tells about brave people who lived in cold lands near the sea. These people sailed on big wooden boats and had fights with swords. You can find sagas in old books from places like Iceland. People read them to learn about the old days. One famous saga is about a man named Njal.
Sahara\n\nThe Sahara is a very big, hot desert in Africa. It is made of sand, rocks, and some tall hills. It is so big that it is almost as big as the whole United States. The sun shines very strong there, and it almost never rains. In the day, it can get hotter than a very hot bath. At night, it can get cold. Not many people live there, but some live near water spots called oases. You can find camels, snakes, and small foxes in the Sahara. It is the biggest hot desert on Earth.
Sail\n\nA sail is a big piece of strong cloth on a boat. It catches the wind and makes the boat move over the water. The sail is held up by a tall stick called a mast. Some boats have one sail, and some have many. A boat with a sail is called a sailing boat. Long ago, people used sailing boats to go far across the sea. Today, people use them for fun and for races. You might see a sail on a lake or at the beach on a sunny day.
Sailing\n\nSailing is moving a boat using the wind. It has a big cloth called a sail that catches the wind and pushes the boat forward. You can find sailing boats on lakes, rivers, and the big blue sea. People use it for fun, for racing, or to go on trips. Some kids learn to sail in a small boat at summer camp. It is also a sport in the Olympic Games.
Sailing (sport)\n\nSailing is a sport where boats race on water. It uses the wind to push the boat forward. The boats can be very small, like a little toy boat but big enough for one or two people, or very big with many people on board. They race around floating balls called buoys that mark the path. The boat that finishes first wins. Sometimes many boats race together, and sometimes just two boats race against each other. You can see sailing races on a lake or the sea near the shore. Some races last for many days and go far across the ocean.
Sailing ship\n\nA sailing ship is a big boat that moves on water. It has tall poles called masts, and big cloths called sails that catch the wind. The wind pushes it across the sea. Long ago, people used it to carry food and things to faraway places. It was also used in big fights on the water. Today, you can see small ones at the beach or in a park lake. People ride them for fun on a sunny day.
Saint\n\nA saint is a very good and holy person. In many religions, people call someone a saint when they live in a kind and loving way. Some saints are in heaven, and some are still on earth. Many people think of saints as helpers who can pray for us. You might see a picture or a statue of a saint in a church, with a soft light around their head.
Saint George\n\nSaint George is a brave man from a very old story. He is often shown as a soldier on a horse. In the story, he fights a big, scary dragon that breathes fire. The dragon lives near a lake and scares a whole town. Saint George uses a long spear to hurt the dragon. Then he ties a belt around its neck and leads it like a pet. He tells the people not to be afraid. He says he will stop the dragon if they learn to be kind and good. The people agree, and Saint George stops the dragon with his sword. Today, some people remember him on a special day. They might wear a red flower or wave a flag with a red cross on white.
Saint Kitts and Nevis\n\nSaint Kitts and Nevis is a small country made of two islands in the warm blue sea. It has green hills, tall mountains, and many palm trees. People live in small towns near the water. They grow sweet sugar and play a game called cricket on big grassy fields. You can see it on a map near other sunny islands.
Saint Lawrence River\n\nThe Saint Lawrence River is a very long, wide path of water. It starts from big lakes called the Great Lakes and flows all the way to the big ocean. It goes through Canada and touches the top of New York. Big boats use it to carry things from one place to another. You can see it in the city of Montreal, where bridges cross over it. The water is deep and blue, and it moves slowly toward the sea.
Saint Lucia\n\nSaint Lucia is a small island country with warm weather. It sits in the big blue sea near other islands. The land has tall green hills and two pointy mountains called the Pitons. People can swim at sandy beaches and see clear water. Many visitors come to enjoy the sun and play in the sea. It is a happy place with music and colorful houses.
Saint Nicholas\n\nSaint Nicholas was a kind man who lived a long, long time ago. He was a bishop, which is a helper in a church. He had a soft heart and gave his money to people who had none. He also helped children and people who sailed on big boats. Today, many people think of him when they hear about Santa Claus, the happy man in a red suit who brings gifts. You can see pictures of him in some churches, standing with a kind face and a long beard.
Saint Peter\n\nSaint Peter was a friend of Jesus long ago. He was a fisherman who caught fish in a big lake. Jesus asked him to help tell people about God. He became a leader for the first group of people who followed Jesus. Later, he went to a big city called Rome. There, he died on a wooden cross. Many people still remember him as a very important person in the church.
Saint Petersburg\n\nSaint Petersburg is a big city in Russia. It sits near the sea and has many rivers and canals, so people call it the Venice of the North. Over five million people live there, and it is the second biggest city in the country. Long ago, a king named Peter started the city to be the capital. It has beautiful old buildings like the Winter Palace, where you can see art and gold rooms. Today, many people visit to walk by the water and look at the pretty bridges.
Salad\n\nA salad is a bowl of cold, fresh food. It has green leaves like lettuce or spinach. People cut up other vegetables like tomatoes, carrots, and cucumbers and mix them in. Sometimes they add cheese, eggs, or little crunchy bits on top. A sauce called dressing makes it taste even better. You can eat a salad before a big meal or all by itself for lunch.
Salamander\n\nA salamander is a small animal that looks like a lizard. It has four short legs, a long tail, and smooth, wet skin. It lives in water when it is a baby and on land when it grows up. You can find it near ponds, streams, or in wet, shady woods. It eats bugs and worms by catching them with its sticky tongue. If a bigger animal tries to eat it, it can drop its tail and grow a new one later. Some salamanders have bright spots to warn that they taste bad.
Sale\n\nA sale is when you can buy something for less money than before. It happens in a store or on a computer. The price tag shows a smaller number, so you pay less. People like sales because they can get more things with the same money. Sometimes a sale is for just one day, like a big holiday. You might see a red sign that says SALE in a shop window.
Sales\n\nSales is when people give something to someone else and get money back. It happens in a store, at a market, or even on a computer. A person who does sales is called a salesperson. They show things like toys, food, or clothes and help people decide what to buy. When you go to the store with Mom and Dad and they pay for food, that is sales. Sometimes a salesperson talks to people on the phone or writes messages to tell them about good things to buy. Sales helps people get what they need and helps stores keep running.
Sales tax\n\nSales tax is a little extra money you pay when you buy something. It is added to the price at the store. The money goes to the town or city to help pay for things like roads, schools, and parks. Not everything has sales tax. Food from the grocery store often does not have it. When you buy a toy, the price tag might say 5 dollars, but you pay a bit more because of sales tax.
Salmon\n\nA salmon is a kind of fish. It has shiny silver skin and a soft pink inside. It lives in the sea but swims up rivers to lay eggs. Many people eat it for food, and you can find it at the store or on a plate. It is often pink on the inside, which makes it look pretty when you eat it.
Salsa music\n\nSalsa music is a fun kind of music from Latin America. It has a happy beat that makes you want to dance. You can hear it at parties, on the radio, or when people dance together. It uses drums, trumpets, and singers who sing in Spanish. Many people love to move their feet and hips when they hear it.
Salt\n\nSalt is a tiny white thing we put on food. It looks like small, shiny grains. You can find it in a shaker on the table at home. It makes food taste better, like on fries or eggs. People also use it to keep food from going bad for a long time.
Salty\n\nSalty is a taste you feel on your tongue. It is like the taste of salt from the sea. You find it in snacks like chips, crackers, and pretzels. It makes food taste strong and yummy. Too much of it can make you thirsty.
Sam\n\nSam is a name for a person. It can be a name for a boy or a girl. You might know a Sam at school or in your neighborhood. Some Sams have short hair, and some have long hair. A Sam can be a friend who likes to play games, draw pictures, or read books. If you meet a Sam, you can say hello and ask to play.
Samba\n\nSamba is a happy dance and music from Brazil. It has fast feet and a bouncy body. You can see it at big street parties with bright colors and feathers. People move to the beat of drums and bells. Sometimes they dance with a partner, and sometimes they dance all alone. The music makes you want to clap and shake your hips.
Same\n\nSame means two things are just alike. It is when you have two red apples and they look the same. You can find same things everywhere, like two socks that match. When things are the same, you can put them together. For example, your friend has the same toy as you.
Samoa\n\nSamoa is a country made of islands in the big blue ocean. It has two main islands and some tiny ones. The islands are warm and have green trees and sandy beaches. Many people there speak Samoan and English. They like to play a game called rugby. The capital city is Apia, where many people live.
Samurai\n\nA samurai is a warrior from old Japan. He wears special clothes and a hard hat called a helmet. He carries a long, sharp sword that is very important to him. A samurai fights to keep his town safe and follows strong rules about being brave and good. You might see him in a picture book or a movie with big castles and cherry trees.
San Antonio\n\nSan Antonio is a big city in Texas. It has a river that runs through the middle, with shops and places to eat next to the water. Many people live there, and it is known for an old fort called The Alamo. You can also see a basketball team called the Spurs play there. Some families go to big parks with rides, like SeaWorld and Six Flags.
San Diego\n\nSan Diego is a big city by the ocean in California. It has many beaches where you can play in the sand and water. The weather is warm and sunny most of the year. There is a famous zoo with lots of animals to see. People also like to visit big parks and watch baseball games there. It is a place where many families live and have fun.
San Francisco\n\nSan Francisco is a big city by the water in California. It has many steep hills and a famous red bridge called the Golden Gate Bridge. You can see the ocean on one side and a big bay on the other side. Many people live there and ride cable cars up and down the hills. It is a place where people from all over the world come to live and work.
San Marino\n\nSan Marino is a very small country in Europe. It is so small that it is one of the tiniest countries in the whole world. It sits on a big hill with rocky ground, and the top of the hill is called Monte Titano. All around it is the country of Italy, so it is like a little island of land inside Italy. People there speak Italian and eat food that is a lot like Italian food. They have a special cake called Torta Tre Monti, which is made of thin layers with chocolate. Many people visit San Marino to see the old buildings and buy pretty stamps.
San Salvador\n\nSan Salvador is a big city in a country called El Salvador. It has many tall buildings, busy streets, and lots of people. It sits in a place with big hills and mountains that can sometimes shake. The city has a big church and many smaller ones where people go to pray. Important leaders work there to make rules for the country. Sometimes people have big sports games and fun shows in the city.
Sand\n\nSand is tiny, tiny bits of rock. It feels rough and gritty when you touch it. You find it at the beach, in a sandbox, or in the desert. It can be many colors, like tan, white, or even black. People use it to build sandcastles at the shore. It is also mixed with other things to make hard paths and buildings.
Sandal\n\nA sandal is a kind of shoe. It has a flat bottom and straps that go over the foot. You can see toes when someone wears it. People wear it in warm weather to keep feet cool. You might see it at the beach or in summer.
Sandbox\n\nA sandbox is a box filled with soft sand. It is usually made of wood or plastic and sits on the ground. You can find it in a park, a playground, or a backyard. Children play in it with shovels, buckets, and toy trucks. They dig holes, build castles, and make shapes in the sand. It is a fun place to play outside on a sunny day.
Sandcastle\n\nA sandcastle is a small pretend castle made from wet sand. It has walls, towers, and sometimes a little gate. You find it at the beach near the water. People use buckets and shovels to build it. It is fun to make, but the waves can wash it away.
Sandcastles\n\nA sandcastle is a little house made of wet sand. It has walls, towers, and sometimes a moat. You find it at the beach where the sand is damp. People build it with buckets and shovels for fun. The waves can wash it away when the water comes up.
Sandpiper\n\nA sandpiper is a small bird that lives near the water. It has a round body, long legs, and a thin, pointy beak. You can see it at the beach or by a muddy shore. It uses its beak to poke into wet sand and mud to find tiny bugs to eat. It runs fast on the sand and sometimes flies low over the water. Its feathers are brown and gray, which helps it hide on the ground.
Sandstone\n\nSandstone is a kind of rock made from tiny bits of sand. It feels rough and can be red, brown, or yellow. You can find it in big cliffs, by rivers, or in the desert. People use it to build walls and paths because it is strong. A long time ago, sand piled up and got pressed together to make this rock.
Sandwich\n\nA sandwich is food made with two pieces of bread. It has yummy things like meat, cheese, or lettuce in the middle. You can hold it with one hand and eat it without a fork or spoon. Many kids take a sandwich to school in a lunchbox. Some sandwiches are hot and some are cold. A sandwich is easy to make and good for a quick meal.
Sandy\n\nSandy is a word that tells about how something feels. It feels like tiny bits of rock, like what you find at the beach or in a sandbox. If you touch something sandy, it feels rough and grainy. You can find sandy places near the ocean or at a playground. After you play in the sand, your hands and feet feel sandy.
Sanitary sewer\n\nA sanitary sewer is a big pipe under the ground. It carries dirty water from homes and buildings to a cleaning place. The dirty water has things like soap, food bits, and waste. At the cleaning place, the water gets clean again so it does not hurt rivers or lakes. This helps keep people from getting sick.
Sanitation\n\nSanitation is keeping things clean so people stay healthy. It means using a toilet to take away pee and poop safely. It also means putting trash in a bin and washing hands with soap. When a town has good sanitation, the water stays clean and germs do not spread. A clean toilet at home or at school is part of sanitation. It helps everyone feel good and not get sick.
Santa Claus\n\nSanta Claus is a happy, kind man who brings gifts to children. He has a big white beard and wears a red suit with white fluffy parts. He lives far away at the North Pole with his wife, little helpers called elves, and flying reindeer. On Christmas Eve, he rides in a sleigh pulled by the reindeer and goes all around the world. He comes down the chimney and leaves toys under the tree. Many children write letters to him and leave out cookies and milk.
Santiago\n\nSantiago is a big city in a country called Chile. It sits in a valley with tall mountains all around it. Many people live there, more than in any other city in Chile. The mountains can trap dirty air, so the sky sometimes looks gray. People in Santiago go to work, ride buses, and play in parks just like in other big cities.
Santo Domingo\n\nSanto Domingo is a big city by the sea. It has old stone buildings and a long wall from long ago. Many people live there, and they speak Spanish. The weather is warm all year, and sometimes big storms come. You can see a zoo with animals and a park with tall trees. People play baseball in a big field, and kids go to school to learn.
Sapphire\n\nSapphire is a shiny, hard stone that people wear as jewelry. It is most often blue, but it can also be pink, yellow, green, or even clear. People find it deep in the ground in faraway places like India and Africa. Kings and queens wear it on rings and crowns because it is very pretty and strong. A sapphire ring is a special gift that means love and truth.
Sarah\n\nSarah is a name for a girl. She can be a baby, a child, or a grown-up. You might meet a Sarah at school or at the park. She could have any color hair or eyes. A Sarah can be a friend who likes to play and share toys.
Sarajevo\n\nSarajevo is a big city in a country called Bosnia and Herzegovina. It has many houses, streets, and people. In the city, you can see tall towers for prayer, big churches, and old buildings all close together. Many people live there, and they come from different places and speak different languages. A long time ago, a big sports party called the Winter Olympics came to Sarajevo. People from all over the world came to play in the snow. Today, the city is busy and full of life again.
Sardine\n\nA sardine is a small, shiny fish that lives in the big, blue sea. It has silver skin and a long, thin body. Many sardines swim together in a big group called a school. People catch them and put them in small, flat cans with water or oil. You can find these cans at the grocery store. Some people eat them on crackers or bread. They are a good food that helps you grow strong.
Sardinia\n\nSardinia is a big island in the sea. It is the second biggest island in that sea, after a place called Sicily. The island has hills, tall mountains, and wide flat valleys. Its biggest city is Cagliari, where many people live. Around the main island, there are many tiny islands. People can take a boat to visit Sardinia and see its blue water and sandy beaches.
Satan\n\nSatan is a name for a bad spirit in some stories. It is not a person you can see. Many people who read the Bible or the Quran talk about it. In those books, it tries to make people choose wrong things instead of right things. Some stories say it was once a bright angel who became too proud. Other stories say it is just a word for the selfish part inside every person. You might hear the name in a church, a mosque, or a movie.
Satellite\n\nA satellite is a thing that goes around a bigger thing in space. It looks like a box or a drum with long flat wings. These wings catch light from the sun to give it power. People send satellites up into the sky on big rockets. It flies high above the clouds and goes around and around the Earth. It can take pictures of our planet and send them back to people on the ground. Some satellites help us talk on phones or watch TV shows from far away. You can sometimes see one at night as a tiny moving dot of light.
Satellite navigation\n\nSatellite navigation is a way to know exactly where you are. It uses signals from special machines high up in the sky called satellites. A small box in a car or a phone hears the signals and shows a map with a dot for your spot. It can tell you how to go to a new place by showing the way. Many people use it when they drive or walk to find a store or a friend's house.
Satellite television\n\nSatellite television is a way to watch TV shows. It uses a big metal dish that sits outside a house or on a roof. The dish catches signals from a satellite far up in space. The satellite sends the TV shows down to the dish. Then a box inside the house puts the shows on the TV screen. Many people pay money each month to get this TV service. It helps people watch shows even where cable TV does not reach.
Satire\n\nSatire is a funny way to show that something is silly or wrong. It can be a story, a picture, a play, or a TV show. It makes people laugh, but it also makes them think. For example, a cartoon might show a grown-up acting like a baby to say that the grown-up is being foolish. Satire helps us see when people in charge do things that are not fair or smart.
Saturday\n\nSaturday is a day of the week. It comes after Friday and before Sunday. Many children do not go to school on Saturday. It is a day for playing, resting, and having fun with family. Some people go to the park or watch cartoons in the morning.
Saturn\n\nSaturn is a big planet far away in the sky. It is the sixth planet from the Sun. It has a round shape but is a little flat at the top and bottom. It spins very fast, so a day there is only about 10 hours long. Saturn is famous for its beautiful rings. The rings are made of ice, rocks, and dust. They go around the planet like a big, flat circle. You can see them with a telescope. Saturn is very light for its size. If you could put it in a giant pool of water, it would float. It is mostly made of gas, not hard ground like Earth. It has many moons. The biggest moon is called Titan. Saturn is very cold and has strong winds. It is one of the biggest planets in our solar system.
Sauce\n\nA sauce is a yummy liquid you put on food. It can be thick like ketchup or thin like gravy. You find it in the kitchen, on top of noodles, or next to meat. It makes food taste better and feel wet in your mouth. Ketchup is a red sauce you dip fries in. Gravy is a brown sauce you pour on turkey.
Saudi Arabia\n\nSaudi Arabia is a big country far away. It has lots of hot, dry sand and a few big cities. People there speak a language called Arabic. Many people visit a special city called Mecca for a big prayer trip. It has a king who helps make the rules.
Sauna\n\nA sauna is a small hot room. It is made of wood and has benches to sit on. You find it at pools, gyms, and some houses. People sit inside it to feel warm and calm. The heat makes your skin wet with sweat. After a sauna, many people jump into cool water.
Sauropod\n\nA sauropod is a kind of big dinosaur that lived a long, long time ago. It had a very long neck, a long tail, and a small head. Its legs were thick like tree trunks. It ate plants and walked on land. You can see its bones in some museums. It was one of the biggest animals ever to walk on the ground.
Sausage\n\nA sausage is a food made from meat that is cut into tiny pieces. It is long and round, and it has a thin skin on the outside. You can find it at the store or at a cookout. People cook it on a grill or in a pan and eat it on a plate or in a bun. A hot dog is a kind of sausage that many kids like.
Savanna\n\nA savanna is a big, open land with lots of grass. It has a few trees and bushes spread out, but mostly you see tall grass. You can find it in hot places like Africa and Australia. Many animals live there, like elephants, zebras, and lions. In the dry time, it does not rain for a long while, and the grass turns brown. When the rain comes, it turns green again.
Save\n\nSave means to keep something safe. When you put a toy in a box, you save it for later. It also means to stop something from going away. You can save a cookie for your friend. Grown-ups save money in a bank to use another day. Saving is a good way to take care of things you love.
Saw\n\nA saw is a tool that cuts things. It has a long flat part with many sharp points that look like teeth. You can find it in a workshop or a garage. People push it back and forth to cut wood into smaller pieces. A builder might use it to make a board the right size for a shelf.
Sawfish\n\nA sawfish is a big fish that lives in the ocean. It has a long, flat body and a very long nose that looks like a saw with little teeth on the sides. It uses its saw-nose to dig in the sand and find food like crabs and shrimp. It can also swing its nose to hit other fish and eat them. You might see a sawfish in a big aquarium or in a picture book about sea animals.
Saxophone\n\nA saxophone is a shiny, curved tube that makes music. It has a mouthpiece with a thin piece of wood called a reed. When you blow into it, the reed shakes and makes a sound. You press keys with your fingers to change the notes. It comes in different sizes—some are small and high, some are big and low. People play it in bands, and you might hear it in happy, bouncy songs.
Say\n\nTo say is to use your voice to make words. When you say something, your mouth, tongue, and lips move to shape the sound. You can say hello to a friend or say what you want for lunch. People say things to share ideas and feelings. A baby learns to say words by listening to grown-ups.
Scaffold\n\nA scaffold is a big frame that helps people work on tall buildings. It is made of long sticks and flat boards put together. You can see it on the side of a house when someone is painting or fixing the wall. Workers stand on it to reach high places safely. It is only there for a short time and comes down when the job is done.
Scale\n\nA scale is a tool that tells you how heavy something is. It has a flat part to put things on and a part that shows a number. You can find a scale in a bathroom or a kitchen. People stand on it to see how much they weigh, or put food on it to see how much it weighs. When you step on it, the number goes up. It helps you know if something is light or heavy.
Scale (music)\n\nA scale in music is a set of notes that go up or down in order. It is like a ladder of sounds. You can hear it when someone plays the white keys on a piano from one C to the next C. It is used to make songs and tunes. Many children learn a scale by singing "do, re, mi, fa, so, la, ti, do".
Scale (zoology)\n\nA scale is a tiny, hard piece on an animal's body. It is flat and thin, like a little shield. You can find it on fish and snakes. It keeps the animal safe from bumps and scratches. If you touch a fish, it feels smooth and a little bumpy from all the scales. Some bugs like butterflies have scales on their wings too. Those scales are very small and can be bright colors.
Scale model\n\nA scale model is a small copy of a big thing. It looks just like the real thing, but it is much smaller. You can hold it in your hands. People make it to see what a big thing will look like before they build it. You might see a tiny car or a tiny house in a toy store. Some people collect them for fun.
Scallop\n\nA scallop is a small animal that lives in the ocean. It has two hard shells that open and close like a book. The shells are round and have lines like a fan. It lives on the sandy floor of the sea. It can swim by clapping its shells together fast. This helps it get away from animals that want to eat it, like starfish. People also eat scallops. The white part inside is soft and tastes good. You might see scallop shells at the beach or in a store.
Scandinavia\n\nScandinavia is a group of countries in the north of Europe. It has three main lands: Denmark, Norway, and Sweden. Some people also count Finland and Iceland. The land has big forests, tall mountains, and many lakes. Long ago, people called Vikings lived there and sailed on the sea. Today, people in Scandinavia speak languages that sound alike, like Swedish and Danish.
Scandinavian Mountains\n\nThe Scandinavian Mountains are a long row of tall hills in the north of Europe. They go through Norway, Sweden, and a little bit of Finland. On the west side, they drop right into the sea and make deep, narrow water paths called fjords. The top of the mountains is very cold, so big sheets of ice and snow stay there all year. Many reindeer live on these mountains and walk around to find food.
Scar\n\nA scar is a mark left on your skin after a cut or a scrape heals. It can look like a line or a patch that is a little different from the rest of your skin. Sometimes it is pink or lighter than the skin around it. You might have a small scar on your knee from falling down when you were little. It does not hurt, but it stays there to remind you that your body fixed itself.
Scare\n\nA scare is a sudden feeling you get when something surprises you. It makes your heart beat fast and your body jump a little. You might feel it when a friend says "boo!" from behind a door. It can also happen when you see a big shadow in the dark. The feeling goes away quickly, and then you might laugh or feel safe again.
Scarf\n\nA scarf is a long piece of cloth you wear around your neck or head. It is soft and can be made of wool or cotton. People wear it when it is cold outside to stay warm. Some people wear it on their head for special reasons. You might see a scarf in many colors like red, blue, or yellow. Mom or Dad might wrap one around your neck before you go out to play in the snow.
Scary\n\nScary is a feeling you get when something seems not safe. It can make your heart beat fast and your body feel tight. You might feel it when you hear a loud noise at night or see a big shadow. A dark room, a strange sound, or a monster in a book can be scary. When you feel it, you want to run to a grown-up for a hug. After a hug, the scary feeling often goes away.
Scene\n\nA scene is a small part of a bigger story. It is like a picture that shows one place and one time. You see a scene in a movie, a play, or a book. In a scene, people talk, move, or do something. For example, a scene might show a girl eating breakfast in her kitchen. Then the next scene shows her at school.
School\n\nA school is a place where children go to learn. It has many rooms called classrooms with desks and chairs. A teacher stands at the front and helps kids learn to read, write, and count. You can find a school in almost every town. Children go there on weekdays to play with friends and learn new things. Some schools have a playground with swings and a slide.
Science\n\nScience is a way to learn about the world. It helps us find out how things work. People who do science are called scientists. They look very closely at things, ask questions, and try things out to see what happens. There are many kinds of science. One kind looks at plants and animals. Another kind looks at stars and space. A third kind looks at how people think and feel. Science is all around you. When you mix colors or watch a bug, you are doing a little bit of science.
Science fiction\n\nScience fiction is a kind of make-believe story. It is about things that do not happen in real life, like spaceships, robots, and aliens. You can find it in books, movies, and TV shows. It shows what the future might look like. For example, a story about a boy who flies to the moon in a rocket is science fiction.
Scientific\n\nScience is a way of learning about the world. It helps us ask questions and find answers. You can see science when you mix colors, watch a plant grow, or see ice melt into water. People who do science are called scientists. They look closely at things, try new ideas, and write down what happens. Science is all around us every day.
Scientific law\n\nA scientific law is a rule that tells us how things in nature always happen. It is a short and clear idea that scientists find after many tests. It tells us what happens, not why it happens. You can see a law at work when you drop a ball and it falls down every time. Scientists use laws to guess what will happen next and to build new things. A law is not the same as a guess or a big idea that explains why. Sometimes a law can change if people learn new facts.
Scientific method\n\nThe scientific method is a way people find out true things about the world. It has steps: first, you ask a question. Then, you guess an answer. Next, you try a test to see if your guess is right. You look closely at what happens and write it down. After that, you think about what you learned. If your guess was wrong, you make a new guess and test again. Scientists use it to learn about stars, plants, animals, and many other things. A child can use it too, like when you test if a toy car goes faster on a smooth floor or a bumpy rug.
Scientist\n\nA scientist is a person who wants to know how things work. He asks many questions about the world. He watches things closely and writes down what he sees. He does tests to find answers. He works in a room with tools and special things. He teaches other people what he learns. Some scientists help make new things to help people. A scientist can study stars, animals, or how our bodies work.
Scissor\n\nScissor is a tool for cutting. It has two sharp blades that slide past each other. You hold it with your fingers through two round holes. People use it to cut paper, string, or cloth. You can find it at home, in school, or in an art box.
Scissors\n\nScissors are a tool that cuts things. It has two sharp blades that slide past each other. You hold it with your fingers in two small holes. You can find it at home, at school, or in a craft box. People use it to cut paper, string, or thin cloth. Some scissors are made just for kids and have a soft cover so they are safe. If you are left-handed, you need a special pair made for your hand.
Scooter\n\nA scooter is a toy with two small wheels and a long board to stand on. It has a tall bar with handles that you hold. You push the ground with one foot to make it go. Kids ride it on sidewalks and in parks. Some scooters fold up so you can carry them. It is a fun way to move around outside.
Score\n\nA score is a number that tells you how well you did. It shows up in games, tests, and races. When you get more points, your score goes up. A high score means you did a great job. You can see a score on a screen or on paper. It helps you know if you are getting better.
Scorpion\n\nA scorpion is a small animal with eight legs. It has a long tail that curves up over its back, and the tail ends in a sharp sting. It has two big claws near its mouth that it uses to grab food. Scorpions live in hot, dry places like deserts, and they hide under rocks to stay cool. It hunts bugs at night and uses its sting to stop them from moving so it can eat. Some scorpions glow green under a special light, but you cannot see that with your eyes.
Scotland\n\nScotland is a country in the north of Great Britain. It has green hills, tall mountains, and many islands around it. The capital city is Edinburgh, and the biggest city is Glasgow. People in Scotland speak English, and some also speak a language called Gaelic. You can see a flag with a white X on a blue sky, and men sometimes wear a skirt called a kilt. A famous animal from there is the Highland cow with long, shaggy hair.
Scouting\n\nScouting is a fun group for kids. It helps them learn to work together and be kind. They spend lots of time outside, playing games and going on walks. They also learn how to help other people. A Scout wears a special shirt and a neckerchief. You might see a group of Scouts in a park or at a parade.
Scrabble\n\nScrabble is a game you play on a board with small letter tiles. It is played by two, three, or four people. The board has many squares, and some squares give you extra points. Each player picks seven tiles and tries to make a word on the board. The first word must touch the star in the middle. After that, every new word must connect to a word already there. Letters like E and A are worth one point, but hard letters like Q and Z are worth ten points. When all the tiles are gone and one player has no tiles left, the game ends. The player with the most points wins.
Scramble\n\nScramble means to mix things up in a hurry. It can be when you stir eggs in a bowl until the yellow and white parts are all together. It can also be when you climb over rocks using your hands and feet. Sometimes people say "scramble" when they rush to get ready fast, like when you put on your shoes and coat to go outside.
Scratch\n\nScratch is a way to make things on a computer. It lets you put together colorful blocks to tell a story or make a game. You can make a cat move, jump, or dance on the screen. Many kids use it at school or at home to learn how computers think. It is like playing with building blocks, but on a screen.
Scratchy\n\nScratchy is a feeling that is rough and makes you want to rub your skin. It can come from a tag on a shirt, a wool sweater, or a dry piece of paper. When something is scratchy, it does not feel smooth or soft. You might feel it on your neck or your arm. Some people do not like scratchy things because they can make the skin red or itchy.
Screen\n\nA screen is a flat, shiny part on a TV, phone, or tablet. It lights up and shows pictures, words, and moving cartoons. You can touch some screens with your finger to make things happen. It is like a magic window that lets you see shows, games, and stories. Many people look at a screen every day to watch videos or talk to far-away friends.
Screw\n\nA screw is a small, pointy thing that holds pieces of wood together. It looks like a shiny stick with a round top and a sharp bottom. Around its body are little lines that twist like a slide. You find screws in chairs, tables, doors, and toys. A person uses a tool called a screwdriver to turn it. Turning it one way pushes it in tight. Turning it the other way pulls it out. This makes it easy to fix things without breaking them.
Script\n\nA script is a set of words that tells people what to say. It is like a recipe for a play, a movie, or a TV show. Actors read it to know their lines. You can find it in a book or on paper. When you watch a cartoon, the voices come from a script.
Scroll\n\nA scroll is a long piece of paper or animal skin with writing on it. It is rolled up like a tube. Long ago, people used scrolls instead of books. You can find old scrolls in museums. A scroll can tell a story or show a picture. When you unroll it, you see the words or drawings inside.
Scrub\n\nA scrub is when you rub something hard to make it clean. You can scrub your hands with soap and water to wash away dirt. You can scrub a dirty floor with a brush. When you scrub, you move your hand or a tool back and forth fast. It helps get sticky or messy spots off.
Sculpture\n\nA sculpture is a piece of art that you can walk around and see from all sides. It is not flat like a drawing; it stands up and has a front, a back, and sides. You can find it in parks, museums, or big open places in a city. People make it from stone, metal, wood, or clay. Some sculptures show people or animals, and some are just fun shapes. You might have seen a big statue of a person on a horse in a park—that is a sculpture.
Sea\n\nA sea is a very big pool of salty water. It looks blue or green and stretches far away until it meets the sky. You can find it at the beach, where the sand meets the water. People swim and play in it, and big boats float on top of it. It is home to fish, crabs, and soft plants that wave under the water. The water tastes salty, like tears. When the wind blows, it makes waves that splash on the shore. Some seas are warm, and some are cold. The biggest seas cover more of the Earth than the land does.
Sea cucumber\n\nA sea cucumber is a soft animal that lives on the ocean floor. It has a long, squishy body that feels like leather. It uses tiny tube feet to move slowly across the sand. Some people eat it, but it can also protect itself by shooting out sticky strings or a soap-like liquid. You might see one in a big fish tank at the aquarium.
Sea ice\n\nSea ice is frozen ocean water. It forms on the sea when it gets very cold. It is salty, not like ice from a freezer. It looks white or blue and can be bumpy. You find it near the North Pole and South Pole. It grows in winter and melts in summer. Animals like seals and polar bears live on it. People who live in cold places walk on it to hunt. It helps keep our Earth cool by bouncing sunlight back up.
Sea level\n\nSea level is how high the ocean water is. It is the middle height of the sea, not too high and not too low. The water goes up and down every day with the tides, so we use an average. People measure mountains and land from this level. When you go to the beach, you see the water line on the sand. That line shows the sea level at that time. The sea level is slowly getting higher because the Earth is getting warmer.
Sea of Azov\n\nThe Sea of Azov is a big, shallow body of water. It is not deep like other seas. It touches the land of two countries, Ukraine and Russia. A river called the Don flows into it. Many people live in cities near its shore. Ships sail on it to carry things from one place to another.
Sea of Japan\n\nThe Sea of Japan is a big body of water next to the ocean. It has water all around it, with land on some sides. Korea is on one side, Russia is on the top, and Japan is on the other side. It is very deep in some places, like a huge underwater bowl. Big boats sail on it to carry things from one country to another. People also catch fish in it. Some people call it by a different name, like the East Sea. You can see it on a map as a blue shape between the lands.
Sea of Okhotsk\n\nThe Sea of Okhotsk is a big body of water. It is part of the ocean near Russia and Japan. In winter, much of it is covered with thick ice, so boats cannot move. Many islands sit inside it, and some have no people. On those quiet islands, seals, sea lions, and birds make their homes and raise their babies.
Sea otter\n\nA sea otter is a small animal that lives in the ocean. It has thick, soft brown fur that keeps it warm in cold water. It lives near the coast where the water is not too deep. It floats on its back and uses a rock to crack open hard shells of clams and sea urchins so it can eat the food inside. It is one of the few animals that uses a tool. A sea otter sometimes wraps itself in long seaweed called kelp so it does not float away while it sleeps.
Sea snake\n\nA sea snake is a snake that lives in the ocean. It has a long, thin body and a flat tail that looks like a paddle. It uses its tail to swim very well. It lives in warm water near the shore. It eats fish and small sea animals. It must come up to the top of the water to breathe air. It can close its nose holes when it goes under water. Some sea snakes have very strong poison, so people should not touch them.
Sea turtle\n\nA sea turtle is a big animal that lives in the ocean. It has a hard shell on its back, four flippers, and a small head. You can find it swimming in warm seas all over the world. It uses its flippers to move through the water like a bird flies in the air. Some sea turtles are very big, as long as a grown-up is tall, and others are smaller. A sea turtle comes to the sandy beach to lay its eggs in a hole. When the baby turtles hatch, they crawl to the water all by themselves.
Sea urchin\n\nA sea urchin is a small round animal that lives in the ocean. It has a hard shell covered with many pointy spikes. The spikes help keep it safe from fish that want to eat it. It moves slowly on the sea floor using tiny tube feet. Some people eat the soft part inside a sea urchin, but you must be careful because the spikes can hurt your hand.
Seabed\n\nThe seabed is the ground at the bottom of the ocean. It is very deep down under the water. It can be sandy, muddy, or full of rocks. Many animals live there, like fish that glow and crabs that walk sideways. People use special boats and small underwater cars to go see it. It is dark and cold because the sun cannot shine that far down.
Seabird\n\nA seabird is a bird that lives near the big blue sea. It has wings and feathers, and its feet can help it swim. You can find it flying over the waves or resting on rocky islands. It eats fish and other small things from the water. A seagull is one kind of seabird that you might see at the beach.
Seafood\n\nSeafood is food that comes from the sea. It can be fish, shrimp, crab, or other animals that live in the water. People catch seafood with nets or traps. It is good for your body and helps you grow strong. You might see seafood at a store on ice, or on a plate at dinner. Some people like to eat it with rice or in a soup.
Seahorse\n\nA seahorse is a small fish that lives in warm ocean water. It has a head that looks a little like a horse, and a long tail that can hold onto plants. It is not a strong swimmer, so it hides in seagrass to stay safe. A seahorse is very special because the daddy carries the eggs in a pouch on his belly until they hatch. You might see a seahorse in a big tank at an aquarium.
Seal\n\nA seal is an animal that lives in the sea. It has a round body, big eyes, and soft fur. It swims fast with its flat back feet. You can see it lying on rocks or ice near the water. It eats fish and makes a funny sound like a bark.
Seamount\n\nA seamount is a big mountain under the sea. It is tall and wide, but the top stays deep under the water. It is made when hot rock comes out of the ground under the sea and cools down. Many fish and other sea animals live near it because the water moves around it and brings food. Some seamounts are so big that if they fell over, they could make a very big wave.
Search engine\n\nA search engine is a special website that helps you find things on the internet. It has a big box where you type a word or a question. Then it shows a list of pages that match your word. The best pages come first. You can click on a page to see it. Google is one search engine many people use. It is like a helper that knows where almost everything is kept online.
Season\n\nA season is a part of the year. It has its own kind of weather. In many places, there are four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Spring is when flowers bloom and baby animals are born. Summer is hot and sunny, and you can play outside. Autumn is when leaves turn red and yellow and fall from trees. Winter is cold, and sometimes snow falls. Some places have only two seasons: a wet season and a dry season. People do different things in each season, like swimming in summer or building a snowman in winter.
Seat\n\nA seat is a place to sit down. It can be a chair, a bench, or a spot on the floor. You find seats in many places like your home, school, or a bus. People use a seat to rest their legs when they are tired. A seat can be soft like a sofa or hard like a wooden stool.
Seattle\n\nSeattle is a big city in the state of Washington. It has a tall tower called the Space Needle that looks like a flying saucer on top. The city sits next to water on both sides, so you can see boats and big ships. Many people work there at places that make computers, airplanes, and coffee. It rains often, but the rain is usually light and soft. You can ride a train that goes high above the streets. In the fall, people cheer for football and soccer teams.
Seaweed\n\nSeaweed is a plant that lives in the ocean. It can be green, brown, or red. It grows near the shore on rocks, where there is light from the sun. It makes its own food from sunlight, just like plants on land. People eat seaweed in many places, like Japan and Korea. They dry it into thin sheets to wrap around rice. Some seaweed is also put into toothpaste and paint. You might see dried seaweed at the store or in a bowl of soup.
Second\n\nA second is a tiny piece of time. It is very short, like one quick heartbeat. You can count seconds by saying "one, two, three" slowly. There are 60 seconds in one minute. When you look at a clock, the thin hand moves one small mark every second. People use seconds to measure how long things take, like how fast you can run to the door.
Secondary school\n\nSecondary school is a school for bigger kids. It comes after primary school. Kids go there when they are about 11 or 12 years old. They stay until they are 16 or 18. In secondary school, kids learn harder things like math, reading, and science. They move to a new grade each year. Some places call it high school or middle school. At the end, they take a big test to show what they know.
Secret\n\nA secret is something you know that you do not tell everyone. It is like a quiet thought you keep inside. You might share it with a best friend or a grown-up you trust. Sometimes a secret is a happy surprise, like a gift you hide before a party. Other times, a secret can feel heavy, and it is good to tell a safe person. Keeping a secret means you choose who gets to know.
Secret society\n\nA secret society is a group of people who meet in secret. It has special rules and signs that only the people inside know. You cannot see what it does because it hides its work. Some people tell stories about a secret group called the Illuminati, but no one knows if it is real. A secret society is like a club with a big secret.
Secretarybird\n\nA secretarybird is a big bird that walks on the ground. It has very long legs, a gray body, and black feathers on its wings and tail. It also has long black feathers sticking out from the back of its head, like old-time pens. It lives in Africa, in places with lots of grass and few trees. It hunts by walking and stomping on its food, like snakes and mice. It is famous for killing snakes with its strong feet.
Section\n\nA section is a part of something bigger. It is like a slice of a cake or a piece of a puzzle. You can find a section in a book, where it is a small group of pages. In a store, a section is a spot for one kind of thing, like toys or fruit. When you sit in a car, you sit in the back section. A section helps you find things or know where you are.
Security\n\nSecurity is keeping people and things safe from danger. It is like a strong wall that stops bad things from coming in. You see it at the airport, where people check bags to keep everyone safe. Banks have it too, with big doors and cameras. At home, a lock on the door is a kind of security. It helps you feel safe when you sleep at night.
Sediment\n\nSediment is tiny bits of dirt, sand, or rock. It sinks to the bottom of water, like in a river or a lake. Over a long time, more bits pile on top and press down hard. This can turn it into a new kind of rock. You can see it when you scoop up wet sand and the water gets cloudy.
Sedimentary rock\n\nA sedimentary rock is a kind of rock made from tiny bits that settle down in water. It often has flat lines inside, like a stack of pancakes. You can see these lines in big cliffs by the ocean or in a canyon. It is made when sand, mud, or little shells pile up and get pressed together over a very, very long time. Some kinds are soft and crumbly, like chalk you use on a sidewalk. Other kinds are hard, like the stone in old buildings. Sandstone and limestone are two common types. You might find a piece of it near a river or at the beach.
See\n\nSee is what your eyes do. It lets you know what is around you. When you look at a red ball, you see the color red and its round shape. You can see things that are near, like your hand, and things that are far, like the moon. You use seeing every day to read books, watch TV, and find your toys.
Seed\n\nA seed is a tiny thing that can grow into a new plant. It has a hard coat on the outside and a baby plant inside. It also has food stored inside to help the baby plant start growing. You can find seeds in many places, like inside fruits or in packets at the store. When you put a seed in dirt and give it water and warmth, it wakes up and begins to grow. First, it sends a little root down and a little shoot up. Later, it needs sunlight to make its own food. Many seeds are good to eat, like sunflower seeds, beans, and rice. An apple has small brown seeds inside, and you can see them when you cut it open.
Seek\n\nTo seek means to look for something. When you seek, you use your eyes and move around to find a thing. You might seek a lost toy under the bed. A dog seeks a bone it hid in the yard. When you play hide-and-seek, one person closes their eyes and counts, then seeks the others.
Seem\n\nTo seem is to look like something, even if it is not really that way. It is how a thing or a person shows itself to our eyes or our mind. For example, a toy might seem real, but it is just a toy. A day might seem sunny, but then rain comes. When a friend is quiet, they might seem sad, but really they are just tired.
Seesaw\n\nA seesaw is a long, flat board that goes up and down. It sits on a middle piece so both ends can move. You find it at a playground or in a park. Two children sit on it, one on each end. When one child pushes up with their legs, the other side goes down. It is fun to play on with a friend.
Selection\n\nSelection means picking one thing from a group. It is when you look at many things and choose the one you like best. You do a selection when you pick a toy from the toy box. At snack time, you make a selection between an apple and a banana. A selection can be big or small, like picking a book to read before bed.
Self-esteem\n\nSelf-esteem is how much you like yourself. It is a feeling inside that says you are good and can do things. When you have high self-esteem, you feel happy and brave. When it is low, you may feel sad or think you are not good at anything. You can build it by trying new things and hearing kind words from people who love you.
Sell\n\nTo sell means to give something to someone and get money for it. When you have a lemonade stand, you sell cups of lemonade. A store sells food, toys, and clothes. The person who buys gives coins or paper money to the person who sells. After you sell something, it is not yours anymore.
Seller\n\nA seller is a person who gives you something and you give them money. They work in a store, a market, or a shop. They show you toys, food, or clothes and you can pick what you like. When you pay, they smile and say thank you. You see a seller when you go to the grocery store with your mom or dad.
Semiconductor\n\nA semiconductor is a special material that helps control electricity. It is inside many things you see every day, like toys that light up, phones, and tablets. It can let a little bit of electricity go through, or stop it, like a tiny gate. People use it to make computers and games work. Without it, your favorite cartoons would not play on the screen.
Send\n\nTo send means to make something go from you to another person or place. It is like when you give a letter to the mail carrier, and they take it to your friend's house. You can also send a message on a phone or a computer. When you send a ball, you throw or roll it to someone else. Sending helps people share things even when they are far apart.
Senegal\n\nSenegal is a country in Africa. It has a big city called Dakar where many people live. The land has a long river in the north and a hot, sunny sky most of the year. People grow peanuts, mangoes, and green beans in the ground. They also catch fish from the sea. Long ago, people from far away came in big boats. Today, people in Senegal speak French and other local words.
Senegal River\n\nThe Senegal River is a long, moving body of water in Africa. It is very long and touches three countries: Senegal, Mauritania, and Mali. It starts where two smaller rivers meet in a place called Bafoulabé. Near the end, it flows past a city on an island called Saint-Louis. Then it goes into the big ocean. People built two big walls in the river to hold water and stop salty sea water. Boats can go on parts of it, and people use its water for farms.
Sense\n\nA sense is a way your body learns about the world. It helps you see, hear, smell, taste, and feel things. Your eyes give you the sense of sight. Your ears give you the sense of hearing. Your nose gives you the sense of smell. Your tongue gives you the sense of taste. Your skin gives you the sense of touch. Some animals have other senses too. A fish can feel water moving around it. That helps it swim away from danger.
Sense of smell\n\nYour sense of smell lets you know what things smell like. It is one of the five main senses, like seeing and hearing. It starts in your nose. When you sniff, tiny bits of smell float into your nose. Inside, special parts pick up the smell and send a message to your brain. Your brain then tells you what the smell is. It helps you enjoy yummy food and know when something is not safe, like smoke. It can also make you remember happy times, like the smell of cookies baking. Some animals, like dogs, have a much stronger sense of smell than people.
Sentence\n\nA sentence is a group of words that tells a full idea. It starts with a big letter and ends with a dot, a question mark, or an exclamation mark. You see sentences in books, on signs, and when people talk. It helps us share what we think or feel. For example, "The cat is soft" is a sentence.
Seoul\n\nSeoul is a very big city in South Korea. It is the capital, so many important people work there. A long river called the Han River runs through the middle of it. You can see tall buildings, old palaces, and big parks in Seoul. Many buses and trains help people move around the city. Seoul has big sports places where people play soccer and baseball. It also has a tall tower on a hill where you can look far and see the whole city.
Separate\n\nTo separate means to move things apart so they are not together. You can separate a pile of red blocks from blue blocks. At snack time, you might separate your crackers into two groups. When you clean up, you separate toys into different bins. It helps keep things neat and easy to find.
September\n\nSeptember is a month of the year. It comes after August and before October. It has 30 days. In many places, the weather starts to get cooler, and leaves on trees may change color. Children often go back to school in September. It is the start of fall in some parts of the world.
Sequence\n\nA sequence is a list of things that follow one after another in a set order. It can be a list of colors, like red then blue then yellow. It can also be a list of numbers, like 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. The order matters—if you change the order, you get a different list. Some lists have an end, like the numbers 1 to 5. Other lists go on forever, like the even numbers 2, 4, 6, 8, and so on. You see sequences every day when you count steps or sing a song with a pattern.
Serbia\n\nSerbia is a country in Europe. It has green hills, big rivers, and many forests. The capital city is called Belgrade. People in Serbia speak Serbian. They grow lots of raspberries and other fruits. Many birds fly over Serbia when they travel to warm places. Kids in Serbia like to play football and basketball.
Serengeti\n\nSerengeti is a big, flat land in Africa with lots of grass and trees. It has wide open spaces where many wild animals live. You can find it in the countries of Tanzania and Kenya. Every year, huge groups of animals like zebras and wildebeests walk a long way to find fresh grass and water. This big walk is called a migration. The Serengeti also has a special park where people come to see lions, elephants, and giraffes.
Series\n\nA series is a group of things that come one after another. It can be a set of books, like the stories about a curious monkey. It can also be a set of TV shows that you watch every week. Each part has a number, like book 1, book 2, book 3. You can find a series in a library or on a screen.
Serious\n\nSerious means something is not a joke. It is a way to talk about things that are very important. When a grown-up has a serious face, they are not smiling and they are thinking hard. A doctor might say a sickness is serious, which means the person needs to get help fast. A fire is a serious thing because it can hurt people. When you cross the street, it is serious to look both ways.
Service\n\nA service is something one person does to help another person. It is not a thing you can hold in your hand. When a doctor makes you feel better, that is a service. When a bus driver takes you to school, that is a service too. A waiter brings food to your table at a restaurant. Many people work by giving a service to others.
Service (economics)\n\nA service is something one person does for another person. It is not a toy or a thing you can hold. When you get a haircut, the barber gives you a service. When a bus driver takes you to school, that is a service. Some services make things you can touch, like a builder making a house. But the work of building is still a service. You do not own the person who helps you, but you may own the thing they make.
Sesame\n\nSesame is a plant that grows small seeds we can eat. It has pretty flowers and can grow taller than a grown-up. The seeds hide inside little pods on the plant. People use the seeds to make oil for cooking. You might see sesame seeds on top of a hamburger bun or a bagel.
Set\n\nA set is a group of things put together. It is like a bag that holds items. You can find sets in math class or when you sort toys at home. People use sets to see what things belong together. For example, a set of your red blocks is all the red blocks you have.
Settlement\n\nA settlement is a place where people live together. It can be a small town with a few houses, or a big city with many tall buildings. People build homes, shops, and schools in a settlement. You can find it near a river, by the sea, or on flat land. A settlement has roads so people can walk or drive. Many families make their life there, and children play in parks or yards.
Seven\n\nSeven is a number. It comes after six and before eight. You can see it on a clock, on a calendar, or when you count your toys. If you have seven crayons, you have one more than six. Some people say seven is a lucky number.
Seventeen\n\nSeventeen is a group of thirteen singers and dancers from South Korea. They make happy music and do big, fun dances together. You can see them on a screen when they sing songs and wear bright clothes. Many people around the world love to watch them and listen to their songs. They smile and wave to the crowd when they are on stage.
Sew\n\nSew is when you use a needle and thread to join pieces of cloth. It looks like a tiny silver stick with a hole at one end, and the thread goes through the hole. You can find needles and thread in a sewing box at home. People sew to fix a hole in a shirt or to make a new dress. A child might see a grown-up sew a button back on a coat.
Sewage treatment\n\nSewage treatment is a way to clean dirty water from homes and factories. It happens in a big place with many tanks and pipes. First, big things like rags are taken out with a screen. Then sand and tiny stones fall to the bottom of a tank. Next, the water sits so heavy bits sink and fat floats up. After that, air is mixed in to help tiny bugs eat the bad stuff. The clean water can go back to a river. The leftover goo can be dried and used on farms to help plants grow.
Sewing\n\nSewing is a way to join pieces of cloth together. It uses a thin, pointy tool called a needle and a long, thin string called thread. You can sew by hand or with a big helper called a sewing machine. People sew to make clothes like shirts and pants. They also sew to fix a hole or put a button back on. Some sewing adds pretty shapes and colors to cloth, like a flower on a bag. You may see sewing at home when a grown-up fixes a torn toy or makes a new dress.
Sewing machine\n\nA sewing machine is a tool that joins pieces of cloth together with thread. It has a needle that moves up and down very fast. You can find it in many homes and in big places where clothes are made. It helps people sew much faster than using their hands. For example, when your shirt gets a hole, a sewing machine can fix it quickly.
Sex\n\nSex is a word for being a boy or a girl. It is something you are born with. Boys have a penis, and girls have a vagina. Most people are either a boy or a girl. When a baby is born, the doctor says 'It's a boy!' or 'It's a girl!' That tells the sex of the baby.
Sexism\n\nSexism is when someone thinks boys are better than girls, or girls are better than boys, just because of being a boy or a girl. It is not fair. It can make people feel sad or left out. For example, if a teacher says only boys can play with blocks, that is sexism. Or if someone says only girls can wear pink, that is sexism too. Everyone should get to do what they like and be treated the same.
Sextant\n\nA sextant is a tool that helps people find their way on the sea. It looks like a piece of a pie with a small telescope and a moving arm. Sailors use it on a boat to look at the sky. It measures how high the sun or a star is above the water line. With that number, they can tell where they are on a map. Long ago, big ships always carried one so they would not get lost.
Sexual Orientation\n\nSexual orientation is about who a person loves or likes in a special way. It is a feeling inside, not something you can see from the outside. Some people love someone of a different kind, like a boy loving a girl. Some people love someone of the same kind, like a girl loving a girl. Some people love both kinds. It is a part of who a person is, like the color of their eyes. Everyone's feelings are okay and normal.
Sexually Transmitted Infection\n\nA sexually transmitted infection is a sickness that can pass from one person to another during close body contact. It is caused by tiny germs that you cannot see. Doctors can help make it better with medicine. The best way to stay safe is to wash hands often and listen to grown-ups about keeping clean.
Seychelles\n\nSeychelles is a small country made of many islands. It sits in the big blue Indian Ocean, far away from other lands. The islands have warm sand, tall palm trees, and clear water. People there speak different words, like Creole, English, and French. Many visitors come to see the pretty beaches and swim with colorful fish. A big, slow turtle called the Aldabra Giant Tortoise lives on the islands. It is one of the biggest turtles in the world. The islands also have a special bird called the Seychelles Black Parrot. It is the country's own bird and is kept safe there.
Shade\n\nShade is a cool, dark spot where the sun does not shine. It is made when something blocks the light, like a big tree or a house. You can find it under a leafy tree on a hot day. It helps you feel cool when the sun is too warm. A hat can also make a little shade for your face.
Shadow\n\nA shadow is a dark shape that shows up when something blocks light. It looks like the thing that made it, but it is flat and has no colors. You can see it on the ground, on a wall, or on the floor when the sun or a lamp shines. It moves when the thing moves, and it gets bigger or smaller when the light moves. On a sunny day, you can chase your own shadow on the sidewalk.
Shake\n\nA shake is a quick move back and forth. You can do it with your body, your head, or your hands. When you shake a toy, it makes a rattling sound. People shake hands to say hello. A dog shakes its body to get water off after a bath. You can also shake a bottle of juice before you drink it.
Shakespeare\n\nShakespeare is a name of a man who wrote many plays and poems. He lived a long time ago in a country called England. He wrote stories about kings, queens, and people in love. Some of his plays are funny, and some are sad. People still read his words and watch his plays on a stage today. You might see a picture of him with a bald head and a beard.
Shaman\n\nA shaman is a person who helps people feel better. He or she talks to spirits and nature. You might find a shaman in a village or a forest. He or she uses songs, drums, and special plants to heal. Some people go to a shaman when they are sick or sad.
Shamanism\n\nShamanism is a way some people talk to spirits. A person who does this is called a shaman. They use drums, songs, and special dances to feel close to the spirit world. People in many places, like cold northern lands and hot jungles, have shamans. A shaman might help sick people feel better or ask spirits for good weather. Long ago, many groups had a shaman, and some still do today.
Shame\n\nShame is a feeling you get when you think you did something wrong. It can make your face feel hot and your eyes look down. You might feel it when you break a rule, even if no one saw you. Sometimes grown-ups tell children to feel shame to help them learn. When you grow up, you learn the difference between shame and a feeling called guilt. Guilt is when you feel bad about what you did, not about who you are.
Shampoo\n\nShampoo is a soapy liquid for your hair. It comes in a bottle and smells nice, like flowers or fruit. You find it in the bathroom, near the tub or shower. When you wash your hair, you squeeze a little bit into your hand, rub it into your hair, and it makes bubbles. Then you rinse it out with water. It helps keep your hair clean and soft.
Shanghai\n\nShanghai is a very big city in China. It has many tall buildings, busy streets, and lots of people. You can find it near a big river and the sea. People go there to see bright lights, ride boats, and visit fun parks. One famous spot is a tall tower that looks like a giant pearl.
Shape\n\nA shape is the way something looks on the outside. It can be flat like a drawing on paper, or it can be round and fat like a ball. You see shapes everywhere. A door is a tall rectangle. A clock on the wall is a circle. A slice of pizza looks like a triangle. When you play with blocks, you hold cubes and long boxes. Those are shapes you can pick up. Even a star in the sky looks like a tiny pointy shape. Shapes help us name what we see.
Share\n\nA share is a tiny piece of a big company. When you have a share, you own a small part of that company. People buy shares to help the company grow. If the company does well, the share can be worth more money. You cannot hold a share in your hand like a toy—it is a special paper or a note on a computer. Many grown-ups talk about shares when they plan for the future.
Shark\n\nA shark is a big fish that lives in the sea. It has a long body, strong jaws, and many sharp teeth. Its skin feels rough if you rub it the wrong way.
