Sharks swim in oceans all over the world. They use their fins to move fast and turn. Some sharks eat other fish, and some eat tiny sea animals. A great white shark is one kind you might see in a book or on TV.
Sharp\n\nSharp means something has a very thin edge or a pointy tip. It can cut or poke things easily. A knife is sharp, and so is a needle. You find sharp things in the kitchen, like scissors. Be careful with sharp things because they can hurt you. A pencil tip is sharp after you sharpen it.
Shaving\n\nShaving is when you cut hair off your skin with a sharp tool. The tool is called a razor. It has a small, flat blade that slides over the skin. Many men shave the hair on their face every morning. Some men shave all the hair off, and some leave a little bit. When a man leaves hair under his nose, it is called a mustache. When he leaves hair on his chin, it is called a goatee. Some men also shave the hair on their head to be smooth and bald. Soldiers in the army often shave their heads. You might see your dad or grandpa shaving at the sink with white foam on their face.
She\n\nShe is a word we use to talk about a girl or a woman. When you see a girl playing, you can say, "She is playing." It is a small word that takes the place of a name. You hear it in stories, songs, and when people talk about someone they know.
Shed\n\nA shed is a small house for your yard. It has four walls, a roof, and a door. You find it in a garden or behind a house. People use it to keep tools like shovels and rakes. It can also hold a lawn mower or bikes. Some sheds are made of wood, and some are made of metal. It keeps things dry when it rains.
Sheep\n\nA sheep is a soft, fluffy animal that lives on a farm. It has four legs, a woolly coat, and a short tail. You can find it in green fields eating grass. People keep sheep for the warm wool that grows on its body. The wool is cut off once a year to make clothes like sweaters and socks. A baby sheep is called a lamb, and it says "baa."
Sheet\n\nA sheet is a big, flat piece of cloth. It is soft and covers your bed. You sleep on top of it or under it. It keeps you warm and cozy at night. Mom or Dad washes it to make it clean and fresh.
Shelf\n\nA shelf is a flat board that holds things. It is often made of wood or metal and sticks out from a wall. You can find it in a house, a school, or a store. People put books, toys, or cups on it so the floor stays neat. A shelf in your room might hold your favorite storybooks.
Shell\n\nA shell is a hard cover that some animals make on their body. It can be round, long, or shaped like a twist. You find shells at the beach, in the sand, or in the water. The animal inside uses it as a safe house to hide from bigger animals. When the animal grows, it may leave the old shell behind. A child might pick up a pretty shell and hold it to their ear to hear the ocean sound.
Shia\n\nShia is a big group of people who follow Islam. They believe that a man named Ali was the right leader after Muhammad. They pray in special buildings called mosques. Many Shia people live in countries like Iran and Iraq. They have special days to remember important people from long ago.
Shia Islam\n\nShia Islam is a way some people follow the religion of Islam. They believe that after the Prophet Muhammad, his family member Ali should have been the leader. They pray, fast, and go to special buildings called mosques, just like other Muslims. They also remember a sad story about Ali's son Hussein, who was hurt a long time ago. Many Shia Muslims live in countries like Iran and Iraq.
Shield\n\nA shield is a flat thing you hold to stay safe. It blocks things that can hurt you, like sticks or rocks. Long ago, people made it from wood or animal skin. Today, police and soldiers use it to stop things from hitting them. Some shields are big and cover the whole body. Others are small and round, like a little plate. You might see a shield in a story about knights. A knight holds it in one hand to block a sword.
Shiitake\n\nShiitake is a kind of mushroom that people can eat. It has a round cap on top and a short stem under it. It grows on trees like oak in cool places. People cook it in soups and other foods because it tastes good. You might see it in a store or in a warm bowl of soup.
Shin\n\nA shin is the front part of your leg, below your knee. It is the hard bone you can feel when you touch the front of your leg. When you run and bump your leg into something, it can hurt a lot. You use it to stand, walk, and jump. It helps hold your body up straight.
Shine\n\nShine means to give off bright light. The sun shines in the sky during the day. A lamp shines light in a dark room. When you clean a mirror, it can shine. Stars shine at night. Some things like gold or a new toy can look shiny and bright.
Shinkansen\n\nShinkansen is a very fast train in Japan. It has a long, pointy nose that looks like a bullet. You find it on special train tracks that go between big cities. It carries people from one place to another very quickly. If you see a picture of a white train with a sharp front, that might be a Shinkansen.
Shinto\n\nShinto is a very old way of thinking and doing things in Japan. It is about spirits called kami. People believe kami live in trees, rivers, mountains, and even in the sun. A shrine is a special house where people go to say hello to the kami. They clap their hands and bow to show respect. Many festivals happen all year with music, dancing, and bright clothes. Some families have a tiny shrine at home to remember the kami every day.
Shiny\n\nShiny means something is very bright and sparkly. It looks like it has little lights on it. You can see shiny things when the sun hits a clean window, a new coin, or a puddle of water. A mirror is shiny because you can see your face in it. Some toys and stickers are shiny too, and they catch your eye right away.
Ship\n\nA ship is a big thing that moves on water. It is bigger than a boat. It has a long body and a tall part that sticks up. You can see it on the sea, a lake, or a big river. People use it to carry things like toys, food, and clothes from one place to another. Some ships carry people on fun trips. A long time ago, ships used the wind to move. Now they use engines. You might see a ship in a picture book or at a harbor.
Shipbuilding\n\nShipbuilding is the job of making big boats that go on the sea. It happens in a very large place called a shipyard, right next to the water. Workers use strong metal to build the outside of the boat, piece by piece. They also put in big engines so the boat can move. When the boat is ready, it slides into the water for the first time. Today, most big boats are built in countries like South Korea and China.
Shirt\n\nA shirt is a piece of clothing that covers the top part of your body. It has a hole for your head and two holes for your arms. Some shirts have long sleeves that go all the way to your hands, and some have short sleeves that stop at your shoulders. A shirt can have buttons down the front or no buttons at all. You can find shirts in a closet or a store. People wear a shirt every day to stay warm and look nice. A T-shirt is a soft, comfy kind of shirt with no collar and short sleeves.
Shiva\n\nShiva is a god that many people in India love. He is part of a group of three big gods. He has blue skin and three eyes. One eye sits on his forehead. He lives high up on a cold mountain with his family. People pray to him to take away bad things. They also dance for him because he is the god of dancing. You can see a big statue of him in a city called Bangalore.
Shiver\n\nA shiver is a quick shake your body makes when you feel cold. It looks like your arms and legs move fast for a short time. You can feel it when you step outside on a chilly day without a coat. It helps your body warm up by moving your muscles. Sometimes you also shiver when you are scared or very excited.
Shoe\n\nA shoe is something you wear on your foot. It covers the bottom and sides of your foot to keep it safe and clean. You put one shoe on each foot, so they always come in pairs. People wear shoes outside to walk on the street, in the park, or at the store. Some shoes are soft and light for running fast. Other shoes are tall and called boots. Boots keep your feet dry in rain and mud. At home, you might wear soft slippers to keep your feet warm. Shoes can be many colors and shapes. Some are shiny and fancy for parties. A shoe has a bottom part called a sole that touches the ground.
Shoebill\n\nA shoebill is a big bird with a very special beak. It looks like a shoe, so people call it a shoebill. It has long legs, a long neck, and gray feathers. It lives in wet, grassy places in Africa. It stands very still in the water and waits for fish. Then it scoops them up with its big beak. It also eats frogs and small water snakes. It is a quiet bird and does not make many sounds.
Shogi\n\nShogi is a board game from Japan. It is like chess, but with its own rules. It has a square board with many small squares. Two people play it, and each person starts with 20 pieces. The pieces are flat and have writing on them. When you take a piece from the other player, you can put it back on the board as your own piece. This makes the game very fun and hard to tie. You can find it in Japan, and some people play it in other countries too.
Shoot\n\nShoot means to send something out very fast. You can shoot a ball with your foot in a game. You can shoot a picture with a camera to save a happy moment. In some stories, a person might shoot an arrow from a bow. It is a quick action that makes something go far.
Shop\n\nA shop is a place where people buy things. It has a door, a window, and shelves with food, toys, or clothes. You can find a shop on a street or in a mall. People go inside to pick what they need and pay with money. A bakery is a shop that sells bread and cakes.
Shopkeeper\n\nA shopkeeper is a person who works in a shop. He sells things like food, toys, or clothes. You can see him behind a counter when you go to a store. He helps you find what you need and takes your money. Sometimes he puts new things on shelves so the shop looks full and nice.
Shopping\n\nShopping is when you go to a store to look at things or buy them with money. It can be a big building with many little shops inside, or just one small shop on a street. People who shop are called shoppers. Sometimes they buy food, clothes, or toys. Other times they just walk around and look. Shopping can be fun to do with a friend or family. It can make you feel happy and less worried. You can also shop on a computer or a phone without going to a store.
Shore\n\nA shore is the land right next to a big body of water. It is where the water meets the sand, rocks, or dirt. You can find it at the beach, by a lake, or along a river. People like to walk on it, build sandcastles, or look for shells. It is a good place to put your feet in the water and feel the waves.
Short\n\nShort is when something is not long. It is the opposite of tall or long. A short pencil is easy to hold in a small hand. A short story has only a few words. When you take a short walk, you come back home very soon.
Short story\n\nA short story is a made-up tale that is not very long. It has a beginning, a middle, and an end. You can find it in a book or hear someone tell it out loud. It tells about people or animals and what happens to them. A short story can be as quick as a few words, like "The cat sat. It saw a bug. It jumped."
Shot\n\nA shot is a small drink of medicine. It comes in a tiny cup or a spoon. You find it at home when you are sick. A grown-up gives it to you to help you feel better. It can taste sweet or yucky. Sometimes a shot is also a quick poke from a doctor with a needle, but that one hurts a little.
Shot put\n\nShot put is a sport where you push a heavy ball far away. It is a small, round ball made of metal. You hold it near your neck and push it into the air. You cannot throw it like a toy ball. People do this sport outside on a big field. It is in the Olympic Games. The person who pushes the ball the farthest wins.
Should\n\nA shoulder is the part of your body where your arm meets your top. It is round and can move your arm up, down, and around. You have two of them, one on each side. When you wave hello or throw a ball, it helps you do that. Sometimes people carry a bag on it or give a friend a pat there.
Shoulder\n\nA shoulder is the part of your body where your arm meets your neck. It is round and soft on top, with a hard bone inside. You can move it to wave hello, throw a ball, or give a hug. When you wear a backpack, the straps rest on it. It helps you lift things and reach up high.
Shout\n\nA shout is a very loud sound you make with your voice. It is like a yell or a big call. You open your mouth wide and push air out fast. People shout when they are far away and want someone to hear them. Sometimes people shout when they are happy, like at a game. Sometimes they shout when they are scared or need help. You can shout outside on the playground or at a park.
Shovel\n\nA shovel is a tool that helps you pick up and move loose things. It has a long stick called a handle and a flat, wide metal part at the bottom. You can find it in a garden, a garage, or a sandbox. People use it to scoop up dirt, sand, snow, or small rocks. When you push the flat part under a pile and lift, it carries the stuff to a new spot. A shovel is not the best tool for making deep holes in hard ground, but it works great for moving soft piles.
Show\n\nA show is something you watch for fun. It can be on a TV, a tablet, or a big stage. In a show, people sing, dance, or act out a story. You might see a show at a theater with your family. Some shows have puppets or cartoons that make you laugh.
Shower\n\nA shower is a place where you wash your body with water. It has a part up high that sprays water down on you. You stand up inside it and the water falls like warm rain. People use a shower to get clean every day. You can find a shower in a bathroom at home. It helps wash away dirt and soap.
Shrew\n\nA shrew is a tiny animal that looks like a mouse with a long nose. It has soft fur, small eyes, and a pointy snout. It lives on the ground in many places around the world, like forests and fields. It hunts for seeds, bugs, nuts, and worms to eat. It is very busy and hungry all day, so it eats a lot. Even though it looks like a mouse, it is not one—it is more like a mole.
Shrike\n\nA shrike is a small bird with a strong, hooked beak. It has gray, black, or brown feathers and a dark mask around its eyes. You can find it in open places like fields and bushes in many parts of the world. It hunts bugs, small mice, and lizards. Sometimes it pokes its food onto sharp thorns or twigs to save it for later. This is why some people call it a butcher bird.
Shrimp\n\nA shrimp is a small water animal with a long tail and a hard shell. It has many legs and two long feelers on its head. It lives in the water, near the sand at the bottom. It can swim very fast by flipping its tail. People catch it to eat. They take off the shell and cook the soft tail meat. You might see it in a fish tank or on a dinner plate.
Shrub\n\nA shrub is a small plant with many stems. It is shorter than a tree and has branches that start close to the ground. You can find it in gardens, parks, and sometimes in the woods. People use it to make their yards look pretty. Some shrubs have flowers, and some stay green all year. A bush you see near your house might be a shrub.
Shut\n\nShut means to close something tight. When you shut a door, it is not open anymore. You can also shut a box, a book, or your eyes. It is the opposite of open. When you go to sleep, you shut your eyes. When it is cold outside, you shut the window to keep the warm air in.
Shy\n\nShy is a feeling you get when you are around new people or in a new place. It can make your cheeks feel warm and your voice very small. You might want to hide behind Mom or Dad. Many kids feel shy on the first day of school. It is okay to feel shy. After a little time, the feeling often goes away and you feel brave again.
Shyness\n\nShyness is a feeling you get when you are around new people. It makes you want to hide or be very quiet. Your face might feel hot, and your heart might beat fast. It can happen on the first day of school or at a big party. Many kids feel shy sometimes, and that is okay.
Siamese cat\n\nA Siamese cat is a kind of cat with a special look. It has short, soft fur that is light on its body and dark on its face, ears, paws, and tail. Its eyes are bright blue and shaped like almonds. It comes from a faraway place called Thailand. It loves to be with people and will follow you around the house. It makes loud sounds that can sound like a baby crying. It is very smart and likes to play even when it is grown up. You might see one in a book or at a friend's house.
Siberia\n\nSiberia is a very big piece of land in Russia. It is in the north part of the world, so it is very cold. It has wide, flat fields and big forests. Many people live in cities there, like Novosibirsk. Some people who live there are called Siberian people.
Sibling\n\nA sibling is a brother or a sister. It is a child who has the same mom and dad as you. You can find a sibling at home, in your family. A sibling plays with you, shares toys, and sometimes fights with you. For example, if you have a baby brother, he is your sibling.
Sichuan\n\nSichuan is a big place in China. It has tall mountains, wide rivers, and green forests. Many people live there in busy cities and quiet towns. The food from Sichuan is very spicy and makes your mouth feel hot and tingly. One famous dish is chicken with peanuts. People also enjoy old songs and colorful shows with masks and costumes. A long time ago, a famous poet named Li Bai was born there. You can visit a pretty garden built to remember him.
Sick\n\nSick means your body does not feel good. It can happen when a tiny bug gets inside you. You might feel hot, have a runny nose, or a tummy ache. When you are sick, you stay in bed and rest. Mom or Dad may give you warm soup and a soft blanket. A doctor can help you feel better with medicine. After a few days, you feel strong and happy again.
Sickle\n\nA sickle is a tool for cutting plants. It has a handle and a long, curved blade that is sharp on the inside. Farmers used it long ago to cut wheat and other crops by hand. They would swing it low to the ground to slice the stems. Some sickles have little teeth on the blade, like a saw. Today, big machines do most of the cutting, but you might see a sickle in a picture or a museum.
Sickness\n\nSickness is when your body does not feel good. It can make you feel hot, tired, or achy. You might have a runny nose, a cough, or a sore tummy. When you are sick, you stay in bed and rest. A grown-up may give you soup or medicine to help you feel better. After a few days, the sickness goes away and you can play again.
Side\n\nA side is one part of something. It can be the left part or the right part of a thing. When you look at a box, it has a top, a bottom, and four sides. Your body has two sides too — a left side and a right side. When you draw a square, you make four straight lines, and each line is a side. In a game, two teams play against each other, and each team is one side.
Sidewalk\n\nA sidewalk is a long, flat path next to a street. It is made of hard stone or cement. People walk on it to stay safe from cars and bikes. You can see it in front of houses, stores, and parks. Sometimes kids draw with chalk or ride small toys on it.
Sideways\n\nSideways means moving or facing to the left or right, not straight ahead. It is like when a crab walks on the sand. You can look sideways by turning your head to the side. A car can slide sideways on ice. When you draw a line that goes left to right, it goes sideways.
Sierra Leone\n\nSierra Leone is a country in West Africa. It is next to the big blue ocean. It has green hills, hot sun, and a long rainy time. Many people there eat rice every day. They play football in the streets. It has a big city called Freetown where boats come and go.
Sight\n\nSight is the way you see the world with your eyes. It lets you know what things look like. Light comes into your eye, and a clear part inside sends a picture to the back of your eye. Then a special path takes that picture to your brain. Your brain figures out shapes, colors, and how far away things are. It helps you catch a ball or find your mom in a crowd. When you look at a red apple, your brain tells you it is round, red, and close enough to grab.
Sigmund Freud\n\nSigmund Freud was a doctor who studied how people think and feel. He lived a long time ago and talked to many people about their dreams and worries. He said that our feelings can hide deep inside us, like a secret box. He helped people by listening to them talk. Many doctors today still use some of his ideas.
Sign\n\nA sign is a flat thing with words or pictures on it. It can be made of wood, metal, or paper. You see signs on streets, in stores, and at school. It tells you something, like where to go or what not to do. A stop sign is red and tells cars to wait. A sign with a picture of a fork and spoon shows where to eat.
Sign language\n\nSign language is a way of talking with your hands. It uses hand shapes, arm moves, and face looks to share ideas. Deaf people often use it to talk to each other. They watch the hands and face to understand what someone says. Some hearing people learn it too, so they can talk with deaf friends. There are many different sign languages around the world, just like there are many spoken languages.
Signal\n\nA signal is a way to send a message without words. It can be a light, a sound, or a hand wave. You see a red light on the street, and it tells cars to stop. A bell ringing at school tells you it is time to go inside. When you wave your hand to a friend, that is a signal too.
Sikhism\n\nSikhism is a way of life and a religion. It started a long time ago in a place called Punjab. People who follow it are called Sikhs. They believe in one God who made everything. They go to a special building called a Gurdwara to pray. Inside, everyone sits on the floor to show that all people are equal. They share a free meal called Langar with everyone who comes. Sikhs try to be honest, share with others, and remember God. Many Sikh men wear a turban on their head.
Silent\n\nSilent means no sound at all. It is like when you press your lips together and do not say a word. You can find silent places in a library or when everyone is asleep at night. When a room is silent, you might hear tiny sounds like your own breathing. A silent game is when friends try not to make any noise. It can feel calm and peaceful.
Silent movie\n\nA silent movie is a movie with no talking or sound. It shows moving pictures on a big screen, but you cannot hear the people speak. Long ago, cameras could not record sound, so all movies were silent. When people watched it, a piano player often played music in the room to make it feel happy or scary. Sometimes words would pop up on the screen to tell you what the people were saying. A famous silent movie star was Charlie Chaplin. He wore a funny hat and a small mustache and made people laugh without saying a word.
Silicon\n\nSilicon is a hard, gray, shiny material. It looks like a dark rock or metal. You can find it in sand and rocks all over the Earth. People use it to make glass, like in windows and bottles. It is also used inside computers and phones to help them work. Many things we use every day have silicon in them.
Silicon Valley\n\nSilicon Valley is a place in California where people make computers and other smart machines. It has many big buildings where grown-ups work on new ideas. Long ago, it was full of fruit trees, but now it is full of tech companies. You can see it on a map near a big bay. Many things you use, like tablets and phones, were thought up there.
Silk\n\nSilk is a soft, shiny thread made by a tiny worm. It comes from the little house the worm spins around itself, called a cocoon. People take the thread and weave it into smooth cloth. They use it to make pretty dresses, soft scarves, and shiny ribbons. Long ago, people even used silk to make big cloths that float down from the sky. You might see silk on a fancy pillow or in a bright hair bow.
Silk Road\n\nThe Silk Road was a long, long path that people used to carry things from one faraway place to another. It was not one road, but many roads that went across big lands and over water. People walked on it with camels, horses, and boats. They brought silk from China to places far away. Silk is a soft, shiny cloth that only China could make back then. They also brought other things like spices, pretty stones, and new ideas. The Silk Road helped people from different lands meet and share stories and food. It made many cities rich and busy.
Silkworm\n\nA silkworm is a small, soft caterpillar. It is the baby form of a moth. It eats only leaves from a mulberry tree. It makes a long, thin thread of silk and wraps it around its body to form a little house called a cocoon. People use the silk to make soft and shiny clothes. The silkworm lives with people and is not found in the wild anymore.
Silly\n\nSilly is a feeling when you want to laugh and be goofy. It makes you smile big and do funny things like make a silly face or wiggle your arms. You might feel silly when you play with friends or wear a hat that is too big. It is a happy, light feeling that makes you giggle. Sometimes you act silly just to make someone else laugh too.
Silo\n\nA silo is a tall round building on a farm. It looks like a big can with a pointy or round top. Farmers put cut-up green plants inside it to keep them wet and fresh. The plants turn into soft food that cows like to eat. In winter, when grass does not grow, the farmer opens a door on the side and takes the food out. A machine helps bring it down so the farmer does not have to climb up high.
Silver\n\nSilver is a shiny, white-gray metal. It is soft and can be bent or hammered into thin sheets. People find it in rocks deep under the ground, often with other metals like copper or gold. It is used to make pretty things like rings and necklaces. Long ago, people used it as money to buy food and toys. It is also in some tools we use every day, like forks and spoons. Silver can keep food and water clean because it stops tiny bugs from growing.
Similar\n\nSimilar means two things are almost the same but not exactly. It is like when you have two red apples, but one is bigger and one is smaller. You can find similar things everywhere, like two socks that are both blue but have different stripes. When you draw a picture, it might look similar to your friend's drawing. A dog and a wolf are similar because they both have four legs and fur.
Simple\n\nSimple means something is easy to do or understand. It has no hard parts or tricky steps. You can find simple things all around you, like a plain circle or a short song. When a job is simple, you can finish it fast without help. Tying your shoes is simple once you learn how.
Simple machine\n\nA simple machine is a tool that makes work easier. It changes how hard you push or pull, or the way you move something. There are six kinds of simple machines. One is a lever, like a seesaw at the playground. Another is a wheel and axle, like on a toy car. A pulley is a wheel with a rope, like on a flagpole. An inclined plane is a ramp, like a slide. A wedge is a sharp tool, like a knife. A screw is a twisty nail that holds things together. People use simple machines every day to lift, cut, or move things.
Sinai Peninsula\n\nThe Sinai Peninsula is a big piece of land shaped like a triangle. It has water on two sides: a big blue sea to the north and a warm sea to the south. It is part of Egypt but sits between two big lands called Africa and Asia. Many people visit it to see pretty fish and colorful rocks under the water. A famous tall mountain there is a holy place for some people.
Since\n\nSince is a word that tells us about time. It means from a time in the past until now. You might hear it in a sentence like, "I have been awake since morning." It helps us know when something started. It is a small word, but it does a big job.
Sing\n\nSing is when you make music with your voice. It sounds like a happy tune or a soft lullaby. You can sing in the car, in the bath, or at school with friends. People sing to feel good or to share a story. A bird also sings when it chirps in the morning.
Singapore\n\nSingapore is a small island country in Asia. It is very clean and has many tall buildings and green parks. People call it a Garden City because there are plants and trees everywhere. Many people live there, and they come from different places like China, Malaysia, and India. They speak English and other languages. Singapore is known for being safe and having strict rules.
Singer\n\nA singer is a person who makes music with their voice. They can sing songs that are happy, sad, or fun to dance to. You might see a singer on a stage, on TV, or in a movie. Some singers sing alone, and some sing with a group. When you hear a song on the radio, that is a singer sharing their voice. You can be a singer too when you sing your favorite song.
Singing\n\nSinging is making music with your voice. It makes your voice go high and low to make a tune, which is called a song. You can sing anywhere—in the car, at school, or in the shower. People sing to feel happy, to tell a story, or to share a song with friends. Many birds also sing, like the little robin outside your window. A group of people singing together is called a choir.
Single\n\nSingle means one. It is a word we use when there is only one thing, not two or more. You might see a single apple on a plate, or a single bird in a tree. When you hold up one finger, that is a single finger. It is the opposite of a pair or a group.
Sinhala language\n\nSinhala is a way people talk and write. It is used by many people on an island called Sri Lanka. It has its own pretty letters that look like little drawings. People speak it at home, at school, and with friends. Some words in Sinhala go in a different order than in English. For example, "I go home" becomes "I home go."
Sink\n\nA sink is a bowl that holds water for washing. It has one or two taps where water comes out. You find it in a kitchen or a bathroom at home. People use it to wash hands, cups, or food. When you pull a plug or push a button, the water goes down a hole called a drain.
Sioux\n\nThe Sioux are a group of Native American people. They live in the middle part of the United States. Long ago, they met people who came from Europe. Today, they have two main groups called the Dakota and the Lakota. They have their own ways of talking, singing, and dancing. Some Sioux live on special lands called reservations. They tell stories and make beautiful art with beads and feathers.
Sip\n\nA sip is a tiny drink. It is when you take just a little bit of water, juice, or milk into your mouth. You do not gulp or swallow a lot at once. You can sip from a cup, a straw, or a spoon. When you have hot cocoa, you sip it slowly so you do not burn your tongue. A sip is a good way to taste something new.
Siren\n\nA siren is a made-up creature from old Greek stories. It looks like a woman with a bird body, but today many pictures show it as a mermaid with a fish tail. It lives on an island with big rocks in the sea. It sings a very pretty song that makes sailors want to come close. When the sailors sail near, their boats hit the rocks and break. In one old story, a man named Odysseus put soft wax in his sailors' ears so they could not hear the song. He tied himself to the boat so he could not jump in the water. That way, they all got past the island safely.
Sirius\n\nSirius is a very bright star in the night sky. It looks like a tiny, shiny dot that twinkles. You can see it when the sky is dark and clear. It is one of the closest stars to Earth. Long ago, people in Egypt watched it to know when the river would rise. Some people call it the Dog Star because it sits in a star picture that looks like a big dog. On hot summer days, people say those are the dog days because of this star.
Sister\n\nA sister is a girl who has the same mom and dad as you. She can be older or younger than you. You live in the same house or visit each other often. She might play with you, share toys, or sometimes argue. A sister can be a friend who knows you very well.
Sit\n\nSit is when you bend your legs and put your bottom on a chair, the floor, or a soft cushion. It is a way to rest your body when you are tired. You can sit at a table to eat, draw, or play with toys. A dog can sit when you tell it to, and a cat sits to clean its fur. In school, children sit on a rug to listen to a story.
Site\n\nA site is a place where something is or where something happens. It can be a spot on the ground, like where you build a sandcastle. You might see a site when people are making a new house or a new road. A site can be big or small, and it is a place you can point to with your finger.
Situation\n\nA situation is what is happening right now. It can be a happy time, like a birthday party, or a sad time, like when a toy breaks. You find a situation everywhere—at home, at school, or on the playground. When you see a friend fall down, that is a situation where you can help. It is just a word for the way things are at one moment.
Situation comedy\n\nA situation comedy is a funny TV show. It has the same people in the same place every time. You might see them in a house, a school, or a store. They make you laugh with silly problems and jokes. Many families watch it together after dinner.
Six\n\nSix is a number. It comes after five and before seven. You can count six things, like six apples or six blocks. It looks like a circle with a little tail at the bottom. When you roll a dice, you might see six dots on one side. Many children learn to count to six when they are very young.
Sixteen\n\nSixteen is a number that comes after fifteen. It is one more than fifteen and one less than seventeen. You can count to it on your fingers and toes, but you will need one extra finger from a friend. When you see the number 16, it has a one and a six next to each other. Some kids turn sixteen and get a big party with cake and candles.
Sixty\n\nSixty is a number. It comes after fifty-nine and before sixty-one. It is six groups of ten. You can see it on a clock when the big hand points to the twelve and the little hand points to the six. That means one hour has passed. People also use it to count things like minutes or seconds.
Size\n\nSize is how big or small something is. It can be tiny like a bug or huge like a house. You can see size when you look at two things next to each other. One might be bigger and one might be smaller. When you put on a shirt, you pick a size that fits your body. Shoes also come in different sizes for your feet.
Skate (fish)\n\nA skate is a flat fish that lives in the ocean. It has a body shaped like a kite, with wide fins on each side. It swims near the sandy bottom of the sea. A skate does not have a sharp sting on its tail, but it may have small bumps. It lays eggs in a hard case that people sometimes call a mermaid's purse.
Skateboarding\n\nSkateboarding is riding on a small board with wheels. It has a flat wooden board and four wheels underneath. You can see people doing it at a skate park or on a smooth sidewalk. A person stands on the board and pushes with one foot to move. Some people jump and spin the board in the air. It is important to wear a helmet and pads so you do not get hurt. Many kids and grown-ups like skateboarding for fun.
Skeleton\n\nA skeleton is the hard frame inside your body. It is made of many bones that fit together. It holds up your skin and muscles so you are not flat like a pancake. It also keeps soft parts like your brain, heart, and lungs safe. Your head has a round bone called the skull. Your back has a long line of small bones that help you bend and twist. Your chest has curved bones like a cage around your heart. Your arms and legs have long bones that let you run, jump, and play. You can feel some bones under your skin, like the hard bumps on your wrist or your knee.
Skepticism\n\nSkepticism is a way of thinking where you ask questions and do not believe things right away. It is like a little voice in your head that says, "Is that really true?" When someone tells you a story, you stop and think before you say yes or no. You look for clues and proof, like a detective. For example, if a friend says there is a dragon in the backyard, you might go look first. That is using skepticism. It helps people not get tricked by tall tales.
Ski jumping\n\nSki jumping is a sport where a person on skis slides down a big snowy hill and flies through the air. It happens in winter when there is lots of snow. The skier starts at the top of a tall ramp, goes very fast, and then jumps off the end. While in the air, they lean forward and try to stay up as long as they can. They land on a steep hill far below. People who watch clap for the longest and prettiest jumps. You can see it on TV during the Winter Games.
Skiing\n\nSkiing is a fun way to slide over snow. It uses two long, flat sticks called skis that you wear on your feet. You also wear special boots that click into the skis. There are two main kinds. In downhill skiing, you go down a snowy hill or mountain. The paths have colors to show how hard they are: green is easy, blue is a little hard, and black is very hard. In cross country skiing, you move across flat or bumpy snow, often through quiet woods. Some people race and try to go very fast between colored sticks. Many families go skiing together when it is cold and snowy outside.
Skill\n\nA skill is something you learn to do well. It can be moving your body, like jumping rope or kicking a ball. It can also be thinking, like counting numbers or remembering a song. You get better at it by trying many times. When you first try, it is hard and you make mistakes. After lots of practice, it feels easy and you do not have to think so hard. Some skills are for playing with friends, like taking turns. Other skills are for school, like writing your name. A grown-up or a teacher can show you how and help you get better.
Skin\n\nSkin is the soft cover all over your body. It wraps around you from head to toe. It feels smooth in some places and a little bumpy in others. You can see it on your arms, legs, and tummy. It keeps bad germs out so you stay healthy. It also helps you feel things like a warm hug or a cold ice cube. When you take a bath, you wash your skin to keep it clean.
Skink\n\nA skink is a small animal with smooth, shiny skin. It has tiny legs and a short neck, so it looks a little like a snake. It lives in warm places and likes to dig in the dirt. It hides under rocks or leaves to stay safe. It eats bugs, worms, and sometimes soft fruit. If a bigger animal grabs its tail, the tail can fall off and grow back later. You might see one in a garden or park on a sunny day.
Skip\n\nTo skip is to move with little jumps. It is like a happy walk where you hop from one foot to the other. You can see children skip on the playground or on the sidewalk. It is a fun way to go fast without running. When you skip, your feet leave the ground one at a time, and your arms swing up and down.
Skirt\n\nA skirt is a piece of clothing that hangs down from the waist. It is open at the bottom and covers the legs. You can see skirts in many places like school, parties, or at home. People wear it to look nice or feel cool. A skirt can be long or short, and it can have many colors and patterns. Some skirts are for girls, and some are for boys in different parts of the world.
Skull\n\nA skull is the hard bone that makes up your head. It is round and has holes for your eyes, nose, and mouth. You can feel it under your skin on top of your head. It keeps your brain safe inside, like a strong helmet. It also holds your teeth in place. Without it, your face would not have its shape.
Skunk\n\nA skunk is a small animal with black fur and a white stripe on its back. It has a big, fluffy tail and short legs. It lives in woods and fields, and sometimes near houses. It can make a very stinky spray from under its tail to scare away big animals that might hurt it. It eats berries, bugs, and small animals like worms. Some people see a skunk at night near trash cans looking for food.
Sky\n\nThe sky is the big open space above us. It looks blue on a sunny day. At night, it turns dark blue or black. You can see the Sun, the Moon, and stars in it. Sometimes you see clouds, rain, or a rainbow. Birds and airplanes fly across it. When the Sun goes down, it can turn orange, pink, or red.
Skyscraper\n\nA skyscraper is a very tall building. It has many floors, one on top of the other. You can see it in big cities where many people work and live. It is so tall that it looks like it touches the sky. People use it for offices, shops, and sometimes homes. A famous one is the Empire State Building in New York City.
Slalom skiing\n\nSlalom skiing is a kind of skiing race. It happens on a snowy hill with many poles stuck in the snow. The skier must go left and right around the poles very fast. The poles are close together, so the turns are quick and small. You can see it on TV during the Winter Games. People cheer when the skier goes through the last pole and crosses the finish line.
Slang\n\nSlang is a kind of talking that is not the usual way. It is words that a group of friends make up and use together. You hear it on the playground or at home with your family. It can be a short way to say something, like saying 'wassup' instead of 'how are you'. It can also be a fun new word for an old thing. Over time, some slang words become words that everyone uses.
Slate\n\nSlate is a kind of flat, gray stone. It comes from deep under the ground, where mud gets squeezed and hot for a very long time. It splits into thin, smooth sheets. People use it to make roofs on houses so rain does not get inside. It is also used for floors, chalkboards in schools, and big flat tables for games. You might see it on an old building or a path in a garden.
Slave\n\nA slave is a person who is not free. He must work for another person and cannot leave. He does not get paid for his work. Long ago, some people were taken from their homes and made into slaves. Today, being a slave is wrong and against the law everywhere.
Slavic languages\n\nSlavic languages are a group of ways people talk. They are used in many places like Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic. Some of them use letters that look like the ones in English. Others use letters that look different, with shapes like funny hats and hooks. If you hear someone say "da" for yes, they might be using one of these languages.
Slavs\n\nSlavs are a big group of people. They live in many countries in the middle and east part of Europe. Some also live in Asia. They speak languages that sound a lot like each other. For example, a Polish person and a Slovak person can often understand each other. Many Slavs live in Russia, Poland, and Ukraine. They have their own songs, stories, and foods that they share with their families.
Sled\n\nA sled is a flat thing you sit on to slide over snow or ice. It has no wheels, just smooth runners on the bottom. You can find it in places where it is cold and snowy, like a hill or a snowy park. People push it down a hill and ride it for fun. Some sleds are pulled by dogs or grown-ups. You might see one in a winter story or at a friend's house when it snows.
Sleep\n\nSleep is a time when your body and brain rest. It happens when you close your eyes and lie still for many hours. Most people sleep at night in a soft bed with a pillow and a blanket. While you sleep, your body grows and gets strong again. Your brain also sorts out things you learned during the day. Sometimes you see pictures and stories in your head called dreams. If you do not sleep enough, you feel tired and grumpy the next day. A short sleep in the afternoon is called a nap. Many animals sleep too, like cats and dogs.
Sleepy\n\nSleepy is a feeling you get when your body wants to rest. It makes your eyes feel heavy and your head want to lie down. You feel sleepy at night when it is dark outside. Sometimes you feel sleepy after a big lunch or a long car ride. When you are sleepy, you yawn and stretch your arms. The best way to fix it is to take a nap or go to bed.
Sleeve\n\nA sleeve is the part of a shirt or jacket that covers your arm. It can be long or short. Some sleeves have buttons at the end. You put your arm through it when you get dressed. It keeps your arm warm on a cold day.
Slice\n\nA slice is a thin, flat piece cut from something bigger. It can be a piece of bread, cake, cheese, or fruit. You make a slice by using a knife and moving it back and forth. A slice is often the right size to hold in your hand or put on a plate. At a birthday party, you might get a slice of cake with frosting on top.
Slide\n\nA slide is a fun thing you find at a playground. It has a ladder to climb up and a long, smooth part that goes down. You sit at the top, push off, and whoosh down to the bottom. It can be made of hard plastic or shiny metal. Some slides are straight, and some are twisty. You can find it next to swings and a sandbox. Kids love going down a slide again and again.
Slim\n\nSlim means thin or not wide. A slim person has a body that is not big around. You might see a slim tree with a skinny trunk. Some clothes are made in a slim size so they fit close to the body. A slim book has only a few pages. It is the opposite of thick or fat.
Slime mould\n\nA slime mould is a tiny living thing that moves very slowly. It looks like a soft, wet blob of jelly. You can find it on the forest floor, on dead trees, or in damp, shady places. It crawls around to find tiny bits of food to eat. When it is ready to make new slime moulds, it sends out tiny dust-like specks called spores. These specks float away and grow into new blobs.
Slimy\n\nSlimy means something feels wet and slippery, like a fish or a snail. It can be gooey and sticky, and it might make your hands feel funny. You can find slimy things in a pond, like a frog or wet mud. Some kids like to play with slimy stuff, like homemade slime that stretches and squishes. A banana peel can feel slimy after it sits out too long.
Sling (weapon)\n\nA sling is a simple tool for throwing a stone very far. It has a small pocket in the middle and two long strings. You put a stone in the pocket, hold both strings, and spin it around fast. When you let go of one string, the stone flies out. Long ago, people used it to hunt animals or fight. A boy named David used a sling to stop a big giant. You can still see a sling in old storybooks.
Slingshot\n\nA slingshot is a small toy that can throw a stone very far. It has a Y-shaped stick and a stretchy rubber band. You put a small stone in the rubber band, pull it back, and let go. The stone flies fast through the air. You can find it in a toy store or make one at home with a stick and a rubber band. Many children use it to hit a can or a target in the yard. Always be careful and never aim at a person or an animal.
Slip\n\nA slip is when your foot slides and you almost fall. It happens on wet floors, ice, or a banana peel. When you slip, your body moves fast and you wave your arms to stay up. It can feel scary for a moment. After a slip, you might laugh if you did not get hurt.
Slippery\n\nSlippery means something is very smooth and hard to hold or walk on. It feels like it has no grip. You find slippery things on a wet floor, on ice, or on a banana peel. When something is slippery, it can make you slide or fall down. A bar of soap in the bath is slippery, so you must hold it tight.
Sloth\n\nA sloth is a slow animal that lives in trees. It has long arms, long claws, and soft brown or gray fur. It hangs upside down from branches most of the time. It sleeps a lot during the day and wakes up at night. It eats leaves and flowers, and it moves very, very slowly. When it is on the ground, it crawls in a funny way. But it can swim well if there is water. Its name means slow.
Slovakia\n\nSlovakia is a country in the middle of Europe. It has no sea next to it, only land. It has tall mountains in the north and flat lands in the south. The biggest city is Bratislava. People there use money called the Euro. Many people visit to see old castles and green hills.
Slovenia\n\nSlovenia is a small country in the middle of Europe. It has green hills, tall mountains, and a little bit of sea. The biggest city is called Ljubljana. People there speak a language called Slovenian. They make things like cars and shiny metal to sell to other places. Long ago, different groups of people lived there, and later it was part of a bigger country. Now it is its own country and works with friends in Europe.
Slow\n\nSlow means something takes a long time to move or happen. It is the opposite of fast. A turtle walks slow, and a snail moves even slower. When you walk slow, you take small steps and do not hurry. A slow song has a gentle beat that feels calm. Sometimes being slow is good, like when you eat your food carefully or look at a pretty flower for a long time.
Slow loris\n\nA slow loris is a small furry animal that moves very slowly. It has big round eyes, soft brown or gray fur, and tiny hands that can hold on tight. It lives in trees in warm forests far away in Asia. It comes out at night to look for food like fruit, tree sap, and bugs. It moves one hand at a time and never jumps. A slow loris is quiet and shy, and it hides in the leaves during the day.
Slowly\n\nSlowly means doing something with no rush. It is the opposite of fast. When you walk slowly, you take small steps and move like a turtle. When you talk slowly, you say each word with care. A snail moves slowly on the ground. Sometimes it is good to go slowly so you do not trip or spill your drink.
Small\n\nSmall means something is not big. It takes up very little space. A tiny bug on a leaf is small. A baby's shoe is small. A little seed you plant in the ground is small. You can hold something small in your hand. A pebble on the path is small. A button on your shirt is small. When you look at a big dog and a puppy, the puppy is the small one.
Small intestine\n\nThe small intestine is a long tube inside your belly. It is very thin, like a long, soft straw. It sits between your stomach and a bigger tube called the large intestine. After food leaves your stomach, it goes into the small intestine. There, your body takes out all the good things from the food, like vitamins and energy, to help you grow and play. It is very long—longer than a grown-up is tall—but it is folded up inside you so it fits.
Smallpox\n\nSmallpox is a sickness that makes people very sick. It causes red bumps all over the skin. Long ago, many people got it, but now it is gone. Doctors used a special shot to stop it. No one gets smallpox anymore.
Smart\n\nA smart is a person who can learn things fast. It means you can figure out puzzles, remember stories, and answer hard questions. You might see a smart friend at school who helps the teacher. It is not just about books—you can be smart at building with blocks, drawing, or being kind. When you try your best and keep thinking, you are being smart too.
Smartphone\n\nA smartphone is a small phone that works like a computer. It has a flat screen you can touch with your finger. You can find it in many people's pockets or bags. It lets you call your friends, take pictures, and play games. You might see your mom or dad use one to send a message or look at a map.
Smash\n\nSmash is when something breaks into many small pieces. It can happen when you drop a glass cup on the floor. It makes a loud, sudden noise. You might see a smash when a ball hits a window too hard. After a smash, there are tiny bits all over the place. It is not safe to touch those bits with bare hands.
Smell\n\nSmell is something your nose does. It lets you know what things are like without touching them. You find smells everywhere—in the kitchen, outside, or near flowers. A smell can be nice, like cookies baking, or yucky, like old socks. Your nose helps you enjoy food and warns you if something is bad.
Smelting\n\nSmelting is a way to get metal from a rock called ore. It uses very hot fire to melt the rock. The metal comes out as a hot, shiny liquid. People pour it into shapes and let it cool. This is how we get iron for pots, copper for pipes, and other metals we use every day. Long ago, people learned to smelt and made tools and swords.
Smi\n\nThe Smi are a group of people who live in the far north of Europe. They have their own ways of talking, dressing, and living. Many Smi take care of reindeer, big animals with antlers that live in cold places. They move with the reindeer to find food in summer and winter. A long time ago, some people tried to make the Smi stop using their own words and ways, but today the Smi keep their culture alive.
Smile\n\nA smile is a happy look on a face. It happens when the corners of the mouth go up. You can see a smile when someone is glad or having fun. People smile when they see a friend, get a hug, or hear a funny joke. A smile can make other people feel warm and happy too.
Smith\n\nA smith is a person who works with metal. He uses a hot fire to make the metal soft, then hits it with a hammer to shape it. You might see a smith in an old story or at a fair, making things like horseshoes or tools. He wears a heavy apron to stay safe from sparks.
Smoke\n\nSmoke is a gray or black cloud that rises from a fire. It is made of tiny bits of ash and gas that float in the air. You can see it coming from a candle, a campfire, or a chimney. It can make your eyes sting and make you cough if you breathe it in. Firefighters wear masks to stay safe from it. When you see a lot of it, it means something is burning.
Smoking\n\nSmoking is when a person breathes in smoke from a burning stick called a cigarette. It makes the air smell strong and can make a room look cloudy. Some grown-ups do it outside or in special places. It is not good for the body and can make a person cough. You might see someone smoking on the street or in a movie.
Smoking (cooking)\n\nSmoking is a way to cook food with smoke from a fire. It is used for meat and fish. The smoke makes the food taste strong and yummy. It also helps the food stay good for a longer time. You might see smoked meat at a store or at a picnic. It often looks brown on the outside.
Smoky\n\nSmoky means something has a lot of smoke around it. It looks gray or white and can be hard to see through. You might find a smoky room if someone forgot food on the stove. It can make your eyes sting and make you cough. A campfire can make the air smoky, and the smell sticks to your clothes.
Smooth\n\nSmooth means something feels flat and soft, with no bumps. It is the opposite of rough. You can find smooth things all around you. A stone by the river can be smooth after water rubs it for a long time. A baby's cheek feels smooth when you touch it. Ice cream is smooth when it melts on your tongue. When you slide your hand over a smooth table, your hand moves easily.
SMS\n\nSMS is a way to send short written notes from one phone to another. It is also called a text message. You type words on your phone screen and press send. Then the words pop up on your friend’s phone. It is good when you need to be quiet or share a quick secret. Some phone plans let you send as many as you want.
Snack\n\nA snack is a little bit of food you eat when you are not having a big meal. It can be something crunchy like chips, or sweet like candy, or soft like a muffin. You might eat it in the afternoon after lunch or before dinner. It helps when your tummy feels a little hungry. Some snacks are good for you, like a banana or an apple. Other snacks are just for fun, like a cookie or some popcorn.
Snail\n\nA snail is a small, soft animal that carries a hard shell on its back. It has a long, squishy body and two tiny feelers on its head. You can find it in gardens, parks, or on wet sidewalks after rain. It moves very slowly by sliding on a flat, wet foot. When it gets scared, it pulls its whole body inside the shell to hide. Some snails live in water, and some live on land. You might see a shiny, silvery trail it leaves behind as it moves.
Snake\n\nA snake is a long animal with no legs. It has smooth, shiny skin covered in scales. Snakes live in many places, like forests, water, and hot sandy deserts. It moves by wiggling its body side to side. A snake eats other animals and swallows them whole. Some snakes have a bite that can hurt, but many are safe.
Snap\n\nA snap is a quick, sharp sound you make with your fingers. You press your thumb and middle finger together hard, then slide them apart fast. It makes a little click noise. People snap to keep time with music or to get someone's attention. You can try it yourself—just push your fingers and let go!
Sneeze\n\nA sneeze is a sudden burst of air from your nose and mouth. It happens when something tickles the inside of your nose. It makes a loud sound like "achoo!" and your eyes close for a moment. You cannot stop a sneeze once it starts. It helps push out tiny things that should not be in your nose, like dust. After you sneeze, it is kind to say "excuse me."
Sniff\n\nSniff is when you pull air into your nose to smell something. It is a quick, short breath through the nose. You do it when you want to know what something smells like. For example, you might sniff a flower to smell its sweet scent. A dog sniffs the ground to find a treat. When you have a cold, your nose may be stuffy and you cannot sniff well.
Snooker\n\nSnooker is a game played on a big green table. It has six holes, one in each corner and one in the middle of each long side. Two people play it with long, thin sticks. They hit a white ball to push other balls into the holes. There are 15 red balls and six balls of other colors. Each color gives a different number of points. You must hit a red ball first, then a color, then a red again. The person with the most points wins. You can see snooker on TV in some countries.
Snore\n\nA snore is a loud sound a person makes when they sleep. It comes from the nose or mouth. The sound can be soft like a kitten or loud like a truck. Some people snore when they are very tired. You might hear it if you sleep near someone who snores.
Snow\n\nSnow is frozen water that falls from the sky. It looks like tiny white stars or soft feathers. It comes from clouds when the air is very cold. Snow covers the ground like a white blanket. Children play in it by making snowballs and snowmen. People also slide down hills on sleds. Big trucks called snow plows push it off roads so cars can drive safely.
Snow leopard\n\nA snow leopard is a big wild cat that lives in cold, high mountains. It has thick, soft fur that is gray and white with dark spots. Its tail is very long and fluffy, and it uses it to stay warm like a blanket. It walks on big, furry feet that help it not sink into the snow. It hunts animals like mountain sheep and goats, and it can eat one sheep for two weeks. It lives alone and hides very well among the rocks. You might see a snow leopard in a zoo or in a picture book about animals.
Snowball\n\nA snowball is a round ball made of snow. It is white, cold, and soft. You make it by scooping up snow with your hands and pressing it together. People throw snowballs at each other in a fun game. You can see snowballs in winter when there is snow on the ground.
Snowboarding\n\nSnowboarding is a fun sport on snow. It uses a flat board that you stand on with both feet. The board slides down a snowy hill, like surfing on snow. You wear warm clothes, special boots, and a helmet to stay safe. Some people do jumps and tricks on the board. You can see snowboarding on big mountains or on TV during the winter games.
Snowman\n\nA snowman is a person made of snow. It has a big round body, a smaller round head, and a carrot for a nose. You can build it outside on a cold winter day when there is snow on the ground. People use sticks for arms, stones for eyes, and a scarf to keep it warm. It melts away when the sun comes out and the air gets warm.
Snowy\n\nSnowy means covered with snow. It looks white and soft, like a big blanket on the ground. You see snowy places in winter when it is very cold outside. Snowy hills are fun for sliding down on a sled. A snowy day is a good time to build a snowman with a carrot nose.
So\n\nSo is a small word we use to join ideas together. It helps us say why something happens. For example, "It is cold, so I wear a coat." You hear it in stories and when people talk. It makes sentences flow like a bridge.
So Francisco River\n\nThe So Francisco River is a very long river in Brazil. It is a big, winding line of water that flows through the land. You can find it in South America, far away from here. It gives water to many towns and farms along its sides. People use it to travel by boat and to catch fish. It is so important that some call it the river that brings different parts of the country together.
So Paulo\n\nSo Paulo is a very big city in the country of Brazil. It has many tall buildings, busy streets, and lots of people. You can find it in South America, far from the beach. Many people live there, and they come from different places around the world. It has big parks, shops, and places to play soccer. Some people say it is too crowded and the air can be dirty. But it is an important city where many things happen.
So Tom and Prncipe\n\nSo Tom and Prncipe is a small country made of two big islands. It sits in the warm ocean near Africa. The islands have green hills and dark sand from old volcanoes. Many people there grow cocoa beans to make chocolate. They also catch fish in the sea. The main town is called So Tom, and people speak Portuguese there.
Soap\n\nSoap is a slippery thing that helps you get clean. It can be a solid bar or a soft liquid. You find it near a sink, in a bathroom, or in a kitchen. When you rub it with water, it makes bubbles and foam. The bubbles lift dirt and germs off your skin. Then you rinse with water and the dirt goes away. Soap is made from fat and a special helper called lye. People have used soap for a very long time to wash hands, faces, and clothes.
Soap opera\n\nA soap opera is a story show on TV or radio. It tells a long story that goes on for many days, weeks, or even years. Each day, you see a new part of the story. It often shows families and friends talking, laughing, and sometimes crying. People watch it in the afternoon or evening. Some shows are about a street, a town, or a group of people who live near each other.
Soapy\n\nSoapy means full of soap or like soap. It feels slippery and wet when you touch it. You see soapy water in the sink when you wash your hands. It makes lots of tiny white bubbles that pop when you poke them. A soapy sponge helps clean dirty dishes.
Soccer\n\nSoccer is a game with a round ball. It is played by two teams on a big green field. Each team tries to kick the ball into the other team's net to score a point. You can see kids playing it at a park or on a school field. Many people love to watch it on TV.
Social\n\nSocial means being with other people. It is when you talk, play, or share with friends. You are social at school when you sit with your class and sing songs. At the park, you are social when you take turns on the slide. Being social makes people feel happy and not alone.
Social Class\n\nSocial class is a way to group people by how much money they have. It can also be about the kind of job someone does. Some people have a lot of money and live in big houses. Others have less money and live in smaller homes. Where you live and what your parents do can show your social class. It is not about being good or bad, just different.
Social equality\n\nSocial equality means everyone is treated the same and gets a fair chance. It is like when all kids in class get a turn on the swing. No one is left out because of how they look or where they come from. It helps people feel safe and happy together. When rules are fair for everyone, that is social equality.
Social movement\n\nA social movement is when many people come together to change something. They work as a group because they want to make things better or fairer. You might see them holding signs and walking in the street. They talk about things like how people are treated or rules that should be different. Sometimes they ask leaders to make new rules. It is like when you and your friends all ask for the same snack at school.
Social network\n\nA social network is a group of people who know each other. It is like a big web of friends and family. You can find it in your town, at school, or at a park. People in it talk, play, and help each other. For example, your class at school is a small social network. When someone is sad, others in the network cheer them up.
Social network service\n\nA social network service is a place on the computer or phone where people talk and share. It lets you send words and pictures to friends who are far away. You can also see what your friends are doing and share fun things you like. Many people use it every day to stay close to friends and family. Some of these places are called Facebook and Twitter. It is like a big playground where everyone can play together, even if they are not in the same room.
Social order\n\nSocial order is the way people live together without fighting. It means everyone follows the same rules, like waiting in line or not taking someone else's toy. When there is social order, the world feels safe and calm. You see it at school when kids listen to the teacher and take turns on the slide. At home, it is when your family eats dinner together and helps clean up. Without it, things would be messy and scary.
Social Science\n\nSocial science is about how people live together. It looks at how we talk, play, and help each other. You can see it at school when friends share toys or take turns. It also looks at big groups like towns and cities. People who study social science learn why we have rules and how we make choices.
Social sciences\n\nSocial sciences are ways people study how we live together. It looks at how we talk, play, work, and help each other. People who study it ask many questions and watch what we do. They might ask you what you like to eat or who your friends are. They learn about families, schools, and towns. It helps us understand why people act the way they do.
Social work\n\nSocial work is a job where people help others who are having a hard time. A social worker is a kind helper who listens and finds ways to make life better. They work in places like schools, hospitals, and offices. They help people who do not have a home, enough food, or someone to care for them. They also help kids and families stay safe and happy. It is a job that needs a big heart and a lot of patience.
Socialism\n\nSocialism is a way of sharing things so everyone gets what they need. It means that big things like farms, factories, and trains belong to all the people, not just one person. In this system, workers run the places where they work together. They share the money they make so no one is too rich or too poor. For example, a bakery in socialism would be owned by the bakers, and they would all decide how to share the bread and the coins.
Society\n\nSociety is all the people living and working together. It is like a big team where everyone helps each other. You see it in your town, your school, and your family. People in a society share rules so everyone stays safe and happy. They also share food, toys, and stories. When many people work as one group, they can do big things that one person cannot do alone.
Sociology\n\nSociology is the study of how people live together. It looks at how we make friends, families, and big groups like schools or towns. It helps us see why people act the way they do when they are with others. You can find it in books and in the way people talk and play. It is like a big map of how we all fit together.
Sock\n\nA sock is a soft piece of clothing you wear on your foot. It covers your toes, your heel, and your ankle. Some socks go all the way up to your knee. It is made from soft things like cotton or wool. It soaks up sweat and keeps your foot warm and dry. You can find socks in many colors, like white, black, or blue. Some socks have fun shapes or stripes on them. You put on a sock before you put on your shoe. It helps your foot feel cozy all day long.
Socrates\n\nSocrates was a man who lived a long, long time ago. He asked many questions to help people think. He did not write books, but his friends wrote down what he said. He walked around the city and talked to everyone. He wanted to know what is good and what is true. People still remember him today.
Soda\n\nSoda is a sweet drink with bubbles. It comes in a can or a bottle. You can find it at a store or a party. People drink it when they are thirsty or with a meal. It can taste like orange, grape, or cola. The bubbles tickle your nose when you sip it.
Sofa\n\nA sofa is a big, soft seat for two or more people. It has a long cushion, a back to lean on, and two arms on the sides. You can find it in a living room or a family room at home. People sit on it to rest, read a book, or watch TV. Sometimes a sofa can open up into a bed for sleeping. It is a cozy spot for the whole family to sit together.
Sofia\n\nSofia is a big city where many people live. It is the most important city in a country called Bulgaria. It has old buildings, big schools, and a pretty garden with water that falls down. People work there and go to shows. It sits on a hill, high up, so the air feels cool.
Soft\n\nSoft means something is easy to push in or bend. It feels nice when you touch it, like a pillow or a stuffed bear. You can find soft things in your bed, like blankets and sheets. A soft toy is good to hug when you go to sleep. Soft things do not hurt when you bump into them.
Soft drink\n\nA soft drink is a sweet, bubbly drink. It comes in a can or a bottle. You can find it at a store, a party, or a fast-food place. It has tiny bubbles that tickle your nose when you sip it. Many kids like the taste, but it has a lot of sugar, so it is not good to drink every day. Some common kinds are cola, lemon-lime, and orange.
Softball\n\nSoftball is a game where players hit a ball and run. It is like baseball, but the ball is bigger and the pitcher throws the ball underhand. The game is played on a field with four bases in a diamond shape. Players use a bat to hit the ball and then run to the bases. The team with the most runs wins. You can see softball at a park or school field.
Softly\n\nSoftly means doing something in a gentle, quiet way. When you touch a baby bunny, you do it softly so you do not hurt it. You can also speak softly, like when you whisper a secret. It is the opposite of loud or rough. Many things feel nice when they are done softly, like a hug or a song at bedtime.
Soil\n\nSoil is the ground under your feet. It is made of tiny bits of rock, water, air, and old dead plants. You find it outside in gardens, parks, and fields. It helps plants grow by holding their roots and giving them food and water. Many little animals like worms live in it and make it soft. When you dig in a garden, you see dark, crumbly soil on top.
Solar\n\nSolar means something that comes from the sun. The sun is a big, bright ball of light in the sky. It gives us warm light every day. People use solar power to make lights and machines work. You can see solar panels on some roofs. They look like flat, dark mirrors that catch sunlight.
Solar eclipse\n\nA solar eclipse is when the moon moves in front of the sun. It makes the day go dark for a little while. You can see it in the sky if you are in the right place. People use special dark glasses to look at it so their eyes stay safe. Long ago, some people were scared because they did not know why the sun went away. Now we know it is just the moon blocking the sun's light.
Solar energy\n\nSolar energy is power that comes from the sun. It is warm and bright. You can feel it on your skin on a sunny day. People use it to heat water and cook food. It can also make electricity with special flat panels. These panels sit on roofs or in big fields. The sun gives us this power every day, and it never runs out.
Solar System\n\nThe Solar System is a big family of things in space that move around the Sun. It has the Sun in the middle, and the Sun is a huge, hot ball of light. It gives us light and heat. Around the Sun, there are eight big planets, like Earth. Some planets are made of rock, and some are made of gas. Many planets have moons that go around them. There are also small, icy rocks called comets and many space rocks called asteroids. You can see some of it at night when you look up at the stars and the Moon.
Solar wind\n\nSolar wind is a fast stream of tiny bits that come from the Sun. It is made of very small pieces that we cannot see. It blows out into space and goes very far, past all the planets. When it reaches Earth, our planet's big magnet shield stops most of it. The bits that get through make pretty lights in the sky near the North and South Poles. These lights are called the aurora. Sometimes a big burst of solar wind can cause problems with lights and power on Earth. It also pushes the long, bright tail of a comet away from the Sun.
Soldier\n\nA soldier is a person who works in an army. He wears a special suit called a uniform that is often green or brown. He may carry a big bag and a hard hat to keep safe. A soldier lives and works with other soldiers in a big group. He learns to march, follow orders, and help people. Sometimes he drives big trucks or flies in planes. You might see a soldier in a parade or on TV.
Solid\n\nA solid is something that keeps its own shape. It does not flow or spread out like water. You can hold a solid in your hand, and it feels hard or soft but stays the same. A rock, a toy block, and an ice cube are all solids. When you push on a solid, it pushes back and does not change shape easily. If you heat some solids enough, they melt and turn into a liquid.
Solomon\n\nSolomon was a king a long, long time ago. He was the son of another king named David. People say he was very wise, which means he knew the right thing to do. He built a big, special house for God called a temple. He also wrote parts of a very old book of wise sayings. He had a lot of gold and many helpers, but he made some sad choices too.
Solomon Islands\n\nThe Solomon Islands is a country made of many small islands in the big blue ocean. It has green trees, sandy beaches, and warm water. People live in villages and speak many different languages. Boats are used to travel between the islands. Sometimes the ground shakes there because of earthquakes under the sea.
Solstice\n\nA solstice is a special day that happens two times every year. It is the day when the sun is highest or lowest in the sky. On one solstice, the day is the longest of the year. On the other, the day is the shortest. In summer, the sun stays up late and the day feels long. In winter, the sun goes down early and the day feels short. Long ago, people had big parties on these days. Some of those old parties turned into holidays we still have, like Christmas time.
Solve\n\nTo solve something means to find the answer or fix a problem. When you have a puzzle, you think and try until all the pieces fit. That is solving the puzzle. If your toy breaks, you or a grown-up might find a way to make it work again. That is solving the problem. In school, you solve a math question when you say the right number. Solving makes things better and helps you feel proud.
Somalia\n\nSomalia is a country in Africa. It is a hot, dry place with not much rain. Many people there take care of camels and goats. They move around to find water and grass for the animals. Somalia is near the ocean on one side. A long time ago, people from far away came to buy special things like sweet-smelling tree sap. Today, Somalia is a poor country, and it is working hard to become safer and stronger.
Some\n\nSome is a word we use when we talk about a part of a group. It means a few, but not all. You might say, "I want some cookies," when you see a big plate. It can also mean a little bit, like when you ask for some water. You hear this word every day at home and at school.
Someday\n\nSomeday means a time that is not today. It is a day in the future, but we do not know exactly when. You might say, "Someday I will learn to ride a bike." It can be a happy thought about something you hope will happen. Someday is like a promise you make to yourself for later.
Someone\n\nSomeone is a word for a person when you do not know their name. It can be a boy or a girl, a man or a woman. You might see someone at the park, in a store, or on the street. If you drop your toy, someone might pick it up and give it back to you. It is a way to talk about a person without saying who they are.
Something\n\nSomething is a word we use when we do not know the name of a thing. It can be anything at all—a toy, a sound, or a feeling. You might say, "I hear something outside," when you do not know what made the noise. It is a helper word for things we cannot name yet.
Sometimes\n\nSometimes means not all the time. It is a word we use when a thing happens only on some days, not every day. You might eat ice cream sometimes, but not for every meal. Sometimes the sun is out, and sometimes it hides behind clouds. It is a way to say that things can change.
Somewhere\n\nSomewhere is a word we use when we do not know the exact place. It means a place that is not here. You might say, "My toy is somewhere in my room," when you cannot find it. It can be a place close by or far away. When you go on a trip, you go somewhere new. It is a fun word because it can be any place at all.
Son\n\nA son is a boy who is someone's child. He has a mom and a dad. He might have brothers or sisters. He lives with his family and goes to school. He likes to play with toys and run outside. When he grows up, he will be a man.
Sonar\n\nSonar is a tool that helps people find things deep under the water. It sends out a sound that bounces back when it hits something, like a fish or a big rock. Boats and ships use it to see what is below them in the sea. It can also listen quietly for sounds made by other things in the water. A long time ago, a man put a tube in the water to hear sounds, and that was the first try at using sonar. Now it helps keep boats safe and find fish.
Sonata\n\nA sonata is a long piece of music. It is played on one instrument, or sometimes two instruments together. You can hear it in a big room or a church. The music starts fast, then goes slow, and ends fast again. A short, easy sonata is called a sonatina.
Song\n\nA song is a piece of music with words. It has a tune you can hum and words you can sing. People make songs to share feelings, tell stories, or just have fun. You hear songs on the radio, on TV, or when someone sings to you. A song can be fast and happy, or slow and soft. Some songs are very old and people have sung them for a long time. When two people sing together, it is a duet. When three sing, it is a trio. Sometimes people change the words of a song but keep the tune, just to be silly.
