Songbird\n\nA songbird is a small bird that sings pretty songs. It has two wings, two legs, a beak, and soft feathers. You can find it in trees, gardens, and parks. It sings to tell other birds where it is and to find a friend. A robin is a songbird you might see hopping on the grass.
Sonnet\n\nA sonnet is a short poem. It has 14 lines, and the words at the end of the lines often sound alike. You can find it in books of poems. People read it to feel happy or sad. It can tell a small story about love or a pretty flower. Some sonnets are very old, like the ones by a man named Shakespeare.
Soon\n\nSoon means something will happen in a little bit of time. It is not right now, but you do not have to wait long. When Mom says "dinner will be ready soon," it means you can play for a few more minutes. When a friend says "I will be there soon," it means they are on their way. Soon is a nice word because it tells you something good is coming.
Sore\n\nA sore is a spot on your skin that hurts. It can look red, puffy, or have a little cut. You might get one if you fall and scrape your knee. It can also be inside your mouth if you bite your cheek. A sore feels ouchy when you touch it. It gets better after a few days if you keep it clean.
Sorghum\n\nSorghum is a tall plant that looks like grass. It grows in hot, dry places where other plants have a hard time. People in Africa use it to make food like bread and porridge. It can live without much water, so it helps feed many families when it does not rain.
Sorry\n\nSorry is a word you say when you did something wrong. It is a way to tell someone you feel bad. You can say it with a hug or a sad face. When you bump into a friend, you say sorry. It helps make things better again.
Sort\n\nSort means to put things into groups or order. You can sort your toys by color, like putting all the red blocks together. You can sort by size, putting big things on one side and small things on the other. At home, you might sort socks into pairs after laundry. Sorting helps you find things faster and keeps your room tidy.
Soul\n\nA soul is the part of a person that is not the body. It is the part that thinks, feels, and loves. Many people believe it lives on after the body stops working. Some say it goes to a happy place called heaven. Others say it comes back in a new baby. No one can see a soul or touch it, but many people feel it is real.
Soul music\n\nSoul music is a kind of happy, strong music that makes you want to move. It mixes church songs, blues, and pop. It often has clapping, call-and-answer singing, and a voice that sounds tight and full of feeling. People sing about love, dancing, and life. You might hear it at a party or on the radio when Mom and Dad play old songs.
Sound\n\nSound is something you hear with your ears. It is made when things shake very fast. When you clap your hands, the air shakes and the shaking moves to your ear. Sound can go through air, water, and hard things like a wall. It cannot go through empty space, so astronauts use radios to talk. A big drum makes a low sound, and a little bell makes a high sound. Loud sounds have big shakes, and soft sounds have small shakes. Some sounds are too high or too low for people to hear, but a dog or a bat can hear them.
Sound recording and reproduction\n\nSound recording is a way to save sounds so you can hear them again later. It uses a machine to catch the sound and keep it on a thing like a flat black circle, a tape, or a shiny silver circle. You can find these things at home or in a car. People use it to listen to music, hear stories, or learn new things. When you press play on a music player, you hear a song that was saved before.
Soup\n\nSoup is a warm food you eat from a bowl. It has water and soft bits of vegetables like carrots and potatoes. Some soups also have small pieces of meat. People make it by cooking everything together in a big pot. You can eat it with a spoon. It tastes good on a cold day. Some soups are thin and clear, and some are thick and creamy. You can dip bread or toast into it. A soup you might know is chicken soup or tomato soup.
Sour\n\nSour is a sharp, tangy taste. It makes your mouth pucker up, like when you bite a lemon. You can find it in foods like lemons, limes, and green apples. Some candies are made to be very sour, and kids like to try them. It is one of the main tastes, along with sweet, salty, and bitter.
Source\n\nA source is where something comes from. It is the start of a thing. You can find a source in many places. For example, a river starts at a source high in the hills. When you turn on a tap, the water comes from a source like a big pipe or a lake. A source can also be a person who tells you a story, like when your friend says where they got a toy.
South\n\nSouth is a direction. It is the way you look when you face the sun at lunchtime. On a map, it is at the bottom. Many birds fly south when the weather gets cold. It is the opposite of north.
South Africa\n\nSouth Africa is a country at the bottom of Africa. It has big cities, wide open lands, and many people who speak different languages. You can find lions, zebras, and giraffes living there in special parks. Long ago, people found shiny diamonds and gold in the ground, and today many people still work in mines. The country has a warm sun and a long beach where the ocean water is blue.
South America\n\nSouth America is a big piece of land on our Earth. It is below North America, and a thin strip of water called the Panama Canal sits between them. It has many countries, like Brazil and Argentina. In South America, you can find a huge, wet forest called the Amazon. It is full of tall trees, colorful birds, and animals like monkeys and jaguars. The Amazon River runs through it, carrying more water than any other river. People also grow coffee and find shiny rocks like gold there. Many people visit to see the wild animals and the big forest.
South Asia\n\nSouth Asia is a big part of the world. It is in the south of the big land called Asia. Many countries are there, like India. It has tall mountains, hot dry places, and green fields. Many people there grow food like rice and tea. They also take care of cows and sheep. A big wind called a monsoon brings rain to help the plants grow. When the rain does not come, the land gets very dry.
South China Sea\n\nThe South China Sea is a big part of the ocean near China. It has blue water and many tiny islands. Some islands are so small that no one lives on them. Big boats carry things from one country to another across it. People catch fish in it for food. Many countries say parts of it belong to them.
South Island\n\nSouth Island is a big piece of land in the country of New Zealand. It is the bigger of the two main islands there. It has tall mountains, green forests, and blue lakes. Many people visit it to see the pretty land and to walk on the hills. Some people live there in small towns and cities. It is a quiet place with lots of open space.
South Korea\n\nSouth Korea is a country in East Asia. It is on the bottom half of a piece of land shaped like a tiger's claw. The top half is another country. Many people live in its big city called Seoul. It has tall buildings, busy streets, and old houses with curved roofs. People there eat rice and a spicy pickled cabbage called kimchi with every meal. They also make cars and shiny phones that people use all over the world. A long time ago, a king made a special alphabet so everyone could read and write. Today, children learn that alphabet in school.
South Pole\n\nThe South Pole is the very bottom point of the Earth. It is a place far away where it is always cold and covered in ice. You can find it on the big white land called Antarctica. No people live there all the time, but some scientists stay in a special building to study the ice and sky. The sun shines for half a year without stopping, and then it is dark for the other half. It is hard to get there because it is so cold and windy.
South Sudan\n\nSouth Sudan is a country in Africa. It is a big piece of land with many trees, rivers, and grassy fields. It has no ocean touching its edges, so it is called landlocked. Many people live there, and they speak many different languages. Most people are young. A long river called the White Nile runs through it and makes a huge wet, muddy place called the Sudd. People use oil from the ground to make money, but the country is still very poor. Many years of fighting have broken roads and houses.
Southeast\n\nSoutheast is a direction on a map. It is halfway between south and east. When you look at a map, it is the corner that points down and to the right. The sun rises in the east, so in the morning, southeast is a little to the right of where the sun comes up. Some places have southeast in their name, like Southeast Asia, which is a big group of warm countries far away.
Southeast Asia\n\nSoutheast Asia is a big part of the world. It is a group of many countries near the bottom of Asia. Some of these countries are on the big land, and some are on islands. It is very warm there, with lots of sun and rain. Many people live there, and they grow rice and fruits. You might see a tall coconut tree or a colorful market if you visit.
Southern Africa\n\nSouthern Africa is a big piece of land at the very bottom of Africa. It has hot sun, dry deserts, and green places with trees. Many wild animals live there, like lions, elephants, and zebras. People in Southern Africa speak many different languages and live in cities and small villages. You can find it on a map by looking for the pointy end of Africa.
Southern Ocean\n\nThe Southern Ocean is a big body of water all around the bottom of our world. It is very cold and touches the land of ice called Antarctica. It is one of the biggest oceans on Earth. Many animals like penguins and whales live in it. Big pieces of ice float on top of it. Ships can sail in it, but it is often stormy and icy.
Southern United States\n\nThe Southern United States is a big part of the country. It is in the southeast corner of the map. It has long, hot summers and short, cool winters. A lot of rain falls there, so plants grow well. Farmers grow cotton, peanuts, and peaches. The food in the South is special and different from other places. Some states in the South are Texas, Florida, and Georgia.
Sow bug\n\nA sow bug is a tiny animal with a hard shell. It has fourteen little legs and a flat, gray body. You can find it under wet rocks or old leaves in the garden. It eats dead plants and helps clean up the ground. When it feels scared, some kinds can roll into a tight ball to stay safe.
Soy milk\n\nSoy milk is a white drink made from soybeans. It looks a lot like cow's milk, but it comes from plants, not animals. You can find it in a carton at the grocery store. People pour it on cereal, drink it from a cup, or use it in baking. Some people who cannot drink cow's milk choose soy milk instead. It tastes a little sweet and a little like beans.
Soy sauce\n\nSoy sauce is a dark brown liquid that makes food taste salty and rich. It is made from soy beans, grain, water, and salt. People pour it on rice, noodles, or meat to add flavor. You can find it in many kitchens and on tables at restaurants. It comes in a bottle and smells strong. A little bit goes a long way.
Soybean\n\nA soybean is a small seed that grows on a plant. It is round and can be yellow, green, or brown. Farmers grow it in big fields where the sun is warm. People use it to make many foods like milk, sauce, and soft white blocks called tofu. It has a lot of good stuff that helps your body grow strong. Some people also use it to make oil for cooking. Long ago in China, it was a very special food.
Soyuz (spacecraft)\n\nSoyuz is a spaceship that carries people into space. It has three main parts. One part is where the people sit and come back to Earth. Another part holds food, tools, and a door to join a big space station. The last part has big flat wings that catch sunlight to make power. It flies from a special place in a country far away. Today, it takes people to a big house in space called the Space Station. It stays there so people can come home fast if there is trouble.
Space\n\nSpace is the big, dark place above the sky. It goes on and on without an end. You can see it at night when you look up at the stars and the moon. There is no air in space, so people need a special suit to breathe. Rockets and spaceships can travel through it. Astronauts are people who go into space to learn new things.
Space exploration\n\nSpace exploration is when people send machines or people into the sky to learn about space. It uses big rockets that go very fast and fly high above the clouds. You can see pictures of the Moon, Mars, and faraway stars that came from space trips. People do it to find out what is out there and to see if other worlds have rocks, ice, or air. A long time ago, people first sent a small metal ball called a satellite around Earth. Later, people walked on the Moon and brought back moon rocks. Now, little cars with cameras drive on Mars and send photos home.
Space Shuttle\n\nA Space Shuttle is a big flying machine that went to space. It had three main parts: a plane-shaped part with wings, a big orange tank, and two long white rockets. It took people called astronauts and big boxes of tools up above the clouds. After its trip, the plane part glided back down and landed on a long road like an airplane. You can see a real one in a museum today.
Space station\n\nA space station is a big house that floats in space. It goes around the Earth, high up where the stars are. People called astronauts live inside it for many days or months. They use it to learn what happens to the body in space and to do science tests. Other flying ships can come and bring food, water, and new people. The biggest one in space right now is called the International Space Station.
Spacecraft\n\nA spacecraft is a big machine that flies into space. It can carry people or just machines. It has a strong engine that pushes it up, up, up past the clouds. You can see it on a launch pad before it goes. It helps people visit the moon or send pictures back to Earth. Some spacecraft stay near Earth and send TV signals or tell us about the weather. Astronauts ride inside and wear special suits to stay safe.
Spaceflight\n\nSpaceflight is when a thing made by people goes up into the sky and far past the clouds into space. It can carry people or go up empty. A big, loud rocket pushes it up very fast. Once it is in space, it can fly around our big round Earth or go to the moon. Some spaceflights have people inside, like a special bus that floats. Others have no people and are just machines that take pictures or send phone calls back to Earth. When it comes back down, a big cloth called a parachute helps it land softly.
Spaceship\n\nA spaceship is a big metal car that flies in the sky. It is long and pointy at the top. You can see it at a space museum or in a movie. It takes people way up high, past the clouds, into space. It goes very fast, faster than a plane. An astronaut sits inside and looks out a small round window. From the window, the sky is black and the stars are bright.
Spade\n\nA spade is a tool for digging in the ground. It has a long handle and a flat, sharp metal end. You push it into the dirt with your foot. People use it to make holes for plants or to move soil. You might see one in a garden or at a farm.
Spain\n\nSpain is a country in Europe. It is next to France and Portugal. It has big mountains in the north and long beaches by the sea. Many people live in Spain. They speak Spanish. They eat yummy food like rice with seafood. They also have big parties with music and dancing. The capital city is Madrid. It has a big park and a king's house.
Spanish\n\nSpanish is a way of talking that many people use. It sounds like music with soft and bouncy words. You can hear it in places like Mexico and Spain. People say "hola" to mean hello and "gracias" to say thank you. If you watch a show or listen to a song, you might hear Spanish words.
Spanish Empire\n\nThe Spanish Empire was a big group of lands ruled by Spain long ago. It had many places across the ocean, like parts of America and islands. People from Spain went there on big ships. They built towns and shared their language and food. Today, many people in those places still speak Spanish. You can see old Spanish buildings in some of those lands.
Spanish language\n\nSpanish is a way people talk and write. It sounds like music and has many words. You can hear it in places like Mexico, Spain, and many other countries. Many children learn it at home from their family. Some kids sing songs or count numbers in it. It is one of the most spoken ways of talking in the whole world.
Spanish literature\n\nSpanish literature is all the stories, poems, and plays that people write in the Spanish language. It started a long, long time ago in a country called Spain. It has many kinds of writing, like happy poems, sad poems, and exciting stories. Some of it is for grown-ups, and some is for kids. You can find it in books at the library or at school. One famous story from Spanish literature is about a man who fights windmills because he thinks they are giants.
Spanish moss\n\nSpanish moss is a plant that hangs from tree branches. It looks like long, thin, gray-green hair. You can find it on big trees in warm, wet places like Florida and Texas. It is not a bad plant—it does not hurt the tree. It gets its food and water from the air and rain. Long ago, people used it to stuff car seats and mattresses.
Sparkle\n\nSparkle is a quick, bright flash of light. It looks like tiny stars dancing for just a moment. You can see it on clean water when the sun shines, or on a shiny ring. It makes things look pretty and full of light. A diamond often has a sparkle that catches your eye.
Sparkly\n\nSparkly means something shines with many tiny, quick lights. It looks like little stars are dancing on it. You can see sparkly things on a princess dress, a birthday card, or a clean window in the sun. Glitter and shiny stickers are sparkly too. When light hits it, it twinkles and makes you smile.
Sparrow\n\nA sparrow is a small bird. It has brown and gray feathers, a short tail, and a small strong beak. You can see it near houses, in cities, and on farms. It eats seeds and tiny bugs. It builds its nest in holes in walls or trees. Many sparrows live together in a group called a flock.
Sparrowhawk\n\nA sparrowhawk is a small bird that hunts other birds. It has short, wide wings and a long tail that help it fly between trees. The boy sparrowhawk has a blue-gray back and orange stripes on its chest. The girl is bigger and has brown feathers with brown stripes. It lives in woods, gardens, and towns in Europe, Asia, and Africa. It catches small birds like sparrows and finches to eat. It builds a nest from twigs high in a tree. The mom lays four or five pale blue eggs. After the babies hatch, they stay in the nest for about a month. Some people train it to hunt with them, but it is hard to teach.
Sparta\n\nSparta is a very old city in a land called Greece. It sits in a valley with tall mountains on both sides. Long ago, it had a strong army with brave fighters. Today, it is a small, quiet town. People visit to see old stones and learn about its past.
Speak\n\nSpeak is when you use your voice to say words. It is how people talk to each other. You move your mouth and tongue to make sounds. When you speak, someone else can hear you and understand what you think or feel. You speak to your friends when you play, and you speak to your teacher at school. Even a baby learns to speak by listening to grown-ups.
Speaker\n\nA speaker is a box that makes sound. It has a round part inside that moves back and forth very fast. You can find it in a phone, a TV, or a radio. It plays music, voices, and other sounds so you can hear them. When you listen to a song on a tablet, the sound comes out of a speaker.
Spear\n\nA spear is a long stick with a sharp point at one end. It is used to poke or throw at something far away. Long ago, people used it to hunt big animals for food. Some spears are light so a person can throw them. A very long spear can help a person on the ground stop a person on a horse. You might see a spear in a picture book about knights or old times.
Special\n\nSpecial means something is not like the others. It is a word we use when a thing or a person is very good or very important. You might have a special toy that you love the most. A birthday is a special day because it is only for you. When someone does something kind, we say that person is special. It feels warm and happy to be special.
Special effect\n\nA special effect is a trick that makes a movie look like something is real when it is not. It can be a tiny model that looks big on the screen, or a picture made by a computer. People use it to show things that are too hard, too costly, or too scary to do for real. For example, a movie might show a big ship on fire, but it is really a small toy ship that is safe to burn. You can see it in cartoons and in movies about space or monsters.
Species\n\nA species is a group of living things that are the same kind. It can be animals, like dogs, or plants, like roses. All the things in one species look alike and can have babies together. For example, all pet cats are one species. They have kittens that grow up to be cats too. You can find different species everywhere—in your backyard, at the park, or in the zoo.
Speech\n\nSpeech is how people talk to each other using words. It comes from sounds made in the throat and shaped by the mouth, tongue, and lips. People use speech to share ideas, ask for things, and tell stories. You hear speech when a friend says hello, when a teacher reads a book, or when you sing a song. Only people can use speech, but some animals make sounds to share simple things too.
Speed\n\nSpeed is how fast something moves. It tells you how much ground a thing covers in a short time. You see it when a car goes down the street or when you run in the park. A fast runner has more speed than a slow walker. If you ride a bike, you can feel the wind when your speed is high. The fastest thing in the world is light.
Speed of light\n\nThe speed of light is how fast light moves. It is the fastest thing in the whole world. Nothing can go faster than it. Light from the sun takes about eight minutes to reach us. When you turn on a lamp, the light fills the room right away because it moves so fast.
Speed of sound\n\nThe speed of sound is how fast a sound moves from one place to another. It moves through the air, but you cannot see it. In warm air, it goes very, very fast — faster than any car or plane you know. It moves even faster through water and hard things like metal. Sound cannot move through empty space where there is no air at all. When something goes faster than sound, it makes a loud boom, like a big pop in the sky.
Speed skating\n\nSpeed skating is a race on ice. People wear special shoes with long, thin blades on the bottom. They skate very fast around a big oval track. Two skaters go at the same time, and the faster one wins. You can see it on TV during the Winter Olympics. Some kids learn to speed skate at an ice rink near home.
Spell\n\nA spell is a set of magic words or actions. It is like a secret recipe that makes something special happen. In stories, a witch or a wizard says a spell to turn a pumpkin into a carriage or to make a broom fly. You might see a spell in a fairy tale book or a cartoon. When someone casts a spell, they wave a wand or say funny words, and then something changes. It is not real, but it is fun to pretend.
Spend\n\nSpend means to use money to buy something. When you give a coin to get a toy, you spend it. People spend money on food, clothes, and fun things. At the store, you see a price tag, and you spend that much to take the item home. You can also spend time, like when you play outside for an hour.
Sperm whale\n\nA sperm whale is a very big animal that lives in the ocean. It has the biggest head of any animal, and its head is about one third of its whole body. It has a small lower jaw with big, pointy teeth. It eats meat, mostly squid and fish, and it dives very deep to find food. It can stay under the water for two hours. It makes clicking sounds to find things in the dark water, and it listens for the echo that bounces back. This helps it hunt and talk to other whales.
Sphere\n\nA sphere is a round shape that is not flat. It looks like a ball. Every spot on the outside is the same space from the middle. You can find it in many places. A basketball is a sphere. A marble is a sphere too. The Earth is a very big sphere. The Sun is a sphere that is far away and very hot.
Sphinx\n\nA sphinx is a made-up creature from old stories. It has the head of a person and the body of a big cat called a lion. Some also have wings like a bird. In very old Greek tales, it was mean and would ask hard questions. If someone could not answer, it would hurt them. In old Egypt, people thought it was kind and strong. They built big stone statues of it to guard special places like pyramids. You can see a very big one in pictures of Egypt, with a person's head and a lion's body lying in the sand.
Spice\n\nSpice is a powder or tiny piece from a plant that makes food taste yummy. It can be brown, yellow, red, or orange. You find it in small jars in the kitchen. People shake it or spoon it into food while cooking. Cinnamon is a spice that tastes sweet on toast. Some spices make food a little hot, like the red one on tacos.
Spicy\n\nSpicy is a hot, tingly feeling you get in your mouth when you eat some foods. It can make your tongue feel warm or like tiny tickles. You find it in foods like hot peppers, salsa, or some soups. People add spicy things to make food taste strong and exciting. A food many kids know is pepperoni on pizza — it can be a little spicy. If you eat something too spicy, drinking milk can help cool your mouth down.
Spider\n\nA spider is a small animal with eight legs. It has a body with two round parts. Many spiders make a sticky thread called silk. It uses the silk to build a web. The web helps it catch bugs to eat. You can find a spider in a garden, in a house, or in the woods. It hides in corners or under leaves. Some spiders are tiny, and some are big and hairy.
Spider monkey\n\nA spider monkey is a small monkey that lives in trees. It has long arms, long legs, and a very long tail. The tail can grab branches like an extra hand. It lives in warm, rainy forests far away. It swings and jumps from tree to tree and almost never comes down to the ground. It eats fruit, nuts, and leaves. A spider monkey stays with a big group of other monkeys.
Spill\n\nA spill is when a liquid falls out of its cup or bottle by accident. It can be water, milk, juice, or paint. You might see a spill on the table, on the floor, or on your shirt. When something spills, it makes a mess that is wet. You can clean it up with a cloth or a paper towel. If you knock over your cup at lunch, that is a spill.
Spin\n\nSpin means to turn around and around very fast. It is like when a top goes round on the floor. You can spin your body by twirling with your arms out. A wheel on a bike spins when you ride. A merry-go-round at the park spins too. When something spins, it does not move far away—it stays in one spot and turns.
Spin (physics)\n\nSpin is a tiny thing that some very small bits of stuff have. It is not like a top that turns around. It is more like a tiny, hidden arrow that points one way. You cannot see it, but it is always there. It makes the tiny bit act like a very small magnet. Scientists use big tools to find it. They call it spin, but it does not really spin.
Spinach\n\nSpinach is a green vegetable with big, soft leaves. It grows from the ground in gardens or farms. People eat it in salads, soups, or cooked on its own. It is very good for your body and helps you grow strong. Some kids see it in cartoons where it gives a sailor man big muscles.
Spinal cord\n\nThe spinal cord is a long, soft rope of nerves inside your back. It runs from your brain down through the bones of your spine. It carries messages between your brain and your body. When you touch something hot, it sends a fast message to your brain so you pull your hand away. It also helps you move your arms and legs when you want to run or jump. The bones around it keep it safe, like a helmet for your back.
Spine\n\nA spine is a long row of small bones that runs down the middle of your back. It goes from your neck all the way to your bottom. You can feel it if you touch the middle of your back. It holds your body up so you can stand and sit tall. Inside it, there is a soft cord that helps your brain talk to the rest of your body. That is why you can move your arms and legs. Many animals, like dogs and cats, also have a spine.
Spiral galaxy\n\nA spiral galaxy is a big group of stars that looks like a pinwheel. It has a bright, round middle and long, curvy arms that spin around slowly. You can see pictures of it in space books or on TV. It holds many stars, glowing clouds, and a very heavy, dark spot at the center. Our own star home, the Milky Way, is a spiral galaxy. When you look up at a dark night sky, the fuzzy band of light you see is part of its arms.
Spirituality\n\nSpirituality is a feeling deep inside you. It is about what makes life feel big and special. Some people find it when they pray or go to a quiet place. Others feel it when they look at a starry sky or help a friend. It can make a person feel calm and happy. You do not need a church to have it. It is like a warm light in your heart.
Splash\n\nA splash is what happens when something hits water fast. It makes water jump up and fly into the air. You can see it when you jump into a pool or when a big rock falls into a lake. It makes a loud, happy sound and little drops go everywhere. After the splash, the water moves in rings that get bigger and bigger.
Spleen\n\nThe spleen is a small body part inside you. It is on the left side, under your ribs, near your tummy. It looks like a soft, squishy fist. It helps keep your blood clean by taking out old, tired blood cells. It also helps your body fight off germs when you get sick. If it gets hurt, a doctor must fix it right away.
Sponge\n\nA sponge is a soft thing full of tiny holes. It can soak up water like a thirsty towel. You find it in the kitchen or bathroom for cleaning dishes and spills. When you squeeze it, water comes out. Some sponges come from the sea, but many are made in a factory. It feels squishy and light in your hand.
Sponge (tool)\n\nA sponge is a soft tool that helps you clean things. It has many tiny holes all over it. You can find it in the kitchen or the bathroom. When you rub it on a dirty plate with some water, the dirt comes off. Some sponges come from the sea, but most are made by people in a factory. A dolphin can even use a sea sponge to help it find food.
Spoon\n\nA spoon is a tool that helps you eat. It has a small round bowl at one end and a long handle to hold. You can find it in the kitchen at home. People use it to eat soft foods like soup, yogurt, and ice cream. It can also stir things in a cup. A big spoon for serving food is called a ladle. Some people even click two spoons together to make music.
Sport\n\nSport is a game where people move their bodies and try to win. It can be played inside or outside, alone or with a team. Some sports use a ball, like soccer or basketball. Other sports use a bat, a racket, or just your own two feet. People run, jump, throw, and catch when they play. Doing sport makes your body strong and your heart happy. Many children play sport at school or in a park with friends. A grown-up called a coach helps them learn the rules and get better. Some people like to watch sport on TV or go to a big field to see it live. They cheer and clap for the players.
Sport Of Athletics\n\nAthletics is a group of sports where people run, jump, or throw things. It includes races on a track, jumping over a high bar, and throwing a heavy ball far away. You can see it at a big stadium with lots of seats. People do it to see who is the fastest or strongest. Many kids try it at school on sports day.
Spot\n\nA spot is a small round mark on something. It can be a different color than the rest of the thing. You might see a spot on a shirt, on a dog's fur, or on a piece of paper. Some spots are made by food or paint. You can try to wash a spot off with water and soap. A ladybug has black spots on its red back.
Spray\n\nA spray is a bunch of tiny drops that fly through the air. It looks like a soft, wet cloud. You can see it when you push the top of a spray bottle. It helps spread water, perfume, or cleaner over a big space. Sometimes you see a spray when a whale blows water out of its head.
Spread\n\nA spread is something soft you put on bread or a cracker. It can be sweet like jam or honey. It can also be creamy like butter or cheese. You use a knife to scoop it and smooth it over the bread. Many people eat a spread for breakfast or a snack. Peanut butter is a spread that kids love.
Spreadsheet\n\nA spreadsheet is a computer tool that looks like a big paper with many little boxes. It has rows that go side to side and columns that go up and down. People use it to write numbers and words in the boxes. It can do math for you, like adding up how much your toys cost. It can also make a picture from the numbers, like a pie chart. You might see a spreadsheet when a grown-up works on a computer at home or at an office.
Spring\n\nSpring is a time of year when the weather gets warm. It comes after winter and before summer. In spring, flowers start to grow and trees get new green leaves. You can see baby animals like chicks and bunnies. Many people go outside to play because the sun feels nice.
Spring (device)\n\nA spring is a twisty piece of metal. It looks like a curly snake or a slinky toy. You can push it down and it gets small. When you let go, it pops back up to its first shape. Some springs are in pens, so the tip goes in and out. Big springs are under cars to make the ride soft and bouncy.
Spring (season)\n\nSpring is a time of year that comes after winter. It gets warmer, and the days get longer. You see new green leaves on trees and bright flowers pop up from the ground. Rain falls often, which helps plants grow. Many baby animals are born in spring, like little birds and bunnies. People like to play outside more because the sun feels nice. Some holidays like Easter happen in spring. At school, you might have a spring break when you get to stay home for a few days.
Spring (water)\n\nA spring is a place where water comes out of the ground all by itself. It can be a small pool or a wet spot on a hill. Sometimes the water flows out all year, and sometimes only after rain or when snow melts. The water from it often runs downhill and can start a little river. Some springs have water that people think is good for the body. Long ago, people built towns near these springs so sick people could come and feel better.
Springtail\n\nA springtail is a tiny animal with six legs. It has no wings and a soft body. It lives in wet dirt and under leaves. It eats tiny bits of old plants and tiny living things in the soil. It can jump very far when something scares it. You might see one if you dig in the garden after rain.
Spruce\n\nA spruce is a tall tree with green needles that stay on all year. It has a pointy top and looks like a big cone. You can find it in cold places where snow falls. People use it as a Christmas tree and put lights on it. Its wood is used to make paper and houses.
Square\n\nA square is a flat shape with four sides. All four sides are the same length. It has four corners that look like the corner of a book. You can find squares on a checkerboard or on a window with small panes. A square is like a box you draw on paper. It is also the face of a cube, like a block you play with.
Squash (plant)\n\nA squash is a plant that grows a big, round or long fruit we can eat. It has a hard outside skin and soft inside with seeds. You can find it in a garden or at a food store. People cook it to make soup, pie, or just eat it warm. A pumpkin is a kind of squash you might see at Halloween.
Squash (sport)\n\nSquash is a game for two people. It is played inside a room with four walls. Each player holds a light racket and hits a small rubber ball. The ball must hit the front wall before it bounces twice on the floor. Players take turns hitting the ball. A point is won when the other player cannot reach the ball in time. The first player to get 11 points wins the game, but they must win by two points. You might see people playing squash at a sports center or gym.
Squeak\n\nA squeak is a short, high, tiny sound. It is like a little peep or a soft cry. You can hear it when a mouse runs across the floor. A door that needs oil can also make it when it opens. A squeaky toy makes this sound when you squeeze it. It is a sound that is quick and light, not loud or deep.
Squeeze\n\nSqueeze means to press something hard with your hands. It can make a thing smaller or push something out. You squeeze a tube of toothpaste to get the paste out. You squeeze a sponge to get the water out. A hug is a gentle squeeze with your arms. You can squeeze a lemon to get juice for your drink.
Squid\n\nA squid is a soft sea animal with many arms. It has eight short arms and two long arms with little cups that stick. It lives deep in the ocean. It moves by pushing water out of its body, like a fast jet. It can change its skin color to hide from bigger animals. Some squids are very small, but a few are as big as a school bus. People sometimes see them in books about sea monsters.
Squirrel\n\nA squirrel is a small, furry animal with a big, bushy tail. It has four legs, sharp claws, and two bright eyes. You can see it in parks, woods, and sometimes in your backyard. It climbs trees very fast and jumps from branch to branch. It eats nuts, seeds, and berries. In the fall, it hides food in the ground to eat later when it is cold. A squirrel makes a nest of leaves high up in a tree to sleep and keep its babies safe.
Squishy\n\nSquishy is a word for something soft and easy to press. It feels like a sponge or a soft toy. When you push it with your finger, it goes flat and then pops back up. You can find squishy things in a toy store, like a squishy ball or a squishy animal. Many kids like to hold a squishy thing because it feels nice in their hand.
Sri Lanka\n\nSri Lanka is a warm island country in the big blue sea. It is shaped like a tiny teardrop near India. On its flag, a golden lion holds a sword. Many people there grow tea leaves on green hills. You can see elephants walking on the roads. It has sandy beaches where children play in the waves.
Stable\n\nA stable is a small house for big farm animals. It has walls, a roof, and a door. Inside, it is split into little rooms called stalls. Each animal gets its own stall to sleep in. You can find a stable on a farm, near the farmer's house. It keeps animals like horses and cows warm and dry. Up high, there is a space to store hay for them to eat. A long time ago, a very special baby was born in a stable and slept on soft straw.
Stack\n\nA stack is a pile of things put one on top of another. It looks like a tower that gets taller as you add more. You can find a stack in many places, like a stack of books on a table or a stack of blocks in a playroom. People make a stack to keep things neat and save space. When you put one more block on top, the stack grows. If you take one from the top, it gets smaller.
Stadium\n\nA stadium is a very big building where many people sit and watch a game or a show. It has lots and lots of seats all around a big open field in the middle. You can find a stadium in a big city. People go there to see football, baseball, or running races. Sometimes a stadium has a name from a store or a company, like a toy store name. An arena is a smaller stadium that is inside, with a roof. People use an arena for basketball, ice hockey, or music shows.
Stage\n\nA stage is a big, flat floor that is raised up high. It is where people sing, dance, or act out a story. You can find it in a school, a park, or a big room with many chairs. When you watch a play, the actors stand on it so everyone can see them. Sometimes it has big red curtains that open and close.
Stage (theatre)\n\nA stage is a big, flat floor where actors stand and perform. It is usually made of wood and is higher than the floor where people sit. You find it inside a theatre, at the front of the room. Actors use it to act out stories, sing songs, or dance. When you watch a school play, the children stand on a stage so everyone can see them.
Stainless steel\n\nStainless steel is a strong, shiny metal. It looks silver and smooth. You can find it in your kitchen as forks, spoons, and knives. It does not get red and flaky like some other metals when it gets wet. People use it to make pots, sinks, and even parts of big airplanes. It stays clean and bright for a long time.
Stair\n\nA stair is a set of steps that helps you go up or down. It has flat parts where you put your feet, and each flat part is a little higher than the one before. You find it inside houses, schools, and stores. People use it to walk from one floor to another. A stair can be made of wood, stone, or metal. When you climb it, you hold onto a rail to stay safe.
Stairs\n\nStairs are steps that help you go up or down. They are made of flat parts where you put your feet. You find stairs inside houses, schools, and big buildings. People use them to move from one floor to another. Some stairs go straight, and some turn at a corner. A railing on the side helps you hold on so you do not fall. You may have seen stairs at home or at the park.
Stamp\n\nA stamp is a small, sticky paper picture. It has a pretty design on the front and glue on the back. You put it on a letter or a postcard before you mail it. It shows that you paid to send the mail. You can buy stamps at the post office. Some people collect stamps in a book because they like the pictures.
Stand\n\nA stand is a thing that holds something up. It can be made of wood, metal, or plastic. You might see a stand in a store holding fruit or in a park holding a sign. It keeps things from falling over. A music stand holds paper so a person can read while playing.
Stand-up comedy\n\nStand-up comedy is a show where one person tells funny stories and jokes to a crowd. It uses a small stick that makes the voice loud, so everyone can hear. You can see it in a club, a big room with a stage, or even at a school. The person on stage talks fast and makes people laugh with silly words and faces. Sometimes they also play a little song or do a trick. Many people go to watch stand-up comedy to have a happy time with friends.
Standard\n\nA standard is a rule or a way of doing something that many people agree on. It helps things work the same way in different places. For example, a red light always means stop, and a green light means go. That is a standard rule for traffic. In school, raising your hand before you speak is a standard way to take turns. Standards make it easier for everyone to understand each other and stay safe.
Standard Model\n\nThe Standard Model is a big idea that scientists use to understand the tiny bits that make up everything. It is like a list of very small building blocks. Some of these blocks are called quarks and electrons. They are too small to see, even with a strong looking glass. Scientists use the Standard Model to guess how these tiny bits move and stick together. It helps them explain why the sun shines and why things have weight.
Star\n\nA star is a big, bright ball of hot gas in the sky. It looks like a tiny, twinkling light at night. You can see many stars when the sky is dark and clear. The Sun is a star too, but it is much closer to us, so it looks big and warm. Stars give off light and heat. Long ago, people used stars to tell stories and find their way.
Star cluster\n\nA star cluster is a big family of stars that stay close together. It looks like a bright, sparkly patch in the night sky. You can see some star clusters with just your eyes when the sky is dark and clear. The stars in it were born at the same time, so they are like brothers and sisters. One famous star cluster is called the Pleiades. It has seven bright stars that shine like tiny diamonds.
Star formation\n\nStar formation is how a new star is born. It starts inside a big, dark cloud of dust and gas in space. The cloud is very cold and full of tiny bits. Over a long time, the cloud pulls itself together into a hot, round ball. That ball gets hotter and brighter until it shines like the Sun. You can see stars at night, and each one began this way.
Star system\n\nA star system is a group of stars that move around each other. They stay together because a strong pull holds them tight. You can see some star systems in the night sky, like the bright star Sirius. A system with two stars is called a binary star. Sometimes there are three or more stars all moving as one family. They are like a space dance that never stops.
Starch\n\nStarch is a white powder that comes from plants. It has no taste and no smell. You can find it in foods like bread, potatoes, pasta, and beans. It helps make sauces thick when you cook. It also gives your body energy to run and play. Some people use it to make clothes feel smooth and stiff.
Starfish\n\nA starfish is a sea animal that looks like a star. It has five arms, or sometimes more, that grow out from a round middle. It lives on the floor of the ocean, in deep water or near the shore. It moves slowly on tiny tube feet under its arms. It eats clams and other animals with shells by pulling the shell open and pushing its stomach inside. If it loses an arm, it can grow a new one. You might see a dry starfish at the beach or in a book about the sea.
Starling\n\nA starling is a small bird with dark, shiny feathers and tiny white spots. It has strong feet and flies fast and straight. You can see it in parks, gardens, and cities, often in big groups. It eats bugs and fruit, and it looks for food by poking its beak into the ground. In the evening, many starlings fly together in a big, twisting cloud before they sleep.
Start\n\nTo start means to begin something. It is the very first part of doing a thing. When you push a button and a toy makes a sound, you start the toy. At school, the teacher says "let's start" before a lesson. In a race, a loud noise tells everyone to start running.
State\n\nA state is a group of people who live in one place and have leaders who make rules for everyone. It has a piece of land with clear lines around it, called borders. You can find a state on a map, like the place where you live. The leaders keep people safe, make laws, and help things run smoothly. For example, the United States is a big state made of many smaller states that work together.
State Of Matter\n\nA state of matter is how a thing feels and acts. It can be hard like a rock, wet like water, or light like the air we breathe. You can find all three in your kitchen: ice is hard, water is wet, and steam from a pot is light. When you heat ice, it turns into water. When you heat water, it turns into steam. That is how one thing can change its state.
Statement\n\nA statement is a group of words that tells something. It can be a short sentence like "The sky is blue" or a longer one. People use statements every day when they talk or write. A statement shares a fact, a thought, or a feeling. For example, when a child says "I am hungry," that is a statement. It helps others know what is in your mind.
States of matter\n\nStates of matter are the ways things can be. There are four main kinds: solid, liquid, gas, and plasma.\n\nA solid is hard and keeps its shape. Ice is a solid. A liquid is wet and takes the shape of its cup. Water is a liquid. A gas is like air and spreads out to fill a room. Steam from a hot bath is a gas. Plasma is a hot, bright gas that makes lightning and stars glow. Heat can change one state into another. When ice gets warm, it melts into water. When water gets very hot, it turns into steam.
Station\n\nA station is a place where people wait for a train or a bus. It has a long, flat floor next to the tracks or the road. You can find a station in a city or a town. People go there to get on a ride and go somewhere else. It often has a roof to keep you dry when it rains. You might see a station near your house or on a trip with your family.
Statistic\n\nA statistic is a number that tells us something about a group. It helps us see how many, how much, or how often something happens. For example, if we count how many kids in class like apples, that number is a statistic. People use statistics to learn about the world, like how many people live in a city or how many rainy days there are in a year. You might see a statistic in a book with a picture of a bar chart or a pie chart.
Statue\n\nA statue is a shape of a person or an animal. It is made from hard stuff like stone, metal, or wood. You can see a statue in a park, a museum, or a big city square. People make it to remember someone important or to make a place look pretty. Some statues are very big, like the tall lady with a torch in New York.
Statue of Liberty\n\nThe Statue of Liberty is a very big statue of a woman. It stands on an island near New York City. It is made of copper, so it looks green. She holds a torch up high in one hand and a stone book in the other hand. She wears a crown with seven points. Long ago, people on boats saw it first when they came to America. It was a gift from France to say 'we are friends.' Today, many people visit it and look up at it from the ground.
Stay\n\nStay means to keep being in one place and not go away. When you stay, you do not move to a new spot. You can stay at home with your family. You can stay sitting on the floor while you play. A dog might stay when you tell it to. It is the opposite of leaving.
Steady\n\nSteady means something stays the same and does not change much. It is like holding your hand still without shaking. A steady light does not blink on and off. When you walk slowly and do not fall, you are steady. A steady friend is someone who is always there for you.
Steal\n\nSteal means to take something that is not yours. It is when a person picks up a toy, a cookie, or money without asking. Stealing is not nice and can make the other person sad. If you see someone steal, you should tell a grown-up. It is always better to ask before you take something.
Steam\n\nSteam is water that has turned into a hot, see-through gas. It comes out when water gets very, very hot and starts to bubble. You can see it rise from a pot on the stove when Mom or Dad cooks. It is so hot that it can burn you, so you must stay back. People use it to push big machines like old trains. It also helps cook soft foods like rice and vegetables.
Steam engine\n\nA steam engine is a big machine that uses hot steam to move. It has a metal box called a boiler where water gets very hot from a fire. The hot steam pushes on a part that goes back and forth. That moving part can turn wheels or work other machines. Long ago, it pulled trains on tracks and pushed big boats on water. Today, some places still use it to make power for lights and homes.
Steam locomotive\n\nA steam locomotive is a big train that runs on tracks. It has a long body, a tall chimney on top, and big round wheels. Inside, it burns coal to make hot steam. The steam pushes a metal arm that turns the wheels. Long ago, it pulled many trains with people and heavy things. Today, you can still see one at a train museum or in an old movie.
Steamboat\n\nA steamboat is a big boat that moves on water. It has a special engine that uses hot steam to turn a wheel or a fan under the water. Long ago, many steamboats had big round wheels on the sides or at the back. You could see them on rivers, carrying people and boxes from one town to another. Today, most boats use a different kind of engine, so you do not see steamboats very often. You might see a picture of one in a storybook about old times.
Steel\n\nSteel is a very strong metal. It is made by mixing iron with a little bit of carbon. It looks shiny and silver. People make steel in big buildings called steel mills. It is used to build tall buildings, long bridges, cars, and ships. When a steel thing gets old, it can be melted and made into something new.
Steep\n\nSteep means something goes up or down very fast, like a big hill. It is hard to walk up a steep hill because your legs get tired. A steep slide at the park goes down fast and feels exciting. You can see steep roofs on houses that look like a tall triangle. A steep mountain is very high and hard to climb.
Stegosaurus\n\nStegosaurus is a big animal that lived a long, long time ago. It had a small head, a round body, and a tail with sharp spikes. On its back, it had big flat plates that stood up. It walked on four legs, but its front legs were shorter than its back legs. It ate only plants that grew low to the ground. You can see its bones in a museum, and it looks like a giant puzzle.
Stem\n\nA stem is the long, thin part of a plant that holds it up. It is like the plant's back. It grows from the ground and reaches up toward the sun. Leaves and flowers grow from it. You can see a stem on a rose or a sunflower. It carries water and food from the roots to the rest of the plant.
Step\n\nA step is one move of your foot when you walk. It is the space between one foot and the next. You take many steps to go from one place to another. When you climb stairs, you put your foot on each step. A step can be big or small. You can count steps when you play a game like hopscotch.
Stepfamily\n\nA stepfamily is a family that grows when a parent marries someone new. It has a mom or dad, a new grown-up partner, and sometimes new brothers or sisters. You might live with them all in one house. The new grown-up is called a stepmom or stepdad. They love you and take care of you, just like your first family. Sometimes you visit one home and then another, and both places are your family.
Stepmother\n\nA stepmother is a woman who marries your dad after your mom is not with him anymore. She is part of your family now. She may live in your house and take care of you. She can read you stories, help you get dressed, and make you snacks. Sometimes she brings new brothers or sisters too. She is not the mom who gave birth to you, but she can love you just the same.
Steppe\n\nA steppe is a big, flat land with no trees. It has lots of grass and small bushes. You can find it in faraway places like Russia and Mongolia. People who live there move around with horses and animals. They live in big round tents that are easy to pack up. Cowboys in America also rode horses on a steppe to take care of cows.
Stethoscope\n\nA stethoscope is a tool that doctors use to listen to your body. It has a long tube that splits into two parts for the ears. At the other end is a round piece that the doctor puts on your chest or back. It helps the doctor hear your heartbeat and your breathing. When you go for a check-up, the doctor may use it to make sure your heart and lungs are healthy.
Stew\n\nA stew is a warm, thick food made in one big pot. It has small pieces of meat and soft vegetables all mixed together. People cook it slowly on the stove for a long time so everything gets very soft and tasty. You eat it with a spoon, and it feels cozy on a cold day. A stew is different from a casserole because a stew has no crunchy top and it cooks on the stove, not in the oven. Many countries have their own kind of stew, like Irish stew with lamb and potatoes. Your family might make a stew with beef, carrots, and peas.
Stick\n\nA stick is a long, thin piece of wood. It comes from a tree branch that has fallen down. You can find it on the ground in a park, a forest, or your backyard. A dog likes to pick it up and carry it in its mouth. A child can use it to draw in the dirt or to play a game. It can be short or long, and it feels hard and rough.
Stick insect\n\nA stick insect is a bug that looks just like a twig or a leaf. It has a long, thin body and six legs. It lives in trees and bushes in warm places. It stays very still during the day so birds and other animals cannot see it. When the wind blows, it sways back and forth like a real twig. It eats leaves at night. Some kinds can even change color to match the plant they sit on.
Sticker\n\nA sticker is a small flat picture with a sticky back. It can be a star, a heart, an animal, or a funny face. You peel it off a sheet and press it onto paper, a notebook, or a lunchbox. It stays there because the back is a little bit like glue. Kids like to collect stickers and trade them with friends. Some stickers shine or feel bumpy when you touch them.
Stickleback\n\nA stickleback is a small fish that lives in water. It has no scales, but some kinds have hard plates on their sides. It has sharp spines on its back that stand up to keep it safe. You can find it in rivers, lakes, and the sea in places like Europe, Asia, and North America. It eats tiny water bugs and baby fish. The boy fish builds a little nest from plants and sticky stuff from his body. He then dances to bring a girl fish to the nest. She lays eggs inside, and he watches over them until they hatch. Some sticklebacks are bold and try new things, while others are shy and hide.
Sticky\n\nSticky means something feels like glue or tape when you touch it. It can hold things together or make your fingers feel tacky. You find sticky things in many places, like a sticker on a paper or honey on a spoon. When you press two sticky things together, they stay put. A bandage is sticky so it can stay on your skin.
Stiff\n\nStiff means something is hard to bend or move. It does not wiggle or flop around. A new book with a hard cover is stiff. A piece of cardboard is stiff. When you try to fold it, it does not fold easily. Some clothes feel stiff before you wash them. If your neck feels stiff, it is hard to turn your head.
Still\n\nStill means not moving. When you sit very quiet and do not wiggle, you are still. A toy that is not rolling or shaking is still. Sometimes people say "be still" when they want you to stop moving for a little bit.
Stingray\n\nA stingray is a flat fish that lives in the sea. It has a long tail with a sharp point on it. The point can hurt if it feels scared, so it uses it only to stay safe. It hides under sand on the sea floor, with just its eyes and tail showing. It eats small animals like clams and shrimp. Some stingrays are as big as a blanket, and some are small. You might see one at an aquarium, gliding through the water like a bird.
Stinky\n\nStinky means something smells very bad. It is a word you use when your nose does not like a smell. You might find a stinky smell near a trash can or old food. A skunk makes a stinky spray when it is scared. Dirty socks that sit too long can get stinky too. When something is stinky, people often hold their nose and say "P.U.!".
Stir\n\nTo stir means to move a spoon or a stick around and around in a bowl or a cup. It mixes things together so they become one. You see it when someone makes cake batter or hot chocolate. It helps sugar melt into tea or milk. A grown-up might let you stir the soup to help with dinner.
Stoat\n\nA stoat is a small, furry animal. It has a long, thin body, short legs, and a tail with a black tip. Its fur is brown in summer and turns white in winter. It lives in cold places like forests and fields. It hunts small animals like mice and rabbits. It is very fast and can climb trees.
Stock\n\nA stock is a tiny piece of a big company. When you own it, you own a small part of that company. People buy and sell stocks at a special place called a market. If the company does well, the stock can be worth more money. If the company does not do well, it can be worth less. Some grown-ups save money by buying stocks for a long time.
Stock exchange\n\nA stock exchange is a big market where people buy and sell tiny pieces of big companies. It can be a real building with a loud floor, or it can be a place on computers. People go there to trade these pieces, which are called shares. When a company does well, its shares can become worth more. A long time ago, the market broke and many people lost their money. That made a very hard time for everyone.
Stockholm\n\nStockholm is a big city in a country called Sweden. It is built on many small islands, so there is water all around it. Many bridges connect the islands so cars and people can go from one to another. The oldest part of the city is called Gamla Stan, which means Old Town. There, you can see old houses and small streets. People visit Stockholm to see museums, parks, and boats on the water.
Stocking\n\nA stocking is a long, soft sock. It is often red and white, with a fuzzy top. People hang it by the fireplace at Christmas time. Santa Claus fills it with small toys and candy while children sleep. In the morning, kids run to see what is inside it.
Stomach\n\nYour stomach is a soft bag inside your body, right below your chest. It is part of the path food takes after you eat. When you swallow, food goes down a tube and lands in your stomach. It holds the food and mixes it with special juices that break the food into tiny bits. This helps your body get the good stuff from the food later. Sometimes your stomach can feel upset and make you throw up. You can call it your tummy or belly.
Stone\n\nA stone is a hard, small piece of rock. It can be gray, brown, white, or many other colors. You find stones on the ground, in a park, or near a river. People use stones to build walls or to make paths. A child might pick up a smooth stone and keep it in a pocket.
Stone Age\n\nThe Stone Age is a very, very old time when people made tools from stone. It started long before your grandma's grandma was born. People used a hard kind of stone called flint to make sharp tools for cutting. They also made tools from wood and bone, but those did not last long. Stone Age people ate berries, fish, and big animals. They did not have stores, so they had to find all their food. Later, they learned to grow food and keep animals like cows and pigs. The Stone Age ended when people learned to make tools from metal instead.
Stonehenge\n\nStonehenge is a very old circle of big stones. It stands in a field in England. The stones are tall and heavy, and some have a stone on top. People put them there a long, long time ago. No one is sure why they built it. On the longest day of the year, the sun comes up right between two stones. Many people visit it to look and wonder.
Stool\n\nA stool is a small seat for one person. It has a flat top to sit on and three or four legs to hold it up. You can find a stool in a kitchen, at a counter, or in a classroom. It does not have a back or arms like a big chair. A child might use a stool to reach a high sink or to sit and draw at a table.
Stop\n\nStop means to not move anymore. When you are walking and you stop, your feet stay still. A red light on the street tells cars to stop. In a game of freeze dance, the music stops and everyone must stop moving. It is the opposite of go.
Store\n\nA store is a place where you can buy things. It has shelves with food, toys, clothes, and other items. You can find a store on a street or in a big building. People go to a store to pick what they need and pay with money. A grocery store sells food like milk, bread, and apples. A toy store sells dolls, blocks, and games.
Stork\n\nA stork is a big bird with long legs and a long beak. It has white feathers and some black on its wings. It lives near water, like a pond or a lake. It walks in the water to catch frogs, crabs, and small fish. Some storks fly far away when the weather gets cold. A stork builds a very big nest high up on a roof or a tall tree. Many people know a story that a stork brings new babies to families.
Storm\n\nA storm is wild weather with strong wind and lots of rain. It can also have bright flashes called lightning and loud booms called thunder. Sometimes small balls of ice fall from the sky during a storm. You see a storm outside when the sky turns dark and the wind blows hard. It can make trees shake and puddles grow big. People stay inside to keep safe and dry. After the storm, the air feels cool and clean.
Story\n\nA story is a set of words that tells about something that happened. It can be about a real thing or a made-up thing. You can find it in a book, on a screen, or hear it from a grown-up. It has a start, a middle, and an end. A bedtime story is one you hear before you go to sleep.
Storybook\n\nA storybook is a book full of made-up tales. It has many pages with words and bright pictures. You can find it on a shelf at home, in a library, or in a classroom. A grown-up or a big kid reads the words out loud, and you look at the pictures. It tells about animals that talk, brave children, or funny adventures. A bedtime storybook helps you feel cozy before sleep.
Stove\n\nA stove is a big, hot box that helps you cook food. It has a flat top where you put pots and pans. Under the top, there is a small room called an oven for baking bread and cookies. You find it in the kitchen at home. When you turn it on, it gets very hot, so you must never touch it. Mom or Dad uses it to make yummy meals like soup or cake.
Straight\n\nStraight means something is not bent or curved. It looks like a line you draw with a ruler. A pencil can be straight, and a road can be straight too. When you stand up tall, your back is straight. It is the opposite of wiggly or round.
Strainer\n\nA strainer is a kitchen tool with many small holes. It looks like a bowl with a handle. You use it to separate water from food. For example, when you wash grapes, you put them in a strainer so the water runs out and the grapes stay in. It can also help when you make spaghetti to keep the noodles and let the water go away.
Strait\n\nA strait is a thin path of water between two big pieces of land. It joins two bigger bodies of water, like two seas. Big boats use it to carry things from one place to another. A strait is not like a river because the water does not flow one way. Many people know about the Strait of Gibraltar, which sits between Spain and Africa.
Strait of Magellan\n\nThe Strait of Magellan is a long, narrow path of water. It connects two big oceans, the Atlantic and the Pacific. It sits at the very bottom of South America, near a cold, windy place called Tierra del Fuego. Ships use it to travel between the oceans without going all the way around the tip. The water is often covered in thick fog and strong winds blow there. A long time ago, a man named Magellan sailed through it first, so it got his name.
Strait of Malacca\n\nThe Strait of Malacca is a long, narrow piece of water. It sits between two big pieces of land. It joins two bigger seas together. Big boats use it to carry things from one place to another. It is a very busy water road. Many people from different lands have used it for a long, long time.
Straits of Florida\n\nThe Straits of Florida is a long, narrow path of water. It sits between the Florida Keys and the island of Cuba. It joins two big bodies of water: the Gulf of Mexico and the Atlantic Ocean. Big boats and ships use it to travel from one side to the other. The water is deep and blue, and you can see it on a map near the bottom of Florida.
Strange\n\nStrange means something is not like the things you see every day. It can look funny, sound odd, or feel weird. You might find a strange toy that makes a noise you never heard before. A strange animal might have very long ears or bright blue fur. When you see a strange cloud in the sky, it might have a shape like a dragon. Strange things can make you stop and look twice.
Straw\n\nA straw is a long, thin tube. It is usually made of paper or plastic. You find it in a cup of juice or milk at a restaurant or at home. You put one end in your mouth and suck to drink. It helps you sip without spilling. Some straws are straight, and some bend at the top.
Strawberry\n\nA strawberry is a small red fruit that tastes sweet. It has tiny yellow dots on the outside that look like seeds. It grows on a short plant close to the ground. People pick it in the spring and summer to eat. You can put it in a bowl with milk, or on top of a cake. It is soft and juicy when you bite it.
Stream\n\nA stream is a small, thin river of water. It flows over rocks and dirt, making a soft, happy sound. You can find it in a forest or a park, running down a hill. Little fish and frogs sometimes live in it. On a hot day, you can take off your shoes and feel the cool water on your feet.
Street\n\nA street is a long, flat road in a town or city. It is made of hard gray stuff like stone or tar. Cars, buses, and bikes drive on it. People walk on the side part called a sidewalk. You can see streets outside your house or near the park. Many streets have trees, lights, and signs to help people find their way.
Stress (biology)\n\nStress is a feeling you get when something is hard or scary. It can make your heart beat fast and your tummy feel tight. You might feel it before a big test or when you have to try something new. A little bit of it can help you try your best, but too much can make you feel sick or sad. When you feel it, you can take a break, play outside, or talk to a grown-up. A hug from someone you love can also help it go away.
Stretch\n\nStretch means to make something longer or wider by pulling it gently. You can stretch your arms up high above your head. A rubber band gets longer when you stretch it. After you sit for a long time, it feels good to stand up and stretch your body. Some clothes stretch when you pull them, like a soft sweater.
Stretchy\n\nStretchy means something can get longer or wider when you pull it, and then it goes back to its old shape. A rubber band is stretchy. You can pull it far, and it snaps back. Some clothes are stretchy too, like socks and leggings. They feel soft and move with your body. When you play with slime, it is stretchy and fun to pull.
String\n\nA string is a very thin, long piece of something. It can be made of cotton, wool, or plastic. You can find it in a drawer at home or in a craft box. People use it to tie things together, like a bow on a present or a shoe. A kite needs a string to fly high in the sky.
String instrument\n\nA string instrument is a thing that makes music with strings. It has long, thin strings that shake to make sound. You can find it in a band or an orchestra. People play it by pulling a bow across the strings or by plucking them with fingers. A violin is a small string instrument that you hold under your chin. A guitar is another one that you strum with your hand. When you hear a soft, pretty song, it might be a string instrument playing.
Strip\n\nA strip is a long, thin piece of something. It can be made of paper, cloth, or plastic. You might see a strip of tape holding two papers together. A strip of cloth can be used as a bandage for a small cut. Sometimes people cut a strip of fruit leather to eat as a snack.
Stripe\n\nA stripe is a long, thin line of color. It can be straight or a little wavy. You see stripes on many things, like a zebra with black and white stripes, or a candy cane with red and white stripes. Some shirts and socks have stripes too. A stripe is often next to other stripes, making a pattern.
Stroke\n\nA stroke is when a part of the brain gets hurt because blood cannot reach it. It happens when a tiny tube in the brain gets blocked or breaks. When that part of the brain stops working, the person may not be able to move one side of their body. They may have trouble talking or seeing. A stroke is very serious and needs a doctor right away. To help spot a stroke, remember to check the face, arms, and speech. If one side of the face droops, one arm cannot lift, or words sound funny, call for help fast.
Strong\n\nStrong means you can push, pull, or lift heavy things without getting tired. It is like when you carry a big bag of toys all by yourself. Some animals are strong too, like a bear or an elephant. You get strong by eating good food, sleeping well, and playing outside. When you are strong, you can help your friends move a heavy chair or open a tight jar lid.
Strong Interaction\n\nA strong interaction is a very strong pull that holds tiny bits together. It works inside the smallest parts of everything around us. You cannot see it, but it keeps things from falling apart. It is like a super strong glue that only works when things are very, very close. Without it, the tiny bits that make up you and me would not stay together.
Structure\n\nA structure is something that people build. It can be big like a house or small like a chair. It has parts that hold it up so it does not fall down. You see structures every day, like the school you go to or the bridge over the water. People use structures to live in, work in, or play on. A table is a structure that holds your food when you eat.
Student\n\nA student is a person who goes to school to learn new things. They sit at a desk and listen to the teacher. They learn about letters, numbers, and the world around them. A student may carry a backpack with books and a lunchbox inside. They play with friends at recess and draw pictures in class. You are a student when you are in your classroom.
Study\n\nA study is a quiet room where you can read and think. It has a desk, a chair, and shelves with books. You find it in a house or a school. People use it to do homework or learn new things. When you sit at the desk, you can draw or look at a picture book.
Stuff\n\nStuff is a word for many things when you do not say each one. It can be toys, clothes, or food all mixed together. You might see stuff in your room, like blocks and books on the floor. People say "pick up your stuff" when they want you to put things away. It is a quick way to talk about a group of things without naming them all.
Stuffed toy\n\nA stuffed toy is a soft, cuddly friend. It is made from cloth and filled with fluffy stuff inside. It can look like a bear, a bunny, or a funny character from a show. You can hug it, hold it close, and take it to bed at night. Many children get one as a gift on a birthday or a special day. It feels warm and safe when you squeeze it tight.
Sturgeon\n\nA sturgeon is a big fish that lives in rivers and lakes. It has a long body, a pointy nose, and a tail that is not the same on top and bottom. Its skin has hard, bumpy plates instead of normal fish scales. It swims near the bottom of the water and eats small things it finds in the mud. Some people catch it for its eggs, which are called caviar. A sturgeon can grow very, very big—bigger than a grown-up person.
Style\n\nStyle is the way something looks or is done. It is the special shape, color, or pattern that makes one thing different from another. You can see style in clothes, like a dress with flowers or a shirt with stripes. It is also in hair, like long braids or short curls. When you draw a picture, your style is the way you make lines and pick colors. Everyone has their own style, and that is what makes things fun and new.
Sub-Saharan Africa\n\nSub-Saharan Africa is a big part of the world. It is the land below a huge sandy desert called the Sahara. Many countries are there, like Kenya and South Africa. It has hot weather, big grassy fields, and many wild animals like lions and elephants. People there speak many different languages and play drums. Some children walk to school under the hot sun.
Subatomic Particle\n\nA subatomic particle is a tiny, tiny piece that makes up everything around us. It is so small you cannot see it, even with a strong magnifying glass. It lives inside atoms, which are the building blocks of all things. Some of them help hold the atom together, and others move around very fast. One kind you may have heard of is an electron, which helps make lights turn on.
Subculture\n\nA subculture is a group of people who share the same fun things. They like the same music, clothes, or games. You can find them in clubs, parks, or online. They have their own special words and ways to say hello. For example, skateboarders are a subculture. They wear cool shoes and do tricks at the skate park.
Subject\n\nA subject is a thing you learn about at school. It can be numbers, letters, or how things grow. You have a subject like reading, where you look at words and say them out loud. Another subject is art, where you draw and paint with bright colors. Every day your teacher picks a subject and you all learn something new together.
Submarine\n\nA submarine is a boat that can go under the water. It has a long, round body and a tall part on top called a sail. You can find it in the big, deep ocean. People use it to look at fish and plants under the sea, or to keep countries safe. Some submarines are very big and can stay under the water for a long time. You might see a small toy submarine in a bathtub or a pool.
Subsidy\n\nA subsidy is money that a government gives to help people or businesses. It helps keep the price of something low so more people can buy it. For example, a bus ride might cost less because the government gives money to the bus company. Sometimes farmers get a subsidy so food stays cheap at the store. It is like a helping hand from the government to make things easier for everyone.
Subsistence farming\n\nSubsistence farming is when a family grows food only for themselves. They have a small piece of land and grow just enough to eat. They do not have extra food to sell or trade. Sometimes they also keep a few animals like chickens or goats. If the weather is bad and the plants do not grow well, the family may not have enough food. This kind of farming happens in places where people do not have big machines or a lot of money.
Substance\n\nA substance is what something is made of. It can be a hard thing like a rock, a wet thing like water, or a light thing like air. You can see it, touch it, or feel it all around you. A toy is made of a substance called plastic. A spoon can be made of a metal substance. Water is a substance you drink every day.
Subtract\n\nSubtract means to take away. When you have five blocks and you take two away, you subtract. It makes the group smaller. You can use your fingers to subtract. If you have three cookies and you eat one, you subtract one cookie. Now you have two cookies left.
Subtraction\n\nSubtraction is taking one number away from another number. It helps you find how many are left. You use it when you eat some of your cookies and want to know how many you still have. For example, if you have 5 blocks and you give away 2 blocks, you have 3 blocks left. That is subtraction.
Suburb\n\nA suburb is a part of a city that is a little far from the busy center. It has many houses, schools, and small shops. The houses are not too close together, so there is room for gardens and parks. Many families live in a suburb because it is quiet and has space to play. People who live there often ride a bus, train, or car to go to work in the big city.
Subway\n\nA subway is a train that runs under the ground. It has many cars joined together, and it stops at stations. People ride it in big cities to go to work, school, or the park. It is fast and does not get stuck in car traffic. You can see it when you go down stairs at a subway station.
