Success\n\nSuccess is when you try hard and get what you want. It feels happy and bright, like a big smile. You can find it when you learn to tie your shoes or count to ten. It happens when you keep trying, even if it is hard at first. A child feels success when they finish a puzzle all by themselves.
Such\n\nSuch is a word we use to talk about something that is a lot or very much. It helps us say how big, small, happy, or sad a thing is. You might hear it in a sentence like "I had such a fun day at the park." It makes the feeling stronger. We use it when we want to show that something is special or more than usual.
Sudan\n\nSudan is a big country in Africa. It has hot, dry land and a long river called the Nile. Many people live in the main city, Khartoum. They speak Arabic and follow the religion of Islam. A long time ago, Sudan was the biggest country in Africa, but now it is smaller because part of it became a new country. Some places in Sudan have fighting, and many people had to leave their homes.
Sue\n\nSue is when you ask a grown-up to make someone follow the rules. It happens when one person says another person did something wrong. A judge in a big room with a high desk listens to both sides. The judge decides what is fair. Sometimes one person has to give money to the other person. You might hear about it on the news or in a story.
Suez Canal\n\nThe Suez Canal is a long, narrow water path in Egypt. It looks like a big blue line on a map. It connects two big seas, so boats can go from one sea to the other without going all the way around Africa. Big ships use it to carry toys, food, and other things from faraway places. It saves a lot of time and fuel. Many ships go through it every day.
Suffrage\n\nSuffrage is the right to vote. It means a person can pick who gets to be in charge. Long ago, only some people could do it. Now, in most places, all grown-ups can vote no matter what they look like. It also can mean the right to try to be a leader yourself. When you raise your hand in class to pick a game, that is a little bit like suffrage.
Sugar\n\nSugar is a sweet thing we eat. It looks like tiny white or brown grains. You find it in candy, cake, cookies, and fruit. People use it to make food taste sweet. A child might see sugar on top of a cookie or in a bowl at breakfast.
Sugar beet\n\nA sugar beet is a plant that grows in the ground. It has a big, round root that is white or light brown. Farmers grow it in big fields. The root has sweet juice inside. People take the juice out and turn it into the white sugar you see at home. You might eat sugar from a sugar beet in cookies or cake.
Sugarcane\n\nSugarcane is a tall plant that grows in hot, sunny places. It looks like a thick green stick with long leaves at the top. Farmers grow it in big fields where there is lots of water and warm weather. Inside the stick there is sweet juice. People squeeze the juice out and use it to make sugar. The sugar makes food and drinks taste sweet. After the juice is gone, the dry parts can be burned to make heat or turned into paper and cups. You may have seen sugar at home in a bowl or a bag.
Suit\n\nA suit is a set of clothes that match. It has a jacket and pants made from the same cloth. People wear it to look neat and dressed up. You might see a suit at a wedding, a party, or when someone goes to work in a big office. Sometimes a suit has a vest too. It can be black, blue, gray, or other colors.
Sum\n\nA sum is what you get when you put numbers together. It is the answer when you add things. If you have two apples and your friend gives you one more, the sum is three apples. You can find a sum by counting all the things in a group. It helps you know how many you have in all.
Sumatra\n\nSumatra is a big island in the country of Indonesia. It has tall mountains, thick green forests, and long rivers. Many animals live there, like elephants, tigers, and funny monkeys with long noses. People grow rice, coffee, and rubber trees on the island. Some parts have sandy beaches next to the blue ocean.
Sumer\n\nSumer is a very old place where people lived a long, long time ago. It was near two big rivers. People there built the first big cities with tall buildings made of mud bricks. They also made one of the first ways of writing by pressing marks into soft clay. Today, you can see old things from Sumer in big museums.
Summer\n\nSummer is the hottest time of the year. It is one of four seasons. In many places, the sun shines bright and the days are long. You can go to the beach, play in the water, and eat cold treats like ice cream. Trees have green leaves and flowers bloom. Some places get a lot of rain in summer, and some places stay dry. People wear light clothes like shorts and t-shirts. It is a fun time to play outside with friends.
Summer Olympic Games\n\nThe Summer Olympic Games is a big sports party that happens every four years. It is held in a different city each time, and people from many countries come to play. They run, jump, swim, and do many other sports. The best players get shiny gold, silver, or bronze medals. You can watch it on TV and see the bright rings and the torch that burns the whole time.
Sumo\n\nSumo is a sport from Japan. It is a game where two big people push each other. They stand in a round ring on the floor. The ring is small, like a big rug. Each person tries to push the other out of the ring. They also try to make the other touch the ground with any part of the body except the feet. The people who play this sport are very strong and heavy. They wear a thick belt and nothing else. You can see sumo on TV sometimes. It looks like a big, slow dance, but it is very strong.
Sun\n\nThe Sun is a big, bright star in the sky. It looks like a round, yellow ball of light. You see it up high during the day. It gives us light and warmth so we can play outside. Plants use its light to grow, and we need its heat to stay cozy.
Sunbird\n\nA sunbird is a tiny bird with a long, thin bill that bends down. It has bright, shiny feathers that sparkle in the sun. Many sunbirds have long tails. They live in warm places near the middle of the world. They fly to flowers to sip sweet juice called nectar. They also eat tiny bugs and spiders. A sunbird can hang in the air like a little helicopter, but it often sits on a branch to eat.
Sunday\n\nSunday is a day of the week. It comes after Saturday and before Monday. Many people do not go to work or school on this day. It is often a day to rest, play, or spend time with family. Some families go to a special building called a church on Sunday morning. You might sleep a little later and eat a big breakfast.
Sundial\n\nA sundial is a tool that shows the time using the sun. It has a flat part with numbers and a stick that stands up. When the sun shines, the stick makes a dark shadow on the flat part. The shadow moves as the sun moves across the sky. You can look at where the shadow falls to know what time it is. People long ago used sundials before clocks were made. You might see one in a garden or a park.
Sunflower\n\nA sunflower is a tall plant with a big, round flower on top. It has a thick green stem and many small yellow parts that look like petals. The middle of the flower is dark and full of tiny seeds. Sunflowers grow in gardens and fields where the sun shines bright. People eat the seeds as a snack, and they also make oil from the seeds for cooking. Sometimes you see sunflowers in a vase at home, and they make the room feel happy and warm.
Sunlight\n\nSunlight is the bright light that comes from the sun. It looks yellow and warm, and it makes the day bright. You see it outside when the sky is blue and the sun is up. It helps plants grow tall and green. It also warms your skin when you play outside. Without it, the world would be dark and cold.
Sunni\n\nSunni is a big group of people who follow the religion of Islam. They believe in one God, called Allah, and follow the teachings of a man named Muhammad. They pray in special buildings called mosques, often with rugs on the floor. Many Sunni people live in countries like Egypt, Turkey, and Pakistan. They have a special month called Ramadan when they do not eat during the day.
Sunni Islam\n\nSunni Islam is a big group of people who follow the religion of Islam. They believe in one God, called Allah, and follow the teachings of a man named Muhammad. They pray five times a day and read a holy book called the Quran. Many of them go to a special building called a mosque to pray together. You can find Sunni Muslims in many countries all over the world.
Sunny\n\nSunny means the sky is bright and the sun is shining. It feels warm on your skin when you go outside. You see a big yellow circle up high in the blue sky. On a sunny day, you can play at the park, ride your bike, or have a picnic. Flowers open up and turn toward the light. It makes people feel happy and full of energy.
Sunset\n\nA sunset is when the sun goes down at the end of the day. It makes the sky turn pretty colors like orange, pink, and purple. You can see it outside in the evening, just before it gets dark. The sun looks big and soft, and it slowly hides behind the trees or houses. Many people like to watch it because it is calm and beautiful.
Sunshine\n\nSunshine is the bright light and warm feeling that comes from the sun. It looks like yellow rays that shine down from the sky. You can see it outside on a clear day, and it makes everything look bright and happy. It helps plants grow tall and keeps us warm. When you play at the park on a sunny day, you feel the sunshine on your skin.
Super\n\nSuper means very, very good or very, very big. When something is super, it is better than just good. You might say a toy is super fun, or a cake is super yummy. A superhero is a person in a story who is super strong and helps people. You can use the word super to talk about anything that makes you really happy.
Supercomputer\n\nA supercomputer is a very, very fast computer. It is much bigger than the computer at home or school. It has many tiny parts inside that all work together. Scientists use it to guess the weather, to look at stars, and to solve hard puzzles. You might see a picture of one in a book about big machines.
Supergiant\n\nA supergiant is a huge, bright star in the night sky. It is much bigger than our Sun. Some are blue, some are red, and a few are yellow. It shines because it is very old and has used up most of its inside fuel. When it runs out of fuel, it can blow up in a big flash called a supernova. You can see some supergiants with just your eyes on a clear night.
Superhero\n\nA superhero is a made-up person who helps others and fights bad people. It often wears a bright, colorful suit and a mask to hide its face. You can find superheroes in comic books, cartoons, and movies. It uses special powers like flying or being very strong to save the day. Some superheroes do not have powers but use their brains and training to be heroes. For example, you might see a superhero like Spider-Man swinging between tall buildings to stop a robber.
Supermarket\n\nA supermarket is a big store that sells food and things for your home. It has many parts, like a part for fruits and vegetables, a part for milk and cheese, and a part for meat. You can find it in a town or city, and people go there to buy what they need to eat and clean. You push a cart and pick things from the shelves, then pay at the front. Sometimes you see a supermarket with a big red sign or one near your house.
Supernatural\n\nSupernatural means something that is not part of nature. It is like magic or a ghost. Some people think it is real, but science cannot show it. You might see it in a story or a movie. A fairy in a book is an example.
Supernova\n\nA supernova is a big star that blows up. It looks like a very bright light in the sky, brighter than a whole group of stars. You can see it far away in space, but not with just your eyes—people use big telescopes. It makes a huge cloud of gas and dust that spreads out. After it blows up, it can leave behind a tiny, heavy star or a black hole. A long time ago, people saw one in the sky and drew pictures of it.
Superstition\n\nA superstition is a belief that something brings good luck or bad luck. It is not based on real proof. Many people have superstitions about things they see every day. Some think a black cat crossing your path brings bad luck. Others think finding a four-leaf clover brings good luck. Some people knock on wood to keep bad things away. Superstitions are like little stories people tell to feel safe or lucky.
Supply\n\nSupply means how much of something we have. It is the amount of things like food, toys, or water that people can use. When a store has many apples, the supply of apples is big. When there are only a few apples left, the supply is small. Farmers grow food to keep the supply full. Mom and Dad buy things from the store to add to the supply at home.
Supply And Demand\n\nSupply is how much of a thing there is. Demand is how much people want that thing. When many people want a toy but there are only a few, the toy costs more. When there are many toys but few people want them, the toy costs less. You see this at a store when a popular snack runs out fast.
Support group\n\nA support group is a small circle of people who help each other feel better. It meets in a quiet room, like at a library or a doctor's office. In it, people sit together and talk about sad or hard things. They listen and give kind words. It helps them feel less alone. Sometimes a grown-up leader guides the talk. It is a safe place to share feelings.
Sure\n\nSure means yes or okay. When someone asks you a question and you want to say yes, you can say sure. It is a short and friendly word. You might hear your friend say sure when you ask to play. You can also use it when you agree to help someone. It is a nice way to show you are happy to do something.
Surf\n\nSurf is the white, bubbly water that rolls onto the sand at the beach. It comes from big waves in the ocean. When a wave gets close to the shore, it breaks and turns into surf. It makes a loud, happy sound as it splashes. You can play in it and feel it tickle your toes. Some people ride on it with a flat board called a surfboard.
Surface\n\nA surface is the top part of something you can touch. It can be flat like a table, bumpy like a rock, or soft like a blanket. You find surfaces everywhere — the floor you walk on, the wall you touch, and the water in a lake. When you draw, you put your paper on a flat surface. A slide at the playground has a smooth surface that helps you go down fast.
Surface tension\n\nSurface tension is a kind of skin on top of water. It is very thin and you cannot see it, but it is strong. You can find it on any puddle, pond, or cup of water. It holds water drops in a round ball shape. It also lets tiny bugs walk on water without sinking. When you fill a cup too full, the water makes a bump at the top. That bump is held by surface tension.
Surfboard\n\nA surfboard is a long, flat board that people use to ride on ocean waves. It is usually made of light foam or wood and has a smooth, shiny top. You find it at the beach, where big waves roll in. A person lies on it, paddles out, then stands up to slide across the water. It can be short or long, and some have bright colors or pictures on them. Many kids see surfboards in movies or at the seaside.
Surfing\n\nSurfing is a fun sport you do in the ocean. It uses a long, flat board called a surfboard. A person stands or lies on it and rides on top of a big wave as it moves toward the beach. You need strong arms to paddle out into the water and quick feet to stand up. Many people surf in warm places like Hawaii. It feels like sliding down a hill made of water.
Surgery\n\nSurgery is when a doctor fixes something inside your body. The doctor makes a small cut to reach the part that needs help. You are given special medicine so you sleep and feel no pain. After surgery, you rest in bed until the cut heals. Sometimes you get a bandage or stitches. It helps you feel better when medicine alone cannot fix the problem.
Suriname\n\nSuriname is a country in South America. It is a warm place with many rivers and green trees. You can find it on a map next to Guyana and French Guiana. Many people there speak Dutch, and the biggest city is called Paramaribo. People in Suriname grow food like sugar and dig up a shiny rock called bauxite. They also sell gold and oil to other countries. Children go to school until they are twelve years old.
Surprise\n\nA surprise is something you did not know was going to happen. It can be a happy feeling when someone gives you a gift you did not expect. It can also be a little scary if something jumps out fast. You might feel a surprise at a birthday party when everyone yells "Happy Birthday!" Your eyes get big and your mouth might open wide. A surprise can make you laugh or jump.
Surprise (emotion)\n\nSurprise is a feeling you get when something happens that you did not think would happen. It can make your eyes open wide and your mouth drop open. You might feel it when a friend jumps out and yells "Boo!" at a party. It can be a happy feeling, like when you get a gift you did not know about. It can also be a scared feeling, like when a loud horn beeps right behind you. The feeling goes away fast, but it makes your heart beat a little quicker for a moment.
Surrealism\n\nSurrealism is a way of making art that feels like a dream. It shows things that do not usually go together, like a clock melting on a tree. You can find it in paintings, movies, and stories. It makes people feel surprised or curious because it mixes real things in strange new ways. For example, you might see a picture of a train coming out of a fireplace. Artists who make surreal art want to show the funny and odd ideas that come from deep inside our minds.
Surveillance\n\nSurveillance is watching people or things to keep them safe or to learn about them. It can be done with cameras that sit on walls or poles. You might see a camera in a store or on a street corner. It helps grown-ups know what is happening, like when a police officer watches a camera to stop bad things. Sometimes it uses tiny hidden tools to listen to sounds. A big example is a camera that watches a baby while she sleeps.
Sushi\n\nSushi is a food from Japan. It is made with special rice that is a little sticky and a little sour. The rice is often shaped into a small block or rolled up. On top or inside, there is usually a piece of raw fish, like salmon or tuna. Sometimes it has cooked shrimp, egg, or crunchy vegetables like cucumber. A dark green sheet called seaweed can be wrapped around the outside. People dip it in a dark, salty sauce before eating. You can find it in small shops with a moving belt that carries plates of it around the room.
Sustainability\n\nSustainability means taking care of what we have so it lasts a long, long time. It is about using things like water, trees, and food in a way that does not run out. People think about the future when they make choices today. For example, turning off the light when you leave a room saves power for later. Planting a new tree after cutting one down is another way. It helps keep the Earth happy and full of good things for all kids, even when they grow up.
Sustainable development\n\nSustainable development is a way to make life better for people today without hurting the world for people tomorrow. It has three big parts: taking care of nature, making sure people have jobs and money, and helping everyone get along. You can see it when a town builds a new park with trees and a playground. It also happens when people fix old houses so families can live in them safely. Another example is when a school teaches kids how to grow food in a garden. All these things help people now and keep the Earth happy for later.
Swahili\n\nSwahili is a way people talk to each other. It is a language with many words and sounds. Many people in Africa use it every day. You can hear it in songs, stories, and when friends say hello. Some kids learn it at home from their family.
Swallow\n\nA swallow is a small bird that flies very fast. It has a tiny beak, long pointy wings, and a tail that looks like a fork. You can see it flying high in the sky, catching bugs to eat. It builds a mud nest under bridges or on the side of a house. In spring and summer, it zooms around fields and ponds. When it gets cold, it flies far away to a warm place.
Swallowtail butterfly\n\nA swallowtail butterfly is a big, pretty insect with wings. It has two wings on each side, and the back wings often have a little tail that looks like a fork. You can see it in gardens, parks, and fields when the weather is warm. It flies from flower to flower to drink sweet juice. Its wings can be yellow, black, blue, or many other bright colors. Some are as big as a child's hand.
Swamp\n\nA swamp is a wet, muddy place with lots of trees and water. It has soft, spongy ground that is often covered with shallow water. You can find it near big rivers or warm coasts. Many birds and animals live there and build their nests. It helps clean water and stops big floods. A swamp is like a giant, wet forest where frogs croak and fish swim.
Swan\n\nA swan is a big white bird that lives on water. It has a long neck, big feet, and wide wings. You can see it on ponds, lakes, and rivers. It swims on top of the water and eats plants and small bugs from the bottom. A baby swan is called a cygnet. It is very strong and keeps its nest safe from other animals. Most swans are white, but some are black with a red beak. In winter, many swans fly to warmer places to have their babies.
Sweat\n\nSweat is water that comes out of your skin when you are hot. It looks like tiny wet drops on your arms, face, or back. You feel it when you run fast, play outside on a sunny day, or feel nervous. It helps your body stay cool, like a fan inside you. After it dries, your skin may feel a little sticky. You can wash it off with soap and water.
Sweater\n\nA sweater is a warm piece of clothing you wear on the top part of your body. It is soft and made of thick, fuzzy threads. You put it on when it is cold outside. It has two long parts for your arms and a hole for your head. Some sweaters have buttons or a zipper in the front. You can wear it to school, to play outside, or when you curl up on the couch. Mom or Dad might help you pull it over your head. It keeps you cozy like a hug.
Sweden\n\nSweden is a country in the north of Europe. It has many trees, big lakes, and a long coast by the sea. It is next to Norway and Finland. In the north, it is very cold and snowy. In the south, it is warmer. Many people live in cities like Stockholm, which is the biggest city. Sweden has a king, but the people choose leaders to make rules. The people speak Swedish. They like to play soccer and ice hockey. They also sing and dance to pop music. A long time ago, Sweden had many wars, but now it is a peaceful place.
Swedish language\n\nSwedish is a way of talking and writing that many people use. It sounds a little like singing, with up-and-down tones. Most people who speak it live in a country called Sweden, and some live in a part of Finland. It is a cousin to English, so a few words sound almost the same. Swedish has three extra letters that English does not have: Å, Ä, and Ö. They look like A and O with small marks on top. When you see a Swedish book, you might spot these funny letters on the page.
Sweep\n\nA sweep is when you move a broom to clean the floor. It pushes dust and little bits into one pile. You can sweep a room, a porch, or a sidewalk. After you sweep, you use a dustpan to pick up the pile and throw it away. It makes the floor look nice and tidy.
Sweet\n\nSweet is a taste that makes your mouth happy. It is the taste of sugar, honey, and candy. You find it in fruits like apples, bananas, and strawberries. Many people eat sweet things for a treat after a meal. A birthday cake is sweet, and so is a lollipop. Too much sweet food is not good for your teeth, so you brush them after.
Sweet potato\n\nA sweet potato is a root that grows under the ground. It has brown or orange skin and is yellow or orange inside. You can find it at the grocery store or in a garden. People cook it and eat it as a warm, soft food. It tastes sweet and is good for your body. You might eat it at dinner with butter on top.
Sweetie\n\nSweetie is a warm, kind word you say to someone you love. It is a name you call a person when you feel close and happy with them. You might hear a mom or dad say, "Good morning, sweetie" when you wake up. A grandma might say, "Come here, sweetie" and give you a big hug. It is not a real name like Sam or Lily, but a soft, loving word. When someone calls you sweetie, it means they think you are very special and dear to them.
Swift\n\nA swift is a small bird that flies very fast. It has long, curved wings and a tail shaped like a V. You can see it high in the sky, swooping and turning to catch bugs. It spends almost all its life in the air, even sleeping while flying. Its tiny feet are weak, so it clings to walls or cliffs instead of standing on the ground. In spring, it flies to warm places like Europe, and when it gets cold, it travels to Africa. Some swifts build cup-shaped nests from mud and spit in corners of houses or caves.
Swim\n\nSwim means to move your body through water. You use your arms and legs to push the water and go forward. People swim in pools, lakes, or the ocean. It is a fun way to play and stay cool on a hot day. Some people swim fast in races, and others just splash and float. You can learn to swim with a grown-up helping you.
Swimmer\n\nA swimmer is a person who moves through water. They use their arms and legs to push the water and go forward. You can see swimmers at a pool, a lake, or the ocean. Some swimmers race each other to see who is fastest. Others swim just for fun or to stay cool on a hot day. A swimmer might wear goggles to see underwater and a swimsuit that dries fast.
Swimming\n\nSwimming is moving your body through water. It uses your arms and legs to push the water and go forward. You can swim in a big pool, in the sea, or in a lake. People swim to have fun, to stay strong, and to race. There are many ways to move in the water, like moving arms over the water or like a frog. Swimming makes your whole body work and helps you go for a long time without getting tired.
Swimming pool\n\nA swimming pool is a big bowl of water made for people to play and swim. It has clean, blue water that feels cool on a hot day. You can find it outside in a yard or inside a big building. People jump in, float, and splash around in it. Some pools have a slide or a diving board for extra fun. A pump and a filter help keep the water fresh and clear.
Swimsuit\n\nA swimsuit is a special set of clothes for swimming. It is made of thin, stretchy cloth that dries fast. You wear it at the pool, the beach, or a lake. It covers your body so you can splash and play in the water. Some swimsuits cover the whole middle, and some have two parts. After swimming, you should change into dry clothes so your skin stays happy.
Swing\n\nA swing is a seat that hangs from ropes or chains. It is tied to a strong bar or a tree branch up high. You find it at a playground or in a backyard. You sit on it and move your legs to go back and forth, up and down. It feels like flying a little bit. Many children love to swing high in the air.
Swish\n\nA swish is a soft, quick sound. It is like the noise when a broom moves across the floor, or when a basketball goes through the net without touching the rim. You can hear it when someone walks fast in a puffy coat, or when a tail wags through the air. It is a gentle, brushing sound that does not last long.
Switch\n\nA switch is a small thing you can move to turn something on or off. It is often a little button or a stick on the wall. You find it in your house, on a lamp, or on a toy. When you push it, it lets power flow so a light glows or a toy moves. When you push it again, the power stops and the light goes dark. A light switch in your room is one you see every day.
Switzerland\n\nSwitzerland is a country in Europe. It has tall mountains with snow on top, and many blue lakes. People speak different languages there, like German, French, and Italian. It is famous for chocolate, cheese, and clocks. Many people visit to ski and see the pretty mountains.
Sword\n\nA sword is a long, sharp tool for cutting. It has a flat, pointy blade and a part to hold called a handle. Long ago, people used it to fight before there were guns. Today, you can see it in sports where people wear safe suits and tap each other. Some swords are straight, and some are curved like a banana. A famous sword from a story is Excalibur, which a king pulled from a stone.
Swordfish\n\nA swordfish is a big fish that lives in the ocean. It has a long, flat nose that looks like a sword. Its body is smooth and round, and it swims very fast. The swordfish uses its sharp nose to hit other fish so it can eat them. People catch swordfish to cook and eat. The meat is often cut into flat pieces and cooked on a grill. Some swordfish meat is pink inside.
Sydney\n\nSydney is a big city by the sea in a faraway land called Australia. It has a famous white building with pointy roofs that looks like sails on a boat. You can see a tall bridge that curves over the water, and many people walk on it. The city has lots of sandy beaches where families swim and play. In one big park, you can visit animals from all over the world. At night, bright lights sometimes color the buildings and the sky.
Sydney Opera House\n\nThe Sydney Opera House is a big, special building in Sydney, Australia. It sits right by the water. It looks like a boat with big white sails. Many people go inside to watch shows with singing and music. It is a place that people from all over the world come to see.
Syllable\n\nA syllable is a small beat inside a word. It is one push of sound you make with your mouth. When you say "cat," that is one beat, so it has one syllable. When you say "kit-ten," that is two beats, so it has two syllables. You can clap your hands to count the beats in a word. Every word has at least one syllable. Some words are short, like "go," and some are long, like "el-e-phant."
Symbiosis\n\nSymbiosis is when two different living things stay together for a long time. It can be a big animal and a tiny bug, or two tiny things you cannot see. Sometimes both are happy and help each other. Sometimes only one is happy, and the other is not. You can find it in the ocean, in the woods, and even inside your own body. For example, a small fish cleans a big fish's teeth, and both get a good meal.
Symbol\n\nA symbol is a simple picture or shape that stands for something else. It can be a drawing, a color, or even a real thing. You see symbols every day. A red heart stands for love. A green light means go. Letters are symbols too — each one stands for a sound. A flag is a symbol for a whole country. Symbols help us share big ideas in a tiny way.
Symbolism\n\nSymbolism is when one thing stands for another thing. It is a way to show a big idea with a simple picture or object. For example, a heart shape can stand for love. A red light can stand for stop. You see symbolism in stories, songs, and art. It helps people share feelings without using many words.
Symmetry\n\nSymmetry is when something looks the same on both sides. It is like a mirror picture. If you draw a line down the middle of a shape, the left side and the right side match. You can find it in many places. A butterfly has it on its wings. A round cookie can have it if you turn it. A square tile on the floor has it too. When you fold a paper heart in half, the two sides fit just right.
Symphony\n\nA symphony is a long piece of music played by a big group of instruments called an orchestra. It has different parts, like chapters in a book, that sound fast or slow. People sit in a big hall to listen to it. A man named Haydn wrote many of them a long time ago, and other people still write them today. When you hear a symphony, you can feel happy, sad, or excited as the music changes.
Synagogue\n\nA synagogue is a special building where Jewish people go to pray. It has a big room for praying and smaller rooms for learning. Inside, there is a special closet called the Ark that holds the Torah scrolls. A person stands on a raised platform to read from the scrolls. Some synagogues have a curtain or a light that is always on. Jewish families may go there on Friday night or Saturday morning.
Syphon\n\nA syphon is a bent tube that moves water from one place to another. It looks like an upside-down letter U. You can find it in a garden or a fish tank. It lets water go up a little and then down a long way, all by itself. No pump is needed. The water falls down one side and pulls more water up the other side. A farmer might use it to give water to plants.
Syria\n\nSyria is a country far away. It sits next to the big blue sea and has tall hills. Many people live in big cities there. It has old stone houses and busy streets. A long time ago, people used a special alphabet to write. Today, children in Syria play soccer and swim. They also go to school to learn.
Syringe\n\nA syringe is a small tool that pushes liquid through a thin, sharp point. It has a hollow tube and a part you push with your thumb. You see it at the doctor's office or in a hospital. A nurse uses it to give medicine that goes right into your body. It is used only one time and then thrown away to keep everyone safe.
Syrup\n\nSyrup is a thick, sweet liquid. It is sticky and pours slowly. You find it on pancakes or waffles at breakfast. People pour it on top to make the food taste sweet. Maple syrup comes from a tree, and chocolate syrup comes from cocoa.
System\n\nA system is a group of things that work together. It can be something you can touch, like all the parts inside a toy car. Or it can be something you cannot touch, like a plan to share toys with friends. A system has parts that each do a job. When all the parts do their job, the whole thing works well. For example, your body is a system. Your heart, lungs, and stomach are parts that work together to keep you alive. Another example is the Solar System. It has the Sun and planets like Earth. They all move around the Sun together.
T-shirt\n\nA T-shirt is a soft shirt with short sleeves and no collar. It is shaped like the letter T when you lay it flat. You can find it in almost every closet. People wear it on warm days or under a jacket when it is cool. It comes in many colors, and sometimes it has a picture or words on the front.
Table\n\nA table is a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs. It has a smooth surface and usually four legs, though some have three or one big leg in the middle. You find it in kitchens, dining rooms, and classrooms. People use it to eat meals, draw pictures, do homework, or put things on top. A kitchen table is where a family sits together for breakfast.
Table (furniture)\n\nA table is a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs. It has a smooth top where you can put things. You find it in kitchens, dining rooms, and classrooms. People use it to eat meals, draw pictures, or play games. At home, you might sit at a table for breakfast with your family.
Table salt\n\nTable salt is tiny white bits that make food taste good. It looks like small clear or white grains. You find it in a shaker on the kitchen table. People sprinkle it on eggs, soup, and other foods to give them more flavor. It also helps keep some foods fresh for a long time. Salt comes from the big, big ocean or from deep under the ground.
Table tennis\n\nTable tennis is a fun game played on a table. It uses a small white ball, two light bats, and a net across the middle. You can play it with one friend or two friends. You hit the ball back and forth over the net. The ball makes a ping-pong sound when it bounces. Many people play it at home, at school, or in a big sports hall. It is a very fast game that makes you move your hands and feet.
Tablet\n\nA tablet is a flat, thin computer. It has a smooth glass screen you can touch with your finger. You can find it at home, at school, or in a store. People use it to play games, watch shows, read stories, or draw pictures. It is like a small TV that fits in your hands. Some tablets are big, and some are small. You can carry it in a bag or hold it on your lap.
Tableware\n\nTableware is the name for all the things we use to eat food. It includes plates, bowls, cups, forks, spoons, and knives. You see it on the table at breakfast, lunch, and dinner. People use it to hold food and to help cut and scoop food into their mouths. A plate is flat and round, a bowl is deep, and a cup has a handle. Some tableware is made of hard white stuff called ceramic, and some is made of shiny metal. At a birthday party, you might see special tableware with bright colors.
Taboo\n\nA taboo is something people are not allowed to do or talk about. It is like a big rule that a group of people share. If someone breaks a taboo, other people may feel upset or think it is very rude. Different groups have different taboos. For example, in many places, eating people is a taboo. Some foods are taboo in certain religions. Talking about private body things in public is often a taboo too.
Tadpole\n\nA tadpole is a baby frog. It lives in the water and breathes like a fish. It has a round body and a long tail that wiggles side to side to help it swim. You can find it in ponds, lakes, or slow streams in the spring. It eats tiny green plants that grow on rocks under the water. As it gets bigger, it grows back legs first, then front legs. Its tail gets smaller and smaller until it is gone. Then it becomes a small frog that can hop on land and breathe air.
Taekwondo\n\nTaekwondo is a way of fighting from Korea. It uses hands and feet to hit and block. Kicking is very big in it because legs are long and strong. People do it as a sport and to stay fit. You can see it in the Olympic Games. Many kids and grown-ups wear a white suit and a colored belt when they practice.
Tag\n\nA tag is a small piece of paper or plastic that tells you something. It is often flat and has words or a picture on it. You can find a tag on a new shirt or a toy. It tells you how to wash the shirt or what the toy is called. Sometimes a tag is stuck on with a string or a sticker. When you buy something, the tag shows the price. You can also see a tag on a pet's collar with its name.
Tagalog language\n\nTagalog language is a way people talk in the Philippines. It is the first language for many people there. Many others learn it as a second language so they can all understand each other. It uses letters like the ones we use in English, but it has a few extra letters. People write it with the same ABC letters we know. You can hear it when Filipino families talk at home or sing songs.
Taiga\n\nTaiga is a big, cold forest. It has many trees with thin, pointy leaves that stay green all year. You can find it in far north places like Canada and Russia. The winters are very cold and long, and the summers are short and cool. Many animals like bears and wolves live there.
Tail\n\nA tail is a long part at the back of an animal's body. It can be short or long, fluffy or smooth. Many animals have a tail, like dogs, cats, and horses. A dog wags its tail when it is happy. A cat uses its tail to keep balance when it walks on a fence. A horse swishes its tail to shoo away flies. Some tails are very colorful, like a peacock's tail.
Taipei\n\nTaipei is a big city on an island called Taiwan. It has tall buildings, busy streets, and many people. One very tall building is called Taipei 101. It looks like a giant tower and lights up at night. In Taipei, you can ride a fast train under the ground. People call it the MRT. There are also buses and cars. Many people ride small scooters to go to work. At night, you can visit a night market. There you can eat yummy food and play games. Taipei has warm weather and lots of rain. Sometimes the air gets a little smoky from all the cars and scooters.
Taiwan\n\nTaiwan is a big island in the ocean near China. It has tall green mountains, busy cities, and warm beaches. Many people live there and speak a language called Mandarin. They grow rice, make computer parts, and ride fast trains. Some children there fly kites by the sea.
Taj Mahal\n\nThe Taj Mahal is a big, beautiful building in India. It is made of white stone that looks pink in the morning and gold at night. It sits next to a river in a city called Agra. A king built it long ago for his wife who died. Many people visit it to see how pretty it is. The air makes the stone turn a little yellow, so people work hard to keep it clean.
Tajikistan\n\nTajikistan is a country far away in the middle of Asia. It has tall, snowy mountains and deep river valleys. Most of the land is high and rocky. The summers are hot and the winters are not too cold. People there speak a language called Tajik. The biggest city is Dushanbe. Long ago, it was part of a big group of countries called the Soviet Union. Now it is its own country.
Take\n\nTake means to pick something up or hold it. You can take a toy from the floor. You can take a cookie from the plate. When you go to school, you take your bag with you. It is something you do with your hands.
Taklamakan Desert\n\nThe Taklamakan Desert is a very big, dry place with lots of sand. It is in China, far away. There is almost no water there, so it is hard to walk across. Long ago, people with camels stopped at small towns with water and trees. Now, some of those towns are empty and broken. The desert is very hot in the day and cold at night.
Tale\n\nA tale is a story. It can be about people, animals, or made-up things. You hear a tale when someone reads a book to you or tells it out loud. Some tales are short, and some are long. A tale can make you laugh, feel happy, or a little scared. Many tales start with "Once upon a time."
Talk\n\nTalk is when people use words to share ideas. It comes out of your mouth as sounds that others can hear. You talk with your family at home, with friends at school, and with teachers in class. It helps you tell someone what you want, how you feel, or a fun story. When you say 'hello' or 'I am hungry,' that is talk.
Talk show\n\nA talk show is a kind of TV or radio program where people talk. It has a host who leads the talk and one or more guests who come to chat. You can find it on a TV at home or hear it on a radio in the car. It is used to share stories, make jokes, or talk about things that matter. Sometimes people at home can call in and join the talk. A famous one is the show with Oprah Winfrey, where she talked to many different people.
Tall\n\nTall means something is very high up. A tall person has a long body from feet to head. A tall tree reaches way up into the sky. You can see tall buildings in a big city. A tall glass holds a lot of water. When you stand next to something tall, you have to look up to see the top.
Tamarind\n\nTamarind is a fruit that grows on a tree. It looks like a brown pod. Inside, it has a sticky, dark brown part that you can eat. It tastes very sour. People use it in cooking to make food taste tangy. In some places, they mix it with water and sugar to make a cool drink. You might find it in a jar or a packet at a store.
Tame\n\nTame means an animal is not wild. It is calm and safe to be near. A tame dog lives in a house and plays with people. You can pet it and it will not run away or bite. A tame cat may sit on your lap and purr. Some birds can be tame too, and they may eat from your hand.
Tamil language\n\nTamil is a language people speak. It has its own letters that look like little drawings. Many people in a place called Tamil Nadu in India speak it every day. They also speak it in Sri Lanka, Singapore, and other parts of the world. You can see it written in books and newspapers. It has been around for a very long time, and many people use it to talk to their family and friends.
Tang\n\nA tang is a strong, sharp taste. It is the zing you feel on your tongue when you eat a lemon or a lime. You can find it in sour candy, yogurt, and some fruits. People use it to make food and drinks more exciting. A glass of cold lemonade on a hot day has a tang that wakes up your mouth.
Tango\n\nTango is a kind of dance. It started long ago in a big city called Buenos Aires. Two people hold each other close and move their feet in a slow, smooth way. The music for it has a strong beat that goes step-step-pause. You can see it at a dance party or on a TV show. Some people learn it in a class with a teacher.
Tank\n\nA tank is a big, strong car that soldiers use. It has a hard metal skin all around to keep the people inside safe. It moves on wide metal belts instead of wheels, so it can go over mud and bumpy ground. A tank has a long gun on top that can shoot far away. Soldiers sit inside and drive it, and one soldier looks out and shoots the gun. You might see a tank in a movie or a picture book about wars.
Tanzania\n\nTanzania is a big country in Africa. It has green land, tall mountains, and a very big lake called Lake Victoria. Many people live there, and they speak different languages. It is home to wild animals like lions and cheetahs that run free in a wide, grassy place called the Serengeti. Some people in Tanzania live in busy cities, and some live in small villages. The weather is warm most of the year.
Taoism\n\nTaoism is a way of thinking and living that started in China long ago. It teaches people to live a simple and quiet life. It says there is a big force called the Tao that moves through everything. People who follow Taoism try to be calm and not fight with others. They also try to live in peace with nature. You might see a round black-and-white sign called yin and yang that shows how two different things can fit together.
Tap\n\nA tap is a thing on a sink that gives water. It has a handle you turn or lift. You find it in the kitchen or bathroom. When you turn it, water comes out for washing hands or filling a cup. Some taps have one handle, and some have two—one for hot water and one for cold.
Tape\n\nTape is a long, flat strip that is sticky on one side. It comes in a round roll that you can hold in your hand. You find it at home, in school, or in an office. People use it to stick paper together or to fix a torn page. Clear tape is see-through, and some tape is brown or colorful. A child might use tape to hang a drawing on the wall.
Tapestry\n\nA tapestry is a big cloth with pictures made from colored threads. It is made by hand on a tall wooden frame. The threads that go side to side cover the threads that go up and down, so you only see the soft, colorful part. Long ago, kings and queens hung it on cold stone walls to keep rooms warm. It can also show a story, like a big battle or a garden full of flowers. You might see one in a museum or a very old house.
Tapir\n\nA tapir is a big animal that looks a little like a pig with a short nose. It has a round body, short legs, and a tiny tail. Its nose and top lip make a short trunk that can grab leaves. It lives in warm, wet forests near water in South America, Central America, and one kind lives in Asia. It eats leaves, fruit, and berries, and it is very good at swimming. A baby tapir has brown fur with white stripes and spots to hide in the woods.
Tarantula\n\nA tarantula is a big, hairy spider. It has eight legs and a round body covered in soft hair. It lives in warm places, like hot forests or deserts. Some live in trees, and some dig holes in the ground. It makes silk, a thin, strong thread, to build a soft home or to wrap up its food. It eats bugs and small animals. A tarantula looks scary, but it mostly hides from danger.
Tardigrade\n\nA tardigrade is a tiny animal that lives in water. It is so small you need a microscope to see it. It has a soft, round body with eight little legs, and each leg has tiny claws. You can find it in wet places like moss, ponds, and even on high mountains. It eats tiny bits of plants. It can live in very hot or very cold places, and it can even go without water for many years. Some people call it a water bear because it looks a little like a bear when it walks.
Taro\n\nTaro is a plant that people eat. It has a big round part under the ground and big green leaves on top. People cook the round part and the leaves to make them safe to eat. If you eat them without cooking, they can make you sick. Taro grows in warm places near the ocean. It is a food that people have eaten for a very long time.
Tarsier\n\nA tarsier is a tiny animal that lives in trees. It has very big round eyes and long back legs. It lives on islands far away in warm places. It jumps from tree to tree at night to catch bugs and small animals to eat. It looks a little like a tiny furry person with a long tail. Some people say it looks like a funny movie character.
Tashkent\n\nTashkent is a big city in a country called Uzbekistan. It has many old buildings, busy streets, and a river next to it. Many people live there, and it is the most important city in its country. It has a museum with old things from long ago, a big theater where people sing and dance, and an old school building made of stone. In summer it gets very hot, and in winter it gets cold with snow. Children there play soccer, and some grow up to be fast runners or bike riders.
Task\n\nA task is a job or a little thing you need to do. It can be something your teacher asks, like putting away your toys. It can also be something at home, like feeding the dog. When you finish a task, you feel good because you helped out.
Tasman Sea\n\nThe Tasman Sea is a big body of water. It sits between two countries: Australia and New Zealand. It is part of the even bigger Pacific Ocean. People use boats to cross it when they travel from one country to the other. Some people call it "The Ditch" as a fun name. The water is deep and blue, and you can see it on a map.
Tasmania\n\nTasmania is a big island that is part of Australia. It sits in the ocean below the main part of Australia. It has many green forests and tall trees. Some animals live only there, like the Tasmanian devil. People can visit old towns and big cities on the island. The biggest city is called Hobart.
Tasmanian devil\n\nA Tasmanian devil is a small, furry animal that eats meat. It is about the size of a little dog, with black fur, a wide head, and a short tail. It lives only on an island called Tasmania. It sleeps during the day and wakes up at night. It makes a very loud, scary noise. It hunts other animals and also eats animals that are already dead. It has strong teeth and can eat bones and fur. A mother Tasmanian devil carries her babies in a pouch on her belly. Many of them are getting sick with a bad lump on their face, so people are trying to help them stay safe.
Taste\n\nTaste is a way your body knows what food is like. It happens when tiny parts on your tongue, called taste buds, feel the food and send a message to your brain. It can tell you if food is sweet like candy, salty like chips, sour like a lemon, or bitter like dark chocolate. It also helps you know if food is safe to eat. When you have a cold and your nose is stuffy, it does not work as well because smell helps it too.
Tasty\n\nTasty means something has a good flavor when you eat it. It can be sweet like candy, salty like chips, or sour like a lemon. You find tasty things at home, at a party, or in your lunch box. When food is tasty, you want to eat more of it. A cookie fresh from the oven is a tasty treat.
Tax\n\nTax is money that people give to the government. The government uses it to pay for things that help everyone. It pays for schools, hospitals, roads, and police. There are many kinds of tax. Some tax is taken from the money you earn at a job. Some tax is added when you buy a toy or a snack. Long ago, people also had to give money to a king or a ruler. That was a kind of tax too.
Taxi\n\nA taxi is a car that anyone can ride. It is often yellow or has a light on top. You see it in big cities on busy streets. You wave your hand to stop it, then tell the driver where you want to go. It takes you right to the door with no other stops. You pay money at the end, and the price goes up the farther you ride.
Taxonomy\n\nTaxonomy is a way to sort things into groups. It is like putting toys into boxes: all the cars go in one box, all the blocks go in another. Scientists use taxonomy to sort animals and plants. For example, they put all birds in one big group and all fish in another. This helps people understand how living things are alike or different.
Tea\n\nTea is a warm drink that people make with leaves and hot water. It can be light green, brown, or dark red. You can find it in cups at home, in a shop, or at a friend's house. Many grown-ups drink it in the morning or when they feel cold. Some people put milk or sugar in it to make it taste sweet. There is also a kind called herbal tea that uses flowers or fruit instead of leaves.
Teach\n\nTo teach is to help someone learn something new. A teacher shows you how to do things, like counting or drawing. You find teaching at school, at home, or anywhere a grown-up helps a child. When you teach, you share what you know so the other person can do it too. For example, a big kid might teach a little kid how to tie shoes.
Teacher\n\nA teacher is a person who helps you learn new things. She works in a room with desks and a big board. You can find her at a school, like your kindergarten or a big kid school. She shows you how to read, write, and count. She also tells you fun stories and helps you make art. When you do not know something, she helps you until you get it. Your teacher at school is one example.
Teaching\n\nTeaching is when one person helps another person learn something new. It can happen at school, at home, or anywhere. A teacher might show you how to count, read a book, or tie your shoes. It uses words, pictures, and sometimes songs to make ideas clear. When you learn to ride a bike, someone is teaching you. Teaching is a kind and helpful thing to do.
Team\n\nA team is a group of people who work or play together. They all try to reach the same goal. You can see a team on a sports field, like a soccer team kicking a ball. In school, you might be on a team for a game or a project. Each person on the team has a job to do. When they help each other, they can do big things.
Tear\n\nA tear is a tiny drop of water that comes from your eye. It feels wet and a little salty. You see tears when you cry because you are sad or hurt. Sometimes tears come when you laugh very hard or when wind blows in your face. It helps wash dust out of your eye and keeps it clean.
Technical drawing\n\nA technical drawing is a careful picture that shows how to build something. It uses lines, shapes, and numbers to tell a clear story. You can find it in places where people make cars, houses, or toys. A person called a drafter draws it so that workers know exactly what to do. For example, before a bridge is built, a technical drawing shows every piece and where it goes.
Technology\n\nTechnology is using what we know to make things that help us. It can be a simple tool like a hammer or a spoon. It can also be a big machine like a car or a computer. People use technology every day to cook food, talk to friends far away, and go places. A long time ago, people made fire and the wheel. Today, we have phones and the internet. Technology makes life easier and helps people all over the world.
Tectonics\n\nTectonics is about how the big, hard outside of the Earth moves. It is like a giant puzzle made of huge rock pieces. These pieces float on a hot, soft layer deep down. They move very, very slowly—only as fast as your fingernails grow. When they bump into each other, they can push up mountains. Sometimes they slide past each other and make the ground shake. That shaking is called an earthquake. You can see mountains and feel earthquakes because of tectonics.
Teddy\n\nA teddy is a soft toy that looks like a bear. It has a round head, two small ears, and a fuzzy body. You can find it in a child's bedroom or on a shelf. A child hugs it at night to feel safe. It can be brown, white, or pink. Many kids get a teddy as a gift when they are very little.
Teeth\n\nTeeth are the hard white parts inside your mouth. They sit in a row on the top and bottom. You use them to bite and chew food so it is easy to swallow. When you smile, people can see your front teeth. You get two sets in your life: baby teeth and then grown-up teeth. It is important to brush them every day to keep them clean and strong.
Tegucigalpa\n\nTegucigalpa is a big city. It is the most important city in a country called Honduras. It sits high up on hills and mountains. Around it, you can see many pine trees and green woods. The weather there has a wet time and a dry time. Many people live in this city.
Tehran\n\nTehran is a very big city. It is the most important city in a country called Iran. Many, many people live there. It has tall buildings, busy streets, and big parks. Long ago, it was a small village, but it grew and grew. Now it is the place where the country's leaders work. You can find old palaces and big markets there. The weather is hot in summer and cold in winter, and sometimes it snows.
Telecommunication\n\nTelecommunication is a way to send messages far away. It uses tools like phones, radios, and computers. Long ago, people used smoke or drums to talk over a distance. Today, you can call Grandma on a phone and hear her voice. A TV show also comes to your house using telecommunication.
Telephone\n\nA telephone is a tool that lets you talk to someone far away. It has a part you hold to your ear and a part you speak into. Long ago, it was tied to the wall with a cord. Now many telephones are small and have no cord. You can carry one in your pocket. People use it to call a friend or family. A child might see a telephone at home when Mom or Dad talks on it.
Telescope\n\nA telescope is a tool that helps you see things that are far away. It looks like a long tube with a big round glass at one end and a small hole to look through at the other end. You can find it in a science room or in a park at night. It makes the moon, stars, and planets look much bigger and closer. When you look through it, you might see the moon's bumps and dips, or a bright star that looks like a tiny dot without it.
Television\n\nA television is a machine with a screen that shows moving pictures and sound. It looks like a flat box with a big glass front. You can find it in many living rooms at home. People use it to watch shows, cartoons, and movies. When you turn it on, you can see people talking, animals running, or funny stories. A remote control helps you change what is on the screen from far away.
Television program\n\nA television program is a show you watch on a TV. It can be a story with people acting, a cartoon, or a show about real animals. You find it on a TV at home, and you pick which one to watch with a remote. Some programs teach you new things, and some are just for fun. A program can be short like a little song, or long like a whole movie. After one program ends, another one starts, and sometimes there are short ads in between.
Tell\n\nTell is a word we use when we share something with words. It means you give a story, a fact, or a secret to someone else. When you tell your friend about your day, you use your voice to make words. You can also tell a story from a book. It is like giving a gift made of words.
Temperate climate\n\nA temperate climate is a place where the weather is not too hot and not too cold. It has four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter. In spring, flowers bloom and it gets warmer. In summer, it can be sunny and warm. In autumn, leaves fall from trees. In winter, it gets cold and sometimes snow falls. The weather can change a lot from one day to the next. Many places where people live have a temperate climate.
Temperature\n\nTemperature is how hot or cold something is. You can feel it with your skin. A hot day feels warm, and ice feels cold. People use a tool called a thermometer to check it. It shows a number that tells you how hot or cold it is. In many places, they use a scale called Celsius. Water freezes at zero and boils at one hundred on that scale. The sun makes the air warm, so summer days have a high temperature. Winter days have a low temperature.
Temple\n\nA temple is a special building where people go to pray. It has walls, a roof, and often a big room inside. You can find a temple in many towns and cities. People go there to be quiet, sing songs, and think about God. Some temples have tall towers or pretty windows. A church is a kind of temple where Christian people go.
Ten\n\nTen is a number. It comes after nine and before eleven. You can see it on a clock, on a ruler, or in a book. It is how many fingers you have on both hands. When you count ten steps, you stop after the tenth step.
Ten Commandments\n\nThe Ten Commandments are ten important rules from the Bible. They were written on two big flat stones a long time ago. People can find them in a holy book called the Bible. The rules tell people to be kind, not to hurt others, and to love God. One rule says to listen to your mom and dad. Another rule says not to take things that are not yours.
Tendon\n\nA tendon is a strong, stretchy band inside your body. It looks like a white rope. It ties a muscle to a bone so they can work together. When a muscle pulls, it pulls the bone, and you can move. You can feel a big tendon on the back of your hand when you wiggle your fingers.
Tennis\n\nTennis is a fun game you play with a soft ball and a racket. It is played on a flat space called a court. The court has a net in the middle. You hit the ball over the net to the other side. If the other player cannot hit it back, you get a point. You can play with one friend or with two friends on each side. People play tennis outside on grass or hard ground. Many people like to watch big tennis games on TV.
Tense (grammar)\n\nTense is a way to show when something happens. It lives inside a doing word, like "run" or "eat". It can change the word to tell us about now, before, or later. For example, "I play" means now. "I played" means before. "I will play" means later. We use it every time we talk or tell a story.
Tent\n\nA tent is a small house made of cloth. It has tall sticks called poles that hold the cloth up. People use it when they sleep outside, like on a camping trip. It keeps the wind and rain away so you stay dry and warm. You can see a tent at a park or in a backyard. Some tents are big enough for a whole family to sit inside.
Term\n\nA term is a word or a group of words that names one thing. It can be a short word like "cat" or a longer one like "fire truck." People use terms when they talk about a special topic, like a game or a job. For example, "home run" is a term in baseball. A term helps everyone know exactly what you mean.
Termite\n\nA termite is a tiny bug that lives in big groups. It has a soft body and looks a little like an ant, but it is not the same. It eats old wood, dead leaves, and dirt. You can find it in warm places, often under the ground or inside old tree stumps. Some termites build tall dirt homes that look like small hills. It can chew through wood in houses, so people try to keep it away.
Tern\n\nA tern is a bird that lives near the water. It has a slim body, long wings, and a tail that looks like a fork. Its feathers are mostly light gray on top and white below, with a black cap on its head. You can see it flying over the sea or a big lake. It dives down fast to catch small fish with its long, pointy beak. Many terns fly very far when the weather gets cold, traveling to warm places and then coming back again.
Terracotta Army\n\nThe Terracotta Army is a big group of clay soldiers. They were made a very long time ago in China. Each soldier is made of baked brown clay and is as tall as a grown man. They were put under the ground near a city called Xi'an. A farmer found them while digging a hole for water. The soldiers were made to guard a king after he died. Every soldier has a different face. Some hold swords, and some hold bows. They stand in neat rows like a real army.
Terrestrial planet\n\nA terrestrial planet is a big ball of rock and metal that goes around a star. It has three main parts: a hard outside called the crust, a soft middle called the mantle, and a hot center called the core. You can find it in space, moving around the sun. Earth is one of these planets, and so are Mars, Venus, and Mercury. It can have tall mountains, deep holes called craters, and even big cracks. Some have air around them, but not always like Earth's air. The ground is made of stone and metal, and it feels hard if you could stand on it.
Terrible\n\nTerrible means something is very, very bad. It can be a scary dream, a loud noise, or a yucky taste. When a toy breaks into many pieces, that feels terrible. A big storm with thunder and lightning can be terrible too. If you fall and hurt your knee, it might feel terrible for a little while.
Terrier\n\nA terrier is a kind of small dog. It has a strong body and short legs. Its fur is often rough and stiff, like a brush. It loves to dig holes in the ground to find little animals. A terrier is very brave and full of energy. It likes to run and play outside. Some terriers have long hair, and some have short hair. You might see a terrier at a park or at a friend's house.
Tesla\n\nTesla is a company that makes cars. It builds cars that run on electricity, not gas. You can see its cars on the road, and they are very quiet. Some of its cars can even drive themselves a little bit. The company also makes big batteries for houses.
Tessellation\n\nA tessellation is a picture made of shapes that fit together with no empty spaces. It uses one shape over and over, like a puzzle. The shapes do not overlap and they cover the whole page. You can see tessellations on floors and walls with tiles. A honeycomb is a tessellation made by bees. The little holes are all the same shape and they fit side by side.
Test\n\nA test is a way to see what you know or can do. It often has questions on paper or a screen. You might take a test at school to show your teacher how much you learned. Sometimes a test is not on paper, like when you try to ride a bike without help. A test can feel a little hard, but it helps you grow.
Texas\n\nTexas is a big state in the United States. It has wide open spaces, hot deserts, green forests, and a long coast by the sea. Many people live in big cities like Houston and Dallas. It is called the Lone Star State because its flag has one star. Long ago, cowboys rode horses and took care of cows there. Today, people work with computers and oil. You can see tall buildings, big trucks, and eat tasty food like tacos.
Text\n\nText is words that people write or type. It can be short like a note or long like a story. You see it in books, on signs, and on your tablet screen. People read text to learn new things or to enjoy a tale. When you send a message to a friend, you use text.
Text to speech\n\nText to speech is a tool that reads words out loud. It takes words on a screen and turns them into a voice you can hear. You can find it on phones, tablets, and computers. It helps people who cannot see well or who find reading hard. For example, it can read a story to you while you look at the pictures.
Textile\n\nA textile is a soft, flat material made from tiny threads. It is made by weaving or looping threads together. You can find it in many places at home, like your clothes, your blanket, and the towel you use after a bath. People use it to make shirts, pants, and cozy socks. It can also cover chairs and beds. Some textiles come from plants, like the fluffy cotton in your t-shirt. Others come from animals, like the warm wool from a sheep.
Textile arts\n\nTextile arts is making things with string, thread, or cloth. It can be a blanket to keep you warm or a pretty picture on the wall. People do it at home or in a craft room. They use their hands to sew, weave, or tie knots. A scarf your mom knits for you is a kind of textile art.
Thai boxing\n\nThai boxing is a way of fighting that comes from Thailand. It uses hands, feet, elbows, and knees to hit. People who do it wear special gloves to keep hands safe. They train very hard to make their body strong. Some kick hard things to make their legs tough. In a match, two people fight in a ring while others watch.
Thai language\n\nThe Thai language is the way people in Thailand talk to each other. It uses a special set of letters that look like pretty shapes and lines. The letters are not like the ABC letters we use in English. When people speak Thai, their voice goes up and down like a song. This is because the same word can mean different things when you say it with a high voice or a low voice. You can hear Thai when you watch a show from Thailand or when you meet someone from that country.
Thailand\n\nThailand is a country in a warm part of the world. It has a king and a flag with red, white, and blue stripes. Many people there go to temples with gold tops and big statues. They eat rice and noodles with tasty spices. Some people ride long boats on rivers. A big city in Thailand is called Bangkok.
Than\n\nThan is a small word we use when we compare two things. It helps us say which one is bigger, faster, or taller. You might say, "My dog is bigger than your cat." It is a word you hear and use every day when you talk with friends and family.
Thank\n\nThank is a word you say when someone does something nice for you. It is a short way to show you are happy and feel good inside. You can say it when you get a gift, when someone helps you, or when a friend shares a toy. Saying thank you makes the other person smile. It is a kind word that everyone likes to hear.
Thanks\n\nThanks is a short way to say "thank you." It is a kind word you say when someone gives you something or helps you. You can say it with a smile or a hug. When you get a cookie from a friend, you say thanks. It makes people feel happy and warm inside.
That\n\nThat is a word we use to point at something far away. It is not close to us, like a toy across the room. We say "that" when we talk about one thing we can see but not touch right now. For example, if you see a bird in a tree, you might say, "Look at that!"
The\n\nThe is a small word we use every day. It helps us point to one special thing, like the sun or the moon. You see it at the start of many sentences and in books. It tells us we are talking about something we both know. For example, when you say 'the cat,' you mean one cat you already see.
The Arts\n\nThe Arts are things people make to share feelings and ideas. They can be pictures you draw, songs you sing, or stories you act out. You find them in books, on walls, and on stages. People use them to make others happy, sad, or excited. A drawing you made for your mom is a piece of art.
The Bahamas\n\nThe Bahamas is a country made of many small islands in the warm blue sea. It has hundreds of islands, but most are tiny and flat. The biggest island is called Andros, and the capital city, Nassau, sits on another island. Many people visit The Bahamas to swim in the clear water and play on the sandy beaches. The people there speak English, and most have dark skin. It is sunny and hot almost all year, and sometimes big storms called hurricanes pass by.
The Beatles\n\nThe Beatles were a group of four friends who made music together. They played guitars, drums, and sang songs. People all over the world loved their happy tunes and dancing. You might hear their music on the radio or in a movie. Many grown-ups still listen to them and smile.
The Blue Marble\n\nThe Blue Marble is a picture of our Earth. It shows the big blue ocean, white clouds, and brown and green land. The picture was taken from a spaceship far, far away. It looks like a round blue ball in the dark sky. Many people love this picture because it shows how pretty our home is.
The Gambia\n\nThe Gambia is a small country in Africa. It is long and thin, and it sits next to the big blue ocean. A big river runs through the middle of it. Most of the land around it belongs to another country called Senegal. Many people there speak English and follow a faith called Islam. The weather is hot, and it rains a lot in the summer.
The Scream\n\nThe Scream is a famous painting by a man named Edvard Munch. It shows a strange person with a round, open mouth and big, wide eyes. The person stands on a bridge, and the sky behind it is red and yellow. The painting lives in a big art house in Norway, a country far away. People look at it and feel strong feelings, like being scared or surprised. You might see a picture of it on a book or a shirt.
The Starry Night\n\nThe Starry Night is a painting of the night sky. It shows a big, bright moon and many stars that look like they are spinning. The sky is blue and full of swirls. Below the sky, there is a small town with dark houses and a tall church. A big, dark tree stands in the front. You can see this painting in a museum. Many people love it because the colors and shapes feel like a dream.
The Thinker\n\nThe Thinker is a statue made of dark, shiny metal. It shows a man sitting on a rock. He bends his arm and puts his chin on his hand. He looks like he is thinking very hard. You can see it in big museums. Many people know this statue because it is famous all over the world.
Theater\n\nA theater is a big room where people go to watch a show. It has a stage at the front with bright lights. Many chairs face the stage so everyone can see. People act, sing, or dance on the stage to tell a story. You might go to a theater to see a play with your family.
Theatre\n\nA theatre is a big room where people watch live shows. It has a stage where actors stand and move. Many people sit in rows of chairs to see the show. The actors wear costumes and pretend to be different people. They tell a story with words and actions. Sometimes there are bright lights and music. You might see a play at a theatre with your family.
Theft\n\nTheft is when someone takes a thing that is not theirs. It is also called stealing. A person who steals is a thief. It can happen in a store, on a street, or in a house. A thief might take a toy, money, or a phone without asking. Stealing is wrong and against the rules. If someone steals, they can get in big trouble.
Their\n\nTheir is a word that shows something belongs to a group of people or animals. It is like saying 'the toy is theirs' when the toy belongs to two or more friends. You can use it when you do not want to say 'his' or 'her' because you are talking about more than one person. For example, if a class has a pet bunny, you can say 'the bunny is their pet.'
Theism\n\nTheism is the idea that there is a god or many gods. It is a way some people think about the world. Some people believe in one god, and some believe in many gods. A person who believes in a god is called a theist. A person who does not believe in any god is called an atheist. Many people around the world are theists. They may go to a special building to pray or sing.
Them\n\nThem is a word we use when we talk about more than one person or thing. It is like saying "those people" or "those things." You hear it when someone says, "I see the kids. I will play with them." It helps us talk about a group without saying all the names. You can use it for people, animals, or things.
Theme park\n\nA theme park is a big fun place with many rides. It has fast rides like roller coasters and wet rides with water. You can also find shops to buy toys and places to eat yummy food. Many parks have a special idea, like a movie world or a water world. One famous park is Disneyland, where you can meet Mickey Mouse. People of all ages go there to have a happy day together.
Then\n\nThen means after something else happens. It tells you what comes next in a story or a day. First you wake up, then you eat breakfast. It helps put things in order so we know what happens when.
Theology\n\nTheology is thinking and talking about God. It is a big word for asking questions like who God is and what God does. People who study theology read old books and tell stories about God. You might hear about it at church or from a grown-up who prays. It helps people understand why we are here and how to be kind.
Theory\n\nA theory is an idea that tries to explain why something happens. It is like a guess that smart people check many times. They look at the world, ask questions, and test the idea to see if it is true. If the idea passes many tests, people trust it more. For example, a theory can explain why the sun comes up every morning or why things fall down when you drop them.
Theory Of Relativity\n\nThe theory of relativity is a big idea from a smart man named Einstein. It tells us that time and space can bend and stretch. It says that time can go slower when you move very fast. It also says that heavy things like stars can pull on light. This idea helps us understand how the whole world works.
Theravada\n\nTheravada is a way of thinking and living that some people follow. It is very old and comes from a warm country far away. People who follow it try to be calm and kind. They sit quietly to make their minds still, like when you take a deep breath. They also try to help others and not hurt any living thing. You might see a statue of a person sitting with eyes closed and a gentle smile—that is a sign of this way.
There\n\nThere is a word we use to point to a place. It is not a thing you can touch. You say it when you want to tell someone where something is. For example, you might say, "Your toy is over there," and point with your finger. It helps people know the spot you mean.
Thermodynamics\n\nThermodynamics is the study of heat and how it moves. It looks at how hot things get and how they cool down. You can see it when you put ice in a warm drink and the ice melts. It also explains why a pot on the stove gets hot when you turn on the fire. Engines in cars and planes use it to make them go.
Thermometer\n\nA thermometer is a tool that tells you how hot or cold something is. It is a long, thin stick with numbers on the side. You can find one at home, at the doctor's office, or in a school. When you feel sick, a grown-up may put one end of it under your tongue or in your ear to check your body heat. Some have a red or silver line that moves up when it gets warm. Others have a little screen that shows the number. A thermometer helps you know if you have a fever.
Thesaurus\n\nA thesaurus is a special book that helps you find words that mean the same thing. It is a big list of words, and next to each word it shows other words that are like it. You can find it in a library or on a computer. When you want a new word for "big," you look in it and see words like "huge" or "large." It also shows words that mean the opposite, like "small" for "big." Many kids and grown-ups use it when they write stories or do homework.
These\n\nThese is a word we use when we point to more than one thing that is close to us. It helps us talk about things we can see or touch right now. For example, if you hold two red blocks, you can say, "These blocks are red." It is the plural form of the word "this." We use it every day when we speak and play.
