Thick\n\nThick means something is wide from one side to the other. It is the opposite of thin. A thick book has many pages. A thick blanket keeps you very warm. You might see a thick tree trunk in the park.
Thief\n\nA thief is a person who takes things that do not belong to them. He might sneak into a house or a store when no one is looking. He takes toys, money, or food without asking. This is not nice and it is against the rules. Police officers try to catch a thief to keep everyone safe. If you see someone taking something that is not theirs, you should tell a grown-up.
Thin\n\nThin means something is not wide or not thick. A piece of paper is thin. A pencil is thin, but a book is thick. When you draw a line with a sharp crayon, the line is thin. Some people are thin, which means their body is not big around. A thin blanket is good for a warm day.
Thing\n\nA thing is something you can see, touch, or think about. It can be big like a house or small like a button. You find things all around you every day. A toy is a thing you play with. A spoon is a thing you eat with. A book is a thing with pages and pictures.
Things\n\nThings are all the objects you can see, touch, or think about. It can be something big like a house or something small like a button. You find things everywhere—in your room, at the park, or in your backpack. People use things every day: a spoon to eat, a book to read, or a toy to play with. A red ball is a thing you might bounce in the yard.
Think\n\nThink is something your brain does. It is like a quiet voice inside your head. You use it to figure things out, like how to build a block tower or what to draw. When you think, you can remember your favorite song or decide which snack you want. Everyone thinks all day long, even when they are sleeping and dreaming.
Thinker\n\nA thinker is a person who uses their brain to have big ideas. She sits quietly and wonders about things like why the sky is blue or how birds fly. You can find a thinker in a library, at school, or even in a park looking at clouds. She asks many questions and tries to find answers. A thinker might write down her ideas or draw pictures to share them. When you solve a puzzle or make up a story, you are being a thinker too.
Third\n\nThird means the one that comes after second. When you count, you say one, two, three. The number three spot is third. In a race, the person who finishes third gets a bronze medal. You might be third in line for the slide at the park. It is a way to tell the order of things.
Thirsty\n\nThirsty is a feeling you get when your body needs water. It makes your mouth and throat feel dry. You can feel thirsty after you run and play outside on a hot day. When you are thirsty, you want a drink of water, juice, or milk. Drinking a big glass of cool water makes the thirsty feeling go away.
Thirteen\n\nThirteen is a number. It comes after twelve and before fourteen. You can count thirteen apples, thirteen crayons, or thirteen blocks. Some people think it is a lucky number, and some think it is not lucky. It has a one and a three when you write it down.
Thirty\n\nThirty is a number. It comes after twenty-nine and before thirty-one. It is three groups of ten. You can count to thirty with your fingers and toes. When you turn thirty, you are not a little kid anymore. Many grown-ups are thirty years old.
This\n\nThis is a word we use to point to something that is close to us. It can be a thing we can touch, like a toy or a book. When we say "this," we mean the one right here, not the one over there. You might say "this cup" when you hold a cup in your hand. It helps people know which thing you are talking about.
Thomas\n\nThomas is a name for a boy. He is a person, just like you. You might meet a Thomas at school or at the park. He could be a friend who likes to play games and share toys. Sometimes a Thomas has a big smile and a kind heart.
Thomas Edison\n\nThomas Edison was a man who made many new things. He made a light that glows with electricity, so people did not need candles at night. He also made a machine that can record sounds and play them back. He worked in a big room with many tools and tried many ideas until one worked. You can see his light bulb in lamps at home.
Thor\n\nThor is a strong god from very old stories. He has red hair and a big beard. He lives in a place up in the sky called Asgard. He makes thunder and lightning when he rides his wagon pulled by two goats. He has a magic hammer that comes back to his hand when he throws it. People long ago told stories about him to explain storms.
Thorax\n\nA thorax is the middle part of a body. In people and animals like dogs and cats, it is the chest. It sits between the neck and the belly. It has strong bones called ribs that protect the heart and lungs. In bugs, it is the part in the middle of the head and the tail. A bug's legs and wings grow from it. You can feel your own chest move when you breathe.
Thoroughbred\n\nA Thoroughbred is a kind of horse. It is tall and has long legs. Its body looks smooth and shiny. People use it to run very fast in races. You can see it at a big track with many seats. It can be brown, red-brown, black, or gray.
Those\n\nThose is a word we use to point at things that are far away. It is the word for more than one thing. You might say "look at those birds" when you see birds in the sky. You can also use it for people, like "those are my friends." It helps us talk about things we can see but are not close to us.
Thoth\n\nThoth is a god from old Egyptian stories. He has the head of a bird with a long, curved beak, or sometimes the head of a dog-like animal. People drew him holding a writing stick and a flat board. In the stories, he was very smart and wrote things down. He helped other gods talk to each other and kept track of what was true and fair. Long ago, people sang songs and had big parties for him in a city by the river.
Though\n\nThough is a small word that joins two ideas. It shows that one idea is a little bit different from the other. You can use it when you want to say something like "I am small, though I am strong." It helps you tell a story with a little surprise or a twist.
Thought\n\nA thought is a little idea that pops into your head. It is like a quiet voice or a picture only you can see. You have thoughts when you are awake, like when you pick a toy or remember a song. It can be about anything—your pet, a cookie, or a happy day. Sometimes a thought comes fast, and sometimes you sit and think for a long time. It helps you choose what to do next.
Thought experiment\n\nA thought experiment is a test you do inside your head. It is not a test with real things you can touch. You ask a question like "what if this happened?" and then you think about what would come next. It helps people learn new ideas without a lab. Scientists and thinkers use it to understand hard things. Anyone can try it, even you.
Three\n\nThree is a number. It comes after two and before four. You can see it on a clock, on a dice, or when you count your fingers. If you have three cookies, you have one, two, three cookies. It is one more than a pair.
Three Dimensional Space\n\nThree dimensional space is the world around us. It has three ways to move: left and right, up and down, and forward and back. You can see it when you look at a ball, a box, or your own room. Everything you touch takes up space in these three ways. When you draw a picture, it is flat, but the real thing is not flat—it has depth too.
Throat\n\nA throat is a tube inside your neck. It helps you swallow food and drink. It also lets air go in and out when you breathe. You can feel it move when you say words or sing a song. Sometimes it feels sore when you are sick.
Throne\n\nA throne is a big, fancy chair. It is made for a king or a queen. It often has gold and soft red cloth. You can see it in a castle or a palace. The king or queen sits on it during special times. It shows that they are the most important person in the room.
Through\n\nThrough means moving from one side to the other side. It is like when you walk into a tunnel and come out the other end. You can look through a window to see what is outside. A ball can roll through a hoop. When you push a string through a bead, the bead goes onto the string.
Throw\n\nThrow means to send something through the air with your hand. You can throw a ball to a friend, and they catch it. It is a way to play games like catch or baseball. When you throw, you move your arm back and then forward fast. The thing you throw goes up and then comes down. Some things are easy to throw, like a soft ball. Other things are hard to throw, like a big rock.
Thud\n\nA thud is a short, low sound. It is the noise you hear when something heavy falls on the floor. You might hear it when a big book drops or when you jump off a chair. It is not a sharp sound like a bang; it is more like a soft, deep bump. Sometimes a thud can be a little scary if you do not know what made it.
Thumb\n\nA thumb is the short, thick finger on your hand. It is on the side of your hand, away from the other four fingers. It can bend and touch the tips of all your other fingers. This helps you hold a spoon, a crayon, or a toy. You use it every day to pick up small things. Without it, many jobs would be very hard to do.
Thump\n\nA thump is a deep, heavy sound. It happens when something big and soft hits a floor or a wall. You might hear it when a heavy book falls off a table. It is not a sharp sound like a clap or a bang. Sometimes your heart makes a thump sound when you are scared or excited.
Thunder\n\nThunder is a loud sound that comes from the sky. It happens when lightning flashes during a storm. Lightning makes the air very hot, and the hot air pushes out fast to make the big boom. You hear it after you see the lightning because light travels faster than sound. It can be a short crack or a long rumble. Sometimes it is so loud it shakes the windows. When you hear it, you know a storm is near.
Thunderstorm\n\nA thunderstorm is a big storm with strong wind, heavy rain, lightning, and loud thunder. It looks like a tall, dark cloud that can be flat on top. You see it in the sky when the air near the ground is warm and wet. It makes flashes of light called lightning and a big boom sound called thunder. Rain falls so hard that streets can fill with water fast. After it passes, the air feels cool and clean, and sometimes you see a rainbow.
Thursday\n\nThursday is a day of the week. It comes after Wednesday and before Friday. It is one of the seven days we count every week. Many people go to school or work on this day. Some kids have special activities like music class or sports practice on Thursday. It is not the weekend yet, but the weekend is very close.
Thyme\n\nThyme is a small green plant that smells very nice. It has tiny leaves and small flowers that can be white, pink, or purple. People grow it in gardens where the sun is hot and the ground is dry. It is used to make food taste good, like in soup or on meat. You might see it in the kitchen as little dried leaves in a jar.
Tian Shan\n\nTian Shan is a very big group of tall mountains. It is in the middle of Asia, near China and other countries. The tops are so high that snow stays on them all year. Long ago, people walked next to it to travel from one land to another. They used a path called the Silk Road. Today, some parts of it are special places that the whole world wants to keep safe.
Tibet\n\nTibet is a big place with tall mountains. It has snowy tops and wide open land. Many people there follow a peaceful way of thinking called Buddhism. They have special teachers called monks who wear red and yellow robes. Some monks live in big houses called temples where they sit quietly and think. A long time ago, Tibet had its own king, but now it is part of China. People in Tibet like to drink tea with butter and salt. They also have a special animal called a yak that gives them milk and wool.
Tibetan Plateau\n\nThe Tibetan Plateau is a very big, flat land that sits way up high. It is so high that it touches the sky. It is found in a part of the world called Asia. Many mountains grew around it a long, long time ago. The land is so big and high that it changes the weather. It helps bring rain to places far away. Some people live there with their animals, like yaks.
Tick\n\nA tick is a very short, soft sound. It is like a tiny tap or a light click. You can hear it from a clock on the wall. The clock makes a tick sound every second as the hands move. Some timers and watches also make this sound. It is a quiet noise that helps you count time.
Ticket\n\nA ticket is a small piece of paper or a picture on a phone. It lets you go into a place or ride on something. You can get a ticket at a movie theater, a train station, or a big park. A person at the door looks at it and lets you in. Sometimes you keep the ticket to remember a fun day.
Tickle\n\nA tickle is a light touch that makes you laugh. It feels like a little wiggle on your skin. You can find it when someone touches your belly, feet, or under your arms. People do it to play and have fun with friends. A tickle can make you giggle and squirm. Sometimes a feather or a soft brush can give a tickle too.
Tide\n\nA tide is the way the big water in the ocean moves up and down. It goes up high on the beach, then it goes back down low. The Moon in the sky pulls the water and makes it move. When the water is high, we call it high tide. When the water is low, we call it low tide. You can see the tide at the beach. In the morning the water might be far away, and later it comes close to your feet. The tide changes two times every day.
Tidy\n\nTidy means to put things in their right place so a room looks clean. When you tidy, you pick up toys from the floor and put them in a box. You also make your bed smooth and put books back on the shelf. It helps you find your things fast. A tidy room feels nice to play in.
Tie\n\nA tie is a long, thin piece of cloth. It goes around the neck and hangs down in front. People wear it with a shirt for fancy times, like a party or a wedding. It can be many colors and have stripes or dots. A grown-up ties it in a knot at the top.
Tiger\n\nA tiger is a big wild cat. It has orange fur with black stripes and a white belly. No two tigers have the same stripes. It lives in Asia, in forests and places with water. It hunts alone and eats meat, like deer and pigs. Some tigers are white, but that is very rare. People can see it in a zoo.
Tiger shark\n\nA tiger shark is a big fish that lives in the warm, blue sea. It has a long, strong body with dark stripes and spots, like a tiger. It has a wide head, big eyes, and many sharp teeth. It swims near the shore and in deep water. It hunts at night and eats fish, seals, and turtles. Sometimes it even eats trash that falls in the water. It can be mean and may bite people, but that does not happen a lot.
Tight\n\nTight means something is held very close or pulled hard so there is no extra space. It is the opposite of loose. Your shoes feel tight when they are too small and squeeze your foot. A lid on a jar is tight when you cannot turn it open. A hug can be tight when someone holds you very close and does not let go.
Tigris\n\nTigris is a long river in a hot, dry part of the world. It starts in mountains far away and flows down through flat land. Long ago, people used its water to grow food like wheat and barley. They dug small paths from the river to their fields. This helped them make the first big towns. Today, many people still live near it and use its water.
Tilapia\n\nTilapia is a kind of fish. It has shiny scales and fins that help it swim. It lives in warm, fresh water like lakes and rivers. People raise it on farms to eat, and some keep it in fish tanks at home. It can be found in many parts of the world, such as Africa and South America. Sometimes, when it gets into new rivers, it can push out the fish that already lived there.
Till\n\nA till is a drawer that holds money in a store. It sits on a counter where you pay for things. When you buy a toy or some candy, the shop worker opens it to put your money inside. It has a bell that rings when it opens. Some tills have a screen that shows numbers. You might see one at the grocery store or a toy shop.
Tillage\n\nTillage is a way to get the ground ready for planting. It uses big tools pulled by a tractor or an animal to break up the hard top of the dirt. This lets air and sun go into the ground, which helps plants grow. But if people do it too much, the dirt can get tired and not work as well. Farmers do tillage before they put seeds in the field.
Timbuktu\n\nTimbuktu is a city in a country called Mali. It is in a hot, sandy place near a big desert. Long ago, it was a place where many people came to learn and to trade. People brought salt and other things to sell there. It has old buildings where people prayed and studied. Many smart people wrote books there a long time ago.
Time\n\nTime is the way we know when things happen. It moves from morning to night, and from today to tomorrow. We use clocks and watches to see what time it is. A clock has numbers and hands that move around. The sun also helps us tell time by making shadows that change during the day. Long ago, people used the sun and moon to count days and months. Now we have calendars to know the date and plan for fun days like birthdays.
Time travel\n\nTime travel is the idea of moving to a different time. It means going to the past, like yesterday, or to the future, like tomorrow. We all move forward in time every day, but time travel is about jumping far ahead or going back. In stories, people use a special machine to travel through time. One famous story is about a man who builds a time machine and visits strange new times. Another story has a funny car that can fly to the past or future. Some TV shows use magic to go to other times instead of a machine. Time travel is not real, but it is fun to think about.
Time zone\n\nA time zone is a way to tell time in different parts of the world. It is like a big clock map that cuts the Earth into 24 slices. When the sun is up in one slice, it is dark in another. People use time zones so that noon is always around the middle of the day where they live. For example, when it is morning in New York, it is already afternoon in London. Some places change their clocks by one hour in summer to have more light in the evening.
Timer\n\nA timer is a small tool that counts time. It has numbers on it and a button to start. You find it in a kitchen or on a phone. People use it to know when food is ready or when playtime is over. When the time is up, it makes a loud beep or ring.
Timor\n\nTimor is a big island in the sea. It has green hills, tall trees, and sandy beaches. You find it in a warm part of the world, near many other islands. People live on both sides of the island. Some people live in East Timor, and some live in West Timor. They grow food like corn and rice. They also catch fish in the blue water. The name means "east" because it sits at the east end of a long row of islands.
Timor Sea\n\nThe Timor Sea is a big body of water. It is not very deep, and it sits between the island of Timor and the north part of Australia. It has many small islands and reefs where no people live. Big rivers from Australia flow into it. The city of Darwin is next to it. Long ago, people may have crossed it in small boats to reach Australia.
Tin\n\nTin is a shiny, silver metal. It is soft and can bend easily. When you bend it, it makes a little crackling sound. People find tin in rocks in the ground. They heat the rocks to get the metal out. Long ago, people mixed tin with copper to make bronze. Bronze was used for tools and swords. Today, tin is used to coat other metals so they do not rust. Food cans often have a thin layer of tin inside. You might see a shiny can in your kitchen.
Tinamou\n\nA tinamou is a bird that lives on the ground. It has a round body, short legs, and small wings. It lives in forests and grassy places in warm parts of the world. It hides very well and is hard to see. It makes a soft whistling sound. It eats seeds, fruit, and little bugs.
Tiny\n\nTiny means very, very small. It is smaller than a little bug or a baby's fingernail. You can find tiny things all around you, like a grain of sand or a drop of water. When something is tiny, you might need to look very close to see it. A tiny seed can grow into a big plant.
Tip\n\nA tip is the very end of something long and thin. It is the pointy part at the top of a pencil or the end of your finger. You can also give a tip when you say a helpful hint to a friend. A tip can be a small extra coin you leave for someone who brings your food. It is a little thing that helps or finishes something.
Tire\n\nA tire is a round, rubber ring that fits on a wheel. It is black and has lines on the outside called treads. You see tires on cars, buses, and trucks. It helps the vehicle roll smoothly on the road. When the treads get worn down, the tire must be changed so the car stays safe.
Tired\n\nTired is a feeling you get when your body needs rest. It can make your eyes feel heavy and your body feel slow. You might feel tired after running, playing, or a long day at school. When you are tired, you may yawn a lot or want to lie down. The best way to fix it is to sleep or take a nap.
Tissue\n\nTissue is a group of tiny parts called cells that work together. It is found inside the bodies of animals and plants. In animals, there are four main kinds of tissue. One kind helps the body move, like in your legs. Another kind covers the outside of the body and the inside of the mouth. A third kind holds things together, like bones. The last kind sends messages, like in the brain. Organs, like the heart, are made of different tissues working together. A tissue is so small you need a special tool to see it.
Titan (moon)\n\nTitan is a big moon that goes around the planet Saturn. It is very cold and has a thick blanket of air around it. This air is not like Earth's air — people cannot breathe it. Titan has lakes and rivers, but they are not made of water. They are made of a liquid that can catch fire. It is one of the biggest moons we know. A robot from Earth once landed on it and sent back pictures.
Titan (mythology)\n\nA Titan is a big, strong being from very old Greek stories. They were the first gods and goddesses who ruled the world a long, long time ago. Later, new gods called Olympians fought them and won. After that, many Titans were sent to a deep, dark place under the ground. You can find pictures of them in books about Greek myths. They look like giant people with great power.
Title\n\nA title is the name of a book, a movie, a song, or a story. It is the big words you see on the front cover. It tells you what the thing is called. When you go to the library, you can look for a book by its title. Your favorite bedtime story has a title too.
To\n\nTo is a tiny word we use to show where something is going. It points the way, like when you say "I go to the park." It can also show who gets something, like "Give the cookie to me." You hear it all the time when people talk and in storybooks.
Toad\n\nA toad is a small animal with bumpy skin. It has four short legs and big round eyes. It lives in gardens, woods, or near water. It hops on the ground and eats bugs. You might see one after rain.
Toast\n\nToast is bread that has been made warm and brown. It is flat and feels a little crunchy on the outside. You can find it on a plate at breakfast time. People make it by putting bread in a toaster or a hot pan. It tastes good with butter, jam, or honey on top. A slice of toast is a simple food that many kids eat in the morning.
Toaster\n\nA toaster is a small machine in the kitchen. It has slots on top where you put slices of bread. When you push a button, it gets hot inside and turns the bread brown and crunchy. People use it to make toast for breakfast. You can put butter or jam on the toast after it pops up.
Today\n\nToday is the day we are in right now. It starts when the sun comes up and ends when we go to sleep at night. You can see it outside your window. We do many things today, like eat breakfast, play, and learn. Yesterday was the day before today, and tomorrow will be the day after.
Toe\n\nA toe is a small part at the end of your foot. It is short and round, and you have five of them on each foot. It helps you stand and walk without falling over. You can wiggle it, and it feels ticklish when someone touches it. Sometimes people paint the hard part at the tip with bright colors.
Tofu\n\nTofu is a soft, white food made from soybeans. It looks like a smooth block, a little like cheese. You can find it in the fridge at the grocery store. People cook it in soup, fry it in a pan, or eat it cold. It takes on the taste of the sauce or food around it. In many places like China, Japan, and Korea, people eat tofu every day. It is good for your body because it has a lot of protein.
Together\n\nTogether means two or more people or things are with each other. It is when you hold hands with a friend or sit next to someone. You can do things together like play, eat, or sing. When you are together, you are not alone. A family eats dinner together at the table.
Togo\n\nTogo is a small country in Africa. It is next to the big water called the ocean. Many people there grow food like corn, beans, and sweet potatoes. Monkeys, snakes, and lizards live in the trees and grass. The people speak French and eat yummy snacks made from peanuts.
Toilet\n\nA toilet is a bowl that you sit on to get rid of pee and poop from your body. It has a seat and a lid. You find it in a small room called a bathroom or restroom. When you are done, you push a handle or button, and water washes everything away through a pipe. Some toilets are outside in a little house called an outhouse. At big parties or parks, you might see a plastic toilet that can be moved, called a portable toilet.
Tokyo\n\nTokyo is a big city in Japan. It has many tall buildings, busy streets, and lots of people. It is near the water, by a big bay. Many trains and buses move people around the city every day. You can see a tall tower called Tokyo Tower and a very tall tower called Tokyo Skytree. There are also pretty parks and old temples to visit. Many people from all over the world live in or visit Tokyo.
Tom\n\nTom is a name for a boy or a man. It is short and easy to say. You might know a Tom at school or in your neighborhood. Sometimes a Tom has a pet or likes to play ball. He can be a friend who shares his toys with you.
Tomato\n\nA tomato is a round, smooth food that grows on a plant. It is shiny and can be red, yellow, or orange. When it is not ready to eat, it is green and hard. Inside, it has many tiny seeds and soft, juicy parts. People eat it raw in salads or on sandwiches. It is also cooked to make yummy sauces for pasta and pizza. Ketchup is made from tomatoes too. You can find it in a garden or at the grocery store.
Tomb\n\nA tomb is a small house made of stone. It holds a person who has died. You can find it in a quiet place like a graveyard. People visit it to remember someone they loved. It has a door or a big flat stone on top.
Tomorrow\n\nTomorrow is the day that comes after today. It is not here yet, but it will be here when you wake up from a night of sleep. People talk about tomorrow to say what they will do next. For example, if today you go to the park, tomorrow you might go to school. It is a new day full of things to do.
Tongs\n\nTongs are a tool you hold in one hand. It has two long arms that pinch together. You find it in the kitchen near the stove. It is used to pick up hot food so you do not burn your fingers. You might see it when someone flips meat on a grill or serves salad from a big bowl.
Tongue\n\nA tongue is the soft, pink part inside your mouth. It is a strong muscle that can move in many ways. You use it to taste food—sweet, sour, salty, and bitter. It also helps you eat by pushing food around and mixing it with spit. When you talk, it moves to make different sounds. Some people can roll their tongue into a tube shape. If you blow through the rolled tongue, you can make a funny high sound.
Tonight\n\nTonight means the night time of today. It is the dark part of the day after the sun goes down. You can see the moon and stars in the sky. People sleep at this time, but some animals like owls wake up. You might hear a bedtime story or see a nightlight in your room.
Too\n\nToo means more than enough. When you have too many cookies, you cannot eat them all. If the music is too loud, it hurts your ears. Sometimes you feel too tired to play. It is a word we use when something is bigger, louder, or more than we want.
Tool\n\nA tool is something you hold in your hand to help you do a job. It can be small like a spoon or big like a shovel. You find tools at home, in a kitchen, or in a garage. People use it to cut, hit, turn, or dig things. A hammer is a tool that hits a nail. A saw is a tool that cuts wood. Some tools need a plug to work, like a drill. Long ago, people made the first tools from sticks and stones.
Tooth\n\nA tooth is a small, hard white part inside your mouth. It has a top part you can see and a root that holds it in your gum. You use it to bite and chew food like apples or bread. You have baby teeth when you are little, and later they fall out so big teeth can grow. You brush it every day to keep it clean and shiny.
Toothache\n\nA toothache is a hurt feeling inside a tooth. It can feel like a sharp poke or a dull ache that does not go away. You feel it in your mouth, right where your teeth are. It can happen when a tooth has a tiny hole or when you eat something very cold or very hot. A dentist is a special doctor who helps fix a toothache and make the hurt stop.
Toothbrush\n\nA toothbrush is a small tool for cleaning teeth. It has a long handle and a top with soft little hairs called bristles. You find it in the bathroom near the sink. People use it with toothpaste to make teeth shiny and clean. You move it back and forth on your teeth every morning and night. A toothbrush can be many colors, and some have a fun picture on the handle.
Top\n\nA top is a piece of clothing. It covers the upper part of your body. You can find it in a closet or a store. People wear it with pants or a skirt. A t-shirt is a kind of top.
Topic\n\nA topic is what you talk or learn about. It is the big idea of a story, a lesson, or a chat. When you sit in a circle and share, you pick a topic like pets or colors. It helps everyone know what to think about. A teacher might say, "Today our topic is the sun." Then you all learn about that one thing.
Topology\n\nTopology is a kind of math that looks at shapes. It does not care about how big or small a shape is. It cares about how the shape is connected. For example, a donut and a coffee cup are the same in this math because each has one hole. You can stretch or bend the shape, but you cannot tear it. This math helps people understand maps and knots.
Torah\n\nTorah is a very special set of books. It has five parts, like five big chapters. People read it in a quiet place called a synagogue. It tells old stories about how the world began and about a man named Moses. Many families keep one at home and read it together.
Torch\n\nA torch is a stick with fire on top. It has a long handle you can hold. The fire part is bright and hot. People used it long ago to see in the dark. You might see one in a story about a castle or a cave.
Tornado\n\nA tornado is a spinning tube of air that touches the ground. It looks like a dark, twisting cloud that comes down from a big storm. You can see it in places with strong thunderstorms, especially in the middle of the United States. It spins very fast and can break houses, toss cars, and knock down trees. If you hear a loud roar like a train, you should go to a safe room with no windows right away.
Toronto\n\nToronto is a big city in Canada. It sits next to a very large lake called Lake Ontario. It has many tall buildings, like the CN Tower, which is one of the tallest towers in the world. People from all over the world live there and speak many different languages. You can see animals at the Toronto Zoo or ride fun rides at Canada's Wonderland. It has teams for hockey, basketball, and baseball. Many visitors come to see the big buildings and eat food from different countries.
Torpedo\n\nA torpedo is a long, thin weapon that moves under the water. It has a sharp front and a spinning tail that pushes it forward. People launch it from a ship or a submarine. It swims by itself toward a target and then goes bang when it gets close. Sailors use it to stop other ships in a fight.
Tortoise\n\nA tortoise is an animal that lives on land. It has a hard shell on its back to keep it safe. It moves very slowly on four short legs. You can find it in warm, dry places like deserts or grassy fields. It eats plants like grass and leaves. A tortoise can live for a very, very long time, longer than many other animals.
Toucan\n\nA toucan is a bright bird that lives in warm, rainy forests. It has black feathers and a very big, colorful beak. The beak looks heavy, but it is light and helps it pick fruit from trees. It lives high up in the trees and sleeps inside tree holes. It flies short hops from tree to tree. You might see a picture of it on a cereal box or in a book about jungle animals.
Touch\n\nTouch is when you feel something with your skin. It happens when your hand or finger meets a thing. You can touch a soft teddy bear, a cold ice cube, or a warm blanket. Your skin tells your brain if the thing is smooth, bumpy, hot, or cold. Touch helps you learn about the world without using your eyes.
Touchscreen\n\nA touchscreen is a special screen you can touch with your finger to make things happen. It is flat and smooth, like the front of a tablet or phone. You find it on smartphones, tablets, and some computers. When you tap or swipe it, it tells the device what to do. For example, you can play a game or draw a picture just by moving your finger on it.
Tour de France\n\nThe Tour de France is a big bike race. It happens every summer in a country called France. Many bike riders go very fast on roads for many days. The rider who finishes first each day gets a special shirt. A yellow shirt is for the fastest rider of all. A green shirt is for the rider who goes fast on flat roads. A shirt with dots is for the rider who is best at going up hills. The race ends in a big city with a tall tower. People all over the world watch it on TV.
Tourism\n\nTourism is when people go to new places to have fun. It means taking a trip to see pretty things, like a big mountain or a blue sea. People who do this are called tourists. They might sleep in a tent or a hotel. They might look at old buildings or play on a sandy beach. Some places have many tourists every year. This can be good because it brings money. But it can also make a mess if people leave trash. It is important to keep the place clean for the animals and people who live there.
Toward\n\nToward means moving closer to something. When you walk toward the door, you get nearer to it. It can also mean looking or facing a way. If you turn toward the window, you can see outside. It is a word that tells which way you go.
Towel\n\nA towel is a soft piece of cloth. It is often square or long like a rectangle. You find it in the bathroom or at the pool. People use it to dry their hands, face, or body after a bath or a swim. It soaks up water so you feel warm and dry. Some towels are fluffy and some are thin. A beach towel is big and colorful.
Tower\n\nA tower is a very tall, thin building. It is much taller than it is wide. People do not live inside it like a house. You can see towers on old castles, where they helped people look far away. Today, some towers hold up big bridges. Other towers send signals for radios and phones. A tall clock tower in a town is one kind of tower you might see.
Tower Bridge\n\nTower Bridge is a big bridge in London. It has two tall towers and a road that can open up in the middle. When a tall boat comes, the road lifts high so the boat can go through. It is painted blue and white, and many people visit it to take pictures. You can walk across the top part and look down at the river. It is very old and very strong.
Town\n\nA town is a place where many people live. It has houses, streets, and shops. It is bigger than a village but smaller than a city. You can find a town in many parts of the world. People in a town work in stores, offices, or small factories. Some towns have a park where children play. A town might have a school, a library, and a fire station. If you visit a town, you can walk on the sidewalk and see many buildings close together.
Toxicity\n\nToxicity is how much a thing can hurt a living body. It tells us if something is safe or if it can make us sick. Some things are very toxic, like snake poison. Even water can be toxic if a person drinks way too much at once. A small bit of a toxic thing may not hurt at all, but a big bit can be very bad. Doctors and scientists study toxicity to keep people safe. They test things on animals or in labs, not on people. If someone touches or eats something toxic by accident, a doctor can help.
Toy\n\nA toy is a thing you play with. It can be soft or hard, big or small. You find toys at home, in a store, or at a friend's house. People use toys to have fun and make up stories. A ball is a toy you can throw and catch. A doll is a toy that looks like a tiny person. Some toys roll, some make noise, and some you can hug. Toys are for kids, grown-ups, and even pets.
Trace\n\nA trace is a tiny mark left behind by something. It can be a line, a shape, or a small spot. You might see a trace of a snail on the ground—a shiny, wet line. A pencil can leave a trace on paper when you draw. You can also trace a picture by putting paper on top and copying the lines. A trace shows where something has been.
Track\n\nA track is a long, flat path made for running, walking, or riding. It can be made of dirt, rubber, or hard ground. You can find a track at a school, a park, or a sports field. People use it to run races or ride bikes in circles. Sometimes a train runs on a metal track too.
Track and field athletics\n\nTrack and field is a sport where people run, jump, and throw things. It happens on a big oval track and a grassy field inside it. Runners race on the track, and jumpers and throwers play on the field. Kids do it at school for fun, and grown-ups do it in big games like the Olympics. You might see a friend run fast or jump over a bar.
Tractor\n\nA tractor is a big, strong machine that pulls heavy things. It has very large wheels with deep bumps to grip the ground. You see it on farms, where it pulls plows to dig the dirt. It also pulls trailers full of food or hay. A farmer sits on the seat and drives it slowly across the field. Some tractors have rubber tracks instead of wheels so they do not sink in soft mud.
Trade\n\nTrade is when people give things to each other. It can be a toy for a snack, or a snack for a toy. Sometimes people use money to trade. You give money and get a toy. That is buying. The person who gives the toy gets money. That is selling. A long time ago, people traded without money. They gave one thing for another thing. That is called barter. You can see trade at a store or a market. Mom and Dad trade money for food at the store. Trade helps people get what they need.
Trade union\n\nA trade union is a group of workers who join together. They talk to the boss about pay, hours, and safety. If the boss says no, they may stop working for a short time. This is called a strike. It helps workers get fair treatment at their job.
Tradition\n\nA tradition is something people do again and again, often on a special day. It can be a fun game, a song, or a food that a family makes together. You might see it at a birthday party or a holiday like Christmas. It helps people feel close and remember happy times. For example, some families always eat cake on the first day of school.
Traditional\n\nTraditional means something that people have done for a long, long time. It is a way of doing things that moms, dads, grandmas, and grandpas did before. You can see it in special clothes, songs, or food that a family makes on a holiday. It is like a story that gets passed down. For example, eating cake on a birthday is a traditional thing many families do.
Traditional Chinese medicine\n\nTraditional Chinese medicine is a very old way of helping sick people feel better. It started in China a long, long time ago. It uses plants, tiny needles, cups that stick to the skin, and soft rubbing to help the body. It also uses slow moving and breathing to keep the body strong. It tries to make the inside of the body calm and even, like a quiet pond.
Traditional medicine\n\nTraditional medicine is a way to help sick people feel better. It uses old ideas that moms, dads, and grandparents share in a family or a town. People use plants, leaves, roots, and warm drinks to make the body strong. In some places, a wise person in the village knows which plant to pick for a tummy ache or a cold. It is different from the medicine you get at a big store or a doctor's office today.
Traffic\n\nTraffic is many cars, trucks, and buses moving on a road. It can look like a long line of vehicles waiting. You see it on big streets and highways, especially when people go to work or come home. Sometimes it moves very slowly, and you have to wait. A red light or a crossing guard can stop traffic so people can walk safely.
Traffic collision\n\nA traffic collision is when a car or truck bumps into something. It can hit another car, a person, or a thing on the road. It often hurts people and breaks things. Many people get hurt in these bumps every year. Roads can be made safer with special paths and safe places to cross.
Tragedy (Greek theatre)\n\nA tragedy is a kind of play with a sad ending. It is a story where the main person has a good heart but one big problem that brings trouble. In the play, the person tries to stop a bad thing from happening, but it happens anyway. Long ago, people in Greece acted out these plays at big parties for their gods. Today, people still watch sad plays and sometimes cry. A tragedy can also mean a very sad thing in real life, like when someone gets hurt.
Trail\n\nA trail is a path on the ground for walking. It is a long, thin line of dirt, rocks, or grass. You can find it in a forest, a park, or on a hill. People walk on it to see trees, flowers, and animals. Some trails are short, and some are very long. You might ride a bike on it or walk with your family. A trail helps you go from one place to another without getting lost.
Train\n\nA train is a long line of cars that move on tracks. It has a strong engine at the front that pulls the rest. You can see it at a train station, where people get on and off. It carries people from one place to another, and it also carries big boxes of food, toys, and other things. Some trains go very fast, and some go under the ground in big cities. When you hear a loud whistle and see a long line of metal cars on rails, that is a train.
Train station\n\nA train station is a place where people get on and off trains. It has a long, flat area next to the train tracks called a platform. You can find it in towns and cities. People use it to travel to other places. You might see a ticket window where you buy a paper to ride the train. Some stations have benches to sit on and a roof to keep you dry when it rains. Big stations may have a small shop to buy snacks.
Tram\n\nA tram is a long box on wheels that carries people. It looks like a small train and runs on metal tracks. You can see it on streets in big cities. It stops at special places so people can get on and off. Many people ride it together instead of using a car. Some trams are old and pretty, and some are new and bendy in the middle. In some cities, trams have two floors.
Transformer\n\nA transformer is a box that changes how strong electricity is. It has two loops of wire inside, wrapped around a metal middle. You can see it on a pole near your house or on the ground in a big metal box. It makes the strong power from far-away wires safe for lights and toys at home. It does not make new power; it only changes the push of the power.
Translation\n\nTranslation is when you change words from one language to another. It helps people who speak different languages understand each other. A person who does this is called a translator. They use a special book to find the right words. Sometimes they change spoken words, and then they are called an interpreter. You can also use a computer to translate. Google Translate is a free tool that does this on the internet.
Transmit\n\nTransmit means to send something from one place to another. It is like when you throw a ball to a friend. A radio can transmit music through the air to a speaker. A phone can transmit your voice so someone far away can hear you. It is a way to move a message or a signal without carrying it yourself.
Transport\n\nTransport is how people and things move from one place to another. It uses roads, train tracks, water paths, and sky paths. Cars, buses, trains, boats, and planes are all ways to move. You see transport every day when you ride in a car or see a big truck on the street.
Trash\n\nTrash is stuff we throw away. It can be old food, paper, or broken toys. You find it in a trash can at home or on the street. People put it in a big bin, and a truck takes it away. We should not drop it on the ground because it makes places dirty.
Travel\n\nTravel is going from one place to another. It can be a short trip, like going to the store, or a long trip, like going to a new city. People travel in cars, on buses, on trains, or in big flying machines called planes. Some people travel to see new things and have fun. They may sleep in a hotel or a tent. A family trip to the beach is one kind of travel.
Tray\n\nA tray is a flat, wide thing you use to carry food or drinks. It can be made of wood, plastic, or shiny metal. You often see it in a kitchen or at a restaurant. A waiter holds it to bring plates and cups to the table. At home, you might use it to have breakfast in bed or to carry snacks to the living room.
Treasure\n\nA treasure is a hidden box of special things. It is often full of gold coins, shiny jewels, and pretty stones. You can find it buried under the ground or inside a big wooden chest. Pirates in stories look for treasure on faraway islands. Sometimes people hide a treasure for others to find as a fun game.
Treat\n\nA treat is something nice you get as a surprise. It can be a sweet snack like a cookie or a piece of candy. Sometimes it is a fun activity, like watching a movie or going to the park. You might get a treat when you do something good, like sharing toys or finishing your food. It makes you feel happy and special.
Tree\n\nA tree is a tall plant with a hard, woody stem called a trunk. It has roots under the ground, a thick trunk covered in bark, and many branches that spread out. The branches hold leaves, which are usually green and flat. You can find trees almost everywhere—in parks, forests, and even along streets. Trees give us shade on a sunny day. They also make the air fresh and clean for us to breathe. Many animals live in trees, like birds that build nests in the branches. Some trees grow fruit that we can eat, like apples or oranges. In the fall, the leaves of some trees turn red, yellow, or orange before they drop to the ground.
Treehouse\n\nA treehouse is a small play house built up in a tree. It has walls, a roof, and a floor made of wood. You find it in a backyard or a park, high above the ground. Kids climb a ladder or a rope to get inside. It is a fun place to play, read, or have a snack with friends. Some treehouses have a little window to look out at the birds and leaves.
Trial\n\nA trial is a meeting in a big room called a court. It has two sides who do not agree. One side says the other side did something wrong. A judge sits at the front and makes sure everyone follows the rules. The judge wears a long black coat. Sometimes a group of people called a jury listens and decides who is right. If the side that did wrong is found guilty, the judge may say they must pay money or go to a special building called a prison. Trials can be short or take a very long time.
Triangle\n\nA triangle is a flat shape with three straight sides. It has three pointy corners. You can see triangles in many places, like on a road sign or a slice of pizza. It is the shape with the fewest sides you can draw. Some triangles have all sides the same length, and some have two sides the same. A triangle can also have a corner that is very wide, like a door that is open. People use triangles to build strong bridges and roofs.
Triangulum galaxy\n\nThe Triangulum galaxy is a big group of stars far away in space. It looks like a spinning pinwheel with long, loose arms made of stars. You can find it in the night sky, but it is very, very far from Earth. It is one of the biggest star groups near our own star group, the Milky Way. On a very dark night, some people can see it without a telescope. It is also called the Pinwheel galaxy because of its shape.
Tribe\n\nA tribe is a big family of people who live together. They share the same land, the same songs, and the same stories. A tribe has a leader called a chief who helps everyone. They work as a team: some people hunt, some cook, and some take care of the little ones. Long ago, all people lived in tribes before big cities were built. Today, some tribes still live in forests or deserts, moving from place to place to find food and water.
Triceratops\n\nTriceratops is a big dinosaur that lived a long, long time ago. It had a huge head with three sharp horns on its face—one on the nose and two above the eyes. It also had a wide, hard shield of bone around its neck. It walked on four strong legs and had a short tail. It ate only plants, using its beak to bite leaves. You can see its bones in some museums.
Trick\n\nA trick is something you do to make someone think one thing when another thing is true. It can be a fun game, like when you hide a toy behind your back and ask a friend to guess which hand it is in. A magician does a trick to make you see something that looks like magic. Sometimes a trick is not nice, like when someone tells a lie to get a cookie. A trick can be a clever way to solve a puzzle, too.
Tricky\n\nTricky means something is hard to do or understand. It is like a puzzle that makes you think a lot. You might find a tricky toy that has many buttons. A tricky game can be fun but takes time to learn. Sometimes a tricky path has many turns and is easy to get lost on.
Trigonometry\n\nTrigonometry is a kind of math about shapes called triangles. It looks at the sides and corners of a triangle and how they fit together. You can use it to find out how tall a tree is without climbing it. People who build houses and bridges use it to make things strong and straight. It is a big-kid math that you will learn when you are older.
Trilobite\n\nA trilobite is a very old animal that lived in the sea a long, long time ago. It had a hard shell on its back, and its body was split into three parts: a head, a middle with many pieces, and a tail. It had many tiny legs under its shell. Some trilobites had big eyes on top, and some had no eyes at all. It crawled on the sea floor or swam in the water. You can see its hard shell in rocks today, because it turned into a fossil. A fossil is like a stone picture of an animal from long ago.
Trinidad and Tobago\n\nTrinidad and Tobago is a country made of two big islands and many tiny islands. It sits in the warm blue sea near another country called Venezuela. The biggest town is called Port-of-Spain. Many different people live there, and they speak English. The islands have music, dancing, and a fun party called Carnival. People also play football and cricket. Some visitors come to see the pretty beaches and green hills.
Trip\n\nA trip is when you go away from home to see a new place. It can be short, like going to the park, or long, like riding in a car to the beach. You pack a bag with clothes and snacks. On a trip, you might sleep in a different bed or see big mountains. It is fun because everything feels new and exciting.
Triton (moon)\n\nTriton is a big moon that goes around the planet Neptune. It is a round ball made of ice and rock. It is very, very cold — colder than any other place we know. The ground on Triton has cracks and flat parts, and sometimes ice shoots up like a fountain. A space robot flew past it once and took pictures. Triton is far away in the dark part of space.
Trombone\n\nA trombone is a shiny brass horn that makes music. It has a long tube that slides in and out. You blow into a mouthpiece and move the slide to change the sound. It plays low, loud notes in bands and orchestras. You might see it in a marching band at a parade.
Tropic of Cancer\n\nThe Tropic of Cancer is an invisible line that goes all the way around the Earth. It sits above the middle of the Earth, a little bit north. On the longest day of summer, the sun shines straight down on this line at noon. You can see it drawn on big maps and globes. It helps people know how hot or cold a place might be.
Tropic of Capricorn\n\nThe Tropic of Capricorn is an invisible line on the Earth. It is far down on the map, below the middle. It is one of the big lines that help us know where places are. On one special day in December, the sun shines straight down on this line. It goes through many lands, like big dry places and wide blue seas. Long ago, people gave it a name from the stars they saw.
Tropical\n\nTropical means a place that is warm all year long. It is near the middle of the Earth, where the sun shines straight down. You can find thick green forests, tall palm trees, and bright flowers there. Many colorful birds, monkeys, and big bugs live in tropical places. It often rains a lot, and the air feels wet and sticky. Some people go to tropical islands for vacation to play on sandy beaches and swim in warm blue water.
Tropical climate\n\nA tropical climate is a kind of weather that stays warm all year. It feels hot and sticky because the air has a lot of water in it. You can find it in places near the middle of the Earth, like big rainforests. It rains a lot there, often in the afternoon. Some places have a long rainy time and a long dry time. It never gets cold enough for snow or ice. Many different plants and animals live in this warm, wet weather.
Tropical cyclone\n\nA tropical cyclone is a big spinning storm that starts over warm ocean water. It has fast winds and lots of rain. The middle of it is called the eye, which is quiet and calm. Around the eye is a ring of the strongest wind and heaviest rain. It can move from the sea onto land, where it can knock down trees and cause floods. People give it a name so they can talk about it easily. In some places it is called a hurricane or a typhoon.
Tropical rainforest\n\nA tropical rainforest is a warm, wet forest with lots of tall trees. It has many layers, like a big green cake. The top layer has the tallest trees that touch the sky. Under that is a thick roof of leaves where monkeys and birds live. Lower down it is dark and quiet, with big leaves and small bushes. The ground is shady and open, with ants and snakes. It is home to more animals and plants than any other place on Earth. You can find it near the middle of the world, where it is hot and rains almost every day.
Tropics\n\nThe tropics are the warm parts of the Earth near the middle. It is a big belt around the planet, close to a line called the equator. In the tropics, the sun shines straight down from high in the sky, so it is hot most of the year. Many places there have lots of rain, so big green forests grow. Some parts are dry like deserts with sand. You can find colorful birds, monkeys, and big cats living there. Some mountains in the tropics are so tall they have snow on top.
Trouble\n\nTrouble is when something goes wrong or feels hard. It can be a big mess, like spilling paint on the floor. It can also be a sad or scary feeling inside. When you break a toy by accident, that is trouble. Sometimes trouble means you did something you should not do. A grown-up can help fix it and make things better.
Trouser\n\nA trouser is a piece of clothing that covers your legs. It has two long parts, one for each leg, and goes from your waist down to your feet. You can find trousers in a closet or a drawer at home. People wear trousers to keep their legs warm and to look nice. You might see trousers in many colors like blue, black, or brown. When you go to school or play outside, you often wear trousers.
Trousers\n\nTrousers are a piece of clothing for the lower part of the body. They have two long parts that cover each leg all the way down. You put them on one leg at a time. People wear trousers at the hips or waist, and they stay up with a belt or straps over the shoulders. You can see trousers in many colors like blue, black, or brown. Both boys and girls wear them to school, to play, or at home.
Trout\n\nA trout is a fish that lives in cold, clean water. It has a long body covered with small, shiny scales. You can find it in rivers, streams, and lakes. It swims fast and jumps out of the water to catch bugs. Some people like to fish for trout and then cook it for dinner.
Truck\n\nA truck is a big, strong car that carries heavy things. It has a front part where the driver sits, and a big open space in the back to hold boxes, sand, or other stuff. You can see trucks on roads and highways every day. Some trucks bring food to stores, some carry dirt and rocks, and some help put out fires with water and long hoses. A garbage truck picks up trash from houses and takes it away. Trucks are very useful because they move things that are too big or heavy for a small car.
True\n\nTrue means something is right or correct. It is the opposite of false. When you say the sky is blue, that is true. In a game, if you guess the right answer, your guess is true. It helps us know what is real and what is not.
True bug\n\nA true bug is a tiny animal with six legs. It has a long, thin mouth like a straw. It uses the straw to drink juice from plants. Many true bugs have wings that are hard at the front and soft at the back. You can find them in gardens, on leaves, or near flowers. Some true bugs are very small, and some are as big as your thumb. They do not chew food; they only sip.
Truffle\n\nA truffle is a kind of mushroom that grows under the ground. It looks like a lumpy, round rock and can be black or white. It grows near the roots of trees like oak trees. People use it in cooking to make food taste very special. It has a strong smell, and some people think it smells like nuts or earth. Because it is hard to find, it costs a lot of money. Trained dogs help people find it by sniffing the ground.
Truly\n\nTruly means something is real and not made up. When you say "I truly love my dog," it means your love is very real. It is a word you use to show you mean what you say. You might hear a friend say "I am truly sorry" after they break your toy. That means they feel very sad about it for real.
Trumpet\n\nA trumpet is a shiny metal tube that makes music. It has a wide end like a bell and three buttons on top. You blow into one end and make a buzzing sound with your lips. The buttons change how high or low the sound is. You can hear it in bands, parades, and happy songs. Some people play it in big rooms with many other instruments.
Trunk\n\nA trunk is the long, bendy nose of an elephant. It is very strong and can pick up heavy things like logs. It also has a little finger-like tip at the end to grab small things like a peanut. An elephant uses it to drink water, smell faraway smells, and make loud sounds. You can see it at the zoo when an elephant swings its nose up and down.
Trunk (botany)\n\nA trunk is the big, thick part of a tree. It stands up from the ground and holds up all the branches and leaves. It is covered with bark, which is like a hard coat that keeps the tree safe. Inside, it has rings that show how old the tree is. You can see a trunk in a park or a forest. People cut it into logs to build things like tables and houses.
Trust\n\nTrust is a warm feeling you have when you know someone is safe and kind. It is like a soft blanket around your heart. You feel it with your mom, dad, or a good friend. When you tell a secret and they keep it safe, that is trust. It grows slowly, like a little plant, when people are nice to you again and again. You can also trust a pet, like a dog who sits by you when you are sad.
Trust (social science)\n\nTrust is a warm feeling that someone or something is good and safe. It is like holding a friend's hand and knowing they will not let go. You find it with your mom, your dad, and your best friend. It helps you feel brave to try new things because you know someone will catch you if you fall. When you share a secret with your big sister and she keeps it, that is trust.
Truth\n\nTruth is when something is real or right. It is the opposite of a lie or a made-up story. When you say what really happened, you tell the truth. People feel good when they hear the truth. A friend who always tells the truth is a good friend.
Try\n\nTo try means to do something new or hard, even if you are not sure you can do it. When you try, you give it your best. You can try to tie your shoes, try a new food, or try to catch a ball. It is okay if you do not get it right the first time. Trying helps you learn and grow.
Tsetse fly\n\nA tsetse fly is a big biting fly that lives in hot parts of Africa. It has a strong body and a sharp mouth to bite animals and people. It drinks blood to live. This fly can carry a sickness that makes people very sleepy. It is found near rivers, in forests, or on wide grassy lands. A mother fly keeps her baby inside her body and feeds it a milky liquid. When the baby comes out, it digs into the ground and grows into an adult fly.
Tsunami\n\nA tsunami is a very big wave in the ocean. It is not like a normal wave at the beach. It starts when the ground under the water shakes hard, or when a big rock falls into the water. The wave moves very fast across the sea. When it gets close to land, it grows tall and crashes onto the shore. It can knock down trees, cars, and houses. Sometimes the water pulls back far from the beach before the big wave comes. People who see this should run to a high place right away. A tsunami can happen in the big ocean, but it can also happen in a big lake. It is very strong and can hurt many people.
Tuatara\n\nA tuatara is a very old kind of animal that looks like a lizard, but it is not a lizard. It has rough, green-brown skin and a row of little spikes down its back. It lives only on some small islands near New Zealand. It hides in holes during the day and comes out at night to eat bugs and worms. It has a special spot on top of its head that can feel sunlight, almost like a tiny extra eye. A tuatara grows very slowly and can live for a very long time, even more than 100 years.
Tub\n\nA tub is a big, open bowl. It can be made of hard, smooth stuff like plastic or metal. You find it in a bathroom. People fill it with warm water and soap to take a bath. A baby might splash and play with a toy duck in it.
Tuba\n\nA tuba is a very big brass instrument that makes low, deep sounds. It is the biggest of all the brass instruments in an orchestra. It has a wide bell at the top and long tubes that wrap around. You blow into a mouthpiece to play it, and it takes a lot of air. It can play loud, booming notes or soft, quiet ones. You can see a tuba in a marching band or hear it in a song on the radio.
Tube\n\nA tube is a long, round, empty shape. It looks like a straw or a pipe. You can find tubes in many places, like in a roll of paper towels or a hose in the yard. People use tubes to move water, air, or other things from one place to another. A drinking straw is a tube that helps you sip your juice.
Tuesday\n\nTuesday is a day of the week. It comes after Monday and before Wednesday. On Tuesday, many children go to school and grown-ups go to work. Some people have music class or sports practice on this day. It is one of seven days that make a whole week.
Tug of war\n\nTug of war is a game where two teams pull on a rope. It has a long rope with a mark in the middle. You can play it outside on grass or in a park. Each team holds one end of the rope and pulls hard. The team that pulls the other team over a line wins. Sometimes there is a mud pit in the middle, and the losing team falls in. It is a fun game to play with friends at a party or on a field day.
Tulip\n\nA tulip is a pretty flower that grows from a bulb in the ground. It has a long green stem and a cup-shaped bloom at the top. You can find it in gardens, parks, and flower shops. People plant it in the fall so it can bloom in spring. It comes in many bright colors like red, yellow, pink, and purple. Holland is a country famous for growing lots of tulips.
Tummy\n\nA tummy is the soft, round part in the middle of your body. It is below your chest and above your legs. When you eat food, it goes into your tummy. Sometimes your tummy makes a funny noise when you are hungry. You can feel it move when you laugh really hard.
Tuna\n\nTuna is a big fish that lives in the ocean. It has a smooth, shiny body and can swim very fast. Its meat is pink or red, not white like other fish. People catch tuna to eat, and you can find it in cans at the store. Some tuna are very big, as long as a car. Fishermen use big nets or long fishing lines to catch it. Tuna eats smaller fish and squid. It is a strong swimmer that travels far across the sea.
Tundra\n\nTundra is a big, open land where it is very cold. It has no tall trees because the ground is frozen deep down. In winter, the land is covered with snow and ice. In summer, the top of the ground gets soft, but just a little bit. Small plants like moss and tiny flowers grow close to the ground. Animals with thick fur live there, like white foxes and big bears. Some birds fly there in summer to lay eggs. The tundra is far up north, near the top of the world.
Tune\n\nA tune is a set of sounds that go up and down in a nice way. It is like a song you can hum or whistle. You hear a tune when someone plays a piano, a guitar, or a flute. It can make you feel happy, calm, or want to dance. A tune you know might be the one from your favorite cartoon.
Tunis\n\nTunis is a big city in a country called Tunisia. It has many buildings, streets, and people. It is the most important city in that country, like a leader city. Many people live there, and even more live in the towns around it. You can find old markets and new shops there. People in Tunis speak a language called Arabic.
Tunisia\n\nTunisia is a country in the north of Africa. It has a long coast next to a big blue sea. Much of the south is covered by a hot, sandy desert. The biggest city is called Tunis, and many people live there. Long ago, people built a famous city named Carthage near the sea. Today, people in Tunisia grow fruits and olives, and visitors come to see the old places and enjoy the sun.
Tunnel\n\nA tunnel is a long hole under the ground. It is like a big tube that people, cars, or trains can go through. You can find a tunnel under a hill, under a city, or even under the sea. It helps people get from one side to the other without going over the top. Some tunnels are made for water pipes or wires. A very long tunnel goes under the sea between two countries.
Turaco\n\nA turaco is a colorful bird that lives in Africa. It has bright green and red feathers, a tall crest on its head, and a long tail. It lives in trees in warm places like forests and woods. It eats fruit, leaves, and flowers, and it loves figs. It is not a strong flyer, but it runs fast on its strong legs. You might see one in a zoo or a picture book about birds.
Turbine\n\nA turbine is a machine that spins around very fast. It has blades that look like a fan or a pinwheel. You can find it inside big power plants, windmills, and jet engines. It uses wind, water, or hot steam to turn and make power. For example, a windmill has a turbine that spins when the wind blows, and that helps make lights turn on in houses.
Turkey\n\nTurkey is a country that sits in two parts of the world. It has land in Europe and land in Asia. It has big cities, old buildings, and long beaches by the sea. People in Turkey speak Turkish and eat foods like flat bread with meat and sweet honey cakes. Many people visit Turkey to swim in the blue water and see old stone places.
Turkish language\n\nTurkish is a way people talk and write. It is used in the country of Turkey and some other places. It has its own set of letters, like a secret code. Some letters have little marks on them. Long ago, people wrote it with different shapes, but a leader changed it so more people could learn. Now many people can read and write it.
Turkmenistan\n\nTurkmenistan is a country far away. It is in the middle of Asia. It has no ocean next to it, but it touches a big lake called the Caspian Sea. Most of the land is a hot, dry desert with lots of sand. People there speak their own language and many follow a religion called Islam. The biggest city is Ashgabat, where the leader works.
Turn\n\nA turn is when something moves in a circle or changes the way it faces. It can be a spin, like when you twist around on one foot. You see a turn when a car goes around a corner on the street. People use a turn when they dance or play a game and need to go a new way. A turn can also be your chance to do something, like when you wait for your turn on the swing.
Turnip\n\nA turnip is a round vegetable that grows under the ground. It has a white or purple top and a pointy tip at the bottom. You can find it in gardens or at the store. People cook it in soup or mash it like potatoes. It tastes a little sweet and a little sharp. Some turnips are small for people to eat, and some are big for farm animals.
Turtle\n\nA turtle is an animal with a hard shell on its back. It has four short legs, a small tail, and a head that can hide inside the shell. You can find turtles in many places like ponds, rivers, and oceans. It moves slowly on land but swims well in water. A turtle eats plants, bugs, or small fish. It lays eggs in sand or dirt and the baby turtles hatch on their own.
Tutsan\n\nTutsan is a small bush with pretty yellow flowers. It has green leaves that come out in spring and fall off in fall. After the flowers, it grows red berries that turn black when they are ready. Some people use parts of it to help with small hurts. You might see it in a garden or near a path.
Tv\n\nA TV is a big box with a flat screen. It shows moving pictures and plays sounds. You can find it in many living rooms at home. People use it to watch cartoons, shows, and movies. When you press a button on a remote, the screen lights up and you can see your favorite characters.
Twelve\n\nTwelve is a number. It comes after eleven and before thirteen. You can count twelve things, like twelve eggs in a box or twelve cookies on a plate. A clock has twelve numbers on its face. When the big hand points to twelve, it means a new hour starts. Twelve is also how many months are in one year.
Twenty\n\nTwenty is a number. It comes after nineteen and before twenty-one. If you have ten fingers and ten toes, that is twenty all together. You can count twenty crayons in a box or twenty kids in a classroom. It is two groups of ten.
Twice\n\nTwice means two times. If you clap your hands once, and then you clap them again, you clapped twice. It is a way to say something happened two times. You might ask for a snack twice, or jump twice on one foot. It is a small number that is easy to count.
Twin\n\nA twin is one of two babies born at the same time. They share a mommy's tummy together. Some twins look exactly the same, like two peas in a pod. Other twins look different, just like any brother or sister. You might see twins at school or at the park. They often have a special friend to play with from the very first day.
Twinkle\n\nTwinkle is a quick, bright flash of light. It looks like a tiny star blinking on and off. You can see a twinkle in the night sky when stars shine. You can also see it on shiny things like a clean spoon or a diamond ring. When you sing 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star,' you are singing about this pretty light.
Two\n\nTwo is a number. It comes after one and before three. You can see it when you count your hands, feet, eyes, or ears. When you have one cookie and a friend gives you one more, you have two cookies. It is a small number that helps you count things in pairs.
Type\n\nType is a way to sort things into groups. It means things that are alike in some way. For example, a dog and a cat are both a type of pet. A car and a bus are a type of thing that moves on wheels. You can use type to talk about food, like fruit is a type of sweet food. It helps us put things together when they are the same.
Typewriter\n\nA typewriter is a machine that puts letters on paper. It has many small buttons called keys. When you press a key, a metal arm hits a ribbon and leaves a letter on the page. People used it before computers to write letters and stories. It does not need a plug or a screen. You can still see one in old movies or at a grandparent's house.
Tyrannosaurus\n\nTyrannosaurus was a very big dinosaur that lived a long, long time ago. It walked on two strong back legs and had a huge head with a big mouth full of sharp teeth. Its front arms were very small, but they were strong. It had a long, heavy tail that helped it stand up straight. You can see its big bones in some museums. In books and movies, it is often called the king of the dinosaurs.
Tyrant flycatcher\n\nA tyrant flycatcher is a kind of bird. It has a small body, two wings, and a beak. It lives in America, from the north all the way to the south. It eats bugs that it catches while flying in the air. Some kinds also eat fruit or tiny frogs. It is a brave bird that chases away bigger birds to keep its home safe.
Uffizi\n\nUffizi is a big, old building in a city called Florence. It has two long parts that face each other with a yard in the middle. Inside, it is full of beautiful paintings and statues from long ago. People from all over the world come to see the art. Some paintings are of ladies in pretty dresses, and some show stories from the old days. It is a very busy place, and sometimes you have to wait in a long line to go in.
Uganda\n\nUganda is a country in Africa. It has green hills, big lakes, and many farms. People grow coffee and tea there. Many children play football, and it is the most loved sport.
Ukraine\n\nUkraine is a big country far away. It has green fields, rivers, and a big sea to the south. Many people live there, and they speak a language called Ukrainian. The biggest city is Kyiv. Long ago, brave people built a strong home there. Today, people grow food, sing songs, and have their own flag. The flag has two colors: blue on top like the sky, and yellow on the bottom like a field of wheat.
Ulaanbaatar\n\nUlaanbaatar is a big city. It is the capital of a country called Mongolia. It is very cold there in winter. Many people live in the city, almost half of all the people in the country. It has tall buildings, shops, and schools. A river runs through the city. Long ago, it was a place for monks to live and pray. Now it is the most important city in Mongolia.
Ultrasound\n\nUltrasound is a kind of sound that is too high for people to hear. It is like a very, very high whistle. Some animals, like dogs, bats, and dolphins, can hear it. Doctors use it to look inside a mommy's tummy to see a baby before it is born. It is safe and does not hurt. People also use it to clean small things like rings and watches.
Uluru\n\nUluru is a giant rock in the middle of Australia. It is very big and looks red, especially when the sun goes down. The land around it is flat and dry, with red sand and small bushes. Long ago, the first people of Australia, called the Anangu, made this place special for their stories and songs. Today, many people visit it to see its big shape and pretty colors. It is one of the most famous rocks in the whole world.
Umbrella\n\nAn umbrella is a tool that keeps you dry when it rains. It has a long stick in the middle and a big round top made of cloth. You can open it and close it with a button. When it is open, it looks like a little roof over your head. People carry it outside on rainy days. Some umbrellas are small and fit in a bag. Others are big and can cover two people. You might see one at home or in a store.
Uncle\n\nAn uncle is the brother of your mom or your dad. He is a grown-up man in your family. You might see him at family parties or when he comes to visit. He can play with you, tell funny stories, or give you a piggyback ride. Some uncles live close by, and some live far away. He loves you and is happy to see you.
Under\n\nUnder means something is below or beneath another thing. It is the opposite of over or on top. You can find a toy under your bed or a ball under a table. A cat might hide under a chair when it feels shy. When you play hide-and-seek, you can look under a blanket to find your friend.
Underground\n\nUnderground is the place under the ground. It is dark and cool down there. You can find dirt, rocks, and sometimes long roots from trees. Some animals like worms and moles live underground. People dig tunnels to make trains go under cities. You might see a hole in the ground where a rabbit hides.
Underline\n\nAn underline is a line you draw under a word. It looks like a straight mark that sits right below the letters. You can make it with a pencil, a crayon, or on a computer. People use it to show that a word is important or to make it stand out. You might see an underline in a book title or when a teacher writes a new word on the board.
Understand\n\nTo understand means to know what something means. When you listen to a story, you understand the words. When you look at a picture, you understand what it shows. It feels good when you learn something new and it makes sense. You can understand a friend when they tell you how they feel.
Underwater diving\n\nUnderwater diving is when a person goes under the water. It can be done in the sea, a lake, or a big pool. A diver wears a mask to see and a tank of air to breathe. Some people dive to look at fish and pretty rocks. Others dive to fix things like boats or bridges. It is a fun way to explore a world that is not like the land.
Underwear\n\nUnderwear is a piece of clothing you wear under your other clothes. It is soft and sits right next to your skin. You put it on first thing in the morning, before your shirt and pants. It helps keep your body clean and warm. Some underwear covers your bottom, and some covers your chest too. You can find it in a drawer at home, in many colors and with fun pictures.
Unemployment\n\nUnemployment is when a grown-up wants a job but does not have one. It means they do not get money from work. Many things can cause it, like not enough jobs in a town. When many people have no job, it is hard for families to buy food and toys. Some people stop looking for work because they feel sad, and then they are not counted. A job helps people feel good and take care of their family.
