Unicorn\n\nA unicorn is a make-believe animal that looks like a white horse. It has one long, pointy horn on its head. You can find it in fairy tales and storybooks from many places. The horn is said to have magic that can help sick people feel better. In old stories, only a kind girl can make it come close and fall asleep. Some flags and coats of arms show a unicorn as a special sign.
Uniform\n\nA uniform is a special set of clothes that a group of people wear to look the same. It often has a shirt and pants or a dress, all in the same color. You can see it on police officers, firefighters, and nurses when they work. It helps people know who they are and what job they do. Many children wear a uniform to school every day. It might have a school badge on the front. A uniform makes everyone feel like they are on the same team.
Union\n\nA union is a group of people who work together. They join hands to make things fair at their job. It helps them ask for better pay and safe places to work. You might hear grown-ups talk about a union at a factory or a school.
Unit\n\nA unit is a single thing. It is one part of a bigger group. You can count with it, like one apple or one block. In school, a unit can be a set of lessons about one topic. At home, a unit can be one piece of furniture, like a shelf. It helps us measure and talk about how many.
Unit of measurement\n\nA unit of measurement is a way to say how big, how heavy, or how warm something is. It gives a number a name so we all know what the number means. For example, when we say a tower is 300 meters tall, the meter is the unit. We use rulers to measure how long things are. We use scales to measure how heavy things are. A clock tells time in hours and minutes. In the kitchen, a cup helps measure flour for cookies. All over the world, people use units to share and compare sizes.
Unite\n\nUnite means to come together as one. It is when people or things join to make a group. You see it when friends hold hands to play a game. It is also when many small drops of water join to make a big puddle. When people unite, they can do big things that one person cannot do alone.
United Arab Emirates\n\nThe United Arab Emirates is a country in a hot, sandy part of the world. It has seven smaller parts called emirates. The biggest city is Dubai, where you can see a very, very tall tower called the Burj Khalifa. It has big deserts with golden sand and also blue sea beaches. People find oil and gas under the ground there. Many people from all over the world live and work in this country.
United Kingdom\n\nThe United Kingdom is a big group of countries in Europe. It is made of four parts: England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. It has a king and a big city called London. People there speak English. Long ago, it had many lands far away, but not anymore. It is on an island with green hills and old castles.
United Nations\n\nThe United Nations is a big group of countries that work together. It has a big building in New York City where people from many countries meet. They talk about how to keep peace and help people all over the world. It sends helpers to places where there is fighting, to keep people safe. It also gives food and medicine to children and families who need it.
United States\n\nThe United States is a big country where many people live. It has 50 parts called states. You can find it on a map in North America, between Canada and Mexico. It has tall mountains, wide flat lands, and long rivers. The flag has red and white stripes and 50 white stars on blue. Many different people from all over the world live there and speak many languages.
United States dollar\n\nThe United States dollar is the money people use in America. It is made of paper and small round coins. You can find it in stores, banks, and your mom or dad's wallet. People use it to buy food, toys, and clothes. One dollar is the same as 100 pennies. A penny is a small brown coin. Other coins are the nickel, dime, and quarter. Paper dollars have pictures of famous people on them.
Universe\n\nThe universe is all of space and everything in it. It is very, very big and has many stars, planets, and big clouds of gas. You can see a tiny part of it when you look up at the night sky. The stars you see are far away suns. The universe started a long time ago from a tiny point and grew bigger and bigger. It is still growing today. We live on a planet called Earth, which is one small part of the universe.
University\n\nA university is a big school for grown-ups. It has many buildings with classrooms, libraries, and places to eat. After high school, people go there to learn more about one special thing, like animals, stars, or how to help sick people. A teacher called a professor helps them learn. Some students live in big houses called dorms right on the school grounds. When they finish, they get a paper that says they worked very hard.
University of Cambridge\n\nThe University of Cambridge is a very old school for grown-ups. It is in a city called Cambridge in England. It has many old buildings, big green yards, and a river where people can ride in long boats. Students go there to learn hard things like numbers, stars, and how the body works. Many smart people who changed the world studied there a long time ago.
Until\n\nUntil means up to a certain time. It tells you when something stops or changes. For example, you might play outside until the sun goes down. Then you come inside. It helps us know the end of a wait or an action.
Up\n\nUp is the way that goes toward the sky. It is the opposite of down. When you look at a bird flying high, you look up. When you jump, your feet leave the ground and you go up for a moment. A balloon filled with air can float up to the ceiling. You can point up with your finger to show where the sun is during the day.
Upper class\n\nUpper class is a group of people who have the most money in a place. They live in very big houses and have many nice things. Some of them got their money from their family, like a king or a queen. Others made their money by selling things. They can help decide what happens in a town or city.
Upset\n\nAn upset is a big, yucky feeling inside. It happens when something goes wrong, like when you drop your ice cream or a friend won't share. Your face might get hot, and you might want to cry or shout. It's okay to feel upset—everyone does sometimes. A hug or a deep breath can help it go away.
Ural (river)\n\nThe Ural is a very long river in Russia. It starts in big hills called the Ural Mountains and ends at a giant lake called the Caspian Sea. It is so long that it marks the line between two big lands, Europe and Asia. Many fish live in its water. Big boats can move on parts of it, and people in cities like Orsk see it every day.
Ural Mountains\n\nThe Ural Mountains are a long line of tall hills and rocks. They go up and down through the land in Russia. It is so long that it touches two big parts of the world: Europe and Asia. The top of the mountains is very cold and has snow. Many trees and animals live on the sides of the mountains. People can walk and climb there, but it is very big and far away for most of us.
Uranus\n\nUranus is a big, cold planet far away in the sky. It is the seventh planet from the Sun. It looks blue-green because of a gas called methane in its air. It has rings around it, but they are very dark and hard to see. It also has many moons going around it. It spins on its side, like a rolling ball, so one side stays in the dark for a very long time. You cannot see it without a big telescope, but a long time ago a man named William Herschel found it while looking at the stars.
Urban planning\n\nUrban planning is the way people decide how a city or town should look and work. It is like drawing a big map for where houses, parks, and roads will go. Planners think about where to put schools so kids can walk there. They also make sure there are trees and places to play. When you see a playground near your home, that is part of urban planning.
Urbanization\n\nUrbanization is when more and more people move from the countryside to live in big cities. It happens slowly over many years. When many people come, cities grow tall buildings, busy streets, and lots of shops. You can see it when a small town gets bigger and has more houses and parks. People move to cities to find jobs and be near schools and hospitals.
Urdu\n\nUrdu is a way people talk and write. It looks like pretty lines that go from right to left. Many people in Pakistan and some in India speak it every day. It sounds a lot like Hindi, so people who speak one can often understand the other. You might hear it in songs or stories from those places.
Urinary system\n\nThe urinary system is a set of body parts that make pee and push it out. It has two kidneys, two thin tubes, one stretchy bag, and one last tube. The kidneys sit deep inside your back and clean your blood. The thin tubes carry the yellow water down to the stretchy bag. The bag holds the pee until you feel full. Then the last tube lets the pee out when you go to the bathroom. Boys and girls have the same parts, but the last tube is a little different in boys.
Ursa Major\n\nUrsa Major is a group of stars in the night sky. It looks like a big bear with a long tail. You can see it in the sky when it is dark, if you live in the north part of the world. It helps people find the way north because part of it points to the north star. Some people call a part of it the Big Dipper, which looks like a big spoon.
Ursa Minor\n\nUrsa Minor is a group of stars in the night sky. It looks like a small spoon with a long handle. You can see it high up in the north when the sky is dark. The star at the end of the handle is the North Star. It helps people find their way at night. Long ago, people told stories about it. Some said it was a little bear with a long tail.
Uruguay\n\nUruguay is a country in South America. It is not very big, and its land is mostly flat with many farms. People there speak Spanish. The biggest city is called Montevideo. It is next to two bigger countries, Brazil and Argentina. Many people in Uruguay love to play football, and their team has won big prizes.
Uruguay River\n\nThe Uruguay River is a long, blue river in South America. It flows through three countries: Brazil, Argentina, and Uruguay. It starts in Brazil and travels a very long way. People use it to move boats and carry things from place to place. Many fish live in its water. You can see it on a big map of the world.
Us\n\nUs means you and me together. It is a small word we use when we talk about two or more people as one group. When you hold hands with a friend, that is us. When a family sits at the dinner table, that is us too. It feels warm and close, like a hug.
Use\n\nUse means to take something and do something with it. You use a spoon to eat soup. You use a crayon to draw a picture. You use your legs to run and jump. When you use a toy, you play with it. People use many things every day, like a toothbrush to clean teeth or a book to read a story.
Useful\n\nUseful means something helps you do a job or makes life easier. A spoon is useful because it helps you eat soup. A coat is useful when it is cold outside. A pencil is useful for drawing and writing. Many things at home are useful, like a cup, a towel, or a light. When something is useful, you are glad to have it.
User interface\n\nA user interface is the part of a machine that lets a person tell it what to do. It has buttons, a screen, or a handle you can touch. You find it on things like a tablet, a microwave, or a toy robot. It helps you play a game, heat up food, or make a robot move. A big red button on a yellow box is a special kind of user interface. When you push it, the machine stops right away to keep people safe.
Usually\n\nUsually means something happens most of the time. It is a word we use to talk about what is normal or common. For example, you usually eat breakfast in the morning. It is not always, but almost always. When you say "I usually play outside after school," it means on most days you play outside, but maybe not every single day.
Uterus\n\nA uterus is a special place inside a woman's body where a baby grows. It is shaped like a pear and sits low in the tummy. When a woman is going to have a baby, it gets bigger and bigger for nine months. It has strong walls that help push the baby out when it is time to be born. Every month, if there is no baby, it sheds a soft lining and a little blood comes out. This is normal and happens to many women.
Utopia\n\nUtopia is a made-up place where everything is perfect. It is not real, but people like to imagine it. In a utopia, everyone is happy, kind, and safe. There are no fights, no one is sad, and all the rules are fair. Some stories in books show a utopia as a far-away island or a land in the sky. The word means "no place" because it does not really exist. People sometimes try to make a real utopia, but it is very hard to do.
Uzbekistan\n\nUzbekistan is a country far away in the middle of Asia. It has big cities, and the biggest one is called Tashkent. Many people live there, and they speak a special language. It is a dry place with no ocean near it. Long ago, people lived there even before your great-great-great-grandparents were born.
Vacation\n\nA vacation is a special time when you stop working or going to school. It is a break for fun and rest. Many families go on a trip together during a vacation. They might stay in a hotel or a small house away from home. Some people go to the beach, a big park, or a new city. Others stay home and find fun things to do nearby. You can play all day, eat new foods, and see new places. A vacation helps you feel happy and fresh when you come back.
Vaccination\n\nA vaccination is a special helper that makes your body strong against sickness. It is a tiny bit of liquid that a doctor or nurse puts into your arm with a small poke. You can get it at a doctor's office or sometimes at school. It teaches the inside of your body how to fight off bad germs before they make you sick. When many people get it, it also keeps babies and older people safe. After you get it, your arm might feel a little sore, but that goes away fast.
Vaccine\n\nA vaccine is a special medicine that helps keep you from getting sick. It is a clear liquid that a doctor or nurse puts into your arm with a tiny needle. You can get it at a doctor's office or a clinic. It teaches your body to fight off bad germs, like the ones that cause a cold or a tummy ache. For example, you might get a shot before starting school so you don't catch the measles.
Vacuum\n\nA vacuum is a space with almost no stuff in it, not even air. It is like a very empty box. Sound cannot travel through it because there are no tiny bits to carry the sound. You can find a vacuum in outer space, where there are almost no bits of air. People use vacuums in big machines to make things clean or to do science tests. A vacuum cleaner at home is not a real vacuum, but it sucks up dust and dirt from the floor.
Vacuum cleaner\n\nA vacuum cleaner is a machine that cleans floors. It has a long hose and a wide mouth that sucks up dust and dirt. You can find it in many homes, and people push it over the floor to make it clean. When it is full, you empty the dirt into the trash. It makes a loud humming sound when it is on.
Vadodara\n\nVadodara is a big city in India. It sits next to a river called Vishwamitri. In the city, you can see a huge, pretty palace named Lakshmi Vilas Palace. Many people live there, and they speak different languages. It has a big school for grown-ups, a busy train stop, and a place where airplanes land. Some famous cricket players were born in this city.
Valley\n\nA valley is a low place in the land. It sits between two higher parts, like hills or mountains. A river or a stream often runs through it, and the water makes the valley deeper over time. Many people live in valleys because there is fresh water and good dirt for growing food. You might see a valley when you drive between big hills.
Valley of the Kings\n\nThe Valley of the Kings is a special place in Egypt. It is a long, dry valley with tall rocky walls. Long ago, people dug deep rooms into the rock to bury their kings. The kings were called pharaohs, and they were put inside with gold and pretty things. Today, many people visit to see the old painted walls and learn about the kings. It is very hot there, and it almost never rains.
Value\n\nValue is how much something is worth. It can be the price you pay at the store. But it is not only about money. A hug from Mom has value even though it is free. In math, a value is a number everyone agrees on, like the number 5. Sometimes people think different things have different value. Water has more value in a hot, dry place than next to a big river. When people do not agree on value, they can get into fights.
Valve\n\nA valve is a small door inside a pipe. It opens and closes to let water or air go through or to stop it. You can find it under a sink, on a garden hose, or on a bike tire. When you turn a handle, it moves the door to let more or less flow. A faucet at home has a valve inside it.
Vampire\n\nA vampire is a made-up creature from old stories. It looks like a person but has long, sharp teeth called fangs. In stories, it comes out at night and drinks blood by biting necks. It can turn into a bat and fly away. You see vampires in movies, books, and TV shows. They are not real, but they are fun to dress up as for Halloween.
Vampire bat\n\nA vampire bat is a small flying animal that drinks blood. It has wings, tiny sharp teeth, and dark fur. It lives in warm places like Mexico and Brazil. It comes out at night to find food. It can drink blood from cows or birds without waking them up. A vampire bat lives in big groups with many friends. It can carry sickness, so people should stay away.
Van\n\nA van is a big car that carries people or things. It has a boxy shape with a flat front and a big space in the back. You can see a van on the road, like when a family goes on a trip or a worker brings tools. It is used to take many kids to school or to move boxes and big toys. Some vans have sliding doors on the side, and some have seats in the back for people to sit.
Vancouver\n\nVancouver is a big city by the sea in Canada. It has tall mountains, a big park with trees and beaches, and a long bridge. Many people live there, and they speak many different languages. In winter, you can ski on a mountain close to the city. In summer, you can play on the beach. It is a place where people from all over the world come to live.
Vanilla\n\nVanilla is a flavor that makes food taste sweet and yummy. It comes from a plant that climbs like a vine. The plant has pretty flowers, and the flavor is inside long, dark pods. People use vanilla to make ice cream, cake, and cookies taste good. Most vanilla flavor today is made in a lab, but real vanilla from the plant is very special and costs a lot of money.
Vanuatu\n\nVanuatu is a country made of many small islands in the big blue ocean. It has about 82 islands, and people live on 65 of them. The islands were made by hot rocks from under the ground called volcanoes. It is warm there, with green trees and blue water all around. Many people in Vanuatu grow food like coconuts. Visitors come to see the pretty beaches and swim in the sea.
Vapor\n\nVapor is tiny drops of water that float in the air. It looks like a white cloud or mist. You can see it when a pot of water gets hot on the stove. It rises up from the pot and disappears. It is also what makes a bathroom steamy after a warm shower. Vapor is not the same as air; it is wet and feels warm.
Variable\n\nA variable is a special box that holds something you do not know yet. It can be a number, a word, or a picture. In math, a variable is often a letter like x or y. You use it when you are trying to find a missing number. In a computer, a variable is a box that can change what is inside. People who make computer games use variables to keep score or remember a player's name. When you play a game and your score goes up, that is a variable changing.
Variable star\n\nA variable star is a star that changes how bright it looks. Sometimes it shines more, and sometimes it shines less. You can find it in the night sky, but you need a big tool to see the change. It does this because it grows bigger and smaller, or because it throws out hot stuff. One kind is a supernova, which gets very bright for a short time and then fades away.
Vase\n\nA vase is a pretty holder for flowers. It is often made of glass or clay and can be tall or round. You find it on a table or a shelf at home. People put water inside it and then place cut flowers in it to keep them fresh. A vase can be many colors, and some have painted pictures on the outside.
Vatican City\n\nVatican City is a tiny country. It is the smallest country in the whole world. It sits right inside the city of Rome, in Italy. It is so small that you can walk across it in less than an hour. The Pope lives there. He is the leader of the Catholic Church. Many people visit to see big, beautiful buildings and old art. One famous place is a huge church with a tall dome. Another is a big open square where people gather. The guards wear colorful striped uniforms. They help keep the Pope safe.
Veda\n\nVeda is a very old set of books from a country called India. It has songs, poems, and rules for how to live. People read it to learn about gods and the world. Long ago, teachers said the words out loud so children could remember them. Even today, some families sing parts of it during special days.
Vega\n\nVega is a bright star in the night sky. It looks like a tiny, shiny dot of white-blue light. You can find it high up in the sky on summer nights. It is one of the first stars you see when the sky gets dark. Long ago, people used it to help them know which way was north. It is very far away, but it shines brighter than most other stars.
Veganism\n\nVeganism is a way of living where people do not eat or use things from animals. It means a person eats only plants, like fruits, vegetables, beans, and nuts. They do not eat meat, eggs, milk, or cheese. Some also do not wear leather or wool. A vegan might choose this because they care about animals or want to help the Earth. You can find vegan food at many stores, like plant-based burgers or soy milk.
Vegetable\n\nA vegetable is a part of a plant that people eat. It can be a root, a stem, a leaf, or a flower. You find vegetables at the grocery store, in a garden, or on a farm. People cook vegetables or eat them raw in meals like soup or salad. A carrot is a vegetable that grows under the ground.
Vegetable oil\n\nVegetable oil is a slippery liquid that comes from plants. It looks yellow or clear and feels smooth. You can find it in a kitchen bottle near the stove. People use it to cook food like eggs or pancakes so the food does not stick to the pan. It also goes into cakes and cookies to make them soft. Some kinds come from sunflowers, olives, or corn. Margarine is a soft spread made from it that you can put on bread.
Vegetarianism\n\nVegetarianism is a way of eating without meat or fish. People who eat this way are called vegetarians. They eat foods like vegetables, fruit, nuts, beans, and grains. Some also eat milk and eggs. They do not eat any animal that had a face. Many people choose this way because they care about animals or want to stay healthy. You can find vegetarian food in many places, like a salad or a peanut butter sandwich.
Vehicle\n\nA vehicle is a machine that moves people and things from one place to another. It is not alive like a horse. Most vehicles have wheels that turn round and round. You see them on roads, on water, and in the sky. Cars, buses, and bikes are vehicles that go on land. Boats and ships are vehicles that go on water. Planes and hot air balloons are vehicles that fly in the air. Some vehicles use gas to go, and some use a push or the wind.
Veil\n\nA veil is a soft cloth that covers part of the face. It is light and thin, so you can sometimes see through it. Brides wear a veil on their wedding day, and it hangs down from their head. In some places, women wear a veil every day to cover their hair or face. A dancer may use a veil to move and twirl in a pretty way. When a bride lifts her veil, it shows she is now married.
Vein\n\nA vein is a tiny tube inside your body that carries blood. It looks like a thin blue or purple line under your skin. You can see it on your wrist or the back of your hand. It brings blood back to your heart after the blood has given air to your body. Inside, it has little doors that stop the blood from going the wrong way. When you get a small cut, dark red blood comes out of a vein and turns bright red in the air.
Velociraptor\n\nVelociraptor is a kind of dinosaur that lived a long, long time ago. It was about as long as a big bed and as tall as a small child. It had a long tail, sharp teeth, and a big curved claw on each foot. It also had feathers all over its body, like a bird. It could not fly, but it ran very fast on two legs. It lived in dry, sandy places with some streams. People found its bones buried in the ground in a faraway land called Mongolia.
Velocity\n\nVelocity is how fast something moves and which way it goes. It has two parts: speed and direction. If a toy car rolls east, its velocity is its speed going east. You can see velocity when you push a ball across the floor. The ball moves fast or slow in a straight line. That line shows the direction part of velocity.
Venezuela\n\nVenezuela is a country far away. It has hot beaches, tall mountains, and the world's tallest waterfall. People there speak Spanish. They grow food like cocoa and coffee. Many people work with oil that comes from under the ground. Some families have a hard time finding enough food. A long time ago, brave people fought to make it a free country.
Venice\n\nVenice is a city in Italy. It is built on many small islands in the water. The islands are separated by canals, which are like streets made of water. People use boats to move around instead of cars. The most famous boat is called a gondola. Many visitors come to see the old buildings and bridges. One famous bridge is the Rialto Bridge. Venice is a very special place with no roads for cars.
Venn diagram\n\nA Venn diagram is a picture made of circles that overlap. It helps you see how groups of things are the same or different. You can find it in school books and on classroom walls. People use it to sort things, like animals that can fly and animals that have two legs. For example, a parrot is in the part where the circles cross because it can fly and has two legs.
Venom\n\nVenom is a special kind of poison that some animals make inside their body. It can hurt other animals. An animal puts venom into another animal by biting or stinging. Some animals use it to catch food. For example, a rattlesnake bites a small animal and the venom stops it from moving. Other animals use it to stay safe. A bee stings to keep its home safe. You might see a bee in a garden. If it stings, the spot gets red and hurts a little.
Venus\n\nVenus is a planet that goes around the Sun. It is the second planet from the Sun. It looks like a very bright star in the sky. You can see it in the morning before the Sun comes up, or in the evening after the Sun goes down. It is sometimes called the morning star or the evening star. It is made of rock, like Earth. But it is much, much hotter than Earth. Thick clouds cover it all the time. These clouds trap heat, so the ground is hot enough to melt metal. It has no water and no oceans. It has many big volcanoes. It spins very slowly and has no moon.
Venus (mythology)\n\nVenus is a goddess from old Roman stories. She is the goddess of love and beauty. People long ago built temples for her and had big parties to say thank you. They thought she helped them be kind and stay away from bad things. In the stories, she was married to Vulcan, the god of fire. A famous leader named Julius Caesar said she was part of his family.
Venus de Milo\n\nVenus de Milo is a very old statue of a woman. It is made of smooth white stone. It stands tall in a big museum in Paris. The woman has no arms, but she looks calm and pretty. Long ago, people found it broken on an island. Now many people come to see it and take pictures.
Verbena\n\nVerbena is a kind of plant with small, pretty flowers. It has thin green stems and leaves that can be soft or a little rough. You can find it in gardens, parks, or sometimes growing wild by the road. People plant it to make their yard look colorful and happy. Butterflies and bees like to visit its flowers for a sweet drink. Some kinds of verbena grow low and spread out, and others grow tall. It comes in colors like purple, pink, red, and white.
Vertebrate\n\nA vertebrate is an animal that has a hard line of bones inside its back. It has a spine that helps it stand up straight and move around. You can find vertebrates in many places — in the water, on land, and in the air. Fish, birds, frogs, snakes, dogs, and people are all vertebrates. A fish uses its spine to swim fast in the sea. A bird uses its spine to fly high in the sky. You are a vertebrate too, because you have a backbone inside you.
Very\n\nVery is a word we use to say something is a lot or a big deal. It helps us tell how much we feel or see. You might say you are very happy when you get a big hug. Or you might see a very tall tree that reaches the sky. When your soup is very hot, you blow on it first. It is a small word that makes other words stronger.
Vest\n\nA vest is a piece of clothing you wear on the top part of your body. It has no sleeves, so your arms are free. You can find it in a closet or a store. People wear it over a shirt to stay warm or to look nice. Some vests have buttons or a zipper in the front. A puffy vest is good for cold days outside.
Vet\n\nA vet is a doctor for animals. She helps pets like dogs, cats, and birds when they are sick or hurt. You can find a vet at an animal hospital or a pet clinic. She looks at the animal's ears, eyes, and tummy to see what is wrong. She may give the animal a shot or some medicine to make it feel better. If your dog has a sore paw, a vet can wrap it in a soft bandage.
Veterinary medicine\n\nVeterinary medicine is the job of helping sick animals get better. It is like a doctor, but for pets, farm animals, and wild animals. A person who does this job is called a vet. The vet checks the animal's body, gives medicine, and fixes broken bones. You can find a vet at an animal hospital or a pet clinic. When your dog or cat feels bad, the vet helps it feel good again.
Victoria Falls\n\nVictoria Falls is a very big waterfall in Africa. It is on a river called the Zambezi. It is taller than a tall building and wider than many football fields. When the water falls down, it makes a loud sound and a big cloud of mist. People can see it from far away. In the dry time of year, the water can almost stop. Many people visit to see it because it is so big and pretty.
Vicua\n\nA vicua is a wild animal that looks like a small llama. It has a soft, warm coat that is light brown or reddish. Its belly and the inside of its legs are white. It has a long neck, skinny legs, and small pointy ears. It lives high up in the mountains where the grass grows. It eats tough grass with its front teeth that never stop growing. People used to hunt it for its wool, but now they try to keep it safe.
Video\n\nA video is a moving picture. It is made of many tiny pictures shown very fast, one after the other. You can see a video on a TV, a phone, or a big screen at the movies. People use a camera to make a video of a birthday party or a funny cat. A video can be short, like a song you watch, or long, like a whole movie.
Video camera\n\nA video camera is a tool that takes moving pictures. It has a lens on the front and a button to start and stop. You can find it on a phone, a tablet, or as a thing you hold in your hand. It lets you make a movie of your friends, your pets, or a fun day at the park. After you take the movie, you can watch it right away on a screen.
Video documentary\n\nA video documentary is a movie that shows real things. It tells true stories about people, animals, or places. You can watch it on a TV or a tablet. It helps you learn new facts, like how bees make honey or how big ships float. Sometimes a person talks and shows pictures to explain things. It is like a school lesson you can watch at home.
Video game\n\nA video game is a game you play on a screen. It has pictures that move and sounds you can hear. You use a controller with buttons to make things happen. You can find it on a TV, a computer, a tablet, or a phone. People play it for fun at home or on the go. Some games let you race cars, jump over gaps, or solve puzzles. A famous game is one where a plumber jumps to save a princess.
Video game console\n\nA video game console is a machine that lets you play games on a screen. It is a box that you plug into a TV. You hold a controller in your hands to move things in the game. Some consoles are small and you can carry them around. They have their own little screen. You can play racing games, jumping games, or games with funny animals. Many kids have one at home and play with friends.
Vienna\n\nVienna is a big city in a country called Austria. It has many old buildings, big parks, and a wide river called the Danube. It is the capital, so the country's leader works there. Many people live in Vienna, and they speak German. You can see big churches, a giant wheel, and horses that pull carts. Long ago, kings and queens lived there in fancy houses. Today, people go to Vienna to hear music and see pretty art.
Vietnam\n\nVietnam is a country in Southeast Asia. It is long and thin, like a noodle. It has green hills, big rivers, and a long beach next to the sea. Many people live there, and they speak a language called Vietnamese. In the north, it gets cold in winter. In the south, it is warm all year. People in Vietnam eat rice, noodles, and soup. They also have big cities with many bikes and cars. A long time ago, two brave sisters fought to keep the land safe. Today, children in Vietnam go to school and play with friends, just like you.
Vietnamese language\n\nVietnamese is a language people speak in a country called Vietnam. It sounds like singing because the voice goes up and down. Long ago, people wrote it with pictures like Chinese, but now they use letters like English. You can hear it in homes, on TV, and when friends talk to each other.
View\n\nA view is what you see when you look out a window or stand on a high hill. It can be a picture of trees, houses, or a big blue sky. You can find a view anywhere you open your eyes. People like to go to tall places to see a pretty view. A view can change when the sun goes down and the sky turns orange and pink.
Vikings\n\nVikings were people who lived long ago in the far north. They came from lands now called Norway, Sweden, and Denmark. They were very good at sailing on the sea. They used long, fast boats to travel to many places. Sometimes they fought and took things from other people. They also built new homes in lands like England and France. Many Vikings wore simple clothes and helmets without horns. They told stories about strong gods like Thor. Today, we can still see old Viking boats and tools in museums.
Village\n\nA village is a small place where people live. It is in the countryside, away from big cities. The houses in it are close together. Long ago, many people lived in villages and grew food on farms. Today, some villages have a church where people go to sing and pray. A village is smaller than a town, and it is quiet and green.
Vincent\n\nVincent is a boy's name. He is a person, like a friend or a brother. You might meet a Vincent at school or at the park. He can have any color hair and eyes. He likes to play and laugh, just like you.
Vincent Van Gogh\n\nVincent Van Gogh was a man who painted pictures. He used bright colors like yellow, blue, and green. His paintings show flowers, stars, and people. You can see his art in big buildings called museums. One famous painting is of yellow flowers in a pot. He lived a long time ago.
Vinci\n\nVinci is a name. It can be a boy's name or a girl's name. Some people have Vinci as their first name, and some have it as their last name. You might meet a friend named Vinci at school or at the park. It is a short name that is easy to say.
Vine\n\nA vine is a plant with a long, thin stem. It cannot stand up straight by itself. It grows by climbing up a wall, a fence, or a big tree. You can see it in a garden or a forest. Some vines have pretty flowers, and some grow fruit like grapes. It uses tiny curly parts to hold on tight as it climbs.
Vinegar\n\nVinegar is a sour liquid used in cooking. It is made from things like wine, apple juice, or other fruit drinks. Tiny helpers called bacteria turn the drink into vinegar. It tastes very sharp and tangy. People put a little bit of it on salad, fish, or fried potatoes to make the food taste brighter. You might see a bottle of it in the kitchen next to the oil. Some kinds are light brown, and some are dark red.
Viola\n\nA viola is a musical instrument that you play with a bow. It looks a lot like a violin, but it is a little bigger. It has four strings that you can pull a bow across to make sound. You hold it on your left shoulder and use your right hand to move the bow. The sound it makes is lower and warmer than a violin. You can find it in a group of players called an orchestra, where many instruments play together.
Violence\n\nViolence is when someone hurts another person on purpose. It can be hitting, pushing, or using mean words that make someone feel very sad. You might see it when people fight or yell in a mean way. It is not okay to be violent, and we should use kind hands and words instead. If you see violence, tell a grown-up you trust.
Violet (plant)\n\nA violet is a small plant with pretty flowers. It has soft petals that are often purple, blue, or white. You can find it growing in gardens, woods, or even in the grass. People like to plant it because the flowers look nice and smell sweet. Some violets come back every year, and some only live for one year. A famous poem says, "Roses are red, violets are blue." It is also a special flower for the month of February.
Violin\n\nA violin is a small wooden instrument that makes music. It has four long strings stretched over a hollow body. You hold it under your chin and play it with a stick called a bow. The bow has horsehair that rubs the strings to make sound. When you press the strings with your fingers, the notes change. It is often seen in big music groups called orchestras. Many children learn to play simple songs on it, like "Twinkle Twinkle Little Star."
Virtue\n\nVirtue is a way of acting that is good and kind. It is like a bright light inside a person that helps them choose to share, tell the truth, and help others. You can see it when someone waits for their turn or says sorry after a mistake. A person with virtue does things that make people feel safe and happy. It is the opposite of doing mean or hurtful things.
Virus\n\nA virus is a tiny thing that can make you sick. It is so small you cannot see it with just your eyes. It lives inside other living things, like people, animals, or plants. Once it gets inside, it makes more of itself and can cause a cold or a fever. You might have had a virus when you stayed home from school with a runny nose.
Visayas\n\nVisayas is a group of many islands in the middle of the Philippines. It has blue water all around and green hills on the land. People who live there are called Visayans. They catch fish, grow rice, and make things from coconut trees. Some islands have big cities with colorful boats called jeepneys. Many families live in houses near the beach.
Vishnu\n\nVishnu is a very important god in a religion called Hinduism. He is often shown with blue skin and four arms. In each hand, he holds a special thing: a shell, a spinning wheel, a flower, and a club. Many people pray to Vishnu at home or in a temple. They believe he keeps the world safe and comes to Earth in different forms to help when things are bad. Two of his most loved forms are Rama and Krishna.
Visible spectrum\n\nThe visible spectrum is all the colors that people can see. It is like a rainbow in the sky. You can see it when light shines through a glass piece or a soap bubble. It has red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. Each color blends into the next one, so there are no sharp lines between them. A TV or a tablet makes many colors by mixing red, green, and blue light together.
Visit\n\nA visit is when you go to see someone or some place. It means you stay for a little while and then go back home. You can visit your grandma at her house. You can visit a friend to play with toys. You can visit a park to swing on the swings. A visit is a nice way to spend time with people you like.
Visitor\n\nA visitor is a person who comes to see you or a place. It can be a friend, a family member, or someone new. When a visitor comes to your house, you might say hello and show them around. Sometimes a visitor stays for a short time, like for a snack or a playdate. Other times they stay longer, like a grandma who sleeps over. A visitor can also be someone at a zoo or a museum who comes to look at things.
Visual\n\nVisual is about things you can see. It is the way we use our eyes to look at the world. When you draw a picture, you make something visual. A book with many pictures is a visual book. A movie is a visual story that moves on a screen. Your eyes help you see colors, shapes, and faces. Everything you see is part of your visual world.
Visual arts\n\nVisual arts is art that you can see with your eyes. It is a thing you look at, not a show you watch. You can find it in a museum, on a wall, or in a book. People make it by drawing, painting, or shaping clay. A drawing you make with crayons is a kind of visual art.
Visual system\n\nThe visual system is the part of your body that lets you see. It includes your eyes and the parts inside your head that help you understand what you see. Your eyes take in light, and then your brain makes a picture of the world. It helps you know if something is near or far, big or small, and what color it is. When you look at a red ball, your visual system tells you it is round and red. Some animals see colors that people cannot see, like bees that see a special light on flowers.
Vitamin\n\nA vitamin is a tiny helper that your body needs to stay strong and healthy. It comes from the food you eat, like fruits, vegetables, milk, and meat. Your body cannot make vitamins on its own, so you must get them from food every day. For example, oranges have vitamin C, which helps you not get sick. Milk has vitamin D, which makes your bones hard. If you do not get enough of a vitamin for a long time, you can feel tired or get a sickness. Some vitamins stay in your body for a while, and some leave quickly. Many people take a small vitamin pill to make sure they get enough helpers.
Voice\n\nA voice is the sound a person makes when they talk or sing. It comes from a part inside the throat that moves when air goes through it. You can hear a voice when someone says hello or sings a song. People use their voice to tell stories, ask for things, and say I love you. If a person cannot make a voice, they may use their hands or a board to share words. You hear many voices every day — your mom, your teacher, and your friends all have a voice that sounds different.
Volcano\n\nA volcano is a mountain that can get very hot inside. It has a hole at the top called a crater. Sometimes, hot melted rock called lava comes out of the crater. The lava is red and glowing and flows down the sides. When a volcano wakes up, it can throw out ash and steam. Some volcanoes sleep for a long time and do nothing. You can find volcanoes on land and under the sea. One big volcano is in Hawaii and people can visit it.
Volga\n\nThe Volga is a very long river in Russia. It is the longest river in Europe. It starts from hills near Moscow and flows a long way down to a big sea. Many smaller rivers join it along the way. In winter, much of it turns to ice for three months. People use it to move boats and carry things. At the end, it spreads out into many tiny streams where pink birds and big flowers live.
Volleyball\n\nVolleyball is a fun game played by two teams. It uses a big, light ball and a tall net in the middle. Each team has six players on the floor. They try to hit the ball over the net so the other team cannot send it back. The ball must not touch the ground on your side. Players can bump the ball with their arms, set it with their fingers, or spike it hard down. You can see it at school, on a beach, or on TV during big games like the Olympics.
Volt\n\nA volt is a way to measure how hard electricity pushes. It is like water pressure in a hose — more volts mean a stronger push. You can find volts written on batteries, like the small round ones in toys or the big ones in a flashlight. A tiny battery might have one and a half volts, while a wall plug in a house has much more. It helps make lights turn on and toys move.
Voltage\n\nVoltage is like a push that makes tiny electric bits move inside a wire. It is not something you can see, but you can feel its work when a toy lights up or a fan spins. You find it in batteries, like the ones in a remote, and in the holes on the wall at home. It helps power things like lamps, phones, and TVs. A battery has two ends, and the push between them is the voltage.
Volume\n\nVolume is how much space something takes up. It is not the same as how heavy something is. A big mountain takes up a lot of space, so it has a big volume. A small rock takes up a little space, so it has a small volume. You can see volume when you pour water into a cup. The water fills the space inside the cup. When you take a bath, your body pushes the water up because your body takes up space. That is volume too.
Vote\n\nA vote is a way for people to pick something together. It is like raising your hand to say what you want. You see a vote when a class picks a game to play. Each person gets one say, and the choice with the most hands up wins. A vote helps a group decide fairly.
Voting\n\nVoting is a way for people to pick something together. It is like raising your hand to say what you want. When a group votes, each person gets one say. Then all the says are counted. The side with the most says wins. You can see voting when your class picks a game to play. Grown-ups vote to pick a leader for a town or a whole country. Voting helps make things fair because everyone gets a turn to speak.
Vowel\n\nA vowel is a sound you make with your mouth open. It is a letter too. In English, the vowel letters are A, E, I, O, and U. You use it in every word you say. When you sing a song, you hold the vowel sounds long. The letter Y can sometimes be a vowel, like in the word 'sky'.
Wag\n\nA wag is a quick, happy shake of a tail. It looks like the tail is waving back and forth very fast. You see it when a dog is glad to see you. It shows that the dog feels friendly and excited. If you throw a ball, the dog might wag its tail even more.
Wage\n\nA wage is money you get for doing a job. It is paid by the boss to the worker. Most of the time, you get a wage for each hour you work. If you work more hours, you get more money. Some people get a wage for each thing they make or do. A wage is not the same as a salary. A salary is a set amount of money you get every week or month, no matter how many hours you work. Many countries have a rule that says the wage cannot be too low. This is called a minimum wage. It helps workers have enough money to live.
Wait\n\nWait means to stay in one place and not do anything for a little while. It is like when you stop moving and look around until something happens. You wait at the bus stop for the bus to come. You wait in line at the store to pay for your snack. When you wait, you might feel still and quiet. Sometimes waiting is hard because you want something right now. But waiting can be good, like when you wait for your birthday and then it feels extra special.
Waiter\n\nA waiter is a person who works in a restaurant. He brings food and drinks to your table. He wears a neat shirt and sometimes an apron. You can see him walking around with a big tray. He smiles and asks what you would like to eat. After you finish, he takes the empty plates away.
Waiting\n\nWaiting is when you stay in one place until something happens. It means you are not doing the thing yet, but you are ready. You might wait for your turn on the slide at the park. You might wait for cookies to cool down before you eat one. Sometimes waiting feels long, like when you wait for your birthday. Other times it is short, like waiting for a friend to say hello.
Waitress\n\nA waitress is a person who works in a restaurant. She brings food and drinks to the table. She wears a uniform and sometimes carries a tray. You can see her when you go out to eat with your family. She smiles and asks what you would like to order.
Wake\n\nWake is the time when you stop sleeping and open your eyes. It happens after a long night of rest. When you wake, you might feel happy and ready to play. The sun coming through the window can help you wake up. Mom or Dad might say "time to wake" in the morning.
Wales\n\nWales is a part of the United Kingdom, next to England. It has green hills, tall mountains, and a long coast by the sea. Many people live in the south, in big cities like Cardiff. People in Wales speak English, and some also speak Welsh, an old language. They are proud of their songs, stories, and a special flower called a daffodil. Long ago, many people worked in mines to dig coal from the ground. Today, visitors come to see the pretty parks and old castles.
Walk\n\nA walk is moving your legs to go from one place to another. It is slower than running. When you walk, one foot is always on the ground. People walk to go to the store, to the park, or just to look around. Walking is good for your body and helps you stay strong. You learned to walk when you were a very little baby.
Wall\n\nA wall is a tall flat side that stands up from the floor. It is made of hard things like brick or stone. You see walls all around you inside a house. They split a big room into smaller rooms, like your bedroom and the kitchen. A wall holds up the roof so it does not fall down. It also keeps out wind, rain, and cold. Some walls outside can hold back dirt on a hill so the ground stays flat.
Wallet\n\nA wallet is a small flat holder for money and cards. It is often made of soft leather or cloth. People keep it in a pocket or a bag. Inside, it has little slots for paper money and plastic cards. Some wallets have a small zipper part for coins. When you go to the store, a grown-up takes out a wallet to pay for things.
Walnut\n\nA walnut is a small, round nut that grows on a tall tree. It has a hard, brown shell on the outside. Inside, the nut is light brown and bumpy, and it looks a little like a brain. You can find it in stores or in some parks and yards. People crack the shell open and eat the soft part inside. It tastes a little sweet and a little oily. Some people put it in cookies, cakes, or bread. Squirrels like to hide walnuts in the ground to eat later.
Walrus\n\nA walrus is a big animal that lives in the cold sea. It has long teeth that stick out of its mouth. These teeth are called tusks. It uses its tusks to pull itself onto the ice. It also uses them to break ice and to fight. A walrus is brown, but it can turn pink when it gets warm. It has a thick layer of fat under its skin to keep it warm in icy water. It can walk on land by turning its back feet forward. You can see a walrus in a zoo or in a book about the Arctic.
Walt\n\nWalt is a name for a boy or a man. It is a short way to say Walter. You might meet a Walt at school, at the park, or in a story. He could be a dad, a grandpa, or a friend. Some Walts like to tell jokes and make people laugh.
Walt Disney\n\nWalt Disney was a man who made cartoons and movies. He drew a funny mouse named Mickey. He also built a big park called Disneyland where families can play. Many children watch his movies and love the songs and stories.
Want\n\nWant is a feeling inside you. It is when you wish for something you do not have right now. You might want a toy, a snack, or a hug from Mom. When you want something, you think about it a lot. Sometimes you say "I want that!" and point. Wanting is not the same as needing. You need food and water to live, but you want candy or a new game. It is okay to want things, but you cannot always get them right away.
War\n\nWar is a big fight between groups of people. It happens when countries or groups cannot agree and use weapons. Soldiers wear special clothes and use things like guns and tanks. War can break homes and make people sad. Many people hope for peace so that wars stop.
War elephant\n\nA war elephant is a big animal that helped people in fights long ago. It has a long nose called a trunk, big ears, and strong legs. People sat on top of it and told it where to go. It ran at the other side and scared them away. Long ago, people in India used it first. Later, people in other places used it too. But when big loud cannons came, people stopped using it in fights. After that, it helped carry heavy things.
Warehouse\n\nA warehouse is a big building where people keep many things before they go to stores. It looks like a giant box with big doors. You can find it near roads or train tracks. Workers use strong machines to lift heavy boxes and put them on tall shelves. When you order a toy online, it may come from a warehouse.
Warm\n\nWarm is a feeling that is not too hot and not too cold. It feels nice on your skin, like when you sit in the sun. You can feel warm when you wear a soft sweater or drink hot cocoa. A warm bath makes your body feel cozy. A warm hug from someone you love feels safe and happy.
Warmth\n\nWarmth is a nice feeling of being cozy and not cold. It can come from the sun on your skin or a soft blanket wrapped around you. You feel it when you sit by a fire or drink hot cocoa. It makes your body feel safe and happy. A hug from someone you love also gives you warmth.
Warsaw\n\nWarsaw is a big city in the country of Poland. It is the most important city there. It sits on both sides of a wide river called the Vistula. Many people live in Warsaw, and they work in tall buildings. One very tall building is the Palace of Culture and Science. You can go to the top and see the whole city. A long time ago, a king lived in a pretty palace there. Today, people visit that palace to see the old rooms and gardens. Warsaw also has many schools and places to watch plays.
Warship\n\nA warship is a big boat that carries weapons. It is used by the navy to protect the sea. It can be very long and made of strong metal. Some warships have a flat top where planes can land and take off. Others have big guns or rockets. You might see a warship in a movie or a picture book about the ocean.
Was\n\nWas is a word we use to talk about something that happened before now. It tells us about one person, one animal, or one thing in the past. You might say, "The dog was happy" or "The sun was bright." It helps us share stories about yesterday or long ago.
Wash\n\nWash means to clean something with water. You can wash your hands with soap to get dirt off. You can wash your clothes in a big machine. When you take a bath, you wash your whole body. It makes things smell nice and look bright.
Washing machine\n\nA washing machine is a big box that cleans dirty clothes. It has a round drum inside where you put the clothes. You find it in a laundry room or a bathroom at home. It fills with water and soap, then spins very fast to wash the dirt away. After it spins, the clothes come out clean and wet. Then you can put them in a dryer or hang them up to dry.
Washington\n\nWashington is a name for a person, a city, and a state. The city is the capital of the United States, where the president lives and works in a big white house. The state is in the far corner of the country, with tall green trees, mountains, and lots of rain. A famous person with this name was George Washington, who was the very first president. You might see the name on a map, in a book, or on a coin.
Washington, D.C.\n\nWashington, D.C. is a big, busy city where the leaders of the United States work. It has wide streets, many parks, and a long green space called the National Mall. You can see the White House, where the President lives, and a tall pointy building called the Washington Monument. People visit it to see museums with dinosaur bones and old airplanes. It is not a state, but many people live there and ride buses and trains.
Wasp\n\nA wasp is a small flying bug with a thin body. It has two wings, six legs, and a sharp point at the back that can sting. It makes a nest out of paper that looks like a gray ball. You can find a nest hanging under the roof of a house or in a tree. A wasp eats sweet juice from flowers and also catches other bugs to feed its babies. It is not fuzzy like a bee, so it looks smooth and shiny. If you leave it alone, it will not bother you.
Waste\n\nWaste is stuff that people do not want anymore. It can be old food, paper, or broken toys. You see it in a trash can at home or in a big bin outside. People put waste in a bag and take it to the street. A big truck comes to pick it up and take it away. Some waste can be used again, like glass bottles or cardboard boxes. This is called recycling. Other waste goes to a big hole in the ground called a landfill. Some waste is burned to make heat. When waste is not put in a bin, it can make the land and water dirty. So it is good to put waste in the right place.
Watch\n\nA watch is a tiny clock you can wear or carry. It shows you the time so you always know when it is morning, noon, or night. Most people wear it on their wrist with a strap. Some watches have hands that move around numbers, and some show numbers on a little screen. A watch can be a pretty thing to wear, like a bracelet. You might see one on your mom or dad’s wrist.
Water\n\nWater is a clear liquid that falls as rain and fills oceans, lakes, and rivers. It has no color, no taste, and no smell. You can find it in your sink, in a puddle, or in a big blue sea. All living things need it to stay alive. People drink it, wash with it, and use it to grow food. When it gets very cold, it turns into hard ice. When it gets very hot, it turns into steam that goes up into the air.
Water buffalo\n\nA water buffalo is a big animal that likes to live near water. It has a dark gray or black body, four strong legs, and two long horns that curve back. You can find it on farms in warm places like Asia. People keep it for its rich milk, which is used to make soft white cheese. It also helps farmers by pulling heavy things and plowing fields. A baby water buffalo stays with its mom and a big group of other moms for three years. Then the young boys go off to live in a small group with other boys. Some water buffalo live in the wild, but there are very few left, so people keep them safe in special parks.
Water cycle\n\nThe water cycle is the way water moves around our Earth. It goes up into the sky and comes back down again. The sun warms up water in the ocean, and the water turns into tiny drops that float up to make clouds. When the clouds get heavy, the water falls back down as rain or snow. Then the water flows into rivers and lakes, and some of it goes back into the ocean. The water cycle never stops, and it gives us the water we need to drink and grow food.
Water pollution\n\nWater pollution is when water gets dirty and unsafe. It happens in lakes, rivers, and the big sea. Dirty things from houses and factories flow into the water. This makes the water look green or brown instead of clear blue. It hurts the fish and plants that live in the water. When people or animals drink the dirty water, they can get sick. Farmers use food for plants that can wash into rivers and make the water dirty too.
Water purification\n\nWater purification is a way to make water clean and safe. It takes out the bad stuff you cannot see, like tiny germs and dirt. People do this so the water is good to drink and does not make you sick. You can find clean water from a tap at home or in a water bottle from the store. Some people use a special pitcher with a filter to clean the water. Clean water is also used in big machines to wash things. When water is not clean, it can hurt pipes and sinks. Many people around the world need clean water to stay healthy.
Water tower\n\nA water tower is a tall building that holds water. It looks like a big tank on top of long legs. You can see it in a town or near a school. It sends water down through pipes to homes and stores. Even when the lights go out, it can still push water out because it uses gravity. It is like a giant cup that shares water with everyone.
Water vapor\n\nWater vapor is water that has turned into a gas you cannot see. It is all around us in the air, but it is invisible. When water gets very hot, it changes into this gas and floats up. You can see it when you breathe out on a cold day and a little cloud forms—that is water vapor turning back into tiny water drops. It helps make clouds and rain, and it is an important part of how water moves around the Earth.
Water viper\n\nA water viper is a kind of snake that lives near water. It has a thick body and a wide, flat head. When it opens its mouth, the inside is white like cotton. It lives in warm, wet places like swamps, lakes, and rivers. It eats small animals like frogs, fish, and birds. Its bite can hurt people very much, so it is best to stay far away if you see one.
Watercolour\n\nWatercolour is a way to paint with colours that mix with water. It uses a brush and special paints that come in a small box. You dip the brush in water, then rub it on the paint, and then you can make marks on paper. When the water dries, the colour stays on the paper. Many children use watercolour at school to make pictures of flowers, houses, or the sky.
Waterfall\n\nA waterfall is water that falls down a big rock step. It starts high up and drops straight down to a pool below. You can find it in rivers where the ground drops suddenly. The water makes a loud, roaring sound when it hits the bottom. Many people visit waterfalls to see the pretty water and feel the cool spray. Angel Falls is a very tall waterfall far away.
Watermelon\n\nA watermelon is a big, round fruit that grows on a vine. It has a thick green skin on the outside. Inside, it is juicy and sweet, and it can be red, pink, or yellow. You can eat the soft part, but not the hard green skin. It has small black or brown seeds, but some kinds have no seeds at all. People love to eat it on a hot summer day because it is cool and full of water.
Watermill\n\nA watermill is a machine that uses moving water to do work. It has a big round wheel with flat blades on it. You can find it next to a river or a stream. The water pushes the wheel and makes it spin. The spinning wheel turns heavy stones inside the mill. These stones grind grain into flour for bread. Long ago, people used watermills to make flour and to shape metal.
Wave\n\nA wave is a wiggling movement that travels from one place to another. It carries energy, like a push or a pull, without moving the stuff around it very far. You can see waves on top of water when you throw a stone into a pond. It moves up and down and spreads out in circles. Sound is also a wave that moves through the air to your ears. Light from the sun is another kind of wave that travels all the way to Earth.
Wavelength\n\nWavelength is how long a wave is from one bump to the next bump. It is the space between two high points of a wave. You can see waves in water when you drop a rock in a pond. The circles that move out are waves, and the space from one circle to the next is the wavelength. Light and sound also have waves, but you cannot see them. A short wavelength means the bumps are close together. A long wavelength means the bumps are far apart.
Wavy\n\nWavy means something has a shape like small hills and valleys. It is not straight or flat. You can see wavy lines on the ocean when the water moves up and down. Hair can be wavy too, with soft bends instead of tight curls. A flag blows in the wind and makes a wavy shape.
Way\n\nA way is a path or a road that takes you from one place to another. It can be made of dirt, stones, or hard black ground. You walk on a way to go to school, the park, or a friend's house. A way can be short or long, straight or curvy. Sometimes a way goes through a forest or over a hill. When you follow a way, it shows you where to go.
We\n\nWe is a word that means you and me together. It is a small word we use when we talk about a group that has the speaker in it. When you say "we are playing," it means you and your friend are playing. When a family says "we eat dinner," it means all the people in the family eat together. We can be two people or many people. It helps us share what we do as a team.
Weak\n\nWeak means not strong. It is when a person or thing has little power. You might feel weak when you are sick and cannot run fast. A weak branch on a tree can break easily. A weak light is not very bright, so you cannot see well. When you are weak, you need rest to feel strong again.
Weak Interaction\n\nA weak interaction is a tiny push or pull that happens inside very small things, like the bits that make up everything. It is one of the ways these tiny bits talk to each other. You cannot see it with your eyes, but it helps the sun shine and makes some things break apart slowly. Scientists study it with big tools to learn how the world works.
Wealth\n\nWealth is having many things that people want. It can be money, a big house, or land with animals. For one person, it means all the nice things they own. For a whole country, it means the land, the buildings, and the things people make together. Long ago, the word meant feeling happy and well. Today, it still can mean a good life, not just coins.
Weapon\n\nA weapon is a thing people use to hurt others or animals. It can be small like a knife or big like a cannon. Long ago, people made weapons from stone and wood. Today, soldiers use guns that shoot fast. Police carry weapons to keep people safe. Some weapons are hidden, like a bomb in the ground. You might see a toy weapon in a game, but real ones are dangerous.
Wear\n\nWear means to have clothes or things on your body. You wear a shirt on your top and pants on your legs. You also wear shoes on your feet and a hat on your head. When it is cold, you wear a warm coat. When it is sunny, you wear sunglasses to keep the sun out of your eyes. Every day, you pick what to wear.
Weasel\n\nA weasel is a small, furry animal with a long, thin body and short legs. It has a red or brown back and a white belly. Its tail is short and thin. It lives in many places around the world, like woods and fields. It hunts small animals like rabbits by going into their holes. It is quick and good at catching food.
Weather\n\nWeather is what the air outside feels like. It can be sunny, rainy, windy, or snowy. Sometimes it is hot, and sometimes it is cold. It changes from day to day, and even from morning to night. You can see it when you look out the window. People wear a coat when it is cold and shorts when it is hot. Rain helps flowers grow, and wind makes leaves dance. A storm can bring loud thunder and bright lightning.
Weather front\n\nA weather front is a line where two big blocks of air meet. One block is warm, and the other is cold. It can make clouds, rain, or wind. When a cold block pushes a warm block, it can bring big storms. When a warm block slides over a cold block, it can bring soft rain and fog. After it moves away, the sky often turns clear and blue.
Weathering\n\nWeathering is when big rocks break into smaller pieces. It happens when wind, rain, or ice touch the rock over a long time. You can see it on old stone walls or on mountains where the rock looks cracked and bumpy. Rain can make the rock soft and crumble. Wind can blow tiny bits of sand that scratch the rock. When water gets into a crack and freezes, the ice pushes the crack open wider. Weathering helps make the soil where plants grow.
Weaving\n\nWeaving is a way to make cloth. It uses two sets of long, thin strings called threads. One set goes up and down, and the other set goes side to side. The threads cross each other to make a flat piece of cloth. People use a big tool called a loom to hold the threads tight. You can see weaving in things like a towel, a blanket, or the shirt you wear.
Web browser\n\nA web browser is a tool on a computer or phone that lets you look at websites. It has a long white box at the top where you type the name of a place you want to see. When you press go, it shows you words, pictures, and videos from that place. You can use it to watch cartoons, play simple games, or read stories. Some browsers are made to keep your secrets safe, and some are made to be very fast. You might see a browser on a tablet at home or at school.
Web design\n\nWeb design is making how a website looks and feels. It is like drawing a picture of a page on the computer. A web designer picks the colors, the words, and where the buttons go. They make sure it is easy to use and nice to see. You can see web design when you visit a fun game site or a story site. It helps you find what you want without getting lost.
Website\n\nA website is a place on the computer where you can see pages with words and pictures. It lives on a big computer called a server, far away. You visit it by typing its name in a box at the top of your screen. Some websites let you play games, watch videos, or learn new things. A website can have many pages, and you click on words or pictures to move from one page to another. The first page you see is called the home page. It is like the front door of the website.
Wedding\n\nA wedding is a happy day when two people promise to love each other forever. It has a special party where they say their promises out loud. They often give each other a ring to wear on the finger. Many weddings happen in a church or a big hall with flowers and music. After the promises, there is a big meal with cake and dancing. The two people wear nice clothes, and the bride may wear a long white dress. Friends and family come to cheer and give hugs. Then they go on a fun trip called a honeymoon.
Wedge\n\nA wedge is a simple tool shaped like a triangle. It has one thin edge and one thick edge. You can find it in a toolbox or a kitchen drawer. People use it to split things apart, like cutting a log with an axe or slicing cheese with a knife. A doorstop is a wedge that keeps a door open.
Wednesday\n\nWednesday is a day of the week. It comes after Tuesday and before Thursday. It is the middle day of the week. Many people go to school or work on this day. Some kids have a special class like music or art on Wednesday. It is a good day to play with friends after school.
Weed\n\nA weed is a small plant that grows where people do not want it. It pops up in gardens, on lawns, and between sidewalk cracks. It has green leaves and sometimes tiny flowers. A weed takes water and sun from the plants people like. Gardeners pull it out by hand or use a tool to dig it up. A dandelion is a weed many children know because its yellow flower turns into a fluffy white ball.
Week\n\nA week is a group of seven days. It goes in a circle: after Sunday, a new week starts again. People use the week to know when to go to school or work. Most grown-ups work for five days and then rest for two days. Those two rest days are called the weekend. A year has about 52 weeks. You can see the days of the week on a calendar at home or in your classroom.
Weekend\n\nA weekend is the two days at the end of the week when many people do not go to work or school. It is Saturday and Sunday. On the weekend, families can sleep late, play outside, or go to the park. Some people watch movies or eat a big breakfast together. It is a happy time to rest and have fun before the new week starts.
Weevil\n\nA weevil is a tiny bug. It has a long nose that sticks out in front. You can find it on plants, in gardens, or sometimes in food like rice or cereal. It eats leaves, seeds, and grains. Some weevils can hurt crops that farmers grow. It is very small, so you might need a looking glass to see its long nose.
Weighing scale\n\nA weighing scale is a tool that tells how heavy something is. It has a flat top where you put the thing you want to weigh. Some scales have a little window with numbers that show the weight. You find scales in a bathroom to check your body weight. You also see them at a grocery store to weigh fruits and vegetables. A kitchen scale helps Mom or Dad measure flour and sugar when they bake a cake.
Weight\n\nWeight is how heavy something feels when you pick it up. It is the pull that the ground has on a thing. On Earth, a big rock has more weight than a small pebble. You can check weight with a scale at home or at the doctor’s office. A scale shows a number that tells you how heavy you are. If you go to the Moon, your weight would be much less because the Moon pulls less than Earth.
Weight loss\n\nWeight loss means your body gets lighter than before. It happens when you move your body a lot, like running or swimming. It also happens when you eat more good foods, like vegetables and fruits, and less sweet foods. Some people lose weight without trying when they feel sad or sick. Getting good sleep at night helps your body stay at a happy weight.
Welcome\n\nWelcome is a warm word you say when someone comes to you. It means you are happy to see them. You can say it when a friend comes to your house or when a new child joins your class. You can also wave your hand or give a big smile to show welcome. It makes people feel safe and loved.
Welfare\n\nWelfare is help that people get when they need it. It can be money, food, or a place to stay. Some people get welfare when they are sick or cannot work. It helps them buy food and clothes. Many countries have welfare to make sure everyone is okay.
Welfare Spending\n\nWelfare spending is money the government uses to help people. It goes to people who are sick, old, or do not have a job. This money can pay for food, a home, or a doctor visit. It helps make sure everyone has what they need to live.
Well\n\nA well is a deep hole in the ground that gives us water. It goes down, down, down until it reaches water hiding under the dirt and rocks. People use a bucket on a rope to pull the water up. Some wells have a pump that pushes the water out. Many towns get their water from big wells. It is important to keep the ground near a well clean so the water stays safe to drink.
Were\n\nWere is a word we use to talk about the past. It tells us that something happened before now. We say "they were" or "you were" when we talk about more than one person or thing. For example, "The kids were happy at the park." It helps us tell stories about yesterday or long ago.
Werewolf\n\nA werewolf is a made-up creature that is part human and part wolf. It looks like a normal person most of the time, but when the moon is big and round, it changes into a big, hairy wolf. It has sharp teeth, pointy ears, and a long tail. You find werewolves in stories, movies, and books. They are often scary and chase people in the dark. In some tales, a werewolf can be hurt by a shiny silver bullet. When it dies, it turns back into a person.
West\n\nWest is a direction. It is the way the sun goes down at the end of the day. If you face the sunset, you are looking west. On a map, west is on the left side. Many people travel west to see the ocean or big mountains.
West Africa\n\nWest Africa is a big part of the world. It is on the west side of a very big land called Africa. Many countries are there, like Ghana and Nigeria. It has hot weather and big rivers. People there grow food like yams and rice. Some places have busy markets with colorful cloth.
West Bengal\n\nWest Bengal is a big piece of land in the east of India. It has tall mountains in the north and a big sea called the Bay of Bengal in the south. Many people live there, and its main city is Kolkata. A long river named the Ganges flows through it and splits into smaller rivers. People grow rice and tea in West Bengal. It is also home to the Sundarbans, a big forest with trees that grow in water and many tigers.
West Lake\n\nWest Lake is a big, pretty lake in a city called Hangzhou. It has calm, blue water with green hills all around. You can see old temples and gardens near the water. People like to walk by the lake or ride on small boats. Many families visit to look at the flowers and trees. It is a quiet place to rest and play.
Western\n\nWestern is a kind of movie or story. It shows cowboys, horses, and big open lands with sand and cactuses. You can see it on TV or in a book. In a Western, people ride horses fast and wear big hats. They help keep a town safe. A child might see a Western when a grown-up watches an old movie with horses and dusty streets.
Western (genre)\n\nA Western is a kind of story. It is often a movie or a TV show. It shows cowboys and horses a long time ago. Cowboys wear big hats and boots. They ride horses and live in a dry, dusty place. Sometimes they help a town, and sometimes they chase bad people. You might see a cowboy hat in a toy store or a picture book.
Western Europe\n\nWestern Europe is a big part of the world. It is a group of countries that sit on the left side of a map of Europe. Some of these countries touch the ocean with long, bumpy edges. People in these countries often share ways of living, like what they eat and how they say hello. Many of them work together to make rules and trade things like toys and food. A country in Western Europe you might know is Spain, where people enjoy sunny beaches.
Western Philosophy\n\nWestern philosophy is a way of thinking about big questions. It asks things like: What is real? How should we be good? What can we know? It started long ago in a place called Greece. People who do this thinking are called philosophers. They talk and write about ideas. You can find their ideas in books and in talks. One example is asking if a chair is still a chair when no one looks at it.
Western Sahara\n\nWestern Sahara is a big piece of land in Africa. It is mostly hot, dry desert with flat sand and rocks. It sits next to the big blue ocean on one side. Not many people live there because it is so dry. The biggest town is called Layoune, and many of the people stay there. Some people say it belongs to one country, and others say it belongs to a different group. This has caused a long fight, but now there is no war. Many families from there live in tents in a nearby country.
Western United States\n\nThe Western United States is a big part of the country. It is the side where the sun goes down. It has tall, rocky mountains with snow on top. There are also hot, dry deserts with sand and cactus. Next to the big blue ocean, you can find long, sandy beaches. Many people live in big cities there, and some live on farms with cows and horses.
