A long time ago, people rode horses and wore big hats in that place. Today, you can still see cowboys and pretty sunsets.
Wet\n\nWet means something has water on it or in it. When you jump in a puddle, your shoes get wet. A towel feels wet after you dry your hands. Rain makes the ground wet. If you paint with watercolors, the paper gets wet. Wet things feel cool and slippery. When the sun shines, wet things dry up and the water goes away.
Wetland\n\nA wetland is a place where land and water meet. It has wet, muddy ground and may have shallow pools. You can find it near rivers, lakes, or by the sea. Many animals live there, like frogs, ducks, and bugs. It helps clean the water and gives animals a safe home. Some wetlands are big and grassy, and you might see tall reeds growing there.
Whale\n\nA whale is a very big animal that lives in the ocean. It is not a fish, even though it swims in water. It breathes air from a hole on top of its head. When it comes up, it blows water and air high into the sky. A whale can be as long as a school bus. Some whales have no teeth. They have long, thin strips in their mouth to catch tiny food from the water. Other whales have sharp teeth to eat fish. A baby whale is called a calf. It drinks milk from its mom. Whales can talk to each other with loud sounds under the water. Sometimes a whale jumps out of the water and makes a big splash. You can see whales in the big, blue sea.
Whale shark\n\nA whale shark is the biggest fish in the sea. It has a wide, flat head and a very big mouth. Its body is gray or blue with white spots and stripes. It lives in warm oceans all around the world. It swims slowly and eats tiny sea animals like krill and plankton. Even though it is huge, it is gentle and shy. People sometimes see it near the top of the water. It can live for a very long time, up to 100 years.
What\n\nWhat is a word we use to ask a question. It helps us find out about things we do not know. You can say it when you see something new and want to learn its name. You can also use it when you hear a sound and want to know where it comes from. For example, if you point at a bug and say "What is that?" a grown-up can tell you.
Wheat\n\nWheat is a plant that gives us food. It looks like tall green grass with thin leaves and a top full of small seeds. Farmers grow it in big fields all over the world. People pick the seeds and grind them into flour. The flour is used to make bread, pasta, and cookies. Many children eat wheat every day in their breakfast cereal or sandwich.
Wheel\n\nA wheel is a round thing that spins. It is shaped like a circle. You see wheels on cars, buses, bikes, and toy cars. When a wheel turns, it helps things move easily on the ground. A big truck has many wheels, and a small skateboard has four tiny ones. Without wheels, we would have to carry everything.
Wheelbarrow\n\nA wheelbarrow is a small cart with one wheel. It has a big open box on top and two long handles at the back. You find it in gardens or on farms. People use it to carry heavy things like dirt, rocks, or plants. You push it by lifting the handles and walking forward. It helps move stuff that is too heavy to carry with your hands.
Wheelchair\n\nA wheelchair is a special chair with wheels. It helps people who cannot walk or find walking very hard. Some wheelchairs are pushed by the person sitting in it, using their hands on the big wheels. Others have a motor that moves it by itself. You might see a wheelchair at a store, a park, or a doctor's office. A person who uses it can go places and do things just like everyone else.
When\n\nWhen is a word we use to ask about time. It helps us find out the moment something happens. You might say "When is lunch?" because you want to know the time to eat. Or you ask "When do we go to the park?" to learn the day or hour. It is a small word that starts many questions about past, now, and later.
Where\n\nWhere is a word we use to ask about a place. It helps us find out where something or someone is. You might say "Where is my toy?" when you cannot see it. A grown-up might ask "Where are we going?" before a trip. It is a small word that starts many questions every day.
Which\n\nWhich is a word we use when we want to pick one thing from a few. It helps us ask about choices. You might say, "Which toy do you want?" when you see a red car and a blue truck. It is a small word that starts a question. We use it every day to find out what someone likes best.
While\n\nWhile is a word that means "during the time that." It joins two things that happen at the same time. You might say, "I sing while I wash my hands." It helps you tell a story with two parts that go together.
Whip\n\nA whip is a long, thin tool. It has a handle at one end and a long, bendy part at the other. You might see it in old stories about cowboys or in a circus. A person swings it fast and it makes a loud crack sound. People used it long ago to guide horses or other animals. Today, some people use it in shows to do tricks.
Whirlpool galaxy\n\nThe Whirlpool galaxy is a big family of stars far, far away in space. It looks like a bright pinwheel with long, curvy arms that spin around a bright center. You can see it in the night sky if you use a special tool called a telescope. It has a smaller friend galaxy next to it, and they pull on each other like two dancers holding hands. Many people who love stars like to look at it because the shape is so pretty.
Whisker\n\nA whisker is a long, stiff hair near an animal's mouth. It is thicker than other hair and sticks out from the face. Cats and mice have whiskers on their cheeks, above their eyes, and sometimes on their legs. It helps the animal feel things around it, even in the dark. You should never cut a whisker because it can make the animal feel lost. Some people also call a beard or mustache a whisker.
Whisper\n\nA whisper is a very soft way of talking. It sounds like a tiny puff of air with words inside. You use it when you want to tell a secret or when you are in a quiet place like a library. To whisper, you make your voice so small that only someone very close can hear it. It feels like a tickle in your ear.
Whistle\n\nA whistle is a small tool that makes a high, loud sound. It is often made of metal or plastic and has a tiny hole for air. You put it to your lips and blow, and it makes a sharp noise. People use it to get attention, like a coach at a game or a lifeguard at the pool. Some whistles are on a string so you can wear them around your neck.
White\n\nWhite is the brightest color we can see. It is the color of fresh snow on a cold day. You can make white light by mixing red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple light together. Many things are white, like clouds, milk, and paper. Doctors and nurses wear white coats to look clean. A white flag means peace. White is a happy color that feels new and fresh.
White blood cell\n\nA white blood cell is a tiny helper inside your body. It is round and very small, so you need a special tool to see it. It lives in your blood and moves all around your body. Its job is to fight germs and keep you from getting sick. When you have a cut, it rushes there to clean up and help you heal. Sometimes it makes a little yellow goo called pus while it works.
White dwarf\n\nA white dwarf is a very old, small star. It is what is left after a star like our Sun runs out of fuel and shrinks. It is very tiny, about as big as Earth, but it has as much stuff inside as the whole Sun. It shines with a white or blue light at first, but over a very, very long time it cools down and stops glowing. You cannot see one with just your eyes, but big telescopes can find them in the night sky.
White Sea\n\nThe White Sea is a big body of water in the north of Russia. It is part of a bigger sea, but land wraps around it on three sides. In winter, the top of it freezes into ice, so strong boats called icebreakers help other boats move. Many rivers flow into it, and people catch fish like salmon and cod there. Big boats carry things from its ports to other places.
Whiteboard\n\nA whiteboard is a big, flat board that is shiny and white. It hangs on a wall in a classroom or an office. People write on it with special markers that wipe off easily. A teacher uses it to draw letters and numbers so the class can see. You can clean it with a soft cloth, and then it is blank again.
Whitefly\n\nA whitefly is a tiny bug with soft white wings. It is so small you may need a big glass to see it well. It lives on the bottom side of plant leaves in gardens and farms. It drinks the sweet juice from the leaves, which can make the plant sick. If you shake a plant and see a little white cloud fly up, that might be a whitefly.
Who\n\nA who is a word we use to ask about a person. It helps us find out someone's name or who did something. You hear it in questions like "Who is that?" or "Who ate the cookie?" When you play a guessing game, you might ask "Who is hiding behind the door?" It is a small word that starts many fun talks.
Whole\n\nWhole means all of something, with no parts missing. When you eat a whole cookie, you eat every last crumb. A whole apple is one apple that is not cut into pieces. You can have a whole toy, a whole book, or a whole day to play. It is the opposite of a part or a piece.
Whoosh\n\nA whoosh is a soft, fast sound. It is like the noise when something moves quickly through the air. You might hear it when a car zooms past on the street. A bird flying close by can make a whoosh with its wings. Even a broom sweeping the floor can make a little whoosh.
Whose\n\nWhose is a question word. It asks who something belongs to. When you see a toy on the floor, you can ask, "Whose toy is this?" It helps you find the owner. If you find a lost mitten, you might say, "Whose mitten is this?" Then someone can say, "It is mine!"
Why\n\nWhy is a word we use to ask for a reason. It helps us learn about the world. When you ask why, you want to know what made something happen. For example, you might ask why the sky is blue or why a ball bounces. Grown-ups and teachers love when you ask why because it shows you are thinking.
Wi-Fi\n\nWi-Fi is a way to connect to the internet without wires. It uses invisible waves that travel through the air. You can find it in many homes, schools, and stores. It lets you watch videos, play games, and talk to friends on a tablet or phone. When you see a little fan shape on a screen, that means Wi-Fi is there.
Wide\n\nWide means something is big from one side to the other side. It is the opposite of narrow. A wide road has lots of space for cars. A wide smile shows many teeth. A wide river is hard to cross. When you stretch your arms out, that is how wide you are.
Width\n\nWidth is how wide something is. It tells you how far it is from one side to the other side. You can measure width with a ruler. A big truck has more width than a small car. A door has width so people can walk through. When you stretch your arms out wide, that shows width.
Wife\n\nA wife is a woman who is married. She and her husband promise to be a family. She may wear a pretty ring on her finger. A wife and her husband live together and help each other. They share a home and often have children. A wife can be a mom, a worker, or a friend. She is part of a family.
Wig\n\nA wig is a pretend head of hair that a person can put on. It looks like real hair, but it is made by people. You can find it in a store or a costume box. Some people wear it when they have no hair on their head. Actors put it on to look like a different person for a show. Sometimes a judge in a big court wears a white wig as part of the job.
Wiggle\n\nWiggle means to move your body or a part of your body back and forth with small, quick shakes. It looks like a little dance or a jiggle. You can wiggle your fingers, your toes, or your whole body. When you wiggle, you do not stay still—you move side to side or up and down. A worm wiggles on the ground when it moves. You might wiggle in your chair when you feel happy or excited.
Wild\n\nWild means something is not tame. It lives or grows on its own, without people taking care of it. A wild animal finds its own food and makes its own home. You might see a wild rabbit in a field or a wild flower by the road. It is free and does not need a person to help it.
Wild boar\n\nA wild boar is a big, strong animal that looks like a pig. It has a large head, short legs, and a body covered with rough hair. Its eyes sit high on its head, and its ears are small. It lives in forests and fields in many parts of the world. It uses its strong nose to dig in the dirt for food like roots, worms, and bugs. A mother wild boar has four to six babies at a time. The babies are tiny when they are born and drink milk from their mom. Long ago, people used its hair to make soft brushes. In old stories, it was seen as a brave and powerful animal.
Wildebeest\n\nA wildebeest is a big animal that looks a little like a cow. It has four long legs, a large head with two curved horns, and a long tail. It lives in Africa on wide, flat lands with grass and trees. It eats grass and walks very far with a big group to find fresh food. A wildebeest is food for lions and other big hunters.
Wildfire\n\nA wildfire is a big fire that burns in the woods or grass. It moves fast and can burn many trees and homes. You might see it on the news when a forest is on fire. Firefighters use water and tools to stop it. Sometimes people start a wildfire by mistake, like when a campfire is not put out. Some plants need a small fire to grow new seeds, but a big wildfire can hurt animals and people.
Wildlife conservation\n\nWildlife conservation means taking care of wild animals and the places they live. It helps keep animals safe so they do not go away forever. People do this by protecting forests, rivers, and oceans. They also make rules to stop hunting and keep the land clean. When we save a home for a bear or a bird, we help many other living things too.
Will\n\nWill is a name for a boy. He is a person, just like you. You might meet a Will at school or at the park. He can be a friend who likes to play games and share toys. Sometimes Will is short for William.
William\n\nWilliam is a name for a boy. It is a very old name that many people have used for a long time. You might meet a boy named William at school or at the park. Sometimes people call him Will or Billy for short. A famous William from stories is a prince who becomes a king.
William Shakespeare\n\nWilliam Shakespeare was a man who wrote many stories and poems. He lived a long time ago in a country called England. His stories are called plays, and people act them out on a big stage. You might see a play about a king, a fairy, or two young people in love. Some of his most loved stories are about a boy named Hamlet and a girl named Juliet. Even today, children and grown-ups all over the world enjoy his words.
Willow\n\nA willow is a kind of tree or bush. It has long, thin branches that hang down like green hair. You can often find it near water, like a pond or a river. The wood is soft and bends without breaking. People use the bendy branches to make baskets. In spring, it grows fuzzy little buds that look like soft caterpillars.
Win\n\nA win is when you do better than others in a game or a race. It means you are first or you get the most points. When you win, you might get a gold star, a ribbon, or a big smile from your friends. It feels good inside, like a happy jump in your tummy. You can win at tag, at a puzzle, or at a drawing contest. Even if you do not win, trying your best is still a win in your heart.
Wind\n\nWind is moving air that you can feel but not see. It can be soft like a whisper or strong like a big push. You find it outside on a windy day when leaves dance and flags wave. It helps kites fly high in the sky and makes windmills spin to make power. Sometimes it blows your hair or makes a howling sound around the house.
Wind instrument\n\nA wind instrument is a toy that makes music when you blow air into it. It is a long or round tube with holes or buttons. You can find it in a band or at a music class. When you blow into it, the air shakes inside and makes a pretty sound. A flute is one kind of wind instrument. You hold it to the side and blow across a little hole.
Wind power\n\nWind power is a way to make electricity using the wind. It uses big fans called wind turbines. The wind pushes the blades and makes them spin around. When the blades spin, a machine inside makes electricity. This electricity can light up houses and turn on TVs. Wind power is clean because it does not make dirty smoke. You can see wind turbines in open fields or on hills where the wind blows a lot.
Wind turbine\n\nA wind turbine is a tall machine that makes power from the wind. It has long arms called blades that spin around and around. You can see it in big open fields or on hills where the wind blows a lot. When the blades spin, it makes electricity that can light up homes and schools. It is like a giant fan that works backward—instead of using power to make wind, it uses wind to make power.
Windmill\n\nA windmill is a tall building with big spinning arms. It has long blades that turn around when the wind blows. You can see it in open fields where the wind is strong. Long ago, people used it to crush grain into flour for bread. Today, some windmills make power for lights and TVs. The spinning arms move a stone inside that grinds the grain. It looks like a giant fan standing in the grass.
Window\n\nA window is a hole in a wall that lets in light and air. It has a clear part made of glass so you can see through it. You find windows in houses, schools, and cars. People open a window to let fresh air come inside. Some windows are big, some are small, and some have pretty colors like in a church.
Windy\n\nWindy means the air outside is moving fast. You can feel it push against your face and see it shake the leaves on trees. On a windy day, you might fly a kite high in the sky. It can make a soft whoosh sound as it goes past your ears. Sometimes it blows hats off heads and makes flags flap.
Wine\n\nWine is a drink made from grapes. It is red, white, or pink in color. People drink it from a glass at dinner or a party. It is made by squishing grapes and waiting for them to change. Only grown-ups can have it because it has a special thing called alcohol. You might see a bottle of it at a family meal.
Wing\n\nA wing is a body part that helps an animal fly. It is flat and wide, and it moves up and down to push against the air. Birds have wings with soft feathers on them. Bats have wings made of thin skin stretched over long finger bones. Bugs like bees and butterflies also have wings, but they look different from bird wings. You can see wings on a bird outside your window or on a butterfly in a garden.
Winner\n\nA winner is a person or a team that comes first in a game or a race. They get a prize, like a shiny cup or a gold star. You can see a winner at a sports day, a school contest, or a fun race with friends. When someone wins, people clap and cheer for them. They feel very happy and proud. Sometimes a winner shares their prize with others.
Winter\n\nWinter is the coldest time of the year. It comes after fall and before spring. The days are short, and the nights are long. In many places, it gets very cold, and white snow falls from the sky. People wear warm coats, hats, and gloves to stay cozy. Some animals, like bears, sleep all winter in a deep rest. Trees lose their leaves and look bare. Winter has fun holidays like Christmas and New Year's Day. You might see your breath like a little cloud when you go outside.
Winter Olympic Games\n\nThe Winter Olympic Games are big sports games that happen every four years. They take place in a cold, snowy place. People from many countries come to play sports on ice and snow. They ski down big hills, skate fast on ice, and slide on sleds. You can watch it on TV and see the colorful flags from all over the world.
Wipe\n\nA wipe is a soft cloth or paper that you use to clean something. It is often wet with a little soap or water. You can find wipes in a kitchen, a bathroom, or a baby's room. People use it to clean hands, faces, or dirty tables. After you eat a messy snack, a wipe helps make your hands clean again.
Wire\n\nA wire is a long, thin piece of metal that can bend. It is like a string made of metal. You can find it inside the walls of your house, behind the TV, or in a phone charger. It carries power from the wall to make lights turn on and toys move. The outside of a wire has a colored cover to keep people safe. Copper wire is a common kind, and it looks shiny and orange.
Wisdom\n\nWisdom is knowing what is right and good. It is not just knowing many facts. It is using your heart and your mind together to make kind choices. You find it in people who have lived a long time and learned from their days. A wise person helps others when they are sad or lost. They think before they act. An owl in old stories stands for wisdom because it looks calm and watches carefully.
Wise\n\nWise means you know a lot and make good choices. A wise person thinks before they act. They learn from things they see and hear. A grandma or grandpa is often wise because they have lived a long time. A wise friend can help you when you are sad or stuck.
Wisent\n\nA wisent is a big, strong animal that looks like a cow. It has brown fur, two short horns that curve up, and a big head. It lives in forests and eats leaves, small plants, and tree bark. A long time ago, many wisents walked around Europe, but now they are very hard to find. People can see them in zoos or safe parks where they are kept so they do not go away forever.
Wish\n\nA wish is something you want very much in your heart. It is like a dream you hope will come true. You can make a wish when you blow out candles on a birthday cake. You can also wish on a star in the night sky. Sometimes a wish is for a new toy or a fun trip. Other times it is for someone you love to feel better. A wish is a happy thought that makes you smile.
Witchcraft\n\nWitchcraft is the use of magic powers. It can be used to help people feel better or to hurt them. A person who does witchcraft is called a witch. In stories, a witch may wear a pointy hat and fly on a broom. Some witches use plants and a big pot to make special drinks. Today, some people practice a kind of witchcraft that is peaceful and kind. They like to be close to nature and do good things.
With\n\nWith means being together or using something. It is a small word that joins two things. You can say "I play with my friend" to show you are not alone. You can say "I eat soup with a spoon" to show the tool you use. It helps tell who or what is next to you.
Without\n\nWithout means not having something. It is the opposite of with. You might eat a cookie without milk, or go outside without a coat. When you draw a picture without colors, it stays just lines.
Witness\n\nA witness is a person who sees something happen. He or she tells other people what he or she saw. In a big room called a court, a witness stands up and talks about what happened. A judge and many people listen to him or her. The witness must promise to tell the truth. If he or she tells a lie, that is very bad and can get him or her in trouble. Sometimes a witness is the person who got hurt. Sometimes a witness is just someone who was there. A police officer can also be a witness if he or she saw what happened.
Wolf\n\nA wolf is a wild animal that looks like a big dog. It has a long nose, pointy ears that stand up, long legs, and a big bushy tail. Its fur can be gray, white, brown, or black. It has two layers of fur to keep it warm and dry. Wolves live outside in forests, mountains, and cold, snowy places. They live together in a family group called a pack. The pack works together to find food. It eats meat from animals like deer and rabbits. It makes a loud, long sound called a howl to talk to other wolves far away. A baby wolf is called a pup.
Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart\n\nWolfgang Amadeus Mozart was a man who made music a long time ago. He played the piano and wrote many songs. He lived in a country far away and started making music when he was very little. People still play his songs today because they are so pretty. You might hear his music in a movie or on a music box.
Wolverine\n\nA wolverine is a strong, furry animal. It looks a little like a small bear with thick brown fur. It lives in very cold, snowy places far north, like Canada and Alaska. It walks on top of deep snow with its big, wide feet. It eats many things, such as mice, birds, and eggs. In winter, it can hunt animals much bigger than itself. It has a very good nose and can smell food hidden under the snow. People sometimes use its warm fur to make coats.
Woman\n\nA woman is a grown-up girl. She is the mom of a child or the sister of a dad. She has a soft voice and may have long hair. You can find her at home, at a store, or at a school. She can do many things like cook food, drive a car, or read a story. A woman can have a baby in her tummy and feed it milk. Your own mom is a woman you see every day.
Wonder\n\nWonder is a big, happy feeling you get when you see something amazing. It feels like a sparkle inside your chest. You might feel it when you look up at the stars at night or see a rainbow after the rain. It makes you stop and stare with wide eyes and a smile. It can happen when you learn something new and surprising, like how a tiny seed grows into a tall sunflower. Wonder makes the world feel full of magic.
Wonderful\n\nWonderful means something is very, very good. It is a word you say when you feel happy and surprised in a nice way. You might say a rainbow is wonderful because it has many bright colors. A birthday party with cake and friends can be wonderful too. When someone gives you a big hug, that feels wonderful.
Wonders of the World\n\nWonders of the World are very special places or things that people built long ago. They are big, beautiful, and hard to make. You can find them in different parts of the world. People visit them to look and say "wow!" One old wonder is a giant stone triangle called the Great Pyramid. It still stands in a hot, sandy land far away.
Wood\n\nWood is the hard stuff that makes up the inside of a tree. It is brown and has lines called rings that show how old the tree is. You can find it in forests, parks, and your own backyard. People cut wood into boards to build houses, tables, and chairs. It is also used to make paper and pencils. A log is a big round piece of wood. When you color with a pencil, you are holding a little bit of wood in your hand.
Wood carving\n\nWood carving is making shapes out of wood. A person uses a sharp tool like a small knife or a flat chisel to cut away bits of wood. It can be a little figure of an animal, a face on a mask, or a pretty pattern on a chair. You can find wood carvings in old churches, in parks, or in a grandpa's workshop. The wood feels smooth after it is rubbed with sandpaper. Some people paint it with bright colors, and some leave it the color of the tree. A totem pole is a very big wood carving that stands outside.
Wooden\n\nWooden means something is made of wood. Wood comes from the hard part of a tree. A wooden thing can be brown and feel smooth or bumpy. You can find wooden things in many places, like a wooden chair at the table or a wooden block in a toy box. People use wood to build houses, make furniture, and carve toys. A wooden spoon is a tool you might see in the kitchen.
Woodpecker\n\nA woodpecker is a bird that pecks on trees. It has a strong, sharp beak for making holes in wood. It lives in forests and woods all over the world. It uses its long, sticky tongue to pull bugs out of the holes. You might see one on a tree trunk, tapping fast with its beak.
Woodwind instrument\n\nA woodwind instrument is a thing you blow into to make music. It is a long tube with holes along the side. You find it in a big music group called an orchestra. When you blow into it, air moves inside and makes a pretty sound. The flute is one kind. It looks like a shiny stick and you blow across the top, like blowing on a bottle. Another kind is the clarinet. It is usually black and uses a small flat piece of wood to make the sound. Some are made of wood, and some are made of shiny metal.
Woodworking\n\nWoodworking is making things out of wood. It uses tools to cut, shape, and smooth the wood. You can find woodworking in a class at school or in a workshop. People make chairs, tables, toys, and little boxes with it. When you do woodworking, you must wear safety glasses to keep your eyes safe. You also should not wear long sleeves that can get caught. Sandpaper is a rough paper that makes wood feel soft and smooth. A saw is a tool with sharp teeth that cuts wood into smaller pieces.
Woof\n\nWoof is the sound a dog makes. It is a short, loud noise that comes from its mouth. You hear it when a dog is happy, wants to play, or sees someone new. Some dogs woof once, and some woof many times. A big dog has a deep, low woof, and a small dog has a high, quick woof. When you hear a woof, you know a dog is near.
Wool\n\nWool is the soft, warm hair from some animals. It comes mostly from sheep, but also from goats, rabbits, and camels. It looks fluffy and can be white, brown, or gray. People use it to make clothes like sweaters, socks, and scarves. It keeps you warm when it is cold outside. You might have a wool blanket on your bed or a wool hat for winter.
Word\n\nA word is a little piece of talking or writing that has meaning. It is made of one or more letters when you write it down. You use words every day when you speak to your friends and family. When you put words together, they make a sentence. Some words are very short, like "a" or "I". Some words are longer, like "happy" or "butterfly". You can find out what a word means by looking in a big book called a dictionary.
Word processor\n\nA word processor is a program on a computer. It helps you write words and make them look nice. You can change how the words look, like making them big or small or a different color. It can also check if you spelled a word wrong and help you fix it. You can add pictures to your writing and print it out on paper. Many people use it to write letters, stories, or school work.
Work\n\nWork is something you do to get a job done. It can be cleaning your room, helping in the garden, or building with blocks. Grown-ups go to work to earn money so they can buy food and toys. Some work is done at a desk with a computer, and some work is done outside with tools. When you finish your work, you can feel proud and happy.
Work (physics)\n\nWork is when a push or a pull makes something move. It happens only when the thing moves the same way as the push. If you push a toy car and it rolls forward, you do work on it. If you push a wall and it does not move, no work is done. The harder you push and the farther it moves, the more work you do. If you lift a book up, you do work. If you hold it still, you do no work.
Worker\n\nA worker is a person who does a job. He helps make things, fix things, or help other people. You can see a worker at a store, a school, or a hospital. He uses his hands or tools to do his work. A mail carrier is a worker who brings letters to your house.
Working class\n\nWorking class means people who work with their hands or bodies. They do jobs like fixing cars, building houses, or cleaning. They often get paid for each hour they work. You can see them in many places, like the person who drives a bus or the person who cuts hair.
World\n\nThe world is the big round place where we all live. It has land, water, and sky. You can see part of it when you look out the window. It is covered with green trees, blue oceans, and tall mountains. People, animals, and plants all share the world together. It spins around every day, which makes the sun come up and go down.
World economy\n\nThe world economy is all the buying and selling that people do around the world. It is like a big, busy market where countries trade things with each other. One country might send toys to another country, and that country might send fruit back. This trading helps people get things they need but cannot make at home. When the world economy is strong, many people have jobs and can buy food and clothes. When it is weak, some people may not have enough money. Even a small shop in your town is a tiny part of this big world market.
World Heritage Site\n\nA World Heritage Site is a very special place on Earth. It can be a forest, a mountain, a lake, a desert, an old building, or even a whole city. A big group called UNESCO picks these places because they are important for all people. They work to keep each place safe so that children everywhere can see them one day. Some sites are important because of nature, like a beautiful waterfall. Other sites are important because of old stories and buildings, like a big castle. There are many of these places in different countries, and Italy has the most.
World peace\n\nWorld peace is when all people everywhere are kind and safe. It means no fighting, no wars, and no hurting. In a world with peace, everyone shares and helps each other. You can see a little bit of it when friends play together without fighting. Grown-ups work hard to make the whole world peaceful, like when countries talk instead of fighting.
World War\n\nA world war is a very big fight between many countries. It happens in many places all over the world at the same time. Soldiers use big guns, tanks, and planes. Many people get hurt, and cities can break. After a world war, countries try to be friends again and make peace.
World Wide Web\n\nThe World Wide Web is a big, big space inside computers. It is full of pages with words, pictures, and videos. You can see it on a screen using a special tool called a browser. When you click on blue words or pictures, it takes you to a new page. This is how you can jump from one place to another, like a magic door. Many people use it every day to learn, play games, and talk to friends far away.
World's Fair\n\nA World's Fair is a big show where people from many places come together. It has lots of buildings and tents filled with new things to see. You can find it in a big city, and it stays open for many months. People go to learn about faraway lands, new machines, and fun art. A child might see a giant wheel that spins high in the air, or taste a sweet treat from another country.
Worm\n\nA worm is a small, soft animal with no legs. It has a long, thin body that looks like a tiny tube. You can find it in the dirt in your yard or garden. It moves by wiggling and sliding through the ground. It helps plants grow by making the dirt soft and full of air. After rain, you might see it on the sidewalk.
Worry\n\nWorry is a feeling you get when you think something bad might happen. It feels like a little knot in your tummy. You might worry before your first day of school or when you hear a loud noise at night. It can make your heart beat fast and your hands feel sweaty. When you worry, talking to a grown-up like Mom or Dad can help you feel better. A hug or a deep breath can also make the worry go away.
Worship\n\nWorship is a way people show love and thanks to God. It can be a quiet prayer or a happy song. People do it alone at home or together in a big room called a church. They may close their eyes, fold their hands, or sing with others. Sometimes they read from a special book and share a small meal of bread. It helps them feel close to God and to each other.
Worth\n\nWorth is how much something matters or how good it is. It is not the same as how much money it costs. A hug from a friend has worth because it makes you feel happy. A drawing you made has worth because you worked hard on it. Even a small, old toy can have worth if it reminds you of a happy day.
Would\n\nWould is a small word we use to talk about things that are not real yet. It helps us say what might happen if something else happens first. You might say, "I would eat a cookie if I had one." It is also a kind way to ask for something, like "Would you like some milk?" People use it every day when they think about wishes or make polite requests.
Wound\n\nA wound is a hurt on your skin. It can be a cut, a scrape, or a tear. Sometimes it bleeds a little. Your body works hard to fix it all by itself. Over time, new skin grows over the hurt spot. You can help by keeping it clean and putting on a bandage. A bruise is a wound under the skin that looks purple or blue.
Wow\n\nWow is a sound people make when they see something amazing. It is a short, happy word that comes out loud. You might say it when you see a big rainbow or a tall tower. It shows that you feel surprised in a good way. Friends and family say it together when they watch fireworks.
Wrap\n\nA wrap is a kind of food you can hold in your hand. It is made with a soft, flat bread that you fold around yummy things inside. You can find it in lunch boxes or at a store. People put meat, cheese, or crunchy veggies inside it. It is like a sandwich but rolled up tight so nothing falls out.
Wrasse\n\nA wrasse is a small, colorful fish that lives in the ocean. It has bright colors like blue, green, and red. It has thick lips and a long fin on its back. You can find it swimming near coral reefs in warm water. It eats tiny sea animals, like small crabs and worms. Some wrasse help other fish by cleaning them. They nibble away little bugs from the bigger fish's skin. This keeps the big fish healthy and gives the wrasse a meal.
Wren\n\nA wren is a tiny brown bird. It has round wings, a short tail, and a small beak that bends down a little. You can find it in gardens, woods, and parks. It sings a very loud, pretty song for such a small bird. If you see a little brown bird hopping fast in a bush, it might be a wren.
Wrestling\n\nWrestling is a game where two people try to push each other down. They use their arms and legs to grab and hold. They cannot hit or punch. The goal is to make the other person lie on their back on a soft mat. You might see wrestling on TV or at a school gym.
Write\n\nWriting is making marks that stand for words. It uses a pen, pencil, or chalk on paper or a board. You see writing in books, on signs, and on your cereal box. People write to tell stories, share news, or make a list for the store. When you draw letters like A, B, C, that is writing.
Writer\n\nA writer is a person who makes stories or books with words. He sits at a desk and writes letters and words on paper or on a computer. You can find his work in picture books, storybooks, or on signs. He uses words to tell you about a funny cat, a brave hero, or a faraway land. When you read a bedtime story, a writer made those words just for you.
Writing\n\nWriting is a way to put words down so others can read them. It uses marks like letters and shapes that people know. You find it in books, on signs, and on paper at home or school. It helps you tell a story, share a message, or remember things. When you draw letters with a pencil, you are writing. Long ago, people wrote on clay or stone, but today we mostly use paper or a screen.
Writing system\n\nA writing system is a set of marks that people use to share words. It has many little shapes called symbols. You see it in books, on signs, and on your tablet. Each symbol stands for a sound or a whole word. When you put the symbols together, you can read a story. English uses an alphabet with letters like A, B, and C. Some other writing systems use pictures for words, like in Chinese.
Wu Chinese\n\nWu Chinese is a way of talking that people use in one part of China. It is spoken near a big city called Shanghai. People who live in different towns may not always understand each other, even if they both use Wu Chinese. Today, more and more people are using a different way of talking called Mandarin instead.
Wu Zetian\n\nWu Zetian was a very important woman in China a long, long time ago. She was the only woman to ever be the top ruler of all of China. She was very smart and made new rules to help people. She lived in a big, beautiful palace. Many stories are told about her, but she is most famous for being a strong leader.
X-ray\n\nAn X-ray is a special kind of light that we cannot see with our eyes. It can go through soft things like skin and muscles, but not through hard things like bones. Doctors use it to take pictures of the inside of your body. When you break a bone, the doctor can see the break on an X-ray picture. The picture shows the bone as a white shape on a dark background.
Xinjiang\n\nXinjiang is a big piece of land in the country of China. It has tall mountains, hot dry deserts, and some green spots with water called oases. Many people who live there are called Uyghurs. Long ago, traders walked through Xinjiang on a path called the Silk Road. Today, people can visit big cities like rmqi, which is very far from the sea.
Xylophone\n\nA xylophone is a music toy with wooden bars. It has bars of different sizes that sit in a row. You find it in a music room or at school. You hit the bars with a small stick to make a sound. Each bar makes a different note, like a happy little song. The sound is short and bright, like a tap on a table.
Yahweh\n\nYahweh is a very old name for God. Long ago, people in a land called Israel said this name when they prayed. They thought he lived up in the sky and sent rain to help plants grow. He also kept them safe when other people tried to hurt them. Today, many people still use this name to talk about the one big God who made everything.
Yak (disambiguation)\n\nA yak is a big, hairy animal that looks like a cow. It has long, thick hair all over its body. It lives in cold, high places with lots of mountains. People use it to carry heavy bags and to get milk. A yak makes a deep, low sound. You might see one in a picture book about faraway lands.
Yam\n\nA yam is a vegetable that grows under the ground. It looks like a big, bumpy potato. The skin is rough and brown, and the inside can be white, yellow, orange, or even purple. People cook it in many ways—they can boil it, bake it, or fry it. It grows in warm places far away, like Africa and Asia. Some people call a sweet potato a yam, but they are not the same.
Yangtze\n\nThe Yangtze is a very long river. It flows across a big country called China. It is one of the longest rivers in the whole world. Many boats and ships move on it, carrying people and things. Lots of fish live in it, and people catch them for food. The water from it helps farmers grow rice and other plants.
Yangtze River\n\nThe Yangtze River is a very long river in China. It is the longest river in China and the third longest in the world. It starts high in the mountains and goes all the way to the big sea. Many boats and ships use it to carry things from one place to another. A huge wall called a dam was built on it to make power. The river is home to fish and other water animals, but some of them are in danger because the water is not clean. People throw trash and dirty water into it, which hurts the animals.
Yard\n\nA yard is a piece of ground next to a house. It is outside, with no roof over it. You can find it in front of a house or behind it. People use a yard to play, run, or sit in the sun. Some yards have green grass, flowers, or a big tree. A yard is a nice place to be on a warm day.
Yarn\n\nYarn is a long, soft string. It is made by twisting tiny hairs or threads together. You can find it in a craft store or at home in a basket. People use it to make warm things like hats, scarves, and blankets. They loop it with sticks called needles or a hook. It comes in many colors like red, blue, and yellow. A ball of yarn is round and fun to touch.
Yawn\n\nA yawn is when you open your mouth wide and take a big breath in. It happens when you are tired or bored. You cannot stop it once it starts. When one person yawns, other people nearby often yawn too. It is something all people and many animals do.
Yay\n\nYay is a happy sound people make with their mouth. It is short and loud, like a little shout. You say it when something good happens, like getting a new toy or winning a game. Kids often yell it at a birthday party when they see the cake. It is a way to show you are very glad without using words.
Year\n\nA year is a long stretch of time. It has 365 days, but every four years we add one more day. That extra day makes a leap year with 366 days. A year is how long it takes for Earth to go all the way around the sun. We use years to know when we grow older, when seasons change, and when holidays come. A year starts in January and ends in December.
Yeast\n\nYeast is a tiny living thing so small you cannot see it without a special tool. It looks like a little round ball. You can find it in the kitchen when you bake bread or make pizza dough. It eats sugar and makes a gas that puffs up the dough, so the bread gets soft and fluffy. Some people also use it to make drinks like beer. It is a helper in many yummy foods.
Yekaterinburg\n\nYekaterinburg is a big city in Russia. It sits near some tall hills called the Ural mountains. Many people live there. A long time ago, a man started the city and gave it a name after a queen. Today, people work and play in Yekaterinburg, just like in your town.
Yellow\n\nYellow is a bright, happy color. It looks like the sun up in the sky. You can see it in a rainbow, right between green and orange. Many things are yellow, like bananas, lemons, and school buses. Some flowers, like sunflowers, are yellow too. When you mix yellow paint with blue paint, you get green.
Yellow Emperor\n\nThe Yellow Emperor is a very old story hero from China. He is like a great, great, great grandpa to many Chinese people. Long, long ago, he was a wise leader who helped his people. Some old books say he taught them how to make tools and live in houses. Today, people still tell stories about him and think of him as a special person from the past.
Yellow River\n\nThe Yellow River is a very long river in China. It looks yellow because it carries a lot of soft, brown dirt. It flows through the land and ends at the sea. Many people call it the mother river because it helped the first Chinese people grow food and build homes. Long ago, people told stories about a river god who lived in it.
Yellow Sea\n\nThe Yellow Sea is a big body of water. It sits between China and Korea. Its water looks a little yellow because tiny bits of sand and mud flow into it from a big river. Many fish live in it, and people use boats to catch them. On a map, you can see it as a wide blue shape next to the land.
Yellowstone National Park\n\nYellowstone National Park is a big, beautiful park in the United States. It has hot water that shoots up from the ground, called geysers. One famous geyser is Old Faithful. It also has colorful hot pools and bubbling mud. Many big animals live there, like bears, wolves, and bison. People visit it to see the animals and the steaming ground. It was the first national park in the world.
Yemen\n\nYemen is a country far away. It has hot sand, tall mountains, and blue sea around it. Many people live in small villages and big towns. They speak a language called Arabic. In Yemen, people love to play soccer. They kick the ball on dusty fields and cheer for their team. Some people also climb rocks or swim in the sea. The capital city is Sana'a. It has old buildings made of mud and stone.
Yen\n\nYen is the money people use in Japan. It has round coins and paper notes. The coins are light and come in sizes from 1 to 500. The paper notes go up to a big number called 10000. When you go to a store in Japan, you pay with yen. It is one of the most used kinds of money in the world.
Yes\n\nYes is a word we say when we agree. It means we want to do something or we like an idea. When someone asks, "Do you want a cookie?" and you say yes, you get the cookie. It is the opposite of no. We use it every day with friends and family.
Yesterday\n\nYesterday is the day that came before today. It is the day you already lived through. When you wake up in the morning, the day that just ended is yesterday. You might remember what you did yesterday, like playing with a toy or eating a snack. It is gone now, but you can think about it. Tomorrow is the day that comes next.
Yet\n\nYet is a small word we use when something has not happened, but we think it will. It often comes at the end of a sentence. For example, you might say, "I did not eat my snack yet." That means you still plan to eat it later. It helps us talk about things that are not finished.
Yin and yang\n\nYin and yang is a special picture from China. It looks like a circle with two teardrop shapes, one black and one white. The black part has a small white dot inside, and the white part has a small black dot. It shows how things that are different can fit together. For example, day and night are different, but both are part of a full day. People use it to remember that too much of one thing is not good. You might see it on a poster or in a movie.
Yoga\n\nYoga is a way to move your body and breathe slowly. It comes from a very old idea about feeling calm and strong. A person doing yoga moves into different shapes with their body. Each shape is called a pose. It helps the body feel loose and happy. You can do it on a soft mat at home or in a big room with other people. Some poses look like a dog stretching or a tree standing tall. Breathing in and out is a big part of it. It makes the mind quiet and peaceful.
Yogurt\n\nYogurt is a thick, creamy food made from milk. It is white and smooth, and it tastes a little sour. You can find it in small cups at the store, often with fruit on the bottom. People eat it for breakfast or as a snack. It is good for your body because it has things that help your bones grow strong. Some kids like to eat it with a spoon right from the cup.
Yokohama\n\nYokohama is a big city in Japan. It is next to the water and has a very large port where big boats come and go. Many cars and machines leave from this port to go to other places. In the city, there is a fun area with rides and shops called Minato Mirai. It also has the biggest Chinatown in Japan, where you can see red gates and eat yummy food. Yokohama is very close to Tokyo, another big city.
Yoruba language\n\nYoruba language is a way people talk to each other. It is spoken in a warm part of the world called West Africa. Many people in places like Nigeria, Benin, and Togo use it every day. It sounds like music, with words that go up and down in tone. Some people who moved far away still speak it at home. It has its own letters and stories that parents teach their children.
Yoruba people\n\nYoruba people are a big group of people who live in Africa. They live on the west side of Africa, mostly in a country called Nigeria. They have their own way of talking, their own songs, and their own stories. Many of them wear bright, colorful clothes with pretty patterns. They cook tasty food like pounded yam and spicy soup. Some Yoruba people live in big cities, and some live in small villages.
Yoruba religion\n\nYoruba religion is a way of believing that comes from Africa. It started with the Yoruba people in a country called Nigeria. In this belief, things like trees, rivers, and big stones have a special spirit inside them. People who follow it may pray to these spirits. Some people in Cuba and other warm islands also follow it. They mix it with other beliefs and give it a new name there.
Yosemite National Park\n\nYosemite National Park is a big, beautiful place in California. It has tall, gray rock walls and many waterfalls that fall from high up. The most famous waterfall is called Yosemite Falls. Many people visit it each year to walk, look at the trees, and see animals like deer and bears. Most of the park is wild land with no houses or roads.
You\n\nYou is a word we use when we talk to one person. It can be a boy, a girl, a grown-up, or even a pet. When you say "you," you point to the person you are talking to. You can use it to ask a question, like "Do you want a cookie?" or to say something nice, like "You are my friend." It is a small word, but it helps us talk to each other every day.
Young\n\nYoung means not old. A baby is very young. A puppy or a kitten is young too. When you are young, you are small and still growing. You learn new things every day, like how to tie your shoes or count to ten. Young leaves on a tree are tiny and light green. They get bigger and darker as they grow. Being young is a happy time full of play and fun.
Your\n\nYour is a word we use when something belongs to you. It shows that a thing is yours. For example, if you have a toy, you can say, "This is your toy." We use it when we talk to one person. It is a small word, but it helps people know who owns what.
Yours\n\nYours means something belongs to you. When you have a toy and it is yours, nobody else can take it without asking. You might see the word on a birthday card that says "This gift is yours." It is a way to show that a thing is for you and only you.
Yourself\n\nYourself means you. It is the one person you see when you look in a mirror. You know what you like, what you feel, and what you think. You can do things all by yourself, like putting on your shoes or drawing a picture. When you say "I did it myself," that means you did it with no help.
Yucca\n\nYucca is a plant with long, pointy leaves. It has a thick stem and white flowers that look like bells. It grows in hot, dry places with lots of sun. People plant it in gardens because it looks pretty. A small moth helps it make seeds by carrying yellow dust from flower to flower.
Yucky\n\nYucky is a word for something that feels or tastes bad. It can be a food that makes your face scrunch up, like a sour lemon or a mushy vegetable. You might say a sticky, gooey mud puddle is yucky when you step in it. It is a feeling you get when something is not nice to touch, smell, or eat. Sometimes a smell from the trash can is yucky too.
Yugoslavia\n\nYugoslavia was a big country in Europe. It was made of many smaller lands with different people who spoke different words and had different ways. It does not live on the map anymore because it broke into smaller places. Some of those places are Serbia, Croatia, and Bosnia. People there used to share one country, but now they have their own.
Yukon River\n\nThe Yukon River is a long, moving path of water. It starts in a place called British Columbia and goes through the Yukon and Alaska. It ends when it flows into the big, cold Bering Sea. Long ago, people used it like a road to travel and look for gold. It is the longest river in those cold, northern lands.
Yummy\n\nYummy is a word we say when food tastes very good. It is a happy feeling on your tongue. You might say it when you eat a sweet cookie, a juicy apple, or a warm piece of bread. When something is yummy, you want to eat more of it. It makes you smile and feel full and happy inside.
Zagros Mountains\n\nThe Zagros Mountains are a long line of tall hills and rocks. They stretch across parts of Iran and Iraq. Some of the peaks are very high, with snow on top. People find oil deep under the ground there. Many animals and plants live on these slopes.
Zambezi River\n\nThe Zambezi River is a very long river in Africa. It starts in a country called Zambia and moves through many other countries. At the end, it flows into the big Indian Ocean. It has a huge waterfall named Victoria Falls, where water drops down with a loud roar. People built a big wall called a dam on the river to make power for lights and machines. During the rainy time, the river gets much bigger and faster.
Zambia\n\nZambia is a country in Africa. It is a big piece of land with many people. It has green trees, wide rivers, and a huge waterfall called Victoria Falls. People in Zambia speak many different languages, but English is used in schools. The biggest city is Lusaka. Long ago, people dug up a shiny orange metal called copper from the ground. Today, many people grow food like corn to sell. Zambia has a flag with green, red, black, and orange stripes, and an eagle on top.
Zebra\n\nA zebra is an animal that looks like a horse with black and white stripes. It has short fur and a dark line down its back. The stripes go up and down on its body and side to side on its legs. Every zebra has its own special stripe pattern, just like a fingerprint. Zebras live in hot places in Africa. They stay together in big groups and eat grass. They like to be near water. A baby zebra is called a foal.
Zen\n\nZen is a way of thinking and sitting still. It comes from a very old teaching that started in China and later went to Japan. People who do Zen sit quietly and close their eyes. They try to let their thoughts float away like clouds. Sometimes they think about a funny puzzle that has no easy answer. A Zen garden has sand and rocks, and people rake the sand into wavy lines. It helps the mind feel calm and quiet.
Zero\n\nZero is a number that means none. It looks like a round circle, like the letter O. You see it on clocks, in books, and on signs. It tells you there is nothing of something. For example, if you have zero cookies, your plate is empty.
Zeus\n\nZeus is a pretend king from very old stories. He lives high up on a big mountain in the sky. He holds a bright, loud bolt of light that he can throw down. People long ago told tales about him to explain thunder and rain. They also had big races and games to make him happy.
Zimbabwe\n\nZimbabwe is a country in the south part of Africa. It has no sea next to it, so it is called a landlocked country. It is home to a big, beautiful waterfall named Victoria Falls. Many animals live there, like lions, elephants, and lots of birds. People in Zimbabwe speak many languages, and they love to play soccer.
Zinc\n\nZinc is a kind of metal. It is shiny and has a bluish-gray color. You can find it inside some batteries that make toys work. People also use it to cover other metals so they do not rust. A penny has a thin copper outside, but the inside is made of zinc.
Zip\n\nA zip is a fast way to close a jacket or a bag. It has two rows of tiny teeth that lock together when you pull a little slider up. You find it on coats, pants, backpacks, and pencil cases. It keeps things inside safe and warm. When you get dressed in the morning, you might zip up your jacket all by yourself.
Zipper\n\nA zipper is a tool that holds two sides of cloth together. It has two long strips with small metal or plastic teeth. A little piece called a slider moves up and down to lock the teeth or pull them apart. You find it on pants, jackets, bags, and shoes. When you pull the slider up, it closes the opening. When you pull it down, it opens. It makes a soft buzzing sound when you move it.
Zodiac\n\nZodiac is a set of twelve signs in the sky. It looks like a circle of stars shaped like animals or people. You can find it in the night sky, but you need a map to see the shapes. People use it to guess what a person is like based on when they were born. For example, if you are born in a certain month, your sign might be a lion or a fish. In another part of the world, the signs are animals like a dragon or a rabbit, and each year gets a new animal.
Zombie\n\nA zombie is a made-up creature that looks like a dead person but walks around. It moves slowly and has gray or green skin. Its clothes are torn and dirty. You see zombies in scary movies and TV shows. In stories, a zombie tries to catch people and bite them. It does not think or talk. Many people dress up as zombies for Halloween.
Zoo\n\nA zoo is a big park where many animals live. It has tall fences and safe houses for the animals. You can walk around and see lions, monkeys, elephants, and birds. People who work there feed the animals and keep them healthy. Some zoos help baby animals when there are very few left in the wild. A zoo is a fun place to visit with your family.
Zoology\n\nZoology is the science of learning about animals. It is a part of biology, the study of all living things. A person who studies animals is called a zoologist. They watch animals to see how they live, grow, and move. They also look at animal bodies to learn what is inside. Some zoologists work at a zoo, where they take care of the animals there. Others work in a museum or a school. They help us understand animals that are alive today and animals that lived long, long ago.
Zoroaster\n\nZoroaster was a wise teacher who lived a very long time ago. He lived in a land called Persia, which is far away. He started a way of thinking about good and bad, and many people followed his ideas. Today, some people still remember his words and try to be good like he said.
Zucchini\n\nZucchini is a long green vegetable. It looks like a cucumber but is a little thicker. People cook it in a pan or bake it in bread. Some people cut it into long thin strips and call them zoodles. You can find it in a garden or at the grocery store.
Zulu people\n\nThe Zulu people are a big group of people who live in South Africa. They have dark skin and dark hair. Many of them live in a place called KwaZulu-Natal. They speak a language with clicks in it. Long ago, they had a strong king who led them. Today, they are the biggest group in their country and have the same rights as everyone else.
